Job Summary:

The Campus loading dock supports all Campus tenants, hotel properties, production and entertainment facilities with daily deliveries of food and beverage, materials and supplies, and stage equipment.  In addition, it manages the waste stream and trash removal.  

The position of Dock Expeditor is to support the management/operation of loading dock activities. This is a position that requires problem-solving skills, diligent attention to detail and being proactive in resolving issues as they arise.  The loading dock is a 24-hour, 7 day a week operation and involves working directly with delivery drivers, restaurant back of house staff, technical and show support crews, and venue management to ensure all deliveries arrive and are unloaded or loaded on schedule and efficiently. The position involves physical fitness, lifting, operating a forklift, and communicating via email and telephonically. It is responsible for ensuring that all safety procedures are followed by delivery drivers and personnel using the loading dock.

Essential Functions:

  • Control truck traffic, dock access and movement of supplies, deliveries, and equipment into and out of the Campus loading dock areas. Maintain efficiency of the Campus dock operation through coordination with Campus security, engineering, third party vendors, tenant and hotel management personnel.
  • Monitor, report and assist with maintaining safety and functionality of all service areas, to include A & B building service corridors, service elevators and foyers, in accordance with directives issued by Dock Master. Must be proactive in inspecting work areas for damage or inefficiencies and reporting to appropriate Manager.
  • Ensure tenants and vendors operate in accordance with all policies pertaining to the loading dock, as issued by Campus management.
  • Assist the Dock Master with assigned duties.
  • Communicate and problem solve access issues in a professional manner and maintain productive and supportive relationships with Campus tenants, third party vendors, security, engineering and hotel teams.
  • Provide operational support to all departments of Campus Operations. Assist with emergency situations as needed.
  • Ensure that all safety policies and procedures are followed and report any issues to Campus management.
  • Maintain cleanliness in the back of house areas, removing waste materials, pallets, food compost, etc.

  • High School Diploma or its equivalency.
  • Proficient in Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Teams, etc.)
  • Must have two (2) years related work experience.
  • Previous experience in event production and logistics
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English (in person, on-line and by phone)
  • Excellent organizational skills with ability to multi-task
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods of time of up to 6 hours with or without accommodations.
  • Must be able to lift/carry/pull/push up to 35lbs.
  • Must be able to work evenings, weekends and/or holidays.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience operating various units of heavy equipment (Boom lift, Scissor lift, Variable Reach lift) preferred.
  • Bilingual in Spanish

The Sr Director Human Resources provides strategic and operational leadership for the human resources function supporting the AEG Sports properties, including the LA Kings and Ontario Reign. The role serves as a senior advisor to business leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, leadership coaching, employee relations, talent strategy, and change initiatives. The Sr Director leads the HR team and provides direction across process improvement, staff development, talent acquisition, learning and development, compliance, and employee relations. This role works across each organization and department to promote consistent, practical, and business-aligned application of human resources programs, policies, and practices while addressing the distinct needs of each property. 

Essential Functions

  • Translate business priorities into an integrated Human Resources strategy for each supported property. Advise senior leaders on workforce, organization, and people implications of business decisions. Participate in key leadership and department discussions, bringing a broad HR perspective and recommending practical solutions that support near-term operating needs and longer-term objectives.
  • Maintain current knowledge of industry trends and employment legislation and oversee the organization's compliance. Assess the impact of regulatory and policy changes, communicate requirements to leaders, and recommend updates to policies, procedures, controls, and practices to reduce risk and support consistent application.
  • Lead the Human Resources department, establish priorities, clarify accountability, coach and develop team members, and monitor goals and service delivery to ensure work is completed accurately, consistently, and in a timely manner.
  • Connect broader business strategy to HR priorities and ensure programs remain relevant to the needs of the supported organizations. Identify patterns and opportunities across properties and recommend approaches, policies, and processes that improve organizational effectiveness, productivity, and HR service delivery.
  • Provide proactive counsel on complex and sensitive people matters, serving as a trusted advisor, coach, and thought partner to senior leaders. Frame issues, assess risk and organizational impact, develop well-supported recommendations, and guide leaders toward timely and sustainable resolutions. Oversee significant employee relations matters and partner with Legal as appropriate.
  • Provide strategic direction for employee experience, recognition, training, and development initiatives. Partner with leadership and the administration team to assess organizational and employee needs, identify capability gaps, prioritize learning solutions, and evaluate whether programs support business and talent objectives.
  • Provide oversight for core HR operations supporting new hires, employee changes, payroll coordination, and benefits administration. Establish appropriate review and escalation practices, ensure regulatory and policy compliance, partner with Legal as needed, and provide leaders and employees with clear interpretation of HR policies.

  • Serve as the senior HR liaison between AEG corporate partners and the supported properties. Shape local implementation of enterprise programs and initiatives, communicate business requirements and feedback, and promote alignment while accounting for legitimate operating differences.

  • Oversee talent acquisition strategy and execution across supported departments. Ensure recruitment, selection, and hiring decisions follow approved practices, address critical and hard-to-fill needs, strengthen candidate quality and experience, and support retention of key talent.
  • Develop and manage the Human Resources budget and workforce plan. Allocate resources against business priorities, monitor spending and capacity, and recommend adjustments that support effective and sustainable HR delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) in Business Management, Business Administration, or Human Resources Management. Advanced degree preferred. 
  • 7+ years of Human Resources leadership experience, including direct people leadership, experience advising senior executives, and responsibility for leading a broad HR function or major client group.
  • Broad experience across Human Resources disciplines, including compensation, talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, and talent management, with the ability to integrate these areas into practical business solutions.
  • Experience leading and developing HR teams that support multiple locations, properties, or business units.
  • Experience with Human Resource Information Systems (i.e. UltiPro; Workday; Oracle; PeopleSoft); and Applicant Tracking Systems (i.e. Greenhouse; Taleo)
  • Experience with compensation planning, job leveling, workforce planning, and organizational design and development.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and improving HR initiatives that support measurable business and organizational outcomes.
  • Experience working within entertainment or sports industry is preferred.
  • SPHR or SHRM-SCP is highly preferred.
Skills and Abilities
  • Demonstrated ability to anticipate, assess, and resolve complex and sensitive Human Resources matters using sound judgment, discretion, and an appropriate balance of business and employee considerations.
  • Executive-level verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex or sensitive matters clearly and follow through on commitments.
  • Strong knowledge of California, Federal and local employment laws including, but not limited to, ADA, FLSA, EEOC, Title VII, Pay Transparency, etc.
  • Ability to professionally handle sensitive and confidential information
  • Ability to establish credibility and influence decisions with senior leaders while communicating effectively across all levels of the organization.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to synthesize data, identify implications, and present clear recommendations.

job.title: Lead DevSecOps Engineer
job.description:
Company Information
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Job Summary

AEG is seeking a Lead DevSecOps Engineer to join its global Information Security organization. Reporting to the Vice President of Information Security, this role provides technical leadership for AEG's DevSecOps and Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) programs, driving the integration of security throughout the software development lifecycle. The Lead DevSecOps Engineer partners closely with Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, and GRC teams to establish secure development standards, strengthen application and cloud security, secure CI/CD pipelines, and advance security automation and continuous compliance capabilities. Serving as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, this role influences technology strategy, leads cross-functional security initiatives, and helps improve AEG's overall cybersecurity posture across its global technology environment. This position collaborates with teams across North America and Europe and may require flexibility to support initiatives across multiple time zones.

Essential Functions

  • Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) Enablement:
    • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the organization's Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) program, partnering with Information Security and Engineering leadership to establish enterprise-wide secure development standards and practices.
    • Drive the integration of security-by-design principles and automated security controls across the software development lifecycle, ensuring consistent adoption across development, platform, and DevOps teams in collaboration with other engineers; lead security discussions with Engineering, DevOps, and Infrastructure teams to drive adoption of secure development practices.
  • CI/CD Pipeline Security:
    • Lead the architecture, strategy, and continuous maturation of enterprise CI/CD security capabilities, establishing secure-by-design standards for software delivery pipelines, deployment platforms, and development ecosystems.
    • Define and govern secure build processes, deployment workflows, container images, and third-party dependencies; drive and expand automation for security testing, validation, and policy enforcement; establish, integrate, and maintain security controls into build and deployment pipelines to support continuous compliance.
  • Security Tooling and Monitoring:
    • Lead the architecture, implementation, and governance of enterprise application security tooling establishing standards for SAST, DAST, and other application security tools.
    • Oversee the improvement of security visibility and monitoring across development environments; drive the configuration and maintenance alerts, notifications, and security monitoring capabilities.
  • Risk, Compliance, and Governance Support:
    • Lead enterprise application risk assessments and threat modeling exercises; establish and maintain the organization’s SDLC security requirements, procedures, and supporting documentation.
    • Document and monitor that compliance efforts align with ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and related frameworks.
  • Application Security and Vulnerability Management:
    • Perform secure code reviews and work with development teams to remediate vulnerabilities; manage vulnerability reporting, remediation tracking, and disclosure processes.
    • Lead remediation efforts across engineering and development teams.
  • Security Consulting and Cross-Functional Partnership:
    • Serve as the lead security advisor and strategic partner with Engineering, DevOps, Platform, Infrastructure, and GRC teams to advance security initiatives.
    • Lead cross-functional security initiatives and provide practical security guidance throughout the design, development, and deployment lifecycle.
    • Define and maintain secure development standards and best practices; serve as a trusted security advisor for application and development-related initiatives.
  • Audit and Incident Response Support:
    • Lead the development and execution of security audits and evidence collection related to SDLC and application security controls.
    • Work with stakeholders on investigations and incident response activities involving applications and development environments.
    • Participate in control testing, validation, and compliance assessments.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) (Advanced Degree Preferred) Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. Master's degree or advanced certifications preferred.
  • 5+ years Experience in DevSecOps, Application Security, Security Engineering, or related cybersecurity roles.
  • Proven experience integrating security throughout the software development lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with application security testing tools, including SAST, DAST, SCA, and container security solutions.
  • Experience performing threat modeling, application risk assessments, vulnerability management, and remediation tracking.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, alerting, and security controls across cloud, application, and infrastructure environments.
  • Strong understanding of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices and secure coding principles.
  • Familiarity with modern application development frameworks and technologies, including Laravel and other enterprise web application frameworks.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to build partnerships and align security objectives with business needs.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams and accommodate occasional meetings across multiple time zones.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with programming languages including JavaScript, Python, Ruby, PHP, or C#.
  • Experience with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, Azure DevOps, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of application security testing methodologies including SAST, DAST, SCA, and container security scanning.
  • Experience with OWASP Top 10, NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF), and related security frameworks.
  • Experience configuring application and infrastructure monitoring solutions, alerts, and notifications.
  • Familiarity with container technologies and cloud-native application deployment models.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively within a highly collaborative global environment.
  • Self-motivated with strong ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester (GWAPT), GIAC Cloud Security Automation (GCSA), AWS Security Specialty, Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), or equivalent certifications.

Pay Scale: $140,000.00 - $160,000.00

AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

The Role

You will lead full-stack work across user interfaces, back-end services, APIs, and integrations. The role combines hands-on development with technical leadership, architecture, and team guidance in a complex enterprise environment. You’ll own initiatives end-to-end on front-end and back-end, drive technical direction, and partner with Product, Design, and engineering to ship secure, scalable software for high-demand, global use cases.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design, build, and maintain front-end and back-end features for web applications.
  • Lead full-stack architecture and design reviews; author or review technical design as needed.

  • Support agile delivery: planning, estimation, backlog breakdown, risk and blocker management.

job.title: Manager DevOps
job.description:
Company Information

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world’s leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.

If you’re ready to help create moments that matter, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here.

Job Summary

The DevOps Manager is responsible for leading and coaching DevOps / Platform Engineers in the maintenance, uptime, monitoring, and automation of our applications and systems. You will design and deliver software to improve availability, performance, and efficiency, your goal will be eliminating manual tasks, evaluating designs, and providing feedback to internal and external teams on how to build the most robust software platforms possible. You will be responsible supporting enterprise application and help to designing cloud native applications.

Essential Functions

  • Deploy microservices using infrastructure as code (IaC) in a CI/CD Code Pipeline environment by scripting, testing, and creating backups to enable independent development, deployment, and scalability of the platform which will also include technical configuration of the system to ensure there are no issues with deployment.
  • Train, mentor and assist other team members in DevOps & Platform Engineering Best Practices. Work with team to define measurable and meaningful KPIs for DevOps Engineers to strive to and follow.
  • Manage automated build processes using software development platforms (Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jenkins, and AWS CodeBuild) to enable quick, efficient, correct, and flexible deployments.
  • Automate, deploy, and test by leveraging webhooks and status checks from software development platforms (Azure, GCP, AWS CodeDeploy, AWS CodePipeline, GitHub, Jira, and Postman).
  • Configure and create automated real-time application monitoring solutions that include database log reviews, key performance indicators of system performance, and other alerts to maintain availability and security of database systems.
  • Champion ChatOps workflows using real-time communication tools (like Slack) and perform system administration tasks including changes to user permissions, system configurations, and tuning applications and processes in support and partnership with the development team.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) in a related field
  • 6-8 years related work experience
  • Experience in cloud-based DevOps and managing a mid-size globally distributed team.
  • Experience with writing infrastructure as code (IaC) (Terraform, Azure ARM, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • Experience in at least one programming language (JavaScript, Ruby, Python, PHP, C#)
  • Experience with a unified, real-time monitoring and analytics platform, such as Azure Log Analytics, Google StackDriver / Operations Suite, New Relic, Splunk or Datadog
  • Experience using a CI/CD tool like CircleCI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or AWS CodePipeline
  • Experience defining and configuring Azure cloud services such as Traffic Managers, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Container Registry (ACR), Azure Front Door, Azure Application Insights, Azure Key Vault, Load balancers, VNets, Azure Event Hub preferred
  • Experience automating the deployment for a microservices platform preferred
  • Experience working on a project that uses a JavaScript Framework (Ember.js, Vue.js, React, Angular) preferred.
  • Experience configuring infrastructure and application alerts, alarms, and notifications preferred.
  • Experience solving application monitoring challenges through the use of continuous synthetic transactions preferred.
  • Results driven with reliable follow through preferred.
  • Eagerness to work in a highly collaborative team environment
  • Understanding of DevOps fundamentals such as security, scalability, and reliability

Job Summary

The Marketing Manager- Festivals is responsible for all marketing assets for festivals on calendar.  This position will work in conjunction with artist management, Radio/TV, and marketing team to create and develop an effective marketing plan that will reach the correct demographic and target customers appropriate for each show.  The Marketing Manager will develop graphic content used to inform the general public of shows for the purpose of gaining ticket sales.  This position will also be responsible for maintaining and tracking budgets to make sure funds are allocated correctly.  The Marketing Manager will oversee social media accounts and ensure they are up to date with engaging material.

job.title: Manager Network Infrastructure
job.description:
Company Information
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Job Summary

The Manager, Network Infrastructure is responsible for deploying, supporting, securing and managing the lifecycle of AEG Global Technology's network infrastructure across US venues and enterprise environments. This role ensures network services, firewalls, routing, switching, wireless platforms and related operational processes meet Global Technology standards, security requirements, governance controls and business priorities. The role also provides on-site event support across multiple venues and requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends and participate in an on-call rota.

Essential Functions

  • Line manage US-based network engineers (and contractors as required) and provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, prioritization and performance support in alignment with Global Technology objectives and ensuring service delivery meets established SLAs.
  • Provide escalation support for critical network incidents, including out-of-hours response for venue, event and enterprise-impacting issues.
  • Ensure existing network infrastructure is effectively managed, supported, patched, monitored and secured, including response to vulnerabilities, threats, audit findings and operational risks.
  • Work with venue technology teams, business stakeholders, information security, operations teams and the Vice President, Network Infrastructure and Venue Technology to plan, budget and prioritize network infrastructure projects and service improvements.
  • Project manage network infrastructure initiatives through the full lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, resource scheduling, implementation planning, change management, handover and documentation.
  • Design and implement scalable, secure and supportable network infrastructure solutions that align with Global Technology architecture, security and operational standards.
  • Maintain accurate design documentation, configuration records, operational runbooks, support models and standard operating procedures for all supported network services.
  • Provide technical input and design review for venue technology, business systems, infrastructure, security, cloud and development initiatives where network architecture or connectivity is a dependency.
  • Maintain current knowledge of network, wireless, firewall, automation, monitoring and security technologies and recommend improvements that improve resilience, performance, security and operational efficiency.
  • Ensure network engineering practices, training, knowledge sharing and development plans support consistent delivery of Global Technology standards across venues and enterprise environments.
  • Understand long-term business, venue and event technology objectives and recommend practical network strategies that support secure, resilient and scalable operations.
  • Provide and promote a high standard of service ownership, stakeholder communication and continuous improvement across network operations and project delivery.
  • Undertake other relevant duties or reasonable requests as required by the Vice President, Network Infrastructure and Venue Technology or senior Global Technology leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) in Information Technology or related area.
  • 4-6 years experience in a similar network infrastructure leadership role, including the design, implementation, support and lifecycle management of large-scale, multi-site and multi-tenant enterprise networks. Experience working with venue, event, corporate or highly available operational environments is preferred.
  • Ability to manage, coach and develop network engineering staff, prioritize work across operational and project demands, and support performance, development and service ownership.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with venue technology teams, business stakeholders, vendors, information security, infrastructure, service desk and senior Global Technology leadership.
  • Understand how technology enables and supports business objectives.
  • Have significant experience configuring, managing and supporting Cisco and Meraki routing, switching, wireless, security appliance and cloud-managed network platforms.
  • Have significant experience configuring and managing Palo Alto firewalls, Panorama and related security policy, segmentation, logging and operational governance processes.
  • Have strong experience in network security, including segmentation, zero trust principles, access control, layer 2 security, layer 7 inspection, vulnerability response and secure change governance.
  • Experience working across test, pre-production and production environments.
  • Demonstrate strong expertise across core network technologies, including the OSI model; fibre, CWDM and DWDM transmission services; Ethernet and layer 2 switching, including VLANs, STP, MTU and layer 2 security; IPv4 and IPv6; VRF; GRE; routing protocols such as HSRP, VRRP, OSPF, EIGRP and BGP; route-based IPsec VPNs; multicast; QoS; MPLS and EoMPLS; network security and 802.1x; DNS; DHCP; and RADIUS.
  • Troubleshoot complex network, voice and internet connectivity issues, including packet capture and analysis.
  • Provide root cause analysis for major incidents and document findings for Global Technology and key stakeholders.
  • Produce accurate, detailed reports while maintaining strong attention to detail and following agreed standards.
  • Understand and consistently apply Global Technology standards for architecture, security, monitoring, documentation, vendor management, operational support and change control.
  • Maintain high documentation standards, including architecture diagrams, configuration records, operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, change records, service incidents and post-incident reviews.
  • Apply industry best practices to design and implement secure, practical technology systems and infrastructure.
  • Use initiative, work with minimal supervision, manage time effectively and deliver within agreed timescales.
  • Must be able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to support venues and live events.
  • Willing and able to travel domestically.
  • Demonstrate a positive, solutions-focused attitude.
  • Collaborate effectively in a high-performing team environment.
  • Maintain a strong commitment to high-quality delivery.
  • Certification for core technologies is highly preferred.

Pay Scale: $155,000.00 - $169,000.00

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements..

Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

job.title: Manager, Payments and Fraud Analytics - AXS
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

 

 

The Role

AXS is seeking a Manager, Payments and Fraud to lead macro-level analytics for AXS payment performance and fraud risk. The role uses advanced SQL, data visualization, and payments expertise to identify opportunities to increase authorization and conversion, reduce processing costs, prevent material fraud and chargeback losses, and improve payment reliability across markets, channels, and providers. Unlike transaction-review roles that make accept-or-decline decisions on individual orders, this position analyzes portfolio trends and converts findings into business, product, routing, and risk recommendations. The manager partners with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, Stripe, and internal Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Fraud Prevention teams. The role initially leads through expertise and cross-functional influence and is expected to assume direct people-management responsibility as the analytics team grows.

 

What Will You Do?

  • Lead deep-dive analysis of payment authorization, decline, conversion, routing, settlement, and processing-cost data; identify material trends and quantify opportunities by market, issuer, network, gateway, payment method, and customer segment.
  • Analyze fraud, chargeback, dispute, and loss data at the portfolio level; identify emerging patterns and control gaps, size financial exposure, and recommend changes to fraud strategies, rules, tools, and operating processes.
  • Build and maintain trusted KPI definitions, SQL analyses, dashboards, and executive reporting for payment performance, fraud, chargebacks, costs, and customer impact; establish data-quality controls and clear measurement methods.
  • Develop business cases and lead cross-functional optimization initiatives, experiments, and post-implementation measurement for payment routing, authorization uplift, fraud controls, payment methods, tokenization, 3DS, and cross-border performance.
  • Monitor high-volume on-sales and material payment or fraud events; perform root-cause analysis, coordinate stakeholders, and translate incidents into corrective actions and longer-term improvements.
  • Partner with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, Stripe, and other providers to review performance, investigate issues, evaluate capabilities, and hold partners accountable for agreed service and optimization actions.
  • Advise Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Fraud Prevention, and senior leaders on priorities, tradeoffs, and policy or process changes; communicate complex findings and gain support for recommendations with financial and customer impact.
  • Establish the operating model, priorities, documentation, and performance standards for the analytics function; coordinate work across analysts and develop, coach, and manage direct reports as positions are added.

 

What Will You Bring?

  • BA/BS Degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 4-6 years of hands-on advanced SQL analysis using large transaction-level datasets and development of dashboards or data visualizations for business decisions.
  • 4-6 years of progressive experience in payments analytics, fraud analytics, payment operations, risk, or a closely related field.
  • 4-6 years of experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives, coordinating the work of analysts, or managing and developing team members.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including the ability to join, validate, segment, and interpret large payment and fraud datasets.
  • Advanced data visualization and dashboard development skills using Tableau, Looker, or comparable tools; experience working with Snowflake or a similar cloud data platform.
  • Strong knowledge of card payments, authorization and decline behavior, routing, processing economics, interchange and network fees, settlement, chargebacks, disputes, and fraud controls.
  • Working knowledge of payment networks and processors or gateways, including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, and Stripe.
  • Knowledge of tokenization, 3DS, alternative payment methods, cross-border payments, and the customer checkout experience.
  • Ability to frame ambiguous business questions, perform root-cause analysis, quantify financial and customer impact, and recommend practical actions.
  • Ability to communicate complex analysis to technical and nontechnical audiences and influence decisions across Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, vendors, and senior leadership.
  • Leadership skills to set priorities, establish standards, coordinate work, coach analysts, and build a high-performing analytics function as the team grows.

 

Pay Scale: $95,000 - $109,000

 

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. Currently, full time employees are eligible for these benefits on the first day of employment.

 

 

*Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.

  • Extraordinary People – we’re not kidding!

  • Community & Belonging – A range of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection, inclusion, and professional growth. Access to meaningful volunteer opportunities and community engagement programs to make a positive impact beyond the workplace

  • Outstanding listening, written, and verbal communication skills

A minimum of 2-4 years of related experience

job.description:
Company Information
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

 

Job Summary

The Privacy Analyst supports AEG’s privacy program by analyzing business activities, systems, products, and proposed uses or disclosures of personal information under applicable privacy laws and regulations. The role gathers and evaluates relevant facts, identifies privacy requirements and risks, and translates that analysis into clear, practical actions for business stakeholders. Responsibilities include conducting privacy impact assessments, supporting data mapping and records of processing, preparing data-sharing arrangements, drafting guidelines and recommendations, supporting consumer-rights compliance, and maintaining accurate privacy-program documentation. The Privacy Analyst partners with Legal, Information Security, Marketing, Global Partnerships, Human Resources, IT, and other business teams and escalates novel or material legal questions as appropriate.

Essential Functions

  • Analyze proposed and existing business activities involving personal information, including products, services, marketing initiatives, employee processes, technologies, vendors, and data-sharing arrangements. Gather relevant facts, identify applicable privacy requirements, assess risks and gaps, document conclusions, and recommend practical actions or escalation.
  • Conduct and document privacy impact, risk, AI and other required assessments under applicable laws. Evaluate issues such as notice, purpose limitation, data minimization, retention, sensitive personal information, consumer rights, targeted advertising, sale or sharing, automated decision-making, AI-enabled processing, profiling, algorithmic decision-making, and contractual requirements.
  • Develop and maintain accurate data maps and inventories by documenting categories of personal information, data subjects, collection sources, business purposes, systems, recipients, disclosures, retention periods, and relevant data flows. Analyze gaps and inconsistencies and work with stakeholders to determine practical solutions.
  • Assess proposed disclosures and transfers of personal information to affiliates, service providers, contractors, and other third parties. Determine whether a data processing, data sharing, confidentiality, or other agreement is required; identify necessary privacy terms and restrictions; document recommendations; and coordinate review or escalation with Legal.
  • Draft and maintain privacy guidelines, assessment templates, standard operating procedures, and playbooks that convert legal and policy requirements into repeatable business practices.
  • Analyze and support data subject requests involving access, deletion, correction, opt-out, limitation, and appeal rights under applicable laws; identify relevant systems and data owners; document exceptions and response decisions.
  • Monitor developments in privacy laws, regulations, enforcement actions, and regulatory guidance; assess their effect on existing business practices, and propose updates to policies, processes, notices, agreements, and training materials.

 

Required Qualifications

  • 2-4 years’ experience in information technology or data privacy and AI governance management, including supporting e-commerce or CRM-focused initiatives.
  • Experience with SaaS privacy platforms such as OneTrust, Ketch, Osano, TrustArc etc.
  • Experience supporting compliance initiatives under North America, APAC, Europe, and LatAm privacy laws.
  • Demonstrated understanding of current data protection and privacy legislation in the United States (must), APAC, Europe, and LatAm (plus).
  • Understanding the role privacy has in supporting business enablement and employee privacy in a global enterprise.  
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytics skills.
  • Detail-oriented and highly motivated.
  • Ability to identify and solve problems quickly.
  • Ability to nurture relationships across large and complex organizations.
  • Comfortable working both independently and in a team setting, in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in the use of Generative AI tools such as Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, etc.
  • Proficiency in the Microsoft Office 365 suite (Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.)
  • CIPP-US, CIPP-EU, or CIPM

Pay Scale: $95,000.00 - $105,000.00

Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: You will be eligible for medical insurance benefits in accordance with the terms of the Company's benefit plan. Currently, full time employees are eligible for these benefits on the first day of
employment.

A Brief Overview

The Manager Production advances all event details for all shows. In addition to managing production crew by interfacing and making production arrangements with local labor vendors, creating production crew schedules, diffusing employee relation situations and conflict resolution, review, approve and submit payroll for production staff.

  • May also be responsible for hiring local labor, rentals and other show needs.

job.description:
Company Information

Job Summary

The Project Manager, Venue Development will support the Project Director and broader Venue Development team by managing project controls, FF&E and procurement coordination, document flow, action tracking, vendor follow-up, and operational-readiness handoffs across active and future venue projects. The role is intended to create a reliable operating picture across budget, schedule, procurement, contracts, invoices, deliveries, installation readiness, turnover, and lessons learned.

Essential Functions

 

  • Own and maintain FF&E and procurement tracker covering budgets, schedules, vendor bids, awards, commitments, contract routing, invoices, delivery, installation, move-in, and open issues across all projects. Ensures AEGP standards and specifications are implemented. 
  • Coordinate project updates across production, interiors, low voltage, operational equipment, construction-adjacent scopes, vendors, Finance/AP, Legal, and internal project leads. 
  • Prepare exception-based reporting that identifies schedule risk, budget exposure, overdue decisions, blocked action items, vendor issues, revised invoices, approval delays, and required leadership decisions.
  • Support bid comparison, vendor selection, award recommendations, procurement planning, contract/work-order routing, payment tracking, and installation-readiness coordination. 
  • Maintain action, risk, decision, lessons-learned, closeout, turnover, and handoff logs so project information is current, visible, and reusable across the team. 
  • Support turnover, commissioning, move-in, GM/on-site team readiness, punch-list follow-up, warranty tracking, and post-opening issue resolution in coordination with the Project Director and project leads. 
  • Assist with project budgets, schedules, forecasts, vendor proposals, historical-cost references, program documents, matrices, and presentation/reporting materials as needed. 
  • Travel to project sites, vendor meetings, construction meetings, turnover reviews, and opening meetings as required.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree is preferred in construction management, real estate, architecture, engineering, business, hospitality, music business, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 2–4 years of relevant project management, construction, development, procurement, FF&E, hospitality, venue or event management, entertainment, or owner-side project delivery experience preferred.
  • Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders, vendors, consultants, contractors, internal operators, Finance/AP, Legal, and senior project leadership.
  • Strong working knowledge of budgets, schedules, commitments, invoices, procurement logs, action trackers, change tracking, and project reporting.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable creating structure where responsibilities cross multiple teams and projects.
  • Proactive follow-up style with the judgment to identify what can be resolved independently and what needs escalation.
  • Ability to read and interpret project schedules, architectural drawings, specifications, vendor proposals, procurement packages, and contract/work-order status.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to summarize complex project status into clear decision points for leadership.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office and project tracking/reporting tools; Smartsheet, construction/project management platforms, or similar systems preferred.

job.description:
Company Information

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

The Senior Data Analyst – Paid Media sits on the Data Analytics, Reporting & Strategy team and serves as the analytical partner and lead for the Paid Media team. Paid Media drives company-wide digital media strategy, campaign management, and consultative support across AEG divisions, including AEG Presents, Global Touring, Festivals, Goldenvoice, Bowery Presents, and Global Partnerships. Campaigns run across a broad mix of channels, including Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, and other social, search, and programmatic platforms.

This role is responsible for pulling, transforming, and modeling campaign data from those ad platforms and joining it with other data sources to build a unified view of performance. The analyst will design scalable data models and automated reporting that measure campaign effectiveness and surface opportunities to optimize budget allocation, audience targeting, creative, and customer acquisition. The role also turns findings into clear, practical recommendations that drive ticket sales, event awareness, and brand initiatives.

The Senior Data Analyst will work closely with the Paid Media, Product, and Data Engineering teams on cross-functional projects covering paid media data ingestion, aggregation, mastering, measurement, and visualization. The position will lead the work to make sure tracking and tagging (pixels, conversion APIs, UTMs) capture accurate marketing data. It will also develop and maintain attribution models and set performance benchmarks for key metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate.

Essential Functions

 

  • Provide analytical support to Paid Media and Marketing teams, compiling performance marketing reports across digital channels using internal BI tools, Google Analytics, native advertising platforms. Communicate results to stakeholders, working with media and strategy teams to demonstrate clear actionable insights for media plans, budget forecasting, targeting/audiences, and creative.
  • Build and maintain comprehensive measurement plans to evaluate paid media performance, calculate benchmarks based on objectives, develop + maintain attribution models to identify trends, testing opportunities, and insights by channel, audience, festival/tour/regional show, and business unit.
  • Partner with Data, Product, Engineering teams to manage data pipelines + ingestion for channel metrics, define data collection requirements and enforce optimal taxonomy for reporting implementations, continual data hygiene + integrity across ad buying and internal platforms.
  • Collaborate with media, marketing, and data teams to inform audience and targeting strategies. Develop tests to evaluate new campaign strategies, ad products, optimization tactics, and targeting features.
  • Manage and lead paid media projects involving data aggregation and measurement tools such as Datorama, Google Analytics / GA4, Tag Manager, DOMO, BigQuery, LiveRamp, server-server integrations with media partners. Ensure appropriate site tracking is in place to capture relevant data points to measure marketing effectiveness.
  • Work closely with data team to develop and maintain reporting dashboards for internal and external use, while providing support for ad hot reporting requests.

 

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree (4-year) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, Marketing, or a related quantitative field
  • 4–6 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role, with exposure to paid media or digital marketing data on the client, publisher, or agency side; e-commerce experience preferred
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience pulling, transforming, and analyzing large, complex datasets
  • Strong ability to build data models, data flows, and ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL and/or Python, bringing together data from multiple media channels into a scalable, automated insights reporting structure
  • Proficiency in BI and data visualization tools such as DOMO, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar, with strong dashboard design and data storytelling skills
  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence (formerly Datorama) or similar marketing data integration platforms is a strong plus
  • Working knowledge of paid media data and performance metrics, including impressions, CTR, CPC, CPA, conversion rate, and ROAS, across platforms such as Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok
  • Familiarity with tracking infrastructure such as GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels, Conversions API, UTMs, and server-side tracking
  • Experience applying statistical methods to performance benchmarking, attribution modeling, and media mix modeling (MMM)
  • Understanding of the ad tech and Martech landscape (programmatic buying, DSP/SSP, audience management, ad serving, social buying platforms), and of privacy regulations’ impact on measurement, including cookie-less tracking and multi-touch customer journeys
  • Ability to clearly communicate insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and manage multiple cross-functional projects at once

job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) II is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable and reliable systems and applications. This role will collaborate with development teams, and employ infrastructure as code principles. This role combines software development and system administration skills to enhance overall system reliability and efficiency. Contributes to capacity planning, on-call support, and documentation efforts within the organization.

What Will You Do?

  • Builds and scales the technology infrastructure to meet rapidly increasing demand.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to launch new features and services.
  • Delivers automation solutions for deployment, monitoring, management. and incident response.
  • Develops and improves operational practices and procedures.
  • Participate in incident response and resolution activities, including root cause analysis, to minimize downtime and prevent future occurrences.
  • Coaches more junior colleagues in techniques, processes, and responsibilities.

What Will You Bring?

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) relevant field such as Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not mandatory.
  • 4-6 years In a site reliability, dev ops, or systems engineering position
  • Intermediate knowledge of cloud service operations, including data assurance, monitoring, alerting and notifications.
  • Intermediate knowledge of Infrastructure as code
  • Intermediate knowledge of containers and orchestration platforms
  • Intermediate knowledge of continuous integration and continuous delivery
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cloud native environments
  • Problem solving and decision making skills.

Position Summary: 

AXS is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end strategy and execution of our Resale platform. This role is responsible for the core marketplace engine that powers secondary ticketing across the AXS ecosystem, including resale listings ingestion and distribution, inventory and pricing services, event and venue data models, partner and marketplace integrations, public-facing APIs, and the platform services that connect fan demand with resale supply across thousands of events each year.  

Success requires balancing platform scalability, data integrity, marketplace health, and delivery velocity while evolving the core engine to support new partners, markets, and fan experiences.  

The ideal candidate combines strong product instincts with a deep technical foundation and a systems-modeling mindset. You are comfortable leading engineering teams through domain and data modeling, API and data contract design, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and platform integrations while translating those capabilities into measurable business and marketplace outcomes. You are execution-focused and thrive on turning ambiguous problems into clear requirements, well-sequenced roadmaps, and shipped software.   

You will work closely with Engineering (including onshore and offshore delivery teams), Architecture, Data, Payments, Partner Experience, and business stakeholders to deliver a scalable, reliable resale platform that grows marketplace liquidity and improves the fan experience across the live event lifecycle. 

Essential Functions: 

As a Senior Product Manager you will be accountable for: 

  • Defining product vision, roadmap, and priorities for the core Resale platform engine across the AXS ecosystem. 
  • Establish platform priorities that balance scalability, reliability, modernization, and marketplace growth.  
  • Own platform capabilities delivered through APIs, data contracts, integrations, event-driven services, and backend systems that power resale listings, inventory, and pricing.  
  • Lead systems and domain modeling for core resale entities, including events, venues, seating, listings, inventory, and transactions, to create a durable and extensible platform foundation. 
  • Serve as the day-to-day product leader for Engineering, driving sprint planning, backlog refinement, technical requirements, and acceptance criteria through delivery. 
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture to define API standards, service-level objectives, reliability goals, and operational readiness standards. 
  • Drive product decisions using marketplace metrics, platform telemetry, observability, and performance data. 
  • Own capacity planning and delivery sequencing with engineering leadership, managing dependencies across onshore and offshore teams. 
  • Partnering with the Partner Experience team to ensure platform capabilities, APIs, and integrations are ready for external partner and developer adoption. 
  • Identifying and prioritizing improvements that reduce technical debt, data quality issues, and integration friction across the resale ecosystem. 
  • Develop a deep understanding of secondary ticketing, marketplace supply and demand dynamics, and resale workflows.  
  • Lead modernization efforts across legacy resale and listing systems while maintaining marketplace continuity.  
  • Define and monitor KPIs related to platform reliability, data quality, listing coverage, performance, and delivery predictability. 
  • Communicate roadmap, risks, priorities, and outcomes clearly across technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leadership. 
  • Build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups and influence decisions through data-driven insights and customer understanding. 

 

We are looking for: 

 

Required Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience delivering complex software products in Agile environments. 
  • Demonstrated success owning technical products, platforms, APIs, SDKs, integrations, or enterprise software solutions. 
  • Experience partnering closely with engineering teams to deliver platform, integration, or infrastructure-adjacent products within modern distributed architectures. 
  • Experience supporting mission-critical workflows where reliability, scalability, performance, and resiliency are essential. 
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures, distributed systems, operational telemetry, observability, and data-driven product decision making. 
  • Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex ecosystems spanning modern platforms, legacy systems, integrations, and operational processes. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to define ambiguous problems, synthesize data, and deliver measurable outcomes. 
  • Proven ability to balance customer needs, business objectives, and technical constraints while driving product strategy and execution. 
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align technical and non-technical stakeholders across organizational boundaries. 
  • Systems thinker with a platform-oriented mindset who can connect business processes, technical systems, operational workflows, and customer experiences to build scalable solutions. 
  • Curious, data-driven, and comfortable operating in complex environments, with a strong bias toward continuous improvement, experimentation, and measurable outcomes. 
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 

 

Preferred Qualifications 

 

  • Background building platform products that enable external partners through APIs, SDKs, integrations, or developer ecosystems. 
  • Track record of modernizing legacy operational systems while balancing migration risk, business continuity, and long-term platform evolution. 
  • Familiarity with software-plus-hardware ecosystems, including mobile applications, hardware integrations, edge devices, or operational technology environments. 
  • Understanding of service reliability, operational readiness, performance objectives, and incident management practices. 
  • Proven ability to design configurable platform capabilities that support regional variation while maintaining a scalable core product. 
  • Exposure to complex global organizations and products serving multiple international markets. 
  • Domain expertise in live entertainment, ticketing, venue operations, access control, identity, payments, transportation, hospitality, logistics, or other operationally intensive industries.

 

 

At AXS, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but can't "check every box" in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles. 

 

Pay Scale: $127.000-$135,000

Bonus:  This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. 

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. Currently, full time employees are eligible for these benefits on the first day of employment.

 *Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position. 

 

What’s in it for You?

  • Extraordinary People – we’re not kidding!
  • Meaningful Mission– Helping revolutionize an industry and deliver better experiences for fans and clients around the world.
  • Development and Learning – Opportunities for learning and leveling up through training and education reimbursement.
  • Community & Belonging – A range of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection, inclusion, and professional growth. Access to meaningful volunteer opportunities and community engagement programs to make a positive impact beyond the workplace.  

 

Curious about the typical interview process for this position? Here's what to expect:

  • Stage 1: 30 min virtual interview (Recruiter)
  • Stage 2: 60-min virtual interview (Hiring Manager)
  • Stage 3: Two 45-min virtual interviews (Engineering & Product Peer)  
  • Stage 4: 60-min Onsite/Virtual Final (Hiring Manager)

*This schedule may be subject to change.

AXS, a subsidiary of AEG, sells millions of tickets each year for 1600+ premier venues, sports teams, and event organizers across North America, Europe, Asia, Australia and New Zealand. Headquartered in Downtown Los Angeles, California, AXS employs more than 900 professionals in multiple locations worldwide. In each location you’ll find a team of dedicated, diverse employees (we’ve dubbed ourselves “Fanatix”) who create groundbreaking products and services in a fun, fast-paced environment.

Job Summary

The Sr. Accountant is responsible for financial reporting, including the reconciliation of the balance sheet and the monthly reforecasting. The Sr. Accountant enters, codes, and approves invoices, road checks and expenses and will also be responsible for preparing the monthly closing, journal entries, balance sheet analysis, expense coding, maintaining show files, settling shows and miscellaneous accounting projects as assigned. The Sr. Accountant is accountable for monthly accounting entries in the general ledger including invoices, petty cash, T&E, corporate credit cards, royalties and insurance. This position works in conjunction with Accounting Manager or Director of Accounting and is a contributing member of the finance team that oversees all financials for venue/region.

Essential Functions

  • Review and reconciliation of balance sheet, general ledger, accounts receivables and accounts payables.
  • Review and coding of invoices, road checks, cash receipts, p-card transactions and expenses. Create and code invoices for outstanding receivables. Obtain proper approval and code to specific events. Audits show file for tour and co-promotion settlements.
  • Responsible for monthly accounting entries in general ledger including invoicing rental clients, 3rd party processing, petty cash, T&E, corporate credit cards, royalties, and insurance.
  • Enter cash receipts and road checks for region into JDE and code to appropriate department. Review event settlements for accuracy and process road checks and cash receipts through AP.
  • Works in conjunction with Accounting Manager or Director of Accounting for department/venue to prepare annual budgeting and reforecasting based on monthly and annual projected sales. Complete the month end close and show and tour reconciliation.
  • Management of audits, including compilation of data for appropriate inquiries. Organize payroll audits for regional venues and offices.
  • Liaison with CAPs and part-time employees. Ensuring that staff needs are met and payroll conflicts are resolved in a timely manner to reduce compliance liability - check requests, rate discrepancies, and payroll audits.
  • Analyzes cost data to determine return on investment on partnership deals and renewals.
  • Annual management of building permits and renewals.
  • May assist in show settlement as necessary for unassigned shows or tours.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year) In Finance/Accounting
  • 4-6 years Of related work experience
  • Experience with JDE, ImageNow, and Concur
  • Knowledge of basic accounting principles
  • Ability to multi-task and detail-orientated
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Outlook; Strong Microsoft Excel skills-specifically working in pivot tables
  • Strong financial analytical skills with prior experience in finance reporting systems
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Able to work independently and as part of a team to accomplish the goals of finance department
  • Strong time management and interpersonal skills
  • Music Industry knowledge and concert operation experience
  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA)

Payscale: $59,564.55 - $90,000.00 annually

Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

job.title: Sr. Director, Business Development - AXS
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

The Role

The Senior Director of Business Development will drive AXS’s growth across the sports industry by identifying, developing, and closing new partnerships with teams, leagues, venues, and other rights holders. Reporting to the Vice President of Business Development, this role will manage the full business development lifecycle, from market development and prospecting through solution design, financial modeling, negotiation, contracting and transition to implementation.

The Senior Director will build trusted relationships with senior decision makers, develop customized partnership strategies, and clearly communicate AXS’s ticketing capabilities. This individual will work closely with Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Operations to create compelling proposals, structure commercially sound agreements, and ensure organizational alignment through the sales process.

The ideal candidate combines deep sports industry knowledge, strong commercial judgement, and a proven ability to navigate complex, long-term sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.

What Will You Do?

  • Financial Proposals and Negotiations: Manage financial proposals and lead contract negotiations for new partnerships and renewals, ensuring terms that support long-term objectives.
  • Revenue Growth: Contribute to achieving and surpassing revenue targets by identifying key opportunities within all verticals.
  • CRM Leadership: Oversee CRM system use, including account maintenance, report generation, and workflow management. Ensure data integrity and process optimization.
  • Industry Representation: Represent AXS at industry events and tradeshows. Facilitate strategic meetings and events with external partners and prospects.
  • Executive Support: Assist the Business Development leadership team with strategic tasks and ad-hoc initiatives that drive growth.
  • Data Integrity: Ensure CRM data accuracy and advocate for best practices in data management, facilitating smooth handoffs to Customer Success.
  • Partnership Development: Cultivate relationships with potential partners and lead efforts to secure and coordinate meetings that drive business opportunities.
  • Sales Tools and Resources: Evolve sales tools, presentations, and contracts to meet marketplace needs and communicate AXS's value proposition.
  • Messaging and Content: Develop messaging and content that clearly articulate AXS's unique value across products, services, and verticals.

 

What Will You Bring?

  • BA/BS Degree in Business Administration, Marketing or a related field
  • 6+ years' experience in Business Development and ticketing or live entertainment
  • Strong experience with identifying opportunities, developing strategies, and negotiating creative solutions
  • Experience negotiating and executing contracts.
  • Experience in evolving sales tools, presentations, and messaging to align with market trends.
  • Experience representing a company at industry events and tradeshows, with the ability to network and generate leads.
  • Strong understanding of the sports and live entertainment ecosystem, including teams, leagues, venues, promoters, and other rights holders.
  • Knowledge of ticketing technology, primary and secondary distribution, pricing, inventory management, data, marketing, sponsorship, and venue operations.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to evaluate opportunities, develop revenue models, and structure mutually beneficial agreements.
  • Consultative selling skills and the ability to translate a prospective partner’s business objectives into a customized solution
  • Exceptional negotiation, presentation, and executive communication skills
  • Ability to communicate complex technology and commercial concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly for client meetings, industry conferences, events, and internal collaboration

job.title: Sr. Director, Production - Global Touring
job.description:
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. 

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. 

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Position Summary:

The Senior Director of Production serves as AEG's on-site representative providing strategic leadership for the operational and execution of large-scale touring productions. Serving as the senior production representative on assigned tours, this role oversees daily show operations, revenue optimization, and cross-functional coordination to maximize tour performance. The Senior Director partners with artists, promoters, venue personnel, ticketing, and production teams to drive operational excellence while ensuring accurate execution throughout the tour lifecycle.

Essential Functions:

  • Lead the day-to-day operational and financial execution of assigned touring productions, serving as the senior production representative with responsibility for production delivery, show settlements, and operational decision-making.
  • Drive revenue optimization by evaluating venue configurations, production layouts, and ticket inventory opportunities to maximize sellable seating while maintaining production, safety, and guest experience standards.
  • Oversee daily financial settlements, expense management, and accounting activities, ensuring timely reconciliation and compliance with internal financial controls and contractual requirements.
  • Coordinate cross-functional tour operations by partnering with ticketing, venue management, production, catering, temporary staffing, and other internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless show execution.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and operational leadership by developing best practices, mentoring production staff, and supporting organizational initiatives related to tour operations, financial processes, and production standards.

Required Qualifications:

  • Extensive experience managing large-scale touring productions, including live event operations and financial settlements.
  • Strong knowledge of production accounting, revenue management, and ticketing operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to make independent operational decisions in high-pressure, live event environments.
  • Experience with tour settlement systems, ticketing platforms, and production management software.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
  • Experience managing multiple complex projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including advanced Excel skills, and experience using budgeting, project management, and financial systems.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with clients, venues, and co-workers
  • Excellent written, verbal and listening communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Self-motivated and takes initiative
  • May require heavy travel for long period of time of the road

Payscale: $157,468 - $241,030

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

 

AEG reserves the right to change or modify the employee’s job description whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship. AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside his/her normal description.

AEG's policy is to hire the most qualified applicants.  We are an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any individual, employee, or application for employment on the basis of race, color, marital status, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other legally protected status recognized by federal, state or local law.

Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.

A Brief Overview
The Talent Buyer is responsible for building relationships, identifying talent and confirming profitable shows. This position will create budgets, map scaling for venues and build offers for artists. Additionally, the Talent Buyer will compile all relevant documents and ensure that all shows are settled accurately. They will also work in conjunction with management to identify and build festivals.

Essential Functions

  • Buy profitable talent by actively reaching out to agents with booking possibilities. Respond to inbound requests from agents and artist management. Follow-up on leads from other talent buyers.
  • Negotiate offer details with music agents for artist performances. Gather all relevant information to build offer and present to artist management.
  • Networking and building relationships with agents, artist management, venue managers and other potential clients. Maintain current client relationships.
  • Oversee the marketing and ticketing of events. Confirm show details and artist requests with marketing and ticketing departments. Ensure that shows go on sale and tickets are being sold.
  • Create show or event budgets. Monitor spending and make sure that event stays in budget.
  • Travel to cover road shows, events, festivals and seek new clients, projects and partners. Handle the settlement of shows when necessary.
  • Work with managers on potential festival projects. Identify potential third party venue and festival sites for events. Assist on festival and concert projects as assigned by manger. Develop creative properties that can be grown into annual events.
