  • 4-6 years Of related work experience
  • Previous experience in the music industry with demonstrated ability to assess current music trends
  • Previous experience supervisor, leading, and/or mentoring team
  • Knowledge of general accounting principles
  • General understanding of ticketing systems
  • Computer savvy and skilled in MS Office (Outlook, Word and Excel); knowledge of social media platforms
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Must have an outgoing personality with the ability to build and cultivate relationships.
  • Exceptional negotiation skills with an ability to analyze complex documents
  • Ability to work independently to perform job, as well as in a team environment
  • Must have established contacts and relationships in the music industry
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule which may include nights, weekends and holidays.

This position will also compile and distribute daily ticket counts to various internal departments, offices, and artist management, agents, and record labels. The Manager, Ticketing will collaborate with venues, artist management, and discount vendors to create ticket packages for shows and events. For assigned special events, this position may also be responsible for managing ticketing operations, including event setup, inventory strategy, ticket allocations, and box office execution. job.title: Ticketing Operations Analyst - Product Ops
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

The Role

The Ticketing Operations Analyst – Product Operations coordinates cross-departmental product initiatives, ensuring effective stakeholder engagement in User Acceptance Testing and managing issue tracking with product teams under the supervision of the Manager, Ticketing Operations.  The role also supports data cleansing efforts and fraud monitoring, collaborates on triage and escalation of product issues, and participates in after-hours on-call rotations as needed. 

What Will You Do?

  • Recruits, coordinates, and holds accountable the business stakeholders required to complete User Acceptance Testing (UAT) on new AXS products and features, working closely with the Product Owner and Project Managers. 
  • Assists with the evaluation and escalation of Global Triage bug tickets. Troubleshoots any reported issues and resolves or escalates as needed. 
  • Serves as overflow support to team members responsible for creating and validating fees, investigating fee variance tickets, and managing Apex user accounts. 
  • Assists with completing client and promoter requests for OTL sweeps, generating reports on problematic orders for clients, and coordinating the bulk cancellation of orders in violation of ticket limits. 
  • Participates in an on-call rotation with other department staff to assist with daily bulk refunds for rescheduled events and triaging emergency requests after hours and on weekends. 
  • Provides general and project-specific assistance as needed to the other Ticketing Operations staff under the supervision of the Manager, Ticketing Operations. 

What Will You Bring?

  • BA/BS Degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or Marketing major preferred. 
  • 2-4 years of significant experience in live event ticketing and/or ticketing software administration may be substituted for equivalent education depending on the nature of the work experience. 
  • Ability to independently manage complex projects
  • Familiarity with software testing protocols  
  • Excel experience required, including a familiarity with data parsing and vlookup functions 
  • Strong communication skills and the ability gracefully enforce accountability standards 
  • Ability to juggle multiple pressing priorities and meet aggressive deadlines 
  • Flexibility in adapting to rules and processes that frequently evolve 

 

At AXS, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but can't "check every box" in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles. 

 

Pay Scale: $62,000 - $70,000

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. Currently, full time employees are eligible for these benefits on the first day of employment.

*Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.

 

What’s in it for You?

  • Extraordinary People – we’re not kidding!
  • Meaningful Mission– Helping revolutionize an industry and deliver better experiences for fans and clients around the world.
  • Development and Learning – Opportunities for learning and leveling up through training and education reimbursement.
  • Community & Belonging – A range of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection, inclusion, and professional growth. Access to meaningful volunteer opportunities and community engagement programs to make a positive impact beyond the workplace.

 

 

More about AXS

AXS, a subsidiary of AEG, sells millions of tickets each year for 1600+ premier venues, sports teams, and event organizers across North America, Europe, Asia, Australia and New Zealand. Headquartered in Downtown Los Angeles, California, AXS employs more than 900 professionals in multiple locations worldwide. In each location you’ll find a team of dedicated, diverse employees (we’ve dubbed ourselves “Fanatix”) who create groundbreaking products and services in a fun, fast-paced environment. 

To learn more about our culture and values, visit: https://solutions.axs.com/careers/

 

 

More about AEG

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people feel, share, and remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience over 13,000 live events across five continents, from iconic concerts and major festivals to championship-level sports and entertainment destinations.
Powered by a passion for live experiences and the people behind them, we connect artists, teams, fans, and communities through world-class venues, events, and partnerships that shape culture and bring people together.
Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose. If you’re ready to do work that shows up in the real world and helps create moments that matter, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here.

 

We are dedicated to a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but can't "check every box" in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Position Summary:

The Touring Coordinator is responsible for supporting the touring department operations by maintaining office systems, controlling department correspondence - the dissemination of tour information to all relevant departments, the maintenance of venue, artist and tour databases, conducting new and relevant research to update the databases as needed. The touring coordinator may also be assign various projects for the touring department including but not limited to the creation of potential tour designs, initial drafting of potential tour offers, coordinating the tour budget development, working on tour routing and execution of venue deals for tour.

Essential Functions:

 

  • Maintains department services & efficiencies by organizing department operations and procedures; controlling correspondence; designing filing systems; processing department supply requests; maintaining department contacts, scheduling meetings, planning and implementing department systems and equipment procurement including repair of machinery and equipment for employees on the road
  • Responsible for building the routing of each assigned tour. Creating a realistic schedule for production crew to follow. Reach out to venues to compare availability to artist availability and submit routing for approval to begin execution of necessary contracts
  • Review of ticket audits to ensure tour is on budget. Ensure that all production needs and requests are met to successfully execute stage, lighting, and sound vision of artist and management team.

  • May be responsible for assisting with show settlements on the road, assisting the ticketing department, and the recruiting and supervision of interns, executive expense reports, planning travel, and routing phone calls to appropriate party.
  • May build financial models for Tour Manager and Tour Director to assess financial risk associated with each venue and the potential revenue of a proposed tour. Prepare potential scaling maps and projected budgets. Work with accounting department for budgeting, expense reports, and various department costs throughout the year with department heads

  • Able to work a flexible schedule which may include nights, weekends and holidays as tour permits

job.title: Touring Project Manager
job.description:
Company Information
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Position Summary

The primary responsibilities of the Touring Project Manager are to support the successful execution of tours and live events by coordinating logistics, operational planning, and cross-functional communication. This role serves as a key operational partner to Touring Managers, exercising independent judgment and discretion in managing project timelines, prioritizing tasks, coordinating resources, and resolving routine operational challenges. The Touring Project Manager supports advancing activities, event settlements, documentation management, and stakeholder communications to ensure tours are delivered efficiently and in accordance with company standards. Additionally, this role maintains strong relationships with venues, vendors, local partners, and internal departments while proactively identifying operational risks and escalating significant issues when necessary.

Primary Job Responsibilities:

  • Support the day-to-day operational execution of tours, events, and live entertainment engagements.
  • Coordinate tour logistics, schedules, timelines, travel arrangements, and operational deliverables.
  • Manage project timelines and ensure key milestones, deadlines, and deliverables are achieved.
  • Support show advancing activities, including venue coordination, artist requirements, production needs, and operational planning.
  • Assist with day-of-show settlements, event reconciliation, and operational documentation.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for venues, vendors, local partners, and internal departments regarding assigned projects.
  • Maintain regular communication with artists, managers, promoters, venues, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment and project success.
  • Monitor project progress and identify potential operational risks, delays, or challenges.
  • Exercise independent judgment in prioritizing competing operational demands and recommending solutions to support successful event execution.
  • Coordinate internal follow-up activities across Booking, Touring, Production, Marketing, Finance, and Operations teams.
  • Prepare and maintain project documentation, schedules, budgets, reports, settlement materials, and operational records.
  • Support expense tracking, budget monitoring, and financial reconciliation activities.
  • Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, artist riders, venue requirements, and company operational standards.
  • Escalate significant operational issues, financial concerns, or project risks to Touring Managers and leadership when appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements, operational efficiencies, and enhanced event execution.
  • Represent the company professionally during events, site visits, meetings, and business travel.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned that are consistent with the nature and level of the position.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Entertainment Management, Event Management, Communications, Music Business, or a related field; equivalent industry experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of 2-4 years of experience in project management, event operations, concert promotion, venue operations, artist relations, or related live entertainment roles.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple projects, events, tours, or operational initiatives simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of live event operations, touring logistics, event production, and artist relations.
  • Experience supporting show advancing, event execution, settlements, and operational planning.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and discretion in coordinating projects, prioritizing resources, and resolving operational issues.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities with the capacity to manage competing priorities.
  • Experience collaborating across multiple departments and managing external stakeholder relationships.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, CRM platforms, event management software, and project management tools.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment.
  • Knowledge of current trends and best practices within the live entertainment and touring industries.
  • Fluency in both English and Spanish (written and verbal) is required.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally and work evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.

 

Payscale: $55,000k-$65,000K

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

job.title: Utility Operator (Crypto.com Arena)
job.description:
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Crypto.com Arena is where the world comes to play, perform, and come together. As one of the most iconic venues in sports and live entertainment, we host unforgettable moments, from championship games and global tours to once in a lifetime events that define the culture of Los Angeles. 

Owned and operated by AEG, our team brings live experiences to life with creativity, precision, and pride. Every role plays a part in creating nights fans remember, powered by people who care about the details and the impact of getting it right. 

If you want your work to show up in real moments, in a venue where history is made every night, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here. 

Job Summary:

The Utility Operator controls and shades cameras during events for Crypto.com Arena.

Essential Functions:

  • Work with the camera operators to prepare the proper connection and operation at the Camera Control Unit (CCU). This includes properly connecting the camera with the camera cable to the assigned port at one of the media panels. This includes running the cable from the panel to the camera location and making sure any points along the run are taped to the ground with non-stick gaffer’s tape at any point that is considered a trip hazard.
  • During the game, will provide support as the handheld camera is requested to move around to get shots. This includes making sure the extra cable staged by the camera is kept organized and fed out and wrapped up neatly as the camera operator moves from their original position.
  • Act as a guide to the camera operator ensuring their safety from their blind side and behind them. May also need to make supply runs back to the control room such as fresh batteries or tape or a replacement headset.
  • Lift and/or carry a handheld camera which can weigh up to 30 lbs.
  • Must be able to spend time on their feet or be seated throughout the shift, including moving from a seated position to standing and moving quickly such as an unexpected time out that requires quick action.

Required Qualifications:

  • A minimum education level of: High School Diploma or its equivalency.
  • A minimum of two years of related work experience.
  • Ability to lift heavy objects, walk, sit and move quickly.
  • Ability to work in a fast paced environment.
  • Must be able to focus on their job in front of very large crowd.
  • Must be able to lift up to 30 pounds either sitting or standing.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to perform a proper “over/under” cable wrap a plus.

Pay scale: $70.00

Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Part-time: This position may be eligible for benefits (ACA qualification).

Description

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

The Data, Insights, Science and Optimization, Consumer Product and Tech (DISCO CPT) team is looking for a Data Scientist to join a team of Data Scientists, Analytics Leads, Business Intelligence Engineers and Data Engineers who analyze big data, provide analytics and insights as well as build models and algorithms that power product for personalized experiences. The team focuses on accelerating Amazon Music customer growth by empowering Product teams to make sound, customer-centric decisions through data and insights. We build data pipelines, science models, self-service analytics, insights and dashboards, deliver engagement and retention at scale. In this role, you will pioneer and execute advanced analytics and experimentation efforts for the Amazon Music product team. You will work with stakeholders and partners to deliver experimentation insights, author scientific artifacts, build scalable models to advance our analytics and science products. The ideal candidate must be willing to effectively lead science solutions, prioritize across multiple stakeholders and projects and be ready to jump into a fast-paced, dynamic and fun environment.

Key job responsibilities
1. Data Scientist I on this role will be a thought partner to Product and Engineering organizations through their expertise in experimentation, statistical modeling and advanced analytics
2. Conceptualize and drive strategic growth areas: app performance, stablity and latency experimentation, Gen AI initiatives, and product excellence.
3. Bridge science, analytics, and engineering to deliver solutions informing strategic decisions on AM technology investments and long-term business performance
4. Drive experimentation, measurement efficiency tooling, and ROI tracking for AM leadership
5. Build and maintain causal models to understand customer sentiment and its impact on key engagement/retention metrics
6. Develop structural and predictive models using data science workflows to deliver measurable customer results

A day in the life
1. Lead strategic initiatives across visual and voice experiences, experimentation and customer retention stakeholders
2. Conduct experimentation, build causal models to better understand key drivers for customer retention
3. Evaluate existing metrics and lead deep dives to ensure the right measurement framework is leveraged to measure and enhance user adoption through visual and voice interfaces
4. Partner with product managers to translate business questions into actionable science projects
5. Influence product roadmaps through data-driven insights on customer behavior patterns
6. Identify and resolve customer experience friction points with cross-functional teams
Drive adoption of best practices and innovative solutions across the organization

Basic Qualifications

- 1+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
- 2+ years of data/research scientist, statistician or quantitative analyst in an internet-based company with complex and big data sources experience
- 1+ years of creating or contributing to mathematical textbooks, research papers, or educational content experience
- Master's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)

Preferred Qualifications

- Ph.D. in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
- Knowledge of statistical packages and business intelligence tools such as SPSS, SAS, S-PLUS, or R
- Knowledge of machine learning concepts and their application to reasoning and problem-solving
- Experience with clustered data processing (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Map-reduce, and Hive)
- Experience working with or evaluating AI systems
- Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions
- Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication

Job ID: 10523979 | Amazon Digital France SAS

Apply now

Description

Français:
Amazon Music est un service de divertissement audio immersif qui connecte les fans, les artistes et les créateurs. Des playlists personnalisées aux podcasts exclusifs, en passant par la diffusion de concerts en direct et les produits dérivés des artistes, Amazon Music innove à l’intersection entre musique et culture. Nous proposons des expériences adaptées à tous les auditeurs grâce à nos différentes offres: les membres Prime bénéficient d'un accès sans publicité à l'ensemble du catalogue musical en mode aléatoire, ainsi qu'aux meilleurs podcasts sans publicité, le tout inclus dans leur abonnement; les clients peuvent opter pour Amazon Music Unlimited afin d'accéder en illimité et à la demande à 100 millions de titres, dont des millions en HD, Ultra HD et audio spatial ; enfin, chacun peut écouter de la musique gratuitement en téléchargeant l'application Amazon Music ou via des appareils compatibles avec Alexa. Rejoignez-nous pour contribuer à façonner la manière dont Amazon Music interagit avec les fans, les artistes et les créateurs à l'échelle mondiale.

Nous recherchons un(e) Responsable de programme (Program Manager) maîtrisant le français (langue maternelle ou niveau C2). Vous intégrerez notre équipe International Product, responsable de l'expérience client dans les nombreux pays où Amazon Music est présent. Vous contribuerez à améliorer le quotidien de nos clients francophones et à définir les exigences linguistiques pour les nouvelles fonctionnalités d'Amazon Music qui améliorent leur expérience musicale. Vos missions consisteront notamment à analyser et résoudre les problèmes rencontrés par les clients, à identifier les lacunes de l'expérience client (CX) via des audits de parcours et des workshops, à fournir un support produit et créer des rapports personnalisés pour les parties prenantes internes et externes, ainsi qu'à accompagner nos équipes mondiales Produit et QA (Assurance Qualité) pour tester l'expérience locale des nouvelles fonctionnalités. Nous recherchons une personne à l'aise avec les données et les produits technologiques pour prendre des décisions et proposer des améliorations de l'expérience client, et qui s'épanouit dans un environnement dynamique et en évolution rapide.

English:
Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music ad-free in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

We are looking for a Program Manager with native / C2 level proficiency in French. You will be part of our International Product Team that owns the customer experience in our vast number of Amazon Music supported countries around the world. You will help us improve the day-to-day experience of our French speaking customers and define language-specific requirements for new Amazon Music features that make it easier for customers to fall in love with music. Your focus will be to analyze and fix current customer issues, identify CX gaps by conducting walk-the-store and workshops, provide product support to and create customized reports for internal and external stakeholders, and support our global Product and QA teams to test the local experience of brand-new features. We're looking for someone who is comfortable working with data and technology products in order to make decisions and suggest improvements to the CX, and thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Key job responsibilities
Français:
- Connaissance client : Vous adorez vous mettre à la place des clients, et êtes curieux(se) d'explorer les différentes manières dont ils consomment la musique. Vous tirez des enseignements des retours clients, des données d'utilisation et d'études externes, et alimentez la réflexion de nos chefs de produit grâce à des analyses ponctuelles ou des rapports hebdomadaires/mensuels sur l’expérience client.

- Gestion des problèmes : Vous gérez simultanément de nombreuses demandes ponctuelles, tout en priorisant et en résolvant les lacunes de l'expérience client, qu'elles soient internes ou externes. Vous simplifiez des problèmes complexes, produisez des rapports personnalisés grâce à votre capacité à analyser les données, et communiquez efficacement avec les chefs de produit ainsi qu'avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.

- Soutien au lancement de fonctionnalités : Vous incarnez la voix locale du client pour les nouvelles expériences Amazon Music. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes mondiales d'assurance qualité (QA) pour comprendre et vérifier l'expérience client locale. Vous communiquez vos conclusions de manière précise et orientée vers les solutions, tout en sachant trouver le juste équilibre entre rapidité d'exécution et obsession du client.

- Soutien éditorial : Vous travaillez avec les équipes éditoriales, de programmation de contenu et de relations avec les labels pour garantir une expérience produit optimale lors de nos campagnes marketing et artistiques. Vous conseillez sur l'expérience visée, puis définissez et mettez en œuvre des solutions créatives pour ravir nos clients.

- Benchmarking : Vous êtes l'expert(e) concernant l'expérience client du streaming musical local. Vous comparez notre produit à ceux d'autres fournisseurs internes et externes, et utilisez vos conclusions pour formuler des recommandations à nos chefs de produit.
- Gestion des parties prenantes: Vous collaborez avec un large éventail d'interlocuteurs clés, notamment les chefs de produit locaux et mondiaux, le service client, les ingénieurs QA, le marketing, la programmation de contenu et les équipes chargées des relations
avec les artistes et les labels.
- Gestion des processus : Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec d'autres chefs de programme et membres de l'équipe à l'élaboration de protocoles et de processus pour les mécanismes existants et futurs. Vous évaluez en permanence les outils et processus de collecte de données et proposez des solutions pour garantir leur efficacité, leur qualité et leur évolutivité.

- Adoption de l'IA : Vous identifiez des opportunités d'utiliser des outils d'IA pour optimiser et automatiser des processus tels que l'analyse de l'expérience client, le reporting et le tri des problèmes, réduisant ainsi la charge de travail manuel tout en étendant la couverture géographique. Vous restez à l'affût des capacités émergentes de l'IA et formulez des recommandations concrètes pour améliorer l'efficacité de l'équipe grâce à ces technologies.

English
- Customer Insights: You live and breathe customer insights, and are curious to explore the differences in how customers consume music. You derive insights from customer feedback, usage data, and external research, and provide input to our product managers through ad-hoc analyses or weekly/monthly CX reporting.

- Issue Management: You manage numerous ad hoc requests concurrently, and prioritize and resolve internal and external customer experience gaps. You simplify complex issues, provide customized reporting with the ability to understand and analyze data, and effectively communicate to product managers, internal and external stakeholders.

- Feature Launch Support: You are the local voice of the customer for new Amazon Music experiences. You work closely with global QA to understand and verify the local CX. You communicate findings in a precise and solution oriented manner and are able to walk the fine line between speed and customer obsession.

- Editorial support: You work with editorial, content programming and label relations to enable a great product CX for our artist and marketing campaigns. You consult on the desired experience, and define and execute creative solutions to delight our customers. Benchmarking: You are the subject matter expert for the local music streaming CX. You benchmark our product against other internal and external providers, and use your findings to make recommendations to our product managers.

- Stakeholder Management: You work with a broad set of key stakeholders including local and global product managers, customer service, quality assurance engineers, marketing, content programming and artist/label relations.

- Process Management: You partner closely with other Program Managers and team members on protocol/process development for existing and future mechanisms. You continuously evaluate data collection tools and processes and offer solutions to ensure they are efficient, high quality and scalable.

- AI Adoption: You identify opportunities to apply AI tools and automation to streamline processes such as CX analysis, reporting, and issue triage — reducing manual effort while scaling coverage across territories. You stay curious about emerging AI capabilities and bring practical recommendations for where they can improve team efficiency.

Basic Qualifications

- Expérience en gestion de programmes ou de projets / Experience in program or project management
- Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (oral et écrit) au niveau C2 ou supérieur / Speak, write, and read fluently in French and English at C2 level or above
- Expérience dans la facilitation de la collaboration interne entre différentes équipes / Experience driving internal cross-team collaboration

Preferred Qualifications

- Connaissance d’outils d'IA généralistes / Knowledge of general AI tools
- Expérience dans des tâches ou projets analytiques impliquant le traitement de données / Experience in analytical tasks or projects, working with data
- Expérience dans la définition et la mise en œuvre des exigences d'un programme / Experience defining and executing program requirements
- Capacité avérée à travailler en autonomie au sein d'une équipe répartie géographiquement, en collaborant efficacement avec des parties prenantes situées sur différents sites et fuseaux horaires / Demonstrated ability to work autonomously within a distributed team, collaborating effectively with stakeholders across multiple locations and time zones
- Expérience de travail avec des technologies et des produits numériques / Experience working with technology and digital products

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

Job ID: 10606618 | Amazon.com Services LLC - A57

Apply now

Description

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

Do you love uncovering what customers think, feel, and do — then turning those findings into strategies that shape a global brand? Amazon Music's Brand Insights team within the Marketing and Growth organization is looking for a Senior Brand Insights Manager to lead brand tracking and audience insights work that directly influences how we grow and connect with listeners worldwide. In this role, you will manage our global brand health tracker across 14+ markets, develop audience segmentation and profiling analyses, and partner closely with integrated marketing, brand, social media, and country teams to turn complex data into recommendations that drive annual planning, campaign measurement, and audience strategy. You'll work hand in hand with senior leadership across the full Amazon Music organization, ensuring that customer insights sit at the center of every strategic decision.

Key job responsibilities
• Manage the global brand health tracker end-to-end across 14+ markets, from evolving the survey design to vendor management and synthesizing data trends into narrative-driven reports.
• Deliver quarterly and ad hoc reports that track performance across key metrics, surfacing notable trends and changes in brand health
• Leverage first and third-party data to measure holistic brand impact of specific cross-channel activations with target audiences
• Drive ongoing socialization of brand insights and partner with stakeholders (primarily across Marketing verticals) to distill findings into opportunities for optimization and strategic planning
• Conduct meta-analyses to explore strategic questions related to brand impact and the metrics that matter
• Develop audience profiles and segmentation analyses to inform targeting, messaging, and strategy for key listener segments
• Serve as the primary POC for stakeholders across the organization on brand health/measurement and audience insights requests
• Manage ongoing vendor/agency relationships end-to-end, including contract and budget oversight, multi-market fieldwork coordination, and reviewing deliverable reports with actionable feedback
• Build and maintain interactive dashboards and self-service tools for brand and audience data, partnering with third party platforms and internal data science teams
• Build scalable and nimble research solutions and processes, leveraging automation and AI tools to raise the bar on how insights are produced and consumed across the organization
• Drive measurable impact to the business and customer experience through research adoption and integration into strategic decision-making


A day in the life
Your primary focus is brand tracking and audience insights for Amazon Music on a global scale. You might start the morning reviewing the latest brand health data across multiple markets, identifying shifts in upper and mid-funnel metrics and preparing a narrative for your stakeholders. By midday, you're meeting with the integrated marketing or social media team to walk through how a recent campaign moved key brand metrics and where to optimize next. In the afternoon, you could be building audience segment profiles with internal data science partners or coordinating fieldwork with a vendor across several countries. Between meetings, you're refining dashboards, exploring automation opportunities, and connecting the dots between what the data says and what the business should do about it. Throughout, you're collaborating with country heads and senior leaders to ensure audience strategies and planning frameworks are grounded in real listener behavior.

About the team
As the Amazon Music Global Brand Insights team, we are responsible for producing best-in-class market research and customer insights. Our domain spans four key pillars: 1) Brand, 2) Go-to-Market (GTM), 3) Customer Lifecycle research, and 4) Audience, delivering data-driven, actionable recommendations for our business and brand. Our work is strategic in nature and aims to provide value to the entire organization, worldwide, and we are intentional about seeing insight through to action. Our overarching vision is to help teams across AM feel confident in making customer-obsessed decisions. We humanize complex data into compelling narratives and actionable strategies to drive growth for AM. We utilize a mix of traditional approaches and innovative methods to uncover both near- and long-term opportunities. We sit in the Marketing and Growth org, reporting to the Global Head of Brand Marketing.

Basic Qualifications

- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience in audience segmentation and targeting
- Experience in marketing or marketing research
- Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
- 5+ years experience managing brand health or brand tracking studies (e.g., survey design, fielding, and trend analysis)
- Experience managing external research vendors or agencies, including scoping, fieldwork coordination, and deliverable review
- Experience translating quantitative and qualitative research into written narratives and recommendations for business stakeholders
- 5+ years experience managing multiple concurrent research projects or deliverables on recurring timelines (e.g., quarterly reporting cycles)

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Salesforce and Tableau
- Experience with primary research methodologies — survey design, audience segmentation, profiling, and advanced analytical techniques (e.g., regression, driver analysis, meta-analysis)
- Experience leading market research or brand insights across multiple international markets or regions
- Experience measuring brand impact of cross-channel marketing campaigns using first- and third-party data sources
- Experience building interactive dashboards or self-service reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms) in partnership with data science teams
- Experience applying automation or AI tools to scale research production and delivery
- Experience working directly with senior leadership to influence annual planning, campaign strategy, or audience strategy
- Experience in the music, entertainment, media, or consumer technology industry
- Advanced degree (e.g., MBA or Master's) in Marketing, Market Research, Statistics, Psychology, Economics, or a related field

From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. As a Software Development Manager (SDM) for App Foundry, you would lead a talented team of engineers building the best in class playback and casting experiences for the iOS, Android, AlexaTablet, and FireTV platforms. You are expected to be a leader in technology, diving deep into problems you own, demonstrate excellent judgement in decision making, mentoring and growing talent. You inspire, motivate, drive a culture of innovation, implement engineering best practices, and are committed to delivering results. You define technical and business strategy which generate a positive experience for customers who consume music from different devices. You are an engineering leader in driving operational excellence by defining strategies, influencing roadmaps and raising the bar for our customers. As an engineering leader, you would be working directly with Music product management and various engineering leaders across Amazon to influence, design and deliver the organizational goals.


About the team
The Amazon Music App Foundry team is responsible for managing the native core platform and components for iOS, Android, and Alexa Tablet. We also also responsible for the native playback engine, stability, and release management. The tech stack is Kotlin, Swift, and C++.

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
- Experience in embedded development in C/C++

Description

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

Amazon Music is hiring a Sr Brand Manager to join our Artist Merchandise team. The Amazon Music Merchandise team is responsible for building a destination for official music merchandise and connecting fans and artists through merch. The Sr. Brand Manager role is responsible for the day-to-day brand management of our strategic 360 artist partners, delivering full-service coordination across creative services, apparel and accessory production, touring, ecommerce and pop-up events. This includes day to day management of event collection launches that are in line with the artist's brand vision, drive revenue growth, and build great artist partnerships. The successful candidate must have experience managing high profile artist relationships, 5+ years in the music industry with an emphasis on merchandise management inclusive of pitching and managing artist and artist teams, developing business plans for artist retail merchandise collections with a focus on revenue margin and driving significant top and bottom-line results, and managing multiple responsibilities, within an entrepreneurial, fast-paced environment.

Key job responsibilities
Own the end-to-end merchandise strategy for strategic artist partners, serving as the primary point of contact for artist teams/management

Pitch, secure, and manage artist merchandise partnerships that drive mutual value for artists and the Amazon Music Merch business

Develop and execute comprehensive business plans for artist retail merchandise collections, including creative development, strategic revenue targets, recoupment and growth strategies

Lead full-service coordination across creative services, apparel and accessory production, ecommerce, artist D2C, touring, and pop-ups

Collaborate with creative directors and manufacturers to develop innovative, on-brand products that resonate with fan communities

Manage day-to-day execution of event collection launches, ensuring alignment with brand vision while driving revenue to the bottom line

Own P&L accountability for assigned artist partnerships with a focus on revenue margin optimization and delivering significant top and bottom-line results

Leverage data and analytics to inform business decisions, identify growth opportunities, and measure collection performance

Work cross-functionally on Pan-Amazon initiatives, influencing merch involvement across livestreams, podcasts, special events, marquee marketing moments and more

Identify and evaluate new artist partnership opportunities that align with the business's growth strategy

Basic Qualifications

- 8 years in the Music Industry and artist management.
- 5+ years experience managing artist merchandise initiatives
- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Legal, Finance, and/or Senior Leadership)

Preferred Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in artist merchandise, licensed consumer products, or music industry brand development with demonstrated revenue growth
- Experience managing pop-up retail activations, live event merchandise, or experiential commerce programs
- Proven track record of building and scaling artist or talent-driven merchandise businesses, delivering measurable YoY revenue and margin improvement
- Experience leveraging data and analytics to inform product assortment decisions, identify growth opportunities, and optimize collection performance
- Deep relationships within the music industry, including artist management, labels, and creative agencies
- Experience working within a high-growth, entrepreneurial environment where you built processes and mechanisms from the ground up
- MBA or advanced degree in a related field

job.title: Administrative Assistant
job.description:
Position Summary

The Administrative Assistant reports to the Vice President, Finance and primarily supports the LAist newsroom and the Senior Vice President of News. The role provides day-to-day administrative and operational support to newsroom leadership, including proactive calendar management for the Senior Vice President of News; meeting coordination and follow-up; vendor, database, onboarding and offboarding, safety gear, and documentation management; and other activities that support an effective newsroom. The role also provides as-needed support to Development and Membership and serves as backup to the Senior Executive Assistant to the President & CEO, including assisting with organization-wide internal meetings such as all-staff meetings.

$25.60–$32.18 per hour. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

The Deputy Managing Editor will lead Marketplace’s YouTube and social video strategy, develop formats and franchises, and use audience and performance insights to guide investment. The role will initially manage the Director of Social Engagement and align social and video work around shared editorial, audience and revenue goals.

  • Lead Marketplace’s YouTube and social video strategy, including programming, packaging, discovery and audience retention.
  • Develop distinctive, repeatable video formats and franchises grounded in Marketplace’s business and economic journalism.

job.title: Senior Producer, MPR News with Angela Davis and Call to Mind
job.description:
Position Summary:

MPR News with Angela Davis is the conversation Minnesotans are already having with friends and family. Each hour digs deep into one topic, bringing in people with expertise and lived experience to put the news in context: how we got here, what’s changed, who the helpers are and what comes next. The show makes room for hard conversations while still making space for what’s good, joyful and possible, and listeners’ calls, stories and questions are essential to every hour. Our promise to listeners: You won’t always agree with what you hear, but you’ll leave understanding why others see things differently. So, let’s gather. We need to talk.

We’re looking for a senior producer to lead this award-winning show: a journalist who wants to put their news judgment, sourcing and storytelling to work in live conversation.

You don’t need a background in call-in programs. If you’ve spent your career reporting, editing or producing (finding the right source, asking the question nobody else has asked, making a complicated story make sense) you already do most of this job. A great hour of talk radio is journalism: a sharp angle, the right voices, and a host who is ready for anything. We’ll help you learn the rhythm of a audience-engagement-centered live show. We need you to bring the instincts.

On a typical day you might lead a morning team meeting, rework tomorrow’s show if news breaks, prepare Angela for a tough interview, call the shots in the control room while the phone lines light up, and then figure out how that conversation lives on as a podcast, a social clip and a story on mprnews.org.

While some public radio stations are stepping back from daily talk, MPR News is leaning in. This show is a break from traditional news: a curious, open and inviting host who is equal parts nosy neighbor and friend who keeps it real; conversations with people listeners wouldn’t normally meet; topics with real personal relevance; and voices from rural and metro Minnesota alike. We’re willing to sit in our feelings (laugh, cry, get mad), and we innovate and experiment with intention to find new ways to serve our audiences. You’ll also lead Call to Mind, the APM and MPR News mental health initiative, carrying forward its conversations, coverage and community partnerships.

MPR News is committed to local broadcasting and to equitable journalism that reflects a changing state. Minnesota is approaching 20 percent Black, Indigenous and People of Color, and the Twin Cities metro is approaching 30 percent. You’ll make sure the voices on the air reflect all of Minnesota, and you’ll help build and sustain a team that does too.

This position sits in the collective bargaining agreement between MPR and Screen Actors Guild—American Federation of Television and Radio Artists (“SAG-AFTRA”).

Expected Compensation Range: $83,640.00 - $100,368 per year. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

Location: Hybrid, St. Paul, MN

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled.

You might be a great fit if you:

  • Are a reporter, editor or producer who loves the interview and wonders what you could do with a whole hour.
  • Know how to find the person nobody else is calling, and how to get them to say yes.
  • Get energy from deadlines and the unpredictability of live broadcasting.
  • Can lean into a hard, necessary conversation and still find room for what’s joyful and possible.
  • Care about how journalism can help people talk more openly about mental health.
  • Think about how a story works on air, in a podcast feed, on social and on the web.
  • Want to lead by example and help other journalists do their best work.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Shape the show
    • Set daily and long-term editorial direction for MPR News with Angela Davis in partnership with the host, guided by the show’s promise to listeners.
    • Originate show ideas, find and book guests who bring both expertise and lived experience, produce segments, and write host prep that goes beyond the obvious.
    • Uphold MPR News standards for accuracy, fairness and balance on every platform; regularly assess the show’s tone, content and priorities.
    • Track the diversity of sources and work with the team to meet MPR News sourcing goals.
    • Make the audience a co-creator: build hours around listeners’ calls, stories and questions, and seek out voices from rural and metro Minnesota.
  • Run the room
    • Line produce the live broadcast: direct the control room, screen calls and adjust on the fly when news breaks.
    • Oversee editing, post-production, promos and archiving of the program.
    • Develop and produce special programs, events and remote broadcasts around the state.
  • Grow the audience
    • Grow the show’s on-demand, podcast and social audiences, and experiment with formats that reach listeners where they are.
    • Collaborate with reporters, editors and digital colleagues so the show’s conversations connect to and strengthen MPR News coverage.
    • Collaborate with Membership during fund drives.
  • Lead Call to Mind
    • Serve as senior producer for Call to Mind, the APM and MPR News mental health initiative, carrying forward its editorial work, events and partnerships.
    • Develop mental health conversations and special programming for MPR News with Angela Davis and other MPR News platforms.
    • Build and maintain relationships with community and mental health organizations, and evaluate partner pitches for events, panels and broadcasts.
    • Deliver a one-hour special hosted by Angela Davis and distributed nationally

  • Lead the team

    • Provide day-to-day editorial leadership to two producers and interns: assign and edit work and give regular, constructive feedback.
    • Foster a creative, inclusive culture that encourages experimentation, learning and growth.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Seven or more years of journalism experience (reporting, editing or producing in audio, digital, print or video), including at least three years producing or editing a program, podcast, documentary or investigative or multi-part series. Talk radio experience is not required.
  • Experience working closely with on-air talent, or conducting interviews for broadcast or podcast.
  • Experience leading projects and guiding the work of other journalists.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

job.title: Associate Director, Creative Membership
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

Job overview:

The Associate Director, Creative Membership leverages deep music industry knowledge to cultivate and maintain strong relationships within the London and European creative community and its surrounding areas. In this role, you will serve as a vital bridge to songwriters, publishers, major record labels, entertainment lawyers, managers, and talent agents. A primary emphasis is placed on enhancing ASCAP's local presence through active on-the-ground engagement, which includes attending live shows, hosting industry mixers, and conducting in-person meetings with ASCAP members and local executives.

This position is based in our London office and will report to the VP, Creative Membership located in London. This position currently is subject to ASCAP’s in office policy.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Discovery and development of talent, including songwriters, composers and producers, in the London, European, and surrounding area
  • Perform market research and partner closely with the London Creative Team to identify, attract, recruit and successfully transition local up-and-coming creators to ASCAP, in order to grow the value of the ASCAP repertory.
  • Support and maintain relationships within the London, Europe, and surrounding creative community, including songwriters, composers, publishers, major record labels, entertainment lawyers, managers, and agents.
  • Develop an understanding of ASCAP’s Survey and Distribution System and ASCAP membership policies and procedures, to confidently guide members through membership and distribution related inquiries.
  • Stay informed of, escalating and making viable recommendations to the relevant internal subject matter experts on effectively addressing member needs.
  • Partner with and support the London Creative Membership Team, as well as the Marketing & Communications team, to plan, curate, and host high-impact member events and recognition initiatives.
  • Act as a brand ambassador of ASCAP by attending industry panels, conferences and events.
  • Collaborate seamlessly across the ASCAP Creative Membership team to share best practices, align regional goals, and unify strategies.
  • Other duties and special projects as assigned

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required in Music Business, Business Administration, Communications, Marketing, or a related field required.
  • 5+ years of experience in the Music Industry.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, navigate ambiguous environments, and communicate with ASCAP leadership.
  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship building skills with the ability to represent ASCAP with poise and professionalism across diverse creator and executive groups.
  • Exceptional judgment.
  • Knowledge of and enthusiasm for the London and European music industry.
  • Ability to juggle priorities and be a team player.
  • Market research skills.
  • Will be required to travel and attend events, including ASCAP’s membership events, outside of office hours and/or overnight.
  • This position requires the incumbent to be in the office 3 days per week.

Occasional travel for in-person meetings may be required.

Please be aware that ASCAP is not a nut-free or other allergen-free workplace.

ASCAP is an equal opportunity employer. All ASCAP employment decisions are made on the basis of individual qualifications and performance and not on the basis of race, national origin, ethnicity, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, genetic information, disability, handicap, color, creed, religion, veteran status, or any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

job.title: Director, Security Engineering
job.description:
The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

About AP Cybersecurity 

Trust is AP's most important asset. Every day, AP journalists, systems and customers depend on technology that must be secure, resilient and available — in newsrooms, in the field and across a global content distribution network that serves media organizations and businesses around the world. 

AP's Cybersecurity team, part of the Technology organization under the Chief Technology Officer, protects AP's people, journalism, platforms and data. We build the security capabilities that let AP report from anywhere, deliver content in real time and adopt new technologies with confidence.  

 

Why this role matters:  

We are seeking a hands-on, strategic Director of Cyber Engineering to lead security engineering across product security, infrastructure and cloud security, cloud governance and network security. Reporting to the Senior Director of Cybersecurity, this is a senior leadership role within AP's security organization. 

You will inherit and lead a team of established engineers, set technical direction for security engineering and turn security strategy into platforms, controls and practices that scale. You will stay close enough to the technology to review architecture, challenge designs and help solve hard problems. 

Building strong partnerships across Technology and the wider AP organization will be central to this role. Security at AP succeeds through collaboration and this leader will help foster a culture where security is clearly understood, valued and built in from the start. 

 

What you will do:  

Lead Security Engineering Strategy & Architecture 

  • Define and execute a security engineering roadmap across products, infrastructure, cloud and network security, aligned with AP's technology and business priorities. 

  • Own security architecture standards and reference designs for AP's cloud, on-premises and network environments. 

  • Advance modern security models such as zero trust, least-privilege access and secure-by-default infrastructure. 

  • Evaluate emerging threats and technologies, including risks introduced by AI, and translate them into practical engineering priorities. 

Product Security 

  • Embed security into the software development lifecycle through threat modeling, secure design reviews, code and dependency scanning, and security testing. 

  • Partner with product and engineering teams to integrate security into CI/CD pipelines without slowing delivery. 

  • Establish clear, practical secure development standards and guidance for engineering teams. 

Infrastructure, Cloud Security & Governance 

  • Lead the security architecture and hardening of AP's cloud and infrastructure environments. 

  • Establish and maintain cloud governance, including policies, guardrails, configuration standards and posture management across cloud accounts and services. 

  • Drive security automation and infrastructure-as-code to improve consistency, reduce manual effort and scale controls. 

Network Security 

  • Own the strategy and engineering of AP's network security controls across offices, data centers, cloud and remote workforce. 

  • Modernize network security architecture, including segmentation, secure remote access and perimeter controls. 

Lead People & Build a Security Culture 

  • Lead, develop and grow a team of established security engineers, and build a culture of ownership, curiosity and continuous learning. 

  • Develop trusted relationships with stakeholders across Technology, product, newsroom, legal, commercial and business teams. 

  • Work with those partners to build and grow a security culture across AP, making secure choices the easy choices. 

  • Act as a senior technical leader during security incidents and turn lessons learned into lasting engineering improvements. 

  • Manage vendor relationships and budget for security engineering tools and services. 

  • Communicate risk, tradeoffs and progress clearly to technical teams, senior leadership and nontechnical audiences. 

 

Who you are: 

We expect strong candidates to bring many, but not necessarily all, of the following: 

  • Minimum 10+ years of experience in security engineering, security architecture or infrastructure engineering, including minimum 4+ years leading engineering teams. 

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.  

  • Deep hands-on experience in at least two of AP's focus areas (product security, cloud and infrastructure security, cloud governance or network security) and working knowledge of the others. 

  • Experience in major public cloud environments and hybrid infrastructure. 

  • Strong grounding in application security and DevSecOps practices in modern software environments. 

  • Experience designing and operating enterprise network security architectures. 

  • Experience with security automation, scripting or coding and infrastructure-as-code. 

  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence without authority across engineering, business and nontechnical teams. 

  • Experience leading security awareness, champions programs or other efforts to shift security culture. 

  • Sound risk judgment: the ability to prioritize what matters most and make pragmatic decisions with incomplete information. 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to senior leadership. 

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, OSCP or cloud security certifications are a plus. 

  • Experience in media, journalism or other high-visibility environments; supporting a global or distributed workforce; securing AI/ML systems; or growing a small team into a larger function is especially relevant but not required. 

 

 

Why This Role 

AP's journalism is only as trusted as the systems behind it. AP operates at a scale and risk profile few organizations share: a global newsroom, real-time distribution to customers worldwide, and a mission that depends on accuracy and trust. 

For a security engineering leader who wants to build, influence and protect something that matters, this is an opportunity to shape how one of the world's most trusted news organizations secures its people, platforms and journalism. 

 

Location:

This role is based in New York, NY. 

 

Why Join Us? 

  • A mission-driven, inclusive environment focused on both individual and collective success.
  • Opportunities for professional development to help you reach your career goals.
  • Access to tools, mentorship, and resources tailored to elevate your proficiency and contributions

 

Salary & Benefits: 

The anticipated salary range for this position is $160,000 - $180,000, based on a candidate’s skills, qualifications and location. The Associated Press offers comprehensive benefits, which include:   

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage   
  • Retirement benefits   
  • Company paid life insurance   
  • Paid vacation and sick days   
  • Paid parental leave for any new parent   
  • Mental well-being resources   

 



 

AP seeks to build an inclusive organization grounded in respect for differences. We support all aspects of diversity and provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, status as a veteran, or other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Video Journalist
job.description:
The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

 

The Associated Press seeks a nimble and enterprising video journalist to cover breaking news in Los Angeles, California. We’re looking for a creative visual storyteller with demonstrated experience independently reporting, shooting, editing and transmitting video, covering live events, writing text stories and making still photographs for news organizations. You’ll join a team delivering accurate, competitive coverage for national and global audiences across digital, mobile and broadcast platforms. This is a newsgathering staff position within U.S. News, covered by AP’s agreement with the News Media Guild.   Responsibilities: You’ll shoot, edit and produce video, including live video, and contribute substantive reporting across formats. You’ll independently gather and verify facts, conduct interviews, write breaking news updates and text stories, and make news photographs with accurate captions. You’ll set up and transmit live video from the field, coordinate feeds with receiving editors, monitor picture and sound, and resolve routine connection and signal problems. You’ll pitch, develop and research distinctive stories, collaborating with colleagues across text, photo, video, audio, digital/social, interactive and graphics. You may occasionally help edit and produce live video, affiliate contributions and video from other AP journalists. Covering extreme weather across California and elsewhere is an essential responsibility. This position requires travel to a variety of news events, sometimes with little to no advance notice, and reports to the US Assistant News Director overseeing California.   Required Qualifications:
  • At least three years of professional electronic newsgathering (ENG) and field videojournalism experience for a broadcast station, news agency, digital news outlet, newspaper or comparable news organization. Candidates must demonstrate direct responsibility for reporting, shooting, editing and filing news video under deadline. A bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience is required separately.
  • Demonstrated experience covering live events and fast-moving general breaking news, including severe weather, wildfires or other emergencies. Candidates must be able to identify the news, verify conflicting information, interview sources and explain the significance of local developments to national and global audiences.
  • Advanced professional competency in independently shooting news video with professional equipment, including manual control of focus, exposure and white balance, strong composition and visual sequencing, interview lighting and recording and monitoring clear interview audio and natural sound.
  • Proficiency in industry-standard editing software such as DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, with demonstrated ability to independently edit and transmit complete news packages and rapid updates to technical specifications under deadline.
  • Professional experience delivering live video and transmitting recorded material from the field using LiveU or comparable transmission systems, with the ability to coordinate coverage with receiving editors as news develops.
  • Demonstrated experience reporting and writing text stories for news organizations. Candidates must independently gather and verify information, conduct interviews, and write clear, accurate breaking news updates and complete news stories for editing. Contributing information to another reporter’s story alone does not demonstrate the required writing experience.
  • Demonstrated experience making still photographs for news organizations. Candidates must produce editorially usable news images, control focus and exposure, select and transmit photographs under deadline, and write accurate captions identifying people, locations and events.
  • Excellent news writing and scripting skills, advanced professional competency in written and spoken English, and experience or demonstrated ability to present accurate reporting on camera and/or on audio as assignments require.
  • Proven ability to make sound editorial decisions, manage competing priorities and deliver accurate coverage under deadline pressure. Strong organization, visual creativity, calmness under pressure, curiosity and a collaborative approach to producing trusted journalism are essential.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain sources, report across communities and quickly build working knowledge of California’s institutions and major news issues.
  • Ability and willingness to travel to assignments, sometimes with little to no advance notice, and work nights and weekends as news demands.
  • Ability to carry and operate video equipment and work for extended periods in varied terrain and weather conditions, with or without reasonable accommodation. AP will provide necessary protective equipment, safety training and ergonomic support.
  • All applicants must be able to work in the U.S. or be able to gain permission to do so.
  • You’ll pursue innovative and inclusive coverage while maintaining AP’s standards for accuracy, integrity and objectivity.
  Preferred Qualifications:

California reporting experience, existing California sources, experience in a global-news environment, longer-term enterprise work across formats, innovative digital storytelling and professional competency in a language besides English are preferred.

 

Why join us:

  • A mission-driven, inclusive environment focused on both individual and collective success. 
  • Opportunities for professional development to help you reach your career goals. 
  • Access to tools, mentorship, and resources tailored to elevate your proficiency and contributions.

job.title: Associate Editor, Breaking News
job.description:
