job.title: Operations Associate, Axios Live
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We're hiring an Operations Associate, Axios Live to support the day-to-day logistics for the events execution team for our rapidly expanding events business.

Why it matters: We need an Associate with events experience who can manage event materials, client-facing documents, and multiple front-of-house and back-of-house tasks on-site at events and in a virtual environment. This person will collaborate across the events team to research and build highly curated guest lists, track event analytics, support the creative team with creation and design of event elements (including signage creation, deck creation, etc), draft and send event attendee communications,  and perform relevant administrative tasks 

Go deeper: This role has operational responsibilities and will often work on multiple, concurrent in-person events while moving at a fast pace.

Key Responsibilities:

Event Support & Execution

  • Assist in the planning and execution of live, virtual, and hybrid events—including setup, breakdown, and onsite guest check-in support.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed event documentation such as seating charts, packing lists, and event deliverables.
  • Support the team in real-time problem-solving and coordination during live events.

Guest List & Research

  • Help manage RSVPs, guest confirmations, and check-in tools.
  • Partner with editorial and marketing teams to ensure strategic guest outreach and an excellent pre and post event audience experience. 

Project & Task Coordination

  • Help coordinate deliverables across internal and external stakeholders, such as vendors, designers, and content teams 
  • Manage multiple competing priorities, providing timely updates and flagging any risks to deadlines or details. 
  • Track administrative follow-ups such as invoicing, shipping logistics, and deliverable collection.

Administrative & Logistical Support

  • Book photographers, travel, and accommodations; submit invoices and process expense reports.
  • Maintain updated records of contracts, agreements, and documentation for vendors
  • Organize and ship event materials (signage, swag, collateral) as needed.
  • Develop and maintain registration pages, ensuring details and accuracy at all times.

The details: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, a passion for Axios’ mission and have the following skills:

  • 1–3 years of experience in events, marketing, project coordination, executive support, or a related field.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and multitasking ability.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Events experience is required
  • Extremely detail oriented and organized
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication, organizational, and time management skills
  • Flexible with a proven ability to think critically in high pressure situations
  • Ability to multitask and meet deadlines
  • Positive, collaborative attitude
  • Competent in Microsoft Word, Excel and Powerpoint
  • Familiarity with event marketing  platforms (i.e. Splash and Sailthru)
  • Experience with Adobe Suite products is a plus
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and event tools such as Splash, Cvent, or Airtable is a plus.
  • Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively across teams.
  • Willingness to travel and work non-standard hours for event support, including early mornings or evenings when required.

job.title: Salesforce Business Analyst
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a modern media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are hiring a Salesforce Business Analyst to help build and scale our CRM, reporting, and analytics capabilities, as part of our Revenue Operations team.

Why it matters: This role owns and administers our Salesforce Media Cloud instance, ensuring the platform supports the needs of our revenue organization and serves as a trusted source of data. Beyond day-to-day Salesforce administration, this role will develop reporting, analytics, and insights that turn revenue data into meaningful business intelligence. This role will report to the Senior Director of Revenue Strategy and Operations. 

Go deeper: This is an opportunity for someone early in their Salesforce and Revenue Operations career who wants hands-on ownership while expanding their skills across systems, processes, and analytics. You’ll partner closely with Revenue Enablement, Client Partnerships, Client Experience, and Business Development teams to solve business challenges, improve revenue processes, and help teams use Salesforce and data more effectively. Responsibilities include:

  • Serve as the day-to-day administrator for Salesforce Media Cloud, managing users, permissions, page layouts, flows, reports, dashboards, validation rules, and automation.
  • Partner with Revenue Strategy & Enablement, Revenue Operations, and sales leadership to translate business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions and operational improvements.
  • Build and optimize a Salesforce environment that supports Axios’ evolving revenue organization, sales processes, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and recurring analyses that give executives, sales leadership, and cross-functional partners actionable visibility into business performance, sales metrics, and KPIs.
  • Support data migration and ongoing data management efforts, ensuring data quality, integrity, consistency, and governance across Salesforce.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows, streamline processes, and improve operational efficiency across the revenue organization.
  • Support sales planning and performance management, including sales goals, conversion and segment analysis, Quarterly Business Reviews, and weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting.
  • Troubleshoot user and system issues, recommend scalable solutions, and support testing, deployment, and change management for Salesforce releases and enhancements.
  • Create and maintain documentation, best practices, and training materials while supporting user adoption of Salesforce functionality, reporting tools, and revenue processes.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, have a passion for the Axios mission, and the following skills and experience:

  • 1–2 years of Salesforce Administrator experience.
  • 1–2 years of experience in sales operations or sales analytics.
  • Salesforce Administrator Certification (ADM-201) or plans to obtain certification within the first year.
  • Experience helping build or significantly expand a Salesforce organization from the ground up, or participating in a major Salesforce implementation.
  • Experience building flows, reports, dashboards, validation rules, and custom objects.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, profiles, permission sets, and data management best practices.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills and a customer-service mindset when supporting end users.
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements and improve business processes.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with Salesforce Media Cloud.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with third-party applications.
  • Experience supporting a Salesforce data migration from one CRM or Salesforce org to another.
  • Experience working in the media industry.

Within your first year, you'll help establish a scalable Salesforce foundation that supports Axios' revenue organization by:

  • Delivering a stable, well-governed Salesforce environment that users trust.
  • Successfully supporting the migration from our legacy CRM while maintaining data quality.
  • Improving automation and reducing manual administrative work across revenue teams.
  • Increasing Salesforce adoption through thoughtful training, documentation, and user support.
  • Partnering with cross-functional teams to improve how they leverage data and analytics to understand their business.

job.title: Senior Security Engineer
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a respected media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format known as Smart Brevity™. We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure and AI security experience to lead our defensive posture, drive threat modeling and vulnerability management, and embed security controls - including AI-driven defense and monitoring - across our platform and automation pipelines.

Why it matters: As a Senior Security Engineer at Axios, you will architect and implement proactive security strategies to protect our audience, platform, and data assets against evolving threat vectors, including AI-driven attacks. In this role, you will define our security roadmap, leverage internal and third-party AI defense tools, and ensure our cloud systems remain resilient, secure by default, and capable of automated threat detection and response.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architectural design and implementation of security controls across cloud infrastructure, platform services, and AI integrations.
  • Drive vulnerability management, threat modeling, incident response, and proactive security assessments across AWS, Kubernetes, and AI application environments.
  • Shape, maintain, and execute the company’s long-term security roadmap in close alignment with engineering and executive leadership.
  • Embed automated security testing, SAST/DAST, and AI-driven compliance checks directly into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code workflows.
  • Oversee identity and access management (IAM), secrets management, encryption protocols, and zero-trust architecture standards.
  • Evaluate, deploy, and maintain internal AI security tools and modern third-party defensive solutions to detect, mitigate, and respond to AI-driven threats and sophisticated attack vectors in real time.
  • Promote a strong security culture across engineering by conducting threat modeling workshops and coaching teams on secure coding and infrastructure practices.
  • Partner with product, infrastructure, data, and QE teams to ensure security is integrated seamlessly into every stage of the development lifecycle.

Skills:

  • Deep expertise in cloud and application security, including threat modeling, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, IAM, secrets management, AI security, and compliance frameworks.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS infrastructure and security controls (IAM, KMS, EKS, RDS, S3).
  • Experience hardening Kubernetes clusters, runtime security, container scanning, and network policy enforcement.
  • Proficiency in integrating SAST/DAST and security automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions).
  • Solid scripting or programming skills in Python, Go, or Bash for security tooling and automated remediation.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM, security logging, automated threat intelligence, and AI-powered monitoring frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or modern SOC tooling).
  • Demonstrated leadership in driving security initiatives, defining policy, and guiding engineering teams on security risk.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively balance security requirements and business agility.

What success looks like:

  • Security & Compliance: Focused on proactive security initiatives, including automated vulnerability scans, implementation of controls, remediation, and contributions to the long-term security roadmap.
  • Cloud Security Architecture: Hardened, reviewed, and optimized AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure security to meet strict compliance, resilience, and least-privilege access standards.
  • DevSecOps & Automation: Integrated automated security scans, secret detection, and vulnerability gates seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines without disrupting developer velocity.
  • Security Tooling Adoption: Evaluated, piloted, and deployed advanced security and defensive AI tools that measurably enhanced threat detection speed and reduced exposure risk.
  • Threat Detection & Response: Established robust security monitoring, SIEM alerting, and incident response playbooks to maintain real-time visibility and rapid response capabilities across all production platforms.
  • Cross-Functional Security Leadership: Partnered with engineering, product, and QE teams to instill a security-first culture, conduct threat modeling workshops, and guide technical teams on risk mitigation.
  • AI Defense & Security: Evaluated and deployed internal AI security tools and 3rd-party defensive solutions to proactively safeguard infrastructure, applications, and corporate assets against AI-driven threats and emerging attack vectors.

job.title: Beasley Media Group
job.description:
Thanks for visiting our Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications.

Account Executive

Augusta, GA Full Time Mid Level Share Account Executive

Position Summary

As an Account Executive, you will serve as a trusted marketing consultant to local businesses and advertising agencies, helping clients achieve their business goals through innovative advertising and marketing solutions. This role combines prospecting, relationship building, strategic planning, and revenue generation across Beasley Media Group's portfolio of broadcast, digital, streaming, event, and experiential marketing assets.

The ideal candidate is a motivated self-starter with a passion for sales, strong communication skills, and the ability to develop long-term client partnerships while driving new business growth.

Key Qualifications

  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented professional who thrives both independently and in a collaborative team environment.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities with attention to detail.
  • Effective negotiator with a customer-focused, consultative sales approach.
  • Ability to identify client needs, develop strategic recommendations, and deliver impactful marketing solutions.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and sales pipeline management.
  • Passion for building relationships and creating measurable results for clients.
  • Valid driver's license, proof of insurance, and reliable transportation required.
  • Employment is contingent upon successful completion of an MVR check.

Essential Responsibilities

Business Development & Sales

  • Generate new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, referrals, and outreach efforts.
  • Maintain and grow existing account relationships while increasing revenue and market share.
  • Develop integrated marketing solutions utilizing Beasley Media Group's full suite of advertising platforms.
  • Create and deliver compelling sales presentations and marketing proposals to local businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Identify client business challenges and recommend customized advertising and marketing strategies.
  • Secure sponsorships, promotional partnerships, experiential marketing opportunities, and digital advertising campaigns.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals.

Client Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers, stakeholders, and business owners.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, ensuring exceptional customer service and responsiveness.
  • Regularly communicate with clients regarding campaign performance, marketing initiatives, sponsorships, and business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through upselling and cross-selling solutions.

Strategic Planning & Market Research

  • Prepare thoroughly for all client interactions by researching industries, market conditions, business objectives, and competitive trends.
  • Analyze client needs, target audiences, and historical advertising investment to develop effective recommendations.
  • Stay informed on emerging advertising, media, digital marketing, and consumer behavior trends.
  • Utilize market insights and audience data to enhance client outcomes and sales effectiveness.

Product & Industry Expertise

  • Maintain comprehensive knowledge of Beasley Media Group's products, platforms, pricing, audience insights, and marketing capabilities.
  • Continuously expand expertise in radio, digital advertising, streaming audio, video, events, promotions, and experiential marketing.
  • Understand competitive offerings and effectively position Beasley Media Group's advantages in the marketplace.

Administrative & Reporting Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records, activity logs, and sales opportunities within the company CRM.
  • Effectively manage schedules, appointments, account plans, and follow-up activities.
  • Provide timely sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and performance reports as requested by management.
  • Document client interactions and strategic account activities to support business growth and customer retention.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Maintain regular communication with leadership regarding sales activity, pipeline development, client opportunities, and business needs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful execution of advertising campaigns and client initiatives.
  • Support client events, promotions, and experiential marketing activities as needed.
  • Contribute positively to a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently meeting or exceeding revenue goals.
  • Developing strong client relationships that result in long-term partnerships.
  • Generating new business opportunities and expanding existing accounts.
  • Delivering strategic marketing solutions that help clients achieve measurable business results.
  • Serving as a knowledgeable and trusted advisor within the local advertising community.

Beasley Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The ideal candidate is a strong business leader with a proven track record of revenue generation, team development, and market influence. This individual will inspire cross-functional teams while ensuring alignment with company objectives and delivering exceptional results for advertisers, listeners, and community partners.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Market Strategy

  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Build strong relationships with local business leaders, community organizations, and key stakeholders.
  • Represent Beasley Media Group within the market and at industry events.

Revenue Growth

Operational Excellence

  • Monitor market KPIs and implement corrective action plans when necessary.
  • Collaborate with corporate leadership to support company initiatives and strategic priorities.

Community Impact

  • Champion diversity, inclusion, and community engagement initiatives.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Media Management, or related field; equivalent experience will be considered.

Why Join Beasley Media Group?

job.title: Morning Show Co-Host / Producer & Assistant Program Director
job.description:
Position Overview
96.3 KKLZ, Las Vegas' heritage Classic Hits station, is searching for an experienced, creative, and entertaining Morning Show Co-Host to join our established morning team.
We're looking for a dynamic personality with a quick wit, strong conversational instincts, and the ability to connect with listeners through humor, storytelling, and relatable content.
This is a hands-on position requiring a versatile broadcaster who can entertain, create, produce, and execute. The successful candidate will serve as a primary on-air personality while also operating the broadcast console and sharing responsibility for daily show preparation and production.

The ideal candidate brings strong ideas, exceptional chemistry, and a collaborative spirit. We want someone who can lead a conversation, share the spotlight, and help create memorable radio every morning.

In addition to morning show duties, this role will provide hands-on daily support to the Programming Department, assisting with music scheduling, log management, and station imaging maintenance. 

Key Responsibilities
On-Air Performance & Content Development
  • Serve as a primary morning show personality, sharing responsibility for the show's entertainment, content, and overall success.
  • Develop and deliver compelling, original content, including topical discussions, humor, storytelling, interviews, and recurring features.
  • Research and prepare relevant daily topics that resonate with the station's adult audience.
  • Demonstrate strong conversational chemistry, improvisational skills, comedic timing, and the ability to engage listeners.
  • Collaborate with fellow hosts to plan show content, develop creative ideas, and maintain a consistent, entertaining presentation.
Broadcast Operations & Production
  • Operate the broadcast console and automation system during live programming.
  • Execute music, commercials, audio elements, contests, and scheduled programming with accuracy and precision.
  • Maintain proper show pacing, timing, and seamless transitions.
  • Share responsibility for producing, editing, and preparing audio elements, including interviews, comedy bits, recurring features, and other show content.
  • Assist with daily show preparation, organization, and execution without reliance on a dedicated producer.
  • Troubleshoot routine technical issues and coordinate with engineering or programming staff as needed.
Programming & Music Support 
  • Assist the Program Director with daily programming operations, including music scheduling, log editing, and log reconciliation.
  • Coordinate and maintain station imaging, liners, promos, and syndicated programming elements.
  • Monitor on-air execution to ensure format clocks, commercial breaks, and programming standards are met consistently. 
Station & Audience Engagement
  • Participate in station promotions, live appearances, community events, and special programming.
  • Engage listeners through phone calls, contests, social media, and other interactive platforms.
  • Contribute to the station's digital presence through engaging and brand-appropriate content.
  • Collaborate with programming, promotions, and sales teams to support station initiatives.
  • Represent KKLZ and Beasley Media Group professionally on and off the air.

Required Qualifications
  • Professional on-air radio experience, preferably in a live, multi-host morning show environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to create and deliver compelling, personality-driven radio content.
  • Experience operating a broadcast console and radio automation systems.
  • Proficiency with digital audio editing and production software.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, improvisational, and interviewing skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, self-motivation, and the ability to independently prepare content.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously during a live broadcast.
  • Strong understanding of radio formatics, show pacing, and audience engagement.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively, accept direction, and contribute to a positive team environment.
  • Willingness to work early morning hours and participate in occasional station events outside regular broadcast hours.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Proven success as a primary morning show personality.
  • Experience developing and producing original comedy bits, recurring features, and entertaining audio content.
  • Familiarity with Classic Hits or other mainstream, adult-targeted radio formats.
  • Experience with social media, video production, and digital audience engagement.
  • Knowledge of the Las Vegas market and local community.
  • Hands-on experience with music scheduling software (such as MusicMaster, Selector, or Powergold) and daily broadcast log management. 

The Ideal Candidate
We're looking for a well-rounded broadcaster who loves creating great radio.
Someone who can generate compelling ideas, deliver a great punchline, tell a memorable story, and make their co-host shine. Someone who understands how to balance spontaneity with preparation and entertainment with the demands of a music-intensive format.
You should be equally comfortable behind the microphone, behind the board, and behind the scenes preparing the content that makes a morning show successful.
Most importantly, we're looking for someone who understands that the best morning shows are built on chemistry, creativity, collaboration, and a genuine connection with the audience.

About 96.3 KKLZ
96.3 KKLZ is a heritage Las Vegas radio station delivering Classic Hits, engaging personalities, and strong community connections. As part of Beasley Media Group, KKLZ is committed to creating compelling local radio that entertains and connects with listeners.
Location: Las Vegas, Nevada
Position: Full-Time Morning Show Co-Host / Board Operator
Schedule: Weekday mornings, with additional station appearances as needed

Beasley Media Group LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

job.description:
Req Id: 433546

 

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day. 

 

We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell. 

 

 

Be at the forefront of one of the most exciting and ever-changing industries. On the Bell Media team you will be a part of creating and delivering the best Canadian and international content across digital media, television, radio and out-of-home advertising platforms. You’ll join a team of passionate and driven innovators, who are breaking barriers and expanding the reach of Canada’s most-loved entertainment.

 

At Bell Media, you’ll redefine digital connections and pioneer next-generation services, propelling us to reach new heights, unlock untapped potential and expand horizons for our customers.

 

Job Description

The national journalist is responsible for producing original and/or high-impact reports on Québec, Canadian and international news topics that are broadcast on nationwide programs, while providing distinctive coverage on various broadcasting platforms. This position requires advanced journalistic expertise and the ability to deal with complex, high-impact topics on a regular basis, and entails conducting interviews with key figures in the news. The multiplatform journalist operates in a highly competitive environment, under constant pressure, with nationwide visibility.

Critical Qualifications

  • Suggest and develop original topics
  • Cover events for TV and digital, conduct interviews, write texts
  • Shoot his or her own images; set up / edit / shed light on and produce news reports for both TV and digital
  • Deliver a dynamic presentation live and in studio
  • Adapt formats to digital trends
  • Ability to have a comprehensive view of national and international news and to be able to explain it in simple terms
  • Ability to be deployed daily in real time on national news
  • Ability to travel quickly in the field to cover international issues
  • Cope with the daily pressure of a national audience and the resulting feedback
  • Maintain and develop a network of reliable and specialized contacts
  • Follow editorial standards and guidelines regarding accuracy, ethics and legal issues
  • Ensure that equipment and cell phone are in good working order
  • Configure and use live equipment as needed
  • Perform any other related tasks requested by the immediate supervisor

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, film, communications or the equivalent
  • Minimum of five years of experience in television / the Internet
  • Proven experience in news reporting, and ability to perform in front of the camera
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills and knowledge of local, national and international news and current events
  • Excellent writing and presentation skills
  • Good understanding of social media and its audience
  • Proven filming and editing abilities
  • Proven organizational skills, and ability to work autonomously under tight deadlines
  • Good editorial judgment; demonstrated ability to produce original, enterprising news reports
  • Ability to manage new and emerging technologies
  • Knowledge of iNews an asset
  • Valid driver’s licence and good record

job.title: Principal DevOps Engineer
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Principal DevOps Engineer is the organization’s senior individual contributor for enterprise DevOps and platform engineering. This role defines and evolves cloud, automation, software delivery, and operational reliability patterns that align Architecture and business strategy. The position leads the design of secure, scalable Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS) platforms; establishes reusable infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, GitOps, observability, and governance capabilities; and sets technical standards adopted across Development, Architecture, Security, Network, Infrastructure, and Operations. Azure DevOps is the organization’s standard source-control, build, and deployment platform for application and infrastructure delivery across both cloud environments. The Principal DevOps Engineer serves as a hands-on technical authority, leads complex cross-functional initiatives and proofs of concept, mentors engineers, and uses measurable outcomes to continuously improve developer experience, delivery performance, resiliency, security, and operational efficiency.

FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB

Essential Functions

Own the enterprise technical strategy and reference architecture for DevOps, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, software delivery, and engineering automation, translating business and Architecture direction into actionable standards and roadmaps.

Design, implement, and support secure, resilient, scalable cloud infrastructure and shared platform services across Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS), including Kubernetes, containers, networking, identity, compute, storage, data, and other cloud-native capabilities.

Architect and govern infrastructure as code using Terraform, including reusable modules, versioning, automated validation and testing, remote state management, policy checks, controlled promotion, and lifecycle management.

Define and evolve enterprise CI/CD and software-delivery patterns using Azure DevOps as the organization’s standard source-control, build, and deployment platform, including Azure Repos, Azure Pipelines, quality gates, artifact management, release controls, progressive delivery, rollback, and traceability across Azure and AWS environments.

Lead GitOps architecture and deployment practices using Azure DevOps, Argo CD, Helm, Kubernetes, and related technologies; establish secure, repeatable patterns for containerized and cloud-native workloads across Azure and AWS.

Create automation and platform capabilities using PowerShell, Bash, Python, APIs, SDKs, and event-driven integrations to reduce manual work, improve consistency, and increase engineering throughput.

Establish Git and repository governance, including branching strategies, pull-request and code-review standards, release practices, dependency management, and software supply-chain controls.

Design and enforce multi-cloud governance and security controls across Azure and AWS, including policy as code, identity and access integration, secrets and certificate management, network and workload security requirements, resource organization and tagging, cost governance, compliance evidence, and automated guardrails.

Define the enterprise observability strategy across Azure and AWS using Datadog and OpenTelemetry as cross-platform capabilities, together with cloud-native telemetry services such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Amazon CloudWatch; establish standards for logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, service-level indicators, actionable alerting, and operational telemetry.

Lead reliability engineering practices across Azure and AWS, including service-level objectives, capacity planning, performance engineering, high availability, disaster recovery, operational readiness, incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action follow-through.

Monitor and analyze key delivery, reliability, security, and platform-adoption metrics; identify systemic constraints and lead improvements that produce measurable business and engineering outcomes.

Chair or provide technical authority for architecture reviews, platform design decisions, change-control standards, and quality and testing requirements for software and infrastructure builds and deployments.

Lead complex technology evaluations and proofs of concept; document findings, risks, total-cost and operational trade-offs, and recommendations for leadership.

Create and maintain reference architectures, implementation guides, reusable templates, technical standards, decision records, training materials, and operational procedures for varied technical and executive audiences.

Provide expert consultation, technical leadership, coaching, and mentoring to DevOps, platform, development, and infrastructure engineers without requiring direct people-management responsibility.

Facilitate alignment across Development, Architecture, Security, Network, Infrastructure, and Operations teams; resolve cross-domain technical issues and influence adoption of enterprise standards.

Participate in development, testing, deployment, implementation, and continuous-improvement activities across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

Lead multiple concurrent initiatives of high scope, ambiguity, risk, and organizational impact; communicate status, decisions, dependencies, and risks clearly to leadership and stakeholders.

Ensure completeness, accuracy, accessibility, and currency of required technical documentation.

Support organizational values and cultivate a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, diversity, inclusion, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.

Perform other duties as assigned.

POSITION QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

Education

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience.

Experience

Ten (10) or more years of progressive experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, software engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a related technical field.

Five (5) or more years designing, implementing, managing, and supporting enterprise cloud infrastructure and cloud-based platforms in Microsoft Azure and/or Amazon Web Services (AWS), with demonstrated ability to design and operate across multi-cloud environments.

Demonstrated experience functioning as a senior technical lead, principal engineer, architect, or equivalent authority for enterprise-scale DevOps or platform engineering initiatives.

Hands-on experience designing and operating distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, containerized workloads, and production services in a large enterprise environment.

Progressive achievement in job history, including successful delivery of complex, cross-functional initiatives with measurable technical or operational outcomes.

Required Technical Expertise

Expert-level infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform, including reusable module design, testing, state and dependency management, upgrade strategy, drift detection, and governed deployment workflows.

Expert-level design and implementation of CI/CD and release-engineering systems using Azure DevOps, including Azure Repos and Azure Pipelines, for application and infrastructure delivery across Azure and AWS.

Advanced Kubernetes and container-platform expertise, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), Helm, GitOps with Argo CD, workload security, cluster operations, upgrades, scaling, networking, storage, and troubleshooting.

Advanced automation and software-development capability using PowerShell, Bash, Python, APIs, SDKs, and Git-based development practices.

Deep understanding of Azure and AWS governance, policy as code, identity and access management, secrets and certificate automation, network security, DevSecOps, software supply-chain security, resource organization, tagging, and cloud cost controls.

Advanced multi-cloud observability and reliability engineering experience using Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Amazon CloudWatch, or comparable tooling, including SLOs, actionable alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis.

Expert understanding of SDLC automation, Agile delivery, design and development practices, testing standards, change control, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and operational readiness.

Ability to develop reference architectures and technical standards that balance security, reliability, developer experience, cost, maintainability, and speed of delivery.

Leadership and Professional Capabilities

Operates independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and exercises sound judgment when requirements are incomplete or priorities conflict.

Influences technical direction across teams and levels through credibility, facilitation, clear decision frameworks, and evidence-based recommendations.

Communicates complex technical concepts effectively to engineering, security, architecture, operations, business, and executive audiences.

Demonstrates exceptional analytical, systems-thinking, troubleshooting, problem-solving, presentation, and technical-writing skills.

Mentors engineers, promotes knowledge sharing, and raises engineering quality through reviews, standards, pairing, and practical guidance.

Demonstrates strong attention to detail, accountability, collaboration, open communication, and commitment to engineering excellence.

Must be willing to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, when required to support releases, incidents, or critical initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience establishing an internal developer platform, paved-road or golden-path capabilities, self-service infrastructure, or developer portals.

Experience applying FinOps practices, cloud cost allocation, capacity optimization, and unit-cost or consumption metrics to platform decisions.

Experience with enterprise risk, regulatory, audit, or compliance requirements and automated evidence collection.

Relevant professional certification such as Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional, AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, or comparable credentials.

MACHINES, TOOLS, EQUIPMENT AND WORK AIDS

Personal computer and associated software; Microsoft Azure; Amazon Web Services (AWS); Azure DevOps; Azure Repos; Azure Pipelines; Terraform; Kubernetes; AKS; EKS; Argo CD; Helm; PowerShell; Bash; Python; APIs and SDKs; Datadog; Azure Monitor; Application Insights; Amazon CloudWatch; OpenTelemetry; artifact-management, security, collaboration, and documentation platforms; and standard office equipment.

LICENSE(S) / CERTIFICATIONS REQUIRED

None required. Relevant advanced Azure, AWS, DevOps, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code certifications are preferred.

JOB DESCRIPTION NOTICE

This job description does not state or imply that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees may be required to follow other job-related instructions and perform other job-related duties as requested, subject to all applicable state and federal laws. “Commonly associated” is not intended to mean always or only. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

COMPENSATION

The salary range is $140,000-$160,000 USD per year, depending on experience, qualifications, and skills. This role may also be eligible for incentives, benefits, and other rewards as part of BMI’s total rewards package.

job.title: Sr. Quality Assurance Analyst
job.description:
Position Summary

Define and execute quality strategies for BMI’s music rights, copyright, and technology platforms in partnership with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

Deliver functional, automated, API, data, integration, performance, and security testing for cloud applications and complex data workflows. Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate QA while independently validating generated output.

Core Responsibilities

Functional & Data Testing

·       Execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and system tests across UI, APIs, backend services, batch processes, and data workflows.

·       Validate music rights, copyright, ownership, and royalty-related data, including works, cues, writers, publishers, shares, territories, agreements.

·       Validate data integrity and transformations across DB2, PostgreSQL, APIs, and downstream systems using SQL.

·       Develop test strategies, plans, cases, scenarios, and test data; reproduce, document, and track defects through resolution.

Test Automation & AI-Assisted QA

·       Build reusable UI, API, and backend automation with Playwright, Cucumber/Gherkin, Selenium WebDriver, REST-based tools, or comparable frameworks.

·       Integrate automated execution, reporting, regression suites, and quality gates into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.

·       Use AI for test generation, automation, synthetic data, documentation, defect analysis, and coverage gaps; independently validate generated tests and results.

Cloud, DevOps & Security Testing

·       Test Azure-hosted applications and distributed services; use Azure DevOps for test planning, work items, defects, and release validation.

·       Troubleshoot applications, APIs, databases, cloud services, and test environments using Datadog, logs, metrics, Linux, and command-line tools.

·       Test OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and Microsoft Entra ID authentication and authorization, including sign-in, service-to-service access, tokens, roles, and denied-access scenarios.

Performance & Reliability Testing

·       Run performance, load, scalability, and reliability tests with Apache JMeter, Lighthouse, or equivalent tools across applications, APIs, databases, and workflows.

·       Validate response-time, throughput, concurrency, and reliability targets; isolate performance hot spots with engineering.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Experience & Technical Qualifications

·       5–8 years of software QA experience, including substantial hands-on functional testing and automation in Agile teams.

·       Strong cloud testing experience, preferably Microsoft Azure, and hands-on Azure DevOps expertise in test management, defects, and CI/CD automation.

·       Experience testing data-intensive applications, APIs, backend services, batch processing, ingestion pipelines, and distributed systems.

·       Hands-on DB2, PostgreSQL, or comparable database experience, with SQL-based validation of complex transformations.

·       Automation with Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, Cucumber/Gherkin, or comparable frameworks; API testing with Thunder Client or equivalent tools.

·       Performance testing with Apache JMeter, Lighthouse, or similar tools, particularly for Java services and data-intensive applications.

·       Practical AI-assisted QA experience with independent output validation; familiarity with Datadog or similar diagnostics, Linux, and command-line tools.

·       Experience testing OAuth 2.0/OIDC and Microsoft Entra ID, including JWT access tokens, client-credentials flows, and role/permission-based access.

Preferred Domain Experience

Music industry technology or data experience is strongly desired, especially music rights, copyright administration, publishing, royalty processing, repertoire, and ownership data.

Skills & Abilities

·       Bridge business validation and technical troubleshooting; design maintainable automation and apply strong analytical skills and attention to data accuracy.

·       Communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders; work independently and manage quality across concurrent Agile projects.

Location Requirements

This person must be based in the Nashville area. While the position will have flexibility to work remotely, the candidate must be able to come into the office for the duration of their onboarding, as well as at an ongoing basis as needed.

We're looking for someone with exceptional digital acumen to act as our Digital Media Strategist in the Seattle market. In addition, this person will work as a trusted consultant providing recommendations of digital advertising strategies to reach key performance goals and providing evaluations of relevant digital performance metrics.

  • Extensive knowledge and experience with DV360, Google Ads, Google Analytics (G4) and TapClicks.

POSITION PURPOSE:

Bonneville Sacramento is seeking a dynamic General Sales Manager to oversee and lead, develop, and inspire our sales team. In this role you’ll help grow revenue and market share across all brands and platforms buidling strong client relationships, creating integrated marketing solutions, and coaching Account Executives to deliver meanginful results for clients.

 

You’ll own sales strategies, budgets, pricing, and inventory management to meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals. As a creative problem solver and motivating leader, you’ll attract and develop top sales talent, foster a collaborative, high-performing culture, and help bring Bonneville International Corporation’s vision, commitments, and values to life.

 

Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.


  • This position is an onsite role that requires the employee to primarily work at our Sacramento site. Specific schedules will be determined based on business needs and evaluated by managers and senior management.

 

What You Will Do:


  • Build and develop a strong sales team. Recruit and attract top talent, and support their success through coaching, training, goal setting, and performance management.

  • Own revenue growth across brands and platforms. Develop and maintain actionable sales strategies to meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual broadcast and digital budgets, increase market share, and improve year-over-year performance.

  • Drive new and existing business. Lead the team in securing transactional business, developing new business, and growing existing client relationships through solutions that address clients’ marketing needs.

  • Create integrated, client-focused marketing solutions. Help the team combine radio, online, mobile, social media, and sponsorship opportunities to deliver results for clients.

  • Maximize inventory and revenue. Manage advertising inventory, pricing, and rate negotiations to achieve sales goals and maximize revenue.

  • Provide consistent, hands-on leadership. Hold weekly one-on-one meetings with Account Executives to review budgets, account progress, and sales activity; lead weekly staff meetings; regularly join sales calls; and participate in other applicable meetings.

  • Lead ongoing learning and development. Plan and deliver training that strengthens the Sacramento sales team’s professional skills and understanding of new and evolving media.

  • Champion your assigned brands. Represent and advocate for the brands internally and externally, building strong relationships with sales representatives, buyers, planners, and clients.

  • Collaborate across sales leadership. Partner with other Sales Managers and the Director of Sales on forecasting, inventory, sales goals, pricing, presentations, revenue-gap solutions, and day-to-day sales activities, encouraging creativity and a unified team effort.

  • Partner across departments to deliver client results. Work closely with Program Directors, Digital Teams, and Marketing to develop and execute effective client solutions.

  • Foster a culture of sales excellence. Set high standards for professionalism, ethics, integrity, customer service, and performance while encouraging collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

 

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:


  • Relevant education and experience. College degree in business, communications, sales, marketing, related field or equivalent experience, preferred. At least five years’ successful sales experience, including two or more years effectively managing a team to achieve sales objectives.

 

  • An inspiring leadership approach. Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing team in a positive, collaborative sales environment

  • Strong multi-platform sales expertise. Knowledge of ad agency, direct, digital, and sponsorship sales with a proven record of achieving budgets across multiple platforms.

  • Sound pricing and negotiation skills. A strong understanding of inventory management and effective pricing, along with the ability to negotiate successfully and identify upselling opportunities.

  • Technology and audience-measurement proficiency. Strong proficiency across Microsoft Office applications and a thorough understanding of Nielsen ratings. Experience with sales management systems such as WideOrbit and Boostr is preferred.

  • Analytical thinking and follow-through. Ability to organize, analyze, and interpret statistical data, draw sound conclusions, and follow through on resulting actions.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills. Strong verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal skills, including the ability to clearly communicate information and instructions, accurately receive and interpret direction, and maintain positive relationships with colleagues, vendors, and clients.

  • Strong organization and attention to detail. Ability to manage time, balance multiple priorities, and complete work accurately with consistent follow-through.

 

  • Adaptability and resourcefulness. Ability to manage stress effectively, resolve unexpected problems, accept direction, adapt to changing needs, and take on unscheduled assignments when needed.

 

  • A professional, team-oriented approach. A collaborative mindset, cooperative working style, and professional appearance and demeanor.

job.title: KSL On-Call Master Control Operator (Part-time)
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

KSL is Utah’s leading local news source across digital and broadcast platforms, delivering trusted, award‑winning journalism through KSL.com and KSL‑TV. We provide in‑depth local reporting, investigative journalism, and up‑to‑the‑minute coverage that serves communities across the state. Committed to being a trusted voice of light and knowledge, KSL helps Utahns stay informed, connected, and engaged with the issues that matter most.

 

Position Overview

The On-Call Master Control Operator plays an important role in supporting the daily operations of KSL TV by providing flexible staffing coverage for Master Control, VTR, and streaming operations. This position helps maintain consistent broadcast operations by filling staffing gaps, covering scheduled absences, assisting during periods of increased workload, and providing additional support when operational needs arise.

 

This role is on-site and requires the employee to work at our Salt Lake City site. As an on-call position, hours are not guaranteed and will vary based on staffing requirements, scheduling needs, and operational demands. The employee must be available to work a flexible schedule, including weekdays, evenings, overnights, weekends, and holidays. Shifts may be scheduled in advance or requested as needed to address unexpected staffing shortages.

 

What You Will Do

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:

 

  • Provide Master Control, VTR, and streaming coverage as needed to support daily operations.
  • Fill in for regularly scheduled employees during vacations, sick leave, and other absences.
  • Assist with staffing shortages, scheduling gaps, and increased operational demands.
  • Monitor multiple incoming and outgoing signals via broadcast and streaming.
  • Maintain broadcast logs and schedule timing.
  • Ensure the continuity and accuracy of station programming.
  • Perform on-air switching of live news and network broadcasts.
  • Set up, control, and monitor broadcast equipment.
  • Prepare content and clips for on-air playback.
  • Support the production of newscasts and other live or recorded programs.
  • Follow FCC and EAS monitoring procedures.
  • Maintain proficiency with broadcast systems and procedures through ongoing training.
  • Cross-train on different shifts and operational responsibilities as needed.
  • Assist with special projects and assignments as requested by management.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For

  • Previous Master Control experience is a plus.
  • Knowledge of NVerzion automation equipment is helpful.
  • Must be a team player who works well with others.
  • Ability to maintain positive and cooperative relationships with staff and management.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to maintain composure and make sound decisions in high-pressure situations.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Computer literacy is required.
  • Ability to learn specialized broadcast applications and equipment.
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Dependable, responsible, and responsive when contacted regarding available shifts.
  • Must be willing and able to work a flexible, on-call schedule, including weekdays, evenings, overnights, weekends, and holidays, to meet the needs of a 24/7/365 operation.
  • Must be able to accommodate schedule changes and occasional short-notice staffing requests.

 

Physical Demands

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively.
  • Perform substantial physical movements involving the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Ability to extend hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction with good eye and hand coordination.
  • Lift, move, and carry up to 25 pounds on occasion.

We are responsible for lifting and inspiring with respect and giving voice to all the communities and clients we serve.

 

We believe that empowering our employees to share their ideas and experiences will fuel creativity, innovation, and inspiration. A diverse and inclusive workforce is crucial to our ability to create and deliver exceptional content, products, and services that represent our communities. We’re proud of our history and we want talented people to join us as we continue to grow!

 

To learn more about Bonneville and how our local media matters, visit: https://bonneville.com/

 

Position Overview: To update, gather and create news content for KTAR.com, with some support for ArizonaSports.com. Ensure that all news and sports content on the websites is fresh and represents the high standards of the Company. Work closely and alongside the Newsroom and other departments to achieve this goal. This job involves reporting on general news stories, sports stories and then writing articles for the websites. 

 

Note:  Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.

  • This position is an onsite role that requires the employee to regularly work at our Phoenix site.

 

What You Will Do: Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Manage daily content, information, news and features for KTAR.com. Produce graphics/images, web pages, stories, audio/video, social media etc. to accomplish this function.
  • Responsible for making sure that websites and social media platforms are continually fresh from both a content and graphical perspective. Ensure that the KTAR News overall image of quality and leadership is carried over to the web.
  • Ensure deadlines are met and projects are completed on time.
  • Develop web/social pages and websites for new site features, events, activities, etc. This includes gathering relevant information and graphic elements from various departments and entities for the website.
  • Ensure that the website provides and promotes sales activities. Help direct site toward becoming a profitable business activity. Put a priority on sales production work.
  • Market and promote the stations via the Internet and the website. This includes stations’ image and brand, events, products, etc. maximize the sites as effective communications medium for stations.
  • Interface and coordinate with technical team regarding technical aspects of web operations (servers, connectivity, etc.). Work with IT to ensure that systems are functioning properly.
  • Ensure that all web related systems are functioning on a daily basis; streaming, content/data feeds, ad servers, etc.
  • Manage online events and special features (interactive contests, message boards, etc.) as well as social media content.
  • Offer ideas, suggestions and other concepts for the stations’ Internet activities that are innovative and creative.

 

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:

  • Two years post high school education in communication/journalism with skills in the following areas: writing, computer and operational skills, related field, or equivalent.
  • Experience working in a newsroom environment. Prefer experience as a reporter, copy editor and/or web editor.
  • Exceptional news writing, editing, and grammar skills. Ability to edit, produce and create accurate, well-presented content in a quick, timely manner.
  • Experience producing graphics/images, audio and video and posting on social media platforms.
  • Must possess typing skills and computer input ability. Basic computer skills and the ability to learn new programs and basic HTML are required. Must enjoy working with computers and technology.
  • Able to produce, gather, edit and update news content for the KTAR News and Arizona Sports websites on a daily basis. Will require the production and gathering of text, images, web pages, audio/video, etc. and work closely with others in the newsroom to accomplish this function.
  • Able to work independently with little supervision. Requires a track record of dependability and evidence of being a self-starter.
  • Experience in a broadcast journalism environment, professional or collegiate level.
  • Knowledge of newswire services and a working knowledge of computer skills.
  • Aggressive attitude with a strong desire to advance in the broadcasting media.
  • Quick learner who is fully committed to meeting the challenge.
  • Strong desire to work at the state’s largest and most respected radio station.
  • Multi-tasking pro.

 

 

Physical Demands

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively.
  • Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to operate computer keys and general office equipment. Ability to work on a computer for prolonged periods of time.
  • Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.

 

Compensation Range

 $17.00-$18.00 per hour

Hourly rate will be determined by an evaluation of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal and external benchmarks.

  • Paid time off for sick leave
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services
  • Access to an entire team of free financial planners
  • Continuous growth and development opportunities
  • Dynamic team culture that values teamwork, having fun, and collaboration

job.title: AI Engineer
job.description:
Opportunity

Brunswick is on an exciting journey to harness the power of artificial intelligence and data science to enhance the way we work and the advice we provide to clients. As we continue to expand our AI capabilities, we are looking for an AI Engineer to join our growing team.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining AI-powered applications that deliver real value across the business. Working closely with our existing AI team, you will help build innovative solutions using modern AI technologies, with a particular focus on large language models (LLMs).

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with hands-on experience developing and deploying AI applications who enjoys solving complex problems, working with a high degree of autonomy, and turning emerging technologies into practical, high-quality products.

You will thrive in this role if you are curious, creative, and passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges. You take pride in writing robust, maintainable code and enjoy collaborating with colleagues to continuously improve and expand our AI capabilities.

About the Role

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Support, run, and iterate existing AI applications.
  • Design, develop, deploy, and maintain new AI applications which can be scaled across multiple business use cases, driving operational and commercial outcomes.
  • Trial and test solutions with end users to iterate and optimise them.
  • Research and analyse data sets using a variety of statistical and machine learning techniques.
  • Track and understand the evolving AI landscape.

What We’re Looking For

The successful candidate will be a highly professional, well-rounded individual with strong problem-solving skills, engineering expertise, strategic thinking, and excellent interpersonal skills. They will have a strong academic background complemented by an outstanding career to date. Standout candidates will demonstrate:

  • Experience building solutions with large language models (LLMs) and a deep understanding of the broader generative AI landscape.
  • Experience designing datasets, conducting model evaluations, and fine-tuning foundation models to improve task-specific performance.
  • Strong Python development skills, including experience writing production-quality code.
  • Experience with front-end technologies such as JavaScript, React, HTML, and CSS.
  • A solid understanding of statistics and machine learning fundamentals.
  • An undergraduate degree in a quantitative discipline, such as Mathematics or Computer Science, or equivalent relevant industry experience.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment with changing priorities and an iterative, user-focused approach to development.
  • Curiosity, a strong sense of ownership, and the ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.
  • Previous experience in professional services would be advantageous.
  • Experience developing cloud applications on Microsoft Azure would be advantageous.
  • Experience with DevOps practices and tools (e.g. CI/CD, Git) would be desirable.
  • Knowledge of, or experience with, secure software development practices would be advantageous.

Why Join Us

job.title: Company Secretary
job.description:
Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced, fully qualified Company Secretary to join our Finance and Tax team and support Brunswick’s international operations.

This is a senior role at the heart of Brunswick’s governance framework, providing trusted advice to the Board of Directors and senior leadership. The Company Secretary will lead our corporate governance and regulatory compliance activities, ensuring Brunswick maintains high standards of governance and meets its obligations under the UK Corporate Governance Code and Companies Act 2006.

Reporting to the Group Head of Tax and Partnership Affairs, the role will work closely with the Group Financial Controller and other senior colleagues across the firm, providing thoughtful, pragmatic guidance on governance and corporate matters.

We are open to considering part-time or flexible working arrangements for the right candidate.

About the Role

Your key responsibilities will include:

Board and governance

  • Support the effective operation of the Board, including preparing agendas and papers, drafting minutes, tracking actions and ensuring appropriate follow-up.
  • Act as a key point of contact for executive and non-executive directors on governance matters.
  • Manage the forward calendar and terms of reference for the Board and its committees.
  • Ensure the Board operates in accordance with the Articles of Association, shareholder arrangements, the Companies Act 2006 and other relevant governance and regulatory requirements.
  • Keep the Board and senior colleagues informed of relevant developments in corporate governance and regulation.

Committee support

  • Provide company secretarial support to the Audit & Risk Committee.
  • Attend committee meetings and prepare accurate and timely minutes.
  • Track actions and support appropriate follow-up.

Shareholder matters

  • Maintain the shareholder register and oversee quarterly updates presented to the Board.
  • Prepare and coordinate communications and documentation for shareholders.
  • Work with the Head of International Tax to support partners on shareholder and share-related matters.

Annual General Meeting

  • Manage the end-to-end delivery of the Annual General Meeting.
  • Prepare notices and supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate communications with shareholders.
  • Manage meeting arrangements and prepare minutes.

Share buy-backs

  • Coordinate the documentation and approvals associated with share buy-backs.
  • Manage relevant filing and record-keeping requirements.

Corporate documentation and records

  • Draft resolutions, letters and other corporate documentation for entities and transactions across the Group.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date statutory books and corporate records for the Group’s subsidiaries using Diligent.
  • Maintain authorised signatory records.
  • Own and maintain the Group structure chart.

Statutory filings and compliance

  • Manage the Group’s Companies House filings, including confirmation statements and other statutory returns.
  • Ensure filings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Maintain oversight of filing deadlines and other company secretarial obligations across the Group.

Corporate transactions

  • Lead the company secretarial and governance aspects of corporate and commercial transactions.
  • Support matters including entity closures, share conversions and Group restructurings.
  • Work closely with Legal, Finance, Tax and other colleagues to ensure transactions are appropriately documented and implemented.

Advice and stakeholder support

  • Provide thoughtful and pragmatic corporate governance advice to directors, Finance, Legal and other senior stakeholders across the firm.
  • Support in-house Legal colleagues on company secretarial and governance matters.
  • Work with and provide guidance to Executive Assistants on Board governance and administration.

KYC

  • Coordinate KYC requests relating to directors and senior management.
  • Ensure relevant information is accurate, current and provided efficiently.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who brings:

  • Significant corporate secretarial experience, typically gained over 6–8 years, with experience working in a UK-listed, highly regulated or complex international environment.
  • Strong knowledge of the UK Corporate Governance Code, Listing Rules and Companies Act 2006, combined with the judgement to apply this expertise thoughtfully and pragmatically.
  • Excellent written and analytical skills, with the ability to listen carefully, identify what matters and capture complex Board and executive discussions in clear, accurate and considered minutes.
  • High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal skills, with the confidence and judgement to build trusted relationships across executive and non-executive leadership while maintaining discretion and impartiality.
  • Fellowship or Associate status with the Chartered Governance Institute (CGI, formerly ICSA) is required.
  • A legal degree or professional qualification as a solicitor would be an advantage.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

job.title: Data Architect
job.description:
Opportunity

Brunswick is accelerating its use of AI to strengthen the advice we give clients and how we operate. We are looking for a Data Architect to join our AI Lab and shape the technical and data foundations that enable us to build and scale proprietary AI products securely and effectively.

This is a hands-on, influential role spanning architecture and practical delivery. You will take a portfolio-wide view of how data, applications, models, APIs and shared components fit together, creating reusable patterns and capabilities that help engineers move faster while maintaining high standards of security, resilience and maintainability.

Working closely with AI Engineers, Infrastructure, Security, Data and other technology teams, you will ensure the Lab has the architecture and underlying platform it needs to innovate at pace while aligning with Brunswick’s wider technology environment.

About the Role

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Design and evolve the data and technical architecture underpinning the AI Lab’s portfolio of proprietary products.
  • Define scalable patterns for how applications, data sources, models, APIs and enterprise systems connect and interact.
  • Design approaches to data modelling, access, storage, movement and governance, particularly for sensitive or business-critical information.
  • Identify opportunities to create reusable services, components and data capabilities that accelerate development across multiple products.
  • Establish standards and patterns for data pipelines, APIs, integration, environments, deployment and observability.
  • Work closely with engineers to translate architectural principles into practical solutions, balancing scalability with rapid prototyping and delivery.
  • Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Data and other technology teams to ensure solutions meet Brunswick’s security, privacy, governance and architectural standards.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify the data landscape, reduce duplication and improve interoperability across the firm.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural approaches that could strengthen the Lab’s platform or unlock new capabilities.
  • Help build the scalable data foundations Brunswick needs to develop and deploy AI responsibly, securely and effectively.

What We’re Looking For

You will combine strong data and solution architecture skills with a practical engineering mindset and the ability to operate in a fast-moving product environment. You will be comfortable moving between strategic architecture and detailed technical decisions, making pragmatic trade-offs between long-term scalability and speed of delivery. The successful candidate will bring:

 

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in data architecture, solution architecture, data engineering, software engineering or a related technical role.
  • Strong experience designing scalable data and application architectures, ideally in cloud environments.
  • Experience designing data models, APIs, integrations and data flows across databases, SaaS applications and enterprise systems.
  • Strong knowledge of modern data architecture, including data modelling, ETL/ELT pipelines, storage, access patterns, data warehouses, lakes/lakehouses and governance.
  • Experience with cloud platforms; Microsoft Azure experience is particularly relevant.
  • Good working knowledge of SQL and modern data engineering approaches, including Python.
  • Experience designing reusable technical components, shared services or platforms used across multiple products or teams.
  • A strong understanding of data governance, security, privacy, lineage and quality, and how these are embedded into architecture and delivery.
  • An understanding of the data requirements of AI and machine-learning applications, including securely making structured and unstructured enterprise data available to AI solutions.
  • A good understanding of modern software engineering and SDLC practices, including CI/CD, version control, testing and observability.
  • Sufficient hands-on technical depth to work credibly with engineers, review designs and contribute to implementation where useful.
  • Strong judgement and pragmatism, with the ability to balance consistency and reuse with experimentation and speed.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical colleagues.

Desirable experience

  • Architecting applications or platforms incorporating generative AI, large language models or machine learning.
  • Designing data and integration architectures for AI applications, including retrieval and grounding approaches.
  • Building internal developer platforms, shared services or reusable application frameworks.
  • Working with sensitive enterprise data and complex security or governance requirements.
  • Experience in professional services, financial services, advisory or another complex enterprise environment.

job.title: Perception Intelligence Analyst
job.description:
Opportunity

Brunswick Group is seeking an Analyst to join our Perception Intelligence practice in New York.

Perception Intelligence is a part of Brunswick's Financial Practice and helps companies understand how investors, analysts, and other key stakeholders assess their strategy, management, communications, and long-term investment proposition. Through in-depth interviews and analysis, we provide actionable insights that help clients strengthen relationships with the capital markets and make better-informed communications and business decisions.

As a Perception Intelligence Analyst, you will play an important role in supporting the execution of perception analytics projects, conducting stakeholder research and interviews, analyzing findings, distilling complex feedback into insights, and helping to develop high-quality client deliverables.

  • Monitor capital markets developments, earnings announcements, and broader market trends relevant to clients.
  • Develop strong understanding of investor relations practices, investment decision-making processes, and financial communications.

Teamwork and Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with a global team across multiple projects concurrently.
  • Support senior team members in delivering high-quality client service and project execution.

At Brunswick, we seek smart and curious individuals dedicated to learning and growth. We value potential, strong work ethic, sound judgment and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • 1-3 years of relevant experience in perception research, investor relations, strategic communications, capital markets, equity research, or a related advisory environment.
  • Strong academic background (finance/economics would be an advantage).
  • Interest in capital markets, investor behavior, and corporate communications.
  • Understanding of financial concepts, including valuation methodologies, capital structure, earnings drivers, etc., and catalysts for investment decisions.
  • Intellectual curiosity and interest in business, financial, and macroeconomic developments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • High level of attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and comfort working with data and research tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative approach to working with colleagues and clients.
  • High levels of professionalism, discretion, and integrity.

Joining Brunswick unlocks a range of exceptional employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

Bonus Eligibility: Annual discretionary bonus contingent upon individual and firm-wide performance.

Benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance. Disability insurance. Employee assistance program. Flexible spending account. Health savings account. Life insurance. Commuter Benefits. Generous Paid Time Off: 25 vacation days and 10 days sick leave, as well as 11 paid company holidays. Firm-sponsored 401(k) Plan with 3% automatic company contribution of base and bonus with an additional 1.5% profit share– immediate vesting. Career training and development opportunities. Employee discounts.

Our policy is that our team members are in person – either in the office or on-site with clients – at least four days each week.
