What you’ll do

  • Support the development and delivery of public affairs strategies for a range of clients, including work on public policy and regulatory affairs.
  • Monitor and analyse political, parliamentary, regulatory and policy developments in Spain and the European Union, assessing their potential impact on clients and their sectors.
  • Map relevant public decision-makers, institutions, stakeholders and sector priorities.
  • Prepare political and regulatory intelligence, stakeholder briefings, reports, key messages and other client materials.
  • Support engagement with policymakers and other relevant stakeholders, helping clients advance their public affairs priorities.
  • Manage day-to-day client accounts and build strong relationships with clients and relevant stakeholders.
  • Contribute to project development, new business proposals and client presentations.

Experience that contributes to success

  • Bachelor’s degree in Political Science, Law, European Law, International Relations, Journalism, Communication or a related fiel
  • Postgraduate studies or specific training in Public Affairs, European Union affairs, public policy, regulatory affairs, public administration or political communication are an asset.
  • 1–2 years’ experience in a public affairs department, parliamentary or government environment, a minister’s cabinet, or an agency with a strong public affairs focus.
  • Good understanding of Spain’s political and parliamentary system, as well as the European Union’s institutions and legislative process.
  • Excellent written and spoken English (C1 level).
  • Strong client-service skills and the ability to work flexibly in a dynamic, diverse and inclusive environment.
  • Creative, proactive and results-oriented, with strong problem-solving skills

#LI-AY1

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. job.title: Account Supervisor, Digital Media (Social & Influencer)
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

We are looking for an Account Supervisor, Social, Digital & Influencer to help clients build meaningful connections with audiences across social platforms, digital channels and creator communities. 

This role sits at the intersection of social strategy, content, culture, influencer marketing and intelligence. You will translate client business and communications objectives into practical programs, guiding work from insight and strategy through content development, creator activation, executive visibility, community engagement, social listening and measurement. 

The ideal candidate understands how brands and leaders show up in social and digital environments, what makes content resonate across audiences and platforms, and how creators can credibly extend a brand's story. You will work directly with clients, partner with creative and integrated agency teams, and manage multiple programs from brief through execution. 

This is a client-facing role with meaningful ownership. We are looking for someone who can provide strategic counsel and also write a brief, build an editorial calendar, evaluate creators, review content, analyze conversation and performance data, manage budgets and troubleshoot.

What you'll do:

Social & Digital Strategy 

  • Develop social and digital strategies grounded in client objectives, audience insights, cultural trends and platform best practices.
  • Translate broader brand, reputation and communications strategies into actionable organic and paid social, creator, community engagement and digital content programs.
  • Conduct audience, competitor, industry and cultural research to identify emerging conversations and opportunities for brands and executives.
  • Define channel roles, audience strategies, content pillars, messaging approaches and publishing plans across LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, X and emerging platforms.
  • Build integrated plans that connect owned content, corporate channels, executive voices, creator partnerships and employee advocacy.

Influencer & Creator Marketing 

  • Identify and evaluate creators based on audience relevance, content quality and performance, credibility, brand fit, risk and potential program impact using different tools and manual desk research
  • Manage end-to-end creator programs from sourcing and outreach through rate negotiation, contracting, briefing, content development, approvals, publishing, amplification, reporting and payment coordination.
  • Develop briefing books and clear campaign guidance that translate messaging, creative requirements and submission processes into actionable direction for creators.
  • Review creator content for message accuracy, brand alignment, disclosure requirements, brand safety and other campaign-specific compliance needs.
  • Maintain productive relationships with creators, talent managers, platforms and partner agencies, including clear communication when timelines or requirements change.
  • Track campaign performance, contribute to reporting and performance recaps, and translate results into actionable insights and optimization recommendations.
  • Track and manage influencer out-of-pocket (OOP) budgets, including creator fees, payments, product reimbursements and other expenses as needed.
  • Coordinate influencer payments through applicable platforms and payment processes, ensuring accurate and timely processing.
  • Coordinate SAG-AFTRA pension and health contributions, as applicable, using relevant vendors and platforms.
  • Support the management of creator contracts, usage rights, content licensing and paid amplification permissions, coordinating with relevant internal teams as needed.

Content, Editorial & Executive Visibility 

  • Develop social-first content strategies, campaign concepts, executive visibility plans and channel amplification recommendations.
  • Write and edit social copy, executive LinkedIn content, briefs, messaging and other digital communications in distinct brand and leader voices.
  • Partner with creative to develop supporting assets and owned content, and coordinate content through client, legal or regulatory review processes when applicable.
  • Review work with a clear understanding of the differences among brand content, executive content, creator content and culturally relevant community content.
  • Identify appropriate formats for leaders and brands to engage, including original posts, reshares, comments, employee advocacy and cross-channel amplification.

Social Listening, Intelligence & Measurement 

  • Use social listening and native platform data to assess brand, executive, competitor and category conversations, including volume, sentiment, share of voice, emerging narratives and top-performing content.
  • Support recurring reporting, executive engagement recommendations, campaign measurement, quarterly earnings monitoring and rapid-response monitoring during fast-moving issues.
  • Work with analytics partners to define objectives and KPIs and evaluate metrics such as reach, impressions, engagement, video views, clicks, audience growth and creator performance.
  • Go beyond reporting numbers to explain what worked, what did not and what should change next.
  • Turn social, cultural and performance insights into clear recommendations for future programming.

Client Counsel & Account Leadership 

  • Serve as a day-to-day client contact and trusted partner across social, digital and influencer workstreams.
  • Lead status meetings, agendas, recaps, open-item tracking and follow-up, ensuring clients and integrated teams remain aligned.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of each client's business, audiences, competitive environment, communications priorities and approval requirements.
  • Partner across creative, strategy, analytics, paid media, earned media, corporate communications and other disciplines to deliver integrated work.

Project, Financial & Team Management 

  • Build practical workplans, calendars, trackers and quality-control processes that make ownership, timing, approvals and next steps clear.
  • Support scope development, staffing, budget tracking, monthly allocations and other account administration in partnership with senior account leads.
  • Provide clear direction, coaching and constructive feedback to junior team members; review their work and help establish consistent team standards.
  • Contribute to brainstorms, thought leadership, new-business opportunities and integrated agency initiatives.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 4–6 years of experience in social media, digital communications, influencer/creator marketing, social intelligence or integrated communications, preferably within an agency or similarly fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing social, digital and/or influencer programs for brands or organizations.
  • Strong understanding of major social platforms and how content, audiences and behaviors differ across channels.
  • Experience identifying, evaluating, briefing and managing influencers or creators, including content review and campaign operations.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to adapt voice and tone for brands, executives, creators and different platforms.
  • Ability to turn audience, cultural, platform and performance insights into clear, actionable strategies and recommendations.
  • Experience working directly with clients, leading day-to-day workstreams and presenting recommendations.
  • Strong project management skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple clients at once.
  • Experience with tools such as Brandwatch, Sprout Social, Sprinklr, native platform analytics, or comparable platforms.
  • Excellent attention to detail, problem-solving skills and comfort operating in fast-moving situations.
  • An inclusive, collaborative leadership style and the ability to guide junior colleagues while partnering effectively with senior specialists.
  • Curiosity about culture, creators, technology and the evolving ways audiences discover, evaluate and share information.

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

The stakes in tech storytelling today are higher than ever. Gone are the days of technology simply “saving the world.” The double-edged sword of today’s technologies creates as much reputational risk as reward across diverse stakeholder groups. 

Want to be on the front lines, shaping the narrative for the large-scale innovations that matter? 

With nearly a century of science and state-of-the-art AI to help us understand the changing dynamics of reputation management, Burson is the partner to leading technology companies, crafting stories that resonate, inspire, and drive real impact. We're not about press releases and blogs; we're about building reputations that stand the test of time. 

If you're obsessed with all things tech, love a good challenge, and want to be part of a growing and collaborative team, Burson's US Technology practice is the place for you! 

As an Assistant Account Executive on our growing US Technology team, you'll play a key role in executing impactful integrated communications strategies and programs for both established brands and disruptive startups. We're looking for a strategic and creative individual with a deep curiosity and understanding of the technology landscape and a passion for media relations. If you're a team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is eager to take ownership of client work, and ready to take a big step in your career, this is the opportunity for you! 

What you'll do:

  • Support day-to-day account management by helping coordinate client projects, track deliverables, and communicate with internal teams and vendors.
  • Assist in the development and execution of integrated communications programs, including media relations, thought leadership, creative campaigns, and product launches.
  • Help build media lists and monitor coverage, while learning how to pitch stories to relevant journalists in the technology space.
  • Conduct research on industry trends and competitors to help identify storytelling opportunities and support strategic recommendations.
  • Draft and edit content such as press releases, media alerts, blog posts, and social media copy, with guidance from senior team members.
  • Participate in team brainstorms and contribute creative ideas to support client programs and campaigns.

  • Internship or 0-1 year of experience in public relations, communications, or a related field – ideally with exposure to the tech industry.
  • A genuine interest for either/both consumer or enterprise technology and ability to "geek out."
  • Past integrated communications experience working with clients, preferably in the technology space
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a keen eye for detail, allowing you to craft compelling narratives and deliver impactful presentations.
  • A proactive and self-motivated approach, demonstrating confidence and a strong presence when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • A highly collaborative spirit and experience and passion for fostering a positive and supportive team environment.
  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.

More about the role:

Burson is building three global Influence & Social Centres of Excellence in the US, Singapore, and London. As part of our UK Centre of Excellence, which serves as the hub for the EMEA region, we are seeking an Associate Director, Influence to play a pivotal, hands-on role in scaling and evolving our Total Influence offer.

This is an exciting opportunity for a mid-to-senior influencer specialist who combines strategic vision with flawless operational execution. Sitting within our multi-disciplinary capability, you will be the day-to-day strategic engine and trusted advisor across all agency practices. You will plan, oversee, and execute best-in-class influencer-led campaigns that earn cultural relevance, protect reputation, and deliver measurable business impact.

As an Influence Associate Director, you will be a dynamic, commercially astute specialist and creative thinker, leading best-in-class, influencer-led content strategies and programmes across all agency sectors. Viewing "influence" holistically, you will provide strategic and practical counsel to clients and internal teams; from identification, vetting, and contracting to creative co-creation, paid integration, and measurement. Partnering with UK head of Influence, you will elevate Burson’s influencer marketing offer, inspire dedicated specialists, and upskill teams to deliver exceptional, measurable results.

What you'll do:

 

Grow: Commercial & Sector Partnership

  • Strategic Influence Partner: Act as a trusted adviser to sector and practice leads, translating client and business briefs into culturally relevant, influencer-led strategies.
  • Commercial & Organic Growth: Partner with the UK Head of Influence and senior teams to develop winning pitches, shape commercial models and identify opportunities to grow influence across existing and new client accounts.
  • Holistic Influence Strategy: Champion a broader view of influence beyond traditional creators, incorporating thought leaders, B2B voices, subject-matter experts and advocates across owned, earned, shared and paid channels.

Enable: Delivery, Operations & Best Practice

  • Best-in-Class Campaign Delivery: Lead end-to-end influencer programmes, from discovery, vetting and contracting through to creator briefing, co-creation, rights management and live campaign delivery.
  • Creative, Paid & Performance Integration: Work closely with creators to deliver authentic, high-quality content while connecting organic influence with paid amplification, licensing, whitelisting and performance marketing opportunities.
  • Governance, Tools & Team Development: Ensure programmes meet ASA, CMA, IP and Burson compliance standards, while embedding tools such as CreatorIQ and GWI and upskilling teams on influencer best practice, cultural trends and effective ways of working.

Transform: Innovation & Modern Measurement

  • Measurement & Impact: Partner with data and intelligence specialists to evolve how influence is measured, moving beyond vanity metrics to demonstrate sentiment, cultural share of voice, reputation shift and conversion.
  • Platform & Innovation Leadership: Build strong relationships with platforms including TikTok, Meta, YouTube and LinkedIn, while testing and embedding AI and emerging capabilities through Burson's AI suite and WPP Open to improve discovery, reporting and workflow efficiency.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Proven Agency Experience: Substantial influencer marketing experience within an agency, PR, or integrated creative environment, operating at Account Director / Junior Associate Director level.
  • Strategic & Creative Rigour: Ability to plan multi-channel content strategies that are influencer-first, with a strong understanding of how audience mapping and data inform creative platforms and creator selection.
  • Negotiation & Contracting Mastery: Deep practical expertise in creator negotiation, complex scope structuring, multi-platform licensing, exclusivity, and contract management.
  • Tech Fluency: Hands-on proficiency with dedicated influencer tech platforms (specifically CreatorIQ) and consumer research tools (such as GWI).
  • Collaborative Leadership: A natural relationship-builder who can seamlessly partner with cross-functional teams (strategy, creative, earned media, paid, data) and mentor junior talent.
  • Client Advisory Skills: Calm, authoritative client-handling skills with the ability to articulate the strategic value of influencer marketing to both senior brand marketers and communications directors.
  • Commercial Acumen: Experience building accurate scopes of work, production budgets, talent fees, and pitch responses that protect agency margins and client ROI.

Burson UK was named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026!

More about the role:

Burson Buchanan is a boutique advisory firm within the Burson Group, focused on financial communications, litigation and government investigations, and crisis and risk management. Buchanan advises corporate clients, investment firms and organizations on stakeholder engagement and reputation management through moments of transformation, complexity, and opportunity. Our team leverages decades of experience navigating high-stakes matters, while integrating Burson's proprietary technology and insights, enabling us to deliver strategic advisory for the intelligence era. 

Burson Buchanan is seeking a highly driven Associate to support client engagements across capital markets situations, litigation, and high-stakes issues management. This role is ideal for a rising strategic communicator with experience working on sensitive, business-critical challenges for clients.

The Associate will work closely with Buchanan team members on multi-faceted programs involving crisis response, high-profile litigation, and major capital markets events including M&A, IPOs and activist defense. They’ll have a front-row seat and opportunity to shape the most critical and high-profile challenges facing companies today.

The right candidate will bring a fast, focused approach to every engagement. They’ll stay responsive around the clock to clients and colleagues, get up to speed quickly on each client, and take pride in producing polished deliverables under pressure. Above all, they’ll thrive in a close-knit team and enjoy contributing meaningfully in a fast-paced, collaborative, and high-performance environment.

What you'll do:

Litigation & Issues Management

  • Support the development and execution of communications and stakeholder engagement strategies for crisis, litigation, government investigations, policy matters, and corporate reputation challenges.
  • Conduct research, rapid situational analysis and synthesize findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Assist in message development, positioning, and scenario planning for sensitive issues affecting corporate operations and leadership.
  • Draft press releases, statements, talking points, key messages, and media background materials.

Financial & Investor Communications

  • Contribute to financial communications programs, including the development of stakeholder communications materials related to M&A, IPOs, shareholder activism, and quarterly earnings.
  • Conduct research on market trends, investor sentiment, and peer positioning to support strategic recommendations.
  • Assist in preparing materials for interactions with analysts, shareholders, and financial media.

Client Engagement & Account Management

  • Serve as a core member of Buchanan client teams, supporting ongoing project management.
  • Support senior leadership in the development of briefings, memos, media materials, Q&A documents and client-facing research.
  • Help coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution and strong client service.

Media Engagement & Issues Tracking

  • Support proactive and reactive media engagement for corporate, financial, and crisis-related matters.
  • Lead media monitoring efforts on client engagements, tracking notable developments, and delivering impactful insights.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 1-2 years of experience in public affairs, corporate communications, financial communications, or public relations—agency or in-house.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting clients on issues such as litigation, government investigations, crisis and reputational management, policy/public affairs, and corporate financial events (e.g. M&A, IPOs, shareholder activism situations).
  • The ability to prepare quality client-facing materials under compressed timelines.
  • Ability to think critically, analyze complex information, and anticipate risks and opportunities.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills and comfort interacting with senior leaders.
  • Proactive, organized, and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Preferred:

  • Experience with financial research tools including platforms such as the Bloomberg Terminal, AlphaSense, and Capital IQ.
  • Understanding of capital markets, investor relations and financial media engagement.
  • Familiarity with litigation and regulatory communications.
  • Prior agency experience strongly preferred.

job.title: Burson Summer 2027 HBSI (Client-Facing, USA Hybrid)
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

The Harold Burson Summer Internship (HBSI) Program gives early-career professionals an opportunity to explore the world of communications at a top-tier global communications agency during an exhilarating 12-week experience. 

The HBSI culminates a real-world challenge where interns research, design and present a campaign for a current Burson client to the agency’s senior management, receiving feedback, tips and insights that would ordinarily take years to obtain. The summer internship program offers an invaluable career-development experience. So … are you ready to be a Harold Burson summer intern?  

The program will run from June 7– August 31, 2027, and you will be connected to one of our U.S. offices. The health and well-being of our employees, including you as our future intern, are our top priorities. All our offices are open, and we plan to welcome you to them as many days a week as you'd like, but Burson U.S. is currently following an in-office hybrid policy.  

Please note, this application is for one of our client-facing positions within the following practices: Consumer & Brand, Corporate & Public Affairs, Digital, Health & Wellness, Insights & Intelligence, Performance Media, Transportation, Energy & Industrials, Technology, and Grassroots (Direct Impact). To help you understand our practices and to aid in your decision making when choosing your top three areas of interest, please review the descriptions at the bottom of this post.  

There is a separate application for Creative roles on the Burson HBSI landing page. If you are interested in a Creative role and this client facing role, please feel free to apply for both. They are all still a part of the broader Harold Burson Summer Internship, you will just have a different focus area.  

Application requirements (Incomplete applications will not be eligible for consideration):  

  1. Resume 
  2. Cover Letter
  3. Writing Prompt: AI is changing the way we communicate, create and solve problems. As our industry continues to evolve, how we use these tools matters just as much as what they help us achieve. In 500 words, how would you use AI responsibly and thoughtfully while staying true to Burson's core values?

APPLICATION DEADLINE: Friday, January 10, 2027 at 11:59 pm PST. If you have specific questions, please email the HBSI team at HBSIProgram@bursonglobal.com. 

What you'll do:

  • During this paid internship, interns work alongside top professionals in the field, participating in everything from strategy and planning discussions to creative brainstorms aimed at capturing national news, shaping public opinion and sparking community engagement. 

    • Consumer & Brand: We build brands that enhance reputation, create culture and influence consumer behavior. Whether putting brands into pop culture at the speed of news or addressing more deeply seeded societal challenges, we develop communications that create reputation capital for our clients with unrivaled intelligence, innovation and impact. 
    • Corporate & Public Affairs: From policy shifts to trade to supply chain dynamics, our experts have worked directly with policymakers around the world. We understand the drivers and know the players, the power centers and the right messages – and messengers – for success. Our global team of strategic advisors provide seasoned counsel and nuanced strategies that reflect and respond to the multi-layered realities of today’s global communities. 
    • Digital: The Digital team customizes campaigns for their clients. From insights to influence and content to paid media, digital designs engagements for brands that move audiences to action. Whether launching social media pages, introducing always-on paid media campaigns or developing creative that breaks through the clutter, Burson’s digital team is synonymous with change and innovation. 
    • Health & Wellness: We provide strategic counsel and flawless execution from corporate to R&D communications to regulatory milestones and more. We have strong connections to regulatory bodies and a deep understanding of the intersection of advocacy, policy and sustainability. 
    • Insights & Intelligence: Burson's Insights & Intelligence team transforms information into action. We cut through the noise, analyzing brand perception, monitoring online conversations, and conducting custom research to uncover actionable strategies. Leveraging data science and AI, we uncover hidden patterns and predict future outcomes with precision, empower brands and businesses with the insights they need to succeed.
    • Performance Media: The Performance Media team specializes in developing integrated media campaigns that intersect audiences where, how and when they are the most receptive to content. The team is focused on developing programs that not only drive results, but also uplift the brand.  The team works to craft amazing stories on behalf of our clients that get audiences to move in the desired direction to make defendable business impact across digital media channels and develop custom measurement and attribution programs to deliver.  
    • Technology: Technology has never been more transformative, more promising or more risky. Burson deftly navigates that balance, and no one is better prepared to help technology clients navigate what's next. 
    • Transportation, Energy & Industrials: From the way people and goods move to the systems that power our world, we help clients navigate complex, fast-moving environments and position themselves for progress. We combine deep issues expertise with an understanding of the policies, regulations and stakeholder networks shaping these industries to help clients navigate challenges and reach the audiences that matter most.
    • Direct Impact (Grassroots): Our team has a nationwide field network that offers scalable, high impact communications services covering every community, media market, political jurisdiction, and digital landscape in the U.S. We redefine what is means to engage communities and move stakeholders through 21st century grassroots and purpose-driven communications. 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • At the start of the internship, must be a recent (May/June) 2027 graduate. 
  • Strong research, written and verbal communication skills.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment with the ability to handle high-pressure situations.  

Please note, Burson does not provide any form of relocation/housing assistance. Once hired, it will be up to the individual to find accommodations for the duration of the program.

Application requirements (Incomplete applications will not be eligible for consideration):

  3. Writing Prompt: AI is changing the way we communicate, create and solve problems. What you'll do:

  • During this paid internship, interns work alongside top professionals in the field, participating in everything from strategy and planning discussions to creative brainstorms aimed at capturing national news, shaping public opinion and sparking community engagement. 

    • Consumer & Brand: We build brands that enhance reputation, create culture and influence consumer behavior. Whether putting brands into pop culture at the speed of news or addressing more deeply seeded societal challenges, we develop communications that create reputation capital for our clients with unrivaled intelligence, innovation and impact. 
    • Corporate & Public Affairs: From policy shifts to trade to supply chain dynamics, our experts have worked directly with policymakers around the world. We understand the drivers and know the players, the power centers and the right messages – and messengers – for success. Our global team of strategic advisors provide seasoned counsel and nuanced strategies that reflect and respond to the multi-layered realities of today’s global communities. 
    • Digital: The Digital team customizes campaigns for their clients. From insights to influence and content to paid media, digital designs engagements for brands that move audiences to action. Whether launching social media pages, introducing always-on paid media campaigns or developing creative that breaks through the clutter, Burson’s digital team is synonymous with change and innovation. 
    • Health & Wellness: We provide strategic counsel and flawless execution from corporate to R&D communications to regulatory milestones and more. We have strong connections to regulatory bodies and a deep understanding of the intersection of advocacy, policy and sustainability. 
    • Insights & Intelligence: Burson's Insights & Intelligence team transforms information into action. We cut through the noise, analyzing brand perception, monitoring online conversations, and conducting custom research to uncover actionable strategies. Leveraging data science and AI, we uncover hidden patterns and predict future outcomes with precision, empower brands and businesses with the insights they need to succeed.
    • Performance Media: The Performance Media team specializes in developing integrated media campaigns that intersect audiences where, how and when they are the most receptive to content. The team is focused on developing programs that not only drive results, but also uplift the brand.  The team works to craft amazing stories on behalf of our clients that get audiences to move in the desired direction to make defendable business impact across digital media channels and develop custom measurement and attribution programs to deliver.  
    • Technology: Technology has never been more transformative, more promising or more risky. Burson deftly navigates that balance, and no one is better prepared to help technology clients navigate what's next.

    • Direct Impact (Grassroots): Our team has a nationwide field network that offers scalable, high impact communications services covering every community, media market, political jurisdiction, and digital landscape in the U.S. We redefine what is means to engage communities and move stakeholders through 21st century grassroots and purpose-driven communications.

  • At the start of the internship, must be a recent (May/June) 2027 graduate.

job.title: Burson Summer 2027 HBSI (Client-Facing, USA Hybrid)
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

The Harold Burson Summer Internship (HBSI) Program gives early-career professionals an opportunity to explore the world of communications at a top-tier global communications agency during an exhilarating 12-week experience. 

The HBSI culminates a real-world challenge where interns research, design and present a campaign for a current Burson client to the agency’s senior management, receiving feedback, tips and insights that would ordinarily take years to obtain. The summer internship program offers an invaluable career-development experience. So … are you ready to be a Harold Burson summer intern?  

The program will run from June 7– August 31, 2027, and you will be connected to one of our U.S. offices. The health and well-being of our employees, including you as our future intern, are our top priorities. All our offices are open, and we plan to welcome you to them as many days a week as you'd like, but Burson U.S. is currently following an in-office hybrid policy.  

Please note, this application is for one of our client-facing positions within the following practices: Consumer & Brand, Corporate & Public Affairs, Digital, Health & Wellness, Insights & Intelligence, Performance Media, Transportation, Energy & Industrials, Technology, and Grassroots (Direct Impact). To help you understand our practices and to aid in your decision making when choosing your top three areas of interest, please review the descriptions at the bottom of this post.  

There is a separate application for Creative roles on the Burson HBSI landing page. If you are interested in a Creative role and this client facing role, please feel free to apply for both. They are all still a part of the broader Harold Burson Summer Internship, you will just have a different focus area.  

Application requirements (Incomplete applications will not be eligible for consideration):  

  1. Resume 
  2. Cover Letter
  3. Writing Prompt: AI is changing the way we communicate, create and solve problems. As our industry continues to evolve, how we use these tools matters just as much as what they help us achieve. In 500 words, how would you use AI responsibly and thoughtfully while staying true to Burson's core values?

APPLICATION DEADLINE: Friday, January 10, 2027 at 11:59 pm PST. If you have specific questions, please email the HBSI team at HBSIProgram@bursonglobal.com. 

What you'll do:

  • During this paid internship, interns work alongside top professionals in the field, participating in everything from strategy and planning discussions to creative brainstorms aimed at capturing national news, shaping public opinion and sparking community engagement. 

    • Consumer & Brand: We build brands that enhance reputation, create culture and influence consumer behavior. Whether putting brands into pop culture at the speed of news or addressing more deeply seeded societal challenges, we develop communications that create reputation capital for our clients with unrivaled intelligence, innovation and impact. 
    • Corporate & Public Affairs: From policy shifts to trade to supply chain dynamics, our experts have worked directly with policymakers around the world. We understand the drivers and know the players, the power centers and the right messages – and messengers – for success. Our global team of strategic advisors provide seasoned counsel and nuanced strategies that reflect and respond to the multi-layered realities of today’s global communities. 
    • Digital: The Digital team customizes campaigns for their clients. From insights to influence and content to paid media, digital designs engagements for brands that move audiences to action. Whether launching social media pages, introducing always-on paid media campaigns or developing creative that breaks through the clutter, Burson’s digital team is synonymous with change and innovation. 
    • Health & Wellness: We provide strategic counsel and flawless execution from corporate to R&D communications to regulatory milestones and more. We have strong connections to regulatory bodies and a deep understanding of the intersection of advocacy, policy and sustainability. 
    • Insights & Intelligence: Burson's Insights & Intelligence team transforms information into action. We cut through the noise, analyzing brand perception, monitoring online conversations, and conducting custom research to uncover actionable strategies. Leveraging data science and AI, we uncover hidden patterns and predict future outcomes with precision, empower brands and businesses with the insights they need to succeed.
    • Performance Media: The Performance Media team specializes in developing integrated media campaigns that intersect audiences where, how and when they are the most receptive to content. The team is focused on developing programs that not only drive results, but also uplift the brand.  The team works to craft amazing stories on behalf of our clients that get audiences to move in the desired direction to make defendable business impact across digital media channels and develop custom measurement and attribution programs to deliver.  
    • Technology: Technology has never been more transformative, more promising or more risky. Burson deftly navigates that balance, and no one is better prepared to help technology clients navigate what's next. 
    • Transportation, Energy & Industrials: From the way people and goods move to the systems that power our world, we help clients navigate complex, fast-moving environments and position themselves for progress. We combine deep issues expertise with an understanding of the policies, regulations and stakeholder networks shaping these industries to help clients navigate challenges and reach the audiences that matter most.
    • Direct Impact (Grassroots): Our team has a nationwide field network that offers scalable, high impact communications services covering every community, media market, political jurisdiction, and digital landscape in the U.S. We redefine what is means to engage communities and move stakeholders through 21st century grassroots and purpose-driven communications. 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • At the start of the internship, must be a recent (May/June) 2027 graduate. 
  • Strong research, written and verbal communication skills.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment with the ability to handle high-pressure situations.  

Please note, Burson does not provide any form of relocation/housing assistance. Once hired, it will be up to the individual to find accommodations for the duration of the program.

APPLICATION DEADLINE: Friday, January 10, 2027 at 11:59 pm PST. If you have specific questions, please email the HBSI team at HBSIProgram@bursonglobal.com. 

What you'll do:

  • During this paid internship, interns work alongside top professionals in the field, participating in everything from strategy and planning discussions to creative brainstorms aimed at capturing national news, shaping public opinion and sparking community engagement. 

    • Consumer & Brand: We build brands that enhance reputation, create culture and influence consumer behavior. Whether putting brands into pop culture at the speed of news or addressing more deeply seeded societal challenges, we develop communications that create reputation capital for our clients with unrivaled intelligence, innovation and impact. 
    • Corporate & Public Affairs: From policy shifts to trade to supply chain dynamics, our experts have worked directly with policymakers around the world. We understand the drivers and know the players, the power centers and the right messages – and messengers – for success. Our global team of strategic advisors provide seasoned counsel and nuanced strategies that reflect and respond to the multi-layered realities of today’s global communities. 
    • Digital: The Digital team customizes campaigns for their clients. From insights to influence and content to paid media, digital designs engagements for brands that move audiences to action. Whether launching social media pages, introducing always-on paid media campaigns or developing creative that breaks through the clutter, Burson’s digital team is synonymous with change and innovation. 
    • Health & Wellness: We provide strategic counsel and flawless execution from corporate to R&D communications to regulatory milestones and more. We have strong connections to regulatory bodies and a deep understanding of the intersection of advocacy, policy and sustainability. 
    • Insights & Intelligence: Burson's Insights & Intelligence team transforms information into action. We cut through the noise, analyzing brand perception, monitoring online conversations, and conducting custom research to uncover actionable strategies. Leveraging data science and AI, we uncover hidden patterns and predict future outcomes with precision, empower brands and businesses with the insights they need to succeed.
    • Performance Media: The Performance Media team specializes in developing integrated media campaigns that intersect audiences where, how and when they are the most receptive to content. The team is focused on developing programs that not only drive results, but also uplift the brand.  The team works to craft amazing stories on behalf of our clients that get audiences to move in the desired direction to make defendable business impact across digital media channels and develop custom measurement and attribution programs to deliver.  
    • Technology: Technology has never been more transformative, more promising or more risky. Burson deftly navigates that balance, and no one is better prepared to help technology clients navigate what's next. 
    • Transportation, Energy & Industrials: From the way people and goods move to the systems that power our world, we help clients navigate complex, fast-moving environments and position themselves for progress. We combine deep issues expertise with an understanding of the policies, regulations and stakeholder networks shaping these industries to help clients navigate challenges and reach the audiences that matter most.
    • Direct Impact (Grassroots): Our team has a nationwide field network that offers scalable, high impact communications services covering every community, media market, political jurisdiction, and digital landscape in the U.S. We redefine what is means to engage communities and move stakeholders through 21st century grassroots and purpose-driven communications.

  • At the start of the internship, must be a recent (May/June) 2027 graduate. 
  • Strong research, written and verbal communication skills.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment with the ability to handle high-pressure situations.

We’re looking for a digital specialist with experience in paid media. 

This existing role will report to our Senior Director, Digital. The Digital Specialist will play a key role in supporting digital research, planning, and paid media solutions for our clients. Based in Toronto, you will work within our Digital team, working closely with our practice teams and consultants across Canada to execute digital paid media across social, programmatic, and search.   

The role is perfect for a digital marketing native, someone who has 2-4 years’ experience working hands-on within the social advertising platforms – including Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Google. They will have a proven ability to manage the end-to-end planning and optimization process. They will be responsible for supporting a range of clients and sectors—such as, Consumer, Health, Tech, Public Affairs, and Energy—with a variety of objectives. Experience in SEO and GEO are a bonus.  

Here’s what you’ll be doing: 

You will be responsible for supporting our sector teams and clients throughout the end-to-end campaign management process, including:   

  • Management and/or QA of paid media campaign creation and set-up process for social and digital paid campaigns
  • On-going monitoring, analysis, and optimization of campaign activity
  • Supporting budget reconciliation and finance management, as required
  • Maintain knowledge of industry best practices and new technologies  
  • Research and supporting the development of paid media plans
  • Performance analysis and reporting for social, content, and digital paid media performance 

What you’ll need to get here: 

  • 2-4 years + of hands-on experience setting up, managing and optimizing digital media campaigns for brands – particularly on paid digital and social platforms
  • Agency-side experience is preferable, but in-house experience is also valuable
  • In-depth experience across social platforms – Facebook/Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, SEM, and YouTube (and Google Ads more widely)
  • Web Analytics capabilities is a plus, especially knowledge of GA4 and unpacking acquisition trends
  • Any experience in other areas of digital media (programmatic, paid search, affiliates, SEO, GEO) is preferable, as is any experience in traditional media channels  
  • High attention to detail
  • Experience delivering client service excellence
  • Capability to problem solve; Have a highly numerical and analytical approach

job.title: Consultant(e) Senior RP Corporate
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Qui sommes-nous:

Burson, leader mondial de la communication, a pour mission de créer de la valeur pour ses clients par la gestion de leur réputation. Grâce à notre expertise, nos technologies de pointe, nos solutions d'intelligence artificielle et notre créativité, nous anticipons les risques en temps réel, identifions les insights générateurs de préférence et d'engagement, et accompagnons la transformation et la réussite de nos clients. Nous réinventons la réputation pour en faire un véritable atout concurrentiel. Burson est le gardien de votre réputation, le partenaire qui vous guide dans un environnement complexe.

En rejoignant Burson, vous intégrez une communauté mondiale d'experts à la pointe de l'innovation.

Burson fait partie du groupe WPP (LSE/NYSE : WPP), spécialiste de la transformation créative. Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur bursonglobal.com et suivez-nous sur LinkedIn et Instagram.

 

En savoir plus sur le rôle:

Nous vous proposons de rejoindre notre département Corporate, composé d’une équipe de 10 consultants passionnés, qui accompagnent des entreprises françaises et internationales dans la gestion de leur réputation.

Travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les expertises de l’agence, Consumer, Tech, Santé, Digital, Gestion de crise et Affaires publiques, nous concevons et déployons des stratégies de communication intégrées et à forte valeur ajoutée, au service des enjeux business et réputationnels de nos clients.

Dans un environnement stimulant, vous accompagnerez des organisations issues de secteurs variés, contribuerez activement au développement de nouveaux comptes et participerez au renforcement de notre expertise corporate.

A ce titre, vos missions seront les suivantes :

Conseil stratégique et accompagnement client

  • Participer activement à l’élaboration de recommandations stratégiques et de plans d’actions.

  • Accompagner les clients sur leurs enjeux de réputation, de visibilité et de transformation.

  • Développer des positionnements, plateformes de messages, éléments de langage et narratifs adaptés aux différents publics cibles.

  • Anticiper les besoins des clients, identifier les risques et leur apporter des recommandations proactives et opérationnelles.

  • Contribuer à la qualité de la relation conseil au quotidien avec les clients.

Relations avec les parties prenantes et influence

  • Concevoir et déployer des programmes de relations avec les parties prenantes des clients, y compris avec les médias  : veille stratégique, identification d’opportunités éditoriales, campagnes de médiatisation et dispositifs de visibilité.

  • Piloter les relations avec les journalistes, médias clés, leaders d’opinion et créateurs de contenus pertinents pour les clients.

  • Organiser interviews, événements presse, rencontres éditoriales et partenariats de brand content.

  • Développer et entretenir un réseau solide de journalistes, médias et influenceurs, en France comme à l’international.

Production de contenus et excellence rédactionnelle

  • Rédiger et/ou superviser la production de contenus à forte valeur ajoutée : communiqués de presse, pitchs médias, tribunes, dossiers de presse, livres blancs, FAQ, articles d’expertise, prises de parole de dirigeants ou contenus digitaux.

  • Garantir la qualité rédactionnelle des livrables clients et accompagner les équipes dans l’amélioration continue de leurs productions écrites.

Gestion de projet et coordination

  • Assurer le pilotage opérationnel des programmes confiés : suivi des budgets, gestion des délais et reporting client.

  • Veiller à la performance des actions mises en œuvre et à la satisfaction des clients.

  • Contribuer à la rentabilité des comptes et au développement durable des relations clients.

Développement commercial et développement de l’expertise

  • Participer activement aux réflexions stratégiques, aux brainstormings et aux travaux de recherche nécessaires aux recommandations.

  • Contribuer à la préparation des propositions commerciales, des appels d’offres et des soutenances de new business.

  • Identifier de nouvelles opportunités de développement auprès des clients existants et prospects.

  • Participer au rayonnement de l’expertise Corporate de l’agence et contribuer au partage des connaissances au sein des équipes.

Collaboration transverse

  • Travailler étroitement avec les autres expertises de l’agence afin de proposer des dispositifs de communication intégrés et innovants.

 

Profil recherché : 

  • Vous justifiez de 4 à 6 années d’expérience en agence de communication ou de relations publics, ou au sein de la Direction de la communication d’une entreprise, avec une expertise reconnue sur les enjeux de réputation et communication corporate. 

  • Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation Bac +3 à Bac +5 (type IEP, droit, affaires publiques, écoles de commerce, sciences politiques). 

  • Vous disposez d’une solide compréhension des enjeux de communication interne, marque employeur, conduite du changement et engagement des collaborateurs. 

  • Vous maîtrisez les mécaniques de relations médias, les stratégies d’influence ainsi que la production de contenus corporate. 

  • Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre capacité d’analyse, votre sens du conseil et votre aptitude à transformer des problématiques complexes en recommandations concrètes et impactantes. 

  • Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français à l’écrit comme à l’oral et êtes capable de travailler quotidiennement en anglais, dans un contexte international. 

  • Créatif(ve), curieux(se) et force de proposition, vous aimez imaginer de nouveaux dispositifs et faire émerger des idées différenciantes. 

  • Vous faites preuve d’autonomie, de rigueur, d’organisation et d’un excellent sens des priorités. 

  • Doté(e) d’un fort esprit d’équipe, vous appréciez les environnements collaboratifs et transverses. 

  • Vous êtes à l’aise dans la gestion de plusieurs projets simultanément et savez évoluer dans un environnement exigeant et dynamique.

 

Ce Que Nous Vous Offrons :

  1. Un environnement stimulant : Intégrez une agence reconnue mondialement, au cœur des stratégies de communication des plus grandes marques.

  2. Un encadrement de qualité : Vous serez accompagné(e) par des experts passionnés qui vous transmettront leur savoir-faire, avec des points réguliers et un feedback constructif pour vous aider à progresser.

  3. Une expérience professionnalisante : Développez des compétences clés et construisez une carrière solide dans un secteur en constante évolution.

  4. Une culture d’entreprise forte : Rejoignez une équipe dynamique et collaborative.

  5. Des avantages attractifs :

  6. Télétravail possible (2 jours/semaine).

  7. Forfait mobilité mensuel de 45,40 euros (carte Swile) pour transports publics ou mobilités durables.

  8. Accès à nos deux restaurants d’entreprise du Campus.

  9. 14 jours de RTT par an

  10. Accès aux avantages du Comité d’Entreprise (cinéma, chèques cadeaux, remboursements sportifs…).

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

About the Team

The Burson Sport, Brand & Entertainment team works with some of the world’s most ambitious consumer brands, helping them earn attention, build cultural relevance and drive conversation across markets. This role will sit across a varied client portfolio of FMCG, Retail and Travel brands including; TK Maxx UK, RAK, Nestle and Royal Caribbean Cruises, supporting work that spans brand storytelling, influence, earned media and travel communications.

The team is united by a belief in the power of culture, creativity and influence to shape how people discover, engage with and talk about brands. Across fashion and retail, lifestyle and technology, and food and drink, the team develops work that is insight-led, locally relevant and capable of travelling across multiple markets.

More about the role:

We are looking for an ambitious, enthusiastic Account Director to join the Sports, Brand & Entertainment team and work across a portfolio of major consumer clients: TK Maxx, RAK, Royal Carribean and Nestle EMEA. The role requires someone with FMCG, travel and retail experience, strong multi-market experience, a confident understanding of earned and influence, and the ability to bring fresh energy, strategic thinking and operational rigour to a fast-moving client portfolio.

The role will involve leading day-to-day client relationships, shaping earned and influencer-led activity, and managing hub responsibilities including market coordination, toolkit development, content planning and campaign roll-out. The right candidate will bring strong media and creator insight, confidence advising senior clients, and excellent organisational skills to help deliver consistent, culturally relevant work across multiple markets.

What you'll do:

  • Drive Excellence: Play a key role within a driven, ambitious, and collaborative team.
  • Manage Client Relationships: Serve as a trusted advisor and day-to-day lead across TK Maxx, Nestle, RAK and RCC, building strong relationships with senior clients and market teams.
  • Provide Media & Influence Insights: Bring a deep understanding of the evolving media, creator and influence landscape, identifying opportunities that help brands earn attention and relevance.
  • Create Assets: Develop clear, engaging toolkits, assets and content that support both global hub requirements and local market activation.
  • Market Liaison: Act as a central hub to coordinate, advise and align multiple markets, ensuring campaigns are delivered consistently while allowing for local nuance.
  • Strategy & Creativity: Write strategic plans and champion bold, creative work.
  • Data-Driven Storytelling: Use data and insights to build and drive effective campaigns.
  • Campaign Coordination: Oversee the planning and delivery of integrated earned, influencer and activation programmes across global, regional and local teams.
  • Leverage Technology: Expertly integrate a broad range of bespoke WPP HAI tools to optimize day-to-day efficiency and outputs.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Strategic & Creative Thinker: A natural ability to think big and connect creative ideas to business goals.
  • Culturally Plugged In: On the pulse of current social trends, street style, and wider culture, with an understanding of how these elements generate campaign cut-through.
  • Proven Track Record: Experience creating and activating impactful campaigns for major consumer brands, ideally across fashion and retail, lifestyle technology, and food and drink sectors.
  • Media, Creator & Influence Expertise: A strong understanding of the media, creator and influence landscape, with the ability to develop credible influencer strategies and earned storytelling across markets.
  • Client Leadership: Proven experience managing clients and leading projects from initial concept design to final delivery.
  • Financial Acumen: Proficient in preparing, tracking, and managing project budgets.
  • Collaborative Spirit: A team player who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Detail-Oriented: Exceptional organizational skills with sharp attention to detail, especially when working under pressure or tight deadlines.
  • Multi-Market Mindset: Proven multi-market communications experience is essential, including the ability to manage hub responsibilities, coordinate local market needs and deliver work that travels effectively across regions.

More about the role:

Burson is seeking a Copywriter who is passionate about health, culture, and big creative ideas to join our growing healthcare team. You’ll help bring a fresh creative lens to pharmaceutical communications, developing work that makes complex health topics more human, relevant, and engaging.

This is a hands-on creative role for someone who wants to dig into the work, challenge the expected, and make the ideas stronger. You’ll collaborate closely with art partners and Associate Creative Directors to concept, write, refine, and bring ideas to life across channels. We’re looking for someone with curiosity, creative ambition, and the drive to continually push the work while contributing to the growth of important client relationships.

You will be joining a team that has won Cannes Lions, Clio, New York Festivals, SABER and PRWeek awards among others .... so you are joining a great team! 

To develop creative communications campaigns for our clients across the earned, owned, paid and shared spaces, we turn to creative and design expertise to come up with original concepts that will break through the noise. 

The Creative team works across the entire Burson client roster to ideate, develop and produce earned campaigns. Our work connects consumers and brands by creating campaigns and content that dig deeper and imagine more. We’ve gathered an intentionally disparate collection of designers, writers, producers, and other creators to give us the expertise to credibly deliver content and programming that can live across any and all platforms. And to that end, we look for people who love what they do and can roll up their sleeves to push our creative even further!

Because your work tells us more than a resume ever could, a portfolio is required. We welcome both published and unpublished work and encourage you to share pieces that best demonstrate how you think, concept, and write. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Click here to see and learn more about our award-winning Creative team: https://www.bursonglobal.com/locations/us/creative-careers-at-bcw-north-america?x-craft-preview=zhHaDwgRpk&token=Hr2_DXhvw31XqcptLeAlGLGTwgjvfPN5 

What you'll do:

  • Ideate and develop thumb-stopping social that tap into cultural trends.
  • Ideate earned- first creative from project brief.  
  • Write and edit strategic client work across all platforms and executions.
  • Work with an art director to deliver creative-forward content as well as breakthrough brand campaign development. 
  • Dig deep for nuggets of inspiration that will help you form ideas. 
  • Participate in collective brainstorms, bringing bold ideas to the team. 
  • Collaborate with art partners, designers, creative directors, strategists and more.
  • Pitch and sell campaigns, activations, and ideas to internal teams and clients, developing the trust of all audiences. 
  • Work to constantly improve your craft, sharpen your storytelling skills, and mature as a creative. 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 4-6 years of experience in ideating and writing across various mediums. 
  • Understanding of popular social networks and cultural trends.
  • Experience working with designers, strategists and producers to deliver content in all forms across any and all platforms. 
  • Strong conceptual and brainstorming skills. 
  • Exceptional communication skills within the agency team. 
  • Very high attention to detail. 
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • You’re curious:  you stay up to date on what breaks in culture before it becomes mainstream.
  • You’re humble: You support other people’s ideas like they were your own, taking direction with grace and confidence. 
  • You’re collaborative: You want to work in a diverse and inclusive organization, actively participating in cultural initiatives.

Who we are:

For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

Ready to skip the typical intern coffee runs and jump straight into work that actually matters? At Burson, we don’t just “do PR” – we shape conversations, influence behaviours, protect reputations, and build campaigns that spark change across social, digital, and traditional channels – in Canada and globally. We're all about smart strategy, real impact, and an international network of thinkers, doers, and game-changers.

This is an existing opportunity to join our team as a Corporate Affairs Intern – someone curious, creative, proactive, and genuinely excited about the intersection of business, reputation and current affairs.

In this paid internship role, you’ll work alongside experienced corporate communications and advisory professionals supporting clients across a variety of industries, including financial and professional services, energy and technology. From monitoring and analysis and media relations to stakeholder engagement and thought leadership, you'll gain hands-on experience helping organizations tell their stories and build trust with their audiences.

This isn’t just an internship – it’s a launchpad into a career in corporate communications.

Annual Compensation: C$38,462, plus applicable vacation pay

What you’ll be doing (and probably have a blast doing):

  • Developing client-ready deliverables including media lists, pitches, stakeholder maps, meeting agendas and summaries, briefing notes, media monitoring and social listening analysis reports
  • Assisting with media relations in support of client announcements focusing on business, news and trade media
  • Conducting research on companies, industries, competitors and current affairs to support client work and new business opportunities
  • Bringing your big ideas to brainstorms and planning meetings
  • Becoming our trend and news spotter – tracking business news, industry developments, emerging issues, and online conversations, and sharing relevant insights with the team and clients

One day you might be supporting a major corporate announcement or helping position a subject-matter expert as an industry voice. The next? You’re tracking a news announcement, pitching journalists or researching an emerging reputational issue. No two days are the same – promise.

What makes you a great fit:

  • You’re a recent graduate in public relations, journalism, business, political science, or a related field
  • You thrive in fast-moving environments and juggle deadlines with ease
  • You have strong writing and research skills and excellent attention to detail (typos tremble in your presence)
  • You’re proactive, curious, and ready to take initiative
  • You’re curious about the world around you – business, current affairs, crisis communications, issues management, corporate reputation
  • You enjoy meeting new people, learning from others, and building your network
  • You’re interested in understanding how organizations communicate with their internal and external audiences to build and manage reputation

Why Burson Is That Internship:

  • Work with leading organizations across a variety of industries
  • Get mentorship from people who are excited to see you flourish, grow, and learn
  • Build a portfolio that makes future-you proud
  • Join a team that’s ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely fun
  • Gain exposure to corporate communications, reputation management, media relations, executive positioning, and integrated communications
  • Be part of a global network of communications experts and learn how strategic communications shape businesses and society

If you’re looking for an opportunity to do great work with great people – and make your mark in the corporate affairs and communications space – we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Data Engineer, Communications Intelligence & Insights
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More About the Role

 

Are you interested in building the systems that underpin how modern communications intelligence is measured, analysed and scaled?

Burson’s EMEA Intelligence & Insights Hub is a centralised production and engineering capability responsible for developing the data infrastructure, pipelines and workflows that power monitoring, measurement and reporting across the region. Bringing together engineers and analysts, the Hub builds scalable platforms, integrates multiple external data sources and develops AI-enabled workflows that enhance both the efficiency and quality of intelligence delivery.

As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in developing, maintaining and optimising the engineering systems that sit at the heart of the Hub’s delivery model. You will work across core platform engineering, client-specific solutions and AI workflow development, helping to evolve The Fount and Burson’s wider Data & Intelligence technology stack.

Our technology ecosystem is built on a modern, highly integrated cloud and relational database architecture. Core data-processing pipelines are developed using object-oriented Python and run through scalable cloud-compute orchestration and enterprise ETL tools. Managed SQL environments provide our relational system of record, while raw and semi-structured assets are maintained within secure cloud object storage.

Advanced language models are integrated directly into our processing pipelines to automate enrichment at scale, with the wider ecosystem managed through GitHub, Azure DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving complex data challenges while building reliable, scalable and reusable systems that support analysts, client teams and global stakeholders.

 

What you'll do:

 

  • Build, develop and maintain Burson’s core data platform and pipelines, supporting scalable ingestion, transformation, storage and delivery of intelligence data across the EMEA Hub.
  • Design and manage robust ingestion pipelines for media monitoring, social listening, APIs, internal datasets and third-party research and analytics sources.
  • Develop transformation and data-modelling layers using SQL and Python, creating both standardised central data models and bespoke client datasets that support downstream reporting, including Power BI.
  • Design and deliver client-specific data engineering solutions, developing custom pipelines, integrations and datasets where off-the-shelf technology does not meet complex or specialist requirements.
  • Optimise the performance, scalability and reliability of data systems, identifying bottlenecks, resolving data-quality issues and continuously improving pipeline efficiency.
  • Develop reusable engineering frameworks, templates and components that enable the Hub to scale solutions consistently across clients, markets and use cases.
  • Contribute to AI-enabled workflows, embedding language models into data pipelines to automate content analysis, classification, tagging, summarisation, relevance, sentiment and other enrichment processes.
  • Develop and refine prompting frameworks and AI-processing workflows, including monitoring and optimising token usage to ensure effective, efficient and commercially sustainable AI enrichment at scale.
  • Partner with analysts, product teams and communications specialists to translate approved business and reporting requirements into clearly defined technical solutions and identify appropriate opportunities for AI and automation.
  • Work within a structured Agile and ticket-driven engineering environment, contributing to sprint planning, daily stand-ups and technical design discussions while delivering against agreed functional specifications and architectural standards.
  • Maintain strong engineering governance and security standards, including consistent code practices, Git workflows, secure credential management, database security and adherence to agreed directory and repository structures.
  • Own high-quality technical documentation, maintaining clear technical guides, markdown documentation, database schemas and system records while contributing to planned refactoring and technical-debt reduction without disrupting production services.

 

 

Experience that contributes to success:

 

  • Strong experience in data engineering, with a track record of designing, building and maintaining reliable production-grade data pipelines and platforms.
  • Advanced SQL skills and strong experience in relational database environments, including data transformation, modelling, optimisation and the creation of data structures for downstream analytics and reporting.
  • Strong Python development capability, including writing clean, readable and object-oriented code, working with pandas and developing concurrent or scalable data-processing workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with APIs, data integrations and ETL/ELT architectures, with the ability to bring together structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources.
  • Experience working within cloud-based data environments, ideally Microsoft Azure, including cloud compute, managed databases, object storage and enterprise data-processing services.
  • Strong software-engineering discipline, including experience designing and writing automated unit, integration and regression tests in Python, ideally using pytest.
  • A strong understanding of secure engineering practices, including database security, firewalls and secure secrets and credential management using tools such as Azure Key Vault.
  • Experience with Git-based engineering workflows and CI/CD environments, ideally including GitHub and Azure DevOps, with an appreciation for structured branching, code governance and multi-developer environments.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code, ideally Terraform or Terragrunt, and the ability to safely manage or update environment variables, configuration and access controls within established infrastructure frameworks.
  • Experience or strong interest in AI-enabled data engineering, including exposure to large language models, prompt-based workflows, automated enrichment or the integration of AI services into production data pipelines.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and technical-planning skills, with the ability to diagnose complex data and performance issues, scope engineering work effectively and build scalable solutions rather than short-term fixes.
  • A collaborative and disciplined approach to engineering, comfortable working across multiple projects with analysts, engineers, product teams and business stakeholders while maintaining strong documentation, continuous improvement and adherence to agreed technical standards.

 

 

#LI-NE1
