Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This role requires full time on site presence.

 

Your Role

 

The Transmission division of CBC/Radio-Canada is looking for a bright and energetic individual to join its Saskatoon team in the role of a Senior Remote Area Transmitter Technologist. The successful candidate will be involved in installing, troubleshooting, and modifying transmission equipment, satellite communication systems, and facilities ensuring their proper operating condition. You will also align, test and configure equipment and systems, including the related software, in order to obtain and confirm optimal performance or to identify existing or potential problems.

 

Also, you will perform and document repairs and regular preventive maintenance procedures according to established procedures and corporate standards. You will carry out and assist in the development of quality control procedures, prepare and correct documents, schematics, functional drawings, specification tables and layout diagrams. In addition, you will contact suppliers for equipment, services or advice, and operate motor vehicles. You guide the development and assist in the training of other employees, as well as contribute ideas and make recommendations to overcome problems or achieve desired results.

 

As required, you may troubleshoot and maintain other equipment associated with remote transmitter sites; maintain complete transmitter sites including buildings, grounds and roads; travel to remote locations under short notice and difficult conditions and work on satellite dishes.

 

We are looking for a candidate with the following: 

  • Must possess at least a two (2) year Post-Secondary technologist diploma from a recognized college in an appropriate discipline or its equivalent as determined by the Corporation.
  • Practical and relevant experience would be considered an asset.
  • Requires overall general knowledge regarding maintenance of equipment, systems and relevant software technologies.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license as well as a driving record that meets the minimum requirements of CBC/Radio-Canada's insurance company.
  • Frequent travel may be required and includes long distance trips.
  • Must be able to travel and to work alone at remote locations under difficult conditions.
  • Must be able to meet the identified physical requirements of the position.
  • Problem solving, interpersonal, and communication skills needed.
  • Self-motivated, initiative, conscientious.
  • Able to grasp new concepts quickly.
  • Reliable and autonomous.
  • Work under minimum supervision.
  • Work in a team environment or individually.
  • Available for overtime.
  • Hours of work: 24/7 operation with occasional shift requirement to cover work outside of standard daytime working hours.

Senior Writer CBC Money, Multiple Locations (English Services) (On-Site), Halifax


CBC News is expanding its financial and consumer storytelling to help Canadians navigate complex economic realities. Affordability remains top of mind for most Canadians. Purchasing power is being squeezed by inflation and tariff policies. Young people are struggling to land that first job at a time when artificial intelligence and technology are changing the workforce. Canadians are faced with a myriad of complex economic realities.


We’re looking for people who are excited to show up to work knowing anything can happen on their watch, thrives when news breaks, and have a keen interest in the way money and the economy shapes the lives of Canadians. 


On the business beat, you will focus on the intersection of money and everyday life. This means looking beyond the market and financial headlines to break down and bring home complex economic stories.  You will actively track economic, corporate, consumer and policy shifts both nationally and in your region with the goal of helping Canadians understand the financial and money forces that are affecting their lives.


Your task would be to break news and build a pipeline of memorable original stories. 

You'll experiment with various formats and platforms, from graphics and social media to radio and TV. You’ll have the voice and reporting chops to explain business news and bring to life economic stories.


Data excites you. You use charts, graphs and explainers to provide clarity and context in our storytelling. This role emphasizes mobile-first and vertical video storytelling tailored to reach younger, diverse, and underserved audiences where they consume media. 


Key Tasks:


  • Consistently pitches original ideas in line with the unit’s mandate and objectives. 
  • Cover stories of regional and national importance, including gathering, writing, vetting, and presenting for all audio, visual, and digital platforms.
  • Maintain a base of sources that allow you to lead on key stories in your region or a beat, including economic experts, business leaders, and voices from underserved communities
  • Participates in all aspects of the production; and brings a willingness to appear on camera for production shoots, as required.
  • Experience writing short-form and vertical video for presentation on mobile and streaming platforms that describes complex business, financial and consumer information in a clear and concise manner.
  • Pivot to breaking news and quickly turnaround stories in a way that enhances the understanding of the audience.
  • Work with the CBC Money team across the country to deliver the stories Canadians need to understand the economy and how it affects them. 
  • That will include collaboration and editing the work of others.
  • As a subject matter expert on business, financial and consumer trends and issue, you will describe these issues and events in a clear and concise manner and provide detailed analysis to enhance the understanding for our audience.

Your Profile:

We are looking for a candidate with the following:


  • A minimum of five years of relevant journalism experience including vertical and short-form visual storytelling.
  • Able to analyze complex data focused on business, economics, and money
  • Solid journalistic skills, including an understanding of legal risk, and demonstrated understanding of CBC’s Journalistic Standards and Practices.
  • Able to work with experienced producers and hosts to develop and produce high-impact short-form and vertical video under tight deadlines.
  • Excellent research, writing and editing skills.
  • Able to keep track of a number of simultaneous activities and prioritize and plan.
  • Able to communicate both verbally and in writing clearly and concisely.
  • Must be available for flexible work hours, that could include overtime,  that could include overtime, early mornings, evenings and weekends.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

job.title: Associate Business Development Manager
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance. Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO! We are the now and the next. The power behind the people building the future. We are born from the spirit of innovation. We are created from the idea that people around the world want more, need more, deserve more. We are the home of the global digital revolution. We are CNN. ã

¤ We are CNN. THE WORLD'S MOST ESSENTIAL AND ENGAGING SOURCE OF DIGITAL NEWS. We are in the midst of rapid transformation and need our next generation of innovators, makers, and dreamers who will lead and drive our growth. We aim to make the world a better, more connected place. Your New Role… CNN is seeking an exceptional and strategic Associate Manager of Business Development responsible for supporting CNN’s Commerce team by growing affiliate revenue through content and linking optimizations, new affiliate solutions, and overseeing key merchant relationships. Revenue from affiliate transactions is the primary monetization vehicle of CNN Underscored, and we are looking to grow this revenue for our 2,000+ existing merchant partners, as well as expand the presence of affiliate through new verticals and unique partnership opportunities. Outside of working with merchant partners, the Associate Manager of Business Development will collaborate with Business and Editorial team members to identify new monetization opportunities, operationalize relevant strategies, and analyze performance for continued growth through both Organic and Paid channels. They will also work closely with Product, Engineering, and Revenue Insights on new features and incremental earnings opportunities. Your Role Accountabilities... Partner Management: Oversee a portfolio of priority merchants to nurture and grow affiliate earnings with through performance incentives, commission negotiations, and strategic initiatives. Content & Linking Optimization: Maximize affiliate revenue from content by implementing high-yield partner links, optimizing content to increase click through rate and conversion rate, and oversee network migrations to mitigate revenue loss. Performance Analysis: Analyze merchant and article-level performance to identify alternative monetization tactics that improve core performance metrics through diverse attribution and partner diversification strategies. Cross Collaboration: Work with Business Development, Editorial, Product and Analytics stakeholders to identify, analyze, and develop new business and product solutions that increase user engagement and revenue earnings. New Revenue: Assist Business Development team in sourcing, identifying and developing new opportunities to create revenue on and off platform through Sponsorships, Paid Media, and other digitally driven concepts. Qualifications & Experience… Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, data science, or related field. Minimum 3 years’ experience in digital marketing, analytics, or related field. Experience working with internal and external stakeholders to develop new concepts, strategies, and processes that drive revenue growth. A fundamental understanding of affiliate revenue KPIs such as, earnings-per-click, cost-per-action, revenue-per-impression, click-through rate, and conversion rate. Affiliate marketing experience and familiarity with affiliate network reporting platforms is preferred. The ideal candidate is organized, has strong analytical skills, the ability to problem solve, and can effectively communicate informative findings to others. About Skydance Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. job.title: KIDZ BOP, Brand Marketing Associate
job.description:
Overview

Founded in 2008, BMG is committed to building the world’s most trusted, forward-looking music company. Following its combination with Concord in 2026, BMG brings together global scale, deep expertise, technology, and partnership to unlock new opportunities for creators while protecting and growing the long-term value and cultural impact of their work.  

 

Headquartered in Nashville with 18 offices globally, BMG is privately held and part of Bertelsmann, the international media, services and education company, with a minority stake held by affiliates of Great Mountain Partners. 

 

KIDZ BOP is the #1 music brand for kids, featuring today's biggest hits, "sung by kids for kids." Since 2001, the family friendly music brand has generated 14 billion streams and currently records in 5 different languages. The brand connects with its fans through year-round music releases, music videos, in-school activations, global partnerships, a dedicated channel on SiriusXM (KIDZ BOP Radio channel 135) and live tours. Each year, KIDZ BOP LIVE, the ultimate pop concert for kids (and grown-ups) hits all major cities across the US. 

Responsibilities

Your Mission:

KIDZ BOP is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and creative-minded Brand Marketing Associate to support the development and execution of marketing campaigns across all areas of the brand, including music releases, live touring, brand partnerships, and major seasonal initiatives.

 

This role will be involved in the full lifecycle of marketing campaigns, from developing marketing plans and coordinating creative assets to managing approvals, media execution, and campaign deliverables. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, resourceful self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys bringing creative marketing ideas to life.

 

What You'll Be Doing:

• Marketing Planning & Campaign Management: Work collaboratively with internal teams to develop and execute integrated marketing plans across album releases, live touring, brand partnerships, and key brand initiatives. Help identify marketing opportunities, build campaign timelines, coordinate deliverables, and manage campaigns from planning through execution.• Creative Development & Execution: Partner with creative, video, and social teams to develop campaign assets across digital, social, out-of-home, and other marketing channels. Manage creative briefs, feedback, revisions, and approvals to ensure assets are on-brand, accurate, and delivered on time.• Media Coordination: Work closely with internal and external media teams to coordinate campaign launches, ensuring advertising assets are delivered, placed, and running correctly across paid digital, social, out-of-home, and other media channels.• Live Tour Marketing: Collaborate directly with concert venues, promoters, and touring teams to develop and execute local marketing plans for KIDZ BOP LIVE tour dates. Manage promotional deliverables and identify opportunities to maximize awareness and ticket sales in each market.• Brand Partnerships: Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for brand partners, managing campaign timelines, creative development, approvals, and deliverables to ensure successful execution of sponsorships and marketing partnerships.• Brand Events & Activations: Support the planning and execution of brand events, promotional activations, and experiential marketing initiatives. Serve as the on-site KIDZ BOP brand representative and primary point of contact, coordinating with partners, vendors, and internal teams to ensure events run smoothly and meet brand expectations.• Marketing Materials: Work with internal teams to develop and update brand presentations, pitch decks, sales materials, sizzle reels, and other promotional assets.• Project Management & Administrative Support: Maintain marketing calendars, campaign trackers, budgets, and timelines to keep projects organized and on schedule. Assist with meeting coordination, invoices, payments, and other day-to-day administrative needs.

Qualifications

What You Bring:

• 2+ years of experience in marketing, campaign management, brand marketing, or a related field.• Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.• Proactive, resourceful self-starter who takes ownership of projects and follows through from start to finish.• Strong project management skills and the ability to coordinate across multiple departments and external partners.• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a personable, positive attitude and strong interpersonal skills.• Collaborative team player who works well with colleagues, external partners, talent, and families, and is comfortable in kid-friendly environments.• Creative mindset with an understanding of effective marketing content and advertising across digital, social, and traditional media.• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with shifting priorities.• Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with Adobe Photoshop, video editing software, and other creative tools is a plus.• Interest in music, entertainment, pop culture, and consumer marketing.• Willingness to travel and work occasional evenings or weekends for events and activations.  Salary: $60,000/year  *This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days minimum on-site. BMG is an equal opportunity employer. We employ, train, compensate and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We believe that diversity, inclusion and equity is paramount for the creation of music, theater and film that celebrates and empowers all cultures.

job.title: KIDZ BOP, Video Editing and Production Coordinator
job.description:
Overview

Founded in 2008, BMG is committed to building the world’s most trusted, forward-looking music company. Following its combination with Concord in 2026, BMG brings together global scale, deep expertise, technology, and partnership to unlock new opportunities for creators while protecting and growing the long-term value and cultural impact of their work.  

 

Headquartered in Nashville with 18 offices globally, BMG is privately held and part of Bertelsmann, the international media, services and education company, with a minority stake held by affiliates of Great Mountain Partners.

Each year, KIDZ BOP LIVE, the ultimate pop concert for kids (and grown-ups) hits all major cities across the US. 

Responsibilities

Your Mission:

KIDZ BOP is looking for a creative, highly organized Video Editor & Production Coordinator to support video content across social media, music, marketing, live events and brand partnerships.

 

The ideal candidate is a strong editor who stays current on TikTok, Reels and YouTube trends, brings creative ideas to the table and is comfortable supporting video production from pre-production through post.

 

What You'll Be Doing:

Video Editing & Creative

• Edit video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, live tour, music releases and marketing.• Create engaging edits using captions, graphics, pop-ups, sound effects, transitions and music-driven pacing.• Stay current on social video trends and help develop fun content ideas that connect with kids and parents.• Take creative feedback well and make revisions quickly.• Explore new editing tools and AI video platforms such as Runway.

Video Production

• Help coordinate approximately 15 KIDZ BOP video shoots per year, including scheduling, call sheets, equipment and freelance crews.• Work with outside production companies and freelancers.• Support shoots on set as needed, including occasional travel, evenings and weekend shoots.• Comfortable with all aspects of smaller scale production including camera, lighting, and sound.• Help build and maintain a network of freelance editors, shooters, motion designers and production crew.

Asset & Project Management

• Manage in-house edit priorities and video requests.• Maintain organized production servers and the KIDZ BOP Video Archive.• Manage video delivery to outside partners and platforms.

Budget & Department Support

• Assist with production budgets and tracking.• Organize invoices and department expenses.• Support additional video and production needs as required.

Qualifications

What You Bring:

• Strong video editing skills with experience in Adobe Premiere.• Working knowledge of After Effects and Adobe Creative Cloud.• Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and current editing trends.• Strong sense of pacing, music, humor and visual storytelling.• Creative thinker who can pitch ideas as well as execute them.• Highly collaborative, open to feedback and comfortable working through multiple rounds of edits.• Organized, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple projects at once.• Experience with AI video or editing tools is a plus.• Experience working with children or family content is a plus.• Existing network of freelance video and production talent is a plus.• Ability to travel and work occasional evenings and weekends based on production schedules.

 

Salary: $55,000/year

 

*This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days minimum on-site.

 

Please include a portfolio or reel with examples of your editing work, especially short-form or social content.

We employ, train, compensate and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We believe that diversity, inclusion and equity is paramount for the creation of music, theater and film that celebrates and empowers all cultures.

Combine radio, digital, promotions, sponsorships, events, and creative partnerships into integrated campaigns that deliver value for advertisers. Turn ideas into revenue. At least two years of sales experience, preferably in B2B sales, advertising, marketing, media, or a client-facing business development role. A track record of developing business, growing revenue, and working toward measurable sales goals. Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment where initiative and adaptability matter. A valid driver’s license and a fully insured personal vehicle for business use. Even better if you bring:

Experience

selling radio, digital advertising, integrated marketing, sponsorships, or events. A strong local network or knowledge of the San Francisco Bay Area business community.

Experience

creating strategic proposals and delivering engaging client presentations. Familiarity with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace. A bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field. We value talent, curiosity, drive, and the ability to build meaningful relationships. If you have the right mindset and a passion for helping businesses grow, we want to hear from you. YOUR AMBITION. OUR PLATFORM. BIGGER POSSIBILITIES. At Connoisseur Media, we believe our people are our greatest competitive advantage. We invest in individuals who take ownership of their careers, bring fresh thinking to their work, and want to be part of a team that supports one another and celebrates success. You’ll have the opportunity to work with established local media brands, develop new business relationships, collaborate with creative and digital marketing professionals, and build a career in an industry that continues to evolve. READY TO MAKE YOUR MARK? Bring your ideas. Bring your ambition. Help us shape what’s next for Bay Area businesses and brands. Discover your talent. Build your future. job.title: Chief Engineer
job.description:
Connoisseur Media is looking for a Full-Time Engineer for our North Dallas (Sherman-McKinney, TX) market. The ideal candidate has basic knowledge of, or is willing to learn about, radio broadcast technical systems and equipment to ensure reliable, high-quality audio transmission for our three radio stations - 97.5 KLAK, 93.1 KMKT, and 102.5 KMAD-FM. The ideal candidate works well under pressure, creates solutions, and is a resourceful, diligent, engaged, and creative problem-solver, with not just a “can-do” but a “will-do” attitude. While we seek someone well-versed in, or willingness to learn, broadcast engineering, a candidate’s interpersonal and communication skills, as well as business and personal integrity, are just as important as technical ability.

Responsibilities

for this position include: Compliance with FCC regulations and station policies regarding broadcast standards. Maintenance of safety protocols in all engineering practices. Chief Operator (EAS, Maintenance, and Transmitter Readings log management & review). Regular inspection and maintenance of broadcast equipment, including a mix of solid-state and high-power tube transmitters, audio consoles, studio gear, audio automation systems, remote broadcast systems, and other related equipment. Perform hands-on routine preventive maintenance and repairs on all technical systems. Monitor audio quality and signal strength during radio broadcasts and be able to quickly troubleshoot issues, as needed. Under the direction of Corporate IT, complete all necessary procedures and paperwork relating to the market’s computer system and be the local eyes and hands for remote IT Help Desk support. Oversee the installation of new equipment and technologies, including the planning and implementation of upgrades to existing systems. Work with the Director of Engineering and market Operations Manager to manage capital projects and implement corporate initiatives. Maintain minimal downtime of broadcast, audio and computer systems, including emergency repairs, but also planning and advocating for any necessary improvements to all systems. Provide technical support and expertise, as needed, to other departments in planning and executing initiatives. Clear, professional, and productive communication with employees who do not have technical or programming backgrounds, as well as subcontractors and vendors. Develop clear instructions relating to simple tasks for non-technical employees to understand and perform. Maintain an accurate equipment inventory, maintenance logs, and technical schematics. This includes the preparation of reports relating to asset additions/disposals and technical issues and solutions. Requirements of this position include the following: A minimum of 1-3 years audio engineering, Radio/TV broadcast engineering and/or IT experience. Knowledge of FCC Regulations. Availability to travel to multiple market locations and transmitter sites. Familiarity with, or willingness to learn about, broadcast automation and centralized audio routing systems. Basic knowledge of, or willingness to learn about, computer networks, STL systems, RF & landline, including analog, digital, and IP. A flexible self-manager with the ability to prioritize tasks and shift priorities as needed. This position requires a fully insured personal vehicle and a valid driver’s license. The candidate is required to provide a safe driving record covering the past three years. Must be able to develop collaborative and productive relationships with market employees, so market staff can help troubleshoot effectively when the engineer is off-site. On call availability for transmitter, studio, and remote broadcast technical issues, remote alarm calls, emergencies, and be proactive about coverage when unavailable. ​

Preferred Qualifications

Military or Post-Secondary electronics training. SBE Certification.

Experience

with Axia LiveWire routing. Demonstrated Project Management skills.​

Connoisseur Media is seeking a talented, motivated, and enthusiastic intern to join our programming department in our Anchorage, Alaska market location. This will be a paid Internship through the Alaska Broadcasters Association. This internship will provide hands-on

experience

in radio broadcasting, news production, and learning how to work with a team. You will be helping out in the Programming Department with news and operations on all seven stations in the market location. What You Will Learn: Prize setup and distribution. General Administrative duties. Produce and edit audio programming segments. Write and post information to station websites and social media platforms. Understand procedures in case of a computer crash or loss of broadcast signal. Communication procedures in the event of any concerns, issues, or problems with the broadcast. What You Will Get Out of the Internship: Hands-on

experience

in radio broadcasting. Opportunity to develop your on-air talent and public speaking skills. Exposure to the inner workings of a radio station. Professional development and networking opportunities.

Responsibilities

of this position may include: Assisting in the production of news content for on-air and online distribution. Monitoring breaking news and updating coverage as needed. Recording hourly newscasts. Engage with listeners via social media and at events. Other duties as assigned by the Business or Operations Manager. Requirements of this position include the following: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Must be a team player and work well with management and staff at all levels. Public speaking skills and the ability to interact with listeners and clients in a public setting. Ability to multitask and handle pressures and deadlines. Be a positive member of a tight-knit team. Must be creative and innovative with a strong work ethic. This internship is an excellent opportunity for students pursuing a career in broadcasting or journalism to gain valuable

experience

in the field. If you are passionate about radio broadcasting and looking for an opportunity to grow and learn, we encourage you to apply for this internship. We’d love to hear a sample of your work! If you would like to send a demo, include the link to your website in your cover letter. If you do not have a website, upload your demo in YouTube and provide the link. job.title: Remote Technician (Part Time)
job.description:
Connoisseur Media – Columbia, SC, is hiring a part-time Remote Technician to bring our live broadcasts and events to life (about 10 hours per week). You’ll drive station vehicles, set up and break down equipment, coordinate on-site contests, and engage with listeners. Most events run about two hours, with setup an hour before. Some office support may be needed. We’re looking for someone outgoing, reliable, flexible on weeknights and weekends, and ready to represent our stations in the community. A valid driver’s license and a clean driving record are required.

Responsibilities

of this position may include the following: Setting up station events: raising tents, plugging in sound systems, putting up signage/banners. Approximately 10 hours a week. Managing the events while in progress: interacting with listeners, leading games, prize wheels, speaking on the microphone/PA. Successfully communicate with several different types of positions: listeners, employees, management at events, and clients. Other duties as assigned. Requirements for this position include the following: Must be 21 years or older. Must hold a valid Driver’s License and a current vehicle with current auto insurance. Must be able to drive a station vehicle (van or SUV). Must be able to lift 25- 50 lbs. Must be willing to work evenings, weekends, and holidays. Preference may be given to candidates who have the above

experience

job.description:

In this on-site role, you will be at the heart of a fast-paced environment, keeping daily operations running smoothly while supporting multiple departments. As a welcoming first point of contact for callers and visitors, you will provide comprehensive support across administrative, business, sales, traffic, and promotional functions. We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive self-starter who excels under deadlines. The ideal candidate communicates effectively, manages competing priorities with ease, and delivers exceptional customer service in a collaborative team setting. To succeed, you must bring strong multitasking abilities, sharp prioritization skills in a high-energy atmosphere, and a steadfast commitment to internal controls and company procedures. Above all, you should be a dedicated and dependable team player.

of this position may include the following: Answer Incoming Phone Calls. Welcome visitors and clients. Maintain office supply inventory Handle Prize Distribution and winner interfacing. Handle Account Executive Requests within Wide Orbit or VCreative. Misc. Office Duties that Management will assign. job.title: Street Team & Board Operator (Part-Time)
job.description:
Connoisseur Media – Amarillo, TX Love live events, great music, sports, and radio? Want to be part of the team behind some of Amarillo's most recognized radio brands? Connoisseur Media Amarillo is looking for an energetic, dependable, and enthusiastic Part-Time Street Team & Board Operator to help bring our stations to life both on the air and in the community. Represent KGNC 97.9 (KGNC-FM), 100.9 The Eagle (KXGL-FM), 102.9 The Rattler (KVWE-FM), and NewsTalk 710 & 97.5 KGNC (KGNC-AM) at concerts, festivals, live broadcasts, sporting events, and community appearances while also helping keep our stations sounding their best behind the scenes. No two days are the same! One day you could be hosting games and giveaways at a concert, and the next you could be running a live sports broadcast or operating the control board during a live show. If you're outgoing, love working with people, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and have a passion for radio and live entertainment, we'd love to meet you!

What You'll Do

Represent our stations at live broadcasts, concerts, festivals, sporting events, and community events. Set up and tear down promotional equipment, including tents, banners, sound systems, tables, and displays. Engage listeners through contests, prize wheels, games, giveaways, and on-site promotions. Make announcements using microphones and PA systems while creating an exciting event atmosphere. Drive station vehicles and transport promotional equipment to and from events. Operate the on-air control board for live and syndicated programming. Run live sports broadcasts, programming, commercials, and station breaks with accuracy. Monitor automation systems, transmitters, and studio equipment to ensure smooth broadcasts. Maintain broadcast logs and accurately report discrepancies. Follow FCC regulations, EAS procedures, and station operating standards. Communicate effectively with station management regarding technical or programming concerns. Work collaboratively with promotions, programming, sales, and engineering teams. Perform other duties as assigned. What We're Looking For Positive, energetic personality with excellent customer service skills. Strong communication skills and the confidence to interact with listeners, clients, and coworkers. Reliable, self-motivated, and able to work independently or as part of a team. Comfortable working outdoors and in varying weather conditions. Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and assist with event setup and teardown. Ability to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and occasional last-minute shifts. Valid driver's license and current auto insurance. Must be able to drive a company vehicle. Must be at least 18 years old (21+ preferred for events where alcohol is served).

Preferred Qualifications

Previous

experience

in radio, promotions, live events, sports broadcasting, or media.

Experience

operating radio automation systems such as Marketron or similar software. Familiarity with FCC rules and EAS requirements.

Experience

with social media platforms, WordPress, or digital content creation. Passion for music, sports, entertainment, and connecting with the local community. This is a part-time position averaging 10–15 hours per week, with additional hours available during busy event seasons and special programming opportunities. If you're looking for a fun, hands-on opportunity to break into broadcasting while representing some of Amarillo's favorite radio stations, we encourage you to apply!

Benefits

Connoisseur invests in people who invest in themselves by offering competitive

benefits

for part-time employees that support success both on and off the job. Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for employees and all household members at no cost. 401(k) Retirement Plan with discretionary employer matching. Sick Leave Pay when required by state law. Discover Your Passion at Connoisseur! We are Connoisseur Media, a broadcast and digital media company serving audiences, advertisers, and local communities. From music and news to community events, we create media that matters. Through Connrex Digital, we help brands thrive with smart strategies, engaging stories, and expert PR. At our core, people are our passion and the heart of the Company, and we’re proud to be community-minded, with employees who love getting involved and making a difference. Connoisseur Media is an

job.title: Street Team (Part-Time)
job.description:
Connoisseur Media in Long Island, NY, is growing our Promotions Team—and we’re looking for outgoing, energetic personalities to join the fun! This part-time opportunity is perfect for someone who thrives on connecting with people and loves being at the center of exciting station appearances, including concerts, community events, walks, runs, and more. As the face of our stations on-site, you’ll be the first person listeners meet, bringing our brands to life with enthusiasm, authenticity, and a positive attitude. We’re seeking awesome, personable, tech-savvy individuals who aren’t afraid to strike up a conversation, engage a crowd, and represent Connoisseur Media with confidence and creativity. This position reports to the Marketing & Promotions Director and plays a key role in creating memorable experiences for our listeners and partners.

Responsibilities

Part-time; hours vary, Sunday through Saturday, with flexible schedules of up to 30 hours a week. Must be available nights and weekends. Setting up sound systems and other promotional equipment. Drive the station vehicle as needed. Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee could also be required to stand, walk, or sit for longer periods. The employee will also be asked to lift and/or move items up to 50+ pounds, including setting up a 10’x10’ tent.

Required Skills

job.description:
Connoisseur Media is seeking a highly organized, detail-driven Traffic Continuity Coordinator to play a vital role in the success of our broadcast and digital advertising operations. This position will be in the office located in the Bay Area of California. This position sits at the intersection of programming, sales, and revenue, ensuring that premium advertising inventory is managed with precision, accuracy, and care across multiple radio stations. As a key member of our operations team, the Traffic Continuity Coordinator helps keep everything running smoothly—meeting tight deadlines, maintaining flawless logs, and supporting both internal teams and clients with reliable, timely information. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, stays calm under pressure, and takes pride in getting the details right the first time. You’ll collaborate closely with programming and management, use industry-leading tools to manage commercial activity, and contribute directly to the financial performance of the stations. If you enjoy a role where accuracy matters, teamwork is valued, and your behind-the-scenes expertise makes a visible impact every day, you’ll feel right at home at Connoisseur Media. What you need to do to be successful in this position: Prepare and Manage Program Logs: Accurately prepare daily program logs for one or more of our five radio stations, ensuring precision and adherence to strict deadlines. Schedule and Process Commercials: Efficiently schedule radio commercials and process commercial contracts on a daily basis. Provide Inventory Insights: Supply station management with accurate and up-to-date advertising inventory information. Collaborate on Programming: Work closely with station programmers to ensure hourly clocks are accurate and current on all program logs. Reconcile Daily Logs: Reconcile daily program logs for assigned radio stations, verifying all scheduled content aired correctly. Generate Reports: Prepare various reports for station management as needed, providing valuable insights into our traffic operations. Manage Commercial Copy as needed: Process and schedule commercial copy, ensuring all ad materials are ready for air. Utilize Industry Tools: Work with third-party service, programming, and spot providers such as Wide Orbit, Mr. Master, vCreative, or other industry networks. Support Team Operations: Perform other duties consistent with the position to ensure smooth and efficient traffic operations. What you need to bring:

You stay cool, calm, and collected, even when things are hectic. Be a Solo Star: You can totally crush tasks on your own without needing constant hand-holding. Problem Solver Pro: You're quick to spot a snag and even quicker to flag it so we can fix it. Keyboard Ninja: You're a data entry whiz – fast and accurate. Tech Savvy: Picking up new software is a breeze for you. Preference may be given to candidates who meet the above requirements plus have the following:

Experience

working with WideOrbit and/or vCreative traffic software. Working knowledge of spreadsheet and word processing applications.

job.title: Broadcast Network Monitoring Operator
job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Technology

Work Status: Full-Time (on-site)

Location: Toronto - Corus Quay

About the Role:

Corus Entertainment is seeking a dynamic and innovative professional to join the Broadcast Operations team at our Toronto location as a Broadcast Network Monitoring Operator.

Reporting to the Lead, Broadcast Network Monitoring, the Broadcast Network Monitoring Operator is part of team that ensures Corus’ broadcast signals are present for over-the-air (OTA) and cable/satellite (BDU) viewers across the country and maintains revenue by ensuring simultaneous substitutions with US networks are in place. The BNM team is also the communication hub for the internal network connecting all of Corus’ news production centres together. The team works extensively with various internal departments and external clients, maintaining a high level of customer service while meeting strict deadlines in a 24/7/365 signal monitoring environment.

You will contribute by:

• Monitor all return broadcast signals originating from Corus for quality, signal integrity, and regulatory compliance and escalate internally and externally accordingly

• Monitor network connectivity and performance within the Corus broadcast and news production footprint and escalate internally accordingly

• Confirm simultaneous substitutions of US network content and communicate information and issues to BDUs in a professional and timely manner

• Accurately create and compile reports detailing issues with broadcast signals, Corus’ network, and simultaneous substitutions

• Perform first-level checks and basic troubleshooting on IP-based broadcast systems such as encoders, decoders, switches and SD-WAN devices

• Help track daily network performance metrics for uptime, stream stability, and error rates

• Gain a firm understanding of broadcast operations technology, workflows and networks to troubleshoot, solve and escalate issues

• Follow existing departmental procedures, workflows, and documentation

• Provide updates and support in a 24/7/365 broadcast and news environment for Corus’ network and all broadcast signals originating from Corus

• Stay current with equipment, workflows and procedural changes required to perform tasks

Skills and experience you will bring:

• Diploma or degree in broadcasting, communications, IT, media or other technology fields or equivalent experience

• Basic knowledge of IP networking (IP addressing, multicast, latency, jitters, bandwidth) and comfort working with network monitoring tools

• A good understanding of video/audio technical standards, cable TV, OTA, satellite (DTH) and IPTV distribution platforms in order to troubleshoot and escalate signal problems

• Experience with broadcast transmission chains, networks, video platforms and associated systems

• Proficiency in computer skills – Microsoft Office suite and other integrated applications and communication tools

• Must be adaptable, able to multi-task and work with acute attention to detail

• Communicate in a positive, friendly manner and with a customer service approach

• Ability to handle challenging situations with professionalism, empathy and sincerity

• Able to work a flexible schedule that includes evenings, overnights and weekends

• Fluency in French is an asset

Application Deadline: November 25th, 2026

Division: Global Edmonton - News Gathering

Work Status: Full-Time, Permanent

Location: Edmonton, AB (On-site)

About the Role

Global Edmonton’s News Department is seeking two permanent, full-time Digital Journalists to join its News Gathering team.

This is an on-site, multiplatform journalism role that requires candidates to report, write, shoot, edit and produce content for television and digital platforms.

Candidates must be available to work a variety of shifts, including early mornings, days, evenings and permanent weekends.

This is a Group H position in accordance with the current collective agreement.

You Will Contribute By

The following represents the primary responsibilities of the role but does not include all duties that may be assigned:

• Research, develop and produce original, enterprising news stories and guest ideas.

• Report, shoot, write and edit stories for multiple daily newscasts and globalnews.ca.

• Write clear, compelling news content for television and digital platforms.

• Produce and line up dynamic newscasts, creating strong content for both live and server-based shows.

• Produce local news content using video gathered in the field, as well as affiliate, national and international material.

• Report live on location and in studio as required.

• Meet multiple daily deadlines to write, publish, promote, update and curate local, regional and national content for globalnews.ca.

• Respond quickly and effectively to breaking news and evolving stories.

• Collaborate with the Edmonton newsroom, local radio newsroom, Resources Desk, National News Desk and Online teams to coordinate coverage.

• Use production graphics and other visual elements creatively to enhance storytelling.

• Participate in editorial and assignment meetings and contribute ideas for daily and future coverage.

• Be a strong advocate, role model and mentor for digital journalism and a video-first workflow.

• Work collaboratively with colleagues based in Lethbridge and Calgary.

• Participate in Global Edmonton promotional and community initiatives.

• Perform other duties as required.

job.title: Manager, Technology Product Quality & Testing
job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Division: Technology

Work Status: Full Time, Hybrid

Location: Toronto, ON

About The Role

Reporting to the Director, Technology Product & Business Application Support, the Manager, Technology Product Quality & Testing, leads a team responsible for testing software and business applications across the Corus application portfolio.

This role balances two priorities. You will lead the team's day-to-day testing delivery, including functional, regression, integration and business-oriented testing, while gradually expanding the team's quality engineering and test automation capability.

Initially, you will work alongside the team to establish a practical and maintainable automation foundation. Over time, your focus will shift toward coaching, technical guidance, test strategy, people leadership and continuous improvement. Automation will complement manual testing and will be applied where it provides clear and sustainable value.

You will contribute by:

• Lead, coach and support a team of QA professionals with varied technical experience

• Develop risk-based test strategies and priorities based on the scope, complexity, likelihood of failure and business impact of changes across the team’s application portfolio

• Plan and coordinate functional, regression, integration, exploratory and release testing

• Ensure test plans, results, defects and release risks are documented and communicated clearly

• Coordinate test environment and test data needs with application, platform, business and vendor teams

• Coordinate defect triage and resolution with application teams, business stakeholders and vendors

• Partner with application, product and business teams early in the change lifecycle to identify quality risks, clarify test requirements and improve testability

• Coordinate business testing and UAT where business validation is required

• Provide a clear quality and release-readiness recommendation to the accountable release stakeholders

• Manage team capacity, workload, hiring, performance and development

• Work hands-on with the team to establish and grow a maintainable test automation approach

• Prioritize automation based on risk, repeatability, business value and long-term maintenance effort

• Identify opportunities to automate testing across user interfaces, APIs, integrations, data exchanges and end-to-end business processes where practical

• Establish and continuously improve the team’s overall testing framework, standards and practices across manual and automated testing

• Coach team members through pairing, review, structured learning and practical application

• Work with platform and technology partners to incorporate automated tests into delivery pipelines where appropriate

• Introduce meaningful quality metrics that support risk, release and improvement decisions, including measures of test effectiveness, automation reliability and escaped defects rather than test volume alone

• Expand the team's testing coverage into additional software and business applications based on business risk, capacity and team readiness

• Continue to improve manual testing, integration testing and business-testing practices alongside automation

Skills and experience you will bring:

• 5 or more years of progressive experience in software testing, quality assurance or quality engineering

• At least 2 years of experience leading or managing QA professionals, including coaching, work allocation or performance responsibilities

• A pragmatic practitioner and coach, comfortable stepping in to help directly when needed

• Strong experience with manual functional, regression and integration testing

• Experience developing test strategies and coordinating testing across complex applications or system integrations

• Hands-on experience creating and maintaining automated tests using at least one modern automation framework

• Ability to help design and establish an automation approach while building capability and ongoing ownership across the team

• Practical understanding of SDLC, STLC, defect management and release validation

• Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and how automated tests can be incorporated into delivery workflows

• Experience working with business stakeholders, application teams and third-party vendors

• Ability to communicate testing status, quality risk and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences

• Proficiency with modern automation technologies such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or WebdriverIO

• Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript, or comparable programming or scripting languages

• Background working with enterprise applications, packaged software or vendor-managed platforms

• Exposure to performance or load testing

• Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or similar delivery platforms

• Knowledge of broadcast, media, advertising, revenue or financial systems

• Familiarity with ITIL, IT General Controls or audit-sensitive technology environments

• ISTQB, ITIL, Agile or Scrum certification

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• A valid Class G driver’s license with a clean driving record required.

• Knowledgeable of all social media platforms including how to post pictures, use of hashtags and replying to comments and messages.

• Knowledge of our stations and their audiences is an asset.

• Ability to learn basic technical engineering.

• Creativity (visually and problem solving) will help you shine in this role.

• Filming and editing skills are a bonus.

• Be responsible, reliable, and punctual. Always represent the station in a professional manner.

• Ability to work both independently and within a team.

• Flexible schedule - this role involves a variety of shifts including weeknights, weekends, early mornings, and holidays.

job.title: Videographer - Global News Kingston
job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Global News Kingston

Work Status: Full-Time

Location: Kingston, ON (Onsite)

About the Role:

Are you curious? Do you like learning new things? Do you want to make a difference by helping people understand the world around them better?

If you have a thirst for knowledge and are looking for a career that provides an outlet for your creativity, you may be interested in working as a Videographer for Global News in Kingston.

Global Kingston is looking for a full-time Videographer (Video Journalist) to join their team. Reporting to the News Manager, the successful candidate will be responsible for pitching, creating, and delivering quality news content for television.

This role will be responsible for CKWS News on Global Kingston at 5:30pm, 6:30pm and 11pm.

This position requires working a variety of shifts, including early mornings, evenings, late nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.

This is a Group 3 position under the current collective agreement.

You will contribute by:

• Daily reporting of local news and community events for Global News CKWS News at 5:30, CKWS News at 6:30, CKWS News at 11.

• Shooting, writing, voicing, editing, and reporting local-sourced news for television broadcast.

• Pitching, pursuing, and producing new and unique news stories that matter to the local community and beyond.

• Initiating and developing story and feature ideas through contact development, research, and interviews.

• Monitoring all news sources, including feeds, wires, and social media.

• Shooting descriptive and interesting video footage to enhance visual storytelling.

• Chasing breaking news stories - including providing live coverage, setting up interviews for broadcast, and facilitating pictures and video for online coverage.

• Coordinating updates for breaking or developing stories.

• Publishing video content to our website and social media channels.

• Establishing and maintaining a network of news contacts throughout Kingston and surrounding regions.

• Creatively using production graphics and other visual elements to enhance storytelling.

• Representing the company at various community and charity events as required.

• Understanding and adhering to Global News’ Journalistic Principles and Practices.

• Backfilling other roles within the newsroom as appropriate (anchor, producer, assignment support, etc.).

• Performing other duties as assigned.

Skills and experience you will bring:

• Post-secondary education in Broadcast Journalism or a related field.

• Experience shooting video, editing, and writing news stories for TV broadcast.

• Excellent news writing and storytelling skills.

• Camera operation experience and familiarity with non-linear editing.

• A demonstrable passion for current affairs and news, with a keen interest in developing skills to grow within the news industry.

• A knack for getting tough interviews.

• Ability to effectively solve problems and trouble-shoot while dealing with the unexpected.

• Ability to handle the demands and pressure of tight deadlines and breaking news.

• Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced and highly demanding environment.

• Effective communication and organization skills.

• A positive attitude, strong team player, and a desire to collaborate in a multiplatform newsroom.

• A valid passport and class “G” driver’s license is required with a clean driver's abstract.

When applying, please include a portfolio or examples of your work, such as demo reels, reporting clips, video samples,

or links to published broadcast and/or digital content.

job.title: Account Executive - Dayton Radio
job.description:
Location: OH-Dayton

Job Title:  Account Executive - Dayton Radio

 

Position Overview

Are you a problem solver? Can you help others identify their goals and get them from where they are to where they want to be? We win when our local business clients get a return on their investment thanks to our creative and innovative digital media solutions. We aim to be more than just exceptional partners; our tools and services are game changers for their businesses.

 

As an Account Executive for Cox Media Group, you will work closely with our clients as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique business goals and partner to help achieve them. In this role, you will collaborate with local sales managers to evangelize solutions that will help customers reach their target audience. As a CMG employee, you’ll have industry-leading tools and resources at your fingertips. We’ll also provide ongoing training and professional development across our full range of products, and you’ll be an integral part of a results-driven, close-knit team that is driving growth for CMG.


 
At Cox Media Group we are building the future of media and have an opening for a skilled Account Executive! Cox Media Group is a forward-thinking, fast-paced, and positive culture of top performing sales professionals that work together to produce results.


 
Cox Media Group has a Training Program that will guide you on your way to launching a successful and lucrative career as an Account Executive! Through the program you will be matched with a personal mentor, practice collaborative teamwork

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Responsible for generating revenue through the development of new accounts
  • Responsible for generating revenue by growing existing advertising revenue from current clients.
  • Able to develop effective marketing plans to meet clients’ needs and objectives.
  • Able to obtain budgets and meet deadlines.
  • Responsible for ensuring superior client relations.
  • Superior management of sales through the entire sales cycle.
  • Use of CRM sales tool for reporting and prospecting
  • Prepare and present both written and oral presentations.
  • Prepare effective advertising schedules.
  • Effectively negotiate advertising rates.
  • Collection of accounts receivable, as required.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record of digital and TV sales success in local media setting
  • Ability to work alone and as part of a team
  • Minimum of 2 years of new business development and prospecting experience required
  • Excellent presentation, verbal and written skills
  • Hard-working, integrity, relationship-builder with a winning attitude
  • Strong problem solving and analytical skills
  • Work with brand teams, ad operations and finance to provide client satisfaction
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office and CRM tools
  • Valid driver's license with clean driving record required
  • Relationship building skills are key and candidate must have a winning, positive attitude.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree with a minimum of three years of media sales, account management or buying experience preferred

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.title: Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle
job.description:
Location: WA-Seattle

Job Title:  Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is seeking Account Executives for outside sales positions selling to new clients and servicing established accounts.  This position is located in Seattle, WA at CMG’s local CBS and Telemundo affiliate, KIRO 7.

 

We’re looking for talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who thrive in a fast-paced working environment. As an Account Executive, you will work closely with our clients as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique business goals and then help them achieve those goals. In this field-based role, you will collaborate with local sales managers and will have industry-leading tools and resources at your fingertips to create solutions that help clients reach their target audiences.  

 

This role specializes in creating new and incremental television and digital revenue. The primary job responsibility is to identify new prospects and present customized multi-platform advertising solutions focused on the customer’s return on investment. The Account Executive is also responsible for retaining and growing their developed accounts through insight proposals, proof of performance, and maximizing all station assets. 

 

To be successful; you need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and analytical. You also need to have effective communication skills and the ability to cultivate client relationships. The ideal candidate should also possess strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you are given a challenging mission, world-class tools to help you succeed, and the chance to realize your full potential as a sale’s professional. This position offers an opportunity to grow your income through a rewarding commission structure. You’ll also become part of a team that with the mission and purpose of making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and apply resources and strategies appropriately.
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling.
  • Consistently works target accounts in the pipeline.
  • Generates revenue through the development of new accounts and growth of existing accounts.
  • Develops advertising solutions for new customers that deliver results to their customers.
  • Provides information to sales management to ensure generation of tracking reports regarding pending deals, forecasts, advertiser, contact and prospect lists.
  • Conducts a need analysis and account reviews to uncover the customer’s most essential needs.
  • Develops effective marketing plans to meet clients’ needs and objectives.
  • Creates compelling and persuasive presentations that facilitate new or additional business.
  • Effectively negotiates advertising rates.
  • Is able to demonstrate product knowledge and value to customers.
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients and persuasively present and sell those sponsorships.
  • Works with internal departments to manage account stewardship throughout the process.
  • Utilizes CRM (HubSpot) to manage day to day activity, build a pipeline and ensure execution along with providing weekly projections and reporting.
  • Upsells current customers by providing proof of performance and solid results.
  • Collaborates with Account Manager to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions; conducts account maintenance including make-goods posts, and aging/collections.
  • Attends sales meetings, training sessions and client remote meetings. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of new business development and prospecting experience in media sales or related role.
  • Proven record of driving revenue growth through successful campaigns.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and people skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a high pressured, fast paced environment with tight deadlines.
  • Strong marketing, presentation and closing skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Has effectively negotiate with customers to meet a winning return on investment.
  • Has experience prospecting for new clients and sell services to them along with maintaining and upselling existing clients.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, and CRM tools, such as HubSpot.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree with a minimum of three years of media sales, account management or buying experience.
  • Proven history of digital and TV sales success in a local media setting
  • Fluent in Spanish

 

This position is 100% commission basis. Commission rates range from 1% - 12%. Final compensation for the role will be determined by a variety of factors such as skills, certifications, and relevant work experience.   

 

Benefits for this role include: 

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance available to the employee and employee’s family (i.e. child, spouse, domestic partner). 

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care) and Health Savings Accounts 

  • Short-term and long-term disability and life insurance (supplemental and accidental, death, and dismemberment) 

  • Participation in CMG’s 401(k) plan with generous company match and both pre-tax and Roth options  

  • Paid flexible vacation and up to four weeks (160 hours) of paid wellness time, inclusive of paid sick and safe time under applicable law. 

  • Up to eight (8) paid holidays throughout calendar year 2026

  • Up to two (2) weeks of paid parental leave  

  • Employee assistance program 

  • All other benefits required by applicable law. 

 

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-John Young

Job Title:  Account Manager - Orlando Radio

 

Position Overview

Our Cox Media Group team in Orlando, FL is looking for an Account Manager (AM). Our AMs get to provide administrative support to the entire sales department. For example, our AMs work on special projects, set appointments, write correspondence, create presentations, compile data and research, and work directly with our clients and sales staff. Some of which could be of a sensitive or confidential nature.

 

Our ideal candidate will have worked in a support position in a sales environment, having an aptitude towards working with the digital sales process and open to learning new software programs.

 

As this position is in sales, the ideal candidate must enjoy working in a team-oriented environment and playing an integral role in achieving the goals of the department. This role may qualify for future promotion to a senior professional assistant or media consultant. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provides high level internal and external customer service 
  • Works with Sales to provide customer-facing support including any billing errors or issues, inputting sales orders/revisions for traditional and digital sales, pulls various sales reports as required by sales management and MCs from Google Analytics, AdWords, DFP, and others. 
  • Serves as our Special Event coordinator. 
  • Creates proposals, presentations and various sales collateral. 
  • Become an expert with all internal systems: Wide Orbit, Miller Kaplan, Nielsen, DOT, XSM, to name a few. 
  • Provides general administrative support. 
  • Maintains keen attention to detail in organizing meetings and anticipating needs. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2 years' college or equivalent high-level administrative experience required. 
  • Excellent communication skills with attention to detail accuracy and follow-up required. 
  • Excellent written correspondence, document presentation, proposal creation (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Photoshop/Illustrator, or other similar tools) skills required. 
  • Experience communicating directly and confidently with clients required. 
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality required 
  • Must be fluent, or have the talent to become fluent, in sales technology assets (to include but not limited to Scarborough, Tapscan, Nielsen, Topline) 
  • Ability to prioritize and complete tasks, with the ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
  • Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record

job.description:
Location: GA-Athens

Job Title:  Activation Specialist (Part-Time) - Athens Radio

 

Position Overview

The Activation Specialist for Athens Radio reports directly to the Promotions & Activations Manager and represents the radio stations as a Brand Ambassador at events and on social media, as well as assisting the promotions team in the office by preparing for events, fulfilling contests and prizing, and utilizing other skills to create content across departments.

 

This role is an entry-level, part-time position, with the opportunity to potentially shadow current CMG employees and assist in videography, graphic design, social media, marketing, promotions, event planning, and sales and programming.

 

Exceptional communication skills and an energetic personality are a requirement. This role will require working nights, weekends and holidays regularly, as well as the ability to lift 50 pounds.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Engaging with the public at events ranging from client locations to major festivals and concerts, which may require high levels of energy for several hours
  • Show up professionally on-site at events, in the office and on social media
  • Represent each radio station in the cluster through knowledge of, and passion for, the brands
  • Set up and break down of station sound and promotional equipment (tents, banners, speakers, audio PA system) at station events
  • Create and post engaging content, photos and video on station social media
  • Assist with organization and maintenance of station vehicles and promotional equipment
  • Compose accurate and detailed event recaps for management
  • Effectively communicate with listeners via email, phone and in-person
  • Assist in various departments throughout the station as needed, including but not limited to digital content, programming, sales, and engineering

Minimum Qualifications

  • Must be a professional team player with customer focus and ability to take initiative and direction
  • 18 years of age or older
  • Highly adaptable and professional
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Able to multi-task in a high-speed environment
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills including grammar, spelling and the ability to tailor copywriting to each stations’ brand voice
  • Must be able to lift 50 lbs.
  • Ability to work nights, weekends and holidays throughout the year
  • Possess a valid driver’s license and clean driving record
  • High school diploma or equivalent required

Preferred Qualifications

  • College coursework in marketing, public relations, digital media, preferred
  • Videography, event coordination, customer service and/or social media skills preferred

The Digital Executive Producer at WSB TV in Atlanta, Georgia will lead our digital content strategy and daily execution across all digital platforms, including web, app, social media, streaming, connected TV, and emerging platforms.

 

The EP is responsible for day-to-day decision-making, and will be an expert at story selection, headline writing, social media, vertical video production, SEO, AP Style writing and editing, and breaking news for a digital audience. The Digital Executive Producer will oversee a team of digital producers and content creators while working closely with newsroom managers, executive producers, reporters, photographers, and assignment editors to ensure our journalism reaches audiences wherever they consume news. This position requires strong editorial judgment, advanced digital storytelling skills, deep audience development expertise, and a proven ability to lead a high-performing team in a fast-paced, breaking news environment. The EP will understand the unique competences and audience consumption preferences of owned platforms and third-party digital platforms. You should be fluent in at least one CMS and have experience with audience signaling tools.

 

The ideal candidate is a newsroom leader who understands the evolving media landscape, can balance audience growth with journalistic excellence, has strong people skills and can manage others to drive best-in-class digital news coverage.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead daily digital content strategy across all platforms
  • Excel at breaking news and AP style writing and editing for a digital audience
  • Direct content selection, prioritization, and presentation for WSBTV.com, mobile apps, social platforms, streaming channels, and emerging products
  • Ensure the newsroom consistently publishes accurate, timely, and engaging content
  • Identify high-value stories and audience engagement opportunities throughout the day
  • Lead the newsroom's vertical video strategy across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook Reels, and emerging social products
  • Develop and execute digital coverage plans for major breaking news, severe weather, investigations, and special events
  • Partner with newsroom leadership to maximize content reach and impact
  • Work closely with other key newsroom managers, reporters, anchors and producers to ensure a multiplatform approach
  • Execute live-streaming strategy to encourage viewership on mobile and on other digital platforms
  • Consistently survey our websites, apps, and social platforms to make sure the freshest content including updated headlines and video are included
