job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive - Greenville, NC 
This is the ideal role for a marketing and sales professional who is looking to join a growing digital and radio business. As our Account Executive, you will be responsible for selling digital and radio campaigns across a wide range of digital products and radio stations in Greenville, NC. Account Executive to work directly with VP of Sales, Digital Coordinator, Digital Team Leader, and Executive VP of radio stations.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Account Management: Works directly with clients, prospects, and company account executives to support their needs and communicate client expectations.
  • Going on in-field calls with prospective clients utilizing the sales process of creating digital and radio campaigns for prospective clients utilizing the Client Needs Analysis, Client Pitch Presentations to Closing of the Sale.
  • Ability to achieve revenue goals and expectations without hesitation.
  • Responsible for building and maintaining a billing book of business with guidance from VP of Sales.
  • Work directly with our Digital Coordinator in processing requests for proposals, insertion orders, sample spec ads and reporting. (for digital only)
  • Project Management: the ability to track timelines and due dates for deliverables, reviews, and approval for campaign launches.
  • Continuity with graphics team: Ensure all ads are being worked on and deadlines are being achieved so all schedules can run on time.
  • Maintain working knowledge of radio and digital products offered by the company through continuous training.
  • Monitor Campaigns to ensure all campaigns are hitting the promised impressions goals and spots during their flights. Adjust priority levels as appropriate.
  • Campaign Reports: At month end and/or the campaign ends, review performance reports for all digital and radio campaigns and present results to the client.
  • Client communication: Work directly with clients to ensure campaign execution and performance meet their standards.
Qualifications:
  • Organization and follow-through are critical skills for this position.  Logical, process-oriented person, who is effective and strategically contributes to campaigns.
  • Strong work ethic, self-motivated and high achiever with a sales drive.
  • Professional demeanor; comfortable presenting to and interacting directly with clients.
  • Demonstrates the ability to successfully collaborate with various team environments with dynamic priorities and meeting deadlines.
  • Quick-witted, understanding and offering solutions regarding various responsibilities.
  • In-depth knowledge of performance marketing with special focus on radio and digital capabilities.
  • Self-motivated and strategic thinker with a bias towards action while also being a strong team player.
  • Ability to thrive under pressure and ability to work in a fast-paced environment; Comfort dealing with ambiguity.
  • Strong partnership and influencing skills.
  • Comfort working with Senior Management.
  • Ability to uncover new opportunities to acquire customers efficiently and on a scale through well-developed relationships with core channel partners and media agencies.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Communications/Marketing preferred and/or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum experience working in sales: 1-3 years preferred.

job.title: Broadcast Operations Manager - Curtis Media Group - Career Page
job.description:
Thanks for visiting the Curtis Media Group Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications.

Broadcast Operations Manager

Raleigh, NC Full Time Manager/Supervisor Share Curtis Media Group is seeking a Broadcast Operations Manager for our multi-market North Carolina radio stations.  The Operations Manager will work closely with the programming, engineering, traffic and IT staff to oversee the day-to-day operations of our FCC licensed radio stations, digital, networks and additional enterprises.  The Operations Manager will work with ownership and senior management in the administration of operational, compliance and administrative activities.
Duties and Responsibilities
  1. Oversees and coordinates the continuous, multifaceted daily operations of radio stations, ensuring compliance with broadcast standards, FCC rules and regulations, and relevant federal and state laws and regulations.
  2. Maintains accurate schedules, records, discrepancy reports, and follow-through communications, and ensures that all on-air broadcast programming complies with FCC rules and regulations.
  3. Participates in the establishment, organization, and implementation of short- and long-range goals, objectives, policies, and operating procedures; monitors and evaluates program effectiveness and effects changes required for improvement.
  4. Directs and administers the provision of day-to-day operation support to the various sub-units of the station, including the non-engineering portions of the station's physical plant, space allocation and utilization, station supplies and inventory, and station safety and security.
  5. Assigns, allocates work, and generally oversees operational and engineering personnel engaged in continuous station operations; performs recruitment, training, scheduling, retention, problem resolution, and performance management.
  6. Develops and implements systems to maintain records on station operations, equipment, and compliance activities; prepares regular and ad-hoc reports.
  7. Provides advice and assistance to senior station management in the planning, implementation, and evaluation of modification to existing operations, systems, and procedures.
  8. Researches and makes recommendations to management pertaining to acquisition of operating equipment; participates in the development and management of annual operating budgets.
  9. Supervises and maintains station FCC Public files including station Political Disclosure Statements, uploading of information to individual station public files including Issues & Ascertainment, EEO and political and issue advertising orders.
  10. May provide services as an on-air host, as required.
  11. Performs miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
Minimum Job Requirements
  • High school diploma or GED; at least 5 years of experience directly related to the duties and responsibilities specified.
  • Completed degree(s) from an accredited institution that are above the minimum education requirement may be substituted for experience on a year for year basis.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required
  • IT and radio automation operations are a must.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to work effectively with a wide range of personnel
  • Records maintenance skills.
  • Skill in the use of personal computers and related software applications.
  • Knowledge of radio principles, procedures, operations, and standards.
  • Knowledge and understanding of radio communications facilities and distribution, and automation systems.
  • Skill in organizing resources and establishing priorities.
  • Knowledge of inventory management practices.
  • Knowledge of radio organizational structures, workflows, systems, and operating procedures.
  • Ability to develop, plan, and implement short- and long-range goals.
  • Knowledge of project management principles, practices, techniques, and tools.
  • Knowledge of FCC and other federal, state and local broadcasting regulations.
  • Ability to supervise and train employees, to include organizing, prioritizing, and scheduling work assignments.
  • Knowledge of budgeting and fiscal management principles and procedures.
  • Knowledge of facilities management, physical plant, safety, and building safety and security procedures.
  • Ability to create, compose, and edit written materials.
  • Supervision of individual station issues and ascertainment for
  • EEO compliance
  • Uploading of Political and Issue orders to FCC public file database
  • Knowledge of on-air and remote broadcasting processes and procedures.
  • Skills in examining and developing station operations and procedures, formulating policy, and implementing organizational strategies and procedures.
  • Ability to oversee, coordinate, and support the execution of continuous broadcast schedules on a 24x7 basis.
  • Knowledge of current and developing trends in radio.
  • Skill in operating radio equipment.

WPTF is seeking a dynamic and experienced Morning News Anchor/Operations Manager to lead our morning programming and oversee day-to-day station operations. This dual-role position blends the energy and visibility of a live news host with the strategic oversight of a broadcast operations manager.

job.title: AI Innovation Manager
job.description:
Job Description:

Merkle is dentsu’s global leadership brand for business and technology consulting, differentiated by an approach to enterprise transformation that’s data-driven, experience-led, and outcomes-obsessed.

With a heritage in data and marketing performance, Merkle has evolved into a transformation consultancy recognized for excellence in CRM, loyalty, digital commerce, technology, engineering, experience design, business advisory, market research, and analytics.


Merkle is seeking an AI Innovation Manager to help us scale how we use AI across our delivery work. Our delivery teams have already built a strong base of AI pilots and tools, and the next step is scaling that work so more of what we deliver gets done efficiently with AI. This individual will run AI pilots day to day, measure results, report progress to leadership, and scale knowledge sharing so what works on one account reaches the next. 


You will be part of the DDM AI Hub, a small central team that points all AI work at four goals: margin, revenue generation, scaling pilots and quality controls. Results go to an AI Steering Committee of DDM senior leadership every month, so this role has direct visibility with the people setting priorities and funding. 


We are looking for someone who is genuinely excited by AI tooling and builds with it, not just talks about it. You understand how tools like Claude fit into real business processes, and you can lead busy delivery teams toward a common goal without managing them directly. AI tools and best practices change month to month, so we want someone adaptable who learns quickly and shifts their approach as the technology evolves. 


There are no direct reports for this role. You will direct teams during sprints and partner with practice leads and account leadership, carrying full ownership of the program's cadence, measurement and reporting. 


Key Responsibilities 

The responsibilities below cover how we run, measure, report on and scale AI across our delivery work. 


  • Run AI pilots day to day. Work with delivery teams to find and prioritize AI opportunities, map current-state workflows, and lead each pilot through build, measurement, and a scale, hold or stop recommendation. 
  • Measure results. Set baselines before each pilot for hours saved, cycle time, quality, adoption and cost, then track those metrics on a regular cadence to confirm results hold. 
  • Report to leadership. Publish regular roll-ups in one consistent format and surface blockers such as tool access and governance approvals for escalation. 
  • Scale knowledge sharing. Lead knowledge sharing across DDM, partnering with Merkle Operations, so team members can find AI assets, pilots and subject-matter experts, and help proven workflows and best practices travel from one team or account to the next. 
  • Lead through influence. Coordinate the four practice AI points of contact through a monthly practice update, assign and direct part-time support from forward-deployed engineers and our global delivery bench during sprints, and confirm every AI deployment has a human-review step and a named reviewer before launch. 

Qualifications 


  • 4+ years of experience in management consulting, strategy, program management, business operations, or similar 
  • Hands-on experience building with AI tools such as Claude (Projects, Skills, artifacts or Claude Code), ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar, with examples of something you built that you or others use 
  • Strong understanding of how AI tools relate to business processes: where they save time, where they need human review, and where they fall short, with experience mapping workflows and measuring before-and-after results 
  • Proven ability to lead people toward a common goal without direct authority, across teams with competing priorities 
  • Strong organization and prioritization skills, with experience structuring ambiguous problems into clear plans, owners and timelines 
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with experience turning complex, multi-threaded work into clear executive updates 
  • Highly adaptable and quick to learn, energized by new technology and comfortable changing tools, methods and priorities as AI capabilities evolve 
  • Marketing services, agency or professional services experience (nice to have) 
  • Familiarity with marketing technology platforms such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Adobe or Snowflake, or with program and reporting tools such as Smartsheet, Jira or Power BI (nice to have) 
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience preferred.

Additional Information

The annual base salary range for this position is $113,000 - $150,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.


Benefits available with this position include:

·         Medical, vision, and dental insurance

·         Life insurance

·         Short-term and long-term disability insurance

·         401k

·         Flexible paid time off

·         At least 15 paid holidays per year

·         Paid sick and safe leave

·         Paid parental leave


Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. job.title: Associate, Planning
job.description:
Job Description:

ROLE PURPOSE 

The Planning Associate will support the planning team across multiple projects and tasks that will help advance larger projects and strategies by maintaining and managing clients' media plans and assisting in the preparation of presentations. They are expected to take daily responsibility for the assigned accounts and ensure that all projects are completed on time, within budget, and in line with the strategy, under the supervision of a manager. You will handle the daily tactical management of the media communications account and must work well in a team environment. The role involves helping to create media campaigns across multiple channels and assisting in the planning, implementation, and maintenance of multi-channel media campaigns. The ability to learn new skills and procedures is essential.   

This position is for the Offshore Team of Dentsu Argentina, and works for teams located in Dentsu's agencies in other countries. Has a local support team that leads the integration and relationship with the other members of the Offshore Team in Argentina. 

 

TASKS AND RESPONSABILITIES 

Support the Planning team in all phases of the media strategy process. 

Work with teams to prepare proposals based on briefs, working on campaign objectives, budgets, and timelines. 

Assist in creating media objectives and strategies for clients. 

Support teams in creating and analyzing audience reports, reach and frequency reports, and other data collections for business reviews. 

Prepare competitive analysis reports with graphs and insights, for digital media, offline media, and social channels by extracting data from media tools. 

Prepare proposal presentations and flowcharts, and make necessary adjustments based on client requests. 

Assist with adjustments to media plan details as needed.  

Prepare and update timelines to meet required dates. 

Create and update campaign flowcharts. 

Complete forms for media authorizations, send them to media vendors and clients, and follow up for approval. 

Actively participate in campaign implementation, working alongside activation teams using flowcharts, budgets, traffic sheets, and taxonomy for setup in media platforms, tracking codes, and other elements. 

Request, receive, traffic, and control creative assets with creative agencies, perform QA with involved internal teams, responsible for aggregating and maintaining creative specifications and manage other operating process details. 

Lead the aggregation of proof-of-purchase materials (post-launch screenshots). 

Manage the trafficking process and prepare traffic sheets. 

Follow up on media authorization forms with clients, media vendors, and internal teams to obtain approvals. 

Monitor the pacing and flights of budgets through the campaign flowcharts, control planned versus actual outcomes, identify deviations, inform internal teams and involved media vendors, and propose recommendations to improve performance and optimize the budget. 

Oversee the billing process with internal teams and media vendors. 

Reconcile invoices with media vendors review billable amounts to clients, verify invoices with the Finance department, send them to clients and follow up them. 

Keep all data updated in the systems. 

As part of the Offshore Team of Dentsu Argentina, you must actively participate in the weekly virtual networking meetings with other members of the Argentina offshore team. 

You must also participate in the Offshore Team's peer-to-peer engagement activities held periodically in our Buenos Aires offices, except for those who are not located in that city. 

 

QUALIFICATIONS 

0 to 1 years of experience. 

A bachelor's degree, preferably in marketing, advertising, finance, or analytics, will be valued. 

Prior internships or work experience in a professional environment are preferred. 

Understanding of basic Digital Marketing concepts. 

Good knowledge of the Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. 

Strong analytical thinking, comfortable with data and mathematical skills. 

Solution-oriented with strong critical thinking skills. 

Interest in offline media, digital media, and programmatic media.  

Works well in a team and in a fast-paced environment. 

Collaborative mindset. 

Consistently delivers accurate and timely work products. 

Ability to prioritize multiple tasks. 

 

PERSONAL SKILLS 

Strong communication skills, both verbal and written. 

Ability to build strong relationships with the teams you work with. 

Proactivity and collaboration with colleagues. 

Attention to detail and precision in your work style. 

Integrity, autonomy, and self-motivation.

ICUC has been the global leader in Social Media solutions for over 20 years. To date, the ICUC team consists of over 350 people, in over 35 countries, covering 50 languages around the clock. We’re a fast-growing team looking for bilingual (English and French) social media professionals who enjoy engaging in online conversations, creating content that connects, and helping foster digital communities that are safe and welcoming.

job.title: Data Engineering Lead
job.description:
Job Description:

Lead the Data Teams Powering Modern Customer Experiences

You know great data engineering is about more than pipelines and platforms. It's about helping people make smarter decisions, creating reliable data foundations, and enabling meaningful customer experiences at scale.

As a Data Engineering Lead, you'll guide talented engineering teams, shape technical strategy, partner with clients, and influence how modern data platforms are built and operated. You'll balance leadership with hands-on technical involvement, helping teams solve complex challenges while delivering measurable business outcomes.

This is a true player-coach opportunity where you'll lead people, drive delivery excellence, and help define the future of data engineering, cloud platforms, AI-enabled solutions, and customer data ecosystems.

What You'll Do

Lead and Grow High-Performing Teams

You'll support the development of Data Engineers by providing coaching, mentorship, career guidance, and opportunities for growth. You'll help create an environment where team members can learn, contribute, and thrive.

Drive Technical Delivery

You'll oversee complex data engineering initiatives, partnering with Solution Architects and stakeholders to deliver scalable, high-quality data solutions. You'll help guide technical decisions, manage delivery risks, and ensure successful outcomes across multiple engagements.

Shape Engineering Excellence

You'll establish and promote best practices across data engineering, including CI/CD, testing, code reviews, observability, data quality, documentation, and governance. You'll help create repeatable approaches that enable teams to deliver consistently and effectively.

Partner with Clients and Stakeholders

You'll collaborate with client leaders, business stakeholders, architects, and delivery teams to translate business goals into actionable engineering solutions. You'll communicate complex technical concepts in a way that supports informed decision-making and successful project outcomes.

Innovate with AI and Emerging Technologies

You'll help evaluate and adopt modern technologies, including AI-assisted engineering tools, cloud-native analytics platforms, warehouse-native AI solutions, and next-generation data architecture patterns.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in data engineering, including cloud-based data platforms, ELT/ETL processes, and production data pipelines.
  • Strong experience with platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Google BigQuery, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, or Amazon Redshift.
  • Advanced SQL and Python skills.
  • Experience with orchestration and transformation tools such as dbt, Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Dagster, Prefect, or similar technologies.
  • Experience designing data models and customer-centric data solutions.
  • Understanding of data quality, lineage, observability, and governance best practices.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, and modern engineering workflows.
  • 2+ years leading, mentoring, or managing data engineering teams.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with any combination of the following is welcomed:

  • Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Adobe Real-Time CDP, Salesforce Data Cloud, or related certifications.
  • Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Real-Time CDP, Customer Journey Analytics, Salesforce Data Cloud, Braze, or other customer data platforms.
  • AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, or Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform.
  • AI/ML technologies, warehouse-native AI capabilities, feature engineering, vector databases, or LLM-ready data architectures.
  • Data privacy, governance, consent management, and secure data exchange practices.
  • Pre-sales, solution design, technical estimation, or consulting experience.

Why You'll Love This Opportunity

Make an Impact Beyond the Code

Your work will influence how organizations use data to better understand and engage their customers. The decisions you help make will drive business outcomes across analytics, customer data platforms, AI solutions, and customer experience technologies.

Grow as a Leader

You'll have the opportunity to mentor engineers, shape engineering culture, build delivery standards, and contribute to the long-term growth of both the team and the broader practice.

Work with Modern Technology

From cloud data warehouses and customer data platforms to AI-assisted engineering and emerging data technologies, you'll have exposure to innovative tools and platforms that are shaping the future of the industry.

We Encourage You to Apply

We recognize that talent comes from many different backgrounds and experiences. If you're excited about leading teams, building modern data solutions, and helping organizations unlock the value of their data, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed.

Your unique perspective, experience, and ideas can help us build stronger teams, better solutions, and more meaningful outcomes for our clients.


The annual salary range for this position is $94,000 - $135K. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.

The purpose of this role is to facilitate delivery of best in class analytic and data assessments and roadmaps per established processes and templates in concert with other business disciplines, to manage and develop the team and serve as a point of escalation as needed.

Job Description:

This role is part of Merkle’s expanding Audience Platform Analytics practice, helping clients unlock value from their data and marketing technology investments. The practice supports the strategic implementation, adoption, measurement, and optimization of leading platforms across Customer Data Platforms solutions (such as Adobe Experience Platform, Salesforce etc.), Content Supply Chain, CMS, Planning & Workflow Management. Our goal is to help clients rapidly deploy and maximize the value of these platforms by establishing right strategic initiatives, robust measurement frameworks, driving adoption, enabling data-driven decision-making, and demonstrating ROI. Through audience intelligence, real-time personalization, omnichannel orchestration, content performance analytics, and operational insights, we help organizations improve efficiency, accelerate business outcomes, and realize measurable value across the end-to-end customer and content lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead CDP engagements by providing expertise in the strategy, design, development and activation of marketing omni-channel use cases and customer journeys within Adobe Experience Platform
  • Develop and execute roadmap for Adobe tech stack, ensuring alignment with business objectives, integration with organization’s Martech ecosystem, and deliver measurables results that drive incremental benefits.
  • Build frameworks required to define use cases based on a detailed understanding of clients’ needs and goals.
  • Conduct audience analyses using data attributes and business knowledge, developing audiences based on testing and targeting strategies.
  • Manage transformation through journey mapping, insight development, development of transformational roadmaps, and value quantification.
  • Lead client engagements by providing expertise across Content Supply Chain Analytics, audience platforms, data strategy, measurement, testing, and cross-channel customer engagement.
  • Define and implement measurement frameworks, KPI strategies to track performance, operational efficiency, adoption, and business value realization.
  • Lead the development of use cases and value hypotheses based on client objectives, platform capabilities, data availability, and organizational readiness.
  • Provide solutioning and strategic guidance to connect Content Supply Chain capabilities with audience activation, personalization, and omnichannel marketing execution.
  • Design and govern taxonomies, metadata frameworks, and measurement requirements.
  • Establish baseline metrics and measurement methodologies to quantify the impact of Content Supply Chain, and audience platform investments.
  • Build reporting frameworks, and insights programs that connect operational, content, and marketing performance metrics to business outcomes and ROI.
  • Collaborate across cross-functional teams to develop strategic and analytics solutions for CDP and Content Supply Chain initiatives.  
  • Develop Merkle points of view (POVs), thought leadership, and industry content related to Audience Platforms, Content Supply Chain Analytics, measurement, and value realization.
  • Possess a deep understanding of the nuances in marketing to customers across different verticals and environments.
  • Collaborate with leadership, key stakeholders and partner agencies to turn ideas into actionable plans.

 

 

Skills and Experience:

 

  • Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) experience is the top priority with CDP strategy, journey orchestration, and measurement expertise as requirements.
  • Proven experience developing content taxonomies, metadata strategies, and data governance frameworks.
  • 8+ years of experience in digital analytics, marketing analytics, CDPs, Content Supply Chain, MarTech, AdTech, consulting, or agency environments.
  • Experienced with planning and execution of digital campaigns in one or many channels including search, display, email, site, mobile
  • Experience defining and implementing measurement frameworks, KPI strategies, and reporting solutions to evaluate content performance, operational efficiency, audience engagement, and business impact.
  • Self-starter with strong problem-solving, communication, and consulting skills, and the ability to quickly learn new technologies, influence stakeholders, and lead strategic client engagements.

Qualifications & Additional Skills:

  • Graduate or bachelor’s degree in related fields preferred: Statistics, Technology or Marketing
  • Excellent presentation skills including creating client-facing PowerPoint
  • Client Management: Ability to manage client expectations, delivery and provide thought leadership
  • Ability to provide clear brief to onshore and offshore analysts
  • Possess ability to summarize key findings/insights and make actionable recommendations
  • trong data-driven mentality, strong problem solving, consulting skills and ability to take initiatives

 

The annual salary range for this position is $113,000-$190,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.

job.title: Director, Customer Lifecycle Marketing Strategy (Open to Remote, Continental U.S.)
job.description:
Job Description:

We welcome remote candidates based in the continental United States


Please Note: Direct mail strategy experience is required for this role. Candidates should have experience incorporating direct mail into broader customer lifecycle and omnichannel marketing strategies.


Merkle is a leading data-driven, technology-enabled, global performance marketing agency that specializes in the delivery of unique, personalized customer experiences across platforms and devices. For more than 30 years, Fortune 1000 companies and leading nonprofit organizations have partnered with Merkle to maximize the value of their customer portfolios. The agency's heritage in data, technology, and analytics forms the foundation for its unmatched skills in understanding consumer insights that drive people-based marketing strategies. Its combined strengths in performance media, customer experience, customer relationship management, loyalty, and enterprise marketing technology drive improved marketing results and competitive advantage.

 

We are champions for meaningful progress and we strive to be a force for good—for our people, for our clients, for the industry and for our society. We keep our people at the center, creating space for growth, understanding and learning so they can thrive. We embed diversity, in our mindset, in our solutions and in our teams to empower an inclusive, equitable and culturally fluent environment. Building this culture within our teams makes us better collaborators with each other and with our clients, driving better outcomes for all. Merkle is an agency of dentsu.

 

As Director, Customer Lifecycle Marketing Strategy, you will join a team of experienced marketers who focus on helping Merkle clients achieve their business goals. 

 

You will be a key member of our client account team and will ensure that the programs we execute are based on a deep understanding of our client’s business and strategic objectives.  You’ll appreciate the importance of strong relationships and become a trusted advisor to the client and Merkle account team. You will be a person who thrives in both analytic as well as creative thinking and will be nimble in solving for client problems.  As a leader your skills and passion for communicating strategy will get others to believe in the ideas that you present and follow that belief through to execution. 

 

At Merkle “Strategy” means a key idea that is informed, executable and provides results.  Those ideas need to be applicable to a variety of client scenarios and must cross any service that is necessary to achieve the client objective.  As a Director in the Customer Lifecycle Marketing team you will demonstrate experience in planning across media and channels, development and management of campaigns that generate measurable ROI and have the ability to work across many of our core vertical markets (Insurance, Financial Services, Non-Profit, Retail, Automotive, Travel, Media and Entertainment, B2B, High Tech) 

 

To be successful in this role you’ll have a passion for problem solving, and a deep understanding of how businesses, brands and customers interact, with an advanced understanding of the rapidly evolving role that data and technology play in this relationship. You can identify business growth opportunities and develop strategic recommendations to support the growth of client relationships. 

 

You Will:

  • Lead the building, development, and delivery of strategic omni-channel marketing plans. 
  • Be a subject matter expert and translate new technology - particularly in the areas of 1st party data marketing and CRM - into new marketing ideas for the client.
  • Show a strong understanding of differences in marketing to customers in different verticals and environments. 
  • Develop trusted, long-term relationships with key client contacts and executives. 
  • Ensure meaningful client value is delivered through a mix of best-practice solutions, skills, capabilities, and original thinking. 
  • Collaborate with team leadership (account management, operations, creative, analytics etc.), and partner agencies to turn ideas into executable plans 
  • Identify key data points and measurements to show the impact of our approach and strategy on the client’s business. 

 

You Have:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree. (Required)
  • Experience leading customer lifecycle marketing strategy engagements and delivering trusted content and recommendations to senior clients. (Required)
  • 8+ years of experience in data-driven marketing, specifically CRM, direct mail, email, and online/offline media strategy. (Required)
  • Hands-on experience and advanced knowledge of how to leverage data to drive customer experiences across the customer lifecycle.
  • 5+ years working in an agency or consulting firm.
  • Deep understanding of how data drives decisions and experience interpreting data-driven results to deliver actionable insights.
  • Proficiency in Excel.
  • Knowledge of Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar CRM platforms and the ability to apply that knowledge to strategy and experience planning. (A Plus)
  • Strong writing, presentation, and client-facing communication skills.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to incorporate internal and external feedback on an iterative basis.
  • Superior multitasking, networking, time management, and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-starter with high intellectual curiosity, drive, determination, and persuasion skills.
  • Comfort and experience working within a matrixed organization in roles with a wide degree of latitude.
  • Average 20%-30% travel (contingent on client needs).

The annual salary range for this position is $113,000-$158,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.

job.title: Event Manager
job.description:
Job Description:

The Event Manager plans and executes dentsu's corporate events, client experiences and industry moments within the Global Events team. This is an individual contributor role based in New York, reporting to the Director of Event Operations. 


The Event Manager owns assigned events end to end, from planning through on-site delivery and wrap-up. They coordinate logistics, registration, vendors and budgets, and work closely with internal stakeholders and external partners to deliver polished, well-run experiences. 


Responsibilities 


Event Planning and Execution 

  • Manage assigned corporate events, client experiences and brand activations end to end, from planning through execution and wrap-up. 
  • Build and maintain project plans, timelines and run-of-show documents for multiple concurrent events. 
  • Turn event goals and creative direction into detailed logistics plans, flagging dependencies, risks and resource needs. 
  • Coordinate venues, registration, attendee management, travel, accommodation, transportation, F&B and staffing. 
  • Serve as on-site lead for assigned events, solving issues in real time and escalating as needed. 

Registration and Attendee Experience 

  • Build and manage registration sites, invitation lists and attendee communications in the team's event technology platforms. 
  • Maintain accurate guest data and produce registration and attendance reports for stakeholders. 
  • Follow data privacy requirements (e.g. GDPR) when collecting, storing and sharing attendee information. 
  • Keep the attendee journey smooth from invitation through post-event follow-up. 

Budget and Vendor Management 

  • Track event budgets against plan, process invoices and support budget reconciliation. 
  • Source vendors and manage scopes of work, estimates and payment schedules in partnership with Finance, Procurement and Legal. 
  • Support negotiations with venues, suppliers and production partners. 
  • Manage day-to-day vendor relationships and hold partners to agreed scope, timelines and budgets. 

Stakeholder Collaboration 

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for internal stakeholders on assigned events. 
  • Work with Marketing & Communications, Growth, Client Leadership and agency brands to keep plans aligned with business goals. 
  • Communicate status, risks and next steps clearly to stakeholders and the Director of Event Operations. 
  • Coordinate freelancers, temporary staff and on-site teams. 

Reporting and Improvement 

  • Collect post-event data and attendee feedback and contribute to debrief reports. 
  • Document learnings and help improve team processes, templates and tools. 
  • Flag new event tools or approaches worth considering. 

Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Event Management or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
  • 3+ years of experience in event management, event operations, project or program management.  
  • Proven experience managing events from planning through on-site execution. 
  • Hands-on experience with event registration and attendee management platforms. 
  • Working knowledge of event budgets, invoicing and vendor management. 
  • Experience coordinating with multiple stakeholders in a matrixed organization. 
  • Strong organization, communication and time-management skills, with close attention to detail. 
  • Sound judgment and composure when solving problems on site. 
  • Able to manage several concurrent events and shifting priorities. 
  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends around event dates. 

Location and Travel  

  • Location: New York, NY. Hybrid role. 
  • Travel: Less than 25% travel, Domestic and occasional international travel as needed

job.description:
Job Description:

Build the future of how work gets done.

Technology alone doesn't create efficiency. Smart systems, connected workflows, and great leadership do. As our Group Director, Workflow & Automation Systems, you'll shape how work moves across our organization by designing scalable workflows, driving automation initiatives, and leveraging AI-enabled solutions that help teams work smarter, faster, and more effectively.

In this role, you'll partner with leaders across Activation, Client Success & Solutions, Data, Technology & Measurement, Finance, and Operations to modernize processes, optimize enterprise platforms, and create seamless experiences for both internal teams and clients.

What You'll Do

Lead Workflow & Platform Strategy

  • Create and execute a long-term vision for workflow, order management, and automation platforms across the business.
  • Own enterprise workflow ecosystems and help shape platform roadmaps that align with business goals.
  • Evaluate, implement, and continuously improve technologies that simplify operations and increase efficiency.
  • Partner with Product and Technology teams to ensure solutions meet evolving business needs.

Drive Automation & Innovation

  • Lead the evolution of AI-enabled and agentic workflow solutions that streamline order management and operational processes.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks, improve decision-making, and reduce operational complexity.
  • Design scalable operating models that support work from intake through execution, billing, and reconciliation.
  • Deliver measurable improvements in speed, quality, compliance, and operational performance.

Transform Business Processes

  • Reimagine workflows across multiple business functions and help teams work more efficiently.
  • Lead process improvement initiatives that reduce friction, improve user experiences, and support growth.
  • Translate business challenges into practical, scalable technology solutions.
  • Champion change management, training, documentation, and adoption strategies that help teams succeed.

Influence Across the Organization

  • Collaborate with leaders across Product, Technology, Finance, Operations, and Client teams.
  • Guide prioritization, roadmap planning, governance, and delivery processes.
  • Communicate business outcomes and program performance to executive stakeholders.
  • Mentor and develop team members while fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation.

What You'll Bring

You may be a great fit if you have:

  • Experience leading workflow management, business operations, systems implementation, product operations, or process transformation initiatives.
  • Success delivering large-scale platform implementations and cross-functional programs.
  • Experience managing workflow platforms, order management systems, CRM solutions, or enterprise business systems.
  • A track record of translating business needs into scalable technology solutions.
  • Experience driving automation, efficiency, and operational improvement programs with measurable results.
  • Strong partnership skills and experience working with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Operations teams.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Experience with platforms such as Placements.io, Salesforce, Mediaocean, Jira, Looker, or similar enterprise solutions.
  • Knowledge of workflow orchestration, AI-powered automation, intelligent process automation, or agentic systems.
  • Experience with systems integrations, data workflows, reporting, and governance.
  • Experience in media, advertising, marketing operations, finance operations, or similar fast-paced environments.

You'll have the opportunity to define how work happens across a complex, dynamic organization. Your ideas will help shape the future of workflow automation, AI-enabled operations, and business transformation at scale. If you're energized by solving complex operational challenges, building better systems, and helping teams achieve more through technology, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Growth & Audiences Media Strategy
job.description:
Job Description:

¡En dentsu estamos en búsqueda de un Growth & Audiences Media Strategy!


Estratega de crecimiento que conecta negocio, medios on y off, audiencias y data, end to end y full funnel.


Propósito del rol

El Growth & Audiences Media Strategy lidera la estrategia de crecimiento del cliente a través de medios y audiencias. Parte del objetivo de negocio y define dónde está la oportunidad, a quién hay que llegar, por qué canales y modelos de compra, con qué datos y cómo se medirá el impacto.

Entiende el ecosistema de medios on y off de punta a punta (planeación, compra, activación, medición y optimización) y piensa en full funnel: equilibra construcción de marca, demanda y resultados. No es un perfil técnico ni un operador de herramientas de data: su valor está en analizar la información, interpretarla y convertirla en recomendaciones y acciones concretas, apoyándose en los especialistas de Data, Tecnología y Analytics para la parte operativa. Orquesta a medios, audiencias, data, tecnología, analytics y cuentas para una ejecución integrada. Actúa como consultor estratégico del cliente y de los equipos internos, e influye en las decisiones con recomendaciones fundamentadas en datos.


Responsabilidades principales


1. Estrategia de crecimiento y medios

  • Liderar la estrategia de medios, traduciendo los objetivos de negocio de la marca en objetivos de medios claros y accionables.
  • Diseñar arquitecturas de medios end to end, online y offline, bajo una visión full funnel y una experiencia consistente a lo largo del recorrido del consumidor.
  • Definir el rol estratégico de cada canal en la generación de demanda, consideración, conversión y crecimiento de marca.

2. Estrategia de audiencias y data

  • Definir qué audiencias construir y activar según adquisición, desarrollo y retención: alto valor, lookalikes, retargeting, cross-sell y up-sell.
  • Construir perfiles y arquetipos de audiencia a partir de datos cuantitativos y cualitativos, interpretando la información de fuentes como GWI, TGI, Comscore y Meta Audience Insights.
  • Orientar qué datos propios y de terceros integrar y en qué plataforma (CDP, DMP u otra), según el objetivo de negocio.
  • Traducir la estrategia en briefs de activación con coherencia entre audiencia, canal, formato, mensaje y momento del recorrido.
  • Diagnosticar la madurez de datos del cliente y proponer una hoja de ruta de audiencias (quick wins y visión a largo plazo).

3. Análisis de datos, insights y oportunidades

  • Analizar el desempeño cruzando plataformas de medios, analítica web y de apps, datos propios del cliente, investigación de mercado y competencia.
  • Identificar patrones de comportamiento, consumo y desempeño que se repiten en las audiencias, los canales y los touchpoints, y reconocer las oportunidades que se desprenden de ellos.
  • Convertir los datos en insights y acciones priorizadas por impacto y esfuerzo, con Highlights, Lowlights, propuestas de optimización y Next Steps.

4. Medición, experimentación y aprendizaje

  • Definir con Data los marcos de medición de audiencias y campañas: KPIs, atribución, incrementalidad, fuentes de verdad y criterios de éxito conectados con el negocio.
  • Especificar los dashboards que integren indicadores de medios, audiencias y negocio para decidir a tiempo.
  • Diseñar y liderar la matriz de experimentación con hipótesis claras, metodología y criterios de evaluación (A/B, incrementalidad, brand lift).

5. Consultoría y storytelling ante el cliente

  • Actuar como asesor estratégico: liderar conversaciones sobre oportunidades de crecimiento, innovación y mejora continua.
  • Construir y presentar narrativas que integren datos, insights, resultados y oportunidades, a nivel gerencial.
  • Diagnosticar la madurez del cliente en medios, audiencias, medición y datos, y construir una hoja de ruta con quick wins y visión de largo plazo.

6. Orquestación, liderazgo y calidad

  • Coordinar a los equipos de medios, audiencias, data, tecnología, analytics, implementación, creatividad, CXM y cuentas para una ejecución integrada.
  • Supervisar y dar seguimiento transversal a iniciativas, planes y resultados, tanto de medios como de audiencias.
  • Liderar y desarrollar a Planner Executives, Planner Analysts y analistas de audiencias mediante mentoría, coaching y retroalimentación continua.
  • Resolver situaciones críticas de campañas, planeación o implementación.

Habilidades técnicas y analíticas

Lo que se espera es criterio para analizar y usar la información, no dominio operativo de las herramientas.


  • Planeación de medios on y off: alcance, frecuencia, cobertura, TRPs, métricas de performance y modelos de compra tradicionales y digitales.
  • Lectura de analítica y medición: interpreta resultados de Google Analytics 4, atribución, incrementalidad, brand lift y MMM (nociones) para sacar conclusiones y definir acciones.
  • Insights de audiencias: sabe leer e interpretar la información de GWI, TGI, Comscore y Meta Audience Insights y convertirla en segmentación y estrategia.
  • Análisis con Excel: manejo cómodo para revisar planes, escenarios y resultados.
  • Visualización de datos: lee e interpreta dashboards (Power BI, Looker Studio) y sabe indicar qué necesita ver para decidir.
  • Conocimiento funcional de CDP, DMP y etiquetado: entiende qué permiten y cómo se aprovechan en la estrategia (Google Tag Manager, píxeles, API de conversiones).

Habilidades estratégicas

  • Pensamiento estratégico de negocio
  • Visión full funnel
  • Análisis de información y orientación a la acción
  • Insights de consumidor y audiencias
  • Identificación de patrones y oportunidades
  • Conexión de audiencias con touchpoints
  • Mentalidad de crecimiento
  • Storytelling estratégico

Habilidades de liderazgo e influencia

  • Consultoría e influencia
  • Orquestación multidisciplinaria
  • Liderazgo y desarrollo de talento
  • Gestión de stakeholders
  • Estandarización del conocimiento

Requisitos

Formación

  • Profesional en Publicidad, Mercadeo, Administración, Economía, Estadística, Ingeniería Industrial, Ciencia de Datos o carreras afines.

Experiencia

  • Mínimo 6 años en planeación y estrategia de medios, con medios masivos y digitales, en agencia o anunciante.
  • Experiencia demostrable analizando información de medios y audiencias para tomar decisiones y proponer acciones.
  • Experiencia en consultoría o relación directa con clientes.

Conocimientos requeridos

  • Ecosistema de medios: tradicionales (TV, radio, OOH, prensa) y digitales (search, social, video, CTV, programmatic, retail media).
  • Metodologías de conocimiento de audiencias: conoce y sabe aplicar, a nivel funcional, Audience Intelligence, Customer Segmentation (incluido el modelo RFM: recencia, frecuencia y valor monetario), Persona Development y Customer Journey Mapping. No se espera que ejecute los modelos, sí que entienda para qué sirven, cómo leer sus resultados y cómo usarlos en la estrategia.
  • Audience Measurement Frameworks: comprende los marcos para medir audiencias y su impacto (alcance, cobertura, afinidad, calidad y valor de la audiencia) y cómo se conectan con los objetivos de negocio.
  • Audiencias y data: segmentación, consumer insights, tipos de datos (1st, 2nd y 3rd party) y comprensión funcional de qué hacen un CDP y un DMP y cómo se usan en la estrategia.
  • Attribution & Incrementality: entiende los modelos de atribución, las pruebas de incrementalidad, el brand lift y las nociones de MMM, y sabe cuándo usar cada uno. Capacidad de plantear hipótesis y pruebas.
  • Marketing technology: etiquetado, DSPs y plataformas sociales, a nivel conceptual y funcional.
  • Privacidad y normativa: Habeas Data, GDPR y consentimiento.
  • Deseable: nociones de identidad digital y de SQL; no son requisito.

job.title: Growth & Performance Marketing Manager SSA
job.description:
The Growth & Performance Marketing Manager is responsible for turning dentsu Africa’s communications, thought leadership and capability marketing into measurable audience growth, qualified engagement, new-business opportunities and commercial pipeline influence.

Working within the Communications team and in close partnership with Growth, New Business, Media, CXM and agency leadership, the role has sole accountability for B2B growth marketing and measurable commercial performance: demand-generation strategy, audience and account segmentation, CRM and HubSpot governance, paid media, SEO, landing pages, marketing automation, conversion optimisation, attribution, lead hand-off and pipeline-influence reporting. The role may brief the Social & Communications Manager on campaign audiences and required content, but does not own internal communications, PR, awards, organic editorial calendars, organic publishing, community management or reputation response.

Job Description:

Clicks are nice. Growth is better.


dentsu Africa is looking for a Growth & Performance Marketing Manager who knows that great marketing shouldn't end with engagement. We want someone who can turn attention into action, audiences into opportunities, and marketing into measurable growth.


You’ll work across growth strategy, HubSpot/CRM, paid media, SEO, audience intelligence, automation, conversion and attribution, connecting our marketing activity directly to dentsu’s new-business and growth ambitions. You’ll need to love ideas and data, creativity and conversion, strategy and performance. Because impressions are great.


Key Accountabilities 

Growth Marketing Strategy

  • Develop the annual B2B growth and performance marketing strategy linked to dentsu Africa’s growth priorities, sector targets and approved new-business plan.
  • Define priority audiences, propositions, conversion objectives, channel roles, investment requirements and measurement frameworks.
  • Create quarterly plans linking thought leadership, credentials, events and capability campaigns to defined commercial outcomes.

Audience, Market and Account Strategy

  • Build priority sector, account and decision-maker segments using CRM, market intelligence, website behavior and campaign data.
  • Partner with Growth and New Business to identify target-account lists, trigger signals and suitable account-based marketing plays.
  • Develop audience insights and channel recommendations for priority sectors and opportunities

CRM, HubSpot and Marketing Automation

  • Own HubSpot Marketing Hub strategy, governance, consent, data quality, campaign architecture and integration with business-development processes.
  • Design landing pages, forms, lead magnets, nurture journeys, retargeting audiences and automated hand-offs.
  • Define lifecycle stages, lead qualification criteria, attribution rules and service-level expectations with Growth and New Business.

Demand Generation and Conversion 

  • Create measurable campaigns that move audiences from awareness to engagement, enquiry, qualified conversation and opportunity.
  • Develop conversion plans for thought leadership, webinars, events, capability launches, case studies and sector campaigns.
  • Improve conversion through testing of propositions, creative, landing pages, forms, calls to action, journeys and channel mix.

Paid Media and Search Strategy

  • Set objectives, audiences, budgets and briefs for paid social, paid search, retargeting and performance-media activity across LinkedIn, Google, Meta and relevant platforms.
  • Work with dentsu media specialists to execute and optimise activity using CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL, cost per qualified lead and pipeline influence.
  • Own SEO and discoverability priorities for strategic Africa content, working with website and content owners on implementation.

New Business and Commercial Enablement

  • Partner with New Business to develop always-on prospect engagement and pre-pitch warming programmes.
  • Use campaign and behavioural signals to identify engaged accounts and recommend timely follow-up.
  • Support priority pitches with audience intelligence, digital journey thinking, sector content and measurable amplification plans.
  • Create reusable campaign assets and conversion journeys that support credentials, client development and cross-sell activity.

Analytics, Attribution and Optimisation 

  • Build an integrated growth dashboard covering audience, campaign, website, CRM, lead, opportunity and pipeline measures.
  • Establish consistent campaign tagging, attribution methodology and reporting definitions.
  • Run monthly optimisation reviews and quarterly growth performance reviews with Communications and Growth leadership.
  • Translate data into clear investment, content, proposition and channel recommendations.

Partnership with Social & Communications Manager

  • Set performance briefs and audience priorities for campaigns while the Social & Communications Manager owns organic editorial execution.
  • Use top-performing organic themes as inputs to paid, nurture and conversion programmes.
  • Provide performance insights that improve content choices without taking over daily publishing, PR, employee communications or community management.

Accountability Boundary

  • Sole owner: growth marketing strategy, target-account and audience segmentation, HubSpot and CRM governance, paid media, SEO, marketing automation, landing pages and forms, lead qualification, nurture journeys, conversion optimisation, attribution, opportunity influence and commercial performance reporting.
  • Receives from Social & Communications: approved content, case studies, thought-leadership assets, brand and editorial guidance, and organic publishing support.
  • Does not own: internal or leadership communications, PR and media relations, awards administration, organic editorial calendars, organic social publishing, executive organic posting, community management, reputation monitoring or crisis-response coordination.
  • Decision rights: has final operational authority for growth campaign architecture, CRM and automation rules, paid-media briefs and budgets within approval limits, SEO priorities, conversion journeys, attribution methodology and performance reporting.
  • Commercial hand-off: owns qualification and routing of marketing-generated leads. Growth and New Business own sales pursuit, pitch leadership, commercial negotiation and final revenue conversion after the agreed hand-off point.

Experience and Qualifications 

Essential

  • Minimum 6-8 years of relevant experience in B2B growth marketing, demand generation, performance marketing, CRM or digital strategy.
  • Practical experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub or a comparable marketing automation platform.
  • Strong understanding of full-funnel strategy, audience segmentation, nurture, conversion and attribution.
  • Experience briefing and evaluating paid social, paid search, retargeting, SEO and landing-page activity.
  • Ability to connect marketing metrics to qualified conversations, opportunities and commercial pipeline.
  • Strong analytical, stakeholder-management and presentation skills.
  • Experience partnering with sales, new business or client-development teams.

Advantageous

  • HubSpot Marketing Hub certification.
  • Experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, GA4, Search Console and dashboarding tools such as Power BI or Looker Studio.
  • Account-based marketing or B2B professional-services marketing experience.
  • Agency, media, creative, CXM or technology-sector experience.
  • Experience across African markets and multi-market data environments.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled audience, content and campaign optimisation tools.

Role Success Profile 

A commercially minded growth strategist, performance marketer and CRM operator.

Success means making dentsu Africa’s communications work harder: building qualified audiences, creating measurable journeys, identifying commercial signals and demonstrating a credible contribution to new business and growth targets.

job.title: Growth Media Strategy
job.description:
Job Description:

¡En dentsu estamos en búsqueda de un Growth Media Strategy!


El Growth Media Strategy lidera la planeación de medios desde una perspectiva estratégica y de negocio, con un entendimiento end to end del ecosistema de medios: planeación, compra, activación, medición y optimización, tanto offline como online. Asegura que las recomendaciones respondan a los objetivos de negocio y comunicación del cliente y a las prioridades comerciales de la agencia.

Piensa en full funnel: no optimiza solo conversión, sino que equilibra construcción de marca, demanda y resultados en cada etapa del recorrido del consumidor. Y usa el análisis de datos para traducir el desempeño en oportunidades y acciones concretas, con una visión integral de las marcas y su crecimiento.


Responsabilidades:


1.    Estrategia de medios end to end

  • Liderar la estrategia de medios, traduciendo los objetivos de negocio de la marca en objetivos de medios claros y accionables.
  • Diseñar arquitecturas de medios end-to-end que integren canales online y offline bajo una visión full funnel, asegurando una experiencia consistente a lo largo del recorrido del consumidor.
  • Definir el rol estratégico de cada canal dentro del ecosistema de medios, estableciendo cómo contribuye a la generación de demanda, consideración, conversión, y crecimiento de la marca.
  • Alinear las estrategias de audiencias con las necesidades de adquisición, desarrollo y retención de clientes, asegurando relevancia en cada etapa del journey.

 

2. Análisis de datos, insights y oportunidades

  • Analizar resultados y desempeño de los planes cruzando fuentes: plataformas de medios, analítica web y de apps, datos propios del cliente, investigación de mercado y competencia.
  • Traducir los datos en insights, oportunidades y acciones priorizadas por impacto y esfuerzo, no solo en reportes descriptivos.
  • Analizar los resultados frente a la estrategia definida y traducirlos en Highlights, Lowligths propuestas de optimización y Next Steps.
  • Analizar la relación entre los resultados de medios y su impacto en los objetivos de negocio.

3. Medición, aprendizaje y experimentación

  • Definir, en conjunto con el equipo de Data, los marcos de medición de campañas y iniciativas de crecimiento, estableciendo KPIs, metodologías de atribución, fuentes de verdad y criterios de éxito alineados con los objetivos de negocio.
  • Diseñar y priorizar requerimientos de visualización y monitoreo, asegurando que los dashboards integren indicadores de medios, audiencias y negocio para facilitar la toma de decisiones oportunas.
  • Diseñar, estructurar y liderar planes de experimentación con hipótesis claras, metodologías definidas y criterios de evaluación previamente establecidos.
  • Transformar hallazgos y resultados de campañas en recomendaciones accionables orientadas a mejorar el desempeño, la eficiencia de la inversión y los resultados de negocio.

4. Consultoría y storytelling ante el cliente

  • Actuar como asesor estratégico del cliente, recomendando modelos de inversión, oportunidades de crecimiento, prioridades de medios y mecanismos de optimización alineados con los objetivos de negocio.
  • Construir y presentar narrativas estratégicas que integren datos, insights, resultados y oportunidades, transformando la información en recomendaciones claras y accionables para la toma de decisiones.
  • Diagnosticar la madurez de medios, audiencias, medición y uso de datos del cliente, identificando brechas y construyendo hojas de ruta de evolución con iniciativas de corto, mediano y largo plazo.
  • Acompañar al Director de Cuenta, Business Lead o líder del área en decisiones clave relacionadas con estrategia de medios, inversiones, medición y crecimiento.

5. Liderazgo de equipo y calidad

  • Liderar y brindar acompañamiento estratégico a Planner Executives y Planner Analyst.
  • Asegurar la calidad estratégica, analítica y metodológica de planes, recomendaciones, racionales, presentaciones y entregables al cliente.
  • Priorizar los esfuerzos del equipo según necesidades del cliente, timing y oportunidades de negocio.
  • Garantizar el cumplimiento de los estándares de calidad, procesos, metodologías y KPIs definidos por el área.
  • Facilitar la colaboración entre equipos de medios, data, implementación, tecnología y CXM para asegurar una ejecución integrada de las estrategias.

Skills

  • Pensamiento estratégico de negocio
  • Conocimiento del ecosistema de medios
  • Interpretación y análisis de datos
  • Generación de insights estratégicos
  • Análisis de audiencias y consumidor
  • Medición y evaluación de efectividad
  • Experimentación y optimización
  • Storytelling estratégico
  • Consultoría e influencia
  • Liderazgo

 

Requisitos

  • Profesional en Publicidad, Mercadeo, Administración, Economía, Estadística, Ingeniería Industrial, Ciencia de Datos o carreras afines.
  • Deseable: certificaciones en marketing, medios, analítica o growth.
  • Experiencia en planeación de medios y estrategia, con manejo de medios masivos y digitales, en agencia o anunciante
  • Experiencia liderando o formando planners y analistas.
  • Experiencia demostrable en análisis de datos aplicado a decisiones de medios.
  • Experiencia en consultoría o relación directa con clientes

Conocimientos técnicos

  • Ecosistema de medios: medios tradicionales (TV, radio, OOH, prensa) y digitales (search, social, video, CTV, programmatic, retail media).
  • Planeación de medios: conocimiento sólido de medios on y off, modelos de compra digital, métricas de performance y metodologías de planeación basadas en alcance, frecuencia, cobertura, TRPs, etc.
  • Analítica y medición: Google Analytics 4, atribución, incrementalidad, brand lift y nociones de MMM.
  • Conocimiento en el manejo de Visualización de datos: Power BI y Looker Studio (Data Studio).
  • Excel avanzado: modelos de planeación, escenarios y análisis.
  • Conocimiento funcional de CDP, DMP y etiquetado: Google Tag Manager, píxeles, API de conversiones.

job.title: Junior Accountant
job.description:
Responsible for managing and supporting complex accounting and financial reporting activities for the Group’s SSA and Uganda entities. The role covers Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, banking, intercompany accounting, month-end reporting, tax administration, reconciliations, and audit support, while working closely with regional and international stakeholders.

Job Description:

Key responsibilities:

Financial Accounting & Reporting

  • Support day-to-day accounting operations and monthly financial reporting for SSA and Uganda.
  • Prepare and post month-end journals, including accruals, leave provisions, interest, depreciation, and reversals.
  • Support month-end close, ABI reporting, and Forex Exposure reporting.
  • Maintain accurate financial records, schedules, and reporting trackers.
  • Provide accounting and reporting support to the wider finance team.

Accounts Payable & Receivable

  • Capture and process supplier, media, and employee expense invoices, ensuring correct allocation, approval, and supporting documentation.
  • Perform creditor, debtor, and intercompany reconciliations.
  • Prepare weekly payment schedules and review payment documentation.
  • Manage vendor records and obtain required supplier documentation.
  • Manage the full debtors function, including billing, invoicing, customer reconciliations, statements, collections, and ageing reports.
  • Follow up on outstanding customer payments and obtain remittance advice.
  • Process Uganda billing in accordance with URA requirements 

 

Banking & Reconciliations

  • Reconcile bank accounts for SSA and Uganda, including ZAR, USD, and GBP accounts.
  • Capture and reconcile foreign currency bank statements.
  • Perform credit card reconciliations and maintain tracking schedules.
  • Monitor and resolve outstanding reconciliation items.
  • Support banking system administration and onboarding of authorised users.

Intercompany & Tax

  • Manage intercompany recharges, reconciliations, loans, and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with the preparation and maintenance of intercompany agreements.
  • Capture EMP201, VAT, and applicable penalties.
  • Maintain working knowledge of URA processes and requirements.
  • Liaise with HR and internal/external payroll providers as required.

Audit, Compliance & Stakeholder Management

  • Assist with internal and external audits and respond to audit queries.
  • Ensure financial transactions comply with company policies, internal controls, and statutory requirements.
  • Liaise with clients, suppliers, auditors, HR, and senior finance stakeholders across Uganda, Kenya, Tanzania, and the SSA region.
  • Provide accurate and timely financial information and support ad hoc reporting requirements.
  • Maintain organised financial records and supporting documentation.

  

Key Areas of Accountability

  • Accurate and timely financial reporting and month-end close.
  • Effective management of Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
  • Accurate bank, credit card, foreign currency, and intercompany reconciliations.
  • Timely customer collections and supplier payments.
  • Accurate ABI and Forex Exposure reporting.
  • Compliance with tax, URA, and statutory requirements.
  • Effective financial controls, documentation, and audit support.

Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or Similar
  • 2-4 years of accounting experience, preferably in a multinational or agency environment (internships or entry-level roles considered).
  • Sound knowledge of financial reporting, controls, and compliance.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in accounting systems and Microsoft Excel

job.title: Lead Analyst, Measurement & Attribution
job.description:
The purpose of this role is to deliver analysis inline with client business objectives, goals, and to maintain, develop and exceed client performance targets.

Job Description:

The Lead Analyst will play an important role in our US-based attribution modeling capabilities. Reporting into the Sr. Director, you will use data science techniques to examine marketing activities and to estimate their growth to our clients. These projects will include Media Mix Optimization or Marketing Mix Modeling, Analysis of Covariance (test and control), Cluster Analysis, and Attribution Modeling of disaggregate event-stream data. You will be hands-on keyboard building and revise code and inspire creativity. 

  

You Will: 

  • Manage data collection with clients 
  • Develop reports and processes to manage data quality control 
  • Drive innovation in analytics and achieve client expectations 
  • Implement and develop attribution models 
  • Interpret and visualize model estimates and diagnostics 
  • Drive innovation and continuous improvement 

  

You Have: 

  • Bachelor's degree in at least one of these fields preferred: statistics, economics, applied mathematics, optimization, computer science, physics; (preference for advanced degree). 
  • 3+ years of experience applying analytics to measure marketing effectiveness with a focus on measurement and attribution 
  • Experience working with and measuring TV, digital media, and CRM data 
  • Knowledge of statistics/data science, including regression, hierarchical or mixed regression, and machine learning techniques (Naïve Bayes, Markov Chain, Random Forest etc.) 
  • Advanced modeling skills with Python and R 
  • Cloud environment experience, especially GCP and AWS 
  • Experience working with platforms like Databricks a plus 
  • Data visualization experience with tools like Tableau or Power BI a plus 
  • An understanding of marketing goals and how different media channels support these goals 
  • Experience presenting information in spoken, written or visual form to a variety of audiences, from our teams to external client teams 
  • Experience with collaboration with teammates, especially global teams, to share insights and techniques 

 

 

The annual salary range for this position is $82,500-110,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. 

 

Benefits available with this position include: 

 

  • Medical, vision, and dental insurance, 
  • Life insurance, 
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance, 
  • 401k, 
  • Flexible paid time off, 
  • At least 15 paid holidays per year, 
  • Paid sick and safe leave, and 
  • Paid parental leave. 

 

Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. For further details regarding Dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com. 

 

To begin the application process, please click on the "Apply" button at the top of this job posting. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted for next steps. 

 

At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Dentsu may designate other Hub offices at any time. Those who live outside a commutable range may be designated as remote, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect our employees to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office.

job.title: Legal Counsel
job.description:
Job Description:

We are looking for an exceptional and experienced commercial lawyer for a role with the dentsu U.S. Legal and Compliance team. The role will focus on dentsu’s media practice in the U.S. The media practice at dentsu provides a diverse range of services to clients to maximize the effectiveness, relevance, and performance of their marketing investment in media. The media practice capabilities help clients manage the ever-increasing complexities of media, data, and customer advocacy and privacy while maximizing business outcomes and drive improved marketing results and competitive advantage. The successful candidate will join a large and vibrant international community of lawyers who provide practical and focused legal advice supporting dentsu as it drives sustainable business growth for our clients. 


We are looking for an individual who is passionate about marketing and will bring energy and enthusiasm to the role. There is plenty of opportunity to develop professional and personal skills, and work alongside senior management as a trusted business advisor. While a background in media is not necessary for the role, a keen interest in learning about all aspects of media marketing, advertising and communication is critical.


Responsibilities of the role include the following:

  • Draft and negotiate a variety of commercial agreements, including services agreements (MSAs and SOWs), media vendor contracts for services like custom content, digital media, OOH, linear and CTV, etc., reseller agreements, data licenses, DPAs, BAAs, SaaS agreements, and other commercial and operational agreements.
  • Analyze comments from opposing counsel and propose solutions. Provide risk assessments.
  • Oversee contract administration and compliance.
  • Review legal contracts for execution by management.
  • Interpret and apply contract terms.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment.
  • Develop training and legal risk management plans for senior management and other partners at different levels.
  • Help implement best-practices in compliance, contract management, intellectual property, and data privacy.

Qualifications

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in commercial transactions, with particular preference for those with experience in marketing, advertising, data, intellectual property, or privacy.
  • Licensed to practice law and in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
  • Possesses a law degree (e.g., Juris Doctor) from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Knowledge of legal principles in relation to contract law, marketing/advertising law, data, intellectual property, and data privacy.
  • Someone who:
  • has a great sense of humor, a client-service mentality, and the ability to collaborate with colleagues across teams and jurisdictions, as well as with clients who place their trust in dentsu;
  • has a desire to learn more about the wider media, advertising, data, and technology industries;
  • possesses well-developed prioritization skills given the likelihood of dealing with multiple projects and internal clients at any one time;
  • can work autonomously, take initiative and be proactive in addressing new matters or challenges;
  • has a passion for the work they do and the industries in which they work;
  • is confident to communicate clearly on matters that involve senior management attention;
  • has strong commercial and business acumen that allows the individual to efficiently and expeditiously compare the relevant legal risks to the scope of commercial strategy and corporate objectives; and
  • believes in the importance of contributing to social impact, DEI, and pro bono initiatives at dentsu.

The annual base salary range for this position is ($136,000 - $180,000). Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.
