job.title: Paid Media Platforms Analyst
job.description:
Job Description:

¡En Dentsu estamos en la búsqueda de un Paid Media Platforms Analyst!


El propósito de esta función es implementar y ejecutar campañas de Paid Media (enfoque en Search, Social y/o Programmatic) de acuerdo con la estrategia acordada, para mantener, desarrollar y superar los objetivos del cliente.


-Proporciona la aplicación, la optimización y la carga diaria de las campañas de los clientes.

-Se mantiene en contacto con proveedores y representantes de terceros para mantener y desarrollar relaciones y desarrollar conocimientos de nuevas funciones.

-Interpreta los informes de rendimiento para proporcionar una visión y un análisis procesable a fin de cumplir con los objetivos de la campaña

-Garantizar la entrega de las campañas en cuanto a presupuesto y objetivos se refiere.

-Generar Best Practices parala unidad con base en la experiencia del día a día en la plataforma, optimizando procesos para alcanzar mejores resultados.

-Proponer y mejorar estrategias de performance con base en las herramientas de cada plataforma para las marcas a cargo.

-Implementar campañas configurando parámetros, presupuesto, duración, segmentación y comunicación.

-Evaluar y optimizar el desarrollo de las campañas midiendo indicadores, realizando diagnóstico del estado de la campaña, estableciendo y aplicando ajustes para maximizar los resultados, verificando la configuración de los parámetros.

-Reportar e informar al cliente interno los resultados parciales y finales de la estrategia planteada, enviando reportes periódicos, realizar estatus de la pauta en cuanto a cumplimiento y efectividad, analizando oportunidades de mejora.


Requisitos:

Profesional en carreras administrativas, mercadeo, comunicación social, negocios, publicidad, ingenierías, matemática, estadística, sistemas y afines.

Experiencia mínima de 1 año en funciones relacionadas al rol.

El candidato ideal debe tener fuertes habilidades relacionadas a: SEM, Performance, análisis y perspectivas, gestión del presupuesto del cliente, medición y entrega de KPIs, Microsoft Excel, orientación al detalle.


Deseable contar con:

Inglés intermedio, certificaciones en Google Ads, certificación Meta Ads (plus), conocimiento de la herramienta Advertmind.

job.title: Senior Account Manager (m/w/d)
job.description:
Job Description:

Dentsu ist ein weltweites Agentur Netzwerk im Bereich Marketing und Werbung und wurde 1901 in Tokio gegründet und ist heute in mehr als 145 Ländern vertreten. Zusammen mit unseren Kund*innen schaffen wir bedeutende Medienerlebnisse auf führenden globalen Plattformen, produzieren Content und erschaffen Influencer-Programme.

Mit unserer einzigartigen Kombination aus Media, Customer Experience Management und Creative transformieren wir Geschäftsmodelle und ermöglichen nachhaltiges Wachstum für Marken, Menschen und die Gesellschaft.



Tätigkeiten / Verantwortlichkeiten


  • Eigenständige Betreuung und Beratung von Kund*innen sowie Steuerung der laufenden Kundenkommunikation und Abstimmung mit relevanten Stakeholdern.
  • Commercial & Budget Management: Erstellung von Kostenvoranschlägen, Projekt- und Kampagnenkalkulationen, Budgetsteuerung, Forecasting sowie Vorbereitung und Begleitung der Abrechnung.
  • End-to-End-Projektmanagement: Steuerung von Projekten und Kampagnen vom Briefing bis zur Auslieferung, inklusive Team-Setup, Ressourcenkoordination, Timings, Qualitätsmanagement und Stakeholder-Abstimmungen.
  • Integriertes Kampagnenmanagement: Übergreifende Koordination und Steuerung von Kampagnen über verschiedene digitale Kanäle und Formate hinweg.
  • Display Campaign Management: Sicherer Umgang mit Produktionsplänen, Vermarktenden/Publishern, Media-Spezifikationen, Formaten, Timings und der Koordination der benötigten Werbemittel.
  • Paid Social Campaign Management: Steuerung und Koordination von Paid-Social-Kampagnen, insbesondere für Meta und TikTok, inklusive Abstimmung von Assets, Formaten, Timings und Anforderungen mit Creative- und Media-Teams.
  • Creator & Influencer Management: Koordination von Creator-Kooperationen inklusive Vertragsabstimmung, Honorarverhandlung, Kostenkontrolle und Abrechnung sowie Abstimmung von Briefings, Content-Ideen und Deliverables.
  • Organic Social: Betreuung und Koordination von Redaktions- und Contentplänen sowie grundlegender Umgang mit dem Meta Business Manager und TikTok Business Tools; Verständnis von Social KPIs, Reportings und Ableitung von Optimierungspotenzialen.
  • Strategische Kundenberatung: Identifikation von Optimierungs- und Entwicklungspotenzialen sowie Beratung zu Kampagnen, digitalen Touchpoints, Social Media und kanalübergreifenden Kommunikationsmaßnahmen.
  • Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Enge Steuerung und Koordination interner und externer Teams, insbesondere aus den Bereichen Creative, Media, Social, Strategy, Production und weiteren Spezialdisziplinen.



Fertigkeiten / Anforderungen


  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Account Management, idealerweise in einer Digital-, Creative- oder Integrated Agency.
  • Sehr gute Fähigkeiten in der Betreuung von Kund*innen und im Stakeholder-Management, auch bei komplexen Projekten mit mehreren beteiligten Disziplinen.
  • Ausgeprägte Projektmanagement-Kompetenz und Erfahrung in der parallelen Steuerung mehrerer Kampagnen und Workstreams.
  • Starkes kommerzielles Verständnis sowie Erfahrung mit Budgets, Kalkulationen, Kostenvoranschlägen und Abrechnungsprozessen.
  • Gutes Verständnis digitaler Media- und Produktionsprozesse, insbesondere in den Bereichen Display, Paid Social und Organic Social.
  • Praktische Kenntnisse der Anforderungen und Prozesse von Meta und TikTok sowie ein solides Verständnis relevanter Social-Media-KPIs.
  • Erfahrung im Creator-/Influencer-Management, idealerweise einschließlich Vertrags-, Honorar- und Content-Abstimmungen.
  • Fähigkeit, Produktionspläne, Media Specs und technische Anforderungen zu verstehen und zwischen Kund*innen, Media-, Creative- und Production-Teams zu übersetzen.
  • Hohe Beratungs-, Kommunikations- und Präsentationskompetenz sowie souveränes Auftreten gegenüber Kund*innen.
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitäts- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.



Deine Benefits bei dentsu creative:


💝 Social Impact: 2 zusätzliche Volunteering Days, um dich für dein Herzensprojekt einzusetzen.

💖 Mental Health: 3 Wellnessdays zusätzlich zu deinen Urlaubstagen, Mental Health First Aider Programme zur Förderung deiner mentalen Gesundheit sowie ein Employee Assistance Program.

♻ Nachhaltigkeit: Unsere Büros nutzen erneuerbare Energien, daher arbeitest du bei uns CO₂- neutral.

🎓 Academy: Weiterbildungs- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch unser Netzwerk und unsere hauseigene Academy.

💼 Learning Allowance: 40h pro Jahr zusätzlich zum gesetzlichen Bildungsurlaub, um dich persönlich & beruflich weiterzuentwickeln.

🛍️ Corporate Benefits: Zugriff auf exklusive Mitarbeiterrabatte über unsere Corporate Benefits Plattform.

💌 Company Pension Plan: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge als Baustein für deine finanzielle Sicherheit.

✈️ Workation: Du hast die Möglichkeit, temporär aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.

💸 Freunde werben Freunde: Empfiehl neue Talente und sichere dir eine Prämie bei erfolgreicher Einstellung.

🐶 Office Dogs: Flauschigen Wegbegleiter sind im Büro erlaubt.



Deine Rahmenbedingungen bei dentsu:

🕒 Arbeitsmodell: Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Gleitzeit & Homeoffice möglich, Mehrarbeit wird ab Minute 1 erfasst.

🍏 Daily Booster: Jeden Tag frisches Obst & Kaffee mit (Hafer-)Milch in unseren Büros.


Bereit, Teil des Teams zu werden? Gestalte deine individuelle Karriere und entfalte dein volles Potenzial. Bewirb dich jetzt und lass uns gemeinsam die Zukunft gestalten!


Bei Fragen melde Dich gerne bei Julia Werner, Senior Talent Acquisition Manager



Vielfalt, Chancengleichheit & Inklusion bei dentsu


Bei dentsu stehen Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) im Mittelpunkt unserer Vision: „An der Spitze menschenzentrierter Transformationen stehen, die die Gesellschaft prägen.“

Wir schätzen die einzigartigen Talente und Perspektiven jedes Einzelnen und heißen Bewerber:innen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität, Nationalität, Religion, ethnischer Herkunft, kulturellem Hintergrund, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeiten.

Indem wir vielfältige Perspektiven einbinden, schaffen wir echten Wandel und nachhaltiges Wachstum –für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden und die Gesellschaft. Unsere Einstellungsentscheidungen basieren ausschließlich auf Qualifikationen und den Anforderungen der jeweiligen Rolle, um ein Arbeitsumfeld frei von Diskriminierung und Belästigung zu gewährleisten.

job.title: Senior Associate Buyer, National Video/Broadcast
job.description:
Job Description:

POSITION DESCRIPTION


The Senior Associate, National Video Investment is the day-to-day focal point for the account, with a focus on national sports, Connected TV (CTV), and evolving digital video alongside traditional linear television. The primary responsibility of the Senior Associate is to negotiate cost-efficient schedules on behalf of clients. Reporting into a Sr. Manager, the Senior Associate coordinates all aspects of the buying process.

 

The Senior Associate is expected to have a strong working knowledge of the converged video marketplace, live sports, and available media research. They are also expected to be proficient with agency buying tools and inter-departmental procedures, acting as an engaged participant who consistently contributes ideas and insights to benefit our clients.


KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY


Media Buying and Execution:

 

  • Negotiate and steward national sports, CTV/streaming, and linear scatter buys, including live game units, sponsorships, and custom integrations.
  • Analyze upfront and scatter plans, execute options, and prepare scatter and digital video buy recommendations.
  • Ensure that DDS, Prisma, and internal charts reflect the most updated brand requirements, allocations, flighting, dollars, and GRP/impression goals.
  • Coordinate directly with network, streaming, and media partners regarding client scheduling, creative rotations, live broadcast contingencies, and make-goods.
  • Organize all upfront and sports package information into clear summary documents (i.e., "Roll-Ups").
  • Prepare client reports on national accounts (Tracking, GRPs/impressions, Post-Buy analyses, and Monthly Spending Reports).

 

Client & Internal Relationships:

 

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with media partners
  • Maintain special client-related projects, including marketplace updates and landscape POVs
  • Assist the VP and Sr. Manager in identifying and growing business opportunities within current accounts.
  • Keep up with the latest trends in converged video, streaming platforms, sports rights, and ratings, proactively informing the team and client of new opportunities or issues.
  • Participate in and lead, where appropriate, face-to-face client and vendor meetings while building positive relationships across internal teams.

 

Strategic Thinking & Leadership:

 

  • Work with the management team (VPs/Sr. Managers) to develop video buying strategies that maximize client media dollars.
  • Share new and relevant advertising opportunities across linear, CTV, in written and verbal form to the media department.
  • Assess scheduling, ratings, or delivery issues in a systematic, logical manner; proactively resolve discrepancies and know when and to whom to escalate.
  • Instruct and develop Assistant Buyers’ knowledge of converged video/TV media, sports negotiation skills, and DDS/agency systems.
  • Provide day-to-day guidance to junior team members, helping manage timelines, budgets, and performance management documentation as needed.
  • Manage multiple fast-moving deliverables seamlessly, particularly around live sports timelines and shifting client priorities.

 

Communications Skills:

 

  • Express ideas clearly and concisely in both oral and written communications.
  • Organize data and strategic recommendations logically and sequentially.
  • Assist in the development of media presentations, campaign recaps, and tactical POVs.
  • Develop client reports that are clear, compelling, and persuasive.
  • Ensure timely communication with the broader team regarding client requests, internal agency updates, and changes in account status.

EXPERIENCE/KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED:


  • Bachelor’s Degree.
  • 1–3 years of media buying experience, including at least 1 year at the Assistant Buyer/Associate level.
  • Thorough understanding of the national video buying process, department workflows, and inter-departmental relationships.
  • Experience negotiating and stewarding linear and CTV/streaming video buys.
  • A desire to grow into cross-platform video investment (hands-on DSP trading not required).
  • Working knowledge of DDS (and Prisma/MediaOcean) alongside media vendor negotiation experience.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to tie cross-screen results (GRPs, CPMs, reach/frequency, VCR) back to client business objectives.
  • Knowledge of media research terminology and experience with research tools such as Nielsen, VideoAmp, etc.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment; able to adapt plans quickly around live sports or shifting budgets without losing momentum.
  • Advanced computer skills (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

The annual salary range for this position is $66,300-$70,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.  

Benefits available with this position include:  

  • Medical, vision, and dental insurance, 
  • Life insurance,  
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance, 
  • 401k, 
  • Flexible paid time off, 
  • At least 15 paid holidays per year, 
  • Paid sick and safe leave, and 
  • Paid parental leave. 

 

Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies.  For further details regarding Dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com. 


To begin the application process, please click on the “Apply” button at the top of this job posting. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted for next steps.

job.title: Senior Media Planning & Buying Specialist (K/M)
job.description:
Job Description:

Grupa dentsu to globalna sieć komunikacji marketingowej stworzona z myślą o przyszłości. W jej skład wchodzą marki: Carat, iProspect, Amplifi, dentsu X i Dentsu Creative.

Przyjmując skoncentrowane na ludziach podejście do transformacji biznesowej, wykorzystujemy naszą wnikliwość do łączenia marki, contentu, handlu i doświadczenia - wszystko w oparciu o innowacyjną kreatywność.

Nasza główna siedziba znajduje się w Tokio, a 65 000 ekspertów pracuje w czterech regionach (Japonia, Ameryka, EMEA i APAC). dentsu łączy japońską innowacyjność ze zróżnicowaną, globalną perspektywą, aby napędzać rozwój klientów i kształtować społeczeństwo

 

W związku z dynamicznym rozwojem poszukujemy osoby na stanowisko Senior Media Planning & Buying Specialist (K/M)

 

ZADANIA

  • Planowanie i zakup kampanii TV dla powierzonych klientów zgodnie z briefem oraz ustaleniami z Media Planning & Buying Managerem
  • Bieżące monitorowanie realizacji kampanii w systemach wewnętrznych.
  • Przygotowywanie raportów post-buy, czyli oceny, jak kampania faktycznie została zrealizowana, oraz wspieranie zespołu przy raportach z innych kampanii
  • Negocjowanie dodatkowych korzyści dla klientów w obszarze TV.
  • Przygotowywanie analiz konkurencji i innych raportów dla klientów
  • Rozliczanie zakupu kampanii w systemach wewnętrznych
  • Wspieranie managera w szkoleniu Juniorów i Specialistów, przekazywanie wiedzy o procesach i narzędziach.  
  • Śledzenie trendów mediowych, komunikacyjnych i konsumenckich oraz nowych rozwiązań TV w Polsce i za granicą.
  • Dzielenie się wiedzą i udział w rozwoju kompetencji zespołu

WYMAGANIA

 

  • minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w domu mediowym,
  • doświadczenie w planowaniu i zakupie kampanii TV,
  • bardzo dobre zdolności analityczne i codzienna praca w Excelu,
  • bardzo dobry język angielski,
  • bardzo dobry język polski
  • doświadczenie we współpracy z klientem.

 

OFERUJEMY

  • Pracę w globalnej, dynamicznie rozwijającej się grupie z obszaru komunikacji marketingowej;
  • Samodzielność w działaniu w zakresie powierzonych zadań;
  • Możliwość rozwoju w ramach grupy dentsu w Polsce i na świecie;
  • Szkolenie on-boardingowe;
  • 3 dodatkowe, wolne dni płatne - tzw. „Wellness days”;
  • 2 dodatkowe dni przeznaczone na wolontariat pracowniczy;
  • Summer Fridays - w okresie wakacyjnym (od czerwca do września, w piątki kończymy pracę 2 godziny wcześniej);
  • Hybrydowy tryb pracy – zależnie od ustaleń w zespole;
  • Wewnętrzne programy szkoleniowe;
  • Nowoczesne i komfortowe biuro zgodnie z ideą work-life-balance, oferujące między innymi takie udogodnienia jak siłownia i sala fitness, punkt opieki dziennej dla dzieci DAY CARE;

  • Dofinansowanie do karty sportowej Medicover sport lub Multisport (do wyboru) i wiele aktywności sportowych w ramach grup zainteresowania.

job.title: Senior Strategist, Brand & Experience Strategy
job.description:
Job Description:

About Dentsu Creative

Business-Driven and Creatively Obsessed. We are dedicated to helping our clients achieve growth. We understand the challenge of standing out in an increasingly competitive marketplace. We recognize that experiences are becoming indistinguishable across industries, and new technologies can both enable creativity and risk commoditization. In this context, the need for a distinct competitive edge is crucial. We believe that embracing creativity is key for sustainable business growth. However, the conventional definition of creativity will not suffice. Our view on creativity goes beyond norms; it’s not just how we execute, but a mindset that permeates our organization and our clients’ businesses. We call it Transformative Creativity. It’s outcome-focused creativity unleashed to solve business problems. This unique brand of creativity sets us apart and drives our clients to success.


About Our Strategists

We’re Proactive Leaders. Great strategists are proactive and take the initiative to lead teams and clients with new ideas and provocative thoughts. We get ahead of the ask, anticipating the next step and setting the agenda with the energy and optimism it takes to ensure that our work is fresh, our clients feel our partnership, and the team stays ahead of the curve and delivers exceptional ideas.


We Challenge the Status Quo. Our strategists take pride in challenging the status quo, always seeking fresh angles and leading with innovative ideas. We push past right, to find what is interesting. We challenge assumptions. We generate the energy and enthusiasm needed to help our teams and clients find the next level in an ever-evolving world, embodying a challenger mindset.


We’re Makers and Doers. At every level, from CSO to junior planner, our strategists are makers who take pride in creating things, not just managing projects. We hold ourselves to a high standard of creation, putting hands on keyboards and turning ideas into tangible outputs, fostering a culture of hands-on involvement and tangible creativity that make ideas in our heads a reality in the world.


We Cherish a Growth Mindset. We value and fuel a growth mindset, encouraging our strategists to be their best and embrace feedback that challenges their thinking and actions. Our culture is hard on the work but kind to our people, recognizing that personal growth is key to our agency’s success.


We’re Radical Collaborators. We are radically collaborative, working fluidly across teams and skill sets with the outcome in mind, not personal egos. Our strategists know that together we are stronger, actively seeking others’ input to solve problems and elevate the work, fostering a culture of collective excellence.


Role Overview

As a Sr. Strategist, Brand Experience Strategy, you will report to the Group Director, Brand Experience Strategy. You will join a team of smart, creative strategists shaping how spirits, alcohol, and non-alcohol brands come to life across retail, restaurant and bar, entertainment, digital, social, experiential and trade. You lead day-to-day strategy on assigned accounts, keep pulse on leading market and consumer trends, turn insight into go-to-market plans, and partner closely with Account, Creative and Analytics teams to make sure great strategy becomes great work in market. 

  • Support strategy leads to create and drive experience strategies, programs and go-to-market plans that both inspire and drive business for our clients
  • Synthesize signals across data, culture, and category to provide teams a clear point of view – not just information, but interpretation and impact on what we need to do.
  • Develop clear, inspiring, evidence-based briefs, POVs, brand and program frameworks, and consumer journeys
  • Lead smaller strategy projects on assigned accounts, projects, and deliverables with minimal oversight
  • Acts as an inspirational and strategic catalyst for our cross-disciplined team of account management, creative, analytics, technology, and production
  • Build strong knowledge of the spirits industry and competitive landscape
  • Uses AI to accelerate research synthesis, pressure-test hypotheses and sharpen output quality – keeping human judgment at the forefront as a clear, defensible strategic point of view at the center of every recommendation.

 

Qualifications

  • 4+ years developing integrated brand strategies, with some experiential, events, shopper or retail-strategy (or equivalent) experience
  • Experience in the spirits/alcoholic beverage category preferred; experience in other beverage or CPG categories will also be considered
  • Acts as a catalyst to creative, media, data, account and other brand teams in finding new ways to add value to brand experiences and identifying future opportunities
  • Demonstrates the maturity and leadership to be a key player on a collaborative, multi-disciplinary cross-agency tea
  • Demonstrates proficiency in using and translating all types of data into insights that drive creative thinking and client growth
  • Proactively seeks out opportunities to make the work better in a collaborative way
  • Has a passion for solving problems and is comfortable using AI as a tool to work faster and sharpen thinking
  • Has built strong relationships with middle-level team members and clients, earning their trust and respect
  • Demonstrates and fosters a collaborative spirit and way of working so ideas can flourish

 

Joining Our Creative Community

We aspire to be the most integrated network in the world for a lot of reasons. A big one is to make sure people always have your back. We don’t want talent to be islands at Dentsu Creative. We want this to be the place where you can do the work of your life while having a life. This means offering an inclusive culture that embraces individual ways of working - a culture that values compensating employees for their contributions in a multitude of ways. For everything we ask of our people to do right by our clients and creative standards, we commit to giving back equally in investing in your unique career aspirations and learning and development needs. Seeing and celebrating our people is where we find joy. When you are a part of our creative network, you get an all-access pass to our global playground. There’s a purposeful, flexible infrastructure for you to jump toward initiatives that excite you in partnership with specialists in entertainment, experience, data, earned attention and more. Your voice and unique lived experience are beyond valued. We want you to be loud, raise your hand and leave your imprint on how we continue building our creative culture while shaping what the very future of creativity can be. So, why not choose your own adventure? Let us be your springboard

job.title: Senior Strategist, Social Marketing & Strategy
job.description:
Job Description:

We're looking for a Senior Strategist, Social Marketing & Strategy to join our team. In this role, you'll report to the Group Director, Social Marketing & Strategy and serve as the strategic lead for a leading outdoor-focused CPG snack brand. This is a highly visible opportunity for someone who thrives at the intersection of social strategy, content planning, creative development, and client leadership. 

 

As the primary strategic contact for the business, you'll help shape how content moves across owned, earned, and paid channels while partnering closely with clients, creative teams, media partners, and agency stakeholders. You'll act as both a strategic storyteller and content curator, ensuring every piece of content reaches the right audience in the right place. 

 

What You'll Do 

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day strategic contact for the client and build strong relationships across client and agency teams. 
  • Develop social and content strategies that connect business objectives, audience insights, and creative opportunities. 
  • Lead internal and client-facing meetings, presenting recommendations and strategic POVs with confidence. 
  • Partner with creative teams to ensure ideas are rooted in insight and aligned to the overall strategy. 
  • Translate social, cultural, category, and consumer trends into actionable recommendations and creative inspiration. 
  • Create and refine creative briefs, content frameworks, and strategic recommendations. 
  • Act as a content steward across channels, evaluating where content should live and how it should be activated across owned and paid environments. 
  • Oversee a high-volume content ecosystem, helping prioritize and optimize approximately 40 pieces of content per month from multiple stakeholders and content sources. 
  • Function as an "editor-in-chief" for the business, ensuring content is relevant, effective, and aligned with brand objectives. 
  • Collaborate with media, analytics, creative, and production teams to maximize the impact of content investments. 
  • Work cross-functionally with multiple agency partners and stakeholders, providing strategic input on briefs and initiatives that impact the broader marketing ecosystem. 
  • Identify emerging social platforms, content formats, cultural trends, and consumer behaviors that can create competitive advantage for the brand. 
  • Contribute thought leadership and help solve complex business and marketing challenges. 
  • Mentor and support junior team members while helping foster a collaborative team environment. 

 

What You'll Bring 

  • 6 years minimum experience in strategy, social marketing, content strategy, digital marketing, or a related field. 
  • Passion for the outdoors and outdoor lifestyles, and/or experience working on outdoor, active lifestyle, food and beverage, or CPG brands. 
  • Experience within an advertising, marketing, media, or creative agency environment. 
  • Experience serving as a primary client contact and managing day-to-day client relationships. 
  • Strong understanding of social platforms, content ecosystems, and channel strategy. 
  • Experience developing strategic and creative briefs grounded in consumer insights. 
  • Ability to synthesize data, trends, and cultural insights into compelling strategic recommendations. 
  • Experience collaborating across multiple agency partners and disciplines. 
  • Experience mentoring, managing, or coaching team members. 
  • Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 

 

Additional Information 

At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Dentsu may designate other Hub offices at any time. Those who live outside a commutable range may be designated as remote, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect our employees to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office.  

 

The annual salary range for this position is $94,875 - $115,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.  

Benefits available with this position include:  

  • Medical, vision, and dental insurance, 
  • Life insurance,  
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance, 
  • 401k, 
  • Flexible paid time off, 
  • At least 15 paid holidays per year, 
  • Paid sick and safe leave, and 
  • Paid parental leave. 

 

Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies.  For further details regarding Dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com.

Job Summary

Job Requirements Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. We’re seeking a Director of Product Software Engineering who will lead our Core Browse team in the Streaming Front-End team responsible for the Disney+ and Hulu homepage experience. The Browse team is responsible for building the experiences that help guide our users to their favorite content on Disney+ and Hulu. The Director of Core Browse is accountable for the

experience

across all client platforms on Mobile, Living Room, and Web. The right person for this role is highly motivated, collaborative, and technical, with the ability to coordinate across teams and empower both themselves and others in striving for and achieving excellence.

Responsibilities

Direct and oversee multiple teams through managers and technical leads: accountable for performance, operations, and outcomes. Ensure growth at every level and cultivate a future bench of leaders. Includes mentoring and coaching for the team and annual compensation planning. Drive vision and strategy for the Disney+ core browse

experience

across Mobile, Living Room, and Web. Own org-level OKR(s). Facilitate architectural decisions in collaboration with Principal engineers. Own significant cross-functional initiatives end-to-end: driving priorities through organizational dependencies, removing systemic bottlenecks, and ensuring nothing stalls waiting for someone else to act. Set technical direction across Mobile, Living Room, and Web ensuring shared platform investments in product excellence and reach for Browse. Build and maintain relationships across organizations and external partners, influencing business direction and ensuring engineering teams have the resources needed to deliver. Shape and operationalize engineering strategy: establishing performance standards, developing organizational policies, and embedding a culture of ownership across teams. Minimum

Qualifications

12+ years of engineering

experience

building consumer-scale applications, with deep expertise in either native Apple/Android development (Swift, Kotlin, Apple/Android frameworks) or modern web platforms (React, TypeScript/JavaScript) or Living Room devices (Roku, Samsung Tizen Smart TVs, LG webOS Smart TVs, and gaming consoles) with demonstrated fluency partnering with leaders in the other. Expertise in all 3 is preferred. 4+ years of

experience

leading engineering managers and building high-performing organizations across multiple teams.

Experience

partnering with senior stakeholders across Product, Design, and business leadership to define and drive a roadmap that balances business objectives with long-term engineering health.

Experience

with leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot), to improve software design, engineering productivity and system capabilities. Effective collaboration and communication skills, able to discuss technical topics clearly and engage in productive technical discussions. Track record of identifying and removing systemic organizational bottlenecks and championing engineering standards and best practices across multiple teams. Demonstrated ability to own and drive alliance-level OKRs, holding teams and stakeholders accountable for outcomes.

Experience

developing and implementing operational policies and engineering performance standards at an organizational scale. High emotional intelligence,

experience

maintaining composure under high-pressure situations and meeting tight deadlines. Strong project management skills, seeing projects through from inception to completion. Bachelor’s degree or better in Computer Science or a related technical field or equivalent job experience. job.title: Lead Data Analyst, Sports & ESPN Analytics — ESPN App Merchandising
job.company: Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Lead Data Analyst, Sports & ESPN Analytics — ESPN App Merchandising Job ID 10163179 Location New York, New York, United States / Santa Monica, California, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Nov. 20, 2026 Lead Data Analyst, Sports & ESPN Analytics — ESPN App Merchandising Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements The Disney DTC Sports & ESPN Analytics team is seeking a Lead Data Analyst who will be an exceptional addition to our team. You will be responsible for turning data into information, information into insights, and insights into key business decisions that steer the strategic direction of ESPN's content merchandising strategy. The right person for this role has exceptional analytical capabilities, thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves problem-solving, is a good communicator, and is passionate about high quality digital product experiences. You will play a key role in building out analytics capabilities for ESPN app merchandising, establishing foundational data assets and then leveraging them to answer critical business questions around impression efficiency, content placement, and how the product

experience

drives user behavior. This is a build-it-first role. The foundational data assets for merchandising analytics do not exist yet in a usable form, and you will be hired to lay them — establishing the connections across datasets, owning the analytics-side validation, and earning the organization's trust in the numbers that result. It requires someone who is comfortable operating well ahead of a settled data landscape and who can set direction for partner teams they do not manage. You will deliver impactful insights to both strategy teams and operational decision-makers by telling powerful stories with data, shaping how content is surfaced and promoted across the ESPN app.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead cross-functional initiatives across the ESPN and Product & Technology organizations to deliver actionable merchandising insights Establish the analytics foundation for impression-level merchandising data — scope what the merchandising dataset can and cannot support, define the analytics use cases, and partner with Data Product to land it alongside our source-of-truth subscriber and engagement data Solve the identity and session-stitching problem that currently prevents merchandising, engagement, and subscriber data from being analyzed together, and serve as the analytics-side owner of definitions and data quality for that space Build frameworks to address complex merchandising challenges such as impression efficiency, content placement, carousel and surface performance, and the impact of content over-exposure Own experimentation for merchandising surfaces end-to-end — translating a placement or promotion question into a testable hypothesis, selecting primary and guardrail metrics, sizing and powering the test, validating assignment and exposure, analyzing the readout, and diagnosing what happened when a test misbehaves or reads flat Analyze cross-source behavioral trends to uncover key engagement drivers, connecting the product

experience

directly to business health and subscriber metrics Partner with Research, Product, and Marketing to refine performance metrics and data storytelling related to the ESPN watch

experience

Navigate platform-level instrumentation differences (mobile, web, and connected TV surfaces log merchandising events inconsistently) and establish conformed reporting that holds up across them Use SQL, Python, and advanced analytics to connect datasets, operationalize metrics, inform strategy, and drive value BASIC

QUALIFICATIONS

Degree in an analytical area such as Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Economics, or equivalent practical

experience

7+ years of relevant work

experience

in analytics and/or business intelligence Advanced SQL — able to read and write complex analytical queries across large behavioral datasets Working proficiency in Python for data manipulation, exploratory analysis, and statistical work Hands-on product experimentation

experience

— designing and executing A/B and multivariate tests, analyzing results (significance, confidence intervals, minimum detectable effect, guardrail metrics), and diagnosing common failure modes such as sample ratio mismatch, assignment or exposure leakage, interaction effects, and novelty decay Practical understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling, including joining datasets across systems that do not share conformed keys Demonstrated

experience

establishing a new analytics capability or dataset from an unvalidated source — exploratory profiling, defining metrics, and building stakeholder trust in the numbers

Experience

setting experimentation standards for a product organization — raising the quality of how tests are designed and interpreted by teams you do not manage

Experience

with data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, or equivalent) coupled with strong storytelling skills for technical and non-technical audiences

Experience

taking vague requirements and manipulating them into polished final products Strong and effective communication and presentation skills, including the ability to influence partner teams you do not manage

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Hands-on

experience

with impression, merchandising, or recommendation-surface data and metrics such as impression-to-click and surface-level engagement rates

Experience

with digital clickstream analytics (Adobe Analytics, Amplitude, or similar) and its identity and measurement limitations

Experience

with identity resolution or session stitching across web, app, and connected TV

Experience

with Databricks, PySpark, or comparable large-scale data processing

Experience

with an experimentation platform (Optimizely, Statsig, Amplitude Experiment, or in-house) and with quasi-experimental methods where a clean A/B test is not available Prior

experience

in Sports or Media/Entertainment #TECHATDISNEY Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in New York City, NY is $150,900 to $202,400 per year and in Santa Monica, CA is $144,100 to $193,200 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and

experience

among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs . We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. Apply Now Save Job About The Walt Disney Company: The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise that includes three core business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Experiences. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. job.title: Principal Product Software Engineer - Java
job.company: Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Principal Product Software Engineer - Java Job ID 10164971 Location Glendale, California, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Nov. 11, 2026 Principal Product Software Engineer - Java Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements On any given day at Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology, we’re reimagining ways to create magical viewing experiences for the world’s most beloved stories while also transforming Disney’s media business for the future. Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to maximize flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. The Product & Data Engineering team is responsible for end-to-end development for Disney’s world-class consumer-facing products, including streaming platforms Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN+, and digital products & experiences across ESPN, Marvel, Disney Studios, NatGeo, and ABC News. The team drives innovation at scale for millions of consumers around the world across Apple, Android, Smart TVs, game consoles, and the web, with our platforms powering core experiences like personalization, search, messaging and data. The ABC Core Content Technologies engineering team is looking for a Principal Product Software Engineer who is passionate about setting technical direction for high-scale content platforms and multiplying the impact of engineers across the organization. As a Principal Engineer, you are a trusted member of the technical leadership of the organization. You build and set the architectural direction for the systems that provide dynamic content management for many of Disney Entertainment’s brands – including ABC Entertainment, ABC News, ABC OTV, Disney, Marvel, National Geographic, and Studios – as well as content ingestion from many internal and 3rd party sources, publishing pipelines, and complex image services. You operate in highly ambiguous and significantly complex problem spaces that have long-term impact on our brands, products, technology, and architecture. You are recognized as an expert across multiple specialties. You influence business and technology direction, bringing industry context to technical decisions, and setting the standard for engineering excellence across the organization. As a hands-on technical leader, you split your time between coding, design, and architecture based on where your skills will have the greatest impact – personally writing critical-path code, deconstructing architectures so multiple teams can execute independently, and aligning those teams toward simple, coherent designs. On a daily basis you should bring: A track record of driving clarity and simplicity in the face of significant ambiguity and complexity. A force-multiplier mindset – amplifying the impact of teams across the organization through design reviews, mentorship, and technical strategy. Deep ownership of the products and platforms your organization delivers. A pragmatic approach to balancing trade-offs between opportunity and architectural complexity. A passion for keeping abreast of industry trends and benchmarking our technology against the best in the industry. Kindness, pragmatic optimism, and your unique view and experience.

Responsibilities

Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of software in highly ambiguous and significantly complex problem spaces that have long-term impact on our products, technology, and architecture. Heavily influence the design and personally write a significant portion of critical-path code, making the right trade-offs between opportunity and architectural complexity. Deconstruct large architectures into components that can be developed independently by multiple teams, then align those teams toward simple, coherent designs that come together into an integrated whole. Lead strategically important projects that span multiple teams. Acquire a deep understanding of our business processes, dependent systems, and teams, and develop professional relationships with key stakeholders — including business users, product managers, designers, and other Principal Engineers both inside and outside of our organization — to inform technical strategy and drive alignment. Set the standard for engineering excellence across the organization – producing designs, algorithms, and implementations that are exemplary in terms of robustness, scalability, cost-effectiveness, and simplicity – and drive best practices across the organization, including driving the adoption of AI-assisted engineering tooling and demonstrating a strong commitment to the productivity and quality gains these tools and models deliver. Amplify your impact as a force multiplier: lead design reviews for complex projects, probe assumptions, illuminate pitfalls, foster shared understanding, handle escalations, and mitigate complexity risks. Bring business and industry context to technology decisions and influence business and technology direction. Actively develop and mentor engineers across and beyond your organization, keep the engineering community current on trends and technologies, participate in hiring, and perform promotion assessments to support the career growth of others. Additional Expectations: Promote and reinforce engineering best practices — design patterns, code review, and automated testing — and drive their adoption across the organization Mentor engineers within and beyond your squad, and educate the broader engineering community on advanced technical issues, technologies, and trends Lead and reinforce a high level of operational excellence for the systems underpinning applications used by millions of fans every day Solicit differing views, build consensus, and be willing to change your mind as you learn more Participate in hiring and interviewing, and perform promotion assessments to support the career growth of others Champion the adoption of AI-assisted development tools, models, and workflows, demonstrating a personal commitment to them and helping the broader team realize measurable productivity and quality gains Minimum

Qualifications

10+ years of

experience

building large-scale, highly available distributed services. Expert-level programming skills in Java or a similar object-oriented language, with strong computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, databases, etc.). Proven track record designing backend architectures that span multiple teams and driving consensus on them.

Experience

building and operating message-based, distributed systems, including caching strategies.

Experience

mentoring engineers and setting technical direction beyond a single team.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience

working on highly scalable, real-time content or data platforms serving millions of consumers. Extensive

experience

with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or a similar cloud service, including Terraform and infrastructure as code (IaC) practices.

Experience

with event-driven messaging architectures (e.g., SQS, SNS) and both relational and non-relational database technologies (e.g., DynamoDB, OpenSearch). Contributions to intellectual property (e.g., patents), industry conferences, or a broader technical community. Keywords Location Search Jobs Product Software Engineer II Job ID 10164778 Location Glendale, California, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Nov. 20, 2026 Product Software Engineer II Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Content Platforms & Operations is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product & Technology with Disney’s EMEA, APAC, and LATAM regional business teams. Ever wonder how the innovative storytelling from the world’s most beloved brands – Star Wars, Marvel, Pixar, ESPN, 20th Century, National Geographic, FX, Freeform, Disney Channels, ABC, and more -- makes it to viewers around the globe and beyond (yes, we also deliver content to the International Space Station)? Come join our growing team that builds global products, platforms and tools that deliver and monetize our company's unmatched collection of content, power our businesses and reflect the company's innovative spirit. If you: Enjoy working with teams of talented and passionate people Have excellent communication skills Demonstrate determination in finding solutions to complex puzzles Have the curiosity and interests in how content goes from inception to consumers Employ positive thinking and can work constructively in a diverse team setting Enjoy transforming business strategy into innovative products & platforms Value learning and being exposed to new experiences Love working in a startup culture Find Media & Entertainment industry fascinating then Content Platforms team is the place for you. We are growing and investing in innovative technology to deliver a state-of-the-art content pipeline . Come be a part of the magic that makes The Walt Disney Company one of the “World’s Most Admired Companies” .

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Product Software Engineer II to join our Content Platform Engineering team, focusing on building and enhancing platform capabilities with a strong emphasis on enhancing and supporting our existing Screening & Marketing platform and workflows. Our team develops and manages a diverse suite of products and services that power Disney’s media supply chain, enabling content delivery, screening and marketing for iconic brands like Disney+, ESPN+, Hulu, ABC, Marvel, and Star Wars. In this role, you will be expected to design, develop backend and frontend solutions in a dynamic, rapidly changing environment using your technical skill sets, working with product managers and team leads to deliver high quality products that are scalable and robust. You will be expected to work closely on solutions with peers in a cross-functional environment to ensure we are delivering products that align to the larger business initiatives within the digital media supply chain that support Disney’s TV, broadcast, theatrical, and direct –to-consumer lines of business.

Responsibilities

Write and Maintain Software Solutions : Design, write, test, and deploy high-quality code to develop reliable, maintainable software solutions. Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams : Work closely with platform engineers, product teams, and stakeholders to ensure technical solutions effectively support business goals and content strategies. Production Support : Monitor and optimize production systems, ensuring platform stability, performance, and uptime. Minimum

Qualifications

3+ years relevant industry

experience

Experience

building backend services with Kotlin/Java, Spring Boot, C#, .Net and NodeJS (TypeScript preferred) programming

Experience

working with REST APIs for building and consuming web services.

Experience

with cloud native technologies such as Azure Web apps, Azure Functions, AWS EC2, Fargate, and CloudFront

Experience

with frontend web development technologies and principles such as Angular and React

Experience

with a wide range of data store technologies such as SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, and DynamoDB

Experience

with event streaming and messaging systems (e.g., Service Bus, Kafka, SNS/SQS)

Experience

with build and deployment technologies such as Docker, Gitlab-CI, and Cloud formation Expertise with full lifecycle of application development, including best practices of unit testing, code reviews, documentation, etc Exposure to building and integrating AI driven solutions into production systems Solid understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures. Ability to research, learn, assess, and evangelize new technologies

Experience

in Agile/Scrum methodology Team player with strong communications skills and attention to detail Bachelor’s degree in computer science or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to large scale production systems with complex backends and integrations

Experience

with Event based processing for asynchronous workflow management Exposure to iOS, tvOS and Android mobile application development Previous work

experience

in media or entertainment technology, particularly in content distribution and media supply chain. job.title: Sr Data Engineer
job.company: Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Sr Data Engineer Job ID 10165147 Location Glendale, California, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Nov. 13, 2026 Sr Data Engineer Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. News & Entertainment Machine Learning (N&E ML) team is responsible for building robust data pipelines and advanced machine learning platforms that deliver personalized experiences to users across Disney's News & Entertainment portfolio including ABC News, ABC Entertainment, National Geographic, Marvel, and Disney Studios. Our services leverage machine learning models to enable real-time content personalization and targeted distribution across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms, ensuring that users receive the most relevant and engaging content tailored to their interests. Our mission is to drive seamless, resilient, and low-latency personalized content delivery at scale, while continuously advancing our ML infrastructure and recommendation algorithms across one of the world's most iconic collections of entertainment brands.

Responsibilities

Build and manage data pipelines to extract, clean, and format training datasets Maintain and optimize the performance of data pipelines Enhance/redesign existing data models with input from Architecture in order to modernize products and/or improve performance and efficiency, and decrease costs. Promote and support Agile methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, and Scrumban by actively participating in regular ceremonies such as stand-up, retrospectives and sprint planning. Collaborate with your squad, Product Managers, Designers, QA, Operations, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and articulate technical decisions and outcomes. Participate in on-call support Participate in code reviews and problem-solving. Basic

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience. 5+ years of related big data engineering

experience

modeling and developing large data pipelines Hands-on

experience

with distributed systems such as Databricks compute using tools/libraries such as Spark, Presto, Hive to query and process large datasets at the petabyte level. Strong Python, PySpark and SQL skills processing big datasets

Experience

with at least one major MPP or cloud database technology (Snowflake, Redshift, Big Query, Databricks) Familiarity with Data Modeling techniques and Data Warehousing standard methodologies and practices Operational

experience

in multi-system/services production environment as point-of-contact / SME Problem solving skills with strong attention to detail and excellent analytical and communication skills Solid

experience

with data integration and orchestration toolsets (e.g. Airflow), CI/CD Solid

experience

with AWS/AWS Glue Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Glendale, CA is $ $144,100 - $193,200 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and

experience

among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered on the level and position offered. This position is with Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs . We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. Apply Now Save Job About The Walt Disney Company: The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise that includes three core business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Experiences. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. Hiring Process Where Does Your Story Begin? Explore Disney Careers and the Life at Disney blog to learn about all the amazing opportunities waiting to be discovered at The Walt Disney Company. Be Part of the Story There are many different brands and businesses to explore. Once you've found the opportunity that is right for you, take the next step by completing your application. The Next Chapter Once you've applied, you will receive an email allowing you to access your candidate dashboard. Create your login and make sure to check your dashboard often to see your application progress. Keywords Location Search Jobs Sr Product Software Engineer Job ID 10162985 Location Santa Monica, California, United States / New York, New York, United States Business Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Date posted Nov. 20, 2026 Sr Product Software Engineer Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. The Growth, Commerce & Identity (GCI) organization is dedicated to three business-critical areas at Disney that will help transform its media business. We build innovative and cutting-edge capabilities to drive subscriptions, engagement, and monetization across Disney's streaming and digital products. We enable the wide range of Disney brands to connect and engage with consumers through a unified identity, powered by shared services that are trustworthy and seamless to integrate with. We deliver experiences across Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+, and Star+ built on a common platform and shared technology. We are fast-paced and fast-growing organization that shares knowledge and code for initiatives throughout Disney! Our mission: Building inclusive user-centered experiences that welcome users, guiding them through a seamless journey from login to sign up, and facilitating effortless account management.

Responsibilities

Serves as a high level technical resource and “go-to” person, solving sophisticated technical challenges and finding opportunities to improve systems, products, and services. Collaborates closely with product and project management to translate requirements into technical specifications and timelines while partnering with other engineering teams to deliver best solutions. Leads by example to write, maintain, and enforce code quality through test driven development. Contributes to project needs and the evolution of the team's practices; recommending changes in development, coding, maintenance and system standards. Efficiently supports software throughout the lifecycle. Adds new implementations and technical maintenance while maintaining clear documentation. Applies experiences and exercises judgment in selecting methods and techniques to identify, resolve, and develop solutions to a variety of complex tasks involving architectural application changes. Supports and mentors developers through code reviews, knowledge-sharing, and technical leadership. Reviews code and pull requests to ensure product and design specifications are met. Basic

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent work experience. 5+ years

experience

building highly scalable and performant modern Javascript/Typescript web applications. Writes well-documented, clear, and robust code. Proven track record to integrate api specifications while collaborating with service teams. Highly diligent with the ability to see projects from beginning to end; designing workflows and completing tasks. Exhibits emotional intelligence, supervising oneself under high pressure situations and meets urgent timelines. Ability to support and mentor other developers by building trust, encouraging, instructing, and providing constructive feedback.

Preferred Qualifications

Shipped production level React/Node.js application with high availability and throughput deployed to cloud platforms (e.g. AWS). Solid understanding of web accessibility fundamentals. Strong knowledge to web standards and new technologies. #DISNEYTECH Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Santa Monica, CA is $144,100 - $193,200 and in New York, NY, $150,900 - $202,400 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and

experience

among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished.
