job.title: SVP, Data Operations
job.description:
Job Title

SVP, Data Operations

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

We are seeking a Senior Vice President of Data Operations to lead the strategy, architecture, and execution of our enterprise-wide data infrastructure. As a data-first media company operating at petabyte scale, data is the connective tissue across our editorial, product, advertising, and audience development functions. This is a defining leadership role for someone who can operate at the intersection of deep technical excellence and enterprise strategy — architecting the systems that power how we understand our content, our audiences, and our business.


The SVP of Data Operations will own the full data stack: from ingestion pipelines and data warehousing to real-time streaming, ML/AI platform capabilities, and the governance frameworks that ensure our data is trusted, accessible, and compliant.

Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team

People Inc. is a leading digital media company reaching millions of consumers across a diverse portfolio of iconic brands. Our content informs, entertains, and shapes culture and increasingly, data, at multi-petabyte scale, is the engine behind how we create, distribute, and monetize that content. Operating in a real-time, multi-platform ecosystem, we rely on data to understand audience behavior, optimize content performance, power advertising solutions, and unlock new revenue streams. The SVP of Data Platform will build and lead a high-performing team, partnering closely with Engineering, Data Science, Ad Tech, Research, Product, Editorial, Revenue, Business, and Marketing leadership, serving as the company's foremost authority on all things data.

About The Positions Contributions:

Strategy & Vision

  • Define and execute a multi-year data platform strategy, aligned to company-wide goals across content, audience, advertising, and product.

  • Serve as the executive voice of data — advising the CTO and C-suite on data architecture decisions, investments, and organizational structure, influencing how the company measures success. 

  • Translate complex data capabilities into clear business value for non-technical stakeholders.

  •  Establish a data-first culture across the organization, advocating for data literacy, democratization, and responsible use.

  • Lead exploration and strategy around the foundational data products required to support use in both internal and external AI applications 

Platform Architecture & Engineering

  • Architect and oversee a petabyte-scale data platform spanning batch and real-time ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers.

  • Drive the evolution of our data warehouse/lakehouse strategy (e.g., BigQuery,  Snowflake, DBT) and ensure the platform is built for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency at scale.

  • Lead adoption of emerging data and AI technologies.

  • Ensure the platform is designed for both technical and self-serve users, enabling analysts, data scientists, and product, and all other teams which use data to move quickly and independently.

  • Own data pipeline architecture across streaming (e.g., Kafka, Pub/Sub) and batch frameworks, ensuring low-latency data delivery at scale.

Data Governance, Quality & Compliance

  • Establish enterprise data governance standards including ownership, lineage, cataloging, and data quality SLAs.

  • Define and enforce data privacy and compliance frameworks (GDPR, CCPA, and evolving state regulations), working in close partnership with Privacy, Legal, and Security.

  • Build a trusted data foundation — ensuring every downstream team operates from a single, authoritative source of truth.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing data organization including Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, and Analytics Engineering functions.

  • Recruit and develop senior technical talent; build a team culture defined by ownership, craft, and continuous learning.

  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and Data Science leadership to align roadmaps and ensure data capabilities are tightly coupled to company priorities.

  • Define team structures, operating models, and performance metrics that scale with business growth.

AI & Advanced Analytics Enablement

  • Drive the company's data infrastructure readiness for generative AI and ML applications — including model training pipelines, embedding stores, and experiment tracking.

  • Partner with Product and Editorial teams to identify opportunities where advanced analytics and AI can create measurable impact.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Education:

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field is required; a Master's or PhD is a plus.

  • Experience:

    • 15+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data platform architecture, or analytics infrastructure.

    • At least 5 years of experience in a senior leadership role.

    • Proven track record designing and scaling petabyte-level data platforms in a high-traffic, data-intensive industry (preferably media, e-commerce, fintech, or similar).

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Deep expertise across the modern data stack: data lakes/lakehouses, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift), stream processing (Kafka, Flink, Dataflow), and orchestration (Airflow, Dagster).

  • Strong command of cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) and experience managing large-scale distributed systems at production quality.

  • Experience establishing data governance programs, metadata management, and data quality frameworks at enterprise scale.

  • Strategic mindset: comfortable defining a 3-year roadmap and equally comfortable making pragmatic architectural trade-offs in the near term.

  • Exceptional communication and executive presence—ability to speak fluently with engineers and senior management alike.

  • Experience in digital media, content platforms, or advertising technology is strongly preferred.

Why Join Us?

  • Own and directly impact the data foundation of one of the largest digital media companies in the world — at petabyte scale, with real business impact.
  • Partner with a technically sophisticated leadership team that views data as a first-class strategic asset.
  • Shape how AI and advanced analytics transform the future of media, content, and audience intelligence.
  • Lead a talented, mission-driven data organization with the resources and mandate to build something exceptional.
  • Be part of a people-first culture with a strong commitment to craft, innovation, and continuous growth.

job.description:
Job Title

UX Design Lead, MyRecipes

Job Description

People Inc. is the largest digital and print publisher in America. From mobile to magazines, nearly 200 million people trust us to help them make decisions, take action, and find inspiration. People Inc. has more than 40 iconic brands, including PEOPLE, Entertainment Weekly, Better Homes & Gardens, Food & Wine, Travel + Leisure, Allrecipes, InStyle,, REAL SIMPLE, and Southern Living. We are building engaging experiences that excite users and amplify the voices of our brands.


We are looking for a User Experience Design Lead to help define experiences for our engaging food sites and utilities, Allrecipes and MyRecipes. In this role you will craft engaging, functional, and elegant experience design solutions based on a deep and empathetic understanding of our user’s needs. You will partner closely with our Product and Engineering teams to quickly iterate on product definition and ship new features, quickly. Listening to users and gathering feedback from them will also be super important in this role. Experience with user research is highly desirable. 


In this role you must be collaborative in your approach to internal stakeholders, while simultaneously and vigorously championing the consumer experience. 


As a UX Design Lead  at People Inc. you will be responsible for collaborating on user research, translating business requirements into concrete ideas, and refining and iterating on those ideas for delivering to engineering teams. You will help design the overall functionality of our products and iterate upon it to ensure a great user experience.


To be successful in this role, we'd expect you to: 

  • Thoroughly understand the wants and needs of our users. 
  • Translate user needs and business requirements into concrete ideas, wireframes, and mockups.
  • Build interactive prototypes suitable for validating design decisions with users.
  • Apply creative problem solving to the design, processes, and tooling of the system itself. 
  • Document design guidelines, share knowledge, and collaborate with the engineering team to ensure products ship on time and as designed. 
  • Help lead our efforts to build accessible digital products (A11y and WCAG), building awareness, and accountability across the rest of our product organization

Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

II. Essential Job Functions


Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results


60%

User Experience Design

  • Use business requirements, user stories, and data to produce user flows, wireframes, prototypes, high fidelity mockups, and rigorous user interface specifications

30%

Collaborate with Design and Product teams

  • Partner with UX researchers to validate assumptions, test designs, and understand user data
  • Present design solutions and build consensus among a broad range of stakeholders
  • Participate in and lead brainstorming and critique sessions that foster big-picture thinking while identifying opportunities to raise the bar on the details

10%

Process Management

  • Collaborate with broader UX Team to develop and implement best practices



III. Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements | All must be met to be considered.


Education: 

Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent education and experience

Experience: 

  • 4-7 years as a UX Designer for mass-market Web and Mobile products

Specific Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: 

  • Strong user experience skills including user research, usability testing, and interaction design
  • Experience designing, planning, and building interactive prototypes suitable for validating design decisions with users
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Familiarity with atomic design methodology and an interest in the challenges that come with building and maintaining design systems
  • Expertise in UX software such as Figma. Basic HTML and CSS skills are a big plus
  • A solid grasp of user-centered design and testing methodologies, subsystems, and usability and accessibility concerns
  • Be excited about collaborating and communicating closely with teams and stakeholders distributed across the country

job.title: Workflow Engineer, 1
job.description:
Job Title

Workflow Engineer, 1

Job Description

AI Workflow & Automation Engineering

  • Prototype and productionize new AI-driven automations.

  • Design and implement Slack features including slash commands, message actions, interactive modals, triage flows, and user-friendly bot behaviors.

  • Develop frameworks, templates, and reusable automation components to accelerate future workflow builds — both for code-first builds and for our low-code stack (n8n, Zapier, Google Workspace Studio).

  • Raise concerns when a proposed approach has technical risk, and help shape a better path forward.

Retrieval, Data Pipelines & AI Quality

  • Build and refine retrieval pipelines, vector stores, data-sync workflows, hashing/diffing systems, and content preprocessing pipelines.

  • Implement structured outputs, evaluation loops, hallucination prevention methods, and AI quality assurance systems.

  • Maintain and improve RAG pipelines using content from Confluence, Google Sheets, Jira, Slack logs, and other internal knowledge sources.

Backend, Reliability & Production Readiness

  • Build and maintain backend services, REST APIs, and serverless orchestrators powering our internal automation platforms.

  • Implement logging, monitoring, retry logic, structured error handling, and observability to keep our automations production-grade.

  • Contribute to CI/CD workflows, testing practices, and version-controlled deployment patterns.

Cross-Team Enablement & Expansion

  • Partner with teams across People Inc. to identify processes that can benefit from intelligent automation or AI augmentation.

  • Translate business needs into reliable automated workflows and internal tools.

  • Contribute to documentation, change management procedures, and the overall evolution of People Inc.'s internal AI platform.

  • Take initiative to propose new AI-enabled enhancements, systems, or assistants the organization has not yet defined.

What You'll Likely Work On in Your First 6 Months

  • Dottie as a service: help extract Dottie (our L1 tech support triage agent) from the existing in-process #it-techsupport implementation into a standalone API, define quality metrics, and onboard at least one new consuming surface.

  • Reusable build patterns: turn our "Slack workflow + AI matcher + Apps Script" pattern into proper templates with example code, intake forms, and stakeholder-facing docs so future builds ship faster.

  • Stack-level upgrades: identify where our current Sheets-based audit logs, Apps Script glue, and ad-hoc retrieval should graduate to more durable infrastructure, and help drive the migration where it makes sense.

Required Skills

Background

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful exposure to AI/LLM-based systems.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

Core Engineering

  • Solid experience with Python and JavaScript; comfort working in Apps Script, or willingness to become fluent.

  • Comfort with REST APIs, webhooks, and event-driven integrations.

  • Experience building and shipping services that have run in production.

AI & LLM

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, OpenAI APIs, embeddings, retrieval pipelines (RAG), and prompt engineering.

  • Familiarity with data normalization, indexing, content segmentation, and retrieval basics.

Cloud & Systems

  • Experience with Google Cloud, particularly Cloud Functions (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, IAM a plus).

  • Experience building on Slack via the SDK, Bolt, or Events API, including interactive UI components.

  • Experience integrating with Jira and similar APIs.

Preferred Skills (Not Required)

  • Experience with low-code or iPaaS tools (n8n, Zapier, Make) used alongside code.

  • Background in agentic workflows or LangChain.

  • Exposure to observability tools and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience designing systems with reliability and a real user-experience focus.

  • Experience operating internal tools — running them, watching usage, iterating — not just building them.

  • Knowledge of Confluence APIs, content hashing, or knowledge retrieval.

  • Experience containerizing AI workloads (Docker) or working with vector databases.

Who Thrives in This Role

  • Engineers who think in systems, not isolated tasks.

  • Builders who enjoy being a strong technical contributor on a small team and want their work to ship and get used.

  • Developers who care about reliability, uptime, and high-quality user experience.

  • Technologists who stay curious about emerging AI advancements and adopt them responsibly.

  • Problem-solvers energized by complex, cross-functional technical challenges.

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, journalism, communications, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications:

You'll combine traditional media relations expertise, business and financial communications fluency, and ownership of complex client accounts.

Who You Are

You're an experienced corporate communications professional who combines strategic counsel with hands-on media relations and independently manages complex client relationships.


You're comfortable with forecasting, staff planning, resourcing and integrated thinking across multiple workstreams.


You demonstrate strong business judgment, understand client business objectives and reputational challenges, and know when to independently drive decisions versus escalate complex issues to senior leaders.


What You'll Do

  • Lead corporate reputation programs for complex clients and develop communications strategies that strengthen stakeholder trust and support business objectives.
  • Drive traditional media relations and earned media strategies, including proactive pitching, journalist relationships, executive profiling and thought leadership.
  • Own day-to-day client relationships, anticipate needs, provide informed strategic counsel and influence client decision-making through proactive, business-focused recommendations.
  • Oversee account operations, including forecasting, budgeting, staff planning, resourcing, scopes of work and overall account financial health.
  • Drive multiple workstreams and coordinate integrated teams, balancing client priorities while ensuring high-quality delivery.
  • Translate complex corporate, economic and financial issues into clear, compelling narratives across relevant communications channels.
  • Guide and mentor junior colleagues, providing direction and feedback while collaborating across creative, digital, social and insights disciplines.
  • Identify opportunities for organic account growth, contribute to new business initiatives and support the development of integrated communications strategies that drive client impact.

What We're Looking For

  • 5–7 years of experience in public relations, corporate communications or reputation management, with a strong foundation in traditional corporate PR and knowledge of the Canadian media landscape.
  • Demonstrated hands-on media relations experience, including pitching journalists, building media relationships and developing earned media strategies for corporate audiences.
  • Strong understanding of business, economic and financial communications, including relevant corporate issues and business media. Experience supporting banking, insurance, fintech, wealth or asset management clients is a strong asset.
  • Practical experience managing the financial and operational aspects of PR accounts, including forecasting, budgeting, staff planning, resourcing, scopes of work and account financial health.
  • Experience leading complex client accounts and driving multiple workstreams, teams and competing priorities while maintaining high standards of quality.
  • Ability to independently manage day-to-day client relationships, anticipate needs, provide strategic counsel and take ownership of client outcomes with minimal oversight.
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills, including translating complex business and reputational issues into clear narratives and developing audience-focused, integrated, earned-first communications strategies.
  • A collaborative and inclusive approach, with experience guiding junior colleagues and partnering across disciplines. Experience in public affairs, government communications, crisis communications or investor relations is an asset.

A bachelor's degree in communications, public relations, journalism, business or another relevant field is preferred.


Why Join Edelman?

At Edelman, you'll have the opportunity to work on high-profile, complex client accounts, take meaningful ownership of client relationships and contribute to communications programs that help organizations build trust.


You'll collaborate with colleagues across disciplines, develop your strategic and commercial capabilities, and contribute to impactful work within a global communications firm.


Our work is guided by four core values:

  • Relentless Pursuit of Excellence
  • Courage to Do the Right Thing
  • Freedom to Be Constantly Curious
  • The Commitment to Positively Impact Society

We value different perspectives, collaboration and curiosity, and believe they make our teams and our work stronger.


Pay Range: $70,000–$85,000 CAD/year.

The role requires strong execution capabilities, proactive project coordination, and the ability to independently manage assigned tasks and workstreams while meeting Edelman Standards and client expectations.
  • S/he demonstrates a solid understanding of integrated Communications Marketing principles, with hands-on experience in media relations, content development, social media communications, influencer engagement, and online community activation. S/he is able to adapt key messages and communications content across different channels to ensure consistency and relevance to target audiences.
  • This role requires the ability to translate communications plans into effective execution, proactively identify opportunities and challenges, and collaborate closely with clients, internal teams, and external partners to deliver impactful integrated communications activities that support client objectives.

RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Integrated Communications Execution

  • Demonstrates a solid understanding of integrated Communications Marketing principles and how PR, social media, influencer engagement, and digital communications work together to achieve client objectives.
  • Supports the implementation of integrated communications plans, translating approved strategies and directions into actionable activities across relevant channels.
  • Coordinates the execution of communications activities across PR and social channels, ensuring consistent messaging, quality, and timely delivery.
  • Contributes ideas, relevant trends, and tactical recommendations to enhance campaign execution and audience engagement.
  • Proactively identifies execution challenges and opportunities, recommending practical solutions to the account team.

2. PR & Media Relations

  • Executes day-to-day PR activities, including media outreach, press release distribution, media pitching, interviews, press events, and other earned media initiatives.

  • Coordinates media engagement activities, including interviews, press conferences, media events, and other outreach programs.
  • Monitors media coverage and supports the evaluation of PR activities, identifying key highlights and areas for improvement.

3. Social Media & Influencer Communications

  • Executes social communications activities in line with approved campaign directions, ensuring content relevance, consistency, and alignment with brand objectives.
  • Develops social content angles, editorial calendars, content briefs, captions, and other channel-appropriate communications materials.
  • Demonstrates a good understanding of social media platforms, audience behaviors, content formats, and emerging trends within the Vietnamese digital landscape.
  • Coordinates influencer/KOL/KOC and online community engagement activities, including influencer research, selection recommendations, briefing, content review, and execution follow-up.
  • Works closely with creative, content, digital, and external production teams to ensure the quality and timely delivery of social communications materials.
  • Monitors social conversations, content performance, and audience engagement to identify relevant insights and tactical optimization opportunities.

4. Account & Project Management

  • Independently manages assigned tasks and workstreams, ensuring timely delivery, attention to detail, and adherence to client requirements and Edelman Standards.
  • Supports day-to-day client communications, including status updates, meeting notes, activity reports, and follow-ups on assigned deliverables.
  • Coordinates effectively with internal teams, media, influencers, vendors, and external partners to ensure smooth campaign execution.
  • Maintains project timelines, tracks deliverables, and proactively flags potential risks or issues to the account manager.
  • Supports the preparation of client presentations, campaign proposals, status reports, and other account-related materials.
  • Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and a solution-oriented approach in managing daily responsibilities.

5. Research, Monitoring & Reporting

  • Conducts desk research on industry developments, competitors, consumer trends, media landscapes, and social conversations to support communications activities.
  • Monitors media coverage, social conversations, and campaign performance across relevant channels.
  • Collects, consolidates, and analyzes campaign results using relevant PR and social performance metrics.
  • Prepares activity reports and post-campaign reports with accurate data, key observations, and actionable learnings.
  • Identifies relevant insights and provides recommendations to improve ongoing campaign execution.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in PR, social media, or integrated communications, including a minimum of 1 year in a Senior Executive or equivalent role.
  • Previous experience in PR, communications, digital, or integrated marketing agency is an advantage.

Working closely with finance leadership, project managers, and account teams, you'll help ensure accurate financial reporting, effective budget management, and smooth financial operations.


You'll also have the opportunity to take ownership of client financial activities, build strong relationships with cross-functional teams, and grow your responsibilities over time.


If you enjoy combining hands-on financial operations with analytical thinking in a collaborative, fast-paced agency environment, we'd love to hear from you.


Who You Are

You're a proactive, detail-oriented finance professional who enjoys working closely with client-facing teams and understands how financial management contributes to the success of client accounts.


You're comfortable navigating project budgets, billing processes, revenue forecasts, and financial reporting while managing multiple priorities. You bring strong analytical and organizational skills, communicate financial information clearly, and take ownership of your work.


You thrive in a collaborative environment where accuracy, problem-solving, and building strong working relationships are essential.


What You'll Do

  • Partner with account teams and project managers to support the financial management of multiple client accounts, including project budgets, financial reporting, and profitability tracking.
  • Coordinate and manage client billing activities, ensuring accurate and timely invoicing, billing reviews, and resolution of discrepancies.
  • Prepare and maintain revenue forecasts based on client contracts, statements of work, project budgets, and billing activity.
  • Support monthly revenue recognition processes, including accruals, deferrals, reconciliations, and revenue tracking.
  • Monitor project financial performance, analyze budget-to-actual variances, and identify potential financial risks and opportunities.
  • Review and process financial documentation, including client contracts, statements of work, purchase orders, service orders, and project financial records.
  • Collaborate with finance leadership and account teams to provide financial guidance, support informed decisions, and maintain accurate client financial information.
  • Take ownership of assigned client financial activities, with opportunities to independently manage client accounts as you grow in the role.

Basic Qualifications

  • A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field and a minimum of two years of relevant finance or accounting experience; or at least four years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Experience in financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, or financial operations.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Client Finance, Commercial Finance, Project Finance, or financial operations, ideally within an advertising, public relations, communications, marketing, consulting, or professional services environment.
  • Hands-on experience with client billing, project budgets, revenue forecasting, reconciliations, and project profitability analysis.
  • Understanding of revenue recognition principles, including accruals, deferrals, and month-end financial processes.
  • Experience partnering with account teams, project managers, or client-facing stakeholders to manage project financial activities.
  • Ability to interpret financial information and communicate insights clearly to non-finance stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with financial systems such as Workday, Ariba, or Coupa is a plus.

Salary Range

$60,000–$80,000 Annual

An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, travel requirements, revenue-based metrics, any contractual agreements, and business or organizational needs. job.title: Senior Vice President, Strategy Director
job.description:
Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum.

At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.

Edelman is a trusted voice helping organizations earn trust through action. Through the Edelman Trust Barometer, the definitive global study of trust, we inform and advise leaders across business, government, media, and civil society on how trust shapes growth, reputation, and societal expectations. Our work is consistently recognized at the industry's highest levels, including Cannes Lions, WARC, and the IPA Effectiveness Awards.


We are looking for a Senior Vice President, Brand Strategy to join our team in Canada, leading strategic thinking for some of the world's most recognized consumer brands.


This is an opportunity to shape brand strategy across North America while collaborating with global teams to deliver culturally relevant, insight-driven work that connects brands with consumers in meaningful ways.


As a senior strategic leader, you will work at the intersection of brand, culture, creativity, and commerce, helping clients navigate evolving consumer behaviours, identify new opportunities, and build brands that earn attention, trust, and relevance.


You'll partner closely with senior client leaders, creative teams, strategists, and specialists across Edelman's integrated network to develop ambitious ideas grounded in consumer understanding and designed to drive business impact.

This is a role for someone who loves the craft of strategy as much as the opportunity to lead it. You'll be hands-on in shaping the work, a trusted advisor to clients, and an inspiring mentor to the next generation of strategic talent.


Who You Are

You're a strategic thinker and brand builder who understands what makes consumers care, what drives culture, and how brands can show up meaningfully in people's lives.


You bring deep experience working with consumer brands, ideally within CPG, and know how to turn complex business challenges, consumer insights, and cultural tensions into clear, compelling strategies that inspire creative thinking.

You're equally comfortable working directly with senior clients, collaborating with creative teams, and rolling up your sleeves to develop the strategic thinking behind the work.


You thrive in collaborative environments, bring curiosity and fresh perspectives to challenges, and enjoy working across markets and disciplines to create work that makes a difference.


What You'll Do

  • Lead brand strategy for major CPG clients, developing insight-led approaches that strengthen brand positioning, cultural relevance, consumer engagement, and business growth.
  • Shape strategic thinking across North America, collaborating with Canadian, U.S., and global teams to connect local market understanding with regional and global brand ambitions.
  • Turn consumer and cultural insights into creative opportunities, drawing on research, data, audience behaviours, category dynamics, and emerging trends to uncover compelling brand platforms and communications strategies.
  • Partner with creative and integrated teams to inspire distinctive, culturally relevant ideas and campaigns that connect with consumers across earned, social, digital, and other brand touchpoints.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior clients, providing strategic counsel, challenging conventional thinking, and helping brand leaders navigate evolving consumer expectations and business challenges.
  • Drive strategic excellence and business growth, identifying opportunities to expand client partnerships, contributing to new business pitches, and championing work that delivers measurable impact.
  • Lead and develop strategy talent, mentoring strategists, fostering collaboration, and building an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives and bold thinking can thrive.
  • Champion innovation and connected thinking, bringing together expertise from across Edelman's North American and global network to explore new methodologies, tools, and approaches to brand-building.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in brand strategy, communications strategy, advertising, integrated marketing, consulting, or a related discipline, including experience leading strategy for major consumer brands.
  • Strong understanding of the CPG landscape, consumer behaviours, brand-building, and the cultural and commercial dynamics shaping categories such as food, beverage, personal care, and household products.
  • Proven ability to develop compelling brand positioning, creative briefs, communications platforms, and integrated strategies that translate insights into distinctive, effective work.
  • Experience leading large, complex client relationships and collaborating with senior stakeholders across multiple markets, ideally including North America.
  • A track record of inspiring creative work and translating strategic thinking into measurable brand or business outcomes.
  • Strong leadership, communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence clients, inspire creative teams, and mentor strategic talent.
  • A collaborative, curious, and entrepreneurial approach, with the ability to bring together diverse perspectives and navigate complex, cross-functional environments.

Life at Edelman

At Edelman, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of some of the world's most recognized brands while working alongside talented colleagues across strategy, creative, communications, data, and digital.


Our global network brings together different perspectives, expertise, and capabilities to solve complex challenges and create work that matters.

Our culture is built on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum.


We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where people feel respected, supported, and empowered to bring their perspectives and ideas to the table.


We believe that great strategy starts with curiosity, thrives through collaboration, and creates impact when it challenges what's possible.

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

job.title: Communications Director
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading

 

 

In addition, a VALUES FIT is top priority. Do our values align with yours? Mission, Beliefs & Values. If so, please read on.

 

 

The Communications Director is responsible for the organization, development, and oversight of comprehensive and integrated communications objectives and message positioning in support of established ministry goals. Responsible for the implementation of internal and external communications initiatives, including public relations initiatives and serves as an official spokesperson for the ministry. Works closely with senior leadership on the development and administration of communication plans and strategies. Supervises staff and outside consultants/vendors responsible for the development and production of strategic communications content for employees, media, and community functions.

 

* This is an in-office role at our Franklin, TN Office

 

 

Here’s just some of what you will be doing daily…

  • Proactively influence our culture, leading by example in demonstrating collaboration, empowerment, innovation, creativity and service, while being a faithful witness on and off the job of K-LOVE’s mission to create compelling media that inspires and encourages our listeners to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.
  • As a member of leadership, contribute to long term planning and vision implementation through identification of strategic Marketing initiatives, collaboration, prioritization, communication, and evaluation of results, while preserving K-LOVE’s reputation for integrity and excellence.
  • Engage Chief Marketing & Communications Officer on communication issues, trends, and proposals for strategic initiatives and delivery.
  • Collaborate closely with other departments such as Programming, Engagement, and other departments.
  • Assist with strategic planning and implementation for communication strategies with a focus on communication goals, timelines, budgets, results tracking, and celebration.
  • Assess communication performance against both annual goals and plans. Provide strategic recommendations based on operational analysis, research, and projections, cost identification and allocation, and resource analysis. Ensure tools and systems are in place to provide critical operational and project information to the Chief Marketing & Communications Officer and others, and make actionable recommendations on both strategic goals and operational constraints.
  • Provide leadership for the communication function and team, ensuring ministry wide collaboration and facilitating appropriate resolution of issues, and competing priorities. Ensure alignment of communication Initiatives with Ministry objectives.
  • Consult with senior leadership to provide communication strategies that protect, promote, and enhance the reputation of the organization.
  • Review and approves the work product of department staff, outside departments, and external vendors and freelancers to ensure quality, accuracy, and brand consistency.
  • Manage the communication strategy and direction for acquisitions, internal communication initiatives, newsletters, and ministry special events.
  • Oversee the writing and production of special reports, executive messages, fact sheets, brochures, newsletters, etc.
  • Provide strategic communication support to the Chief Marketing & Communications Officer and the Ministry Leadership Team in the form of talking points, speeches, and other resources.
  • Plans and directs administrative, financial, and operational activities for the department as needed and requested by senior management. Organize and prioritize critical issues and required information to facilitate efficient decision making.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

We are looking for a very specific skill set. If you can say yes to each of these requirements, then we want to meet you!

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, public relations, English, or related field, or combination of education/training with relevant experience.
  • Six plus years of communications and/or public relations experience is required.
  • Experience directing and/or managing comprehensive strategic communications, media relations, and related teams preferred.
  • Strong writing skills including a working knowledge of AP Style required.
  • Experience working closely with creative teams on the design and production of creative products that support strategic communication goals.
  • Effective communication skills written, verbal, listening, and presentation are required.
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with all levels of the organization, including senior management. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications is required.
  • A collaborative and flexible style, with strong service mentality. Need to be seen as a team player.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop sincere business/ministry relationships.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the social sector with a passion for our mission and values.

 

Employment Requirements

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

Why work for K-LOVE?

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values. 

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

    • Partner across the engineering team to ensure K-LOVE's programming is broadcast successfully and to the highest quality through expert installation, maintenance, operation, updates, and intricate repairs.
    • Lead the operation, testing, and maintenance of advanced broadcast equipment such as audio processors, transmission systems, EAS equipment, receivers, monitors, electrical systems, and optimizing signal and sound based on Ministry guidelines.
    • Drive a culture of excellence by identifying opportunities to enhance system performance, reliability, and efficiency, with a focus on IP-based, modern microwave, and Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite solutions.
  • Troubleshooting & Mentorship:
    • Serve as a primary expert in diagnosing and resolving complex technical faults on equipment and systems down to the component level, utilizing advanced analytical methods.
    • Partner and communicate with engineers (including contract engineers) to accomplish critical objectives.
    • Serve as a dedicated mentor and escalation point for more junior Broadcast Engineers, fostering their technical knowledge and professional development.
  • Administrative & Documentation:
    • Accurately complete and submit all required administrative documentation, including but not limited to timecards, expense reports, vehicle logs, budgeting documents, and other relevant records by established deadlines.
    • Utilize and maintain designated asset management, work order, and ticketing system software to log activities, track inventory, and update status efficiently.
    • Respond promptly and professionally to emails, texts, and phone calls, ensuring clear and timely communication regarding operational status, project updates, and other work-related matters.
    • Maintain organized digital and physical records as required for compliance and operational continuity.
  • Advanced Compliance & Safety Stewardship:
    • Maintain an expert-level understanding of FCC rules and regulations, ensuring all equipment and operations are compliant and uphold safety standards.
    • Actively champion K-LOVE's Injury Prevention and Safety program, ensuring strict adherence to safety standards.
    • Strict adherence to lock out-tag out procedures.
    • Serve as a Chief Operator/Engineer for assigned broadcast station(s), meticulously fulfilling all regulatory responsibilities.
  • Critical Site Management & Extensive Field Presence:
    • Conduct mandatory, comprehensive on-site visits to each assigned transmitter site at least once per quarter.
    • Provide immediate and expert response for unplanned outages, emergency repairs, and critical events requiring on-site presence.
    • Perform essential maintenance and troubleshooting on non-broadcast equipment (e.g., generators, HVAC, minor electrical/plumbing) ensuring complete site functionality.
    • Undertake necessary trips to remote sites for complex installations or critical repairs, or K-LOVE Campus for specialized training or leadership on projects.
    • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent technical studies in electronics, broadcast communications, or a related field; OR a minimum of five years of directly related experience; OR an equivalent combination of education
  • SBE Certification highly desirable.
  • Minimum of 6+ years of demonstrated expert-level experience in troubleshooting, installing, repairing, and maintaining complex broadcast electronic equipment, or comparable relevant experience.
  • Thorough understanding of broadcast air-chain components, including complex system interactions and IP-based signal distribution.
  • Intermediate networking skills (TCP/IP, routing, switching) and ability to diagnose common network issues.
  • Advanced understanding of modern microwave and Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite technologies and their integration.
  • Deep understanding of radio frequency (RF) emissions, interference mitigation, and regulatory compliance, serving as an escalation point for complex RF challenges.
  • Expertise in soldering and desoldering electronic components, including precision work.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of applicable broadcast-related FCC rules and regulations.
  • Ability to perform complex calculations for common broadcast-related formulae.
  • Advanced proficiency with standard broadcast test equipment (VOMs, Oscilloscopes, Spectrum Analyzers).
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and other common software.
  • Proven ability to systematically and logically address multiple, highly complex technical problems, often requiring innovative solutions.
  • Ability to apply sophisticated common-sense understanding to carry out complex instructions and think strategically from abstract problems to practical solutions.
  • Exemplary communication skills characterized by grace, respect, and humility; strong ability to listen, provide constructive feedback, and influence positively.
  • Demonstrates lifelong learning, actively pursuing and taking personal responsibility for advanced professional development.
  • Maintains a deep and current understanding of technical processes/equipment, strategically leveraging new technologies to enhance performance and productivity.
  • Strives for error elimination, prioritizes high-quality work, and proactively seeks opportunities to improve products and services.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop sincere business/Ministry relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the social sector with a passion for our mission and values.

Job Summary

Responsibilities

Works with others on the Music staff on the implementation of the company’s music procedures and policies as they pertain to ESPN Content. Organizes and inputs audio assets and music cue metadata into the cue sheet management system for all ESPN networks. Assists in the registration of ESPN-owned copyrights and organization of copyright metadata. Management of the storage, organization, updates, and ingest of digital metadata for tracking and monetization. Edits music cuts for thematic, commercial, and library music packages, as needed. Works with Music Coordinators to organize, compile, and deliver series/seasonal music packages for assigned productions. Assists in the preparation, filing, trafficking, and organization of music licenses and related music documentation. Inputs song and license fee information for cleared third-party songs into the departmental database. Cue sheet support including, but not limited to, the approval of music cue sheets, facilitation of cue sheets to licensors, compliance reporting for all ESPN networks, delivery of ESPN cue sheets to affiliated networks and/or publishing entities. Coordinates updates from production music libraries, tracks usage, and liaises with production contacts at the libraries. Assists in the procurement and monitors the circulation of physical audio media. Maintains the department’s Music Resource website. Responsible for the organization, upkeep, and maintenance of the Music Department’s audio equipment. Manages the conversion of music from physical CDs to audio files for storage in digital archives. Exhibits the ability to train incoming employees on the department’s basic functions, cue sheet management system, and administrative systems currently in use. Assists others on the music team with other music-related projects and tasks, as needed. Assists in the preparation of clearance requests, reporting, correspondence, and licensing agreements, as needed.

Must be willing to work second shift and weekends. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Prioritizes projects based on time and resources available. job.title: Part-Time Sports Content Researcher
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Part-Time Sports Content Researcher Job ID 10164761 Location Los Angeles, California, United States Business ESPN Date posted Nov. 13, 2026 Part-Time Sports Content Researcher Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements You have a head for stats, an eye for a great story, and the range as a writer to be creative and succinct -- and your passion for sports is the beating heart that fuels it all. This is the type of person who thrives as a Sports Content Researcher at ESPN. This position will work on NFL Network and other shows produced in Inglewood, CA, and be part of the company’s larger Research & Graphics squad – with staff also located in Bristol, CT and Charlotte, NC. Our mission is simple to define but incredibly complex to deliver: Provide ESPN’s television, audio, digital and social platforms with statistics, context and historical perspectives that make our sports coverage as interesting to the sports fanatic as it is understandable to the casual observer. It’s no easy feat, but we do it 24/7, and we think we do it better than anyone else. If this sounds like you and you’re up for the challenge, please apply today! Ok, it’s true: You’re in the office on Super Bowl Sunday. And for the NFL Draft. And the NFL schedule release. But the office is ESPN’s production center in Inglewood, CA, and you’re surrounded by people who share your passion. You’re a member of a tight squad of like-minded professionals who feed an endless flow of differentiating content that lands across ESPN platforms. Sports Content Researchers tap their existing reservoirs of knowledge and use ESPN’s vast resources – including access to world-class advanced metrics -- to hone in on the why and how of the sporting events that are most important to ESPN and sports fans. The NFL, college football, and the NBA are year-round staples, with significant coverage of the NHL, WNBA, and college basketball. Any sport could deliver the story of the day, week, or month.

Responsibilities

Many people say this, but in Research, it really is true: Sports news is constant, so no two days are the same. On any given day or night, you might: Create original full-screen graphics and anchor lead-ins for live shows such as those on NFL Network or any ESPN platform , using research you’ve done and copy you’ve written; Post the most relevant news on the ESPN BottomLine/NFL Network ticker – from Breaking News alerts to in-depth coverage and putting complex news stories into context; Put your deep knowledge to work to create game previews for shows that are informative, factually accurate, and unique enough that even die-hard sports fans really learn something; Collaborate with colleagues for every element of a studio show, from unearthing little-known facts to quickly bringing up relevant stats when things such as trades, coaching changes, or injuries are announced; Provide real-time updates for anchors and announcers while they are on the air; Flex your storytelling muscles by developing interesting segments, and help your colleagues flesh out their own ideas; ESPN is known for its cutting-edge graphics, and you will be one of the people who develop visually appealing, factually revealing visuals for our TV and digital feeds; Drop everything when news breaks and use your deep knowledge of advanced metrics, analytics, and research tools to create supporting content, often with a deadline of minutes or seconds! Working in Research also means you: Work a schedule that will vary by month and/or season -- you’ll get to dive deeply into sports and have enough variety to keep your days and week fresh;

Experience

professional growth and development – in addition to onboarding, training, and coaching that is a constant, you’ll meet with your supervisor formally twice a month and receive quarterly performance updates. Basic

Qualifications

Minimum of 1 year of related

experience

in sports, statistics, research, or a related field Full availability for this position to work days, nights, weekends, and holidays Broad knowledge of most sports and deep knowledge of the NFL and several others, including awareness of current/historical sports statistics, milestones, news, and events Elite writing and grammar skills. Must have aptitude to research, write air-ready scripts for BottomLine as well as Event and Studio productions Must be able to communicate information accurately Must be able to adhere to strict deadlines and react to breaking news Must be able to follow all Disney, ESPN, and department policies and directives

Preferred Qualifications

Minimum 2 years of

experience

working with statistics in an online, television, or print media environment Fluency in reading, speaking, and writing Spanish Demonstrated track record of training others and/or managing team-based projects Required

Education

High School diploma or equivalent Preferred

Education

College degree or equivalent #ESPNMedia Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Los Angeles is $42,280 to $56,630 per year based on a 28 hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and

experience

among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with ESPN Productions, Inc, which is part of a business we call ESPN. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. ESPN Productions, Inc is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs . We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. Apply Now Save Job About The Walt Disney Company: The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise that includes three core business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Experiences. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law. Hiring Process Where Does Your Story Begin? Explore Disney Careers and the Life at Disney blog to learn about all the amazing opportunities waiting to be discovered at The Walt Disney Company. Be Part of the Story There are many different brands and businesses to explore. Once you've found the opportunity that is right for you, take the next step by completing your application. The Next Chapter Once you've applied, you will receive an email allowing you to access your candidate dashboard. Create your login and make sure to check your dashboard often to see your application progress. Explore this Location Los Angeles, CA The entertainment capital of the world offers diverse shopping, dining, and sightseeing opportunities packed into little more than 500 square miles. job.title: Security Specialist
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Security Specialist Job ID 10164561 Location Southington, Connecticut, United States Business ESPN Date posted Nov. 17, 2026 Security Specialist Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements The Global Security & Safety department is dedicated to protecting the safety, security, and well-being of ESPN employees, guests, facilities, and assets. Our team provides security and safety services across ESPN-owned and leased facilities, as well as remote events around the world. If you are a customer-focused security professional who can remain calm under pressure, exercise sound judgment, and provide a welcoming presence while maintaining a safe and secure environment, we encourage you to apply and Be A Part Of The Story!

Responsibilities

Greet, screen, and assist employees, visitors, vendors, and guests in accordance with established security procedures. Enforce company security, access control, and parking policies consistently, professionally, and fairly. Monitor ESPN facilities and identify, address, and report potential safety and security hazards. Perform access control duties at high-traffic exterior posts, including vehicle and truck inspections in accordance with established procedures. Conduct X-ray screening of packages and mail following required certification and operating procedures. Monitor fire alarm control panels, interpret alarm indicators, determine the type and location of emergencies, and initiate the appropriate response within established timeframes. Complete and issue hot work permits and perform required inspections and fire watch assignments in designated hot work areas. Respond to medical, fire, security, and other safety-related emergencies and incidents in accordance with training and established protocols. Prepare clear, accurate, and comprehensive incident and security reports. Provide a professional security presence at on-campus and off-campus events. Assist with traffic and crowd management by operating gates, establishing barricades, and directing vehicle and pedestrian traffic. Perform routine security system checks and provide general assistance and information to employees and visitors. Assist with scheduling maintenance for company fleet vehicles and operate company transportation as required. Support Command Post and Global Operations Center operations and complete additional security-related assignments as needed. Basic

Qualifications

Minimum of one year of customer service or related professional experience. Minimum of two years of

experience

in security, law enforcement, public safety, military security, or a related field. Valid Connecticut Driver's License and Connecticut Guard Card. Ability to successfully complete required pre-employment screening, including applicable background, DMV, and drug screening requirements. Flexibility to work varying schedules, including weekends, holidays, overtime, and adjusted days off as business needs require. Strong customer service, interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment and make effective decisions in high-pressure or emergency situations. Ability to take command of challenging situations while remaining calm, professional, and diplomatic. Strong teamwork skills with the ability to work effectively with employees, guests, leadership, emergency responders, and other partners. Ability to work independently and carry out

responsibilities

within established policies, procedures, and guidelines. Professional demeanor and the ability to represent ESPN appropriately in all interactions. Working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook and Word. Ability to operate company vehicles and transportation as required. Required

Education

High School Diploma or equivalent. Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Bristol, CT is $44,700 to $59,800 per year. The base pay actually offered will into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and

experience

among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with ESPN, Inc, which is part of a business we call ESPN. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. ESPN, Inc is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs . We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. Apply Now Save Job About The Walt Disney Company: The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise that includes three core business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Experiences. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. job.title: Art Manager
job.description:
Manage process, traffic and materials for large multi-part projects, based on the overall direction of the Senior Creative Director, in service of business needs. Oversee daily hands-on design and production within the FCP Creative Development Department and ensure smooth transitions of information and files between project team partners and colleagues. Track jobs and monitor progress on projects and identify potential scheduling issues, using workflow/traffic management systems. Provide technical counsel and answer questions on production issues. Proof interim versions of specs sheets for accuracy before final approval round and oversee accuracy of final materials sent to vendors. Assist Senior Creative Director with review of Licensing and Global Partnership materials (revisions to submissions for Licensing and to environment and product mockups for GP). Provide backup support for Senior Creative Director during travel/absence. Assist in the writing and preparation of reports and documents such as RFPs and presentation materials. 

Research, design and produce graphic solutions for specific special projects (such as development of new products and processes); however, position is not primarily for design.

job.title: Manager, Experiential Activation
job.description:
The Activation department develops and delivers strategic experiential marketing programs, touring activations, branded experiences, consumer engagements, and product demonstrations that connect Feld Entertainment properties and partner brands with consumers through live experiences.

The Manager of Activation is responsible for leading the successful planning, execution, and delivery of experiential marketing programs, touring activations, branded experiences, and consumer engagements on behalf of Feld Entertainment properties and partner brands.

This position provides leadership across multiple client programs while managing project teams, operational resources, budgets, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure programs are delivered safely, efficiently, and within budget. The Manager serves as both an operational leader and client partner, balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution while developing Project Managers and supporting the continued growth of the Activation department.

Success in this role is measured by successful program delivery, client satisfaction, financial accountability, team development, and consistent operational execution.

job.title: Media Services Coordinator
job.description:
The Media Services Coordinator supports the Media Services team by performing hands-on operational work supporting media intake, asset preparation, metadata, and workflow execution across physical and digital media environments. This role is designed to develop expertise in media workflows, standards, and governance. 

You’ll spend your time organizing media, preparing assets for ingest, applying metadata, managing physical legacy media libraries, supporting internal users, and learning how enterprise media workflows operate from capture through archive.

This role is part of Feld Entertainment’s modernization of enterprise media operations, helping build the systems, workflows, and standards that support millions of media assets across multiple global entertainment brands. You’ll support media used across production, broadcast, marketing, and archive operations for some of the world’s most recognizable live entertainment brands.

Reporting directly to the Senior Manager of Media Services, the Media Services Coordinator builds expertise in media asset lifecycles, metadata standards, file formats, and operational best practices. The successful candidate will actively develop expertise in Media Services platforms, enterprise workflows, metadata standards, and media formats while growing into a trusted operational contributor supporting increasingly complex workflows and stakeholders.

Note: This position is not a Creative Services role and does not involve creative production responsibilities.

job.title: Senior Manager, Digital Marketing
job.description:
Feld Entertainment is seeking a strategic, hands-on Senior Digital Marketing Manager to lead the evolution and optimization of the company’s portfolio of consumer-facing digital experiences, including brand websites, mobile applications, campaign landing pages, and other owned digital platforms.

Supporting Monster Jam, SMX, Disney On Ice, Ringling, and other Feld Entertainment brands, this position will lead major digital initiatives from discovery and requirements gathering through design, development, launch, and ongoing optimization. The role will focus on creating intuitive, personalized, and high-performing experiences that connect fans with Feld’s brands, content, events, and ticketing opportunities.

Serving as the business and product owner for Feld’s digital platforms, the Senior Digital Marketing Manager will translate business objectives and user needs into technical requirements, functional specifications, platform roadmaps, and actionable development priorities. The role will partner closely with internal teams and external development partners to manage execution, project timelines, budgets, platform standards, and the customer journey.

Success in this role requires digital product leadership, marketing strategy, technical fluency, strong project management, and the ability to build alignment across Brand Marketing, IT, Ticketing, Ecommerce, Analytics, Creative Services, Legal, Operations, and external agencies.

job.title: Supercross Operations Manager
job.description: The Operations Manager leads on-site Registration and Will Call for Supercross events, including hiring, scheduling, and supervising seasonal staff and handling registration documents and Will Call funds. The role also manages credentials, tour hotel contracts and rooming lists, unit-level travel and accommodations, budget accounting support, team and crew packets, event supplies and apparel, summary reports, and summit presentations. The ideal candidate is organized, able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines, and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced touring environment.

job.title: 2027 Graduate Programme - Asia
job.description:
Pave your career path with FGS Global

We are the best at what we do because we hire people who are open-minded, collaborative and bring diverse perspectives to the table.  

If you’re looking to be challenged, want to learn and progress in a fast-paced environment, and have excellent written and verbal communication skills, we want to get to know you.
