job.title: Consultor De Viajes
job.description:
The Corporate Travel Consultant is responsible for coordinating and managing end-to-end domestic and international travel arrangements for executives, talent, production teams, and groups, ensuring an efficient, well-organized travel experience aligned with the company's operational needs.

This role requires specialized expertise in Global Distribution Systems (GDS), travel reservations and ticketing, supplier negotiations, and corporate travel policy compliance.

The position also involves providing timely assistance and follow-up on travel-related requests and issues that may arise before, during, and after trips, offering support as operational needs require and in accordance with established company procedures and service arrangements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Travel Operations and Reservations

  • Coordinate and manage end-to-end travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, car rentals, and rail services for executives, vice presidents, talent, and production teams.
  • Research and compare routes, schedules, fares, and connections to recommend cost-effective travel options aligned with corporate policies and approved budgets.
  • Develop and manage complex and multi-destination itineraries, ensuring seamless coordination of all travel services.
  • Maintain accurate traveler profiles, loyalty program information, and required travel documentation.

2. GDS and Ticketing Operations

  • Utilize Global Distribution Systems (Sabre and/or Amadeus) to create, modify, and manage Passenger Name Records (PNRs), electronic tickets, and Electronic Miscellaneous Documents (EMDs).
  • Manage public, private, and corporate fares, fare rules, routing requirements, IATA codes, and BSP procedures.
  • Process ticket issuance, reissues, itinerary changes, cancellations, refunds, and applicable penalties in accordance with established policies.
  • Monitor unused tickets and travel credits to maximize cost recovery and optimize company resources.

3. Payments, Billing, and Reconciliation

  • Manage authorized payment methods, including corporate credit cards, centralized payment solutions, and bank transfers.
  • Ensure accurate allocation of expenses to the appropriate cost centers, projects, and internal accounting records.
  • Request, validate, and follow up on tax invoices, ensuring compliance with Mexican fiscal requirements, including RFC, legal entity information, and CFDI usage.
  • Support financial reconciliation processes with airlines, hotels, and other travel suppliers, identifying discrepancies, duplicate charges, and billing inconsistencies.

4. Traveler Support and Incident Management

  • Provide timely assistance and follow-up on traveler requests, ensuring a responsive and service-oriented experience.
  • Manage travel disruptions, including flight delays, cancellations, missed connections, overbookings, and last-minute itinerary changes.
  • Coordinate alternative arrangements to address accommodation, transportation, or travel documentation issues.
  • Maintain effective communication with travelers and relevant internal teams, providing updates and escalating critical situations when appropriate.
  • Assist with travel-related operational matters requiring special attention, based on business needs and in accordance with established internal procedures and service coordination arrangements.

5. Supplier Relations and Cost Management

  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with airlines, hotel chains, car rental companies, and travel service providers.
  • Negotiate waivers, special arrangements, traveler protections, and alternative solutions when necessary.
  • Identify cost-saving opportunities and recommend improvements to travel booking and procurement processes.
  • Monitor supplier performance and service quality while promoting compliance with corporate travel policies.

Requirements and Qualifications

Professional Experience

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience as a Corporate Travel Consultant, Executive Travel Agent, or In-Plant Travel Consultant.
  • Previous experience in the media, entertainment, sports, or live production industries is preferred.

Technical Expertise

  • Advanced proficiency in Sabre and/or Amadeus is required.
  • Strong knowledge of IATA/BSP procedures, fare rules, NDC platforms, and IATA codes.
  • Experience with SSR, OSI, and APIS procedures.
  • Proven experience in domestic and international ticket issuance, modifications, cancellations, and refunds.

Languages

  • Native Spanish proficiency.
  • Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate effectively in international business environments.

Technical Tools

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Experience with corporate travel booking and expense management platforms.
  • Familiarity with Workday, Coupa, or Graphite is preferred.

Core Competencies

  • Strong customer service orientation.
  • Excellent organizational, planning, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Effective problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Adaptability to changing operational requirements and unexpected situations.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Supplier negotiation and relationship management.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks in fast-paced, high-demand environments.

job.title: Maintenance Engineer
job.description:
KTVU FOX 2 is seeking a versatile, hands-on Broadcast Engineer to join our team in Oakland, CA. Maintains and installs equipment at the studio and technical facilities, provides broadcast engineering support for all news and production operations (both linear and streaming), assists and trains operators, and collaborates on technical projects varying in scale. This role is ideal for a proactive engineer with strong troubleshooting instincts looking to contribute to a live, 24/7 news operation.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Studio & Production Support: Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot studio cameras, robotic pedestal systems, production switchers, audio consoles, graphics systems, and news video playback equipment.

Signal Flow & Routing: Maintain central routing, master control systems, TOC, and terminal equipment to ensure flawless linear and streaming video/audio delivery.

Newsroom IT & Systems Maintenance: Assist with the upkeep and integration of newsroom computer platforms, editing bays (NLEs), playout servers, virtual platforms, and production automation systems (e.g., Ross Overdrive, NRCS).

System Integration & Documentation: Design, wire, and integrate equipment racks, patch bays, and IP-based broadcast infrastructure. Develop support documentation and standards for operations personnel.

Operational & Incident Support: Perform operational duties in Master Control and TOC as scheduled. Respond to, manage, and track technical issues as they arise in a live 24/7 environment with urgency.

Compliance & Standards: Ensure all operations and broadcast technology comply with FCC rules, safety standards, and station engineering protocols.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience: 3–5 years of experience in broadcast equipment maintenance, studio AV setup, system integration, or IT/networking in a broadcast environment.

Technical & IT Skills: Strong diagnostic skills; working knowledge of computer networking (IP, subnets, switchers), virtual computing, basic tools, soldering, and custom cable fabrication.

Emerging Technologies: Familiarity with IP-based broadcast standards (e.g., SMPTE 2110, DANTE, NDI) and compressed video encoding/decoding techniques.

Communication & Logistics: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Must hold a valid driver's license with a good driving record for local travel as needed.

Schedule Flexibility: Ability and willingness to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to support continuous news operations.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & EDUCATION

Physical Demands: Ability to stand, walk, reach, stoop, climb ladders, work behind equipment racks, and lift up to 50 lbs.

Education & Certifications: Technical degree in Electronics, IT, or equivalent military/trade experience. SBE, Cisco, CompTIA, or Microsoft certifications and AutoCAD experience are a plus.

job.title: Manager, Podcast Marketing
job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world’s top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content through advertising, subscriptions, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our proprietary technology stack, including Supercast for subscriptions and Speakeasy for hosting, distribution, and monetization.

Named after Ted Williams’ longest home run at Fenway Park, Red Seat Ventures was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we are the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Red Seat Ventures is looking for a Manager, Podcast Marketing to lead cross-promotional campaigns across our portfolio of nearly 70 podcasts while building relationships with external shows, creators, and platforms. Reporting to the Senior Director, Podcast Marketing, you will own campaigns from initial planning and creative development through ad operations, measurement, and reporting. You will translate campaign performance into clear insights that help senior leaders understand what worked and what we should do next.

This position sits within a growing Audience Development function with established systems and active campaigns already in place. The work is currently hands-on and high-volume as we continue to improve and automate our processes. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys owning complex systems, maintaining operational precision, and turning campaign data into a compelling and actionable story.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Book and manage in-network and out-of-network cross-promotional campaigns, including launches for new shows and always-on promotional rotations
  • Own campaign execution details, including flight dates, frequency caps, audience targeting, creative trafficking, and delivery
  • Build and deliver weekly and monthly reports on net-new listeners, conversion, and retention for senior leadership
  • Develop clear performance narratives and recommendations based on campaign data
  • Maintain consistent campaign naming conventions across booking, hosting, and measurement platforms so promotional activity can be accurately matched to results
  • Research and pitch podcasts and YouTube channels for promotional swaps, collaborations, and client guest appearances
  • Manage scheduling and promotional materials, including biographies and headshots, in partnership with client teams, host-show contacts, and Creator Partnerships
  • Maintain the programming calendar for editorial pitches to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Amazon Music, iHeart, and YouTube
  • Track upcoming show moments, platform requirements, and submission lead times to support timely and relevant editorial pitches
  • Help improve and automate campaign workflows, reporting processes, and other repetitive operational tasks

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 3–5 years of experience in audience development, marketing operations, campaign management, or ad operations within podcasting, audio, or digital media
  • Hands-on experience booking campaigns in an enterprise podcast hosting and advertising platform
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including experience using pivot tables and lookup functions to create clear reports from raw data exports
  • Familiarity with podcast measurement or attribution platforms such as Magellan AI, Podscribe, or Podtrac
  • Strong written communication skills and the confidence to present performance data, insights, and recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Experience managing outreach or partnerships, including promotional swaps, guest bookings, creator collaborations, or platform relationships
  • Careful and consistent execution, with the judgment to identify incorrect date ranges, mismatched metrics, or other discrepancies before they reach a final report
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and stakeholder relationships in a fast-paced environment
  • A proactive approach to improving systems, solving operational challenges, and identifying opportunities for audience growth

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Day-to-day experience working with podcast attribution tools such as Magellan AI, Podscribe, or Podtrac
  • Previous experience working within a podcast network
  • Listener fluency across podcast genres such as news, true crime, comedy, and sports
  • Working knowledge of SQL or light Python
  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, reporting, and repetitive workflows, including agentic tools such as Claude Code or Codex

job.title: News Anchor
job.description:
The news team at FOX 26 and FOX Local Houston is transforming how local news is gathered and delivered. We no longer wait for appointed times to deliver content. We're a 24/7 STREAMING FIRST news organization.

As we continue to evolve, we’re hiring a News Anchor for our top-rated morning news block. Our next anchor will bring the passion and skillset to create and deliver live and unscripted content across streaming programs and platforms, digital news sites, social media and on linear TV.

In this role, you’ll anchor 3-hours of morning news from the studio and then transition to anchoring streaming programs from our redesigned newsroom during the remainder of your day. For streaming news shows, you’ll be responsible for operating our Tricaster switcher, while disseminating live and breaking news in a raw, unscripted format with no teleprompter.

Here’s what you’ll need to be successful in this role:

  • A streaming and digital first mindset, that has evolved beyond traditional TV news constructs. You’re as comfortable and skilled delivering unscripted content as you are with a teleprompter. You bring the same enthusiasm to your delivery and on-air performance regardless format, studio environment or platform.
  • You ditched the “anchor voice” long ago and you’ve mastered a more authentic style of delivery that doesn’t rely on a teleprompter. We don’t use teleprompters in our streaming news programs.
  • You have experience and skill anchoring continuous live breaking news events and severe weather such as hurricanes, tornado outbreaks and winter storm coverage. This experience and skill are evident on your reel.
  • You’ve spent a minimum of 3-5 years in the field as a news reporter, covering big news stories, honing your journalism, polishing your on-air performance and proving that the best anchors have built a reputation as aggressive, successful reporters.
  • You have experience field anchoring big news, demonstrating a range of skills from hard news and politics to sports and community events.
  • You are a leader in the newsroom, with a demonstrated track record of mentoring younger reporters, helping them become better storytellers and writers.
  • You are an engaged copy editor, carefully reviewing and signing off on scripts before they go on air. You provide constructive feedback and actively participate in the editorial process.
  • You have impeccable journalistic ethics and integrity. You can spot problematic copy, flag stories that need more vetting, unearth biased narratives and make sound decisions under deadline pressure.
  • You’ve already created a significant social footprint across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook. Your content is rooted in news, not selfies and vacation photos.

You must have significant experience as an anchor, on top of 3-5 year of experience as a reporter in a professional news operation. Candidates who have experience hosting unscripted, live news streaming programs will move up the list. job.title: Sports Data & Metadata Engineer
job.description:
FOX Sports is looking to add a Sports Data & Metadata Engineer to bolster our AI Solutions team. The Sports Data & Metadata Engineer is responsible for cleaning and structuring both the proprietary data we already own and league data (Sports Radar, MLB BAM, etc.)so it can train models, power generative tools, and surface the right context at the right moment.

You’ll build the automated systems that pull our data out of scattered, non-integrated tools and into one place engineers and producers can actually rely on, and you’ll maintain the source of truth that feeds contextual information to our AI tools. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who knows both the data stack and the sports, and who understands that a stat is only useful if it arrives correct, fast, and in a shape a model can read.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Clean, structure, and normalize FOX Sports data, including player tracking, historical statistics, and sensor data, for model training and inference
  • Work with leagues, teams, and external data providers creating data workflows and processes
  • Work with data providers and league partners to integrate external feeds and resolve discrepancies against our own records
  • Build and maintain automated pipelines that ingest, validate, and reconcile data across FOX Sports systems
  • Develop an automated data management system that eliminates silos and consolidates fragmented, non-integrated architecture
  • Maintain the source of truth database that feeds contextual information to our AI tools
  • Design and document metadata schemas and taxonomies so sports content and data stay consistently machine-readable across platforms
  • Implement data quality monitoring, validation, and alerting so errors are caught before they reach a model or an audience
  • Partner with departments from around the company to understand how the data is actually used, and shape the schema around it

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, including production pipelines you built and maintained
  • Experience integrating third-party data feeds and reconciling conflicting sources
  • Experience designing schemas, taxonomies, and metadata models for large, messy datasets
  • Strong attention to detail and a low tolerance for silent data errors
  • Strong SQL and Python, with experience in modern data warehousing and orchestration tools
  • Familiarity with preparing data for machine learning, including feature pipelines and training datasets
  • Extensive knowledge of sports data: statistics, player tracking, and the context that makes a number meaningful
  • Ability to work nights and weekends, whenever sports are on the air

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

job.title: Sr. Manager, Legal and Business Affairs LATAM
job.description:
Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Legal & Business Affairs will provide strategic legal counsel and business-oriented support to the company's operations across Latin America, with a particular focus on Mexico and Central America.

This role will serve as a trusted legal advisor to business leaders and cross-functional teams, providing practical, commercially focused guidance on a broad range of legal, contractual, regulatory, and corporate matters.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience navigating complex legal and business environments within multinational organizations, demonstrating the ability to assess legal risks, develop effective solutions, and support business objectives while ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

The position requires strong commercial awareness, sound legal judgment, excellent stakeholder management skills, and fluency in both English and Spanish.

Key Responsibilities

1. Legal Advisory & Business Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted legal and business advisor to regional leadership and cross-functional teams across Latin America, particularly Mexico and Central America.
  • Provide strategic, practical, and timely legal guidance on commercial, operational, regulatory, and corporate matters.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to evaluate legal implications, identify potential risks, and develop solutions that support business priorities and commercial objectives.
  • Provide legal support for business initiatives, transactions, and operational projects, ensuring alignment with corporate policies and applicable legal requirements.

2. Commercial Contracts & Negotiations

  • Draft, review, negotiate, and manage a broad range of commercial agreements, including marketing, vendor, licensing, service, and other business-related contracts.
  • Advise internal stakeholders on contractual terms, obligations, liabilities, and potential legal or commercial risks.
  • Support contract negotiations with external partners, suppliers, and service providers, balancing legal protections with business needs.
  • Ensure contractual arrangements comply with applicable laws, internal policies, and corporate standards.

3. Corporate Governance & Regulatory Compliance

  • Support corporate governance activities, including legal entity management, corporate documentation, regulatory filings, and coordination with external legal advisors.
  • Provide legal guidance on regulatory requirements affecting business operations across relevant Latin American jurisdictions.
  • Collaborate with internal compliance teams to identify, assess, and address legal and regulatory risks.
  • Monitor relevant legislative and regulatory developments and proactively communicate potential implications for business operations.
  • Support the implementation of appropriate legal and compliance practices in coordination with relevant internal stakeholders.

4. Legal Risk Management & External Counsel

  • Identify, evaluate, and mitigate legal risks associated with commercial activities, contractual relationships, and regional operations.
  • Develop practical, risk-based recommendations that support informed business decisions.
  • Coordinate and oversee external legal counsel across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring consistent, high-quality, and cost-effective legal support.
  • Manage legal matters requiring specialized external advice and facilitate coordination between internal stakeholders and external advisors.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Initiatives

  • Collaborate closely with business, finance, compliance, and operations teams to support regional business objectives.
  • Provide legal guidance on cross-functional projects and initiatives involving multiple business units or jurisdictions.
  • Facilitate effective communication between legal and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on legal requirements, commercial priorities, and operational needs.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing legal processes, operational efficiency, and risk management practices.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • Law degree from an accredited university or institution.
  • Admission to practice law in at least one jurisdiction.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant legal experience, either as in-house counsel or at a reputable law firm, preferably within a multinational or regional business environment.
  • Demonstrated experience advising on commercial contracts, corporate matters, and business operations.
  • Experience supporting legal and commercial activities across Latin America, particularly Mexico and Central America, is strongly preferred.
  • Previous experience in the media, entertainment, advertising, technology, or other fast-paced industries is considered an advantage.
  • Proven ability to provide practical legal advice while balancing regulatory requirements, risk management, and business objectives.

Languages

  • Fluency in Spanish and English, both written and spoken, is required.
  • Ability to draft, review, and negotiate legal documents and communicate effectively with stakeholders in both languages.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Strong understanding of commercial operations and the ability to align legal recommendations with business objectives.
  • Legal Analysis & Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and address legal and regulatory risks while providing practical, solution-oriented guidance.
  • Contract Drafting & Negotiation: Excellent legal drafting, contract review, and negotiation skills.
  • Stakeholder Management: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build effective relationships with business leaders, cross-functional teams, and external advisors.
  • Strategic Thinking & Problem-Solving: Ability to evaluate complex legal matters, anticipate potential challenges, and recommend commercially viable solutions.
  • Organization & Prioritization: Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal concepts clearly to non-legal stakeholders.
  • Professional Integrity & Judgment: High ethical standards, discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment when handling sensitive or confidential matters.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Red Seat Ventures is launching a new premium membership business and is hiring a Vice President, Hospitality who will lead the delivery of exceptional, high-touch hospitality and member experiences across Red Seat Ventures' portfolio of premium live entertainment events. This leader will oversee all aspects of event hospitality, from pre-event planning and arrival through seating, food and beverage, unique experiences, departure, and post-event feedback, ensuring consistent execution of the company's premium service standards across multiple markets.

With primary responsibility for event hospitality operations, the VP will establish the operating models, processes, procedures, and staffing strategies needed to deliver seamless, scalable experiences. This includes overseeing the recruitment, training, scheduling, and development of Suite Hosts, managing venue and hospitality partnerships, and owning the P&L associated with delivering exceptional event experiences.

The VP will also oversee the Member Experience function through a Director, Member Experience, ensuring the team delivers personalized member service, builds strong relationships, and maintains consistent communication and service standards throughout the membership lifecycle. This leader will provide strategic direction and operational oversight to support member satisfaction, engagement, and retention.

This is a highly operational leadership role ideal for an experienced, multi-market hospitality executive who knows how to translate an elevated service vision into repeatable, scalable execution while building and leading high-performing teams.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the end-to-end hospitality experience at events, from pre-event planning and arrival through seating, food and beverage, unique experiences, departure, and post-event follow-up, ensuring exceptional service across all markets.
  • Translate the company's hospitality vision into scalable operating standards, processes, procedures, and playbooks that drive consistent execution across events, venues, and markets.
  • Oversee all operational elements of event hospitality, including venue coordination, seating layouts, food and beverage, guest flow, and onsite service delivery.
  • Develop and execute event staffing strategies, including recruiting, training, scheduling, managing, and developing a high-performing team of Suite Hosts across multiple markets.
  • Establish policies, procedures, and escalation protocols for anticipating and resolving event-related issues, ensuring teams are equipped to deliver seamless experiences and respond professionally to member needs.
  • Partner with internal teams, venues, vendors, and hospitality partners to ensure operational readiness, consistent service standards, and exceptional event execution.
  • Own the P&L for event hospitality operations, including labor planning, budgeting, vendor management, and cost control, balancing premium service delivery with financial discipline.
  • Oversee the Director, Member Experience, providing leadership and strategic direction for the Member Experience team and ensuring consistent service standards, communication protocols, and member relationship management.
  • Build and scale the hospitality and member experience functions as the business grows, developing leadership talent, strengthening operational processes, and ensuring a consistent, premium experience across all markets.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Extensive experience leading complex, multi-location hospitality, event, or guest-service operations, with a demonstrated track record of delivering consistent, high-quality execution across multiple markets.

  • Strong operational leadership skills, with the ability to translate premium service standards into scalable processes, training programs, playbooks, and measurable operating practices.
  • Demonstrated P&L ownership and financial acumen, including labor planning, budgeting, vendor management, cost control, and balancing exceptional service with financial discipline.
  • Experience overseeing high-touch guest or member experiences, with an understanding of how exceptional hospitality, personalized service, and consistent execution contribute to member satisfaction and loyalty.

job.title: AI Solutions Architect
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Sports

FOX Sports, the industry leader in live events, is the umbrella entity representing Fox Corporation’s wide array of multi-platform US-based sports assets. Built with brands capable of reaching more than 100 million viewers in a single weekend, FOX Sports includes the sports television arm of the FOX Network; FS1, FS2, FOX Soccer Plus and FOX Deportes, as well as a joint-venture business in the Big Ten Network and digital properties including http://FOXSports.com and the FOX Sports App. FOX Sports has delivered the most watched television program, NFL’s America’s Game of the Week on FOX, for fourteen consecutive years.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX Sports is seeking an AI Solutions Architect to help us build products that solve problems. The AI Solutions Architect creates the pipelines, integrations, and infrastructure that turn models into systems our producers, editors, engineers and employees can depend on to save time and achieve more.


You will be on the front lines of creating the applications that supercharge our workforce. That means designing real-time video and data pipelines that hold up on an NFL Sunday, integrating LLMs and Computer Vision into the workflow tools our teams already use and developing solutions for business functions around the company. The ideal candidate has deep cloud architecture experience, has put ML systems into production at scale, and can move between a whiteboard with leadership and a conversation with an employee who wants to work more efficiently.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with departments across the company to identify where AI creates real leverage and where it doesn’t
  • Design and deploy scalable AI pipelines for real-time video and data processing across FOX Sports properties
  • Oversee integration of LLMs and computer vision models into our existing workflow and production systems
  • Optimize cloud and compute costs to ensure AI efficiencies remain sustainable, across both operating costs and capital investment
  • Define reference architectures, technical standards, and evaluation criteria for AI systems moving from prototype into production
  • Inform build-vs-buy assessments for AI platforms, models, and vendors, and the technical relationships that follow
  • Establish monitoring, observability, and fallback strategies so AI-dependent workflows degrade safely during live events
  • Use performance and cost data to evaluate deployed systems and guide ongoing architecture decisions
  • Work with Security, Legal, and Standards teams to ensure AI implementations meet FOX’s requirements for rights, privacy, and editorial integrity
  • Train engineers and technical staff, raising the organization’s overall fluency in building with AI

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of experience in software or systems architecture, with demonstrated production ML/AI deployments
  • Deep experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including compute cost modeling and optimization at scale
  • Hands-on experience deploying LLMs and Computer Vision models in production, including inference optimization, orchestration, and evaluation
  • Strong background in real-time and streaming data architecture; video processing pipeline experience strongly preferred
  • Proficiency in coding tools and familiarity with modern ML tooling and MLOps practices
  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous business needs into durable technical architecture, and to explain that architecture to non-technical stakeholders
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across engineering, production, and business teams
  • Ability to work nights and weekends as needed to support live event windows

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • Interest in sports and live media production; experience in broadcast, streaming, or media tech

The Creative Producer/Editor develops and produces compelling marketing and other creative content for FOX TV Stations and related brands across broadcast, streaming and digital platforms. job.title: Director, FAST Licensing
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX Entertainment Global is seeking a Director of FAST Licensing to manage content strategy, channel programming, and account management across international FAST digital platforms, working internally with relevant groups within the wider FOX organization. Reporting directly to the Executive Director, TVOD & Revenue Share, this role will drive revenue and viewership growth primarily through the strategic licensing of FOX content to established third party channels and platforms, while simultaneously collaborating with internal teams to establish the foundation for the future launch and management of owned FOX FAST channels.


The Director will serve as a senior, client facing leader responsible for daily platform relationships, commercial strategy, and channel performance. The role will maximize the value of FOX content by applying a deep understanding of ad supported media rights, windowing, audience engagement, programming strategy, and partner business objectives. Success will require strong analytical judgment, cross-functional leadership, and the ability to move complex initiatives forward under strict deadlines.


Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage FAST distribution strategy internationally and leverage relationships across the organization to license FOX content to third party platforms, structuring deals to maximize inventory yield, reach, and revenue
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for key accounts, building trusted relationships to support renewals, channel placement, and long-term collaboration
  • Partner directly with OEM platforms and digital partners to negotiate and secure premium in-platform merchandising, promotional placement, and marketing visibility that enhance channel discoverability and viewer acquisition
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and Ad Sales to execute distribution plans, track deliverables, and present forecasts to internal leadership
  • Collaborate with internal teams across the organization to help drive the future international rollout of owned FOX FAST channels, partnering to coordinate programming, technical setup, asset delivery, and operational readiness
  • Operationalize KPI frameworks to evaluate viewership metrics, channel performance, and audience retention to inform content selection and optimize engagement
  • Develop joint business plans and evaluate content availability, rights, and windowing to maximize revenue across ad supported and revenue share opportunities
  • Support deal negotiations and review licensing agreements to balance partner needs with FOX financial and strategic objectives

WHAT YOU WILLNEED

  • 7+ years of experience in FAST distribution, digital distribution, licensing, or account management, preferably at a major studio or media company
  • 2+ years of experience operating as a direct client facing primary point of contact and managing daily account activities
  • Experience working with international clients, markets, or digital distribution businesses and understanding of global audiences
  • Experience managing programming strategy, including content selection, channel scheduling, audience retention, and performance optimization
  • Direct, hands-on experience partnering directly with OEM platforms such as Samsung TV Plus, LG, and Roku
  • Demonstrated experience in sales analysis, performance reporting, forecasting, and joint business planning
  • Familiarity with licensing agreements, ad revenue share structures, commercial terms, and deal execution; negotiation experience
  • Deep understanding of licensed media rights, content availability, windowing, and digital distribution models
  • Entrepreneurial, "builder" mindset with a proven ability to help take digital channels from concept to successful launch and execution
  • Strong critical thinking skills and the ability to translate data, market dynamics, and client objectives into practical recommendations
  • Proven ability to lead projects and workflows across multiple teams while managing competing priorities and strict deadlines
  • Excellent communication, presentation, relationship building, and stakeholder management skills
  • Professional who takes initiative, exercises sound judgment, and is comfortable managing responsibilities with limited direction
  • Highly organized, detail oriented, and able to manage multiple accounts, deliverables, and timelines in a dynamic environment

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • MBA
  • Familiarity with AI tools and their practical application in professional environments

job.title: Maintenance Engineer
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KTVU FOX 2 is seeking a versatile, hands-on Broadcast Engineer to join our team in Oakland, CA. Maintains and installs equipment at the studio and technical facilities, provides broadcast engineering support for all news and production operations (both linear and streaming), assists and trains operators, and collaborates on technical projects varying in scale. This role is ideal for a proactive engineer with strong troubleshooting instincts looking to contribute to a live, 24/7 news operation.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Studio & Production Support: Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot studio cameras, robotic pedestal systems, production switchers, audio consoles, graphics systems, and news video playback equipment.

Signal Flow & Routing: Maintain central routing, master control systems, TOC, and terminal equipment to ensure flawless linear and streaming video/audio delivery.

Newsroom IT & Systems Maintenance: Assist with the upkeep and integration of newsroom computer platforms, editing bays (NLEs), playout servers, virtual platforms, and production automation systems (e.g., Ross Overdrive, NRCS).

System Integration & Documentation: Design, wire, and integrate equipment racks, patch bays, and IP-based broadcast infrastructure. Develop support documentation and standards for operations personnel.

Operational & Incident Support: Perform operational duties in Master Control and TOC as scheduled. Respond to, manage, and track technical issues as they arise in a live 24/7 environment with urgency.

Compliance & Standards: Ensure all operations and broadcast technology comply with FCC rules, safety standards, and station engineering protocols.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience: 3–5 years of experience in broadcast equipment maintenance, studio AV setup, system integration, or IT/networking in a broadcast environment.

Technical & IT Skills: Strong diagnostic skills; working knowledge of computer networking (IP, subnets, switchers), virtual computing, basic tools, soldering, and custom cable fabrication.

Emerging Technologies: Familiarity with IP-based broadcast standards (e.g., SMPTE 2110, DANTE, NDI) and compressed video encoding/decoding techniques.

Communication & Logistics: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Must hold a valid driver's license with a good driving record for local travel as needed.

Schedule Flexibility: Ability and willingness to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to support continuous news operations.

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & EDUCATION

Physical Demands: Ability to stand, walk, reach, stoop, climb ladders, work behind equipment racks, and lift up to 50 lbs.

 

Education & Certifications: Technical degree in Electronics, IT, or equivalent military/trade experience. SBE, Cisco, CompTIA, or Microsoft certifications and AutoCAD experience are a plus.

job.title: Multi-Media Journalist
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX 5 Atlanta (WAGA-TV), the FOX-owned and operated station in Atlanta, GA, is seeking a versatile, driven Multi-Media Journalist (MMJ) to join our News team. Reporting to the Managing Editor, the Multi-Media Journalist shoots, gathers, edits, prepares, writes, and disseminates general news information and video across broadcast television, live streams, online platforms, and social media. This is an on-site, full-time position based at our Atlanta station, requiring flexibility for field assignments, overnight travel, and breaking news coverage.

 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Use contacts and sources to cultivate story ideas daily and actively participate in the news editorial planning process.
  • Produce and present extended live, unscripted content from the field for the station’s live stream, often working independently using a smartphone and related audio/video accessories.
  • Interview subjects in the field and gather news information to produce news reports and generate content for newscasts and digital platforms.
  • Shoot, write, and edit news packages for on-air and online use utilizing Sony camcorders (or similar) and Adobe Premiere Pro (or similar non-linear editing system).
  • Present stories live in studio and at remote locations, assuming full responsibility for final content and presentation.
  • Write effective text copy for digital publication of news stories on the station website.
  • Actively contribute to station social media accounts across platforms including X, Facebook, and Instagram.
  • Travel on overnight assignments and use file-based video systems to deliver material to the station via computer while on assignment.
  • Make occasional promotional appearances on behalf of the station while communicating clearly and dealing effectively and politely with the public in person, over the phone, and online.
  • Maintain operational agility by performing other duties as required to support evolving business priorities.

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Two (2) years of experience as a Multi-Media Journalist (MMJ) at a commercial television station.
  • Strong writing skills with proficiency in English grammar, spelling, and punctuation, and the ability to write conversational broadcast copy efficiently under daily deadline pressure.
  • Significant, current experience shooting and editing with Sony camcorders / ENG accessories and Adobe Premiere Pro (or similar non-linear editing system).
  • Proficiency with newsroom, digital, and broadcast production tools, including iNews (or similar NRCS), BitCentral, LU-Smart (or similar live broadcast smartphone app) with smartphone A/V accessories, bonded cellular transmission equipment, website Content Management Systems (CMS), Microsoft Office, and social media platforms (X, Facebook, Instagram).
  • Excellent on-camera delivery and communication skills.
  • Ability to make independent editorial decisions in the field.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and perform effectively under strict daily deadline pressure.
  • Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

 

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEAL BREAKER

Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university in Journalism, Broadcast Communications, or a related field.

 

WORKING CONDITIONS

This position operates both in the newsroom/studio and extensively in the field across varying outdoor weather and news environments, often working independently. The role requires travel on overnight assignments as well as schedule flexibility to cover breaking news, live events, evenings, weekends, or holidays as needed.

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear, and frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands and fingers, and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, or crouch, and must be able to lift and/or carry up to 40 pounds.

FOX Sports is looking to add a Sports Data & Metadata Engineer to bolster our AI Solutions team. The Sports Data & Metadata Engineer is responsible for cleaning and structuring both the proprietary data we already own and league data (Sports Radar, MLB BAM, etc.)so it can train models, power generative tools, and surface the right context at the right moment.


You’ll build the automated systems that pull our data out of scattered, non-integrated tools and into one place engineers and producers can actually rely on, and you’ll maintain the source of truth that feeds contextual information to our AI tools. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who knows both the data stack and the sports, and who understands that a stat is only useful if it arrives correct, fast, and in a shape a model can read.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Clean, structure, and normalize FOX Sports data, including player tracking, historical statistics, and sensor data, for model training and inference
  • Work with leagues, teams, and external data providers creating data workflows and processes
  • Work with data providers and league partners to integrate external feeds and resolve discrepancies against our own records
  • Build and maintain automated pipelines that ingest, validate, and reconcile data across FOX Sports systems
  • Develop an automated data management system that eliminates silos and consolidates fragmented, non-integrated architecture
  • Maintain the source of truth database that feeds contextual information to our AI tools
  • Design and document metadata schemas and taxonomies so sports content and data stay consistently machine-readable across platforms
  • Implement data quality monitoring, validation, and alerting so errors are caught before they reach a model or an audience
  • Partner with departments from around the company to understand how the data is actually used, and shape the schema around it

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, including production pipelines you built and maintained
  • Experience integrating third-party data feeds and reconciling conflicting sources
  • Experience designing schemas, taxonomies, and metadata models for large, messy datasets
  • Strong attention to detail and a low tolerance for silent data errors
  • Strong SQL and Python, with experience in modern data warehousing and orchestration tools
  • Familiarity with preparing data for machine learning, including feature pipelines and training datasets
  • Extensive knowledge of sports data: statistics, player tracking, and the context that makes a number meaningful
  • Ability to work nights and weekends, whenever sports are on the air

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $128,000.00-170,000.00 annually. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents. Benefits for Union represented employees will be in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Our Account Executive (Integrated Media Specialist) – sales role is a consultative, relationship-driven sales position for someone who loves owning the full sales cycle—from net-new prospecting through long-term account growth—and who thrives in both hunting and managing client relationships.

In this role, you will actively hunt for net-new business, while also managing, growing, and expanding an ongoing book of clients. You’ll create tailored marketing strategies, guide businesses from first conversation through ongoing performance discussions, and continually identify opportunities to deepen partnerships over time. You’ll act as a trusted marketing partner—not a transactional seller—balancing new business development with retention, upsell, and account expansion to drive long-term client value.

Our Account Executive - Integrated Media Specialist role is partnered with a post-sales team that manages campaign performance, optimizes results, and prepares reporting. Additional support resources are available, including the Data and Insights team, Client Strategists, and other product-specific resources.

In your first 90 days, you’ll gain confidence in LocaliQ’s solutions, tools, and sales approach while building meaningful prospecting and discovery habits. By the end of this period, you’ll be owning your territory and sales cycle end-to-end, with the support and coaching needed to set you up for long-term success.

What You Will Do

Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

Manage and grow a territory by balancing new business development, client retention, and account expansion.

Lead thoughtful discovery conversations to understand business goals, marketing challenges, and growth opportunities.

Build and present data-informed digital and traditional marketing proposals that connect strategy, tactics, and budget to client goals.

Own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through close—while maintaining accurate CRM activity, pipeline management, and forecasting.

Partner with internal account management, creative, and strategy teams to support strong client outcomes.

Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

Qualifications

2+ years of B2B sales experience with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles

Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.

Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

Comfort learning and discussing digital marketing solutions such as search, social, display, and video (direct experience is a plus, not required).

Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear data-driven recommendations.

Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot.

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance.

Who Thrives Here

High performers in this role are resilient, self-motivated, strategic and creative minded and competitive, with a strong drive to outperform and continuously take on greater impact. They are coachable and highly self-directed, comfortable initiating outreach, staying organized, asking thoughtful questions, and using data and tools to work efficiently. Energized by real-time results, they handle rejection well and maintain full ownership of their performance and trajectory.

Benefits

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

Competitive base salary + Uncapped commission opportunity

401(k) with company match

Career progression opportunities

Flexibility and autonomy in a hybrid/remote work environment

High-performance culture with recognition, incentives

Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays

Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast

Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

Access to industry-leading tools, resources, and marketing expertise

Step into a territory where you can own the full sales cycle, bring smart marketing solutions to the table, and be recognized for the results you deliver. If you’re ready to grow your career and be part of a high-performing team, we encourage you to apply.

The annualized base salary for this role will range between $60,000 and $65,000. $100,000-$108,333 OTE. Uncapped commission with accelerators. Variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, location, and union representation, if applicable.

job.title: Breaking News Reporter
job.description:
The Cincinnati Enquirer/cincinnati.com part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, is seeking a digital-first reporter to be part of the Breaking News team.

Job Details:

This reporter will be at the center of the region's biggest stories, from breaking crime and public safety news to severe weather. The reporter understands that breaking news is often the front door to deeper accountability and enterprise reporting.  A great breaking news reporter cuts through official-speak and lets the community know what’s happening clearly and concisely. We’re looking for a reporter who goes beyond standard press releases, digging into how and why things happen. Reporters on this team also pursue explainers, features and other enterprise stories that reflect life in Greater Cincinnati.  The position requires urgency, curiosity, accuracy and a willingness to chase news wherever it leads. It also demands strong news judgment and the ability to find and identify stories with impact and reflect the community through the inclusion of a variety of voices.

About The Enquirer:

The Enquirer, founded in 1851, serves communities in southwest Ohio and Northern Kentucky. With major league sports (go Bengals!), a blossoming food and craft beer scene, hundreds of parks, world-class performing arts and eight Fortune 500 companies, Cincinnati offers the amenities of a big city with the comfort and charm of a small town.

Responsibilities:

Monitor real-time news and sniff out stories that are important to our audiences.

Report quickly, clearly and accurately and deliver news via stories, video, newsletters, Facebook, X, Instagram, TikTok or any other methods available to reach our audience and develop new audiences.

Use metrics to inform story choices and shape beat strategies.

Work a schedule that may include nights, weekends and whenever news demands.

Work with editors to experiment with new ways of informing and engaging audiences on social platforms and through alternate story forms. This includes long-tail (evergreen) content.

Requirements:

Bachelor's or master’s in communications, journalism or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

2 + years of reporting experience, applicants with less experience and strong clips may be considered.

Proven ability to write on deadline.

Exceptional core journalism skills (reporter, producing, editing). Strong command of AP grammar and style.

Familiarity with public records and their use in reporting.

Self-motivation and self-direction.

Photo and video skills.

Effective communicator; able to get along with diverse personalities.

Knows how to use time effectively in a 24-hour news environment.

Works collaboratively within a cross-functional environment.

Must embrace peer-to-peer feedback and training.

Applies innovative, creative thinking to support the company's goals.

Industry knowledge.

Organizational skills.

Command of media law and Principles of Ethical Conduct.

This position sometimes requires employees to work extended hours, evening, weekends and holidays, sometimes unexpectedly.

This role requires a valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and the minimum liability insurance required by state law.

Employment is contingent on passing a post-offer pre-employment background check, motor vehicle record check.

job.description:
The Courier Journal/courier-journal.com, the leading news and information provider in Kentucky and part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, seeks an experienced digital producer who will be part of a team that helps manage the newspaper's digital content across a number of platforms to ensure our content is compelling and engaging for our audience. This person will be part of the team that plays a critical role in our goals to be urgent each day with news and information that is relevant and timely for our audience.

The successful candidate will have experience with audience metrics and the ability to write clear, accurate copy and social posts using AP style. Candidates must be detail-oriented and work well under pressure to meet demanding deadlines, as well as demonstrate an understanding of audience metrics and SEO with the goal of growing the audience.

The candidate must demonstrate strong news judgment to manage the website’s fronts, send alerts, write daily newsletters and serve as quality control on its content. The ideal candidate will be a strong collaborator who can work closely with reporters, content coaches and newsroom leadership.

The Courier Journal was awarded a 2020 Pulitzer Prize for its breaking news coverage. It’s a high-performing newsroom focused on meeting the demands of an engaged readership. Louisville has some of the highest-profile coverage opportunities in the country: national championship-caliber college basketball teams; SEC and ACC football; and the world-famous Kentucky Derby. Our coverage is built on digital storytelling and mobile consumption, which includes real-time reporting, smart analysis, video, deep storytelling and social engagement.

Responsibilities:

Edit, produce and publish content, optimizing for SEO and digital best practices.

Edit sensitive content for clarity, fairness, legal issues, spelling, grammar, punctuation and style.

Work with reporters and editors on projects to produce in-depth story packages.

Create engaging social media posts on all relevant platforms, editing video or creating graphics as needed.

Use metrics to determine traffic patterns and make changes tied to the data. Familiarity with Parse.ly and Google Analytics products is a plus.

Manage courier-journal.com home pages, programming desktop and mobile, and send alerts to engage a loyal audience.

Manage workflow to meet deadlines.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

1-3 years of experience working for a daily news organization.

Excellent news judgment.

Top-notch writing, editing and headline-writing skills.

Excellent communication skills.

Proven experience with advanced storytelling techniques on multiple platforms.

Effective communicator; able to get along with diverse personalities.

Able to multitask and excel under intense deadline pressure in a rapidly changing industry.

Ability to act calmly and decisively in complex breaking news situations.

Able to work early mornings, nights or weekends.

job.title: Daily news editor
job.description:
The Salem Statesman Journal and Eugene Register-Guard, the leading news organizations in Salem and Eugene, Oregon, part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, seek an energetic and collaborative editor to oversee breaking news and public safety, trending news and food and drink content.

You will identify and champion breaking news and exclusive storytelling in our markets and across Oregon and help reporters tell stories with speed and context through any medium to inform and inspire the public. You must possess sound skills in using metrics and analytics, social media and online tools to identify trending topics and be able to edit and produce multimedia content. Collaboration and clear communication with other editors, digital producers, and photographers is expected.

Our ideal candidate has a proven record of identifying breaking and trending news, driving engagement and growing audience, and is comfortable leading coverage on topics including public safety, courts and criminal justice, local government, wildfires, extreme weather and news of the day. Excellent news judgment and organizational skills, the ability to supervise quick-turn daily coverage and pivot as news happens is essential. A strong understanding of Oregon public records and open meeting laws as well as the legal system and law enforcement is required.

This editor will be adept at coaching and motivating journalists, helping them refine their reporting and writing, manage their beats and leverage multimedia storytelling to reach audiences wherever they are. Previous experience in government, crime, and public safety coverage is highly valued.

Salem and Eugene are located in the Willamette Valley, famed for its agriculture and hundreds of vineyards and wineries. The cities are situated between the Oregon Coast and Cascade Mountain ranges and are known for their vibrant food and drink scene, arts and culture as well as outdoor recreation and sports.Responsibilities

Lead breaking news and public safety coverage in Salem and support Eugene as news demands.

Develop and oversee trending and service journalism that delivers timely, useful information to diverse audiences in both markets.

Edit food and drink coverage in Salem and Eugene with a focus on utility and service journalism, exclusive stories and multimedia content.

Mentor seasonal interns across beats with a focus on breaking, trending and service journalism and exclusive storytelling.

Drive innovative storytelling in all formats—written, video, audio, and graphics—to enhance multimedia engagement.

Identify and fulfill training needs to support dynamic, multimedia-focused newsrooms.

Supervise simultaneous production of print and digital news products with emphasis on immediacy and relevance.

Collaborate with editors across the USA TODAY Network on best practices and regional multi-site initiatives.

Be available to work evenings and weekends to ensure around-the-clock coverage of critical news developments.

Requirements

Bachelor's or master’s degree in communications, journalism or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Minimum 5 years of journalism experience, with at least 2 years in newsroom editing and leadership roles.

Command of media law, libel law, open records law, and ethical standards.

Strong planning and organizational skills, and a proven ability to lead teams in delivering urgent, high-impact news coverage.

Expertise in managing multiple tasks and balancing daily news demands with long-term strategic audience growth.

Ability to make complex stories accessible, with a keen sense for identifying and communicating urgent local issues.

Experience in harnessing public records and data to inform coverage and answer community questions.

Advanced storytelling skills with emphasis on multimedia engagement.

Expert knowledge of audience metrics, social media, and SEO principles for maximizing reach and engagement.

Self-motivation and self-direction and ability to adapt to the evolving needs of a modern newsroom.

Mastery of writing, spelling, grammar, AP and local style.

Able to multitask and excel under the pressures of rapid, deadline-driven coverage.

Understanding of the changing media landscape and a strategic approach to audience and market needs.

Strong competitive instincts, intellectual curiosity, and commitment to public service journalism.

Ability to manage and motivate high-performing teams.

Knowledge of Salem, Eugene and Oregon communities is a plus.

This senior newsroom leader will be responsible for audience growth, digital innovation, platform strategy and newsroom transformation across freep.com, search, social media, newsletters, video, emerging platforms and AI-powered tools. The Digital Director will oversee the digital team, partner closely with newsroom leadership and help ensure that Detroit Free Press journalism reaches the largest possible audience while driving loyalty, engagement and subscriptions.

The ideal candidate is a strategic, forward-thinking newsroom leader with a deep understanding of audience behavior, digital publishing, analytics and emerging technologies. They are passionate about local journalism and understand how to balance editorial excellence with audience needs. They are equally comfortable leading major newsroom initiatives, analyzing performance data, experimenting with new products and coaching journalists to succeed in an increasingly digital and AI-driven media landscape.

The Digital Director will play a critical role in ensuring the Detroit Free Press remains the leading source of trusted journalism in the region by continuously improving how we discover, package, distribute and engage audiences with our work.

This role reports to the executive editor and serves as a key member of the newsroom leadership team.

Monitor audience, platform and technology trends and translate insights into actionable newsroom strategies.

Oversee daily digital publishing operations, story presentation and audience-focused coverage planning.

Lead audience development efforts around major news events, breaking news and enterprise journalism.

Help newsroom staff build digital, audience and AI-related skills through coaching, training and professional development.

Define and execute the vision, product strategy, and roadmap for audience capabilities.

Build differentiated products using first-party, behavioral, contextual, geographic, and advertiser-permissioned data.

Create packaging, activation, pricing, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

job.title: Enterprise Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive - Performance Marketing – Outside Sales

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network Location: USA Remote with some travel

Why This Role Stands Out:

Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and strong earning potential Visibility, recognition, and growth opportunities within a performance‑driven, enterprise sales environment

Access to the full USA TODAY Network + additional partners—860+ markets, trusted media assets, and subscriber‑based audiences at scale

True ownership of enterprise relationships with the autonomy to build and grow a national book of business

Remote flexibility with autonomy to manage your schedule and territory with some travel

Structured onboarding, coaching, and sales support to help you ramp quickly

Career Development – Clear paths to career advancement, mentor programs, and tools to manage your long-term career.

Backed by marketing expertise, post‑sale specialists, and industry‑leading tool

About LocaliQ:

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role:

This is an enterprise-level role focused on C-suite conversations rather than local business owners. PIQ is a performance-based marketing program that converts print advertising space into marketing opportunities on a revenue-share, cost-per-acquisition, or cost-per-lead model. The PIQ Account Executive tells an enterprise story about partnership relationships—not transactional relationships—leveraging USA TODAY’s entire asset base to partner with national and regional clients. The role aligns with national sales efforts and one-to-many programs, focusing on enterprise-level relationships that allow the company to leverage its full scale.

In your first 90 days, you’ll ramp into the PIQ enterprise story—gaining a deep understanding of our performance-based model, how we partner with C-suite leaders, and how our national scale creates value for enterprise clients. As you progress, you’ll begin building and advancing a strong enterprise pipeline while establishing core sales rhythms and collaborating closely with internal strategists. By the end of this period, you’ll be confidently owning enterprise opportunities and leading complex, high-impact deals with support from a seasoned cross-functional team.

What You Will Do:

Generate a sales pipeline through self-directed prospecting using ZoomInfo, LinkedIn, attendance at vertical-specific expos, referrals from existing clients, and AI tools for finding leads and building outreach strategies.

Qualify and pursue enterprise level opportunities—focus on prospects capable of $150,000+ deals selling to C-suite and marketing directors at regional, state, and national level.

Deliver the PIQ value proposition—one-to-one exclusive leads to subscriber-based audience, with high frequency exposure through trusted USA TODAY content, and scale across 860 markets/publications.

Collaborate with strategists on proposals for deals exceeding $150,000; quarterback internal resources to design, build, and deliver campaigns.

Manage and grow existing accounts; maintain weekly client touchpoints to drive retention and expansion.

Lead cross-functional delivery—delegate effectively, maintain quality control, run pod cadences, and own outcomes while leveraging specialist expertise

Track performance data—monitor campaign metrics, set clear expectations, review performance regularly, address issues early, and resolve problems through appropriate specialists.

Maintain client data in Salesforce—log activities, track pipeline, and forecast accurately.

Qualifications:

5+ years’ proven track record of success in B2B sales, with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles, selling to the C-suite or marketing director level on deals that exceed $150K+

Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.

Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity.

Digital acumen—understanding of digital marketing landscape and performance-based marketing models.

Data-minded, able to understand tracking, performance metrics for client campaigns and developing strategies from that data.

Experience working with agencies and understanding agency operations and relationships.

Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders.

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

Who Thrives Here:

You’ll thrive here as a self‑motivated, competitive, and consultative seller who owns a book of business, creates opportunities, and confidently leads complex deals. Top performers are data‑driven, resilient, and results‑focused—energized by real‑time performance metrics and rankings, motivated by commission upside, and accountable for outcomes. They consistently outperform peers, earn expanded roles or territories, and effectively quarterback internal teams to deliver measurable client impact.

Benefits:

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

Competitive base salary + uncapped commission opportunity

401(k) with company match

Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays

Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast

Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

Flexibility and Autonomy: remote work environment

Access to industry-leading tools, resources and marketing expertise

Career development opportunities

High-performance culture with recognition, incentives, and contests

#LI-REMOTE#LOCALiQ

If you’re energized by enterprise level selling, motivated by performance and ownership, and ready to build something meaningful at scale, this role was designed for you. Apply now to bring your expertise, ambition, and curiosity to PIQ—and be part of a high‑impact team shaping the future of performance marketing.
