The Columbus Dispatch seeks an investigative/enterprise reporter who uses AI, public records, open-source information and large datasets to find patterns and stories that would be very hard to uncover by hand. This position based in central Ohio is a one-year grant-funded fellowship.

The best candidate has a deep curiosity and unrelenting commitment to get to the bottom of an issue, hold individuals and institutions accountable, and identify solutions. Growth and development, data centers, economic and social disparity, affordable housing, and traffic are among key coverage topics.

This reporter must be proficient in using AI to speed up reporting and other manual processes, creating time and space for more shoe-leather journalism and audience engagement.

We’re also looking for a reporter who is comfortable with ambitious enterprise, text and video coverage, including on-camera video.

What you’ll do:

Find stories in records, court filings, datasets and open-source information across central Ohio.

Use AI to extract, sort and review large document sets and datasets.

Verify digital and open-source material.

Turn promising signals into publishable journalism, confirmed through traditional sourcing and interviews.

Work alongside our journalists, following your own news judgment, to produce exclusive and distinctive stories for our audience.

Bachelor's or master’s in communications, journalism or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

5+ years of news reporting experience.

Strong reporting, writing, editing and storytelling skills.

Experience with practical use of AI in reporting and research.

Prefer experience with OSINT and digital verification.

Comfort analyzing large document sets and datasets.

Scripting (Python or similar) a plus.

Experience creating digital-first content, including video and social media storytelling.

Strong copy editing and self-editing skills.

Strong understanding of audience analytics, SEO and engagement strategies.

Ability to work independently, build trust with stakeholders and manage multiple deadlines.

job.title: High School Sports Reporter (Wilmington DE Guild)
job.description:
Inform readers, celebrate achievement and demand accountability.

We are seeking a High School Sports Reporter to help lead our coverage of local teams and athletes while becoming a prominent on-camera voice. The reporter will produce frequent field video and authoritative rankings of teams, players, games and performances that keep fans returning throughout the season. The role also includes breaking news, major events and distinctive enterprise reporting.

Video and high-interest rankings are central to the job. The reporter will create mobile-first updates, interviews, analysis and personality-driven features, along with recurring lists of top teams, players, games and performances. Other coverage will include daily stories, investigations, explainers, profiles, newsletters and service journalism—all designed to build readership and subscriptions.

What you’ll do:

Partner with our current high school reporter to own the high school sports beat by developing deep knowledge of local teams, athletes, coaches, athletic directors and governing organizations.

Shoot and edit vertical video, conduct interviews and become a recognizable on-camera personality who can host and analyze high school sports coverage.

Break news with urgency and accuracy, including off-field developments, policy changes and other issues affecting student-athletes and school communities.

Publish a regular cadence of authoritative rankings and compelling lists of teams, players, games, matchups and standout performances, backed by clear reporting and analysis. Add timely previews, profiles, trend and investigative stories, reader polls and postseason honors.

Build and maintain a diverse network of sources and consistently identify distinctive stories that competitors do not have.

Use newsletters, social platforms, audience data, reader feedback and verified real-time reporting to strengthen engagement, reach new readers and convert loyal audiences into subscribers.

Work independently on deadline and collaborate closely with editors, photographers and other journalists to set priorities and coordinate coverage.

Pitch ambitious enterprise and accountability stories that examine trends, decisions and institutions influencing high school sports.

What you’ll need:

A bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

At least two years of journalism experience, with demonstrated reporting and writing ability; sports reporting experience is preferred.

Strong news judgment, high ethical standards and a proven ability to source, report and break news.

Clear, engaging writing and the ability to deliver accurate work on tight deadlines.

Demonstrated video production skills, including shooting and editing, plus the confidence and presence to appear regularly on camera and build a credible, engaging connection with viewers.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance breaking news, daily assignments and longer-term projects.

Experience building and engaging digital audiences, using metrics, emerging tools and responsible applications of artificial intelligence to improve reporting, presentation and reach.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, along with the initiative to work independently.

A commitment to inclusive sourcing and coverage that reflects the breadth of the communities we serve.

Work requirements:

This position requires regular night and weekend work based on the sports calendar, as well as travel to games, practices, interviews and other assignments. Reliable transportation is required. The reporter must be comfortable working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and adjusting coverage plans as news develops.

job.description:
Remote Account Manager/Sales – Inside Sales & Advertising

Remote | Existing Account Management | Customer Retention & New Business

Company: LocaliQ, powered by USA TODAY Co.Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)Start Date: January 11, 2027

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by combining trusted local media, advanced marketing technology, and expert guidance to deliver measurable results. From digital advertising solutions to the reach of the USA TODAY Network, we help businesses connect with the right customers and grow with confidence.

As an Account Manager, you'll play an important role in helping local businesses succeed by building lasting customer relationships, maintaining existing advertising accounts, and identifying opportunities to expand their advertising reach.

About the Role

We're looking for a motivated, customer-focused sales professional who enjoys building relationships, managing an established book of business, and working in a fast-paced, high-activity sales environment.

This position is primarily focused on managing and retaining existing customer accounts (approximately 80% of your time), with the remaining 20% dedicated to new business development. You'll work with an assigned portfolio of customers, primarily supporting basic classified advertising needs, while ensuring accounts remain active, customers receive consistent communication, and opportunities for additional business are identified.

This is a phone-driven role that requires consistent daily outreach, strong follow-up habits, and the ability to manage multiple customer conversations throughout the day. While much of your focus will be on maintaining existing relationships, you'll also be expected to prospect for new business when opportunities arise.

During your first 90 days, you'll learn LocaliQ's products, advertising processes, and technology while developing the skills needed to confidently manage your assigned accounts. With structured onboarding, ongoing coaching, and support, you'll build a strong foundation for long-term success.

Why This Role Stands Out

Base salary of $40,000 plus uncapped commission, with first-year on-target earnings of $55,000–$60,000

Three-month commission guarantee to support your onboarding and ramp

Established book of business with a primary focus on customer retention and relationship management

Opportunity to identify additional revenue through upselling, account growth, and new business development

100% remote work arrangement with a dedicated home workstation

Ongoing sales training, coaching, and professional development

Recognition programs, contests, and performance incentives

Opportunity to build a long-term career with one of the nation's most trusted media organizations

Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, and more

What You Will Do

Manage an assigned portfolio of existing advertising customers, focusing primarily on account retention, satisfaction, and long-term relationships.

Maintain consistent communication with customers through a high volume of outbound and inbound calls, averaging 50+ calls per day.

Identify opportunities to retain customers, address concerns, and prevent account cancellations.

Recommend relevant advertising solutions and additional services based on customer needs.

Generate new business through outbound prospecting and follow-up when opportunities arise.

Manage short, transactional sales conversations with a focus on responsiveness, accuracy, and customer experience.

Process advertising orders, campaign updates, and customer requests efficiently.

Maintain accurate CRM activity, account information, and pipeline documentation using Salesforce and other sales tools.

Balance account management, prospecting, administrative responsibilities, and customer follow-up throughout the workday.

Partner with internal support teams to ensure a positive customer experience and successful advertising execution.

Qualifications

Previous experience in inside sales, account management, customer retention, advertising sales, or business development preferred.

Experience managing customer relationships or an established book of business is a plus.

Comfortable making 50+ outbound and inbound calls per day in a high-activity, metrics-driven environment.

Confident communicating with customers, identifying needs, handling objections, and recommending solutions.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, conversations, and follow-up activities.

Comfortable balancing customer retention responsibilities with occasional new business prospecting.

Ability to work independently while remaining accountable to daily activity and performance expectations.

Comfortable learning CRM platforms, sales technology, and multiple internal systems.

Experience with Salesforce or other CRM platforms is preferred but not required.

Who Thrives Here

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys the relationship side of sales just as much as the opportunity to generate revenue. They're comfortable managing an established customer base, making consistent outbound calls, following up on opportunities, and finding ways to keep customers engaged and satisfied.

Successful Account Managers are proactive, organized, resilient, and motivated by results. They understand that retaining customers requires consistent communication, strong follow-through, and the ability to recognize opportunities before they are missed.

Candidates with backgrounds in high-volume inside sales, advertising sales, customer retention, or account management environments will be particularly well-suited for this role. Experience in transactional, phone-based sales organizations is especially valuable.

This is not a passive account management position. While the primary focus is on maintaining and growing existing relationships, success requires a willingness to make calls, manage activity expectations, and pursue new business when needed.

Remote Work Expectations

This is a fully remote position, with the expectation that employees work from their assigned, dedicated home workstation throughout their scheduled workday.

Employees must:

Perform their work from their designated home workstation using company-issued equipment.

Remain at their assigned workstation and be available throughout scheduled working hours.

Use company-approved systems and technology to perform their job responsibilities.

Maintain a consistent, professional, and productive remote work environment.

This position does not offer a work-from-anywhere arrangement. Working from alternate locations, using personal devices in place of company-issued equipment, or downloading unauthorized applications onto personal devices is not permitted.

Benefits

We believe great performance deserves meaningful rewards, career development, and opportunities for growth.

Base salary plus uncapped commission

Three-month commission guarantee

Fully remote work environment

Career advancement opportunities

Medical, dental, and vision insurance

401(k) with company match

Generous paid time off and paid holidays

Ongoing onboarding, training, and coaching

High-performance culture with recognition and incentive programs

Access to industry-leading marketing solutions and sales technology

Interested in building customer relationships, growing accounts, and making an impact in a fast-paced sales environment? Apply today!

Deliver a strong client experience from the initial conversation through ongoing partnership

Track activity, opportunities, pipeline, and performance using Salesforce

Consistently work toward and exceed sales and activity goals

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree OR 2+ years of inside sales experience, with B2B sales preferred

Strong prospecting and cold-calling skills with confidence initiating conversations with new prospects

Ability to uncover client needs and recommend consultative, solution-based offerings

Strong communication, relationship-building, and closing skills

Comfortable working toward sales goals in a performance-driven environment

Experience with digital marketing or recruitment is a plus

Tech-savvy with experience using Salesforce or another CRM

Competitive, resilient, self-motivated, and highly organized

Strong follow-through and ability to manage multiple opportunities

Team-oriented and comfortable balancing individual accountability with collaboration

Who Thrives Here

The people who succeed in this role are competitive, resilient, curious, and motivated by results. They aren't afraid to pick up the phone, start conversations with new businesses, and work through rejection to find the next opportunity.

You’ll thrive if you enjoy building relationships, asking thoughtful questions, solving business challenges, and seeing your effort translate into results.

You’ll also have the support of a collaborative team. While you’ll own your pipeline and performance, you’ll work closely with Client Success Managers and other internal partners to create strong experiences for your clients.

What Success Looks Like

First 3 Months:Complete immersive onboarding, build your product and recruitment marketing knowledge, develop strong prospecting habits, and begin building a healthy pipeline.

6 Months:Consistently prospect, manage a growing book of business, conduct confident consultative sales conversations, and establish steady performance against revenue goals.

12 Months:Own your sales cycle with confidence, consistently deliver against quota, grow existing client relationships, and identify opportunities to expand your book of business.

Benefits & Growth

We believe strong performance should be supported with competitive compensation, development opportunities, and the tools needed to build a successful career.

$41,000 base salary + uncapped commission

$55K–$60K OTE

401(k)

Medical, dental, and vision coverage

PTO and floating holidays

8 paid holidays

Four-week immersive onboarding program

Ongoing training and digital skills development

Career growth and advancement opportunities

Collaborative team environment with strong leadership support

Help Businesses Find the People They Need

Businesses can’t grow without great people. In this role, you’ll help them solve that challenge while building valuable sales, marketing, and recruitment expertise of your own.

If you’re ready to build relationships, close deals, help businesses hire great talent, and be rewarded for your results, we encourage you to apply.

The hourly rate for this role will range between $12.55 and $19.24. Base compensation is reflective of multiple factors, including market location, education level, skills, certifications, and experience. Variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and may apply based on the role.

job.title: Press Operator I
job.description:
PRESS OPERATOR I

Gannett Publishing Services/USA TODAY CO

Des Moines, IA

The Press Operator I is assigned to perform printing related tasks to support efficient press operations as needed to achieve and maintain on-time production, product quality standards, low waste, and operational safety.

Pressroom Tasks

Communications

Other duties as assigned

job.title: Video Producer
job.description:
USA TODAY Co. is seeking a detail-oriented, platform-native video producer to expand video support for local USA TODAY Network newsrooms. This full-time role will use strong editorial judgment and AI-assisted production workflows to turn local reporting, photos, data and graphics into timely, accurate and engaging short-form video.

The producer will work directly with local reporters, editors and newsroom leaders to identify stories that can reach broader audiences through video. Coverage will span the range of local journalism, including breaking news, public safety, weather, government, education, business, consumer issues, community stories, major local events and other topics important to individual markets. This is a hands-on production and service role focused on helping local newsrooms publish more video efficiently across owned and social platforms.

What you’ll do:

Serve as a dedicated video production resource for local USA TODAY Network newsrooms, supporting market needs and network-wide local coverage priorities.

Use AI-assisted platforms, including Stringr, along with templates, automation and editing tools to produce a high volume of accurate, on-brand video from local reporting, photos, data, graphics, user-generated content and newsroom briefs.

Use Stringr AI UGC production capabilities to help local newsrooms identify and develop relevant user-generated content into publishable video while following verification, sourcing, rights and editorial standards.

Use Stringr Clip Gen to create timely clips and short-form video from press conferences, public meetings, interviews, podcasts and other longer recordings.

Use Stringr Show Stacker and other AI-assisted long-form production tools to assemble structured video from local programs, interviews, recurring shows and extended newsroom content.

Partner with local reporters, editors and newsroom leaders to identify stories with strong visual, audience and distribution potential.

Respond quickly to local breaking news and major developing stories while also supporting planned enterprise, service and community coverage.

Create useful explainers that make complex local topics clear, accessible and relevant to the communities our newsrooms serve.

Turn newsroom briefs and published stories into clear video treatments, selecting effective visuals, scripts, on-screen text, audio, pacing and formats.

Adapt local journalism into platform-native vertical video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, YouTube Shorts and other platforms.

Repurpose AI-assisted and automated content for owned-and-operated and social platforms, tailoring each version to the audience, market and platform.

Optimize video length, aspect ratio, captions, headlines, thumbnails, metadata and calls to action using platform best practices and performance insights.

Program videos on corresponding local articles and support distribution workflows that increase the reach and value of local journalism.

Manage and prioritize requests from multiple newsrooms, communicate progress and blockers, and balance planned work with urgent coverage needs.

Maintain editorial, legal, brand and visual standards, including accuracy, sourcing, attribution, captions, fonts, colors and overall presentation.

Track core performance metrics, identify successful local formats and topics, and share repeatable lessons with newsroom and video partners.

Test emerging AI and automation capabilities responsibly, helping improve templates, workflows and production standards for local newsroom use.

Review videos produced by others for quality and accuracy and provide feedback

What success looks like:

Local newsrooms receive reliable, timely video support across a broad range of coverage needs.

More high-priority local stories include relevant video on owned and social platforms.

Story-to-video turnaround improves, particularly during breaking news and other time-sensitive coverage.

Produced videos meet high standards for accuracy, clarity, audience value and brand consistency.

Local newsroom partners have clear visibility into priorities, progress and production capacity.

Strong formats and workflows are identified, documented and applied across additional USA TODAY Network markets.

AI-assisted tools and automation improve production efficiency while preserving editorial judgment and quality.

Who you are:

A digital-first journalist or producer who understands the role video can play in extending the reach and impact of local journalism.

A strong editor with sound news judgment, a sharp eye for visuals and the ability to identify the clearest audience takeaway from a story.

Comfortable producing quick-turn, high-volume video without sacrificing accuracy, quality or brand standards.

Able to move between breaking news, service journalism, enterprise reporting and community stories based on newsroom needs.

Highly organized and able to manage requests from multiple markets, changing priorities and deadline pressure in a remote environment.

A clear, responsive and collaborative partner who can work effectively with local reporters, editors, newsroom leaders and centralized video teams.

Curious and adaptable, with a practical interest in AI, automation and new approaches to newsroom production.

Committed to journalistic ethics, accuracy, fairness, transparency and responsible use of emerging technology.

Qualifications:

2-5 years Professional experience in digital journalism, video production, social video or a related field.

Demonstrated video editing experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, mobile editing applications or comparable tools.

Experience creating and publishing video for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube.

Strong writing and editing skills, including the ability to create concise scripts, captions, headlines and on-screen text.

Ability to work independently, make sound editorial decisions on deadline and collaborate across newsrooms and time zones.

Experience working with local newsrooms or producing video from local reporting is preferred.

Experience with AI-assisted production platforms, including Stringr or comparable tools, template-driven workflows, content-management systems or publishing tools is preferred.

How To Apply:

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, put together a single document file that includes the following, in this order:

Your resume – one to two pages.

A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

Links to 3-6 online samples of your work. Show us what you’ve produced or had a hand in that best reflects what you can do in your desired role.

It is important that these items be assembled into a single document and uploaded in PDF format. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

job.title: Producer - Newsradio 620 WTMJ
job.description:
Newsradio 620 WTMJ Producer

(Milwaukee, WI)

As Wisconsin's heritage news-talk station, Newsradio 620 WTMJ is seeking a full-time producer to produce live, local news and sports programming. The primary responsibilities of this role include producing Wisconsin’s Midday News, working with on-air hosts on content planning and execution, running the board for drive-time shows, supporting the Content Director with show production and log fulfillment, collaborating with other show producers to share news, ideas, and audio, working with marketing/promotions on contesting and sponsorships, and assisting engineers in ensuring the station operates within FCC guidelines and remains on-the-air.

The ideal candidate will have a passion for local and national news, politics and sports, along with previous experience behind the scenes producing for a news-talk format while being proactive and energetic about growing the show both on-air and online and helping Wisconsin’s Midday News reach new heights.

Career responsibilities include but are not limited to: 

  • Produce Wisconsin's Midday News on WTMJ from 12 p.m. to 3 p.m., Monday through Friday.
  • Maintain an understanding of and interest in the daily news cycle.
  • Work with on-air hosts to develop daily content plans and social media strategies.
  • Source potential contributors and interviewees.
  • Post on social media about the show, including stories, interviews, and podcasts.
  • Convert text, graphics, video, and audio files for all digital platforms.
  • Create daily audio and video content.
  • Contribute to and make use of archived audio files and sources for content segments.
  • Respond to audience feedback and refer matters to other departments as necessary.
  • Demonstrate proficiency with editing software such as Adobe Audition and Adobe Premiere Pro for production purposes.
  • Utilize AI tools to support news research, content development, editing, and distribution while maintaining accuracy, authenticity, and editorial judgment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Represent Good Karma Sports as an ambassador of the company’s core values: Listen, Be Honest, Follow Through, Work Hard, Teamwork, and Over Deliver.

Preferred knowledge, skills and qualifications:

  • Previous experience producing news-talk programming, working in a newsroom, or working in television news.
  • A passion for local news and covering impactful stories.
  • An understanding of the daily news cycle and current events.
  • A desire to be part of a team and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Personal sense of responsibility and accountability.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Willingness to accept and provide feedback.
  • Valid driver’s license required.

Hours/Salary/Benefits

job.title: Developer, Audience Engagement
job.description:
Graham Media Group November 10, 2026 Developer, Audience Engagement Graham Media Group November 10, 2026

Reports to: Director of Transformation

Work location: Detroit, MI (on-site)

Description

We are seeking a developer who puts the audience first. You will join the team that builds the websites and apps for our local news stations in Detroit, Houston, San Antonio, Orlando, Jacksonville and Roanoke. In 2027 our focus is engagement: helping people connect with their local news and with each other and giving them reasons to come back.

You will listen to our audiences through surveys, comments and community spaces, and turn what they tell us into experiences that fit them. You will connect survey answers to real, activated audiences: newsletters, alerts and pages our newsrooms use, and first-party audiences our advertising team offers to local businesses. Then you will help both teams plan how each launch reaches the people it is for.

This is a technical role for someone who wants their work used. You will ship, watch real people use what you built, hear what they think, and make it better. You take pride in using modern tools, including AI coding agents you set up and run yourself, to move fast and build with care.

Responsibilities

  • Own an audience product of your own, live with at least one of our stations within your first 90 days.

  • Turn survey answers into first-party audiences that refresh on their own, with consent recorded, and that our newsroom and advertising teams both put to work.

  • Plan each launch with our editorial and advertising teams: who it serves, how stations use it and how sellers explain it.

  • Grow the number of people who come back: return visitors, email and push subscribers, and contributors.

  • Ship steadily. Take small features from ideas to live in two weeks or less. Set a success metric up front and report the results afterward

  • Actively listen to our users and station partners, translating their real-world feedback into meaningful product changes.

  • Share the AI agent workflows and guidelines that work well, so everyone on the team can use them.

  • Adhere to privacy and security rules with every release; treat both as requirements from the start, not checks at the end.

Requirements

  • Proven track record of shipping production-ready web or mobile app features that real people use.

  • Fluency in TypeScript or JavaScript, React or a similar framework, and Node. Comfort across the stack: interface, APIs, data and deployment.

  • Experience with audience data: SQL, event tracking and survey data, and turning raw responses into segments someone can use.

  • Strong proficiency with modern AI development tools. You have set up and run your own coding agents, and you review and test everything they write.

  • Git, code review, CI/CD, testing and feature flags as everyday habits.

  • A habit of measuring what you ship. You define the metric before you build and read the results honestly, including the misses.

  • Sound privacy judgment and working knowledge of web security: consent, common attacks and how to prevent them, and recently announced exploits and their fixes.

  • An audience-first mindset. You start from the person using the product, seek out feedback after launch and welcome it.

  • A clear bias toward shipping: you would rather release a good v1 and iterate than polish something indefinitely before users ever see it.

  • Ownership. You see a project from idea to production and beyond, and you fix problems before anyone reports them.

  • Clear communication with newsroom, sales and product partners, and a willingness to share what you learn.

  • Experience with survey tools, audience platforms such as Google Ad Manager audiences or Braze, or mobile apps in Flutter or React Native is a plus.

Graham Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. In addition to complying with the requirements of federal law, GMG will comply with applicable state and local laws prohibiting employment discrimination. Any offer of employment is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment drug screening, investigative background check, employment/education verifications and reference checks.

Please submit your resume along with a link to a live web or app feature you have shipped to real users to mnewman@grahammedia.com

job.title: Director of Sales Enablement & Development
job.description:
Graham Media Group November 9, 2026 Director of Sales Enablement & Development Graham Media Group November 9, 2026

Reports to: Sr. Director, of Sales

Work location: Detroit, MI

Description

The Director of Sales Enablement & Development leads Graham Media Group’s enterprise-wide strategy for sales training, onboarding, leadership development, and performance excellence. Serving as the sales organization’s center of excellence for learning and talent development, this role ensures Account Executives, Sales Managers, and emerging leaders have the skills and resources to drive revenue growth and strong client outcomes.

The incumbent owns the full learning ecosystem for sales positions within Graham Media Group including onboarding, manager development, certifications, sales specific LMS strategy, sales playbooks, and go-to-market readiness. They partner with Sales Leadership, Digital, Product, and HR teams to build a culture of continuous learning, accountability, and career growth. They also help advance the company’s multi-platform evolution by equipping sellers to position integrated broadcast, streaming, digital, social, sponsorship, data, and emerging advertising solutions.

Success is measured by onboarding effectiveness, retention, manager readiness, seller productivity, leadership bench strength, training engagement, and adoption of strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Organization Learning & Development Strategy

  • Develop and lead the company’s enterprise sales learning and development strategy to support engagement, retention, and career growth for those in sales positions.

  • In close partnership with HR, develop competency models, career development pathways, and learning frameworks for both independent contributor and manager-level sales roles.

  • Partner with Human Resources and Sales Leadership to identify talent gaps and create development solutions that strengthen organizational capability.

  • Create and maintain succession development programs that cultivate future leaders across the organization.

  • Develop and deliver leadership training programs for sales managers and emerging leaders.

  • Equip sales managers with tools and resources to effectively lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams.

  • Create sales leadership certification pathways that strengthen management effectiveness and organizational leadership capability.

  • Continuously evolve the LMS to support hybrid learning, self-paced education, manager coaching, and performance development initiatives for sales positions.

  • Lead the expansion, maintenance, and governance of a centralized learning library that houses onboarding materials, sales certifications, product training, leadership development programs, best practices, and professional development resources.

  • Develop and execute the strategy for the asynchronous learning & development for sales positions via the learning management system.

  • Develop reporting and analytics to track participation, certifications, completion rates, learning effectiveness, and business impact.

  • Establish sales training standards and certification requirements for sales positions across the organization.

Sales Onboarding & Readiness

  • Responsible for owning and enhancing onboarding programs for sales roles across the company.

  • Design, document, and implement structured 30-, 60-, 90-, and 180-day onboarding and development plans.

  • Create sales certification programs that ensure new hires demonstrate readiness in core sales competencies, products, tools, platforms, and company processes.

  • Partner with market sales leadership to accelerate ramp time and improve new hire retention and long-term success.

  • Design and lead comprehensive sales enablement programs that improve seller effectiveness across prospecting, consultative selling, account growth, client retention, negotiation, presentation skills, pipeline development, forecasting, and strategic account management.

  • Build and maintain sales playbooks, enablement resources, talk tracks, case studies, customer success stories, and best practices.

  • Deliver ongoing sales skills training aligned with evolving market conditions, customer needs, and company priorities.

  • Develop role-based learning journeys that support career progression and continuous improvement.

Multi-Platform Sales Growth & Go-to-Market Enablement

  • Create training and go-to-market programs that strengthen sales capabilities across broadcast television, streaming, CTV, OTT, digital marketing services, social media, sponsorships, audience targeting, data solutions, and emerging products.

  • Partner with various teams in the sales and digital organizations to create launch materials, positioning, competitive intelligence, and sales narratives.

  • Develop executive-level sales presentations, customer-facing materials, and enablement resources supporting new revenue opportunities.

  • Ensure every strategic initiative includes consistent training and adoption plan across all markets.

Sales Performance & Process Excellence

  • Partner with market sales leadership to identify skill gaps and development opportunities.

  • Drive adoption of sales methodologies, CRM best practices, pipeline management disciplines, forecasting standards, and account growth strategies.

  • Measure and communicate the business impact of learning and enablement initiatives.

AI, Technology & Future Readiness

  • Serve as organizational leader for AI-enabled selling, productivity, and learning.

  • Deliver training focused on Spark, AI-assisted prospecting, proposal generation, client research, presentation development, and workflow automation.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and learning solutions that increase productivity and seller performance.

  • Ensure the organization remains at the forefront of modern sales enablement and learning practices.

Qualifications

Required

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in sales leadership, sales enablement, learning and development, organizational development, sales training, or performance coaching.

  • Demonstrated success building enterprise onboarding, training, and enablement programs.

  • Experience leading learning management systems, certification programs, and talent development initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of consultative selling, media sales, digital advertising, and multi-platform revenue strategies.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Copilot, PowerPoint, Excel, Teams, and SharePoint.

  • Strong CRM expertise, including pipeline management, forecasting, reporting, adoption, and sales analytics.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

  • Exceptional facilitation, presentation, communication, and leadership skills.

Preferred

  • Media industry sales leadership experience.

  • Experience supporting multi-market organizations.

  • Sales methodology certifications (Miller Heiman, Challenger, Sandler, Strategic Selling, SPIN, or comparable programs).

  • Experience implementing or managing an LMS platform.

  • Background in organizational development, learning strategy, or talent management.

  • Experience leading large-scale change management and transformation initiatives.

job.description:
Graham Media Group November 19, 2026 HR Generalist Graham Media Group November 19, 2026

Reporting to the HR Director and supporting employees in the Texas region, currently KSAT-TV (San Antonio) and KPRC-TV (Houston), the HR Generalist is the first point of contact for HR in the assigned region. This role owns tier 1 employee support, onboarding and offboarding, HR transactions, and compliance tracking and audits for the assigned stations. The HR Generalist partners closely with the HR Business Partner assigned to the region, who leads employee relations, investigations and strategic work, and delivers a positive employee experience grounded in our values of Integrity, Teamwork, Innovation and Passion.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Tier 1 employee and manager support

  • Serve as the first point of contact for HR questions from employees and managers at the assigned stations, with a strong commitment to internal customer service

  • Answer questions on policies, procedures and HR processes; guide employees to Workday self-service

  • Recognize issues that need judgment or carry risk, take intake and documentation, and escalate promptly to the HR Business Partner assigned to the region

Onboarding

  • Coordinate pre-hire activities, including background checks, drug testing and follow-up

  • Prepare new-hire documents, complete I-9 verification, and coordinate with local teams so equipment and workspace are ready on day one

  • Deliver orientation that introduces new employees to Graham Media Group and station culture, values, policies and procedures

  • Follow up with new employees and their managers after the first weeks to gather feedback and address issues

  • In the short term, support recruiting (job postings in line with internal policy and FCC/EEO guidelines, interview scheduling, offer letters) while recruiting moves to the Talent Acquisition team and Workday

Offboarding

  • Process resignations and terminations in Workday and coordinate with payroll, benefits and IT

  • Ensure required notices, final-pay handoffs and benefits paperwork, including COBRA, are completed on time

  • Coordinate and complete exit interviews

Benefits, leave and HR transactions

  • Serve as the local resource for health and welfare benefits questions; support new-hire enrollment and annual open enrollment, including employee information sessions/office hours

  • Administer FMLA, ADA and other leave programs, keeping timely, accurate and confidential records; involve the HR Business Partner in complex accommodation conversations

  • Review and process employee changes in Workday (hires, transfers, job and status changes) and raise concerns to the HR Director as needed

  • Maintain accurate personnel files and process employment verifications

  • Administer workers’ compensation claims and incident and accident reporting for the assigned stations

Compliance tracking and audits

  • Assign and track completion of required compliance training, certifications and policy acknowledgments

  • Maintain I-9 compliance, including reverification, and conduct periodic I-9 and personnel file audits

  • Prepare the annual FCC EEO public file report for the assigned stations and maintain all supporting documentation

  • Keep federal, state and local labor law postings current at the assigned stations

  • Run routine HR data audits and support internal and external audits and agency requests

Project support

  • Support company-wide people, culture and engagement initiatives at the local stations

Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education and experience

  • 3 or more years of HR experience in a generalist role

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business or a related field, or equivalent experience, preferred

  • Experience supporting more than one location preferred

  • SHRM-CP or PHR certification preferred

Skills and abilities

  • Working knowledge of federal, state and local employment laws, including FMLA, ADA, I-9 and EEO requirements

  • High attention to detail and a track record of accurate, on-time work

  • Excellent communication and organization, with a customer service mindset

  • Sound judgment about what to handle and what to escalate, and a high level of professionalism and discretion with confidential information

  • Proficiency in HR systems and Microsoft Office; Workday experience strongly preferred

  • Confident self-starter who can manage competing priorities across multiple stations

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Primary work location: KSAT-TV in San Antonio, in a typical office environment

  • Travel up to 10% to other assigned stations, currently KPRC-TV in Houston

  • Flexibility to support news operations that run around the clock

  • Assigned region and work location may be adjusted as business needs change

HOW TO APPLY

Interested candidates, please submit your resume and cover letter detailing your relevant experience to careers@grahammedia.com. Please reference HR Generalist in the subject line.

job.description:
About Gray Media:

About KSLA:

KSLA News 12 is the aggressive, National Edward R. Murrow Award-winning CBS affiliate serving the region known as the ArkLaTex. The station is the market’s leader in timely and accurate reporting of breaking news, investigative journalism, award-winning storytelling, and First Alert Weather. KSLA News 12 serves its community on all on-air, digital, and mobile platforms, embracing the innovation of the industry. In the center of the ArkLaTex is the Shreveport/Bossier City metroplex where the best of Louisiana, Texas, and Arkansas culture is combined to create a vibrant and comfortable lifestyle.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you the person family and friends call for advice if they’ve been ripped off? Do you have an instinct for spotting a scam and a relentless drive to help people who might have fallen victim? KSLA News 12 is looking for an Anchor/Consumer Reporter who isn't just a face behind a desk, but a champion for the ArkLaTex. We need an artful storyteller who thrives on getting answers and knows how to turn a complex consumer complaint into must-watch content—whether it’s a 30-second social clip or a deep-dive long-form investigation.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

What You'll Do: 

• Champion the consumer: Lead our "Getting Answers" brand by investigating local scams, retail rip-offs, and bureaucratic red tape with a sense of urgency that matches the frustration of our audience. 

• Anchor with authority: Command the desk for both digital and broadcast newscasts, delivering impactful news with the credibility our audience expects.
• Master visual storytelling: Use creative, high-impact visuals to break down complex data, crafting stories that are so visually engaging they leave the viewer wanting more.
• Own the digital space: Create daily, platform-specific content for social media and streaming that doesn't just repeat the broadcast but engages our digital audience where they live.
• Tell community stories: Find the human heart in every consumer issue, telling stories that resonate deeply with our local community and drive real change.

Qualifications/Requirements: 

What You Bring:

• A proven track record: 2-3 years of experience in a newsroom (consumer or investigative reporting experience is a massive plus).
• Visual eye: You understand that how a story looks is just as important as what is said; you’re a pro at using visuals to hook an audience and keep them watching.
• Digital fluency: You know how to stop the scroll on social media and understand that "digital-first" isn't just a buzzword—it's how we win.
• Relentless curiosity: You don't take "no comment" for an answer, and you’re comfortable digging through records to find the truth.
• Versatile storytelling: You can write a tight broadcast script, a compelling web article, and an engaging social thread with urgency and ease.
• On-air presence: You’re authentic, energetic, and authoritative, whether you’re in the field, on the anchor desk, or live streaming from your phone.
• Technical savvy: You’re comfortable with the tools of modern journalism, from mobile editing to navigating streaming platforms.

WTHI-TV is seeking a hands-on technical professional to help lead the engineering and technology operations of our television station. This role partners directly with the Regional Chief Engineer to maintain, modernize, and future-proof all station systems, from traditional SDI broadcast infrastructure and automation to IT networks, building systems, and vendor relationships. You will support live news production in a Grass Valley hot-punch environment, oversee the health of a hybrid broadcasting plant, and help guide the next wave of technical evolution while ensuring daily broadcasts run reliably.

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

The Right Fit: This position is designed for a well-rounded engineer who thrives at the intersection of broadcast and IT. You will maintain, improve, and innovate across all technical systems while providing vital support to a fast-paced, live news environment. The ideal candidate is a steady hand, a creative problem solver, and a trusted partner ready to help lead one of the Wabash Valley’s most dynamic television operations.
Core Responsibilities:

In 2026, the news team was recognized as the Wisconsin Broadcasters Association "News Operation of the Year" and also the small-market "Station of the Year" (for coverage airing in 2025). Also in 2026, WSAW's podcast "Wisconsin Cold Cases: Who Killed Gerald Mork?" was honored with a Regional Edward R. Murrow Award. These are just a few examples of the honors WSAW has received in recent years.

North Central Wisconsin is also known as "Wisconsin's Basecamp." In Wausau, you will live and work where thousands of people come to vacation each year. Whether you're skiing down the slopes of Granite Peak, boating on Lake Du Bay, or enjoying Concerts on the Square or a show at The Grand Theater in downtown Wausau, there's something for everyone, and you will enjoy the community we serve. Wausau is also located within 3 hours or less of Minneapolis, Milwaukee, and Green Bay; and is just a two-hour drive from Madison, the state's capital city.

WSAW's viewing area covers 11 counties, including the cities of Stevens Point, Wisconsin Rapids, Marshfield, Rhinelander, and the summer retreat hotspot of Minocqua. WSAW is dedicated to serving the community and does so through several weeks-long campaigns such as Share Your Holidays and the annual Diaper Drive.

WNEM is looking for a forward-thinking, high-energy Digital Content Manager to lead our growing digital operation and oversee the creation and publishing of content across all WNEM multimedia platforms. This role will drive audience engagement and expand CTV/streaming performance, while ensuring the station stays ahead of digital best practices and emerging trends—including SEO and social strategy.

As part of the newsroom leadership team, the Digital Content Manager helps deliver accurate, timely, and compelling content for a diverse audience. The ideal candidate is an exceptional writer and communicator who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven newsroom.

- Track algorithm changes on platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok and adjust posting strategies as needed.
- Lead WNEM’s responsible AI strategy by developing ethical AI-use guidelines, evaluating and improving AI tools for content and engagement with human oversight, and staying current on AI trends to enhance content delivery, all in compliance with our company AI policy.
- Work with the digital team and other newsroom leaders to build and execute content plans, including regular reviews of successes and opportunities using digital analytics tools.
- Lead and coach a team of digital content creators, ensuring they are trained, supported, and meeting goals.
- Collaborate closely with reporters, producers, and newsroom staff to identify breaking news, trends, and features for digital distribution.
- Manage content flow by prioritizing coverage and monitoring all digital channels to ensure timely, accurate publication.
- Coordinate with marketing and promotions to align digital strategy with station-wide initiatives.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Minimum 3 years of experience developing, creating, and executing content for broadcast, digital, and social platforms.
- Knowledge of SEO best practices and social media strategy.
- Familiarity with digital publishing tools and content management systems (CMS).
- BS/BA in Journalism/Communications or equivalent experience.
- Demonstrated ability to evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies, including AI’s role in SEO optimization.

This producer will help power both news and sports digital and social coverage on weekends — publishing breaking news fast, supporting game-night highlights/scores/recaps, and creating social-first video for station accounts.

• Write clearly for multiple platforms under tight deadlines with strong editorial judgment, accuracy, and adherence to journalistic ethics and libel laws.
Schedule:
• Part-time: Friday, Saturday, Sunday, 2:00 p.m. – 10:30 p.m. (~25.5 hrs/week)
• Some holiday and late-night work may be required depending on sports/news coverage needs.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in journalism/communications or related field (or equivalent newsroom/digital experience).
• Must have consistent availability for Fri-Sun 2-10:30 p.m. schedule.
• Demonstrated ability to publish quickly and accurately on digital platforms (web + social).

• Strong communication and collaboration skills; thrives in a fast-paced, team-driven environment. Passion for both news and sports coverage a plus.

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 such markets measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group, with 46 markets, and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies and the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KBTX:

KBTX Media operates the CBS and CW affiliates in Bryan-College Station, Texas, serving an 18-county area known as the Brazos Valley. For over 65 years, KBTX has been the ratings leader and dominant choice for local news and entertainment. Our team produces six newscasts each weekday, three each weekend, a breaking news digital channel, and a daily lifestyle show, totaling more than 40 hours of programming each week. KBTX is routinely recognized among the best in the state by organizations including the Associated Press, RTDNA, and the Lone Star EMMY Chapter of the National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences. In 2023, the station was honored to receive a National Edward R. Murrow Award, three regional Murrow Awards, a National Gracie Award, and the Texas Association of Broadcasters’ Bonner McLane Public Service Award. KBTX is also a recent Texas AP Broadcasters/Freedom of Information Foundation of Texas Station of the Year and Texas Associated Press Broadcasters Station of the Year. KBTX has helped launch the careers of many well-known journalists, meteorologists, and network and production executives, and takes pride in helping talent grow quickly into the nation’s largest television markets.

You'll also craft digital and streaming projects designed to boost cross-platform viewership.

KBTX News is excited to welcome a Digital Innovation Fellow to our newsroom. - Intimate familiarity with content management systems
- Demonstrated ability to adjust strategy and implementation based on evolving needs
- Ability to work with others to achieve a common goal

This group of stations also places an important emphasis on community service with year round campaigns directly benefiting area non-profit organizations.

Job Summary/Description:  

The digital marketing & content producer is a dual-impact role designed to integrate on-air station promotion, community branding, and multi-platform digital execution. This role drives audience engagement and station brand loyalty by planning and executing creative station marketing campaigns while actively producing, packaging and managing digital-first content across station websites, mobile apps, social media channels, and FAST/streaming properties.

Duties/Responsibilities will include (but are not limited to):

• On-Air & Cross-Platform Promotion: Conceive, write, produce, and edit high-impact on-air topical promos, image campaigns, sports programming spots, and station initiative announcements.

• Video & Graphics Creation: Shoot, edit, and optimize short-form video (reels, social clips, digital packages) and visual graphics tailored for mobile and digital consumption.
• Analytics & Optimization: Track KPIs across digital properties (page views, video starts, social reach, engagement) using analytics platforms to refine promotional and content strategies.
• Digital Growth & Innovation: Assist in managing streaming channels (FAST/OTT), push notification strategies, and newsletter distribution.

• Experience: 2–4 years of experience in broadcast television promotion, digital content production, media marketing, or a related multimedia field.
• Technical Skills:
    o Proficiency in non-linear editing (Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or equivalent).
    o Working knowledge of graphic design tools (Adobe Photoshop, After Effects, Canva).
    o Experience with enterprise Content Management Systems (CMS) and social media publishing suites.
• Writing & Storytelling: Strong copywriting abilities for both broadcast promotion (scripts) and digital platforms (headlines, social copy, SEO descriptions).
• Communication & Organization: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple daily deadlines, collaborate across news, sales, and engineering departments, and work independently.
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Journalism, Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or equivalent practical experience.

Job Summary/Description:

Thousands watch each day as our hosts report news as it is breaking, live from our newsroom. East Texas Now is live, local news and talk 19 hours a day and in operation seven days a week. This is an established, mature streaming production that has served as the model for many others in the industry.

The hosts produce, present, and technically direct their shows every day using a special interface developed for and with the input of KLTV/KTRE. East Texas Now is live each day on desktop, mobile devices, in our apps, and on Amazon Fire and Roku OTT devices. East Texas Now even has its own dedicated app with integrated chat that allows viewers to interact with the host. If you can talk, love breaking news, and are technically inclined to multitask while talking in front of one of multiple cameras, this is an exciting, groundbreaking position.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Handle Breaking News
- Talk to reporters and news makers via FaceTime and Skype
- Self-direct the show
- Set up and coordinate guests for in-studio or remote appearances
- Plan content for each day
- Perform "live read" commercials from the East Texas Now desk
- Talk a lot!

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Competence in reporting live, online, and on air
- Reporting on digital platforms, often live via FaceTime or Skype
- Setting up guests and reporters
- Computer skills
- Position generally alternates schedules dayside/nightside weekly
- Experience in talk radio is a plus

Campaign Operations & Order Entry:
* Responsible for Digital order entry with a high level of accuracy across all platforms and campaign types

* Troubleshoot Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Google Business Manager, Google Search Console, Meta Business Suite + more for all access issues and support proper attribution tracking setup for clients

Reporting & Analytics:
* Pull, compile, and distribute regular campaign performance reports for internal stakeholders and clients
* Maintain accurate records of campaign metrics, pacing, and delivery outcomes
* Reconcile and audit third-party billing and impressions

Sales Support & Communication:
* Work closely with Media Executives and the current Digital Sales Coordinator to ensure seamless campaign execution and client satisfaction
* Manage and communicate digital inventory availability and sell-through percentages to the sales team
* Assist with compiling regular reporting and establishing recurring cadences per account

Qualifications/Requirements:

* Experience in digital advertising operations, media, or a related field preferred
* Familiarity with digital marketing products including OTT/CTV, programmatic display, video, paid social, audience targeting, and mobile
* Working knowledge of Google Analytics (GA4), ad trafficking platforms, and/or order management systems is a plus
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint
* Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail
* Ability to prioritize, multitask, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced sales environment
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Self-starter who takes initiative and works well both independently and cross-functionally

Job Summary/Description:

WBTV is seeking a Broadcast Engineer/IT Technician to support reliable, high-quality live and recorded programming, newsroom operations, and post-production. This hands-on, service-oriented role combines broadcast engineering fundamentals with modern IT and IP-based workflow support in an automated environment.

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

* Support on-air operations for live and recorded programming across studio, control room, and post-production environments.
* Troubleshoot baseband, RF, and IP-based systems quickly and methodically under deadline pressure.
* Install, maintain, and repair broadcast and post-production equipment, including studio systems, routing, audio, video, editing, and ingest and playout workflows.
* Perform preventive maintenance and document configuration changes to support maximum system uptime.
* Collaborate with News, Production, Creative Services, Engineering, and IT to keep workflows running smoothly.
* Ensure daily operations comply with WBTV policies and applicable FCC standards and guidelines.
* Oversee and support IT-based broadcast workflows in an automated environment, including networked systems and related infrastructure.
* Support digital transmitter operations and assist with transmitter maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, providing status updates and post-incident summaries as needed.
* Maintain familiarity with FCC operational standards and compliance expectations for broadcast television.
* Work a schedule that may include nights, weekends, holidays, and on-call support as needed.

Qualifications/Requirements:

* At least two years of experience in broadcast engineering or IT.
* On-the-job or formal training in broadcast transmitter repair.
* Professional appearance and demeanor consistent with station standards.
* Ability to troubleshoot calmly and methodically under pressure.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation habits.

About WWSB:

Live, work, and play in a unique media market that millions of vacationers consider a top destination. WWSB-TV is the ABC station serving Sarasota and Manatee counties on Florida’s Suncoast. Beautiful, postcard-worthy views are everywhere — and so are opportunities to enjoy the Florida lifestyle. The beaches are minutes away, and you’re a short drive from top attractions in Tampa Bay, Orlando, and South Florida, including major theme parks and cruise ports. While visitors come and go, our station and our newsroom are committed to serving the many thousands of people who call the Suncoast home. You’ll find a special emphasis on hyper-local coverage, while embracing the best practices used in some of the region’s top markets.

Job Summary/Description:

ABC7 Sarasota is searching for a morning executive producer to lead and grow our broadcast, digital, and streaming coverage during this essential daypart. This role is ideal for a strong line producer ready to step into management, guiding a team that is laser-focused on breaking and updating local news on every platform. Our newsroom prioritizes quality and innovation, building newscasts rich in story showcasing, targeted layering, and engaging studio storytelling. You’ll drive a “hungry rundown” — aggressively stacking “happening now” live content, real-time social interaction, and smart, local coverage that reflects how our viewers start their day.

ABC7 Sarasota is ready to add a morning executive producer who can own our biggest growth opportunities in one of the most important dayparts we serve. You’ll lead a team that starts the day with urgency, thinks digital first, and believes smart showcasing and strong studio storytelling are how we win. This is a hands-on role for an experienced producer who is ready to move into management, stay close to the work, and help shape where our morning coverage goes next.

Successful candidates bring solid news judgment, strong producing fundamentals, and a clear understanding of how audiences move between platforms. Together, we break local news on our website, push it on social, and add context and emotion on broadcast and streaming. Writing is at the core of the job, and you’ll be expected to move seamlessly between formats.

Our executive producers focus on quality control, “show wizardry,” and smart content and segment planning. You’ll work with a team of top performers who are hungry for leadership and expect their manager to be in the trenches with them. Our executive producers are considered “best practices producers”: they train new producers and step in to produce newscasts as needed. You’ll help the team commit to lead stories, see what’s possible with the resources we have, and bring breaking news to life on every platform. “Happening now” newscasts centered on unique, local content are a priority in our newsroom.

Duties/Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

• Manage the morning team and grow weekday and weekend broadcasts
• Review news scripts for accuracy, legal issues, and proper grammar/spelling
• Evaluate and elevate rundowns for maximum showcase opportunities using the producer toolbox
• Develop and maintain plans for daily and future content generation
• Work with newscast and digital producers to enhance storytelling techniques
• Train new producers, editors, and associate producers
• Ensure accuracy and urgency by leveraging ticker, lower thirds, and full screens
• Help maintain producer schedules and produce newscasts as necessary
• Oversee and produce newscast replacement specials as needed
• Recruit producers and MMJs
• Collaborate with other managers to evolve SOPs, plan, and create accountability for newsroom targets
• Attend station-sponsored events
• Write copy for web and edit video for playback
• Edit video for newscasts
• Communicate with newsmakers and field inquiries from viewers

PLEASE NOTE: Executive producers are expected to produce newscasts as necessary, based on business and scheduling needs. WWSB-TV regularly covers extreme weather threats, including strong tropical storms and hurricanes. The morning executive producer leads station efforts to connect broadcast and streaming viewers and digital users with life-saving information. Safety is always our top priority, and all teammates and management are required to be present at the station to serve our local community before, during, and after a storm.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• 2–3 years’ experience line producing in a commercial television newsroom
• Reel that demonstrates a consistent understanding of showcase producing and creative stacking
• Strong news judgment and a solid command of producing fundamentals
• Collaborative, empathetic, training-centered approach to leadership and feedback
• Proven ability to think digital first and integrate web/social elements into newscasts
• Comfortable leading breaking news coverage and pivoting rundowns in real time
• Excellent writing and copy-editing skills across broadcast, streaming and digital formats
• Knowledge of ENPS, Edius, Vizrt and Ross OverDrive preferred

Gray Media Lansing (WILX-WSYM) News 10, home of the highly rated NBC and FOX affiliates in Lansing, Michigan, is on a dynamic growth trajectory. Our combined operations produce over 50 hours of local news per week—and counting. We are Mid-Michigan's undisputed media leader, home to Emmy Award-winning journalists, the Michigan Association of Broadcasters’ “Station of the Year,” your exclusive home for the Detroit Lions on FOX 47, and home to Studio 10, our popular daily local lifestyle show. Alongside our powerhouse primary stations, our family of channels includes MeTV (10.2) and the regional Great Lakes Sports & Entertainment Network (47.2).

Beyond traditional broadcast, we are a true 24/7 multi-platform powerhouse. Through www.News10Lansing.com and our dedicated News 10 and First Alert Weather apps, and our continuous livestreaming channel News10+, our audience stays connected to trusted local coverage whenever and wherever they need it.
We are a breaking news and weather-first station with a fierce commitment to original, local reporting. Our respected anchors and reporters live in the community and have made our newsroom their home—including the longest-running sportscaster in the state of Michigan. Our leadership team is equally passionate about mentoring and developing the next generation of top-tier journalists.

Mid-Michigan (the Lansing/Jackson area) is a big news market, home to the state capital and Michigan State University. It is a vibrant, diverse, stable, and highly affordable region that offers an outstanding quality of life. Lansing is ideally located just an hour from Grand Rapids and downtown Detroit, and is perfect for day trips “up north” to explore some of the most beautiful scenic spots in the country. If you love lakes, boating, fishing, camping, beaches, downhill skiing, craft breweries, local wineries, Broadway shows, Big Ten sports, minor-league baseball, and professional NFL, NBA, and NHL games... Michigan has it all! Come grow your career with our winning, forward-thinking team.

About KSLA:

KSLA News 12 is the aggressive, National Edward R. Murrow Award-winning CBS affiliate serving the region known as the ArkLaTex. The station is the market’s leader in timely and accurate reporting of breaking news, investigative journalism, award-winning storytelling, and First Alert Weather. KSLA News 12 serves its community on all on-air, digital, and mobile platforms, embracing the innovation of the industry. In the center of the ArkLaTex is the Shreveport/Bossier City metroplex where the best of Louisiana, Texas and Arkansas culture is combined to create a vibrant and comfortable lifestyle.

Job Summary/Description:

Even before the sky turns dark in the ArkLaTex, the audience turns to us for the First Alert on timing, clarity, and preparation. KSLA News 12 is searching for a high-energy, digitally savvy Meteorologist who understands that weather doesn't just happen at 5:00 and 6:00 PM. We need a communicator who can convey the next weather event with urgency and impact, ensuring our audience is prepared and informed whether they are watching on a big screen or a smartphone.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

What You'll Do:
• Own the First Alert brand: Deliver accurate, high-impact forecasts during our newscasts and across all digital/social platforms with a relentless focus on the "Next Weather Maker."
• Drive digital urgency: Lead our weather coverage on the digital streaming desk, social media, and the KSLA weather app, providing real-time updates that keep our audience engaged and safe.
• Master severe weather coverage: When severe weather strikes, you are the front line—delivering life-saving information with calm authority and a "digital-first" mindset that reaches people wherever they are.
• Create visually stunning content: Use the latest weather technology to craft compelling, easy-to-understand graphics that make complex atmospheric science accessible and visually compelling.
• Engage the community: Build a loyal following by being active and accessible on social media, answering questions, and providing context that goes beyond a standard seven-day forecast.
• Collaborate for impact: Work seamlessly with the Chief Meteorologist and the First Alert Weather team to ensure a consistent, aggressive weather brand across every screen.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring:
• A passion for the "Why": You don't just read the models; you understand the science and can explain it with urgency and clarity.
• Digital-first DNA: You’re a pro at going live and crafting weather threads on socials and creating engaging reels that make weather the most talked-about topic in town.
• Visual storytelling chops: You have a keen eye for graphics and understand that a great weather hit is as much about the visuals as it is about the data.
• Severe weather experience: You thrive under pressure and have the field or studio experience to handle high-stakes weather events with confidence.
• Technical expertise: A Bachelor’s degree in Meteorology or a related field is required, along with proficiency in modern weather computer systems (WSI/Baron experience is a plus).
• Team player mentality: You’re ready to jump in whenever the weather demands it, supporting the team during major events and contributing to a winning culture.
• Authentic presence: You’re energetic, relatable, and authoritative—someone the ArkLaTex can trust when it matters most.

The twin cities have a unique small-town feeling, but offer big-city amenities, including a vibrant arts community, a city-wide, all-terrain trail system and world-class dining and nightlife. Bryan and College Station are routinely recognized as a leader in quality of life and as one of the fastest-growing communities in the country.
College Station is also home to Texas A&M University, the nation’s largest university. Aggie home football games attract more than 100,000 in the stands, with tens of thousands more camped outside celebrating at tailgates during football weekends.

About WILX:

Gray Media Lansing (WILX-WSYM) News 10, home of the highly rated NBC and FOX affiliates in Lansing, Michigan, is on a dynamic growth trajectory. Our combined operations produce over 50 hours of local news per week—and counting. We are Mid-Michigan's undisputed media leader, home to Emmy Award-winning journalists, the Michigan Association of Broadcasters’ “Station of the Year,” your exclusive home for the Detroit Lions on FOX 47, and home to Studio 10, our popular daily local lifestyle show. Alongside our powerhouse primary stations, our family of channels includes MeTV (10.2) and the regional Great Lakes Sports & Entertainment Network (47.2).

Beyond traditional broadcast, we are a true 24/7 multi-platform powerhouse. Through www.News10Lansing.com and our dedicated News 10 and First Alert Weather apps, and our continuous livestreaming channel News10+, our audience stays connected to trusted local coverage whenever and wherever they need it.

We are a breaking news and weather-first station with a fierce commitment to original, local reporting. Our respected anchors and reporters live in the community and have made our newsroom their home—including the longest-running sportscaster in the state of Michigan. Our leadership team is equally passionate about mentoring and developing the next generation of top-tier journalists.

Mid-Michigan (the Lansing/Jackson area) is a big news market, home to the state capital and Michigan State University. It is a vibrant, diverse, stable, and highly affordable region that offers an outstanding quality of life. Lansing is ideally located just an hour from Grand Rapids and downtown Detroit, and is perfect for day trips “up north” to explore some of the most beautiful scenic spots in the country. If you love lakes, boating, fishing, camping, beaches, downhill skiing, craft breweries, local wineries, Broadway shows, Big Ten sports, minor-league baseball, and professional NFL, NBA, and NHL games... Michigan has it all! Come grow your career with our winning, forward-thinking team.

WTAP is THE main voice in the Mid-Ohio Valley. We may be among the smallest TV stations in America, but we are also one of the most dynamic. With state-of-the-art technology, a terrific on-air look, and a dynamic digital presence … you’ll be proud of the work you’ll do here. And you’ll grow quickly because there is so much opportunity! You’ll get to explore whatever you want to do in the communications field, whether it’s on-camera, behind-the-scenes, or in sales. The WTAP team is involved in the communities we cover. From covering high school sports to participating in local events, to helping small businesses grow and thrive through commercials and mobile products, WTAP does it all. And we do it all – together.

The Mid-Ohio Valley includes the communities of Parkersburg, WV, and Marietta, OH and the 50-mile area surrounding them. It’s the kind of place where you can walk down the street and say “hi” to people, and they’ll say “hi” right back at you! It’s the kind of place where local news people become like family to the viewers and online readers they serve and communicate with. There are wonderful parks, great hiking and biking areas, high-quality restaurants, and shopping – whether you like a mall or the uniqueness of small stores on Main Street. Our area is big on heritage, and the many fairs and festivals reflect that passion. Marietta College gives its hometown a New England feel. Ohio University and the community of Athens, Ohio, are nearby.
The Ohio River is the common thread that runs through everything, and the Blennerhassett State Park, located on an island of the same name very close to Parkersburg, is a historic and beautiful place to get away to on a summer day.

There’s much to see and do within a couple of hours' drive from our location in Western West Virginia and Southeastern Ohio. Whitewater rafting, snow skiing, and so much more are available in the mountains of West Virginia. The locally situated Mid-Ohio Valley regional airport and airports in Charleston, West Virginia, and Akron, Columbus, and Cleveland, Ohio, give you access to anywhere you want to go. Wherever you may travel,
Our area is proud of its history and heritage with roots in oil and industry, which have helped shape our region into what it is today. WTAP’s commitment to serve the Mid-Ohio Valley, the place that we call home, shows that it doesn’t matter what the market size is… we are here doing what really matters.
