job.title: HR Director - Supply Chain & Retail Strategy/Operations
job.description:
WHO WE ARE & WHAT WE DO

People & Business Partnering connects our people strategy with the needs of the business. We partner with leaders and employees to strengthen talent, leadership, culture, organizational effectiveness and the overall employee experience. Working across our Employee Experience capabilities, the team translates business strategies into practical solutions that help our people and businesses thrive while advancing our culture and business priorities.

 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING & THE IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE

The HR Director, Supply Chain & Retail Strategy & Operations serves as the senior People & Business Partnering leader for these organizations and a trusted advisor to senior leaders on workforce strategy, talent, leadership, culture and organizational effectiveness. Supporting complex, operationally intensive and geographically dispersed teams, this role translates enterprise Employee Experience strategies into practical people solutions that strengthen business performance, workforce capability and employee experience. The HR Director leads the HR team supporting these businesses, partners across Employee Experience functions, and helps leaders anticipate workforce needs, develop talent, navigate change and build high-performing organizations prepared for the future.

 

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • This position offers a hybrid work arrangement, giving you the best of both worlds: collaborating in person at Hallmark Headquarters in Kansas City, MO and our plant location facilities in Missouri, Kansas, Texas and Illinois, and enjoying the flexibility of working remotely. Employee will be required to be onsite at our plant facilities plus Headquarters for job specific reasons but may also work remotely based on business need.
  • This role is eligible for Hallmark’s Annual Incentive Plan. More information will be shared during the interview process.
  • Hallmark is committed to recognizing and rewarding performance. Employees are eligible for annual merit-based increases, aligned with individual and company performance.
  • In alignment with our culture of care, Hallmark offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental and vision plans, paid time off, 401K with company match, and profit-sharing.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS (the following is required to be considered for this role):

  • Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in Human Resources or a combination of HR and relevant business/supply chain leadership experience. Candidates must demonstrate substantial experience addressing people, talent, organizational, and employee-related priorities.
  • Minimum 3 years of people leadership experience leading HR professionals and/or multi-level teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (your application will stand out if you have the following):

  • Extensive experience in HR business partnering, workforce and talent strategy, organizational effectiveness, and change management.
  • Demonstrated success advising senior leaders on workforce strategy, succession, leadership development, organizational effectiveness, and complex change or transformation.
  • Strong understanding of talent and culture practices across the employee lifecycle, including talent acquisition, performance and development, succession, and compensation planning.
  • Experience leading and developing high-performing HR teams and building future HR talent and leadership capability, ideally within a complex, matrixed environment.
  • Proven ability to use workforce analytics, employee listening, and business insights to inform decisions and organizational priorities.
  • Strong understanding of employee relations, employment practices, organizational risk, and workplace culture.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach and influence leaders on leadership effectiveness, talent, performance, career development, and workplace challenges.
  • Strong executive presence and consulting skills, with the ability to partner across HR disciplines and business leadership, balance strategy with execution, and drive outcomes through others.

 

Now’s your chance to embrace a future with Hallmark—just follow the instructions below to apply.

You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are DOCX and PDF. 

 

In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment.

Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks.

Hallmark is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, pregnancy, national origin, physical or mental disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally-protected status. Principals only please.

 

HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important

For more than a century, Hallmark has been bringing people together and improving the relationships that matter most. That’s why millions of people all over the world connect with the Hallmark brand. It has always been a mission so much bigger than any one of us who work here. Today, we need empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries with diverse experiences and skills to help us create the rest of Hallmark’s second century as we shift to a more digitally savvy, unified approach that combines the best of brick-and-mortar retail with the efficiency of dot-com spaces. Help us imagine what our next hundred years could look like!

When you join Hallmark, we will go out of our way to make you feel like part of the team, even in a remote/hybrid work environment. In the day-to-day, we’ll make the best use of the skills and talents you already have. We’ll also give you leadership opportunities and show you multiple potential pathways to future success.

Our culture of care for our consumers and for one another shows in the way we embrace different backgrounds, identities, and working styles, deliberately seeking out ways to be more inclusive both internally among our work groups and externally through the things we make and sell to our retail partners and consumers. We believe that a broadly inclusive, equitable approach is also our best path to future success. We’re seeking out those who can bring a fresh perspective to our business and would love your input as someone new to our team! We can only change and grow when we intentionally include new perspectives–like yours.

job.title: Packaging Operator (37) - 3rd Shift
job.description:
FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

The Packaging Operator position reports through the Lawrence Production Center and may be in the Quality, Folding, Page Insert, Specialty Packaging and/or Counter Packaging departments.  Individuals in these departments operate various machines to package greeting card products and perform the quality inspector role.

      

This position is a Full time position Sunday - Friday, 11:30pm - 7:30am. First shift will be Sunday night and last shift of the week is Thursday night into Friday morning.

 

The Packaging Operator in Lawrence sets up and operates automatic production machines that involve standard or high speeds to produce/package specialty or greeting card products.  Operations may include such activities as winding or spooling, wrapping or banding, folding, packaging product, labeling, and other final production processes. Makes judgment calls in the make-ready and production and/or packaging stages in order to insure quality production. Monitors, troubleshoots and corrects machine malfunctions. Completes required paperwork and/or computer input on specific SAP screens to confirm production and spoilage/scrap. Adheres to quality standards and procedures and initiates adjustments as needed to correct product and/or packaging defects. Prepares and maintains necessary paperwork. May perform quality inspections on in-process and finished goods in accordance with the Quality Department procedures. Assesses cause of defects, charging responsible operations. Records and inputs pertinent data.      

 

Maintains a neat and safe working environment. Actively engages and asks probing questions regarding press issues or performance.  Performs required preventive maintenance.  Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities. Identifies potential problems and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation. Demonstrates leadership amongst the team. Flexibility is key as the incumbent will operate multiple machines and perform the quality inspector role, as needed. Incumbent possesses moderate mechanical abilities, but training is obtained on the job. 

 

The Packaging Operator position may be in the Quality, Folding, Page Insert, Specialty and/or Counter Packaging departments, and incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.   

 

In this position you will:

  • Perform make-ready procedures and other press adjustments on a variety of equipment with similar skill set.  Prepare the press to run and maintain or exceed the specified quality and production expectations. Troubleshoot from a variety of maintenance issues which may deal with robots, feeders, batches, bow machines, etc.  
  • Set up and operate a variety of automated production and/or packaging type machines, along with continually improving the specified production including throughput, OEE, etc.  May work with the computer systems to track components, order materials, etc. 
  • Execute Quality System including preflight, sampling plan and the removal of salvage/spoilage. Develop an understanding of a wide range of quality systems and product specifications. Help prepare related paperwork/documentation for shipping accuracy, including completing production data and spoilage. 
  • Determine sample size and perform audit inspections on in-process and finished goods in accordance with the Quality Department standard operating procedures. Record all required production and defect information on inspection sheets and in SAP.
  • Demonstrate the flexibility and teamwork to positively influence how goals are accomplished within the shorter periods of time.  Participate in performance dialogues and team problem-solving activities. Identify potential problems and proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Communicate with peers so everyone is current on the day to day process. Creatively think outside the scope to see how you can help others.
  • Utilize good safety practices; understand and follow established safety procedures. Complete regular press maintenance and cleaning including TPM's/MIRC's (monthly inspection, repair & cleaning). Demonstrate mechanical ability by problem solving technical issues on the equipment.

 

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

You must show how you meet basic qualifications (listed below) in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields.  Accepted file types are Microsoft Word (DOC or DOCX), PDF, HTML, or TXT. 

 

In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment. Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ability to grasp, lift and carry product weighing up to 15 lbs frequently and 65 lbs occasionally
  • Ability to stand and walk approximately 90% of the time
  • Ability to reach, twist, bend, perform repetitive hand/wrist motion, and use fine motor skills 90% of the time
  • Ability to occasionally work at or above shoulder level  

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Basic math, written and oral communication skills
  • High School Diploma, GED or equivalent
  • Ability to understand the computer and ordering systems and successfully operate both systems
  • Ability to set up area and work under pressure to meet production targets
  • Ability to understand and follow established safety procedures
  • Ability to accept other duties as assigned
  • Ability to learn and retain knowledge
  • Ability to work as a team member

 

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • Work overtime as required during peak seasons
  • There is some noise and hearing protection is required by Hallmark.
  • This is a climate-controlled manufacturing environment with normal physical injury hazard.   

                                            

This position is located in Lawrence, Kansas.  Relocation is not provided.

job.description:
The Packaging Operator sets up, operates, and maintains production and packaging machines to produce gift presentation products. This role ensures quality standards are met, troubleshoots equipment issues, and supports a safe, efficient work environment.

 

This position is on 3rd Shift (11:30pm - 8:00am), Monday through Friday

This position is located in Leavenworth, Kansas.  Relocation is not provided.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Set up, adjust, and operate a variety of production and packaging machines
  • Monitor equipment performance, troubleshoot malfunctions, and perform preventive maintenance
  • Conduct quality inspections on in-process and finished goods; remove defective products
  • Accurately complete production, defect, and shipping documentation in SAP
  • Collaborate with team members to solve problems, drive results, and share process updates
  • Maintain a clean and safe work area; follow all safety protocols
  • Support multiple assignments and departments as needed; demonstrate flexibility
  • Track and replenish packaging materials to minimize downtime
  • Participate in performance dialogues and team problem-solving activities
  • Learn and apply a wide range of quality systems and product specifications

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

job.description:

The Press Operator in Lawrence sets up and operates belt fold machines, page insert machines, double overlay machines, etc. that fold paper, light weight packets, and board stock in multiple ways.  May apply glue to stock during operation.  The machinery is of varying vintages, manufacturers, and types with multiple variables impacting press performance.  Applies acetate, vinyl overlay (materials sensitive to temperature, pressure, ink, etc.) or insert pages to greeting cards.  Performs make-ready duties and prepares press or multiple presses, and types of presses to run a variety of folds, some with severe die cut design.  Maintains and operates glue systems.  Incumbent may also diagnose and perform machinery maintenance repairs and preventive maintenance functions while assisting operators.  Responsible for specified production, quality checks, and TPM’s.  Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities.

Identifies potential problems, and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.

job.title: Production Support Specialist (36) - 1st Shift
job.description:
FIND OUT WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A PART OF HALLMARK SUPPLY CHAIN

JOB OVERVIEW

You’ll be at the heart of our production center, helping millions of customers across the world enjoy Hallmark products. You will have a variety of duties that support the production process in numerous ways. You’ll be cross-trained across multiple departments by a support team of trainers and supervisors to help you learn every step of the way!


SALARY AND SHIFT DETAILS

  • This position is a full-time, 5-day work week position in the 1st shift from 7:30am to 3:30pm, Monday through Friday.
    Don’t see a shift that works for you? We still encourage you to apply! We’ll work with you to find a shift that fits your lifestyle and gives you the flexibility you need.

The Production Support Specialist in Lawrence has a variety of duties that support production in numerous ways.  Prepares greeting card stock for the Cutter to cut.  Jogs, skids and moves stock to the cutter.  Carries stock to skids and moves finished skids into the outgoing area.  Responsible for complete make-ready, run, monitoring and maintenance.  Removes die cut cards from full sheets either using a hammer or by using an Automatic Card Extractor (ACE).  Performs make-readies on the ACE and prepares rails/bars and press set-up.  Responsible for quality sampling and stacking cards onto skids according to register, blockouts, salvage and spoilage.  Determines when adhesive will be mixed and when test will be performed on the mixture.  Responsible for ensuring that the ingredients are in the area for mixing the adhesive.  Assists the Webtron press operator with press set up and changeover, make-readies, machine adjustments and routine preventative maintenance procedures.  Responsible for supporting the production areas by ordering the correct stock, moving components in and out of the areas, inputting information on the computer system, and maintaining a clean, safe, work environment. 

Positively participates in performance dialogues and other team problem-solving activities.  Sets up and operates a Gem/Cello machine, wholesale sealer, accumulator and shrink tunnel which shrinks poly film around wholesale unit of specialty items and/or operates a lift truck and keeps track of stock in the OAI.  Performs all paperwork assigned involved in moving stock, either into or out of the department.  Packs finished goods on a packaging line.  Identifies potential problems, and shows willingness to proactively work on problem resolution and alternative solutions to traditional methods of operation.  Flexibility is key as the incumbent will be expected to move to different work assignments as needed.

Important things to know:

  • Position may be in several departments and incumbent will be expected to learn and perform multiple assignments within this job classification.

  • In the production areas there is some noise. Hearing protection is provided by Hallmark.
  • Overtime is available and will be covered during the interview process.
  • The reporting area may change as business needs change.

In this position you will:

  • Perform make-ready duties on the Gem/Cello machines, ACE press and Webtron presses.  Set up wholesale sealer and pack product into shipping containers.  Mix adhesives and assure the proper ingredients and quantities are available in the area. 
  • Execute Quality System including preflight, sampling plan and the removal of salvage/spoilage.  Perform quality and/or adhesive test and report results in a timely manner.  Plan and maintain the workflow through the department in accordance with work schedule.  Order and deliver stock, cartons, and other components needed for production to the work area. 
  • Achieve and continually improve specified production including production goals, throughput, etc. during training.  Participate in performance dialogues and team problem-solving activities.  .
  • Complete regular press maintenance and cleaning, including TPM’s.  Move skids of stock into and away from the press, including completion of related paperwork.  Transport and handle hazardous waste material in accordance with all Federal, State, and Local regulations.  Be certified to operate power lift equipment and skid inverting machine. 
  • Demonstrate the flexibility and teamwork to positively influence how goals are accomplished within shorter periods of time.  Effectively communicate information to the next shift to ensure consistency and continuous operation. 
  • Utilize good safety practices.

 

YOUR AREAS OF KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERTISE

Basic Qualifications

  • You’re at least 18 years of age
  • You have the ability to grip and push/pull lifts of stock 2”-3.5” thick, 80-120 times per hour
  • You have the ability to lift 20-30 lb stacks of stock, 60-80 times per hour, with frequent lifting throughout the shift of 40-60 lbs.
  • You have the ability to constantly stand, walk, twist, bend, and reach above shoulder level
  • You have the ability to constantly use repetitive hand/wrist motion and perform fine motor skills
  • You have the ability to operate a computer independently

Preferred Qualifications

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent
  • Strong communication- and problem-solving skills

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING AT HALLMARK

We want to help you be your best – at work and at home, now and in the future. It’s why providing benefits to support you and your family’s well-being is one of the most important investments Hallmark makes.

  • Your Health: Medical, vision, and dental plans; Specialized plan option for people with type 2 diabetes; Short-term and long-term disability coverage; Life and accident insurance
  • Your Well-Being: On-site registered nurses who provide health consultations and optional seasonal vaccinations. Health rewards program (earn up to $400 per year).
  • Your finances: A 401(k) with a 4% company match vested from day one. Health savings (HSA) or Flexible spending (FSA) accounts.
  • Your life: During your first year, you’ll receive 18 days (144 hours) of PTO and 10 paid holidays. Paid parental leave, adoption assistance, and comprehensive fertility benefits for eligible employees.
  • Your work environment: Climate-controlled and safety-first environment; On-site café that offers hot and cold meals; On-site Hallmark store where you can shop Hallmark products for 50%-75% off; Inclusive environment and a relaxed dress code, with a few safety rules to follow (close-toed shoes are required). Whether you have purple hair or express yourself through body art, we want you to bring your whole self to work.
  •  Your career: A career with Hallmark can take you anywhere. Our career paths are shaped by your talents and ambitions. Whether you want to take the next step up in a role you know and love or are looking to move into an entirely new area or location. We can help you do just that.

Now’s your chance to embrace a future with Hallmark—just follow the instructions below to apply. 

You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are DOCX and PDF.  

In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Hallmark Cards, Inc. and its subsidiary companies will hire only individuals lawfully authorized to work in the United States. Hallmark does not generally provide sponsorship for employment. 

Employment by Hallmark is contingent upon the signing of the Employment Agreement, signing of an agreement to arbitrate in connection with the Hallmark Dispute Resolution Program, completing Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification, passing the urinalysis drug screen, education verification and satisfactory reference and background checks. 

Hallmark is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, pregnancy, national origin, physical or mental disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally-protected status. Principals only please. 

HALLMARK – Because Connecting With Each Other Has Never Been More Important 

For more than a century, Hallmark has been bringing people together and improving the relationships that matter most. That’s why millions of people all over the world connect with the Hallmark brand. It has always been a mission so much bigger than any one of us who work here.

Today, we need empathetic learners, strategic thinkers, and enthusiastic visionaries with diverse experiences and skills to help us create the rest of Hallmark’s second century as we shift to a more digitally savvy, unified approach that combines the best of brick-and-mortar retail with the efficiency of dot-com spaces. Help us imagine what our next hundred years could look like! 

When you join Hallmark, we will go out of our way to make you feel like part of the team. In the day-to-day, we’ll make the best use of the skills and talents you already have. We’ll also give you leadership opportunities and show you multiple potential pathways to future success. 

Our culture of care for our consumers and for one another shows in the way we embrace different backgrounds, identities, and working styles, deliberately seeking out ways to be more inclusive both internally among our work groups and externally through the things we make and sell to our retail partners and consumers. We believe that a broadly inclusive, equitable approach is also our best path to future success. We’re seeking out those who can bring a fresh perspective to our business and would love your input as someone new to our team! We can only change and grow when we intentionally include new perspectives–like yours.

job.title: GENERAL REPORTER - SASKATOON, SK
job.description:
Position: (Full Time)

General Reporter

Reports to:

Content Manager

Station(s)

SaskToday

Location:

Saskatoon, SK

Application Deadline:

Until filled

Harvard Media is a leading media company in Western Canada, operating 13 radio stations and several top-tier digital news sites like SaskToday.ca. Our digital footprint includes websites, streaming audio, and social media channels. We reach a vast audience, delivering engaging news, sports, and entertainment content focused on Western Canada.

The General Reporter will be key in our newsroom, responsible for covering diverse events and topics in Saskatoon, including local politics, agriculture, business, and arts and culture. This role demands a passionate journalist with a strong sense of curiosity and the ability to produce accurate and engaging news stories under tight deadlines. The ideal candidate will develop and maintain relationships with key community stakeholders and enhance storytelling through multimedia tools.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Covering diverse events and topics in Saskatoon, including local politics, agriculture, business, arts and culture.

Conducting interviews, research and fact-checking to produce accurate and engaging news stories for online publication.

Developing sources and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders in the community.

Pitching story ideas and collaborating with editors and fellow reporters to ensure comprehensive coverage of local events and issues.

Working as a team player, co-operating with other reporters on projects that have a province-wide value.

Adhering to tight deadlines and editorial standards while producing high-quality journalism.

Utilizing various multimedia tools, including photography and video, to enhance storytelling.

Radio tasks.

Other duties as assigned.

Essential Knowledge and Skills:

Strong understanding of local politics, agriculture, business, arts and culture.

Excellent interviewing, research, and fact-checking skills.

Proven ability to develop and maintain sources within the community.

Proficiency in multimedia tools for storytelling, including photography and video.

Ability to work under tight deadlines while maintaining high editorial standards.

Strong writing and editing skills, with an emphasis on accuracy and clarity.

Effective collaboration and teamwork abilities.

Essential Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, or a related field.

Proven experience as a reporter covering a diverse range of topics, with a strong portfolio of published work.

Excellent writing and communication skills, with a keen eye for detail and accuracy.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced virtual newsroom environment.

Knowledge of local issues, politics and community dynamics in Saskatoon is preferred.

Familiarity with multimedia reporting tools and social media platforms.

Commitment to journalistic ethics and integrity.

Flexibility to work evenings and weekends as needed.

Must have a current driver’s license and reliable vehicle.

We appreciate the interest of all applicants. While we will only be able to contact those selected for interviews, we kindly request to refrain from phone inquiries.

Harvard Media values diversity in its work force and is committed to Employment Equity

job.title: SALES ENABLEMENT & OFFICE SUPPORT
job.description:
Sales Enablement & Office Support

Play 103.7 & 100.5 Cruz FM | Harvard Media

Location: Fort McMurray, AlbertaSchedule: Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PMWork Arrangement: 100% In-OfficeReports to: Market Lead / Sales Manager

YOUR ROLE

We're looking for a highly organized, creative, and proactive individual to join our Fort McMurray team in Sales Enablement & Office Support.

This position plays an important role in supporting our local sales team, ensuring advertising campaigns run smoothly, client commitments are fulfilled, and creative ideas are brought to life.

Working closely with our Sales Manager, Sales Representatives, and internal departments, you'll help turn great ideas into successful advertising campaigns and memorable client experiences.

From preparing sales proposals and coordinating advertising campaigns to supporting sales-driven promotions, events, and daily office operations, you'll be an essential part of keeping our sales team and office organized, efficient, and moving forward.

This is a hands-on, fully in-office position that requires a strong sense of ownership, initiative, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

We're looking for someone who doesn't wait to be told what needs to be done. You'll anticipate needs, recognize priorities, take responsibility for assigned projects, and follow through to completion.

The ideal candidate thrives in a busy environment, can confidently juggle multiple responsibilities, adapt when priorities shift, and takes pride in being the person the team can count on to keep things running smoothly.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Sales Support & Campaign Coordination

Assist the Sales Manager and Sales Representatives with preparing proposals, presentations, sales materials, and client communications.

Support the coordination and execution of advertising campaigns, promotions, and client commitments.

Maintain accurate sales records, inventory trackers, reports, and internal documents.

Coordinate with internal departments to ensure campaigns and projects are completed accurately and on time.

Follow up on outstanding requests, deadlines, and deliverables to keep projects moving forward.

Creative & Marketing Support

Use Canva to create professional sales presentations, promotional materials, social media graphics, and other marketing assets.

Assist with the development and execution of sales-driven promotions, contests, and special events.

Support the preparation of client proposals and customized advertising packages.

Bring creative ideas and solutions to the team while maintaining brand consistency and professionalism.

Office & Administrative Support

Support daily office operations, ensuring the workplace remains organized, professional, and efficient.

Welcome and assist clients, visitors, and staff in a friendly and professional manner.

Assist with scheduling, correspondence, document preparation, and general administrative duties.

Maintain organized files, supplies, records, and office resources.

Respond to changing office and sales needs while managing multiple tasks and deadlines.

Ownership, Initiative & Accountability

Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and projects from start to finish, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

Proactively identify what needs to be done and take action without waiting for direction.

Anticipate the needs of the Sales Manager, Sales Representatives, and office, staying one step ahead whenever possible.

Confidently multitask in a fast-paced environment, balancing competing deadlines, unexpected requests, and changing priorities.

Manage competing priorities independently, recognizing urgent requests and adjusting accordingly.

Follow up on outstanding tasks, client commitments, and internal requests until they are resolved.

Identify opportunities to improve processes, organization, and efficiency within the sales department and office.

Communicate proactively, providing updates, flagging concerns early, and asking questions when clarification is needed.

Be a reliable, consistent presence in the office who takes pride in supporting the success of the entire team.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Experience with Canva and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) is required. Candidates must be comfortable using these programs independently and confidently.

Strong Canva skills, with the ability to create professional sales presentations, promotional materials, social media graphics, and other marketing assets.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel for tracking and organizing information, Word for document preparation, PowerPoint for presentations, and Outlook for email and scheduling.

Proven ability to multitask and thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing several projects, requests, and deadlines simultaneously without sacrificing accuracy or attention to detail.

Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively as needs change throughout the day.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

High attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, professional work.

Ability to work independently, take initiative, and follow projects through to completion with minimal supervision.

Strong problem-solving skills, resourcefulness, and a willingness to learn new systems and processes.

A positive, team-oriented attitude with the flexibility to jump in and help wherever needed.

Previous experience in sales support, marketing, administration, or a related role is considered an asset.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success in this role means:

The Sales Manager and Sales Representatives can focus more of their time on selling and building client relationships.

Sales orders, campaigns, promotions, and client commitments are completed accurately and on time.

Tasks and projects are managed independently with minimal follow-up required.

Multiple projects and competing priorities are handled efficiently, even during busy periods.

Office needs are anticipated and addressed before they become problems.

Clients, visitors, and colleagues receive friendly, professional, and timely assistance.

Sales resources, inventory trackers, and internal systems are consistently organized and up to date.

Communication between departments is clear, proactive, and efficient.

The team has confidence that when something is assigned, it will be handled from beginning to end.

WORK ENVIRONMENT & EXPECTATIONS

This position is based entirely at our Play 103.7 and 100.5 Cruz FM office in Fort McMurray.

Regular working hours are Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM. This is not a remote or hybrid position.

Being physically present is an essential part of the role, as the position supports daily office operations, walk-in visitors, client needs, staff, and time-sensitive sales activities.

Our office is a busy, fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly. The successful candidate must be comfortable multitasking, adapting to unexpected requests, and maintaining a high level of organization and professionalism throughout the day.

The successful candidate will be expected to work independently, exercise good judgment, maintain confidentiality, and demonstrate a high level of accountability in their daily responsibilities.

Harvard Media values diversity in its work force and is committed to Employment Equity.

Position at Havas Media

job.title: AI Music Research Intern
job.description:
About Hook Hook is a social music platform, backed by top-tier investors, building the next generation of music discovery, fan expression, and creator growth. We turn the songs people love into sounds they can play with, enabling fans and creators to reimagine music through intuitive, remix-friendly experiences with zero learning curve. By partnering directly with artists, labels, and rightsholders, Hook ensures music is discovered, shared, and expressed in ways that respect and reward the people behind it. At Hook, music isn’t just consumed. It’s experienced, expressed, and made personal. Role

Overview

We are looking for a curious and motivated AI Music Research Intern to help us explore and develop AI-powered tools for music creation, transformation, remixing, and creative interaction. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of music, machine learning, and creative technology, experimenting with emerging AI techniques and helping turn research ideas into practical tools for music creators. You’ll have the opportunity to work on real-world challenges involving generative audio, music understanding, and audio modeling, while collaborating with our music technology, engineering, product, and creative teams. Whether you have

experience

through academic research, coursework, or personal projects, this is an opportunity to apply your technical skills to exciting problems in AI music and help shape new ways for people to interact with music. At Hook, we believe AI should expand creative possibilities while respecting the people behind the music. You’ll contribute to developing tools that support musical expression and responsible use of music and data.

Responsibilities

Explore AI music technologies: Research and experiment with machine learning approaches for music generation, transformation, remixing, and audio understanding. Implement and evaluate models: Use Python and modern ML frameworks to build, test, and evaluate AI models and audio processing techniques. Build prototypes: Develop experimental tools and prototypes that explore new ways to make music more interactive, expressive, and accessible. Work with data and experiments: Process audio datasets, run experiments, and evaluate model performance, audio quality, and musicality. Collaborate and share findings: Work with engineers, music technologists, and producers to explore creative use cases, document experiments, and contribute to responsible AI development.

Qualifications

Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Audio Signal Processing, Music Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Foundational knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, and statistical methods. Proficiency in Python and familiarity with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch. Interest in audio, music, generative AI, or creative applications of machine learning. Familiarity with audio processing, digital signal processing, or music-related datasets through coursework, research, or personal projects. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with curiosity and a willingness to experiment with new ideas. Ability to work independently on technical tasks while collaborating effectively with a multidisciplinary team. Genuine interest in music, creative tools, and how technology can expand musical expression. Bonus

Qualifications

Academic projects, research experience, or personal projects involving audio processing, music generation, or machine learning. Familiarity with generative audio models, including diffusion-based, autoregressive, or other neural audio architectures.

Experience

with audio libraries, such as librosa or torchaudio, or tools for audio analysis and manipulation. Familiarity with audio embeddings, neural audio codecs, text-audio models, or multimodal learning.

Experience

with music production software, digital audio workstations (DAWs), audio plugins, or creative coding tools.

Experience

collaborating with musicians, producers, or other creative professionals. Familiarity with evaluating generative models or assessing subjective qualities such as musicality, expressiveness, and controllability. Interest in responsible AI practices, including artist consent, music rights, and ethical dataset development. Contributions to research projects, open-source software, machine learning competitions, or relevant technical communities. Our Approach to Responsible AI Music At Hook, we believe AI should expand what people can do with music while respecting the people who create it. We build with artists and rightsholders in mind, developing tools that support creative expression while recognizing the value of human creativity. This means taking a thoughtful approach to the music and data used in model development, respecting rights and permissions, and considering how our technology affects artists, producers, and the broader music ecosystem. We value interns who combine technical curiosity with a thoughtful approach to building AI responsibly and who are excited to help develop technology that

benefits

both music creators and listeners. What We Offer Hands-on

experience

researching and building AI-powered music tools. The opportunity to work on real-world challenges in generative AI, audio modeling, and music technology. Close collaboration with researchers, engineers, music technologists, and producers. The opportunity to experiment with emerging technologies and contribute ideas to product development. Exposure to the process of turning research prototypes into practical creative tools. Mentorship and support for continued technical learning and professional growth. A chance to help shape the future of music discovery, creation, and expression in a responsible, creative environment.

About Hook Hook is a social music platform, backed by top-tier investors, building the next generation of music discovery, fan expression, and creator growth. Fans use Hook to legally remix, mashup, and reimagine the songs they love, then share their creations with the world. We work with artists, labels, and rights holders to turn passive listening into active participation. Role

Overview

We are looking for a Data Intern to work directly alongside our Data Insights lead, keeping our tracking accurate, our reporting current, and supporting analyses across the company. You will own day-to-day tracking QA and recurring reports, then take on analysis projects as you earn trust, working with our product, engineering, growth, marketing, business development, and content teams. This is a 10-20 hours per week role based at our TriBeCa, NYC office.

What You’ll Do

Check that event tracking is implemented correctly across iOS and web, and flag gaps or broken events to engineering Maintain tracking documentation, such as event specs and naming conventions Build and maintain recurring reports and dashboards for product, growth, and leadership Pull data to answer ad hoc questions, then summarize findings and caveats in plain language Support analyses for Marketing, Business Development, Content, and Product, spanning user behavior, conversion and acquisition, content management, and industry-wide trends

Required Skills

&

Experience

Currently a senior undergraduate or a master’s student Strong analytical thinking Detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines Clear written communication, including the ability to explain results to non-technical teammates Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment Preferred Skills &

Experience

Working knowledge of SQL or another way of querying and analyzing data (Python or advanced Excel/Sheets) A previous analytics or data internship Familiarity with event tracking, attribution, or A/B testing concepts

Experience

working at an early-stage startup Passion for music and technology. Music industry

experience

is not required. Why This Role Matters This role will help make sure Hook’s teams are working from numbers they can trust as the consumer app scales, and will shape how we track, report, and analyze across the company. Compensation This internship is unpaid and available for school credit. The internship offers the opportunity for exceptional interns to grow into a longer-term or full-time role at Hook. Work authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Hook is unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of an employment visa (e.g., H-1B) for this role, now or in the future. We turn the songs people love into sounds they can play with, enabling fans and creators to reimagine music through intuitive, remix-friendly experiences with zero learning curve. At Hook, music isn’t just consumed. It’s experienced, expressed, and made personal. Role

Overview

We are looking for a Research Scientist, AI Music to advance the state of the art in AI-powered music creation, transformation, and interaction. In this role, you will research, develop, and evaluate machine learning models that enable new ways for people to play with music, while translating cutting-edge research into intuitive, high-quality product experiences. You’ll work at the intersection of music, machine learning, and creative technology, collaborating closely with our music technology team, producers, and product and engineering partners to turn creative ideas into powerful AI tools. From exploring generative audio models and music understanding to developing novel ways to remix, transform, and interact with music, you’ll help define how AI can make musical expression more accessible. At Hook, we believe the future of AI music should be built responsibly. We are committed to developing tools that respect artists, their creative work, and the rights of music creators and rightsholders. You’ll help shape this approach by building AI systems that enable creative expression while prioritizing ethical data practices, transparency, and responsible use of music.

Responsibilities

Research and develop AI music models: Design and develop machine learning models for music generation, transformation, remixing, and creative interaction. Explore emerging technologies: Investigate advances in generative audio, music understanding, audio representation learning, and related areas of machine learning. Translate research into products: Turn research ideas and prototypes into practical, high-quality AI capabilities, working closely with engineering and music technology teams. Experiment and evaluate: Design experiments and evaluation frameworks to assess audio quality, musicality, controllability, performance, and creative usefulness. Collaborate with creative teams: Work closely with producers, musicians, and cross-functional teams to understand creative workflows and develop intuitive, musically meaningful tools. Champion responsible AI development: Consider music rights, training data provenance, artist consent, and attribution throughout model development.

Qualifications

Advanced degree (PhD or MS) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Audio Signal Processing, Music Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong foundation in machine learning, deep learning, and statistical methods, with

experience

developing and evaluating ML models.

Experience

with audio or music-related machine learning, such as generative audio, music understanding, audio representation learning, source separation, or signal processing. Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks, such as PyTorch. Familiarity with audio processing libraries, datasets, and evaluation techniques. Ability to conduct independent applied research and translate research insights into working prototypes and real-world applications. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and creative disciplines. Genuine interest in music, creative tools, and the ways technology can expand musical expression. Bonus

Qualifications

Experience

training, fine-tuning, or deploying generative audio or music models, including diffusion-based, autoregressive, or other neural audio architectures.

Experience

with audio codecs, neural vocoders, audio tokenization, text-audio models, or multimodal learning. Familiarity with agent frameworks and workflow orchestration tools for building multi-step AI applications. Familiarity with music production workflows, DAWs, audio plugins, or creative software.

Experience

collaborating directly with producers, musicians, or other creative professionals to develop or evaluate AI-powered tools.

Experience

building low-latency, interactive audio systems or deploying ML models in production environments.

Experience

designing evaluation methods for subjective qualities such as musicality, expressiveness, controllability, and creative utility. Knowledge of responsible AI practices for music, including rights-aware dataset development, artist consent, data provenance, and attribution. Research publications or contributions in machine learning, audio processing, generative AI, or music information retrieval. Our Approach to Responsible AI Music At Hook, we believe AI should expand what people can do with music while respecting the people who create it. We build with artists and rightsholders in mind, and we aim to develop AI tools that support creative expression rather than undermine the value of human creativity. This means taking a thoughtful approach to the music and data used in model development, respecting rights and permissions, and considering how our technology affects artists, producers, and the broader music ecosystem. We value researchers who bring both technical ambition and a strong sense of responsibility to their work, and who see ethical considerations as an integral part of building great products. What We Offer The opportunity to shape the future of AI-powered music creation and expression. Freedom to explore ambitious research ideas and influence technical and product direction. Close collaboration with a multidisciplinary team of researchers, engineers, music technologists, and producers. The opportunity to see your research become real tools used in creative workflows. A mission-driven environment focused on making music more interactive, accessible, and expressive while respecting the people behind it. Support for continued learning, research, and professional growth. Competitive compensation and benefits.

The role will also define, develop and support HMGs ability to use and apply data as a strategic asset and provide analytical insights that enhance strategic and operational planning. Summary: 

The Vice President, Donor Engagement provides leadership for Hope Media Group's entire donor engagement and fundraising strategy, ensuring an integrated donor journey from acquisition through transformational giving. The VP leads the strategy and performance of donor care, donor communications, mid-level giving, major and catalyst donor engagement, and other donor-facing initiatives, with accountability for donor retention, revenue growth, stewardship, and long-term donor value. As a senior leader within Donor Engagement, this role develops leaders, drives cross-functional alignment, uses data and analytics to inform investment and strategy, and partners with the Chief of Donor Engagement and organizational leadership to advance HMG's ministry and revenue objectives.  

 

Essential Functions

Strategic Direction: 

  • Develop and lead HMG's comprehensive donor engagement strategy, establishing the vision, priorities, goals, and measures of success for donor acquisition, cultivation, retention, stewardship, and growth across the donor lifecycle. 
  • Use data and analytics to evaluate donor behavior, fundraising performance, and engagement trends, informing strategies across the donor lifecycle and identifying opportunities for growth, retention, and increased donor value. 
  • Establish and maintain clear donor pathways that move individuals from initial engagement through mid-level, major, and catalyst giving. 
  • Provide strategic leadership and input into fundraising campaigns and initiatives that generate resources to expand ministry impact. 
  • Collaborate with ministry and organizational leaders to ensure a cohesive, integrated donor journey across HMG brands and platforms. 
  • Establish key performance indicators and regularly evaluate progress toward donor engagement, retention, and revenue objectives. 

Organizational & Executive Leadership: 

  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Chief of Donor Engagement in establishing fundraising priorities, revenue strategies, and long-term donor engagement goals.
    • Translate organizational strategy into clear priorities and measurable objectives across Donor Engagement teams.
    • Partner with senior leaders across HMG to align donor strategy with programming, marketing, digital, finance, data, and ministry initiatives.
    • Provide executive-level insight into donor trends, fundraising performance, opportunities, and risks.
    • Represent Donor Engagement in organizational planning and cross-functional initiatives.
    • Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing leadership team, equipping directors and managers to effectively lead their functions and teams. 
  • Ensure alignment, accountability, and effective decision-making across Donor Engagement functions while empowering leaders to execute within their areas of responsibility. 

Donor Engagement & Program Oversight 

  • Provide strategic oversight of HMG's donor engagement programs, ensuring alignment and effectiveness across donor care, communications, mid-level, major, catalyst, events, and other donor-facing initiatives. 
  • Oversee the mid-level donor advisor program, ensuring effective portfolio strategy, donor cultivation, stewardship, and pathways to major giving. 
  • Lead Donor Communications strategy, including collaboration with fundraising consultants, ensuring cohesive multi-channel stewardship and solicitation across print, digital, on-air, and other donor touchpoints. 
  • Provide strategic oversight to Donor Care, ensuring donors receive responsive, compassionate, and effective support. 
  • Guide strategies that strengthen donor acquisition, retention, engagement, stewardship, and long-term donor value. 
  • Ensure alignment between fundraising leadership and HMG's overall donor engagement strategy. 

Department Operations & Performance: 

  • Ensure Donor Engagement has effective systems, processes, tools, and resources necessary to achieve departmental objectives. 
  • Establish expectations for operational excellence, accountability, documentation, reporting, and cross-functional collaboration across Donor Engagement. 
  • Identify organizational or departmental barriers to effectiveness and partner with Donor Engagement leaders and cross-functional teams to implement solutions. 
  • Provide executive oversight of key departmental projects and initiatives, ensuring appropriate ownership, prioritization, and accountability. 
  • Partner with Finance, HR, IT, and other organizational functions to ensure Donor Engagement leaders and teams have the resources and support necessary to achieve fundraising and donor engagement objectives. 

Budget Management:

  • Partner with the Chief of Donor Engagement and Finance to develop annual departmental budgets, fundraising revenue goals, and forecasts. 
  • Regularly evaluate departmental spending and fundraising performance against budget and forecast, identifying risks, opportunities, and necessary adjustments. 
  • Ensure departmental resources are strategically allocated toward initiatives that advance donor engagement and fundraising objectives. 
  • Provide FP&A monthly input to accurately forecast costs and revenue. 
  • Ensure departmental spending complies with HMG financial, credit card, travel, and purchasing policies.

About Us

Job Overview

The position of Accounting Coordinator is responsible for assisting the market controller and vice president/general manager with a wide range of accounting responsibilities including accounts receivable, accounts payable, fixed assets, deposits, and billings. This position is also responsible for performing accounting activities for payroll, AP, and AR using the professional application of accounting principles, practices and techniques in accordance with industry standards, current laws and Company policy.

Job Responsibilities

Perform accounts payable duties including invoice review and coding, 1099 reporting and non-cash awards reporting and other year-end and IRS requirements.

Point of contact for Sales and Clients with current account AR balances.

Point of contact for Vendors with basic AP questions and issues.

Assist in Concur expense approvals.

Month end revenue reports and balancing.

Maintain proper records for payments to non-corporate entities for government reporting purposes.

Maintain electronic vendor files of all purchases.

Fixed asset additions and capitalizations.

Master the chart of accounts and code payables appropriately.

Approve credit on sales orders in Wide Orbit system.

Make daily collection calls and write letters to clients on past due accounts.

Host monthly aging meetings with account managers and recommend accounts to be placed with outside agency.

Complete other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Two plus years post high school education in accounting, business, or related field, preferred; or a combination of work experience and education to complete the requirements of the position.

Working knowledge of MS Office products, especially Excel.

Knowledge of Wide Orbit traffic system a plus.

Multi-task with a variety of duties while running the board.

Able to make decisions and judgments quickly.

Follow directions well, especially over the phone.

Work well under pressure.

About Us

Hubbard DC, which includes WTOP, Federal News Network and 2060 Digital, is committed to reporting relevant news for our region. Through continuously evolving brands, we connect consumers with advertisers across a growing number of distribution platforms including radio, podcasts, social media, and websites. We do this with a commitment to our community...while growing our people and profits.

OUR VISION

To be an industry leader and set the standard for equality and inclusivity for all races, genders, ages, ethnicities, abilities, sexual orientations and religions by creating and fostering principles that integrate our core values.

OUR MISSION

To be proactive in providing a welcoming, professional environment; free of harassment, discrimination and marginalization with on-going habits that incorporate our unique experiences into the overall success and continuous evolution of this organization.

Job Overview

The Federal Drive anchor must have experience in developing ideas, conducting and managing audio and video interviews is strongly preferred, but will consider the right person with the right background in federal issues. This position holds the primary responsibility for the show’s content and adherence to Federal News Network editorial standards and focus areas. Also responsible for ensuring show is prepared and ready for broadcast each work day, five days per week. Audio and video show segments are posted online and published as podcast segments on major distribution networks, the Federal News Network website and multiple social media platforms. Therefore, anchor must treat Federal Drive as a primary contributor to Federal News Network’s website and as a means of attracting audience via multiple listening and watching formats and digital distribution channels.

Job Responsibilities

PLANNING:

Leading the team to determine which guests and topics should be on the show, with a strong preference for federal executives

Working with news staff for suggestions and referrals

BOOKING:

Working with producers to contact potential guests and their public affairs teams to schedule show appearances. Supervising scheduling; frequently supplying interview questions ahead of the interview

CREATING INTERVIEWS:

Reading, understanding background material

Writing teases, leads, tag

Conducting audio and video interviews, typically 2-to-5 per day

CREATING A SHOW:

Deciding which interviews will run on a given day’s show

With the assistance of producers, editing audio and video

Turning interviews into finished show segments, including the voicing of tags and tracking segment length

Creating show scripts

Creating reporter segments. These consist of voicing lead and tag provided by reporter for his or her taped or pre-produced segment. Also engineering and conducting audio and video interviews with staff reporters as daily show segments.

PROMO:

30-second daily element written, voiced and mixed by anchor, to promote subsequent day’s show.

WRITING:

Write newscast items and other news stories, as appropriate

Write occasional columns

TOOLS:

Familiarity with audio editing tools and newsroom content management systems is preferred, but willing to train the ideal candidate.

Qualifications

Experience in the public/federal government sector is strongly preferred.

Experience in journalism is preferred.

Working knowledge of social media platforms

About Us

As an ABC6 News (KAAL-TV) employee, you are surrounded by opportunity while experiencing a forward-thinking philosophy. Whether you are searching for a career On-Air, Behind-the-Scenes, or Marketing & Promotion, there is an opportunity to learn, grow, and thrive within ABC6 News and Hubbard Broadcasting.

Job Overview

KAAL ABC 6 News is seeking a highly organized, creative, and community-focused professional to serve as our Marketing, Community & Creative Services Director. This leadership position is responsible for leading the station's marketing, community outreach, event planning, brand management, and creative services efforts.

The ideal candidate is both a relationship-builder and a creative storyteller who can strengthen KAAL's connection with the communities we serve while developing impactful promotional campaigns across television, digital, social, and community platforms. This individual will serve as the station's primary coordinator for community engagement, marketing initiatives, station promotions, and creative services projects.

Job Responsibilities

Community Outreach & Engagement

Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of station community outreach initiatives, partnerships, and events.

Serve as the primary liaison between KAAL and local nonprofits, civic organizations, schools, businesses, and community groups.

Develop and maintain strategic partnerships that enhance KAAL's visibility and community impact.

Identify and secure opportunities for station participation in local events, public service initiatives, and fundraising campaigns.

Coordinate signature station initiatives including food drives, toy drives, school supply drives, awareness campaigns, and community service projects.

Represent KAAL at community events and ensure a professional and positive station presence.

Collaborate with News leadership to identify and promote community-focused stories and initiatives.

Creative Services & Brand Management

Manage the station's Creative Services function, ensuring consistent execution of KAAL's brand across all platforms.

Develop, write, produce, and coordinate on-air promotional campaigns for news, weather, special programming, community initiatives, and station events.

Maintain brand standards and ensure consistent messaging throughout all station communications.

job.description:
Promotion/Social Media Specialist - KS95

#26-1339

Minneapolis/St. Paul, Minnesota, United States

Apply

Business Unit

KSTP-FM

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

Hubbard Radio-Twin Cities is a full-service media company with legendary radio stations and cutting-edge digital solutions. We serve the Greater Minneapolis-Saint Paul community and offer a menu of marketing services including radio, full-service digital, influencer marketing, creative services, custom content, podcasts and events. At Hubbard, we're looking for the best people in local media to help build dominant brands that connect consumers and advertisers to build better businesses and communities. We succeed by always doing the right thing with focus, urgency, and passion.

Job Overview

The Promotions Coordinator/Social Media Strategist serves as the primary liaison for contest winners, manages prize fulfillment, coordinates station events, and works closely with programming, sales, and promotional partners to ensure flawless execution of station campaigns and experiences. The role also provides support for the station's digital and social media strategy by analyzing audience engagement, evaluating campaign performance, identifying opportunities for growth, and helping shape content strategies that strengthen listener connection and brand impact.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, customer-service focused, and thrives in a fast-paced environment with multiple deadlines and moving pieces.

Job Responsibilities

Contest & Promotion Management

Coordinate and execute all on-air and online contests and giveaways.

Manage winner selection, verification, paperwork collection, and prize fulfillment.

Process contest-related documentation, including tax forms and check requests.

Track winner paperwork and ensure compliance with station, legal, and accounting requirements.

Maintain accurate records of prize inventory and distribution.

Monitor and respond to promotions email and phone lines.

Event Coordination

Execute station events, appearances, and promotional activations.

Coordinate event staffing, logistics, and communication with sales, talent, and street team.

Create event materials, schedules, and briefing sheets.

Maintain event supplies, promotional inventory, and station vehicles.

Attend and support station events, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.

Digital Marketing & Social Media Strategy

Create a station social media strategy for KS95. Provide actionable recommendations to enhance station/brand content performance, audience growth, engagement, and campaign effectiveness.

Assist with content planning and social media calendars, ensuring consistent and strategic messaging across platforms.

Coach and direct the team on best practices in social media posting by platforms.

Analyze social media, digital marketing, and audience engagement performance to identify trends, successes, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

Help execute sponsor and client deliverables across social media platforms.

Assist in promoting station events, contests, and community initiatives.

Stay informed on emerging social media trends across platform changes, algorithm updates, digital marketing best practices, and new advertising opportunities across TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Event Management, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.

Strong understanding of major social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging digital channels.

Experience using analytics and reporting tools such as Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, Google Ads, or similar platforms.

Ability to analyze audience, social media, and promotional campaign data; identify what is driving engagement and results; and make strategic recommendations for future content, campaigns, and marketing initiatives.

Strong organizational and project management skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Strong customer service and relationship-building abilities.

Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and Holidays.

Preferred

Experience in radio, media, entertainment, promotions, marketing, or event coordination.

Familiarity with WordPress, VPromo, Asana, Audience, and Canva

Experience with contesting, prize fulfillment, and event logistics.

Compensation and Benefits

When extending an offer, the company considers a variety of factors such as (but not limited to) the candidate's work experience, education/training & key skills as well as internal peer equity and other market and business considerations.

The hourly rate of pay for this position is $24.04 per hour.

job.description:
PT Talk Show Producer - myTalk 107.1

#26-1221

Minneapolis/St. Paul, Minnesota, United States

Apply

Business Unit

Employee Classification

Part Time Intermittent

About Us

Hubbard Radio-Twin Cities is a full-service media company with legendary radio stations and cutting-edge digital solutions. We serve the Greater Minneapolis-Saint Paul community and offer a menu of marketing services including radio, full-service digital, influencer marketing, creative services, custom content, podcasts and events. At Hubbard, we are looking for the best people in local media to help build dominant brands that connect consumers and advertisers to build better businesses and communities. We succeed by always doing the right thing with focus, urgency, and passion.

Job Overview

This person is responsible for producing and operating the board for a live show and syndicated programming.

Job Responsibilities

Responsible for overall content and flow of a live show.

Assist and collaborate with show host on preparations for show on daily basis and for future shows. Make sure all aspects of the talk show are complete before the show airs. Plan ahead and meet deadlines so show can run smoothly for all involved. Important details include booking guests as directed by show host, offering suggestions for guests, confirming guest appearances, daily postings to website on show content, understanding program log, assemble audio clips for daily promo updates and key information.

Notify proper people of any changes or special situations that may come up in a timely manner (i.e. breaking news, cancellations, and technical problems).

Ensure show runs smoothly while on air by following established timelines, handling caller requests, notifying talent of important information, keeping show host on time and on track, interacting with talent, callers and guests when appropriate, following program log, taking breaks, running the board flawlessly, handling changes, monitoring of equipment to ensure it is operating correctly.

Answer phone calls during airtime and screen calls. Make decisions as to which callers go on the air. Must be able to respond and work well in a crisis.

Be able to handle last minute and unexpected changes during regular work shift, during shows and at other times as necessary. Be able to communicate quickly and clearly to show host, guests and others as needed.

Ability to relate and communicate with a variety of people including talent, guests, callers, and other staff.

Assist with daily commercial production including voice-overs and copywriting as directed by Production Department. Ensures that all commercial production is completed as specified and on time.

Develop and write copy for station and show promos.

Working knowledge of radio systems to solve minor, routine problems as needed.

Assess emergency situations for the station, and make decisions on when to call Engineering, ENCO or Programming managers for additional support. When necessary, go on-air to report on life-threatening or emergency situations until further support arrives.

Understands and can articulate station and show's programming directions and philosophies.

Qualifications

One year of professional broadcast experience.

Ability to run the board flawlessly under pressure. Ability to work effectively in a high intensity, environment with on air talent.

Ability to write creative, entertaining and informative copy for commercial production and promos.

Multi-task with a variety of duties while running the show (may have to track down guests and/or talk to listeners while running the technical operation of the show).

Must be flexible and able to deal with unexpected show changes calmly. Able to make decisions and judgments quickly, often in a chaotic environment.

Follows directions well, especially over the phone.

Operating knowledge of ENCO system or similar digital radio automation systems.

Ability to work on short deadlines and in pressure situations.

Ability to make basic programming decisions based on emergency situations.

job.title: Reporter
job.description:
Reporter

#26-1353

Minneapolis/St. Paul, Minnesota, United States

Apply

Business Unit

KSTP-TV

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

KSTP 5 Eyewitness News is the award-winning ABC network affiliate for the Twin Cities. Part of Hubbard Broadcasting, KSTP-TV is a longtime market leader, and is committed to excellence in all that it does-broadcast news with hyper-local coverage, important public service that deals powerfully with today's issues, and now, more than ever, top-notch digital content, to reach our viewers and followers with information the way they want to receive it. When you work for KSTP, or our other local, independently operated station KSTC, Channel 45, you will find yourself among dedicated, passionate people who work hard every day to improve our product and our community. If you have the qualifications, and you are a person of talent and integrity, we invite you to apply!

Job Overview

This position is responsible for covering and reporting the news for the station.

Job Responsibilities

Present live on television scripted and unscripted news reports; may present live stories from the scene of the news, the newsroom and/or studio or may tape stories for later broadcast.

Enterprise and develop stories for broadcast daily. Research and gather content for story. Write clear, accurate and interesting stories. Break down complicated and involved stories so that they are easy to understand. Ensure that any visuals shown are relevant, appropriate and impactful. Maintain standards of accuracy and fairness in news coverage.

Write for and maintain strong presence on website and other social media platforms.

Travel to the scene of a news story to gather and compile the information into the proper form for broadcast.

Complete assignments according to established deadlines.

Maintain extensive community contacts and awareness of local and national current events.

Make promotional and community appearances as required.

Maintain professional standards with regard to wardrobe, hair, cosmetics, and other areas of grooming as required for position.

Write and post stories to website and other digital media platforms. Frequently update online stories.

Work closely and respectfully with assigned photographers.

Communicate frequently throughout the day and work collaboratively with others in the newsroom.

Contribute to the overall team effort to provide the market with the best possible local television journalism. Work in a team environment cooperatively and collaboratively with a variety of people. Build working relationships with co-workers, community members, and the general public.

Act in a professional manner when representing the station.

Attend editorial and strategic meetings. Contribute story ideas on a daily basis.

Must be reliable, able to work a flexible schedule as needed, when needed and where needed, and be attentive to safety and federal laws. Airline travel may be necessary. Will require lifting of up to 50 pounds. Driver Training Certification through an accredited CDL driver training program desired and at least 5 years experience preferred. Requires a valid Class A CDL Driver License and U.S. Passport. Must have a proven driving and safety record, which will be updated/checked on a periodic basis. Must possess a current FMCSA physical examination card and is subject to federal regulations for random drug and alcohol testing and any other required medical exams.

Additional Information

This position is subject to pre-employment criminal background check. A criminal conviction or arrest pending adjudication that does not relate to the requirements of the position will not, on its own, disqualify an applicant. The company will use background check information in a confidential, non-discriminatory manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

job.description:

#26-1286

St. Louis, Missouri, United States

Employee Classification
