About Us

Hubbard Saint Louis is a full-service media company with legendary radio stations and cutting-edge digital solutions. We serve the Greater St. Louis community and offer a menu of marketing services including radio, full-service digital, influencer marketing, creative services, custom content, podcasts and events. At Hubbard, we're looking for the best people in local media to help build dominant brands that connect consumers and advertisers to build better businesses and communities. We succeed by always doing the right thing with focus, urgency, and passion.

Job Overview

This position prepares and performs a compelling, topical and relevant morning drive show weekdays on 92-3 WIL.

Job Responsibilities

Plan, prepare and deliver live and voice tracked program content for WIL-FM in an entertaining and professional manner in a style consistent with the appropriate station format.

Create and execute content on air and on station social media accounts that is relatable and aligns with target audience.

Operate studio equipment, board operation, computer automation system, phone call editing, etc.

Must be available to work weekends, holidays, etc.

Follow and enforce FCC regulations, station and company polices, including implementing station's/state's EAS procedures.

Perform necessary and required technical functions of assigned air-shift, including the performing and logging of engineering readings.

Maintain the program and music logs and ensure that commercials or programs are aired at times logged and the program log is properly signed, initialed and any omissions noted. Report all discrepancies on the Company Discrepancy Report.

Record assigned commercial, promotion or public service announcements in a professional manner.

Act in a professional manner when representing each station.

Attend and participate in meetings as required.

Report to work on time and work established schedule/hours. Ability to work other hours or alternate schedules as needed, as assigned or required.

Make public appearances.

Complete other duties as requested and needed.

Qualifications

Previous on-air experience in Hot AC, CHR, Country, Rock or similar format preferred with a track record of Nielsen success. Degree in Communication, Journalism, related field or equivalent experience preferred.

Good conversationalist, well-read, knowledgeable and articulate in dealing with current affairs; Ability to enunciate clearly and interpret and read copy fluently. Articulate information in clear, concise manner to others. Ability to read, hear and speak clearly and follow both oral and written direction. Ability to think spontaneously and ad lib while on air and at appearances in a coherent manner in situations that can change quickly.

Ability to operate all mechanical functions of preparing and delivering an on-air performance, including the recording, editing and playback of listener telephone calls; the preparation of recorded "bits" and other show elements; the operation of the control room console and studio equipment.

Ability and willingness to be coached and directed by Program Director

Project a professional appearance and demeanor.

Ability to work in compliance with company policies and procedures.

Ability to function in a team environment.

Ability to work established schedule and other hours as needed.

Travel to and attend station promotional appearances including sales appearances.

Physical Requirements Ability to communicate in English, both verbally and in writing. Ability to multi-task with a variety of duties while producing the show. Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to manipulate computer keys and board controls as well as general office equipment (telephone, copier, etc.) for extended periods of time. Wear headsets and be confined to a specific space while work. Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time. The Company may make reasonable accommodations to facilitate the ability to perform essential job functions.

Additional Information

About Us

At Hubbard Radio Chicago we look for the best people to build dominant brands that connect consumers and advertisers to build better businesses and communities. We succeed by always doing the right thing with focus, urgency, and passion. Our company culture builds connections, careers, and employee growth. How? By creating a workplace that values autonomy and transparency. If that sounds like something you'd like to be part of, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

The Morning Show Producer for WTMX assists with the daily preparation and execution of The Morning Mix, helping create engaging, entertaining content that connects with listeners. This role supports the on-air team through content research, segment coordination and production to keep the show running smoothly.

Job Responsibilities

Responsible for overall content and flow of The Morning MIX.  Assists in producing the show from prep/pre-planning, airing of live elements to final editing, post-show promos and production.

Searches online / on social media for potential topics for show to cover on air.  Ensures hosts have show-prep materials for each day and associated audio.

Creates external relationships with key partners in the market so the show has access to high profile events and talent coming to the area.  This includes being connected with agents, concert venues, promoters, production studios etc.

Manage guest scheduling and logistics

Coordinate live and pre-recorded interviews.

Ensure show runs smoothly by following established timelines and program logs.  Assists in running the board flawlessly, handling changes, and monitoring of equipment to ensure it is operating correctly.

Edit audio, posts to online feeds; create audio highlights for promos and social media and podcast.  Assist in generating social media content for the show as directed.

Assist with on air/off air contest execution

Communicates with listeners via social media, phone, text platforms.

Maintain show archives and prepare segments for show vacations with “best of” shows.

Help with basic video recording and production.

Is able  to handle last minute and unexpected changes during regular work shift, during shows and at other times as necessary. Communicate quickly and clearly.

Work seamlessly with other departments.

Stay updated on industry trends to keep content fresh and competitive

Works cross-functionally across content, digital and sales departments to ensure station goals are met.

Attend and participate in meetings as required. Make public appearances.

Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Three+ years of experience as producer or on-air contributor.

Passion for pop culture, current music and entertainment news.

Experience with all aspects of an on air broadcast studio. Operating the board, automation system, understanding radio clocks, logs, and scheduling.

Demonstrated ability for using social media including, but not limited to, Facebook, YouTube, and Instagram.

Willingness to learn new tools and how they can help content, distribution, or sales.

Willing to work in the office or on location.

Multi-task with a variety of duties.

Ability to ad lib while on air and at appearances in a coherent manner in situations that can change quickly.

Project a professional appearance and demeanor.

Work in compliance with company and FCC policies and procedures.

Work established schedule and other hours as needed. Travel to and attend station promotional appearances including sales appearances.

Must be able to perform the essential functions of the job.  The Company will make reasonable physical accommodations to facilitate the ability to perform essential job functions.

job.description:
WTOP Traffic Reporter/Producer, Freelance

#26-1078

Washington, District Of Columbia, United States

Apply

Business Unit

WTOP-AM/FM

About Us

Hubbard DC, which includes WTOP, Federal News Network and 2060 Digital, is committed to reporting relevant news for our region. Through continuously evolving brands, we connect consumers with advertisers across a growing number of distribution platforms including radio, podcasts, social media, and websites. We do this with a commitment to our community...while growing our people and profits.

OUR VISION

To be an industry leader and set the standard for equality and inclusivity for all races, genders, ages, ethnicities, abilities, sexual orientations and religions by creating and fostering principles that integrate our core values.

OUR MISSION

To be proactive in providing a welcoming, professional environment; free of harassment, discrimination and marginalization with on-going habits that incorporate our unique experiences into the overall success and continuous evolution of this organization.

Job Overview

The Traffic Reporter/Producer works directly with other members of the location Traffic Team to bring each hour's traffic reports to life on-air in a way that is both factually accurate, up-to-date and engaging. The Traffic Reporter/Producer works as part of a diverse team to make the location the leading provider of traffic information.

Job Responsibilities

Anchor live reports of traffic conditions for the region as required in a clear, concise manner with the latest possible information while maintaining high broadcast standards

Continually monitor scanners, cameras and the web/social media to make sure the station is on top of current road conditions and events impacting traffic

Actively pursue traffic tips that come in via email, phone calls or other official sources

Answer phone calls, emails, and social media posts from listeners, providing top-notch customer service

Update internal traffic system with the latest traffic information

Update social media channels with information on current traffic conditions

Keep the news team informed of possible traffic-related story ideas for reporters to pursue

Maintain awareness of the latest local news and how it may impact travel

Contact local agencies for information on traffic incidents

Communicate effectively with the digital team to share new information on major traffic incidents the station is covering and opportunities to tease on digital platforms

Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

2-3 years professional on-air broadcasting experience (radio or television preferred)

Degree in Journalism, Communications, Broadcasting or related field, preferred

Extensive knowledge of area roadways

Ability to understand and decipher scanner traffic from local police and fire departments

Working knowledge of social media platforms

Ability to work quickly in breaking traffic situations and handle stressful situations in a calm manner

Ability to multitask and work under pressure

Ability to work both alone and as part of a team

Strong leadership and communication skills

Project an appropriate and professional appearance and demeanor

Ability to work in compliance with company policies and procedures

Ability to function well in a diverse team environment

Report to work on time

Ability to work weekdays and weekends. Must be able to work early morning, midday, and evening shifts

Physical Requirements

Average sitting, standing and office-type movements. Light lifting, moving and pulling abilities. Ability to communicate in English both verbally and in writing. Ability to hear and see clearly. Dexterity to manipulate computer keys and board controls as well as other office equipment. Requires the ability to think critically and tactically and to articulate information in clear, concise manner to others verbally and in writing. Must be able to think quickly and work under tight deadlines and in high pressure situations. Ability to work in a variety of settings including outdoors. The successful candidate must be able to perform the essential functions of the job. The Company will make reasonable accommodations to facilitate a person's ability to perform those essential job functions.

Compensation and Benefits

Job Summary

Job Requirements This role is considered Hybrid, which means the employee will work 2-3 days onsite at a Company designated location and occasionally from home.

Position Summary

The Production Coordinator for Technology works directly with the CG Technology Supervisors to ensure that all escalated Show Support tickets in their studio are routed to the correct Engineering discipline team and addressed in an appropriate and timely manner. They will be responsible for crewing, scheduling, and managing support tickets and communicating the status back to the show CG Supervisor. Coordinators are significant points of information on all shows for Technology and need to be able to balance multiple needs, projects, and tasks at one time.

What You’ll Do

Work closely with Engineering Leads in crewing, casting and scheduling your Studio’s escalated show support tickets or communicating alternative next steps back to the show stakeholders Work closely with CG Technology Supervisors in your studio, developing specialized knowledge around the Technology, Tools, Pipeline and workflows used in specific artist disciplines supported by your CG Tech Supervisors Establish a process for communicating escalated show support assignments and priorities to show CG Supervisors, Artist Supes, and Leads, as well as the appropriate CG Technology Supervisor and Engineering Discipline team - this should be daily Schedule, track, and manage assigned work within JIRA as well working with Technology Project Managers and CG Technology Supervisors to ensure the status of the work is visible to the right Technology teams Ensure the escalated show support for your studio is prioritized for each appropriate Engineering Discipline and is meeting internal (show) expectations and needs; check in with the crewed Engineers on a regular basis regarding workload, targets, needs, etc. Track escalated support status and coordinate artist testing and feedback at appropriate intervals to ensure the solution being delivered with meet show needs Keep a weekly synopsis of your studio’s escalated show support and its status in a clear and always available format Serve as key communication liaison between all parties relevant to your work; provide updates, priorities, reschedules, and status of all escalated support at any given moment Anticipate and communicate issues to heads of team(s) to reach solutions in a timely manner Technical ability and knowledge required to run Linux, Windows, and Mac-based programs Perform special projects as needed What We’re Looking For 2-3 years in the VFX Production environment or transferable skills from similar positions Bachelor’s degree in Film, Art, Drama, Computer Science or related field or equivalent work

experience

required Proficiency in Macs/PCs including Microsoft Word and Excel; familiarity with Google Suite Must possess very strong organizational and communication skills and be able to handle a variety of tasks in an efficient manner while meeting deadlines Ability to work on a computer/keyboard for long periods of time Must have the ability to juggle multiple projects, work with diverse personalities and work within strict deadlines Attention to detail, follow through and strong communication skills JoinILM Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Vancouver, BC is C$54,900 to C$66,900 per year based on a 40-hour work week. experience

job.title: Director, Income Tracking & Business Intelligence
job.description:
Director, Income Tracking & Business Intelligence

Department: Royalties & Income Tracking
Location: London, UK
Hybrid Working: 3 days per week in the office
Employment Type: Full-time | Permanent

The Role

We are looking for a Director of Income Tracking & Business Intelligence to join our Royalties & BI team in London. In this role, you will lead a cross-territorial team responsible for maximizing global publishing collections, identifying and fixing underperforming tracking and revenue assurance processes, and delivering business intelligence to key stakeholders across Kobalt Publishing and the Kobalt Group.

You will manage five analysts who develop and refine workflows based on complex internal and external big data sets, identify gaps in royalty collections, and design automated mitigation processes to recover revenue as efficiently as possible. You will also lead cross-functional projects and translate findings into clear, actionable insights for our Executive Board to drive data-informed decision-making across Kobalt.

Working closely with the VP of Income Tracking & Business Intelligence, you will oversee relationships with third-party data providers to ensure our tools and services deliver value and support Kobalt's evolving business intelligence needs. This includes collaborating with colleagues across Royalties, Copyright, Technology, Writer & Publisher Relations, and Finance to ensure our processes remain efficient, accurate, properly resourced, and best-in-class in light of industry developments.

This position requires a combination of strong analytical expertise, deep music publishing knowledge, commercial acumen, and people leadership. The ideal candidate will have the ability to coach a high-performing team, manage and report ROI on structured operational processes, and foster creative analytical investigation.

What You'll Do

Income Tracking & Royalty Collections

  • Develop and maintain processes to identify gaps in global publishing collections, investigate under-collections and support the recovery of outstanding revenue across all income streams.
  • Develop and maintain forecasting methodologies to proactively prioritise income tracking activities and improve collection performance.
  • Work closely with Copyright and Royalties teams to assess changes in royalty reporting, catalogue information and deal structures, ensuring tracking and analysis remain accurate and relevant.
  • Monitor deal economics, including the recoupment of advances and minimum guarantee payments.
  • Establish and maintain service level agreements (SLAs) for incoming requests, ensuring appropriate prioritisation and efficient turnaround times.

Business Intelligence & Reporting

  • Develop and maintain internal business intelligence reporting tools, providing stakeholders with accurate, timely and actionable insights.
  • Maintain KPI reporting, ensuring methods of data retrieval, analysis and presentation remain efficient and up to date.
  • Produce regular reports to help stakeholders assess operational performance, identify risks and evaluate potential impacts on client royalty statements.
  • Deliver ad hoc business intelligence analysis and reporting for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Translate complex datasets into clear findings and recommendations to support commercial, operational and strategic decision-making.

Operational Leadership & Process Improvement

  • Lead and develop a cross-territorial team, coordinating operational priorities and ensuring objectives are delivered within agreed timeframes.
  • Document, review and improve operational processes, ensuring colleagues have clear guidance to complete tasks and resolve queries efficiently.
  • Balance structured, recurring data-processing activities with more complex analytical investigations.
  • Partner with the SVP, Royalties, to evaluate technology solutions, assessing effort, cost and potential impact to improve analytical efficiency.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance existing tools, workflows and reporting processes in response to changing business requirements and industry standards.

Data Partnerships & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage relationships with third-party data providers, including vendor evaluation, selection, performance reviews and contract renewals.
  • Assess the return on investment of external data services, identifying opportunities to improve value and exploring alternative providers where appropriate.
  • Work cross-functionally with Royalties, Copyright, Technology, Writer & Publisher Relations and Finance to understand requirements and develop practical solutions.
  • Provide clear recommendations and communicate complex analytical findings to stakeholders with varying levels of technical knowledge and seniority.

What You'll Bring

Preferred

  • Significant music industry experience with a strong understanding of music publishing, copyright and royalty administration processes.
  • Experience managing, supervising and motivating teams, including colleagues working across different territories and time zones.
  • Proven experience in income tracking, royalty analysis, business intelligence or a related analytical function, with a track record of reviewing and improving processes, reporting tools and analytical workflows.
  • Knowledge of SQL or analytical programming languages such as Python or R for large-scale data processing and analysis.
  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage workload distribution, competing deadlines and under pressure deliveries.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting complex information, recommendations and trade-offs to stakeholders across different functions and levels of seniority.

Additional Skills That Could Add Value

  • Experience working with commercial KPIs and OKRs to monitor performance and drive operational improvements.
  • Hands on experience developing business intelligence visualization dashboards such as Tableau.
  • Experience managing third-party data providers, vendor relationships or commercial agreements.
  • Familiarity with best-in-class Snowflake data platform and other emerging analytical technologies, automation and AI-enabled tools.

What Success Looks Like

By Month 3: You'll have developed a strong understanding of Kobalt's income tracking processes, reporting tools, third-party data partnerships and operational priorities. You'll have established relationships with key stakeholders, assessed existing workflows and identified opportunities for improvement.

By Month 6: You'll be confidently leading the team's operational activities, ensuring consistent KPI reporting, effective prioritisation of income tracking initiatives and timely delivery of business intelligence requests. You'll have begun implementing improvements to processes, reporting and analytical capabilities.

By Year 1: You'll have delivered measurable improvements in income tracking effectiveness, reporting quality and operational efficiency. Your team will have established reliable processes for identifying under-collections, supporting revenue recovery and delivering actionable business intelligence that informs decision-making across Kobalt.

Key Behaviours for Success

Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving – Interprets complex data, identifies trends and collection gaps, and develops practical solutions supported by evidence.

Ownership & Accountability – Takes responsibility for operational performance, follows through on commitments and ensures priorities are delivered accurately and on time.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation – Challenges existing processes, explores new technologies and identifies opportunities to improve efficiency, reporting and income tracking.

Leadership & Development – Provides clear direction, supports team development and model high-quality structured operational delivery based on analytical investigation.

Interview Process

  • Introductory call with our Recruitment Team
  • Hiring manager interview
  • In person case study presentation
  • Final stage interview

We aim to complete the full interview process from initial application to offer within three working weeks. While we do our best to meet this timeline, there may be occasional delays. If that happens, our Recruitment Team will keep you updated every step of the way.

Why Choose Us

At Kobalt, we've championed creators since 2000. Our technology and music services are built to make the industry more transparent, fair and rewarding for artists, songwriters and rights holders. We're proud to work with some of the world's most influential talents including Phoebe Bridgers, Sam Fender, Paul McCartney, Foo Fighters, Karol G, Young Thug, Kali Uchis and Andrew Watt, as well as acclaimed writers like Simon Aldred (Rag'n'Bone Man, Liam Gallagher, Celeste) and Clarence Coffee Jr. (Dua Lipa, Lizzo, The Snuts).

We're a company that thrives on creativity, collaboration and progress. Our values — Music First, Transparent, Tech Powered and Transformative — shape how we work, build and grow together. We are a community of people who care deeply about making a meaningful impact in music and technology.

Kobalt is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in equitable access to opportunities and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and supportive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know — we're happy to help.

If this sounds like you, then please share your story by filling out the application below.

Important Notice

Applicants must be eligible to work in the United Kingdom. A full DBS check will be conducted on acceptance of the offer. Kobalt is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any status or characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Director, Sync Licensing Administration
job.description:
Director, Sync Licensing Administration & Operations

Department: Sync
Location: London, UK
Hybrid Working: 3 days in your local office
Full-time | Permanent

The Role

We’re looking for a Director, Sync Licensing Administration & Operations to oversee our UK sync licensing administration function.

You’ll be responsible for ensuring sync agreements move efficiently from deal through contracting and administration, providing expertise on complex licensing matters and maintaining the contractual and operational standards that protect Kobalt and our creators.

But this role is about more than running the process as it exists today.

We’re looking for someone with a curious, solutions-focused mindset who wants to understand how work gets done, challenge unnecessary complexity and find better ways of doing things. You’ll look for opportunities to streamline workflows, use data more effectively and introduce automation and AI where they can improve speed, accuracy and scalability.

You’ll work closely with our US team and colleagues across Creative, Business Affairs, Legal, Copyright, Product, Technology and Data to help evolve licensing administration into an increasingly data-led and technology-enabled function.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the UK Sync Licensing Administration function, working closely with US counterparts to deliver consistent global standards and ways of working.
  • Oversee the end-to-end administration of publishing sync agreements, ensuring licensing activity is accurate, commercially responsive and appropriately governed.
  • Provide expertise and escalation support on complex licensing and contractual matters.
  • Work closely with Business Affairs and Legal on negotiation principles, contractual approaches and appropriate commercial risk.
  • Get close to existing processes and workflows, identifying bottlenecks, repetitive tasks and opportunities to simplify how work gets done.
  • Take the initiative in designing and implementing more efficient workflows, rather than accepting established processes as fixed.
  • Explore and implement automation, AI and agentic solutions that reduce manual administration and allow the team to focus on higher-value work.
  • Work confidently with large datasets, using SQL and increasingly AWS Athena to query and investigate operational data.
  • Build and interpret dashboards and reporting in Tableau to understand performance, identify trends and inform decisions.
  • Define meaningful operational KPIs and use data to understand licensing volumes, turnaround times, exceptions, risk and opportunities for improvement.
  • Experiment with Kobalt’s available technology and AI tooling to identify practical solutions to operational problems.
  • Translate operational challenges into clear requirements and work with Product, Technology and Data teams where more complex solutions are required.
  • Build strong partnerships across Creative, Sync, Copyright, Royalties, Legal, Finance and Technology.
  • Contribute to the continued development of Kobalt’s global licensing administration operating model.

What You’ll Bring

    • Extensive experience within music publishing sync licensing administration, with a thorough technical understanding of publishing sync agreements, global copyright structures, multi-territory licensing practices, and European copyright nuances.
    • Proven track record of independently managing complex licensing matters and contractual disputes, applying sound commercial judgement to balance revenue opportunity, operational capacity and contractual risk.
    • Evidenced success in identifying operational bottlenecks and implementing measurable process improvements, rather than simply maintaining legacy administration workflows.
    • Strong analytical capability with extensive, practical experience auditing and interrogating large datasets to answer operational questions and resolve discrepancies.
    • Direct, hands-on experience querying structured data using SQL and query engines such as AWS Athena to drive operational reporting and analysis.
    • Proven ability to build, maintain and interpret operational dashboards and business intelligence reporting, specifically using Tableau or comparable platforms.
    • Demonstrable experience designing and deploying workflow automation to eliminate manual, repetitive administrative tasks and improve processing turnaround times.
    • Practical experience applying generative AI and agentic tooling (such as Claude, Gemini, AWS Quick, or NotebookLM) directly within administrative, operational, or documentation workflows.
    • Proven technical autonomy and confidence to experiment, prototype and deploy operational solutions independently, rather than relying solely on Product, Data or Technology teams.
    • Hands-on experience working with contract lifecycle management (CLM), rights management, or legal technology platforms to administer licensing lifecycles.
    • Proven track record of cross-functional stakeholder management, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across Creative, Legal & Business Affairs, Data, Product and Technology.

Key Behaviours for Success

Curiosity & Continuous Improvement: You question how things work today, explore what could work better and proactively turn ideas into practical improvements.

Problem-Solving & Initiative: You don’t simply identify problems or pass them to another team. You investigate the root cause, explore solutions and take ownership of moving improvements forward.

Technology & Data Mindset:You’re comfortable getting hands-on with data and technology and are curious about how emerging tools can improve the way the function operates.

Interview Process

  • Introductory call with a member of our Recruitment Team
  • Interview with the hiring manager
  • Technical/data and problem-solving interview
  • Final stage interview with relevant stakeholders
  • Feedback at each stage

We aim to complete the full interview process from initial application to offer within three working weeks. While we do our best to meet this timeline, there may be occasional delays. If that happens, our Recruitment Team will keep you updated every step of the way.

Why Choose Us

At Kobalt, we’ve championed creators since 2000. Our technology and music services are built to make the industry more transparent, fair, and rewarding for artists, songwriters, and rights holders. We’re proud to work with some of the world’s most influential talents including Phoebe Bridgers, Sam Fender, Paul McCartney, Foo Fighters, Karol G, Young Thug, Kali Uchis, and Andrew Watt as well as acclaimed writers like Simon Aldred (Rag’n’Bone Man, Liam Gallagher, Celeste) and Clarence Coffee Jr. (Dua Lipa, Lizzo, The Snuts).

We’re a company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and progress. Our values: Music First, Transparent, Tech Powered, and Transformative. Shape how we work, build, and grow together. We are a community of people who care deeply about making a meaningful impact in music and technology.

Kobalt is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in equitable access to opportunities and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace. job.title: Intern, Contract Administration
job.description:

We are looking for a highly detail-oriented and proactive Intern to join our Contract Administration team. Based in Nashville, this role supports the onboarding, interpretation, and administration of our client agreements, a crucial step in ensuring we deliver accurate, timely royalty collections and reporting to our creators.

You’ll play an essential part in maintaining the integrity of our publishing agreements within Kobalt’s bespoke operational systems and supporting ongoing contract workflows. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their career who enjoys solving technical challenges, has a curious mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. There is an opportunity for a full-time role at the end of this internship, dependent on company needs and performance in the role.

What You’ll Do

  • Interpret and input key terms from publishing agreements, including Schedule 1s, into our proprietary operations system
  • Assist in maintaining accurate records, tracking logs, and system documentation
  • Provide general administrative support to the broader Contract Administration team
  • Handle high-volume deliveries efficiently by mapping datasets into our internal custom template

  • Experience working in an administrative or detail-driven capacity
  • Responsive to timely emails and ability to meet deadlines

job.title: Manager, Royalties
job.description:
Manager, Royalties

DEPARTMENT: Royalties, Tracking & Business Intelligence

TEAM: Royalties - Data Processing

LOCATION: London (5th Floor, Goldings House, Hays Galleria, 2 Hay's Lane, London, SE1 2HB, United Kingdom) - Hybrid [3 days a week in office]

REPORTING TO: George Wroodgate - Senior Manager, Royalties

Joining the growing Royalties team in our London office, the Royalties Manager will head up the Data Processing (DP) team. You will play a crucial role in managing the ingestion of royalty statements from societies, sub-publishers, direct licensees, and flow-through into our bespoke in-house rights management software.

This role requires a detail-oriented, highly analytical leader who can confidently oversee the Identification process—combining technical and manual methods to accurately match incoming royalties to works, right types, exploitation dates, territories, revenue sources, audio-visuals, and sub-accounts. You will navigate incoming queries, new process requests, oversee bespoke ingestion and identification for non-standard sources, and ensure high accuracy through rigorous scheduled quarterly QC tasks while constantly iterating and improving on existing workflows.

The Role

Joining the growing Royalties team in our London office, the Royalties Manager will head up the Data Processing (DP) team. You will play a crucial role in managing the ingestion of royalty statements from societies, sub-publishers, direct licensees, and flow-through into our bespoke in-house rights management software.

This role requires a detail-oriented, highly analytical leader who can confidently oversee the Identification process—combining technical and manual methods to accurately match incoming royalties to works, right types, exploitation dates, territories, revenue sources, audio-visuals, and sub-accounts. You will navigate incoming queries, new process requests, oversee bespoke ingestion and identification for non-standard sources, and ensure high accuracy through rigorous scheduled quarterly QC tasks while constantly iterating and improving on existing workflows.

Requirements

What You’ll Do

  • Team Leadership & Oversight: Manage, develop, and support the Data Processing team responsible for royalty statement ingestion and complex identification processes.
  • Statement Ingestion: Oversee the ingestion of royalty statements from diverse sources including societies, sub-publishers, direct licensees, and flow-through into our proprietary royalty processing software.
  • Identification & Matching: Lead the work identification processes, utilising both technical and manual methods to accurately match incoming royalties to works, right types (radio, streaming, performance, mechanical), exploitation dates, territories, revenue sources, audio-visuals, and sub-accounts.
  • Bespoke Processing: Design and execute custom ingestion and identification processesfor sources that do not adhere to standard formats or normal processes.
  • Quality Control: Execute a large volume of scheduled QC tasks throughout the quarter to check and maintain the highest accuracy of the team's work.
  • Process Improvement: Constantly review, iterate, and improve upon existing ingestion and identification processes to maximize efficiency and keep up to date with changing industry standards.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Interpret and communicate information received from various stakeholders (Copyright, Tech, Client Relations) to ensure processing methods are altered when necessary.
  • Ad-Hoc Query Resolution: Efficiently manage and resolve ad-hoc queries and process requests from internal teams and external partners, ensuring timely and clear communication.
  • Documentation: Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation for all data processing workflows, ingestion rules, and quality control procedures.
  • Team Training & Upskilling: Lead training initiatives to continually upskill team members on new tools, system updates, and changing industry standards.

What You’ll Bring

Essential:

  • Data & Analytics: Numeracy, exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and strong analytical skills.
  • Processing Expertise: Solid understanding of music publishing, copyright & royalty processes, particularly regarding global statement ingestion and data matching.
  • Technical Proficiency: Confident Excel user (calculating percentages, manipulating large datasets using formulas and pivot tables); familiarity with rights management software.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to think of improvements to existing tools and processes to continually enhance what we do to achieve our goals.
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills with experience communicating to a wide-ranging audience of varying seniority, skill, and knowledge.

Preferred:

  • People Management: Experience in supervising, managing, and motivating team members.
  • SQL Skills: Background and knowledge of SQL or other domain-specific languages used in programming is preferred.

Additional Skills That Could Add Value

  • Solutions-orientated and adaptable to change.
  • Track-record of excellent organization & prioritisation skills working under high pressure and to tight deadlines.
  • Uses initiative to problem-solve.
  • Positive, determined attitude.
  • Empathetic, open, and honest.
  • Confident in decision-making and own abilities.

Key Behaviours for Success

  • Leads and develops others: Sets clear expectations, coaches with empathy, shares knowledge and holds the team accountable for quality and delivery.
  • Takes ownership of accuracy and outcomes: Prioritises effectively, applies rigorous quality checks and resolves issues promptly to meet processing deadlines.
  • Challenges and improves processes: Uses data and initiative to identify root causes, simplify workflows and implement practical improvements, adapting as requirements change.
  • Collaborates and communicates clearly: Builds effective relationships across teams, translates complex information into clear actions and keeps stakeholders informed of progress, risks and decisions.

Interview Process

  • Introductory call with a member of our Recruitment Team
  • Interview with the hiring manager
  • Interview with relevant members of the Royalties team
  • Final stage interview
  • Feedback at each stage

We aim to complete the full interview process from initial application to offer within three working weeks. While we do our best to meet this timeline, there may be occasional delays. If that happens, our Recruitment Team will keep you updated every step of the way.

Benefits

Kobalt Music Group Employee Benefits from Day 1

  • Annual Leave: Contractually 25 days, however Kobalt closes its offices for the 3 days between Christmas and New Year’s when staff contribute 1 day.
  • Life Assurance: Equal to four (4) times base salary.
  • Income Protection: Covers up to 75% of base salary up to the age of 65.
  • Travel Insurance: Business travel insurance cover.
  • Gym Membership: Corporate rates available at Nuffield Health and Fitness First. Kobalt will subsidise £45.00 per month towards your corporate gym membership if your membership is processed through company payroll.
  • Eyecare: Full eye test provided at a range of opticians through a voucher scheme.
  • Wellbeing: Wellbeing Hub and Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Food & Drink: Fresh fruit, selection of snacks and cereal supplied.
  • Regular Socials: Including seasonal social events and parties.

Post Probationay Period Benefits

  • Pension: Kobalt’s pension scheme is currently with Aviva. On passing probation, staff can select to move to salary sacrifice and benefit from a 2.5% - 5% company matched contribution.
  • Private Medical Insurance: Policy is with the AVIVA ‘select’ scheme.
  • Travel Insurance: Personal travel insurance, individual or family cover.
  • Interest Free Season Ticket Loan: (eligible after 1 month of service) Loans deducted from net pay over a 12-month period.
  • Cycle to Work Scheme: In partnership with Evans Cycles.

Why Choose Us

At Kobalt, we’ve championed creators since 2000. Our technology and music services are built to make the industry more transparent, fair and rewarding for artists, songwriters and rights holders. We’re proud to work with some of the world’s most influential talents including Phoebe Bridgers, Sam Fender, Paul McCartney, Foo Fighters, Karol G, Young Thug, Kali Uchis, FINNEAS and Andrew Watt, as well as acclaimed writers like Simon Aldred (Rag’n’Bone Man, Liam Gallagher, Celeste) and Clarence Coffee Jr. (Dua Lipa, Lizzo, The Snuts).

We’re a company that thrives on creativity, collaboration and progress. Our values — Music First, Transparent, Tech Powered and Transformative — shape how we work, build and grow together. We are a community of people who care deeply about making a meaningful impact in music and technology.

Kobalt is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in equitable access to opportunities and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and supportive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re happy to help.

If this sounds like you, then please share your story by filling out the application below.

Important Notice

Applicants must be eligible to work in the United Kingdom. A full DBS check will be conducted on acceptance of the offer. Kobalt is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any status or characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Deputy Managing Editor, Limited Term
job.description:
Title: Deputy Managing Editor

Schedule Format - Location:Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: $129,776 - $162,220 Annually



A Deputy Managing Editor at KQED’s primary responsibility is to direct strategy and management of senior editors and reporters on beats across the newsroom, as well as to generate story ideas and execute edits with members of the newsroom. A deputy managing editor at KQED works closely with managing editors to set editorial priorities on coverage across our platforms. A deputy managing editor assists managing editors in shaping coverage, and often manages and directs editors, reporters and producers throughout the newsroom. 

Deputy managing editors work closely with managing editors to work as part of our newsroom leadership to take our editorial priorities and help decide how to greenlight stories and projects with those guiding principles in mind.

Deputy managing editors also provide direction, editing and help to other senior editors as needed, but work as a strong and empathetic leader and manager to senior editors as well.  

California Newsroom Editor Addendum

The California Newsroom, a collaboration of public radio and nonprofit news outlets in the state spearheaded by KQED, is seeking a deputy managing editor to lead statewide content planning and coordination. This position is a six-month, limited-term position with a possibility to be extended.

This position requires a journalist who is skilled in leading collaborations and partnerships across multiple newsrooms. We are seeking an empathetic and human-centered manager who works well with people at all levels of experience, from early-career reporters to seasoned editors. The deputy managing editor will also be a key editorial strategist, working closely with news directors, reporters and editors from multiple outlets to serve the needs of all the partner newsrooms, from major outlets in large markets to smaller stations with limited resources and personnel. 

This editor will work in collaboration with journalists spread across 14 public radio stations and other partners such as the nonprofit news organization CalMatters to ensure coverage of significant issues, assigning and editing daily news and in-depth features and projects. The editor will also be responsible for coordinating California coverage for a national audience in partnership with NPR.

This editor will work closely with the California Newsroom Managing Editor to ensure that content production aligns with larger strategic goals. The Deputy Managing Editor will step in to run the entire California Newsroom operation in the absence of the Managing Editor, so we’re seeking candidates with both impeccable news judgment and advanced managerial skills. This is a remote position, but the editor must reside in California. The Deputy Managing Editor will manage from 1-4 journalists.

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. We value the contributions of marginalized people in society, including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people, and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do. We strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics: https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics
 

The mission that drives us:

KQED provides citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.




Essential Functions:
  • Coordinates with newsroom leaders throughout California on daily news coverage, major breaking news and long-term joint projects.
  • Maintains a running database of assignments and planning.
  • Oversees California Newsroom employees assigned to content production and planning. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Non-Essential Functions:
  • Occasionally fills in for other colleagues.
  • Represents KQED at events.

Knowledge/Experience Required:
  • At least five years of experience in a similar role in a newsroom or news environment.
  • Interest and knowledge in California news.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills; clear communication with colleagues.
  • Excellent news judgment.
  • Thorough command of journalistic principles, ethics and standards.
  • Ability to meet deadlines and goals while working under pressure.
  • Proven collaboration skills, which are essential in working with fellow KQED staffers across departments and with partner organizations.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to stay focused, organized, communicative and proactive while working with a number of journalists and staffers across the organization and dealing with several different editors.
  • Ability to stay organized and prioritize tasks when working on multiple projects at once.

Knowledge/Experience Desired:
  • Non-English language skills (fluency in Spanish, Mandarin or other widely spoken languages in California).
  • Previous work as a newsroom manager.
  • Proven capacity to identify opportunities for stories of high relevance to audiences.
NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as necessary to meet the ongoing needs of this organization.

job.title: Engagement Producer, Close All Tabs
job.description:
Title: Engagement Producer, Close All Tabs

Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: $42.00 - $51.00 per hour
 


Close All Tabs, KQED’s tech and internet culture podcast, is looking for a part-time Engagement  Producer specializing in video to join our team. The show breaks down how the digital world impacts our real lives, and we’re bringing that mission to video. 

You’ll create video and social content for our digital platforms. This includes short-form vertical videos like interview highlights, explainers, behind-the-scenes content, and person on the street interviews. You’ll also create image assets, graphics, and caption copy. 

Working closely with the Close All Tabs podcast team, you’ll adapt the show’s audio storytelling into a visual medium and help refine its look and tone. You’ll take each video from idea to publication: pitching, scripting, shooting, editing/post-production, and posting. You’ll also be responsible for helping grow the show’s social presence, expanding to new platforms, and contributing to audience growth. 

This is a hands-on role for an experienced visual storyteller who wants to combine polished video skills with strange, absurd, and compelling stories from the internet. 

This is a part-time, limited term position reporting to the Senior Editor, Close All Tabs.

 

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics

The mission that drives us:

KQED provides citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.


Job duties:
  • Pitch, produce, and edit short-form video content for Close All Tabs’ social channels, including Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube shorts.
  • Write scripts, production notes, shot lists, and other planning materials
  • Work with the podcast’s producers on a social media plan to promote new episodes 
  • Run single-person or potentially small-crew video production shoots and field work, maintaining professional standards for video and audio recording
  • Direct performance and delivery of host and other on-camera talent
  • Find and license third-party b-roll, photos, music, and other materials, ensuring appropriate rights and permissions
  • Optimize content to perform on each platform (length, format, captions, hashtags, thumbnails, calls to actions) and keep up to date with algorithm changes and new formats
  • Track performance metrics (views, reach, engagement, follower growth, click-throughs to episodes and subscriptions) and use the results to shape creative strategy
  • Maintain an organized archive of assets and templates, and streamline production workflows
  • Follow KQED editorial standards, journalistic ethics, and standards for accuracy and fairness
  • Meet production and publishing deadlines while managing multiple assignments

Knowledge/Experience Required
  • Three or more years of video production, video journalism, or multimedia experience (podcast, newsroom, or digital media preferred)
  • Fluency in video editing and post-production tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or Final Cut Pro, plus Descript for selecting and editing video.
  • Comfort with static image design (Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva) and motion graphic templates
  • Demonstrated ability to produce compelling short- and long-form video, especially for talk-based or interview-driven formats
  • Strong storytelling instincts: spotting moments that hook viewers, spark emotion, and prompt engagement
  • Experience growing a show’s or brand’s social presence through original, engaging video ideas
  • Strong grasp of how each social platforms works: (Instagram feed, stories, and reels; TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook), including what drives performance and growth
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects at once, prioritize under tight deadlines, and collaborate closely with teammates
  • Solid understanding of journalistic principles, including ethics, accuracy, fairness, attribution, and editorial standards

Knowledge/Experience Desired:
  • Experience working in a public media newsroom or mission-driven journalism organization
  • Familiarity with audio production and sound design
  • Experience with long-form video content, including interviews, video essays, and short documentaries
  • Experience covering technology and the internet, and a real interest in internet culture, online communities, or gaming
  • Experience producing journalism for younger or hard-to-reach digital audiences
  • Experience with professional cameras, lenses, lighting, and audio equipment
  • B.A./B.S. degree in journalism, communications, film, media production, or a related field preferred
  • Love of absurd internet humor a plus

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as necessary to meet the ongoing needs of this organization.

job.title: Director of Financial Planning and Analysis
job.description:
Lee Enterprises is seeking an experienced, hands-on Director of Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) to lead the company's financial planning, forecasting, and reporting functions. This position will play a key role in supporting financial decision-making across the organization by delivering accurate financial reporting, actionable insights, and forward-looking analysis.

The Director of FP&A will oversee the corporate FP&A team and partner closely with Finance leadership and operational business units to drive financial performance, improve reporting capabilities, and support strategic business objectives.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the company's annual budgeting, periodic forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes.

Coordinate financial planning activities across departments and business units, ensuring consistent assumptions, accurate submissions, and alignment with company objectives.

Drive continuous improvement in forecasting accuracy and financial planning processes.

Financial Reporting

Oversee preparation and delivery of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting packages for executive leadership.

Lead financial variance analysis, including comparisons to budget, forecast, and prior-year results, with clear explanations of key business drivers.

Support preparation of financial materials and analysis for executive leadership, Board of Directors meetings, and quarterly earnings reporting.

Partner with Accounting to ensure financial reporting accuracy, consistency, and alignment with monthly and quarterly close processes.

Business Partnership & Financial Analysis

Monitor company performance through financial and operational KPIs, identifying trends and opportunities for improvement.

Serve as a key financial partner to departments and business leaders, providing analysis and actionable recommendations to support operational and strategic decisions.

Perform financial analysis related to business initiatives, cost optimization, resource allocation, and investment opportunities.

Develop and maintain models to identify opportunities to improve profitability, manage expenses, and optimize cash flow performance.

Financial Systems & Process Improvement

Oversee administration, maintenance, and ongoing development of the company's financial planning and reporting systems.

Ensure integrity, accuracy, and consistency of financial information across planning, reporting, and accounting systems.

Identify opportunities to automate reporting, streamline financial processes, and improve productivity through technology.

Develop and maintain financial reporting tools and processes, supporting training and adoption across the organization.

Team Leadership & Development

Lead, mentor, and develop the corporate FP&A team, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Ensure timely and accurate delivery of financial reporting, forecasts, and analysis.

Support the ongoing development of FP&A capabilities, processes, and talent to meet evolving business needs.

Core Competencies:

Strong financial planning, forecasting, financial modeling, and analytical capabilities.

Ability to interpret complex financial information and communicate meaningful insights to executive leadership.

Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to develop and motivate team members.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present financial results and recommendations clearly.

Desire to improve efficiencies through technology, automation, and process improvement.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take ownership of deliverables.

Strong attention to detail with a commitment to financial accuracy and reporting integrity.

Ability to collaborate effectively across departments and build productive working relationships.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field required.

7+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, corporate finance, accounting, or a related discipline.

Prior experience managing or leading finance professionals preferred.

Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial modeling required.

Experience with enterprise financial planning, reporting, or ERP systems preferred.

Experience with business intelligence and reporting tools preferred.

Strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance analysis.

Location

This position will be located at Lee Enterprises' headquarters office in Davenport, Iowa, with hybrid and remote work arrangements considered for qualified candidates.

Why Join Us?

Lee Enterprises offers competitive wages in a dynamic, interesting work environment with career growth opportunities. We offer an extensive benefit program that can be personalized to your needs. Our benefit program includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, company provided life insurance and supplemental life insurance. This includes paid parental leave for new parents.

job.title: News Intern - Greensboro, NC
job.description:
NEWSROOM INTERNSHIP IN GREENSBORO, N.C.

The Greensboro News & Record, a Lee Enterprises company, located in Greensboro, NC., is now hiring a creative, motivated student journalist or recent graduate for a 10-week paid internship this summer.

We want our interns to walk away with a rewarding, real-world newsroom experience, a pile of great clips and the skills they need to develop into the next generation of journalists.

Qualified candidates should be inquisitive self-starters capable of producing compelling content for our digital and print platforms. Interns should feel empowered to find and pitch great stories about our increasingly diverse communities. We want multitaskers who can juggle multiple assignments and embrace all facets of multimedia storytelling.

We will provide an atmosphere of collaboration and support for all interns.

For our summer internships, we are seeking a variety of applicants, from news and sports reporters to photographers and videographers, but successful candidates will be innovative, prolific and deadline-driven.

Interns will work alongside professional journalists in our newsroom, who will provide guidance, direction and support. Interns will receive customized training on topics such as how to develop sources, how to build a digital audience and how to pitch a great story. They’ll also have access to Pulitzer Prize-winning journalists who are part of the Lee Enterprises network of 73 news markets across the U.S.

job.title: Omni-Channel Digital Campaign Manager, Remote
job.description:
Omni-Channel Digital Campaign Manager, Remote

Amplified Digital, a division of Lee Enterprises, is seeking a highly skilled and analytical Omni-Channel Digital Campaign Manager to manage, optimize, and scale digital advertising campaigns across multiple platforms, with a primary focus on Google Ads, Meta, and programmatic demand-side platforms (DSPs).

This position will be responsible for the hands-on execution of paid media campaigns, advanced conversion tracking and attribution, and in-depth performance analysis to drive measurable business outcomes for our clients. The ideal candidate combines strong technical platform expertise with a strategic mindset, leveraging data to uncover optimization opportunities, improve campaign performance, and support client retention and upsell opportunities.

This role will work closely with our Client Experience, Sales, Analytics, and Product teams to translate campaign data into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.

Position Responsibilities

Campaign Management & Optimization: Build, launch, manage, and optimize digital advertising campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube), Meta (Facebook and Instagram), and programmatic DSPs.

Performance Analysis: Conduct detailed campaign performance evaluations, identifying trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS), conversion rates, and overall advertising effectiveness.

Attribution & Conversion Tracking: Implement, troubleshoot, and maintain conversion tracking and attribution solutions utilizing Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Ads, Meta Pixel, and Conversions API (CAPI).

Advanced Analytics: Perform deep-dive analysis across advertising platforms, website analytics, and customer conversion data to assess the complete customer journey, identify attribution gaps, and recommend data-driven improvements.

Strategic Growth Opportunities: Proactively identify campaign expansion, budget reallocation, cross-channel advertising, and upsell opportunities based on performance data, audience insights, and client business objectives.

Cross-Channel Strategy: Evaluate performance across Google, Meta, and programmatic channels to develop cohesive strategies that maximize advertising effectiveness throughout the customer journey.

Reporting & Insights: Develop actionable performance insights and recommendations utilizing GA4 and other reporting platforms. Translate complex datasets into clear findings for internal teams and client-facing discussions.

Technical Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve tracking discrepancies, conversion reporting issues, campaign delivery challenges, and platform integration problems.

Campaign Quality & Compliance: Ensure campaigns adhere to platform advertising policies, internal best practices, budget pacing requirements, and established quality assurance standards.

Automation & Efficiency: Leverage platform automation, AI-powered bidding strategies, and campaign management technologies to improve operational efficiency and campaign performance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Client Experience, Sales, Product, and technical teams to develop advertising strategies, resolve performance concerns, and deliver recommendations that support client growth.

Platform Expertise: Stay current on changes to advertising platforms, measurement capabilities, privacy regulations, AI-driven optimization, and emerging digital advertising opportunities.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Advanced proficiency in Google Ads, including campaign architecture, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, keyword management, and conversion-based optimization.

Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and programmatic advertising platforms, including The Trade Desk, DV360, or comparable DSPs.

Demonstrated expertise in GA4 and Google Tag Manager, including event configuration, conversion tracking, attribution analysis, and technical troubleshooting.

Understanding of server-side tracking, enhanced conversions, Meta Conversions API, offline conversion imports, and CRM-based attribution.

Ability to interpret complex performance datasets and identify meaningful insights beyond standard platform reporting.

Strong understanding of marketing attribution models, conversion paths, customer acquisition costs, and the limitations of platform-reported performance.

Experience analyzing campaign performance to identify opportunities for budget expansion, incremental investment, and additional advertising products.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently investigate performance discrepancies and recommend solutions.

Ability to communicate technical findings and strategic recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client accounts, competing priorities, and performance deadlines.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment with an emphasis on accountability, continuous optimization, and measurable client outcomes.

Self-motivated with a proactive approach to identifying performance improvements and growth opportunities.

Certifications:

Google Ads Search Certification required.

Google Analytics Certification required or willingness to obtain within 90 days.

Google Ads Display, Video, and Measurement certifications preferred.

Meta Blueprint and The Trade Desk Edge Academy certifications preferred.

Work Environment: Remote position with collaboration across distributed teams. Occasional travel may be required for team meetings or company events.

Education & Experience

3–5+ years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing paid digital advertising campaigns, preferably within a digital advertising agency.

Demonstrated experience managing Google Ads campaigns across multiple clients, industries, and budget levels.

Minimum 2 years of experience working with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and digital advertising conversion tracking.

Experience managing Meta advertising campaigns and working within at least one programmatic DSP.

Proven ability to analyze advertising performance, troubleshoot attribution discrepancies, and implement optimization strategies that produce measurable results.

Experience identifying strategic growth opportunities through campaign analysis and performance insights.

Familiarity with CRM integrations, offline conversion tracking, and first-party data measurement strategies preferred.

Experience with marketing automation, campaign management platforms, and reporting tools is a plus.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, Analytics, or a related field preferred. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

Preferred Platform & Software Experience:

Google Ads and Google Ads Editor

Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

Google Tag Manager (GTM)

Meta Ads Manager and Events Manager

The Trade Desk, DV360, Madhive, or similar DSPs

Looker Studio, Power BI, or comparable BI platforms

Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets (advanced proficiency)

HubSpot, Salesforce, or comparable CRM platforms

Campaign automation and management platforms

Compensation

Base Salary: $75,000 annually, plus performance-based bonus opportunities.

In addition to a competitive base salary, this position offers opportunities to earn performance-based bonuses tied to individual contributions and measurable business outcomes. Bonus considerations may include:

Achievement of campaign performance and optimization goals.

Client retention and overall account performance.

Identification of strategic upsell and revenue growth opportunities.

Operational efficiencies and improvements in campaign execution.

Contributions to broader team and company performance objectives.

Bonus eligibility and payouts will be determined based on established performance criteria and company guidelines.

Our benefit program includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, company provided life insurance and supplemental life insurance. job.title: Public Safety Reporter-Rapid City, SD
job.description:
Public Safety Reporter-Rapid City, SD

The Rapid City Journal, South Dakota’s largest newspaper, is looking for a curious, dogged public safety reporter to join our collaborative team in a competitive media market.

Our public safety reporter will tackle crime, courts and breaking news coverage as needed.

Rapid City is located in South Dakota’s Seventh Judicial Circuit and the federal South Dakota District Court’s Western Division, with the Pennington County Courthouse and Andrew W. Bogue Federal Building and U.S. Courthouse located within walking distance of the Rapid City Journal’s office in downtown Rapid City.

For a reporter who is interested in the intersection of legal process and human experiences, there are endless stories to tell. As a now-retired federal judge stationed at the federal courthouse in Rapid City once said, “It’s the kaleidoscope of human behavior that keeps us going.”

Our public safety reporter must possess the ability to take accurate notes in court without the aid of a recording device, along with an aptitude to sensitively communicate with families of victims and defendants alike. They will build relationships with prosecutors, defense attorneys, law enforcement and court staff to ensure all sides of a story are told in a fair and accurate manner. A knack for turning legal jargon and system processes into easily-understandable copy for our readers is paramount, as is the ability to produce quick turns on developing breaking news events, which often fall into the crime category.

Court coverage spans local cases and major crimes from the nearby Pine Ridge Reservation that move through the federal system. There is a disturbing number of missing persons cases on the reservation and in Rapid City, with both communities contending with Murdered and Missing Indigenous Peoples cases specifically. Cultural sensitivity in these cases is an important element for a candidate to possess.

It’s an exciting time to cover public safety for the Journal from an administrative angle as well. The South Dakota Supreme Court is considering a merger of the Seventh and Fourth Judicial circuits, which would create the state’s largest circuit by landmass. The Pennington County Jail contends with overcrowding and reports of issues with conditions as the county eyes a jail expansion, and the state recently opened a women’s prison in Rapid City.

The Journal newsroom is made up of great journalists who work hard and enjoy working together to tell the stories of the people, places and events happening in the Black Hills.

A bachelor’s degree in journalism or a related field is preferred.

Why Rapid City?

Rapid City is a scenic destination and hidden gem in the heart of America with a population over 80,000 that continues to grow. Western South Dakota includes the Black Hills National Forest, Crazy Horse Memorial, Mount Rushmore, Badlands National Park, Ellsworth Air Force Base, the Pine Ridge Indian Reservation, countless lakes, streams and outdoor recreation opportunities and the largest ski resort this side of the Rockies. Rapid City is a bustling and growing city that serves as a regional hub for tourism and commerce.

The Black Hills also holds claim to historic Deadwood, a relic of the Wild West and home to some of the best gaming resorts in the region. The nearby wide-open spaces reflect that same Western flair as well. We have mild winters, gorgeous summers and great people.

Why Join Us?

Lee Enterprises offers competitive wages in a dynamic, interesting work environment with career growth opportunities. We offer an extensive benefit program that can be personalized to your needs which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, company provided life insurance and supplemental life insurance. In addition, we offer a 401K retirement plan with company match. We also offer generous paid time off to allow the flexibility to balance personal life and work. This includes paid parental leave for new parents.

job.title: Program Director - Wild Country 99
job.description:
Position Summary

Leighton Media is seeking a reliable, energetic and creative Program Director to lead Wild Country 99 in St. Cloud, Minnesota. This role combines station programming, a compelling weekday on-air presence, music scheduling, digital and social engagement, production, promotions and day-to-day problem-solving. The Program Director will help protect and grow the Wild Country 99 brand while supporting the broader market team.

 

Essential Responsibilities

  • Prepare for and host a live, engaging on-air show Monday through Friday, including severe weather coverage as needed.
  • Provide day-to-day programming leadership for Wild Country 99 and maintain a consistent station sound and brand.
  • Work with MusicMaster on a daily basis to schedule music.
  • In addition to normal PD duties, syndication responsibilities for The Kelly Jordan Show on owned and operated affiliates.
  • Update station social media and digital platforms with contests, promotions, programming content and community information while following established brand standards.
  • Complete production and voice-tracking responsibilities, including at least one hour of production and voice tracking each week.
  • Coordinate station imaging, promotions, contests and on-air execution using established processes and software.
  • Host remote broadcasts, station appearances and community events as required.
  • Troubleshoot and help resolve transmitter, studio and other technical issues, escalating when appropriate.
  • Attend weekly team meetings, provide programming updates and collaborate with sales, promotions, digital and operations staff.
  • Meet applicable BMI reporting requirements on a quarterly basis.
  • Cover weekend or additional on-air shifts when needed.
  • Perform other duties that support the station and the Leighton Media team.

 

Qualifications

  • 3 – 5 years of Previous radio programming and on-air experience; country-format experience is a must.
  • Passion, energy and enthusiasm for local radio, the Wild Country 99 brand and Leighton Media.
  • Strong communication, organization, decision-making and time-management skills.
  • Ability to coach, collaborate and work effectively across programming, sales, promotions, digital and operations.
  • Experience with music scheduling and broadcast automation systems; MusicMaster experience is preferred.
  • Experience using Adobe Audition and Microsoft 365 is preferred.
  • Social media and digital content skills, with an understanding of how to extend on-air programming across platforms.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including occasional evenings, weekends, remote broadcasts and severe weather coverage.

 

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $60,000-$80,000 annually, depending on experience. Leighton Media offers a 401(k) plan, employee stock ownership plan (ESOP), health, disability and life insurance, comprehensive training programs and vacation time.
