job.title: Bookings Manager - HSMH
job.description:
Job Summary:

About Hindley Street Music Hall:
Join the team at Hindley Street Music Hall, Adelaide's purpose-built home for live entertainment in the heart of the city's vibrant West End. A flexible space offering standing, seated and cabaret configurations, the Hall is designed to deliver exceptional experiences across music, comedy, theatre and more. As part of the Live Nation Group, be part of a venue built for the future of live entertainment in South Australia.

 

About the role:

Adelaide’s live music calendar needs a safe pair of hands and a sharp commercial eye. As Bookings Manager at Hindley St Music Hall, you’ll own the diary for the venue and its sister room, Div-de, working with promoters, agents and clients to lift the show count and keep the doors open more nights of the week.

 

You’ll lock in great shows, develop venue-produced events, turn dark days into private hire wins and lead the Club Bookers at Div-de. You’ll do it as part of Venue Nation Australia, part of Live Nation Australasia, with the backing of a national venue portfolio and plenty of room to spot new opportunities.

 

If bookings are your thing and you’re ready for your next move in Adelaide, we’d love to hear from you. Send through your resume and a cover letter telling us what you’d bring to the calendar.

 

 

What you’ll be doing: 

·       Calendar management: Run the booking diary for Hindley St Music Hall and Div-de, keeping event statuses accurate and venue use at its best.

·       Event development: Lead the creation of venue-produced events and drive private hire on dark days.

·       Relationships and new business: Build strong ties with promoters, agents and clients, and chase new business and cross-selling opportunities across the portfolio.

·       Negotiation and contracts: Work with the Bookings & Programming Director to negotiate deals that sit outside standard hire agreements.

·       Settlements and reporting: Oversee event settlements with the Venue Manager and Finance, and deliver weekly and monthly reporting on bookings, sales, pricing and attendance.

·       People leadership: Coach and support the Club Bookers at Div-de to keep the team engaged and performing.

 

 

 

What you’ll bring:

·       Booking experience: 5+ years in live events, venue booking or programming, ideally in a similar venue or entertainment setting.

·       Relationship skills: A knack for building long-term partnerships with promoters, agents and clients.

·       Negotiation know-how: Confidence working through contracts, artist fees and event-specific terms.

·       Organised and detail-driven: Strong time management and an eye for detail across contracts, event statuses and settlements.

·       Commercial mindset: A proactive, strategic thinker who spots opportunities and goes after new clients.

·       Tech confidence: Familiarity with venue software like VenueElite or Momentus, plus Microsoft Office and Slack.

·       Flexible and passionate: A genuine love of live entertainment and the adaptability to work outside standard hours in a fast-paced environment.

 


The Benefits:

·       A vibrant, music-focused workplace fostering creativity and collaboration.

·       Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

·       A flexible approach to when and where you work, designed to support balance in all aspects of life.

·       Access to concerts, events, and other entertainment perks.

·       A diverse, equitable workplace where every voice matters.

·       Comprehensive benefits, from volunteer days to wellness programs and mental health support.

 

Equal Opportunities: 

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and Homelife. As a growing business, we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

job.title: C3 Presents - Associate Manager, Guest Services Production
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

C3 Presents creates music festival experiences for millions of fans across the globe, setting the new standard each year for events that are as memorable as they are spectacular, including Austin City Limits Music Festival in Texas and Lollapalooza in Chicago (and seven other countries.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

The Associate Manager, Guest Services Production is responsible for operational planning, vendor administration, process development, and resource coordination for Guest Services programs across C3 Presents festivals and events.

The Associate Manager evaluates operational needs, identifies risks, and recommends improvements that support consistent and efficient execution across the event portfolio.   Working in partnership with Guest Services leadership and cross-functional teams, the position manages departmental timelines, deliverables, approvals, vendor requirements, contracts, inventory, signage, and event-specific documentation.

The role also provides onsite support and oversees coordination of warehouse operations, departmental inventory, documentation, and vendor requirements. The position requires flexibility for travel, evenings, weekends, and additional hours during peak event periods.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

•  Manage Guest Services operational planning across the event portfolio, establishing priorities, project trackers, timelines, deliverables, and accountability in collaboration with departmental leadership and cross-functional partners.  Follow up on outstanding items, encourage submissions ahead of deadlines, and maintain verification forms and year-over-year event records. 

•  Manage operational relationships with Guest Service vendors throughout the advancement process, serving as primary point of contact for requirements, timelines, contracts, payments, and issue resolutions.  Track annual and multi-show agreements, identify contract concerns, and monitor adherence to applicable price locks. 

•  Coordinate vendor access to require systems and information, prepare and submit vendor and nonprofit organization (NPO) contracts, and track vendor invoices through C3PO.    

•  Manage the build, configuration, and regularly audit the Advancement Management Platform (AMP).  Oversee vendor setup, approval workflows, Notion documentation updates, removal of outdated requests, and coordination of last-minute changes.  Evaluate system practices and recommend improvements. 

•  Maintain accurate, organized, and accessible departmental documentation in Box, SharePoint, Asana, and Google Drive, including project folders, seasonal records, meeting materials, vendor resources, and event specific operational files. 

•  Oversee Guest Services Airtable workflows, including contract lists, signage processes, and event-level tracking.  Coordinate with Guest Services Production and Access leads across the event slate, communicate C3 signage updates to vendors, and track completion. 

•  Develop and maintain Guest Services standard operating procedures (SOPs) and recurring processes, ensuring materials remain current, practical, clearly documented, and consistently implemented across events. Recommend changes that improve consistency, efficiency, and service delivery across events.

•  Partner with Guest Services Production team to plan warehouse operations and departmental resource allocation.  Assess and organize inventory, recommend purchasing and logistics decisions, and coordinate final inventory communications.

•  Coordinate and track the location, movement, and allocation of Ropacks and other departmental assets.

•  Evaluate inventory and warehouse processes and recommend improvements to support event readiness and effective use of department resources.

• Develop and maintain onsite operational guides, documents, and reference materials that clearly communicate event-specific requirements, decisions, and procedures to staff, vendors, and cross-functional teams.

•  Collaborate, track, develop, and maintain relevant documentation and assets that support large scale staff training and company hospitality expectations.

•  Provide onsite Guest Services Production support for approximately 25% of C3 events. Assess and resolve operational issues within assigned authority, coordinate with vendors and event teams, and escalate significant matters to leadership.

•  Conduct post-event reviews of operational process, vendor performance, and resource needs; recommend improvements for future events.

•  Support additional projects and events and perform other duties as assigned.


WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

•  Bachelor’s degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

•  Two or more years of experience in event operations, project management, production, hospitality, vendor management, administrative operations, or a related field. 

•  Demonstrated ability to evaluate operational challenges, exercise sound judgement, and recommend or implement solutions.

•  Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, deadlines, stakeholders, and detailed deliverables simultaneously.

•  Strong vendor relationship and contract administration skills, including the ability to identify issues and coordinate resolutions.

•  Ability to develop, document, and improve operational processes and procedures.

•  Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across teams and with external partners.

•  Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace. Experience with Notion, Airtable, project management tools, contract systems, or inventory systems is a plus.

•  Strong attention to detail, follow-through, tact, and diplomacy.

•  Ability to work independently, adapt to changing priorities, and remain composed in a fast-paced live event environment. 

•  Interest in live music, festivals, hospitality, or event production preferred.

•  Ability to travel and work evenings, weekends, and additional hours during event periods. 

•  Ability to lift and move up to 30 pounds and participate in warehouse and onsite operational work.

     

C3 CORE COMPETENCIES:

•  Demonstrate integrity in the way you operate in day-to-day business and the way you deal with people

•  Communicate effectively with various audiences by organizing and delivering information appropriately and listening actively to others

•  Proactively seek solutions to problems. Be enthusiastic and energetic in your approach to your job. Commit to putting in extra effort with a positive attitude.

•  Be flexible in handling change, able to juggle multiple demands, and adaptable to new situations with fresh ideas or innovative approaches

•  Stay composed, confident, optimistic, and in problem-solving mode when the going gets tough

•  Possess the skills needed to perform your job well, paying close attention to detail, accuracy, and completeness

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

 

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

job.title: Client Services Specialist
job.description:
Job Summary:

THE TEAM


The Client Management team is responsible for the delivery of exceptional ticketing service to clients (Venue & Promoter) through the effective management of client requirements. Working closely and collaboratively with both clients and internal stakeholders ensuring systems and process are delivered to ensure not only a positive client experience but also positive customer experience. The Client Services team are key to maintaining a strong and connected client relationship and plays a critical role in the development and implementation of ticketing strategies to maximize sales.

THE JOB

The Client Services Specialist works as a key member of the Client Services team, supporting the delivery of high-quality ticketing services to clients. The role involves working closely with clients and internal stakeholders, sharing knowledge, information, and client feedback to help improve service delivery and support the implementation of effective ticketing strategies.


The Client Services Specialist is responsible for maintaining and developing strong client relationships, ensuring clients receive the full benefit of Ticketmaster’s technology, products, and marketing initiatives across the primary and secondary ticketing markets.


Client Management Best Practice – Ensure ticketing service delivery is efficient, accurate, and of a consistently high standard through clear internal and external communication, effective coordination, and adherence to relevant policies, procedures, and documentation requirements.


Client Relationships – Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential clients. Act as a reliable point of contact, understand client requirements, provide timely support, and represent Ticketmaster professionally in all client interactions.


Revenue Growth – Identify opportunities to support ticket sales, revenue, and ancillary revenue through Ticketmaster products, technology, and marketing initiatives. Work with the Sales and Business Development teams to identify potential opportunities and support new business activities in the primary and secondary ticketing markets.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

Client Management

  • You will be proactive in the management of a specific client base and develop long-term partnerships with clients which ensuring contractual obligations are understood and achieved.  


  • You will plan and deploy ticketing strategies for clients ensuring improvements and recommendations are applied from previous years’ events.


  • You will maintain current knowledge of Ticketmaster’s technology advances and marketing initiatives to ensure the most up to date and relevant information can be communicated to clients both specific and general.


  • Keep abreast of external trends in the marketplace to enable informed advice to be given to clients and to promote development of internal strategies to optimize client relations.


  • You will manage client relationships whilst ensuring that all contractual obligations are understood and achieved.


  • You will identify new business opportunities and participate in the presentation with new Clients.


  • You will ensure all relevant staff are kept fully informed about upcoming events and services that have been committed to clients. Accordingly provide all necessary information and assistance to these departments in their planning so all client deadlines are achieved.
  • You will ensure all relevant staff have accurate information and are sufficiently briefed, effectively trained, motivated and empowered to make decisions within their respective areas when performing duties related to event management to ensure the provision of excellent service to patrons.


  • You will work closely with Venue/Customer Service and support areas are properly set up and appropriately rostered with fully trained staff to provide the maximum level of service. Certain Events and/or Clients will require the presence of the Client Manager on-site during the event.


  • You will assist in the development of clear policies and procedures for Client Managers and for Venue/Customer Service.
  • You will resolve disputes or conflicts with clients. 


  • In conjunction with the Marketing Department, you will develop marketing initiatives specific to client needs to maximize ticket sales.


  • Communicate and assist with the Business Development Manager and Customer Service to plan event building whilst ensuring that deadlines for on sales are met.
  • You will ensure the coordination and direction of all parties involved in ticketing and box office including all Ticketmaster personnel and financial arrangements (armed money escorts, security, working environments, catering, banking, on-line credit card facilities, merchant numbers, codes, service charges and settlement arrangements) are finalized prior to ticket sales commencing.


  • Working with the Client Service Manager you will ensure that Ticketmaster has a signed Ticketing Agreement with the client for the respective Event(s) prior to ticket sales commencing.


  • At every opportunity, the use of new products/functionality should be enthusiastically embraced and opportunities for innovation should be encouraged.


  • You will develop post event reports that are relevant to each client and are presented with professionalism in every instance.


  • You will be required to ensure Corporate Services are fully informed of all financial arrangements and both Ticketmaster and the client meet their financial obligations under the contractual arrangement or letter of agreement.


  • You will entertain clients and attend client functions and launches as required, and which maybe outside normal business hours.


  • You will arrange and/or facilitate presentations using Ticketmaster technology for existing and potential clients.


  • You will actively support new initiatives and product developments.


  • Carry out other duties that may be required by the Client Service Manager.


  • You will provide support and coverage for the Client Service Manager as required.



Event Creation

  • Configure, create, and maintain events accurately within the ticketing system.
  • Review and validate event details, including dates, times, pricing, seating, and on-sale information before publication.
  • Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail to ensure data accuracy and minimize publishing errors.
  • Utilize advanced Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets for data management, reporting, and event setup.
  • Learn and effectively navigate ticketing platforms and related systems.
  • Manage multiple event setups while meeting strict deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to ensure event requirements are accurately implemented.
  • Basic knowledge of Adobe Photoshop or Adobe Illustrator is an advantage for simple event artwork or image updates.


Client Relationships

  • You will be responsible for establishing and maintaining relationships with all key local clients.


  • You will represent Ticketmaster at networking functions with key clients if/when required.


  • Proactively maintain existing industry network contacts and grow the network contacts where possible to provide industry information, be aware of venue/event opportunities, and to be an Ambassador for Ticketmaster in the local industry.


WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW

Customer / Client Focus 
Extensive ticketing and client relationship experience ensuring Ticketmaster’s internal and external customers’ needs are continually satisfied. Maintain and build of strong customer relationships with current and future clients.

Communication
Demonstrating strong communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal. Assist with the development of clear written policies and procedures for Client Managers. Strong ability to communicate with clarity and confidence business developments and each client’s requirements and deadlines to internal and external customers. Effective listening skills are also paramount. The ability to effectively handle difficult conversations is a key communication requirement.

Flexibility
Demonstrated ability to accommodate and adapt to changing needs of the business in a highly pressured working environment. At the same time, proven ability to adhere to set guidelines and process adherence. Deal with higher-level complaints and recognise the need for flexibility where applicable.

People Management & Leadership
Proven staff management and delegation skills. Set an example for staff in the office. Effectively manage the professional requirements of Ticketmaster’s internal and external customers. Lead by example; gather support from staff and work together to achieve desired outcomes.

Research/Analytical
Experience developing and implementing strategic plans. Maintain up to date knowledge of industry developments incorporating marketing and technological advances, both internally and externally.

Initiative
Ability to recognise and pursue new business opportunities. Possession of “natural energy” with a proactive focus responding quickly and positively to ensure that business deadlines and needs are met.

Computer literacy
I.T. literacy essential - Windows Office Suite (PowerPoint, Word, Excel and Outlook) Familiarity and aptitude with a significant number of different ticketing systems, products and websites/apps including current database management systems and Ticketmaster programs and reports. Typing skills with high accuracy.

Negotiation
Conflict resolution skills. Oversee all aspects of the contracts for specific client base and recognise the need to be flexible whilst still achieving Ticketmaster and client objectives.

Results oriented
Show commitment to the achievement of results and targets by accepting responsibility, owning the task, and applying effective application of effort and resources, combined with passion, belief and energy.

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

Our work is guided by our values:

Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive

job.title: Client Support Specialist
job.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – CLIENT SUPPORT SPECIALIST

Location: Stockholm

Division: Ticketing Client Support

Line Manager: Client and Event Support Manager

Contract Terms: Full Time

THE TEAM

Global Support & Operations Organization has the mission to build a global support & operations center of excellence where all processes, tools & best practices are applied to all regions across the globe in order to achieve the highest levels of employee, fan & Client satisfaction.

EMEA Support & Operations team, a vertical of this organization, is accountable for supporting Clients in markets located under the EMEA Region (Europe, Middle East and Africa) and providing the ticketing service to the full life-cycle of their events (from onsale to entry).

Our Clients demand and value high service levels and we believe our people are the foundation to deliver great service. We are fortunate to have the most experienced and skilled operations experts on the field around the globe, regionally and locally, that have a deep understanding of our Clients’ needs. We then apply our own ticketing technology to help our Clients innovate in their offering and ticketing strategies.

THE JOB

In this role as a Client Support Specialist, part of the Event & Client Support Team in the Swedish Market, you will be responsible for delivering services to support Clients’ day-to-day operational needs related to the use of ticketing systems and products in facilitating ticketing operations through the life-cycle of the Clients’ event portfolio.

You will operate in between multiple departments and make sure the Client has a unified experience throughout the contract period.

You will become the Clients’ primary support contact at Ticketmaster, and you will work closely with Clients to continuously improve service levels, sales performance and increase Client satisfaction. The Client Support Specialist will be responsible for maintaining agreed upon service levels. Responsibilities will also include training, sharing of best practices, and general operational support including installs and upgrades.

You will leverage ticketing products and process knowledge and provide consultancy services to help define solutions that fulfil Clients’ operational needs. In doing so, you will lead and coordinate consultancy efforts with other functional experts within Ticketmaster (Product Operations, Event Support, Client Development, Customer Support, Finance, etc.).

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

Client Relationship Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for an assigned portfolio of clients, delivering proactive and high-quality support.

  • Build, develop, and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients by understanding their business, operational goals, and future needs.

  • Lead client onboarding and ensure a smooth transition into our services.

  • Conduct regular client meetings to review operations, discuss upcoming events, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • Collaborate closely with Client Development and other internal teams to ensure excellent client experience and alignment between commercial and operational objectives.

Operational Support

  • Manage the operational delivery throughout the full event lifecycle, from planning to post-event follow-up.

  • Coordinate operational activities and ensure all client requirements are delivered successfully.

  • Monitor event performance and sales trends to support clients in achieving their objectives.

  • Provide onsite event support and occasional out-of-hours support when required.

  • Identify process improvements and recommend operational best practices.

Product & Technical Support

  • Serve as a trusted advisor by supporting clients in the effective use of our ticketing products and services.

  • Deliver training and guidance on new features, product updates, and operational best practices.

  • Troubleshoot operational and technical issues and coordinate with internal specialists to ensure timely resolution.

  • Support clients with event setup, event management, reporting, and operational processes.

Collaboration & Administration

  • Maintain accurate client documentation and operational records.

  • Prepare reports and analyse operational performance where needed.

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Client Development, Event Support, Product Operations, and Field Operations, to deliver a seamless client experience.

  • Use Microsoft Office and internal business systems to support daily operations.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

  • Experience in client support, account management, customer success, operations, or a similar client-facing role.

  • Strong customer service mindset with excellent communication and presentation skills.

  • Ability to understand operational processes and provide practical solutions.

  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

  • Experience from the live entertainment, sports, ticketing, or event industry is an advantage.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is preferred.

  • Fluent in both Swedish and English.

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

We're looking for someone who enjoys building relationships and creating trust with clients and colleagues alike.

You are:

  • A natural relationship builder who enjoys meeting new people and creating long-term partnerships.

  • Curious, proactive, and always looking for ways to improve client experience.

  • A confident communicator who can engage stakeholders at different levels.

  • Solution-oriented, adaptable, and comfortable working in a dynamic environment with changing priorities.

  • Well-organized and able to balance multiple projects simultaneously.

  • A collaborative team player who enjoys working across departments.

  • Passionate about delivering outstanding service and continuously improving ways of working.

Additional Information

  • Regular travel is an expected part of the role, including onsite support at client venues and events.

  • Flexibility to provide occasional evening and weekend support during live events may be required.

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company. Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision. Reliability - We understand that fans and Clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent
Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive

job.title: Cocktail Server- Foundation Room
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 500 million tickets sold annually and more than 12,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 40,000 shows and 100+ festivals annually for nearly 4,000 artists in over 40 countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect over 1,000 brands with the 98 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

Live Nation’s Concerts Division is where tours are born, artists come to life, and fans get to experience the rush of live music. From our dozens of owned/operated Amphitheaters to our Global Touring team, from Ticketing and Venue Operations to Marketing and Sales... we foster a fun and upbeat work culture with no shortage of opportunities. With perks ranging from free concert tickets to dog-friendly offices, to progressive benefits like student loan reimbursement and adoption/fertility support... it’s no wonder we are certified as a Great Place to Work organization and one of People Magazine’s “50 Companies that Care”. We want everyone to feel like they belong and can thrive in our community, so we strive to help you achieve your career and personal goals. Live music is our passion and where we find our common ground. There has never been a better time to join Live Nation.

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Ability to give proper recognition to Foundation Room Members, Live Nation Corporate Executives and VIP’s to instill appreciation for their membership and patronage
  • Impeccable knowledge regarding the steps of service for up-scale dining
  • Expert confidence in both bottle and wine service skills 
  • The ability to up-sell and offer food and beverage suggestions to guests
  • Extensive aptitude of culinary terms, methods, and up-scale cuisine
  • Capacity to guide and direct guests through their dining experience utilizing recommendation and expertise
  • Ability to understand and execute flawlessly the standards and procedures of Bottle Service.
  • Articulate vocabulary with the ability to adapt and socialize with current audience
  • Exemplary and professional grooming standards
  • Cash handling experience and Point of Sales System experience
  • Strong working knowledge of all beverages
  • Ability to deal with intoxicated guests in a positive and safety minded manner
  • Ability to anticipate and respond to guests needs
  • Suggestively sell beverages and menu items; take orders
  • Answer guest questions, make recommendations, up-sell liquors
  • Communicate drink orders to bar through Point of Sales system
  • Deliver drinks, maneuvering trays through large crowds
  • Maintain line of sight/atmosphere control by circulating through your work area throughout shift
  • Remove dirty glasses, dishes, ashtrays from tables, including the lifting/moving of bus tubs up to 25lbs.
  • Keep tables clean/wiped
  • Clean spills, remove food, trash or other obstacles from floor using proper lifting techniques
  • Maintain House of Blues safety and sanitation standards
  • Follow housekeeping standards per HOB policy
  • Keep current on all standard operating procedures
  • Request identification from any guest who appears to be under 30 years of age
  • Ensure responsible alcohol service per local ordinance alcohol awareness training and HOB alcohol policies
  • Recognize when guests are becoming too intoxicated and refuse further service of alcohol in a courteous and safety-minded manner, bringing it to the attention of the manager
  • Receive payment and process cash, credit card or Travelers check transactions according to HOB policy
  • Ensure that comp and void checks are processed according to HOB policy
  • Assist other servers and staff as needed Attend pre-shift meeting conducted by Manager on Duty prior to the start of each shift

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

Required:

  • (State or County Licensee or Certification Requirement)/ Responsible Alcohol Awareness Training Certification or Equivalent
  • Must have a minimum of 2 years experience serving in a up-scale dining and night life venue
  • Working knowledge of high-end restaurant operations and safe, responsible alcohol service
  • Ability to handle multiple tables at one time efficiently and with an upbeat, friendly attitude; read guests in order to anticipate their needs
  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Must have a flexible schedule
  • Must be able to adhere to Dress and Appearance Guidelines
  • Flexible schedule and ability to work late hours
  • Working Knowledge of cocktail tray service, basic food service, responsible alcohol service, drink recipes and garnishes, point of sales systems
  • Ability to deal with intoxicated guests in a positive and safety minded manner
  • 2 years bottle service experience
  • 3 years work experience interacting with people in a positive environment
  • Tolerance of all cultures, music and art forms

Preferred:

  • Point of Sales knowledge
  • Interest in wines, spirits, and Mixology
  • Interest in Night Life
  • Cash handling experience
  • Experience recognizing valid ID's
  • Experience in a live music environment

Physical Demands/Working Environment:

  • Working environment is fast-paced and often loud and stressful
  • Position requires extended periods of prolonged standing and working on your feet
  • Must be able to lift or move up to 25 lbs using proper lifting techniques

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion.  You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work.  We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife.  As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.  It’s talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

job.title: Coordinator, Event Finance & Contract Operations
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable Event Finance & Contract Operations Coordinator to support the Finance team across a fast-paced portfolio of live events. This role keeps the administrative and financial details behind each project moving—from crew agreements and vendor documentation to expense backup, payment requests, reconciliations, and post-event cleanup.

 

The ideal candidate is a proactive, resourceful professional with strong communication skills and exceptional follow-through. They are comfortable managing multiple priorities, maintaining accurate records, and coordinating with internal teams, vendors, crew, and clients to ensure that nothing falls through the cracks.

 

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys the intersection of live-event operations, finance, contracts, and project coordination. A love of spreadsheets, organized files, and closing open loops is a plus-plus.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Prepare and organize financial backup for event expenses, including PEX and Uber reconciliations, retagging, settlements, and reimbursement support.
  • Compile invoices, coding details, and supporting documentation for accounts-payable requests; route packages for approval and payment processing.
  • Track open invoices, expenses, payment-related documentation, and financial follow-ups across multiple active event projects.
  • Support event financial cleanup by organizing backup, researching discrepancies, coordinating expense allocations, and assisting with reconciliation preparation.
  • Prepare, proof, merge, and issue deal memos, crew agreements, statements of work, and contractor agreements through DocuSign.
  • Track document status, pursue outstanding signatures, correct discrepancies, and ensure fully executed agreements are saved in the appropriate shared folders.
  • Coordinate directly with crew, vendors, and internal stakeholders to obtain missing information, documentation, signatures, invoices, and payment details.
  • Verify vendor banking information through approved outreach and maintain clear documentation of confirmation.
  • Research citations, fines, rental charges, and other operational expenses; match them to the appropriate event, reservation, project, or responsible party.
  • Support payroll and contractor-administration workflows, including reimbursement collection, payroll-vendor follow-up, and audit-status tracking.
  • Assist with staffing-budget updates, event staffing coordination, and supporting materials for rehearsals and live projects.
  • Coordinate finance meetings, manage calendars and invitations, circulate meeting notes, and maintain action items and Outlook to-do lists.
  • Support Finance leadership with ad hoc administrative, project-tracking, and operational needs.

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in finance administration, accounting support, contract administration, project coordination, or a related operations role.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.
  • Ability to manage multiple high-priority tasks and shifting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the professionalism to work effectively with internal teams, vendors, crew, and clients.
  • Experience preparing invoices, expense backup, payment requests, reconciliations, or other financial documentation.
  • Comfort handling confidential financial, vendor, and contract information with discretion.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and shared-file systems.
  • A proactive problem-solving approach and willingness to ask questions, clarify details, and close gaps before they become issues.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting live events, entertainment, music, production, hospitality, or another project-based industry.
  • Familiarity with QuickBooks, PEX, DocuSign, Dropbox, and spreadsheet-based tracking tools.
  • Experience with accounts payable, vendor onboarding, payroll coordination, contractor agreements, or expense reconciliation.
  • Experience coordinating meetings, calendars, staffing details, and cross-functional project follow-up.
  • Familiarity with event budgets, project codes, cost allocations, or post-event closeout processes.
  • Comfort working in a collaborative environment where priorities can change quickly.

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

 

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.


WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 


We are seeking an extremely technical Director to serve as Live Nation Entertainment’s Incident Commander and lead Incident Response for the US region. When an incident hits, you run it: you direct the investigation, drive containment and remediation, brief executives, and coordinate with Legal, outside counsel, and our incident response retainer firm.


Reporting to the Vice President, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) and Operations, you will also own the functions that feed incident response: our 24x7x365 Security Operations team, detection engineering, and threat intelligence, across Live Nation Entertainment’s global technology environment. You will partner with two regional IR leads to deliver follow-the-sun coverage for a global business.


This is a leadership role for a hands-on responder. You can review a packet capture, challenge a forensic timeline, and explain business impact to the executive team on the same day. You own the budget, vendor relationships, and metrics for the function, and you are accountable for faster detection and containment, better incident outcomes, and using automation and AI to help a large, global team work faster and make better decisions.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO


Incident Response & Incident Command

  • Lead all security incidents as Incident Commander, from triage through closure, including ransomware, eCrime, business email compromise (BEC), account takeover, insider threats, data exposure, and third-party or supply-chain compromise
  • Conduct and manage incident response investigations, including host and network forensic analysis (packet capture, NetFlow, proxy, DNS, and firewall logs), log and memory analysis, malware triage, and timeline reconstruction, with defensible evidence handling and chain of custody
  • Personally step into or take over investigations when they stall, escalate, or need senior technical judgment
  • Lead cloud incident response across AWS, Azure, and GCP, as well as SaaS and identity platforms (e.g., Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta), including response to credential, token, and control-plane abuse
  • Coordinate with two regional IR leads on follow-the-sun coverage, including structured handoffs of active incidents at each shift change (status, evidence, open actions, and pending decisions) so investigations continue without losing context
  • Own incident remediation: build tactical and strategic remediation plans tailored to each incident, drive containment, eradication, and recovery with Infrastructure, Engineering, Cloud, and business owners, verify that remediation is complete, and turn root-cause findings into new detections and hardening across on-premises and cloud environments
  • Coordinate with outside counsel, including investigations conducted under attorney-client privilege, and with Legal, Privacy, and Communications on regulatory, contractual, and public-company disclosure decisions (e.g., SEC cyber disclosure rules, GDPR, U.S. state breach-notification laws, PCI DSS)
  • Own and mature the Cyber Security Incident Response Plan, playbooks, escalation paths, and out-of-band communication plans (for when email, chat, or identity systems are compromised) in line with NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3 and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0; run executive and technical tabletop exercises at least annually
  • Prepare the team and decision playbooks for high-impact scenarios, such as ransomware, extortion, and bot, credential-stuffing, or DDoS attacks during major on-sales and live events; work with Legal, the cyber insurer, and executives on decisions like system shutdown, restoration priorities, and engagement with threat actors

Incident Communication

  • Brief the CISO and executive leadership during and after incidents in plain business terms: what happened, impact, risk, decisions needed, and next steps; support communications with regulators and other external parties in coordination with Legal
  • Communicate tasks, guidance, and methodology clearly to responders, engineers, and partner teams during active incidents
  • Write or review incident reports, root-cause analyses, and after-action reports for accuracy, consistency, and completeness

Security Operations, Detection Engineering & Threat Intelligence

  • Own 24x7x365 monitoring, triage, and escalation, with defined service levels for alert response and incident handling
  • Lead detection engineering: own detection strategy and coverage mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, and drive detection-as-code, testing, tuning, and false-positive reduction across SIEM, EDR/XDR, NDR, cloud, and identity telemetry; lead proactive threat hunting informed by intelligence and incident findings
  • Lead the threat intelligence function: set intelligence requirements with the business, track threat actors relevant to ticketing, live events, and e-commerce, and turn intelligence into detections, hunts, and executive briefings
  • Partner with Vulnerability Management and Penetration Testing on zero-day response and on red and purple team exercises that validate detection and response

AI, Automation & Metrics

  • Use AI technologies to improve decision-making and efficiency across incident response and operations, such as AI-assisted triage, enrichment, investigation summaries, and SOAR playbooks, with clear human oversight, quality checks, and measured results
  • Prepare the team to detect and respond to threats against AI-enabled products and agents used across the business
  • Define, track, and report metrics, including mean time to detect, contain, and remediate; share of incidents detected internally; detection coverage against MITRE ATT&CK SLA attainment; closure of post-incident actions; and automation and AI impact

Team Leadership

  • Lead, build, and scale a 24x7x365 team of incident responders, SOC analysts, detection engineers, and threat intelligence analysts, including managers, across multiple countries and time zones; hire, develop, and retain top talent
  • Set the strategy, operating model, and capability roadmap for incident response and security operations, and run incidents, projects, and priorities with clear plans, owners, and deadlines
  • Coach and mentor the team, and build an inclusive culture of accountability, composure under pressure, and continuous learning, including blameless post-incident reviews

Budget, Vendors & IR Retainer

  • Own the budget (headcount, tooling, and services) and vendor relationships, including the incident response retainer, MDR/MSSP partners, and threat intelligence providers; manage retainer hours, scope, and readiness, and hold vendors accountable to contractual SLAs

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Experience serving as Incident Commander on high-severity, business-impacting incidents
  • Extremely technical, hands-on background: proven experience conducting and managing incident response investigations in large enterprises, including ransomware, eCrime, BEC, and targeted intrusions
  • Hands-on experience in network forensic analysis, with a strong understanding of network architecture, security control placement, and baselining normal traffic, plus host forensics (Windows, macOS, Linux), memory analysis, and basic malware triage
  • Cloud incident response experience across AWS, GCP, and Azure (deep experience in at least one), plus identity investigations across Active Directory and Entra ID, and SaaS investigations
  • Track record of incident remediation: building and driving remediation plans to verified completion
  • Strong ability to communicate with executives and regulators, and to communicate tasks, guidance, and methodology effectively to internal teams
  • Experience coordinating with outside counsel, cyber insurers, and law enforcement during incidents
  • Proven experience using AI technologies to improve decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, increase efficiency, and drive business outcomes
  • 12+ years in cyber security, including 8+ years in incident response or digital forensics
  • 6+ years leading technical teams, including at least 3 years managing managers, with a track record of leading large, geographically distributed teams across countries and time zones in a 24x7x365 environment
  • Experience with SIEM (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM), EDR/XDR (e.g., CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender), SOAR, and NDR platforms; able to write and review queries and detection logic
  • Experience owning a budget and managing vendors, MDR/MSSP partners, and incident response retainers
  • Ability to influence and drive action across teams you don’t manage, including during disagreements under pressure
  • Highly organized, with strong program management discipline and a track record of defining and reporting operational metrics
  • Knowledge of NIST CSF 2.0, NIST SP 800-61, ISO/IEC 27035, and MITRE ATT&CK, and of regulatory requirements relevant to a global, public, payment-processing company (e.g., PCI DSS, SEC cyber disclosure rules, GDPR)
  • Calm, decisive judgment under pressure, high ethical standards, and discretion with confidential information
  • Availability 24x7 for escalations and major incidents, including nights, weekends, and holidays; some domestic and international travel
  • Ability to pass a background check, in accordance with applicable law
  • BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent experience

Desirable

  • Experience leading a detection engineering function (detection-as-code, ATT&CK coverage, testing and tuning)
  • Experience leading a threat intelligence function (intelligence requirements, actor tracking, turning intelligence into detections and hunts)
  • Incident response consulting experience at a leading firm, or experience leading a large enterprise CSIRT
  • Experience in ticketing, e-commerce, live events, media, or other high-traffic consumer platforms
  • Relevant certifications, such as GCIH, GCFA, GNFA, GCFR, GCTI, GSOM, CISSP, or a cloud security certification (e.g., AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft SC-200, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer)
  • Experience building or maturing an AI-enabled SOC or agentic security workflows

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. 


Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation. 

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas.


We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job should contact a Human Resources Representative to request the opportunity to participate in a timely interactive process.  Live Nation will also provide reasonable religious accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

job.title: Event Programming Manager
job.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – EVENT PROGRAMMING MANAGER


Location: Prague
Division: Ticketmaster International
Line Manager: Senior Operations Manager
Contract: Permanent, Full-Time 40 hours per week

 

THE ROLE


As an Event Programming Manager, you will lead and develop a team of Event Programming Specialists. You will be responsible for team performance, event management processes, and delivery quality across your markets.
You will oversee day-to-day event programming operations while remaining close to the detail, ensuring accurate event setup, efficient workflows, and high-quality delivery.
This role combines team leadership with hands-on operational involvement and continuous improvement of processes and client service. You will drive alignment across markets and stakeholders, ensuring consistency in processes, tools, and delivery standards.

 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING


Team Leadership & Performance


•    Lead, manage, and develop a team of Event Programming Specialists, including coaching, training, and performance management.
•    Accountable for team operational KPIs including delivery SLAs, event setup quality, productivity, and client satisfaction measures.
•    Direct management of specialists.
•    Team performance accountability.
•    Workforce planning responsibilities.
•    Set clear priorities and support the team in managing workload effectively.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, and development of team members.
•    Foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing team environment.


Operations & Delivery


•    Oversee daily event programming activities to ensure accuracy and timely delivery.
•    Manage and prioritise workload across the team based on client and event needs.
•    Support complex event setups and step in when additional support is required.
•    Ensure smooth execution across the full event lifecycle, from setup to onsale and post-onsale support. Provide on-site assistance to clients when required.
•    Act as an escalation point for operational and client-related issues.
•    Stay up to date with systems, tools, and operational processes.
•    Take on additional responsibilities as required to support business needs.
•    Work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends when required.
•    Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients and internal stakeholders.
•    Work closely with Client Support, Fan Support, and other departments to ensure smooth operations.
•    Align with Client Support on priorities and client needs.
•    Support client adoption of self-service tools where relevant.
•    Represent Event Programming in cross-functional discussions within the region.


Process, Quality & Continuous Improvement


•    Ensure accurate event data management across Ticketmaster systems.
•    Oversee usage of TM1, Microflex, and related tools within the team.
•    Ensure proper tracking of work and event updates in Salesforce.
•    Maintain data accuracy across the event lifecycle.
•    Own and improve event management processes within your markets.
•    Ensure adherence to QA standards and monitor quality of event setups.
•    Identify gaps in processes and implement practical improvements.
•    Support rollout of new tools, products, and ways of working within the team.
•    Use data and team feedback to improve efficiency and delivery.

 

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)


•    Minimum of one year experience in a supervisory or team leadership role preffered.
•    Minimum of three years’ experience in Event Programming, Ticketing, or a similar operational environment.
•    Strong understanding of event management processes and ticketing systems.
•    Ability to manage workload and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
•    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
•    Hands-on, detail-oriented approach with a focus on quality.
•    Ability to work collaboratively across teams and markets.
•    Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant systems with excellent data entry and proof-reading skills.
•    Fluency in local language and English.
•    Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, or holidays when required.

 

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)


•    Strong leadership and team development skills.
•    Customer-focused with a service-oriented mindset.
•    Proactive and solution-driven approach.
•    Hands-on and detail-oriented attitude.
•    Ability to build strong working relationships across teams and stakeholders.
•    Adaptability and resilience in a dynamic environment.
•    Strong organisational and time management skills.
•    High level of ownership and accountability.
•    Ability to assess situations, make decisions, and solve problems effectively.
•    Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on service excellence.

 

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

 

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

 

Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision. 

 

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

 

Our work is guided by our values:

 

Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

 

Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team

 

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent

 

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

 

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

 

HIRING PRACTICES


The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

 

Ticketmaster recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Ticketmaster may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms. Ticketmaster may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support application screening and assessment. All hiring decisions are made with human review.

Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – CLIENT AND EVENT SUPPORT SPECIALIST

 

Location: Stockholm, Sweden

Division: Ticketmaster International

Line Manager: Client and Event Support Manager

Contract Terms: Permanent, Full-Time 38 hours per week

 

THE TEAM

 

Global Support & Operations Organization has the mission to build a global support & operations center of excellence where all processes, tools & best practices are applied to all regions across the globe in order to achieve the highest levels of employee, fan & client satisfaction.

 

EMEA Field Operations team, a vertical of this organization, is accountable for supporting clients (Promoters, Venues, Artists, Clubs, etc.) in markets located under the EMEA Region and providing the ticketing service to the full life-cycle of their events (from onsale to entry).

 

Our clients demand and value high service levels and we believe our people are the foundation to deliver great service. We are fortunate to have the most experienced and skilled operations experts on the field around the globe, regionally and locally, that have a deep understanding of our clients’ needs. We then apply our own ticketing technology to help our clients innovate in their offering and ticketing strategies.

 

 

THE JOB

 

As an Event Support Specialist, you’ll support Ticketmaster’s clients in Sweden with the setup and management of their events. You will create and update events in our ticketing systems, help clients use our tools and provide support on site when needed.

You will work closely with clients and colleagues across the business, making sure event information is accurate and that each event is ready for fans.

 


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 

As an Event Support Specialist, you’ll help bring events to life by making sure they are accurately set up and supported in our ticketing systems. You’ll work closely with clients and colleagues across the business to deliver a smooth experience throughout the event lifecycle.

  • Create, configure and quality-check events in Ticketmaster’s ticketing systems, following established processes and service standards.
  • Make event updates based on client requests and resolve event-related issues.
  • Support clients who manage their own events using Ticketmaster’s tools.
  • Provide onsite support at events when needed.
  • Keep event information accurate and up to date in Salesforce.
  • Collaborate with clients, promoters and teams across marketing, finance, client support and fan experience.
  • Coordinate requests with internal specialist teams and review completed work for quality.
  • Configure events for connected Ticketmaster products and learn how to support new features as they are introduced.

 

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (OR TECHNICAL SKILLS)


  • A service-minded approach and a commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality work.
  • Strong attention to detail, with an organized and structured way of working.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and solve problems with curiosity and creativity.
  • Fluent in both Swedish and English. Clear communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Confidence using computers, strong data entry skills and familiarity with Microsoft Office.
  • An interest in the entertainment and sports industry.
  • Flexibility to work some evenings, weekends and holidays.
  • A high school diploma or equivalent. A university degree is a plus.


Experience in event management or box office operations, as well as knowledge of how Ticketmaster’s teams work together, is an advantage.


YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)


You’re a curious and collaborative person who enjoys supporting others and finding ways to improve. You build trusted relationships with clients and colleagues, and you’re comfortable adapting when priorities change.

  • You have strong attention to detail and an organised approach to your work.
  • You manage your time well and can balance multiple priorities.
  • You ask questions, consider different perspectives and enjoy solving problems.
  • You proactively support your colleagues and share your knowledge.
  • You’re eager to learn how our products work and how they support clients and fans.
  • You act with integrity and treat others with empathy and respect.

 


LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company. Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision. We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

Our work is guided by our values:
Reliability - We understand that fans and Clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.
Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team
Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent
Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive

 

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

job.title: Experiential Marketing Coordinator
job.description:
Job Summary:

Title: Experiential Marketing Coordinator

Reports to: VP, Digital Marketing & Marketing (Spirits & Wine)

Location: New York, NY (In-office, 5 days a week)


The Role:

Roc Nation is seeking an Experiential Marketing Coordinator who will be responsible for the planning, coordination and execution of experiential marketing initiatives across the spirits portfolio.


This role will serve as the central point of support for event logistics, production, vendor management and on-site execution, ensuring that all brand experiences are organized, strategically aligned and delivered to the highest standard.


Responsibilities:

Event Planning & Production

  • Manage event timelines, production schedules and run-of-show documents
  • Coordinate all logistical elements of brand activations, dinners, tastings, launches and partnerships
  • Oversee event setup, breakdown, staffing and on-site execution
  • Ensure all event details align with brand standards and creative direction

Vendor & Partner Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for event vendors, venues, production teams and external partners
  • Source and coordinate photographers, videographers, florists, caterers and other event-related vendors
  • Manage vendor communication, deliverables and production timelines

Budget & Administrative Management

  • Maintain centralized event calendars and production trackers
  • Coordinate product deliveries, inventory, branded materials and event supplies

Experiential & Brand Activation Support

  • Coordinate consumer-facing activations, trade events, influencer experiences, hospitality partnerships and brand dinners
