job.title: Insomniac - Senior Accountant, Consumer Products - Motorsports
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE YOU?

Do you enjoy dance music? Are you passionate about production finance and the accounting space? Then you’re in luck! We are looking for a highly motivated self-starter who embodies both a passion for dance culture and a strong financial background. Sounds like you? Then keep reading...


WHO ARE WE?

Insomniac produces some of the most innovative, immersive music festivals and events in the world. Enhanced by state-of-the-art lighting, pyrotechnics and sound design, large-scale art installations, theatrical performers and next-generation special effects, our events captivate the senses and inspire a unique level of fan interaction. The quality of the Headliner experience is our top priority.


Insomniac produces 10,000 concerts, club nights and festivals for seven million attendees annually across the globe. Since its inception, Insomniac's events have taken place in 13 countries across five continents. The company's premiere annual event, Electric Daisy Carnival Las Vegas, is the world’s largest dance music festival and attracts more than 525,000 fans over three days. The company was founded by Pasquale Rotella and has been based in Los Angeles since it was formed in 1993.


THE ROLE

Insomniac is seeking a Senior Accountant to support accounting operations and financial reporting, financial planning and analysis for the Motorsports Consumer Products division. This role will serve as a key business partner, participating in month end close and various accounts reconciliations, providing financial insights, budgeting, forecasting, and analytical support that drive strategic decision-making across merchandising, operations, and executive leadership. This position reports to the Senior Manager, Finance; Consumer Products-Motorsports. This position is required to be in office and on site at various event locations as needed.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and execute month-end close activities, including journal entries, inventory analysis, event flash reporting, and other financial close requirements, ensuring compliance with GAAP and sox
  • Manage financial planning, reporting, budgeting, forecasting and ROI analysis for Motorsports apparel licensing across all sales channels
  • Manage and analyze P&L performance, including revenue, cost of goods, operating expenses, margins, and other key financial drivers
  • Conduct variance analysis and identify opportunities to improve profitability, manage costs and optimize margins
  • Partner with business leaders to provide financial insights and recommendations related to growth initiatives, pricing margin strategies, and overall business performance
  • Support and lead the annual budgeting process and financial forecasting
  • Analyze key financial and operational metrics to identify trends, risks and opportunities
  • Develop and implement process improvements to streamline financial reporting, forecasting, and licensing royalty reporting
  • Partner cross-functionally with business and operational teams to support financial goals and business objectives
  • Mentor and support junior team members as needed, contributing to the development of a collaborative, high-performing team
  • Support ad hoc financial analyses and projects as needed

    QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field required; CPA and/or MBA preferred
  • 4-7 years of progressive accounting and finance experience, in CPG, retail, licensing or a related industry required
  • Strong experience with month-end close, journal entries, account reconciliations, financial reporting and financial analysis
  • Strong understanding of GAAP and experience working within SOX- controlled environments
  • Experience analyzing P&L performance, budgets, forecasts and financial variances
  • Experience with royalty accounting, licensing, inventory or CPG/retail finance preferred
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle
  • Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools preferred
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to identify issues, develop solutions, and communicate financial information clearly
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines while working effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Must be able to tolerate loud noise levels & busy environments
  • Must be willing to work during evening and weekend hours, as required, to meet deadlines

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

We are looking for a creatively minded, strategically sharp, and highly organized Brand & Experience Director to help bring our new venues to life across the US and Canada.

 

This hands-on role sits across the full venue development life cycle, from brand creation, experiential design, operations through to venue launch. You will act as the guardian of each venue’s central brand idea, ensuring a clear and recognizable red thread runs through every touchpoint, from the physical environment and customer experience to communications, partnerships and day-to-day operations.

 

You will manage agencies and partners, support idea development, and oversee execution. The right person will be comfortable moving between big-picture thinking and detailed delivery, with the confidence to align multiple teams around a shared vision.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

You will manage agencies and partners, support idea development, and oversee execution. The right person will be comfortable moving between big-picture thinking and detailed delivery, with the confidence to align multiple teams around a shared vision.

 

Creative and Strategic Development

  • Support the development of ideas for venue brands and experiences.
  • Contribute to workshops, brainstorms and concept development.
  • Assess ideas against brand strategy, customer experience and commercial objectives.
  • Translate creative thinking into clear, practical plans for cross functional teams.
  • Bring relevant cultural references, inspiration and fresh thinking into the work.

Brand Stewardship

  • Own and protect the central brand idea for each venue.
  • Ensure the brand vision is consistently reflected across design, programming, communications, service, operations and the physical experience.
  • Review creative work and provide clear, constructive feedback to internal teams, agencies and partners.
  • Identify where execution is drifting from the original vision and bring it back into alignment.

Partner Management

  • Help manage relationships with creative agencies, consultants, suppliers and external partners.
  • Lock in and collaborate with local venue & talent teams across the US and Canada
  • Coordinate briefs, timelines, budgets, feedback and approvals.
  • Ensure all partners understand the wider venue vision and how their work contributes to it.
  • Track deliverables and confidently challenge work when needed.

Project Management

  • Organize meetings, workshops, presentations and site visits.
  • Prepare agendas, capture decisions and maintain clear actions, owners and deadlines.
  • Coordinate multiple workstreams, priorities and dependencies.
  • Maintain project trackers, presentations, brand materials and key documentation.
  • Ensure relevant information is shared clearly and on time.

Site and Experience Development

  • Coordinate and attend site visits, reviewing how the brand is expressed within the physical environment.
  • Work closely with design, operations, sponsorship, marketing and venue teams.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen brand consistency and improve the customer experience.
  • Manage the creation and delivery of venue-opening assets, including booking websites, tech packs, renderings, groundbreaking collateral, uniforms, merchandise, artist gifting and other experiential elements that bring the brand to life for various stakeholders.
  • Support testing and refinement ahead of launch and beyond.

Execution and Delivery

  • Move ideas from concept through to practical delivery.
  • Coordinate approvals and ensure agreed actions are completed (especially over final photos/videos of completed projects)
  • Balance creative ambition with operational requirements, timelines and budgets Identify risks, gaps and dependencies early, and help develop practical solutions.
  • Maintain a high standard of detail across major brand moments and everyday operational touchpoints. 

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Experience in brand management, experiential design, creative operations, project management, venue development, hospitality, entertainment or a related field.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Experience managing agencies, suppliers and external creative partners.
  • A strong creative eye and the ability to assess design, ideas and experiences thoughtfully.
  • Strategic thinking, with the ability to connect individual decisions to a wider brand vision.
  • A strong focus on operational excellence and bringing brands, products and experiences to life.
  • Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong deck-building skills, with the ability to clearly communicate brand stories, assets and plans.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with leadership, peers and cross-functional teams.
  • Confidence working independently, taking ownership and constructively challenging others.
  • Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture.
  • Willingness to travel to Live Nation venues across the region to support and lead brand implementation.
  • Enthusiasm for learning, development and long-term career growth.
  • 8-10 years working in brand, experiential marketing, development

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

 

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

job.title: LN Concerts, Executive Assistant
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive Executive Assistant to provide high-level support to the Chief Financial Officer of LN Concerts, who oversees the Finance, Accounting, Shared Services, Analytics, and other operational functions departments. As a trusted partner to the CFO and leadership team, this role ensures that priorities, communications, meetings, and critical deliverables are managed with precision, discretion, and sound judgment.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Proactively manage the CFO's complex calendar, protecting time for strategic priorities while balancing internal and external commitments.
  • Coordinate meetings, leadership forums, and events; ensure the right participants, materials, logistics, and follow-up are in place.
  • Manage the CFO's workflow across meetings, correspondence, decisions, and milestones; surface conflicts, deadlines, and required actions early.
  • Partner closely with leaders across Finance, Accounting, Shared Services, Analytics, and other operational functions to coordinate cross-functional priorities and executive-level deliverables.
  • Prepare agendas, collect and organize pre-reads, maintain action logs, and drive timely follow-up on commitments from finance leadership meetings.
  • Handle highly confidential financial, organizational, and personnel information with discretion and excellent judgment.
  • Draft, format, and proofread high-quality correspondence, presentations, meeting materials, and other confidential documents for the CFO and leadership team.
  • Serve as a professional point of contact for senior leaders, internal partners, external advisors, vendors, and other key stakeholders.
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel, including flights, lodging, ground transportation, itineraries, and real-time updates as plans change.
  • Support expense reporting, invoice and purchase-order coordination, and other administrative processes in partnership with Finance and Shared Services teams.
  • Help organize executive offsites, department meetings, team events, and onboarding activities for the Finance organization.
  • Track priority projects and requests, maintain organized records, and ensure materials and decisions are readily accessible.
  • Anticipate needs, resolve routine issues independently, and escalate matters requiring the CFO's attention with clear context and recommendations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve administrative workflows, meeting practices, and communications across the organization.
  • Provide diversified administrative support and manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to work independently while building strong partnerships across the concerts division.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience preferred.

job.title: LN Concerts, Production Manager
job.description:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE JOB

The Production Manager is responsible for the on-stage, backstage, show settlement, and other technical details of concerts and events at Live Nation-operated venues and third-party venues, including theatres, clubs, amphitheaters, stadiums, and arenas in the local market and surrounding areas.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Manage 70+ shows annually, maintaining an active on-site presence during load-in, show, and load-out with an emphasis on customer (artist/client) service, adherence to timelines, sound restrictions, and cost containment
  • Coordinate between tour production and the building operations.  Advance and communicate presale technical information, including production needs (audio, video, lighting, staging, power, rigging), all rider requirements, layouts, on-sale maps, parking requirements, dressing rooms, etc. 
  • Interface with local contractors (vendors) for all show requirements, including stagehands, runners, security, casual labor, catering, and other rental equipment, with an emphasis on quality, reliability, and costs. 
  • Coordinate and manage approved subcontractors and third-party vendors to ensure safe, efficient, and successful events.
  • Work with the box office to ensure all seats are open and available with excellent sightlines to the performance
  • Work as the Live Nation representative at scheduled shows for the business unit, including production and/or show settlement responsibilities for shows in the market, as directed. 
  • Complete show settlements, when necessary, along with artist and vendor payments for events   
  • Collaborate in a team environment while working with other Production Managers and sharing valuable information about upcoming tours and buildings
  • Submit all invoices and agreements for processing before each event.

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Combination 4 plus years’ experience as Production Manager, promoter rep, or event coordinator; general knowledge of venue operations and production preferred
  • Experience with show settlement, encompassing both the building and artist-facing finances
  • Possess strong organizational, communication, interpersonal, and analytical skills with attention to detail/problem solving skills
  • Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • Be a self-motivated individual who possesses a “roll up the sleeves attitude” and a “hands-on” style, as well as the aptitude to thrive in a fast-paced, results- oriented environment
  • Ability to travel within the South region as schedule dictates
  • Flexible Schedule (days/nights, late hours, weekends, and holidays)
  • Implementation and execution of all Live Nation policies, procedures, and programs.
  • Must work well under pressure/Even tempered
  • Ability to make clear, concise decisions, sometimes with limited information.
  • Computer proficiency in Windows applications (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  • ROME (Salesforce) experience preferred 
  • OSHA 10 certified (if not, LN will provide)

job.title: LN Media & Sponsorship || Regional Brand Manager
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.


WHO ARE YOU?

The Regional Brand Manager helps build and strengthen client relationships while owning the day-to-day delivery and fulfillment of strategic marketing partnerships for local and national brands. This NH-based role at BankNH Pavilion collaborates with clients, venue teams, and internal partners to bring programs to life across multiple categories.  

  • Account Ownership: Take ownership of your assigned sponsorship programs and commitments while building strong relationships with clients and internal partners.
  • Strategic Client Partnership: Engaging with brands year-round to understand evolving goals, bring forward ideas to optimize programs, and plan for future growth.
  • Market Ownership: Becoming the go-to expert on your venues, inventory, market, and open opportunities.
  • Venue Excellence: Preparing venues and sponsorship assets for the season and delivering consistent, high-quality execution on show days.
  • Financial Performance: Account forecasting, budget management, accounts payable, reporting, data analytics, and identifying trends.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnering with Sales to understand client commitments, strategy and planning to shape programs, product specialists to deliver the right solutions, and fulfillment and venue teams to execute each element; keeping everyone aligned and informed along the way.

 

The best Brand Managers stay hungry. They keep learning, deliver consistently internally and externally, show up to every type of client interaction prepared and present, push to consistently meet client and divisional standards, and take ownership of the outcome, not just the task. Here's what that looks like day to day.


Account Ownership & Client Strategy

  • Know the business inside and out: how Live Nation Media & Sponsorship contributes to company revenue, the products and assets we offer, what's in each of our venues, where the sales team is focused, and which teams you'll partner with to deliver every client commitment.
  • Know your regional and national clients just as well, including their objectives, KPIs, audiences, and what success looks like to them, so you can put the right Live Nation products, inventory, and business solutions to work for them.
  • Execute regional and national sponsorship programs in line with contract deliverables, timelines, and venue requirements, from strategic planning through measurement.
  • Serve as a key day-to-day contact for assigned accounts, venues, and markets, in partnership with the relevant account and venue teams.
  • Hold yourself to a high standard with everyone you work with: be professional, be a great teammate, manage your time, follow through on every commitment, and own your results.
  • Coordinate the sponsorship contract process with Legal and other teams, tracking approvals and helping move agreements forward accurately and on time.
  • Manage program budgets and forecasts, monitor spending and financial risk, and partner with Finance on related financial documents, accurate reporting, and revenue recognition.
  • Build relationships beyond day-to-day client contacts and stay connected with clients year-round through regular meetings and conversations about their evolving business goals and priorities.
  • Create client-facing pacing updates, recaps, reports, and presentations that use KPIs and client feedback to communicate results and recommend ways to optimize programs.
  • Partner with Sales on renewal planning, using client insights and program results to identify opportunities to strengthen and grow each partnership.

Market Excellence & Venue Readiness

  • Become the go-to expert on your market(s), including venue operations, sponsorship inventory, existing partner programs, sales opportunities, market dynamics, and ways to operate more efficiently.
  • Own sponsorship execution on assigned show days, coordinating on-site logistics, activations, venue requirements, and sponsorship event staff from pre-show through close.
  • Lead preseason preparation so every sponsorship asset and activation area is ready by opening day, and partner with venue teams on end-of-season winterization.
  • Partner with Regional Sales and National Brand Management to spot opportunities and shape sponsorship packages using available inventory, client needs, and venue capabilities based on local nuances.

Concert Execution & Staffing

  • Serve as on-site sponsorship coverage at assigned concerts and key engagements, including client hospitality and custom events.
  • Plan schedules and sponsorship coverage across 40+ shows each year, balancing overlapping events, activation deadlines, and staffing needs.
  • Schedule, train, and direct Sponsorship Event Staff for assigned events and alternate show coverage, providing clear briefings, execution guidance, and post-event follow-up.
  • Keep clients and internal partners informed with clear, timely communication on show announcements, presales, day-of-show needs, and post-event follow-up.

Collaboration & Innovation

  • Build strong relationships with venue teams, Sales, Legal, Finance, SES, senior leadership, and other Live Nation partners to keep programs aligned with client objectives.
  • Collaborate with Brand Management counterparts across regions to share best practices, resolve challenges, and strengthen consistency across regional and national programs.
  • Stay curious. Bring audience insights, marketing trends, and emerging technologies to the table to develop fresh activation ideas and keep programs ahead of the curve.
  • Support additional sponsor-related projects and department priorities as requested by management.

 

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING 

  • 3+ years of direct experience in brand or account management, client service, media, entertainment, marketing consulting, sales, advertising, or activation agencies.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Strong client service instincts, diligent follow-up, and the ability to build trusted relationships with clients and internal partners.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and a calendar of 40+ shows a year at the venue, balancing overlapping schedules, staffing needs, and client deadlines.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and visual storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with clients, venue teams and event staff.
  • A proactive, organized, and collaborative working style. You anticipate needs, meet deadlines, and take ownership without waiting to be asked.
  • A strong desire to learn and grow, with the drive to stay engaged, ask questions, and show up prepared and present every day.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to adjust priorities, respond to changing business needs, and work effectively under pressure.
  • Experience coordinating event staff to deliver flawless on-site programs.
  • Familiarity with marketing programs that connect in-person experiences with digital components preferred.
  • Knowledge of consumer and market research, with the ability to translate insights into client recommendations and performance reporting.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Asana, Airtable, Slack, Keynote, AI tools, social media tools, or graphic design applications preferred.
  • Strong financial management skills, including the ability to maintain multiyear budgets, monitor expenses, and prepare reliable forecasts.
  • Attention to detail when reviewing program and financial results, including the ability to identify errors, explain trends, and highlight opportunities.
  • A passion for music, live events, branding, and current entertainment trends.
  • Ability to be based in the New Hampshire area, provide regular on-site coverage at assigned venues, and travel within the market and surrounding areas as needed, including nights and weekends.
  • Reliable transportation to and from assigned venues and the office.
  • Ability to lift items weighing up to 50 pounds as needed.

 

BENEFITS & PERKS 

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits: 

 

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)  

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days 

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program 

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support 

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment  

OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

  • Become the go-to expert on your market(s), including venue operations, sponsorship inventory, existing partner programs, sales opportunities, market dynamics, and ways to operate more efficiently.
  • Own sponsorship execution on assigned show days, coordinating on-site logistics, activations, venue requirements, and sponsorship event staff from pre-show through close.
  • Lead preseason preparation so every sponsorship asset and activation area is ready by opening day, and partner with venue teams on end-of-season winterization.
  • Partner with Regional Sales and National Brand Management to spot opportunities and shape sponsorship packages using available inventory, client needs, and venue capabilities based on local nuances.

Concert Execution & Staffing

  • Serve as on-site sponsorship coverage at assigned concerts and key engagements, including client hospitality and custom events.
  • Plan schedules and sponsorship coverage across 100+ shows each year, balancing overlapping events, activation deadlines, and staffing needs.
  • Schedule, train, and direct Sponsorship Event Staff for assigned events and alternate show coverage, providing clear briefings, execution guidance, and post-event follow-up.
  • Keep clients and internal partners informed with clear, timely communication on show announcements, presales, day-of-show needs, and post-event follow-up.

Collaboration & Innovation

  • Build strong relationships with venue teams, Sales, Legal, Finance, SES, senior leadership, and other Live Nation partners to keep programs aligned with client objectives.
  • Collaborate with Brand Management counterparts across regions to share best practices, resolve challenges, and strengthen consistency across regional and national programs.
  • Stay curious. Bring audience insights, marketing trends, and emerging technologies to the table to develop fresh activation ideas and keep programs ahead of the curve.
  • Support additional sponsor-related projects and department priorities as requested by management.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 3+ years of direct experience in brand or account management, client service, media, entertainment, marketing consulting, sales, advertising, or activation agencies.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Strong client service instincts, diligent follow-up, and the ability to build trusted relationships with clients and internal partners.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and a calendar of 100+ shows a year at the venue, balancing overlapping schedules, staffing needs, and client deadlines.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and visual storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with clients, venue teams and event staff.
  • A proactive, organized, and collaborative working style. You anticipate needs, meet deadlines, and take ownership without waiting to be asked.
  • A strong desire to learn and grow, with the drive to stay engaged, ask questions, and show up prepared and present every day.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to adjust priorities, respond to changing business needs, and work effectively under pressure.
  • Experience coordinating event staff to deliver flawless on-site programs.
  • Familiarity with marketing programs that connect in-person experiences with digital components preferred.
  • Knowledge of consumer and market research, with the ability to translate insights into client recommendations and performance reporting.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

THE BRAND MANAGEMENT TEAM

This is the get stuff done, turn-problems-into-solutions, make our clients look like the rock stars, driving force within Live Nation’s Media & Sponsorship division. We are a collection of resourceful, ambitious, and strategic-minded individuals that thrive in an environment full of variables and unknowns.  If you like to sit at a desk, write white papers, and theorize on how things should work, this is not the job or team for you.  If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, we should talk.

THE JOB

The Brand Manager leads day-to-day relationship and activities of Live Nation’s strategic marketing partnership with our top corporate brands within our team’s portfolio of management.  This role will have an emphasis on festivals and social content and may work across multiple categories. You will be directly involved in maximizing the value of the client relationship and performance of client’s entertainment marketing programs with a focus on:

  • Client Relationship Service

  • Program Activation & Performance

  • Financial Performance, Budget Planning & Reporting

  • Team Management & Development

  • Innovation & Growth

  • Supports or leads (depending on situational needs) key client meetings throughout the year (i.e., periodic status meetings, mid-campaign reviews, end of year recap/renewal discussions, etc…) to ensure alignment between LN & client on strategy, delivery and performance of partnership

  • Manage the financial health of sponsorship programs by forecasting precisely, partnering across teams to optimize spend and mitigate budget risks, and serving as the account lead to ensure accurate financial reporting and revenue recognition.

  • Supports the definition of program Key Performance Indicators (KPI) that Live Nation can directly impact and manages the measurement and optimization of those performance metrics

  • Explores and applies cutting-edge marketing trends, emerging technologies, and industry best practices to strategically enhance sponsorship programs and foster team-wide learning and development.

  • Meaningfully impacts department wide development initiatives that improve overall team efficiency and effectiveness

  • Develops and grows relationships with key Live Nation teams (i.e., Digital and Social Media, Promotions, Talent, Content Production, Legal, Finance, Research, etc.) to ensure the desired program delivery and results for clients

  • Continuously strengthens day-to-day client relationships as well as grow relationships with key client contacts outside of the day-to-day team to support potential renewal and growth of sponsorship programs

  • Supports Brand Director, VP of Brand Management, Creative team, and Integrated Marketing team, with developing strategic roadmap, creative programs, and business development/growth opportunities for key client relationships

  • Proactively supports peers including helping new staff assimilate into Live Nation and mentoring early-career professionals and College Associates/Interns

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 5-7 years of direct experience in brand or account management, client service, media, or entertainment, and/or marketing consulting, advertising or activation agencies

  • 1-3 years of employee and/or agency team management experience

  • Strong project management skills including ability to communicate, prioritize, manage, and organize simultaneous projects and deadlines

  • Excellent communication skills – written, verbal, presentation and visual storytelling

  • A proactive, collaborative, and organized working style

  • Excellent interpersonal skills for building relationships internally and externally

  • Track record of working with recognizable global brands and growing client relationships

  • Experience with marketing programs across physical and digital components preferred

  • Record of success building, selling, and delivering innovative marketing programs with measurable results

  • Knowledge of consumer and market research with ability to integrate sponsorship program recommendations, recaps and other client-oriented communications

  • Proficiency in enterprise technology platforms including AI, Microsoft Office, Keynote, Salesforce, Slack, Asana, Tableau or other relevant applications

  • Strong passion for branding, marketing, and the music industry including knowledge of relevant artists and industry trends

  • Ability to travel up to 30% of time or more in season, often nights and weekends and occasionally without significant advanced notice

  • Strong financial management skills including ability to manage multiyear budgets and forecast with confidence

  • Ability to examine and interpret results, auditing for errors and highlighting opportunities and trends

job.title: Madison Box Office Staff
job.description:
Job Summary:

Frank Productions, LLC is looking for Box Office staff to join our team part-time in Madison, WI. Positions are open at the following venues: The Sylvee, The Orpheum, Majestic, and High Noon Saloon with a starting rate of $20/hr. We are committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion and encourage talent from all backgrounds to apply.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL DO

  • Assist in daily operations of the box office, including opening and closing box office procedures
  • Quickly and efficiently identify a customer’s will-call order by verifying all pertinent customer information including the customer’s name, email, and order number in order to distribute tickets 
  • Assist customers with mobile tickets during day-of-event and ingress
  • Understand the venue seat-map and assist customers in seat selection
  • Efficiently and accurately answer customer questions in-person and over the phone
  • Accurately accept customer payment while adhering to company’s procedures and policies
  • Utilize ticketing software to sell tickets to patrons
  • Follow company protocol for the relevant building as communicated by venue management
  • All other duties as assigned

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Applicable customer service skills working with a diverse set of customers
  • Ability to work independently and solve problems using sound decision-making skills
  • Ability to learn and work within systems such as MS Office, ticketing software, and other company software
  • Ability to communicate effectively in a team environment that includes in-person collaboration, group e-mails, and instant messaging
  • Ability to handle difficult situations and sensitive information with care and professionalism
  • Professional and friendly demeanor
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Committed to learning, and fostering an environment of diversity, equity, and inclusion
  • Background check required

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Extended periods of sitting in a box office
  • Performs duties while standing and walking, including ascending and descending stairs
  • Utilization of hands and fingers to operate computers and ticketing equipment
  • Lifts up to 20 pounds
  • Crouches, kneels, bends, and reaches frequently
  • Regularly exposed to large crowds and high volumes of noise
  • Regularly exposed to lighting changes including low lit areas, strobe lights, and moving lights
  • Occasionally works in outdoor conditions
  • Requires extended work hours

Founded in 1964 in Madison, WI, Frank Productions started as a family-run, full-service concert promotion company, bringing the likes of Johnny Cash, Elvis Presley and Bruce Springsteen to Wisconsin. Over the next five decades, we have become one of the largest concert promoters in the United States. We did this by building a business model in which promoters help artists achieve their goals, not simply sell the tickets. Our unique approach has led to tremendous growth and success with artists at all stages of their careers.

Today, as a joint-venture partner with Live Nation, Frank Productions continues its successful growth and offers FPC Live and National Shows 2 executive and administrative management. These brands are full-service concert promotion companies involved in every facet of event management built to help support artists at every level of their careers.

Frank Productions is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer and believes in equal opportunity for all employees and applicants. Accordingly, all employment decisions are based on the principles of equal opportunity. These decisions include recruitment, selection, promotion, transfer, discipline, compensation, benefits, training and other personnel actions involving persons in all job titles and we take affirmative action to ensure that they shall occur without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, less than honorable discharge, military status, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical appearance, creed, ancestry, income level or source of income, marital status, student status, arrest and conviction records, use of honesty testing, pregnancy, childbirth, pregnancy-related conditions, the use or nonuse of lawful products off the employers’ premises during non-work hours, declining to attend meetings or participate in communications about religious or political matters or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.


WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 


THE ROLE

The Senior Category Manager, Technology on Live Nation's Global Procurement team is jointly responsible for strategically managing $250M+ in annual IT spend. This hands-on role leads procurement for stakeholders' highest-priority technology projects – reducing cost structurally and permanently where possible, while supporting stakeholders' broader strategic and operational objectives. The role also shares responsibility for strategic supplier management within the category.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

Stakeholders & Sourcing

  • Jointly develops, with the category leader and key stakeholders, the overarching enterprise-wide procurement strategies for Live Nation's technology spend, primarily software/SaaS, telecom and networking, physical and cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, AI/ML platforms, and IT professional services.
  • In concert with key stakeholders, owns the category strategy and multi-year sourcing roadmap for assigned technology segments, including developing recommendations and advising on demand prioritization, supplier strategy, and value-delivery plan.
  • In a non-mandated environment, leads multiple simultaneous direct negotiations and full-lifecycle competitive sourcing events (e.g., RFPs) that have two or more of: enterprise-wide impact, material financial exposure, multiple internal decision-makers, novel commercial/risk structure, executive visibility, supplier escalation, or a cross-category dependencies.
  • Advises senior executives on negotiation strategy, supplier selection and qualification, and contracting approach; analyzes business, financial, and legal risk and develops practical mitigation options.
  • Identifies, quantifies, and captures cost reduction, cost avoidance, and other value opportunities across divisions and functions, incorporating rigorous analysis of available spend data and market dynamics with a confident, collaborative, creative and adaptable negotiation style.
  • Partners with IT, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Risk Management, Finance, and Operations to bring deals to closure.

Suppliers

  • Leads the commercial and operational contracting process for high-profile, complex, and/or strategic procurement projects, ensuring terms reflect Live Nation's business interests and policies.
  • Supports stakeholders’ efforts to manage and maintain ongoing supplier performance, contributing to development and negotiated implementation of solutions to service, quality, and commercial issues and disputes.
  • Represents Global Procurement with account representatives and supplier executives at Live Nation's most strategic incumbent technology suppliers.

Team

  • Serves as a delegated escalation and decision-support point for assigned portfolio matters; prepares executive-ready recommendations and independently advances work through cross-functional ambiguity.
  • Provides functional mentorship to fellow Technology team members, including resolving questions of prioritization, coaching, and quality review of sourcing deliverables.
  • Contributes to Procurement process improvement and automation, including appropriate use of AI and other technology to improve team efficiency and effectiveness.[Designs, pilots, and embeds, including through the appropriate use of AI and other technologies, improvements to sourcing methods, commercial standards, operational efficiency, and/or category analytics that are adopted beyond their own projects.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned, consistent with the nature and level of this role, as business needs evolve.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • 8-10+ years of progressively responsible experience in sourcing/procurement, supply chain, or operations transformation; top-tier consulting experience preferred.
  • Proven track record of generating financial and operational value from complex, high-profile procurement projects, ideally in a non-mandated environment; advanced influencing and negotiation skills.
  • Deep knowledge of multiple IT categories: software/SaaS, infrastructure, networking/telecom, cybersecurity, cloud economics, or IT professional services.
  • Proficient with generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) in a procurement context and comfortable validating AI-generated output rather than relying on it uncritically.
  • Exceptional project management skills; thrives self-directed in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with minimal supervision.
  • Strong business acumen, including contract development and risk mitigation.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to influence audiences from analysts to senior executives. Fluent English required.
  • Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud Procurement or a comparable source-to-pay platform (SAP Ariba, Coupa) preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree required (Master's preferred); candidates with an Associate's degree and a strong track record of significant professional experience will also be considered

Reporting to the Chief Privacy Officer, you will join a global team covering cybersecurity legal frameworks, incident response, digital regulation, data governance, privacy, and AI.


You will partner closely with our Chief Information Security Officer, Technology, and Product teams to support critical global strategies designed to keep our fans, employees, and business safe.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Partner with the CISO, global technology, and product teams to translate principles into practical controls and implementation guidance.
  • Lead contractual negotiations, risk reviews, and recommend mitigations balancing innovation with accountability for cybersecurity vendors and products.
  • Track emerging laws, regulations, and technologies to ensure our governance approach remains forward-looking and globally relevant.

  • Strong foundation in governance, risk, and compliance with experience leading cross-functional programs.
  • Experience working with technology and product teams to implement controls and standards.
  • Excellent communication skills—able to distill complexity and present confidently to senior audiences.

job.title: Specialist, North America Pricing (Temporary)
job.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – SPECIALIST, NORTH AMERICA PRICING
Location: East Coast Remote
Division: Music
Line Manager: Director, NA Pricing
Contract Terms: Temporary Contract: Jan 4 2027 - September 30 2027

THE TEAM
Ticketmaster Music is a passionate team dedicated to supporting the needs of the world’s biggest touring artists (and their promoters, agents, and managers). Tasked with building Ticketmaster’s relationships with the Artist community, this entails being on the pulse of where the business is moving through discussion with major industry players, informing the Artist community of the latest developments within Ticketmaster, assisting with the operations of events, acting as a resource to help maximize ticket sales and awareness, driving incremental revenue throughout the tour cycle, and understanding Artist needs and how Ticketmaster can serve them with new Products and Services.

Within Ticketmaster Music, the Global Pricing team plays a critical role – an invaluable resource for top tours to price their tickets to market and capture fair value on their events, ensuring we sell the right ticket, to the right fan, at the right price.

THE JOB
The role of Pricing Specialist manages a portfolio of events and is responsible for implementing a pricing strategy commensurate with client goals for inventory of premium tickets. This includes market research to develop a unique plan for each client, and management of clients with updates and price adjustments throughout an event’s sales cycle. This position requires client-facing interaction to help build the client relationship. This position will research market trends and work within various technology platforms to make price adjustments and report on sales. In addition, this role will be responsible for recommending front-end and back-end enhancements to improve the efficiency and display of tickets and ensure our offering is cutting edge and delivering maximum value to Artists and promoters. This is a temporary contract running Jan 4 2027 - Sept 30 2027.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Manage a portfolio of events and implement pricing changes through various internal tools
  • Execute a pricing strategy for North America music events under management
  • Identify trends in sales, and be proactive in making price adjustments
  • Find opportunities for case studies to drive revenue and sales goals
  • Research on maximizing revenue for top performing events
  • Collaborate with Product and design teams to build new features – suggest ideas, give feedback on designs, and help prioritize most valuable enhancements
  • Provide guidance and actionable information to clients, and define prioritized events based on revenue opportunities and partner relations
  • Collaborate with Global counterparts to share best practices and strategy on global tours
  • Build relationships with key industry stakeholders – Promoters, Agents, Venues, and Managers
  • Run reports as needed and identify sales trends, anomalies, and other actionable data points
  • Work with cross-functional groups, including - but not limited to - tour execution, marketing, finance, event operations, legal, product teams, data teams, etc., to initiate and execute ad hoc projects within the constraints of tight, and often fluid, time deadlines

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

  • Strong analytical background with creative thinking and problem-solving skills
  • At least 2 years work experience preferred
  • Must have exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail
  • Understanding of the business dynamics between venue, promoter and artist
  • Ticketing experience preferred
  • Highly effective communication skills – written and verbal
  • Must be proficient in Excel, Word, Powerpoint and Outlook
  • Airtable proficiency preferred
  • Must be able to think through, evaluate and solve problems logically and efficiently
  • Knowledge of the Ticketmaster Host system and event build process a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, but not required

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

  • Exhibiting characteristics of integrity, honesty, discretion, loyalty and kindness to peers
  • Ability to build relationships and work collaboratively to drive results
  • Good interpersonal skills, and ability to work effectively with a range of people and personalities
  • Must conduct all matters and communications in a professional and courteous manner as a representative of the company

BENEFITS & PERKS
Through our ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ program, we provide benefits across six key pillars:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER
We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.
Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.
We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

Our work is guided by our values:

Reliability- We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.
Teamwork- We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team
Integrity- We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent
Belonging- We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.


WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 


THE ROLE

The LATAM Tax Director owns the tax function for Live Nation Entertainment’s Latin American operations (including Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico and Peru). This individual contributor sets the regional tax strategy, makes and recommends the tax decisions affecting the region, and is accountable for the accuracy, efficiency and risk posture of direct tax, indirect tax, transfer pricing and global minimum tax matters across all LATAM jurisdictions.


Operating with a high degree of independence, the Director defines how the region responds to a rapidly evolving Latin American tax landscape, determines the positions the company takes on complex and often unprecedented technical matters, and serves as the authoritative tax voice to regional and corporate leadership. Fluency in Spanish is required.
 

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO


Regional Tax Strategy & Governance

  • Own the LATAM tax strategy, including the annual and multi-year regional tax plan, and align it with corporate tax, finance and business objectives.
  • Establish the governance framework, policies and controls under which tax is managed across LATAM jurisdictions, and hold the region accountable to them.
  • Determine and document the company’s technical tax positions for the region, exercising independent judgment on complex, ambiguous and precedent-setting matters.
  • Own the regional tax risk profile: identify, quantify, prioritize and mitigate exposures, and escalate material matters with a clear recommended course of action.
  • Anticipate and interpret regulatory change (SAT in Mexico, AFIP in Argentina, Receita Federal in Brazil and other comparable authorities), assess business impact, and direct the company’s response.


Tax Provision, Compliance & Reporting

  • Oversee LATAM direct and indirect tax compliance — income tax, VAT/IVA and withholding taxes — and ensure appropriate governance and consistency across jurisdictions.
  • Own the tax provision and reporting for LATAM entities under US GAAP and IFRS, including the judgments underlying uncertain tax positions, valuation allowances and effective tax rate drivers.
  • Lead LATAM implementation of and compliance with Pillar Two and Country-by-Country Reporting, including data readiness, modeling of outcomes and the region’s filing strategy.
  • Direct the regional tax calendar and set the standard for quality, timeliness and audit-readiness of all filings and disclosures.
  • Serve as the region’s decision-maker and technical authority in partnership with the U.S. and global tax teams on matters affecting LATAM.

Transfer Pricing & Intercompany

  • Own the tax implications of intercompany transactions across the region and the design and defense of regional transfer-pricing positions.
  • Direct the preparation and maintenance of transfer pricing documentation, local files and intercompany agreements, and approve the methodologies applied.
  • Assess the regional impact of changes to the intercompany operating model and recommend structural adjustments to leadership.

Audit & Controversy

  • Lead LATAM tax audits and controversy end to end, including strategy, negotiation posture, settlement recommendations and coordination of consistent positions across countries.
  • Own root-cause analysis of audit findings and drive the process, documentation and control changes required to eliminate recurring exposures.
  • Manage regional tax advisor and external auditor relationships, including selection, scope, budget, performance and resolution of tax matters.


Transactions & Structuring

  • Lead and advise on LATAM tax planning for cross-border transactions, repatriations and cash-movement strategies, and recommend the approach the company adopts.
  • Own tax due diligence for regional M&A and joint ventures, evaluate identified exposures, and advise deal teams and senior leadership on materiality and mitigation.
  • Determine the optimal structure for new entities, joint ventures and market entries, and direct implementation.
  • Evaluate the existing regional structure for tax inefficiencies and lead the design and execution of optimization initiatives.
  • Negotiate tax provisions, permanent establishment protections, and indirect and withholding tax terms in transaction documents, in partnership with Legal.

Process, Systems & Controls

  • Lead the tax workstream for the Cumulus SAP rollout across LATAM, setting the standard processes, procedures and best practices for the region.
  • Identify and drive process improvement and automation opportunities enabled by expanded data and ERP functionality.
  • Own the design and operating effectiveness of tax-related internal controls for LATAM, including Sarbanes-Oxley documentation, and guide local teams through financial audit requirements.


Stakeholder Leadership & Influence

  • Act as the senior tax business partner for LATAM, advising regional and corporate leadership on the tax consequences of business decisions and influencing outcomes accordingly.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, Treasury and Human Resources on payroll tax, permanent establishment, employment structuring and other cross-functional tax matters.
  • Represent the company with tax authorities, external advisors and industry groups on LATAM tax matters.
  • Build regional tax capability by mentoring and developing finance and accounting colleagues across LATAM, and by delegating and reviewing the work of advisors and junior professionals.

Scope & Decision Authority

  • Individual contributor with no direct reports; leads through influence, delegation to external advisors, and direction of in-country finance teams.
  • Sets policy and strategy for the LATAM tax function with a one- to three-year horizon.
  • Operates with minimal supervision; work is reviewed for strategic alignment rather than technical accuracy.
  • Regularly communicates and negotiates with executive leadership, external advisors and tax authorities on matters of material financial consequence

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Law or a related field; CPA, Contador Público, tax law qualification or Master’s in Taxation strongly preferred.
  • Minimum 12 years of progressive international tax experience, including substantial LATAM multi-jurisdiction responsibility gained in a multinational corporate tax department, Big 4, or comparable professional services environment.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a regional or multi-country tax function, including accountability for technical positions, risk and audit outcomes
  • Deep technical command of LATAM direct and indirect tax regimes, transfer pricing, tax treaties, permanent establishment risk and cross-border structuring.
  • Working knowledge of Pillar Two / OECD BEPS 2.0 and Country-by-Country Reporting, with practical implementation experience preferred.
  • Strong US GAAP and IFRS tax accounting and provision expertise (ASC 740 / IAS 12).
  • • Proven ability to influence senior and executive stakeholders and to translate complex technical matters into clear business recommendations
  • Experience leading tax workstreams within an ERP implementation (SAP preferred)
  • Professional fluency in Spanish and English required; Portuguese strongly preferred.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. 


Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

job.title: Chief Engineer
job.description:
Chief Engineer

Chief Engineer

Department: Engineering
Reports To: General Manager / Corporate Director of Engineering
FLSA Status: Exempt
Location: Boise Market (KQXR-FM, KJOT-FM, KTHI-FM, KRVB-FM)

 

POSITION SUMMARY

Lotus Boise Corp is accepting applications for a Full-Time Chief Engineer. This position is responsible for the technical operation, maintenance, and regulatory compliance of all broadcast transmission and studio facilities for the cluster. Working closely with the local GM and Corporate Director of Engineering, this role ensures uninterrupted broadcast operations, maintains FCC compliance, and oversees building and facility maintenance.

Due to the nature of broadcast operations, the Chief Engineer position is considered an on-call role and must be available to respond to technical issues or facility emergencies that may impact broadcast operations at any time, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Operations

  • Oversee the installation, maintenance, and repair of all broadcast equipment including transmitters, antennas, STL systems, automation systems, and studio equipment.
  • Ensure reliable operation of broadcast facilities to maintain continuous on-air operations.
  • Monitor transmitter performance and conduct routine inspections of transmitter sites.
  • Ability to resolve complex problems not covered by existing procedures or practices independently often whilst under pressure.
  • Self-motivated to work independently under timeline to achieve departmental and station goals
  • Maintain broadcast automation systems, audio routing systems, and studio consoles.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues affecting broadcast operations.

Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure full compliance with all applicable FCC regulations and licensing requirements.
  • Maintain and update required FCC documentation and station engineering records.
  • Manage EAS (Emergency Alert System) equipment testing and compliance.
  • Coordinate required FCC filings, inspections, and technical reporting.

 

Building and Facility Maintenance

  • Oversee the maintenance and operational readiness of studio facilities, transmitter buildings, and related infrastructure.
  • Coordinate routine maintenance of building systems including electrical, HVAC, grounding systems, generators, and backup power systems.
  • Monitor and address building maintenance needs to ensure a safe and functional work environment for staff and visitors.
  • Coordinate facility repairs and improvements in collaboration with management.
  • Ensure transmitter sites, towers, and studio spaces remain compliant with safety and operational standards.

Vendor Management and Coordination

  • Serve as the primary liaison with technical vendors, contractors, tower companies, equipment suppliers, and facility maintenance providers.
  • Coordinate vendor scheduling for maintenance, repairs, and equipment installations.
  • Obtain quotes, evaluate service providers, and recommend vendor solutions for engineering and facility needs.
  • Monitor vendor work to ensure quality, compliance with safety standards, and completion of contracted services.

Engineering Leadership

  • Coordinate with General Manager and corporate engineering leadership on capital equipment needs and long-term technical planning.
  • Assist with engineering budgets, equipment procurement, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Provide technical guidance and training to station personnel.

Programming and Promotions Support

  • Support programming operations including studio setup and signal quality management.
  • Provide technical support for remote broadcasts, live events, and promotional activities.
  • Assist in implementation of new broadcast technologies and digital platforms.

On-Call and Emergency Response Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary on-call engineering contact for technical emergencies affecting broadcast operations.
  • Respond to equipment failures, signal disruptions, facility issues, or other operational emergencies in a timely manner.
  • Be available outside of normal business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, when technical issues require immediate attention.
  • Coordinate emergency repairs with vendors or technical staff as necessary to restore broadcast operations.

 

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5–7 years of broadcast engineering experience.
  • Strong knowledge of FCC broadcast regulations and compliance requirements.
  • Experience with radio transmitters, automation systems, audio consoles, and studio-transmitter links.
  • Working knowledge of IP networking and broadcast automation systems.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues under time-sensitive conditions.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing engineering operations for a multi-station broadcast cluster.
  • Experience overseeing facility maintenance and vendor coordination.

 

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to climb ladders and work at transmitter sites and tower locations.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to work in indoor studios and outdoor transmitter environments.

 

Work Environment

This position works in broadcast studios, office environments, and transmitter facilities. The role requires travel between studio and transmitter sites and may require work during evenings, weekends, or holidays to support station operations, technical maintenance, or emergency response situations.

 

Disclaimer:

Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

ABOUT US:

Lotus Boise Corp. is a subsidiary of Lotus Communications Corp. and is a media, entertainment and digital marketing services company that owns and operates radio properties. Lotus Communications Corp. operates 47 radio stations in the Western United States including stations in Los Angeles, Las Vegas, Sacramento, Boise, Tucson, Fresno and Bakersfield. Lotus Boise Corp ensures there is no discrimination based on the grounds of race, color, religion, gender, age, handicap, veteran status or national origin in respect to recruitment, evaluation, selection, promotion, compensation and training. Lotus Boise Corp. is an equal opportunity employer. If you know anyone who may be qualified to fill this position, please let him or her know about this opportunity. All interested candidates are encouraged to contact Careers@lotusboise.com .
