job.description:
Account Director (w/m/d), Advertising – BERLIN


Wir suchen ab sofort eine:n Account Director (w/m/d)
Du bist strategisch versiert, behältst Kundenbedürfnisse und Zahlen gleichermaßen im Blick und willst Verantwortung für große Accounts, spannende Marken und ein motiviertes Team übernehmen? Du liebst es, Konzepte in messbare Erfolge zu übersetzen und gemeinsam mit Kolleg:innen Wachstum zu schaffen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Ausgestattet mit Marktverständnis und Weitsicht bist du ein(e) souveräne(r) AnsprechpartnerIn für unser Team sowie unsere Kunden und lieferst mit viel Kreativität, Verhandlungsgeschick sowie Konzeptionsstärke ein optimales Projektmanagement.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Du bist die zentrale:r Ansprechpartner:in für unsere Kund:innen – proaktiv, verlässlich und immer mit strategischem Weitblick.

  • Du entwickelst integrierte Kommunikations- und Marketing-Strategien (online & offline) und setzt diese mit dem Team um.

  • Du verantwortest die Planung, Steuerung und das Reporting von Budgets, Kampagnen-KPIs und P&L-Zielen.

  • Du leitest cross-funktionale Projekte (Kreation, Social, Media, Produktion) und sorgst für termingerechte, qualitativ hochwertige Umsetzung.

  • Du führst und entwickelst dein Account-Team – von der Aufgabenverteilung bis zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.

  • Du präsentierst Konzepte und Ergebnisse kompetent bei Kund:innen und verhandelst Verträge, Scope-Änderungen und Budgets.

  • Du identifizierst Upsell-/Cross-Sell-Potenziale und unterstützt New Business-Initiativen.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass Prozesse effizient laufen und dass Qualität, Timeline und Budget eingehalten werden.

  • Du erkennst Risiken frühzeitig und erarbeitest pragmatische Lösungswege — intern wie extern.

  • Du gestaltest aktiv unsere Agenturkultur mit: offen, kooperativ, ergebnisorientiert und mit Freude an guter Arbeit.

  • Zentraler Ansprechpartner für Kunden vom Briefing über die kreative Entwicklung bis einschließlich der Produktion für alle klassischen und digitalen Medien

  • Übersicht des Projekt-Managements von der Projektplanung über Timing- & Budgetkontrolle bis hin zu Status-Reports

  • Informationsmanagement und Feedback an das Projektteam

  • Planung & Optimierung von Prozessen, Ressourcen & Kapazitäten

  • Erstellen & Halten von Präsentationen & Workshops

  • Beteiligung an Pitches

DEINE SKILLS

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Kommunikation, Marketing, BWL oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Ca. 5-8 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Kommunikationsagenturen

  • Mehrjährige Agenturerfahrung in der Kundenführung (Account Management) – idealerweise mit internationalen Kund:innen und komplexen Projekten

  • Erfahrung in der Kunden- und Mitarbeiterführung

  • Ausgeprägte Service- und Qualitätsorientierung und hohe Zuverlässigkeit

  • Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Operatives Geschick, strategisches Denken und selbstsichere Präsentation intern und vor Kunden

  • Viel Leidenschaft für klare Botschaften und ein gutes Gespür für Kreation

  • Erfahrung in Budget-/P&L-Verantwortung und Projektsteuerung

  • Hohes strategisches Verständnis gepaart mit Hands-on-Mentalität

  • Ausgeprägte Präsentations- und Verhandlungsstärke

  • Organisationsgeschick, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und sicheres Projektmanagement

  • Leadership-Erfahrung und Freude an Mitarbeitendenentwicklung

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Kanälen, Reporting-Tools und gängigen Office-Programmen

  • Proaktive, lösungsorientierte Haltung und Belastbarkeit in dynamischen Situationen

  • Du bringst exzellente Englischkenntnisse mit und beherrschst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau

  • Ausgezeichnete MS Office Kenntnisse

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

  • Mitarbeit an spannenden, zukunftsorientierten und interdisziplinären Kundenprojekten

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und eine offene Unternehmenskultur

  • Ein kreatives, unterstützendes Team, das zusammen an Zielen arbeitet und voneinander lernt

  • Abwechslungsreiches Kundenportfolio

  • Modernes Design-Büro am Rosenthaler Platz mit inspirierender Arbeitsumgebung

  • Gutschein-Benefits oder Firmen-Deutschlandticket für Festangestellte

  • Trainings- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

ÜBER UNS

M+C Saatchi ist eine globale Agentur für Markenkommunikation, die unter dem Dach des weltweiten M+C Saatchi Netzwerks in London gegründet wurde. Heute zählt die Agentur mehr als 2.000 Mitarbeiter:innen, mit Büros unter anderem in Mailand, London, Sydney, Amsterdam, Kapstadt, New York, Los Angeles und Berlin. Zum Kernangebot gehören Markenstrategie, Kampagnen, PR & Influencer Relations, Sponsoring, Events & Brand Experience, Social Media sowie Content-Produktion. Mit dem M+C Saatchi Deutschland Team realisierte die Agentur in den letzten Jahren unter anderem Projekte für Peloton, The North Face, ING, Porsche, Porsche Design, Mercedes-Benz Vans, Nike, Ferrero, Heineken, WHOOP, UEFA, Riot Games und Volkswagen. Unser Ziel ist es, Kund:innen dabei zu unterstützen, wirkungsvolle 360°-Kommunikation zu schaffen, die ihre Zielgruppen begeistert.

Bereit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und mit uns zu wachsen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

job.title: Concept Creative Social (w/m/d)
job.description:
Standort: Berlin

Start: asap

Anstellung: Vollzeit

Für diese Rolle sind Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachniveau essenziell.

Wir suchen ab sofort eine:n Concept Creative Social  (w/m/d) für einen großen Retail-Account.  
Du arbeitest hands-on mit starkem Fokus auf Cultural Trends und übernimmst kreative
Verantwortung von der ersten Konzeptidee bis zur finalen Umsetzung.
Du kennst die aktuellen Social-Mechaniken und kulturellen Trends, verstehst, wie Inhalte auf Plattformen funktionieren und welche Formate Menschen bewegen. Du entwickelst Konzepte,
die maximal Aufmerksamkeit generieren – von kreativer Social-Copy über Stories bis hin zu
großen Kampagnenideen, über die ganz Deutschland spricht.
Bei uns kannst du genau das tun: Content und Konzepte gestalten, Marken eine unverwechselbare Stimme geben und mit deinem kreativen Gespür immer wieder neue Impulse setzen.

Dich erwarten spannende kreative Herausforderungen für große nationale und internationale Marken.
In unserem Team mit einem Standort am Rosenthaler Platz bekommst du viel Gestaltungsspielraum und echte Eigenverantwortung — mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und Kolleg:innen, die dich jederzeit unterstützen.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Social-first Ideenentwicklung und plattformgerechte Konzeption von
    Formaten und Kampagnenmechaniken.

  • Entwicklung von Kampagnenmechaniken — von der Idee bis zur finalen Storyline und zur Übergabe an Produktion/Paid.

  • Copywriting für Social: Skripte für Reels/TikToks, Knowledge der gängigen Social Lingo, Funktionseise von Captions, CTAs und mehr.

  • Erstellung inspirierender und involvierender Contents über mehrere digitale Kanäle hinweg (Social Posts, Native Ads, Virals, Stunts, Content-Snippets für Websites).

  • Trend-Research und kontinuierliches Plattform-Scouting:
    du identifizierst relevante Creator-Formate, Cultural Moments und neue Mechaniken.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Art Direction, Social Management, Strategie, Produktion und Paid, inklusive kreativer Qualitätssicherung.

  • Unterstützung bei Präsentationen, Workshops und Pitches sowie aktive Mitwirkung an der Ausarbeitung von Pitch-Ideen.

  • Sicherstellung, dass Konzepte kulturell relevant und technisch für die jeweiligen Plattformen umsetzbar sind.

DEIN PROFIL

  • Du bist Social-first denkend und liebst Social Media — du kennst Funktionen, Verbreitungsweisen und Mechaniken der Plattformen aka bist „chronically online“.

  • Du verfügst über ca. 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung als Concept Creative, Social Creative, Copywriter:in oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit Social-Fokus.

  • Du hast ein starkes Gespür für Sprache, Storytelling und Headlines; du verfasst klare, pointierte und conversion-orientierte Copy.

  • Du konzipierst zielsicher und kannst komplexe Themen in appetitliche Häppchen verpacken.

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Kampagnenmechaniken und crossmedialen Content-Formaten ist vorhanden.

  • Du bringst technisches Verständnis mit und weißt, welche Umsetzungsanforderungen (Produktion/Editing) Formate benötigen.

  • Teamplayer: Du arbeitest gern interdisziplinär mit Strategie, Kreation, Social Management und Produktion zusammen.

  • Ein Studium im Bereich Kommunikation/Werbung oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung ist ein Plus — oder du bist ein Naturtalent mit hervorragender Schreibe.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (muttersprachlich) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Einen mutigen und experimentierfreudigen Kunden

  • Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein kollegiales Miteinander

  • Modernes Design‑Büro am Rosenthaler Platz sowie Mobile Working nach Absprache

  • Gutschein‑Benefits oder Firmen‑Deutschlandticket für Festangestellte

ÜBER UNS

M+C Saatchi ist eine globale Agentur für Markenkommunikation, welche unter dem Dach des weltweiten M+C Saatchi Netzwerks in London gegründet wurde. Heute zählt die Agentur mehr als 2000 Mitarbeiterinnen, mit Büros u.a. in Mailand, London, Sydney, Amsterdam, Kappstadt, New York, Los Angeles und Berlin. Zum Kernangebot gehören Markenstrategie, Kampagnen, PR & Influencer Relations, Sponsoring, Events & Brand Experience, Social Media sowie Content Produktion. Mit dem M+C Saatchi Deutschland Team realisierte die Agentur in den letzten Jahren unter anderem Projekte für Peloton, The North Face, ING, Lidl, Porsche, Porsche Design, Mercedes-Benz Vans, Nike, Ferrero, Heineken, WHOOP, UEFA, Riot Games und Volkswagen. Unser Ziel ist es, Kundinnen dabei zu unterstützen, wirkungsvolle 360° Kommunikation zu schaffen, die ihre Zielgruppen begeistert.

job.title: Finance Assistant (w/m/d) – BERLIN
job.description:
Finance Assistant (w/m/d) – BERLIN

Wir suchen ab sofort eine:n Finance Assistant (w/m/d) für unseren Standort Berlin.

Du arbeitest gerne strukturiert, hast ein gutes Gespür für Zahlen und möchtest praktische Erfahrung in einem abwechslungsreichen Finance-Umfeld sammeln? Du bist zuverlässig, genau und behältst auch bei mehreren Aufgaben den Überblick? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

In dieser praxisnahen Support-Rolle unterstützt du unseren Head of Finance im operativen Tagesgeschäft. Du musst noch kein Finance-Profi sein: Wichtig sind uns Organisationstalent, Genauigkeit, Verlässlichkeit und die Bereitschaft, bestehende Prozesse sorgfältig umzusetzen. Eine umfassende Einarbeitung in unsere Abläufe, Systeme und deine konkreten Aufgaben ist vorgesehen.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Du unterstützt den Head of Finance bei den täglichen Finance- und administrativen Aufgaben.

  • Du arbeitest nach bestehenden Finance-Prozessen und stellst sicher, dass Aufgaben sorgfältig und zuverlässig erledigt werden.

  • Du verfolgst offene Vorgänge mit unserem Shared Service Centre nach und unterstützt dabei, dass Anfragen abgeschlossen werden.

  • Du aktualisierst Excel-Tabellen, Reports und Finance-Tracker.

  • Du unterstützt bei einfachen Datenanalysen und prüfst Informationen auf Vollständigkeit und Richtigkeit.

  • Du hilfst bei der Pflege von Prozessdokumentationen, erinnerst an Abläufe und beantwortest grundlegende Fragen aus dem Team.

  • Du unterstützt bei Kunden- und Lieferantenanfragen, beim Forderungsmanagement und bei routinemäßigen Mahnläufen; komplexere Themen stimmst du mit dem Head of Finance ab.

  • Du hilfst bei der Anlage von Kund:innen, Lieferant:innen und Projekten, einschließlich der Erstellung und Nachverfolgung von Tickets.

  • Du unterstützt bei einfachen Finance-System- und Workflow-Themen zwischen Business, Shared Service Centre und Finance Systems Team, zum Beispiel bei fehlenden Freigaben oder Änderungen von Zuständigkeiten.

  • Du prüfst Reise- und Ausgabenabrechnungen auf Vollständigkeit und klärst offene Punkte.

  • Du unterstützt nach Anleitung bei der Vorbereitung von Umsatzsteuererklärungen, Zahlungsläufen und routinemäßigen Monatsabschlussaufgaben.

  • Du übernimmst weitere klar definierte Finance- und administrative Aufgaben nach Bedarf.

DEINE SKILLS

  • Erste Erfahrung im Finance-Bereich ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss – wichtiger sind Neugier und Lernbereitschaft.

  • Du verfügst über gute Excel-Kenntnisse und arbeitest sicher mit Tabellen.

  • Du arbeitest gerne mit Zahlen und prüfst Details sorgfältig.

  • Du bist organisiert und kannst Aufgaben systematisch abarbeiten.

  • Du kannst Anweisungen gut aufnehmen und bestehende Prozesse zuverlässig umsetzen.

  • Du arbeitest genau, verlässlich und übernimmst Verantwortung für die vollständige Bearbeitung deiner Aufgaben.

  • Du fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist.

  • Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Du bringst eine positive, praktische Haltung und die Bereitschaft mit, Neues zu lernen.

  • Interesse an Technologie und KI-Tools, die effizientes Arbeiten unterstützen, ist ein Plus.

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

  • Mitarbeit an spannenden, zukunftsorientierten und interdisziplinären Kundenprojekten

  • Ein kreatives, unterstützendes Team, das gemeinsam an Zielen arbeitet und voneinander lernt

  • Ein modernes Design-Büro am Rosenthaler Platz mit inspirierender Arbeitsumgebung

  • Gutschein-Benefits oder ein Firmen-Deutschlandticket für Festangestellte

  • Trainings- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

ÜBER UNS

M+C Saatchi ist eine globale Agentur für Markenkommunikation, die unter dem Dach des weltweiten M+C Saatchi Netzwerks in London gegründet wurde. Heute zählt die Agentur mehr als 2.000 Mitarbeiter:innen, mit Büros unter anderem in Mailand, London, Sydney, Amsterdam, Kapstadt, New York, Los Angeles und Berlin. Zum Kernangebot gehören Markenstrategie, Kampagnen, PR & Influencer Relations, Sponsoring, Events & Brand Experience, Social Media sowie Content-Produktion. Mit dem M+C Saatchi Deutschland Team realisierte die Agentur in den letzten Jahren unter anderem Projekte für Peloton, The North Face, ING, Porsche, Porsche Design, Mercedes-Benz Vans, Nike, Ferrero, Heineken, WHOOP, UEFA, Riot Games und Volkswagen. Unser Ziel ist es, Kund:innen dabei zu unterstützen, wirkungsvolle 360°-Kommunikation zu schaffen, die ihre Zielgruppen begeistert.

Bereit, mit uns zu wachsen und praktische Finance-Erfahrung zu sammeln? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

job.title: Praktikant:in Account Management, Sport & Entertainment (w/m/d) – BERLIN
job.description:
Praktikant:in Account Management, Sport & Entertainment (w/m/d) – BERLIN

Standort: Berlin

Start: 4.1.2027

Anstellung: Pflichtpraktikum im Rahmen eines Studiums, Vollzeit

Dauer: mindestens 3 Monate, besser 5-6 Monate

Für diese Rolle sind Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachlerniveau essenziell.

Wir suchen eine motivierte, neugierige und strukturierte Persönlichkeit, die unser Account-Team im Bereich Sport & Entertainment unterstützt. In deinem Praktikum erhältst du Einblicke in die Betreuung nationaler und internationaler Kund:innen und arbeitest an Projekten rund um Sport, Fußball, Lifestyle und Entertainment mit. Du unterstützt das Team im Tagesgeschäft und begleitest Kampagnen, Sponsoring-Projekte, Aktivierungen, Events und Content-Produktionen von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Strategy, Kreation, Social, PR und Produktion zusammen und lernst, wie Briefings, Timings, Budgets, Freigaben und Deliverables in einer internationalen Agentur koordiniert werden. Wir wünschen uns, dass du dich aktiv einbringst, Verantwortung für klar definierte Aufgaben übernimmst und ein echtes Interesse an den Communities, kulturellen Momenten und Geschichten hinter Sport und Entertainment mitbringst.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Unterstützung bei der Betreuung nationaler und internationaler Kund:innen aus Sport, Fußball, Lifestyle und Entertainment

  • Mitarbeit im operativen Tagesgeschäft, von der Vorbereitung von Briefings über Abstimmungen und Freigaben bis zur Umsetzung

  • Unterstützung bei Sponsoring-Projekten, Kampagnen, Aktivierungen, Events und Content-Produktionen

  • Recherche zu Marken, Zielgruppen, Trends, Sportarten, Talents, Partnerschaften und relevanten kulturellen Themen

  • Vorbereitung von Präsentationen, Statusübersichten, Reportings, Meeting-Unterlagen und Projekt-Dokumentationen

  • Koordination von Terminen, Aufgaben und Follow-ups sowie Pflege von Timings und Deliverable-Listen

  • Unterstützung bei der Abstimmung mit internen Teams, Kund:innen und externen Partner:innen oder Dienstleister:innen

  • Aufbereitung und strukturierte Weitergabe von Kund:innenfeedback an die beteiligten Projektteams

  • Unterstützung bei Events und Aktivierungen, bei Bedarf auch vor Ort, beispielsweise in den Bereichen Ablauf, Gästemanagement oder Ticketing

  • Mitarbeit bei Brainstormings, Workshops und Pitches sowie Einbringen eigener Ideen und Perspektiven

  • Unterstützung bei administrativen Aufgaben wie Ablage, Kostenübersichten und Rechnungsunterlagen

DEIN PROFIL

  • Du bist an einer Hochschule oder Universität immatrikuliert und musst ein Pflichtpraktikum absolvieren, idealerweise in den Bereichen Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, Sportmanagement, Eventmanagement, Wirtschaft oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang

  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Sport und Entertainment und verfolgst relevante Marken, Plattformen, Communities und kulturelle Trends

  • Du arbeitest organisiert, zuverlässig und sorgfältig und behältst auch bei mehreren Aufgaben den Überblick

  • Du kommunizierst klar, freundlich und verbindlich und hast Freude an Teamarbeit und Kund:innenkontakt

  • Du bringst Eigeninitiative, Lernbereitschaft und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mit

  • Du hast Freude an Recherche, Präsentationen und der strukturierten Aufbereitung von Informationen

  • Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel und Word

  • Erste praktische Erfahrungen durch vorherige Praktika, studentische Tätigkeiten oder eigene Projekte im Agentur-, Marketing-, Sport-, Event- oder Medienumfeld sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung

  • Du bist bereit, bei Kund:innenterminen, Produktionen, Events und Aktivierungen flexibel zu unterstützen und bei Bedarf zu reisen

  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachniveau sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit in internationalen Teams

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Praxiseinblicke und die Möglichkeit, an echten Kund:innenprojekten, Kampagnen, Sponsoring-Aktivierungen, Events und Content-Produktionen mitzuwirken

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und ein kollegiales, internationales Team

  • Ein modernes Design-Büro am Rosenthaler Platz

ÜBER UNS

M+C Saatchi ist eine globale Agentur für Markenkommunikation, die unter dem Dach des weltweiten M+C Saatchi Netzwerks in London gegründet wurde. Heute zählt die Agentur mehr als 2.000 Mitarbeiter:innen, mit Büros unter anderem in Mailand, London, Sydney, Amsterdam, Kapstadt, New York, Los Angeles und Berlin. Zum Kernangebot gehören Markenstrategie, Kampagnen, PR & Influencer Relations, Sponsoring, Events & Brand Experience, Social Media sowie Content-Produktion. Mit dem M+C Saatchi Deutschland Team realisierte die Agentur in den letzten Jahren unter anderem Projekte für Peloton, The North Face, ING, Porsche, Porsche Design, Mercedes-Benz Vans, Nike, Ferrero, Heineken, WHOOP, UEFA, Riot Games und Volkswagen. Unser Ziel ist es, Kund:innen dabei zu unterstützen, wirkungsvolle 360°-Kommunikation zu schaffen, die ihre Zielgruppen begeistert.

job.title: Senior Growth Manager
job.description:
M+C Saatchi Group is looking for a strategic, commercially minded and highly motivated Senior Growth Manager to help shape how the UK Group shows up, connects and grows.

Sitting at the heart of our UK Growth and Marketing team, and reporting to the UK Head of New Business, you'll play a pivotal role in identifying, developing and converting new business opportunities, leading major pitches and bringing together the collective strength of our specialist businesses.

This is an opportunity to work across one of the UK's most diverse creative communications groups, with clients and opportunities spanning major Government departments, leading commercial brands, sport and entertainment, brand communications, consultancy, social and media.

You'll help drive our proactive growth agenda, develop our recently launched Culture Collective community and deliver marketing initiatives that strengthen our reputation, relationships and commercial pipeline.

You'll also play an important role in bringing our Cultural Power proposition to life, ensuring our thinking, storytelling and market presence reflect our ambition to shape culture and create meaningful connections.

Working closely with senior leadership and specialist teams across the Group, you'll operate in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where no two opportunities look the same.

We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with exceptional delivery, thrives on complexity and brings clarity, energy and momentum to everything they do.

ABOUT THE ROLE:
This is a varied, high-impact role focused on driving growth through proactive business development, world-class pitching and a compelling marketing presence.

You'll help develop complex, high-value new business opportunities from initial qualification through to final delivery, often bringing together multiple specialisms to develop integrated responses to challenging client briefs.

Our opportunities span major public sector procurement processes, significant commercial pitches and proactive growth initiatives across advertising, PR, sport and entertainment, brand consultancy, social, data and media.

You'll need to be comfortable managing multiple priorities, influencing senior stakeholders, navigating ambiguity and delivering to demanding deadlines without compromising quality.

Beyond pitching, you'll help shape our approach to prospecting, relationship development, thought leadership and industry engagement, ensuring the Group is present in the right conversations, with the right message.

Success will be measured through the quality and conversion of our new business pipeline, the effectiveness of our pitches, the strength of cross-Group collaboration and the commercial impact of our marketing activity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

New Business & Pitch Leadership

  • Lead major new business pitches end-to-end, including opportunity qualification, strategy, team mobilisation, content development, commercial coordination and final delivery.

  • Bring together specialist capabilities and senior stakeholders from across the UK Group to develop compelling, integrated responses to complex client challenges.

  • Lead public sector and commercial procurement processes, including tenders, framework opportunities, RFIs and RFPs, ensuring submissions are strategically strong, compliant and commercially considered.

  • Manage multiple concurrent opportunities against demanding deadlines, maintaining momentum, quality and accountability throughout.

  • Partner with senior leadership to evaluate opportunities, shape competitive positioning and make informed recommendations on where to invest time and resources.

  • Work with finance, commercial and legal teams to support pitch budgets, commercial submissions and governance requirements.

Growth Strategy & Prospecting

  • Partner with the CMO, UK Head of New Business and business leads to shape and deliver our annual growth and marketing strategy.

  • Develop proactive prospecting strategies, identifying priority audiences, building contact plans and nurturing relationships with prospective clients.

  • Identify opportunities to connect Group specialisms, unlock cross-selling potential and develop broader, more valuable client relationships.

  • Build a strong understanding of the Group's capabilities, identifying opportunities to bring together expertise in response to emerging client needs.

  • Maintain accurate pipeline management, opportunity tracking and reporting through HubSpot.

Marketing, Reputation & Relationships

  • Develop and grow Culture Collective as a platform for meaningful industry connections, prospect engagement and new business opportunities.

  • Support the delivery of the UK Group marketing strategy, bringing our Cultural Power proposition to life through compelling content and market engagement.

  • Contribute to thought leadership, social content, PR and industry events, working closely with communications and specialist teams.

  • Maintain and evolve credentials, case studies, pitch templates and other new business collateral, ensuring consistency, quality and relevance.

  • Coordinate industry award entries, directory submissions and other reputation-building opportunities.

  • Build strong relationships across the UK Group, fostering collaboration and ensuring our collective expertise is represented effectively in the market.

ABOUT YOU

  • You're a natural connector, a strategic thinker and someone who knows how to make things happen.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, ambitious environment where priorities shift, opportunities are complex and collaboration is essential.

  • You're equally comfortable shaping a compelling pitch narrative, influencing senior stakeholders, coordinating multiple teams and getting into the detail to ensure exceptional delivery.

  • You understand that great business development is about more than responding to briefs. It's about spotting opportunities, asking the right questions, connecting capabilities and building relationships that create long-term value.

  • You bring strong commercial instincts, excellent judgement and a genuine curiosity about the wider marketing, communications and cultural landscape.

  • Above all, you take ownership, bring people with you and deliver.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: (Experience and qualifications)

  • Significant experience in business development, growth, client leadership or strategic marketing within a creative, communications or integrated agency environment.

  • A proven track record of leading major new business pitches, from opportunity qualification and strategic development through to final presentation and delivery.

  • Experience managing complex, multi-disciplinary opportunities involving multiple agency specialisms or business units.

  • Strong commercial judgement, with the ability to assess opportunities, understand client challenges and develop compelling, commercially credible responses.

  • Exceptional storytelling, writing and editing skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear, persuasive narratives.

  • A broad understanding of the marketing and communications landscape, including advertising, PR, social, brand strategy, sport and entertainment, consultancy and media.

  • Experience of significant public sector, Government or complex commercial procurement processes would be advantageous.

  • Strong project management skills, with experience managing multiple high-priority projects simultaneously.

  • Confidence using CRM systems, managing pipelines and reporting on business development activity, ideally using HubSpot.

  • A track record of building relationships and influencing senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

WHAT YOU'RE GOOD AT: (Behaviours)

  • Connecting the dots: Seeing opportunities across different businesses, capabilities and client challenges, and bringing the right people and ideas together.

  • Making sense of complexity: Turning ambiguous briefs, competing perspectives and complex information into clear strategies and actionable plans.

  • Driving momentum: Taking ownership, anticipating challenges and keeping people and projects moving, even when priorities shift.

  • Thinking commercially: Understanding what makes an opportunity valuable, where to focus effort and how to create compelling reasons for clients to choose us.

  • Influencing and collaborating: Building trust, navigating different perspectives and aligning senior stakeholders and specialist teams.

  • Delivering under pressure: Remaining calm, resourceful and solutions-focused while maintaining exceptional standards.

  • Balancing strategy and execution: Seeing the bigger picture while being equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves and delivering the details.

  • Staying culturally connected: Bringing curiosity, fresh thinking and an informed perspective on the trends and conversations shaping our industry.

WHAT YOU’LL GET:

For the right candidate, we will offer a competitive salary and benefits package which includes 27 days annual holiday, private healthcare, employer contributory pension, life assurance and income protection. We also offer a host of benefits that support wellbeing including subsidised gym membership, whilst our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion sees us offer learning opportunities around D&I, mentoring programmes and the opportunity for all to participate in a number of active Employee Led Networks and associated events. Finally, this role will be supported with all the necessary personal development required to set someone up for success.

ABOUT M+C SAATCHI GROUP

M+C Saatchi Group has pledged its commitment to create a company that values difference, with an inclusive culture. As part of this M+C Saatchi Group continues to be an Equal Opportunity Employer which does not and shall not discriminate, celebrates diversity and bases all hiring and promotion decisions solely on merit, without regard for any personal characteristics.

If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment and selection process, please make us aware as part of your application.

All employee information is kept confidential according to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

job.title: Category Manager – Books and Calendars
job.description:
Drive the future of retail category management with McClatchy’s Retail Network as our Category Manager – Books and Calendars. We’re looking for a dynamic, data-driven leader ready to shape and grow our books and calendars category through innovation, analytics, and strong supplier partnerships. If you thrive on optimizing performance, leveraging AI-powered insights, and exceeding sales targets, this is your opportunity to make a measurable impact in a fast-evolving retail environment.

In this role, you’ll lead the procurement, development, and management of book and calendar programs, collaborating closely with vendors, publishers, and cross-functional teams. You’ll use advanced analytics and emerging technologies to inform product selection, streamline operations, and ensure our offerings are always relevant and competitive. Your strategic thinking and relationship-building skills will be key to maximizing profitability and driving customer satisfaction.

What you’ll do:

  • Manage and optimize the books and calendars category, from procurement and negotiation to sales performance and product availability
  • Leverage AI, data analytics, and market trends to inform go-to-market strategies, pricing, and promotions
  • Build and maintain strong supplier relationships, using technology to enhance sourcing and forecasting
  • Analyze category performance and P&L, identifying opportunities for profit growth and cost savings
  • Support the retailer partnership team through training, pipeline development, go-to-market tools, and serving as an SME on client calls  
  • Champion continuous improvement, innovation, and alignment with company growth objectives
  • Occasional travel may be required

What sets you apart:

  • Proven expertise in category management, retail dynamics, and supply chain optimization—especially in books/calendars or similar categories
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using AI-driven tools and consumer insights
  • Excellent negotiation, consultative selling, and vendor management abilities
  • Creative, strategic thinker with a passion for tailored solutions and measurable results
  • Bachelor’s degree (advanced degree preferred) and 5+ years’ experience in senior book/calendar purchasing, distribution, or retail category management

Join us and help redefine category leadership in the retail network space. If you’re ready to innovate, collaborate, and deliver results in a modern, tech-enabled environment, we want to hear from you!

The anticipated base salary range for this position is between 95k and 110k base salary annually. Plus bonus potential.  Individual base pay may vary within that range depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, relevant education, department equity, training, geography, and local wage and hours laws.

About McClatchy: 

Our impact is growing every day. 30 growing markets. Over 65 million monthly readers. 56 Pulitzer Prizes. A strong portfolio of dynamic partnerships and smart investments. Our award-winning journalism, digital reach, and commitment to innovative growth have never been stronger.  

As a member of the McClatchy family, you are part of a flexible, empowering, and exciting culture dedicated to creating a work/life balance and consistent opportunities for growth—a place where you have a voice and the ability to impact our future. It’s an exciting time to be here. Our company is experiencing the most transformative period in its history. We’re growing rapidly in the digital space and delivering award-winning journalism in innovative ways. 

McClatchy strives to be an employer of choice, and our benefits package is made with this goal in mind. With a focus on well-being and daily life, our package options include healthcare coverage for employees and their families, financial protection from expected and unexpected expenses, multiple no-cost wellness resources and even coverage for four-legged friends.  

Our comprehensive benefits package also includes a 401(k) plan with employer match, competitive paid time off and corporate holidays, as well as a range of mental health benefits. For more information on McClatchy's benefits plan, please visit McClatchyLivewell.com.

job.title: Political Advertising Sales Manager (California)
job.description:
Political Advertising Sales Manager (California) – Political & Public Affairs Vertical

McClatchy | West Coast Division

Location: California / Sacramento or Los Angeles Area (Field-based / Remote)

Position Type: Full-Time

McClatchy, a leader in local and regional media, seeks a strategic, results-oriented Account Executive to lead revenue development across California and the West Coast. With a powerful portfolio of iconic West Coast publications—including The Sacramento Bee, The Fresno Bee, and The Modesto Bee—McClatchy pairs a legacy of trusted regional journalism with a sophisticated, data-driven digital marketing suite that allows our clients to reach key decision-makers and voters with precision and impact.

Our mission has never been more vital. As a successful candidate, you will be the bridge between our first-class digital portfolio and the fast-paced political arena, leveraging data, innovation, and unmatched regional reach to drive measurable revenue growth and shape the conversations driving Western policy.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Vertical Mastery: Act as a subject matter expert in the political, government, and advocacy space, deeply understanding California policy initiatives, ballot measures, and legislative calendars.
  • Strategic Business Development: Adopt a "Hunter" mentality to identify, qualify, and secure new revenue streams from political campaigns, PACs, trade associations, and public affairs firms across the West Coast.
  • Consultative Selling: Conduct deep-dive campaign assessments to understand complex legislative or electoral objectives and design highly targeted multi-platform issue-advocacy solutions.
  • Solution Engineering: Develop and deliver compelling marketing strategies utilizing McClatchy’s full suite of products, including high-impact display, programmatic geotargeting, social media amplification, CTV/OTT, and custom branded content.
  • Relationship Management: Build long-term, trust-based partnerships with leading political consultants, media buying agencies, and corporate advocacy directors.
  • Operational Excellence: Maintain rigorous pipeline management and accurate records of sales activities, compliance tracking, and revenue forecasts within rapid-fire political windows using CRM tools.

Desired Experience & Qualifications

  • Industry Knowledge: Proven experience working directly with political campaigns, issue-advocacy groups, or within the California public affairs ecosystem.
  • Digital Fluency: A strong background in digital marketing and advertising, with a proven track record of selling custom digital solutions (Programmatic, Social, First-Party Data targeting, etc.).
  • Sales Excellence: Demonstrated ability in strategic prospecting, high-stakes negotiation, and closing business under tight deadlines through a persuasive, solutions-oriented approach.
  • Agility & Collaboration: The ability to pivot instantly in a high-pressure, rapidly evolving political environment without losing quality, while collaborating constructively with cross-functional media teams.
  • Communication: Exceptional presentation and writing skills with the ability to earn the trust of high-profile political operatives and translate policy goals into media strategies.

Requirements

  • Education: A combination of knowledge and experience equivalent to a B.A. or B.S. Degree in Political Science, Public Policy, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in HubSpot, Salesforce, or equivalent CRM tools; daily CRM utilization for pipeline tracking is required.
  • Logistics: Must be located in California (Sacramento or Los Angeles regions preferred). A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and valid vehicle insurance are required for frequent regional travel.

Professional Offerings

  • Compensation: Base salary plus commission with uncapped earning potential. 
    • The anticipated base pay range for this position is between $80,000 and $95,000 annually.  Individual base pay may vary within that range depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, relevant education, department equity, training, geography, and local wage and hours laws.
  • Advancement: Clear opportunities for professional growth within a nationally recognized media organization.
  • Benefits: Full suite of benefits including a 401(k) with company match. 
    • For a full overview of our benefits:  www.mcclatchylivewell.com
  • Culture: A fast-paced, professional, and mission-driven work environment aligned with major news cycles.

McClatchy is an Equal Opportunity Employer and supports a Drug-Free Environment.

job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
Summary:


The Account Manager, Strategic Partnerships is responsible for supporting key customers and channel partner accounts across our online and offline buying and media placement desks. The ideal candidate is a natural at building and maintaining strong relationships with a well-tuned attention to detail across a high volume of accounts, maintaining satisfaction among key stakeholders at all levels. The Account Manager, Strategic Partnerships applies a “solution mindset” to remove obstacles and ensure a clear path to account success and growth. This position is the principal point of contact for all service-related matters, anticipates the needs of clients, and works cross-functionally to meet milestones and deadlines.


Although this is a remote position, candidates must reside within a reasonable distance of the Orange County, CA market to accommodate occasional in-person meetings.


What you will do:


  • Become a knowledgeable client partner for SoCal News Group’s online and offline media placement solutions
  • Conduct required active daily outreach to current and lapsed clients to secure, retain, and upsell revenue to meet monthly and annual budget expectations, managing the pipeline through sequences and stages for new and recurring opportunities
  • Facilitate necessary probing and needs analysis to develop annual brand and media strategies for placement, upsell, and cross-sell based on overall clients' goals and objectives
  • Develop campaign strategies and audience targeting recommendations per brand and product line
  • Evaluate KPIs and optimize campaign performance using a data-driven approach, leveraging insights from our AdTech and MarTech platforms
  • Perform in-depth pre- and post-data analysis to deliver actionable insights and recommendations that influence short-term and long-term online and offline media strategy
  • Educate advertisers on performance metrics, insights, and how to achieve greater results
  • Work cross-functionally with sales and marketing to achieve overall company annual targets
  • Support the client buying cycle and manage all post-sales activities, including proposal coordination, material and content collection, insertion orders, billing, and other onboarding deliverables to help secure revenue and implement programs
  • Increase customer retention by conducting regular performance checks to identify areas for improvement and performing data analysis for ongoing strategic reviews
  • Interface with Ad Operations to resolve issues and provide the highest level of customer service

What you will bring:


  • Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of experience in a Strategic Account Manager or Account Executive role with demonstrated success as a high-performing individual contributor
  • Experience in omnichannel marketing, with a concentration in programmatic or social media and a discipline in understanding market penetration for in-home media buying
  • Media planning capabilities using data, analysis, and market research
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage shifting priorities
  • Positive attitude, high energy, and a collaborative team spirit
  • Unwavering desire to learn and take direction to improve productivity
  • Solid analytical skills and comfort working with numbers
  • Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal, while working as part of a team or independently
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Salesforce
  • Demonstrated success working with cross-functional teams and building strong relationships internally and externally

SCNG has become the largest news content provider in the five-county Los Angeles metropolitan area, boasting a leading circulation nationwide with 11 daily newspapers and over a dozen community weeklies. Our mission is to connect communities by providing readers with top-notch local news coverage and offering advertisers unparalleled access to a diverse and engaged audience. No matter the distribution vehicle - newspaper, magazine, mobile, online - SCNG's in-depth reporting on local news, politics, sports, and entertainment attracts a highly desirable audience of over 8.1 million adults weekly. job.title: Accounting Manager
job.description:
Summary:

 

The General Ledger Manager is responsible for ensuring all general ledger and financial close activities are completed timely and accurately for the MNG properties managed in the Shared Services Center, as well as ensuring all payroll activity is recorded timely and accurately for MediaNews Group and Tribune Company. Working in Oracle and its respective reporting tools (EPM), this role handles all activities related to preparing and recording journal entries, maintaining sufficient backup documentation, and account reconciliation. Additionally, this position will be assigned the financial statement responsibilities for one or more newspaper properties and all payroll activity, supervise other staff, and serve as a key communication link with assigned properties' FP&A contacts. This position may also be responsible for tracking newsprint inventory and calculating expense.

 

Although this is a remote position, candidates must reside in Colorado or Ohio.

 

What you will do:

 

  • Supervise the General Ledger Team within the Shared Services Center to ensure all financial close activities are completed in a timely and accurate manner in accordance with GAAP
  • Review and post journal entries and review and approve payroll journal entries and reconciliations
  • For assigned properties, prepare monthly journal entries and supporting schedules, ensuring proper approvals have been received
  • Prepare documentation for journal entries in the following areas: ad revenue, interactive revenue, circulation revenue, circulation expenses, advertising expenses, newsprint expenses, payroll expenses, benefits expenses, and allocations
  • Enter journal entries into Oracle
  • Obtain appropriate authorization from properties for journal entries requiring approval
  • Complete quarterly reporting requirements for Internal Control Questionnaires and Representation Letters
  • Participate in quarterly close calls and respond to PAR questions from the Corporate Accounting Team
  • Support the Senior Director of Accounting with special projects and reporting
  • Release P&L details to department heads at field locations
  • Respond to questions and inquiries from department heads, FP&A contacts, and publishers regarding financial results, and perform related research
  • Assist FP&A resources with variance analyses and Day 7 reports
  • Review account reconciliations
  • Perform newsprint analyst tasks: tracking inventory orders, receipts, and invoicing
  • Complete the inventory roll-forward to calculate newsprint expense and generate the related journal entry
  • Perform bad debt analysis and record bad debt expense
  • Provide customer service to key contacts at field locations and the corporate office
  • Identify areas for process improvement and increased efficiency
  • Hire, train, and manage the General Ledger Team
  • Actively participate in the future expansion of Shared Services

 

What you will bring:

 

  • Knowledge of accounting processes and internal controls
  • Strong knowledge and application of GAAP

job.title: DOT Compliance & Field Safety Technician
job.description:
Title: DOT Compliance & Field Safety Technician

Reports to: Director of Safety

 

At Meruelo Enterprises, we’re building more than infrastructure, we’re building communities, careers, and a better tomorrow.

Founded in 1986 and proudly minority-owned, we’ve grown into one of California’s leading construction and engineering firms, serving major utility, transportation, and telecom clients across the West Coast. With a talented team of over 2,500 professionals and a family of top-tier subsidiaries, we deliver innovative, high-impact solutions in gas, electric, water, and more.

From the ground up, we’re committed to safety, quality, and integrity. If you're looking to be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven company making a real difference, welcome to Meruelo Enterprises.

 

About the Role:

The DOT Compliance & Field Safety Technician is a senior individual contributor responsible for owning and continuously improving the company’s transportation compliance and fleet safety programs across all operations. Reporting directly to the Director of Safety, this role serves as the enterprise subject‑matter expert for DOT/CHP compliance, fleet risk reduction, incident investigation, and telematics-driven performance management.

This position has no direct reports but carries company‑wide authority and accountability for transportation safety outcomes, compliance readiness, and fleet risk mitigation.

 

Key Responsibilities:

²  Own all transportation compliance programs, including DOT/FMCSA (as applicable), CHP, DMV pull‑notice, driver qualification files, medical certification tracking, and onboarding controls.

²  Plan, lead, and support internal and external transportation audits and inspections.

²  Interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical SOPs, controls, and field‑ready tools.

²  Lead initiatives to reduce preventable incidents, injuries, and claim severity across CDL and non‑CDL fleets.

²  Conduct transportation incident and collision investigations; perform root‑cause analysis and ensure timely corrective and preventive actions.

²  Partner with Risk Management, Insurance, and Legal on claim documentation, trends, and litigation support.

²  Serve as program owner for fleet telematics and safety technology platforms (e.g., Samsara, Geotab, Lytx or similar).

²  Develop and maintain driver scorecards, coaching workflows, compliance alerts, and trend analysis.

²  Produce monthly dashboards and executive summaries for the VP of Safety and leadership team.

²  Develop and deliver transportation safety training, refresher programs, and remedial coaching.

²  Equip field leaders with coaching tools and clear compliance expectations.

²  Perform field observations, yard reviews, and ride‑alongs as needed.

²  Create and maintain standardized SOPs, checklists, and documentation related to transportation compliance and fleet safety.

²  Lead cross‑functional corrective action plans with Operations, Fleet, HR, and Safety.

²  Support contractor and vendor transportation compliance expectations where applicable.

 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

²  Preventable incident frequency and severity trends

²  DOT/CHP audit readiness and outcomes

²  Driver coaching completion and improvement metrics

²  DMV pull‑notice and DQ file accuracy

²  Telematics utilization and leading indicator improvement

²  Timely investigation and corrective action closure

 

Qualifications:

²  5+ years of experience in transportation safety, DOT compliance, fleet risk, or safety roles within construction, utilities, logistics, or similar environments.

²  Demonstrated ownership of compliance programs and audits.

²  Strong incident investigation and corrective action leadership skills.

²  Strong analytical capability; working knowledge of Excel and fleet analytics platforms.

²  Experience supporting utility construction or heavy civil operations. (Preferred)

²  Familiarity with California fleet compliance standards and CHP interactions. (Preferred)

²  Experience with safety management systems and telematics‑driven coaching programs. (Preferred)

²  Safety or compliance certifications (CSP, ASP, CHST, accident investigation, etc.). (Preferred)

²  Bilingual Spanish a plus.

²  Reports directly to: VP of Safety

²  Works closely with: Operations, Fleet Maintenance, Risk/Insurance, HR, and Legal

²  Senior Individual Contributor (no direct reports)

²  Combination of office and field environment.

²  Regular visits to yards and jobsites across Southern California.

²  Occasional after‑hours support during serious incidents.

 

 

At Meruelo, we believe that diverse teams drive innovation and better business outcomes. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

job.description:
Join the Ownership Class.

Tired of the “agency grind” where your hard work only lines a CEO’s pockets? Here, you are a shareholder. Mid-West Family Marketing & Media

Full Time: South Haven Office

Are you driven to succeed? A strategic-thinking, competitive person with an interest in marketing? Mid-West Family Marketing & Media has a career opportunity for a self-starting, growth-minded, problem-solver dedicated to growing themselves, their client’s business, and their community as our next Account Executive.

As the dominant local media company & content producer in the region, we’ll empower you to leverage our top-rated media, successful brands, digital assets, influencers, marquee sports properties, and more to bring measurable results to area businesses and others. You’ll work directly with businesses, non-profits, and area leaders to build integrated marketing campaigns telling their story creatively, reaching audiences across radio, streaming, interactive websites and apps, and digital services.

In this position, you’ll earn a steady salary and commission for your hard work. There is huge room for growth, career advancement, and promotion. Full benefits, including vacation, health benefits 401k, and more. We celebrate individual and team successes with recognition and rewards. Do you see yourself as a marketer? Do you have an interest in media and sports marketing? Consider a career with the best. job.title: Advertising Sales Executive
job.description:
Job Type Full-time Description

 

Advertising Sales Executive


We connect businesses with people, and people with the things that matter.


Representing some of Fargo's most recognized radio brands:

KFGO-AM/FM, KOYY-FM (Y94), KNFL-AM/FM, KVOX-FM (FROGGY 99.9), KRWK-FM (JACK FM)

Strong local businesses help create even stronger communities. At Midwest Communications, our goal is to help Fargo area businesses reach new customers, strengthen their brands, and turn great ideas into results. As an Advertising Sales Executive, you’ll become a trusted marketing partner for businesses in your community. You’ll learn what a client is trying to accomplish, identify opportunities, and build marketing strategies using radio, digital, social media, promotions, and more. 


What You’ll Do:

  • Help local businesses become stronger and more successful- understand what they’re trying to accomplish and find ways to help them by using marketing strategies across radio, digital, social media, and promotions.
  • Create new opportunities for growth- conduct needs assessments and build relationships with businesses that could benefit from what Midwest Communications has to offer.
  • Build a presence by attending client meetings, networking events, and community functions. 
  • Turn marketing strategies into results- help clients connect with customers, increase awareness, drive traffic, generate leads, and grow their business.
  • Create your own success story- develop new business, grow existing partnerships, and build a book of clients you’re proud to represent.
  • Stay ahead of the market by tracking the latest trends, competitor offerings, and best industry practices. 

What We Offer:

  • A full-time position with an established and successful business.
  • Competitive draw pay with commission and benefits ($45,000-$60,000 based on experience). Start with a guaranteed draw pay while you build your business and client relationships, with additional earning potential through commission. 
    • Paid time off/holidays, health/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), flexible spending accounts, life insurance, and disability coverage. 
  • Professional development and sales training.
  • Performance based incentives/bonuses.
  • Opportunities to grow within Midwest Communications, Inc.

We’re Looking for Someone Who...

  • Has a bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field—or equivalent experience.
  • Has previous sales experience; advertising or media experience is a plus.
  • Understands sales activity, forecasting, and CRM software.
  • Is a strong communicator, negotiator, presenter, and problem-solver. 
  • Has a valid North Dakota driver’s license, reliable transportation, and a satisfactory background/motor vehicle check. 
  • Is self-motivated, goal-oriented, and capable of working independently.

The Midwest Communications, Inc Culture


At Midwest Communications, we’re invested in the longevity and success of our sales teams. You’ll join an established team of professional sales consultants who know how to build relationships, uncover opportunities, and create solutions that make an impact. You will also work alongside talented programming, promotions, digital, and production teams to create campaigns. 

As a privately owned, family-founded business, we expect our team members to take ownership of their work while also maintaining a laid-back, collaborative atmosphere. You’ll have the tools, resources, and support of an established media company but the autonomy to build relationships, develop your business, and make your mark in the local market.


Are you ready to make an impact in the radio industry? Apply now!

  • Work with creative, digital and sales colleagues to launch campaigns, review results and find ways to improve them.
  • Keep learning as audiences, platforms and marketing tools change.
  • Own your pipeline and work toward sales goals.

Who could thrive here

You might come from advertising sales—but you don’t have to. If you’ve built trust, won business or helped customers make decisions in another field, we want to hear from you. That could mean business development, hospitality, retail, real estate, recruiting or another relationship-driven role.

You’re curious about how businesses grow, comfortable starting conversations, organized enough to follow through and excited to turn a client’s challenge into a compelling idea. You can explain your thinking clearly and enjoy learning new tools. Experience selling connected TV or digital advertising is valuable, not required to start the conversation. Experience with traditional TV advertising is welcome, not required.

Why media? Why us?

Media keeps changing—and that’s part of the fun. You can pair the reach of an established local ABC brand that has partnerships with the Seattle Kraken and Seattle Mariners along with digital and streaming options, bring creative people into the conversation and help businesses show up where their customers are. It’s a career built on relationships, ideas and learning, with support to grow your media and digital sales skills.

Compensation and benefits

  • Posted compensation range: $45,000–$100,000 per year, including supplemental pay such as commission. Actual earnings vary; commissions are uncapped.
  • Monthly cell phone and gas allowances.
  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance.
  • Paid time off; sick, vacation, holidays and a 401(k) with company match.

Ready to make your mark in a field that’s never boring? Apply to be a Media Sales Executive with Apple Valley News Now and Phase 3 Digital. Tell us about the relationships you’ve built, the goals you’ve helped others reach or the new skills you’re eager to learn—even if your career so far hasn’t been in media.

Apple Valley News Now is an equal opportunity employer.

APPLE VALLEY NEWS NOW IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

job.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
job.description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR)

KXLY Brands | Spokane, WA

Help Local Businesses Grow. Build Connections. Create Opportunities.

KXLY Brands is looking for a motivated, outgoing, and results-driven Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our Spokane sales team.

We connect local businesses with powerful advertising and marketing solutions across television, radio, digital, and streaming platforms. We’re looking for someone who enjoys researching businesses, making connections, starting conversations, and opening doors for our sales professionals.

This is a prospecting and appointment-setting position, ideal for someone who is naturally curious, confident on the phone, highly organized, and energized by achieving measurable goals.

What You’ll Do

Research & Identify Prospects: Find and qualify Spokane-area businesses that could benefit from our advertising and marketing solutions.

Outbound Prospecting: Proactively contact potential clients through phone calls, personalized emails, and other outreach strategies.

Set Qualified Appointments: Generate meaningful, well-qualified sales meetings for our Account Executives with local business owners, decision-makers, and marketing leaders.

Manage HubSpot CRM: Maintain accurate prospect records, document outreach activities, track follow-ups, and manage prospecting pipelines in HubSpot.

Build Prospect Lists: Research industries, business categories, and growth opportunities to develop targeted lists of potential advertisers.

Communicate Our Value: Introduce KXLY Brands’ television, radio, digital, and streaming advertising solutions and create interest in learning more.

Follow Up Consistently: Develop and execute organized follow-up strategies to turn initial conversations into scheduled appointments.

Collaborate with Sales: Work closely with Account Executives and sales leadership to identify priority accounts, coordinate meetings, and support new business development.

Meet Performance Goals: Achieve established targets for prospecting activity, qualified appointments, and sales opportunities generated.

What We’re Looking For

The right personality and work ethic matter as much as experience.

Our ideal candidate is:

Confident & Outgoing: Comfortable picking up the phone, introducing themselves, and speaking with business decision-makers.

Persistent & Resilient: Understands that rejection is part of prospecting and doesn’t get discouraged by hearing “no.”

Self-Motivated: Takes initiative, manages time effectively, and doesn’t need constant direction.

Naturally Curious: Enjoys learning about local businesses, industries, and what drives their success.

Organized & Detail-Oriented: Can manage multiple prospects, follow-up schedules, and CRM records without letting opportunities slip through the cracks.

Goal-Oriented & Competitive: Motivated by measurable results and takes pride in exceeding expectations.

An Excellent Communicator: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to create interest quickly and professionally.

Coachable: Welcomes feedback, learns quickly, and continually works to improve.

Tech-Savvy: Comfortable using CRM systems, online research tools, email, and productivity software.

Accountable: Takes ownership of commitments, activity levels, and results.

Positive & Energetic: Brings enthusiasm, professionalism, and a team-first attitude to work every day.

Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience in sales development, appointment setting, outbound calling, lead generation, or customer service.

Familiarity with HubSpot or similar CRM platforms.

Strong online research and prospecting skills.

Ability to write effective, personalized prospecting emails.

Interest in advertising, media, digital marketing, and the Spokane business community.

Experience working toward activity and appointment-setting goals.

Previous media sales experience is not required. We’re willing to train the right person who brings initiative, strong communication skills, and a desire to succeed.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means consistently identifying new business opportunities, building a healthy prospect pipeline, maintaining accurate HubSpot records, and scheduling qualified appointments that help our sales team grow revenue.

This position is about more than making calls. It’s about creating meaningful business opportunities and helping connect Spokane businesses with marketing solutions that deliver results.

What you’ll get in return:

You’ll get a supportive work environment with co-workers and managers who value your work, your time, and your perspective. We are committed to maintaining a culture where employees can flourish and grow, professionally and personally. We offer extensive training, and you get to work alongside some of the most talented colleagues in the broadcast industry, at all levels of their career, who are passionate about what they do it and why they do it.

Pay range: $50k-$65k ($50k salary plus incentives on performance)

Benefits: We offer employees and their families medical, dental, vision, prescription, life insurance, and Employee Assistance Program benefits. Employees are also offered long-term disability insurance, flexible spending account, 401(k), health savings account, employee referral program, and paid time off including 80 hours of vacation following 1 year of service, 1 hour of sick time for every 40 hours worked, 2 personal days and 9 paid holidays.

Why KXLY Brands?

KXLY Brands brings together some of the Inland Northwest’s most recognized television, radio, and digital media platforms. Our team helps businesses reach local consumers, build their brands, and grow.

You’ll work alongside experienced media and marketing professionals, develop valuable business development skills, and play an important role in the growth of our organization.

If you’re a motivated self-starter who loves connecting with people, enjoys a challenge, and gets satisfaction from turning conversations into opportunities, we’d love to hear from you.

What’s next? Apply online and include your resume.

KXLY Brands / Morgan Murphy Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer

job.title: Weekend Anchor / Senior MMJ
job.description:
WKBT News 8 Now, the CBS affiliate in La Crosse, Wisconsin (DMA 129) is looking for an experienced Weekend Anchor/Senior MMJ who is ready to take the next step in their career. If you are a strong and engaged communicator who wants to cover the stories that matter from the field as well as the anchor desk, this is the opportunity for you. 


Here's what our ideal candidate needs to know: 

  • WKBT is the type of station where you can share your passion with other like-minded storytellers, advance your career, and make an immediate contribution. 
  • We will provide you with the opportunity to grow as a storyteller, do great live shots, and lead in the digital landscape.  
  • You may be tapped to serve as fill-in anchor for other shows as needed. 
  • We provide regular, constructive feedback from an experienced team and an outside storytelling coach. 
  • You'll need a passion to look beyond an event or press release to provide context to the stories you're assigned. 
  • You will have the opportunity to work with a photographer on a regular basis and will not do your own live shots. 
  • We love innovation when it comes to workflow, content, and training, and we want to hear your ideas. 

Qualifications/Requirements: 

  • Two years of anchoring/live reporting experience, preferred. 
  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism or related field. 
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including excellent news writing and visual storytelling. 
  • Familiarity with digital video cameras, non-linear editing, and social media platforms. 
  • Demonstrated proficiency with social media platforms and audiences. 
  • Willingness to work evenings, weekends, and holidays if needed. 
  • Ability to lift 30 lbs. of gear and to sit, walk, or stand for long periods of time. 
  • Valid Driver's License and good driving record. 

 

Morgan Murphy Media is a progressive and family-owned business that places our highest values on our employees, the workplace culture, and the communities we serve. WKBT is the CBS affiliate proudly serving western Wisconsin, southeastern Minnesota, and northeast Iowa. In addition to offering an array of traditional broadcast channels and award-winning newscasts, we are at the forefront of the digital and on-demand landscape locally through our website and news, weather, and streaming apps.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate and support diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our employees and our communities.

job.title: Account Services Representative
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

As an Account Services Representative, you are responsible for maintaining all aspects of account management while providing timely and accurate information to the sales team and to the client. This involves working with multiple departments such as Advertising Sales, Inventory, Strategic Planning, Commercial Operations, Finance and Billing.

Duties and Responsibilities

Client Service:

  • Responsible for maintaining and monitoring all upfront and scatter deals in order management system
  • Develop strong understanding of our products and capabilities to better develop solutions for advertisers
  • Serve as the first line of contact with internal and external entities to ensure proper maintenance of advertisers’ schedules
  • Support and enhance agency relationships by monitoring requests and ensuring commercial spots are booked according to guidelines

Deal Maintenance and Stewardship:

  • Schedule commercials and coordinate client brand allocations, reconcile account discrepancies, send flowcharts and issue change notices to clients
  • Steward deals through careful monitoring of delivery
  • Offer recap packages to clients as needed and as available
  • Develop a strong working relationship with Commercial Operations guaranteeing a timely and precise order process
  • Collaborate with Sales Planner, Account Executive and Marketing to ensure that all marketing elements are properly booked and executed
  • Identification and resolution of invoice discrepancies and adjustments
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Must be able to work out of the offices in a hybrid capacity. Monday- Thursday onsite; Friday remote with the flexibility to adjust as business needs dictate.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States now and in the future
  • Must be 18 years or older
  • Must be willing and able to work overtime, as needed

Desired Characteristics:

  • Client Service and/or Account Management experience a plus.
  • Must have strong communication/interpersonal skills, be able to multi-task in a fast paced environment, be detail oriented and responsive, deadline driven and have strong quantitative reasoning skills.
  • Computer Skills – Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and Outlook)

Additional Requirements:

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $55,000 - $58,000; overtime eligible

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Your future in media starts here. The NBCUniversal Summer Internship Program is your chance to help shape what’s next in media and entertainment. Whether you’re supporting major news coverage, creating content for iconic brands, or contributing to innovative projects, you’ll bring your ideas, creativity, and perspective to make an impact throughout your internship.

Beyond your day-to-day role, you’ll take part in a thoughtfully designed program focused on career development, building your professional presence, and growing your workplace confidence. Through real-world experience and a community of fellow interns, you’ll explore what’s possible in this ever changing and exciting industry.

In addition to all of our internships being paid, we will also offer the following for our Summer 2027 interns:

· Paid company holidays for full-time interns.

· Robust networking, learning and development opportunities.

· Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship.

· Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship.

· Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions.

· Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer.

· At NBC Sports Headquarters in Stamford, CT, you’ll have access to great perks and amenities including free shuttle service to/from the Metro North Stamford train station and the office, as well as discounted admission to Chelsea Piers Athletic Club.

Summer 2027 Program Details

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need.

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from Stamford, CT.

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers

To Apply:

· Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.

· Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).

· Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program.

NBCUniversal Advertising & Partnerships brings together the power of NBCUniversal’s iconic brands, premium content, innovative technology, and expansive audiences to create meaningful connections between advertisers and consumers. From entertainment and sports to streaming and digital platforms, our teams work across sales, marketing, insights, data, technology, and creative solutions to develop impactful advertising experiences for brands and partners.

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

· Ad Sales Golf Development: The Golf Partnership Initiatives team develops and manages advertiser sponsorship integrations across NBC, Peacock, and Golf Channel programming. Interns may support creative sponsorship development, sales materials, business research, brand-integration fulfillment, production documentation, and campaign recaps.

Basic Requirements:

· Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program.

· Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).

· Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

· Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.

· Must be willing to work in Stamford, CT.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.

Desired Characteristics:

· Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.

· Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.

· Strong interest in sports, advertising, marketing, sponsorships, or media.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills.

· Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel.

· Strong research and organizational skills with attention to detail.

· Interest in developing creative brand partnerships and sponsorship opportunities within sports media.

The hourly rate for student interns is $19.00.

We’re looking for a Design Engineer I who thrives at the intersection of interaction design, front-end engineering, and emerging technologies. You are passionate about collaborating on early-stage ideas and bringing them to life as real, tangible, high-fidelity prototypes, proofs-of-concept, and internal tools that help teams learn faster, make better decisions, and automate manual tasks.

In terms of core skill set, you look like a front-end engineer, but you think like a designer. You bring a strong visual and interaction sensibility, paired with pragmatic engineering judgment. You bias toward speed, clarity, and craft, while maintaining a deep respect for usability, performance, and maintainability. You’re eager to learn from senior teammates, building your ability to work independently, and proactively identifying opportunities where prototyping, tooling, or automation can unlock new possibilities.

You’re also excited about how AI is reshaping design and product workflows. You don’t just use AI tools—you experiment with them, integrate them into prototypes and pipelines, and explore how generative and assistive AI can meaningfully improve user experiences, internal workflows, and design quality.

You’ll be joining a small but mighty Design Engineering team within the Viewing Experience, Product and Design organization at Peacock. Our mission is to bring ideas to life and power innovation. Your primary focus will be helping build high-impact prototypes that explore new features and experiences across the Peacock ecosystem, while also contributing to design tools, Figma plugins, and AI-powered utilities that help our teams work faster, smarter, and with greater confidence. You’ll work on specific features and components, with guidance and support from senior members of the team.
