  • Translate abstract ideas and early concepts into interactive, high-fidelity prototypes for specific features and components across web, mobile, and TV platforms
  • Help design and build internal tools, utilities, and Figma plugins that improve design quality, consistency, speed, and scalability
  • Explore and apply AI-driven approaches to design, prototyping, automation, content exploration, and workflow optimization
  • Integrate live or simulated data into prototypes by building or consuming APIs
  • Improve and evolve initial design concepts through iterative prototyping and feedback
  • Contribute to shared toolkits, frameworks, and codebases that accelerate prototyping across the team
  • Contribute technical and creative ideas to projects, including experimenting with new frameworks, tools, or approaches with guidance from senior team members
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging interaction patterns, and new technologies, and proactively apply them where they create leverage
  • Continuously look for opportunities to improve how the team prototypes, experiments, and collaborates
  • Regularly present and demo work to the immediate team, seeking feedback and flagging issues early as you grow your craft
  • 1+ years of relevant professional experience in design engineering, front-end engineering, or a related hybrid role
  • Degree in Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Design, or equivalent practical experience
  • Portfolio of relevant work and code samples demonstrating strong interaction design sensibility, technical execution, and polished final outcomes
  • Working proficiency in HTML, CSS, modern JavaScript, and React
  • Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Augment, Cursor, etc.) to assist with coding and design-related tasks
  • Working knowledge of design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong eye for visual detail and a foundational understanding of interaction design principles, user experience best practices, and modern design workflows
  • Some experience contributing to software projects in a team environment, including peer code reviews, version control, and shared coding standards
  • Familiarity with building and/or consuming APIs and working with live or structured data

NBC News Digital is looking for an associate editor to join its platforms team, working nights and weekends. The editor will curate content from all newsroom sections, including breaking news, politics, business, sports, and lifestyle. ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) will be responsible for advancing software quality across the Post Production Automation platform through a combination of manual validation, test automation, performance testing, and quality engineering practices. The role will partner closely with Development, DevOps, Architecture, and operational teams to improve test coverage, shorten feedback loops, and establish repeatable quality practices throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, integration, performance, and regression tests for the Post Production Automation platform.
  • Develop and maintain reusable test frameworks, fixtures, utilities, test data, and automation standards to support scalable testing.
  • Create and maintain test cases for critical user workflows, including functional, negative, regression, integration, and edge-case scenarios.
  • Partner with Development and DevOps to identify high-value manual validation scenarios and convert appropriate scenarios into repeatable automated tests.
  • Partner with Development early in the delivery lifecycle to review requirements and acceptance criteria for testability, completeness, business risk, adjacent workflow impact, and potential defects.
  • Perform exploratory and manual testing when automation is not appropriate or additional investigation is required.
  • Troubleshoot test failures and application issues to distinguish between software defects, automation defects, test data issues, and environment-related failures.
  • Support root cause analysis for significant defects and production issues and develop regression coverage to help prevent recurrence.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and establish practical quality gates for software delivery.
  • Develop and maintain test reporting, dashboards, and quality metrics that provide visibility into test results, coverage, defects, and application quality.
  • Ability to provide off-hours operational support, including nightly deployments and incident response.
  • Collaborate with DevOps on release readiness, deployment validation, and production issues requiring additional test coverage or defect reproduction.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve test reliability, execution time, automation coverage, and overall quality engineering practices.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 3+ years of experience in hybrid QA, SDET, Software Quality Engineering, or similar roles combining manual testing and test automation.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience with test management tools such as QMetry, TestRail, or similar platforms.
  • Strong experience designing and maintaining automated UI, API, integration, regression, and performance test suites.
  • Experience with modern test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with REST API and performance testing, including analysis of application behavior under load.
  • Experience creating and maintaining reusable test cases, test data, fixtures, and regression coverage for business-critical workflows.
  • Strong systems-level troubleshooting and debugging skills, with the ability to trace failures across UI, API, application services, test automation, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated critical-thinking skills and the ability to analyze complex problems, identify risk, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Experience performing root cause analysis and converting production defects into preventative regression coverage.
  • Experience with source control management, preferably Git.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and software build and deployment processes.
  • Ability to read and understand application code, logs, API responses, and system behavior to support defect investigation.
  • Strong cross-team collaboration skills with experience working across Development, DevOps, Architecture, Product, and operational teams.
  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or similar iterative software development environments.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with Production Asset Management and Media Asset Management systems.
  • Experience mentoring developers on unit testing, testability, and quality-engineering practices.
  • Experience testing applications deployed across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, or similar infrastructure and deployment technologies.
  • Experience testing complex integrations, asynchronous workflows, file movement, databases, messaging, and distributed application components.
  • Familiarity with observability tools, logging, monitoring, dashboards, and test reporting platforms.
  • Ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.
  • Ability to adapt to changing requirements, priorities, release schedules, and production needs.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build effective relationships across technical and operational teams

Additional Requirements: 

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

NBCUniversal’s Cyber Threat Operations team is responsible for providing cyber threat intelligence, event monitoring, response, and threat hunting for all areas of NBCUniversal in a highly collaborative, fast paced, and agile fashion. As a member of the Cyber Response team, a candidate can expect to utilize their technical expertise to assess, contain, and remediate cyber threats. The Sr Incident Responder is also an escalation point for security alerts from the security event analysts, and a candidate would be expected to mentor and share knowledge with others in the organization.

The ideal candidate would have a working knowledge of current and relevant security technologies and how to apply them to cyber incident response actions. A clear investigative methodology with a focus on preserving evidence and analyzing data to form conclusions that will steer response directions. Experience responding to multi-faceted security events and incidents and assisting with the coordination of subsequent response efforts prioritizing mission critical elements.

The role involves regular interaction with various groups and leadership within the organization to accomplish job responsibilities. Working closely with the Cyber Response Manager the Incident Responder will manage workflows, escalations, and advance technical processes to build program maturity and growth. The successful candidate will be responsible for participating in the following activities:

• Responsible for day-to-day operational tasks related to the ongoing support of Threat Operations.

• Forensically analyzing escalated security incidents from the SOC and conducting response actions following NIST and SANS Incident Response Frameworks.

• Provide direction on appropriate containment and remediation strategies, and implement controls

• Oversee and triage ticket queues focusing on prioritization based on risk and potential impact, and escalations.

• Responsible for analyzing threat data from multiple sources and identifying security incidents and events of importance for direct escalation to Incident Commander(s).

• Perform root cause and forensic log analysis for security incidents to determine enterprise risk, impact, and effective remediations needed across multiple technology platforms (Cloud, Hosts, Networks, Applications, Email)

• Mitigate risk by taking appropriate containment response actions on multiple platforms, or in some cases Handoffs to partner teams

• Provide detailed timeline analysis to showcase evidence-based conclusions on entry vectors, lateral movement, and campaign correlation

• Identify, articulate, and explain attack vectors, threat tactics, and attacker techniques to technical and non-technical stakeholders including senior leadership

• Collaborate with internal teams, external partners, and vendors to resolve active Cyber Incidents

• Keep detailed notes on all analysis activity, documented in the case management tool to validate process adherence.

• Contribute to the strategic creation and updating of new and existing SOAR playbooks, automations, and response process documentation.

• Provide On-Call support for escalated events for 1 week on a rotation with other Incident Responders

• Work alongside Incident Commanders and Incident Handlers to analyze, contain, and remediate named incidents

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree/Masters Degree in an IT related field and/or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years working in Cyber Defense with experience in Incident Response, Security Operations Center (SOC), detection engineering, or similar functions.
  • Previous experience supporting or leading incident response functions.
  • Experience using industry-standard security toolsets in a layered defense model
  • Working knowledge of core Enterprise IT concepts (web application architectures, networking, etc.)
  • Experience with host-based and network-based forensics tools and analysis
  • Knowledge of the cyber threat landscape to include different types of adversaries, campaigns, and the motivations that drive them
  • Knowledge of industry recognized security and analysis frameworks (Mitre ATT&CK, Kill Chain, Diamond Model, NIST Incident Response, etc.)
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Strong communication (both verbal and written) and client intimacy skills with experience briefing corporate executives and professionals
  • Ability to be on call and provide support during nontraditional working hours

Desired Characteristics:

  • Hands on experience working with Incident Response and Threat Monitoring SOC functions
  • Previous experience providing incident response/SOC support for Fortune 1000 companies
  • Previous experience with various endpoint detection and response (EDR) technologies
  • Previous experience working with various Forensics technologies to include EnCase, FTK, etc.
  • Incorporates the word “Peacock” into resume and/or job application
  • Previous experience working with network tools and technologies such as firewall (FW), proxies, IPS/IDS devices, full packet capture (FPC), and email platforms
  • Previous experience conducting static, dynamic, or reverse engineering malware analysis
  • Experience in applying security concepts to Cloud com

Additional Requirements: 

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

NBC News is seeking a versatile and experienced journalist to cover polling, elections and other political data, including demographic shifts.

In this role, you will work closely with the director of elections, the Decision Desk team, NBC News’ chief data analyst and the Digital Politics team. Your primary mission is to use data to surface smart, original insights into how Americans are thinking and feeling about their elected officials and the issues that affect their lives and shape their votes — and to help explain what happens on pivotal election nights across multiple digital and linear platforms, including newsletter formats.   

You might have a formal political scientist background. You might be a reporter with an aptitude for statistics. Either way, you must have a track record of authoring thoughtful, nonpartisan, fact-based analysis of public opinion surveys and vote data for a news organization. You must also be a sharp writer, with a knack for translating complex matters to a broad audience. 

Ideally, you have the ability to zoom in on significant data points while capturing larger themes and trends to tell us why what you’re seeing matters. You have experience authoring and explaining methodologies. You have strong knowledge of election procedures, statistical data sets, and geographical and demographic considerations, and some experience or familiarity with standard visualization and data tools. 

You should hate to be beat by the competition when it comes to smart angles. You should also take direction well and be able to execute on the ideas of others. Above all, you are collaborative and eager to work with NBC News colleagues across the organization as we build on our best-in-class election data operation.

This job is based in New York, and will involve being comfortable reporting across NBC News’ many platforms. Your work will help anchor our new subscription service, including but not limited to contributing to newsletters, live chats, and other audience engagement opportunities. The role will report to the director of data and election experiences. 

Responsiblities

  • At our Universal City office interns will have access to the NBCUCommutes program, which provides fully subsidized transit passes to full-time lower lot employees, good for unlimited rides on all Metro bus and rail, such as the Metro Red Line.

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027 

Time Commitment: 32-40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need.  

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from Universal City, CA. 

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline 

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)   

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews    

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews   

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.

Universal Pictures is a division of Universal Filmed Entertainment Group, within NBCUniversal, one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. For more than a century, the Studio has helped to redefine global popular culture, ensuring that audiences have access to stories by artists who look like them, who see them, and who celebrate them. Universal’s deep library includes many of the world’s most beloved films and homegrown franchises, including Jaws, Back to the Future, Bourne, Jurassic World, Fast & Furious, Mamma Mia!, Fifty Shades of Grey, Jordan Peele’s Get Out and Nope, Blumhouse’s The Purge franchise and M3GAN, Christopher Nolan’s Academy Award®-winning Oppenheimer, as well as animated blockbusters from Illumination and DreamWorks Animation.

  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States. 
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027. 
  • Must be willing to work in Universal City, CA.  

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.  

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.   

Desired Characteristics:

  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above. 
  • Experience with JavaScript, Python, Node.js. 
  • Experience with machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g. TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.)  
  • Experience with GenAI platforms and ComfyUI.

The Director, Food Services will lead the strategy, operations, vendor partnerships, and employee experience for food service offerings across NBCUniversal’s New York campus, with a primary focus on 30 Rockefeller Plaza. This role sits within the Hospitality team and will be responsible for elevating the quality, consistency, efficiency, and financial performance of food service operations, including cafés, catering, pantry programs, executive dining, employee dining, and special event support.  The Director will report to the VP of Guest Experience. 

The ideal candidate is a strategic hospitality leader with deep food and beverage operations expertise, strong vendor management skills, and a passion for creating high-quality, service-oriented workplace experiences. This individual will partner closely with Guest Experience, Facilities, Business Operations, Finance, Procurement, Sustainability, and key business stakeholders to deliver food services that meet the needs of employees, productions, executives, visitors, and events while supporting broader Rock Center Operations priorities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead day-to-day oversight and long-term strategy for food services across the campus, including cafés, catering, pantry services, executive dining, employee dining, special events, and related hospitality offerings.
  • Establish and maintain high standards for food quality, service consistency, cleanliness, safety, accessibility, and employee experience across all food service touchpoints.
  • Manage and strengthen relationships with food service vendors, catering partners, pantry providers, and other third-party suppliers; hold partners accountable to service levels, contractual obligations, budget expectations, and continuous improvement goals.
  • Develop and execute a food services roadmap that improves quality, expands offerings, enhances the employee and guest experience, and supports evolving workplace expectations.
  • Partner with Hospitality, Guest Experience, Facilities, Events, Production, Retail, Finance, Procurement, Legal, EHS, Security, and Sustainability teams to ensure seamless planning and execution of daily operations, activations, and special events.
  • Oversee food service budgets, forecasts, invoices, P&L performance, vendor spend, and operating metrics; identify opportunities to improve efficiency, cost management, utilization, and revenue performance.
  • Use data, employee feedback, utilization trends, and stakeholder insights to evaluate program performance and recommend service enhancements.
  • Support large-scale events, executive meetings, production needs, and high-visibility activations requiring food and beverage services, ensuring polished execution and alignment with business expectations.
  • Drive operational standards related to food safety, sanitation, regulatory compliance, allergen awareness, sustainability, waste reduction, and responsible sourcing.
  • Develop clear operating procedures, escalation practices, reporting rhythms, and communication plans for food service operations.
  • Lead, coach, and develop internal team members and vendor teams, fostering a culture of accountability, hospitality, collaboration, inclusion, and service excellence.
  • Monitor industry trends and workplace hospitality best practices to introduce innovative, practical, and employee-centered food service solutions.

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in food service, hospitality operations, workplace services, corporate dining, catering, hotel operations, restaurant operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience leading teams, vendors, or complex cross-functional operations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing vendor relationships, service-level expectations, budgets, operating metrics, and business reviews.
  • Strong knowledge of food and beverage operations, catering logistics, workplace hospitality, food safety standards, and customer service best practices.
  • Experience working with executives, senior leaders, cross-functional business partners, and high-touch client groups.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and PowerPoint, and comfort using data to inform operational decisions.

Desired Characteristics

  • Strategic, service-oriented leader with a strong hospitality mindset and passion for creating excellent employee and guest experiences.
  • Strong financial acumen, including experience with forecasting, budgeting, P&L management, contract oversight, and cost optimization.
  • Proven ability to influence vendors and internal partners while balancing quality, cost, speed, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage employees and executives with professionalism and polish.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, time-sensitive requests, and high-visibility events in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative problem solver who can anticipate needs, resolve issues quickly, and maintain composure under pressure.
  • Knowledge of sustainability practices in food service, including waste reduction, responsible sourcing, reusable service ware, and operational efficiency.
  • Prior experience in media, entertainment, corporate campus environments, high-volume hospitality operations, or premium guest service settings is a plus.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

JOB TITLE

Director, Government and Regulatory Affairs, Latin America

Location

Miami (hybrid, four-day office attendance)

Department

Government and Regulatory Affairs

Reports to

Head of Government and Regulatory Affairs, NBCUniversal International

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Director, Government and Regulatory Affairs is responsible for:

  • leading the company’s engagement with the governments in Latin America, politicians, regulators, industry bodies and market stakeholders on issues affecting the film and television production and distribution business. The role will shape and advance the company’s Latin American public policy and regulatory strategy, ensuring a stable, competitive, and sustainable environment for investment, content creation and distribution;
  • developing and advancing the company’s government affairs strategies for the region to address key areas of importance for NBCUniversal’s Latin American businesses and to ensure a favourable, competitive and sustainable environment for the business; and
  • developing and maintaining strong working relationships with regional governments in priority territories and other political and industry stakeholders.

Current priority countries in the region for NBCUniversal are Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile and Peru.

The Director will work as a key member of NBCUniversal’s International Government and Regulatory Affairs team and will need to liaise, coordinate and work closely with NBCUniversal’s government affairs team members responsible for the UK, Brussels, Continental Europe, Canada and Asia-Pacific.   

The Director will be responsible for managing NBCUniversal’s relationship with its external government affairs consultants in the region, and providing instructions on NBCUniversal project work, securing and developing their advice and overseeing their work for the company.

The Director will also be responsible for providing instructions to and managing our relationships on regional government affairs matters with our key trade associations – the Motion Pictures Association and AVIA.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Director, Government and Regulatory Affairs will be responsible for driving NBCUniversal’s government affairs and regulatory work in the Latin America region. The role will both formulate and implement NBCUniversal’s agreed strategy in line with targeted international priorities.

Government affairs matters covered will include those that are particular to NBCUniversal’s business as a media company and IP owner. These will include copyright, copyright ownership, AI and content protection, broadcasting, streaming and media regulation, consumer protection, market access for distribution of our content and the delivery of public subsidies and tax incentives for content production for our international film and television production businesses.

Matters covered will also include government affairs matters that are relevant to all US-owned companies conducting business in the Latin American region, such as data privacy, sustainability, employment law and sanctions laws.

The Director will:

  • Be responsible for leading NBCUniversal’s government affairs initiatives in Latin America in close collaboration with NBCUniversal’s business leaders and corporate functions;
  • Develop and implement prioritised and strategic objectives and action plans to support our business and government affairs priorities and coordinate closely with NBCUniversal’s International and US-based government and regulatory affairs team members;
  • Represent NBCUniversal’s agreed policy interests in priority countries in the region with government and other political stakeholders, regulators and other relevant bodies;
  • Work with external consultancies in developing and implementing NBCUniversal’s advocacy priorities in the region, both directly as NBCUniversal but also by working with, and through, third parties, trade associations and coalitions of like-minded entities; and
  • Develop and maintain strong and effective working relationships with political and regulatory stakeholders and present to them the best of NBCUniversal’s business and business investments in the region, including through screenings and set and other visits.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Essential

  • Experience in Latin American regional government affairs, regulatory affairs, public policy, or a related field, ideally within media, entertainment, technology, or another regulated sector.
  • Strong understanding of the legislative and regulatory landscape in key countries in the region for media businesses, including the role of independent regulators.
  • Proven experience engaging effectively with political stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distil complex regulatory and policy issues for senior business audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate strategically and independently in a fast-moving environment.
  • Fluent English and Spanish.

Desirable

  • Direct experience working on film, television, broadcasting, or digital media regulation.
  • Existing relationships with key policymakers, regulators, and industry stakeholders.
  • Experience contributing to or leading regulatory or industry-wide advocacy initiatives.
  • Familiarity with international regulatory and policy frameworks affecting content creation, copyright ownership and distribution.
  • Portuguese language skills.

Personal Attributes

  • Team player
  • Strong communicator and networker
  • Politically and regulatorily astute
  • Fast learner, strategic, analytical, and solutions-oriented
  • Collaborative and relationship-driven
  • Confident, credible, and persuasive at senior levels
  • High integrity and sound judgement

job.description:

    • Champion a culture of user-centered design and iterative improvement.

    • Partner with technical leadership to validate feasibility of requirements.

  • Experience working with Jira or other similar project tracking software
  • Background in user research methodologies and synthesizing insights into product strategy
  • Experience working with internal customers or enterprise users, ideally in a creative industry
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools
  • Awareness of UX design principles and best practices
  • Familiarity with Figma or similar collaborative design workflows
  • Experience with React, Vue, or other  similar component-based technologies
  • Production experience in computer animation, visual effects, or game industry

The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.

The Core Video iOS team is looking for an exceptional Engineering Manager to grow and develop our international talent base into a first-class team of engineers. Join us as we redefine the future of streaming video technology for the iOS and tvOS platforms. Together, we will shape our culture, solve technical problems, and create extraordinary streaming experiences that captivate audiences worldwide.

Essential Functions (Responsibilities):

  • Own the public playback API for iOS and tvOS, including session lifecycle, configuration, player events, and the error model, and manage the relationship with the client applications that depend on it.
  • Own SDK release mechanics, including versioning, deprecation windows, and migration guidance for client applications.
  • Uphold playback KPI targets for startup time, rebuffering, seek behavior, and fatal-error recovery on iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV across supported OS versions.
  • Direct the design of adaptive bitrate, buffering, live and on-demand playback, content protection, and ad insertion inside the SDK.
  • Decide where playback stays on AVFoundation and where the stack needs custom work for threading, main-thread safety, memory, and thermal limits.
  • Use production playback telemetry, including startup, rebuffering, error rate, and device-specific failures, to prioritize engineering work and to lead technical triage on playback incidents.
  • Define the playback library's test strategy, including automated golden scenarios, content-protection and ads edge cases, and device-level regression on iOS and tvOS.
  • Represent iOS and tvOS constraints in wider architecture decisions, including FairPlay, AVPlayer behavior, and Apple TV input and display limits.
  • Apply AI in solution design, code review, and production investigation, and keep the team accountable for the public API and for what ships.
  • Mentor and coach team members.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across the organization to gather requirements, understand user needs, and provide technical direction.
  • Strive to constantly improve the overall quality through code reviews, tech talks, pair programming and other collaborative practices.
  • Understand business needs and design valuable software solutions that work well within the wider architecture.
  • Proactively estimate efforts and identify any potential risks.
  • Manage team roadmap and capacity.
  • Push technical boundaries while also recommending new processes and technologies.
  • Help foster an environment of inclusiveness
  • 4 years of leading an engineering team with prior senior-level experience in iOS SDK development
  • Must have an enthusiasm for building an iOS library that handles all aspects of video playback.
  • Value collaboration with teammates and stakeholders.
  • Understanding deadlines, constraints and scope of delivery and experience working with stakeholders to ensure the right balance between these are met, setting expectations and handling risks early.
  • Being an analytic problem solver with a strong sense of autonomy, and with an open collaborative approach to getting the job done.
  • Interest in cultivating a strong team culture where engineers of diverse backgrounds can grow.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $140,000 - $200,000 (bonus and long-term incentive eligible)

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.

We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead the multidisciplinary team responsible for NBCUniversal’s cloud-native VOD encoding platform and associated media engineering capabilities. This leader will own engineering execution, technical direction, production reliability, and team development across software and media engineering. The role will bring together platform development, codec and quality innovation, and operational excellence to deliver secure, scalable, cost-efficient media-processing capabilities for Peacock and other NBCUniversal streaming services.

What the VOD team does

  • Builds and operates the end-to-end media processing platform powering Peacock and other NBCUniversal streaming services.
  • Develops cloud-native systems for ingest, encoding, packaging, quality validation, and delivery.
  • Advances video, audio, subtitle, caption, and packaging technologies.
  • Researches emerging codecs, HDR formats, AI-assisted workflows, and media innovations.
  • Partners with Product, Operations, Playback, and Media Supply Chain teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow a multidisciplinary team of software and media engineers.
  • Own execution of the media processing platform roadmap, translating strategic priorities into clearly scoped initiatives, measurable outcomes, and predictable delivery across software and media engineering workstreams.
  • Provide technical direction and architecture oversight for scalable, resilient, cloud-native media-processing services, while empowering senior engineers to lead design and implementation.
  • Define and evolve engineering standards for architecture, API design, code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, release management, observability, documentation, and production readiness.
  • Establish and maintain service-level objectives, operational metrics, alerting, incident-response practices, capacity planning, and continuous-improvement mechanisms for production media services.
  • Drive adoption of new codecs, HDR formats, packaging standards, and AI-assisted media processing.
  • Mentor engineers through coaching, career development, hiring, and performance management.
  • Foster experimentation through proof-of-concepts, benchmarking, and data-driven engineering decisions.
  • 3+ years of experience managing or formally leading software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and delivery accountability.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate software architecture, APIs, distributed-system designs, operational data, and technical trade-offs; recent hands-on development experience with languages such as Go, Python, or Java is preferred.
  • Experience leading iterative software delivery, dependency management, roadmap planning, and prioritization across multiple technical workstreams.
  • Experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms.
  • Strong understanding of video compression, adaptive bitrate streaming, HLS, DASH, CMAF, and DRM.
  • Experience with FFmpeg or equivalent media frameworks.
  • Understanding of video quality analysis (VMAF, SSIM, PSNR and subjective evaluation).
  • Knowledge of video codecs (H.264, HEVC, AV1, VVC), HDR formats (HDR10, Dolby Vision, HLG), audio codecs (AAC, HE-AAC, Dolby Digital Plus), and subtitle/caption technologies (WebVTT, TTML, IMSC1, CEA-608/708).
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
  • GPU-accelerated media processing.
  • AI/ML or computer vision for media workflows.
  • Encoding optimization and bitrate reduction.
  • Cloud migration and platform modernization.
  • Open-source or media standards contributions.

Leadership Expectations

  • Build an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture.
  • Recruit, mentor, and retain top engineering talent.
  • Drive engineering excellence through metrics and continuous improvement.
  • Promote collaboration across engineering, product, and operations.
  • Encourage innovation while maintaining operational excellence.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $125,000 - $160,000. (bonus and long-term incentive eligible)

ABOUT UNIVERSAL GLOBAL TELEVISION (UGT)

Universal Global Television (UGT), a division of Universal Studio Group, partners with visionary storytellers across the globe to deliver bold, distinctive shows with universal resonance. Led by President Beatrice Springborn, UGT’s portfolio brings together award-winning production companies Carnival Films, Heyday Television, and Working Title Television alongside leading creators including Seth MacFarlane, Patrick Macmanus, Nick Antosca and Rachel Shukert.

Headquartered in London and Los Angeles, the studio currently produces 27 series across 14 platforms, including local linear powerhouses such as BBC (UK), ABC (Australia), CBC (Canada) and streamers Peacock, Netflix, Apple and Binge (Australia). Its slate spans genres and territories, with titles including 'The Day of the Jackal,' ‘Downton Abbey,’ 'All Her Fault,' 'Cape Fear,' 'Ted,' ‘The Five-Star Weekend,’ and ‘The ‘Burbs.’  UGT titles have broken streaming records globally, with series regularly topping charts across the US, UK, and more than 50 other countries. Home to ground-breaking and intentional storytelling, UGT's slate has earned recognition from the Peabody Awards, Emmy Awards, BAFTAs and Golden Globes.

UGT’s internal scripted unit develops and produces original programming and has a proven track record of co-producing, financing, and partnering with independent producers to bring ambitious projects to screen. Partnerships include "One Day" with Drama Republic, "The Undeclared War" with Playground Entertainment, and forthcoming "The Dream Lands" with Sister Pictures. UGT also invests in leading creative talent through its minority stake and first-look distribution deal with Canada's Lark Productions ("Law & Order Toronto: Criminal Intent," "Allegiance”).

The Entertainment Coordinator provides comprehensive administrative support to designated department leaders and their teams within UGT. This role serves as a key point of coordination across internal stakeholders and external industry partners, managing schedules, communications, office operations, and departmental logistics with professionalism, discretion, and attention to detail.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and resourceful, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, anticipate needs, and maintain confidentiality while supporting a collaborative team environment.

Essential Responsibilities

  • General administrative duties include: answering telephones, scheduling, arranging drive-ons, copying, filing, compiling and submitting expense reports, and planning all travel arrangements
  • Assist in internal communication across NBCU departments and divisions, as well as with external partners in the creative community: networks, streaming services, other studios, agencies and managers
  • Maintain submission log and status reports for all aspects of production
  • Assist in communication with the creative community on a daily basis
  • Conduct research on request and maintain a general awareness of industry trends, formats, talent and competitive environment
  • Periodically coordinate, plan and execute office events
  • Have a solid knowledge of completing executive-ready power point presentations 
  • Handle highly confidential materials and information in a discreet manner 
  • Will be a team player and cover for other department assistants as needed

Basic Requirements:

  • Minimum 1 year of entertainment-industry experience
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

Desired Characteristics:

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Previous experience on high-level entertainment executive desk
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment
  • Detail-oriented and have excellent organizational skills
  • Highly flexible and collected under high-pressure circumstances

Additional Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV online to be considered
  • Willingness to work long hours and on weekends with short notice, specifically when dealing with international clients/time zones
  • Must be willing to work in Universal City, CA
  • Must have work authorization to work in the United States
  • Must be covered by Solutions, NBCU’s Alternative Dispute Resolution Program
  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

job.title: Film Production & Development Internships – Summer 2027
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Your future in media starts here. The NBCUniversal Summer Internship Program is your chance to help shape what’s next in media and entertainment. Whether you’re supporting major news coverage, creating content for iconic brands, or contributing to innovative projects, you’ll bring your ideas, creativity, and perspective to make an impact throughout your internship. 

Beyond your day-to-day role, you’ll take part in a thoughtfully designed program focused on career development, building your professional presence, and growing your workplace confidence. Through real-world experience and a community of fellow interns, you’ll explore what’s possible in this ever changing and exciting industry. 

In addition to all of our internships being paid, we will also offer the following for our Summer 2027 interns:    

  • Paid company holidays for full-time interns.   
  • Robust networking, learning and development opportunities. 
  • Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship. 
  • Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship. 
  • Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions. 
  • Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer.  
  • At our Universal City office interns will have access to the NBCUCommutes program, which provides fully subsidized transit passes to full-time lower lot employees, good for unlimited rides on all Metro bus and rail, such as the Metro Red Line. 

Summer 2027 Program Details 

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027 

Time Commitment: 32-40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need.  

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from Universal City, CA. 

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline 

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)   

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews    

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews   

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers   

To Apply: 

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year. 
  • Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below). 
  • Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program. 

Universal Pictures is a division of Universal Filmed Entertainment Group, within NBCUniversal, one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. For more than a century, the Studio has helped to redefine global popular culture, ensuring that audiences have access to stories by artists who look like them, who see them, and who celebrate them. Universal’s deep library includes many of the world’s most beloved films and homegrown franchises, including Jaws, Back to the Future, Bourne, Jurassic World, Fast & Furious, Mamma Mia!, Fifty Shades of Grey, Jordan Peele’s Get Out and Nope, Blumhouse’s The Purge franchise and M3GAN, Christopher Nolan’s Academy Award®-winning Oppenheimer, as well as animated blockbusters from Illumination and DreamWorks Animation. 

In addition to its lineup of groundbreaking originals, Universal Pictures works with leading content creators around the world to distribute and market their films to its global audience. 

Focus Features acquires and produces specialty films for the global market, and holds a library of iconic movies from fearless filmmakers. Our mission: to make a lasting impact on global audiences by creating the home for artists to share distinctive stories that inspire human connection. 

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to: 

  • Focus Features Physical Production: research (filming location, tax rebates, crew availability), review production/post-production schedules, production reports, call sheet, wrap reports, and provide general administrative support.    
  • Focus Features Production Development: script coverage, maintain filmmaker and project databases, review production schedules and call sheets, and general administrative support.   
  • Working Title Development: script coverage, maintain filmmaker and project databases, review production schedules and call sheets, and general administrative support.   
  • Post-Production Operations: assist teams in the daily operational processes needed to produce high-end marketing material, such as theatrical trailers and TV advertisements, for Universal Theatrical Film campaigns.  

Basic Requirements: 

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program.  
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits). 
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States. 
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027. 
  • Must be willing to work in Universal City, CA. 

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.  

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.   

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred. 
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above. 
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, strategic thinker, creative, researcher, energetic, resourceful, self-starter, great time-management.   
  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment.   
  • High level of organization and ability to manage multiple projects with various deadlines.   
  • Excellent communication skills, including written, verbal, and proofreading skills. 
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.   

The hourly rate for student interns is $19.00.

NBCUniversal Telemundo Enterprises is a world-class media company leading the industry in the production and distribution of high-quality, Spanish-language content to U.S. Hispanics and audiences around the world. This fast-growing multiplatform portfolio is comprised of the Telemundo Network, Telemundo Deportes, Telemundo Global Studios, Universo, and a Digital Enterprises & Emerging Business unit. Telemundo Network features original Spanish-language entertainment, news and sports content. Telemundo Deportes is the designated Spanish-language home of two of the world’s most popular sporting events: FIFA World Cup™ through 2026 and the Summer Olympic Games through 2032. Telemundo Global Studios is the company’s domestic and international scripted production unit. 

The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.    

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Telemundo Finance: The Telemundo Content Finance team supports the financial evaluation of content across broadcast, cable, and streaming platforms. The team oversees the Greenlight process, analyzing the projected profitability of productions and acquisitions before they receive executive approval. After content is completed and distributed, the team conducts Postmortem analyses to compare actual performance with initial projections and provide insights that help guide future content and investment decisions.
  • Telemundo Accounting: The Telemundo Miami Controllership team oversees essential accounting and financial reporting activities across Telemundo Network’s U.S. legal entities. The team manages the month-end close process, internal controls, SOX compliance, account reconciliations, financial reporting, and Telemundo consolidation activities. It also supports major business initiatives, including financial systems enhancements and technology-driven improvements that help strengthen reporting, analysis, and accounting operations.
  • International Networks & Direct-to-Consumer Finance: The NBCU International Networks & Direct-to-Consumer Finance team supports financial planning, reporting, and business decision-making across the organization. Working across Controllership, FP&A, and Finance Operations, the team helps ensure financial information is accurate, analyzes performance and key metrics, supports forecasting and reporting processes, and identifies opportunities to improve financial processes and tools.

Your future in media starts here. The NBCUniversal Summer Internship Program is your chance to help shape what’s next in media and entertainment. Beyond your day-to-day role, you’ll take part in a thoughtfully designed program focused on career development, building your professional presence, and growing your workplace confidence. Through real-world experience and a community of fellow interns, you’ll explore what’s possible in this ever changing and exciting industry.

NBCUniversal Advertising & Partnerships brings together the power of NBCUniversal’s iconic brands, premium content, innovative technology, and expansive audiences to create meaningful connections between advertisers and consumers. From entertainment and sports to streaming and digital platforms, our teams work across sales, marketing, insights, data, technology, and creative solutions to develop impactful advertising experiences for brands and partners. 

Universal Television Entertainment is responsible for world-class television entertainment. The division programs and markets content across leading entertainment brands Bravo, NBC and Peacock, and produces over 3,000 hours of television annually through Universal Studio Group, the studio business comprised of Universal Television, Universal Global Television and Universal Television Alternative Studio.

NBCU Corporate groups are uniquely positioned at the core of our organization. Employees within these groups use their area of expertise to support all businesses across the company, keeping the heart of each brand at the forefront.

NBCUniversal Local is NBCUniversal’s local media division that delivers English and Spanish-speakers and bilingual audiences in 31 U.S. markets and Puerto Rico the very best in local sports, news, weather, consumer and investigative reporting, and lifestyle entertainment across any platform and screen. NBCUniversal Local is comprised of three individual media groups including the NBC Owned Television Stations, the NBC Sports Regional Networks and the Telemundo Station Group. NBCUniversal Local’s stations and networks serve diverse audiences and communities across linear, streaming, OTT, digital web, mobile and audio, and cable platforms and work together to keep local audiences informed anytime and anywhere.       

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Ad Sales Finance – Digital: The Digital Finance team supports financial planning, reporting, and analysis across NBCUniversal’s streaming and digital advertising business. Interns may assist with revenue reporting, forecasting, pacing analysis, partner deliverables, and month-end activities while gaining exposure to the financial processes that support the advertising business.
  • HQ Controllership, Stage Plays: The intern will gain hands-on exposure to entertainment accounting, quarterly close, account reconciliations and journal-entry procedures. The intern will also contribute to process-improvement efforts involving data automation, responsible use of AI-enabled tools and implementation of scalable accounting solutions, while gaining broader cross-functional exposure to the Stage Plays Finance organization.
  • UTE Finance Programming: Our team has full oversight of the Unscripted Programming & Development budgets for Bravo and Peacock. The role will provide operational support and will work cross-functionally between the Finance, Strategy, Scheduling and Production Operations teams, and provides the unique opportunity to be involved in programming strategy.
  • UTE Media Platforms Marketing Finance: This position is a key member of the UTE Marketing Finance team, partnering with Marketing and Communications leaders to provide strategic financial support, help drive planning and close processes, and provide insights that drive informed business decisions and organizational growth. Interns will support the maintenance and reporting of key marketing metrics, and ad hoc analysis across Peacock, NBC, Bravo, and Sports, get hands-on experience with the monthly budget cycle, including prepping and maintaining budget files and partnering with operating teams, and support monthly consolidation of the Marketing portfolio, including variance analysis.
  • Corporate Strategy: The Intern, Corporate Strategy & Development will have the opportunity to work across multiple businesses within NBCUniversal (Film & Television Studios, Television & Direct-to-Consumer Entertainment, News & Sports, Telemundo, Consumer Products, and Parks). This unique position will provide access to high-level strategic decision-making in the ever-evolving world of media and entertainment. Responsibilities may include but are not limited to: providing financial and strategic support in evaluating mergers & acquisitions, joint venture partnerships, minority investments, and cross-divisional business development initiatives; developing financial models and valuation analyses, including returns analysis and sensitivities; preparing comprehensive business plans for new growth initiatives, including new business opportunities or opportunistic enhancements to internal businesses; and conducting market research and competitive benchmarking to inform leadership on industry trends.
  • International Corporate Finance – Billing Ad Sales: Global Customer Finance Operations (Order to Cash - O2C) builds competitive advantage by accelerating revenue cycles, optimizing cash flow and enhancing customer relationships for NBCU’s Digital and Linear networks and Properties, including Peacock. O2C is responsible for the set of business processes that involve receiving and fulfilling customer requests for goods or services, invoicing and collecting $15B from over 30,000 customers worldwide. Responsibilities of O2C include: Risk management, Billing, Collections, Cash operations, and Finance reporting and analysis. This internship will work with the Billing Ad Sales team, the team responsible for the preparation, analysis, and invoicing our domestic and global media campaigns and licensing fees. 
  • Media Group Controllership: The Intern will play a key role in the general accounting and compliance of NBCUniversal’s Media Group. This role provides an outstanding opportunity to learn about the NBC broadcast network, Peacock, and Bravo, as well as Media HQ. The position will work closely with the Media Group finance team and collaborate with Controllership across the NBCUniversal portfolio. This position will support the monthly close and the overall accounting processes to ensure accurate and timely reporting.  The role will support the (i) standardization of existing processes, (ii) identification of business process efficiencies, and (iii) implementation of best practices.  This position is expected to challenge the status quo and think of more enhanced approaches and methodologies to support Media’s overall close and control structure. 
  • NBCU Local Ad Sales Finance: This intern will work closely with the Ad Sales Finance team, along with partnering with sales leadership and sales support functions, to support the reporting of revenue and expenses across the Local Division. Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to: maintaining and updating recurring revenue trackers across NBC Owned Stations, Telemundo Owned Stations, and RSN reporting; supporting preparation of the weekly pacing deck by compiling revenue updates and organizing supporting materials; assisting with recurring finance presentations by formatting charts, updating commentary with team guidance, and organizing appendix details; developing familiarity with SAP, Operative, Wide Orbit, and business intelligence tools while supporting day-to-day finance operations; and assisting with the consolidation of quarterly sales incentive compensation revenue reports.
  • Local HQ Finance: The NBCU Local HQ Finance Intern will support the team across financial reporting, forecasting, month-end close, variance analysis, and process-improvement initiatives. This role offers hands-on exposure to financial planning and analysis in the media industry, with opportunities to work with BPC, Corporate Finance, Accounting, and business partners while helping improve the accuracy, efficiency, and clarity of recurring finance processes.

Universal Film consists of the operations to produce, acquire, market and distribute filmed entertainment worldwide in various media formats for theatrical, home entertainment, television and other distribution platforms.  The division operates globally with colleagues spread across 20 countries. We pride ourselves in supporting and amplifying diverse stories told by unique voices. We want to bring in driven, dedicated, and diverse talent into our organization who are just as passionate as we are in continuing to tell stories that reflect our global audience.  

Universal Television Entertainment is responsible for world-class television entertainment. The division programs and markets content across leading entertainment brands Bravo, NBC and Peacock, and produces over 3,000 hours of television annually through Universal Studio Group, the studio business comprised of Universal Television, Universal Global Television and Universal Television Alternative Studio.

Franchise, Products & Partnerships extends NBCUniversal’s iconic brands, characters and stories through global consumer products and games, theme park merchandise and retail, in addition to the UDX enterprise function of franchise management and strategic partnerships. Supporting NBCUniversal’s owned portfolio of properties as well as third-party partners across the theme park business, FPP creates products, experiences and partnerships that deepen fandom and connects audiences around the world with the characters, stories and worlds that define Universal.​

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Controllership, Global HQ & Distribution: This role will be responsible for assisting Global Distribution Accounting, and Reporting with the monthly and quarterly close process, financial audit and SOX compliance, customer audits, and monthly reporting to third parties for whom NBCU serves as the distribution agent.
  • HQ Controllership: The intern will gain hands-on experience with financial reporting systems, contribute to meaningful projects, and have opportunities to present financial insights to Senior Leadership across the Studios business. The intern will also learn how financial reporting helps drive business decisions and how those numbers can help executives rethink future productions and bring the next big hit to life.
  • Film Finance: The Film Finance team is responsible for managing all financial aspects of a film project’s lifecycle—from budgeting and pre-production, through production, to post-production. The Finance Intern will work closely with finance managers to assist in the preparation of film budgets, perform ad hoc financial analyses, and contribute to the overall financial duties of film projects.
  • Ultimates FP&A: The Ultimate FP&A team owns ultimate forecasting for the Film Group – the full lifetime P&L for each Universal and Focus Features film. The team partners with finance teams across 11 film business units to consolidate forecasts, analyze performance drivers, and deliver insights to senior leadership that inform strategic decisions. Interns will gain hands-on exposure to how a major studio evaluates film performance while also supporting live work. 
  • International Finance: The International Finance and UPHE Global Finance interns will be integral parts of the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team. The interns will be involved in sales and revenue forecasting, working directly with the sales organization to develop and review revenue budgets in over 100 territories and will be responsible for creating and maintaining deal analysis/financial models, and providing insights to key trends in the markets.
  • Production Finance: The intern will support NBCU Studio Group, which oversees the development, production, and marketing/distribution of our Film & TV Content. The Studio Group Finance team is responsible for the financial consolidation, reporting, and analysis of the Film & TV studios.
  • USG Finance Content Strategy: This internship will support greenlights through data gathering, validation and variance analysis, along with supporting preparation of weekly leadership reports on series financial performance and new releases and contributing to preparation of bi-annual P&L review.
  • USG FP&A: This intern will work on Monthly Pacings/Forecasts while assisting in pulling reports from our Finance database (BPC SMART) to help in variance analysis for both EBITDA & FCF, such as Content Delivery & Airing Schedule Analysis. They will also work on the 13-Week Forecast, 3rd Party Collections Reconciliation, and with the Development Finance Assist team in tracking development projects within. This team works regularly with partners across the broader organization including TV Distribution, Home Entertainment, and Studios/Corporate finance, so being proactive, adaptable, and team-minded is key in our day-to-day environment.
  • USG TV Production Finance: Interns are educated on business unit operations and workflows that support various domestic and international television productions and on-site accounting teams. Interns partner internally and externally to gain exposure to financial systems, accounts payable, production payroll, budgeting, and cost reporting. Daily ad hoc projects include ledger inquiry research, analysis, forensic accounting, p-card management, invoice processing, and check printing, as well as updating and distributing various weekly production tracking spreadsheets and more.
  • UTE Platforms Marketing FP&A: The internship will provide general support for monthly pacing cycles. Responsibilities may include but are not limited to: pulling reports from SAP’s forecasting system; assisting with EBITDA and FCF variance analysis; completing system checks and supplemental schedules; helping clean, reconcile, and load Centers of Excellence submissions into forecast P&Ls contributing to the maintenance of forecasting models and ensuring their accuracy; and collaborating on enhancement of ancillary revenue and cost tracking.
  • FP&A, Consumer Products: Under the Franchise, Products & Partnerships business group, the FP&A Consumer Products intern will be a key contributor to the Global Consumer Products FP&A team. Their primary role is to be the support function for the FP&A team across various financial processes and other ad hoc tasks, especially during the forecasting cycles. For the intern, this role will provide a wide exposure across different responsibilities within the FP&A team and will be a vital member to ensure the team can continue to provide the assistance and business partnering requirements necessary to all international finance teams.

job.title: Host/Producer Acceso Total, Telemundo Ft. Myers
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

We are seeking a dynamic, creative, and highly engaging Host/Producer for Acceso Total serving the  market. This individual will serve as both an on-air personality and an editorial/content leader, helping shape a compelling lifestyle, entertainment, and community-focused program that connects with Southwest Florida's diverse Hispanic audience.

The Host/Producer will bring energy, authenticity, strong storytelling skills, and a deep connection to the community. The role requires someone equally comfortable engaging audiences on camera, interviewing guests and community leaders, developing original content, and collaborating with producers and other station teams to deliver relevant multiplatform programming.

Job Responsibilities

On-Air Hosting & Storytelling

  • Serve as a primary on-air host and representative of Acceso Total.
  • Deliver engaging, conversational, and authentic presentations across broadcast, digital, streaming, social, and other platforms.
  • Conduct compelling interviews with entertainers, community leaders, experts, local personalities, businesses, and other guests.
  • Develop, produce, and present sponsored segments, product integrations, and promotional content in collaboration with sales, clients, and production teams, ensuring engaging on-air delivery consistent with the program’s format and station standards.
  • Communicate naturally with audiences while maintaining strong editorial judgment and professionalism.
  • Participate in field shoots, community events, promotional appearances, and station initiatives.
  • Develop a recognizable and credible connection with viewers and the Southwest Florida community.

Editorial & Content Leadership

  • Partner with the production team to develop daily and longer-term content strategies for Acceso Total.
  • Identify and develop stories and segments focused on entertainment, lifestyle, culture, community, consumer interests, social trends, and topics relevant to local Hispanic audiences.
  • Generate original segment ideas and identify potential guests, experiences, and community stories.
  • Write and/or contribute to scripts, show copy, interview questions, opens, teases, promotional material, and digital content.
  • Help determine the appropriate tone, presentation, and storytelling approach for individual segments.
  • Maintain strong editorial standards and ensure content aligns with station and company expectations.

Producer Responsibilities

  • Take an active role in the planning and execution of the program from concept through air.
  • Work closely with producers, photographers/editors, MMJs, creative services, sales, community engagement, digital teams, and station leadership.
  • Help prioritize stories and segments based on audience relevance, timeliness, production requirements, and overall program strategy.
  • Provide editorial input and creative direction to strengthen the quality, consistency, and identity of the program.
  • Support special programs, sponsored integrations, community initiatives, and other station projects while maintaining appropriate editorial standards.

Digital & Social

  • Develop content specifically designed for social, digital, streaming, and emerging platforms.
  • Maintain an active and professional social media presence supporting Acceso Total and the station's brands.
  • Identify opportunities to extend on-air stories into digital and social conversations.
  • Participate in short-form video, behind-the-scenes content, live social coverage, and other multiplatform initiatives.
  • Collaborate with station teams to grow audience engagement beyond the traditional broadcast.

Community & Brand

  • Serve as a visible ambassador for Acceso Total and the station throughout Southwest Florida.
  • Build relationships with community organizations, cultural institutions, local businesses, artists, entertainers, and community leaders.
  • Identify stories and voices that authentically represent the interests and experiences of the local Hispanic community.
  • Represent the station at community events, promotional opportunities, and public appearances as assigned.
  • Help strengthen Acceso Total's position as a locally relevant lifestyle and entertainment brand.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, broadcasting, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Professional experience in television, digital media, entertainment, lifestyle programming, journalism, or related content production.
  • Demonstrated on-camera hosting, reporting, or presenting experience.
  • Strong interviewing, writing, storytelling, and communication skills.
  • Ability to develop and produce engaging content for television, digital, streaming, and social platforms.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish with strong Spanish-language on-air communication skills.
  • Strong knowledge of social media and evolving audience-consumption habits.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced production environment and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Availability to work flexible hours, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and community events as business needs require.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Submit a resume/CV and demo reel through nbcunicareers.com.
  • Must have unrestricted authorization to work in the United States and be at least 18 years old.
  • Must be willing to work in Fort Myers/Naples viewing area.

Desired Characteristics

  • Charismatic and authentic on-camera presence with the ability to connect naturally with viewers.
  • Strong knowledge of Southwest Florida and its Hispanic communities, culture, businesses, entertainment, and lifestyle.
