job.title: Lead Data Scientist
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Position Overview:

As part of the Peacock Data Science team, the Lead Data Scientist will be responsible for creating recommendation and personalization solutions for one or more verticals of Peacock Video Streaming Service.

You’ll collaborate with an international, cross-functional team of engineers, architects, product managers and analysts to identify and prioritize enhancements to Peacock’s personalization models. Your responsibilities will touch everything from feature creation to model development, evaluation, and deployment, and you’ll have opportunities to work on cutting edge machine learning like foundation models and reinforcement learning.

 

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Work with a group of data scientists in the development of recommendation and personalization models using statistical, machine learning and data mining methodologies.
  • Drive the collection and manipulation of new data and the refinement of existing data sources.
  • Translate complex problems and solutions to all levels of the organization.
  • Collaborate with software and data architects in building real-time and automated batch implementations of data science solutions and integrating them into the streaming service architecture.
  • Drive innovation of the statistical and machine learning methodologies and tools used by the team.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+years of experience in machine learning, data science, or applied research.
  • Hands-on experience designing, building, training, tuning, and evaluating deep learning models.
  • Experience building models for commercial recommender systems, personalization, or ranking systems.
  • Strong Python skills with an understanding of computational complexity.
  • Experience with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow.
  • Experience taking ML/deep learning models from experimentation through production deployment.
  • Experience with SQL and PySpark for large-scale data processing.
  • Experience with foundation models and Generative AI technologies.
  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience in media analytics and application of data science to the content streaming and TV industry.
  • Good understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and graph methodologies.
  • Experience with multi-billion record datasets and leading projects that span the disciplines of data science and data engineering.
  • Experience with Kubeflow, Airflow, and Databricks (or equivalent).
  • Experience with large-scale video assets.
  • Team oriented and collaborative approach with a demonstrated aptitude and willingness to learn new methods and tools.

 

Additional Requirements: 

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $145,000 - $175,000 (bonus and long-term incentive eligible).

Nous possédons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de diffusion en continu haut de gamme financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des films et des émissions de premier plan par l’intermédiaire de nos puissants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que les quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de calibre mondial partout dans le monde grâce à Universal Destinations & Experiences, dont Universal Orlando Resort, qui accueille Universal Epic Universe, ainsi qu’Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Pour en savoir plus, visitez www.nbcuniversal.com.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des collectivités où vivent et travaillent les membres de notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics. Nous avons une riche tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à ce que notre personnel ait l’occasion de contribuer activement à sa communauté. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et d’offrir un vaste éventail de contenus qui reflètent le monde dans lequel nous vivons.

As Lead Tools Programmer, you are responsible for defining, building, and guiding tools and workflows that empower content creators and developers across the project. This role spans in‑engine tooling, standalone desktop applications, and optional web‑enabled tools, enabling efficient production at scale on an AAA title. You provide technical leadership for tools architecture while collaborating closely with Design, Art, Production, and Engineering to ensure tools are robust, scalable, and production‑ready.

RESPONSIBILTIES

  • Lead the design and implementation of tools supporting content creation, iteration, validation, and debugging.
  • Define and maintain tools architecture spanning Unreal Engine editor tools and standalone applications.
  • Design and oversee standalone desktop tools using frameworks such as Qt, .NET / WPF, WinUI, or similar cross‑platform solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership for tools written in C++, with supporting layers in Python or C# where appropriate.
  • Act as the primary technical partner for artists, designers, and developers, translating workflow needs into effective tools.
  • Mentor and support tools programmers through code reviews, technical guidance, and best‑practice development.
  • Collaborate with Pipeline, Gameplay, UI, and Production teams to integrate tools into daily workflows.
  • Oversee performance, stability, usability, and maintainability of tools used across disciplines.
  • Establish coding standards, documentation practices, and testing strategies for tools development.
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks and drive improvements through tooling, automation, and data‑driven solutions.
  • Guide the evolution of tools toward extensibility, cross‑project reuse, and long‑term scalability.
  • Debug complex tools issues involving engine integration, file I/O, data pipelines, and external services.
  • Stay current with industry trends in tools development, automation, and developer experience.

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

À titre de Programmeur ou programmeuse outils Lead, vous êtes responsable de définir, développer et orienter les outils et les flux de travail qui permettent aux créateurs et créatrices de contenu ainsi qu’aux équipes de développement de travailler efficacement à l’échelle du projet. Ce rôle couvre les outils intégrés au moteur, les applications de bureau autonomes et, au besoin, les outils connectés au web, afin de soutenir une production AAA efficace à grande échelle. Vous assurez le leadership technique de l’architecture des outils tout en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes Design, Art, Production et Ingénierie afin de garantir que les outils sont robustes, évolutifs et prêts pour la production.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Diriger la conception et l’implantation d’outils soutenant la création de contenu, l’itération, la validation et le débogage.
  • Définir et maintenir l’architecture des outils couvrant les outils d’édition d’Unreal Engine et les applications autonomes.
  • Concevoir et superviser des outils de bureau autonomes à l’aide de frameworks tels que Qt, .NET / WPF, WinUI ou d’autres solutions multiplateformes comparables.
  • Fournir un leadership technique pour les outils développés en C++, avec des couches complémentaires en Python ou en C# lorsque pertinent.
  • Agir comme principal partenaire technique des artistes, des concepteurs et conceptrices ainsi que des développeurs et développeuses, en traduisant les besoins liés aux flux de travail en outils efficaces.
  • Encadrer et soutenir les programmeurs et programmeuses outils grâce aux revues de code, à l’orientation technique et aux pratiques exemplaires de développement.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Pipeline, Gameplay, UI et Production afin d’intégrer les outils aux flux de travail quotidiens.
  • Superviser la performance, la stabilité, la convivialité et la maintenabilité des outils utilisés par les différentes disciplines.
  • Établir les normes de codage, les pratiques de documentation et les stratégies de test pour le développement d’outils.
  • Identifier les goulots d’étranglement dans les flux de travail et piloter les améliorations au moyen d’outils, d’automatisation et de solutions fondées sur les données.
  • Orienter l’évolution des outils vers une plus grande extensibilité, la réutilisation entre projets et une évolutivité à long terme.
  • Déboguer des problèmes complexes liés aux outils, notamment l’intégration moteur, les entrées-sorties de fichiers, les pipelines de données et les services externes.
  • Se tenir à jour quant aux tendances de l’industrie en matière de développement d’outils, d’automatisation et d’expérience des développeurs et développeuses.

Basic Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in C++, with extensive experience developing tools or editor‑focused systems.
  • At least 8+ years of professional experience in game programming, with shipped titles or equivalent AAA production experience.
  • Professional experience with Unreal Engine editor tooling and engine integration.
  • Strong understanding of tools architecture, data‑driven systems, and content creation workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, or technically guiding programmers on a production team.
  • Excellent problem‑solving skills and the ability to design robust systems under production constraints.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Perforce or Git.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience building standalone desktop tools using Qt, .NET (WPF/WinForms), or similar frameworks.
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python for tooling, automation, and glue code.
  • Familiarity with web‑enabled tools using technologies such as REST APIs, Electron, or lightweight web dashboards.
  • Strong empathy for end‑users and a focus on usability and iteration speed.
  • A passion for enabling teams through high‑quality tools and workflows.

QUALIFICATIONS

Exigences de base :

  • Solide maîtrise du C++, avec une vaste expérience dans le développement d’outils ou de systèmes axés sur les éditeurs.
  • Au moins 8 ans ou plus d’expérience professionnelle en programmation de jeux vidéo, avec des titres commercialisés ou une expérience équivalente dans des productions AAA.
  • Expérience professionnelle avec les outils d’édition d’Unreal Engine et leur intégration au moteur.
  • Solide compréhension de l’architecture des outils, des systèmes pilotés par les données et des flux de création de contenu.
  • Expérience démontrée de leadership, de mentorat ou d’accompagnement technique de programmeurs et programmeuses au sein d’une équipe de production.
  • Excellentes aptitudes de résolution de problèmes et capacité à concevoir des systèmes robustes dans un contexte de contraintes de production.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et capacité à collaborer efficacement avec diverses disciplines.
  • Expérience avec des systèmes de gestion de versions tels que Perforce ou Git.

Atouts souhaités :

  • Expérience dans le développement d’outils de bureau autonomes à l’aide de Qt, .NET (WPF/WinForms) ou de frameworks comparables.
  • Expérience avec des langages de script tels que Python pour les outils, l’automatisation et le code d’intégration.
  • Connaissance des outils connectés au web utilisant des technologies telles que les API REST, Electron ou des tableaux de bord web légers.
  • Forte sensibilité aux besoins des utilisateurs et utilisatrices et souci de la convivialité ainsi que de la rapidité d’itération.
  • Passion pour soutenir les équipes grâce à des outils et des flux de travail de grande qualité.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Your future in media starts here. The NBCUniversal Summer Internship Program is your chance to help shape what’s next in media and entertainment. Whether you’re supporting major news coverage, creating content for iconic brands, or contributing to innovative projects, you’ll bring your ideas, creativity, and perspective to make an impact throughout your internship.

Beyond your day-to-day role, you’ll take part in a thoughtfully designed program focused on career development, building your professional presence, and growing your workplace confidence. Through real-world experience and a community of fellow interns, you’ll explore what’s possible in this ever changing and exciting industry.

In addition to all of our internships being paid, we will also offer the following for our Summer 2027 interns:   

  • Paid company holidays for full-time interns.  
  • Robust networking, learning and development opportunities.
  • Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship.
  • Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship.
  • Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions.
  • Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer.

Summer 2027 Program Details

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need. 

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from Miami, FL.

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)  

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews   

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews  

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers  

To Apply:

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.
  • Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).
  • Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program.

The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.    

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Unisla Business & Legal Affairs (JD-level): NBCU International Networks & Direct-to-Consumer’s Business & Legal Affairs team supports key commercial and strategic initiatives across content distribution, advertising sales, digital products, and other areas of the business. This BLA intern will work under the team, which collaborates closely with legal and business partners to draft and evaluate agreements, assess contractual rights and obligations, and provide guidance that supports revenue, day-to-day operations, and long-term growth across the region.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in Miami, FL.  

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Must be a current J.D. candidate in good standing.  
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.  
  • Previous legal experience or demonstrable interest.
  • Strong interest in entertainment/media.
  • Strong professional maturity and judgment. 
  • Collaborative and enjoys working in a team environment. 
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. 

The hourly rate for JD student interns is $25.00.

Universal Television Entertainment is responsible for world-class television entertainment. The division programs and markets content across leading entertainment brands Bravo, NBC and Peacock, and produces over 3,000 hours of television annually through Universal Studio Group, the studio business comprised of Universal Television, Universal Global Television and Universal Television Alternative Studio.

Universal Film consists of the operations to produce, acquire, market and distribute filmed entertainment worldwide in various media formats for theatrical, home entertainment, television and other distribution platforms.  The division operates globally with colleagues spread across 20 countries. We pride ourselves in supporting and amplifying diverse stories told by unique voices. We want to bring in driven, dedicated, and diverse talent into our organization who are just as passionate as we are in continuing to tell stories that reflect our global audience.  

Franchise, Products & Partnerships extends NBCUniversal’s iconic brands, characters and stories through global consumer products and games, theme park merchandise and retail, in addition to the UDX enterprise function of franchise management and strategic partnerships. Supporting NBCUniversal’s owned portfolio of properties as well as third-party partners across the theme park business, FPP creates products, experiences and partnerships that deepen fandom and connects audiences around the world with the characters, stories and worlds that define Universal.​

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Corporate Legal Rotational (JD-level): The NBCU Corporate Legal Function is hosting a Legal Rotational Experience for law students interested in Entertainment Law. This program is designed to positively impact inclusion in the legal profession. The Legal Rotational Experience will be a program that provides training, exposure, and opportunities to law students. Interns will work in one Corporate Legal group and one Business Legal group during the course of the 10-week internship. Responsibilities may include but are not limited to: assisting team members with drafting, reviewing and negotiating a wide variety of legal agreements; providing timely and thorough analysis on potential risks and issues, and proposing practical, responsive solutions; and working collaboratively with lawyers to identify and implement improvements to contract forms and processes. 
  • Corporate Legal – Music Business & Legal Affairs (JD-level): NBCUniversal Music Business & Legal Affairs services an array of clients in the Film & Television portfolios. The overall landscape of Film includes distinct business functions that each touch a key segment area in the overall lifecycle of a film, from ideation to premiere. On the TV side, there is a vast portfolio of sports, news networks, streaming, entertainment networks, and significant television production operations, including scripted, alternative, and late night, and a leading television stations group. This intern’s responsibilities may include the following: researching music rights, analysing and summarizing music deal terms, drafting music talent agreements, reviewing production content for music information, and assisting with tracking rights, analysis, and grid maintenance.     
  • UTE Legal Affairs (JD-level):  Interns will assist show lawyers with vetting television show scripts for legal risks, making clearance determinations for production-related materials, and other issue-spotting and analysis. Interns will also conduct legal research on issues that may arise during the production of both unscripted and scripted television shows, as well as assist the team by leveraging existing legal technology tools, like Microsoft Power Automate, to support the group’s efforts to streamline process, generate forms, and create efficiencies. 
  • USG Business Affairs (undergrad-level): This intern will support the administrative arm of USG’s Business Affairs and Legal Affairs Departments. We support the two departments by keeping track of all deal points, tracking options & deadlines, talent fees, insurance, and more. We work with IT to develop and maintain supporting applications to facilitate the deal-making and legal drafting functions, as well as robust reporting. We also interface with several other departments, such as Finance and Creative, as projects develop from an idea to a television series. The USG BA intern will assist with responsibilities including reviewing deal memos, agreements, and other correspondence; summarizing relevant deal points and updating Salesforce with fee information; and reviewing documents that have come into the department. 
  • Film Rights & Clearances (JD-level): The Film Rights & Clearances intern will work with the Legal, Bonus Legal, and Music Legal teams to research/analyze and provide guidance on rights, contractual requirements, studio policy, guild issues, and product licensing to a variety of teams within Global Distribution and Universal Pictures Home Entertainment. 
  • Business & Legal Affairs, UDX Franchise, Products, and Partnerships (JD-level): UDX Franchise, Products, and Partnerships (UDX FPP) globally drives the expansion and elevation of NBCUniversal’s iconic collection of brands, intellectual properties, characters, and stories based on the company’s extensive portfolio of properties created by Universal Pictures, Illumination, DreamWorks Animation, and NBCUniversal Television and Streaming. The division executes this through innovative physical and digital products, engaging retail and product experiences across our expansive global theme park destinations (for both owned and 3rd party IP), location-based venues, e-commerce product platforms, and retailers around the world. Along with global brand strategy and creative, UDX FPP’s three lines of business include Consumer Products, Games and Digital Platforms, as well as Theme Parks Products & Retail. The legal intern will assist with drafting outgoing consumer product, videogame, publishing or promotional license agreements under the supervision of an attorney using forms, templates, and deal memos as guides. Telemundo Arizona is looking for a driven and results-oriented multiplatform sales leader to join our team.   The successful candidate will oversee local sales for our linear and non-linear product portfolio which provides Spanish and English language marketing solutions for brands and businesses across every industry to reach Hispanic and non-Hispanic audiences in the Phoenix and Tucson DMA and throughout the United States through NBCU OTT Spot On & Peacock.  The Local Sales Manager will be responsible for partnering with local advertising agencies and clients to create innovative, targeted, and unique multi-platform marketing and advertising solutions that deliver results across the portfolio. 

Essential Responsibilities

The Local Sales Manager will be responsible for directing the local sales efforts of Telemundo Arizona and will report to the station’s General Manager/VP of Sales

  • The LSM will work strategically with research, business development, and sales leadership across the division to grow revenue for Telemundo Phoenix and Tucson and NBCUniversal Local linear and non-linear platforms, including Peacock, Spot On and NBC / Telemundo Full Episode Player. 
  • The LSM will be responsible for leading a team of AEs and formulate sales goals and competitive advantage strategies to achieve/surpass revenue targets.
  • The LSM must be willing to carry a sales list, work on avails and stay connected with clients to contribute to the overall success of the station. 
  • The LSM will lead local sales and planning, pricing strategies, inventory management, market growth and revenue forecasting across the station’s sales portfolio, including tentpoles. 
  • The LSM will partner with General Manager/VP of Sales, Research, Traffic and Finance to provide local market insights throughout the budget planning process and presentations. 
  • The LSM will direct the local sales effort through clear communication and detailed planning. Review strategies with clients. Provide quick response and turnaround to the local sales team and deliver on timelines and commitments.
  • The LSM must develop strategies to enhance traditional revenue opportunities as well as identify new revenue streams and lead execution of activation and integration sponsorships.
  • The LSM will work with closely with Research to create presentations and determine estimates on programs.
  • Identify local decision makers impacting local buys.
  • The LSM will develop an understanding of our ad products, leverage tentpole events like the World Cup, Super Bowl, and the Olympics, and have solid consultative selling skills to best develop solutions to meet client needs.
  • New business, revenue closure, account relationship building, customer satisfaction, and product implementation success are key responsibilities.
  • Aggressively meet and develop strong business relationships with all buyers, media planners and brand managers throughout Arizona.
  • Ensure optimal market coverage, professional client engagements, increasing awareness of products, services, and capabilities.
  • Provide continual input and assessments to station and division leadership to drive ongoing improvements in sales strategy and approach.
  • Achieve quarterly linear and non-linear revenue targets and support station’s overall OCF achievement.
  • Manage the opportunity pipeline and revenue forecasting.
  • Identify, coordinate, and attend all appropriate local marketing and advertising association events.
  • Collaborate with NBCU Local's sales teams across the division to share best practices, implement new strategies and utilize expertise to drive results.

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in business development and media sales
  • Minimum 5 years of digital media sales experience.
  • A solid record of attaining or exceeding sales quotas by developing creative solutions that meet customers’ needs across traditional and non-traditional advertising categories.
  • Minimum 5 years of working knowledge with Word, PowerPoint and Excel
  • A demonstrated record of growing market share and outperforming the market
  • Ability to understand the big picture and long-term objectives, positive mental attitude, sense of professionalism, team orientation, resourcefulness, and client focus.
  • Excellent communication skills, initiative, creativity, detail oriented, organizational, analytical and presentation skills required.
  • Strong sense of drive and ambition.
  • Industry contacts, client list including both agencies and client direct contacts.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV through nbcunicareers.com to be considered
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be 18 years or older.
  • Must be willing to work at the NBCU location in Phoenix, and travel to Tucson occasionally.
  • Must have access to a vehicle and excellent driving history.
  • Must provide proof current valid U.S. driver's license, vehicle insurance, and registration as requested.
  • Willingness to travel and work overtime, and on weekends with short notice when circumstances warrant.

Desired Qualifications

  • A proven track record of managing a successful sales team
  • Degree in marketing, business, or communications
  • Some level of Spanish language skills (a plus)
  • Experience selling OTT/CTV ad solutions
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to successfully apply sales techniques; creative and analytic ability to use information such as behavioral, demo and geo targeting data plus industry research to make effective and persuasive verbal, written or electronic sales presentations.
  • Good organizational and time management skills.
  • Experience working with WideOrbit and Salesforce platforms

Additional Requirements

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

job.title: Manager, Corporate Events
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Role Purpose

At NBCUniversal, the Corporate Events Department produces high-impact experiences for clients and C-suite executives across some of the most recognized brands in media and entertainment — from marquee tentpole events and corporate initiatives to brand activations and large-scale client programs.

The Corporate Events Manager is an experienced event lead who independently drives small to mid-sized programs from ideation through execution while also contributing to larger-scale events as part of a broader team. This individual brings 5–7 years of experience in events, hospitality, entertainment, or related industries, along with a proven ability to lead programs, navigate complex logistics, and collaborate effectively across stakeholders. The Manager serves as a key partner to internal teams, clients, vendors, and executives, balancing strategic thinking with flawless execution. This position may provide guidance and oversight to Coordinators, Associates, Pages, or project-based team members depending on event staffing and department structure.

This role is built for an events professional who is already working at the Manager level. The ideal candidate brings strong, Manager-level hospitality experience, is confident and polished interacting with C-suite executives, and has the knowledge to take on programs immediately after starting. In return, the role offers a clear path for growth within the department, with the opportunity to advance to Senior Manager and Director roles over time.

Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. The position reports to a Vice President within the Corporate Events Department. At NBCUniversal, you’ll have opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact alongside some of the industry’s most talented professionals.

Job Duties

Event Leadership & Execution

  • Lead small to mid-sized programs from initial planning through on-site execution and post-event reconciliation
  • Take ownership of assigned programs immediately upon starting, applying established Manager-level hospitality expertise with minimal ramp-up
  • Contribute to larger-scale and high-profile events in partnership with senior team members, owning specific workstreams, logistics, vendors, or operational components within the broader program
  • Oversee all aspects of assigned events, including venue sourcing, vendor coordination, run-of-show development, premium sourcing, guest experience, and on-site logistics
  • Partner closely with internal stakeholders and clients throughout the planning and execution process, facilitating meetings and ensuring clear communication and follow-through
  • Interface directly with clients and C-suite executives with professionalism and discretion
  • Serve as a trusted, polished point of contact for C-suite executives and VIP guests, anticipating needs and delivering white-glove hospitality
  • Develop and track event budgets, process invoices, and support post-event reconciliation
  • Negotiate contracts, track deliverables, and maintain detailed production timelines
  • Coordinate event registration, attendee communications, and guest management to ensure a seamless experience
  • Produce or oversee the creation of digital and printed event materials in collaboration with vendors and internal/external partners
  • Travel domestically and internationally to execute and support events
  • Provide on-site support across the department’s broader event portfolio as needed

Team Collaboration & Department Support

  • Provide guidance and day-to-day direction to Associates, Coordinators, Pages, and project-based team members assigned to events
  • Foster a collaborative and supportive working environment while helping junior team members strengthen their event management skills
  • Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional teams on complex programs and department initiatives
  • Contribute to operational improvements, internal processes, and shared departmental resources
  • Maintain awareness of emerging trends across hospitality, food and beverage, entertainment, sports, venues, experiential marketing, and premium gifting

Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related work experience
  • 5+ years of experience in events, hospitality, entertainment, experiential marketing, production, client services, or related fields
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading and executing events from concept through completion

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

About UDX FRANCHISE, PRODUCTS & PARTNERSHIPS:

Universal Destination & Experiences’ Franchise, Products & Partnerships team (UDX FPP) extends NBCUniversal’s iconic brands, characters and stories through global consumer products and games, theme park merchandise and retail, in addition to the UDX enterprise function of franchise management and strategic partnerships. Supporting NBCUniversal’s owned portfolio of properties as well as third-party partners across the theme park business, UDX FPP creates products, experiences and partnerships that deepen fandom and connects audiences around the world with the characters, stories and worlds that define Universal.  www.udxfpp.com

UDX FPP is looking for a creative and strategic Design Manager to guide product design and development from initial concept through final execution. This role combines hands-on design expertise, creative direction, team leadership, brand stewardship, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver products that are innovative, consumer-relevant, commercially viable, and authentic to Universal’s properties.

With the primary focus on the collectibles market, this role requires a deep understanding of the collector consumer and the ability to respond quickly to evolving trends, fandom, nostalgia, emerging aesthetics, new formats, and product innovation. In addition, this role requires a deep understanding of Universal’s properties and franchises including our animated, live action and horror portfolios.

Design & Development

  • Oversee product approvals and provide timely, actionable feedback to licensees through the online product approval process.
  • Embrace coaching and mentoring as opportunities to support individual and team growth.
  • Deliver accurate design direction, draw-overs, and overlays aligned with property guidelines and franchise priorities.
  • Serve as a design expert across assigned categories, materials, technologies, and 2D/3D execution.
  • Create mood boards, concept sketches, visual direction, and assets for presentations.
  • Research trends, innovation, and consumer insights to inspire new product ideas, with a strong focus on collectibles while remaining flexible across categories.
  • Lead the creative vision and design direction across assigned product categories.
  • Maintain a high standard of character, property, and brand integrity throughout development.
  • Communicate effectively and confidently across internal teams, external partners, and leadership.
  • Understand packaging structure, branding elements, legal requirements, and toy functionality.
  • Provide clear meeting recaps, next steps, and action items to management and key stakeholders.
  • Embrace Artificial Intelligence as an evolving creative tool and demonstrate a willingness to learn, experiment, and improve.
  • Demonstrate versatility across design styles and aesthetics to respond to changing consumer and market trends.

Design Strategy

  • Identify emerging trends, consumer behaviors, new play patterns, technologies, and white-space opportunities.
  • Translate business and franchise strategies into compelling product concepts and design solutions.
  • Monitor emerging trends and innovation across collectibles, toys, and adjacent product categories.
  • Understand the competitive landscape, target consumer, and evolving collector mindset.
  • Build clear, polished design strategy presentations for internal and leadership reviews.
  • Plan, develop, and execute visual line plans that communicate cohesive product strategies and storytelling.
  • Present concepts, product strategies, and design recommendations clearly and confidently to leadership.
  • Balance nostalgia, fandom, current trends, and forward-looking innovation to create products that connect with both established and emerging collectors.

Licensing Expertise

  • Understand the licensed entertainment and consumer products landscape.
  • Maintain brand consistency across licensed characters, storytelling, products, assets, and toolkits.
  • Guide product development from show to shelf, translating Universal IP into compelling consumer products.
  • Direct external partners and licensees toward creative solutions that authentically represent Universal properties.
  • Review product submissions and provide clear, actionable design feedback throughout development.
  • Balance partner creativity with franchise authenticity, particularly within the collectibles space, while maintaining Universal’s quality standards.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Communicate strategically and effectively with internal teams, leadership, licensees, and external partners.
  • Lead creative discussions, product reviews, kickoff meetings, and approval conversations.
  • Maintain clear, consistent, and productive communication with licensees throughout development.
  • Collaborate closely with Category, Franchise, Legal, Retail, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external partners to drive alignment and successful product execution.
  • Advocate for strong design solutions while working collaboratively toward shared creative and business goals.
  • Can confidently present creative concepts, product designs, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership, clearly articulating how creative solutions support franchise objectives, licensing opportunities, partner needs and broader business goals.
  • Perform other related duties assigned to support the needs of the team.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $105,000 - $125,000

  • 5+ years of experience in licensing, manufacturing, consumer products, toy design, collectibles, or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in industrial design, Toy Design, Illustration, or a related field preferred.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating commercial product development and trend-forward design.
  • Demonstrates openness to giving and receiving constructive feedback, embracing continuous improvement, and adapting approaches and ways of working to meet evolving business needs.
  • Strong traditional and digital sketching skills, with strength in figures, collectibles, character-driven products, and stylized design trends.
  • Strong understanding of the collectibles market, including established, emerging, and upcoming consumer trends.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify trends and translate them into relevant product opportunities.
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to drive projects forward.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and creative-direction skills.
  • Experience developing licensed entertainment products.
  • Strong understanding of product development and manufacturing processes.
  • Excellent illustration, conceptualization, and design skills.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, with working knowledge of InDesign, Keynote, PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.
  • Strong understanding of 2D composition and 3D form.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and adaptable within a fast-paced development environment.
  • Confident advocating for design recommendations while collaborating toward shared solutions.
  • Comfortable experimenting with emerging creative technologies, including AI-assisted ideation and visualization.

Portfolio

  • PORTFOLIO SUBMISSION GUIDLINES: Please submit a professional portfolio 
    demonstrating strong product ideation, sketching, creative problem-solving, and design development is highly preferred. Examples of collectible or other three-dimensional product design are strongly preferred. Portfolios must showcase the full product development lifecycle, from concept to shelf, and include examples of sketches, trend research, pattern and print development, overlays/redlines, technical design packages (tech packs), sampling iterations, and final produced products. All submitted work must be the candidate's original work, with clear examples of their individual design contributions.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. The Manager, Soundtracks & Marketing, Film Music supports integrated soundtrack, score, artist, social, publicity, awards, and event campaigns across the film slate. Working closely with the SVP, Soundtracks & Marketing, this role supports priority campaigns while independently leading select album, awards, and screening initiatives. The ideal candidate is creative, highly organized, collaborative, and able to manage multiple partners, deliverables, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Soundtrack Marketing & Publicity

  • Develop and manage marketing and publicity strategies for soundtracks, scores, singles, composers, and artists.
  • Partner with the SVP on major soundtrack campaigns while independently leading select releases from planning through execution.
  • Liaise with composers, artists, managers, labels, and internal and external marketing teams to establish rollout plans, timelines, key dates, approvals, and deliverables.
  • Create and distribute campaign strategies, release information, assets, and updates to domestic and international partners.
  • Coordinate major-label soundtrack and album campaigns with outside record labels and distribution partners.
  • Work with publicity teams to secure interviews, features, exclusives, and editorial opportunities for composers, songwriters, and artists.
  • Prepare priorities and action items before and after executive meetings; create and distribute Back Lot Music press releases and campaign communications.
  • Develop and maintain strong music-industry relationships. DSP, editorial, and music-press contacts are a plus.

Social Media & Digital Marketing

  • Manage Back Lot Music social accounts, content calendars, release posts, and music distribution and smart-link destinations.
  • Coordinate copy, creative, timing, approvals, tagging, and collaborative posts with film accounts, artists, composers, labels, and partners.
  • Create, organize, and distribute social assets and identify catalog, anniversary, talent, and film-marketing moments that extend campaign reach.
  • Ensure messaging and creative remain consistent across social channels and partner campaigns.

Awards Strategy & Submissions

  • Support awards strategies for eligible scores, songs, soundtracks, composers, songwriters, and artists.
  • Lead direct submissions, including the GRAMMY Awards, Hollywood Music in Media Awards (HMMA), and Society of Composers & Lyricists (SCL) Awards.
  • Spearhead submission reels and supporting materials, including music assets, credits, and required documentation.
  • Manage awards accounts and profiles; track eligibility, categories, lists, deadlines, submissions, and status.
  • Coordinate with talent representatives, labels, internal awards and publicity teams, and other partners to ensure accurate, timely submissions and communicate action items.

Premieres, Screenings & Events

  • Manage quarterly music department screenings and composer or artist hosted screenings for internal teams and external partners.
  • Manage invitations, guest lists, RSVPs, print requests, security, drive-ons, venue coordination, and guest accommodations.
  • Partner with events, publicity, security, and operations teams to execute screenings smoothly.
  • Staff premieres and support composers, songwriters, artists, and music partners throughout event and red-carpet activity.

Campaign & Project Management

  • Manage concurrent release, social, publicity, awards, and event workstreams from planning through completion.
  • Maintain campaign timelines, release calendars, asset and awards trackers, meeting follow-ups, and status updates.
  • Identify and resolve scheduling, asset, approval, eligibility, and communication issues; serve as a central point of contact across internal and external teams.
  • Track campaign activity and identify opportunities to improve collaboration, efficiency, reach, and engagement.
  • Experience in music or soundtrack marketing, record labels, artist or film marketing, entertainment publicity, awards, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of music release campaigns and how publicity, social, digital platforms, talent, labels, awards organizations, and film marketing work together.
  • Proven ability to independently manage multiple projects, stakeholders, deadlines, detailed submissions, and time-sensitive materials.

The Manager, Strategic Enablement is a member of the Platform Distribution & Partnerships (PD&P) Partner Operations team. This role leads cross-functional projects and programs that translate distribution deals and strategic initiatives, deal terms, partner commitments, and business requirements into clear execution plans. The Manager also owns and continuously improves the department’s portfolio tools and workflows in Smartsheet and JIRA, creating reliable visibility into priorities, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and delivery health. We're not looking for someone to simply collect updates but rather someone who can drive teams to collaborate on solutions, connect dots and bring teams together to deliver outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Lead multiple cross-functional programs and projects from intake and requirements definition through execution, launch, transition, and closeout.
  • Execute distribution deal terms, partner requests, business decisions, structured requirements through creation and ownership of project plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and execution handoffs.
  • Own and administer the Strategic Enablement portfolio environment in Smartsheet and JIRA, including intake workflows, project structures, dashboards, reporting views, templates, status fields, permissions, and data standards.
  • Design and improve workflows that connect deal-cycle inputs to execution, including requirements capture, prioritization, change control, escalation, status reporting, and closure criteria.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Business Development, Legal, Product, Technology, Partner Operations, Distribution Solutions, Data, Advertising, Finance, and other stakeholders to align requirements, ownership, timing, and delivery expectations.
  • Create integrated project plans and roadmaps that connect contractual commitments, product and technology delivery, operational readiness, partner dependencies, and commercialization activities.
  • Run portfolio operating rhythms, including intake reviews, project health reviews, cross-functional status meetings, leadership updates, and decision forums; prepare agendas, facilitate discussion, document decisions, and drive follow-through.
  • Maintain accurate portfolio-level visibility across active initiatives, including milestones, risks, blockers, resource constraints, decision needs, and upcoming commitments.
  • Produce concise, executive-ready dashboards, portfolio summaries, steering committee materials, project updates, and decision documents that make complex work easy to understand and act on.
  • Identify delivery risks and process gaps early, facilitate mitigation plans, and escalate decisions with clear options, impacts, and recommendations.
  • Build scalable templates, playbooks, standard operating procedures, and reusable program frameworks that improve consistency across deals and reduce manual or duplicative work.
  • Support broader department priorities, including portfolio planning, operating-model improvements, tool adoption, process transformation, and special projects.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, program or project management, media, technology, operations, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+  years of experience in program management, project management, business operations, strategic enablement, transformation, media distribution, digital products, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated success leading multiple complex, cross-functional initiatives with evolving requirements and senior stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience building, administering, and improving portfolio solutions with project management and data visualization tools.
  • Strong command of project and portfolio management practices, including intake, prioritization, planning, dependency management, risk and issue management, change control, governance, and executive reporting.
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex information for leadership and delivery teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across business, legal, product, technology, operations, and partner-facing organizations.
  • Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills and proficiency with Microsoft 365 collaboration tools, including Copilot.; PMP, Certified ScrumMaster, or Smartsheet certification is a plus.

Desired Qualifications

  • Business-first operator who can connect commercial intent to practical product, technology, and operational execution.
  • Proactive portfolio owner who improves tools and processes rather than simply maintaining them.
  • Clear, concise communicator who can move comfortably between executive narratives and detailed project artifacts.
  • Collaborative leader who creates accountability, transparency, and alignment without adding unnecessary process burden.
  • Comfortable challenging unclear assumptions, surfacing trade-offs, and guiding teams toward decisions.
  • Strong problem-solver who thrives in complexity.
  • High attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to create structure and momentum in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Knowledge of media and entertainment distribution, streaming, TVE, dMVPD, FAST, SVOD, advertising, measurement, or digital product operations.

Work with a driven and highly motivated team to support the On-Air Operations of NBC Universal, one of the world’s leading media and entertainment companies. As a Master Control Operator at NBC Universal, you will be responsible for all aspects of maintaining and ensuring the reliability of all NBCU Cable Networks channels including live execution of events for news, entertainment, and sports. Will be required to monitor and recover live networks for all NBCU Cable channels.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform the duties of a live sports master control operator in a fast paced environment, including taking ownership of manipulating commercial playlists, executing program/commercial/marketing changes, managing playlists, sending logs for reconciliation and maintaining the overall reliability and execution of live sports network broadcasts using cutting edge software SNELL Morpheus and Amagi. 
  • Monitor and maintain the continuity and availability for all Networks and distribution channels.
  • Perform control room duties (Technical Director, Commercial Integration, and Associate Director) to support live events.
  • Receive and execute direction of the networks operating.
  • Perform ingest and quality control duties for on-air content airing on sports networks.
  • Work well within a team environment. 
  • Continue to exceed expectations in on-air reliability and customer service for all NOC clientele.
  • Ensure reliability of on-air schedules in a dynamic environment.
  • Act as the last line of defense for internal clients and stations, swiftly responding to any on-air discrepancies with situational awareness and quick decision-making skills.
  • Protect our airwaves by meticulously simulating the viewer experience, constantly checking for proper audio, video, captioning, and picture quality.
  • Collaborate with Operation Supervisors and work as a cohesive team to promptly recover from any on-air discrepancies.
  • Act as a mentor and subject matter expert by contributing and supporting on-going 1:1 peer-to-peer training.
  • Perform all other duties to support the success of the Network Operations Center as assigned by manager and follow company rules and policies

Requirements:

  • A High School Diploma and relevant certification or Associate's Degree in Media or Communications, or equivalent professional experience in broadcast, digital, or post production role.
  • A solid understanding of television production, broadcast operations, and/or news/sports/entertainment technical production requirements.

Desired Characteristics:

  • BA/BS in related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in an On-air broadcast environment with a proven understanding of live “on-air” broadcast operations execution.
  • 2+ years of experience in a live environment, specifically a strong background in executing live sports broadcasts.
  • 2+ years of experience demonstrating an overall understanding & knowledge of the television production process, broadcast operations & news/sports/entertainment technical production requirements.
  • 2+ years of proven knowledge of switchers, routers, communications, ingest and automation systems.
  • 2+ years of experience in ingest and quality control processes.
    Proven ability to handle multiple tasks and pressure situations. Ability to be flexible in approach and respond well to pressure.
  • Proven leadership, high energy level, strong attention to detail and strong team and communication skills.
  • Extensive and significant experience, understanding and knowledge of digital broadcast and production technical systems, standards and processes.
  • Technical experience with automated, real-time systems, digital video and audio troubleshooting and test techniques.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience with work rules and scheduling.

Additional Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV through www.nbcunicareers.com to be considered.
  • Must be willing to work in Stamford, CT- This position is fully onsite with no ability to work hybrid or work from home.
  • Must have unrestricted employment authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be at least 18 years old.
  • Must be willing and available to work any shift including overnight shifts, weekends, and holidays to meet the needs of a 24x7/365 operation, with possibility of schedule changes based on business needs and priorities.
  • Must be willing and able to view all content including that considered to be mature in nature, repetitive, and potentially controversial

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from Universal City, CA.

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)  

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews   

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews  

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers  

To Apply:

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.
  • Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).
  • Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program.

Operations & Technology, Media Tech: Here at NBCU, we strive to be at the forefront of leading-edge technology and are looking for the next generation of technologists to join our Media Tech Internship Program.

The Media Tech Internship Program provides students with practical experience across NBCUniversal’s Operations & Technology organization, giving interns the opportunity to apply their technical skills to real-world projects while gaining exposure to the teams and technologies that power our business.

The internship also serves as a key entry point into our early-career technology pipeline and the primary pathway for consideration into the Media Tech Associate Program, our two-year rotational program designed to build technical breadth, business knowledge, and professional skills through meaningful work experiences, mentorship, networking, and development opportunities.

Throughout the internship, students will gain insight into how one of the world’s leading media and entertainment companies uses technology to solve business challenges, build innovative solutions, and shape the future of media.

Many of our past interns have gone on to join the Media Tech Associate Program. More information can be found at nbcunicareers.com/mediatech/associate-program.

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Platform Engineering: The NBCUniversal Operations & Technology (O&T) Platform Engineering team develops and supports enterprise platforms and capabilities spanning API management, API governance, and AI enablement. Our engineers work closely with application development, product, and cybersecurity teams to support technology powering consumer-facing experiences and business operations across NBCUniversal, including News, Sports, Studios, and Universal Destinations & Experiences. Our work plays an important role in strengthening the company's technology ecosystem by improving visibility into API traffic, maintaining a comprehensive API inventory, and helping engineering and cybersecurity teams understand and manage the services supporting our business. Interns will gain exposure to enterprise-scale engineering challenges, modern cloud and edge technologies, AI-assisted development, and the processes used to build and operate secure, reliable platforms.
  • Studio Production Technology: Our Studio Production Technology team supports film and television productions across NBCUniversal, including Universal Pictures, Illumination, DreamWorks Animation, Focus Features, UCP, UTV, UTAS, UIS, and Peacock. We partner with production, engineering, cybersecurity, and operations teams to deliver secure, enterprise-grade technology solutions that enable productions to operate efficiently and at scale. An intern on our team would gain exposure to business analysis, technology strategy, production systems, enterprise platforms, and emerging technologies such as AI, while working with stakeholders across both Film and TV. Current areas of focus include modernizing production systems, standardizing tools and processes across productions, improving identity and access management, expanding cloud-based solutions, and exploring innovative technologies that enhance production workflows and collaboration.
  • Product & AI Solutions: As part of Studio Tech Solutions, our group, Product & AI Solutions, focuses on Product Management and AI. Interns will gain exposure to how technology products are developed and used to solve real business problems. On the product side, they will learn about product management, project management, Salesforce solutions, and data modeling. On the AI side, they will gain practical experience with prompt engineering, AI agents, governance, and other emerging AI technologies.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in Universal City, CA.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Programming Fundamentals: Experience with Python or a comparable programming language, including writing, debugging, and testing application code. Python is preferred.
  • API Development and Integration: Understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, JSON, and API authentication concepts. Previous experience building or integrating with at least one API is highly desirable.
  • Source Control and Automation: Familiarity with Git, GitHub, and collaborative development workflows. Exposure to GitHub Actions or other CI/CD tools is a plus.
  • AI-Assisted Software Development: Experience with, or a strong interest in, AI-powered coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or OpenAI Codex. Familiarity with AI agents, prompt engineering, or LLM-based integrations is a plus.
  • Experience with Microsoft tools such as Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Excel, or SQL through coursework, projects, or internships.

The hourly rate for student interns is $43.00 for Platform Engineering.

The hourly rate for student interns is $38.00 for Studio Production Technology and Product & AI Solutions.
