job.title: MEP & Site Utilities Manager
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal is seeking a Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) and Site Utilites Manager to join the Facilities Operations and Engineering team in Universal City, CA.

The MEP & Site Utilities Manager provides technical and operational leadership for the mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and utility infrastructure supporting a large-scale, mission-critical facility or campus.

You will be responsible for ensuring the safety, reliability, efficiency, and resiliency of critical building and utility systems, including electrical distribution, HVAC and central plant equipment, plumbing, water, natural gas, stormwater, wastewater, and emergency power systems.

You will lead preventive and predictive maintenance strategies, infrastructure reliability initiatives, capital improvement projects, utility planning, emergency response, and regulatory compliance. You will also oversee multidisciplinary technical teams, contractors, vendors, and engineering partners while collaborating closely with Facilities, Engineering, Construction, Operations, EHS, Finance, Sustainability, and other business stakeholders.

What You’ll Do:

Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing & Critical Infrastructure Operations

  • Serve as the primary technical and operational resource for MEP systems and site utility infrastructure, directing the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and modernization of critical systems across multiple facilities.
  • Oversee medium- and low-voltage electrical distribution, including transformers, switchgear, substations, motor control centers, generators, automatic transfer switches, and UPS systems.
  • Manage central utility plants, chillers, cooling towers, chilled water systems, pumps, air handling units, HVAC, and building automation systems, as well as domestic water, sanitary sewer, stormwater, natural gas, industrial piping, drainage, and pumping stations.
  • Ensure equipment and infrastructure are maintained in accordance with engineering standards, manufacturer requirements, operating procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with engineering, construction, environmental health and safety, sustainability, security, and business units to evaluate equipment capacity, system redundancy, and expansion requirements, and to align infrastructure operations with production schedules, facility occupancy, and organizational priorities.

Infrastructure Reliability & Business Continuity

  • Develop and manage preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance programs for mission-critical infrastructure.
  • Lead risk assessments, equipment condition evaluations, and root-cause investigations; implement sustainable corrective actions to reduce equipment failures and unplanned outages.
  • Maintain emergency response plans, utility shutdown procedures, contingency strategies, and recovery plans; coordinate planned shutdowns with affected business units to minimize disruption(s).
  • Evaluate system redundancy, backup generation, UPS capacity, and emergency cooling, and support business continuity efforts during utility failures, natural disasters, and other critical events.

Site-Wide Utilities & Energy Management

  • Oversee electrical, natural gas, domestic water, wastewater, stormwater, and other utility services supporting facility and campus operations.
  • Build productive relationships and coordinate with public utilities, municipalities, regulatory agencies, engineering consultants, equipment manufacturers, and service providers on capacity, upgrades, planned shutdowns, and emergency restoration.
  • Monitor demand, peak loads, consumption, and system capacity to support planning for new construction, facility expansion, and changing operational requirements.
  • Drive utility reliability, energy efficiency, demand management, electrification, renewable energy, and distributed generation or microgrid initiatives.

Capital Projects & Infrastructure Modernization

  • Develop, prioritize, and execute capital improvement projects focused on infrastructure reliability, lifecycle replacement, energy efficiency, and long-term facility needs.
  • Manage MEP and utility projects from feasibility and design through procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout.
  • Prepare scopes of work, technical requirements, cost estimates, schedules, and capital justifications; review engineering drawings, specifications, submittals, and construction plans.
  • Coordinate architects, engineers, contractors, specialty trades, vendors, and internal stakeholders, evaluating lifecycle cost and total cost of ownership to ensure projects meet safety, budget, schedule, and operational requirements.

Team Leadership & Operational Management

  • Lead and provide technical direction to multidisciplinary facilities personnel, technicians, supervisors, engineering partners, and contractors.
  • Establish work priorities, performance expectations, and accountability; oversee daily maintenance, preventive maintenance schedules, work orders, inspections, and emergency repairs.
  • Support technical training, performance evaluations, employee development, workforce planning, and succession planning.
  • Manage vendor performance, service agreements, and service-level expectations while fostering a culture of safety, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Financial Management & Operational Budgeting

  • Develop and manage operating budgets, maintenance expenses, service contracts, and capital funding for MEP and utility infrastructure.
  • Evaluate replacement costs, project estimates, and infrastructure investments; prepare forecasts, budget justifications, and capital recommendations for senior management.
  • Manage vendor proposals, competitive bids, contract negotiations, purchase approvals, and project cost controls.
  • Identify cost savings through energy optimization, maintenance efficiencies, lifecycle planning, and strategic procurement while balancing reliability, safety, business continuity, and long-term asset preservation.

Regulatory Compliance, Safety & Risk Management

  • Ensure operations, maintenance, construction, and infrastructure modifications comply with applicable codes, standards, safety requirements, and environmental regulations.
  • Promote compliance with OSHA/Cal-OSHA requirements, NFPA standards, electrical safety practices, lockout/tagout, confined-space, and contractor safety requirements.
  • Coordinate inspections, permits, testing, certifications, and corrective actions; maintain operating procedures, safety records, inspection reports, and maintenance histories.
  • Identify operational hazards and infrastructure risks and implement mitigation strategies to protect personnel, facilities, equipment, and business operations.

Facilities Technology & Performance Reporting

  • Utilize CMMS, IWMS, BMS, asset management, and infrastructure monitoring technologies, including Archibus, ArcGIS/ESRI, Siemens, Tridium, and comparable systems.
  • Maintain accurate asset inventories, equipment records, electrical single-line diagrams, utility maps, and infrastructure drawings.
  • Establish KPIs, outage tracking, and dashboards for infrastructure availability, utility reliability, maintenance performance, asset condition, energy consumption, safety, and capital project delivery.
  • Use performance data, trends, and condition assessments to inform risk-based maintenance and capital decisions, and communicate infrastructure risks, service interruptions, project milestones, capital requirements, and technical recommendations to senior leadership.

Let’s Talk About You…

  • Analytical - You create tools and processes quickly and accurately to provide job estimates for clients levering deep industry experience, historical trends, teams and vendor relationships.
  • Executer - You get things done and take accountability! Using strong business acumen, organizational and superior process/project management skills, you prioritize and execute numerous complex projects in parallel.
  • Customer Service Skills - You communicate effectively and solve problems to drive customer service and make client delivery a priority. 
  • Principles- Displays integrity, responsibility, accountability, teamwork, and ethics.
  • Team Player Fosters a culture of teamwork, mutual respect, and collaboration across diverse teams. Builds and maintains strong, productive relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Leadership - You are a proven leader known to challenge the status quo, introduce new and better ways of delivering results, and make difficult decisions and lead through change.

 

What You Must Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Facilities Management, Construction Management, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in facilities engineering, MEP systems, utility infrastructure, industrial maintenance, critical facilities, or a related environment.
  • 3+ years of leadership experience managing technical employees, contractors, maintenance operations, engineering functions, or multidisciplinary facilities teams.
  • Strong technical understanding of electrical distribution, HVAC and mechanical infrastructure, plumbing systems, utility distribution, emergency power, and critical facility systems.
  • Experience developing or managing preventive maintenance and infrastructure reliability programs.
  • Experience supporting equipment replacement, infrastructure upgrades, troubleshooting, and capital improvement projects.
  • Demonstrated experience working with contractors, engineering consultants, vendors, and construction partners.
  • Working knowledge of relevant building, electrical, life-safety, environmental, and workplace safety requirements and operating procedures.
  • Strong project management, budgeting, procurement, analytical, and technical reporting skills.

What Would Make You a Stand-out:

  • Experience supporting large commercial campuses, entertainment or production facilities, industrial operations, data centers, healthcare environments, or other mission-critical facilities.
  • Experience with medium-voltage electrical distribution, central utility plants, emergency power, redundant infrastructure, and large-scale utility systems.
  • Experience with infrastructure modernization, lifecycle replacement programs, and complex capital projects.
  • Knowledge of utility planning, energy management, renewable energy, distributed generation, electrification, or microgrid technologies.
  • Experience with facilities and asset management technologies such as Archibus, ArcGIS/ESRI, Siemens, Tridium, CMMS, IWMS, or BMS platforms.
  • PE, CEM, PMP, CFM, or similar technical or facilities-related credentials are a plus.
  • Studio Lot experience.
  • Experience managing in a union environment.

Additional Requirements:

  • Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $90,000-$115,000 (bonus eligible)

Telemundo Sacramento is seeking a highly qualified individual with a strong background in television news production. The ideal candidate will possess exceptional writing and verbal communication skills in Spanish, along with a solid understanding of editing systems and camera operations. This individual will be responsible for shooting, writing, creating, and editing original news stories; gather information for news stories using beat sources, contacts and leads.

  • Will coordinate, organize, conduct and video-record interviews in Spanish.
  • Deliver news reports demonstrating energy, confidence, professional appearance, and voice quality.
  • Presents complete stories that are accurate, journalistically sound, fair and balanced in Spanish.
  • Responsibilities also include keeping up to date on current events and local news.
  • Must be able to work independently using a video camera for news gatherings. 
  • Will report Live during newscasts and breaking news as needed, out in the field.
  • Will work directly with News Director, Executive Producer and News Producers on story ideas and development.
  •  Post video, pictures and stories to websites, Facebook, and other social media outlets under the direction of our Digital content producers. 
  • Will develop on-going “sweeps” and “special series” stories.
  • Build relationships with the community and contacts for developing story leads.
  • Journalist will be expected to participate in community events and station activities from time to   time as master of ceremonies and/or Host as requested by the station.
  • Participation in station special events is required.
  • Manage general upkeep of assigned company equipment.

Basic Qualifications

  • Fluency in Spanish and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both languages.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a Reporter working in Spanish market broadcast television.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Bilingual journalist.
  • Develop and maintain a network of contacts providing access to exclusive stories.
  • Establish sources, finding and executing enterprise news investigations, building and maintaining a strong list of story ideas.
  • Maintain a positive work atmosphere by behaving and communicating in a manner that works well with coworkers, supervisors, and the community at large. 

Eligibility Requirements

  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
  • Must be 18 years or older.
  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV online to considered at nbcunicareers.com
  • Must be able to provide reel examples -- if available, include a web address when you submit your resume (if applicable).
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule in a 24/7 news environment in addition to standard hours.
  • Must be willing to work in the Sacramento, CA area.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must be willing to work long hours, varying shifts (including nights, weekends and holidays) and report to work in emergencies depending upon news coverage when necessary.

Desired Characteristics

  • Be informed of news events locally and nationally.
  • Ability to ad-lib and improvise effortlessly in various types of on-air situations.
  • Must work well under pressure with an ability to meet deadlines.
  • Independent problem solving & multi-tasking.

Additional Requirements

Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite (Sacramento, CA).

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. job.title: Multiplatform Story Producer, Telemundo T20 San Diego
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

As a Bilingual Multiplatform Story Producer, you will be required to create and produce news content for broadcast or digital platforms based on daily newsroom needs. This role requires strong editorial judgment, adaptability, and the ability to deliver accurate, compelling content under deadline. 

Job Responsibilities 

  • Gather, research, write, and edit local news content, focusing on our brand pillars of breaking news, weather, consumer, investigative, and stories that impact our community. 
  • Write, edit, and publish stories, prepare pre-pro elements, text articles, video clips, packages, and digital elements.  
  • Back up producer for both linear and streaming platforms when necessary 
  • Collaborate with producers, reporters, and talent on both broadcast and digital platforms. 
  • Edit live event coverage or breaking news footage for quick turnaround, ensuring stories are engaging, visually compelling, and delivered under tight deadlines. 
  • Publish content across platforms, including broadcast, digital, social, streaming and emerging platforms. 
  • Manage video livestreams when necessary 
  • Stay well-informed of daily news events and knowledgeable of the San Diego news market 
  • Contribute story ideas, participate in daily coverage decisions and editorial meetings 
  • Perform other related duties as assigned 

Basic Qualifications 

  • Fluency in Spanish and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both languages.
  • A minimum of 2 years of experience as broadcast line producer and/or digital producer 
  • Bachelor’s degree in communication, journalism or related field 
  • At least 1-year prior news editing experience 
  • Familiarity with Adobe Premiere and/or other editing programs  
  • Ability to work on multiple tasks and stories simultaneously in a fast-paced environment 
  • Ability to react to breaking news, updating the news as stories evolve and write intros and leads to video online content 
  • Experience working with online publishing tools or content management system 
  • Demonstrated knowledge of AP style writing and guidelines 

Eligibility Requirements

  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States 
  • Must be 18 years or older 
  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV and Demo Reel/Portfolio through the www.nbcunicareers.com site 
  • Internal applicants must submit via myNBCU Careers 
  • Must be willing to work at the station in San Diego location 
  • Must have valid driver’s license 
  • Must have ability to work any of a 24x7 shift 
  • Must submit a sample of own work to be considered 

Desired Characteristics

  • Demonstrated leadership abilities and communication skills 
  • Experience writing scripts, captions and text for video graphics

  • Paid company holidays for full-time interns.  
  • Robust networking, learning and development opportunities.
  • Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship.
  • Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship.
  • Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions.
  • Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer. 

Summer 2027 Program Details

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need. 

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from Needham, MA.

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews  

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers  

To Apply:

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.

NBCUniversal Local is NBCUniversal’s local media division that delivers English and Spanish-speakers and bilingual audiences in 31 U.S. markets and Puerto Rico, the very best in local sports, news, weather, consumer and investigative reporting, and lifestyle entertainment across any platform and screen. NBCUniversal Local is comprised of three individual media groups including the NBC Owned Television Stations, the NBC Sports Regional Networks and the Telemundo Station Group. NBCUniversal Local’s stations and networks serve diverse audiences and communities across linear, streaming, OTT, digital web, mobile and audio, and cable platforms and work together to keep local audiences informed anytime and anywhere.       

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:  

  • NBC Boston News: The NBC Boston News internship offers hands-on experience in the editorial process, including planning, researching, newsgathering, writing, and editing. The intern will learn both editorial and technical aspects of news production, shadow producers and assignment editors, and create individual news stories for demo reels and online platforms. Additional responsibilities include participating in studio anchor sessions, assisting with viewer calls and tips, and contributing to special projects.   
  • Sports News: The Sports News intern will collaborate with content producers across social, digital, linear, and audio platforms. The role involves hands-on experience in content creation, including shooting and editing video, designing graphics, executing social media content, creating motion graphics, conducting research, archiving feeds, and writing copy.  
  • Digital: The Digital internship involves creating and adapting content for digital platforms, including pitching, reporting, and writing news and feature stories, as well as producing and editing video pieces for social media in collaboration with digital staff and on-air reporters. Interns will transform linear broadcasts into short-form content, identify opportunities for interactive engagement and data visualization, and cut video for use across websites, apps, and social channels. Additionally, the role includes shadowing various newsroom professionals and assisting with social media management. 
  • Creative Services/Social Media: This internship will support station marketing strategies and initiatives across various digital platforms, including social media and YouTube. Responsibilities include story selection and editing of social videos for NBC10 accounts, collaborating with the Programming Department on content for The Hub Happenings and community initiatives, creating daily YouTube thumbnails, attending on-site events to capture photos and videos for social media, and brainstorming creative ideas to engage followers and elevate marketing messages across all platforms. 
  • Original Content & Community: This internship will involve learning to write on-air scripts, produce segments, and assist with field shoots. Responsibilities include managing on-site guests, running the teleprompter, editing video and social media content, planning live shots, researching community features, and writing web articles. The role also involves helping with the logistics, data, and activations of community campaigns.  
  • Sales/Marketing: The Sales Marketing Internship assists with partnership initiatives, sponsorship fulfillment, and proof-of-performance executions, including gathering sponsorship clips and screengrabs, maintaining updated tracking documents, and working with Creative Services, Operations, and other internal teams to provide materials for Recaps and Special Requests.  

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in Needham, MA.  

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Pursuing a degree in Journalism or Broadcast Journalism, Digital/New Media Studies, Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, Production, English, Social Media, or Research.   
  • Bilingual in Spanish and English a plus (written and verbal).  
  • Commitment to building an inclusive work environment.  
  • Ability to multitask and highly organized.  
  • Excellent verbal and written communication.  
  • Previous internship experience within a corporate setting.  
  • Experience with Social Media Platforms, Final Cut Pro, Adobe Creative Suite, and SEO tools such as Google Trends a plus.  

The hourly rate for student interns is $19.00.

More Americans watch NBC News than any news organization in the world. NBC News’ leading and award-winning television news broadcasts include TODAY, NBC Nightly News, Meet the Press, and Dateline NBC. The rapidly-growing NBC News Digital Group – including its streaming news services NBC News NOW and TODAY All Day – and the network’s award-winning original podcast and audio unit provide continuous content to consumers wherever they are, whenever they want it.

NBCUniversal Local is NBCUniversal’s local media division that delivers English and Spanish-speakers and bilingual audiences in U.S. markets and Puerto Rico, the very best in local sports, news, weather, consumer and investigative reporting, and lifestyle entertainment across any platform and screen. NBCUniversal Local is comprised of three individual media groups including the NBC Owned Television Stations, the NBC Sports Regional Networks and the Telemundo Station Group. NBCUniversal Local’s stations and networks serve diverse audiences and communities across linear, streaming, OTT, digital web, mobile and audio, and cable platforms and work together to keep local audiences informed anytime and anywhere.

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • NBC News Digital Creative Design/UX: As a part of the Product and Design team at NBC News Digital, you’ll join in as we design the future of our products, supporting flexible systems that fuel brands like NBC News, TODAY, Telemundo, and more. Our team of designers are involved from strategy to execution for our mobile apps, OTT platform, web experiences, and the Big Board used on broadcast. You will also have the opportunity to gain exposure to our cross-functional teams and learn from product, engineering, and user insights leaders in addition to being embedded in the design team.
  • NBC News Data/Graphics: This team is responsible for explaining the news through visualizations and data analysis. We build interactives, charts, maps, illustrations, graphics and more to tell the news in a compelling and thoughtful way. The intern should be interested in data visualizations and be an avid news reader. You should have an interest in data journalism and will help find stories that we could be telling in a new and visual way. You will also help create charts, maps and graphics for breaking news stories and for reported features.
  • NBC News Mobile App Development: The team is responsible for designing, developing and testing NBC News’s flagship Android/iOS applications. The intern will be working on native mobile applications across all the NBC News brands and collaborate with developers, product and project management in shipping out features. The intern will be mentored by senior developers in the team and will be guided in their work. The intern will be working on various team initiatives following engineering best practices and writing quality code.
  • NBC News Digital – Software Engineering: As a Software Engineer Intern, you will partner with the Product, Operations, Design, and Editorial teams to bring NBC News Digital content to life. You will be a significant influence on our product roadmap, bringing a technical and strategic perspective. You will work alongside fellow inspired developers in a fast-paced environment using technologies like Sass, React.js and GraphQL to help shape the future of digital news.
  • NBCU Local HQ Digital Agile: NBCUniversal Local is NBCUniversal’s local media division that delivers English and Spanish speakers and bilingual audiences in 31 U.S. markets and Puerto Rico the very best in local sports, news, weather, consumer and investigative reporting, and lifestyle entertainment across any platform and screen. This candidate will be working with the digital Product & Technology team and have in-depth exposure to the development and release of digital products across multiple platforms: Desktop, MobileWeb, OTT, and Mobile Apps. Working with the Agile Program Team, the candidate will have a high-level introduction to Agile Project Management for Local News. 

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program.

job.title: NBC News Product Manager
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

As our NBC News Product Manager, you’ll own the strategy, execution and successful delivery of audience and revenue-driving initiatives, developing features, robust subscriber experiences and insights across our award-winning, market-leading news products. You’ll thrive making impactful decisions for a brand customers know and trust, based on a deep understanding and ability to draw actionable insights from user data and research, and be acknowledged as the company’s expert in the space.

Your passion will be to discover, develop and ship products and features which deliver both meaningful benefit to our users and strategic business growth success for our company.

Day-to-day, you’ll succeed by learning which solutions are simultaneously impactful, usable, valuable, and feasible, through product discovery, clear prioritization of effort and collaborative design thinking. You’ll lead, coach and motivate a dedicated, cross-functional Agile team by communicating your vision, authoring user stories, optimizing team welfare and experience, actively prioritizing the backlog, and coordinating regularly and clearly with partners, external vendors and stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and share a deep understanding of the customer, data, business, and industry
  • Establish, articulate, and advocate product vision, strategy, and what business-facing success looks like
  • Define and build consensus on meaningful metrics for success
  • Prioritize upcoming sprints, features and enhancements in story backlog
  • Build and maintain roadmap (annual and quarterly KPIs and OKRs) to ensure alignment and focus on resourcing, progress and success
  • Create a clear path for defining value for users and business growth
  • Author use cases and user stories and build shared understanding around user needs and the definition of “done”
  • Identify and implement opportunities to reduce technical, business and user experience debt
  • Discover value-driven opportunities via product discovery experiments and methods
  • Identify and map customer goals, values and needs rather than “wants” or “table stakes”
  • Inform decisions with unbiased qualitative and quantitative data
  • Ensure good communication and transparency by partnering with internal teams including editorial, marketing, advertising, business development and others
  • Coordinate and collaborate with product peers and their teams to share learnings, leverage shared effort and ensure quality cross-platform experience
  • Minimum of 5+ years in digital growth experience, combined with domain subject-matter expertise and proven thought leadership. Digital subscription experience is preferred, but not required.
  • Proven ability to deliver successful, valuable customer and business outcomes
  • Strong user experience sensibilities
  • Strong experience with analytics, and using user research to drive decisions
  • Strong experience with Agile methodologies, sprints, prioritization and debt elimination

Desired Characteristics:

  • Human-centered thinking and a strong empathy for solving problems for customers
  • Exceptional written, spoken and visual communication skills
  • Exceptional storytelling skills
  • Exceptional organizational and analytical skills
  • Ability to speak fluently with business people, stakeholders, partners, engineers
  • Experience in the media, news, or technology/internet industries
  • Experience with Product Discovery, Design Thinking, Lean Product a plus

Additional Requirements:

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $130,000 - $160,000 (bonus eligible)

NBC4 is looking for an innovative, forward-thinking newscast producer with extensive experience handling live breaking news who is eager to reimagine the way local news is produced and presented.

We’re seeking a creative storyteller and strategic thinker with sound news judgment and a strong understanding of how audiences engage with content today. The ideal candidate will turn important stories into compelling, visually dynamic newscasts while developing fresh approaches for broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms.

Whether covering breaking news, producing daily newscasts, or developing special projects and major events, this producer will contribute original ideas, work closely with colleagues throughout the newsroom, and help advance the future of local journalism.

Responsibilities

  • Produce and execute daily newscasts that blend strong reporting, creative storytelling, innovative production, and effective showcasing to attract and engage viewers
  • Manage live breaking news coverage by making thoughtful, timely editorial decisions that balance speed, accuracy, creativity, and audience relevance across platforms, coordinating live components, and adjusting coverage as events unfold
  • Introduce fresh concepts and strong story angles, challenge conventional formats, explore new approaches to pacing and presentation, and identify tools that make coverage more engaging, relevant, and visually effective; guide daily coverage, special projects, and major events from initial concept through completion
  • Leverage video, graphics, sound, live shots, anchor interaction, and other production elements to create distinctive and memorable television
  • Write, edit, and adapt concise, conversational, headline-focused scripts and teases for broadcast and other platforms; produce, desktop edit, and gather material when necessary
  • Work with anchors, reporters, directors, content producers, and newsroom leaders to deliver polished, compelling programming
  • At least 5 years of experience producing daily newscasts in a major market
  • Extensive background producing live breaking news
  • Proven ability to write, produce, and desktop edit content
  • Proficiency with newsroom production systems and broadcast technology
  • Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays, when needed

Eligibility Requirements

  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/cover letter through nbcunicareers.com to be considered
  • Must be willing to work in Universal City, CA
  • Must have a valid driver’s license
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States

  • Knowledge of current events, politics, pop culture, and local communities (through email, social media, and news releases)
  • Los Angeles market experience and Spanish-language proficiency
  • Familiarity with multiple media platforms, ratings, audience data, and viewing trends
  • Commitment to high-quality journalism and curiosity about emerging technologies and the future of news
  • Strong writing skills, including teases and headlines
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, including experience partnering with anchors and directors
  • Strong strategic, research, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, manage time, and meet deadlines amid competing priorities

job.description:

NBC News is seeking a seasoned, driven Producer to support newsgathering, storytelling, and live production across all platforms. This role will work closely with a Correspondent and production teams to pitch, develop, report, and execute compelling journalism—from breaking news to in-depth features, investigative reporting to national coverage.

The ideal candidate is a creative journalist with sharp editorial judgment, strong writing and research skills, and the confidence to thrive under pressure. This producer should be equally at home in the field, on location, or in the control room, and adept at delivering both live and taped segments that meet NBC’s highest editorial standards. The ideal candidate is a news junkie who can’t wait to get out the door and, on the road, to cover that next story. This producer should also enjoy storytelling for morning television, an evening newscast and everything in between. The ability to shoot and edit is a plus, along with a sense of what does well on social media or in vertical video formats.

This role is right for you if you’re a versatile storyteller who thrives on urgency and impact. You move seamlessly between producing, reporting, and writing, and you’re as comfortable leading coverage during breaking news as you are crafting enterprise stories. You’re highly organized, competitive, and relentless about accuracy and detail—yet collaborative, adaptable, and energized by working with correspondents and teams under tight deadlines. Most importantly, you’re passionate about journalism that informs, engages, and makes a difference.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Correspondent and show teams to develop, report, and deliver strong, visually compelling stories with clear narratives and well-researched journalism.
  • Pitch, field produce, write, and fact-check stories across NBC News linear and streaming platforms, including daily news, longform pieces, and cross-platform content.
  • Conduct original reporting, deep research, and source interviews.
  • Secure guest bookings in a competitive environment; conduct pre-interviews and prepare talking points.
  • Ability to travel at a moment’s notice to cover a story and commit to staying on the road as long as the story takes.
  • Collaborate with control rooms, senior producers, and editorial teams to build rundowns, write intros, and produce live and taped segments.
  • Oversee field operations, including live shots, remote anchor setups, and breaking news coverage.
  • Track and manage correspondent’s schedule when working with them closely. 
  • Work closely with editors to ensure high-quality video packages, graphics, and sound.
  • Partner with Standards & Legal to ensure all content adheres to editorial and corporate guidelines.
  • Maintain strong communication between the Correspondent, senior leadership, assignment desk and production teams.
  • Contribute ideas for a wide range of content including news-of-day, lifestyle features, celebrity interviews, and human-interest stories.

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in network news, cable, or talk show production, including live and taped segments.
  • Strong journalistic writing, research, and editorial judgment skills.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of U.S. politics, current events, pop culture, and lifestyle trends.
  • Experience shooting (DSLR or iPhone) and editing (Avid and/or Adobe Premiere).
  • Strong ability to navigate newsroom tools and technology (Slack, NCX, Latakoo, etc.)
  • Proven ability to work in fast-paced environments under tight deadlines.
  • Must be willing to work nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime with short notice.
  • Must be able to travel frequently, domestically and internationally.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills; ability to collaborate across teams.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Strong storytelling ability with creativity in pitching original ideas.
  • Experience working with live programming.
  • Cool under pressure and comfortable managing breaking news situations.
  • A self-starter with strong organizational and multitasking skills.
  • Knowledge of NBC News Policies, Guidelines, and Practices.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal est l’une des principales entreprises de médias et de divertissement au monde. Nous créons du contenu de calibre mondial que nous diffusons par l’entremise de notre portefeuille de films, de télévision et de plateformes de diffusion en continu, et que nous faisons vivre grâce à nos destinations de parcs thématiques, à nos produits de consommation et à nos expériences partout dans le monde. Nous détenons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de diffusion en continu haut de gamme financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des films et des émissions de premier ordre par l’entremise de nos importants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que des quatre studios de télévision internationaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de premier plan partout dans le monde par l’entremise d’Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment Universal Orlando Resort, où se trouve Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Visitez www.nbcuniversal.com pour en savoir plus.

Notre impact repose sur notre volonté d’améliorer les communautés où vivent et travaillent les membres de notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics. Nous avons une longue tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à offrir aux membres de notre personnel la possibilité de s’investir au service de leurs communautés. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de proposer une vaste gamme de contenus qui reflètent notre monde.

We’re looking for a Producer for an exciting interactive entertainment project to support the creation, tracking, and execution of game assets for a discipline (environment, characters, audio, animation). In this role, you will help teams stay organized by maintaining asset schedules, tracking progress, coordinating priorities, following up on dependencies, and supporting milestone delivery.

You will work closely with craft directors, producers, pod leads, and multidisciplinary teams to define execution strategy of asset production from request through review, approval, integration, and delivery. You will help ensure creative and technical asset goals are translated into clear tasks, visible progress, and reliable execution across disciplines, pods, and pillars.

RESPONSIBILTIES

  • Formalize asset creation workflows and determine requirements for asset management.
  • Oversee, build and/or maintain asset schedules, task lists, production plans, and milestone deliverables.
  • Track daily progress across assigned teams and ensure asset status is accurate in project tools.
  • Maintain visibility on blockers, dependencies, approvals, reviews, known issues, and next steps.
  • Coordinate priorities between craft directors, product owners, producers, pod leads, and pillar needs.
  • Support asset reviews, feedback sessions, approvals, and follow-up actions.
  • Identify risks, blockers, or priority conflicts and escalate them to producers or production leadership.
  • Facilitate communication between design, engineering, art, animation, audio, QA, and other departments.
  • Help maintain production tracking tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.
  • Work with QA and development teams to ensure asset-related issues are tracked and followed up effectively.
  • Support milestone readiness by helping ensure asset deliverables, dependencies, reviews, and known issues are clearly tracked.
  • Help refine asset workflows, pipelines, tracking practices, and communication habits.
  • Contribute to retrospectives or post-milestone reviews and follow through on actionable improvements.

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

Nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne pour occuper le poste de producteur ou productrice dans le cadre d’un projet captivant de divertissement interactif, afin de soutenir la création, le suivi et l’exécution des éléments de jeu pour une discipline (environnements, personnages, audio, animation). Dans ce rôle, vous aiderez les équipes à rester organisées en tenant à jour les calendriers de production des éléments, en assurant le suivi de l’avancement, en coordonnant les priorités, en effectuant le suivi des dépendances et en soutenant la livraison des jalons.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de disciplines, les producteurs et productrices, les responsables de pods et les équipes multidisciplinaires afin de définir la stratégie d’exécution de la production des éléments, depuis la demande jusqu’à la révision, l’approbation, l’intégration et la livraison. Vous contribuerez à faire en sorte que les objectifs créatifs et techniques liés aux éléments soient traduits en tâches claires, en progrès visibles et en une exécution fiable dans l’ensemble des disciplines, des pods et des piliers.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Formaliser les flux de travail liés à la création des éléments et déterminer les exigences en matière de gestion des éléments.
  • Superviser, élaborer et/ou tenir à jour les calendriers de production des éléments, les listes de tâches, les plans de production et les livrables associés aux jalons.
  • Assurer le suivi quotidien de l’avancement des équipes assignées et veiller à ce que le statut des éléments soit exact dans les outils de gestion de projet.
  • Maintenir une visibilité claire sur les obstacles, les dépendances, les approbations, les révisions, les problèmes connus et les prochaines étapes.
  • Coordonner les priorités entre les responsables de disciplines, les responsables de produits, les producteurs et productrices, les responsables de pods et les besoins des différents piliers.
  • Soutenir les révisions des éléments, les séances de rétroaction, les approbations et les mesures de suivi.
  • Repérer les risques, les obstacles ou les conflits de priorités et les signaler aux producteurs et productrices ou à la direction de la production.
  • Faciliter la communication entre les équipes de design, d’ingénierie, d’art, d’animation, d’audio, de QA et les autres services.
  • Contribuer à la tenue à jour des outils de suivi de production tels que Jira, Confluence ou des outils similaires.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes de QA et de développement afin de veiller à ce que les problèmes liés aux éléments soient consignés et fassent l’objet d’un suivi efficace.
  • Soutenir la préparation des jalons en contribuant à assurer un suivi clair des livrables liés aux éléments, des dépendances, des révisions et des problèmes connus.
  • Contribuer à améliorer les flux de travail, les pipelines, les pratiques de suivi et les habitudes de communication liés aux éléments.
  • Contribuer aux rétrospectives ou aux revues post-jalon et assurer le suivi des améliorations pouvant être mises en œuvre.

Basic Requirements: 

  • 8+ years of experience in game production, asset coordination, project coordination, external development coordination, or related production roles.
  • Experience supporting content teams, asset production, or a related production role for a specific discipline.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to track multiple assets, tasks, dependencies, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Strong communication and follow-up skills.
  • Comfortable working with creative and technical teams across multiple disciplines.
  • Ability to clarify next steps, maintain visibility, and keep information organized.
  • Proactive mindset with a willingness to solve problems and remove friction.
  • Experience using JIRA or similar project management tools.
  • Interest in AAA game development, asset production, and content pipelines.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, changing environment with professionalism and adaptability.

Exigences de base : 

  • 8 ans ou plus d’expérience en production de jeux, en coordination d’éléments, en coordination de projets, en coordination du développement externe ou dans des rôles connexes en production.
  • Expérience dans le soutien d’équipes de contenu, la production d’éléments ou un rôle connexe en production pour une discipline précise.
  • Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et grand souci du détail.
  • Capacité à assurer le suivi de multiples éléments, tâches, dépendances, priorités et échéances.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en suivi.
  • Aisance à travailler avec des équipes créatives et techniques dans plusieurs disciplines.
  • Capacité à clarifier les prochaines étapes, à maintenir une bonne visibilité sur l’avancement et à garder l’information organisée.
  • Esprit proactif et volonté de résoudre les problèmes et d’éliminer les obstacles.
  • Expérience avec JIRA ou des outils de gestion de projet similaires.
  • Intérêt pour le développement de jeux AAA, la production d’éléments et les pipelines de contenu.
  • Capacité à travailler dans un environnement dynamique et en constante évolution, avec professionnalisme et adaptabilité.

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Experience with asset pipelines, review cycles, approvals, dependencies, and delivery tracking.
  • Experience with production tracking, asset lists, delivery reporting, or milestone planning.
  • Understanding of agile production, sprint planning, backlog tracking, or milestone execution.
  • Experience working with craft directors, pod leads, artists, designers, engineers, or QA teams.
  • Background in a creative production discipline.
  • Experience with tools such as Confluence, Miro, Perforce, Git, or build tracking systems.

Caractéristiques souhaitées : 

  • Expérience des pipelines d’éléments, des cycles de révision, des approbations, des dépendances et du suivi des livraisons.
  • Expérience du suivi de production, des listes d’éléments, des rapports de livraison ou de la planification des jalons.
  • Compréhension de la production Agile, de la planification des sprints, du suivi du backlog ou de l’exécution des jalons.
  • Expérience de travail avec des responsables de disciplines, des responsables de pods, des artistes, des designers, des ingénieurs ou des équipes de QA.
  • Expérience dans une discipline de production créative.
  • Expérience avec des outils tels que Confluence, Miro, Perforce, Git ou des systèmes de suivi des builds.

 Eligibility Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must apply to be considered.
  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week.
  • Must be willing to work overtime when required, in accordance with Quebec labor standards.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada.
  • Must be willing to travel for work related business, if necessary

Conditions d’admissibilité :

  • Les personnes intéressées doivent soumettre leur candidature afin d’être prises en considération.
  • La personne retenue doit être disposée à travailler à notre bureau de Montréal au moins 4 jours par semaine.
  • La personne retenue doit être disposée à faire des heures supplémentaires lorsque requis, conformément aux normes du travail du Québec.
  • La personne retenue doit être légalement autorisée à travailler au Canada.
  • La personne retenue doit être disposée à voyager pour des raisons professionnelles, au besoin.

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

job.title: Producer, Dateline NBC
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Dateline NBC is seeking an experienced Producer to develop, report, and produce longform investigative and true crime stories for broadcast, streaming, and digital platforms. Working closely with correspondents, senior producers, editors, legal teams, and production staff, the Producer will play a key role in all phases of production—from story development and reporting through scripting, field production, editing, and post-production.

The ideal candidate is a strong journalist and storyteller with exceptional editorial judgment, strong organizational skills, and a passion for investigative reporting and true crime programming.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, research, and produce original longform stories for Dateline NBC.
  • Conduct extensive reporting, including interviews with sources, attorneys, law enforcement officials, experts, and key stakeholders.
  • Identify, cultivate, and maintain relationships with sources and potential interview subjects.
  • Write and edit scripts, teases, and promotional materials.
  • Collaborate with correspondents to shape story structure and editorial direction.
  • Plan and oversee field shoots, including interviews, as well as character and location b-roll.
  • Work closely with editors to craft visually compelling, accurate, and engaging stories.
  • Review court records, legal filings, police reports, and other source materials to verify facts and support reporting.
  • Coordinate with Standards, Legal, and Rights & Clearances teams to ensure compliance with NBC News policies and practices.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting production deadlines.
  • Contribute story ideas and editorial updates as cases develop.
  • Collaborate with digital, streaming, audio and promotional teams to extend storytelling across platforms.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience producing longform news, documentary, investigative, or true crime programming.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience reporting, researching, and producing complex stories.
  • Experience managing productions and production budgets from development through post-production.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills.
  • Experience conducting interviews with victims, families, attorneys, and law enforcement personnel, and on sensitive subject matter.
  • Must be willing to travel domestically as needed.
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY or Los Angeles, CA.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Exceptional editorial judgment and journalistic integrity.
  • Strong knowledge of the criminal justice system, investigative journalism, and current events.
  • Ability to synthesize large volumes of information and identify compelling story angles.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize competing deadlines and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Familiarity with broadcast journalism guidelines, standards and ethics.

Additional Job Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week when not in the field. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $115,000 - $165,000

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

job.title: Producer, Telemundo T60 San Antonio
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

KVDA Telemundo San Antonio is seeking a Multiplatform Producer to join our award-winning team. The Multiplatform Producer will be responsible for successful coordination and execution of a newscast, other special programs as needed, content for all platforms including apps, social media accounts and streaming channels. This role will report to the Executive Producer.

We’re looking for someone who’s passionate about news, loves breaking news and has a creative vision for crafting live programs. You’ll work closely with managers to create innovative, up-to-the-minute content that resonates with our audiences. The ideal candidate loves to collaborate, wants to help lead a team, and is ready to take on new challenges to help us continue to grow.

Responsibilities

  • Understand and follow all Telemundo San Antonio News and NBC standards and ethics.
  • Responsible for multiple news cast production, content, and elements of the shows.
  • Responsible for being a strong communicator in the newsroom- talking with key stakeholders who will participate or provide content for that newscast (i.e. VP of News, Executive Producer, Managing Editor, anchors, Digital, MMJ's and production crews).
  • Coordinate Live Shots and Satellite Remotes during live newscasts.
  • Select, assign, write, and organize news stories. Write news scripts, headlines, teases and topicals.
  • Contribute story ideas, participate in daily coverage decisions and editorial meetings.
  • Must select stories, understand all the elements, and design a newscast that achieves the daily goal.
  • Knowledgeable on daily news events, awareness of past news events and know what news in the market.
  • Respond to breaking news with urgency and accuracy.
  • Develop special projects involving community and social content.
  • Work with Multimedia Journalists to improve story and presentation.
  • Work closely with VP. Of News, Executive Producer and Managing Editor on story/sweeps planning and coordination.
  • Complete discrepancy reports with detail and accuracy to help prevent future problems and cue sheet.
  • Support Talent with the creation of original digital content.
  • Contribute to the creation of video series for OTT, FAST and all platforms.
  • Understand newscast mission, station priorities and be familiar with all the platforms.
  • Leadership: take responsibility for own actions and take risks for the team and be a team player.
  • Be detail oriented, organized, and able to handle intense deadline pressure.

Basic Qualifications

  • Fluency in Spanish and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both languages
  • Minimum of 2 years producer experience
  • 1 year experience with writing and/or editing and/or producing daily video
  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism or media communication or equivalent experience products

Eligibility Requirements

  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV through nbcunicareers.com to be considered
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
  • Must be 18 years or older
  • Must have a valid driver's license
  • Must be available to work overtime, evenings, weekends and holidays as needed or required
  • Must have a flexible schedule with ability to work multiple shift and willingness to travel and work long hours and on weekends and holidays with short notice
  • Must be able to carry or lift 25 lbs.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Leadership qualities
  • Team player mentality
  • Exceptional communication skills
  • Excellent news instincts with the ability to react decisively to breaking news
  • Take an active role in selecting the stories of the day - come up with story ideas that reporters can turn in one day
  • Create producer driven content to enhance our coverage of the big story and other stories that appear in the newscast
  • Anticipate problems and address them throughout the course of the shift, eliminate all factual/spelling/other errors that appear in the show. If a problem arises, address it immediately
  • Ability to resolve conflict
  • Bring creativity into every aspect of the newscast
  • Ability to perform under tight time deadlines
  • Editing skills to edit video clips

Additional Job Requirements

Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

job.title: Product Design Internships – Summer 2027
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Your future in media starts here. The NBCUniversal Summer Internship Program is your chance to help shape what’s next in media and entertainment. Whether you’re supporting major news coverage, creating content for iconic brands, or contributing to innovative projects, you’ll bring your ideas, creativity, and perspective to make an impact throughout your internship.

Beyond your day-to-day role, you’ll take part in a thoughtfully designed program focused on career development, building your professional presence, and growing your workplace confidence. Through real-world experience and a community of fellow interns, you’ll explore what’s possible in this ever changing and exciting industry.

In addition to all of our internships being paid, we will also offer the following for our Summer 2027 interns:   

  • Paid company holidays for full-time interns.  
  • Robust networking, learning and development opportunities.
  • Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship.
  • Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship.
  • Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions.
  • Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer. 

Summer 2027 Program Details

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027

The Film & TV Studio group is looking for a Product Manager to lead the development and ongoing support of the Studio Distribution Applied AI and Analytics portfolio. This is a highly technical, hands-on role that combines product ownership, solution development, and technical leadership. The role partners directly with business teams to understand operational challenges, rapidly develop and iterate on solutions, and scale successful concepts into reliable production applications.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Business & Product Management

  • Develop and maintain relationships with Theatrical, Home Entertainment and Global Distribution business teams.
  • Learn how our content is created, marketed, and distributed worldwide and serve as the subject matter expert on the systems and data that enable these processes.
  • Identify opportunities for workflow transformation, serving as a trusted expert on operational workflow and data systems.
  • Translate business needs into working prototypes, gather user feedback, and rapidly iterate toward effective solutions.

Hands-On Solution Development:

  • Design and develop production applications, AI agents, analytics solutions, and automated workflows using technologies such as Python, Snowflake Cortex, LangGraph, Power Apps, and related platforms.
  • Take solutions from initial concept and proof-of-concept through production deployment, operationalization, and ongoing support.
  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, and data platform teams to translate repeatable business needs into scalable technical solutions.

Technical Leadership:

  • Lead solution design reviews that promote secure, maintainable, scalable solutions and consistent technical patterns across the portfolio.
  • Champion builder best practices including modular design, automated testing, CI/CD, design reviews, observability, and documentation.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other builders, sharing technical patterns, development best practices, and practical guidance.
  • Leverage observability tooling (metrics, logs, traces) and performance analytics to detect issues proactively and drive fast, data-driven root-cause analysis.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience developing and maintaining medium-to-large-scale products, including experience leading technically complex initiatives.
  • 3+ years of professional software development experience, including hands-on development in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar languages.
  • Experience designing, deploying, and supporting applications in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD workflows and experience using Git-based repositories, automated testing frameworks, and build pipelines.
  • Strong SQL skills with hands-on experience in writing complex queries involving multi-table joins and advanced analytical functions.
  • Experience building AI-powered workflows using LLMs, agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or similar tools.
  • Experience driving solutions from initial ideation and proof-of-concept through full-scale deployment.
  • Experience working in fast-paced or ambiguous environments where solutions evolve through rapid prototyping and user feedback.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across business and technical teams and bring together expertise from multiple functional domains to deliver solutions.
  • Strong understanding of product development lifecycles, SDLC practices, and iterative delivery methodologies.
  • Excellent written, oral, and presentation skills with the ability to effectively communicate across all levels of the organization

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field.
  • Experience in the global Media & Entertainment industry.
  • Demonstrated interest in evaluating emerging AI technologies and applying them pragmatically to business problems.

Additional Requirements:

This position has been designated as hybrid, which currently requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

The Producer/Reporter will generate original story ideas, cultivate sources, conduct interviews, and produce and present assigned stories and segments. Working closely with the Executive Producer, Line Producer, assignment editors, photographers, and other newsroom staff, this individual will contribute to the editorial direction and overall execution of Al Rojo Vivo.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate, pitch, research, and develop a wide variety of compelling story ideas that reflect the interests and needs of our viewers.
  • Actively participate in daily editorial meetings, presenting story pitches, identifying emerging news angles, and contributing to coverage planning.
