  • Research, write, produce, field-produce, edit, and present fair, accurate, and engaging news and feature stories for broadcast, digital, and mobile platforms.
  • Develop enterprise, exclusive, and original content that adds depth and perspective to coverage.
  • Independently research and develop assigned segments, working under the guidance of the Line Producer, General Producer, and/or Executive Producer.
  • Write compelling scripts, headlines, teases, and promotional copy that engage viewers and support the overall editorial vision of the show.
  • Collaborate with producers, photographers, editors, and other newsroom personnel to conceptualize, write, shoot, and produce stories.
  • Coordinate with Graphics, Technical Operations, Satellite Operations, the video library, and other departments to secure and track production elements and requests.
  • Assist the Line Producer with the production and execution of the show during and after tapings, including overseeing editorial elements and coordinating necessary content.
  • Communicate regularly with news producers, assignment editors, and newsroom managers regarding story development, field progress, breaking news, and production needs.
  • Fluency in Spanish and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both languages. 
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Television Production or an equivalent combination of education and experience 
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Communications, Journalism, or related field 
  • Knowledge of iNews and Media Central 

Eligibility Requirements

  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.

  • Must be able to perform job at locations in and outside work environment with varying weather conditions  

Desired Characteristics

  • Passionate about news/entertainment 
  • Energetic, and creative team player 
  • Creative, highly organized and detail oriented 
  • Strong interpersonal & Leadership skills 
  • Proactive thinker/self-starter 
  • Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and successfully manage multiple assignments

NBCUniversal Telemundo’s social media marketing team is seeking a Senior Analyst, Social Analytics & Listening to help measure and optimize social media campaigns and always-on social properties. In this role, you will use platform analytics, social listening, sentiment analysis, and audience insights to turn complex performance data and audience conversations into clear, actionable recommendations for internal partners. 

You will work across shows, franchises, brand initiatives, live events, campaigns, and other social properties. You will balance quantitative reporting with qualitative analysis to explain what audiences are saying, sharing, and responding to across social platforms.

Role Responsibilities 

  • Analyze performance across owned social platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, Threads, and additional relevant channels. 
  • Track and report social metrics for campaigns, launches, live events, tentpole moments, talent initiatives, and always-on properties. 
  • Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, recurring reporting templates, and campaign wrap reports. 
  • Measure performance against objectives, historical benchmarks, platform benchmarks, and campaign KPIs. 
  • Analyze results by platform, content format, show, campaign, talent, creative theme, audience segment, publishing cadence, and organic support, where applicable. 
  • Identify the drivers of strong and weak performance and provide concrete recommendations to improve future content and campaign results. 
  • Conduct data quality checks to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability across all reports. 
  • Develop property-specific benchmarks and performance narratives that help teams understand growth over time. 
  • Deliver mid-campaign performance reports that identify opportunities for real-time optimization. 
  • Own weekly and full recap performance reporting for assigned properties, including show accounts, brand accounts, franchises, talent-related properties, and other designated social channels. 
  • Partner with Social Creative teams to recommend changes to content, platform strategy, timing, and audience engagement. 
  • Create, maintain, and optimize social listening queries for shows, campaigns, cast, talent, brand initiatives, events, hashtags, and relevant cultural conversations. 
  • Monitor conversation volume, sentiment, net sentiment, key topics, fan reactions, audience questions, hashtags, emojis, keywords, emerging narratives, and viral moments. 
  • Analyze both quantitative social-listening data and qualitative fan commentary to understand why audiences are responding positively, negatively, or neutrally. 
  • Monitor sentiment changes before, during, and after major campaigns, episodes, premieres, finales, talent moments, and live events. 
  • Identify potential reputational issues, misinformation, recurring complaints, sensitive themes, and escalation-worthy conversations. 
  • Surface positive advocacy, fan-generated content, creator activity, and talent-related opportunities that can be amplified by the broader social team. 
  • Conduct competitive, industry, and cultural benchmarking as needed. 
  • Partner closely with Social Creative, Community Management, Production, Marketing, Production, Paid Media, and other relevant stakeholders. 
  • Participate in campaign planning, content planning, performance readouts, and post-mortem discussions. 
  • Work with Community Management to identify recurring fan feedback, sentiment issues, questions, and engagement opportunities. 

Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Media, Business, Social Sciences, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field. 
  • 5+ years of experience in social analytics, digital analytics, marketing research, social listening, audience insights, campaign measurement, or a related area. 
  • Demonstrated experience developing social media reports, dashboards, campaign recaps, and actionable insights. 
  • Strong knowledge of social platform metrics, content performance, audience behavior, social-media measurement, and reporting best practices. 
  • Experience using social listening tools, including building Boolean queries, developing keyword taxonomies, monitoring sentiment, and analyzing online conversations. 
  • Experience with reporting and analytics tools such as Sprout Social, ListenFirst, Pickaxe, Comscore Social, Meta Business, TikTok Studio, and Talkwalker. 
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, data cleaning, formulas, lookups, charts, and reporting automation. 
  • Professional fluency in English and Spanish, with the ability to analyze and communicate audience insights across bilingual and multicultural communities. 
  • Strong written, visual, and verbal communication skills. 
  • Ability to manage multiple reporting deadlines, campaigns, stakeholders, and priority changes in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Strong attention to detail, quality control, curiosity, organization, and problem-solving skills. 

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience in entertainment, television, streaming, news, sports, consumer media, or a fandom-driven industry. 
  • Familiarity with U.S. Hispanic audiences and bilingual social behavior. 
  • Experience with Sproutsocial, Sprinklr, Brandwatch, Talkwalker, Meltwater, Synthesio, or similar social intelligence platforms. 
  • Experience measuring paid social campaigns or working with performance marketing teams. 
  • Experience analyzing live-event social conversation, talent engagement, awards shows, premieres, finales, or major cultural moments. 

Additional Requirements

  • This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

NBCUniversal est l’une des principales entreprises de médias et de divertissement au monde. Nous créons du contenu de calibre mondial que nous distribuons par l’intermédiaire de notre portefeuille de films, de contenus télévisuels et de services de diffusion en continu, et que nous faisons vivre grâce à nos destinations de parcs thématiques à travers le monde, à nos produits de consommation et à nos expériences. Nous détenons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de diffusion en continu haut de gamme financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des productions cinématographiques et des émissions de premier plan par l’intermédiaire de nos importants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi que des quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de premier plan à travers le monde par l’intermédiaire d’Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment Universal Orlando Resort, où se trouve Universal Epic Universe, ainsi qu’Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Visitez www.nbcuniversal.com pour en savoir plus.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés où vivent et travaillent les membres de notre personnel, notre clientèle et nos publics. Nous avons une longue tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à offrir aux membres de notre personnel la possibilité de s’investir auprès de leurs communautés. Nous favorisons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et d’offrir une vaste gamme de contenus qui reflètent notre monde.

The Senior Development QA Tester partners directly with designers, engineers, and artists to test features throughout the development cycle. You’ll validate functionality, identify issues early, analyze root causes, and help maintain build stability. You will collaborate closely with developers, review requirements, and use tools to perform functional, regression, and performance tests, ensuring software is reliable, secure, and user-friendly.

  • Test new features during development and provide clear, actionable feedback to developers.
  • Identify, reproduce, and document bugs with detailed steps, logs, and supporting evidence.
  • Analyze issues to determine severity, patterns, and potential root causes.
  • Collaborate with engineers and designers to understand feature intentions, edge cases, and technical constraints.
  • Verify bug fixes and ensure regressions are caught early.
  • Create and maintain test plans, test cases, and checklists for ongoing features.
  • Support integration testing when new systems, builds, or content are merged.
  • Participate in daily stand‑ups, feature reviews, and sprint planning to stay aligned with development progress.
  • Use debugging tools, logs, and engine features to investigate issues more deeply.
  • Provide feedback on usability, clarity, and player experience from a QA perspective.
  • Help maintain build stability by identifying blockers quickly and communicating them effectively.

RESPONSABILITÉS

La personne responsable des tests QA senior en développement travaille directement avec les équipes de conception, d’ingénierie et d’art afin de tester les fonctionnalités tout au long du cycle de développement. Vous validerez les fonctionnalités, repérerez rapidement les problèmes, analyserez leurs causes fondamentales et contribuerez à maintenir la stabilité des builds. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes de développement, examinerez les exigences et utiliserez différents outils pour effectuer des tests fonctionnels, de régression et de performance afin de garantir que le logiciel est fiable, sécuritaire et convivial.

  • Tester les nouvelles fonctionnalités pendant le développement et fournir aux équipes de développement une rétroaction claire et exploitable.
  • Repérer, reproduire et documenter les bogues en fournissant des étapes détaillées, des logs et des éléments probants à l’appui.
  • Analyser les problèmes afin d’en déterminer la gravité, les tendances et les causes fondamentales potentielles.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie et de conception afin de comprendre les objectifs des fonctionnalités, les cas limites et les contraintes techniques.
  • Vérifier les correctifs de bogues et veiller à ce que les régressions soient détectées rapidement.
  • Créer et tenir à jour des plans de test, des cas de test et des listes de vérification pour les fonctionnalités en cours de développement.
  • Soutenir les tests d’intégration lorsque de nouveaux systèmes, builds ou contenus sont fusionnés.
  • Participer aux réunions quotidiennes, aux revues de fonctionnalités et à la planification des sprints afin de rester au fait de l’avancement du développement.
  • Utiliser des outils de débogage, des logs et les fonctionnalités des moteurs de jeu afin d’analyser les problèmes plus en profondeur.
  • Fournir une rétroaction sur la convivialité, la clarté et l’expérience des joueurs du point de vue de l’assurance qualité.
  • Contribuer à maintenir la stabilité des builds en repérant rapidement les blocages et en les communiquant efficacement.

Basic Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (QA), software testing, or a related testing role, preferably within game development.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Selenium, Jira, SQL, or scripting languages.
  • Knowledge of software development lifecycles (SDLC) and debugging tools.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to simulate real-world user scenarios.
  • Strong understanding of game development workflows and common tools (Unity, Unreal, or proprietary engines).
  • Ability to write clear, concise, and reproducible bug reports.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort working directly with developers.
  • Ability to stay organized and detail‑oriented in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Passion for games and curiosity about how systems and features are built.

Exigences de base :

  • 4 ans ou plus d’expérience en assurance qualité (QA), en tests logiciels ou dans un rôle connexe en matière de tests, de préférence dans le domaine du développement de jeux.
  • Familiarité avec des outils tels que Selenium, Jira, SQL ou des langages de script.
  • Connaissance des cycles de développement logiciel (SDLC) et des outils de débogage.
  • Grand souci du détail et capacité à simuler des scénarios d’utilisation réels.
  • Solide compréhension des processus de développement de jeux et des outils couramment utilisés (Unity, Unreal ou moteurs propriétaires).
  • Capacité à rédiger des rapports de bogues clairs, concis et reproductibles.
  • Solides compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication et aisance à travailler directement avec les équipes de développement.
  • Capacité à rester organisé et à faire preuve de minutie dans un environnement au rythme soutenu.
  • Passion pour les jeux et curiosité à l’égard de la façon dont les systèmes et les fonctionnalités sont conçus.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience with console certification requirements or platform‑specific testing.
  • Knowledge of version control systems (Perforce, Git).
  • Experience in embedded QA, feature‑focused QA, or Dev QA roles.

Caractéristiques souhaitées :

  • Expérience des exigences de certification des consoles ou des tests propres à une plateforme.
  • Connaissance des systèmes de contrôle de versions (Perforce, Git).
  • Expérience dans des rôles de QA intégrée, de QA axée sur les fonctionnalités ou de Dev QA.

 Eligibility Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must apply to be considered.
  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week.
  • Must be willing to work overtime when required, in accordance with Quebec labor standards.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada.
  • Must be willing to travel for work related business, if necessary

Conditions d’admissibilité :

  • Les personnes intéressées doivent soumettre leur candidature afin d’être prises en considération.
  • La personne retenue doit être disposée à travailler à notre bureau de Montréal au moins 4 jours par semaine.
  • La personne retenue doit être disposée à faire des heures supplémentaires lorsque requis, conformément aux normes du travail du Québec.
  • La personne retenue doit être légalement autorisée à travailler au Canada.
  • La personne retenue doit être disposée à voyager pour des raisons professionnelles, au besoin.

The Senior Director, Digital Advertising & Partnerships will lead NBCUniversal's digital advertising monetization strategy across Latin America, driving revenue growth through CTV, streaming, programmatic, and emerging digital advertising solutions. This leader will oversee commercial strategy, partnerships, revenue operations, inventory optimization, and digital transformation initiatives while collaborating across sales, finance, product, content, and technology teams to maximize business performance. We’re looking for an exceptional, results-oriented individual who uniquely combines the interpersonal skills to act as a primary liaison between NBCU and our new, established, and emerging partners with the quantitative skills to analyze and grow the business.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Revenue Growth & Monetization

  • Develop and execute digital revenue strategies across LATAM markets.
  • Deliver against digital advertising revenue goals and growth targets.
  • Identify new monetization opportunities across streaming, CTV, and digital platforms.
  • Lead commercial negotiations and strategic partnership development.

Digital Strategy & Product Collaboration

  • Partner with Product and Technology teams to shape the digital advertising roadmap.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and market opportunities.
  • Champion new advertising capabilities and monetization products.

Revenue Operations & Inventory Management

  • Own digital inventory strategy, yield optimization, and revenue management.
  • Lead forecasting, budgeting, KPI reporting, and long-range planning activities.
  • Establish scalable processes that improve operational efficiency and revenue performance.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the key liaison between Sales, Finance, Insights, Traffic, Operations, Product, and Technology teams.
  • Drive alignment across stakeholders to ensure successful execution of business initiatives.

Talent Development & Change Leadership

  • Build, coach, and develop a high-performing team.
  • Lead digital capability-building efforts across the organization.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

BASIC REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in in digital media, advertising sales, ad technology, streaming, or related industries.or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Deep expertise in CTV, OTT, AVOD, FAST, and streaming monetization models.
  • Understanding of audience targeting, attribution, measurement, and identity solutions.
  • Expertise in programmatic advertising ecosystems, including DSPs, SSPs, private marketplaces, yield management, and ad-tech partnerships.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and lead through a matrixed organization.
  • Experience managing forecasting, annual operating plans, long-range planning, and revenue modeling.
  • Understanding of platforms and technologies that support digital content distribution and monetization (e.g. OTT, mobile, DAI, ad serving, measurement, etc.)
  • Uniquely combine quantitative skills needed to analyze the business with interpersonal skills needed to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Direct experience and high comfort level performing real-time business analysis and execution of priority initiatives.
  • Experience in and understanding of the Latin America market.
  • Passion for simplifying complex concepts, defining value propositions, and championing the voice of advertising sales.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive self-starter with the ability to thrive in an ambiguous, fast-paced, results-oriented environment.
  • Strong track record of cultivating relationships.
  • Keen attention to accuracy and detail.
  • Systems and tools: Demonstrate an understanding of key ad sales, planning and financial systems (e.g. CRM, NBCU Internal budgeting systems) and tools.

The Senior Director, Programmatic Strategy will report to the VP, Programmatic Strategy, owning strategy development, partnership relationship management, and business analysis for Programmatic supply. As CTV transforms to a performance media vehicle and NBCUniversal’s advertising sales business shifts toward more automated, data-driven ways of transacting with strategic first-party audiences at its core, the opportunity to launch and scale partnerships and monetization with live sports and device partnerships is accelerating.

You will represent priorities future-proofing NBCUniversal’s advertising business while maintaining distribution agreements with streaming device platforms, working closely with stakeholders across the entire Ad Sales division.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the strategy and business plan for addressability and supply health for all programmatic supply and endpoints
  • Cross-functional stakeholder alignment for Programmatic supply workstreams across Product, Operations, Planning, Marketing, Sales and other relevant teams.

  • Set prioritization for the programmatic product roadmap to explore and expand addressability and signaling products, including upside analysis and post mortems
  • Day-to-day contact for supply partners, managing communication around performance, possible troubleshooting, and/or progress of new initiatives
  • Assist in structuring partnership frameworks and deal terms alongside internal Business Development leads inclusive of revenue and product development goals.

  • Diagnose supply health and sell through across all subsets of supply (genre, rating, mobile, etc) and identify opportunities
  • Clearly communicate partnership status updates to executive leadership.

  • Stay abreast to new developments within the broader media and advertising technology industry and within NBCUniversal’s ad tech ecosystem.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years’ experience directly working in retail media, programmatic, or advanced advertising at a leading corporation, agency, technology platform and/or management consulting firm.
  • Strong PowerPoint skills and proven proficiency summarizing information/analyses into coherent and concise slides.

  • Proven communicator with the ability to simplify complex concepts and distill information down to concise, digestible bullets.
  • Superior attention to detail in written reports, emails, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong organizational skills – ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support the daily financial operations for the NBCUniversal Local Television stations serving Orlando, Tampa and Fort Myers.

Reporting to the Director of Finance, this role serves as a key finance partner supporting financial planning, analysis, forecasting, reporting, month-end close and operational finance activities. The Senior Financial Analyst will play an integral role in maintaining financial accuracy, supporting budget oversight, and providing timely analysis and insights that drive informed business decisions.

This position partners closely with station leadership, FP&A, Controllership, Operations & Technology, AP and Vendor Management teams to support the day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver, is a strong collaborator, demonstrates strong analytical and organizational skills and can effectively balance operational execution with financial analysis.

Responsibilities:

The primary responsibilities of this role include, but are not limited to:

  • Support monthly close activities including journal entries (accruals and reclasses), variance analysis, AP processes, etc.
  • Build, maintain, and analyze financial forecasts, budgets, and estimates.
  • Monitor actual versus budgeted spend, identify risks and opportunities, and provide actionable insights to finance and operational leadership.
  •  Prepare consolidated close reporting packages, variance analyses, overtime and T&E reporting for station management.
  • Support capital planning and reporting, including project pacing, variance analysis, project close-outs, and coordination with operating partners.
  • Serve as the primary finance contact for accounts payable activities including vendor onboarding, vendor maintenance, payment processing, and invoice management.
  • Serve as a day-to-day finance liaison with local operations team including department heads to provide financial support, insights, performance tracking, and decision-making assistance.
  • Support ad-hoc financial analysis, special projects, process improvements, and automation initiatives that enhance reporting efficiency and financial transparency.
  • Maintain compliance with company policies, financial controls, and accounting standards while ensuring accuracy of financial records and supporting documentation.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • 2+ years of finance experience.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; strong proficiency with MS Office Suite products.
  • Experience using financial/accounting software and applications (SAP and BPC preferred).
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities across markets.
  • Clear and effective communication skills with ability to present complex data to non-financial stakeholders.

Desired Characteristics

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to quickly reassess priorities and adapt as required.
  • Demonstrated interpersonal & leadership skills; ability to effectively interact with individuals at all levels of the organization.
  • Solid business partnering skills and ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Pioneering spirit – continuously seeking and implementing best practices.
  • Excellent time management skills, with deadline orientation.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Detail oriented and self-starter; can work independently and take initiative in challenging situations.
  • Work experience in Media, Entertainment or Advertising industry desirable.
  • Spanish-language proficiency is preferred.
  • Must be willing and able to work flexible hours as needed to support business requirements, deadlines, and key financial deliverables

 

Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the Orlando office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

The Senior Product Manager, SAP GRC is an integral part of the Corp Core Innovation & Operations organization, reporting directly to the Director, GRC. This role leads the strategy and execution of complex SAP security and access-governance initiatives across NBCU, using advanced functional and technical expertise to evaluate multiple variables, resolve complex problems, and enhance methods, systems, and tools. The Senior Product Manager serves as a subject matter expert for SAP GRC and security, provides technical guidance and oversight, drives architecture and design decisions, and ensures successful delivery of high-impact initiatives. The role also mentors and coaches associates, advises stakeholders on complex matters, adapts communication to influence audiences across the broader business, and may be accountable through the team for delivery of tactical business targets.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the implementation, configuration, and continuous improvement of SAP GRC Access Control (AC) and Identity and Access Governance (IAG) modules, ensuring successful execution across complex, interdependent workstreams.
  • Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) security concepts, including identity authentication, authorization, role collections, destination security, and integration with enterprise identity providers.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Joule and AI-enabled SAP solutions, with an understanding of security, access governance, data privacy, and responsible AI considerations in SAP environments.
  • Ability to support security design for SAP BTP extensions, Fiori applications, cloud integrations, and AI-driven business processes across SAP S/4HANA and connected systems.
  • Familiarity with securing and governing emerging SAP capabilities such as Joule, generative AI, workflow automation, and cloud application services within SAP’s security and compliance framework.
  • Lead collaboration with architecture, application, engineering, business, and compliance teams to evaluate and implement secure access models for SAP BTP, AI services, and intelligent automation solutions; provide technical guidance and drive architecture and design decisions.
  • Design and implement role-based access controls (RBAC), firefighting, and segregation of duties (SoD) rules to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and company policies.
  • Build and maintain a network of key contacts across and beyond the immediate area of expertise; influence senior stakeholders, adapt communication style, and use persuasion to translate business needs into scalable technical specifications and delivery priorities.
  • Recommend new SAP GRC features and functionality, security technologies, tools, and practices to improve the organization's risk and compliance posture.
  • Own and evolve SAP GRC strategies, policies, roadmaps, standards, and procedures; break down complex problems and identify opportunities to enhance methods, systems, and tools.
  • Serve as the SAP GRC and security subject matter expert, applying deep domain specialization to frequently advise product, engineering, architecture, audit, compliance, and business teams on complex matters.
  • Lead complex projects with multiple variables and dependencies, establish clear delivery outcomes, provide technical oversight, proactively manage risks, and remain accountable through the team for achievement of tactical business targets.
  • Mentor and coach product, security, and technical associates, strengthening domain capability, technical judgment, and consistent application of SAP security and governance standards.
  • Exercise independent judgment on product, architecture, control, and delivery decisions that can affect the broader area of contribution, balancing business value, technical feasibility, compliance, and risk.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., SOX, GDPR) and industry standards.
  • Exposure to other GRC products like SAP IAG, SAP BIS, SAP Audit Management, and Process Controls.       
  • Develop and maintain GRC workflows, including access request, approval, and review processes.
  • SAP GRC integration with SAP Analytics Cloud, Success Factors, SAP BTP, SAP HANA, Fieldglass, AD, etc.
  • Conduct detailed assessments of existing access controls and authorization processes to identify gaps and risks.
  • Designs, develops and maintains the company’s SAP user management and security architecture across multiple SAP environments in addition to providing solution recommendations
  • Analyze & understand the current Roles and Access Restrictions from Audit standpoint and synchronize with existing GRC access management solution to provide a risk-free environment
  • Maintaining, managing and monitoring compliance with the SAP IT Security framework; tracking Internal Security Control (ISC) gaps and exceptions for the global IT control environment
  • Commitment to upholding government and corporate security guidelines including Segregation of Duties (SoD), Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) and Privacy related standards
  • Assist with the development and implementation of SAP security policies, processes, architecture, training, and communications.
  • Identify security solutions, implement standards and best practices, proactively identify and remediate vulnerabilities
  • Responsible for managing Security for SAP ERP, SAP BW, Fiori, Gateway, SAP S/4, SAP HANA Implementation in accordance with SAP Security Strategy and Administration/Troubleshooting the complex SAP Security Issues
  • In partnership with solution architects and the business process owners, translate business requirements into the SAP Security design and maintenance of the SAP Security Roles in SAP Systems

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in SAP Security, SAP GRC, Identity and Access Management, or related SAP security disciplines.
  • Strong knowledge of the SAP Authorization Concept, including roles, profiles, authorization objects, user administration, and troubleshooting authorization issues.
  • Hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining SAP security roles and authorizations across SAP S/4HANA, MDG, BW4HANA, SAC, CIS/BTP environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of SAP GRC Access Control, including Access Risk Analysis (ARA), Access Request Management (ARM), Business Role Management (BRM), Emergency Access Management (EAM/Firefighter), and MSMP workflows.
  • Experience performing Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis, security risk assessment, remediation, and mitigation.
  • Experience supporting SAP security implementations, upgrades, migrations, and production environments.
  • Knowledge of application security concepts across ABAP, SAP HANA, Fiori, and related SAP technologies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex SAP security and authorization issues.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business, functional, technical, audit, and compliance teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities in a complex enterprise environment.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to learn quickly and adapt to changing technologies and business priorities.

Desired Characteristics:

  • 12+ years of experience as an SAP Security and/or SAP GRC professional, preferably in large, complex enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrated leadership of at least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including architecture and design decisions, cross-functional delivery, risk management, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Preferred experience with 3 to 5 full lifecycle SAP Security/GRC implementations, particularly across SAP S/4HANA, and SAP GRC Access Control/Process Control 12.x.
  • Deep expertise in one or more SAP Security/GRC domains with demonstrated credibility as a Subject Matter Expert (SME).
  • Experience designing SAP security architecture and authorization models for SAP S/4HANA and Fiori, including business roles, catalogs, spaces/pages, OData services, and backend authorization requirements.
  • Experience with SAP HANA security, including database roles, privileges, and integration with application-level security.
  • Experience with SAP cloud security technologies such as SAP BTP, SAP Cloud Identity Services / IAS and IPS, SAP IAG, and SAP Analytics Cloud, where applicable.
  • Experience integrating SAP security with enterprise Identity and Access Management and Privileged Access Management solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor and coach team members, and establish security standards and best practices across cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to translate complex SAP security, SoD, and compliance issues into business risks and recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Experience partnering with Internal Audit, External Audit, SOX, Compliance, Cybersecurity, and Risk Management teams.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate multiple variables, resolve ambiguous issues, and recommend pragmatic solutions.
  • Strategic thinker capable of aligning SAP Security and GRC architecture with broader cybersecurity, IAM, compliance, and business strategy.
  • SAP Security, SAP GRC, cybersecurity, IAM, or related professional certifications are preferred.

Additional Requirements: 

  • Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

  • Experience developing and extending cloud applications using SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP). 
  • Experience conducting technical reviews and ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture, governance, and development standards.

  • Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), including Cloud Foundry, API Management, Cloud Connector, Event Mesh, Build, Work Zone, Cloud ALM, SAP Joule, and ABAP Cloud. 
  • Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Signavio, and SAP Fieldglass.   
  • 2+ years of experience integrating SAP SuccessFactors with SAP HCM, Employee Central Payroll (ECP), SAP S/4HANA, SmartRecruiters, Onboarding, and other third-party applications.

We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the VOD Engineering team, responsible for building and evolving large-scale media processing systems. This is a high-impact, hands-on role focused on designing, building, and operating distributed systems that power the ingestion, processing, and delivery of video content at scale.

We are looking for someone who is not afraid to take ownership, proactively identify improvements, and build systems that are reliable, performant, and scalable in real-world conditions.

What the team does

  • The VOD Engineering team builds E2E video on demand solutions
  • The VOD team is responsible for the automated media pipeline delivering content to NBCU’s streaming platforms including Peacock.
  • Troubleshoots issues arising in the VOD pipeline.
  • Configures encoding of video, audio and subtitles for delivery across various platforms/devices.
  • Research new technologies in the media space and conduct POCs.
  • Collaborates with Operations, player and client teams to drive innovation and improvements in video delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and continuously improve scalable media pipelines for processing, transforming, and delivering large-volume media content.
  • Implement and productionize core algorithms for media analysis, computer vision, or machine learning workloads where they can materially improve the platform.
  • Build distributed systems and services that raise the bar on reliability, performance, observability, and operational scale.
  • Partner across engineering and product to identify problems and opportunities early, then turn them into technical design, milestones, and execution plans.
  • Bring a builder’s mindset to day-to-day engineering, using strong judgment, modern tooling, and pragmatic execution to move systems forward.

Required Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience building, operating, and improving media pipelines at scale
  • Experience designing, deploying, and evolving distributed systems in production
  • Fluency in Python, plus proficiency in Go, C++, and/or Rust
  • Experience with performance optimization, observability, and reliability engineering for large-scale platforms
  • Experience working with Unix-based environments, source control, and production software development workflows
  • Ownership mindset, with the ability to identify problems, drive solutions, and turn business needs into scalable technical systems

job.description:
Your future in media starts here. The NBCUniversal Summer Internship Program is your chance to help shape what’s next in media and entertainment. Whether you’re supporting major news coverage, creating content for iconic brands, or contributing to innovative projects, you’ll bring your ideas, creativity, and perspective to make an impact throughout your internship.

Beyond your day-to-day role, you’ll take part in a thoughtfully designed program focused on career development, building your professional presence, and growing your workplace confidence. Through real-world experience and a community of fellow interns, you’ll explore what’s possible in this ever changing and exciting industry.

In addition to all of our internships being paid, we will also offer the following for our Summer 2027 interns:   

  • Paid company holidays for full-time interns.  
  • Robust networking, learning and development opportunities.
  • Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship.
  • Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship.
  • Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions.
  • Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer. 

Summer 2027 Program Details

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need. 

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from New York, NY.

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)  

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews   

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews  

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers  

To Apply:

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.
  • Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).
  • Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program.

NBC News: More Americans watch NBC News than any news organization in the world. NBC News’ leading and award-winning television news broadcasts include TODAY, NBC Nightly News, Meet the Press, and Dateline NBC. The rapidly-growing NBC News Digital Group – including its streaming news services NBC News NOW and TODAY All Day – and the network’s award-winning original podcast and audio unit provide continuous content to consumers wherever they are, whenever they want it. 

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • NBC News Mobile App Development: The team is responsible for designing, developing and testing NBC News’s flagship Android/iOS applications. The intern will be working on native mobile applications across all the NBC News brands and collaborate with developers, product and project management in shipping out features. The intern will be mentored by senior developers in the team and will be guided in their work. The intern will be working on various team initiatives following engineering best practices and writing quality code.
  • NBC News Digital, Software Engineering: As a Software Engineer Intern, you will partner with the Product, Operations, Design, and Editorial teams to bring NBC News Digital content to life. You will be a significant influence on our product roadmap, bringing a technical and strategic perspective. You will work alongside fellow inspired developers in a fast-paced environment using technologies like Sass, React.js and GraphQL to help shape the future of digital news.

 

Media Group: The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.   

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Global Video Engineering, Video-On-Demand SRE: The Jupiter SRE Team is a SRE Team that is embedded as part of the Video on Demand (VOD) team in the Global Video Engineering Group. The VOD team is a mix of software engineers and video engineers, that define and maintain the VOD workflow (The Path a piece of content follows to get on to the streaming Platform).  The SRE Team is responsible for deploying and maintaining availability of all Infrastructure and applications that are part of this workflow. Currently the VOD team uses a mixture of vendor and in house-built applications to implement this workflow. However, we are in the middle of an exciting transition bringing many of these workflows in-house and therefore this internship is an exciting opportunity to get real world exposure to all the work necessary to get content ready for streaming.
  • Global Delivery, Quality Engineering: Our Global Quality Engineering Team is responsible for broad scale of quality by testing integrated systems and the client applications focused on delivering flawless experience for our customers. Our teams analyse requirements, create test plans and perform feature testing for Peacock & all of its propositions which includes backend integration of components and application front end across all the major device platforms. Our goal is to educate the interns on Software Development Life Cycle and importance of Software Quality Assurance.
  • Video-On-Demand Engineering, Workflows: The VOD Engineering team is hiring a summer intern to join the VOD Workflows team, which builds and supports the automated media pipeline that delivers video-on-demand (VOD) content to NBCUniversal’s streaming platforms. The intern will work with engineers on business-critical video workflows and cloud services. They will gain exposure to how the team troubleshoots VOD workflows and playback and configures encoding for video, audio, and subtitles across platforms. Day to day, the work is scoped and guided: contributing to the pipeline, learning how media-processing and cloud delivery systems are operated, and helping improve them.
  • Peacock, Live, Play, and DAI: Global Video Engineering’s Live, Play, and DAI group builds and runs the systems behind Peacock’s live events, video playback, and direct ad insertion. These are the paths viewers hit when they watch a live game, press play, and see an ad. The work is user-facing and revenue-critical, and it has to stay up while millions of people are watching at once. The group is organized as product engineering teams with embedded Site Reliability Engineers. Live covers event orchestration, encoding, and distribution. Play covers playback, and the services that get a stream to the device. DAI covers ad decisioning and inserting ads into live and on-demand video. SREs sit with those teams and own reliability across the stack: AWS, Kubernetes, networking, the application, and the telemetry that shows whether it is healthy. An intern will work with engineers who ship code and operate what they ship. They see how a live event is prepared and run, how an ad decision becomes a break in the stream, and how playback failures show up in metrics, logs, and traces. They will contribute to real systems with a focus on improving reliability, performance, observability, and automation that removes repetitive operational work.
  • Global Streaming Tech, Live Play & DAI: Our Backend Video Engineering team builds and maintains the technology that powers video content and advertising delivery across NBCUniversal’s digital platforms. The team develops scalable backend services and APIs using Go (Golang), helping ensure reliable and efficient video experiences for audiences. Interns will gain hands-on exposure to backend software engineering while collaborating with experienced engineers and learning how large-scale video systems are designed, developed, tested, and maintained.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Infrastructure as Code – Exposure to CloudFormation or Terraform etc.
  • Proficiency with Python and/or Go, JavaScript, Java or related programming languages.
  • Basic AI Knowledge – Exposure to generating Code and Docs with LLMs management tools.
  • Knowledge or experience in testing Mobile applications on both Android and iOS platforms.
  • Knowledge or experience working in an Agile development environment.
  • Knowledge or experience in Automation and GenAI.
  • Exposure to cloud systems, particularly AWS, or to workflow, ETL, or data-pipeline concepts, Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with Git and a CI system, and comfort reading an existing codebase before changing it.
  • Exposure to observability (Prometheus, Grafana, or similar) or to debugging with logs and metrics.
  • Working knowledge of Linux and basic networking (DNS, HTTP, load balancers, TLS).
  • Interest in video streaming, advertising technology, or large-scale distributed systems.
  • Basic understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, and Git.

The Integrated Sales Marketing Specialist supports NBCU Local's NY business development and sales-marketing initiatives, developing strategic sales proposals, client-specific materials, sponsorship programs, and creative marketing solutions that address advertiser needs and advance campaign objectives within a collaborative team of media professionals. 

This role manages projects from concept through production, approval, execution, and recap, ensuring accurate, efficient, and timely delivery. The Specialist serves as a key liaison among Sales, Sales Management, Creative Services, Production, Research, Content, and other internal partners. 

The ideal candidate is a strategic and creative thinker with impeccable attention to detail, strong communication and relationship-management skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. This individual should demonstrate initiative, sound judgment, resourcefulness, and a commitment to developing effective solutions for both internal and external clients. 

Responsibilities 

  • Partner with the Sales team to create external communications, proposals, and category- and brand-specific materials that highlight the value and capabilities of the NBCU Local portfolio. 

  • Respond to client and brand briefs by developing comprehensive business cases, customized marketing solutions, and media-plan recommendations that align with advertiser objectives. 

  • Serve as a primary liaison among Sales, Sales Management, Creative Services, and Production for local sales sponsorships, including weather, traffic, sports, and other recurring or custom opportunities. 

  • Manage sponsorship production from kickoff through recap, coordinating communications, assets, production, internal and client approvals, and on-air execution. 

  • Deliver accurate, organized, and timely proof-of-performance materials, including air checks, links, screenshots, and campaign recaps. 

  • Keep WNBC and WNJU sponsorship trackers current and accessible, covering project status, production requirements, approvals, flight dates, and final deliverables. 

  • Identify and implement more efficient ways to track projects, share information, and communicate with Sales and Production partners. 

  • Improve transparency, organization, and cross-functional communication by developing and maintaining workflows in SharePoint, Monday.com, and other collaboration platforms. 

  • Create, update, and customize client-specific sales materials, sponsorship packages, presentations, and other marketing resources based on the needs of the Sales team. 

  • Deliver client-facing materials in the appropriate format and platform, including PowerPoint, SharePoint, and other digital presentation tools. 

  • Source, organize, and distribute relevant video examples and creative assets through Vimeo and other approved content platforms. 

  • Maintain local tentpole, sponsorship, and general-market sales decks, incorporating updates as programming, pricing, inventory, creative elements, or sales priorities change. 

  • Manage relevant SharePoint pages and sales-resource libraries to ensure that current decks, packages, examples, and support materials are organized and easily accessible to the Sales team. 

  • Support NY Live, Acceso Total, and other advertiser integrations by assisting with production coordination, on-site shoots, social media collateral, asset management, and communication with internal creative partners. 

  • Participate in client shoots and integrated-content productions as needed, providing logistical, creative, and project-management support. 

  • Partner with internal teams across NBCU Local, including Research, Content, Sales, Creative Services, and Production, to analyze data and develop marketing solutions that address advertiser and category objectives. 

  • Monitor industry, category, consumer, and media trends to identify relevant insights and proactive opportunities for clients. 

  • Collaborate and brainstorm with internal partners to develop proactive proposals, innovative sponsorship concepts, and strategic sales-marketing initiatives. 

  • Work with sales planners to create dynamic, research-supported plans across linear, digital, social, streaming, and out-of-home platforms.

  • Three years of related experience in sales marketing, media, advertising, creative services, production, integrated marketing, or project management preferred. 

  • Strong proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, Adobe Illustrator, Canva, and other presentation or design tools. 

  • Experience with collaboration, project-management, content-sharing, and presentation platforms such as SharePoint, Highspot, or Vimeo preferred. 

  • Familiarity with sales and traffic systems such as Salesforce and WideOrbit is a plus. 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills across internal stakeholders, including Sales, Management, Creative Services, and Production. 

  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate projects from initial concept through production, approval, execution, and recap. 

  • Strong project-management and organizational skills for managing concurrent deliverables, trackers, timelines, assets, and approvals. 

  • Ability to create compelling visual presentations and persuasive business cases by analyzing information and translating data, research, and insights. 

  • Strong client-service orientation and the ability to respond quickly and thoughtfully to evolving business needs.

job.title: Sr Cyber Event Analyst (Shift: Thursday to Monday | 1:45 PM PDT to 10 PM PDT)
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

This is a Second Shift position (1:45 AM PDT to 10 PM PDT) with a schedule of Thursday through Monday.

NBCUniversal’s Cyber Defense Operations team provides cyber threat intelligence, security event analysis, incident response, threat hunting, and detection and response capabilities across the enterprise. As a member of the Cyber Response team, the Senior Cyber Event Analyst will serve as a senior technical investigator responsible for identifying, analyzing, scoping, and responding to cybersecurity events.

This role requires an analyst who can go beyond the alert. The successful candidate will dive into underlying security telemetry, correlate activity across multiple data sources, develop and test investigative hypotheses, and determine the actual risk and potential impact of security events. The analyst will also help engineer and improve SOAR playbooks, investigation workflows, and response processes.

This is a shift-based role supporting NBCUniversal’s 24x7 Cyber Defense operation and includes participation in an on-call rotation; including the need to cover Company holidays.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and prioritize the queue including the Cyber hotline
  • Perform advanced triage, investigation, scoping, and disposition of security events across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, application, and email environments.
  • Go beyond surfaced alerts by querying and analyzing underlying logs and telemetry to validate detections, reconstruct activity, determine scope, and identify potential impact.
  • Correlate evidence across SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, DNS, proxy, firewall, WAF, cloud, email, application, and threat intelligence data sources.
  • Conduct hypothesis-driven investigations, identifying the additional evidence required to confirm or disprove malicious activity.
  • Assess security risk based on technical evidence, including affected identities and assets, privileges, persistence, lateral movement, data access, exposure, and business context.
  • Develop clear, evidence-backed dispositions documenting investigative findings, scope, confidence, risk, and recommended response actions.
  • Maps observed attacker behaviors and techniques to MITRE ATT&CK and other applicable security frameworks.
  • Collect and preserve endpoints, identity, network, cloud, and application artifacts to support investigations.
  • Design, build, test, troubleshoot, and maintain SOAR playbooks and investigation workflows for enrichment, evidence collection, containment, and response.
  • Translate manual investigation procedures into scalable automation using APIs, Python, PowerShell, JSON, or similar technologies.
  • Identify gaps/tuning opportunities in detection logic, telemetry, logging, and response processes and partner with Detection Engineering to implement improvements.
  • Perform technical peer reviews and mentor analysts on investigative methodology, query development and telemetry analysis.
  • Maintain detailed investigation records, technical runbooks, and shift handoffs to ensure continuity and analytical rigor.

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, relevant certifications, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 4+ years of hands-on cybersecurity experience in SOC, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, or Cyber Defense.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently investigate complex security events beyond the information provided in the initial alert.
  • Hands-on experience querying and analyzing security telemetry using SIEM, security data lake, and/or log analytics platforms.
  • Experience correlating data across endpoints, identity, network, cloud, email, and application security technologies.
  • Strong understanding of Windows/Linux, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, identity and authentication, enterprise networking, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience investigating threats such as credential compromise, malware, phishing/BEC, endpoint or network intrusion, suspicious cloud activity, and unauthorized data access.
  • Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and incident response methodologies.
  • Experience developing, modifying, or troubleshooting SOAR playbooks and security automation workflows.
  • Experience with Python, PowerShell, APIs, or similar scripting and automation technologies.
  • Ability to clearly distinguish and communicate confirmed evidence, analytical conclusions, risk, assumptions, and investigative gaps.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to support shift-based operations and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Ability to cover Company holidays to ensure 24x7 all year-round coverage.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience with query languages such as KQL, SPL, SQL, or equivalent.
  • Experience analyzing Windows Event Logs, Sysmon, EDR telemetry, authentication logs, DNS, network telemetry, cloud audit logs, and application logs.
  • Experience with endpoint/network forensics, packet analysis, or attack-path reconstruction.
  • Advanced experience developing SOAR automation, API integrations, or analyst enrichment tools.
  • Experience supporting Cyber Defense or Incident Response within a large, globally distributed enterprise or Media and Entertainment organization.
  • Relevant technical certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GIAC, or equivalent.

Additional Requirements

This is a First Shift position (8:45 AM EST to 5 PM EST) with a schedule of Thursday through Monday.

NBCUniversal’s Cyber Defense Operations team provides cyber threat intelligence, security event analysis, incident response, threat hunting, and detection and response capabilities across the enterprise. As a member of the Cyber Response team, the Senior Cyber Event Analyst will serve as a senior technical investigator responsible for identifying, analyzing, scoping, and responding to cybersecurity events.

This role requires an analyst who can go beyond the alert. The successful candidate will dive into underlying security telemetry, correlate activity across multiple data sources, develop and test investigative hypotheses, and determine the actual risk and potential impact of security events. The analyst will also help engineer and improve SOAR playbooks, investigation workflows, and response processes.

This is a shift-based role supporting NBCUniversal’s 24x7 Cyber Defense operation and includes participation in an on-call rotation; including the need to cover Company holidays.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and prioritize the queue including the Cyber hotline
  • Perform advanced triage, investigation, scoping, and disposition of security events across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, application, and email environments.
  • Go beyond surfaced alerts by querying and analyzing underlying logs and telemetry to validate detections, reconstruct activity, determine scope, and identify potential impact.
  • Correlate evidence across SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, DNS, proxy, firewall, WAF, cloud, email, application, and threat intelligence data sources.
  • Conduct hypothesis-driven investigations, identifying the additional evidence required to confirm or disprove malicious activity.
  • Assess security risk based on technical evidence, including affected identities and assets, privileges, persistence, lateral movement, data access, exposure, and business context.
  • Develop clear, evidence-backed dispositions documenting investigative findings, scope, confidence, risk, and recommended response actions.
  • Maps observed attacker behaviors and techniques to MITRE ATT&CK and other applicable security frameworks.
  • Collect and preserve endpoints, identity, network, cloud, and application artifacts to support investigations.
  • Design, build, test, troubleshoot, and maintain SOAR playbooks and investigation workflows for enrichment, evidence collection, containment, and response.
  • Translate manual investigation procedures into scalable automation using APIs, Python, PowerShell, JSON, or similar technologies.
  • Identify gaps/tuning opportunities in detection logic, telemetry, logging, and response processes and partner with Detection Engineering to implement improvements.
  • Perform technical peer reviews and mentor analysts on investigative methodology, query development and telemetry analysis.
  • Maintain detailed investigation records, technical runbooks, and shift handoffs to ensure continuity and analytical rigor.

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, relevant certifications, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 4+ years of hands-on cybersecurity experience in SOC, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, or Cyber Defense.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently investigate complex security events beyond the information provided in the initial alert.
  • Hands-on experience querying and analyzing security telemetry using SIEM, security data lake, and/or log analytics platforms.
  • Experience correlating data across endpoints, identity, network, cloud, email, and application security technologies.
  • Strong understanding of Windows/Linux, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, identity and authentication, enterprise networking, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience investigating threats such as credential compromise, malware, phishing/BEC, endpoint or network intrusion, suspicious cloud activity, and unauthorized data access.
  • Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and incident response methodologies.
  • Experience developing, modifying, or troubleshooting SOAR playbooks and security automation workflows.
  • Experience with Python, PowerShell, APIs, or similar scripting and automation technologies.
  • Ability to clearly distinguish and communicate confirmed evidence, analytical conclusions, risk, assumptions, and investigative gaps.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to support shift-based operations and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Ability to cover Company holidays to ensure 24x7 all year-round coverage.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience with query languages such as KQL, SPL, SQL, or equivalent.
  • Experience analyzing Windows Event Logs, Sysmon, EDR telemetry, authentication logs, DNS, network telemetry, cloud audit logs, and application logs.
  • Experience with endpoint/network forensics, packet analysis, or attack-path reconstruction.
  • Advanced experience developing SOAR automation, API integrations, or analyst enrichment tools.
  • Experience supporting Cyber Defense or Incident Response within a large, globally distributed enterprise or Media and Entertainment organization.
  • Relevant technical certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GIAC, or equivalent.

Additional Requirements

Summary

This position is responsible for leading the Sourcing and Procurement functions for Universal Studios Hollywood, overseeing daily procurement operations, sourcing strategies, and supplier relationships.  The Sr. Manager will deliver procurement efficiency, beneficial spend economics and savings via utilization of sourcing strategies /best practices, on-time ordering accuracy, supplier compliance, and consistent execution across all Food & Beverage categories.  This role will also oversee sourcing readiness and onboarding for all new ventures, ensuring that new concepts are fully supported through SKU setup, vendor engagement, and procurement readiness.  Additionally, this position will serve as the primary liaison to the Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) for all R&D and New Venture sourcing efforts, ensuring alignment with Universal’s sourcing governance framework and overall corporate strategy. 

This position requires a candidate with proven leadership ability to facilitate, guide, and implement improvements within the sourcing organization and operation of the company. This position will lead a team of sourcing professionals and must have the ability to motivate others to meet the challenges of a face paced, collaborative, and results driven environment. This position will work to ensure Sourcing initiatives are executed efficiently, industry best practices are adopted, and corporate Sourcing policies are adhered to for Universal’s domestic properties; may require global interaction with stakeholders and other UPR Sourcing professionals.  Travel is required.

 

Essential Functions

  • Lead a high performing team in sourcing and procurement execution for Universal Studios Hollywood (USH) Food & Beverage, ensuring daily operational continuity, cost visibility, and vendor compliance.
  • Design and implement sourcing programs, including bid specifications, distributor and manufacturer negotiations, and supplier development strategies.
  • Design and execute RFX Processes- RFI, RFP, RFQ - and negotiate economically beneficial contracts with suppliers to deliver competitive product and service pricing across categories.
  • Responsible for delivery of on-time ordering and accuracy for replenishment levels of warehouse and direct shipment items for responsible site and New Ventures sites
  • Oversee procurement processes within Eatec/S4 to ensure accurate purchase orders, on-time delivery, and full adherence to Universal’s governance model.
  • Serve as the primary liaison to the GPO for all R&D and New Venture sourcing efforts, ensuring project transparency, data accuracy, supplier compliance, and measurable value delivery.
  • Coordinate cross-functional alignment with Culinary, Operations, Shared Services, and IT for USH and all new venue onboarding, including SKU creation, sourcing timelines, and supplier readiness.
  • Partner with the Cost Control team to ensure budget alignment, identify cost-saving opportunities, and support margin expansion initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain procurement policies and sourcing procedures to enhance efficiency, transparency, and alignment with Universal’s national sourcing governance.
  • Design and execute category sourcing strategies that deliver short and long term benefits across pricing, delivery, storage and supplier utilization/management.
  • Design and execute procurement ordering and replenishment strategies and/or playbooks that deliver operational efficiency and cost effectiveness across product portfolio.
  • Analyze procurement data and supplier performance to identify cost reductions, supplier consolidation, and continuous improvement opportunities.
  • Forecast demand and usage patterns to optimize inventory levels and procurement scheduling.
  • Ensure sourcing compliance, sustainability standards, and food safety requirements are met across all vendors.
  • Drive completion of key projects by proactively considering new alternatives and applying critical thinking to achieve optimal results.
  • Provide leadership and mentoring to the USH Sourcing & Procurement team to promote continuous improvement, accountability, and best-in-class performance.
  • Build and foster relationships by collaborating with internal stakeholders, external suppliers, and UDX leadership.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established USH policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Various projects as assigned

Requirements:

  • Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in Food & Beverage sourcing or procurement, including at least 3–5 years in a management or leadership capacity.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; Certified Professional Food Manager (CPFM) preferred.
  • Strong understanding of ERP systems (Eatec/S4) and procurement workflow automation. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio.
  • Deep knowledge of multi-step strategic sourcing, bid management, and category management strategies. Proven success in cost modeling, supplier negotiation, and analytics-driven decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams in a high-volume, fast-paced environment with multiple competing priorities. Skilled in cross-functional partnership and influencing without direct authority.
  • Strong analytical acumen with the ability to translate data into insights and actions. Capable of balancing strategic vision with executional precision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills at all organizational levels, with a focus on clarity, persuasion, and professionalism.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and results-driven. Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement, accountability, and operational excellence.
  • Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week.

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong leader with the ability to motivate and develop a high-performing team in a collaborative, results-driven environment.
  • Deep understanding of product life cycle, price elasticity, COGS, and program-building concepts.
  • Demonstrated success leading sourcing and onboarding initiatives for new concepts and operational expansions.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams, including Culinary, Operations, and Shared Services, to deliver enterprise sourcing solutions.
  • Experience working with a GPO or similar sourcing framework to deliver measurable value while maintaining compliance with corporate governance.
  • Strong project management skills, including stakeholder management, forecasting, and cost analysis.
  • Resourceful problem solver with the ability to prioritize, negotiate, and drive outcomes in ambiguous or high-pressure situations.
  • Analytical thinker capable of developing frameworks for planning and implementing organizational change.
  • Passionate, positive, and results-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset.

This role serves as the Theme Parks primary on-the-ground external affairs leader by driving proactive engagement with key stakeholders including local and state elected officials, government agencies (City, County and State) and industry associations.  This role collaborates cross-functionally and works in partnership with Universal Destinations and Experiences (UDX), Comcast and NBCUniversal State & Local Government Affairs, Corporate Communications and Global Real Estate departments to support initiatives that drive growth strategies for the destination. This position will own the development and delivery of local government relations strategies that impact park operations by building and maintaining relationships with industry peers and associations to advocate theme park priorities and position the company as a trusted regional partner and employer of choice.  This leader protects and advances the corporate brand in a fast-paced, high-visibility environment. 

Major Responsibilities 

  • Research, track and provide briefing papers to internal stakeholders on local ordinances and state legislation on issues supporting or impacting tourism, transportation, park operations and business regulation. Leverages information to align, navigate, and execute Universal’s relationship strategy in accordance with government proceedings.
  • Partners with business units on local issues and response efforts for USH, including analysis, monitoring, escalation and on-the-ground coordination to support the Theme Park.
  • Manages business and industry association relationships throughout Los Angeles and California including board membership, sponsorship, and issues management. Positions USH as a business leader and partner by building and maintaining relationships with key community stakeholders and leaders. Ensures compliance with all government laws for hosting events following Comcast Political Affairs Guidelines.
  • Support business unit strategic plans that support park initiatives, including community impact, neighborhood engagement, and USH corporate communications.
  • Engages with numerous regulatory agencies at the local and state level with key internal stakeholders to ensure operational efficiencies and compliance
  • Bachelor’s degree in Political Science, Public Relations, Communications, Business Administration or related field is required.
  • 10+ years of legislative, community relations, government, or external affairs experience is required; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to identify, assess and remediate and execute external affairs strategies
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize issues management
  • Effective verbal, written communication, and presentation skills
  • Ability to interact with and influence all levels of the organization, community organizations and elected officials effectively
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.
  • Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week.
