The Product Manager is an individual contributor responsible for hands-on product delivery across assigned Enterprise Rights products, platforms, and workstreams. Reporting to the Manager, Product, this role operates within the product vision, strategy, roadmap, governance, and priorities established by the Manager and translates them into requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, prioritized backlogs, sprint plans, releases, and measurable outcomes.

The role provides hands-on delivery support across discovery, requirements definition, backlog management, sprint execution, testing, release readiness, adoption, and continuous improvement. It works closely with business stakeholders, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Quality Assurance, Operations, and vendors, while escalating priority conflicts, delivery risks, dependencies, and decisions outside the assigned scope to the Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assigned Product Delivery and Workstream Execution
    • Execute assigned work within the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and priorities established by the Manager, with accountability for requirements quality, backlog readiness, sprint execution, release coordination, and outcomes within the assigned scope.
    • Translate portfolio objectives, roadmap direction, and business needs into clear product capabilities, sequenced delivery plans, requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
    • Raise options and recommendations for delivery decisions within the assigned scope and escalate decisions affecting product direction, roadmap, funding, resources, or cross-portfolio priorities to the Manager.
    • Maintain epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, backlog priorities, sprint boards, dependencies, risks, defects, release status, and supporting documentation in Jira and Confluence.
    • Escalate cross-portfolio priorities, unresolved dependencies, capacity constraints, material risks, and strategic decisions to the Manager.
  • Requirements, Agile Delivery, and Release Execution
    • Support discovery and lead detailed requirements development, backlog creation and grooming, sprint planning, release planning, and outcome tracking for assigned initiatives; provide analysis and recommendations to planning and prioritization led by the Manager.
    • Coordinate day-to-day product delivery through implementation, integration, migration, testing, deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.
    • Facilitate and actively manage Agile delivery ceremonies for assigned workstreams, including sprint planning, backlog grooming and refinement, daily stand-ups, estimation, sprint reviews, demos, retrospectives, release planning, and continuous-improvement activities.
    • Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, Operations, and vendors to evaluate options, clarify tradeoffs, and support technically sound delivery decisions.
    • Use data, analytics, user feedback, and operational insight to guide product decisions and measure results.
  • Enterprise Rights Domain Leadership
    • Translate complex rights, licensing, contractual, title, territory, windowing, exclusivity, restriction, avails, and distribution requirements into scalable product capabilities.
    • Lead product activities across Legal, Business Affairs, Content Acquisition, Distribution, Finance, Operations, Data, Architecture, Engineering, and Product for assigned scope.
    • Ensure assigned solutions account for upstream sources, downstream consumers, reporting, integrations, data quality, governance, and operational workflows.
    • Contribute to RMS and related Enterprise Rights transformation initiatives as assigned, while maintaining alignment with the overall portfolio roadmap and governance model.
  • Data, Automation, and AI
    • Identify and prioritize practical opportunities to apply data, analytics, workflow automation, and AI within assigned products or workstreams.
    • Partner with Data, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Security, and business teams to evaluate use cases and move approved concepts from discovery into delivery.
    • Ensure proposed capabilities are grounded in reliable data, clear business value, measurable outcomes, and responsible governance.
  • Stakeholder and Team Collaboration
    • Build alignment among business and technology stakeholders, resolve priorities within the assigned scope, and communicate decisions clearly.
    • Work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, Engineering, Quality Assurance, and other delivery resources to maintain requirements clarity, backlog readiness, sprint commitments, and timely issue resolution.
    • Communicate roadmap status, delivery health, risks, options, and recommendations in a concise, decision-oriented manner.
    • Support change management, training, operational readiness, and adoption for delivered capabilities.
    • Contribute to consistent product-management practices established by the Manager across discovery, planning, requirements, delivery, documentation, and outcome measurement.

Requirements: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data/Analytics, Media & Entertainment, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of product management, product ownership, business analysis, or Agile delivery experience supporting enterprise or platform products.
  • Demonstrated experience translating established product direction and roadmaps into requirements, prioritized backlogs, sprint plans, releases, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  • Experience leading enterprise transformation, implementation, integration, migration, or modernization initiatives.
  • 3+ years of media and entertainment experience supporting rights, licensing, content acquisition, distribution, or media supply-chain functions.
  • Strong understanding of rights-in, rights-out, avails, contract metadata, title management, territories, windowing, exclusivity, restrictions, and distribution workflows.
  • Strong technical fluency across enterprise integrations, APIs, data platforms, reporting, cloud or legacy modernization, security, and interconnected system landscapes.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Agile delivery methods, including Scrum and Kanban, and experience managing epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, backlogs, sprint boards, dependencies, defects, releases, dashboards, and documentation in Jira and Confluence.
  • Ability to influence without authority, challenge assumptions, navigate ambiguity, and drive decisions across senior business and technology stakeholders.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, problem-solving, and organizational-change skills.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience with enterprise rights-management platforms such as Rightsline, Vistex, RightsLogic Media Maestro, FilmTrack, or similar solutions.
  • Experience with enterprise architecture, APIs, data platforms, reporting tools, and cloud or legacy-system modernization.
  • Practical experience using SQL, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools to analyze data and support product decisions.
  • Experience partnering with Data Engineering, Analytics, or Data Science teams on decision-support capabilities.
  • Experience working within product operating models, portfolio governance structures, and outcome-based planning practices.
  • Working knowledge of Figma or similar design and collaboration tools, with experience reviewing prototypes, supporting requirements discussions, and collaborating with UX/UI and product teams.
  • Scrum, Agile, or product-management certification, such as CSPO, CSM, PMI-ACP, SAFe, or an equivalent credential.

  • Experience with data visualization tools and techniques
  • Strong skills in data processing using SQL

  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum and Kanban).  
  • A flair for communicating clearly via design document, text, voice and code to a wide variety of nationalities.

  • Experience with data visualizations
  • Experience with multi-billion record datasets and leading projects that span the disciplines of data science and data engineering
  • Knowledge of enterprise-level digital analytics platforms

job.description:

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems to help shape the foundations that power experiences across our global streaming portfolio.

You’ll help evolve our global design system, creating the components, patterns, frameworks, and tools that enable teams to build cohesive, accessible, and scalable experiences across TV, web, mobile platforms.

This role is anchored in systems thinking and sits at the intersection of product design and engineering. You'll partner closely with Product Design, Product Management, Engineering, and Brand teams to turn product needs into reusable solutions, strengthen the connection between design and code, and make it easier for teams to build high-quality experiences at scale.

We’re looking for someone who sees patterns beyond individual screens, enjoys solving complex platform challenges, and believes a great design system should empower teams rather than constrain them.

What You'll Do:

  • Build and evolve our design system. Design scalable components, patterns, and foundations, using thoughtful component architecture, variables, modes, and tokens to support experiences across products and platforms.
  • Bridge design and engineering. Partner closely with engineers to translate designs into production-ready components, defining properties, states, behaviors, and specifications while strengthening design-to-development workflows.
  • Solve at the system level. Identify patterns across products, standardize where it creates value, reduce unnecessary complexity, and turn individual product needs into flexible solutions that can scale across experiences.
  • Drive adoption and enable teams. Create clear documentation, usage guidance, and contribution processes. Partner with teams through design reviews, consultation, and office hours to help them effectively use and contribute back to the system.
  • Design with accessibility at the foundation. Incorporate accessibility into components and patterns from the start, applying WCAG standards at the component level and supporting consistent experiences across platforms.
  • Improve how the system works. Explore tooling, automation, and emerging technologies that can improve system maintenance, documentation, QA, and design-to-code workflows.
  • Shape what’s next. Explore how tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows can improve how we build, maintain, document, and use the system.
  • Balance today's needs with long-term system health. Help prioritize system evolution based on product needs, adoption, and system health while balancing near-term delivery with the long-term sustainability of the system.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of product design experience, with at least 2+ years of direct experience building, scaling, or implementing design systems.
  • A portfolio demonstrating design systems work, including your approach to components, patterns, systems thinking, and implementation.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including component architecture, variants, auto layout, variables, modes, and library management.
  • Hands-on experience with design tokens, theming, and scalable component architecture.
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering to translate design system decisions into production components.
  • Strong systems-thinking skills and the ability to identify patterns, understand tradeoffs, and translate complex product needs into scalable solutions.
  • Strong understanding of interaction design, visual design, and accessibility, including WCAG standards.
  • Experience designing systems that support multiple platforms, products, or devices.
  • Knowledge of and interest in AI-assisted design and development workflows.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions and tradeoffs across Product, Design, and Engineering.
  • Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and move complex initiatives forward across multiple teams.

As our Senior Software Engineer, you’ll join the Content Delivery Engineering team (CDE) within NBCUniversal’s Global Video Engineering organization in New York City, USA. Your mission is to get involved with delivering outstanding VOD, live event, and linear streaming experiences to millions of viewers across our US, UK, EU, and Africa services - including Peacock, SkyShowtime, Showmax, and NOW/WOW.

You’ll collaborate daily with colleagues across the US, UK and beyond – excellent communication skills are essential. Our team specializes in large-scale Multi-Content Delivery Network design and operations, performance telemetry and analytics, selection & interfacing with content origins via multiple workflows - dynamic ad insertion, manifest manipulation and integrating new player technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance software systems and features—primarily in Go—used to deliver world-class video content at massive scale for brands like Peacock, SkyShowtime, Showmax, and NOW/WOW.
  • Build reliable, testable, and user-focused services supporting key streaming workflows, such as VOD, live events, linear channels, dynamic ad insertion, and manifest manipulation.
  • Participate in thoughtful and consistent code reviews that promote high code quality, clear architectural patterns, and healthy engineering culture.
  • Partner closely with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) to architect systems that are highly available, resilient, performant, and fault-tolerant across multiple regions.
  • Leverage observability tooling (metrics, logs, traces) and performance analytics to detect issues proactively and drive fast, data-driven root-cause analysis.
  • Contribute to the design and evolution of multi-CDN strategies, routing logic, and origin workflows that ensure exceptional global streaming performance.
  • Collaborate daily with engineers across the US, UK, EU, and Africa—requiring clear communication and strong documentation skills.
  • Influence technical direction, system architecture, and best practices as a senior member of the Content Delivery Engineering team.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on development in Go (preferred) or Python.
  • Experience deploying and operating applications in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) using containers and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD workflows and experience using Git-based repositories, automated testing frameworks, and build pipelines.
  • Practical experience with Site Reliability Engineering concepts such as reliability targets (SLIs/SLOs), auto-scaling, distributed systems reliability, or incident response.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to articulate design decisions and collaborate with distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with CDNs (e.g., Akamai, CloudFront, Fastly, Cloudflare) or streaming media delivery systems.
  • Understanding of video streaming technologies such as HLS, DASH, manifests, origins, or content routing.
  • Experience building systems that support global scale, multi-region deployments, or high availability architectures.

job.title: Staff DevOps Engineer
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

As the Staff DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for leading our DevOps and platform engineering initiatives, fostering a culture of automation, continuous integration, observability, reliability, and delivery. Your efforts will support consumer data-driven advertising and marketing products, standardized consumer identity solutions, machine learning platforms, and emerging AI-powered applications across NBCUniversal and its brands. 

You will partner with engineering, data, security, and AI teams to design and operate scalable cloud platforms that enable application development, analytics, machine learning, and AI workloads. Your expertise in AWS services, Infrastructure as Code, container orchestration, observability, platform automation, and cloud architecture will be critical in building secure, resilient, and cost-effective environments that accelerate innovation while maintaining enterprise governance and operational excellence. You will operate in an individual contributor capacity, but as a Staff Engineer, you will lead and mentor more junior DevOps Engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, operational excellence, and platform-first thinking. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Develop and lead the implementation of DevOps, Platform Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices to improve the efficiency, scalability, reliability, and security of cloud-based applications and services. 
  • Design, build, and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines that automate software delivery, infrastructure deployment, platform provisioning, and operational workflows. 
  • Architect, deploy, and manage scalable AWS cloud infrastructure supporting applications, data, machine learning, and AI workloads. 
  • Implement and manage containerization and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, EKS) to ensure consistent, secure, and resilient environments across development, testing, and production. 
  • Establish and maintain Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and Git Ops practices to improve platform consistency, governance, and operational efficiency. 
  • Build and support ML Ops and AI platform capabilities, including model deployment automation, inference platform operations, AI workflow orchestration, secure API integration, and lifecycle management for AI-enabled services. 
  • Enable secure integration of AI platforms, LLM-based applications, vector databases, agent frameworks, and machine learning services while ensuring compliance with enterprise security and governance standards. 
  • Develop observability solutions using logging, monitoring, tracing, and operational analytics platforms to proactively detect performance issues, infrastructure anomalies, security risks, and AI workload health concerns. 
  • Design scalable cloud architectures that support high availability, disaster recovery, cost optimization, and AI workload scalability. 
  • Partner with Security, Data, and Architecture teams to implement cloud security controls, identity and access management, secrets management, and compliance requirements across traditional and AI-enabled platforms. 
  • Drive automation of infrastructure operations, environment provisioning, platform governance, and operational processes to reduce manual effort and improve developer productivity. 
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation, operational runbooks, architecture standards, and platform governance processes 
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
  • 6+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering, including experience operating at a senior or technical leadership level. 
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, including building, deploying, and maintaining cloud infrastructure at scale. 
  • Deep experience with AWS and core cloud services such as EC2, EKS, ECS, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch, and VPC networking. 
  • Strong experience with containerization and container orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes, EKS/ECS, and Docker. 
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using technologies such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, AWS CodePipeline, or similar tools. 
  • Experience supporting high-traffic, high-throughput consumer-facing applications or platforms, with demonstrated knowledge of scalability, performance, availability, and production reliability. 
  • Experience implementing observability and monitoring using tools such as Datadog, Splunk, ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or CloudWatch. 
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices, including IAM, secrets management, networking, and secure infrastructure design. 
  • Experience designing scalable platform architectures that balance reliability, performance, governance, and cost optimization. 
  • Ability to provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers while remaining a hands-on individual contributor. 
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across engineering, data, security, and architecture teams. 

Desired / Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience supporting large-scale, high-volume platforms processing 5,000+ transactions per second (TPS). 
  • Experience supporting high-visibility live or tentpole events where traffic can increase significantly and platform availability is business-critical. 
  • Experience working in multi-cloud environments, particularly Microsoft Azure in addition to AWS. 
  • Experience with data pipeline orchestration and supporting data-intensive platforms. 
  • Experience deploying or operating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or similar technologies. 
  • Familiarity with agentic AI architectures, agent workflows, AI skills, and AI-enabled application infrastructure. 
  • Experience supporting LLM-based applications, AI/ML workloads, model-serving infrastructure, inference services, or related AI platform capabilities. 
  • Familiarity with AI platform security, governance, operational monitoring, and secure API integrations. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $130,000 - $160,000 (bonus eligible)

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

Universal Pictures is a division of Universal Filmed Entertainment Group, within NBCUniversal, one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. The Studio Transformation team partners closely with Studio Finance, Technology, and Business stakeholders to modernize financial processes, systems, and ways of working across the Studio organization. The intern will work closely with the Studio Transformation leadership team, supporting project management, business analysis, documentation, and stakeholder coordination across multiple initiatives—including modernization programs, finance automation efforts, AI enabled pilots, and governance initiatives.

  • Supporting business analysis and documentation, including process maps, requirements summaries, and executive ready materials
  • Helping analyze and synthesize information related to finance transformation projects, system pilots, and process improvement efforts
  • Contributing to the preparation of executive readouts, presentations, and dashboards for senior leadership
  • Supporting coordination with cross functional partners across Finance, Technology, and Operations
  • Assisting with research, data validation, and ad hoc analysis related to active transformation initiatives

Universal Television Entertainment is responsible for world-class television entertainment. Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Brand Marketing-Bravo: Intern will support a highly dynamic marketing team in concepting, developing, and executing marketing campaigns for Bravo. This includes brand initiatives including experiential marketing programs, tentpole cultural events and activations, strategic partnerships, and E-commerce merchandising initiatives. The intern will also be responsible for monitoring cultural trends on both a macro and micro level and conducting competitive research to inform our marketing and promotional strategies. The ideal candidate will have a creative sensibility and strategic acumen, will be a highly organized self-starter while demonstrating thorough attention to detail, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Bravo & Peacock Multiplatform Strategy & Planning: The Bravo Multiplatform Strategy and Planning Team within NBCU oversees promotional scheduling on linear, Peacock, digital, and other platforms. The team works with a variety of different partners in marketing to create and execute promotional strategies, which helps promote all linear and streaming programming on a daily basis. We are looking for an exceptional intern who will be tasked with planning and scheduling daily graphic logs on Bravo, pulling data reports, entering various metadata into our system and working with the wider Multiplatform Team on any ad-hoc projects/assignments.
  • Digital Content Strategy, Bravo Digital: Intern will assist with/create NBCU IP intelligence reports for entertainment marketing teams and stakeholders (search, social, AI, etc.), conduct keyword research for editorial team and other relevant teams, assist with bravotv.com homepage programming tasks, assist with other intelligence or performance reports and presentations, assist with Bravo Insider editorial and fan acquisition initiatives (creating blog posts, monitoring fan submission initiatives, etc.), and assist with social/short form video cutting (Daily Dish Instagram, other SFV needs).
  • Communications-Unscripted: Support communications efforts by maintaining and updating press lists, preparing for press junkets, monitoring press breaks and compiling clip packets, researching media outlets & contacts, and compiling coverage reports, assist with press releases and various writing assignments/research projects.  
  • Communications-Platform Publicity: The platform publicity comms team supports PR efforts for all scripted series across NBCU broadcast and cable TV networks. While every day will be different, the scripted comms intern can expect to work with team members across both coasts and on a variety of series. Opportunities include (but are not limited to) helping track big stories surrounding series, research journalists, publications and trends, garner experience in PR-centric writing, attend team and series meetings, and more. 
  • Late Night & Specials Publicity: Our team oversees publicity for the late night shows and various specials programming across the NBCU portfolio. Our intern can expect to gain an in-depth understanding of publicity and insight into the numerous strategies the Entertainment PR team employs, and how they differ from show to show. Interns can also expect to gain a heightened ability to efficiently and effectively prioritize, organize, and communicate. They will receive exposure to any virtual press days/junkets, interviews, and events.   
  • NBC & Peacock Marketing: The NBC & Peacock Marketing team communicates with all departments to build strategies and marketing campaigns for NBC Entertainment primetime and late-night programming, in addition to leading promotional activations. The marketing intern will support the brand team throughout these processes, partake in weekly trainings, attend meetings and assist in daily tasks to understand brand’s role throughout a show’s lifecycle. 
  • NBC Late Night Digital Marketing: Intern will work with The Tonight Show and Late Night with Seth Meyers teams to ensure show calendars are up to date, accurate and aligned with confirmed guest listings, organize and maintain guest images for each show, collaborating with talent teams and stakeholders to ensure consistent imagery across all channels, write original and accurate guest biographies for show talent using strong research skills and relevant SEO keywords, support the team in brainstorming and creating compilation content for The Tonight Show, Late Night with Seth Meyers and Saturday Night Live and more.
  • Social Media Marketing: Monitor fan social sentiment/conversation and utilize social listening tool Sprout Social, identify trends on TikTok and Instagram, and ideate ways for NBC & Peacock to participate in trending conversations, curate a weekly top performing posts report to highlight wins of the week, perform social media marketing and competitive research as needed, and more.

 

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program. 
  • Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.  

Desired Characteristics:

  • Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Familiarity with Muck Rack, Cision, and Google Alerts a plus, but not required.  
  • Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.   
  • Experience or familiarity with the Adobe Creative Suite a plus (Premiere, Photoshop).   
  • Familiarity with HTML & Web technologies.   
  • Familiarity with content management systems or a willingness to learn. 
  • Strong writing skills, with ability to write clean copy quickly and efficiently for short-form, digital and promotional content.  
  • Knowledge of social platforms (Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, TikTok, Threads) and each platforms’ distinct role in the media landscape.

  • Robust networking, learning and development opportunities.
  • Complimentary Peacock subscription during your internship.
  • Free admission to Universal Parks to use during your internship.
  • Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions.
  • Financial assistance to offset expenses for transportation and housing may be available on a needs-based basis for eligible in-person interns. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer. 
  • At our Universal City office interns will have access to the NBCUCommutes program, which provides fully subsidized transit passes to full-time lower lot employees, good for unlimited rides on all Metro bus and rail, such as the Metro Red Line.

 

Summer 2027 Program Details

Program Dates: June 7 – August 13, 2027

Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need. 

Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from Universal City, CA.

 

Summer 2027 Recruitment Timeline

November 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)  

Mid November – Late December: First round video interviews   

Mid – Late January: Second round interviews  

Late January – February: Selected candidates receive offers  

 

To Apply:

  • Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year.
  • Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).
  • Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program.

 

Universal Television Entertainment is responsible for world-class television entertainment. The division programs and markets content across leading entertainment brands Bravo, NBC and Peacock, and produces over 3,000 hours of television annually through Universal Studio Group, the studio business comprised of Universal Television, Universal Global Television and Universal Television Alternative Studio.

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

  • Campaign Project Management: Intern will support Production Assistants and Bravo teams across on-air and off-air campaigns. Responsibilities include managing assets and trackers, assisting with press materials, reporting music usage, and pitching promotional content, ideal for students interested in entertainment marketing, production, and project management.
  • Casting: Intern will support NBC Entertainment by tracking talent across current series, reading scripts, watching cuts, and curating daily casting news. Interns gain exposure to casting, talent research, and competitive reporting while working with teams behind award-winning programming for NBC, Bravo, and Peacock.
  • Creative Acquisitions: Intern will maintain department databases of incoming and outgoing IP submissions, format and create copy for internal memos, read prospective material to succinctly pitch or pass in internal meetings, cover desks, phones, and administrative tasks for coordinators, spearhead special research projects and create presentation decks. Interns should have a voracious appetite for books and a general understanding of publishing landscape.
  • Production & Operations: Intern will attend and participate in meetings to stay up to date with projects, help to manage NBCU’s internal screening system, review and audit postproduction materials in wrap bibles, support Production Managers/Coordinators with document review, updating production spreadsheets, and distributing production information, work with other departments to find most up to date information and documents for shows in production and more.
  • Scripted Programming: Intern will develop original scripted programming for NBC and Peacock, supporting Comedy Development, Drama Development, and Current Programming from pitch through premiere. Interns assist with weekly newsletters, script coverage, creative call and pitch notes, and administrative support for department coordinators, while also helping manage office needs and contributing to additional projects that support daily operations.
  • Television & Streaming Inclusion: Intern will support NBCU LAUNCH, contributing to efforts that champion authentic and compelling content across NBCUniversal. Responsibilities include reviewing project materials and providing feedback to department, research, social media and internal communications, and administrative support across talent development programs - ideal for students interested in television, inclusion, and programming strategy.
  • UGT Creative Development and Current Programming: Intern will organize incoming submissions, maintain talent lists and writer samples, and track international festival films, review scripts, books, IP and other project materials and provide feedback to the department, participate in weekly submission meetings to log and track new books, IP and materials coming to market, maintain talent, festival, roadmap strategy, monthly agent/buyer, staffing, OWA and ODA tracking grids, and more.
  • Unscripted Content- Alternative, Documentary, Formats, and True Crime: Intern will support alternative, formats, and crime/documentary projects for NBC, Bravo, and Peacock, gaining exposure to the full development process. Responsibilities include research, development grids, case checks, watching cuts, and providing creative input on pitches and talent—ideal for students interested in television development.
  • UTE Programming Content Acquisitions: Intern will play a key role in post-deal partner relationships, collaborating cross functionally with NBCU leadership and business teams to ensure strategic and operational alignment. If you’re fluent in media and technology and excited to help guide partners through onboarding, this opportunity is for you.
  • UTV Programming & Creative: Intern will provide desk coverage across the departments as needed, including scheduling, rolling calls, and emailing with both internal personnel and external assistants, read scripts and provide written coverage, that includes a summary and comments on if the material would be well suited to adapt for TV, helping the UTV coordinators with keeping grids and reports up to date, and participating in a self-guided project to hone industry knowledge and skills relevant to the intern’s career aspirations in entertainment.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBC News Group Digital’s Vendor Management Office (VMO) is seeking a detail-oriented Vendor Management Analyst to support the oversight of third-party vendor relationships. This role will partner with business stakeholders, Procurement, Legal, Finance, Risk, Privacy, AI, Cyber Security, and external vendors to help ensure services are delivered on time, contractual commitments are met, risks are tracked, and vendor processes are managed accurately. The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, collaborative, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist with end-to-end vendor lifecycle management by supporting intake requests, onboarding, ongoing governance, renewal tracking, and offboarding activities.
  • Conduct market research and comparative analysis across multiple vendors to evaluate capabilities, service offerings, pricing models, rate structures, and overall value. Support vendor benchmarking efforts by gathering data, summarizing findings, and providing clear recommendations to help stakeholders make vendor selection decisions.
  • Monitor vendor performance against service levels, deliverables, milestones, and key performance indicators. Document performance concerns and service-level issues/outages, escalate as appropriate, and track corrective actions through completion.
  • Prepare and maintain scorecards, dashboards, reports, and data summaries.
  • Monitor contract expirations, renewal windows, amendments, and key obligations using the vendor dashboard.
  • Support vendor risk and compliance activities, including assessments, security reviews, privacy requirements, audit requests, and remediation plans.
  • Coordinate financial aspects such as review invoices, purchase orders, and spend data to identify discrepancies, and savings opportunities; partner with finance on financial requests and approvals.
  • Cross-functional collaborations with internal teams to ensure vendor activities align with company policies and procedures.
  • Maintain accurate vendor documentation and records, including contract details, statements of work, purchase orders, compliance documentation, and related contract materials.
  • Coordinate vendor engagements, business reviews, operational check-ins, standups, and action-item follow-ups.
  • Recommend process improvements to strengthen vendor governance, reporting, documentation, and operational efficiency.
  • Support the VMO team on additional projects as needed.

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or 1 - 2 years of experience in vendor management, procurement, supplier management, contract administration, business operations, finance, risk management, or related function.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines, requests, and priorities across various stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including strong listening skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and external vendors.
  • Self-starter who is resourceful, organized, and able to manage time efficiently.
  • Ability to support, mentor, and encourage team members when appropriate.
  • Ability to retain detailed information related to technical projects and operational processes.
  • Proficiency with Smartsheet, Microsoft 365 Copilot, SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, Visio, databases, PowerPoint, and Excel macros/formulas.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Comfortable leveraging AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Anthropic.
  • Experience using or creating agents and GPTs to improve daily workflows.
  • Experience with scorecards, SLAs, KPIs, quarterly business reviews, or governance programs.
  • Familiarity with procurement, contract management, Jira ticketing, or workflow tools such as SAP, SNAP, Purchase Manager, ServiceNow, Smartsheet, Domo, or Figma.
  • Exposure to third-party risk management, information security reviews, privacy requirements, compliance tracking, or audit support.
  • Experience with invoice validation, budget tracking, purchase order management, or spend analysis.
  • Ability to prepare clear reports, dashboards, and leadership-level presentations.
  • Process improvement mindset with the ability to identify gaps and recommend practical solutions.

Additional Requirements:

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the Vendor Management Office with contract intake, routing, execution, amendments, renewals, and closeout activities.
  • Maintain accurate records for master agreements, statements of work, amendments, change orders, purchase orders, trial agreements, proofs of concept, NDAs, addenda, service-level agreements, compliance documents, and supporting materials.

  • Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to strengthen administration, governance, reporting, and workflow efficiency.
  • Handle confidential vendor, financial, and contractual information with discretion.

  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time efficiently.
  • Ability to listen actively and retain detailed information across technical projects.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex contract terms clearly.
  • Ability to negotiate effectively and support mutually beneficial agreements.
  • Understanding of relevant legal principles and contract law.
  • Ability to interpret basic contract terms, statements of work, renewal language, service levels, pricing, payment terms, purchase orders, invoices, and performance data.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and external vendors or service providers.
  • Ability to analyze contract terms and identify potential risks.
  • Ability to manage large volumes of contracts and supporting documentation efficiently.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate records and documentation.
  • Ability to manage confidential information professionally and responsibly.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint; experience with tools such as Atlassian Jira, Slack, Figma, Zendesk, Snap System, Basware, Purchase Manager, Agile1, and Smartsheet.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience supporting a Vendor Management Office, Procurement, Legal Operations, or Third-Party Risk Management team.

  • Familiarity with contract lifecycle management, procurement, ERP, ticketing, or workflow tools such as DocuSign CLM, Agile1, SAP, Oracle, Purchase Manager, ServiceNow, SharePoint, Smartsheet, Netlify, Jira, or Domo.

The Vice President, Advanced Advertising Strategy will shape the long-term vision, strategic direction, and innovation agenda for NBCUniversal’s advanced advertising business, translating market shifts, technology advancements, and evolving client needs into growth opportunities.

The role will take emerging ideas from their earliest stages through validation and toward commercial viability, working with Product and Strategy teams and ad-tech ecosystem partners to develop scalable businesses and capabilities aligned with NBCUniversal’s broader priorities and technology roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the long-term strategy. Set NBCUniversal’s advanced advertising vision, strategic roadmap, and investment priorities across audience intelligence, performance advertising, data collaboration, retail media, identity, measurement and attribution, emerging media channels, and AI-enabled advertising.
  • Incubate and validate new growth opportunities. Take emerging ideas from initial thesis through business-case development, market validation, testing, and commercial readiness. Establish disciplined experimentation frameworks to determine which opportunities merit further investment and scale.
  • Partner deeply with Product and Strategy. Work closely with Product teams to connect market opportunities to technology and capability roadmaps, and with Strategy teams to ensure advanced advertising priorities align with NBCUniversal’s broader strategic direction.
  • Identify and assess market disruption. Evaluate shifts in technology, consumer behavior, regulation, competitive dynamics, and advertising business models to identify where NBCUniversal should invest, partner, build, or experiment.
  • Build connectivity across the ad-tech ecosystem. Develop relationships with operators, entrepreneurs, technology companies, platforms, and other innovators across the advertising ecosystem to surface emerging ideas, capabilities, partnership opportunities, and potential strategic investments.
  • Advise senior leadership. Translate complex market developments and emerging opportunities into clear executive recommendations, strategic narratives, and investment priorities.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing strategy team. Build a team that combines strategic rigor, intellectual curiosity, commercial orientation, and a bias toward action, while effectively leading initiatives that require influence across organizational boundaries.
  • 10+ years of experience in business strategy, corporate strategy, management consulting, advertising technology, media, digital advertising, technology, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience developing new strategies, businesses, products, or capabilities from early-stage concept through validation and commercialization, connecting opportunities to client needs, market adoption, and business value.
  • Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem; experience in advertising technology, programmatic, CTV, audience and identity, performance advertising, data collaboration, measurement, or related areas strongly preferred.
  • Established credibility and relationships within the advertising and technology ecosystem, with the ability to engage effectively with technology operators, entrepreneurs, platforms, partners, and other industry leaders.
  • Exceptional strategic and analytical capabilities, including assessing emerging technologies, business models, partnerships, and investment opportunities; structuring ambiguous problems; and translating complex information into actionable strategies.
  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives, influence senior stakeholders without direct authority, and manage, develop, and motivate high-performing teams.
  • Strong executive presence and exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex ideas clear and actionable.
  • Highly proactive and intellectually curious, with a strong bias toward action and the ability to operate effectively in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree a plus.

job.description:

We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We are seeking an experienced Video Streaming Engineer to design, develop, operate, and optimize large-scale live and linear video streaming workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with audio and video encoding, live video processing, cloud-based media services, and streaming technologies.

This role involves working with cross-functional engineering, operations, and partner teams to deliver high-quality, reliable, and scalable streaming experiences. The candidate will also leverage scripting, automation, and AI-powered tools to improve operational efficiency, accelerate troubleshooting, and streamline engineering workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Audio and Video Encoding: Design, configure, troubleshoot, and optimize live video encoding workflows, including video codecs, audio formats, bitrate profiles, frame rates, resolutions, HDR, and adaptive bitrate (ABR) streaming.
  • AWS Media Services: Configure and manage AWS Elemental MediaLive and related AWS media services to support live video processing, encoding, and delivery workflows.
  • Live Streaming Operations: Support live and linear streaming pipelines, investigate video and audio quality issues, and ensure reliable delivery during high-profile live events.
  • Streaming Protocols and Formats: Work with HLS, MPEG-DASH, CMAF, MPEG-TS, and related streaming technologies, including manifest analysis, segment validation, and playback troubleshooting.
  • Automation and Scripting: Develop scripts and tools using Python, Bash, or similar languages to automate operational tasks, validate streaming configurations, analyze logs, monitor workflows, and reduce manual effort.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Apply AI-powered tools and coding assistants to accelerate script development, automate repetitive tasks, analyze logs, assist with troubleshooting, and improve engineering productivity.
  • Monitoring and Reliability: Develop and improve monitoring, alerting, diagnostics, and automated health checks to identify issues proactively and improve service reliability.
  • Performance and Cost Optimization: Analyze encoding performance, resource utilization, latency, bitrate efficiency, and cloud infrastructure costs to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Incident Management: Participate in troubleshooting production incidents, perform root-cause analysis, document findings, and implement preventive measures.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with software engineering, SRE, QA, video operations, and external technology vendors to test, qualify, deploy, and maintain streaming platform enhancements.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides, and share knowledge across engineering and operations teams
  • 5+ years of experience in video streaming, broadcast engineering, media processing, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Strong understanding of audio and video encoding concepts, codecs, compression, bitrate control, frame rates, resolution, and audio/video synchronization.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Media Services, MediaKind VOS360, Ateme, or other cloud-based vendors used for encoding and packaging Experience with live streaming workflows and protocols such as HLS and MPEG-DASH.
  • Proficiency in Python, Bash, or another scripting language for automation and troubleshooting.
  • Experience analyzing streaming manifests, media segments, encoding logs, and playback issues.
  • Understanding of live streaming reliability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production incident management.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools to improve coding productivity, automate workflows, or accelerate technical problem-solving.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, communication, and collaboration skills.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with AWS Elemental MediaPackage, MediaConnect, MediaTailor, CloudWatch, and related AWS services.
  • Familiarity with FFmpeg, media probing tools, and automated audio/video quality validation.
  • Knowledge of HEVC/H.265, AVC/H.264, AV1, AAC, Dolby Digital Plus, Dolby Vision, HDR10, or other modern media formats.
  • Experience with low-latency streaming, live event delivery, adaptive bitrate ladders, and content protection/DRM.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, APIs, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, and configuration management.
  • Experience developing AI-assisted operational tools, log-analysis workflows, intelligent alerting, or automated incident diagnostics.
  • Experience supporting large-scale live sports, entertainment, or broadcast streaming events.
  • Knowledge with Server Side Ad insertion (SSAI), transcoding and packaging

What’s In It For You?

  • Working for a well-known, globally leading Media Streaming organization
  • Exposure to high-level business professionals in a variety of departments and geographic locations
  • Opportunity to work and grow your career in fast-paced environment

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. job.id: Western New York Public Broadcasting Association
job.title: Broadcast Systems Engineer
job.description:
Buffalo Toronto Public Media is your local source for television and radio -

WNED PBS, WNED PBS KIDS, WNED Create, WBFO NPR, WNED Classical, and WBFO The Bridge!

We reach Western New York and Southern Ontario and can be streamed from your favorite device.

Engaging our communities through exploration and entertainment-everywhere.


We're looking for a Broadcast Systems Engineer!


What you'll be doing:

The Broadcast Systems Engineer is a member of the Tech Team responsible for the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting and integration of broadcast and broadcast IT systems supporting BTPM's radio and broadcast operations and systems design. This position serves as a technical bridge between traditional broadcast engineering and increasingly IP-, network- and software-based broadcast infrastructure. The position independently supports radio automation, Audio over IP (AoIP), streaming, broadcast applications, network-connected equipment and related systems while implementing and maintaining transmission and other broadcast infrastructure. This position can be hybrid - a blend of remote and in-office work. In summary, this individual will:

  • Perform the daily operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of broadcast systems and related IT infrastructure, including radio automation, AoIP systems, streaming platforms, digital audio systems, and network connected broadcast equipment and infrastructure
  • Perform installations, removal, configuration, testing, labeling, documentation, and maintenance of broadcast hardware and software, including workstations, servers, audio interfaces, codecs, processors, and other IP connected broadcast devices
  • Support and maintain internet radio streaming, enhanced HD Radio features, metadata delivery, and other digital broadcast services
  • Apply established broadcast audio practices, operating procedures, signal flow, cabling, patching, routing, inventories, and system and equipment configuration; develops and maintains technical documentation accordingly
  • Support broadcast network infrastructure, including IP addressing, VLANs, switches, routing concepts, network connectivity, and troubleshooting in coordination with IT personnel
  • Administer and support radio broadcast applications as assigned, including ENCO automation, Marketron Radio Traffic, NPR Composer, audio editing applications, streaming systems, and other software platforms
  • Troubleshoot broadcast signal paths and system failures across traditional audio, IP, software, and network environments; identifies root causes and implements corrective action
  • Perform transmitter, studio, microwave, satellite, and remote site maintenance activities as assigned, including preparation, documentation, and routine checks
  • Monitor system performance and reliability and performs preventive maintenance, software and firmware updates, backups, and other routine system maintenance
  • Participate in broadcast technology projects, system upgrades, equipment replacements, and integration of new technologies; maintain current knowledge of evolving broadcast technologies, broadcast IT systems, equipment, software, and applicable industry standards
  • Provide technical support and instruction to staff regarding broadcast systems, automation, and technical workflows
  • Coordinate with IT and Engineering personnel to maintain reliable, secure, and compatible broadcast technology environments.
  • Respond to broadcast outages and other urgent technical issues and participate in after hours or on call support as operationally required
  • Participate in scheduled training and hands on development in broadcast engineering practices, equipment, software, safety procedures, and industry standards
  • Follow established safety procedures and maintains knowledge of FCC requirements and applicable broadcast technical standards

What you'll need:

  • Minimum of Associate's degree (Bachelor's preferred) broadcast engineering, electronics, information technology, media technology, networking or related field; equivalent relevant industry/military experience or certifications considered
  • Minimum four (4) years of progressively responsible experience in broadcast engineering, broadcast technology or related technical operations
  • Demonstrated ability to independently install, configure, maintain and troubleshoot broadcast systems and equipment
  • Working knowledge of IP networking concepts including TCP/IP, addressing, VLANs, switching, routing and network troubleshooting
  • Demonstrated experience with AoIP and network-connected broadcast systems
  • Experience supporting Windows-based computers, servers and software applications in a broadcast environment
  • Working knowledge of radio automation, traffic, streaming and digital content-delivery systems.
  • Familiarity with RF transmission systems, transmitters, translators, STL systems and related broadcast infrastructure
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex problems involving multiple interconnected hardware, software, network and broadcast systems
  • Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, system diagrams and signal-flow documentation
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to independently prioritize urgent technical and operational needs
  • Knowledge of FCC broadcast rules and regulations
  • Ability to work collaboratively across Engineering, IT, Programming/Content and other operational departments
  • Authorized to work in the U.S.
  • Current, valid driver's license

Why BTPM?

Because we're awesome! You won't find a better group of talented, energetic people dedicated to quality content and reaching the various communities of our region. We are proud of our culture and promote a realistic balance of both work and personal life. Our benefits package is fantastic and we have free parking!


Salary and Benefits:

This is a full-time, non-exempt hourly position and starting pay will be based on education, experience and interview. Starting range: $23.38 - $29.23 per hour.

  • 12 paid holidays
  • 3 weeks of paid Vacation
  • Sick time (accrued)
  • Medical, Dental, Life, Vision Short- & Long-Term Disability insurance options
  • Health Savings Account (for applicable plans) with employer contribution
  • Flex Spending Account option
  • Voluntary Life, Accident, Critical Illness coverage options
  • Identity Protection option
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Tuition Assistance (based on eligibility)
  • Retirement Plan with 7.5% employer match (based on eligibility)

About the Role

New York Public Radio is seeking an experienced, results-driven Sales Director to join our Sponsorship team and drive revenue growth across NYPR’s portfolio of brands, programming, and platforms. job.title: New York Public Radio Careers
job.description:
Producer, Radiolab Radiolab, pioneer of narrative nonfiction podcasting, is seeking a full-time Producer to join the team. Radiolab producers take ideas from pitch to broadcast, participating in all parts of the production process. We’re seeking an ambitious, deep-thinking, deep-feeling journalist who is obsessed with great stories, eager to help our team tackle the big questions facing our world today. The Producer will spend much of their time deep in tape, sorting through vast amounts of audio, crafting the arc of the episode in ProTools, and building out the story. They will work closely with the editorial team, making new drafts of episodes. Sometimes the Producer will work on ideas they’ve pitched; oftentimes they’ll produce other team member’s work. The Producer will help craft the soundscape of the show.

Key Responsibilities

Regularly produce episodes from pitch to broadcast with minimal support Find, pitch more ambitious, nuanced, and successful story ideas Develop the arc of an episodes and craft narratives, with minimal editorial support Executing notes from editors on new drafts of episodes Cut interview selects and tracking tape Source archival tape Research for story ideas, booking guests, arranging logistics (ie ISDN, travel) Pre-interview, book potential guests, engineer in-studio interviews and tracking Perform field reporting and/or recording Conceive of storyboards with the team Write narration and craft the sound design/soundscape of episodes. Create new drafts of episodes in ProTools, experimenting relentlessly with story construction Liaise with fact checker for episodes Write and produce content for web, newsletter, and other platforms as needed Key

Qualifications

At least five years

experience

producing, reporting and/or editing in long-form narrative audio, and/or comparable

experience

in a related field Preferably has

experience

creating stories similar to the ones heard on Radiolab Has a clear grasp of what makes a surprising, impactful and complicated story that could be heard on Radiolab Has a proven ability to develop story arc and narrative Has solid journalism skills including: interviewing, database research and fact checking Has

experience

with linear editing software (ProTools, Logic, et cetera), and an advanced understanding of sound design Sense of humor and musicality are a plus It's important on the Radiolab team for everyone to work hard, be willing to pitch in on whatever is needed to get the job done, have an open mind, demonstrate integrity in their journalism, be wildly curious, and not be afraid to be a little bit weird. Additional Information This is a full-time non-exempt position with a salary range of $87,771-$95,000 and includes eligibility for medical, dental and vision insurance through SAG-AFTRA. This role is based in New York City and is expected to work at our NYC Headquarters two days per week. This position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement between New York Public Radio and SAG-AFTRA. Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion New York Public Radio is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We continuously strive to place our employees at the center of our thinking and elevate inclusive practices to develop and support a more engaged and productive workforce. Our journalism and operations in the service of that journalism benefit from a broad range of perspectives, from all backgrounds, at all levels of the organization. Diversity is essential to honest, authentic, accurate storytelling and reportage; creating an institution in which all voices are encouraged, valued, and heard. Equal Opportunity New York Public Radio is an

equal opportunity employer

committed to achieving the goal of equal employment opportunity for all. Applicants and employees are considered and evaluated for positions without regard to mental or physical disability, race, creed, color, religion, gender, national origin, citizenship status, age, genetic information, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, employment status or any protected federal, state or local status unrelated to the performance of the work involved. About Radiolab: Created in 2002 by host Jad Abumrad, and now co-hosted by Lulu Miller and Latif Nasser, Radiolab began as an exploration of science, philosophy, and ethics using innovative composition and sound design. Radiolab has expanded and evolved to become a platform for long-form journalism and storytelling. The show challenges its listeners’ preconceived notions about how the world works. Radiolab provokes, it moves, it delights, and it asks its audience to see the world around them anew. In the past year, the show released a series on a Guantanamo Bay detainee named Latif Nasser; covered the pandemic (by looking at the present and the past); composed an experimental non-narrative meditation on the end of the world; reported out topical stories on the power of protest (here and here, too), the risk of Donald Trump trying to steal the election, the

responsibilities

of the police (and lack thereof); and escaped to the bottom of the sea to spend time with an octomom. Since its founding nearly two decades ago, Radiolab has won some of the most prestigious awards in journalism, including two George Foster Peabody Awards, Third Coast awards, The Silver Gavel, as well as other accolades. In 2011 Abumrad received the MacArthur Genius grant. The show has spawned successful spinoff series, like More Perfect, Gonads, The Other Latif, G, Border Trilogy, and Radiolab for Kids. job.description:
A-hed Deputy Editor - Dow Jones A-hed Deputy Editor Dow Jones New York, NY Apply NowSign Up for Job Alerts Return to search results Job Description: A-hed Deputy Editor The Wall Street Journal New York City, Full-time

About the Role

The A-hed is one of the most beloved and distinctive features in The Wall Street Journal—the whimsical, front-page story that interrupts the day’s headlines with an arresting and creative tale. We’re looking for an experienced editor to shape and champion these stories: an editor with the judgment to spot a great idea in the wild, the skill to shepherd it from pitch to a polished, dynamic finished piece, and the newsroom relationships to pull great stories from every team. You will report to the Exchange & A-hed Editor on the Features team in New York, and also help edit business features and columns for Exchange. The ideal candidate is a self-starting editor experienced in news-feature editing with proven success producing highly engaging and visual digital-first stories across coverage areas. Stories from the Features team offer a lively lens on the zeitgeist, drawing connections between events and trends in the culture to form original, big-picture theses about the present moment.

What You’ll Do

Edit A-heds—which publish once daily—from pitch to publication, working closely with reporters to sharpen structure, voice and the reporting detail that makes a story sing. Solicit and develop ideas from reporters and editors across the entire newsroom, building a steady pipeline of distinctive stories. Coach reporters, some of whom may be writing their first A-hed, on the craft of the form. Exercise sharp news judgment about which stories work in the day’s mix could be refashioned as an A-hed. Collaborate with the news hub and Page One team on timing, print close and story mix with the rest of the Journal's daily report. Maintain and grow relationships across the newsroom so that good A-hed material reaches you early and often. Help maintain the consistency, surprise and delight that readers have come to expect from the fixture over its many decades. Contribute to other features editing and features projects as needed and assigned Who You Are An editor with 10+ years of

experience

and a strong track record of developing and editing narrative, feature, or enterprise journalism. Widely read and curious across many subjects—business, culture, science, sports, politics and global affairs. Possessed of real energy and enthusiasm for the unexpected, with an instinct for the story idea or headline that makes it to the group chat. A sharp, skilled line-editor of newswriting with a sense for wit, pacing, structure and well-placed reporting detail. Collaborative and relationship-driven, with the interpersonal skills to work across the entire newsroom and Features team. Strong, sound judgment on reporting scruples, legal considerations and tone, making sure every A-hed is meticulously bulletproofed and adherent to overall Wall Street Journal reporting standards. Organized and ready to manage a steady pipeline of stories at different stages, from early pitch to final polish, and take responsibility for managing a robust backlist and active calendar of stable options. How to Apply Please submit a resume, cover letter, and up to five editing samples (ideally including any feature, narrative, or humor writing you've shaped) by December 5th.

benefits

package covering health, retirement, wellbeing, and more, along with optional

benefits

to meet the diverse needs of our employees. The Wall Street Journal is a global news organization that provides leading news, information, commentary and analysis. The Wall Street Journal engages readers across print, digital, mobile, social, audio, and video. Building on its heritage as the preeminent source of global business and financial news, the Journal includes coverage of U.S. and world news, politics, arts, culture, lifestyle, sports, and health. job.description:
Email Marketing Specialist - Realtor.com Email Marketing Specialist Realtor.com Austin, TX Apply NowSign Up for Job Alerts Return to search results Email Marketing Specialist Location: Austin, TX, United States Category: Marketing Job ID: 3432 Apply Now Description Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user

experience

that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

About the Role

The Email Marketing Specialist handles day-to-day campaign deployment, QA, and subscriber management across our marketing automation stack. This role owns the email production pipeline, transforming creative assets and target criteria into tested, scheduled, and personalized email sends. The ideal candidate brings rigorous attention to detail, strong production discipline, and the ability to run day-to-day campaign operations efficiently.

What You'll Do

Campaign Deployment & Execution: Build, test, schedule, and send dynamic email campaigns and automated drip flows within Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Email Studio, Content Builder, Journey Builder). Audience Segmentation & Data Lists: Pull and configure targeted audience lists and data extensions; collaborate with the data/ops team to ensure accurate exclusion and inclusion filters. Template Assembly & Personalization: Assemble responsive email templates utilizing standard modular blocks, basic HTML/CSS adjustments, and dynamic personalization tags. Rigorous Quality Assurance (QA): Execute complete pre-flight checklists, including cross-device rendering checks (inbox placement tools), dynamic token validation, link/UTM tracking verification, and proof distribution. Operational Reporting & Hygiene: Monitor real-time send status, track core engagement metrics (open rates, click-through rates, deliverability, bounce rates), and flag delivery anomalies to leadership. Compliance & Best Practices: Maintain compliance with global messaging standards (CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR) and manage unsubscribes and suppression lists. What You Bring:

Experience

1–3 years of hands-on

experience

in email marketing production, campaign coordination, or digital marketing operations. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. Platform Proficiency: Direct working

experience

in enterprise email platforms (Salesforce Marketing Cloud preferred; candidates with strong hands-on

experience

in Marketo, HubSpot, Braze, or Iterable will also be considered). HTML/CSS Literacy: Ability to read and troubleshoot responsive HTML/CSS for email rendering fixes across major clients (Outlook, Gmail, Apple Mail). Execution & Detail: Proven track record of managing high-volume email deployments with zero tolerance for broken links, broken merge tags, or erroneous segmentation. Data Fluency: Fundamental understanding of contact lists, relational data/data extensions, and basic query logic (SQL awareness is a plus, but not required). Bonus Points Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Email Specialist credential. Familiarity with AMPscript, basic SQL, or Server-Side JavaScript.

Experience
