job.description:
Mgr, Software Engineering - Realtor.com Mgr, Software Engineering Realtor.com Austin, TX Apply NowSign Up for Job Alerts Return to search results Mgr, Software Engineering Location: Austin, TX, United States Category: Technology Job ID: 3445 Apply Now Description Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user

experience

that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

About the Role

Every visit to realtor.com passes through our edge before it reaches anything else. As Manager, Engineering for Edge Security and Delivery, you'll lead the team that owns that front door: DNS, CDN and edge routing, web application firewalls, bot defense, and DDoS protection for one of the most visited real estate sites in the US. You'll inherit an experienced team of edge engineers, grow it with new hires, and lead the shift from protection added case by case to an edge that is secure by default. You'll report to the Director of Edge Security and Traffic Engineering and work closely with product, data, security, and platform teams across the company. Top Reasons to Apply: Own the front door for a top real estate marketplace, serving billions of requests a month across hundreds of CDN distributions. Build, not just maintain: the role comes with a mandate and approved headcount to stand up a secure-by-default edge program. See your impact in the business. Bot traffic shapes audience metrics, lead quality, and ad revenue, so the team's work shows up in numbers leadership watches. Lead a small, senior team with clear ownership and few handoffs. Join an engineering org that is serious about AI-assisted engineering, with the tools and support to use it well.

What You'll Do

Lead, coach, and grow a team of about 5 engineers today, growing to about 7. Hire to a high bar, write development plans, and handle performance constructively. Own the roadmap for edge security and delivery: CDN, edge routing and compute, WAF, bot management, DDoS protection, and origin protection standards. Make protection the default. Every new public page, API, and distribution should launch covered, enforced through CI checks and launch review rather than follow-up tickets. Run the bot defense program. Deliver one bot signal shared with audience measurement, ads, leads, and sign-in, and balance stopping bad traffic against blocking real customers. Cut detection time. Build the observability that lets engineering spot edge attacks and misconfigurations in minutes, not weeks. Set edge standards for product teams that own their own origins, and review the launches that cross the edge. Own operational excellence for a Tier 1 path: on-call, incident response, postmortems with real follow-through, and change management. Manage edge vendors and spend: CDN, WAF, and bot management contracts, renewals, and cost per request. Drive AI adoption on the team and measure whether it actually improves outcomes. What You'll Bring: 2+ years managing software or infrastructure engineers, including hiring and performance management. 7+ years of engineering experience, with depth in at least one of: CDN and edge delivery, web application security, bot and abuse mitigation, or large-scale traffic engineering. Hands-on credibility with AWS edge services (CloudFront, Lambda@Edge or CloudFront Functions, AWS WAF, Shield, Route 53) or equivalents such as Akamai, Fastly, or Cloudflare. A strong grasp of HTTP, TLS, DNS, and caching, plus the OWASP Top 10 and common abuse patterns such as scraping, credential stuffing, and form spam. A track record of shifting security left: guardrails in CI/CD, policy and infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation), and secure defaults that teams adopt without being chased. A data-driven approach. You measure coverage, false positives, and time to detect, and you use those numbers to set priorities. The ability to explain risk and trade-offs clearly to engineers, product leaders, executives, and finance.

Experience

running on-call and incident response for a high-traffic, customer-facing system. Nice to have:

Experience

with commercial bot management platforms. API and GraphQL security experience.

Experience

leading AI-assisted engineering on a team. How We Work: We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. In this hybrid editorial, presenting, and technical production role, you will work predominantly across our dedicated Ukraine war YouTube channel Frontline and The Trump Report as well as on location shoots across multiple brands. You won’t just be behind the scenes - you will be a regular on-screen presence, hosting and presenting multiple episodes per week, while also possessing the hands-on technical expertise to shoot, light, and produce studio and on-location content using professional broadcast camera equipment. Day to day you will: On-Screen Presenting:Host, anchor, and present multiple video episodes and sharp social explainers per week across our Ukraine war YouTube channel andThe Trump Report, delivering complex geopolitical and US political developments with authority, clarity, and pace. Camera Operation & Studio Production:Set up, frame, light, and film video episodes using professional broadcast camera equipment, audio gear, and studio setups—ensuring broadcast-grade visual and sound quality across every shoot. End-to-End Video Production:Pitch, script, shoot, edit, and package original long-form YouTube episodes alongside high-impact vertical clips (YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and X). Editorial & News Judgement:Monitor breaking developments in the Russia-Ukraine conflict and US politics in real time, reacting quickly to turn breaking news into engaging, accurate, and legally compliant video content. Channel Growth & Optimisation:Manage uploads, titles, thumbnails, metadata, and SEO across YouTube and social platforms, using audience retention metrics and platform analytics to continually refine formats and drive subscriber growth. Talent & Guest Collaboration:Work closely with News UK correspondents, military analysts, political commentators, and editors to source expert insight and produce collaborative segments. experience

experience

operating professional broadcast cameras (e.g., Sony FX series, Canon Cinema EOS, or ENG cameras), lighting setups, and professional microphones in both studio and location environments. Subject Matter Knowledge:Strong editorial grasp of international affairs—specifically the ongoing war in Ukraine—as well as US politics and the Trump administration. Post-Production & Social Savvy:Proficient in non-linear editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or similar) with a deep understanding of YouTube algorithms, thumbnail packaging, and vertical video pacing. Newsroom Agility:Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced breaking news environment, capable of turning around scripts and edits quickly without compromising editorial standards or accuracy. job.description:
Reporter, Page Six Hollywood - New York Post Reporter, Page Six Hollywood New York Post Los Angeles, CA Apply NowSign Up for Job Alerts Return to search results Los Angeles Full time Job_Req_56607 Job Description: Page Six Hollywood (https://pagesix.com/hollywood/) is a distinct brand covering the business of Hollywood and the wider entertainment industry. We are looking for a resourceful, well-connected Los Angeles-based Reporter who understands the city’s cultural and industry landscape and knows how to turn access, relationships and firsthand experiences into compelling stories. The ideal candidate is plugged-in, energetic and naturally curious, with a genuine feel for the people, places and relationships that make Hollywood tick. Equally comfortable at a film screening, an industry party, a nightclub, an art gallery opening or a major Hollywood event, they will have a strong instinct for what matters, an eye for interesting characters and the ability to develop meaningful original journalism across written, video and social platforms. Strong writing and reporting skills are essential; on-camera confidence, social media fluency and

experience

creating content across multiple formats are major advantages.

Key Responsibilities

On-the-Ground Reporting: Build a regular presence at events across Los Angeles, from premieres and screenings to industry parties, clubs, gallery openings, cultural gatherings and entertainment business functions, identifying opportunities for original reporting. Hollywood and LA Knowledge: Demonstrate a strong understanding of Los Angeles, its cultural scene and the people and networks shaping the entertainment industry, including executives, talent, agents, producers, creatives and emerging industry figures. Original Story Development: Turn conversations, observations, relationships and access into distinctive stories, uncovering the personalities, trends, tensions and developments shaping the business and culture of Hollywood. Relationship Building and Access: Develop and maintain a broad network of useful contacts across the entertainment industry, nightlife, arts, media and Hollywood’s wider professional and social circles, building trust while pursuing original reporting. Business of Entertainment Coverage: Look beyond the red carpet to identify stories about the commercial, creative and cultural forces shaping Hollywood, from industry dealmaking and changing business models to the people and places influencing its future. Writing and Storytelling: Produce sharp, engaging copy in the distinctive Page Six Hollywood voice, combining strong reporting, vivid detail, original observations and an instinct for what will resonate with readers. Event Coverage and Editorial Initiative: Identify worthwhile events to attend, make the most of opportunities on the ground and proactively pitch story ideas, ensuring coverage delivers original insight rather than simply documenting who was present. On-Camera Reporting: Ideally be confident and engaging on camera, conducting interviews, capturing reactions and delivering concise, personality-driven pieces that bring Page Six Hollywood’s reporting to life. Social and Multi-Platform Content: Understand how to identify and create compelling social media content, including short-form video, interviews, behind-the-scenes footage and other material that extends the reach of original reporting across platforms. Collaboration and Editorial Judgment: Work closely with editors and colleagues to develop story ideas, verify information, identify follow-up opportunities and adapt reporting for newsletters, digital articles, video and social formats, while maintaining strong editorial standards. Requirements: At least 5 years of

experience

in journalism, reporting, entertainment writing, or a related editorial role, preferably covering Hollywood, entertainment, media, or culture. Strong knowledge of Los Angeles, its entertainment industry, cultural landscape, nightlife and social scene. Established relationships and contacts across the entertainment industry, including executives, talent, agents, publicists, producers, creatives and other influential industry figures. Exceptional writing, reporting, interviewing, sourcing and fact-checking skills, with the ability to produce engaging, accurate and well-researched stories. Strong news judgment and a natural instinct for identifying newsworthy moments, developing original story angles and uncovering stories others may overlook. Familiarity with digital publishing and social media platforms, including the ability to identify and create engaging content for digital, video and social audiences.

Experience

with short-form video, on-camera interviews or other multimedia storytelling is a plus. Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven newsroom. Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, to cover premieres, industry events, parties and breaking entertainment news. Must be based in or within commuting distance of Los Angeles, with the ability to regularly attend in-person events throughout the region. Note: This role will be based in our Century City office, with regular field reporting and attendance at events throughout Los Angeles. All work arrangements are subject to change based on business needs.

Senior Engineering Manager Mobile Platform - Realtor.com Senior Engineering Manager Mobile Platform Realtor.com Austin, TX Apply NowSign Up for Job Alerts Return to search results Senior Engineering Manager Mobile Platform Location: Austin, TX, United States Category: Technology Job ID: 3368 Apply Now Description Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user

experience

that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

About the Role

Realtor.com's mobile apps help millions of people each month search for, tour, finance, and move into their next home. The Mobile Platform team owns the shared foundations, tools, and standards that let our product teams ship quickly and confidently on iOS and Android. As Senior Engineering Manager, you will lead the iOS, Android, and tooling/build/release engineers on that team and treat the platform as a product. Internal mobile engineers are your customers, and you will measure success by their productivity, the quality and performance of our apps, and how quickly and safely we deliver value to consumers. You are a technically credible leader who guides architecture through strong tech leads, builds a high-performing and inclusive team, and influences across the Consumer organization. Top Reasons to Apply: Lead a major mobile modernization initiative. Help shape the future of Realtor.com's iOS and Android platforms, with the opportunity to influence architecture and long-term engineering strategy. Manage a highly experienced engineering team.Work alongside talented Staff and Senior Staff Engineers while focusing on technical leadership, mentorship, and strategic execution. Make an impact across the entire mobile organization.Build the tools and infrastructure that empower multiple feature teams to deliver better mobile experiences to hundreds of thousands of daily users.

What You'll Do

Platform as a product:Set the vision and multi-quarter roadmap, gather feedback from product teams, set adoption goals, and measure impact. Partner with Product, Design, and Mobile Product Engineering leaders to prioritize work. Developer experience:Own build systems, CI/CD, release automation, test infrastructure, and developer workflows. Improve release confidence with automation, feature flags, staged rollouts, and quality gates, and reduce duplication across iOS and Android with paved paths, templates, and documentation. Shared capabilities:Guide shared capabilities such as the design system, networking and data layer, authentication, analytics, experimentation, and SDKs. Set direction for app architecture and modularization on both platforms, and adopt cross-platform frameworks such as KMP or React Native where they make sense, respecting native conventions. App health:Own startup time, responsiveness, stability (crash and ANR rates), app size, accessibility, security, and privacy. Establish engineering standards and observability, lead incident response and root-cause analysis, and keep apps current with OS releases, store policies, and dependencies. Leadership:Lead, coach, and grow a team of 7 to 10 engineers, hiring and retaining top mobile talent. Work through tech leads and staff engineers to set technical direction and raise the bar. Build a culture of integrity, trust, quality, and continuous improvement, drive Agile incremental delivery, and communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership. What You'll Bring: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent

experience

8+ years of software engineering experience, including significant

experience

shipping mobile apps 2-5 years leading engineering teams, tech leads, or senior and staff engineers Deep

experience

in one native ecosystem (iOS with Swift/SwiftUI or Android with Kotlin/Jetpack Compose) and working knowledge of the other;

experience

in both is strongly preferred A track record of treating a platform, shared library, or internal tooling as a product, with defined customers, roadmaps, adoption, and measurable outcomes Strong grasp of mobile architecture, modularization, testing, CI/CD, and release engineering, and

experience

improving app performance and quality at scale Ability to set technical direction through tech leads, make sound trade-offs, and hold teams accountable for quality A results-oriented mindset, excellent communication, and the ability to influence across teams without direct authority A proven record of coaching engineers and growing their careers, with empathy for our customers How We Work: We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. job.title: Senior Manager, Transportation (Brownsburg, IN) - HarperCollins Publishers
job.description:
Senior Manager, Transportation (Brownsburg, IN) - HarperCollins Publishers Senior Manager, Transportation (Brownsburg, IN) HarperCollins Publishers Brownsburg, IN Apply NowSign Up for Job Alerts Return to search results

Overview

HarperCollins Publishers is opening a state-of-the-art, 1.6 million-square-foot distribution center in Brownsburg, Indiana, an exciting new hub that will help bring books to readers, customers, and communities across the country. We are currently seeking a Senior Transportation Manager for this start-up operation. This critical leadership role responsible for establishing and executing the transportation strategy for new distribution center operation. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Logistics, this position provides strategic and operational leadership for all inbound and outbound transportation activities, carrier management, yard operations, transportation systems, and logistics personnel supporting a high-volume, multi-shift distribution environment. Success in this role requires a transformational leader with a proven ability to build high-performing teams, drive organizational change, develop scalable processes, leverage data-driven decision making, and create a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus.

Responsibilities

Lead all inbound and outbound transportation operations supporting a 1.6 million square foot distribution facility with more than 80 dock doors. Provide leadership and strategic direction for transportation operations supporting a multi-shift operation. Maintain availability during operational business hours to support transportation-related escalations, issue resolution, and business-critical decision making. Oversee a combination of live load/unload and drop trailer operations while ensuring cost, service, safety, and productivity objectives are achieved. Manage facility trailer yard operations supporting approximately 150 trailer positions, including oversight of Yard Jockey operations. Ensure team compliance with company policies, transportation regulations, and safety standards. Partner other Distribution Leaders to establish and maintain best practices for pallet preparation, trailer loading methods, load securement, and trailer cube optimization; implement loading strategies that maximize trailer utilization, reduce transportation costs, minimize product damage, and improve safety. Utilize the HarperCollins Transportation Management System (TMS) to support routing, load planning, carrier selection, freight management, and transportation optimization. Work extensively within the HarperCollins Warehouse Management System (WMS) to support efficient inbound and outbound operations, including ASN creation and management, scheduling and dock management, freight consolidation and documentation compliance. Provide cross-functional collaboration with Production, Sales, Finance, Customer Service, and Information Technology teams to develop cost-effective and efficient supply chain solutions. Develop, implement, and maintain transportation KPIs, scorecards, dashboards, and reporting processes, analyzing operational performance data and implementing solutions that improve efficiency, service, safety, and cost performance. Lead root-cause investigations and corrective action plans related to transportation delays, service failures, freight claims, and operational disruptions. Lead, coach, develop, and retain a team of Freight Planners, Logistics Specialists, and Logistics Coordinators, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, safety, customer service, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field preferred. Equivalent combination of education, professional certifications, and relevant work

experience

will be considered.

Experience

10+ years of progressive transportation, logistics, or supply chain leadership experience. Demonstrated success leading transportation operations within large-scale, multi-shift distribution, fulfillment, manufacturing, or warehouse environments. Proven

experience

managing domestic transportation networks and carrier relationships.

Experience

with Parcel, Less-Than-Truckload (LTL), and Full Truckload transportation modes. Strong

experience

with Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).

Experience

leading transportation planning, yard operations, dock operations, and logistics teams within a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; Working knowledge of SQL and database reporting tools. Occasional travel may be required. The salary range for this position is $105,000 - $115,000. We recognize that attracting the best talent is key to our strategy and success as a company. As a result, we aim for flexibility in structuring competitive compensation offers to ensure we are able to attract the best candidates. The quoted salary range represents our good faith estimate as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on the selected candidate's experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process. In addition to cash compensation, the company provides a comprehensive and highly competitive

benefits

package, with a variety of physical health, retirement and savings, caregiving, emotional wellbeing, transportation, and other benefits, including "elective"

benefits

employees may select to best fit the needs and personal situations of our diverse workforce. Visit our careers webpage (https://www.harpercollins.com/pages/careers) for more information. Please note: The Brownsburg operation is a smoke-free, tobacco-free campus. HarperCollins Publishers is an equal opportunity employer. HarperCollins Publishers is committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities, in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application, due to a disability, email us at TalentManagement@harpercollins.com . Note: we will only respond to accommodation requests. job.title: Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Security - Realtor.com
job.description:
Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Security - Realtor.com Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Security Realtor.com Austin, TX Apply NowSign Up for Job Alerts Return to search results Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Security Location: Austin, TX, United States Category: Technology Job ID: 3427 Apply Now Description Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user

experience

that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

About the Role

Our apps and websites run on APIs. A public API gateway and a federated GraphQL platform carry billions of requests a month, covering listings, search, sign-in, saved homes, and the leads we send to agents. As the founding Staff engineer for API security on our new Edge and API Security team, you'll set the technical direction for how we protect them. You'll decide how every API is authenticated, which operations are allowed, how abuse is detected and stopped, and how new APIs ship secure by default. You'll work hands-on and lead through influence across platform, product, identity and security teams, with leadership backing and a clear mandate. Top Reasons to Apply: A Key technical role on a high impact team. You'll shape its architecture, standards and hiring from day one. Real scale: billions of API and GraphQL requests a month, and abuse that ranges from scraping to account takeover. Direct business impact: your work protects consumer accounts, the quality of leads sent to agents, and the data that powers our business. A modern stack, all managed as code: an API gateway, Apollo GraphQL Federation, Kubernetes and policy-as-code. Room to apply automation and AI to detection and response. Leadership that wants guardrails built into the platform, not more tickets.

What You'll Do

Own the API security architecture across the API gateway and the GraphQL platform, and set the multi-quarter roadmap. Define and enforce an authentication standard for every public API, and lead the migration of existing unauthenticated APIs to it, working with the owning teams. Secure GraphQL end to end: approved-operation lists and persisted queries, depth and cost limits, field-level authorization, and safe schema change. Protect high-value flows such as sign-in, registration, account and lead submission against credential stuffing, account takeover, scraping and fake submissions. Make "secure by default" real, using admission policies, CI checks and gateway policies that stop an unprotected API from reaching production. Build detection and alerting on API abuse, so attacks surface in minutes, not in downstream business reports. Lead response to API attacks and abuse, and turn every incident into a lasting fix. Mentor engineers, set API security review standards, and help hire the rest of the team. What You'll Bring: 8+ years in security, platform or backend engineering, with 5+ years focused on API or application security at large scale. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. Deep knowledge of API security: OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, API keys and client identity, mTLS, and the OWASP API Security Top 10. Hands-on GraphQL security

experience

federation, persisted queries and safelists, query cost analysis, introspection controls, and authorization patterns.

Experience

operating an API gateway (such as Tyk, Kong or AWS API Gateway), including policy design, rate limiting and key management. Kubernetes and policy-as-code

experience

(ValidatingAdmissionPolicy, OPA or Kyverno), plus infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Strong programming skills in at least one language such as Go, TypeScript or Python, and comfort reading and changing service code.

Experience

job.title: Anchor/Reporter
job.description:
Newsroom leaders wanted!  WFFF/WVNY, the Fox & ABC affiliates in the beautiful Burlington-Plattsburgh area are looking for a News Anchor/Reporter. You will serve as a primary presenter of news stories and other content for all platforms in a manner that is clear, engaging and meaningful to news consumers.  You will write and edit copy for news and serve as the co-anchor.

We are looking for an experienced journalist who can lead by example.  This anchor must maintain an on-air persona that is friendly, energetic, and authoritative.  Anchor must exhibit urgency every day, particularly during breaking news, and be able to engage with the community on air, digitally and in person. 

We expect our anchors to be newsroom leaders.  You will be a part of a growing news team built on a strong emphasis of positive reinforcement, feedback, growth, and a desire to win. 

Duties & Responsibilities:

·         Produce content for multiple platforms, including TV, internet, mobile, etc.

·         Work with management to enterprise and develop stories daily

·         Demonstrate compelling storytelling using dynamic live shots and stand-ups, creative graphics, and use of digital and social media platforms

·         Organize material, determine angle or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards

·         Gather and verify information regarding stories through interview, observation and research.

·         Build network of sources who supply information that allows the Company to stay ahead of its competitors

·         Performs special projects and other duties as assigned

Requirements & Skills:

·         Bachelor’s degree in communication/journalism or related degree required (equivalent years of experience may substitute for education)

·         Three (3) years television anchoring or reporting experience preferred

·         Solid vocal delivery, camera presence, and clear enunciation

·         Strong reporting skills

·         Understand importance of social media

·         Excellent reading, writing, spelling, grammar and organizational skills

·         Promotes teamwork and maintains attitude of cooperation with all station personnel

·         Operate newsroom computer systems

·         Valid Driver’s License with good driving record

·         Flexibility to work any shift

 

Benefits:

·         Pay: $16 - $18 per hour, depending on experience

Competitive compensation package with medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(K), and more.

job.title: Content First News Anchor
job.description:
Fox 2 St. Louis is looking for a dynamic journalist who can lead on-air and on every platform where audiences spend their time. This role combines the credibility and leadership of a traditional news anchor with the creativity and agility of a modern content creator.

 

This is more than a traditional anchor role - it's an opportunity to inform communities, build meaningful audience relationships, and deliver impactful local journalism across broadcast, streaming, digital, social, and emerging platforms.

The Ideal Candidate:·        

  • You understand how to turn one great story into compelling experiences across multiple platforms while maintaining the highest standards of accuracy, fairness, and trust.·        
  • You understand that trust is earned through strong reporting, transparency, authenticity, and consistency.·        
  • You're equally comfortable anchoring a major breaking news event, reporting in the field, posting a quick social update, hosting a live stream, or creating a digital explainer that helps audiences better understand the issues shaping their community.·        
  • You know great journalism deserves great distribution, and you're excited to help reach audiences wherever they are.. 

What You'll Do:·        

·         Anchor newscasts, live streams, and breaking news coverage with confidence, credibility, and energy.

·         Report and produce original content that informs, explains, and serves local communities.

·         Create platform-specific content for social media, streaming, digital, and broadcast audiences.

·         Develop short-form videos, explainers, live updates, and behind-the-story content that extends coverage beyond the newscast.

·         Build direct relationships with audiences through authentic engagement and conversation.

·         Identify stories and topics that matter most to local communities and prioritize content accordingly.

·         Collaborate with reporters, producers, photographers, and digital teams to maximize reach and impact.

·         Respond quickly to breaking news while maintaining accuracy and strong editorial judgment.

·         Participate in community events and represent the station throughout the market.

·         Help drive innovation in storytelling, audience engagement, and content distribution. 

Qualifications·        

·         Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

·         Minimum five years of experience in news anchoring, reporting, or multi-platform journalism.

·         Strong live presentation and ad-lib skills.

·         Excellent writing, editing, and communication abilities.

·         Experience creating engaging content for digital, social, streaming, and video platforms.

·         Understanding of audience engagement strategies and modern content distribution.

·         Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced newsroom.

·         Experience with video editing, social publishing tools, and content management systems.

·         Valid driver's license and flexibility to work schedules driven by news coverage.

job.title: Content First Traffic Reporter/ MMJ
job.description:
Fox 2 St. Louis is looking for a dynamic journalist who can deliver breaking traffic information, enterprise reporting, and compelling content across every platform where audiences spend their time.

 

This role combines the urgency and precision of a traffic reporter, the storytelling skills of a multimedia journalist, and the versatility of a modern content creator.

 

The Traffic Reporter serves as the face of the FOX 2 CrossRunner, a first-of-its-kind cross-platform mobile newsroom that allows you to work on the go while streaming live to air and digital audiences. Equipped with workstations, cameras, live streaming capabilities, and an onboard drone, the CrossRunner enables real-time traffic reporting and breaking news coverage from anywhere in the market.

The Ideal Candidate:

·         You understand how to transform real-time traffic information into meaningful content that helps viewers make smarter decisions throughout their day.

·         You thrive in breaking news environments and can quickly communicate evolving situations clearly, accurately, and conversationally.

·         You are equally comfortable presenting live traffic reports, reporting breaking news in the field, creating social content, hosting livestreams, and producing digital updates.

·         You understand that traffic reporting is more than maps and delays. It's storytelling that explains the impact of crashes, construction, weather, and transportation issues on local communities.

·         You have strong editorial judgment and understand that trust is earned through accuracy, authenticity, transparency, and consistency.

 

What You'll Do:

·         Deliver live traffic reports across station newscasts, streaming channels, social platforms, and digital products.

·         Monitor traffic systems, traffic cameras, transportation resources, and breaking incidents to provide timely, accurate updates.

·         Utilize the FOX 2 CrossRunner to produce, direct, and present live traffic reports from locations across the St. Louis region.

·         Respond immediately to major crashes, traffic jams, road closures, severe weather impacts, and transportation-related breaking news.

·         Operate as a Multimedia Journalist, reporting original stories that impact local communities beyond daily traffic coverage.

·         Pitch, shoot, write, edit, produce, and present content for broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms.

·         Build direct relationships with audiences through authentic engagement on social media and community events.

·         Collaborate with producers, reporters, photographers, content creators, and digital teams to maximize the reach and impact of coverage.

·         Maintain the highest standards of journalistic integrity, accuracy, fairness, and production quality.

·         Participate in special projects and other duties as assigned.

 

Qualifications

·         Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Broadcast Journalism, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

·         Minimum two years of experience in reporting, multimedia journalism, traffic reporting, anchoring, or related newsroom experience.

·         Strong live presentation, conversational delivery, and ad-lib skills.

·         Superior on-air presence and the ability to communicate complex situations clearly and confidently.

·         Excellent writing, editing, storytelling, and communication abilities.

·         Experience creating engaging content for broadcast, digital, streaming, social, and video platforms.

·         Strong news judgment and ability to make quick editorial decisions under deadline pressure.

·         Experience shooting, editing, and producing multimedia content.

·         Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

·         Familiarity with traffic reporting systems, maps, transportation resources, and breaking news workflows is preferred.

·         Experience with video editing software, social publishing tools, content management systems, and mobile journalism equipment is preferred.

·         Valid driver's license with a good driving record.

·         Flexibility to work schedules driven by breaking news and coverage needs.

job.title: Digital Campaign Specialist
job.description:
WKRG is seeking an experienced Digital Campaign Specialist to support the execution, measurement, and optimization of our digital advertising solutions. This role serves as the technical bridge between our sales team, corporate ad operations, digital partners, and clients.  You will coordinate campaign setup, implement tracking, monitor performance, and analyze results to help ensure campaigns deliver measurable value. You will also equip our sales team with the insights, recommendations, and technical expertise they need to grow client relationships and digital revenue.  This is a hands-on technical role for someone who understands digital advertising tools, can troubleshoot problems independently and knows how to turn data into actionable business insights.

Key Responsibilities

 

Campaign Strategy & Coordination

  • Translate client objective into coordinate, full-funnel campaign plans rather than disconnected tactics.
  • Coordinate campaign setup with corporate ad operations and extended digital partners, communicating essential requirements such as creative assets, tracking pixels, audiences, geography, product specifications, timelines, and measures of success.
  • Work with digital partners across programmatic, CTV/OTT, online video, streaming audio, social, paid search, and email.
  • Monitor campaign pacing and performance, identify issues and coordinate solutions or recommend optimizations.

 

Tracking and Measurement

  • Implement and troubleshoot Google Tag Manager, GA4 events, pixels, conversion tags, UTM standards, call tracking and form tracking.
  • Measure relevant outcomes such as qualified visits, calls, leads, appointments, bookings, purchases, and matched-audience activity where data allows.
  • Distinguish delivery metrics from business outcomes and communicate attribution or cross-platform measurement limitations clearly.
  • Analyze campaign, audience, and client-provided data to identify trends and next steps.

 

Technical Expertise & Sales Support

  • Build and maintain mobile-friendly landing pages and lead forms and conversion pathways aligned with campaign goals.
  • Audit digital readiness to include website experience, analytics, conversion friction, content quality, local business information, reviews and brand consistency. 
  • Develop clear, client-ready reports that connect campaign performance to client goals.
  • Identify performance trends, optimization opportunities and potential upsells, sharing actionable recommendations with sales team.
  • Partner with sales team to develop digital proposals, including recommended tactics, budgets, targeting, estimated delivery and measurement plans.
  • Join client meetings, discovery calls, and campaign reviews when technical expertise is needed.

 

Qualifications

 

Required

Candidates must have hands-on experience with the following:

  • Analytics and tracking: Proficiency with GA4, Google Tag Manager, tracking pixels, conversion events, UTMs, and attribution fundamentals.
  • Digital campaign operations:  Experience with campaign setup, targeting, creative requirements, pacing, performance troubleshooting, and optimizations across multiple channels.
  • AI-era discovery:  Understanding of generative search, AI visibility, zero-click behavior, content authority, and video discoverability.
  • Audience strategy:  Familiarity with first-party data, household or addressable targeting, propensity signals, retargeting, match back, and privacy conscious measurement.
  • Conversion experience: Experience with landing pages, forms, websites, and digital touchpoints that influence lead quality and conversion.
  • Paid digital advertising: Working knowledge of SEM and other paid digital campaigns, including performance analysis and optimization.
  • Reporting and analysis: Ability to analyze data across multiple platforms, identify trends, explain limitations, and communicate actionable recommendations.

 

Preferred

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience in digital advertising, ad operations, campaign strategy, marketing analytics, or performance media.
  • Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, ad servers, DSPs, CTV/OTT platforms, social platforms, YouTube, CRM systems, or first-party data workflows.
  • Experience with AI visibility audits, content strategy, generative search readiness, publisher content, or video discoverability.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, including sound judgement about what campaign data can and cannot prove.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical concepts and performance results in plain language.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines while working collaboratively with sales, corporate teams, and external partners.
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, analytics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

job.title: Digital Content Producer
job.description:
Position Summary: This role is responsible for updating the KNWA/FOX24 news website, curating local content, crafting homepage layouts driven by data, and helping to report the news -- everything from quick-hit local stories to breaking news and enterprise reports. The successful candidate will have strong writing skills, an aptitude for social media, and a passion for content creation.

The ability to shoot and edit video is desirable for the role, as well. Above all, we're looking for someone with an optimistic outlook and a winning attitude.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepares, writes, copy-edits and posts news, community and promotional content on the station's website, mobile apps and other social media accounts
  • Ensures factual, grammatical and legal accuracy online and upholds the station’s established journalistic standards
  • Monitors real-time metrics to guide content decisions and reviews past story performance to identify topics of interest to our audience
  • Works closely with the greater newsroom and station to have online content properly published
  • Monitors local and statewide topics and pitches trending & high-interest stories
  • Finds ways to convert one-time and regular visitors into loyal followers
  • Strong writing and editing skills, attention to detail
  • Ability to function under tight deadlines and shifting priorities
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Requirements & Skills:

  • Requirements & Skills:
  • Degree in Journalism or a related field, or experience as a digital content producer or related experience
  • Excellent writing and editing skills, attention to detail
  • Ability to take complicated facts and data and relay them in easy to understand, fair, and accurate stories
  • Familiarity with news writing and journalistic standards
  • Ability to function under the pressure of tight deadlines
  • Must have strong news judgment and work with the online team and greater newsroom to plan daily and long-term content
  • Strong multi-tasking abilities and quick decision-making

If interested, apply online now or email resume to Jesse Cordova, at jcordova@knwa.com.

Northwest Arkansas is a rapidly growing and vibrant community filled with rolling hills, rivers, lakes and Fortune 500 company headquarters. Our population just crossed 500k and is rising. Why? Because high-end business industries are here and they are bringing in some of the best talent in their fields, cost of living is low, quality of living is high and we fill up our days/nights with world-class museums, performing arts centers, major sporting venues, amazing concerts, fantastic foodie destinations and tons of community-centric events. 

In fact, U.S. News ranks Fayetteville as one of the best places to live in the country:  http://realestate.usnews.com/places/arkansas/fayetteville

Our newsroom is forward-thinking and built on a strong emphasis of positive reinforcement, feedback, growth and development of talent and a desire to win. We are consistently winning awards from our local audiences for our commitment to our community and our service-centered sense of duty. Whether you are looking for a place to settle in or a place to equip yourself and launch into that “big step” – we have a proven track record of providing both outcomes.

job.title: Digital Content Producer
job.description:
The Digital Content Producer crafts, curates and distributes timely news content for multiple audiences and platforms. 

The producer must thrive in a fast-paced news environment, responding quickly and decisively to breaking and developing stories. They must be able to craft content that is engaging and audience-focused while maintaining high standards of fairness, accuracy and editorial integrity. They will work collaboratively with newsroom staff to develop compelling multimedia coverage while demonstrating the initiative and problem-solving skills necessary to work independently. Daily decisions will be guided by strong editorial judgment, audience data and engagement trends. Adaptability, positivity and a passion for news are essential.

The typical schedule for this position is Monday through Friday, 2:30 p.m. to 11:30 p.m. The schedule may include occasional weekend and holiday shifts, and hours may vary to cover breaking news.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Writes and publishes news articles for multiple platforms
  • Acts with urgency during breaking news, quickly producing accurate, clean copy for immediate distribution
  • Gathers information and reaches out to sources to develop cross-platform news coverage
  • Collaborates with reporters, producers and newsroom staff
  • Edits and posts reporter scripts and newsroom content for platform-specific audiences
  • Curates and edits national wire content
  • Coordinates content sharing with sister stations
  • Manages video content for digital publication
  • Selects and schedules social media content based on audience trends, engagement data and editorial priorities
  • Crafts engaging social media posts designed to drive readership without sensationalism or misleading language
  • Distributes time-sensitive app, desktop and email alerts, including selecting stories and writing concise, compelling alert language
  • Curates the homepage and other digital platforms using editorial judgment, audience analytics and performance data
  • Applies SEO best practices in headlines, article structure and metadata
  • Works collaboratively across departments and contributes positively to newsroom culture

Skill/Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field required
  • 2 years of experience in digital news, web production, or social media production preferred
  • Commitment to accurate, fair and ethical journalism
  • Strong news judgment and understanding of audience interests
  • Excellent writing and editing skills with experience writing full articles
  • Exceptional attention to detail with strong spelling, grammar, fact-checking and copy editing skills 
  • Ability to write compelling headlines and social copy to drive engagement without clickbait
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills within a newsroom environment
  • Comfortable making phone calls, interviewing sources and independently gathering information for digital reporting
  • Ability to remain focused, prioritize effectively and quickly execute time-sensitive publishing procedures during breaking news situations
  • Strong technical proficiency and digital literacy, including the ability to troubleshoot routine technical issues
  • Ability to quickly learn, retain and consistently apply established editorial guidelines and technical workflows.
  • Experience with AP Style
  • Experience managing and posting content on social media platforms, particularly Facebook
  • Experience with basic video editing
  • Some schedule flexibility (weekends, holidays)

job.title: Evening News Anchor (Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Portsmouth)
job.description:
Evening News Anchor (Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Portsmouth)


WAVY-TV 10 / WVBT FOX 43 is searching for an ambitious and dedicated news anchor. You'll join the number one team in the Virginia Beach/Norfolk, Virginia market. WAVY has a reputation for winning breaking news coverage, using top shelf technology and resources for getting people answers through our 10 On Your Side reporting.

We are looking for someone who actively engages in all areas of journalism, especially the call to serve the public. This anchor will be asked to field anchor, report, break news stories and handle long-form content when necessary. You will be responsible for generating sources, enterprising story ideas, and follow-ups. "Digital First" thinking is a must. We are searching for a standout anchor who is just as comfortable anchoring on CTV as they are on linear platforms, with a strong emphasis on adlibbing and producing content.


Experience: 3-5 years of experience anchoring newscasts at a commercial station is required.


The successful candidate will have strong command of all aspects of anchoring; demonstrates strong news judgment; and is a proven team leader. The successful candidate must demonstrate the desire to put journalistic skills such as newsgathering, writing, interviewing, and ethical decision-making into practice daily.


Overnights, nights, and weekends may be required; candidate must be willing and able to work any and all shifts.


To be considered for this job you must apply online at https://nexstar.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/nexstar. Pre-employment background & DMV check.


Please remember to upload a copy of your resume and include a link to your work.

 

COMPENSATION RANGE:

Annual Salary $120,000 - $130,000 – commensurate with experience

 

ADDITIONAL BENEFITS:

  • A career path to grow your professional experiences
  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits
  • Retirement savings plan with company match
  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, hospital indemnity, critical illness, life insurance, AD&D, ID protection, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.

job.title: FREELANCE/CONTRACT DIGITAL VIDEO JOURNALIST
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: 

 

PIX11 News is looking for a full-time digital video first journalist who is passionate, talented and hard-working to help report on stories for social media and digital platforms. 

 

This digital video journalist will be focused on creating at least two vertical videos a day for our social platforms and news app. They will also be responsible for writing articles for our PIX11.com website. 

 

The ideal candidate will have a knack for finding stories that align with our content pillars as a news organization. They will also have a general knowledge of the area including all of NYC and New Jersey. 

 

This person will be an expert in SEO and vertical video content creation. While creating content that performs well is ideal -  we are more focused on locating a candidate who is well-versed in adapting news stories for social media consumption that focus on integrity, service and reliability. 

 

The right person for this job will be able to produce fast, compelling and accurate content, and help take PIX11.com and its social media platforms to the next level as an important source for news and video with a strong local focus.

 

This role will include morning, evening and weekend shifts.

 

The position’s chief responsibilities require that the digital video journalist:

 

Be able to work in a fast-paced environment. Digital video journalists are expected to write multiple stories per day, shoot/edit two vertical videos a day and pivot to breaking news stories as needed.

 

Be proficient in creating vertical video and have knowledge of programs like Adobe Premiere and CapCut. 

 

Be proactive in content discovery, identify social media content that our audiences will want and keep abreast of breaking local news.

 

Have knowledge of SEO best practices and website optimization. The ability to write strong headlines is essential.

 

Be familiar with website and social media analytics, and how to use these metrics to inform future editorial decisions, grow our digital audience and drive traffic. 

 

Create vertical video content and write compelling social media copy for Facebook, TikTok, X and Instagram. 

 

Create engaging mobile app and desktop pushes using language that drives pageview traffic.

Copy edit stories and video graphics, keeping in mind both grammar and AP style.

 

Clip and publish video segments from newscasts.

 

Requirements and skills

 

Minimum of 3-5 years of news reporting or writing experience in a digital space.

 

Ability to work professionally with station staff to put out the best possible digital product. 

 

Applicants should be able to work independently and as part of a larger team, including fellow digital producers, assignment editors, reporters and TV producers.

 

Passion for the news, digital presentation and a commitment to fairness and accuracy.

 

Curiosity about the latest digital tools and a willingness to experiment with new ways to tell stories and reach a wider audience.

 

Knowledge of the following tools is a plus: WordPress, Google Trends, Chartbeat, Meta Insights, CapCut, Adobe Premiere and Social News Desk.  

 

At the time of your application, please be prepared to show at least five video samples published within the last two years.

job.title: Full Time News and Content Producer
job.description:
KNWA & FOX24, the NBC & FOX affiliates in Fayetteville, Arkansas, are looking for an aggressive, innovative, creative and dynamic News Producer to help take our product to the next level!

 

Do you love breaking news and investigative reports?

Are you willing to drop everything to win the big story and showcase weather?

Do you live for the thrill of finding a new way to make a story pop?

 

If so - you could be the right person for this job! We need a strong, experienced producer who can build newscasts to make an impact in our community!

 

Digital and social media chops are a strong plus -- we want to win across every platform! This role will include producing evening newscasts, possibly filling in as a producer on other shifts if needed, writing daily news stories for television and digital, working with video and managing multiple content sources before and during live broadcasts.

 

Above all, we're looking for someone with journalistic integrity an optimistic outlook and a winning attitude!

 

Northwest Arkansas is a rapidly growing and vibrant community filled with rolling hills, rivers, lakes and Fortune 500 company headquarters. Our population just crossed 500k and is rising. Why? Because high-end business industries are here and they are bringing in some of the best talent in their fields, cost of living is low, quality of living is high and we fill up our days/nights with world-class museums, performing arts centers, major sporting venues, amazing concerts, fantastic foodie destinations and tons of community-centric events. 

 

Our newsroom is forward-thinking and built on a strong emphasis of positive reinforcement, feedback, growth and development of talent and a desire to win. We are consistently winning awards from our local audiences for our commitment to our community and our service-centered sense of duty. Whether you are looking for a place to settle in or a place to equip yourself and launch into that “big step” – we have a proven track record of providing both outcomes. 

 

KNWA-TV/KFTA-TV is an equal opportunity employer.

·         Responsible for evaluating stories; organizing them into a cohesive sequence within a newscast or digital content for the web

·         Contribute to the editorial process and make solid decisions in breaking news situations

·         Execute strategies that engage and grow audiences across all media devices

  • Responsible for evaluating stories; organizing them into a cohesive sequence within a newscast or digital content for the web

  • Contribute to the editorial process and make solid decisions in breaking news situations

  • Execute strategies that engage and grow audiences across all media devices

 

Requirements & Skills:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Communications, TV/film or the equivalent

  • Experience in television or radio broadcast/production a plus

  • Must be able to interact well with video journalists, anchors, videographers, news managers, production and engineering staff

  • Detail oriented

  • Excellent verbal, written, and analytical skills

  • Strong news judgment, journalistic integrity and understanding of viewer needs and expectations

  • Utilize state-of-the-art television technology and digital/social media platforms

job.title: Investigative Reporter/Producer (Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Portsmouth)
job.description:
WAVY-TV 10 / WVBT FOX 43 is searching for an INVESTIGATIVE REPORTER/PRODUCER who is driven to research, write and produce hard investigative enterprise stories. You will be required to work within a team of reporters, photographers, and managers to cultivate sources, dig up source material from scratch, and organize several stories in various stages of development simultaneously. This role will be a major part of the station's online success with your story posts to WAVY.com.

Several years of experience as an investigative reporter/producer delivering enterprise stories from pitch to air is a must.

A history of on-air work at a commercial television station is required. The ideal candidate will also know how to acquire relevant public records by searching court databases and filing FOIA requests.  The successful candidate will be relentless in the pursuit of the truth. You must have a proven track record of strong journalistic skills and supreme ethical standards.


We're looking for someone who understands how to be professional and fair in investigative newsgathering techniques, and who knows how to take advantage of all resources available to a free press. We believe in the IRE mission of fostering excellence in investigative journalism and protecting the rights of investigative journalists.


Overnights, nights and weekends may be required; candidate must be willing and able to work any and all shifts, including holidays.

job.title: Master Control Operator
job.description:
The Master Control Operator is responsible for the overall on-air look of television stations through airing programming and scheduled station breaks in a centralized broadcast hub environment. 

  • Updates and maintains signal control systems
  • Maintains programming logs as required by station management
  • Segments content and clips to the server and then trims and modifies it
  • Prints traffic logs and appends logs to the data management system
  • Monitors strength, clarity and reliability of incoming and outgoing signals and adjusts equipment as necessary to maintain quality broadcasts
  • Selects sources from which programming will be received, or through which programming will be transmitted
  • Reports equipment problems and ensures that repairs are made and makes emergency repairs to equipment when necessary and possible
  • Ensures the station’s compliance with Emergency Alert System requirements
  • Performs other duties as assigned

 Requirements & Skills:

 

  • Technical degree in Digital Electronics, Broadcasting, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience
  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written
  • Minimum three years’ experience with digital electronics systems in a television broadcasting environment (More or less depending on market size)
  • Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment.
  • Strong PC/MS Office experience
  • Experience with digital transmitters and other broadcast-related equipment
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Previous broadcast hub or Master Control experience preferred

job.title: Meteorologist
job.description:
From powerful thunderstorms and tornados to damaging winds, hail, winter storms, and rapidly changing conditions, Kansas experiences some of the nation’s most dynamic and high-impact weather. Keeping people informed, prepared, and safe is our responsibility. Our meteorologists play an important role in the community we serve.

 

KSNT/KTMJ is seeking a meteorologist who can forecast, produce and anchor weather coverage in a manner that is clear, engaging and meaningful to consumers. That includes live field reporting during significant weather events and creating original content for broadcast and digital platforms.

Job Duties:

 

·         Produce and present weather reports that are informative, easy to understand, and engaging for our viewers.

·         Help keep the community safe by communicating potentially dangerous weather conditions, explaining threats, and providing actionable information during severe and rapidly changing weather events.

·         Create compelling weather reports for television, our website, social media, and streaming platforms.

·         Take weather stories beyond the forecast by writing, shooting, and editing original video content.

·         Collaborate with meteorologists and the rest of the news team to deliver timely, accurate, and comprehensive weather coverage.

·         Respond quickly to breaking and/or severe weather events and other urgent newsrooms situations when needed.

·         Connect with viewers through social media, answering questions and sharing useful weather information.

·         Participate in community events, public appearances, and station promotions.

·         Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Requirements & Skills:

 

·         Bachelor’s degree in meteorology, atmospheric science or a related field. Current college students working toward a related degree and recent graduates are encouraged to apply.

·         Good communication and storytelling skills, with the confidence and ability to think on your feet and communicate naturally during live coverage of weather events.

·         Ability to become proficient in newsroom systems and technology following training. Experience with MAX weather software is a plus.

·         Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

·         Initiative and creativity, with the ability to take a story from an idea to finished content with appropriate guidance and support.

·         Fluency in English.

·         Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

·         Flexibility to work a variety of shifts, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and breaking news/severe weather coverage.

job.title: Meteorologist (Part-time/Temporary)
job.description:
KSNW TV in Wichita, Kansas is looking for a part-time meteorologist to join an experienced weather team on a temporary basis. You'll get a chance to forecast in one of the most dynamic weather markets in the country. Bilingual (Spanish) meteorologists are encouraged to apply, to provide forecasting for our Telemundo station. Top notch forecasting and radar skills must be matched by great communication skills, a learning attitude, and a positive style. Our new Meteorologist will also need to be enthusiastic about competing in the digital realm, including podcasts and streaming shows, social media and regular contributions to our website. Knowledge of Baron systems is a plus. BS in Meteorology or equivalent is preferred, although students with strong experience working toward the appropriate degree may be considered. AMS/CBM and/or NWA Seal preferred. 

 

JOB SUMMARY:  Anchors weathercasts and weather content for all platforms, including TV and digital, able to handle continuous severe weather coverage in the heart of Tornado Alley.

Principal Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Forecasts and prepares weather products across all platforms, including television and digital platforms
  • Anchors weathercasts on KSN and affiliated newscasts; Bilingual (Spanish) meteorologists will anchor weathercasts on Telemundo newscasts
  • Anchors severe weather coverage and produces special content as required for severe weather
  • Actively develops content for social media, podcasts and other digital platforms to inform and engage viewers and grow audience
  • Plays an active and visible role in the community

 

Specialized Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Rock solid forecasting skill and love of meteorology
  • Outstanding real time Dual Pol Doppler Radar interpretation skills
  • Dynamic, personable, genuine on-air performance skills
  • Strong ability to grasp the fast-changing digital world, delivering weather content across multiple platforms
  • Excellent people skills to ensure smooth and productive working relationships both internally and externally
  • Positive leadership skills to create and maintain cohesive weather team
  • Fluent in English, Bilingual (Spanish) a plus 

 

Training/Equipment: Familiarity with Baron broadcast meteorology systems a plus. Willingness to learn and gain expertise a must.

 

Requirements: BS in Meteorology or equivalent preferred, although students with strong experience working toward the appropriate degree may be considered. Transcripts will be required. AMS/CBM and/or NWA Seal required or the ability to obtain your seal both preferred. Two years of professional broadcast meteorology experience preferred.

 

Work Environment/Mental/Physical Requirements: This position requires the occasional lifting of objects up to 50 pounds. Work may be conducted in extreme outdoor weather conditions. Position requires long hours, work on weekends, evenings and holidays. High stress environment with deadline pressures. Some travel may be required.

job.title: Meteorologist, Nexstar Weather Center
job.description:
The Meteorologist, Nexstar Weather Center works in the weather support center for broadcast stations owned or operated by Nexstar Media Group. Based in Dallas, Texas, the Nexstar Weather Center provides forecasting and on-air weather to markets and creates content for streaming and digital platforms.

Responsibilities

  • Works with a team of meteorologists based in Dallas, Texas
  • Delivers on-air weather for multiple Nexstar stations
  • Provides weather support to several Nexstar divisions, finding coverage and logistics solutions
  • Ensures all weather content meets company standards for journalistic integrity and production quality
  • Assists Nexstar markets as needed, prioritizing requests to serve local audiences
  • Contributes to streaming and digital weather products, including CTV content

Requirements and skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Meteorology or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience
  • At least 18 months of experience in weather forecasting in broadcast television
  • Proficient on both Max (TWC) and Lynx (Baron) graphics systems
  • Strong understanding of meteorology and a proven forecasting record
  • Experience with CTV and streaming production tools, such as OBS or vMix
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to ad lib when required
  • Strong on-air presence
  • Ability to listen, understand a local market's needs, and collaborate on a solution
  • Proficiency with computers, telephones, and standard office equipment
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize, and handle multiple tasks at once
  • Flexibility to work any shift, including weekends
  • Required to work in a studio in Dallas, Texas. No remote work.
  • Fluency in English
  • Valid driver's license with a good driving record

job.title: MMJ
job.description:
Excited to grow your career?

We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply!

Our people make all the difference in our success.

Report on stories in several newscasts to the public.  Ability to ad-lib and handle breaking news.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Accurate reporting of news stories
  • Attend editorial meetings and submit story ideas
  • Develops community contacts and a network of news sources
  • Must be able to ad lib live breaking news by telling a compelling story with a strong ability to interact with anchors in studio
  • Works with the photographer in the recording and editing of a story
  • Regularly updates newsroom on story elements and progress
  • Use various social media platforms to provide updates and news stories to the public
  • Timely file stories to all platforms-on-air, online and mobile
  • Attend station partnerships in the community

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Must have undergraduate degree or equivalent related experience
  • Prefer 3-5 years TV news reporting experience in a medium to large market

REQUIREMENTS/QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Must interact positively and productively with other employees and in the field
  • Strong on-air presentation - must be credible, personable and passionate
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Must be able to accept constructive direction and criticism designed to enhance individual’s performance
  • Can perform duties and make decisions under extreme pressure
  • In line with reporting duties, individual must be flexible with schedule and be willing to work additional hours or days or different shifts as required by news content

job.title: Multi Media Account Executive (Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Portsmouth)
job.description:
MULTI-MEDIA ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE (Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Portsmouth)

Ready to help shape the future of media? At WAVY-TV, WVBT FOX43, and CW Hampton Roads, we do more than sell TV—we help local businesses grow with creative marketing solutions across broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms. We're looking for a driven, motivated Account Executive who enjoys building relationships, thinking strategically, and helping clients connect with their audiences through the power of multi-platform media.

About the Role:

As an Account Executive at WAVY-TV, WVBT and CW Hampton Roads, you'll serve as a consultative partner to local and regional businesses—developing custom advertising strategies across our robust multimedia portfolio. You’ll be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values creativity, integrity, and performance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospect and secure new business through networking, referrals, and outreach.
  • Manage and grow a book of active clients, cultivating long-term partnerships.
  • Develop integrated marketing campaigns that include linear TV, streaming (OTT/CTV), digital display, social, and branded content.
  • Work cross-functionally with production, creative, promotions, and digital teams to bring campaigns to life.
  • Deliver clear, data-backed proposals and recommendations to clients.
  • Consistently meet or exceed individual revenue goals and quarterly targets.
  • Stay current on media trends, competitive insights, and emerging platforms.

What We’re Looking For:

  • A creative, proactive problem solver who thrives on helping clients succeed.
  • A persuasive storyteller who can connect business challenges to tailored media solutions.
  • A self-starter with strong time management and follow-through skills.
  • A confident communicator—written, verbal, and in client-facing presentations.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Communications or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Minimum 2-5 years of proven success in media, marketing, or B2B sales.
  • Knowledge of digital advertising platforms (e.g., OTT, SEO/SEM, etc.).
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office; CRM experience is a plus.
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.

Why WAVY-TV, WVBT and CW Hampton Roads?

  • We're part of Nexstar Media Group, the nation’s largest local media company.
  • Our reach includes NFL, college football, Hampton Roads Show, and trusted news coverage.
  • Access to advanced tools, strong leadership, and hands-on sales training.
  • Full benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401k) & monthly phone allowance provided.

To be considered for this job you must apply online at https://nexstar.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/nexstar. 

COMPENSATION RANGE:

Commission based

ADDITIONAL BENEFITS:

  • A career path to grow your professional experiences
  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits
  • Retirement savings plan with company match
  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, hospital indemnity, critical illness, life insurance, AD&D, ID protection, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.

No calls

No telecommuting.

EOE/Minorities/Females/Vet/Disability

#LI-Onsite

SCAM ALERT:

Please be aware candidates may be at risk of being targeted by scammers seeking personal data or money. Recruiters with Nexstar Media Group and its local stations will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with Nexstar.tv domain or official station email addresses (example:@wreg.com).  Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nexstar or its recruiters via any other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. We will not contact you using a @gmail email address. If you are unsure about the authenticity of a job inquiry or offer, email us at corporaterecruiters@nexstar.tv.
