job.title: Multi Media Journalist - Part Time
job.description:
The Multimedia Journalist Reporter produces, reports, shoots, writes, voices, edits and feeds news production content for all platforms in a manner that is clear, engaging and meaningful to news consumers.

KSNT-TV/KTMJ-TV is seeking a part-time Multimedia Journalist to join our news team. We're looking for someone eager to develop their reporting, storytelling, and content creation skills in a fast-paced, multiplatform newsroom. The ideal candidate is curious about local communities and current events, has a passion for journalism, and is motivated to tell compelling stories that matter to local audiences across television, digital, streaming, social media, and mobile platforms.


This position is designed for aspiring journalists looking to gain hands-on newsroom experience and build skills in broadcast and digital news. Successful candidates will have the opportunity to develop a professional portfolio, strengthen reporting and storytelling abilities, and work alongside experienced journalists covering the issues and events that impact northeast Kansas.


Applicants should include a link to a demo reel, portfolio, or examples of relevant class projects, student media work, internships, or other storytelling content.


Responsibilities

  • Assist in reporting, shooting, writing, editing, and presenting local news stories for television and digital platforms.
  • Develop and pitch story ideas that inform, engage, and connect with local audiences.
  • Create and publish content across television, digital, social, streaming, and mobile platforms.
  • Research stories, conduct interviews, verify information, and develop an understanding of responsible and ethical journalism.
  • Produce content in real time as news develops, including breaking news coverage, while building newsroom reporting skills.
  • Develop relationships with community members, local organizations, public officials, and news sources.
  • Participate in field reporting and build confidence in live reporting and on-camera presentation.
  • Use newsroom technology, digital publishing tools, editing software, and broadcast equipment while developing technical proficiency.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements and Skills

  • A bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, or a related field is preferred. Current college students pursuing related degrees, recent graduates, and candidates with relevant experience are encouraged to apply.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Interest in developing skills in video production, photography, editing, and digital content creation.
  • Familiarity with social media platforms and digital audience engagement.
  • Willingness to learn broadcast equipment, mobile journalism tools, editing software, and newsroom systems.
  • Valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record.
  • Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions.
  • Flexibility to work a variety of shifts, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours during breaking news and special event coverage.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist
job.description:
The Multimedia Journalist Reporter produces, reports, shoots, writes, voices, edits and feeds news production content for all platforms in a manner that is clear, engaging and meaningful to news consumers.

  • Reports news stories for broadcast, describing the background and details of events
  • Arranges interviews with people who can provide information about stories
  • Reviews copy and corrects errors in content, grammar and punctuation, following prescribed editorial style and formatting guidelines
  • Reviews and evaluates notes taken about event aspects to isolate pertinent facts and details
  • Determines a story’s emphasis, length and format, and organizes material accordingly
  • Researches and analyzes background information related to news stories to be able to provide complete and accurate information
  • Gathers information about events through research, interviews, experience or attendance at political, news, sports, artistic, social or other functions
  • Pitches stories to news managers and news producers which are relevant to the local community
  • Receives assignments and evaluates leads and tips to develop story ideas
  • Discusses issues with producers and/or news managers to establish priorities or positions
  • Checks reference materials such as books, news files or public records to obtain relevant facts
  • Revises work to meet editorial approval or to fit time requirements
  • Shoots and edits news events and news reports
  • Produces and presents reports for all platforms
  • Ensures that all content meets company standards for journalistic integrity and production quality
  • Writes stories for the web and other eMedia platforms
  • Interacts with viewers/users on social media sites
  • Performs special projects and other duties as assigned

 

Requirements & Skills:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Journalism, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience
  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written with the ability to ad lib when required
  • Minimum two years’ experience in news reporting (Depending on market size)
  • Superior on-air presence
  • Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Valid driver’s license with a good driving record
  • Flexibility to work any shift

job.title: On Air Television Host/Digital Lifestyle Content Correspondent
job.description:
Nexstar Media Group’s WAVY-TV 10 (NBC) in Hampton Roads, Virginia, is looking for a full-time, on-air Co-Host for its one-hour daily lifestyle show “The Hampton Roads Show.”


Key Responsibilities:


The successful candidate is a skilled and seasoned communicator who is adept at engaging viewers, guests, and clients in both a non-scripted, fun, lifestyle show environment and the social media world.  Knowledge of current events, popular culture, and compelling subjects making news in Hampton Roads (Norfolk DMA) is key. The ideal candidate brings strong interview skills, relatable on-camera personality, and an energetic social media presence. Contributions to other WAVY-TV, FOX43, The CW Hampton Roads, WAVY+ programs and platforms will be required.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Host daily, hour-long lifestyle show and host post-show production elements.
  • Write and edit scripts; prep for interviews. Schedule show content well in advance.
  • Post and Interact regularly with viewers and users on social media.
  • Represent HRS and WAVY at community events as an emcee and/or speaker.
  • Research show topics and develop questions for guests/clients in coordination with Producer.
  • Greeting and assisting guests/clients during show preparations.
  • Other duties as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS & SKILLS


  • Ability to work a regular on-site schedule required (8:00am-5:00pm Monday-Friday mornings), with additional night and weekend shoots occasionally possible.
  • Three years’ on-air lifestyle/interviewing/hosting experience is preferred: Strong hosting, interviewing, and Creative Writing skills required with experience with hosting sales-integrated content being a plus.
  • Excel on multiple platforms – broadcast, connected television (CTV-streaming), web, and social media.
  • Ability to coordinate, shoot, and edit your own content required.
  • Proven execution in writing for the web using AP style and adept at creating and managing social media posts of lives/videos/images to engage and grow an audience.
  • Software: ENPS, Adobe Creative Cloud, Premiere and Photoshop, Bit Central, OBS, VMix.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:  Bachelor’s degree in journalism, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience


To be considered for this position you must apply online. Please remember to include a link to your hosting demo reel in your cover letter or resume (required). No hard copy submissions accepted, reviewed, or returned.

Key Responsibilities:


The successful candidate is a skilled and seasoned communicator who is adept at engaging viewers, guests, and clients in both a non-scripted, fun, lifestyle show environment and the social media world.  Knowledge of current events, popular culture, and compelling subjects making news in Hampton Roads (Norfolk DMA) is key. job.description:
The PT Seasonal - JIB & Handheld Camera Operator is responsible for getting shots using either a JIB or Handheld camera. This person will be responsible for setting up, operating and maintaining both types of cameras and equipment to create visually compelling footage for both News and other productions.


MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work with technical and news staff to satisfy production needs for live, taped and automated programming
  • Collaborate with news, production, and engineering teams to ensure smooth operations and troubleshoot technical issues.
  • Follow directions from the director to get shots that help enhance the presentation of our news and other productions
  • Actively contribute to SOP, workflow, and show report documentation.
  • Adapt to last-minute changes and breaking news, making quick decisions under pressure.
  • Other duties include Robotic Camera Operation for breaks and meals

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Must be organized and methodical
  • 2+ years of experience as a Camera Operator, preferably JIB and Handheld experience
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays as news coverage demands.
  • Must be able to lift 25+ lbs. depending on set / strike studio gear

job.description:

We provide the tools for powerful advertising solutions - you provide a positive attitude, client focus, and desire to WIN! If you want to work for the best, we want to hear from you today!

The Multimedia Marketing Executive generates advertising revenue by calling on established agencies, cold-calling new prospects and convincing potential clients of the merits of television, digital and social media advertising. While implementing strategies to consistently grow revenue and exceed revenue goals.

  • Establishes credible relationships with local business community.
  • Makes sales calls on existing and prospective clients.

  • Provides clients with information regarding rates for advertising placement in all media.

  • Works with clients and station personnel to develop advertisements.

Requirements & Skills:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising or Mass Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.
  • Minimum one year’s experience in sales, preferably in the media field.
  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Experience achieving long-range objectives and implementing the strategies and actions to achieve them.
  • Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment.

job.title: Strategic Account Manager
job.description:
WJZY / Queen City News is seeking a Strategic Account Manager to help lead the growth of our digital and cross-platform advertising business in the Charlotte market. This is a sales-focused, consultative leadership role for someone who understands that successful digital selling is about more than presenting products. The Strategic Account Manager will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Managers, and clients to uncover business challenges, develop compelling marketing strategies, and build solutions that drive measurable results. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker, strong communicator, curious problem solver, and confident sales partner who can help transform complex digital marketing opportunities into simple, compelling solutions for local businesses. You will serve as a digital and cross-platform subject matter expert, helping the sales team identify opportunities, strengthen client relationships, win new business, and grow existing accounts.

  • Key ResponsibilitiesDrive Digital Revenue Growth
  • Partner with Account Executives and Sales Managers to identify, develop, and close digital and cross-platform revenue opportunities.
  • Develop strategies to grow both new and existing digital business.
  • Identify high-potential accounts and verticals and create targeted sales strategies to penetrate those opportunities.
  • Participate in client meetings and presentations as a strategic marketing and digital subject matter expert.
  • Help sales teams increase the value of client relationships by expanding marketing solutions beyond traditional television.
  • Become a Strategic Sales Partner
  • Work alongside Account Executives throughout the sales process—from prospecting and discovery through presentation, closing, and campaign strategy.
  • Help sellers prepare for meetings through research, business intelligence, and development of a clear client-focused point of view.
  • Coach and collaborate with sellers on digital strategy, positioning, objection handling, and solution development.
  • Bring creativity and a challenger-style, consultative approach to client conversations.
  • Help simplify complex digital marketing concepts and translate them into clear business outcomes.
  • Develop Client-Centric Marketing Solutions
  • Conduct research to understand a client's business, competitive environment, target audience, and marketing objectives.
  • Ask thoughtful questions to uncover client needs and opportunities rather than relying on a product-first sales approach.
  • Develop customized marketing strategies designed to increase awareness, generate leads, drive conversions, and grow market share.
  • Present recommendations with a focus on business outcomes, audience strategy, measurement, and return on investment.
  • Build trusted relationships with local businesses and advertising agencies by serving as a marketing resource and strategic advisor.
  • Lead Digital Sales Enablement
  • Keep the sales organization informed about new products, capabilities, industry trends, best practices, and emerging opportunities.
  • What We're Looking ForThe ideal candidate will have:
  • Proven experience in digital advertising, media sales, marketing, advertising technology, or a related field.
  • Strong consultative and solution-based sales skills.
  • A demonstrated ability to develop relationships with clients and uncover business needs.
  • Experience presenting marketing strategies and recommendations to business owners, executives, and/or advertising agencies.
  • A strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem and current marketing trends.
  • The ability to translate complex marketing concepts, data, and technology into simple business solutions.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • A proactive, competitive, and entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to understand how marketing impacts revenue and growth.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively with salespeople while also taking ownership of revenue opportunities.
  • A willingness to continually learn and adapt in a rapidly changing media and advertising landscape.
  • What Success Looks LikeSuccess in this role goes beyond selling digital products.The successful Strategic Account Manager will:
  • Grow digital revenue.
  • Help Account Executives win more business and larger opportunities.
  • Create stronger, more strategic client relationships.
  • Turn client business challenges into compelling marketing solutions.
  • Increase adoption of cross-platform solutions.
  • Elevate the digital expertise of the entire sales organization.
  • Become a trusted strategic resource for both clients and sellers.
  • This is an opportunity for a sales-minded marketing strategist who wants to have a direct impact on revenue, client success, and the evolution of a modern local media organization.

job.title: Technical Director - Part Time
job.description:
The Technical Director coordinates the efforts of all technical operators during newscasts and other live and recorded productions.

KSNT/KTMJ is seeking a part-time Technical Director to play a key role in producing live local news and special programming. Working behind the scenes with producers, anchors, and field crews, you'll help manage the technology and production systems that bring broadcasts to viewers across northeast Kansas.


Whether you're studying media production, exploring a career in broadcasting, or already have experience with video and production technology, this role offers valuable hands-on experience in a fast-paced newsroom. We value technical aptitude, attention to detail, dependability, and a willingness to learn. Training is provided, and prior experience is helpful but not required.

 

Job Duties

  • Direct live and recorded newscasts and special programs using automated production control systems to manage cameras, graphics, audio, and video playback.
  • Coordinate closely with the content team to execute the editorial and creative vision of each broadcast.
  • Respond quickly to technical issues during live broadcasts and breaking news coverage.
  • Maintain high production standards and ensure compliance with FCC regulations and company policies.
  • Support special projects and perform other duties as assigned.

 

Requirements and Skills

  • Ability to make sound decisions and remain focused in a fast-paced, deadline-driven live production environment.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Willingness to learn broadcast systems, production workflows, and newsroom technology through training and hands-on experience.
  • Experience with video production, live events, broadcasting, streaming, audio/video systems, or related technology is a plus but not required.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, quality, and professional broadcast standards.
  • A bachelor's degree in media production, broadcasting, communications, film, audio/video technology, or a related field preferred. Current college students working toward a degree in a related field, recent graduates, and candidates with equivalent education or relevant experience are encouraged to apply.
  • Availability to work a flexible part-time schedule, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and breaking news coverage as needed.

job.title: Traffic Coordinator
job.description:
Nexstar Media Group, Inc. has an immediate opening for a Traffic Coordinator! Do you have a knack for numbers? Are you a schedule follower? If keeping the largest television station ownership group in the country on-the-air and broadcasting around the clock could enhance your career journey, Nexstar Media Group invites you to be our next behind-the-scenes star. Help us broadcast and program commercials from coast to coast in Traffic operations hubs located in Salt Lake City!

Nexstar owns America’s largest local broadcasting group comprised of top network affiliates, with 200 owned or partner stations in 117 U.S. markets reaching 220 million people. In addition to delivering exceptional content and service to our communities, Nexstar provides premium multiplatform and video-on-demand advertising opportunities at scale for businesses and brands seeking to leverage the strong consumer engagement of our compelling content offering.

We are extremely proud of our collection of outstanding television stations, digital businesses and talented employees nationwide. Within Nexstar, we are investing and building for the future while forging a culture that promotes our entrepreneurial spirit, embraces bold thinking and challenges the conventional way. If you have curiosity, passion, are inclusive and collaborative, work with us and let’s continue to make a difference for all our stakeholders ~ our colleagues, our customers, our owners, and the communities in which we operate.

What you’ll accomplish as a Traffic Coordinator (Essential Duties):

·         Multitasking with new orders and adjustments to existing logs

·         Daily interaction with television professions in markets across the country

·         Cross department collaboration with sales, engineering, master control, etc.

·         Processing of incoming orders and sales contract translation into the sales module

·         Daily generation of commercial and programming logs for 200 stations in 117 markets

·         Scheduling commercials and applying traffic instructions to every scheduled commercial

·         Inventory control, database library management, broadcast automation, logistical issues

·         So much more


What you’ll need as a Traffic Coordinator (Preferred Qualifications):

  • High school diploma
  • English language skills
  • Meticulous data-entry skills
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written
  • Knowledge of, and the ability to interpret, sales contracts
  • Ability to comply with deadlines and perform under pressure
  • Proficiency with computers and an ability to learn new software quickly
  • At least 1 year of experience in clerical support or administrative assistance

If this sounds like you, Nexstar Media Group could be your next home for thriving community involvement, omnichannel advertising innovation and supported career growth.


Nexstar offers full-time employees a comprehensive benefits package to include medical, life and short-term disability insurance, worker’s compensation, and unemployment insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid holidays, paid vacation, paid sick time, employee assistance program, bereavement leave, jury duty service time off, military leave and medical/maternity and family leave.


Nexstar is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the industry’s top talent.  In compliance with the provisions of all applicable state and federal civil rights laws, every effort will be made to employ the most qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, disability, age, sex, national origin, citizenship, veteran’s status, sexual orientation, military status or any other protected personal characteristic. Additionally, it is and shall continue to be our policy to provide promotion and advancement opportunities within the Company in a nondiscriminatory fashion based on merit, qualifications and ability.

·         Daily generation of commercial and programming logs for 200 stations in 117 markets

·         Scheduling commercials and applying traffic instructions to every scheduled commercial

·         Inventory control, database library management, broadcast automation, logistical issues

·         So much more


What you’ll need as a Traffic Coordinator (Preferred Qualifications):

  • High school diploma
  • English language skills
  • Meticulous data-entry skills
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written
  • Knowledge of, and the ability to interpret, sales contracts
  • Ability to comply with deadlines and perform under pressure
  • Proficiency with computers and an ability to learn new software quickly
  • At least 1 year of experience in clerical support or administrative assistance

job.title: Traffic Reporter/MMJ
job.description:
As the part-time Traffic Reporter/MMJ at WRIC, this individual must be able to manage our traffic system and be comfortable reporting on breaking accidents and jams. This candidate will also go out as a multimedia journalist and report.

 

  • Reports news stories for broadcast, describing the background and details of events
  • Arranges interviews with people who can provide information about stories
  • Reviews copy and corrects errors in content, grammar and punctuation, following prescribed editorial style and formatting guidelines
  • Reviews and evaluates notes taken about event aspects to isolate pertinent facts and details
  • Determines a story’s emphasis, length and format, and organizes material accordingly
  • Researches and analyzes background information related to news stories to be able to provide complete and accurate information
  • Gathers information about events through research, interviews, experience or attendance at political, news, sports, artistic, social or other functions
  • Pitches stories to news managers and news producers which are relevant to the local community
  • Receives assignments and evaluates leads and tips to develop story ideas
  • Discusses issues with producers and/or news managers to establish priorities or positions
  • Revises work to meet editorial approval or to fit time requirements
  • Shoots and edits news events and news reports
  • Produces and presents reports for all platforms
  • Ensures that all content meets company standards for journalistic integrity and production quality
  • Writes stories for the web and other eMedia platforms
  • Interacts with viewers/users on social media sites
  • Performs special projects and other duties as assigned

Salary Range: 18.00 – 21.00 per hour


Requirements & Skills:

 Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Journalism, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience

  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written with the ability to ad lib when required
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Valid driver’s license with a good driving record
  • Flexibility to work any shift

job.title: Administrative Assistant
job.description:
The Administrative Assistant will primarily provide administrative support to three Senior Vice Presidents. The position will handle a wide range of administrative and executive support-related tasks, including but not limited to calendar management, meeting preparation, travel arrangements and coordination, organizing and submitting expenses, and project management. The Administrative Assistant will operate with the utmost discretion while working with highly confidential information, ensuring impeccable attention to detail, organizational skills, and thoroughness. Additionally, this position will be in constant communication with both internal and external partners and clients.

Responsibilities

  • Manage complex and ever-changing day-to-day schedules of the SVPs via Microsoft Outlook, scheduling and organizing meetings across multiple time zones.
  • Anticipate all needs of the executives by thinking and working proactively with a one-step-ahead mentality throughout the day in terms of meeting prep, arising issues and new developments.
  • Prepare for meetings and appointments by creating agendas and other pertinent materials, preparing conference rooms and audio/visual needs and securing external guests when applicable.
  • Provide high-level administrative support to executives including answering phones, coordinating/preparing for meetings, maintaining calendar, arranging conference calls, arranging complex travel arrangements which include international, etc.
  • Serve as liaison between the SVPs and key stakeholders.
  • Act as a "gatekeeper" by managing the SVPs leadership’s calendars. This involves using discretion in identifying critical items, setting up meetings and making scheduling changes with minimal involvement by the executive. Plans, coordinates and ensures schedules are followed and respected.
  • Make thoughtful, quick and accurate decisions when executive is unavailable.
  • Assist in regularly creating and editing memos and PowerPoint presentations to be presented by the executives.
  • Coordinate travel arrangements; prepare detailed travel itineraries inclusive of flights, hotels, meeting agendas, etc.
  • Screen phone calls and forward calls appropriately, communicating with external and internal partners in a professional manner.
  • Oversee personal and departmental expenses. Prepare, reconcile and submit all necessary invoices and credit card expenses in Concur in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Handle confidential information meticulously; escalate any required information with discretion.
  • Ensure SVPs remain organized and on-schedule through proactive, consistent communication throughout the day.
  • Facilitate mass internal communication (ie. distributing company-wide e-mails, reports, etc.)
  • Draft, review and send communications on behalf of executives.
  • Organize and coordinate multiple large meetings, materials, reports, etc.
  • Keep up to date on department specific initiatives and timelines.
  • Maintain an accurate and current list of internal and external contacts.
  • Have a clear understanding of the company structure and the way departments operate.
  • Miscellaneous projects and tasks as assigned in a timely and accurate fashion.
  • Nurtures strong partnerships with a broad range of individuals including other EAs, facilities, the executive’s direct reports, travel, IT, security and other key internal stakeholders.
  • Answer questions with tact, diplomacy and accuracy.
  • Operate with sound judgement and efficiency.
  • Keep executives abreast on time sensitive and priority issues, ensuring appropriate follow-up.
  • Handle printing, faxing, copying, filing, mail and shipping.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 4+ years of prior administrative/executive assistant experience for senior-level executives.
  • Significant experience working in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint required.
  • Strong technology skills including ability to work within PC and Mac programs, iPad, iPhone, and Google products. The ability to type fast and efficiently is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Experience within digital, entertainment or sports industry 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Exceptional interpersonal and phone skills and the ability to interact with staff at all levels.
  • Expert level written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience managing highly sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Strong ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a positive attitude.
  • Highly organized; a strategic planner who is able to create, implement and improve organizational systems, both digital and physical files.
  • Able to work independently and with little supervision.
  • Demonstrated project management skills.
  • Demonstrated comfort interacting with high level executives and high-profile individuals.
  • Ability to work proactively with a solution-oriented mindset and a can-do attitude; always thinking one-step-ahead, while staying calm and confident.
  • Impeccable attention to detail and solutions oriented.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project/program management skills.
  • Exercise a high degree of professionalism and diplomacy in interactions with all levels of the organization.
  • Excellent follow through skills and the ability to anticipate and address business needs proactively.
  • Exemplary time management skills.
  • Highly adaptable to a fluid, ever-changing work environment.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, resourcefulness, resilience and a commitment to process improvement.

Physical Demands

  • Occasional light lifting and standing

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week in office.

Salary / Pay Range

  • Coordinate and schedule meetings and conference calls
  • Manager calendars across different time zones
  • Create and distribute agendas
  • Answer and route telephone calls and incoming mail

job.title: Application Developer
job.description:
The NFL is looking for a software engineer with football knowledge to join an innovative team of .NET developers and solutions architects. The team is responsible for timely delivery of software and hardware solutions for football technologies at the NFL. We work closely with multiple NFL departments to design and develop our systems to satisfy our ever-growing customer needs.

We are looking for extremely driven software engineers interested in working on a focused team to deliver successful solutions that impact several core NFL functions. The successful candidate will be a self-starter with ownership attitude and a good communicator that is able to work within a team that delivers cutting edge solutions with tight deadlines.

Responsibilities

  • Determines operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, solution development, and proposed solutions.
  • Documents solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code.
  • Improve operations by conducting systems analysis; recommending changes in policies and procedures.
  • Remains on the cutting edge by studying state-of-the-art data driven philosophies, development tools, and programming techniques; participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations.
  • Protects intellectual property & operations by keeping information confidential.
  • Provides information by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing development and service issues.
  • Develop software solutions by studying information needs; conferring with users; studying systems flow, data usage, and work processes; investigating problem areas; following the software development lifecycle.
  • Perform technical analysis and document technical requirements, design, and development of software.
  • Convert functional specifications and design artifacts into software designs and other technical artifacts, with an emphasis on performance, security, extensibility and efficient reuse.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure conformance with specifications and established methodologies.
  • Provide technical support for various activities and internal infrastructure within the company.
  • Work with business implementation leads to identify workflows, protocols, and information gathering for new solutions.
  • Responsible for effectively engaging with IT project management and reporting project status.
  • Participate and work with Business Analysts in the analysis and development of business requirements.
  • Establish and adhere to set project development plans and release dates.
  • Contribute to the development of QA Functional Test Scripts and Performance Test Plans.
  • Provide on-site (league office) and remote (stadiums) game day support during the NFL Season and for NFL tentpole events, including the NFL Draft, Scouting Combine, or League Meetings as needed.
  • Willing to travel for project deployments, off site meetings and on-site game day support at NFL games.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field with strong technical background.
  • Knowledge of American Football (required).
  • Strong knowledge of C#, SQL Server, .NET, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API, HTML5, CSS, jQuery, ReactJS or other modern frontend UI frameworks.
  • 5+ years’ professional experience developing technology platforms in the Microsoft technology stack, including IIS, Windows Server, .NET, SQL Server, Web API, Azure DevOps, GitHub Copilot.
  • Experience in the following areas: Software architecture and development: Data modeling and database design; Web application security; Hardware devices including laptops, desktops, mobile, storage; TCP/IP and networking.
  • Be able to communicate technical issues in business terms so that senior leadership can evaluate options and make sound decisions.
  • Ability to handle multiple priorities and meet aggressive deadlines.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience with AWS and Azure cloud environments is a plus.
  • Highly organized, focused, flexible, motivated, detail oriented, and dedicated team player.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Employees are to work 40 hours a week in the office.

job.title: Associate Counsel
job.description:
The Associate Counsel will report to the Senior Vice President, Labor Relations and be responsible for development, negotiation and administration of the NFL-NFLPA Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), including representing the league and clubs in litigation under the CBA.  The holder of this position will represent the league in grievance hearings and arbitrations brought by or against the NFL and supervise outside counsel in the litigation of such matters.  This critical role will require strong investigative and advocacy skills, and the ability to spot and solve issues related to league policies. 

Responsibilities

  • Acquire and demonstrate substantive mastery of the CBA and league policies regulating the conduct of clubs and players.   
  • Litigate grievances on behalf of the league and member clubs under the collective bargaining agreement with the NFL Players Association.  
  • Provide counsel to the league and clubs regarding rights and obligations under the CBA, the Salary Cap system, Player Personnel rules, and other collectively bargained league rules. 
  • Assist in the investigation and enforcement of potential violations of the CBA and related policies regulating player and club conduct.  
  • Draft and review policy directives for NFL players and Clubs. 
  • Interact with outside law firms, consultants and others involved in the administration of the CBA, policies and/or litigation. 
  • Assist in negotiations with the NFL Players Association. 
  • Prepare legal memoranda for clubs regarding policy obligations. 
  • Independently develop and maintain working relationships with club counsel and NFLPA representatives. 

Required Qualifications

  • Law Degree (J.D.); 4 to 6+ years of litigation experience at a top law firm or federal government agency.   
  • Experience conducting and maintaining a docket of litigation matters and internal investigations.   
  • Experience appearing in court or similar settings, interviewing senior executives and drafting investigatory findings.   
  • Experience deposing and cross-examining witnesses.    
  • Experience making presentations to large groups of senior executives. 
  • Familiarity with NFL and other sports’ labor relations. 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours in-office per week. 

 

Salary / Pay Range

job.title: Associate, Marketing Science & Strategy- (External Agency Employee)
job.description:
The NFL Marketing Strategy & Insights team serves as the voice and advocate of NFL fans, leveraging diverse data sources to generate actionable insights that help inform League-wide business decisions and optimization. The Associate, Marketing Science and Strategy will support research and analysis across media, marketing, and key fan development priorities. This role is ideal for a curious, flexible, and detail-oriented professional who can help design and execute research, analyze syndicated and proprietary data, and translate findings into clear, strategic insights for internal and external stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the planning, execution, analysis, and reporting of primary research projects for the NFL.
  • Manage research initiatives by coordinating with internal stakeholders and third-party vendors to help ensure projects are delivered on time and on budget.
  • Create story-driven reports that translate research findings into strategic insights for teams across NFL Media, Marketing, Sponsorship, Club and other key areas.
  • Serve as a research resource and voice of the fan by supporting study development, methodology selection, survey design, data weighting, and reporting recommendations.
  • Use research tools and platforms, including MarketSight, Sports Poll, YouGov, and AceMetrix, to pull, analyze, and interpret data.
  • Provide support across Consumer Insights projects, including ad hoc analyses and custom research studies throughout the year.
  • Ensure research and insights work reflects best-in-class diversity, equity, and inclusion practices.

Required Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience in market research, consumer insights, analytics, consumer behavior, or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Market Research, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Understanding of quantitative research, including the ability to write surveys aligned to business questions and research objectives.

job.title: Associate, Player Relations (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The Player Relations Associate will assist the Sr. Manager, Player Relations and the Sr. Director, Player Relations in building a strong partnership with the entire football community with a focus on marketing and branding opportunities for both players and Legends. The associate will also play a pivotal role in the player procurement process and execution of all player appearances for the League.   

Responsibilities:

  • Player procurement and appearance management
    • Management of all player contracts for 1,000+ annual appearances
    • Liaison between NFL Legal, Finance, players and marketing reps for any contract edits
    • Collaborate with all internal NFL departments that book players to ensure the best players are selected and all contractual elements are executed correctly
    • Management of all appearance tracking documents and reporting including department metrics and fee trackers
    • Management of the Player Procurement System including liaising with NFL IT
  • Cultivate relationships with key stakeholders that support the player partnership
    • Act as the point of contact for the NFLPA Player Services team as it relates to player appearance contracts and creative approvals
    • Management of the quarterly NFL Agents Meeting which disseminates pertinent detail to key marketing representatives
    • Represent the Player Relations team in internal meetings that include player involvement in events or activations
  • Assist with all player brand building and marketing opportunities
    • Assist with league wide NFL marketing initiatives that effect the larger player population including My Cause My Cleats and the NFL Heritage Program
    • Collaborate with the Player Communications and Marketing team on content opportunities involving players or Legends
    • Management of the Player Office Visit program for all players and Legends
    • Manage the process for all group licensing creative approvals across the League to ensure guidelines are followed and player rights are protected
    • Review, track, and route all print, video, online promotions, enhancements and vignettes featuring active NFL players to the NFLPA for necessary approvals
  • Support the overall player experience and event activation
    • Manage the logistics tied to executing player appearances or activations and any support staff or vendors (i.e., Carey Cars, rotational staff, AMEX, etc.)
    • Management of specific groups at tent pole events to ensure they receive a best-in-class experience (i.e. Pro Bowl Roster, NFL Draft Prospects, WPMOY at Super Bowl, etc.)
    • Provides overall support to NFL Legends Community as needed

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Minimum 1-3 years of relevant experience
  • Experience with Microsoft Office
  • Excellent writing and presentation skills
  • Experience working in the sports industry and/or client management preferred

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • General knowledge of football and NFL players/teams
  • Strong ability to multi-task and prioritize effectively
  • Effective interpersonal skills and ability to be a team player
  • Ability to collaborate with internal groups and external partners
  • Ability to manage others with different interests and skill sets
  • Maintain autonomy on select projects and integrate internal parties where necessary

job.title: Associate, Product Operations (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The NFL Digital Media Technical Operations team is seeking an experienced Product Operations Associate to assist with supporting various platforms at NFL Media including: NFL+, NFL.com, NFL app, and Clubs Sites. This person will be expected to immerse themselves within the details of all digital products and become a communication hub for operational activities. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills and demonstrate confidence in a fast-paced environment. This position communicates with Product Management, Technology, Marketing and Sales departments This role will report directly to the Senior Director of Digital Operations.

This is a temporary benefited role spanning 8+ months, paying $2,200.00 - $2,500.00 weekly.  

Responsibilities

  • Serve as central POC for communication and stakeholder management for all NFL's in-market products from product marketing, in-market operational support, content strategy, product enhancements, engineering, business development and legal.
  • Create concise plans and presentation for cross functional teams not limited to senior leadership from process/product ideation to in-market consumption.
  • Develop, manage, and continuously improve processes for scale that help the Digital Programming and Product teams meet their goals more efficiently and effectively.
  • Develop, manage, and enhance business analytics of in-market performance, not limited to KPI measure of operational performance, foster and maintain new technical partnerships with external and internal clients/vendors.
  • Provide operational support for our digital O&O platforms on all gamedays and around League tentpole events, including reporting and prioritization of issues.
  • Manage operational execution and support of live streaming digital shows on NFL.com.
  • Manage content updates within the CMS for various stakeholders within digital content programming, editorial and the League including active NFL.com webpage.
  • Manage request of access on NFL.com for API portals, databases, and ecommerce platforms services.
  • Oversee all new/existing partner integrations and operational responsibilities for authentication management for NFL O&O products not limited to MVPDs and Broadcast partners.
  • Serve as central POC for Live Broadcast blackout/retrans management & communications.
  • Maintain relationships with partner support teams who operate within and outside NFL.com support instance.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Manage Service Desk Jira board (Kanban) and ensure all tickets are being properly QA’d.
  • Help communicate Club product needs.
  • Ensure Service Desk developers have all the information they need to troubleshoot bug tickets.
  • Have an overall understanding of NFL and Club issues for prioritization.
  • Create runbooks and instructional articles to assist clubs with product updates.
  • Act as liaison between Clubs and the NFL streaming services during Preseason.
  • Quickly triage incidents impacting all Clubs.
  • Send release notes to Clubs and communicate platform updates/outages.

 Required Qualifications

  • BS or BA in business, marketing, communications, computer science, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years working in either product management, project management, business analysis, and live event support in large scale media environment.
  • Must be passionate about the NFL and its clubs.
  • Ability to supervise employees, handle conflict, manage change, and improve operations.
  • Excellent problem-solving ability; highly motivated to drive positive change.
  • Prior experience with Content Management Systems (CMS).
  • Prior experience in operational support of a web and mobile based applications.
  • Prior experience managing a JIRA board and writing user story tickets.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with markup skills utilizing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is preferred.
  • Proficiency in design via tools such as Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Strong Knowledge of 3rd party authentication work streams.
  • Avid interest and knowledge of NFL football.
  • Demonstrate the ability to create and maintain documentation and runbooks.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Ability to understand and document business rules.
  • Attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
  • Excels collaborating with teams.
  • Ability to quickly learn new systems and programs.
  • Excellent problem-solving ability; highly motivated to drive positive change.
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Passion for leading in a collaborative, cross functional team environment.
  • Well-organized; able to manage multiple tasks and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.

Travel 

  • Up to 15% travel required. 

 Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • This is a temporary position providing leave coverage and is anticipated to work for up to 8 months based on business needs.
  • Minimum 40 hours a week.
  • Must be flexible to work weekends (specifically Sundays in-season and Holidays).
  • Must be able to work all NFL Game Days, including Preseason, Regular Season and Playoffs, in-office.
  • Must be able to work on holidays (e.g. Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas, New Year's Eve, New Year's).

job.title: Associate, Real-Time Systems (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The Associate, Real-Time Systems supports the design, configuration, operation, and troubleshooting of Real-Time Systems that power NFL Media digital graphics experiences, including FAST channels, NFL+, RedZone, and other digital productions. This role serves as a technical resource for Viz graphics workflows, ticker systems, L-Bar applications, data integrations, and real-time content delivery while helping ensure reliable operation of critical production systems.

Responsibilities

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Viz graphics systems, render engines, ticker systems, L-Bar applications, and supporting software environments to ensure reliable delivery of graphics across FAST, digital, and RedZone platforms.
  • Support end-to-end graphics workflows including data-driven Viz graphics, scorebars, ticker content, promotional elements, sponsorship integrations, countdown clocks, and lower-third graphic packages to ensure accurate on-air and digital presentation.
  • Maintain RTS applications, databases, APIs, and automated page generation tools while validating data flow between internal services, graphics systems, and production environments.
  • Serve as a frontline technical resource during live productions by diagnosing and resolving graphics, connectivity, software, and data issues to minimize operational disruptions.
  • Partner with production, engineering, and operations teams to support FAST channel graphics, RedZone L-Bar workflows, ticker content management, and digital platform graphics delivery.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, diagrams, workflow guides, system inventories, and operational procedures while identifying opportunities for process improvements and automation.
  • Assist with preparation, testing, deployment, and operational support for major league events including the NFL Draft, NFL Combine, International Games, Kickoff, Playoffs, and Super Bowl coverage.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Digital Media, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting broadcast graphics, digital media operations, production technology, or real-time systems.
  • Experience supporting Vizrt, graphics rendering systems, or similar real-time graphics platforms.
  • Working knowledge of networking, Windows administration, system configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with data-driven graphics, APIs, databases, and content automation workflows.
  • Experience supporting live production, digital streaming, or broadcast operations.
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.

Qualifications

  • Experience supporting FAST channels, OTT streaming platforms, or sports media operations.
  • Experience with Viz Trio, Viz Engine, ticker systems, or graphics automation workflows.
  • Familiarity with SQL databases and scripting/automation tools.
  • Experience supporting major live sporting events.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational abilities.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure during live productions.
  • Strong customer service mindset and production support orientation.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work in control rooms, machine rooms, and production environments.
  • Occasional lifting and movement of production or IT equipment up to 40 pounds.

Travel

  • No travel typically required.

 Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Flexible schedule required.
  • Evening, overnight, weekend, and holiday work may be required during live productions and major events.
  • Overtime may be required based on production schedules.

job.title: Associate, Reporting & Finance System Administration (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
Associate, Reporting & Finance System Administration Specialist

The Associate, Reporting & Finance System Administration Specialist supports the daily administration, reporting, and operational effectiveness of the organization's financial systems. This role assists with system support, report development, data validation, troubleshooting, and user support across Oracle ERP, Oracle EPM, BlackLine, and other finance applications.

Partnering closely with Finance, Accounting, Shared Services, and IT teams, this individual helps ensure data integrity, reporting accuracy, and efficient financial operations while contributing to process improvement and system enhancement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Systems Administration & Support

  • Provide day-to-day support for Oracle ERP, Oracle EPM, BlackLine, and related finance applications.
  • Troubleshoot system and reporting issues, escalating more complex matters as needed.
  • Support user access, security administration, and master data maintenance.
  • Assist with system testing, upgrades, patches, and enhancements.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities by resolving system-related issues.

Reporting & Data Management

  • Develop and maintain, standard and ad hoc financial reports.
  • Validate financial data and investigate reporting discrepancies.
  • Monitor data quality and support reconciliations across systems.
  • Maintain reporting documentation, standards, and data definitions.
  • Assist with data validation during system updates and enhancements.

Process Improvement & Projects

  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, data accuracy, and automation.
  • Support implementation of process improvements and system enhancements.
  • Participate in upgrades, implementations, and finance technology projects.
  • Assist with business requirements gathering, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and issue tracking.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, training materials, and end-user guides.

Collaboration & Customer Support

  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, Shared Services, IT, and business stakeholders.
  • Provide responsive support and clear communication regarding system issues, updates, and process changes.
  • Build strong working relationships with users and cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 1-3 years of experience in finance systems support, accounting operations, financial reporting, business analysis, or a related field.
  • Experience working with ERP systems, financial applications, or reporting tools.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

Preferred

  • Experience with Oracle ERP, Oracle EPM, BlackLine, or similar financial systems.
  • Experience supporting financial reporting, data analysis, or business intelligence initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Power BI or comparable reporting platforms.
  • Exposure to Finance, Accounting, Shared Services, or IT operations.

job.title: Associate, Transmission (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The NFL Media group is looking for a TOC Operator who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and demonstrates strong technical, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills while supporting live broadcast and transmission operations. The TOC Operator performs a broad range of technical and operational duties, including monitoring systems, coordinating broadcast workflows, and ensuring all technical facility requests are resolved in a timely and effective manner. The ideal candidate has extensive knowledge in operation of broadcast routing systems, including split routes and familiarity with other broadcast transmission systems. This role requires a strong understanding of analog, digital, and SMPTE 2110 signal flows, as well as the ability to troubleshoot technical issues in a fast-paced broadcast environment. As the first point of escalation for broadcast and transmission issues, the TOC Operator is responsible for communicating with Operations and Production Management in a timely and effective manner.  

This long term, benefitted contingent role compensates at $35 to $54 per hour.

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with the NFL Media Production team, Streaming Video Group, NFL Films Technical Operations, Encompass Atlanta Technical Operation, and all 32 NFL Clubs to ensure all video content is received and distributed to broadcast specifications. 
  • Partner with the Remote Operations team to support the transmission and receipts of feeds for live remote productions, including NFL Network games, the Super Bowl, NFL Combine, NFL Draft, Hall of Fame Enshrinement, and other NFL Network remote projects.  
  • Collaborate with the Streaming Video Group (SVG) to ensure content is captioned across NFL.com, NFL Fast Channel, NFL+ streaming platforms.  
  • Partner closely with the Engineering team to troubleshoot all issues that may occur with a feed or broadcast.  
  • Communicate with NFL Network Master Control during live broadcasts to ensure signal continuity. 
  • Perform test bar setups as needed 
  • Conduct extensive transmission, sync, and fax checks prior to live shows and remote events.  
  • Manage booking and goodnight procedures for The Switch, Lumen, AT&T Fiber, and Satellite orders. 
  • Responsible for the generation of broadcast reports as required. 

 Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a broadcast operations environment, including 2110, HD/SD, ASI, JPEG and MPLS signals, with the ability to troubleshoot those signal paths. 
  • Strong understanding of analog, digital, and SMPTE 2110 signal flows. 
  • Ability to read audio meters, digital and analog waveform monitors, and set up test bars.

job.title: Director, Broadcast Engineering
job.description:
The Director, Broadcast Engineering is responsible for leading the strategy, operation, modernization, and reliability of mission-critical broadcast engineering systems that support live production, studio operations, transmission, post-production, digital media, and multi-platform content delivery. This role manages a team of engineers, technicians, specialists, and vendor partners while bridging traditional broadcast workflows with IP-based, virtualized, and cloud-enabled media infrastructure. The Director will provide technical leadership, staff development, operational discipline, and long-range planning to ensure high-quality, resilient, and scalable production services.

Responsibilities

Staff Leadership and Management

  • Lead, manage, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary broadcast engineering team responsible for live production, technical operations, maintenance, system support, and engineering projects.
  • Define team priorities, assign resources, manage schedules, establish performance objectives, and conduct regular performance reviews.
  • Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational readiness, documentation, continuous improvement, and inclusive leadership.
  • Develop career paths, training plans, succession plans, and cross-training programs to strengthen technical depth and leadership bench strength.
  • Partner with production, operations, IT, transmission, digital media, security, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders to align staffing and engineering priorities with business objectives.

Broadcast Infrastructure and Operations

  • Oversee the design, deployment, maintenance, and lifecycle management of studios, control rooms, routing, intercom, audio, video, replay, graphics, monitoring, transmission, post-production, and media asset systems.
  • Ensure reliable operation of live broadcast environments through preventive maintenance, system monitoring, incident response, disaster recovery planning, and root-cause analysis.
  • Establish engineering standards, documentation practices, escalation procedures, commissioning processes, and operational readiness checklists.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable broadcast, safety, security, accessibility, and regulatory requirements. 

IP, Cloud, and Emerging Technology Strategy

  • Lead the transition from traditional SDI and hardware-centric workflows toward IP-based, software-defined, virtualized, and cloud-connected media infrastructure.
  • Evaluate and implement technologies such as SMPTE ST 2110, PTP timing, NMOS discovery and control, AES67, Dante, JPEG XS, SRT, NDI, bonded contribution, REMI production, virtualization, containerization, cloud playout, cloud production, remote monitoring, and observability platforms.
  • Develop hybrid architectures that connect on-premises broadcast facilities with digital media platforms, OTT distribution, FAST channels, content supply chains, and cloud-based production workflows.
  • Partner with IT, cybersecurity, network engineering, and cloud architecture teams to ensure media systems meet requirements for latency, timing, resiliency, security, scalability, and operational support.
  • Create roadmaps that balance current broadcast reliability requirements with future-facing digital media, automation, AI-assisted workflows, metadata, and cloud-native capabilities.

Project, Budget, and Vendor Management

  • Lead capital and operational engineering projects from concept through design, procurement, implementation, testing, training, handoff, and ongoing support.
  • Develop budgets, forecasts, business cases, technical requirements, scopes of work, risk assessments, and implementation schedules.
  • Manage vendor relationships, integrators, managed service providers, service contracts, support agreements, and equipment lifecycle planning.

Operational Support and Incident Management

  • Provide senior technical leadership during live events, critical outages, major launches, and high-priority production support scenarios.
  • Lead troubleshooting efforts across broadcast, IP network, storage, compute, cloud, audio, video, and application layers.
  • Develop incident reports, postmortems, lessons learned, corrective actions, and preventative controls.
  • Ensure teams are prepared for 24/7 operations, live-event support, escalation coverage, and business continuity requirements.

Communication and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for executive, operational, production, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Facilitate collaboration between engineering, production, digital media, IT, security, facilities, vendors, and business leadership.
  • Represent broadcast engineering in strategic planning, technology evaluation, roadmap development, standards alignment, and operational governance.

 Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, broadcast engineering, computer science, information technology, media technology, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in broadcast engineering, media systems engineering, technical operations, or live production technology, including leadership of complex broadcast facilities or production environments.
  • 5+ years of people-management experience leading engineers, technicians, managers, project teams, vendors, or managed service providers.
  • Demonstrated experience managing live production environments where reliability, speed, operational discipline, and incident response are critical.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast signal flow, studio systems, production control rooms, intercom, audio, video, routing, replay, graphics, transmission, post-production, monitoring, and media asset workflows.
  • Working knowledge of IP media standards and systems, including SMPTE ST 2110, SMPTE 2022-6/7, PTP/IEEE 1588, NMOS IS-04/IS-05, AES67, Dante, multicast networking, QoS, and media-over-IP troubleshooting.
  • Experience with cloud, virtualization, digital media, or software-defined infrastructure, including hybrid workflows that connect broadcast operations with cloud production, streaming, OTT, FAST, remote production, or digital distribution platforms.
  • Familiarity with compute, storage, networking, cybersecurity, automation, orchestration, APIs, monitoring, observability, and DevOps-style support practices as they apply to media systems.
  • Proven ability to lead technical strategy, capital projects, budgets, vendor negotiations, RFPs, scopes of work, implementation plans, and lifecycle management.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours as needed to support live events, urgent technical issues, launches, maintenance windows, and business-critical operations.

Qualifications

  • Experience with ST 2110 facility design, IP fabric architecture, timing design, boundary clocks, grandmaster redundancy, multicast routing, and vendor interoperability testing.
  • Experience with media supply chain platforms, MAM/DAM systems, storage orchestration, transcoding, cloud-based playout, streaming workflows, and metadata-driven content operations.
  • Experience leading engineering teams through organizational change, facility transformation, SDI-to-IP migration, cloud adoption, or major technology refresh initiatives.
  • Knowledge of AI-assisted media workflows, automation, quality control, captioning, accessibility, rights-aware distribution, and digital content monetization platforms.

job.title: Executive Assistant
job.description:
The Executive Assistant provides high-level administrative and operational support to two senior executives in a fast-paced, highly visible environment. This role manages complex calendars, meeting preparation, travel, expenses, communications, and projects while anticipating priorities and helping the executives remain organized and focused.   The Executive Assistant serves as a key liaison with internal and external stakeholders and regularly handles highly confidential information. Success requires exceptional judgment, discretion, attention to detail, organization, adaptability, and the ability to anticipate needs and act proactively with limited supervision.

Responsibilities

  • Manage complex, frequently changing executive calendars, coordinating meetings across multiple time zones, resolving scheduling conflicts, and proactively protecting time for critical priorities.
  • Anticipate the executives' day-to-day needs and priorities, proactively identifying scheduling issues, meeting requirements, emerging developments, and matters requiring timely attention or follow-up.
  • Coordinate and prepare executives for meetings and appointments, including agendas, briefing and presentation materials, conference rooms, audio/visual requirements, conference calls, external guests, and related logistics.
  • Plan and coordinate complex domestic and international travel, developing detailed itineraries that integrate transportation, accommodations, meetings, agendas, and other logistical requirements.
  • Serve as a trusted liaison and point of contact among the executives, their direct reports, other Executive Assistants, and internal and external stakeholders, exercising professionalism, diplomacy, tact, and discretion.
  • Manage executive communications and information flow, including reviewing and prioritizing correspondence, drafting and editing communications, memos, reports, and presentations, and ensuring time-sensitive matters receive appropriate attention and follow-through.
  • Exercise sound independent judgment when executives are unavailable, assessing urgency, making appropriate administrative decisions, escalating critical matters, and maintaining confidentiality.
  • Coordinate large and complex meetings and executive activities, ensuring materials, participants, technology, facilities, security, and other logistical requirements are organized and executed effectively.
  • Manage executive and departmental administrative processes, including preparing, reconciling, and submitting invoices and credit card expenses in Concur and maintaining accurate internal and external contact information.
  • Maintain awareness of relevant sports business developments, organizational initiatives, and department priorities, identifying information, deadlines, or developments requiring executive awareness or action.
  • Build strong working partnerships with Executive Assistants, direct reports, facilities, travel, IT, security, and other key stakeholders to facilitate effective executive operations.
  • Provide additional administrative and project support as needed, including document and records management, shipping and mail coordination, and other assignments that support executive and department priorities.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 4+ years of administrative or executive assistant experience supporting a senior-level executive.
  • Significant proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong technology skills, including experience working across PC and Mac environments and mobile devices.
  • Demonstrated experience handling sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex calendars, meetings, travel, communications, and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, solve problems independently, and follow through on commitments with limited supervision.
  • Strong attention to detail and demonstrated project-management capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Experience in the digital, entertainment, or sports industry.
  • Fast and accurate typing skills.

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics

  • Proactive and anticipatory: Consistently thinks ahead, identifies needs and potential issues early, and takes appropriate action.
  • Judgment and discretion: Handles confidential and sensitive information appropriately and makes thoughtful decisions in high-pressure situations.
  • Executive presence and diplomacy: Communicates effectively and professionally with senior executives, high-profile individuals, colleagues, and external partners.
  • Organization and execution: Effectively manages multiple priorities, deadlines, details, and changing requirements while maintaining accuracy and follow-through.
  • Composure and adaptability: Remains calm, solution-oriented, and effective in a fluid, fast-paced environment.
  • Resourcefulness and problem solving: Approaches challenges with curiosity, sound judgment, resilience, and a continuous-improvement mindset.
  • Collaboration: Builds trusted relationships across functions and works effectively with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.

Travel

  • Travel to main NFL events with the Executives as needed.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week in office.
  • FLSA Exempt.

job.title: Manager, DTC Product Marketing
job.description:
The Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Product Marketing team is a group of strategic brand and product marketers responsible for driving campaign development, brand strategy, media planning, and execution across the DTC portfolio – including NFL+, NFL App, and more.  

As DTC Product Marketing Manager, you will support the go-to-market (GTM) strategy development and lead day-to-day marketing execution for the DTC portfolio. Accelerating subscriptions, minimizing churn, deepening engagement, and delivering fan-first campaigns powered by insights and personalization for NFL+ will be your primary focus. You’ll collaborate closely across departments – from Product to Consumer Insights to Media – and work externally with league partners, agencies, and platform partners to bring innovative plans to life.  

Responsibilities

  • Support GTM strategy development and lead execution for NFL+ and related DTC experiences, from planning to launch to optimization
  • Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure strategic campaign alignment and tactical implementation
  • Craft clear and inspiring marketing briefs for internal teams and external agencies that articulate the objective, audience, product value, desired customer action, and measures of success
  • Oversee campaign development across owned and paid channels, including audience targets, messaging, creative assets, approvals, and execution
  • Lead promotional planning and manage creative asset delivery for both on-platform and off-platform touchpoints
  • Analyze and interpret performance across marketing channels and fan journeys to optimize initiatives and tactics
  • Leverage fan insights, campaign outcomes, and market intelligence to support recommendations for product marketing strategy, audience definitions, messaging, and customer journey design
  • Contribute to weekly cross-functional planning meetings to ensure alignment and delivery against business goals, milestones, and dependencies
  • Support executive communication and internal rollout of marketing initiatives through clear updates on plans, performance, risks, and next steps
  • Lead assigned projects and workstreams, escalating key risks and decisions as needed 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in marketing, preferably in entertainment, sports, tech, or subscription-based products
  • Strong strategic mindset with a track record of translating insights into action
  • Creative instincts and experience managing campaigns from ideation to execution
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills (copywriting experience a plus)
  • Highly organized with a commitment to operational rigor and accuracy
  • Strong time management skills and the ability to juggle multiple high-stakes projects
  • Comfort with managing multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment
  • Team-oriented mindset with a drive for collaboration and accountability

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Passion for sports and an understanding of its role in culture
  • Background in subscription models, streaming, DTC platforms, and/or product marketing
  • Familiarity with the evolving media landscape and digital consumption behaviors
  • Hands-on experience with personalization, testing, measurement, and optimization  
  • Comfort using AI and emerging technologies to drive workflow efficiencies and/or support customer-facing efforts
  • Ability to navigate projects through ambiguity and formulate clear next steps 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Employees are to work 40 hours per week in the office.

job.title: Manager, Global Sponsorship
job.description:
The Manager, Sponsorship is part of the Global partnerships team that manages and executes League sponsorship deals and relationships. The specific duties essential for this role are to manage the day to day relationships of League partners including all activations, strategy, planning, creative and work across the League to support initiatives with our partners. The position also requires sales skills and asset creation/development with execution.

job.title: Manager, Sponsorship New Business
job.description:
The Manager, Sponsorship New Business, is a key member of the Business Development team responsible for generating revenue by developing and selling integrated marketing partnerships for the NFL globally.

This position will work collaboratively across the NFL to identify partnerships that support key initiatives such as NFL FLAG, International growth, audience growth across youth, multicultural and women, and game innovation.

Given the new business focus of this position, we are seeking candidates with a demonstrated track record of independently sourcing, negotiating, and closing sponsorship or partnership deals, and who can quickly contribute to revenue growth.

Responsibilities: 

  • Responsible for developing a global pipeline and executing partnerships with blue-chip brands to reach Sponsorship revenue goals 
  • Cultivate global and local market category prospects through category analysis and market research, with a focus on international markets without a dedicated new business resource  
  • Establish and build relationships with key external contacts (e.g., corporate decision makers at Fortune 500 companies and influencers in the sports marketing and agency world) 
  • Pursue prospects through contact strategy, development, and delivery of sales presentations, negotiation, and contract execution 
  • Actively contribute innovative thinking and fresh ideas that help lead to new revenue-generating sponsorship opportunities and contribute to cross-functional working groups consisting of key internal stakeholders (e.g., Media, IT, Football Operations, Social Responsibility, etc.) to develop customized marketing platforms that align with prospective partner objectives 
  • Develop and write strategic, customized presentations and partnership proposals for prospects 
  • Effectively maintain sales pipeline and reporting documents, as well as other duties as directed 
  • Help manage Sponsorship Business Development Senior Coordinator contributions to the team in partnership with the Senior Director 

Required Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor's Degree 
  • 5+ years of direct sponsorship sales experience at league, team, agency and/or company 
  • Hands-on experience leading the full new-business sales cycle, from prospecting through deal execution, required

Preferred Qualifications:
