job.title: Part-Time Media Design Group Designer/Animator
job.description:
The NFL Media Design Group is seeking a Designer/Animator to create high-quality graphics, motion design, and visual storytelling assets that support shows, live events, special programming, and emerging platforms. This role combines concept development, design execution, and animation, requiring creativity, technical expertise, and a strong attention to detail.

Working closely with Art Directors and Creative Producers, the Designer/Animator will develop original concepts, iterate on creative solutions, and deliver polished motion graphics that meet the highest production standards.

Responsibilities

  • Conceptualize, design, and animate high-production-value graphics for a variety of NFL Media projects.
  • Create original visual concepts and translate them into compelling motion design solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with Art Directors to ensure creative alignment and execution excellence.
  • Develop scalable, repeatable animation systems and templates that can be shared across internal teams, editors, and external vendors.
  • Maintain organized project files and adhere to established workflows and production standards.
  • Partner with Creative Producers to establish realistic timelines and manage design, revision, and delivery schedules.
  • Balance multiple assignments while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
  • Execute projects efficiently, including those with accelerated turnaround times, by leveraging existing toolkits, templates, and custom assets.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in design, motion graphics, or animation.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe After Effects (including Scripting and Mogrts), Photoshop, and Illustrator.
  • Experience using Figma, UI/UX design
  • Knowledge of Cinema 4D (C4D)
  • Ability to develop custom designs and animations from original concepts, style guides, existing graphic packages, and creative references.
  • Strong understanding of motion design principles, visual storytelling, and production workflows.
  • Ability to follow established file naming conventions, organizational standards, and production processes.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Proactive, detail oriented, organized, and accountable, with the ability to perform in a highly collaborative setting. 
  • Confidence in a fast-paced environment 
  • Flexibility when faced with new information, needs or challenges 
  • Ability to ask questions and communicate with art directors and creative producers when uncertain a current assignment or when ready for the next one. 
  • Willingness to invest in understanding the business of the NFL to better support and enhance how the League serves our clubs and engages our fans.  

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Part-time, up to 29 hours per week
  • Flexibility to work non-standard hours, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays, as production schedules require.

job.title: Recruiter, Seasonal & Early Careers Associate (External Agency Employee)
job.description:
The Early Careers & Seasonal Recruitment Associate will support full-cycle recruiting efforts across Early Career programs and high-volume Seasonal hiring for various NFL offices. This role is critical to building and sustaining talent pipelines that support both near-term staffing needs and long-term talent development.

The successful candidate will partner closely with hiring managers, senior leaders, Human Resources, Compensation, Finance, and HR Business Partners to deliver efficient, equitable, and high-quality hiring outcomes that align with the NFL’s vision, mission, and values.

Responsibilities

  • Provide full-cycle recruiting support, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, scheduling, and offer management, for:
    • Early career programs (internships, rotational programs, fellowships, entry-level roles)
    • High-volume seasonal and temporary roles across multiple departments and locations
  • Handle 40–50+ requisitions during peak seasonal periods across multiple departments and locations.
  • Partner with hiring managers and HR to understand workforce needs, headcount planning, and role requirements.
  • Build and maintain diverse talent pipelines for early career and recurring seasonal hiring.
  • Provide regular search updates, hiring insights, and pipeline reporting to stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate candidate and requisition data in Greenhouse.
  • Coordinate offer processes and ensure completion of onboarding requirements.
  • Represent the NFL at campus events, job fairs, and virtual or in-person recruiting events as needed.
  • Ensure compliance with EEO, ADA, and applicable federal and state employment laws.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 3 years of recruitment experience (early career, seasonal, or high-volume), or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Demonstrated success managing high-volume requisitions concurrently.
  • Experience with recruitment platforms such as Greenhouse, LinkedIn, and HireVue.
  • Strong working knowledge of federal and state employment laws and corporate recruiting practices.
  • Proven candidate management and stakeholder partnership skills.
  • Excellent project management, organizational, and communication skills.

Other Key Attributes

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Experience supporting large-scale, fast-turnaround hiring initiatives.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to quickly learn operational needs across departments.
  • Detail-oriented with strong follow-through and proactive problem-solving skills.
  • Self-starter who can work independently while collaborating effectively with teams.
  • Creative, resourceful, and solutions-oriented thinker.

Travel

  • Potential travel during peak recruiting seasons.

Terms & Expected Hours of Work

This job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. The individual selected for this role will be an employee of that third-party agency and not the NFL. All compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment are handled by the agency. The assignment to provide services to the NFL will be limited in duration but may be extended for an additional period by agreement between the NFL and the agency.

  • Anticipated engagement of up to six months or longer, subject to business needs.
  • 40 hours per week required; overtime and/or weekend hours may be necessary during peak recruiting periods.
  • FLSA non-exempt.
  • This role is with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners providing recruitment services to the NFL.

job.title: Seasonal Designer, Global Creative Marketing
job.description:
The NFL Global Creative Marketing team is seeking a seasonal designer adept in the Adobe Creative Suite for the NFL's official social platforms, as well as other NFL-affiliated channels, teams, and players. The right candidate has a passion for football, social media and storytelling, and has a drive to create new and innovative original content. As a part of the most creative and experimental group of the NFL, this role is for someone who is comfortable with change and able to balance a heavy workload. Success in this position is reliant on being a self-starter with a willingness to learn and grow alongside the brand. The successful candidate is a creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, with a deep understanding of, and experience with, social design.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and animate various graphics and other creative needs for the NFL's official social platforms and other NFL-affiliated social platforms, teams, and players.
  • Work with large creative team made up of designers, illustrators, editors, and copywriters to conceive and executive multiple daily projects.
  • Pitch and conceptualize original content ideas and franchises for NFL social media platforms.
  • Manage the story telling behind each creative output to ensure it is clear, concise, snackable and true to the content
  • Identify important storylines from around the NFL and know how to best tell them to our audience

Required Qualifications:

  • At least 2-5+ years of relevant experience in graphic design and animation
  • Must have prior experience building and animating assets on social and/or digital platforms
  • Must have a Design portfolio containing various examples of relevant work
  • Strong ability with Photoshop, After Effects, and Illustrator are must-have’s.
  • Video Editing experience is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Must be willing to work early mornings, nights, and weekends due to the nature of the NFL schedule
  • Bachelor's degree preferred
  • Knowledge of football and the NFL audience is a major plus
  • Must be adaptable and able to work quickly under short deadlines
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to take creative direction and incorporate feedback into revised work
  • Must be able to handle concept changes and accept creative feedback

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics:

  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, including nights and weekends
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organization skills

 

Physical Demands:

N/A

Travel:

N/A

Terms/Expected Hours of Work:

Nights and Weekends, especially during the NFL season.

Opportunities for overtime.

Salary $42—$60 USD

job.title: Seasonal FAST Video Systems Operator
job.description:
The National Football League Digital Media Group is looking for a Seasonal FAST Video Systems Operator that is highly motivated and able to work in a fast-paced environment. The role will require an individual with a flexible schedule that is punctual and dependable. He or she will be expected to operate, monitor, and configure software relative to digital video distribution for the NFL’s FAST Channel. This position is based in Inglewood, CA and does not offer relocation or remote work.

Responsibilities

  • Support live streaming of games, weekly shows, and tent-pole events.
  • Document, escalate, and manage video distribution incidents to resolution.
  • Create and update operational runbooks for live on air workflows.
  • Maintain documentation of video acquisition scheduling and live event programing.
  • Setup and operate digital video environment in Digital Master Control (DMC).
  • Provide live event support during all live operation workflows including holidays, nights, early operation windows and/or weekends.
  • Perform quality control tasks for video streaming distribution.
  • Perform digital ad insertion operations on FAST live games.
  • Setup and maintain electronic programming guide (EPG) metadata for live game broadcasts.
  • Manage video routes for international game channels.
  • Collaborate with department initiatives to automate SCTE-35 insertion for DAI.

Required Qualifications

  • BS degree and/or equivalent experience.
  • Direct sports broadcast production and/or production operations experience (TV studio/truck experience, stadium broadcast operations) preferred
  • Experience monitoring and responding to live streaming service health metrics, alarms, and operational incidents in a 24/7 broadcast, streaming, or FAST channel environment.
  • Knowledge of digital protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP, HLS, SRT, RTMP, SSH.
  • Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions precisely with minimal supervision.
  • Execute SCTE-35 cue insertion for live and recorded programming, following AD commands and established operational procedures to ensure seamless break triggering and ad insertion.
  • Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across control room and production teams
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to respond quickly to changing production needs
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot audio/video and playout issues
  • Ability to effectively communicate technical information to internal and external stakeholders through well-organized maintenance notices, incident reports, outage summaries, and status updates

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 2-years of experience in a Technical Support role (i.e. IT Service Desk, TOC/NOC Operations, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Content Distribution Networks.
  • Knowledge of 2110 Broadcast Networks
  • Knowledge of Linux and/or Windows web servers.
  • Knowledge of Cloud Video Distribution platforms
  • Experience with Multi-Viewer Systems
  • Working knowledge and experience with FAST distribution systems
  • AI automation experience
  • Knowledge of encoding standards, including H.264, AAC, GOP structure, I-P-B frame schemes, profiles, bitrates, and aspect ratios.
  • Solid troubleshooting experience in Linux/Mac/Windows environments.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must be a Team Player, Initiative, Resourceful.
  • Exceptional composure and accuracy in high-pressure, live broadcast environments
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to on-air quality and precision

Physical Demands

  • Ability to lift and carry video equipment weighing less than 40lbs.

Travel

  • 0 - 10%

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • On-call position working less than 40 hours per week based on production needs
  • Must be available for early mornings, evenings, overnights, weekends, holidays, and remote production support as required
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months

Salary / Pay Range

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

job.title: Seasonal Feature Producer
job.description:
The Seasonal Feature Producer is responsible for producing assigned feature content from concept through final delivery. This role may lead the creative execution while collaborating with editors, production teams, and senior leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop story concepts, treatments, and editorial plans for assigned features.
  • Lead Production Assistants, Associate Producers, and Senior Associate Producers on delivery of workflow and skillset building.
  • Spearhead research, scripting, and editorial execution.
  • Oversee the editing process and shape the final content.
  • Considered an expert in assistant editor duties; footage logging, project organization and go-to resource for footage library.
  • Direct interviews and manage field production components.
  • Ensure accuracy, tone, and storytelling quality consistent with NFL Films standards.
  • Manage post-production workflows and delivery schedules.
  • Deep understanding of production workflow through the entire production life cycle.
  • Participate in creative discussions and pitches ideas.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in film, television, media, communications, creative writing, or related field.
  • 5-7+ years of experience producing sports, documentary, or feature content.
  • Strong editorial and storytelling skills and enhanced skills using Avid Media Composer.
  • Advanced knowledge of professional football and sports media.
  • Available to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

Travel

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Audio 2
job.description:
NFL Media Technical Operations is looking for an A2 Audio Mixer. This role will provide supplemental audio production services by coordinating, mixing, and delivering support audio for live news/sports and key show programming. Production services will be located at our State-of-the-Art NFL Media Studios in Inglewood, CA. 

Responsibilities

  • Mix live and recorded show format productions with heavy emphasis on remotes and server playback.
  • Test and verify equipment: Networked audio consoles, intercoms, multiple audio and video servers, EVS Playback audio.
  • Required experience working with cart playback systems such as Ovation or 360systems. Must work with system templates and Music logging files.
  • Extensive knowledge and proper setup protocol of communication panels (i.e. Riedel) required.
  • Work with A1, show director and production teams on the proper audio requirements for each show.
  • Must display a strong sense of team with the audio group and all levels of staff.
  • Ability to work in fast paced, high pressure environment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned such as A3 functions. 

Required Qualifications

  • 5–10+ years of experience mixing linear and IP content in a television studio environment, including live and non-live productions.
  • Experience mixing with SSL audio boards (specifically S500) preferred.
  • Experience in Stereo and 5.1. surround mixing formats required.
  • Understanding of IP Networked audio devices, specifically AES67 with Dante knowledge or certifications a plus. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must possess superior interpersonal communication and organizational skills. 
  • Detail oriented/multi-tasker with ability to work independently or in teams. 
  • Strong technical/computer skills (Microsoft, Apple, File management, Email, Slack, MS Teams, ENPS). 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Availability to work flexible hours including holidays, nights, and weekends.
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Broadcast Associate
job.description:
The Broadcast Associate (BA) will work in a LIVE television control room and coordinate LIVE graphics for many different studio & remote shows.  Must work to ensure all graphics are spelled correctly, are factually & grammatically accurate, and reflect proper news judgment as stories develop.

  • Responsible for the development and implementation of on-screen graphic elements
  • Work with the operator to build graphics, and monitor execution of graphics during the show
  • Communicate with line and edit producers to understand what material is covered in each show
  • Create graphics that reflect breaking news, current NFL topics, and statistics related to show content
  • Facilitate communication and exchange of ideas with the NFL Network graphics department

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Lighting Director
job.description:
NFL Media, Technical Operations is looking for a Lighting Director for shows produced at NFL Media in Inglewood, CA. Qualified candidates will have experience working in multi-camera studio environments and have a general knowledge of lighting studio talent for live sports and key show programming.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with show Directors, Producers, Scenic, and Video teams - implementing and maintaining the specific look of various productions between multiple stages and remote locations.
  • Support stage lighting designs in tandem with our Scenic and Integrations teams.
  • Operation of ETC EOS consoles to playback and modify existing lighting looks.
  • Monitor show productions from shading room and consult with video operator as necessary.
  • Perform tech checks at the beginning of each shift to check for burnouts, repositioning of equipment and overall stage & grid maintenance.
  • Conduct and perform routine and preventive maintenance of lighting fixtures and boards.
  • Report technical and/or equipment issues to Studio Operations and Engineering teams.

Required Qualifications

  • 5-10 years of experience working in a studio environment; live & recorded productions.
  • Have working knowledge of studio lighting equipment and studio light design. Including exterior staging and lighting requirements during all day parts.
  • Have a creative eye and can improvise on the fly.
  • Knowledge of ETC EOS family lightboard(s) and controllers required.
  • Knowledge and understanding of lighting data protocols and networks, DMX-512, SACN and ETC NET3.
  • Knowledge of moving light fixtures, High End Systems, GLP.
  • Knowledge of LED broadcast fixtures: ETC, Chauvet, Arri, Cineo, ChromaQ.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Ability to draft, read, and interpret lighting plots for new or existing sets.
  • Auto-Cad, Vectorworks, ETC Concert and Lightwright experience.
  • Advanced ETC EOS programming training.
  • Advanced ETC NET3 Networking training.
  • Ability to program lighting consoles and Network management.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Familiarity and experience working with 1080p, HDR, UHD, and 4k studio environments a plus.
  • Interpersonal communication and organizational skills.
  • Strong technical/computer skills (Microsoft, Apple.)
  • Ability to “multi-task” various duties as necessary.
  • Be a team player and excel under pressure.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work high above the ground, on lifts and/or ladders.
  • Must be able to lift 75lbs for up to 30 minutes at a time.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to work in fast paced, stressful environments.

Travel

  • Limited

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Flexible schedule to include early mornings, late nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Less than 29 hours/week when needed.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time TOC Operator
job.description:
The TOC Operator will perform multiple job functions and ensure that all technical facility requests are met.  Works closely with NFL Media Production team, Newsroom personnel, NFL Films Technical Operations, Encompass Atlanta Technical Operation, and members of all 32 NFL Clubs to ensure all video content is received and distributed to broadcast specifications.  Works closely with Engineering to troubleshoot all issues that may occur with feeds or broadcast.  Communicates with NFL Network Master Control during live broadcasts to ensure signal continuity.  Works closely with Remote Operations team for the proper transmission and receipt of feeds for live remote network productions including NFL Network Games, Super Bowl, NFL Combine, NFL Draft, Hall of Fame Enshrinement, and any other NFL Network remote projects.  Works closely with SVG team to provide content with captioning for our streaming platforms on NFL.com, NFL FAST Channel, and NFL +.  The TOC operator is the first point of troubleshooting and escalation if an issue occurs and will be expected to communicate issues to Operations and Production Management in a timely and efficient manner.

Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate knowledge and operation of broadcast routing systems, including split routes as required.
  • Ability to read digital & analog waveform monitors and how to set up test bars.
  • Ability to read audio meters.
  • Must have strong understanding of analog, digital and SMPTE 2110 signal flows.
  • Must be able to perform Sync and Fax checks prior to live shows and events.
  • Ability to perform extensive transmission checks prior to live remote events.
  • Booking and goodnight procedures for The Switch, Lumen & AT&T Fiber and Satellite orders.
  • Strong understanding of common broadcast signal problems and how to rectify them, i.e. audio levels or distortion, sync issues, video issues.
  • Must possess above average writing skills to document on-air issues.
  • Requires strong oral and written skills, including excellent telephone etiquette.
  • Requires strong organizational skills to ensure high broadcast quality on multiple feeds.
  • Must be willing to adapt in a quickly changing environment.
  • Familiarity with EVS IP Director ingest server systems.
  • Responsible for the generation of broadcast reports as required.

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years’ experience in a broadcast operations environment including 2110, HD/SD, ASI, JPEG and MPLS signals and the ability to troubleshoot those signal paths. 
  • Possess a strong work ethic and positive attitude and leadership qualities. 

Expected Hours of Work

  • Up to 29 hours per week up to 7 months based on business needs
  • Must be willing to work flexible schedules including nights, weekends and holidays.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time V1/Shading Operator
job.description:
NFL Media Technical Operations is seeking a part-time Video Operator to lead in-studio and remote camera shading for live and pre-recorded news and sports productions across all platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring consistent, high-quality visual output across all camera feeds by managing real-time shading, color correction, and signal integrity. 

The Video Operator serves as a critical technical resource within the control room and engineering ecosystem, partnering with Technical Directors, Engineering, and production teams to deliver a seamless, broadcast-ready product in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. 

Responsibilities

  • Perform real-time shading of multiple camera sources during live and recorded productions, ensuring consistent color, exposure, and visual quality  
  • Configure and manage camera shading systems, including Sony broadcast camera chains, CCUs, and RCPs   
  • Adjust iris, gamma, black levels, and color balance across multiple camera feeds to maintain a cohesive on-air look  
  • Color correct inbound video feeds using Selenio Network Processor Manager to ensure broadcast quality and consistency  
  • Manage video signal routing for shading and production workflows using Imagine Magellan Control systems   
  • Monitor and troubleshoot video signals using waveform monitors, vectorscopes, and diagnostic tools to maintain broadcast standards  
  • Collaborate with Technical Directors, Engineering, and production staff to support the creative and technical execution of productions   
  • Support setup, calibration, and testing of cameras, shading systems, and video infrastructure for studio and remote productions   
  • Adjust shading dynamically based on changing lighting conditions, production requirements, or environmental factors   
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, adapting quickly to real-time production changes and technical challenges   
  • Support advanced production environments, including robotic camera systems (Panasonic, Telemetrics), Ultimatte systems, and OLED display integrations

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Viz Operator
job.description:
NFL Media is seeking a highly motivated Viz Operator to execute real-time graphics playout for live and pre-recorded programming. This role is responsible for ensuring all on-air graphic elements are delivered accurately, seamlessly, and at the highest quality standards in a fast-paced, high-pressure broadcast environment.

The Viz Operator will work closely with production, technical operations, and editorial teams to support the execution of dynamic live shows, translating rundowns into precise on-air graphics while adapting quickly to changing content and breaking situations.

Responsibilities

  • Execute real-time graphics playout using Viz Trio during live and pre-recorded broadcasts, ensuring accuracy and timing of all on-air elements
  • Operate and manage multiple graphics engine outputs
  • Ability to prep and operate graphics without the need of a BA or PA
  • Interpret and execute graphics needs based on live and taped broadcast rundowns (e.g., ENPS or iNews)
  • Collaborate with producers, directors, and technical staff to align on graphic content, timing, and execution
  • Troubleshoot graphics and playout issues in real time, in coordination with production and technical teams
  • Maintain full awareness of broadcast flow, adjusting graphics execution to support evolving editorial priorities
  • Ensure quality control of all graphics elements, verifying accuracy, formatting, and readiness prior to air
  • Support transmission and technical operations teams during non-show hours as needed
  • Operate effectively in high-pressure live environments, adapting quickly to changes, late updates, and breaking content

Required Qualifications

  • 5–10+ years of graphics playout experience in a live control room environment
  • Working knowledge of Viz Trio with demonstrated experience executing graphics in live production
  • Familiarity with broadcast workflows, including rundowns, playout timing, and control room coordination

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in live sports or fast-paced broadcast environments
  • Familiarity with HD quality control equipment and broadcast signal workflows
  • Experience with newsroom and rundown systems such as ENPS or iNews

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Exceptional composure and accuracy in high-pressure, live broadcast environments
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to on-air quality and precision
  • Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across control room and production teams
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to respond quickly to changing production needs
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot audio/video and playout issues

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • On-call position working less than 29 hours per week based on production needs
  • Must be available for early mornings, evenings, overnights, weekends, holidays, and remote production support as required
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months

job.title: Seasonal Rights & Clearances Coordinator
job.description:
Summary

The Rights & Clearances Coordinator is responsible for researching, sourcing, and securing third‑party materials for use in NFL Films programming. This role works closely with producers, post‑production, media management, business affairs, and project managers to fulfill content needs while ensuring all material is properly licensed according to deadlines, budgets, and legal requirements.

Essential Functions

  • Research, request, and acquire third‑party materials including—but not limited to—photos, footage, newspaper articles, social media posts, podcasts, and other intellectual property.
  • Navigate and research archival collections, stock footage libraries, and professional photo agencies to locate hard‑to‑find materials.
  • Screen down cuts/programs and create detailed clearance logs to document all third‑party material usage.
  • Secure licenses, permissions, and releases for all third‑party content used in NFL Films programming.
  • Serve as a resource for production teams regarding rights, usage restrictions, and clearance options at all stages of production.
  • Track, organize, and maintain accurate records for all research and clearance documentation including agreements, invoices, purchase orders, and correspondence.
  • Communicate with internal departments to move acquired materials through workflows and deliver them to producers.
  • Maintain strong administrative procedures and uphold departmental standards.
  • Learn and use internal rights/clearance tracking systems and screening tools.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 2 years dedicated Rights & Clearances or Archival Producing experience.
  • Foundational understanding of third‑party rights, licensing, and clearances.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience in post‑production or within a similar archival/rights/clearances environment.
  • Experience with AirTable or similar systems.
  • Experience navigating and interpreting EDLs.
  • Proven negotiation experience with major archives, stock footage/photo libraries, and independent rights holders

Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional organizational and time‑management skills.
  • Strong problem‑solving ability; resourceful and proactive.
  • Ability to manage sensitive or confidential information.
  • Flexibility to be on call for occasional weekend work.
  • Comfort working in deadline‑driven environments with shifting priorities.

Supervisory Responsibility

  • Assist with training and mentoring interns as needed.

Physical Demands

  • Occasional handling of physical archival materials such as footage reels, tapes, newspapers, and photo collections.

Travel

  • No regular travel expected.

job.title: Seasonal Senior Coordinator, Studio Technical Operations
job.description:
The Senior Coordinator, Operations provides hands-on technical and operational support to the Director of Production Operations, keeping control room, stage, and studio environments production-ready at all times. The role performs pre-production checks and first-line troubleshooting of router and comms panels, cameras, IFB and mic belt packs, stage lighting, replay, graphics, and audio systems, escalating unresolved faults to Engineering with documented detail. In partnership with Production Management, Scheduling, and Facilities, the Coordinator also confirms daily crew and resource readiness and manages equipment logistics, shipping, and staging for studio, remote, and tentpole productions. Administratively, the role maintains asset records, procurement and purchase order tracking, SOPs, and incident logs that support uninterrupted production. 

Responsibilities

  • Provide first-line troubleshooting and technical support for control room and stage equipment, including router panels, comms panels, cameras, IFB and mic belt packs, stage lighting, EVS systems, Vizrt graphics systems, and associated audio equipment.
  • Perform pre-production technical checks of control room and stage systems, including signal routing, intercom and IFB functionality, camera and lighting readiness, belt pack frequencies and batteries, and audio levels.
  • Assist with setup, strike, and reconfiguration of studio, control room, and stage equipment, including cable management, panel configuration, and equipment swaps.
  • Partner with Engineering and Operations to monitor production and studio spaces and escalate unresolved technical faults, documenting symptoms, troubleshooting steps taken, and resolution to support recurring-issue tracking and preventive maintenance.
  • Coordinate with Production Management to ensure studio spaces, production resources, and operational dependencies are ready before scheduled productions.
  • Work with Scheduling to verify daily crew assignments, confirm personnel arrival and check-in, and promptly escalate staffing gaps or call-outs.
  • Plan and coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, receiving, inspection, equipment staging, transport, and organized storage for studio, remote, and tentpole productions.
  • Work with the IT Asset Management team to maintain equipment lifecycle and asset records in Oracle and ServiceNow, including serial numbers, locations, condition, warranties, inventory audits, check-in/check-out, and disposition.
  • Coordinate procurement activities, including purchase requisitions and purchase orders, vendor onboarding, contract intake documentation, and routine studio and engineering supply orders.
  • Maintain a centralized PO Tracker documenting approval status, delivery timelines, budget classification, SLA tracking, and invoice reconciliation.
  • Maintain SOPs, incident logs, workflow guides, facility reference materials, and operational status reports for the Director of Production Operations. 

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in operations coordination, procurement, or asset management within a broadcast, media, or technical production environment.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast control room and stage systems, including router and comms panels, cameras, IFB and wireless mic belt packs, stage lighting, replay and graphics systems, and associated audio equipment.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform pre-production technical checks, isolate and troubleshoot equipment faults under live production conditions, and escalate unresolved issues to Engineering with clear, documented detail.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office 365 skills, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and Teams, with experience building and maintaining trackers, logs, and operational records.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and multitasking abilities in a fast-paced production setting.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Prior experience in a broadcast facility, live event, or technical operations environment.
  • Hands-on experience with broadcast engineering equipment such as Evertz or Grass Valley routing, RTS or Clear-Com intercom and IFB systems, studio camera systems, EVS replay, Vizrt graphics, and digital audio consoles.
  • Experience with production management tools such as Media Pulse.
  • Experience using Oracle and ServiceNow for purchase orders, asset records, and ticket-based workflows.
  • Experience coordinating shipping, receiving, and equipment logistics for remote or tentpole productions.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint, Microsoft Forms, and Power Automate for request intake, tracking, and document management. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Composure and decisiveness under live production conditions, where equipment issues must be diagnosed and resolved quickly.
  • Proactive problem resolution; anticipates operational and technical needs before they affect production.
  • Sound operational judgment when prioritizing tasks, escalating faults, and balancing competing demands.
  • Cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Production Management, Scheduling, Facilities, and Operations.
  • Precision and accountability; maintains meticulous equipment, procurement, and incident records with minimal oversight.
  • Safety-minded approach to equipment handling, cable management, and studio and stage work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, time management, attention to detail, and ability to work under pressure. 

Physical Demands 

  • Ability to lift and transport equipment up to 50 lbs and to support equipment setup, strike, and staging. 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Full-time, non-exempt position requiring 40 hours per week.
  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on production needs.
  • Seasonal position up to 7 months 

Salary / Pay Range

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. job.title: Senior Manager, Finance - League Operations
job.description:
The Senior Manager, League Corporate Functions Finance, leads forecasting, budgeting, and long-range planning activities for League Corporate departments, partnering closely with business teams to deliver insights and support strategic decisions. This role will provide oversight and support to various league departments including Information Technology, Data & Analytics, Diversity & Inclusion, Human Resources, and Corporate Social Responsibility.

This role oversees financial deliverables across assigned functions, provides direction to staff, and ensures accuracy, consistency, and compliance with all planning and reporting outputs. The position plays a critical role in aligning financial strategies with departmental and enterprise-wide objectives to drive informed decision-making and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the preparation of monthly forecasts, annual budgets, and long-range planning deliverables for League Corporate departments.
  • Oversee financial analysis and reporting packages to support quarterly business reviews, strategic initiatives, and CFO-level discussions.
  • Understand close results by closely interacting with the Global Accounting team
  • Manage and develop direct reports, providing direction and oversight across forecasting, budgeting, and reporting activities.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders—including Strategy, Media, Operations, and Shared Services—to align financial targets and inform decisions.
  • Deliver accurate financial insights and scenario modeling to guide executive planning and performance management.
  • Ensure consistency in FP&A processes and uphold planning standards across supported business areas.
  • Drive process improvements and implement best practices to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and collaboration across planning cycles.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 7+ years of finance and/or accounting work experience related to budgeting, forecasting, analytical and problem-solving
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strong ability using Excel, PowerPoint
  • Experience with ERP and Forecasting systems
  • Experience creating and editing financial models is a plus
  • Interpersonal Skills: Building and maintaining relationships with colleagues and business stakeholders.
  • Time Management: Prioritize tasks effectively to meet deadlines and manage workloads efficiently

job.title: Sr. Manager, Club Revenue Analytics & Data Science
job.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Sr. Manager of Club Revenue Analytics & Data Science to join our Data & Analytics team at the NFL. Based in the League’s New York office, this role partners with internal stakeholders and all 32 clubs to turn business questions and fan data into actionable recommendations, scalable analytics products, and measurable growth across ticketing, premium seating, sponsorship, and fan engagement. The role also works with Data Engineering and Business Intelligence to ensure solutions are accurate, governed, and scalable.

The ideal candidate combines business acumen, data science and advanced analytics experience, executive communication skills, and a consultative mindset to turn insights into action.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and collaborate with stakeholders from Club Business Development and the 32 clubs to understand their analytics needs and deliver actionable insights.
  • Oversee the development and ongoing maintenance of comprehensive analytics platforms to support ticketing, premium seating and sponsorship analytics and insights.
  • Lead advanced analytics to evaluate ticketing, premium seating, and sponsorship behavior, including KPI monitoring, segmentation, customer profiling, and predictive modeling.
  • Effectively communicate analytical findings to stakeholders, translating complex data analysis into clear and concise insights.
  • Collaborate with BI and technology teams to ensure ticketing, premium seating, and sponsorship platforms receive accurate, reliable data through regular quality audits and validation.
  • Perform data extraction, transformation and analysis using SQL and Python.
  • Develop and implement attribution models to measure the impact of different League-provided data products.
  • Work with the BI COE to create dashboards to provide insights and recommendations based on analytics findings.
  • Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in club analytics and data quality management.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Club Business Development, Marketing and the 32 clubs to align analytics initiatives and drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Collaborate with analytics consulting vendors.
  • Foster a collaborative and agile work environment, leveraging tools like Jira for project management and task tracking.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Economics, Statistics, Operations Research, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience in revenue analytics, pricing, customer analytics, ticketing, consulting, ecommerce, hospitality, sports, media, or another commercially oriented industry or other relevant industry experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems, direct analytical work, and translate findings into clear commercial recommendations.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with practical experience working with large customer, transactional, or behavioral datasets.
  • Experience with predictive modeling, customer segmentation, forecasting, experimentation or campaign measurement, and analytical storytelling.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex analytical workstreams and coaching analysts
  • Proven ability to communicate with senior business and technical stakeholders and present complex analysis in a clear, concise, and influential manner.
  • Experience partnering with data engineering, BI, product, or technology teams to deliver scalable analytical solutions with strong data quality and governance.
  • 3 years of management experience.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Sports, clubs, ticketing, live events, venue, hospitality, airline, subscription, or revenue management experience.
  • Experience with Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, or comparable ticketing and live-event datasets.
  • Experience developing club-facing, client-facing, or executive-facing recommendations in a consulting or analytics advisory environment.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex analytical findings to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
  • Strong collaborator who communicates transparently, supports shared goals, and welcomes constructive challenges.

job.title: VP, International Licensing & Consumer Products
job.description:
The Vice President, International Licensing & Consumer Products, will lead the NFL’s international growth through Consumer Products. The role will lead the development and execution of international Consumer Products strategies to expand the NFL’s presence in priority markets, grow licensing and retail opportunities, and strengthen fan engagement. Working across local markets and global teams, this position will identify and develop new business opportunities, maximize the value of existing partnerships, and build innovative commercial models that drive sustainable revenue and long-term NFL brand growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for leading and managing all licensee accounts with more than 50% of their business generated from the EMEA, LATAM or APAC markets, including product development, retail distribution, and marketing
  • Responsible for setting and achieving annual growth targets and long-range plans for the international CP business
  • Responsible for local account management of global accounts, including product development, retail distribution, and marketing
  • Fan Development/Data Acquisition through international CP partners
  • Liaison to local GMs and marketing teams on all global CP strategy and initiatives
  • Successful International Games execution

Core Responsibilities:

  • New Business
    • Identify and manage international licensing agencies in key territories; lead RFP and negotiations as needed  
    • Lead and execute new business focused on accounts where more than 50% of sales will be derived outside of the US
    • Expand global partner rights through new rights and  development of localized product assortments, retail distribution, and marketing support
    • Identify new retail distribution opportunities and innovative products to drive growth with a specific focus on unique international needs
    • Support GMP with localized Club programs that drive retail revenue or maximize brand exposure for their awarded markets
    • Identify new business models – i.e., licensed events and branded or experiential retail that will drive both revenue and brand awareness
    • Support new LBE initiatives in international markets through marketing, retail execution, and consultation with local country teams
  • Account Management
    • Lead international account strategy to drive NFL Consumer Products revenue growth
    • Own licensing forecasts, performance, and long-term growth plans for internationally focused accounts (>50% of sales come from outside the US) in partnership with Finance and Strategy
    • Develop and own bespoke retail distribution strategies across key markets.
    • Oversee management of licensing agencies and drive them to identify meaningful, strategic new business opportunities
    • Expand global partners by maximizing rights, categories, and geographic reach in collaboration with the Global Licensing team
    • Oversee the local CP leads in managing local teams of key global accounts (e.g., Fanatics, New Era, Topps, etc.) to translate Global account strategy into local implementation across product, retail, marketing, and activations
    • Partner with the GMs and Country marketing leads to understand local opportunities for global and local partners to drive Fan Engagement
    • Drive partner support and engagement in focus markets and at key tentpoles (e.g., Draft, Super Bowl, IGs, and International Watch Parties)
    • Collaborate with local marketing teams to secure revenue-driving marketing / creative for international partners
  • International Football Development Support
    • Partner with Global Licensing and other function heads to ensure on-field partners are supporting strategic League on-field initiatives internationally (e.g., Marketing / Brand, FLAG, International Growth)
    • Act as key liaison to local GMs and marketing teams on new global partner initiatives, i.e., Nike, Wilson
    • Execute implementation of on-field strategies to ensure flawless execution for international accounts
  •  Global / International Collaboration
    • Partner with Global Licensing to ensure the overall consumer products portfolio mix is maximizing fan engagement and revenue
    • Collaborate with Global Licensing leads to ensure partners are activating their rights and that Global partners' rights are being activated in key international markets
    • Provide event retail support and in-market activation support for the larger Global licensing ecosystem by attending site visits, building local relationships, and overseeing market activations in their market
  • Collaboration/Partnership with Strategy Team:
    • Build strategic vision for International Consumer Products long-term to ensure sustainable growth
    • Outline international partner/category insight needs for Consumer Products Strategy to research, investigate, and design to leverage data-based and insights-driven decision-making
    • Provide insights to inform partner strategy planning and forecasting
    • Articulate forecasts and business changes to help shape narrative for ongoing business reviews (e.g., Business Planning, QBRs)
    • Help identify policy challenges and opportunities and support in building business cases for necessary revisions
    • Input into materials for executive-level updates, including EOC, Committee Meetings, and Owners Meetings

Core Categories:

  • Apparel
  • Hardlines
  • Local eCommerce
  • Third Party Retail/DTC
  • On-Field
  • Licensed Events

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • 15+ years of experience in Licensing/Consumer Products
  • Proven experience leading teams and developing individuals

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Adaptability & Resilience: The ability to pivot quickly when priorities change, process unexpected disruptions, and bounce back from setbacks.
  • Curiosity & Growth Mindset: An inner drive to learn new things, ask critical questions, and continuously build capabilities rather than staying static.
  • Initiative & Self-Motivation: Acting proactively to solve problems without needing constant direction or oversight.
  • Integrity & Honesty: Operating with strong moral standards, building trust, and taking accountability for outcomes.
  • Teamwork & Collaboration: Valuing peer input, sharing credit, and lifting up the collective performance of the group.
  • Big-Picture Thinking: Understanding how individual tasks tie into broader organizational goals and market shifts.

job.title: VP, Treasury & Risk
job.description:
The Vice President, Treasury & Risk will be a key leader within the NFL Finance organization, responsible for leading enterprise risk management, treasury, insurance, and internal audit functions. This role will strengthen the League’s governance, risk management, and control environment while providing strategic oversight of liquidity, cash forecasting, banking administration, and financial risk.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of Internal Audit and Treasury professionals and manage external/co-sourced service providers as needed
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on risk, controls, governance, liquidity, insurance, and financial stewardship
  • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the League’s enterprise risk management framework, including enterprise-wide risk assessments, risk monitoring, mitigation planning, and reporting
  • Prepare clear and timely enterprise risk and emerging risk reporting for senior leadership and the Audit Committee
  • Oversee daily cash positioning activities, including liquidity management and cash position optimization
  • Develop short- and long-term cash flow forecasts to support liquidity planning, strategic business decisions, and investments
  • Develop a structure to work cross functionally to optimize working capital
  • Oversee banking administration, banking relationships, investments, and other treasury operations
  • Invest excess cash within approved cash investment guidelines to optimize interest income while preserving liquidity and principal
  • Design, analyze, monitor, and hedge exposures to foreign exchange and interest rate risk
  • Oversee and evaluate insurance programs to help ensure appropriate coverage, administration, and compliance

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field
  • 15+ years of experience across treasury, enterprise risk management, accounting, or finance, including significant leadership responsibility
  • Management experience and proven success leading and developing teams
  • Proven success building functions and creating or improving processes, policies, controls, and reporting
  • Strong executive presence, judgment, communication skills, and ability to influence across a complex organization

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • CPA, CIA, CTP, CRMA, CISA, or other relevant professional certification
  • Experience using data analytics, automation, and continuous monitoring within treasury, risk, or internal audit
  • Experience managing co-sourced internal audit or other third-party professional service relationships

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week in the office.

 

Salary / Pay Range

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

job.title: IT Engineer I
job.description:
IT Engineer I #26-1159 St Joseph, Missouri, United States Apply Location: NPG Management LLC-1100 Area of Interest: Corporate - Information Technology Exempt/Non-Exempt: Non-exempt [Non-ex.] FT/PT: Full-time Number of Positions: 1 Job Description: IT Engineer I Position: IT Engineer I Location: St. Joseph, MO

About Us

NPG is a news and media company with investments in online education, manufacturing, and technology infrastructure. Our employees work across broadcast, digital education, technology, printing, newspaper, and corporate operations in locations throughout the country. We value dependable technology services that help our businesses meet their goals while protecting company data, networks, and assets. We support professional growth through training, teamwork, and continued learning. IT Engineer I is an explicitly entry-level position designed for someone beginning or building a career in IT. Prior IT

experience

is not required; structured training and support help you develop a solid foundation and grow your technical capabilities over time. Position Information NPG is seeking a customer-focused, curious, and dependable person to join the Corporate IT Engineering team as IT Engineer I. This explicitly entry-level position provides first-line technology support to onsite and remote employees across NPG and BERKS companies and locations, including the corporate/home-office environment and shared corporate functions such as IT, Human Resources, Finance, and other business services, as well as broadcast, digital education, technology infrastructure, manufacturing, printing, and newspaper operations. The primary office is St. Joseph, Missouri. Travel to other company offices may be required based on business needs. As a member of the NPG IT Team, you will be the first point of contact for employee support requests submitted through the Radar Ticket System. You will troubleshoot common computer and technology issues, keep employees informed, document your work, and determine when a request should be resolved by you or routed to another member of the team. You will support Windows and Mac computers, laptops and peripherals, phones, virtual machines and virtual desktop environments, approved software, VPN, Microsoft 365, email, employee accounts and access, and security-related reports within your training and authorization. Your

responsibilities

will also include preparing and deploying equipment, maintaining hardware inventory, completing standard employee onboarding, and offboarding tasks with required approval, and helping with office work such as workstation setup, deliveries, mail, vendor visits, remote hands, and daily data-center walkthroughs. You will work with IT Engineer II and IT Engineer III teammates on issues that need additional expertise and remain engaged, so employees receive a clear resolution or next step. IT Engineer I participates in a scheduled weekly 24/7 on-call rotation. On-call duties include initial troubleshooting and verification of urgent end-user and security concerns, following documented incident-response procedures, and escalating issues that exceed your training, access, or role scope. This is the baseline scope and expected work for IT Engineer I. As your

experience

and technical ability grow, you may be asked to assist IT Engineer II and IT Engineer III teammates for continued learning, backup coverage, and business needs. IT Drivers Exceptional customer service — provides prompt, respectful support and keeps employees informed. A highly functional team — communicate clearly, document work, and collaborate or escalate when needed. A resilient business platform — troubleshoot carefully, follow security procedures, and support stable service. IT Engineer I supports these priorities through careful triage, security-conscious support, and clear follow-through. What We are Looking For This is an entry-level role. Customer-service experience, foundational computer understanding, a strong interest in technology, and the ability to learn as you go are important. Prior IT support experience, formal education, and certifications are helpful but not required. You should be responsible and comfortable working through unfamiliar issues, while knowing when to communicate, collaborate, or escalate. The position requires the ability to lift and move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds and to travel between company offices as required. Reliable transportation is required for inter-office travel. Participation in the weekly 24/7 on-call rotation is required. If interested in this position, please submit your resume with a cover letter to www.npgco.com/careers EOE Requisition Number: 26-1159

job.title: Chief Business Editor
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application deadline and instructions :

  • Please complete and submit your application by 11:59 pm EST on Monday, December 7th, 2026
  • Please submit your resume and cover letter. In your cover letter please share your philosophy for leading a Business desk and what you envision the top focus areas should be for the desk in 2027.

Intro to Position

NPR’s Chief Business Editor has overall operational and editorial responsibility for business and economics coverage on all platforms. This editor supervises assignments and provides editorial guidance to a team of business reporters, correspondents and editors across the country. The position also advises NPR shows, including Morning Edition and All Things Considered, and coordinates editorial content closely with the Planet Money podcast team. This includes preparation of material on all platforms, overseeing the editorial integrity and quality of content, monitoring and evaluating staff performance, recommending new hires and providing editorial support to the Executive Editor.  This position will be responsible for a team and report to the Executive Editor.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

Responsibilities

  • Leads NPR’s business coverage through a combination of distinctive stories, daily news, enterprise and scoops
  • Identifies and sharpen areas of coverage across broadcast and digital platforms
  • Supervises assignments and provide editorial guidance to staff, station and freelance reporters, and production staff
  • Works across the newsroom to determine the best approaches to stories, subjects to be discussed and treated, and individuals to be interviewed 
  • Tracks station, freelance and staff submissions and assignments. 
  • Ensures that speculative submissions from stations and freelancers are auditioned to determine suitability for airing. 
  • Regularly has critical discussions about pieces with reporters and editors, and with the Executive Editor, as appropriate.   
  • Makes hiring and salary recommendations for staff members under his or her supervision, in consultation with the Executive Editor. 
  • Responsible for preparing performance reviews for assigned staff members. 
  • Assists in planning and monitoring the business unit’s annual budgets and in monitoring current spending. 
  • Coordinates business unit staff schedules, submits and approves time sheets and maintains other personnel records as needed. 
  • Responsible for tracking overtime and travel expenditures.
  • Ensures that all material aired and published meets the highest journalistic standards and practices, including standards of accuracy, fairness and probity. 

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • A minimum of 15 years’ experience as a news reporter or editor, including demonstrated experience covering business and economics
  • Demonstrated experience overseeing editorial output for social media and digital platforms
  • Demonstrated collaborative approach to newsgathering and story presentation across platforms
  • Considerable skill in both news and feature editing

Preferred Qualifications

  • Broadcast and specifically radio news experience
  • Familiarity with the NPR member station network

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Previous managerial experience

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience 

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role require duties better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C., New York City, or Culver City location at least 3 days a week.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $190,000-215,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.title: Cloud Systems Engineer
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR is seeking a Systems Engineer for its Distribution IT Infrastructure team to manage, test, and maintain our enterprise virtualized infrastructure, including servers, storage, and networking systems. In this role, you will deploy, configure, monitor, and troubleshoot modern virtualization platforms (such as VMware vSphere, HPE Morpheus VM Essentials, or Proxmox) to guarantee high availability, scalability, and security across NPR's core distribution technologies.

This role sits at the intersection of physical and virtual infrastructure: you will help stand up new data center hardware and build NPR's private cloud environment on top of it, from rack and cable to hypervisor and host networking.

Working collaboratively with Infrastructure and Security colleagues, you will analyze business workflows, implement structured change management processes, and support capacity planning initiatives to deliver resilient, mission-critical operations for NPR and our nationwide Member station network.

Responsibilities

  • Physical Infrastructure Build-Out: Partner with Infrastructure colleagues to install, rack, cable, and configure new server, storage, and network hardware, including firmware updates, out-of-band management (e.g., HPE iLO, Dell iDRAC), and RAID/BIOS configuration, to establish the foundation for virtualized workloads.
  • Virtual Infrastructure Deployment & Maintenance: Deploy, configure, and maintain virtualized systems using enterprise tools (e.g., HPE Morpheus VM Essentials, Proxmox, Nutanix, Incus, or VMware) to support operational reliability.
  • Architecture Evaluation & Testing: Evaluate virtual system architecture, compare existing applications, and create metrics to measure response times and availability for test environments.
  • Change Management Implementation: Recommend and execute system enhancements following established organizational change management policies and procedures.
  • Operational & Capacity Support: Assist the Distribution Infrastructure team in executing cloud/virtualization workflows and capacity planning tools focused on return on investment and business value.
  • Security Alignment & Compliance: Partner with Security Engineers to ensure virtual hosts, operating systems, and network configurations comply with organizational security policies.
  • Workflow & Process Analysis: Analyze and document Distribution IT process workflows, identifying areas for continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
  • Technical Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Create comprehensive documentation, procedures, instructions, and training materials for internal colleagues and system users.
  • Incident Escalation & Operational Support: Proactively communicate operational status to management, participate in an on-call rotation, and respond to critical system issues on a 24x7 basis as needed.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience supporting, maintaining, troubleshooting, and administering servers and networking within a data center environment.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in the planning, design, deployment, and management of enterprise virtualized cloud infrastructure (e.g., VMware ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, or open-source hypervisors).
  • Hands-on experience with physical data center hardware, including racking and cabling servers, configuring out-of-band 
  • Competence in DNS administration (BIND preferred).
  • Experience with IP address management (IPAM) and DHCP services.
  • Experience with configuration management (Puppet preferred).
  • Experience creating agentless automation workflows (Ansible preferred).
  • Experience with Mail Transfer Agent administration (Exim).
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server administration (2022+) alongside core directory and networking protocols (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, IIS).
  • Practical experience supporting enterprise storage (NetApp or TrueNAS).
  • Comfortable with networking configuration of hosts, switches, and routers, including VLANs, trunking, and NIC bonding/link aggregation as applied to hypervisor hosts.
  • Proven track record as a key contributor or project leader on complex technical initiatives, including the creation of detailed technical documentation and workflow diagrams.
  • Demonstrated ability to participate effectively in a team environment, handle multiple concurrent projects, and contribute to an on-call rotation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Unix/Linux networking configuration and Cisco switches and routers (Catalyst or Nexus/NX-OS).
  • Familiarity with scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, or JavaScript).
  • Experience with enterprise backup/recovery solutions (e.g., Veeam).
  • Experience with HPE ProLiant or Dell PowerEdge server hardware.
  • Knowledge of Linux operating systems and relevant industry certifications (VMware VCP, Microsoft, or AWS).

Required Skills/Competencies

  • System Troubleshooting & Diagnostics: Ability to systematically isolate, diagnose, and resolve complex issues across hardware, server, storage, network, and virtualized layers.
  • Structured Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills to present technical concepts and write actionable system documentation.
  • Prioritization Under Pressure: Capacity to prioritize tasks effectively during high-urgency system maintenance or operational incidents.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to partner seamlessly with Security, Network, and Distribution engineering teams.
  • Continuous Learning Mindset: Commitment to staying current with emerging virtualization tools, cloud platforms, and data center technologies.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, OR equivalent practical work experience.

Work Location

Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role require duties better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location at least 2 days a week. The employee must also reside in an NPR-supported location based on the number of on-site days they choose.

Job Type
