job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR's AI Labs team is looking for a Manager of AI Engineering and Vendor Operations. This person will serve on the AI Labs leadership team and help inform NPR's AI technical strategy. We are seeking a player-coach style who understands the complexities of building adaptive and conscientious AI coding teams, and can help us apply rigor and standards to our infrastructure decisions and rollouts. In this role, you will supervise the mid-level engineering staff, provide mentorship and support to NPR's larger engineering teams and own the evaluation and deployment of the team's AI tools and vendors. This role suits someone who can weigh build-versus-buy decisions honestly, explain technical trade-offs to non-technical colleagues, and hold both vendors and our own work to NPR's standards for privacy, security, and accuracy. This is a chance to shape a new team and have a tangible effect on how NPR uses AI responsibly in service of its mission, on a team built on respect, trust, and work-life balance.

Responsibilities

  • People Leadership: Manage and mentor a team of entry and mid-level AI engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and supporting each person's professional growth.
  • Delivery: Lead technical planning, scoping, and sprint execution for AI Labs engineering work, such as NPR's AI-powered metadata service, in partnership with AI Labs leadership and editorial and business stakeholders.
  • Engineering Standards: Work with AI Labs leadership to develop AI coding frameworks, practices, and expectations for the team.
  • Code Quality and Architecture: Review designs and code, and contribute hands-on where it helps the team, keeping systems maintainable, secure, and consistent with NPR's technical standards.
  • Testing and Evaluation: Build and maintain automated testing and model evaluation practices, including regression tests and evaluation checks before release, aligned with quality bars set by the product team.
  • Production Support: Coordinate the team's response to production bugs and infrastructure incidents, and lead follow-up reviews to prevent repeat problems.
  • Vendor Evaluation: Lead technical evaluations of AI vendors, models, and tools, covering architecture, data handling, security, and cost, and recommend whether NPR should build, buy, or partner.
  • NPR-wide AI Tool Review: Participate in AI Labs' review of AI tools requested by teams across NPR, working with IT Security through the vendor risk and security intake processes. AI Labs assesses, and IT and the Office of General Counsel approve.
  • Vendor Relationships: Take over day-to-day management of selected AI vendors and tools, from onboarding and seat provisioning through renewal and offboarding. 
  • Responsible Scaling: Track vendor usage, spend, and renewal dates against budget, and ensure AI systems scale securely and cost-effectively while maintaining strong data privacy protections.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of experience building and shipping production AI or machine learning systems, with deep hands-on knowledge of large language models and the systems built around them.
  • 2+ years of experience managing or mentoring engineers.
  • Experience setting engineering practices for a team, such as code review, testing, or deployment standards.
  • Experience working with technology vendors and managing software tools, including security and data privacy reviews.
  • Experience building automated testing, including methods for evaluating the quality of AI model outputs.
  • Hands-on experience building in a major cloud environment (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Experience setting up automated testing, including methods for evaluating the quality of AI model outputs.
  • Experience working across technical and non-technical teams, including explaining technical and cost trade-offs to people without a technical background and working with product managers to gather requirements from stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a media organization, newsroom, or public service institution.
  • Experience onboarding staff into a new or growing team.
  • Experience designing harnesses for AI coding agents, including permissions, approval steps, and automated checks.
  • Experience working with procurement, legal, or vendor risk teams on technology reviews.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Strong Python skills and working knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search.
  • Proficiency in design and architecture of AI systems and systems of AI evaluation
  • Proficiency in SQL and cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake.
  • Familiarity with model evaluation methods, prompt engineering, and API integration, including NPR's approved model families such as Claude, Gemini, Gemma, and Llama.
  • Ability to assess vendor security documentation, data processing terms, and seat-based and usage-based pricing.
  • Commitment to data privacy, AI ethics, and identifying and reducing bias.

Education Requirements

job.title: Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, Morning Edition & Up First
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Instructions:

Please submit your resume and cover letter. In your cover letter please share your philosophy for leading a newsroom overnight in order to deliver the most up-to-date morning broadcast possible.

Intro to Position

Morning Edition and Up First are looking for a resilient journalist with strong news judgment, excellent writing skills and a willingness to work overnights as the Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, managing  a production team that executes what is needed to get the live radio show to air and the Up First podcast to publication.

Millions of listeners depend on Morning Edition and Up First to set the news agenda to start their day. We deliver the latest national and international news stories paired with analysis to put headlines into context. Morning Edition is a platform for accountability through interviews with government officials and decision makers who make or influence policy that affect people's lives. The show also features culture stories about music, movies and books that bring joy and provoke thoughtful conversations about who we are in this world.

The right candidate for this position is committed to daily news, and is eager to deliver the freshest, most important stories to listeners. They put the needs and wants of audiences first. They believe in the mission of public media.

As the Overnight/Live Broadcast Supervising Editor, you will join a team of managers who collaboratively lead news and editorial coverage of events in the U.S. and around the world for Morning Edition and Up First. You ensure that the show is at the leading edge of the conversation across a range of issues. Most importantly, you work directly with our hosts to edit and make final changes to the show before and while it is live on air to ensure we are broadcasting our best journalism and editorial work.

Duties for this position include assigning stories and segments to hosts, producers and editors; editing show scripts, crafting live coverage and breaking news plans; leading the control room during the live broadcast; finding guests and reporters to feature on the show when needed; monitoring news and responding with show coverage plans as needed; mentoring and editing producers’ and editors’ writing for stories and show segments; managing staff work schedules as emergencies arise; coordinate and collaborate with other newsroom editors, leaders and journalists on show coverage plans, projects; upload editorial standards and ethics as the lead show manager during your shift. As a manager, you will be assigned direct reports and are expected to evaluate and develop staff.

This is an overnight position with a shift scheduled from approximately 11:30pm - 8:30am Eastern Time Sunday-Thursday.

Morning Edition is a 24/6 news operation. Successful candidates can work holidays and may be asked to temporarily change their work schedule to cover other show shifts and special assignments as needed.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff are defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the show production team in bringing the live radio show and podcast to air, including the most listened to segment that airs during the 7a ET hour

  • Make editorial, programming and news judgment decisions about edits and show coverage plans, especially during breaking news situations
  • Provide written and verbal editorial feedback to staff on work
  • Evaluate, develop, and manage staff performance
  • Collaborate with multiplatform news teams to maximize reach of show content
  • Participate in the hiring of individual staff
  • Cultivate, promote and advance diversity, equity, and inclusion in one’s work and in the workplace.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

job.title: Senior Mobile Software Architect
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

A Software Architect exemplifies technical expertise and excellence at NPR. Working alongside engineering leadership and cross-functional discipline teams, you will guide strategic technology decisions, design scalable solutions, and build robust pipelines, services, and tools that support NPR and our Member Station Network.

In this role, you will lead technology strategy across our most complex engineering initiatives—those impacting multiple product lines, distributed systems, and mobile platforms simultaneously. Responsible for end-to-end architecture from platform services to client applications and downstream data pipelines, you will balance system performance, developer velocity, data privacy, and cost-efficiency to deliver exceptional public media experiences at scale.

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with NABET-CWA DMU.

Responsibilities

Architectural Strategy & System Design

  1. Architect Unified Mobile & Cross-Platform Systems: Define and implement shared architectural patterns and modular design systems across native iOS and Android codebases and cross-platform integrations to maximize code reuse and development velocity.
  2. Design Scalable Personalization & Delivery Pipelines: Lead platform-to-client architecture for personalized content delivery, supporting high-traffic, localized media experiences across owned digital properties and member station networks.
  3. Drive Technology Standards & Evaluation: Conduct technical evaluations for custom builds versus vendor solutions; introduce modern technologies and establish architectural standards across divisions.

Cross-Team Collaboration & Governance

  1. Lead Multi-Team Engineering Initiatives: Provide technical oversight and direction across cross-divisional product roadmaps, project proposals, and OKR planning cycles for multi-team initiatives.
  2. Establish Quality & Code Governance: Conduct architectural proposals and code reviews, providing substantive feedback on system designs, security protocols, workflows, and peer-written software.
  3. Integrate Compliance & Cost Controls: Architect solutions with explicit focus on privacy compliance (GDPR/CPRA), security standards, CDN caching strategies, and cloud cost optimization frameworks.

Operational Excellence & Mentorship

  1. Support Deployment & Operational Resilience: Participate in automated deployments across QA, UAT, and production environments; join the developer on-call rotation to diagnose and resolve critical incidents.
  2. Contribute High-Quality Code: Author documented, resilient code and reusable core libraries aligned with department standards and sprint commitments.
  3. Foster Technical Mentorship & Team Growth: Assist in onboarding, training, and interviewing software engineering staff, advocating for efficient agile processes and inclusive team practices.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

  • Proven track record designing high-traffic, resilient distributed systems, RESTful/GraphQL APIs, and client-server integration patterns.
  • Practical experience architecting media playback, streaming protocols, CDN configurations, and cloud infrastructure ecosystems (e.g., AWS or GCP).
  • Hands-on experience integrating data privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CPRA) alongside cloud cost optimization frameworks in high-availability environments.
  • Demonstrated experience with modern version control systems (Git), continuous integration pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Mission-Driven Innovation: Passion for leveraging modern technology to advance public media, accessibility, and audience engagement.

Intro to Position

NPR is seeking an experienced, technically rigorous Senior IT Systems Engineer to join our IT Systems team. In this role, you will serve as a primary technical lead responsible for the design, deployment, administration, and optimization of NPR’s core virtualized data center infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on expertise in VMware vSphere, enterprise Storage Area Networks (SAN/NAS), and Cisco Unified Computing System (UCS) environments.

You will play a critical role in ensuring the high availability, scalability, performance, and security of our enterprise systems while partnering across Technology to advance infrastructure modernization and automation initiatives in support of our nationwide public media mission.

Responsibilities

Data Center Architecture & Storage Administration

  1. Architect Virtualized Infrastructure: Design, deploy, and manage core virtualized data center infrastructure, leading enterprise VMware vSphere environments, Cisco UCS compute platforms, and SAN/NAS storage arrays.
  2. Administer Enterprise Compute & Storage: Execute routine server builds, security patch management, virtual machine lifecycle administration, and enterprise storage capacity allocation.
  3. Advance Cloud & Hybrid Integration: Evaluate systems architecture and hybrid-cloud strategy, taking operational ownership of the maintenance and integration of cloud infrastructure (AWS or Azure).

Systems Governance & Disaster Recovery

  1. Govern Disaster Recovery Strategies: Design, maintain, and rigorously test business continuity and disaster recovery strategies, including enterprise backups, data replication, and automated site failovers.
  2. Manage Structured Change Processes: Recommend, test, and implement system enhancements in strict adherence to established organizational change management policies and procedures.
  3. Publish System Documentation & SOPs: Author and maintain comprehensive systems architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures (SOPs), runbooks, and technical documentation for IT colleagues and system stakeholders.

Incident Escalation & Operational Automation

  1. Lead Tier-3 Escalations & Root Cause Analysis: Serve as the senior technical escalation point for enterprise technology teams, isolating root causes and resolving complex production incidents.
  2. Automate Infrastructure Operations: Design and execute automation scripts using modern scripting languages to streamline routine administrative tasks, infrastructure provisioning, and systems health reporting.
  3. Maintain Operational Communications: Provide timely status reporting on system health to engineering leadership, manage incident response on a 24x7 rotation, and articulate outage impact clearly to technical and operational partners.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

  • Proven, hands-on experience designing and managing complex VMware vSphere environments (clustering, DRS, HA, vMotion).
  • Extensive experience with Cisco UCS Manager, configuring service profiles, templates, and physical hardware deployment.
  • Strong background in configuring and managing enterprise SAN/NAS storage arrays and storage networking protocols.
  • 2+ years of experience planning, designing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure (AWS or Azure).
  • Strong working knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem, including Windows Server (2016+), Active Directory, Azure AD, Office 365, IIS, SQL, DFS, DHCP, and DNS.
  • Experience creating detailed systems documentation and flow charts.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to successfully handle multiple projects in a high-pressure, collaborative environment.

  • Industry Certifications: Active professional certifications in VMware (VCP), Cisco (CCNA/CCNP Data Center), Microsoft, or AWS/Azure solutions architecture.

job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and mission-aligned executive to serve as Senior Vice President (SVP), Audience Development & Content Distribution. Reporting directly to the Chief Content Officer (CCO), this executive will bridge enterprise editorial vision with multi-platform publishing, network syndication, and station distribution strategy. While our newsroom leadership focuses on the stories we tell, you will lead how, when, where, and to whom public media journalism is delivered and experienced across our nationwide network.

The ideal candidate sits at the intersection of executive media leadership, digital strategy, and network operations—scaling quality, editorial integrity, and audience reach by building a collaborative publishing framework that aligns, empowers, and coordinates NPR, Member stations, and affiliate partners. You will oversee enterprise content roadmaps and channel distribution strategies to maximize audience acquisition, reader/listener retention, and civic impact across owned properties, third-party platforms, and member newsrooms.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

Responsibilities

Multi-Platform Distribution & Ecosystem Growth

  • Drive Enterprise Content Planning: Build and manage the enterprise-wide content roadmap, aligning daily news flow, major investigative series, podcasts, newsletters, and special projects across all publishing platforms to optimize newsroom capacity and audience engagement.
  • Execute Channel & Syndication Strategy: Oversee multi-platform distribution across owned digital properties (apps, web, newsletters) and third-party networks (search, social platforms, news aggregators, streaming platforms) while adapting to media consumption trends and algorithm shifts.
  • Lead Ecosystem Relationships: Build, maintain, and expand long-term executive relationships with publishers, digital-native media outlets, radio/TV syndicators, and non-profit journalism networks.
  • Optimize Audience Growth & Impact: Direct cross-functional initiatives with SEO, social media, and newsletter teams to boost discovery, retention, and measurable civic and journalistic impact.

Member Network Strategy

  • Architect Station Network Publishing: Design, govern, and scale the operational framework for network syndication, content sharing, joint reporting initiatives, and affiliate publishing across Member stations and affiliate newsrooms.
  • Cultivate Member Relationships: Serve as the central executive partner to station managers, news directors, and affiliate leaders, establishing partner advisory cadences and service standards that deliver maximum strategic value to Member stations.
  • Establish Impact & Performance Metrics: Partner with data and analytics teams to define network operational KPIs, content adoption metrics, and ROI frameworks, translating audience data into actionable strategic recommendations for editorial leadership.

Enterprise Infrastructure & Strategic Leadership

  • Modernize Publishing Workflows: Architect technology-enabled distribution workflows, enterprise CMS stacks, asset management repositories (DAM/MAM), and ethical AI tools designed for distributed network environments.
  • Manage Budget & Executive Alignment: Oversee the content operations and distribution budget, manage strategic resource allocation, and collaborate with Legal, Product, Tech, and Revenue leadership to preserve brand safety and organizational alignment.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in media strategy, content operations, audience development, or network distribution—ideally within a major newsroom, public broadcasting network, or federated media alliance.
  • Demonstrated expertise managing complex editorial calendars, media partner relationships, and multi-channel digital distribution mechanics (SEO, news aggregators, newsletters, social platforms, and streaming syndication).
  • Proven experience designing, scaling, and managing complex affiliate syndication systems, content-sharing networks, or federated member-station alliances.
  • Executive-level familiarity with enterprise publishing architecture, distributed CMS stacks, media asset management systems (MAM/DAM), and workflow automation.
  • Exceptional executive presence with a track record of building consensus, inspiring collaboration, and aligning independent station partners and cross-functional leaders around shared strategic goals.
  • Strong operational budget management experience with familiarity with network economics, membership models, or syndication structures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep operational understanding of public radio, member-station governance, and federated media fundraising/licensing models.
  • Direct experience evaluating and implementing ethical AI, automated distribution tools, or next-generation media delivery frameworks within distributed media environments.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Strategic Publishing Vision: Ability to bridge high-level editorial vision with operational execution, aligning enterprise storytelling with multi-platform delivery mechanics.
  • Federated Stakeholder Diplomacy: Exceptional interpersonal and negotiation skills to build trust, navigate federated governance structures, and align independent partners.
  • Data-Informed Editorial Judgment: Strong competency in translating quantitative audience analytics and qualitative metrics into strategic publishing decisions.
  • Executive Change Leadership: Proven capacity to guide teams through digital transformation, process modernization, and evolving media landscapes.
  • Mission-Driven Commitment: Passion for public-interest journalism, editorial integrity, and the vital role of news in a healthy democracy.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Media Studies, Business Administration, or a related field, OR equivalent practical work experience demonstrating equivalent executive capability.

job.title: Vice President, Marketing Strategy
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR’s Marketing team is responsible for building and growing our audience for podcasts, programs, and platforms. The team seeks to grow the reach and impact of everything NPR puts out in the world—from our up-to-the-minute digital and broadcast content to our on-demand podcasts, events, videos, website, and app  The Vice President, Marketing Strategy leads the operational planning and execution of comprehensive marketing strategies across NPR's portfolio. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer, this role manages a team of marketing professionals to execute targeted initiatives that attract, grow, and retain diverse audiences for NPR while driving brand alignment and engagement across all channels. 

Responsibilities

  • Partner across divisions to identify emerging audience opportunities and propose initiatives and campaigns aligned with NPR’s strategic goals.
  • Directly manage, guide, and mentor a team of marketing professionals overseeing audience development work on NPR products, podcasts, and platforms.
  • Define target audiences, perform competitive landscape analyses, identify market opportunities, establish messaging frameworks, and set KPIs to launch new properties and sustainably grow audiences.
  • Create cohesion and consistency across marketing strategy work by lifting up best practices, strengthening and reimagining workflows, and deepening team collaboration.
  • Maintain and enforce a consistent brand expression, voice, and positioning across all channels and consumer touchpoints.
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to develop third-party publisher and brand partnerships to grow, diversify, and acquire new audiences.
  • Strengthen the marketing team’s commitment to cultivating meaningful, collaborative partnerships with our network of Member stations.
  • In close collaboration with the CMO, set operational priorities, allocate staff effectively, and manage project workflows.
  • Build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships to ensure Marketing’s capabilities, role, and integration across the organization are clear.
  • Measure project success using industry-standard metrics (Nielsen ratings, Cume, AQH, CTR, downloads, etc.) to evaluate show and podcast campaign performance.
  • Support and optimize NPR’s consumer products marketing strategy to expand brand reach and complement revenue initiatives.
  • Select, manage, and hold accountable external partners, such as digital ad agencies.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 12 to 15+ years of progressive marketing experience, with at least 7+ years in a senior management role overseeing multidisciplinary teams and project budgets.
  • Proven track record of operationalizing strategic goals into execution roadmaps, managing competing priorities, and leading cross-functional project teams through complex, deadline-driven product or campaign launches. 
  • Hands-on experience conceptualizing, building, and executing end-to-end integrated marketing campaigns across multiple distribution touchpoints—including broadcast, podcasting, digital display, social media, email lifecycle marketing, and mobile app ecosystems. 
  • Demonstrated proficiency in establishing performance benchmarks and leveraging audience measurement metrics (such as Nielsen ratings, Cume, AQH, CTR, downloads, active users, and conversion rates) to evaluate, optimize, and report on campaign ROI. 
  • Strong listening, writing, and speaking skills.
  • Knowledge of best marketing practices for email, display ads, websites, and apps.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of the public media landscape, preferably with direct experience either at a Member station or in close collaboration with federated systems.
  • Experience managing external creative or digital advertising agency relationships.
  • Experience supporting product marketing, merchandising, or consumer brand expansion
  • Demonstrated understanding of the unique dynamics, revenue models, and collaborative touchpoints between national network programming and local station engagement. 
  • Hands-on experience working alongside product development, digital design, and editorial teams to align marketing strategy directly with audience UX and content lifecycle management. 

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Exceptional collaboration skills with a proven ability to work cross-functionally and gain the respect and support of internal and external clients.
  • Deep knowledge of modern audience acquisition, retention, and engagement practices across broadcast, podcasting, digital display, social media, lifecycle email marketing, and mobile app ecosystems. 
  • Outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Creative mindset with a passion for marketing, advertising, design, and storytelling.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust, drive consensus, and maintain productive relationships across diverse departments (editorial, product development, legal, finance, and revenue teams). 

Education Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degree (e.g., MBA) preferred.

Work Location & Requirements

NPR Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid-permitted role based in one of NPR’s office locations: New York City, Washington, D.C., or Los Angeles. Employees are expected to work from their designated office at least three days per week and must reside within commuting distance of their assigned office.

Job Type

This is a full-time, exempt position.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. job.title: Vice President, Talent Strategy
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

Reporting directly to the Chief Content Officer (CCO), the Vice President of Talent Strategy serves as the principal architect, relationship builder, and strategic scout for creative, journalistic, and host talent across NPR. In this role, you will work side-by-side with the CCO and editorial leadership to align talent acquisition, career stewardship, and creator partnerships directly with NPR’s long-term multimedia vision.

You will nurture trusted relationships with our established roster of award-winning journalists, hosts, and commentators while proactively identifying, evaluating, and attracting emerging voices from independent media, podcasts, newsletters, and digital platforms. Serving as an executive bridge across Content, People, Legal, and Member station network, you will champion a collaborative environment where exceptional storytellers can thrive and expand public media's reach across platforms.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.

Responsibilities

  • Executive Talent Relationship Management: Serve as the primary executive liaison and trusted advisor to high-profile journalists, hosts, and creative contributors, cultivating sustainable career pathways and retention strategies in close collaboration with the CCO.
  • Talent Scouting & Pipeline Development: Design and lead a comprehensive discovery strategy across traditional broadcast, podcasting, newsletter platforms, social ecosystems, and independent journalism to build an ongoing, diverse pipeline of on-air and digital talent.
  • Cross-Functional Mediation & Advocacy: Act as the central connective tissue between creative talent, talent representatives (agents, managers, attorneys), and internal executive teams (People Team, Legal, Marketing, and Operations) to align individual goals with organizational priorities.
  • Complex Contract Structuring & Negotiations: In close coordination with the CCO, Legal, and People teams, oversee talent agreement frameworks, leading contract renewals, compensation structures, and rights agreements with precision and diplomatic finesse.
  • Editorial Standards & Mission Alignment: Ensure all talent recruitment, onboarding, and partner strategies rigorously reflect NPR’s core mission, journalistic ethics, and commitment to public service.
  • Audience Forecasting & Metric Analysis: Partner with Content Insights and divisional leadership to evaluate audience consumption trends and identify future talent requirements across evolving media such as video, episodic audio, and experiential storytelling.
  • DEI Talent Initiatives: Systematically embed diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into every phase of talent identification, pipeline cultivation, and retention.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 12+ years of progressive executive leadership in talent management, talent relations, media recruiting, or creative talent strategy within news, podcasting, digital media, or broadcast entertainment.
  • Demonstrated, active network of professional relationships with journalists, creators, literary and talent agencies, management firms, and digital-first storytellers.
  • Proven track record of structuring and negotiating complex, multi-party talent contracts, intellectual property rights, and compensation agreements in compliance with organizational policies.
  • Demonstrated success building and sustaining diverse, multi-perspective talent rosters that engage cross-generational and culturally diverse audiences.
  • Substantive experience acting as a trusted mediator in high-stakes creative environments, resolving interpersonal, contractual, or operational friction with discretion and high emotional intelligence.
  • Unwavering commitment to editorial independence, high-integrity journalism, and the civic mission of public media.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience navigating talent relations within a federated, public service, or non-profit media network operating alongside union collective bargaining agreements (e.g., SAG-AFTRA).
  • Proven experience executing creator-led co-productions, live podcast tours, or multi-platform distribution partnerships.
  • Familiarity with the commercial and sponsorship frameworks unique to digital audio, podcast monetization, and multi-market station networks.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Executive Relationship Building: Exceptional diplomatic presence with the proven ability to build trust quickly with high-profile personalities, agents, and senior internal stakeholders.
  • Contractual & Negotiation Acumen: Strong fluency with creative intellectual property rights, talent deal points, non-disclosure terms, and talent contract structuring.
  • Audience & Format Vision: Forward-looking creative perspective capable of identifying how emerging digital storytellers can translate their voices to public radio and multimedia platforms.
  • Strategic Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional alignments involving Legal, Finance, People, and creative stakeholders without friction.
  • Crisis Management & Discretion: Exceptional judgment, confidentiality, and composure when navigating sensitive personnel or creative matters under public or time pressure.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Media Studies, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical work experience demonstrating equivalent executive capability.

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. or the New York City location at least 3 days a week. The employee must also reside in Washington, D.C. / Maryland / Virginia / New York City.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. job.title: Board Operator
job.description:
Job Type Part-time Description

NRG Media seeks part-time Board Operators to run sports programming and remote broadcasts on our six stations in the Northwoods. The ideal candidate must be able to work flexible weekend and evening hours.


Responsibilities

· Operate control board for studio and remote programming

· Monitor logs, ensure proper placement and timing for syndicated programming and commercials.

· Off-air support of commercial production.

· Perform on-air announcement as assigned. Run ball games and commercials

· Understand the procedures to follow in case of a computer crash or loss of broadcast signal.

· Communicate with the station PD/Ops Manager regularly and as needed.


NRG Media, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Benefits:

NRG Media offers part-time employees the ability to participate in the 401k program, with company match, and access to mental health resources.


NRG Media is dedicated to providing Great Local Radio and committed to being an active and integral part of the communities in which it serves. NRG Media has radio stations in Iowa, Nebraska, and Wisconsin. The company is headquartered in Cedar Rapids, Iowa and led by President/CEO Mary Quass.

  • Willingness to learn and excitement for HS Sports.

  • Knowledge of all applicable FCC rules and regulations.

job.title: Account Coordinator
job.description:
About Ogilvy  

Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named Network of the Year at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and ranks as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.

 

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

 

 

 

Account Coordinator 

Ogilvy Health Canada 

 

About Ogilvy Health: 

Ogilvy Health is focused on driving superior outcomes in the ever-changing healthcare environment, an increasingly complex and evolving marketplace. We inspire brands and people to impact the world by keeping our audiences’ health and wellness needs at the center of every touchpoint. Ogilvy Health delivers insight, creativity, innovation, and engagement solutions for all healthcare stakeholders, patients, and consumers across the healthcare continuum. Through borderless creativity—operating, innovating, and creating at the intersection of talent and capabilities— Advertising, Experience, Public Relations, Health, and Consulting work fluidly across 131 offices in 93 countries to bring forth world-class creative solutions for our clients. 

For more information on us, visit OgilvyHealth.com, or follow Ogilvy Health Canada on  LinkedIn. 

 

About the Role: 

 

The Account Coordinator will work within assigned brands and partner daily with account leaders to learn about the agency as well as the client’s business.  Account Coordinators are curious observers of life, passionate about learning all they can about our industry. They are pro-active and adaptable, brave and resourceful.    

 

What You’ll Do  

  • Establish and build relationships with internal team and brand/client team 
  • Provide administrative support, including status reports/meeting recaps, meeting scheduling, budget tracking, etc.  
  • Manage finances – open jobs, issue POs, reconcile invoices & Pos and upload for processing  
  • Learn about key agency disciplines such as Media, Production, Strategy, Account, PMO, Medical Communications, Creative 
  • Job initiation, including development of Project Briefs in coordination with Project Managers on timeline development 
  • Oversee project execution against timelines 
  • Manage small projects and support more senior Account Managers on larger projects  
  • Submit and manage regulatory submissions (Veeva, PAAB) and coordinate internally 
  • Quality control – proofread copy decks and layouts for additional review 
  • Basic analysis of client’s business results and competitive landscapes  
  • Recognizing scope change and knowing when to escalate  

 

 

What You’ll Need    

  • Related pharmaceutical/healthcare experience from agency, marketing and/or medical education account management experience, or relevant internships 
  • Interest in healthcare and pharmaceutical practices 
  • Excellent interpersonal skills 
  • Good organizational skills 
  • Proactive, can-do attitude to finding solutions. 
  • Be a team player who operates in a fast-paced setting 
  • Ability to listen, learn and add value 
  • The ability to work independently 
  • Strong attention to detail without losing the big picture 

 

How We’ll Support You 

Ogilvy Health celebrates its people. Fully. Enthusiastically. Unhesitatingly. We’ll empower you with the tools you’ll need to succeed. We’ll give you the autonomy to seek out new paths and better ways of doing things. We’ll support you with colleagues who are experts in their disciplines, drawn from across the Ogilvy network. And we’ll provide opportunities for you to do work of which you’ll be proud, with people you’ll be proud to call your teammates.  

 

Ogilvy Health Canada employees are encouraged to bring their ideas, experiences and perspectives, gleaned from their varied backgrounds, to the workplace.  We strive to create an environment in which all employees can feel comfortable to contribute to their fullest potential without regard to their race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.  

 

The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications.

Salary Range $39,750—$66,250 CAD

At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression. 

We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality. 

Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve.  This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.

Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please contact us at accommodations@ogilvy.com. Please note that this contact is only for candidates who are requesting accommodation. Emails for other purposes, including application status requests, will not receive a response.

job.description:

Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

 


About the Role  

We are looking for an experienced and driven Account Director to join our team and take ownership of a portfolio of high-profile, globally recognized clients. This is a role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, multi-disciplinary environment - someone who loves the craft of integrated storytelling just as much as they love the rigor of running a seamless account. 

You'll be working across 360 campaigns - from strategy and ideation through to production and performance - partnering with some of the best creative, strategy, and media minds in the industry. 

What You’ll Do 

Client Leadership 

  • Serve as the senior day-to-day lead across a portfolio of well-known brands, building deep, trusted relationships at senior client levels. 
  • Act as a strategic partner to clients - understanding their business objectives, challenges, and opportunities, and proactively bringing forward ideas and solutions. 
  • Lead and facilitate strategic briefings, presentations, and reviews, ensuring the agency's output consistently exceeds client expectations. 

Campaign & Project Management 

  • Oversee the end-to-end delivery of fully integrated 360 campaigns spanning brand, digital, social, content, experiential, and more. 
  • Manage and coordinate cross-functional internal teams (Creative, Strategy, Media, Production, Data) to ensure seamless project delivery- on time, on brief, and on budget. 
  • Maintain a clear view of all workstreams, proactively identifying risks and removing roadblocks before they impact delivery. 

Commercial Accountability 

  • Own the financial health of your accounts - managing scopes of work, budgets, forecasting, and billing with accuracy and confidence. 
  • Identify and pursue organic growth opportunities across existing clients, partnering with senior leadership to develop proposals and presentations. 
  • Maintain accurate revenue forecasting and contribute to the team's commercial targets. 

Team Development 

  • Lead, mentor, and develop more junior members of the account team (Account Supervisors, Account Executives), fostering a culture of excellence, curiosity, and accountability. 
  • Contribute to a positive, inclusive team environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated. 

 

Who You Are 

  • A natural relationship builder - you make clients feel confident, heard, and excited to collaborate. 
  • A champion of great work - you understand what makes creative ideas powerful and know how to protect and elevate them. 
  • Calm under pressure - you bring clarity and structure to complexity, and your team looks to you for direction. 
  • Commercially minded - you understand the business of advertising and can speak fluently about scopes, margins, and growth. 
  • A connector - you know how to bring together the right people at the right time to solve problems and unlock opportunities. 
  • Inclusive and collaborative - you lead with empathy, create space for others, and bring out the best in every team around you. 

 

What You'll Need 

  • 8+ years of experience in an integrated agency environment, with proven Account Director-level responsibility across multiple accounts or brands. 
  • A strong track record of delivering complex, multi-channel (360) campaigns - from brief through to final delivery. 
  • Experience managing senior client relationships across well-known, high-profile brands. 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills - written, verbal, and visual. 
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience managing budgets, scopes, and profitability. 
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously without sacrificing quality or attention to detail. 
  • Experience leading and developing junior talent. 
  • A passion for creativity, culture, and the ever-evolving marketing landscape. 

 

How We’ll Support You 

Ogilvy celebrates its people. Fully. Enthusiastically. Unhesitatingly. We’ll empower you with the tools you’ll need to succeed. We’ll give you the autonomy to seek out new paths and better ways of doing things. We’ll support you with colleagues who are experts in their disciplines, drawn from across the Ogilvy network. And we’ll provide opportunities for you to do work of which you’ll be proud, with people you’ll be proud to call your teammates.  

À propos du poste 

Nous recherchons un(e) Directeur(trice) de Comptes expérimenté(e) et motivé(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe et prendre en charge un portefeuille de clients prestigieux, reconnus à l'échelle mondiale. Ce poste s'adresse à une personne qui s'épanouit dans un environnement dynamique et pluridisciplinaire - quelqu'un qui aime autant l'art de la narration intégrée que la rigueur d'une gestion de compte sans faille. 

Vous interviendrez sur des campagnes 360° - de la stratégie et l'idéation jusqu'à la production et la performance - en collaborant avec certains des meilleurs esprits créatifs, stratégiques et médias de l'industrie. 

Vos missions 

Gestion de la relation client 

  • Assurer le rôle d'interlocuteur(trice) principal(e) au quotidien pour un portefeuille de marques reconnues, en établissant des relations de confiance solides avec les interlocuteurs clients de haut niveau. 
  • Agir en tant que partenaire stratégique pour les clients - comprendre leurs objectifs business, leurs défis et leurs opportunités, et proposer proactivement des idées et des solutions. 
  • Animer et piloter des séances de briefing stratégique, des présentations et des bilans, en veillant à ce que les livrables de l'agence dépassent systématiquement les attentes des clients. 

Gestion des campagnes et des projets 

  • Superviser la livraison de bout en bout de campagnes 360° pleinement intégrées, couvrant la marque, le digital, les réseaux sociaux, le contenu, l'expérientiel, et bien plus encore. 
  • Coordonner les équipes internes transversales (Création, Stratégie, Médias, Production, Data) afin de garantir une exécution fluide des projets - dans les délais, dans le respect du brief et du budget. 
  • Maintenir une vision claire de l'ensemble des flux de travail, en identifiant proactivement les risques et en levant les obstacles avant qu'ils n'impactent la livraison. 

Responsabilité commerciale 

  • Assurer la santé financière de vos comptes - en gérant les périmètres de mission, les budgets, les prévisions et la facturation avec précision et assurance. 
  • Identifier et saisir les opportunités de croissance organique auprès des clients existants, en collaborant avec la direction pour développer des propositions et des présentations. 
  • Maintenir des prévisions de revenus précises et contribuer aux objectifs commerciaux de l'équipe. 

Développement des équipes 

  • Encadrer, accompagner et faire évoluer les membres juniors de l'équipe comptes (Superviseurs de Compte, Chargés de Compte), en favorisant une culture d'excellence, de curiosité et de responsabilité. 
  • Contribuer à un environnement d'équipe positif et inclusif, où la diversité des perspectives est valorisée. 

 

Votre profil 

  • Un(e) bâtisseur(euse) de relations naturel(le) - vous donnez aux clients confiance, sentiment d'être écouté(e)s et envie de collaborer. 
  • Un(e) défenseur(e) du travail de qualité - vous comprenez ce qui rend les idées créatives percutantes et savez comment les protéger et les sublimer. 
  • Serein(e) sous pression - vous apportez clarté et structure face à la complexité, et votre équipe se tourne vers vous pour trouver une direction. 
  • Orienté(e) business - vous comprenez les enjeux économiques de la publicité et maîtrisez les notions de périmètres de mission, de marges et de croissance. 
  • Un(e) connecteur(trice) - vous savez réunir les bonnes personnes au bon moment pour résoudre des problèmes et saisir des opportunités. 
  • Inclusif(ve) et collaboratif(ve) - vous managez avec empathie, créez de l'espace pour les autres et faites ressortir le meilleur de chaque équipe. 

 

Ce dont vous aurez besoin 

  • 8 ans d'expérience minimum dans un environnement d'agence intégrée, avec une responsabilité avérée au niveau Directeur(trice) de Clientèle sur plusieurs comptes ou marques. 
  • Un solide bilan dans la livraison de campagnes complexes et multi-canaux (360°) - du brief jusqu'à la livraison finale. 
  • Une expérience dans la gestion de relations clients senior auprès de marques reconnues et à fort profil. 
  • D'excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation - à l'écrit, à l'oral et visuellement. 
  • Une forte acuité commerciale, incluant une expérience dans la gestion de budgets, de périmètres de mission et de rentabilité. 
  • La capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément sans sacrifier la qualité ni l'attention aux détails. 
  • Une expérience dans l'encadrement et le développement de talents juniors. 
  • Une passion pour la créativité, la culture et le paysage marketing en constante évolution. 

 

Comment nous vous soutiendrons 

Ogilvy célèbre ses collaborateurs. Pleinement. Avec enthousiasme. Sans réserve. Nous vous donnerons les outils dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir. Nous vous accorderons l'autonomie nécessaire pour explorer de nouvelles voies et trouver de meilleures façons de faire les choses. Nous vous entourerons de collègues experts dans leurs domaines respectifs, issus de l'ensemble du réseau Ogilvy. Et nous vous offrirons des opportunités de réaliser un travail dont vous serez fier(ère), aux côtés de personnes que vous serez fier(ère) d'appeler vos coéquipiers.

Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

 

Department: Advertising

Location: London 

Contract Type: Permanent

Full Time/Part time: Full Time 

Reporting into: Business Director

About Ogilvy 

Ogilvy UK has been creating iconic ideas that deliver impact at scale for clients ever since David Ogilvy founded the company in 1948. Ogilvy UK specialises in bringing together brand advertising, customer experience marketing, PR, influence and consulting, all fuelled by Behavioural Science. Our world-class award-winning creative campaigns deliver solutions for clients including Sainsbury’s, Argos, , Mondelēz International, Unilever, TK Maxx and Pernod Ricard.  

In 2023, Ogilvy UK celebrated their 75th anniversary and was the most awarded agency in Europe. Ogilvy is home to the largest influencer marketing practice globally, and hosts the world’s biggest festival of behavioural science and creativity, Nudgestock – now in its 12th year. 

The Role:  

An Account Executive provides the solid and essential foundations of the team. Keeping projects on track, fostering enduring and robust relationships with junior clients and internal agency team to make sure every detail is considered from briefing to final execution – you’re the glue that holds the internal team together. 

The ‘go to person’ for both Client and Agency when it comes to co-ordination, and a master of the little things that make all the difference.  

You’ll need to be switched on, full of energy, keen to learn and obsessed with great work. 

Key Responsibilities:  
 

  • Be the client and competitor expert – become the fountain of all knowledge on client mandatories and regulations, be on the lookout for information, articles and new work relating to the clients, the category or the competition 
  • Be the go-to for Junior clients – helping to maintain and strengthen relationships at that level  
  • Be opinionated about the creative – bring your own unique perspective on work to creative reviews, share creative you think is good/interesting with the team, offer ideas on how to work more effectively     
  • Be commercial - Work closely with finance team to ensure all day-to-day account and project finance is managed smoothly  
  • Be the main support for your team – be organised and proactive in thinking about how you can assist internal teams and clients to keep everything running smoothly and to set the right conditions for great work to thrive   
  • Be organised - Ensure guard books, client server files and brand guidelines are kept up to date; own client status meetings and reports – ensuring actions are met; attend meetings and capture notes and clear next steps; support on prepping creative presentations and sense check work with meticulous attention to detail.  
  • Be collaborative – develop great working relationships with all teams internally; support delivery by managing internal reviews & approvals, setting up projects and defining small scopes    
  • Be curious – get to know the craft of advertising, actively read industry press to develop your own sense of what good looks like, ask questions and actively seek out new learning opportunities   
  • Be an Operational Steward: As the team's operational linchpin, you drive daily operations, uphold processes, and maintain alignment for smooth project execution. You partner with the Project Director to develop scopes, fees, timings, and resource allocation, expertly setting up projects on platforms (e.g., Wrike, Workday), orchestrating kick-offs, and aligning internal stakeholders. 

 Key Skills:  

  • A meticulous eye for detail and a proactive, problem-solving mindset 
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to juggle multiple projects  
  • A collaborative approach – to enable you to work closely with creatives, strategists, producers, and clients to bring campaigns to life 
  • A natural communicator  
  • A love of brands, storytelling and creativity  

 

Benefits 

  • 25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day 
  • Bupa Healthcare
  • Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave
  • We have a Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm
  • A 1.5:1 Matching Pension Structure
  • Wellbeing and Health: Up to £25.00 per month towards physical or online exercise class membership, Unmind membership, LifeWorks tool and annual eye tests and development budgets and Wellbeing incentives and activities throughout the year 
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Life Assurance

OGILVY HEALTH: WE INSPIRE PEOPLE AND BRANDS TO IMPACT THE WORLD

Guided by this vision, Ogilvy Health, part of WPP, combines borderless creativity, scientific precision, cultural fluency, and AI-enabled capabilities to build healthcare's most influential movements. We believe the future belongs to those who can seamlessly blend human ingenuity with emerging technologies, using AI not simply as a tool, but as a catalyst for deeper insights, faster problem solving, and more impactful work. We drive measurable impact and category-defining growth for brands ready to shape what's next. Our approach is powered by fearless creativity that dares to be different, sparks emotional connections, and inspires action, ensuring cultural resonance. Scientific precision translates complex data into stories that resonate, while our impact-obsessed mindset focuses on delivering real-world outcomes.

For more information on us, visit OgilvyHealth.com, or follow Ogilvy Health on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and Threads.

About the Role 

As an Account Executive specializing in Paid Media Buying, Social Analytics, and Generative Impact, you will assist the technical and strategic processes across paid social and digital media activation, social listening, and emerging AI search visibility for leading healthcare and pharmaceutical clients.

This is not a traditional Account Management AE role—you will not be managing day-to-day project logistics, call agendas, or administrative client account management. Instead, your core focus is technical media buying, campaign trafficking, data analytics, social listening, and Ogilvy's proprietary Generative Impact (Generative Engine Optimization / GEO) offering.

What You’ll Do:

Paid Social & Digital Campaign Execution & Media Operations

  • Campaign Setup & Media Buying: Assist in building, launching, trafficking, and managing paid social media campaigns across self-serve ad platforms (e.g., Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, TikTok, Reddit, Pinterest, etc.) and support activation and coordination across digital media channels such as GOOH (Digital OOH), Programmatic, Search, Direct Partnership and Sponsorships.
  • Audience & Targeting Strategy: Assist in building and implementing compliant audience targeting parameters tailored to healthcare stakeholders (HCPs, patients, caregivers) in alignment with platform policy and healthcare privacy regulations.
  • Medical/Legal/Regulatory (MLR) Compliance: Ensure all paid social assets, ad copy, and targeting parameters comply with brand guidelines, platform policies, and FDA/MLR regulatory requirements.

Generative Impact & GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)

  • AI Search Visibility Tracking: Support Ogilvy’s Generative Impact offering by tracking, analyzing, and measuring brand visibility, sentiment, and share of voice across generative AI search engines and LLM platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews).
  • GEO Insight Generation: Identify prompt opportunities, content gaps, and source citation trends in AI-generated responses to help optimize healthcare brand discovery.
  • Search-Social Integration: Connect paid social strategy with GEO insights to ensure brand messaging is aligned across both social feeds and AI discovery platforms.

Social Intelligence, Analytics & Listening

  • Data Aggregation & Performance Reporting: Extract performance metrics across paid social campaigns and aggregate data to build weekly, monthly, and post-campaign analytical reporting decks.
  • Social Intelligence & Listening: Utilize enterprise social listening tools (e.g., Brandwatch, YouScan, Quid, Sprinklr) to monitor share of voice, emerging disease-state conversation trends, competitor paid activity, and audience sentiment.
  • Dashboard Management: Maintain and update client analytics dashboards and reporting templates to ensure data accuracy and real-time visibility into KPI performance.

Client Relations

  • Paid Media & Analytics Advisory: Interact directly with clients to answer technical questions regarding paid media execution, social listening findings, platform algorithm updates, and GEO trends.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with internal creative, strategy, media planning, and account management teams to optimize creative ad assets based on real-time performance data and social listening insights.

What You’ll Need:

  • Experience: 1–2 years hands on in paid social media execution, social listening, or marketing analytics—preferably within an advertising agency or healthcare/pharmaceutical environment.
  • Paid Social & Media: Direct experience trafficking campaigns inside self-serve ad platforms (Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, etc.).
  • Search: Hands on experience supporting paid search campaigns in Google Ads, including keyword research, campaign and ad group setup, ad trafficking and quality assurance, negative keyword management, budget pacing, bid and performance optimization, and reporting.  
  • Analytics, Listening & GEO: Familiarity with enterprise social listening/reporting platforms (e.g., Sprinklr, Brandwatch, YouScan, NetBase Quid, Google Analytics, advanced Excel/Google Sheets).
  • Strong interest in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI search platforms (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini), and prompt monitoring.
  • Self-motivation, strong organizational skills, attention to detail and excellent time management skills.
  • Healthcare Knowledge: Understanding of pharmaceutical/healthcare marketing, MLR review processes, and healthcare privacy/compliance guidelines is highly desirable.
  • AI Fluency: Demonstrated curiosity and proficiency in using generative AI and applicable emerging technologies. Ability to adapt to new tools and integrate AI responsibly into day-to-day work is expected.

How We’ll Support You 

Ogilvy celebrates its people. Fully. Enthusiastically. Unhesitatingly. We’ll empower you with the tools you’ll need to succeed. We’ll give you the autonomy to seek out new paths and better ways of doing things. We’ll support you with colleagues who are experts in their disciplines, drawn from across the Ogilvy network. And we’ll provide opportunities for you to do work of which you’ll be proud, with people you’ll be proud to call your teammates.

Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click here for more details.

Pay Range$45,000—$100,000 USD

At Ogilvy Health, we work with ambitious healthcare brands to create work that makes a meaningful difference.

We’re looking for an Account Manager to join us at an exciting time for one of our fast-growing global rare disease accounts. With a strong pipeline of work ahead, you’ll be joining a well-resourced, supportive team where there’s plenty of variety, visibility and opportunity to grow.

You’ll build your global healthcare experience, get involved in major campaign and congress work, and take real ownership of your projects, with an experienced team around you for support.

If you’re ready for your next step in healthcare communications and want a role where you can properly get stuck in, we’d love to hear from you.

 

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Managing multiple projects from brief through to delivery
  • Keeping timelines, priorities and stakeholders on track
  • Working closely with clients and internal teams to make things happen
  • Supporting the development and rollout of campaign materials
  • Getting involved in a broad range of promotional work, which could include e-details, patient profiles and objection-handling materials
  • Playing an important role in preparations for a major European congress next year
  • Building strong relationships and becoming a trusted day-to-day partner to your clients 

It’s a busy account with lots happening at once, so you’ll need to be someone who enjoys spinning a few plates, can work out what needs attention first and is comfortable taking ownership of your own projects.

What You’ll Need  

You’ll ideally already have experience within a healthcare communications agency, with an understanding of how pharmaceutical accounts and promotional work come together.

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • Healthcare communications agency experience
  • Experience working with Rx/pharmaceutical brands, ideally across global work
  • Exposure to creating and delivering different types of promotional materials
  • Confidence managing several projects and competing priorities at the same time
  • Strong client and team relationships
  • A proactive approach and the confidence to take ownership rather than waiting to be told what happens next

Congress experience would be useful, but it’s not essential. And if you’re currently a strong Senior Account Executive looking for your first Account Manager role, we’d absolutely be open to hearing from you.

About the Role

Ogilvy New York is searching for a Consulting Analyst to join our Consulting team.

As a Consulting Analyst, you'll work with consulting teams and business leaders to help clients address complex business, brand, and marketing challenges. You'll combine research, data analysis, strategic thinking, and creative problem-solving to uncover insights and develop actionable recommendations. You'll play an important role in structuring analyses, building compelling narratives and presentations, and supporting the delivery of high-quality consulting engagements. Working collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to a wide range of strategic projects across industries and clients.

What You'll Do

  • Work on qualitative and quantitative research to understand business challenges, market dynamics, competitive landscapes, consumer needs, and growth opportunities.
  • Analyze and synthesize information from multiple sources, including primary and secondary research, market reports, consumer insights, and business performance data, to identify meaningful insights.
  • Apply structured problem-solving and critical thinking to support the development of strategic recommendations for clients.
  • Translate research and analysis into clear, compelling narratives and presentations that communicate key findings, implications, and recommendations.
  • Develop high-quality PowerPoint presentations, including charts, frameworks, and visual storytelling, for internal discussions and client deliverables.
  • Support the development of brand, marketing, customer, and growth strategies, working closely with senior consultants and strategists.
  • Take ownership of assigned workstreams and deliverables, managing priorities, timelines, and quality while proactively communicating progress and potential challenges.
  • Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams, contributing ideas, participating in working sessions, and supporting the successful delivery of consulting projects.
  • Leverage analytical tools, research platforms, and emerging AI technologies to enhance efficiency, generate insights, and support strategic decision-making.
  • Participate in client meetings and workshops, helping prepare materials, document key discussions, and support follow-up actions.

What You'll Need

  • 1–3 years of experience in consulting, brand strategy, marketing strategy, consumer insights, market research, business analysis, or related fields.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to structure problems, interpret data, identify patterns, and develop meaningful insights.
  • Excellent storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear, compelling narratives and actionable recommendations.
  • Strong proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel, including the ability to develop professional presentations, charts, and analyses.
  • Good research skills, including experience gathering, evaluating, and synthesizing information from multiple sources.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments, prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and maintain attention to detail.
  • A collaborative mindset and strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams, disciplines, and levels of seniority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence in presenting ideas and contributing to team and client discussions.
  • Intellectual curiosity, creativity, and a proactive approach to problem-solving, with a willingness to learn and take initiative.
  • Comfort working with quantitative and qualitative data, using analytical tools and research methodologies to support strategic recommendations.
  • Familiarity with market research, consumer insights platforms, data visualization tools, and AI-enabled research and productivity tools is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Psychology, Communications, or a related field.

How We’ll Support You 

Ogilvy celebrates its people. Fully. Enthusiastically. Unhesitatingly. We’ll empower you with the tools you’ll need to succeed.
