About The Role: 

Ogilvy is looking for a highly organised and detail-oriented Content Producer to join its Digital Experience team on a fixed-term contract until May 2027, commencing ASAP.

In this role, you'll play an important part in bringing digital content to life across the website. Working closely with writers, designers and developers, you'll manage the publishing process from draft through to live, ensuring content is accurately formatted, optimised and ready for audiences.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working with digital content, has a strong understanding of website publishing and takes pride in keeping projects organised and moving forward.

  • Coordinate the end-to-end publishing process, taking content from draft through to publication across the website.
  • Build and format web pages within the CMS, including uploading and optimising images, applying metadata, tagging and schema markup.
  • Proofread and quality-check content to ensure accuracy and consistency before publishing.
  • Work closely with writers, editorial, newsletter, brand, design and development teams to keep content production moving.
  • Manage the publishing calendar and maintain visibility of content in progress, under review and ready to publish
  • Apply SEO and GEO best practices to published content, following recommendations from relevant workstreams
  • Support fast-turnaround content requirements for events and campaigns as priorities arise.
  • Troubleshoot CMS and publishing issues, working collaboratively with design and development teams to resolve them.

What You'll Bring:

  • Proven experience in content production and publishing, with hands-on experience using a CMS
  • Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals, with exposure to GEO and structured data for AI search is highly regarded
  • Experience with image optimisation, metadata and basic schema markup
  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple pieces of content and competing priorities
  • Strong attention to detail and proofreading skills
  • Confident communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with writers, designers and developers
  • Experience working within tourism, government or large content-heavy websites will be highly regarded.

If you're passionate about digital content and enjoy bringing great content to life online, we'd love to hear from you!

Ogilvy was founded in 1948 by David Ogilvy. David created a culture that deeply respects and cares about its people and clients. Our mission is to inspire people and brands to make an impact and we are committed to attracting, growing, and retaining the best talent in the industry. 

About the Role  

Marketers have never had so much data at their disposal - and they’ve never been more at a loss as to how to use it. This leads to lost opportunities at best, and ineffectual, brand-devaluing efforts at worst.

The Data & Effectiveness team helps make brands matter by leveraging the right data assets in the right way in order to make more inspired decisions for our brands. Better decisions means creating more effective work more consistently. It means learning from the past to be better at influencing the future. It means looking for data-backed evidence on how to drive better business results. And it means more value for the agency - now and in the long run.

For us to harness data, we need to understand what it means. Our Analysts arm our teams by arming them with that understanding and drawing useful implications that inspire the work.

What You’ll Do 

The Analyst’s core responsibility is to our teams are consistently equipped with the necessary evidence to inspire decisions for our clients.

WORK

  • Help strategy development by helping find evidence to test its effectiveness
  • Culling actionable insights from quantitative data sets by performing basic structured analysis
  • Support in Creative development by spotting insights that can be used as a jump-off point
  • Identifying the right KPIs and performance benchmarks for communication efforts
  • Ensuring that analysis reports contain useful insights that can help improve performance

BUSINESS

  • Maintain existing client relationships by delivering work that meets agreed quality standards

TEAM

  • Support more senior Analysts in running day-to-day operations 

ADVANCEMENT

  • Stay updated on the data & analytics landscape

What You’ll Need  

  • 1-2 years experience in an Analytics post inside a Creative or Media agency; graduate of Statistics- or Engineering-leaning courses a plus
  • Have a working knowledge of Digital Analytics tools ( e.g. Google Analytics, native social analytics, social listening)
  • Have a working knowledge of paid and performance media
  • Basic interpretation skills for both quantitative and qualitative data
  • Basic data visualisation and report preparation
  • Basic knowledge of research and measurement methods
  • An understanding of fundamental communication and business principles

How We’ll Support You 

Ogilvy celebrates its people. Fully. Enthusiastically. Unhesitatingly. We’ll empower you with the tools you’ll need to succeed. We’ll give you the autonomy to seek out new paths and better ways of doing things. We’ll support you with colleagues who are experts in their disciplines, drawn from across the Ogilvy network. We're looking for a talented Digital Designer to join our creative team at Ogilvy, bringing campaigns to life across a range of digital channels and customer touchpoints.

Working across an exciting mix of campaigns and platforms, you'll translate creative concepts and brand assets into engaging digital experiences, ensuring work is visually compelling, consistent and effective wherever audiences interact with it.

You'll collaborate closely with creative, campaign and digital teams, bringing fresh ideas, strong design craft and a proactive approach to every brief. This is a great opportunity for a versatile designer who loves exploring creative possibilities and making work come to life across multiple formats.

What You'll Do: 

  • Bringing campaign concepts to life through engaging digital creative across paid media, social, email, websites, digital signage and partner channels
  • Adapting and extending creative assets across multiple formats and platforms, ensuring consistency throughout the customer journey
  • Working closely with campaign leads, creatives and digital specialists to understand objectives and develop effective design solutions
  • Proactively contributing ideas, exploring creative approaches and recommending ways to strengthen campaign expression

  • Working across email marketing and customer engagement platforms, considering their specific creative and technical requirements

  • Keeping up with emerging digital trends, formats and technologies to continually push the quality of our work

  • A strong portfolio showcasing your digital design capabilities across a variety of channels and formats
  • At least 5 years' relevant design experience, ideally with a focus on digital marketing and multi-channel creative
  • Strong visual design skills, with an excellent eye for typography, layout, composition and detail
  • Experience designing for digital advertising, social media, email marketing and websites
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign
  • Experience with Figma, After Effects and email marketing or customer engagement platforms will be highly regarded
  • A proactive, solutions-focused mindset, with the confidence to contribute ideas and explore creative possibilities beyond the brief
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across creative, marketing and digital teams

Ogilvy was founded in 1948 by David Ogilvy. David created a culture that deeply respects and cares about its people and clients. Our mission is to inspire people and brands to make an impact and we are committed to attracting, growing, and retaining the best talent in the industry. 

About the Role  

A Designer should have an good grasp of visual design behavior and craftsmanship. The Designer is a critical player in bringing master campaigns to life across the final touchpoints of the consumer journey. They should have a solid grasp of visual design behavior, craftsmanship, and proficiency in mainstream design software. The successful candidate will be fully embedded with our client's team and will be on-site at client’s office thrice a week. You will act as Ogilvy’s on-the-ground creative ambassador, handling high-volume adaptation and shopper design requirements directly aligned with the client's daily operational needs, while remaining a core part of Team Ogilvy/WPP. A Designer in this role focuses heavily on the adaptation and rollout of visual design outputs, specializing in Shopper Marketing, Point-of-Sale Materials (POSM), e-commerce assets, and localized brand cascades. The ideal person is highly detail-oriented, possesses a strong sense of collaboration, and understands crucial brand standards required to maintain a consistent design aesthetic. He/she must be able to multitask various adaptation projects and formats while maintaining a gold-standard quality of output. Experience in shopper marketing is a strong advantage, but a rigorous eye for design adaptation is the primary requirement.

What You’ll Do 

Brand Execution & Guardianship

  • Deeply understand the Client's brand guidelines, visual identity, and specific layout requirements.
  • Act as a meticulous guardian of brand consistency when adapting global or regional toolkits for local use or specific retail channels.

Brief Comprehension & Application

  • Thoroughly read and understand daily creative briefs, specifically looking out for shopper path-to-purchase and channel-specific requirements (retail, e-commerce, digital).
  • Understand the technical specifications, structural realities, and limitations of the formats being designed (e.g., printed POSM vs. digital banners).

Design & Adaptation Craft

  • Under the guidance of senior creatives and client stakeholders, adapt and produce high-quality materials, translating master Key Visuals (KVs) into various formats, sizes, and specs.
  • Complete the daily design and adaptation work independently, accurately, and at speed in an embedded environment.
  • Demonstrate strong time management skills to handle high-volume adaptations and meet tight client deadlines.
  • Maintain strict attention to detail in typography, color-matching, layout adjustments, and image resizing.
  • Note: Prior experience in Shopper Marketing (understanding retail environments, gondolas, endcaps, shelf-talkers) is a plus, but a willingness to learn is required.

Collaboration & Professionalism

  • Be passionate about design craft; take pride in ensuring even the smallest adaptations meet both the client's expectations and the Ogilvy standard of excellence.
  • Collaborate seamlessly with Final Art/DTP and production teams (both agency and client-side) to ensure files are print-ready and technically sound.
  • Manage stress and prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.
  • Be a professional ambassador for Ogilvy/Team WPP while on-site—be humble, respectful, and communicative to create a highly functional working environment.
  • Abide by the WPP Code of Business Conduct.

What You’ll Need  

  • Experience: At least 2 years of professional experience in graphic design or creative production, preferably within an advertising agency, in-house design team, or printing studio.
  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced skills in industry-standard design software (Adobe Creative Cloud: Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign). Familiarity with 3D rendering basics or structural design for POSM is a strong advantage.
  • Production Knowledge: A solid understanding of print production processes, including setting up files with correct bleed, die-lines, CMYK vs. RGB color spaces, and resolution limits.
  • Portfolio Strength: A portfolio demonstrating a meticulous eye for detail, strong typography, layout skills, and specific examples of multi-channel campaign rollouts or format adaptations.
  • Agility & Temperament: Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Must be highly organized, capable of multitasking, and comfortable receiving direct, real-time feedback from the client.

Lead a highly skilled team of social and influence specialists across the Ogilvy Network in ANZ and deliver effective and award-winning social-first strategies for the world’s most successful brands.  

Are you a proven leader in social-first creativity who wants to elevate your career at one of the most successful creative networks?

We are on the hunt for a new Head of Social to inspire an established and specialised team of social strategists, social creatives, advocacy, orchestration, and analytics experts.   

ABOUT THE ROLE: 

In this role, you’ll be responsible for evolving our end-to-end social offering from organic and culture-first social through to business influence and social commerce.  

You’ll play a key role in the realisation of our strategic and creative process as we deliver a truly integrated, social-first and earned-first approach to clients and prospects. You’ll relish the challenge of competing head-to-head with pure play social agencies and developing social-first strategies as the basis for culturally impactful and integrated brand campaigns. 

Working with senior stakeholders across the business, you’ll be responsible for shaping and growing a best-in-class social offering and driving impact with existing and new clients. You'll have the opportunity to shape the role that our clients play in culture, leveraging our proprietary tech stack, deep creative talent pool and proven methodologies.  

The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of culture-first brand strategy, a passion for creative excellence in social and the ability to consult with clients across the full spectrum of social media.  

You’ll be an empathic leader and a highly effective collaborator who drives growth by enabling those around you to deliver the best work of their careers. This role presents a unique opportunity for an established social leader to develop their career on one of the biggest agency stages in Australia and New Zealand with the support of the wider regional and global leadership team.  

With social and influencer marketing firmly on the radar of CMOs and marketers in Australia and New Zealand, there’s never been a better time to take your career in social media to the next level with Ogilvy.      

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Consulting

  • Lead the development and execution of social-first brand strategies that drive cultural relevance and business impact for consumer, corporate, public sector and health clients  
  • Play a lead role in the development of distinctive social strategies for our major clients with a focus on brand building and meaningful cultural impact 
  • Develop social-first creative briefs and guide creative teams through ideation and execution  
  • Manage senior client relationships and serve as strategic advisor on social brand building and drive integration of social strategy across broader marketing and communications programs 

Product & Growth 

  • Lead and evolve the four product offers – commerce, paid, organic and influence – and develop integrated strategies and campaigns that weave specialist teams together 
  • Manage and extend a best-in-class cultural and social listening program to identify reactive and strategic opportunities for brands  
  • Oversee the day-to-day operation of an agile content production engine and collaborate with specialists across the network to deliver high-performing and innovative content-led campaigns   
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities through the development of innovative social solutions and product offerings  
  • Join the APAC social media community and partner with colleagues across the region on multi-market client campaigns and regional new business opportunities   
  • Play a lead role in the development of thought leadership initiatives and represent the agency at industry events and in external communications 

Leadership & Operations:

  • Set the direction and growth strategy for Ogilvy’s social and influence offering, working in partnership with the Group Managing Director for PR, Social and Influence and ECD  
  • Build and mentor a team of social specialists, setting performance standards, team values and vision and driving professional development 
  • Inspire and grow the social leadership team within the agency, including strategy and creative specialists, working in partnership with the Head of Influence  
  • Create an unstoppable team culture and ambition and optimise the processes, operations and platforms that we need to deliver effectively, resulting in profitable growth 
  • Manage department P&L, including budget planning, resource allocation, and revenue forecasting  

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • You have 10+ years of experience in social media strategy and/or a GAD or agency leadership role, with a proven track record of building brands through culture-first strategy and platform-first thinking  
  • You're deeply versed in the social media landscape, with hands-on experience developing strategies across established and emerging platforms 
  • You have a natural talent for spotting cultural trends before they peak and can translate these insights into compelling brand opportunities  
  • You've successfully led and grown social teams, with experience mentoring strategists, creatives, community management and analysts, fostering a culture of innovation  
  • You have strong commercial acumen, having managed significant client budgets and department P&Ls in an agency environment  
  • You're an accomplished presenter and relationship builder, comfortable advising C-suite clients on social strategy and brand building  
  • You bring a data-driven approach to strategy, with experience in brand strategy, social listening, performance analysis, and insight development  
  • You have a portfolio of award-winning social campaigns that demonstrate your ability to drive both cultural impact and business results  
  • You've developed and sold innovative social products and services, with a track record of driving agency growth  
  • You're recognised in the industry for your thought leadership, regularly speaking at events and contributing to the broader social media discourse 

WHY YOU'LL LOVE OGILVY:

  • Global opportunities – Access career pathways, projects and connections across the Ogilvy and WPP network.
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave – Gender-neutral leave for all parents and caregivers.
  • Leading AI tools – Exclusive access to WPP Open, our global AI platform.
  • Inclusive culture – A workplace where everyone can belong and thrive.
  • Career development – Personalised growth plans, coaching and ongoing learning opportunities.
  • Extra time off – Birthday leave, Summer Fridays and loyalty leave.
  • Wellbeing support – Health and fitness discounts, wellbeing programs and mindfulness resources.
  • Employee Assistance Program – Free, confidential counselling support.
  • Recognition and rewards – Celebrating great work and long-term contribution.
  • Referral bonuses – Earn rewards for introducing great talent.
  • Exclusive discounts – Savings on major brands through perkSPACE.

At Ogilvy, inclusivity is essential to our success. We're committed to building a workplace that embraces various perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds, knowing that diverse teams drive more impactful work. 

We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, Māori, people with disabilities, diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds, all ages, genders, sexual orientations, gender identities and expressions, nationalities, and family structures. 

We believe everyone thrives when they can be themselves. We provide equal opportunities and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to reach their full potential.

Sobre Ogilvy

Ogilvy fue fundada en 1948 por David Ogilvy. David creó una cultura que respeta y se preocupa profundamente por su gente y sus clientes. Nuestra misión es inspirar a personas y marcas para generar un impacto, y nos comprometemos a atraer, desarrollar y retener el mejor talento de la industria.

Sobre el puesto

Buscamos un/a Influence Strategist para liderar la visión estratégica dentro de nuestro equipo de Influence Marketing, un área transversal clave que da soporte y consultoría a toda la agencia.

Siendo el foco el diseño estratégico, la conceptualización y la supervisión cualitativa de los proyectos. Liderarás la estrategia de influencia para concursos de nuevo negocio (pitches), campañas puntuales y estrategias anuales de clientes consolidados. Buscamos un perfil con una mirada 360°, creativa y analítica, capaz de integrar de forma natural el Influencer Marketing en el ecosistema digital y garantizar la excelencia estratégica en cada propuesta.

Principales responsabilidades:

  • Dirección Estratégica 360°: Diseñar marcos y estrategias de influencia de alto nivel que se integren coherentemente con los planes de PR, social media, medios pagados y activaciones de marca.
  • Propuestas de nuevo negocio: Idear y liderar la propuesta estratégica de influencia en pitches y concursos clave para la captación de nuevas cuentas.
  • Estrategias Anuales y Proyectos Clave: Desarrollar hojas de ruta estratégicas anuales (always-on) y marcos conceptuales para proyectos especiales de gran envergadura.
  • Supervisión y Validación de Castings: Definir los criterios estratégicos de selección (perfiles, afinidad, brand safety, representatividad) y supervisar/validar las propuestas de perfiles elaboradas por los equipos operativos o agencias colaboradoras.
  • Ideación Creativa: Generar conceptos, narrativas y dinámicas innovadoras de la mano del equipo creativo que sirvan de guía para que los creadores desarrollen contenidos alineados con los objetivos de marca.
  • Supervisión de Calidad y Regulación: Garantizar que las activaciones respeten la estrategia definida y cumplan rigurosamente la normativa legal vigente sobre publicidad de influencers y transparencia.
  • Frameworks de Medición & Análisis: Definir los KPIs y modelos de atribución/impacto; supervisar los informes de resultados para extraer aprendizajes e insights estratégicos para los clientes.
  • Rol Consultor Transversal: Asesorar y actuar como referente estratégico de influencia para los directores de cuentas, directores creativos y equipos de PR de la agencia.
  • Tendencias & Innovación: Identificar tendencias emergentes en la creator economy y plataformas para traducirlas en oportunidades estratégicas para nuestros clientes.

Requisitos:

  • Experiencia: Entre 3 y 5 años en roles estratégicos de Influencer Marketing, Estrategia Digital o PR Estratégico en agencia.
  • Pensamiento 360° (PR + IM): Capacidad probada para conectar la disciplina de influencia con la narrativa corporativa/de marca y las Relaciones Públicas.
  • Enfoque analítico y creativo: Capacidad para traducir datos, métricas y herramientas del sector en conceptos creativos e historias con impacto de negocio.
  • Capacidad de supervisión: Criterio sólido para evaluar propuestas, validar selecciones de talento y asegurar la calidad sin necesidad de involucrarse en la gestión operativa del día a día.
  • Conocimiento normativo y de plataformas: Dominio de las plataformas sociales y pleno conocimiento de la regulación y códigos de autorregulación publicitaria aplicables a creadores de contenido.
  • Competencias personales:
    •    Autonomía y rigor: Habilidad para liderar proyectos estratégicos con criterio propio y de forma resolutiva.
    •    Flexibilidad: Adaptabilidad para saltar de un sector a otro (FMCG, belleza, tech, lifestyle, etc.) y gestionar distintos ritmos de trabajo.
    •    Trabajo en equipo y comunicación: Excelentes dotes de presentación ante clientes y facilidad para colaborar de forma transversal con diferentes equipos.
    •    Idiomas: Español nativo/bilingüe e Inglés fluido (C1).

¿Qué ofrecemos?

  • Rol 100% estratégico con gran impacto en el crecimiento y nuevo negocio de la agencia.
  • Entorno multidisciplinar, creativo y en constante evolución.
  • Trabajo transversal con marcas y clientes líderes de diversas industrias.
  • Modelo de trabajo flexible.
  • Horario de lunes a jueves de 09:00 a 18:00 con una hora para comer, y los viernes de 09:00 a 15:00. Durante julio y agosto, el horario de trabajo será de 09:00 a 15:00.
  • Ubicación: Calle Ríos Rosas, 26, 28003 Madrid.

 

How We’ll Support You 

Ogilvy celebrates its people. Fully. Enthusiastically. Unhesitatingly. We’ll empower you with the tools you’ll need to succeed. We’ll give you the autonomy to seek out new paths and better ways of doing things. We’ll support you with colleagues who are experts in their disciplines, drawn from across the Ogilvy network. Szukamy zorganizowanej osoby ze świetnym wyczuciem internetu i social mediów, która dołączy do naszego zespołu. Będziesz na co dzień pracować przy naszych kluczowych klientach, łącząc świat influencerów, tworzenia contentu i eventów. 

Nie musisz znać wszystkich procesów agencyjnych od pierwszego dnia - wszystkiego Cię nauczymy! Szukamy kogoś, kto ma naturalną zajawkę na SoMe i trendy, a jednocześnie potrafi skrupulatnie dopiąć formalności, harmonogramy i umowy. 

Twój zakres obowiązków: 

  • Research twórców (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube), weryfikacja ich profilu, sprawdzanie ewentualnych ryzyk i przygotowywanie rekomendacji pod kampanie. 
  • Kontakt z twórcami i ich agencjami, briefowanie, zbieranie materiałów oraz pilnowanie terminów publikacji.
  • Przygotowywanie umów z twórcami, wprowadzanie dostawców do systemów, pilnowanie rozliczeń, faktur i rachunków. 
  • Wsparcie działań PR i biura prasowego – tworzenie komunikatów prasowych, dystrybucja i stały kontakt z mediami 
  • Codzienna współpraca z domem mediowym  -przekazywanie materiałów influencerskich do płatnego promowania zgodnie z harmonogramem. 
  • Wsparcie przy realizacji materiałów na kanały marki. 
  • Pomoc przy organizacji eventów i akcji specjalnych. 
  • Przygotowywanie podsumowań, zestawień i prezentacji kampanii - w dużej mierze w języku angielskim. 

Nasze wymagania: 

  • Świetna organizacja pracy i dokładność: potrafisz zaplanować swoją pracę, dbasz o detale, pamiętasz o formalnościach i terminach bez konieczności stałego przypominania. 
  • Aktywnie korzystasz z TikToka, Instagrama i YouTube'a, wiesz, co jest teraz w trendach, kto jest na fali, a kogo lepiej unikać ze względu na kontrowersje. 
  • Bardzo dobry język angielski (min. B2/C1): będziesz go używać na co dzień przy tworzeniu prezentacji, raportów, rekomendacji oraz w stałej (mailowej) komunikacji z klientem.  
  • Łatwość w nawiązywaniu relacji - u nas każdy członek zespołu ma bezpośredni, partnerski kontakt z klientem, twórcami i dostawcami. 

Mile widziane (duży plus!): 

  • Doświadczenie (nawet stażowe) w agencji PR, digital lub influencer marketingu. 
  • Zmysł wizualny i podstawowa umiejętność montażu wideo na telefonie (np. CapCut, Canva). 

Czego możesz spodziewać się po tym stanowisku? 

  • Świetny projekt na start w branży: rzadka okazja, by w ramach jednego klienta spróbować wszystkiego - od influencer marketingu, przez social media, po PR korporacyjny/produktowy i eventy. 
  • Wyjątkowa kultura i relacja z klientem: projekt, w którym Twoje kreatywne pomysły naprawdę mają szansę na realizację. 
  • Praca z topowymi twórcami: możliwość bezpośredniej współpracy z influencerami, których być może sam(a) na co dzień obserwujesz w sieci. 
  • Pełne wdrożenie i mentoring: trafiasz do zgranego, wspierającego zespołu, który krok po kroku nauczy Cię procesów agencyjnych. 

Benefity: 

  • Dostęp do platform edukacyjnych i rozwoju: szkolenia, webinary oraz narzędzia globalnej sieci agencji (w tym innowacyjne narzędzia AI wspierające codzienną pracę). 
  • Prywatna opieka medyczna o podwyższonym standardzie oraz dofinansowanie do karty sportowej. 
  • Elastyczność i wygoda: model hybrydowy (min. 2 dni z biura, reszta z domu) w nowoczesnej przestrzeni w Centrum Praskim Koneser. 

     

    _______________________________________________________

     

Poniżej podajemy orientacyjny zakres wynagrodzenia brutto na tym stanowisku w momencie publikacji ogłoszenia. Przedział ten odzwierciedla ramy wynagrodzeń obowiązujące w całej naszej globalnej grupie, obejmujące różnorodne Agencje i specjalizacje. W przypadku tej konkretnej roli, nasza propozycja wynagrodzenia zostanie ustalona w ramach wskazanego zakresu, w oparciu o nasze wewnętrzne wytyczne oraz z uwzględnieniem specyficznych warunków rynkowych dla naszej specjalizacji. Ostateczna wysokość indywidualnego wynagrodzenia zależy od wielu czynników związanych z danym stanowiskiem, m.in.: bieżących potrzeb biznesowych, posiadanego doświadczenia, poziomu odpowiedzialności oraz kwalifikacji.

Department: People team

Location: London/hybrid

Contract type: 6 month Fixed-term contract 

Full Time/Part time: Full Time 

Reporting into: Chief People Officer

About the Role 

Are you passionate about people? Do you thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment? Are you excited about championing diversity and inclusivity in the workplace? If you answered yes to these questions, then we have the perfect opportunity for you!

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced HR Advisor to join our team at the world's leading creative advertising agency. As an HR Advisor, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for providing HR advice and support to our employees across the organisation. You will play a critical role in helping us to, develop, and retain top talent while ensuring that our employees have the support and resources they need to excel in their roles.

As an HR Advisor, you will work closely with our People Partner’s to develop and implement HR strategies, policies, and programs that promote a positive and inclusive workplace culture. You will have the opportunity to partner with our business leaders to provide guidance on a wide range of HR issues, including employee relations, performance management, and talent development.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide HR advice and support to all employees across the organization.
  • Partner with business leaders to identify talent development needs and design and implement strategies to support employee growth and development.
  • Act as a key point of contact for all employee relations matters, ensuring that all concerns are addressed with respect and empathy.
  • Lead and support the performance management process, ensuring that employees receive regular feedback and support to achieve their goals.
  • Develop and deliver training programs on HR policies and procedures, ensuring that all employees have a clear understanding of their rights and responsibilities.
  • Support the recruitment and selection process, ensuring that all candidates are evaluated fairly and without bias.
  • Maintain accurate HR records and ensure that all data is managed in accordance with relevant legislation and best practice.
  • Participate in employee engagement initiatives, ensuring that all employees have a voice and that their feedback is valued and acted upon.

Department: People team

Contract type: 6 month Fixed-term contract

Full Time/Part time: Full Time

Reporting into: Chief People Officer

 

The Role:

We are seeking an experienced and commercially astute People Partner to join our People team in our world-leading creative agency. As a strategic business leader, you will own the employee experience and people-related outcomes for a defined part of our business, acting as a primary "Experience Account Manager." You will orchestrate HR products and services to solve real business problems and drive significant change, directly impacting engagement, performance, capability, and retention for your "account" areas.

This role requires a proactive, data-driven individual who can act as a credible 'thinking partner' to senior leaders, translating business strategy into impactful people plans and ensuring Ogilvy remains an employer of choice. You will be instrumental in driving organisational change and transformation, shaping the people narrative, and leveraging HR as a critical toolkit to achieve commercial success and foster our Borderless Creativity culture.

 

Responsibilities:

  1. Strategic Leadership Advisory & Development:
  • Act as a primary "thinking partner" to senior business leaders, providing expert counsel and strategic challenge on people, culture, performance, and organisational risk.
  • Proactively work with leadership to achieve commercial goals, business strategy, and desired culture, using data from 360-degree feedback, engagement surveys, performance reviews, and attrition analysis.
  • Treat your business areas as your "clients," understanding their unique needs and delivering tailored people solutions.
  • Develop and implement strategic people plans aligned with business objectives, driving outcomes such as improved engagement, performance, capability uplift, and retention within your business areas.

 

  1. Organisational Change & Transformation:
  • Partner with your business for significant business initiatives, including restructurings, acquisitions, integrations, and new growth areas, framing the people, culture, and capability implications.
  • Lead organisational design and workforce planning conversations, developing scenario models for structures, critical roles, skills, and future talent needs.
  • Work in Partnerships with centralised Centres of Excellence and HR Operations to ensure effective end to end HR service.
  • Identify and mitigate risks such as culture challenges, leadership bottlenecks, key person dependencies, employee relations and burnout.

 

  1. Planning, Design & Delivery (Product & Portfolio Mindset):
  • Clarify and diagnose critical business problems (e.g., growth, margin, productivity, churn) that can be addressed through people solutions.
  • Partner with specialist HR Centres of Excellence (L&D, TA, Reward, People & Culture and People Operations), acting as the voice of the business leader and employee into the wider People team.
  • Continually look for ways to improve approach/ ways of working to managing ongoing "BAU" People needs (e.g., hiring processes, manager support, benefits, etc), ensuring efficiency and freeing up capacity for truly strategic initiatives. 

 

  1. Commercial & Financial Acumen:
  • Understand the commercial context of your business areas and link HR initiatives directly to business value drivers (e.g., margin improvement, revenue growth, productivity gains, risk reduction).
  • Collaborate closely with finance teams to manage HR-related budgets, analyse data, and ensure people investments deliver clear ROI.
  • Contribute to workforce planning initiatives, assessing staffing needs, developing strategies for talent retention, and succession planning.
  • Lead talent management activities, ensuring robust succession planning, critical role identification, and proactive development pathways.

 

  1. Employee Engagement & Experience:
  • Own and drive initiatives that promote a positive, inclusive work culture and enhance employee engagement across your business areas.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and provide guidance to managers and employees on various HR-related matters, including performance management, employee relations, and career development.
  • Facilitate feedback channels, interpret engagement survey results, and lead the creation and implementation of action plans.
  • Ensure compliance with employment legislation and regulations in the UK, providing clear guidance to managers and employees.

 

Please note that these responsibilities are not exhaustive and may vary depending on the specific needs and priorities of the business. 

 

Key Skills & Experienced Required:

  • Commercial and Financial Literacy: Proven ability to understand P&Ls, budgets, value drivers, and business models. Able to credibly discuss margin, revenue, productivity, risk, and growth strategy with senior leaders.
  • Strategic HR Experience: Significant proven experience as a People Partner in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, ideally within a creative agency or similar industry, and have experience of working within a centralised HR model. Demonstrable track record of owning outcomes and driving business impact through people strategy.
  • Leadership, Coaching & Consulting Skills: Credible peer to senior leaders; able to challenge and support effectively. Highly skilled at framing complex problems, contracting work, and delivering difficult feedback constructively.
  • Change, Communications & Storytelling: Expertise in leading organisational change initiatives. Able to craft compelling narratives, gain leadership buy-in, and understand both behavioural and process change.
  • Data & Insight Fluency: Strong analytical skills with a data-driven mindset. Proficient in using people and business data for diagnosis, prioritisation, and building simple, sharp insight packs for leaders. Experience with HR analytics and metrics to inform decision-making.
  • Organisational Design & Development: Demonstrated knowledge and experience in leading org design, workforce planning, and talent management (succession, critical roles, development).
  • Stakeholder Management: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively build trust and influence stakeholders at all levels, including external partners.
  • Technical HR Expertise: CIPD certification (Level 7 preferred). Strong understanding of HR best practices, employment legislation, and regulations in the United Kingdom. Experience with HRIS (Workday implementation experience is a plus).
  • Resilience & Adaptability: Proven ability to thrive in a complex, ambiguous, and continuously evolving environment, managing multiple priorities and driving continuous improvement.

 

Benefits 

  • 25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day 
  • Bupa Healthcare
  • Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave
  • We have a Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm
  • A 1.5:1 Matching Pension Structure
  • Wellbeing and Health: Up to £25.00 per month towards physical or online exercise class membership, Unmind membership, LifeWorks tool and annual eye tests and development budgets and Wellbeing incentives and activities throughout the year

job.title: Supervisor Tax
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Tax Supervisor is responsible for performing activities related to activities related to Indirect Tax & Statutory compliance procedures for Good and Service tax (GST), Withholding Tax and Corporate Income tax across multiple entities of the Group.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Calculation, filing preparation and remittance - GST, TDS/ Withholding tax
  • Ensuring all Monthly/Annual returns in Form GSTR 1, GSTR 3B, GSTR 6 (ISD) and GSTR 9 and 9C are filed within the due dates
  • Preparation of outward GL and outward report working file. Reconciliation of such working files i.e. Outward report and Output liability GL accounts
  • Preparation of inward GL and inward report working file. Reconciliation of such working files i.e. Inward report and inward GL accounts
  • Discussions with relevant teams in case of differences between outward register and the IRN portal data
  • Review of errors/ observations for outward and inward transactions
  • Co-ordination and discussions with agencies and relevant SSC teams for resolving the errors/ observations
  • Review of ITC matching files which includes the following –
    • Review of split-booking transactions
    • Review of invoices for resolving the transactions with document number mismatch and document date mismatch
  • Preparation of dashboard workings to ensure that the liability is discharged correctly in the monthly return
  • Review of 180 days deferment report shared by EY along with the interest workings
  • Timely payments to tax bank accounts and vendor related TDS payments processing
  • Support team members and Senior team members with audits – GST, client’s audit.
  • Prepare/ Review Vendor and Employee quarterly e-TDS processing and monthly remittances
  • Support Local Finance in Tax compliance documentation as required.
  • Liaise with tax consultant on ongoing matters such as Show Cause Notice, hearings with department, etc.
  • Review Corporate Income Tax calculation.
  • Review documentation prepared for filing of withholding tax
  • Prepare agencies with supporting documentation as per the local tax & statutory requirements
  • Prepare annual financial statements
  • Review Withholding tax calculation and filing preparation
  • Review 26AS Income tax provision, filing, and remittance
  • Income tax assessment and audit
  • Calculate roll forward of deferred income taxes and accrued income taxes payable
  • Estimate annual effective tax rate calculation
  • Ensure timely preparation of Other IPG Tax Reporting Schedules
  • Perform transfer pricing audit and assessment reconciliation
  • Update and send for TL review Month/Quarter end Tax compliance check list.

Other activities:

  • Resolve Agency Local Finance queries within defined timelines by meeting SLAs agreed
  • Assist client and external audit process when necessary
  • Supervising activities within process
  • Assisting Team Leads in productivity and work load management for their respective areas
  • Supporting TLs in Leave and Attendance management for their respective areas
  • Cross training activities
  • Act as Subject matter experts within the team.

EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

Essential

  • 5-8 years of work experience in a similar role
  • Experience in Advertising and Media industry preferred
  • Minimum Education Qualification – B. com/M. com with Chartered Accountant or other equivalent post qualification
  • Management of a high transaction volumes business, with good knowledge of associated controls and procedures
  • Knowledge of statutory requirements in relation to Tax & Compliance
  • Ability to provide high level of customer service for the R2R process
  • Strong written and oral communications skills in English
  • Strong problem solving, team management and organizational skills
  • Experience in managing people and processes through a sustained period of change
  • Excellent computer skills and competency in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook)
  • Experience in Tax compliance tools, AI and Automation tools, S4 HANA, MS Dynamics or similar ERP systems

A distinct advantage:

  • Experience working in a Shared Services Centre focused on Finance & Accounting activities
  • Experience in document imaging software like SharePoint
  • Good knowledge of working with Government Portal and integrating with ERP.

job.title: 403g Broadcast Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

  Overview and Responsibilities:   Paramount Tech is hiring a 403g Broadcast Maintenance Technician to support engineering maintenance and technical operations for the CBS Network and affiliated production units. This role offers essential support around the clock for broadcast systems that are on-air and in production. It involves setting up, monitoring, and solving problems related to complex technical systems.   We use several systems. These include SDI and ST 2110 IP video routers. We also have channel playout systems, high-speed Ethernet fabrics (25–200GbE), and structured fiber optic cabling. In addition, we utilize media storage and transfer platforms, switchers, and both satellite and terrestrial contribution and distribution systems. Our on-air graphics and internet/cloud streaming encoding systems are included as well.     Basic Qualifications:  
  • 3+ years of engineering support and troubleshooting experience in broadcast environments, including one or more of the following:
  • On-air playout in broadcast and/or streaming environments
  • Live broadcast control room operations, preferably in sports or live entertainment
  • Transmission operations supporting real-time monitoring and distribution across multiple delivery paths
  • Expert-level knowledge of SMPTE ST 2110 IP video infrastructure, including uncompressed video (ST 2110-20), audio (ST 2110-30), and ancillary data (ST 2110-40) flows, with solid comprehension of PTP-based timing and synchronization
  • Proficiency with broadcast test and measurement equipment (waveform monitors, vectorscopes, rasterizers, signal analyzers) for validating video/audio integrity across SDI and IP signal paths
  • You need to know about broadcast network design principles for high-bandwidth, uncompressed video. This includes redundancy models such as dual fabric and hitless switching. It is also important to understand multicast design and how to manage essence flow bandwidth.
  Additional Qualifications:   IP & Broadcast Systems
  • End-to-end signal chain troubleshooting across IP, SDI, LTC, L-Band, and ASI signals, with a structured methodology for isolating issues across network, device, and workflow layers
  • Experience configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining Evertz IP-based systems, including ST 2110 routing, signal processing, control infrastructure, NMOS integration (e.g., Evertz Magnum), SDP generation/exchange, and control plane vs. data plane separation
  • Knowledge of broadcast engineering best practices related to signal redundancy, failover, and resiliency design
Playout & Monitoring
  • Experience supporting channel origination workflows with Grass Valley AMPP. This work involves playout service orchestration. It also includes graphics insertion, SCTE triggers, and content scheduling.
  • Experience supporting Imagine Communications SNP or equivalent IP gateway systems in live production or playout environments
  • Familiarity with TAG Video Systems multiviewers, including monitoring layout configuration, signal health validation, and alarm interpretation in IP video environments
  • Working knowledge of Telestream PRISM waveform monitors for real-time SDI and ST 2110 signal analysis, including video quality, color space accuracy, and HDR/SDR compliance
Color, HDR & Satellite
  • Knowledge of color space conversion and HDR/SDR compatibility is important. This involves working with LUTs and tone mapping. You should also be able to fix EOTF/gamma errors, address color space metadata mismatches, and ensure consistent HDR/SDR output across devices.
  • Proficiency configuring and troubleshooting IRDs, L-Band routers, and associated RF equipment; solid knowledge of end-to-end satellite downlink signal chains including RF, L-Band, ASI, and IP outputs
Cloud & General
  • Knowledge of cloud-based or hybrid broadcast workflows, including remote production or IP extension of linear streams into AWS or Oracle Cloud environments
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering teams to troubleshoot issues across routing control systems, multicast networking, and downstream playout or monitoring devices
  • Proficient written documentation skills. This includes operational procedures. It also includes troubleshooting guides and engineering run books.
  • You should communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should also be self-directed and able to work in environments where priorities change.

The Convergent Account Executive owns the full advertising relationship across both linear and streaming for their assigned clients — spanning Broadcast dayparts (Prime, News, Late Night and Daytime), Cable Networks, and the full Streaming/CTV portfolio, including programmatic and direct IO (DIO) channels. This includes regular scheduled programming as well as specials (e.g., The VMAs, Golden Globes, AMAs) and sponsorship/integration opportunities. The Convergent AE is the single point of accountability for delivering unified, cross-platform (“360”) solutions, working in tandem with specialty, programmatic, and AM partners to maximize revenue across the entire Paramount portfolio. This position sets its own sales agenda and is responsible for growing and maintaining a book of business across both linear and streaming properties.

This is not a maintenance role. This is a growth role built for a broadcast-experienced seller who can do it all — someone who has spent time in local TV knows how to maximize opportunities, and is hungry to excel as a multi-screen, multi-market powerhouse.
As an Account Executive on the Local Ad Sales team at CBS, you will sell across our full O&O footprint — with the ability to close multi-market broadcast deals that span from coast to coast. Layered on top of that is the opportunity to sell Paramount+ and Pluto TV streaming inventory, giving clients a truly end-to-end screen solution backed by one of the most recognized brands in media.
You will bring new business to the table. You will build client relationships that outlast any single campaign. And you will deliver results.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Hunt — hard. Prospect relentlessly across local, regional, and national categories. New-to-station and non-traditional revenue is your primary mandate. You don't wait for the phone to ring.
  • Sell all screens. Drive revenue across CBS O&O broadcast, Paramount+ and Pluto TV — in a single, integrated pitch.
  • Think multi-market. Leverage the full 17-market CBS O&O footprint to bring advertisers a scaled broadcast solution to reach audiences across any & all markets.
  • Build don't inherit. Develop direct client and agency relationships from the ground up. Own your pipeline and your outcomes.
  • Be a marketer first. Package custom solutions — tentpole programs, sports integrations, streaming packages, sponsorships — tailored to client business goals, not just available inventory.
  • Own your numbers. Manage quarterly and annual account plans, forecast accurately, and hit your monthly and quarterly revenue goals. 
  • Stay ahead of the market. Know the linear and streaming landscape. Understand where categories are investing and why. Bring category intelligence into every client conversation.
  • Collaborate to win. Partner with Integrated Marketing, Account Management, Traffic, and deliver seamless, high-impact campaigns from pre-sale through post-recap.
  • Stay sharp. Keep a pulse on marketplace trends, category dynamics, and the evolving linear and streaming landscape.
  • Represent CBS Pittsburgh at client meetings, presentations, and station events.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 

Required:

  • 2+ years of local broadcast experience, multi-platform, or local media advertising sales with a verifiable history of hitting or exceeding revenue goals.
  • Real hunger—you prospect, you pitch, you close. You don’t wait for business to come to you.
  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to build lasting client partnerships.
  • Experience working with both advertising agencies and direct clients.
  • Outstanding presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage a high-volume, fast-paced book of business with professionalism and precision.
  • Valid Drivers License

 

Preferred:

  • Experience selling streaming, digital, or OTT inventory in addition to linear television.
  • Familiarity with Paramount+, Pluto TV, or FAST/AVOD platform sales.
  • Experience selling multi-market or national broadcast packages.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Proficient in Wide Orbit, Strata, Salesforce, and Microsoft Excel.

 

CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. The ideal candidate brings a sophisticated understanding of today’s evolving media landscape and excels at translating Paramount’s full range of capabilities into integrated solutions that deliver against advertisers’ business objectives—moving beyond traditional demo guarantees and delivery metrics.


As an Account Executive on the Advanced Advertising Team, you will serve as a strategic advisor to agencies and advertisers, helping them navigate and capitalize on the convergence of linear TV, streaming, digital video, programmatic, and data-driven advertising. You will leverage Paramount’s suite of audience, identity, optimization, attribution, measurement, programmatic, and advanced advertising solutions to develop holistic, outcome-oriented media strategies.


The ideal candidate understands how programmatic buying and activation intersect with premium streaming and traditional television, and can articulate the value of bringing these channels together through a unified approach. You will be expected to identify opportunities to expand relationships, drive incremental revenue, and position Paramount as a leading partner for clients seeking greater scale, precision, flexibility, and measurable business outcomes across the entire video ecosystem.


Success in this role requires a balance of revenue generation, executive presence, convergent selling expertise, analytical thinking, and cross-functional collaboration. You will work closely with agency investment and strategy teams, programmatic and digital leads, data and analytics partners, and Paramount’s broader sales organization to develop integrated solutions and unlock new sources of growth.


You thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, are comfortable selling complex technology and data-enabled solutions, and can move fluidly between high-level business strategy and the details of media activation. You are equally effective influencing senior clients, educating agencies on emerging capabilities, partnering across internal teams, and turning sophisticated media solutions into measurable business results.

 

Results Driven 

  • Consistently meet or exceed established revenue targets on a quarterly and annual basis.
  • Proven capability to sell data-driven and optimized executions across linear and streaming.
  • Manage a Hold Co aligned Advanced Advertising sales pipeline—including forecasting, prospecting, pipeline management, reporting and long-term revenue growth.
  •  Identify and cultivate new Advanced Advertising opportunities across existing and prospective clients.
  • Leverage campaign performance, audience insights, and measurement outputs to uncover incremental revenue opportunities.
  • Establish and cultivate relationships with internal stakeholders and clients by conducting a high volume of face-to-face calls.

 

A Consultative Sales Executive

  • Collaborate across platforms within your Hold Co (including linear, streaming, and sports) to generate revenue across the Paramount portfolio product suite to deliver holistic client solutions.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for both clients and internal counterparts.
  • Develop and present data-driven recommendations that improve campaign effectiveness and return on advertising investment.

 

Multi-platform Proficient

  • Understand the complementary value and nuance of representing all platforms and buy types, including programmatic, across a portfolio to execute a unified advertising strategy. 
  • Stay ahead of industry trends by actively engaging in events, training, and trade publications.
  • Confidently articulate the role of audience-first planning, cross-platform activation, and performance measurement in today's fragmented media landscape.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of the Advanced Advertising ecosystem and competitive marketplace.

 

 A Leader by Example

  • In partnership with AA Management, work closely with and mentor your Account Manager(s) to develop into future sales leadersCreate meaningful opportunities for Account Managers to participate in client-facing sales efforts and strategic conversations.
  • Deliver best-in-class client service throughout the campaign lifecycle, including onboarding, stewardship, optimization recommendations, and post-campaign reporting.
  • Foster strong collaboration with Planning, Data Solutions, Measurement, Product, Operations, and Sales teams to deliver seamless client experiences.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of advertising sales or agency experience, with a demonstrated understanding of how data flows throughout the ecosystem, and is applied in planning, execution, and measurement

 

Additional Qualifications: 

  • Strong relationship building skills and a collaborative nature.

job.description:

AI Engineering Technical Lead


The Applied Intelligence Data Engineering team is seeking an AI Engineering Technical Lead
to drive the design, development, and productionization of AI-powered data products acrossParamount streaming platforms.

 

This role will lead the development of intelligent systems that leverage real-time and batch data
to power personalization, recommendations, content discovery, and advanced analytics. You will
work at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning, and software engineering,
building scalable AI systems that integrate tightly with our real-time data ingestion platform.
As a technical leader, you will define architecture, guide implementation, mentor engineers, and
ensure production-grade performance, scalability, and reliability of AI-driven systems.


Key Responsibilities
Lead AI System Design & Development
● Develop real-time and batch inference pipelines integrated with streaming data
platforms.
● Design feature engineering pipelines leveraging high-volume behavioral and content
metadata.
● Implement end-to-end ML workflows from data ingestion to model serving.
Build AI-Powered Data Products
● Develop production-grade AI services that power user-facing and internal data products.
● Design APIs and services to expose AI capabilities to downstream applications and platforms.
● Ensure tight integration between AI systems and the core data platform.
Architect Scalable ML Infrastructure
● Define architecture for model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
● Build and optimize feature stores, model registries, and inference services.
● Design systems that support low-latency, high-throughput model serving.
● Establish best practices for reproducibility, versioning, and lifecycle management.
Production Reliability & Model Performance
● Monitor and optimize model performance, latency, and system reliability in production.
● Implement observability for data quality, feature drift, and model degradation.
● Establish automated testing, validation, and deployment pipelines for ML systems.
● Ensure scalability and cost efficiency across AI workloads.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
● Partner with Data Engineers to integrate AI pipelines with real-time and batch data systems.
● Collaborate with Product Managers to define AI-driven product capabilities and roadmap.
● Work with Software Engineers to integrate AI services into user-facing applications.
● Align with analytics and experimentation teams to measure model impact.
Technical Leadership
● Lead architectural decisions for AI/ML systems and data-driven applications.
● Mentor engineers in machine learning engineering, system design, and best practices.
● Establish standards for model development, deployment, and operational excellence.
● Drive innovation in applied AI across streaming and content platforms.

 

Required Technical Skills
Machine Learning & AI Systems
● Strong experience building and deploying machine learning models in production.
● Expertise in recommendation systems, personalization, ranking models, or NLP.
● Experience with model training frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar).
● Understanding of feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimentation frameworks.
Data & Feature Engineering
● Experience designing large-scale feature pipelines using batch and streaming data.
● Strong knowledge of data modeling and transformation for ML use cases.
● Familiarity with feature stores and real-time feature serving architectures.
Streaming & Real-Time Systems
● Experience integrating ML systems with real-time data platforms (e.g., Kafka, Pub/Sub).
● Understanding of event-driven architectures and low-latency processing patterns.
● Ability to design real-time inference and decisioning systems.
Cloud & Distributed Systems
● Strong experience with cloud-native architectures (GCP preferred).
● Experience deploying ML systems in Kubernetes-based environments.
● Understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and fault tolerance.
Software Engineering & APIs
● Proficiency in Python, Java, or similar languages for production systems.
● Experience building microservices and APIs for model serving.
● Strong software engineering fundamentals, including testing, CI/CD, and observability.

Basic Qualifications
● Strong foundation in machine learning engineering, data systems, and distributed
architecture.
● Proven track record of building and scaling AI/ML systems in production environments.
● Experience working with real-time data platforms and high-scale user-facing systems.
● Ability to balance long-term architecture with rapid product delivery.
● Excellent leadership, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
● Self-motivated, quality-driven, and focused on delivering measurable impact through AI.

Preferred Qualifications
● Experience in streaming, media, or consumer-facing platforms.
● Familiarity with experimentation platforms (A/B testing) and metrics-driven optimization.
● Experience building AI-powered data products and platform capabilities

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

 

 

 

The Associate Producer (GFX) serves as shift supervisor within the CBS Sports HQ graphics team, leading the playout and execution of on-air graphics for live studio productions. This role blends creative storytelling, editorial judgment, and technical execution — building custom Photoshop and XPression graphics, coaching teammates, enforcing editorial standards, and keeping the control room running smoothly during tentpole live events.

This role supports a swing shift (4pm-1am) on-site at our Stamford office and nights, holidays and weekends are to be expected.

Responsibilities
  • Serve as shift supervisor: delegate assignments, troubleshoot basic graphics technical issues with Engineering, and provide feedback and coaching to teammates.
  • Collaborate with fellow Associate Producers, Graphic Designers, and Content Producers to plan graphic execution and align branding and strategy across the CBS Sports HQ graphics team.
  • Enforce CBS Sports editorial standards and align audience messaging within segments, reviewing graphics closely and in a timely fashion to catch mistakes.
  • Oversee coordination of graphics in the control room for tentpole events (e.g., Selection Sunday, Super Bowl Sunday, NBA Draft).
  • Collaborate directly with producers and the Research department to design and pitch custom Photoshop graphics and XPression templates that enhance storylines, statistics, and game analysis for viewers.
  • Provide feedback on custom studio wall graphics to elevate creativity and innovation.

Job Summary

 

The Data Engineering team is hiring a Data Engineer – Data Pipeline & ETL. You will help build and maintain scalable data platforms and ETL/ELT pipelines in a fast-moving environment. You will also grow your expertise in modern data architecture and cloud-native best practices.

Build and Maintain Scalable Data Pipelines

Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch and streaming data pipelines for large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.

Optimize pipelines for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

Data Modeling & Data Warehouse Architecture

Design scalable, dimensional, and hybrid data models optimized for analytics and ML use cases.

Build and maintain modular data components following established framework patterns.

Contribute to architectural decisions across streaming systems, data lakes, and warehouses.

Data Quality, Governance & Observability

Implement automated data validation, anomaly detection, and monitoring frameworks.

Enforce governance, privacy, and security best practices, particularly for sensitive AI datasets.

Ensure responsible AI data usage and compliance standards.

Advanced Data Pipeline & ETL/ELT Expertise

2–4+ years of experience building and scaling ETL/ELT pipelines in production environments.

Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Composer, or similar platforms.

Strong understanding of distributed data processing concepts.

SQL & Data Modeling for Analytics & ML

Expert-level SQL skills for large-scale transformation and analytics.

Experience designing scalable warehouse schemas and ML-ready data layers.

Strong experience optimizing complex queries across multi-terabyte datasets.

Programming & ML Data Integration

Proficiency in Python (or similar language) for data processing and ML pipeline integration.

Experience with distributed processing frameworks such as Spark.

Familiarity integrating data pipelines with ML platforms such as Vertex AI (preferred), Databricks ML, or equivalent.

Streaming & Event-Driven Systems

Experience building real-time data pipelines using Kafka, Pub/Sub, or similar technologies.

Understanding of feature streaming, low-latency data processing, and event-driven architectures.

Ability to architect and build real-time dashboards using Superset.

Cloud & Modern AI Data Platforms

Experience designing cloud-native data architectures (GCP preferred).

Experience with Lakehouse architectures and cloud data warehouses.

2–4+ years of experience in data engineering, data pipeline development, or related fields.

job.description:

Apply to join our new platform initiative and take ownership of building a centralized performance testing automation platform for games development. In this role, you will collaborate with developers, designers, and QA teams to design and deliver a unified system that aggregates performance data from multiple game engines, processes results, and clearly highlights performance issues. 

 

You will play a key role in defining the software architecture, database schemas, and overall system experience, while helping to track and visualize optimization progress over time. As this is a brand‑new platform with no prior internal equivalent, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape its foundations and influence how performance testing is approached across our game development teams. 

 

 

 

What you will do: 

  • Develop and maintain a platform (applications, integrations and infrastructure) supporting gaming department

  • Partner closely with software architects, game developers, QA, and operations to remove bottlenecks and improve delivery 

  • Build and Maintain CI/CD Pipelines 

  • Script repetitive tasks and develop self-service tools for developers 

  • Design and manage infrastructure 

  • Implement and manage containers, stand up and manage VMs 

  • Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting 

  • Ensure infrastructure is scalable, secure, and reliable. 

 

We are looking for Engineers that: 

  • Are curious, with a desire to learn and the ambition to quickly become a self-reliant, top-notch software engineer,  

  • Value collaboration, knowledge sharing, and contributing to the team's overall effectiveness,  

  • Equally enjoys coding applications and managing infrastructure 

  • Keep up to date with modern web technologies,   

  • Want to actively participate in decision making and fully understand products they work on,   

  • Open to learn new programing languages, 

  • Enjoy working in a team,   

  • Easily and openly communicate in English.  

 

And on the technical side, we need: 

  • 3+ years of experience in software development, build automation, delivery and deployment 

  • Good understanding of concepts like CI/CD, GitOps, configuration management, cloud platforms, version control, automation, monitoring, analytics, containerization, and microservices architecture 

  • Comfortable coding in at least one programing language (preferred: Kotlin, Java, JavaScript, Python, C++/C#) 

  • Experienced in code collaboration in Git, 

  • Experienced in containers orchestration in Kubernetes, 

  • Good knowledge and practical experience managing Cloud infrastructure. OCI is a huge plus. 

  • Experience standing up and maintaining Windows and/or Linux VMs 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience scripting in BuildGraph

job.title: Digital Producer, WJZ
job.description:
CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.  

 

Organizations that wish to receive job vacancy notices from this posting’s television station should contact sf_recruitingsupport@paramount.com.

 

CBS Stations is hiring a part-time digital producer to create compelling, relevant content for CBS Baltimore’s digital platforms. This role is responsible for overseeing local digital breaking news coverage, writing and editing stories across a wide range of topics, clipping and optimizing video on CBSNews.com and on YouTube, and executing on growth initiatives across platforms.

We are looking for someone with strong news judgment who can write and edit clear, accurate, fact-driven copy and craft compelling headlines on deadline in a fast-paced environment. Scrupulous attention to detail, a cool head under pressure, and excellent communication skills are essential.

 

Your day-to-day:

  • Coordinate, produce and update web coverage of news stories, gathering the latest information from a variety of sources, always being mindful of WJZ and CBS News standards
  • React quickly to breaking news, writing and publishing articles and running live blogs as appropriate
  • Execute content and headlines with SEO strategies in mind
  • Clip and optimize videos for CBSNews.com, YouTube and other platforms, writing compelling, SEO-friendly headlines and descriptions
  • Manage the WJZ homepage to present the best of the journalism we produce
  • Work with reporters and producers to publish the best of WJZ to our website
  • Proactively plan content around key news events and tentpoles
  • Track content performance and share content insights across WJZ to help inform story selection across platforms
  • Send push alerts on breaking news, weather and other high-interest stories

 

What you bring to the team:

  • You have 1+ years of experience in a digital breaking news environment and a proven ability to react quickly as news develops
  • You are a skilled writer who can produce quality copy on deadline
  • You have a deep understanding of SEO strategies 
  • You have a knack for framing content in an engaging way for a digital audience
  • You're familiar with analytics platforms like Google Analytics, Omniture, Chartbeat
  • You thrive in a collaborative team environment
