job.title: Lead Software Engineer - Web
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Location: In-Office, New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale

 

Overview:

 

Paramount is looking for a Lead Software Engineer to join our Web Engineering organization. In this role, you'll own the technical direction and delivery of frontend experiences across Paramount+ and the other brands we support. You'll lead a team of engineers, drive execution on high-impact projects, and raise the bar on code quality, performance, and developer experience — all while shipping features that millions of users interact with every day. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll spend meaningful time in the codebase while also mentoring engineers, unblocking teams, and partnering closely with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to deliver great user experiences. If you thrive at the intersection of technical depth and people leadership, this role is for you.

 

Responsibilities:

 

• Lead the technical planning, execution, and delivery of frontend features for Paramount+ and Pluto.tv web applications

• Build and maintain high-quality React and Next.js applications with a focus on performance, reliability, and scalability

• Own and evolve frontend architecture decisions — component design, data fetching patterns, state management, and rendering strategies

• Develop and maintain a GraphQL API layer (Apollo Server) consumed by multiple frontend applications

• Contribute to and steward shared packages across a monorepo (pnpm workspaces, Turborepo)

• Lead and mentor a team of engineers — provide technical guidance, conduct code reviews, and foster a culture of continuous improvement

• Drive web performance optimization across the application, with a focus on Core Web Vitals, critical rendering path, and perceived load times

• Work with personalization and engagement teams to ship real-time recommendations, personalized artwork, sign-up flow optimization, and short-form video experiences across Paramount+ and Pluto.tv web surfaces

• Partner with Product and Design to translate requirements into well-scoped, well-executed technical solutions

• Collaborate with Backend Engineering and DevOps/SRE teams to build and deploy high-performing services

• Continuously improve CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins), testing infrastructure, and developer tooling

• Champion the adoption of modern AI-powered development tools and workflows to accelerate team velocity and code quality

• Communicate tradeoffs, technical decisions, and project status clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Write things down — RFCs, ADRs, Confluence pages, Slack threads — and default to async communication that scales

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

• 7+ years of experience in web application development

• 2+ years of experience in a technical leadership or lead engineer role

• BS degree in Computer Science, a similar technical field of study, or equivalent applicable experience

• Deep knowledge of web application development, best practices, and modern frontend architecture

• Deep knowledge of Object Oriented Programming and Design, data structures, and algorithms

• Expert-level JavaScript/TypeScript, CSS, Sass, HTML

• Strong experience building production applications with React (including SSR) and Next.js or similar frameworks

• Solid understanding of GraphQL — schema design, resolvers, federation

• Familiarity with monorepo tooling (pnpm workspaces, Turborepo or equivalent)

• Deep understanding of web performance, browser rendering, Core Web Vitals, and the critical rendering path

• Experience with Webpack, Rspack, and/or Turbopack

• Strong testing discipline — Jest, Cypress, or equivalent

• Good understanding of HTTP protocol and caching layers

• Solid knowledge of the HTML DOM and Event APIs

• Demonstrated ability to lead engineers, make architectural decisions, and communicate design concepts clearly — in writing, design reviews, and real-time discussions with engineers at all levels

• Experience using modern AI agents and tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude, Cursor) to improve personal and team productivity

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

• Familiarity with micro-frontend architectures, multi-zones, or platform/design system integration

• Experience with microservices and distributed systems

• Experience with GraphQL, PHP

• Experience with E2E testing frameworks — Cypress, Synergy, or similar

• Working knowledge of Docker and CI tools

• Observability experience (New Relic, Datadog, or similar)

• Understanding or experience with Atomic Design concepts

• You've integrated recommendation or personalization APIs into production frontend applications

• You've worked with streaming event pipelines or real-time decisioning systems

• Track record of inspiring and coaching engineers to adopt AI-powered tools and workflows, maximizing team efficiency

• Eagerness to collaborate with Product and Design to ensure a high standard of UX

• Passion for delivering without compromising standards

• Humility to speak up when lacking knowledge or experience in an area

• Experience working asynchronously across time zones

 

 

#LI-VA1

job.title: Lead Software Test Engineer
job.description:

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

For our Milan office (Corso Europa) we are currently recruiting for a full-time:

 

Lead Software Test Engineer

 

Is this the role for you?

POSITION SUMMARY:

Skydance is looking for a passionate, self-motivated lead software test engineer to handle all aspects of testing (functional, performance, load, security, etc) across a large multiplatform environment.  This individual will be partnering with various teams (product, engineering, and quality) by assisting with the development of processes and tools that allow the organization to excel in its continuous software development initiatives.  As code is being delivered multiple times per day, test coverage and automation is crucial in allowing products to deliver quickly to market while maintaining the high level of quality our consumers deserve across our many diverse platforms. 

 

What will you be doing?
PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide technical quality leadership and guidance to the projects and resources that are assigned by implementing testing best practices 

  • Work on product/project teams developing test plans, test cases and test execution 

  • Partner with software engineering to design and develop tools and to assist in continuous development initiatives 

  • Conduct technical assessment of process and teams 

  • Perform load / performance testing where applicable 

  • Work alongside and mentor other test engineers to continuously improve process and provide input into our internal training bootcamps 

  • Contribute to and help maintain the testing framework for various types of testing (functional, load/performance, security) on multiple platforms (web, iOS/Android, emerging platforms) 

  • Operate in an agile software delivery methodology focused on testing new features within an iteration and providing near immediate feedback to engineers through test automation 

  • Perform exploratory testing where necessary in addition to regression testing 

  • Effectively communicate complex and/or difficult information to both technical and non-technical audiences 

  • Work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment supporting many products on varied release cycles 

  • Oversee activities of other QE Engineers contractors

  • Design and architect end-to-end test frameworks and strategy from the ground up for large-scale, multiplatform streaming applications, applying appropriate design patterns without over-engineering 

  • Lead the adoption of AI-augmented quality engineering practices, including AI-assisted test generation and review, evaluation of AI/LLM feature outputs, and establishing safeguards and data-governance practices (e.g. anonymization) for AI tool usage 

  • Perform hands-on code and test-design review (spotting logic bugs, flaky-prone patterns and bad practices), and hold the line on quality standards across the team 

  • Own test-suite health: prioritize test maintenance, identify and resolve flaky tests in CI, and drive risk-based and requirements-based coverage decisions 

  • Document processes and testing knowledge continuously to reduce key-person risk and support knowledge transfer across the team.

 

What are we looking for?

JOB SKILLS:

  • Deep understanding of software quality best practices, with a passion for learning and adopting emerging technologies and methodologies
  • Solid software development expertise and technical architecture capabilities
  • Strong object-oriented programming background, with a focus on building scalable, reliable, and reusable solutions
  • Hands-on proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, with practical experience in one or more of C#, PHP, or Java
  • Experience working in Unix/Linux environments
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git, SVN, and Stash
  • Experience with automation and testing tools, including Selenium, WebDriver, JUnit, TestNG, Appium, and Cypress
  • Proficiency with CI/CD and build automation tools such as Jenkins and Bamboo
  • Experience using performance testing tools, including JMeter and LoadRunner
  • Experience working within Agile development and testing environments
  • Understanding of web video playback, encoding, live streaming, and related technologies
  • Knowledge of network analysis and proxy tools such as Charles, Fiddler, and HttpWatch
  • Working knowledge of IT infrastructure, networking concepts, content delivery networks (CDNs), database fundamentals, and caching strategies
  • Experience with TDD and BDD methodologies is a plus
  • Strong coding and analytical problem-solving skills, with hands-on experience writing and debugging unit tests
  • Good understanding of test design patterns and the ability to apply them pragmatically when appropriate
  • Practical experience leveraging AI within quality engineering, including AI-assisted test generation, prompt engineering, and evaluation of AI/LLM outputs, combined with an awareness of data governance and safety considerations
  • Experience designing and building test automation frameworks and architectures from the ground up
  • A proactive, self-motivated professional who thrives both independently and as part of a collaborative team

 

EXPERIENCE:

The ideal candidate should have a background in software engineering and is seasoned in software quality best practices.  Additionally, the candidate should have: 

  • 5+ years of designing and working with test automation frameworks and developing automated test scripts (web, mobile & OTT) specifically object-oriented frameworks 

  • 5+ years working and testing with various online research and analytics tools 

  • 3+ years working with and leading offshore resources 

  • Demonstrated experience designing (not only maintaining) a test automation framework from scratch, including architecture and technology choices 

  • Experience with online streaming video experiences (web, mobile & emerging technologies) a plus 

 

 

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business or related discipline. The combination of education and relevant work experience will be considered.

 

Does it sound like you? Apply now and become part of our team!

The benefits available for this position include lunch vouchers; Cancer Prevention Centres ("Centri Prevenzioni LILT");  Parents Package ("Pacchetto Genitori"); Employee Discount Program; Tax Assistance; Business Travel Accident Insurance; Employee Assistance Program (EAP); Well-being programmes, and applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement benefits.

job.title: Licensing Manager (12 Month FTC)
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Is this role for you?

The Licensing Manager – Softlines owns revenue growth, partner relationships and new business for the Softlines category, with a particular focus on home & accessories.

Working in a retail-first model, you’ll manage licensing relationships end to end, from pitch and negotiation through contract, launch and in-store performance. You’ll be the commercial lead for property launches with the region’s key retail partners, and accountable for your own numbers: budget, forecast, minimum guarantees (MGs) and sell-through as part of the wider softlines business.


What you will be doing?

Commercial ownership and performance

  • Own the Softlines portfolio on home & accessories and deliver or exceed annual revenue, MG and new-business targets.

  • Own the forecast, budget and long-range plan inputs for the portfolio, providing regular variance analysis that explains gaps to budget, the drivers behind them and the recovery actions.

  • Build growth plans per category and per partner, balancing retention and expansion of existing partners, collaborations, new brands and categories at current partners, and new partners.

  • Monitor concentration risk by property and by partner, and diversify the portfolio where needed.

New business and expansion

  • Define white space through market, consumer and retail analysis, and expand successful partnerships across additional categories and retailers.

  • Pitch and close new partners.

  • Secure MG-backed partners across categories ahead of major releases, partnering with the retail & marketing team to convert them into retail activations.

  • Partner with the Creative team to develop retailer-exclusive collections, capsules and limited editions, and collaborate with the team on cross-category initiatives.

  • Maintain a qualified pipeline with clear stages, owners and conversion targets.

Market analysis

  • Attend key trade shows and use in-house tools, including WGSN, to analyze fashion, retail and consumer trends, and bring them into strategy, partner pitches and growth plans.

  • Monitor competitor activity and developments in the market.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Partner closely with Operations, Product Development, Legal/BALA, Franchise, Retail & Marketing and Finance to deliver DTR programs efficiently and without interruption for partners.

  • Partner with Global CP teams on global launches and DTR initiatives, and share market insight and best practice with colleagues in the region.

What are we looking for?

  • 4+ years of experience in Softlines, fashion licensing or DTR models.

  • A track record of closing MG-backed deals and managing key retail accounts on exclusive or DTR programs.

  • Strong commercial, negotiation and business development skills, with a solid understanding of contracts.

  • Strong analytical skills: P&L ownership, forecasting, and the ability to explain performance against budget.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, internally and with external partners.

  • A self-starter who builds a pipeline from scratch and works well across cultures and markets.

  • Experience with licensing and royalty systems.


How Success Is Measured

  • Delivery against revenue and new-business targets, and MGs secured.

  • Retention and growth of key Softlines partners.

  • Pipeline value and conversion to signed agreements.

  • Sell-through and campaign performance at key retailers.

  • Forecast accuracy and the quality of variance analysis.

  • Feedback from partners and internal stakeholders.

Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. job.description:

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview:

The Paramount Skydance Corporate Development Group is responsible for sourcing, evaluating, executing, and integrating/separating the company’s strategic acquisitions, divestitures, investments, and joint ventures. The Manager role will work with team members and senior leadership throughout the Paramount Skydance business units to assess and execute external transaction opportunities and internal business-building opportunities. The Group has a process that governs the organization’s M&A activities. Within that framework, the individual is expected to work and make decisions with some level of independence. For unresolved issues, the individual is expected to recommend a course of action for discussion. The individual will have the opportunity to develop close working relationships with key leaders at and beyond Paramount Skydance, and as such will need to exercise good judgment and quick thinking.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

  • Collaborate with team members, senior management, business units, and outside advisors to identify and assess potential external transactions in the form of acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, minority investments, and business development opportunities
  • Assist with transaction execution, including developing valuation analyses and transaction briefing materials and coordinating due diligence efforts
  • Conduct research on target companies, competitors, and market dynamics to support opportunity evaluation
  • Build financial and operating models; develop various financial analyses including discounted cash flow, merger analysis, comparable company analysis, precedent transaction analyses, and general financial statement analyses; present analytics to an executive audience
  • Track current deal flow and proactive & reactive pipelines
  • Build strong working relationships across the Paramount Skydance organization

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+ years at a top-tier investment bank or private equity firm preferred
  • Bachelor’s Degree required (with preference for an MBA)
  • Strong interest in the intersection of Media and Technology

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Deep financial modeling expertise with knowledge of accounting, corporate finance, and valuation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent research skills and ability to prioritize, synthesize, and present information in written format
  • Attention to detail
  • Ability to work skillfully and on multiple projects at once
  • Comfort operating in environments with ambiguity and evolving priorities
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the solid ability to persuade others, build consensus, and work in a team

job.title: Manager, Internal Audit, Risk and Analytics
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview and Responsibilities

As a Manager of Risk & Data Analytics, you deliver data-driven insights, lead risk-based audits, and support investigations, risk assessments, and special projects across Paramount. You work with leaders across corporate, media, streaming, and production to evaluate processes, governance, and controls using useful judgment and analytics. The role requires comfort with complex data, deep risk assessment skills, and the ability to operate in fast-moving, judgment-heavy environments. Engagements include operational reviews, T&E and production audits, and advisory projects in partnership with SOX, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and other teams.   Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  
  • Plan and lead risk‑based analytics to support operational audits, advisory work, and special projects across corporate, media, streaming, advertising, and production areas
  • Develop focused project objectives, scopes, and risk assessments aligned to key business priorities
  • Design flexible approaches for non‑routine or evolving activities requiring solid professional judgment
  • Use analytics to evaluate processes, controls, and governance, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accountability, and growth
  • Conduct end‑to‑end process walkthroughs and root‑cause analysis to address underlying issues
  • Assess operational maturity and scalability in high‑growth or transformational initiatives
  • Apply advanced analytics to audit planning, testing, investigations, and continuous risk monitoring
  • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and emerging risks across areas such as production, T&E, payroll, vendor payments, and revenue
  • Translate business risks into targeted, meaningful analytics and communicate insights through clear visuals and presentations
  • Lead or support special projects through data collection, validation, analysis, and documentation of findings
  • Synthesize insights from multiple systems and data sources and present conclusions through dashboards and presentations
  • Build robust relationships with business leaders and cross‑functional partners, including SOX, Compliance, Finance, and Legal
  • Communicate results and recommendations clearly, explaining root cause, risk, and business impact in an accessible language
  • Create recommendations that fit the business needs. When needed, promote remediation plans while keeping a focus on solutions
  • Serve as a trusted advisor while maintaining sovereignty and objectivity
  • Manage, coach, and develop team members while ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to internal standards
  • Advance the team’s shift toward insight‑driven, judgment‑based auditing
  • Contribute to annual risk assessments and audit planning using data and industry insights
  • Support continuous improvement of Internal Audit methodologies, analytics capabilities, and investigative approaches
  • Partner with the Audit executive team on analytics tools, technologies, and industry trends to enhance the function’s capabilities
  • Assess audit and operational risks, design effective analytics procedures, identify control gaps, and manage multiple engagements in a dynamic environment
  • Apply sound judgment, professional skepticism, and well-developed communication skills to drive outcomes and maintain high standards of quality and integrity
  Basic Qualifications  
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, data analytics, or a related discipline
  Additional Qualifications  
  • Experience leading or executing analytics-driven reviews, including areas such as T&E, production, vendor payments, or revenue-related processes
  • Big Four or consulting experience preferred
  • Professional certification(s) such as CIA, CPA, CFE, CISA, or equivalent (active or in progress) preferred
     

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

  • Unique opportunities to make meaningful connections and build a vibrant community, both inside and outside the workplace.
  • Explore life at Paramount: https://www.paramount.com/careers/life-at-paramount

At Paramount, the spirit of inclusion feeds into everything that we do, on-screen and off. From the programming and movies we create to employee benefits/programs and social impact outreach initiatives, we believe that opportunity, access, resources and rewards should be available to and for the benefit of all. The role focuses on evaluating processes, governance, and internal controls using data and judgment to identify risks, strengthen decision‑making, and deliver meaningful insights. The work includes operational reviews, T&E audits, production audits, and investigations. It also involves management-requested reviews and advisory projects. These tasks often require collaboration with SOX, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and other teams.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

 

  • Plan and lead risk‑based audits, advisory engagements, and special projects

  • Assess operational maturity and scalability in high‑growth initiatives
  • Use advanced analytics for audit planning, testing, investigations, and risk monitoring
  • Analyze large datasets (production costs, T&E, payroll, vendor payments, revenue) to identify trends and risks
  • Translate risks into targeted analytics and communicate insights through visuals and dashboards
  • Lead or support investigations and fraud risk assessments; partner with Legal, Compliance, and HR on confidential matters

  • Communicate results clearly and develop functional, business‑aligned recommendations
  • Manage, coach, and develop team members; review work for quality and consistency

  • Apply professional skepticism while remaining impartial and solutions‑oriented
  • Manage multiple engagements and deadlines in a fast‑paced environment

  • Experience with operational audits (T&E, production, vendor payments, revenue)
  • Extensive experience analyzing large, complex, or unstructured datasets
  • Proficiency with analytics/visualization tools (SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, ACL)

 

Basic Qualifications

 

  • 7+ years in internal audit, external audit, risk management, forensic accounting, data analytics, or related fields
  • Experience with operational audits (T&E, production, vendor payments, revenue)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related field
  • Professional certifications (CIA, CPA, CFE, CISA) preferred
  • Expert MS Office skills
  • Strong project management, communication, analytical, and problem‑solving skills

  • Navigate ambiguity and incomplete data to drive effective audit and analytics work
  • Balance risk management requirements with business realities and operational needs
  • Lead teams, engage stakeholders, and perform hands‑on analysis throughout engagements
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects while maintaining quality, accuracy, and impact

  • Experience with Legal/Compliance on investigations is a plus
  • Knowledge of ERM frameworks and regulatory considerations
  • Ability to assess fraud risk and support investigations
  • Collaborative mindset; ability to influence and work across teams

  • Research and synthesis skills
  • Comfort using AI‑enabled tools and advanced analytics

job.title: Media Planning Interns
job.description:
Media Planning Intern

Step behind the scenes of television and media broadcasting. We are looking for an ambitious, detail-oriented Media Planning Intern to join our On-Air Media Planning team.

In this role, you will gain hands-on experience in how linear TV campaigns are built, scheduled, and delivered across our network. You will collaborate closely with planners, work directly with broadcast management systems, and see the immediate impact of your work on screen every single day.

What You’ll Do

  • On-Air Support: Partner with the On-Air Media Planning team to coordinate and execute daily and weekly operational tasks.

  • Campaign & Grid Setup: Set broadcast windows, build target parameters, and generate campaigns and GEGs directly within our broadcast system.

  • Agile Grid Management: Adapt quickly to live programming shifts by updating tune-ins according to potential broadcast grid changes.

  • Planning & Drafting: Build weekly media plan drafts and supervise their real-time execution across channels.

  • Data & Project Tracking: Maintain accurate, up-to-date campaign and GEG records in our project management tools.

  • Analytics & Performance: Generate promo reports, monitor weekly NRTX campaigns, and deliver actionable performance statistics.

  • Cross-Department Collaboration: Serve as an active operational point of contact to handle ad hoc requests from partner teams.

What You’ll Bring

  • Education: Currently enrolled in a university program (Media Studies, Communications, Marketing, or a related field).

  • Languages: Native-level Hungarian paired with confident written and spoken English. (Proficiency in Dutch or Polish is a strong plus!)

  • Mindset: Proactive "can-do" approach, solid problem-solving instincts, and the ability to stay organized under tight broadcast deadlines.

  • Eye for Precision: High attention to detail with clear, structured communication skills.

  • Tech Comfort: Solid working knowledge of Microsoft Office or Google Workspace tools.

  • Passion: A genuine interest in the evolving world of TV and broadcast media.

Why Join Us?

  • Real Impact: Your media plans go straight to screen, directly reaching viewers across the region.

  • Industry Tools: Gain practical experience with enterprise broadcast systems and professional project management workflows.

  • Mentorship: Learn alongside seasoned media strategists in an international, supportive environment.

 

 

Paramount Networks International, is comprised of many of the world's most popular multimedia entertainment brands, including MTV, MTV LIVE HD, Nickelodeon, Nick Jr., Comedy Central, Paramount Channel, BET and more. •    B.S. Degree or equivalent experience in Meteorology or Earth Sciences preferred

CBS News Philadelphia is seeking a passionate, dedicated, forward-thinking leader to guide our critical morning daypart. We need a newsroom leader who will revolutionize our morning content through relevant push alert strategy and brand-consistent storytelling on linear, streaming, and social media. Knowledge and experience in both broadcast and digital newsroom spaces will set our ideal leader apart and will be key to leading now and into the future.

 

As leader of the morning daypart, this person will be key to setting strategy for the entire day. We are a research-driven local news operation focused on community, breaking news, weather, problem-solving, and storytelling that reflects the lives of people in the Philadelphia region. The ideal candidate for the Morning Executive Producer embraces our brand of Heart, Hustle, Home, weaving that brand through all content across broadcast, streaming, and social platforms.

 

This leader will help drive relentless and consistent execution of our Next/Weather brand. The ideal candidate will deliver a compelling product to our entire audience, on any platform they consume our morning news product.

 

Our leading candidate will be a strong and empathetic manager who empowers staff to believe in local news as a change agent and community-builder, someone who brings out the best in our team daily through support and informed mentoring.

 

This leader will oversee the day-to-day morning news editorial operations with a collaborative style, coaching and inspiring a team of content creators who meet our audience where they are, in a content-agnostic space.  We work in a highly competitive market. Our best candidate will bring a desire to compete and win.
 

Requirements:
 

  • Proven success with people as a leader, mentor, collaborator and teammate.
  • Proven success in developing accountability fostered through considerate feedback & coaching.
  • Respect for research and successful experience implementing a research-driven strategy.
  • Deep knowledge of how to deliver news via broadcast, streaming and social platforms mission. 
  • Agile and responsive to an ever-evolving dynamic.
  • Aptitude for integrating new technology applications in this multi-media, multi-platform environment.
  • Understand how to motivate and lead the various personalities and levels of experience.
  • Experience working in a non-linear newsroom.
  • Flexibility with work schedule. 
  • College degree and minimum 3-5 years’ experience working in a content operation in a non-managerial role and five years leadership experience in a large to medium market or equivalent experience in streaming and social media.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview
As Principal Product Manager, Ads Monetization, you’ll use machine learning and AI to help Paramount+ and Pluto TV earn more from advertising while keeping the viewing experience great. Sitting within our Consumer AI group, you’ll do two things: lead the product direction for ML-driven improvements to our ad systems, and act as the Ads team’s go-to product partner for AI/ML needs. You’ll work as a senior individual contributor under limited supervision, setting your own priorities and making most product calls individually, with executive team guidance on overall strategy. This is a [hybrid] role.

 

Primary Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for AI/ML-driven ads monetization across Paramount+ and Pluto TV, spanning areas such as ad decisioning, result optimization, pacing, forecasting and personalization. Make self-directed decisions on prioritization, trade-offs and sequencing, and align the roadmap with Consumer AI and Ads executive team.
  • Drive ML-powered optimization of ad systems by partnering with data scientists and ML engineers to define model objectives, constraints and success metrics. Balance revenue, viewer experience and advertiser outcomes, and decide independently which model and product bets to pursue.
  • Serve as the AI/ML product partner to the Ads team. Gather needs from Ad Sales, Ad Operations, Planning and Finance, and shape them into AI/ML solutions (including generative AI workflows). Prioritize requests independently, and align on cross-team commitments with Ads product leadership.
  • Define requirements and evaluation frameworks for ML-based products, including data needs, experiment design, A/B testing and ongoing model performance monitoring. Use results to quantify revenue impact and decide whether to scale, iterate or stop initiatives.
  • Influence stakeholders at all levels, including Engineering, Data Science, Ad Sales, Ad Operations, Finance, Legal and Privacy. Present strategy, results and trade-offs to senior executives. Decisions with significant budget, privacy or advertiser-contract implications are made jointly with the hiring manager or relevant committees.
  • Raise the bar for product practice by mentoring other product managers, setting standards for how ML products are scoped and measured, and sharing learnings across Consumer AI. Provide indirect executive team through influence, with no formal direct reports at this time.

Basic Qualifications  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years managing advertising, ad tech or monetization products.
  • Extensive knowledge of how ML is applied to advertising problems such as ranking, prediction, forecasting and optimization, with 3+ years shipping ML-driven products in partnership with data scientists and ML engineers.
  • Working knowledge of the ad serving and decisioning stack, including auctions, pacing, outcome management, and supply- and demand-side technologies.
  • Expertise in experimentation and measurement, including defining success metrics, A/B testing and interpreting results to drive decisions.
  • Knowledge with generative AI and LLM product concepts, including evaluation and iteration.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functionally without direct authority and to communicate clearly with senior executives.

 

Preferred Skills

  • Advanced degree or hands-on technical skills (e.g., SQL, Python) for working directly with data.
  • Experience with identity, audience signals, clean rooms or privacy-compliant data use in advertising.
  • Experience with generative AI applied to ad creative or ad operations workflows.
  • Experience mentoring or managing product managers.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

CBS Sports Digital is looking for a Product Growth Manager to own growth on the CBS Sports app. You'll sit on the app product team and carry your own roadmap alongside feature work. The job is to make sure what we build gets found, adopted, and kept.
That means owning the parts of the product where growth actually happens: onboarding, activation, how users discover new features, and the store listing as a conversion surface. It also means owning the acquisition spend pointed at the app and the instrumentation that tells us whether any of it worked. You'll be measured on install volume, install quality, feature adoption, and retention.
You should be comfortable in a standup and comfortable in a spreadsheet. You think in funnels, you ship experiments, and you can tell the difference between a number that moved and a number that matters.


Responsibilities:
●    Own a growth roadmap for the CBS Sports app, scoped and prioritized alongside feature work.
●    Own onboarding, activation, and in-product feature discovery, from problem definition through shipped changes.
●    Own the app store listing as a conversion surface, including testing, positioning, and editorial pitches for featuring.
●    Own paid acquisition for the app, optimizing toward high-LTV users and aligning spend to the roadmap and the sports calendar.
●    Define the growth instrumentation and reporting the product team runs on. Monitor installs, adoption, engagement, retention, and funnel performance, and act on what you see.
●    Run experiments with clear hypotheses and readable results. Kill what doesn't work.
●    Sequence releases against tentpole windows so launches land when fan demand is highest.
●    Test new acquisition channels and fold the ones that work into a single growth approach.
●    Work with brand, creative, and lifecycle teams so what ships in-product and what runs outside it say the same thing.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
●    5+ years in growth product management, product growth, or mobile growth.
●    Experience owning a growth funnel end to end, including shipping changes to a live product.
●    Hands-on experience running paid user acquisition (Apple Search Ads, Google App Campaigns, or similar).
●    Fluency with app metrics: installs, CAC and LTV, activation, adoption, retention, and cohort analysis.
●    Experience running A/B tests and making calls off the results.
●    Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
●    Experience embedded on a product and engineering team in an Agile environment.
●    Background in sports, streaming, media, or consumer subscription apps.
●    Familiarity with ASO and app store editorial and featuring processes.
●    Experience with product analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel), attribution (Kochava, AppsFlyer, Branch, Adjust), and lifecycle tools (Braze, Iterable, Airship, SalesForce Marketing Cloud).
●    A real interest in sports and how the sports calendar shapes fan behavior.

job.title: PTP Intern
job.description:
PTP Intern (Procure-to-Pay)

  • Department: Procure-to-Pay (PTP)

  • Location: Budapest, Hungary — Hybrid (2–3 days on-site per week, preferably Tuesdays & Wednesdays)

  • Working Hours: 30–40 hours/week (flexible around your studies)

  • Reports To: PTP Manager

  • Start Date: Immediate

Why Join Us? Ready to turn your university theory into real-world global finance experience? Join our Global Business Services (GBS) team in Budapest as a PTP Intern and see how a multinational company operates from the inside out. Reporting directly to the PTP Manager, you won’t just be doing repetitive admin—you’ll get hands-on exposure to the full Procure-to-Pay lifecycle, from the moment an invoice arrives to the final payment run. We offer a student-friendly, flexible schedule (30–40 hours/week) with 2–3 collaborative days in our Budapest office (ideally Tuesdays and Wednesdays) and remote work for the rest of the week.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Master Global Finance Workflows: Dive into daily invoice processing and payment execution, troubleshooting system errors and keeping transactions running smoothly in top-tier systems like SAP and Oracle.

  • Keep Things Moving: Track open Purchase Orders, aged invoices, and upcoming payment runs, teaming up with internal stakeholders to make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Ensure Accuracy & Compliance: Help run tax and compliance checks on international transactions, verify vendor details, and step in with manual data handling when needed.

  • Solve Financial Puzzles: Assist with operational reporting, reconcile vendor statements, and investigate intriguing discrepancies like credit balances or overpayments.

  • Be the Go-To Contact: Communicate professionally with external vendors, internal business partners, and fellow finance teams to resolve everyday queries.

  • Bring Fresh Ideas: Spot bottlenecks and share your own ideas on how we can make our daily workflows smarter and faster.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Education: Ongoing university/college studies (or a recent degree) in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Tech Savviness: Solid working knowledge of Microsoft Excel. Familiar with SAP or Oracle? Awesome—that’s a plus! Never used them before? No worries, we’ll give you full, structured training from day one.

  • Languages: Fluency in English (both written and spoken) is a must; Hungarian or any other European language is a great bonus.

  • Mindset:

    • A sharp eye for detail, an analytical brain, and genuine curiosity about how global finance works.

    • Strong communication skills and the ability to juggle priorities without breaking a sweat.

    • A proactive, team-player attitude—you enjoy collaborating in an international environment.

  • Availability: Ready to jump in on short notice, commit to 30–40 hours per week, and join the team in our Budapest office 2–3 days a week (preferably Tuesdays and Wednesdays).

What’s in It for You?

  • Resume-Boosting Tech Skills: Comprehensive training and daily hands-on practice with industry-leading ERP systems (SAP, Oracle) in a global corporate setting.

  • True Flexibility: A 30–40 hour schedule designed to fit alongside your studies, backed by a predictable hybrid setup.

  • Mentorship That Matters: A welcoming, down-to-earth team and direct support from your PTP Manager to guide your learning curve.

  • A Launchpad for Your Career: Gain practical experience that sets you apart—with real potential to grow into a permanent role within our GBS center.

job.title: PTP Invoice Auditor
job.description:
PTP Invoice Auditor

Department: Procure-to-Pay (PTP)

Location: Budapest, Hungary — hybrid, on-site 2–3 days per week

Employment Type: Fixed term Contract – 1 year (extension possible based on business needs)

Reports To: Sr Manager – PTP Invoicing

Start Date: Immediate — candidates must be available to commence on short notice and commit fully to the duration of the assignment

 

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented PTP Invoice Auditor to join our GBS PTP team reporting to the Senior Invoicing Manager. This role performs quality control reviews of invoices for accuracy and compliance. The role is based in Budapest and requires 2–3 days per week on-site, with flexibility for remote work on the remaining days. Familiarity with Oracle Fusion (Fusion Cloud ERP/Financials) is a plus.



Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor invoice processing and error resolution queues, performing detailed analytical reviews to identify and resolve issues preventing successful invoice posting within SAP and Oracle systems.

  • Manage and monitor aged and open Purchase Orders, proactively following up with business stakeholders on Goods Received/Invoice Not Received (GR/IR) and Invoice Received/No Goods Receipt exceptions.

  • Monitor, investigate, and resolve aged invoices to ensure timely processing and payment.

  • Perform fiscal and tax compliance reviews of invoices for international entities in accordance with local statutory requirements.

  • Execute manual entry of approved invoices when automated processing is not feasible.

  • Initiate, coordinate, and drive resolution of issues impacting invoice processing and vendor payments, engaging cross-functional teams as required.

  • Prepare and maintain operational reports, ensuring effective tracking, monitoring, and resolution of outstanding invoice and payment issues.

  • Conduct research and recovery activities related to vendor credit balances, overpayments, and unapplied credits.

  • Respond to and resolve internal and external inquiries in a timely and professional manner, providing support to vendors, business stakeholders, and other finance teams.

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process gaps, root causes of recurring issues, and opportunities to enhance efficiency and controls within the PTP process.

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls, and service level agreements (SLAs) across all assigned activities.



Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

  • 1-3 years of experience in Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Accounts Payable, or a related finance operations environment.

  • Experience working with ERP systems is required; Oracle Fusion Cloud and/or SAP experience is highly preferred.

  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting, and reconciliation activities.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with vendors, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.

LET’S GO!

 

 

We’re looking for an energetic publicist who has a strong passion for news and an understanding of the media ecosystem! The right person for this position is a team player with strong media contacts and a strong ability to handle deadline pressure.
 
Responsibilities: 


•    Create and implement press strategies and develop timelines to maximize CBS News programming and talent profiles. 
•    Pitch to secure feature stories and talent interviews across a variety of media platforms and outlets, including online, print, talk shows, podcasts, and industry panels, among others.

Job Title: RtR Analyst – Cash & Banking

Location: Budapest, Hungary (Hybrid – 3 days remote / 2 days in our dog-friendly office)

About the Role Looking to build your accounting career in a fast-paced, global media environment? We are looking for a detail-oriented RtR Analyst – Cash & Banking to join our Budapest GBS Finance team.

As Skydance (formerly Paramount) builds a next-generation global entertainment powerhouse, our finance operations are evolving too. You will join us on an initial 1-year fixed-term contract (with a planned 1-year extension) to support key cash management operations and process standardization projects. This is a great opportunity to gain hands-on US GAAP, SAP, and BlackLine experience, work directly with global Treasury teams, and position yourself for long-term career opportunities within our growing Budapest hub.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Cash & Bank Operations: Perform daily and monthly bank reconciliations across multi-currency accounts, and investigate and resolve unallocated cash items and open clearing balances.

  • Month-End Close & US GAAP: Prepare and post cash-related journal entries, bank charges, interest postings, and intercompany cash settlements in line with US GAAP/IFRS standards.

  • Drive Automation & Process Improvement: Actively participate in optimizing automated cash-clearing rules in SAP and BlackLine as workflows transition into our GBS model.

  • Partner Across Finance: Liaise directly with Treasury, Accounts Payable (P2P), Accounts Receivable (O2C), and external auditors to resolve operational queries and maintain strong SOX compliance.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience: 1–3 years of hands-on accounting or finance experience (GL, Cash & Banking, AP/AR, or RtR) within an SSC/GBS or multinational environment.

  • Systems & Tools: Practical knowledge of Excel (Pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS) and experience with an ERP system (SAP is a strong plus). Familiarity with BlackLine is an advantage.

  • Accounting Fundamentals: Solid understanding of basic accounting principles, reconciliations, and month-end cut-off processes.

  • Mindset & Language: Proactive, structured problem-solver with high attention to detail, fluent English (B2/C1, written and spoken), and valid, unrestricted Hungarian work authorization (visa sponsorship and relocation assistance are not available for this role).

What We Offer in Budapest (From Day One)

  • Work-Life Balance & Office: Flexible hybrid working model (3 days Home Office / 2 days in our modern, dog-friendly Budapest office with weekly fresh fruit), generous paid time off, and commuting support in line with statutory regulations.

  • Financial Package: Monthly flexible Cafeteria budget, attractive employee referral bonus program, and a company mobile phone with mobile internet.

  • Health & Wellbeing: 100% employer-funded Allianz private health & accident insurance (with optional discounted coverage for family members), annual comprehensive health screenings, eyewear support, life & business travel insurance, plus a confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and global Employee Assistance Fund (EAF).

  • Learning & Development: Dedicated annual L&D budget for professional courses and conferences (post-probation), global online learning platform access, paid and unpaid study leave, and free language courses during working hours (post-probation in English, German, Spanish, French, or Hungarian).

  • Entertainment & Culture: Complimentary annual SkyShowtime and HBO Max subscriptions, exclusive pre-premiere movie screenings, and cross-team social events.

Note for Internal Applicants: Moving to a fixed-term assignment does not impact your permanent contract status. You will retain employment continuity and return to your previous or equivalent role upon completion.

job.title: SAMMA Digitizer
job.description:
CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS Evening News, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.  

 

Project Overview

The CBS News & Stations archive is one of the world’s largest and most valuable collections of its kind. Housing millions of original assets dating back to before the 1950s, it represents an extraordinary record of American history, journalism, culture, and broadcast media.

 

CBS News & Stations has launched a major initiative to digitize, catalog, and enrich more than 3 million film reels, videotapes, and audio reels. This initiative includes one of the largest robotic tape digitization operations in existence, paired with cloud-based systems and AI-supported metadata workflows operating at significant scale.

 

SAMMA is CBS News Archives’ robotic tape digitization system. It is used to migrate legacy videotape formats into digital files as part of the broader preservation and access initiative.

 

Position Summary

CBS News Archives is seeking SAMMA Digitization Operators to support this large-scale archive digitization initiative. These roles are part of the end-to-end digitization workflow, with an initial emphasis on preparing archival videotape media for migration through SAMMA digitization systems.

 

Primary responsibilities will initially include tape preparation, barcode application, tape identification, metadata entry, sorting, staging, workflow tracking, and ensuring a steady supply of prepared tapes for digitization. As operational needs evolve and training progresses, SAMMA Digitization Operators may also be assigned to operate SAMMA digitization systems, monitor ingest workflows, troubleshoot routine workflow issues, perform quality-control checks, and support related archive digitization activities, including film preparation and film digitization workflows.

 

The ideal candidates are detail-oriented, reliable, comfortable following specific workflows, and able to work carefully with physical media and metadata entry. Prior experience with broadcast archives, videotape formats, film handling, digitization, media asset management systems, or production operations is helpful, but not required if candidates are organized, trainable, and consistent.

 

Location, Hours, and Compensation

  • These positions are based onsite at the CBS News Archives facility in Metropark/Iselin, NJ.
  • Expected schedule is 40 hours per week. Hours may include nights and weekends depending on operational needs.
  • Hourly rate: $26.44 per hour, equivalent to $54,995.20 annually based on a 40-hour workweek.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the end-to-end archive digitization workflow, with an initial focus on SAMMA tape preparation and staging.
  • Prepare, barcode, label, sort, organize, and stage videotape media for digitization.
  • Enter and verify identifying metadata, including tape IDs, station IDs, dates, and other available information.
  • Follow established workflows for preparing Beta, U-matic, DVCPro, XDCAM, and other legacy videotape formats.
  • Identify and escalate unclear labels, missing metadata, damaged media, equipment concerns, or workflow questions.
  • Maintain accurate tracking of prep, staging, digitization, and workflow status.
  • Support daily production goals by ensuring media is prepared and available for digitization.
  • As trained and assigned, operate SAMMA robotic tape digitization systems and monitor digitization workflows.
  • Perform basic workflow checks and quality-control steps to confirm successful completion of assigned tasks.
  • As trained and assigned, support film preparation and film digitization workflows, including inspection, labeling, documentation, staging, and scanner support.
  • Handle videotape, film, and related archival media carefully to prevent damage or misplacement.
  • Follow all safety, handling, and operational procedures in the archive workspace.

 

Required Qualifications

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions carefully.
  • Comfortable performing repetitive but detail-sensitive work.
  • Basic computer skills, including data entry and use of web-based tools or spreadsheets.
  • Ability to read handwritten and printed labels and transcribe information accurately.
  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.
  • Ability to work independently once trained, while escalating questions when needed.
  • Comfortable handling physical media, boxes, labels, barcode scanners, and digitization-related equipment.
  • Ability to stand, sit, bend, and move throughout the workday as needed.
  • Ability to lift and move boxes of videotapes or film materials, typically up to approximately 25–35 lbs.
  • Availability to work onsite in Metropark/Iselin, NJ, including nights and weekends as operational needs require.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in archives, broadcast, libraries, records management, digitization, post-production, or a related media environment.
  • Familiarity with legacy media formats, including videotape and/or motion picture film.
  • Experience with barcode workflows, inventory systems, asset management systems, or media tracking tools.
  • Experience operating or supporting digitization, ingest, playback, scanning, or media migration systems.
  • Comfort working in a production-focused environment with daily throughput goals.
  • Interest in archive preservation, legacy media, and digitization workflows.

 

Skills and Attributes

  • Highly organized and methodical.
  • Patient and careful with legacy media.
  • Comfortable asking questions when instructions or media labels are unclear.
  • Able to maintain focus and accuracy over long periods of repetitive work.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Team-oriented, but capable of working independently.
  • Flexible and willing to adapt as workflows evolve.
  • Willing to be trained across multiple parts of the tape and film digitization workflows.

 

Work Environment

  • These positions are based onsite in an archive/digitization operations environment at the CBS News Archives facility in Metropark/Iselin, NJ. The work involves handling physical videotape, film, and related archival media; applying or scanning barcodes; entering metadata; staging media for digitization; operating or supporting SAMMA digitization workflows; supporting film prep and digitization workflows; and coordinating with Archives staff and digitization operators.
  • The roles support a high-volume digitization operation, so consistency, accuracy, dependability, and careful handling of archival media are critical.

 

Training

  • Training will be provided on CBS News Archives’ specific SAMMA workflows, barcode procedures, tape identification rules, prep and staging processes, digitization procedures, film preparation workflows, film handling procedures, and escalation processes for unclear, unknown, damaged, or problematic media.
  • Initial training and assignments may focus primarily on SAMMA tape preparation and staging. As employees demonstrate proficiency and as operational needs require, additional training may be provided for SAMMA digitization operation, workflow monitoring, basic troubleshooting, quality-control procedures, film preparation, and film digitization support.
  • Additional training and/or certification opportunities may be available as related workflows and partnerships continue to develop.

Job Title: Senior Front-End Developer (AI-Augmented Engineering) Team: Global Quality Engineering (GQE)
Location: New York City, Los Angeles, San Francisco   Overview Paramount Skydance Corp. is seeking a Senior Front-End Developer to lead the development of high-performance, user-centric web applications that power the next generation of Quality Engineering platforms. This is a modern engineering role designed for a developer who has mastered the balance between expert-level coding and advanced AI-assisted development. In this role, you will not just write code; you will orchestrate it. You will leverage modern AI tooling—such as Claude Code, Gemini Code Assist, and GitHub Copilot—to accelerate delivery while acting as the ultimate authority on architectural integrity, security, and compliance. As part of the QE Innovation team, you will build the interfaces that streamline automation workflows and surface quality insights across the entire enterprise.   Key Responsibilities

 AI-Driven Application Development ● Accelerated Engineering: Design and build high-quality React applications using TypeScript. Use modern UI patterns and AI tools to improve coding efficiency. This includes optimizing boilerplate code, refactoring, and making feature development faster. ● Human-in-the-Loop Oversight: Act as the primary filter for AI-generated output. You must meticulously monitor, audit, and correct code produced by AI to ensure it adheres to Paramount Skydance’s strict architectural standards and security protocols. ● Design-to-Code Mastery: Rapidly translate Figma design comps into reusable UI components and design systems, leveraging AI to bridge the gap between design intent and production-ready code.

Platform & Tooling Innovation ● Build the front-end for internal QE platforms, including automation dashboards, triage tools, and AI-assisted testing interfaces. ● Implement real-time data visualizations and telemetry streams, ensuring that even complex, AI-curated data is presented with clarity and performance. Quality, Security & Compliance ● Validation and Verification: Ensure that all code, whether created by humans or AI, meets high standards. This includes performance, WCAG accessibility, and reliability. ● Security First: Audit AI suggestions for potential vulnerabilities, ensuring that sensitive data handling and API interactions remain compliant with enterprise security standards. ● Automated Testing: Implement robust testing strategies (Jest, Cypress, Playwright) to provide a safety net for rapid, AI-assisted iterations.
Required Qualifications ● 7+ years of professional experience in front-end or full-stack development. ● AI Tooling Fluency: Demonstrated "must-have" experience using Claude Code, Gemini Code Assist, or equivalent LLM-based coding agents to deliver complex features. ● Expert React & TypeScript: Deep proficiency in React Hooks, state management (Zustand, Redux, or Context), and component-driven design. ● Critical Oversight Capability: A solid ability to identify errors or bad patterns in AI-generated code. Can manually correct these issues to meet senior-level engineering standards. ● Security & Architecture: Proficient in secure front-end development according to OWASP standards. Knowledge of browser performance and scalable architectural patterns.

Preferred Qualifications ● Experience building developer productivity tools or internal engineering dashboards. ● Familiarity with data visualization (D3.js, Recharts) and real-time interfaces (WebSockets). ● Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) and CI/CD workflows.   Key Competencies ● AI-Augmented Execution: The ability to achieve 10x output by effectively prompting and managing AI agents without sacrificing code quality. ● Architectural Rigor: A refusal to accept "working code" if it violates long-term maintainability or security standards. ● Systems Thinking: Understanding how front-end applications integrate with complex backend data pipelines and AI-driven quality insights.   Success Metrics ● Velocity & Quality: Delivery of high-quality features at an accelerated pace through the expert application of AI tooling. ● Standardization: Successful implementation of reusable patterns that pass all security and architectural audits. ● Efficiency: Significant reduction in manual UI development time through the adoption of AI-assisted workflows.   #LI-JC1    

Paramount+, a direct-to-consumer digital subscription video on-demand and live streaming service from Paramount Global, combines live sports, breaking news, and a mountain of entertainment. The premium streaming service features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including BET, CBS, Comedy Central, MTV, Nickelodeon, Paramount Pictures and the Smithsonian Channel. The service is also the streaming home to unmatched sports programming, including every CBS Sports event, from golf to football to basketball and more, plus exclusive streaming rights for major sports properties, including some of the world’s biggest and most popular soccer leagues. Paramount+ also enables subscribers to stream local CBS stations live across the U.S. in addition to the ability to stream Paramount Streaming’s other live channels: CBSN for 24/7 news, CBS Sports HQ for sports news and analysis, and ET Live for entertainment coverage.

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Content Engineering
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

  Overview   We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead the development of our multimodal embedding and retrieval systems that power content discovery across Paramount's video library. In this role, you will own the full lifecycle of multi-modal embedding systems, optimized for text and video understanding, from generation, ingestion and indexing, to retrieval — directly impacting how millions of users discover and engage with short-form clips.   You will partner with product leadership, Content and Personalization engineering teams, mentor engineers and serve as a senior technical voice shaping how the platform "sees" and retrieves video clip content at scale.   The ideal candidate will be:
  • A hands-on systems builder who takes full ownership of pipelines that enable storing, indexing, and querying high-dimensional vector embeddings
  • Skilled at designing hybrid retrieval systems that combine vector similarity, lexical search, and reranking
  • Invested in multimodal video understanding as the foundation for meaningful content representations
  • Skilled at translating embedding system tradeoffs — latency, recall, cost — into product-relevant context that drives cross-functional decisions
  • Committed to mentoring and knowledge sharing with engineering resources
  • Effective at operating in a dynamic environment and comfortable taking ownership of project outcomes end-to-end


Responsibilities

Video Understanding & Multimodal Embedding

  • Design and build embedding pipelines for video content metadata and clip-level representation
  • Design collection and vector schemas to shape data structure, indexing behavior, and retrieval performance under scale and modality complexity
  • Lead the transition from traditional feature engineering to a vector-centric "context-first" architecture, through compositional queries and by designing high-dimensional hyper-vector representations that unify visual, textual, and behavioral signals
  • Design offline/online evaluation frameworks (e.g., nDCG, MRR, Recall@K) specifically for multimodal alignment, ensuring content embeddings match search intent
  Vector Search & Retrieval Infrastructure
  • Build hybrid retrieval systems that combine vector similarity search with lexical search and reranking layers to deliver fast, accurate, and scalable performance at production scale
  • Engineer the retrieval layer to capture nuanced user-content relationships that model training alone cannot surface, combining multimodal embeddings to improve recommendation depth at scale
  • Implement query-time optimizations including caching, filtering, and index sharding strategies
  • Tune vector quantization strategies (PQ, SQ, Binary Quantization) to reduce memory footprint and improve search throughput without compromising retrieval precision
  • Own performance SLAs and monitor retrieval systems for latency, throughput, recall, and cost efficiency
  Production Systems, Pipeline Engineering & APIs
  • Build and maintain scalable batch and streaming pipelines, with logging, metrics, and alerting to surface anomalies and maintain observability
  • Process content at scale using distributed frameworks such as Spark or Ray
  • Architect and build scalable integration layers on top of vector databases, exposing robust APIs and services for similarity search, hybrid retrieval, and metadata filtering
  • Own model versioning and embedding migration strategies, building compatibility tooling that prevents embedding drift from degrading retrieval quality across model upgrades
  • Collaborate with backend and platform teams to ensure interoperability with upstream data pipelines and integration with downstream personalization and discovery surfaces
  Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration
  • Communicate technical system behavior, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor direct reports, providing technical guidance in multimodal ML, vector retrieval, and production systems design
  • Take ownership of project outcomes from scoping through delivery in a dynamic environment, proactively identifying and mitigating risks across video processing, metadata, and indexing workflows


Basic Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, with a focus on production ML systems
  • Expertise in multimodal ML, including experience with video, image, and/or audio embedding models
  • Deep knowledge of vector embedding generation, storage and retrieval, with preference for hands-on Qdrant experience (FAISS, Pinecone, Pgvector, AlloyDB or similar also considered)
  • Strong Python proficiency; Java is a plus
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating data pipelines at scale, including batch and streaming ingestion workflows
  • Solid understanding of hybrid retrieval systems: vector search, lexical search, and reranking
  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and partner effectively with product and engineering teams
  • Track record of mentoring engineers and leading technical decisions in a team setting


Additional Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic systems and multi-agent orchestration
  • Knowledge of Diversity & Relevance algorithms such as Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) within the re-ranking phase
  • Background in video codecs, FFmpeg, or low-level video processing pipelines
  • Awareness with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems

job.description:

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. Overview

 We're hiring a Senior Machine Learning Operations Engineer to own the operational layer around our personalization and recommendation Machine Learning (ML) systems. Our models retrain and deploy daily on automated pipelines. Your job is to make sure we can trust what's running, know when something is off, and fix it fast. You'll sit within DevOps and work closely with ML engineers, who own the models end-to-end. You won't be building infrastructure from scratch, you'll partner with DevOps and Platform Engineering to get the tooling you need, then own it day-to-day.

What You'll Do
  • Own model traceability: Every model in production should have clear lineage: what data trained it, what code produced it, what validation it passed, and how it's performing. Evaluate and recommend tooling for versioning, metadata, and model registry, and work with MLEs to drive adoption.
  • Build end-to-end monitoring: Monitor the full signal path: data arrival, feature distribution stability, model metrics, and serving latency against SLA. Own this individually, don't rely solely on upstream teams to catch their own issues.
  • Partner with Data Engineering on data quality: Collaborate to surface data quality issues, detect drift in upstream sources, and ensure features stay fresh and reliable.
  • Detect issues proactively: Track drift over weeks, flag slow degradation before it crosses a threshold, surface feature freshness problems before they cascade.
  • Build diagnostic tooling: When something goes wrong, get from "recommendations look off" to root cause in minutes. That means ensuring the right context is logged at each stage, candidates, features, serving context, and building the dashboards to tie it collectively.
  • Own incident response for ML systems: Maintain rollback playbooks and pre-defined hotfix strategies with quantified tradeoffs. Own automated gates that block bad deployments. Run post-mortems and close the gaps.
  • Coordinate on post-deployment metrics: Work with ML engineers, data engineers, and stakeholders to define what metrics to collect after deployment and why they matter.


Basic Qualifications
  • 5+ years in ML engineering, applied ML, or a related ML role, with demonstrated experience on the operational side of monitoring, reliability, deployment, or incident response
  • Has built or operated model registries, ML monitoring systems, or production ML pipelines
  • Understands ML systems end-to-end — not just the infra layer, but why a stale feature or a shifted distribution matters
  • Robust SQL skills and comfort digging into data distributions, feature health, and model behavior
  • Comfortable partnering with DevOps and Platform teams to define infrastructure needs without needing to own the infra yourself


Additional Qualifications

  • Experience operating recommendation or personalization systems at scale
