We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

The Senior Social Media Producer will produce, write, and edit social media content and copy for 60 MINUTES across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X and YouTube. This content will need to adhere to 60 Minutes' overarching style, while also demonstrating an awareness for the modern best practices of each specific social platform. The Senior Social Media Producer will film with talent, screen 60 Minutes pieces and suggest which clips they feel will perform best on social. They should also be proactively pitching original social content ideas, in innovative formats, to complement what appears on the broadcast.  


The ideal candidate will have at least 6-10 years of hard news production experience with advanced editing skills and the ability to write copy that adheres to our high standards of style and syntax. They should be knowledgable about the larger news cycle and constantly abreast of current events, so they can suggest timely and relevant posts from the 60 Minutes archives. 

 

The Senior Social Media Producer must collaborate well, and drive results among matrixed cross-functional teams where there is not always direct reporting authority. A successful candidate will understand the heritage of the broadcast, and how the past informs how we approach the future. Finally, they should be able to work flexible hours, including nights and weekends, as the broadcast production schedule dictates.


Education:
•   BA/BS in Journalism, Communications or related is preferred
•   Equivalent experience is acceptable
Qualifications:
•   A minimum of 6-10 years of TV news, show producer and/or social media experience
•   Ability to partner and work across internal departments and teams to execute flawlessly
•   Position demands extremely strong editorial judgement and impeccable creative writing ability.
•   Position requires highly developed relationship building skills, from pitching concepts to execution and measurement.
•   Candidate should possess ability to multi-task and excel in a dynamic, quickly changing environment.
•   A strong sense of editorial fairness, and a keen understanding of the stakes of
producing accurate copy and content.
•   Video and photo editing skills are a must.
•   Expertise on Adobe Premiere and Photoshop and/or Avid to create, reformat, and edit content optimized for success on social media platforms.
•   Ability to understand breaking news platforms and obtain rights and clearances for various media usages.
•   Understanding of TV production process and workflows, and how social media content drives and supports audience loyalty and growth.
•   Candidate should anticipate occasionally irregular hours as breaking news cycles and broadcast workflows dictate.

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Tooling & Quality Engineering Platforms

Location: New York City, Los Angeles, San FranciscoOverview

 

Paramount Skydance Corp. is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design and build
advanced AI‑powered tooling and internal platforms that modernize quality engineering across
the organization. This is not an “in test” role — you will be building production systems,
internal platforms, and intelligent automation services that materially improve engineering
efficiency. You will lead the development of AI‑driven services, RAG pipelines, and automation
accelerators that streamline test authoring, triage, and analysis.

 

Key Responsibilities
● Architect and implement AI‑driven services, micro‑platforms, and developer tools that
support GQE.
● Build and optimize RAG pipelines, embeddings systems, and LLM‑powered utilities.
● Develop intelligent automation accelerators that classify failures, detect flakiness, and
recommend fixes.
● Integrate AI capabilities into CI/CD pipelines and existing automation frameworks.
● Partner with QE, Platform, and Data Engineering to define requirements and deliver
scalable solutions.
● Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards and best practices.
● Evaluate emerging AI technologies and propose useful applications.

 

Qualifications
● 4+ years of software engineering experience with robust backend expertise.
● Proven experience building production‑grade AI or ML‑powered systems.
● Strong knowledge of distributed systems, microservices, and cloud platforms.
● Hands‑on experience with vector databases, embeddings, and LLM orchestration.
● Experience integrating tools into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows.
● Strong communication and cross‑functional collaboration skills.

 

Key Competencies
● Technical leadership within a team.
● Strong architectural judgment and design skills.
● Ability to break down complex problems and deliver scalable solutions.
● Mentorship and uplift of junior engineers.

 

Success Metrics
● Delivery of scalable AI tooling adopted across multiple GQE teams.
● Measurable reduction in triage time and improved automation signal quality.

● Strong technical influence and mentorship impact.

job.description:

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced.   Job Title: Senior Software Engineer in Test Team: Global Quality Engineering Location: New York City, Los Angeles, San Francisco   Overview Paramount Skydance Corp. is seeking a Senior Software Engineer in Test to design, architect, and deliver high-quality, scalable, and reliable automated testing solutions across our enterprise platforms. This role requires proficient skills in Java engineering. It also requires experience in advanced test automation and knowledge of the media and streaming industry. You will use modern CI/CD practices to improve quality and reduce risk. Your work will help provide great customer experiences on CTV, SmartTV, mobile, and web platforms. As a member of the Global Quality Engineering (GQE) organization, you will utilize our existing departmental automation framework, help drive quality strategies, and mentor engineers across GQE to elevate testing maturity and engineering excellence. You will also leverage AI-augmented development and testing practices using Claude Code, GitHub Copilot (in-IDE), Cursor, and similar tools.   Key Responsibilities   Create Robust & Reliable Automation Coverage across front-end and back-end • Create and maintain automated tests using our existing Java-based departmental test automation framework supporting API, UI, Mobile, CTV/SmartTV, and integration testing; introduce reusable libraries, utilities, and patterns to improve stability and scale. • Utilize scalable patterns for reusable test components, data management, assertions, parallelization, and distributed execution. • Integrate the framework deeply into CI/CD pipelines to support shift-left testing and continuous quality.   AI-Augmented Quality Engineering • Champion AI-assisted development and testing using tools such as GitHub Copilot (IDE), Cursor, and LLM-based assistants to improve developer productivity, test authoring velocity, code reviews, and defect triage. • Apply prompt engineering and retrieval techniques to accelerate test case generation, log/telemetry summarization, video-quality anomaly detection, and root-cause analysis. • Evaluate and integrate functional AI capabilities that measurably reduce flakiness, false positives, and triage time within the existing framework.   Media & Multi-Platform Quality • Expand automation coverage for video playback, streaming resiliency, DRM flows, SSAI/CSAI ad insertion, captions/subtitles, and content protection. • Validate QoE metrics (startup time, rebuffering ratio, frame drops, video/audio sync, error recovery) across Roku, Fire TV, Android TV/Google TV, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Apple TV, iOS/Android mobile apps, and modern web players. • Leverage media tooling such as ffmpeg/ffprobe, Charles/Fiddler, and player inspection APIs for diagnostics and validation. • Ensure consistent adoption of engineering best practices, coding standards, and high-quality test development patterns.   Cross Functional Collaboration • Partner with Video Engineering, Playback/Player, Ads/Monetization, CDN/Streaming Operations, and Platform teams to ensure robust validation of streaming experiences and ad workflows. • Collaborate with Product to ensure test coverage aligns to business priorities and quality goals. • Work closely with Platform and Data Engineering to support scalable test environments, quality data, and telemetry.   Technical Execution • Design and implement complex automated test suites using Java, Selenium, Appium, JMeter, Locust, REST-Assured, TestNG/JUnit, and related tooling within the existing framework. • Build and optimize testing strategies including API/contract, integration, performance/reliability, and device-level testing for CTV/SmartTV, mobile, and web. • Diagnose and tackle issues related to automation reliability, environment instability, device fragmentation, and system integration.   Required Qualifications • 6+ years of experience in software engineering or quality engineering with solid Java development expertise. • Demonstrated experience using and enhancing an existing enterprise/departmental automation framework. • Deep expertise in common test automation tools (Selenium, Appium, Playwright, REST-Assured, TestNG, JUnit, Maven/Gradle). • AI experience (must-have): hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools. This includes tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot (IDE), Cursor, or similar. Candidates should also have useful prompt engineering skills for code and tests. LLMs are leveraged for tasks such as generating tests, suggesting code reviews, summarizing logs, and speeding up triage. • Strong knowledge of CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo, Spinnaker) and quality gates. • Proven experience testing media/streaming applications across CTV (Roku, Fire TV, Android TV/Google TV), SmartTV (Tizen/webOS), iOS/Android mobile, and web. • Hands-on validation of HLS/DASH, ABR, DRM, captions/subtitles, and QoE metrics. • Cloud experience (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). • Solid knowledge of software design patterns, data structures, and core engineering principles.   Preferred Qualifications • Familiarity with observability and APM tools (Grafana, Prometheus, NewRelic, DataDog) and media telemetry(Conviva, MUX, NPAW etc). • Experience with contract testing (PACT), service virtualization, or synthetic media test data. • Exposure to CTV/SmartTV automation stacks and remote device labs.   Key Competencies • Quality mindset – commitment to reliability, maintainability, and continuous improvement. • AI fluency – practical judgment on where AI adds measurable value in testing. • Systems thinking – understanding distributed systems and complex media pipelines.   Success Metrics • Increased automation coverage across CTV/SmartTV, mobile, and web; reduced manual regression. • Measurable reduction in escaped defects and media playback incidents. • Improved stability and reliability of automated pipelines and device runs. • Faster release cycles through scalable, AI-augmented automation. • Broad adoption and consistent usage of the GQE test framework across teams.   #LI-JC1

job.title: Senior Software Engineer - CTV
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Senior Software Engineer, Smart TV/CTV 

 

Location: New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale


Overview


You’ll build and ship Paramount’s Smart TV applications across Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, and other CTV
platforms. These apps run on web-based runtimes with tight memory budgets, limited CPU, and hardware that
varies by model year and price point. You’ll write React and TypeScript that performs within those constraints.
You’ll own features from concept through certification. You’ll work with central video engineering, external
platform partners, and Product/Design to deliver what millions of viewers see on the biggest screen in the
house.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain application components for Paramount’s Smart TV apps using React and
    TypeScript
  • Optimize application performance on resource-constrained CTV devices. Profile rendering, measure
    memory, fix what’s slow
  • Collaborate with central video engineering teams to integrate and optimize video players across platforms
  • Work with external platform partners (Samsung, LG, and others) to develop, debug, and certify
    applications
  • Manage application state with Redux and RTK. Keep the store clean and selectors fast as the app grows
  • Write clean, tested code and participate in code reviews. Hold your teammates to the same standard
  • Coordinate with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to turn requirements into working features
  • Work across multiple agile teams and contribute to all phases of the development cycle
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines and testing infrastructure for multi-platform Smart TV deployments
  • Document components, platform-specific patterns, and technical decisions
  • Use AI development tools to move faster and share what works with the team

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years writing software
  • 2+ years building Smart TV or CTV applications on web-based platforms (Tizen, webOS, or similar)
  • BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • React and TypeScript. You build components, not just consume them
  • State management with Redux and RTK. You understand store shape, middleware, and when selectors
    cause unnecessary re-renders
  • Client-side routing patterns (React Router or equivalent)
  • Front-end fundamentals: HTML, CSS, modern JavaScript. You can debug layout and rendering issues on
    a TV runtime
  • You’ve taken features from concept through delivery on CTV platforms, including certification
  • CI/CD environments with DevOps and SRE principles
  • RESTful API integration and data handling
  • You communicate technical decisions in writing and in conversation. People act on what you say because
    it’s clear
  • You use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to write and ship code faster

 

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with multiple CTV platforms (Tizen, webOS, Vizio, Xbox, PlayStation, or others)
  • Performance optimization on TV devices: profiling, memory measurement, rendering analysis. You know
    how to find the bottleneck, not just guess
  • Browser internals knowledge: rendering pipelines, compositing, layout thrashing, and how these behave
    on TV runtimes vs. desktop browsers
  • Video player integration experience (Shaka, hls.js, or native platform players)
  • Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry, or similar
  • Experience working in Agile frameworks across distributed teams and time zones
  • Rapid proof-of-concept experience. You’ve built throwaway prototypes to answer hard questions fast
  • Enthusiasm for sharing AI tools and workflows that save the team time
  • You care about UX on the 10-foot screen and you’ll push back when something isn’t right
  • You say “I don’t know” when you don’t know

 

What Good Looks Like

  • You open a Smart TV codebase you’ve never seen, connect a Tizen emulator, and start diagnosing a
    rendering issue the same afternoon
  • Other engineers read your code and understand it without a walkthrough
  • You spot a memory leak on a 2020-era LG TV before QA files a ticket. You fix it and write up what
    happened
  • When a certification submission fails, you read the rejection, fix the issue, and flag what the team should
    check next time
  • You own your features end to end. From scoping through deployment, you don’t wait for someone to tell
    you what’s next
  • You know which React patterns cause jank on low-end CTV hardware. You avoid them and explain why to
    teammates who ask
  • You push back when a plan has gaps. You suggest a better approach
  • You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features
  • You help your teammates get better. Through code reviews, pairing, or writing things down so the next
    person doesn’t hit the same wall

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER — ROKU

 

Location: On-Site - New York / Los Angeles / San Francisco / Ft. Lauderdale

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

You'll build and ship the Paramount+ Roku application used by millions of viewers. The Roku platform has constraints other platforms don't: tight memory budgets, a single-threaded render loop, device hardware that ranges from flagship to five years old. You'll solve problems inside those constraints.

 

We write software that's simple to read, cheap to maintain, and built to last. You'll own features from design through deployment, work across agile teams, and help other engineers get better at this work.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

• Design, build, and maintain core Roku framework components and application features for Paramount+

• Architect around Roku's constraints: memory limits, render-thread/task-thread boundaries, device performance tiers, and certification requirements

• Use RSG 1.3 data transfer APIs, BrightScript Memory Monitor, and Perfetto tracing to find and fix performance problems before users hit them

• Build real-time personalization and engagement features — personalized recommendations, dynamic artwork, ad engagement — within Roku's memory and performance budgets

• Write clear documentation for components, architecture decisions, and platform-specific patterns

• Measure and improve application performance and stability through instrumentation and observability

• Work across agile teams and coordinate with backend engineering and DevOps/SRE on service builds and deploys

• Review code, pair with teammates, and raise the quality bar across the team

• Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and testing infrastructure

• Design and run A/B tests, then act on what the data says

• Use AI development tools to move faster and share what works with the team

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

• 6+ years writing software

• 3+ years building Roku applications

• BS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience

• You know OOP, data structures, and algorithms well enough to design systems, not just pass interviews

• BrightScript and SceneGraph SDK, including RSG 1.3

• You can explain Roku's memory model, the render-thread/task-thread split, device tiers, and what certification requires

• RESTful API design and data serialization

• Roku frameworks and services: RAF, RMF, RokuPay

• Unit and integration testing on Roku

• HTTP protocol and caching behavior

• Git and GitHub

• You write and speak about technical decisions in a way that helps people act on them

• You use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to write and ship code faster

 

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

• BrighterScript and Roku community tooling (ropm, bslint, roku-debug)

• Other OTT platforms: Fire TV, Android TV, Apple TV, Samsung TV, LG webOS

• Observability tools: Conviva, New Relic, Datadog, Sentry

• Microservices and backend-for-frontend patterns

• You've worked with personalization or recommendation APIs on resource-constrained devices

• E2E testing for connected-device applications

• Docker and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins or similar)

• GraphQL

• You share AI tools and workflows that save the team time

• You care about UX enough to push back on Product and Design when something isn't right

• You say "I don't know" when you don't know

• You've worked across time zones without waiting for meetings to unblock you

 

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

 

• You open a 200-file BrightScript repo you've never seen and start making changes the same day

• Other engineers read your code and understand it without a walkthrough

• You notice a memory spike on a Roku Express before QA files a ticket. You fix it and write up what happened

• You track Roku OS releases and adopt new APIs when they solve a real problem, not because they're new

• You write architecture docs, component guides, and Slack explanations that save ten people from asking the same question

• You push back when a plan has gaps. You suggest a better one

• You treat the build pipeline, test coverage, and error monitoring like product features

• You make the people around you better at their jobs

  • Open to learn new programing languages, 

  • Enjoy working in a team,   

  • Easily and openly communicate in English.

  • 5+ years of experience in software development, build automation, delivery and deployment 

  • Very good understanding of concepts like CI/CD, GitOps, configuration management, cloud platforms, version control, automation, monitoring, analytics, containerization, and microservices architecture

  • Experienced in containers orchestration in Kubernetes, 

  • Deep knowledge and practical experience managing Cloud infrastructure. OCI is a huge plus. 

  • Experience standing up and maintaining Windows and Linux VMs

Production Ownership

  • Ensure monitoring, runbooks, deployment procedures, rollback plans, and escalation paths are in place.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and corrective action for recurring defects and reliability issues.
  • Maintain clear boundaries between frontline operational support and engineering escalation.

And on the technical side, we need:

job.title: Sr. Digital Producer
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Overview:

CBS News Growth & Engagement team is looking for a Senior Digital Producer to help shape how we tell stories on YouTube and other digital platforms. Were looking for a skilled video editor with a creative eye, strong editorial instincts and a knack for finding fresh ways to tell stories. From developing original series and experimenting with new concepts to finding unique angles on the biggest news stories, you will create videos that give audiences more reasons to watch CBS News channels on YouTube.   You will take ideas from pitch to final cut, writing scripts, producing shoots and getting hands-on in the edit to create engaging videos that stand out on the platform. This position is onsite Monday through Friday, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Edit original videos, using color correction, sound mixing, graphics integration, visual effects and other post-production techniques to create polished, engaging content.
  • Pitch original YouTube videos and repeatable series based on breaking news, audience interests and compelling stories, using analytics to inform ideas and maximize engagement
  • Collaborate across teams to produce interviews with correspondents, experts and other sources, writing scripts and providing guidance for shoots
  • Repurpose long-form reporting and video into snackable YouTube Shorts and social clips
  • Work with the Graphics department to create clear, engaging visuals that support the story and align with the brand
  • Partner with editors to refine scripts, review cuts and ensure videos are accurate, visually compelling and ready for publication; work with Rights & Clearances, Legal and Standards teams as needed to confirm content is cleared and compliant
  • Write compelling, accurate and error-free titles and descriptions; optimize chapters, tags and other metadata to extend each video reach
  • Monitor YouTube performance and audience behavior, with a focus on retention, using those insights to inform future story selection and video packaging
  • Stay up to date on YouTube formats, audience trends and platform best practices, identifying opportunities to experiment with new storytelling styles to grow the channel's audience
  • Draft and send breaking news and segmented push alerts across platforms, including app, desktop, OTT, email, text and instant messages and for partner platforms.
  • Help coordinate detailed rollout plans across departments for specials, documentaries and other major news events, creating and executing a promotional plan (crafting push copy, prewriting articles and video heds/deks, etc.)

 

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience producing content in a fast-paced digital media environment
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, with a strong portfolio of video editing work
  • Familiarity with Adobe After Effects and motion graphics is a plus
  • Strong understanding of media production workflows, including asset management and production platforms
  • Strong interest in breaking news and current events, with an eye for compelling stories and trends
  • Exemplary writing and self-editing skills, with the ability to draft copy quickly and accurately while exercising strong editorial judgment
  • Proficiency with analytics platforms, including YouTube Studio, Adobe Analytics, Chartbeat, and similar tools

 

 


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. job.title: Sr. Product Designer
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

 

Discipline: Design | Team Model: Embedded on a cross-functional CBS Sports App squad

Location: New York, NY

 

The Mission

CBS Sports is the digital stadium for millions of fans. We hold the rights to the biggest moments in sports—NFL, UEFA Champions League, March Madness, the Masters, and UFC. We aren't just a scoreboard; we’re a massive content engine of fantasy leagues, live video, and deep journalism. We’re looking for a Lead Product Designer to join a small, cross-functional squad that operates with the speed of a startup and the scale of a legacy giant.

 

The Role: Build and Own

You won’t just work on a product; you’ll own the design outcomes from first framing through ship. We believe in a builder culture where designers aren't waiting for handoffs or research gates. You will:

  • Own the Project: Take full responsibility for your product squad’s design outcomes. You lead the direction from initial concept to the final shipped experience.

  • Build Constantly: Prototype early and often. We use AI tools (like Cursor or Claude) to visualize ideas and test interactions before they hit engineering, letting us move faster than ever.

  • Lead with Visual Craft: We need designers who bring energy, taste, and dynamic design sensibilities. Whether it’s motion that obeys physics or layouts that capture the intensity of game day, your work should set the bar for the squad.

  • Shape the Product: You’ll trade honest, real-time feedback with engineers and PMs. We don't just "deliver" designs; we shape products in the build.

 

Core Capabilities

  • Visual Design: You have a refined eye for type hierarchy, layouts, and intuitive UI/UX. You deliver high-impact, immersive designs for complex app systems that capture the intensity of game day and live sports.

  • Motion & Interactivity: You understand motion as a logical system. Your designs feel tactile, precise, and alive.

  • Fluency in Native Design: You have deep experience with mobile paradigms (iOS/Android). You know how to leverage native capabilities to elevate the user experience.

  • Owner Mindset: You treat research as a velocity tool, not a gate. You use your intuition, analytics, and direct fan feedback to make smart product decisions quickly.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of end-to-end product design experience.

  • A portfolio showing shipped consumer work on mobile apps or web (required).

  • Comfort moving across prototyping, production, and interaction design without handoffs.

 

Additional Qualifications

  • Passion for sports, betting, live events, or broadcast media.

  • Experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows.

  • Contributions to a design system.

 


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

job.title: SVP, Finance Innovation
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview: 

The Senior Vice President, Finance Innovation is a newly created, high-visibility leadership role responsible for reimagining how the Finance organization operates through the application of artificial intelligence and agentic automation. This role will identify, champion, and implement AI-driven opportunities across the Finance function, with a particular focus on building agentic workflows and AI systems capable of autonomously executing multi-step financial processes with human oversight, across Accounting, Forecasting & FP&A, Treasury, Tax, and operational finance areas unique to a media and entertainment enterprise, including Production Finance and Participations & Residuals. This leader will serve as the bridge between Finance, Technology, and Data/AI teams, translating complex financial processes into scalable, intelligent automation while maintaining rigorous controls, auditability, and compliance standards appropriate for a large public company. The successful candidate will combine deep finance domain expertise with a strong point of view on emerging AI capabilities, and the organizational influence to drive adoption across a broad and often decentralized finance ecosystem. As Finance advances its Fusion systems integration, this leader will be a key voice in shaping how that effort intersects with Finance's broader innovation and automation agenda.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Define and lead the enterprise Finance Innovation strategy and multi-year roadmap for AI and agentic workflow adoption across all Finance sub-functions.
  • Partner with the CFO organization and Finance leadership to identify, prioritize, and business-case AI opportunities based on value creation, risk profile, and feasibility. 
  • Build and maintain a prioritized pipeline of use cases spanning close and consolidation, reconciliations, forecasting and variance analysis, cash and liquidity management, tax provision and compliance, and production finance/participations & residuals calculations and reporting.
  • Stay ahead of the external AI and finance-technology landscape (agentic frameworks, LLM-based finance copilots, RPA-to-agentic evolution) and translate relevant developments into actionable internal opportunities.
  • Partner with Product, Technology, Data & Analytics, and external delivery partners on agentic workflow and AI-tool initiatives as the Finance domain voice, defining use cases, finance requirements, and success criteria, and providing continuous feedback through design, build, and deployment. Product and Technology direct solution design, engineering, and production deployment; this role ensures what gets built reflects finance process reality and business need.
  • Own finance-side accountability across the delivery lifecycle: opportunity identification and prioritization, requirements definition, controls and change management within Finance, driving adoption, and validating realized value while Product and Technology own solution design, build, and rollout execution.
  • Specify the finance control requirements agentic systems must meet: human-in-the-loop oversight, exception handling, and escalation, and validate that the frameworks Product and Technology implement keep those systems within Finance's risk, controls, and SOX/regulatory boundaries. 
  • Convene Internal Audit, SOX, and Compliance to define the control and documentation standards AI-driven finance processes must satisfy, and carry those requirements into the Product and Technology build so solutions meet public-company standards.
  • Partner closely with the EVP of Integration on systems integration work related to Fusion, ensuring Finance requirements, controls, and adoption considerations are represented as Fusion capabilities are integrated into Finance systems and processes.
  • Accounting & Close: Identify opportunities for agentic automation in journal entries, reconciliations, close checklists, and financial reporting. 
  • Forecasting & FP&A: Champion AI-augmented forecasting, scenario modeling, and variance analysis to improve speed and accuracy of business planning.
  • Treasury: Explore agentic support for cash positioning, liquidity forecasting, bank reconciliations, and risk monitoring.
  • Tax: Identify AI applications in tax provision, compliance documentation, and regulatory research and monitoring. 
  • Production Finance: Drive automation of production cost tracking, budget-to-actual analysis, and studio/content cost reporting specific to media production.
  • Participations & Residuals: Champion agentic solutions for the complex, high-volume calculations, contract interpretation, and reporting inherent to participations and residuals processing. 
  • Serve as a visible champion and educator for AI adoption, building Finance-wide fluency and comfort with agentic tools through training, communication, and hands-on enablement.
  • Develop governance structures, including an AI use-case intake process and a Finance Innovation council or working group with representation across Finance sub-functions.
  • Partner with HR and Finance leadership to evolve talent, role design, and ways of working as agentic workflows shift the nature of finance work.
  • Manage change resistance thoughtfully, ensuring adoption is durable and supported by the broader finance organization rather than imposed top-down. Stakeholder Management & Reporting
  • Regularly report progress, value delivered, and roadmap updates to executive leadership, including the CFO and relevant Audit/Risk committees as appropriate.
  • Build strong relationships with Technology, Data/AI, Legal, business-unit finance leaders, and the EVP of Integration to ensure alignment and shared ownership of innovation initiatives, including Fusion-related systems integration work. 
  • Represent the company's Finance Innovation agenda in relevant internal forums and, where appropriate, external industry settings.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field required; MBA, CPA, or equivalent advanced credential preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive finance, accounting, or FP&A experience, ideally within a large, complex, public media, entertainment, or content organization. 
  • Demonstrated track record leading finance transformation, process automation, or technology-enabled change initiatives at scale. 
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI/ML concepts, generative AI, and agentic or RPA-based automation, and how they apply to financial processes; direct experience implementing such tools strongly preferred.
  • Experience with production finance and/or participations and residuals processes is a plus given the specialized nature of these areas in media and entertainment.
  • Prior exposure to SOX controls, internal audit requirements, and the governance considerations of deploying automation in a public-company financial environment. 

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong finance and accounting fundamentals combined with genuine curiosity about, and fluency in, emerging AI capabilities.
  • Executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Finance, Technology, and business units without direct authority over all of them.
  • Proven ability to translate technical AI/automation concepts into business terms finance professionals can act on, and vice versa.
  • Strong program and change management skills, with comfort operating in ambiguity and building new organizational muscle from scratch.
  • Sound judgment regarding risk, controls, and the appropriate pace and boundaries of automation in regulated financial processes.

 


About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

job.title: Technical Automation Engineer
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.
If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

  Overview Paramount Global is seeking a Technical Automation Engineer / Architect to join the Technology Operations team, focused on automation, scripting, and broadcast systems integration. You will integrate broadcast infrastructure with Skyline DataMiner and other key applications. You will also create intelligent automation using AI. This will help reduce manual operational tasks. You will use your broadcast engineering knowledge along with your experience in software automation and systems architecture. Your job will include supporting the design and operation of broadcast systems.     Responsibilities
  • Develop automation frameworks and remediation workflows. These will enhance operational efficiency, reliability, and scalability in broadcast and technology environments. The automation will enable systems to recover on their own, reducing the need for manual intervention.
  • Develop scripts and services using tools such as Python, PowerShell, and Bash to support system deployments, configuration management, monitoring, and operational processes.
  • Integrate playout systems, signal distribution, encoding, and media processing platforms with monitoring and automation platforms such as Skyline DataMiner.
  • Design and deploy monitoring, observability, and alerting dashboards that provide operational visibility across broadcast workflows in real time.
  • Implement monitoring solutions driven by system events to detect faults across video transport, playout, and distribution systems.
  • Configure and maintain alerting policies, thresholds, escalation workflows, and alarm correlation to improve root cause analysis and reduce operational noise.
  • Develop integrations using REST APIs, SNMP, webhooks, and telemetry feeds to ingest operational data into monitoring and automation platforms.
  • Build middleware, connectors, and data pipelines that normalize broadcast system telemetry for monitoring dashboards and operational tools.
  • Configure and extend Skyline DataMiner connectors and elements, including custom monitoring and data models.
  • Build dashboards, visualizations, and alarms within DataMiner based on complex engineering architectures.
  • Optimize monitoring capabilities to improve fault detection, incident response, and system observability.
  • Review the current technology architecture. Look for ways to automate tasks. Identify ways to improve performance. Find methods to enhance operations.
  • Recommend and implement system upgrades. Make improvements to the architecture. Develop strategies for automation. These changes should improve reliability and scalability.
  • Work across hardware, software, and network technologies in distributed computing and broadcast environments.
  • Work with the broadcast engineering, operations, and technology teams. The goal is to address operational and business needs. We will create technical solutions that can grow and adapt.
  • Ensure automation solutions adhere to corporate security, compliance, privacy, and governance policies.
  • Provide technical direction for the project at every stage. This includes designing the architecture, implementing it, and supporting operations.
  • Mentor team members on automation best practices, scripting methodologies, and observability tools.
  • Maintain documentation and procedures for automation workflows. Keep knowledge repositories for monitoring architectures. Manage system integrations.
  • Develop processes and tools that improve incident response, troubleshooting efficiency, and operational workflows.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and automation practices, recommending new tools and techniques where appropriate.

 

Basic Qualifications
  • A bachelor's degree is required in one of the following areas: Broadcast Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, Media Technology, or Digital Media Engineering.
  • Equivalent experience of 5 to 7 or more years in broadcast engineering, NOC operations, or automation development, or applicable certifications, may be accepted in place of a degree.
  • Applicable certifications include: 1. Society of Broadcast Engineers certifications like CBNE, CBTE, or CBRE. 2. Skyline Communications DataMiner certifications such as DMA or DMS training tracks. 3. Cisco certifications such as CCNA or CCNP. 4. Cloud certifications from Amazon Web Services, Microsoft, Google, or Oracle.
  • Experience with Skyline DataMiner or comparable broadcast monitoring platforms.
  • Experience integrating systems using REST APIs, SNMP, webhooks, or other telemetry protocols.
  • You should have experience in developing automation scripts. You also need to have experience with monitoring tools. Additionally, experience with operational dashboards is required.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, such as Python, JavaScript/Node.js, or PowerShell.
  • Knowledge with architectures driven by system events, observability, and alerting systems.
  • Experience working with containerized services, including Docker and Kubernetes, and modern automation frameworks.
  • Knowledge of modern broadcast workflows, including playout automation, video encoding and transcoding, IP video transport (SMPTE 2110, NDI, and SRT), and satellite or fiber distribution.
  • Knowledge of broadcast equipment telemetry and control interfaces and their integration with monitoring platforms.
  • Experience integrating broadcast ecosystem systems, such as media asset management, scheduling and traffic systems, or cloud media workflows.

 

Bonus Skills (Nice-to-Haves)
  • Experience developing Skyline DataMiner connectors (DIS, DMA, and SLProtocol).
  • Experience with platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, or ELK.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure platforms (AWS, OCI, Azure, or GCP) supporting broadcast workflows.
  • Awareness of development tools assisted by AI and emerging agentic AI technologies.
  • Experience working in television broadcast, media operations, or live production environments.
  #LI-JJ1

job.title: Technical Director
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, and we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is…YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team that values authenticity and embraces inclusion for all. We are searching for individuals who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees. You fuel our culture of purpose, passion, and collaboration. We’re in this together.

Role Details:

The ideal candidate will have extensive knowledge of broadcast operations and production activities.  The Technical Director will work together with Directors, Producers and Graphics/Video Teams in planning newscasts and overseeing the crew on newscast pre-production activities.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Set up and prepare the studio for each broadcast including lighting and camera framing

  • Check in each guest/analyst via LiveU, Zoom, etc. This includes a full audio check

  • Direct, switch, and operate audio and cameras during broadcasts. Show times and durations vary from 15 minutes to full hour broadcasts on CBS Sports HQ

  • Work closely with various Paramount Global entities to connect guests and analysts

  • Must be prepared for breaking news and postgame reactions throughout each shift at any time

 

Key Projects:

Work closely with CBS Sports Broadcast to create compelling content for customers on CBS Sports Digital platforms.

 

Qualifications:

What you bring to the team:

You have -

  • At least 2 years of "hands-on" experience in the technical direction of television newscasts

  • Since the schedules will rotate, you must be able to work all shifts, including weekends and overnights, and holidays. Must be able to work additional hours beyond scheduled shift with little or no notice if needed

  • Must be willing and able to work flexible hours, under tight deadline pressure, including breaking news

  • Experience with ELC OPERATIONS – calling and cutting News Broadcasts, Camera Robotics, Audio Consoles, Playout Servers, and Graphics Playback 

  • Extensive knowledge of video switchers, graphics systems, server playout systems, audio consoles and robotic camera systems is essential. 

  • Desire to learn and adapt in a fast paced environment. 

You might also have –

  • Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Communications or equivalent

  • Experience with Ross products including switchers, Inception and Xpression 


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

 

What We Offer:
  • Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here: https://www.paramount.com/careers/benefits
  • Generous paid time off.
  • An exciting and fulfilling opportunity to be part of one of Paramount’s most dynamic teams.
  • Opportunities for both on-site and virtual engagement events.
  • Unique opportunities to make meaningful connections and build a vibrant community, both inside and outside the workplace.
  • Explore life at Paramount: https://www.paramount.com/careers/life-at-paramount

job.description:

Overview:

 

As a member of the Paramount+ Content Systems Product team, you will help shape the automation strategy for our tools and systems. These are the systems that power our global streaming experiences. What an exciting place to be! Your mission is to learn the manual, hands-on challenges of our partner teams. Then you build the right solutions to solve the right problems at the right time.

 

You will play a key role in keeping Paramount+ running efficiently. We are growing to millions of new subscribers around the world! This team cares about solving problems and improving workflows for the people we work with each day. Together, we build forward-looking tools that scale right along with our business.

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Operational Excellence: Partner with Video and Content Operations to learn where the gaps are in our content supply chain. Then turn those needs into a clear automation plan we can act on.
  • Systems Mapping: Map how our content systems connect from end to end - data flows, handoffs, and dependencies. Then use that picture to find where and how to automate.
  • Process Automation: Guide the product development of our Content Systems. This includes rights, title, and media asset management. Your sharp focus: automate manual, high-touch workflows!
  • AI & Innovation: Find and roll out AI-driven solutions that help our operations teams work more effectively. Think automated metadata extraction, AI-assisted QC, and auto-created localized assets!
  • Technical Documentation: Share a clear vision for technical work. Write up scope, use cases, workflows, and sequence diagrams.
  • Agile Execution: Lead scrum team activities such as grooming, planning, and setting priorities. That way, our development teams always have what they need to succeed.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Bring partners in product, tech, and operations together on delivery scope. Then get set for exciting global launches!

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • Experience: 2-4 years in software product management. You know how to put business value first and weigh trade-offs.
  • Systems Thinking: Ability to map and visualize how complex, interconnected systems work together end-to-end - understanding not just individual tools but the relationships between them - in order to identify where and how to automate across the workflow.
  • Automation Mindset: A proven passion for building workflow tools. You want them to be a "joy to use" for internal teams!
  • Technical Depth: Deep comfort with complex technical workflow systems. Engineering experience or a background in AI/ML is a big plus.
  • Domain Knowledge: A strong interest in the streaming media world and the content supply chain.
  • Collaboration: You build caring, trusting relationships across teams. This helps product work run smoothly, even in a complex space.

job.title: TOC/Editor
job.description:
The Ingest/Transmission Operator and Editor oversees all inbound and outbound media, content distribution, and news-gathering operations. Responsibilities include monitoring on-air product quality, ensuring compliance with government regulations, troubleshooting technical equipment, editing news content, and preparing programming for broadcast. This position is governed by the National IBEW Broadcast Agreement for CBS television stations.

 

Duties & Responsibilities


• Monitor and manage inbound and outbound media using various transmission methods, including fiber, Skype, and LiveU.
• Ensure timely response to breaking news events and oversee broadcast delivery.
• Collaborate with team members and network staff, providing operational support as needed.
• Identify, edit, and insert broadcast-quality video and audio into news bulletins on short notice.
• Handle broadcast media and feeds, manage video and audio switching, and operate recording equipment.
• Utilize servers and monitoring systems to manage media acquisition and delivery.
• Ingest media into servers and prepare files for editing and broadcast.
• Perform basic troubleshooting and escalate technical issues when necessary.
• Support live studio production requirements and provide excellent service to internal and external media operations clients.
• Monitor and control video encoding and decoding systems and troubleshoot incoming and outgoing transmission paths.
• Develop and implement backup plans for equipment or transmission failures.
• Edit news content using non-linear editing systems.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Skills & Qualifications


• Strong knowledge of server-based news environments, broadcast hardware, and software systems.
• Understanding of news operations, current events, and the importance of attention to detail.
• Proficiency in quality control (QC) tools and processes.
• Familiarity with digital video formats, ingest workflows, media servers, and broadcast production environments.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

job.description:

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Vice President, News

 


CBS NEWS PHILADELPHIA  |  SENIOR NEWSROOM LEADERSHIP

 


CBS News Philadelphia is seeking a bold, forward-thinking news and content leader to set the vision for our 24/7 newsroom and move our journalism decisively into the future. This Vice President will lead with urgency, empathy and clear editorial purpose, shaping relevant, brand-consistent storytelling across broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms.
Working in partnership with the President and General Manager, this leader will define and execute a research-driven strategy that grows audience, strengthens community connection and builds a culture where journalists can do their best work. The Vice President will champion breaking news, weather, investigative reporting, consumer advocacy and enterprise storytelling that reflect the lives and needs of people across the Philadelphia region.
This is the senior editorial leader for the news organization. The Vice President directly leads and develops the newsroom leadership team, and provides the strategic direction, accountability and resources that enable each daypart leader to execute at a high level. The Vice President sets the broader newsroom vision, aligns priorities across dayparts and platforms, and ensures consistent standards across the operation.
The ideal candidate is an inclusive, decisive and highly collaborative leader who combines excellent news judgment with curiosity about audience behavior, new technology and emerging storytelling formats. This person is a creative problem-solver who leads with “yes,” makes smart investments and builds modern workflows that help teams move faster without compromising journalistic quality.

 

Overview and Responsibilities
• Set and communicate the editorial vision and 24/7 content strategy for CBS News Philadelphia across broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms.
• Lead, coach and hold accountable the newsroom leadership team, including the Morning Assistant News Director, while respecting each leader’s ownership of day-to-day execution.
• Partner with the President and General Manager to establish and maintain high standards for journalism, community relevance, brand execution and audience growth.
• Use research, performance insights and audience behavior to make informed editorial decisions and evolve content strategy.
• Drive distinctive coverage of breaking news and weather, along with investigative, consumer advocacy and enterprise journalism.
• Recruit, develop and retain exceptional journalists and leaders through clear expectations, timely feedback, informed mentoring and meaningful growth opportunities.
• Create an inclusive, collaborative culture that values different perspectives, encourages smart experimentation and strengthens accountability.
• Build modern, flexible workflows; delegate authority effectively; and align people and resources around the organization’s highest priorities.
• Collaborate with fellow department heads to strengthen the promotion, distribution and monetization of content across platforms.
• Lead newsroom budget planning, resource allocation and strategic investment while anticipating changes in technology, audience habits and the competitive landscape.
• Advance the thoughtful adoption of new tools and technology that improve storytelling, speed, collaboration and audience experience.

 

Basic Qualifications
• Minimum eight years of newsroom leadership experience, preferably in a large or highly competitive market.
• Demonstrated success leading multi-platform journalism across broadcast, streaming, digital and social media.
• A strong record of covering breaking news and weather and supporting investigative, consumer and enterprise storytelling.
• Proven ability to recruit, develop and retain journalists and newsroom leaders.
• Experience managing newsroom budgets, allocating resources and making strategic investments.
• Exceptional news judgment, communication skills and the ability to translate strategy into consistent execution.
• Demonstrated commitment to empathy, inspirational leadership, innovation, collaboration and inclusive team-building.
• Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university preferred, or equivalent professional experience.
Leadership approach: Strategic enough to see what is next, close enough to the work to remove barriers, and disciplined enough to turn vision into daily results.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Work closely with the executive producer & supervising producer in a fast-paced, demanding environment, handling breaking news and news-of-day demands for a 24-hour digital news channel
  • Line produce editorial news content, shape show flow and stack elements in the rundown

  • Distribute assignments and direct a team of writers, associate producers and digital associates to build original content as well as edit and repurpose content from broadcast and other content partners

  • Generate story ideas for future coverage
  • Assign and record swap content for automated software wheel
  • Monitor and take newsworthy live events to air in the control room
  • Communicate with anchors, correspondents and control room team ahead of and during live shows, exhibiting a calm and professional demeanor in high pressure situations
  • Serve as a mentor to junior writers
  • Coordinate with sales department to implement accurate ad loads in rundowns
  • May also perform the responsibilities of content producers, producers, and associates producers and digital associates, as needed

  • 5+ years of experience producing and writing copy for a national broadcast, cable or streaming network, or equivalent local TV news experience in a major market
  • Command of AP style and broadcast writing with impeccable grammar and spelling
  • Ability to multi-task and handle multiple assignments for regular programming as well as rolling breaking news coverage
  • Superior news judgment & critical thinking skills
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education in journalism or related field
  • Fluency using ENPS is a must
  • Deep knowledge of news standards, rights and clearances and fact-checking practices
  • Must pass comprehensive CBS News Digital writing test
  • Must be available to work all shifts — early morning, dayside, nights, weekends and holidays — sometimes on short notice or as coverage, scheduling and news events warrant, as this is a 24-hour news organization
  • This position is based in New York and requires working in-person at the CBS Broadcast Center
 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Well-developed communication skills and ability to train and advise associate producers, production assistants and junior staff in writing and editing broadcast copy
  • Deep knowledge of editorial production, including control room experience, with well-developed writing and copy-editing skills
  • Detail oriented with ability to work in dynamic environment, deal with intense deadlines and continually react to breaking news with factual programming and creative storytelling
  • Broad knowledge of top stories driving the news cycle, including political news, and a knack for identifying lesser-known angles that resonate with audiences

Additional Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of ENPS
  • Line producing experience

job.title: Junior Broadcast Technician - Melfort SK
job.description:
Junior Broadcast Technician

Melfort, Saskatchewan

After an incredible 51 years of service, our longtime Technical Manager in Melfort has recently retired. Pattison Media is now looking for a Junior Broadcast Technician to join our Technical Services team and help support our two radio stations in Melfort.

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their technical career who enjoys troubleshooting, working with technology and learning how things work. You don't need to arrive knowing everything about broadcast engineering. You'll be supported by Pattison Media's Technical Services team and will work closely with our Technical Services Manager in Prince Albert, who will provide ongoing technical support and mentorship.

If you have a background in electronics, IT, networking, telecommunications or broadcast technology and are interested in building a career in radio broadcast engineering, we'd like to hear from you.

What you’ll do:

  • Help maintain, troubleshoot and repair studio and broadcast equipment.
  • Assist with the operation and maintenance of radio transmission systems.
  • Support computers, servers, network equipment and other technology used by our Melfort stations.
  • Support broadcast systems including WideOrbit automation and other studio, newsroom and audio systems.
  • Assist with the installation and commissioning of new technical equipment and systems.
  • Maintain technical documentation, records and drawings.
  • Help troubleshoot technical issues affecting our on-air and business operations.
  • Work with the Pattison Media Technical Services team on technical projects and upgrades.
  • Provide day-to-day technical assistance to staff at our Melfort stations.

What we’re looking for:

  • A genuine interest in broadcasting, electronics and technology.
  • Education or experience in electronics, electrical technology, IT, networking, telecommunications, broadcast technology or a related technical field.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Basic knowledge of computers and networking.
  • Good organizational skills and an ability to follow tasks through to completion.
  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a larger technical team.
  • Good communication skills and a willingness to learn.
  • A valid driver’s License.

Broadcast experience is an asset, not a requirement.

Previous experience working in radio or with broadcast equipment would certainly be an asset, but we're also interested in candidates with strong technical aptitude who are willing to learn.

You'll have the support of an experienced Technical Services team and the opportunity to develop hands-on experience with studio technology, radio automation, IT and networking, RF transmission systems and other broadcast infrastructure.

If you're technically curious, enjoy solving problems and are interested in building a career in broadcast technology, we'd like to hear from you.

Please apply below or submit a cover letter, resume and demo along with the completed Pattison Media Self ID Form before Friday, November 27th 2026 to:

Bill Stovold

Director, Technical Services

Pattison Media Ltd.

Bill.stovold@pattisonmedia.com

job.title: Maintenance Technician - Prince George, BC
job.description:
Combination of CKPG-TV, 99.3 REWIND, 101.3 The RIVER and CKPGToday.ca logos
Maintenance Technician

Prince George, BC

Pattison Media is looking for an experienced Maintenance Technician to join our Technical Services team in Prince George.

This is a hands-on technical position supporting our radio and television operation in Prince George. We are looking for someone with a strong technical background who enjoys troubleshooting, working with technology, and learning how complex systems work. Broadcast experience would certainly be an asset, but we are equally interested in candidates coming from electronics, telecommunications, IT, networking, audio/video, RF, or other related technical fields.

The successful candidate will support day-to-day operations and participate in equipment installations, system upgrades, technical projects, and the ongoing modernization of Pattison Media's broadcast infrastructure. The position works closely with our broader Technical Services team, which will provide support and help the successful candidate become familiar with our specialized radio and television systems.

What you'll do
  • Maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and install radio and television studio and broadcast equipment.
  • Maintain and support radio and television transmission systems, including transmitters, RF systems, and associated equipment.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot audio and video systems, including studio, production, and signal-distribution equipment.
  • Support computers, servers, network equipment, and other technology used throughout the Prince George operation.
  • Support broadcast and production systems, including automation, newsroom, audio, video, and content-delivery systems.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues affecting on-air, production, newsroom, and business operations.
  • Install and commission new technical equipment and systems.
  • Diagnose problems across complete broadcast workflows, from studio and production systems through transmission and distribution.
  • Work with IP networking, server infrastructure, and increasingly IP-based and cloud-connected broadcast systems.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, records, and system drawings.
  • Work closely with programming, news, television production, sales, and other departments to provide reliable day-to-day technical support.
  • Help ensure technical systems follow Pattison Media standards for reliability, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure.
What we're looking for
  • A graduate of a recognized Electronics Technician, Electronics Engineering Technologist, Broadcast Technology, or related technical program, or a combination of relevant education and practical technical experience.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to logically diagnose technical and electronic systems.
  • Experience working with electronics, electrical systems, telecommunications, IT, networking, audio/video systems, RF, or other related technical equipment.
  • Good working knowledge of computers, IP networking, and modern IT infrastructure.
  • Comfort learning and working with radio and television studio, transmission, audio/video, automation, and production systems.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and see tasks through to completion.
  • Ability to work independently while also being part of Pattison Media's larger Technical Services team.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills with a practical, positive, solutions-focused approach.
  • Comfort working at transmitter sites and other technical facilities as required.
  • A valid driver's license.
Experience we're particularly interested in

Previous radio or television broadcast experience would be an asset, but it is not essential.

We recognize that strong technical candidates can come from many different backgrounds. We are interested in people with solid hands-on experience in electronics, telecommunications, IT and networking, audio/video systems, RF, or other related technical fields. Someone with a strong technical foundation, good troubleshooting skills, and a willingness to learn the specialized systems used in broadcasting could be an excellent fit.

Experience with broadcast automation, production, or newsroom systems would also be an asset. Pattison Media uses systems such as WideOrbit in radio and Broadstream OASYS in television, along with newsroom and other supporting broadcast technologies.

About Pattison Media

Pattison Media is one of Canada's leading independent media companies, operating radio, television, and digital platforms across Western Canada. We continue to invest in modern broadcast technology, IP and cloud-based systems, and new workflows that support reliable multi-platform content delivery.

This position offers the opportunity to work with a broad range of technology. One day may involve troubleshooting a radio studio or computer system, while another may involve television production equipment, networking, servers, or a transmission system.

If you enjoy solving problems, working with technology, and keeping radio and television operations running reliably, we'd like to hear from you.

How to apply

When applying, please identify that you are applying for the Prince George Maintenance Technician position.

You can apply online below or submit a cover letter, resume, and a completed Pattison Media Self ID Form before Friday, November 30th, 2026, to:

Bill Stovold

Director, Technical Services

Position Overview

The Technical Privacy Analyst supports the Privacy Engineering function within the Data Privacy team and reports to the Privacy Engineering Manager. This role helps put PBS's privacy program into practice at the technical level by assisting with data mapping and discovery, data integration, and the configuration of privacy controls across advertising and analytics technology stacks. The analyst helps integrate age assurance technologies into privacy product development and technology stacks, assists the Privacy Engineering Manager with privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs), and supports data labeling that enables privacy-preserving data collaboration across the public media community, so that data is minimized, accurately labeled, and protected by design. This position is fully funded through 6/30/2029.

will include, but are not limited to: Data Mapping, Discovery, and Integration Assist with data mapping and data inventory efforts, documenting data flows, systems, data elements, and processing purposes across PBS platforms, applications, and vendors Support data discovery and classification to identify where personal data resides across cloud, application, and analytics environments Assist with data integration work, including ingesting, normalizing, and reconciling privacy-relevant data across systems so data maps and inventories stay current Maintain data mapping outputs that support Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), consumer rights requests, partner data use reviews, and data deletion workflows Help identify and triage privacy debt, including legacy technical gaps that pose compliance risks, and support remediation with engineering teams Privacy Configuration Across Digital Marketing and Measurement Platforms Configure, validate, and document privacy-relevant Hands-on
