  • Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance through automation, AI, platform innovation and emerging audience strategies.
  • Contribute to POVs, best practices, process improvements, governance documentation and thought leadership initiatives that advance the Paid Search practice.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends, platform updates, healthcare advertising regulations, privacy changes and evolving search behaviors.
  • Manage, mentor and coach junior team members, helping develop campaign-management, optimization and client-leadership skillsets.
  • Support cross-functional education by sharing industry trends, case studies, platform enhancements and innovation opportunities.

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an "I," reflect how you approach your work and leadership.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by combining strategic thinking, accountability and a solutions-oriented approach.
  • You enjoy transforming performance data into business insights and actionable client recommendations.
  • You proactively identify challenges and bring solutions, not just problems.
  • You thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy partnering across disciplines to deliver integrated media solutions.
  • You are energized by innovation and continuously seek opportunities to improve campaign performance, efficiency and client outcomes.
  • You enjoy coaching others and helping elevate the capabilities of the broader team.

What you should have:

  • 4+ years of experience managing paid search, performance media or digital activation campaigns in an agency or client-facing environment.
  • Deep expertise across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, SA360 and related paid search platforms.
  • Strong understanding of bidding strategies, audience targeting, attribution models, measurement frameworks and optimization methodologies.
  • Experience translating client business objectives into channel strategies and tactical paid search recommendations.
  • Proven success managing campaign performance, addressing complex business challenges and driving measurable account growth.
  • Experience presenting recommendations, performance insights and strategic plans to clients and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of campaign budgeting, forecasting, pacing and financial management.
  • Outstanding analytical, problem-solving and strategic-thinking capabilities.
  • Experience leveraging bid-management, measurement and tracking platforms.
  • Excellent written, verbal and presentation communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and navigate a fast-paced environment with confidence.
  • Experience mentoring junior team members and contributing to team development.
  • Healthcare, pharmaceutical or life sciences experience is preferred but not required.
  • Experience across additional biddable channels, including Programmatic and Paid Social, is a plus.

 

Pay Range: $80,000 - $95,000

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Manager, Social Media to join our growing team!

For us, social isn’t just a channel — it’s a craft. Our Social Media team blends deep healthcare expertise with sharp strategy, standout content and data-driven execution to help clients show up with purpose across platforms.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—New York City, Boston, Chicago, San Francisco, Indianapolis, or Lambertville (NJ)—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Help clients and internal teams connect the dots between organic and paid social within broader healthcare communications programs.
  • Turn platform best practices, cultural trends and healthcare requirements into smart, compliant recommendations clients can act on.
  • Support paid social from planning and setup through trafficking, optimization and performance reporting.
  • Use platform insights and campaign data to make the work sharper, smarter and more effective.
  • Write clear, compelling, platform-native copy for organic and paid social campaigns across channels.
  • Team up with creative partners to develop social-first content built for platform behavior, ad formats and audience needs.
  • Use AI tools and Canva to move faster — drafting, organizing, resizing, versioning and refining content with efficiency and care.
  • Keep brand, compliance and quality standards high while improving everyday workflow.

  • Keep work moving with thoughtful follow-ups, clear feedback tracking and strong next-step management.
  • Work closely across account, paid social, earned and digital media teams to bring integrated social programs to life.

 This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead. 
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.

  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact. 

Mindset, Ownership & Adaptability 

  • You feel energized by our Company values: Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I.” 
  • You’re adaptable, resilient and comfortable shifting gears as priorities evolve. 
  • You’re proactive, resourceful and solutions-oriented, with strong prioritization skills and curiosity about smarter ways of working. 

What you should have: 

  • 5+ years of social media experience, ideally in a regulated industry such as biotech, pharmaceutical or financial services. 
  • 2–4 years of hands-on paid social experience, including setup, trafficking, optimization and performance reporting. 
  • College degree required; BA or equivalent preferred. 
  • Agency experience in a client-facing role preferred. 
  • Understanding of FDA regulations guiding social media efforts for biotech and pharma clients preferred. 
  • A strong command of major social platforms and a clear understanding of how audiences use them. 
  • A proven ability to write, edit and publish short- and long-form social content. 
  • Experience with social media buying platforms such as Meta Business Manager and LinkedIn Ads; Meta Blueprint or similar certifications are a plus. 
  • Comfort using Canva, AI-enabled tools and Microsoft Office — especially PowerPoint — to improve speed, organization and output quality.

Senior Medical Writer 

Please note: We are unable to offer visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the legal right to work in the UK. If you do not meet this requirement, please do not apply. This is a hybrid position and is not a fully remote role.

Our Senior Medical Writers are responsible for driving day-to-day project delivery (with support from others) within an account in order to create outstanding medical content across a variety of therapy areas. This position is ideal for an experienced writer who has a passion for scientific and medical developments, a keen interest in AI, and who enjoys tackling new problems, interacting with clients, and mentoring internal team members.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Scientific knowledge:
    • Confidently steps into new therapeutic areas
    • Starting to lead discussions with clients and external experts on therapy area, drivers which influence treatment decision-making and patient pathways
  • Strategic knowledge: Helps to lead meetings and strategic discussions with clients
  • AI
    • Proactively utilizes a broad range of AI solutions to streamline complex projects, with support from others
    • Evaluates and implements AI-driven solutions to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of projects, identifying opportunities for improvement and collaborating with team members to optimize project delivery
    • Provides guidance and training to team members on best practice
  • Project ownership:
    • Leads content delivery for complex projects with supervision from senior team, delegating to AMW/MWs as needed and where appropriate to ensure timely execution to a high standard
    • Skilled in achieving communications objectives by employing a broad range of channels and formats
  • Project development:
    • Interrogates briefs from clients/internal teams and proactively flags any queries or potential issues
    • Applies critical thinking skills towards a project brief to achieve deliverables in a timely and efficient manner
    • Provides a proactive, solution-focused approach towards resolving queries, and addressing feedback
    • Initiates discussions with Account Teams regarding potential barriers to successful project completion that may arise
  • Editorial:
    • Develops compelling narratives from complex information
    • Structures and writes novel projects that may not have been executed previously
  • Quality control:
    • Takes responsibility for overall quality of deliverables with supervision from senior team
    • Reviews JMWs’ work for adherence to brief, client objectives and quality of writing, providing constructive feedback
  • On site: Leads elements of the on-site programme across a variety of events with support from others
  • Client liaison: Leads scientific discussion with clients and external experts as appropriate to capture briefs, resolve queries, and progress scientific content development in timely and efficient manner
  • Growth and new business
    • Supports development of scientific content for new therapeutic areas for new business
    • Proactively identifies new business opportunities with new and existing clients
  • Project management: Provides timely and accurate communication to accounts team on writer hours, and project progress
  • Teamwork: Trains/mentors junior writers on account-specific therapy area knowledge and processes

Qualifications and skills

  • You should bring a strong scientific background with a degree in a scientific or medical discipline (post-graduate degree preferred). A high level of academic achievement is expected
  • You should bring previous experience of medical writing at an MW level or above
  • A passion for, and profound understanding of, healthcare, science, medicine, and the pharmaceutical industry is essential, as well as a keen interest in AI technologies
  • You’ll need to be personable, articulate, and capable of nurturing relationships. Previous experience mentoring MWs and interacting regularly with clients is essential

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Position Summary:

The Senior Medical Writer serves as an integral part of the Real Chemistry Medical Communications division in developing scientific content in support of a variety of omnichannel medical communication tactics, as assigned to particular therapeutic areas and client brands. The Senior Medical Writer must have the ability to analyze and interpret complex scientific data and translate these into compelling and relevant clinical communications and commercial/medical messages. The Senior Medical Writer collaborates closely with the Medical Director and cross-functional teammates in the development and execution of scientific strategies and tactics. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Indianapolis, Lambertville (NJ), or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role requires working eastern US hours.

What you'll do:

  • Develop core deliverables (eg, PowerPoint slides, manuscripts, video scripts, executive summaries) and ancillary materials (eg, participant handouts, moderator guides) for medical communication projects, including promotional/medical presentations, advisory board meetings, product theaters as well as various educational videos and digital solutions
  • Perform and analyze literature searches and scientific research regarding clinical data and key scientific information for content development projects to meet client needs for relevant, up-to-date, evidenced-based, and accurate medical communication content
  • Collaborate with the Medical Director, in partnership with Creative and Client Services, on medical storytelling, drawing upon client insights, landscape intelligence, and relevant evidence-based medical literature to provide informed and relevant strategic recommendations
  • Partner with Presentation and Graphic Designers on various illustrations, animations, and creative applications of medical and scientific information
  • As assigned, develop relationships and collaborate closely with clients and key opinion leaders to develop scientific content and execute medical communication strategy to communicate complex scientific information to medical professionals 
  • Conduct quality checks on all content-related materials, including annotated deliverables, to ensure scientific integrity and accuracy, and support Veeva submissions of all medical communication deliverables for client medical/legal/regulatory reviews by highlighting all relevant references and creating detailed reference notes
  • Support project management within the cross-functional team by effectively communicating and aligning with Account and Project Managers, and actively participating in all internal and client meetings
  • Train and mentor more junior medical writers under the guidance of the Medical Director
  • Maintain full compliance with legal, regulatory, and corporate requirements as well as all applicable US laws and regulations

Senior Medical Writer 

Please note: We are unable to offer visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the legal right to work in the UK. If you do not meet this requirement, please do not apply. This is a hybrid position and is not a fully remote role.

Our Senior Medical Writers are responsible for driving day-to-day project delivery (with support from others) within an account in order to create outstanding medical content across a variety of therapy areas. This position is ideal for an experienced writer who has a passion for scientific and medical developments, a keen interest in AI, and who enjoys tackling new problems, interacting with clients, and mentoring internal team members.

This role is based in the UK and employed under a UK contract of employment, with contractual working hours of 40 hours per week, but works as part of teams supporting US business and clients. The role works closely with US-based colleagues and may have day-to-day line management from leaders supporting US business. As for any role in Real Chemistry, reasonable flexibility to work across US and other time zones will be required depending on business need.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Scientific knowledge:
    • Confidently steps into new therapeutic areas
    • Starting to lead discussions with clients and external experts on therapy area, drivers which influence treatment decision-making and patient pathways
  • Strategic knowledge: Helps to lead meetings and strategic discussions with clients
  • AI
    • Proactively utilizes a broad range of AI solutions to streamline complex projects, with support from others
    • Evaluates and implements AI-driven solutions to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of projects, identifying opportunities for improvement and collaborating with team members to optimize project delivery
    • Provides guidance and training to team members on best practice
  • Project ownership:
    • Leads content delivery for complex projects with supervision from senior team, delegating to AMW/MWs as needed and where appropriate to ensure timely execution to a high standard
    • Skilled in achieving communications objectives by employing a broad range of channels and formats
  • Project development:
    • Interrogates briefs from clients/internal teams and proactively flags any queries or potential issues
    • Applies critical thinking skills towards a project brief to achieve deliverables in a timely and efficient manner
    • Provides a proactive, solution-focused approach towards resolving queries, and addressing feedback
    • Initiates discussions with Account Teams regarding potential barriers to successful project completion that may arise
  • Editorial:
    • Develops compelling narratives from complex information
    • Structures and writes novel projects that may not have been executed previously
  • Quality control:
    • Takes responsibility for overall quality of deliverables with supervision from senior team
    • Reviews JMWs’ work for adherence to brief, client objectives and quality of writing, providing constructive feedback
  • On site: Leads elements of the on-site programme across a variety of events with support from others
  • Client liaison: Leads scientific discussion with clients and external experts as appropriate to capture briefs, resolve queries, and progress scientific content development in timely and efficient manner
  • Growth and new business
    • Supports development of scientific content for new therapeutic areas for new business
    • Proactively identifies new business opportunities with new and existing clients
  • Project management: Provides timely and accurate communication to accounts team on writer hours, and project progress
  • Teamwork: Trains/mentors junior writers on account-specific therapy area knowledge and processes

Qualifications and skills

  • You should bring a strong scientific background with a degree in a scientific or medical discipline (post-graduate degree preferred). A high level of academic achievement is expected
  • You should bring previous experience of medical writing at an MW level or above
  • A passion for, and profound understanding of, healthcare, science, medicine, and the pharmaceutical industry is essential, as well as a keen interest in AI technologies
  • You’ll need to be personable, articulate, and capable of nurturing relationships. Previous experience mentoring MWs and interacting regularly with clients is essential

Senior Strategist 

21GRAMS | Strategy | London 

Job Summary 

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Strategist to join the growing 21GRAMS Strategy team in London. This is an opportunity to support high-profile global accounts within one of healthcare advertising’s most creative agencies, working alongside award-winning creative, strategy and client teams. 

You will combine strong research and analytical foundations with creative strategic thinking. You will explore markets, audiences and competitors, turn insights into clear strategic recommendations, and help shape work that resonates with clients and their audiences. The role will mainly support senior strategists while offering strong scope to learn, collaborate internationally and progress as the team continues to grow. 

What you’ll do 

  • Conduct primary and desk research to build a clear understanding of markets, sectors, audiences and behaviours. 
  • Develop consumer and stakeholder insights that help shape creative and brand strategy. 
  • Carry out category and competitor analysis, identifying the most relevant opportunities and challenges. 
  • Support senior strategy colleagues across global account work, strategic projects and client deliverables. 
  • Contribute to creative briefs, strategic narratives and presentations, making complex findings clear and engaging. 
  • Work closely with Creative, Client Services, Medical Education and wider cross-functional teams. 
  • Support new business pitches through research, insight development and strategic thinking. 
  • Present thinking confidently to internal teams and, as experience grows, to clients. 
  • Manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-moving agency environment. 

This position is a perfect fit for you if 

  • You are curious, creative and commercially aware, with a genuine interest in understanding people and what drives them. 
  • You are a clear and engaging communicator who enjoys presenting ideas and contributing to discussion. 
  • You bring positive energy, ambition and a desire to develop within strategy. 
  • You can balance detailed research with the ability to step back, identify the key insight and tell a compelling story. 
  • You are collaborative, proactive and comfortable working across different disciplines and with colleagues in other markets. 
  • You are adaptable, organised and able to deliver high-quality work against deadlines. 
  • Our Company values - Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” - really speak to you. 

What you should have 

  • Approximately 3-5 years of strategy, planning, research or insight experience within an agency environment. 
  • Experience in healthcare advertising is welcome, but candidates from traditional consumer or AOR advertising agencies who are interested in moving into healthcare will also be considered. 
  • A strong foundation in market research, desk research, audience insight and competitor or category analysis. 
  • Experience working across more than one client, category, sector or therapy area. 
  • An understanding of how agency teams operate, including fast-paced delivery and changing priorities. 
  • Experience supporting new business pitches is useful but not essential. 
  • Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to distil information into clear, persuasive recommendations. 
  • A collaborative mindset and the potential to grow into greater strategic ownership over time.

Real Chemistry Media is a fully integrated media, analytics, technology, and customer engagement organization that helps healthcare brands create meaningful, measurable connections with healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers, and consumers. Our teams bring together media, omnichannel strategy, analytics, CRM, creative, influencer, technology, medical communications, integrated communications, and engagement expertise to design connected customer experiences that drive business outcomes across the healthcare ecosystem. 

 

As a Supervisor, you'll serve as a key client contact, a confident strategic contributor, and a hands-on team leader—owning tactical recommendations, leading the RFP process, and supervising a pod of Associates through Senior Managers to deliver integrated, high-quality work. In this role, you'll bring together deep digital and omnichannel expertise, proactive client communication, and a natural mentorship style to elevate both the work and the people around you. 

 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or Lambertville—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. 

 

What you'll do: 

  • Play a lead role partnering with strategy on overall plan development; own tactical recommendations across assigned accounts spanning omnichannel, CRM, MarTech, creative, and digital workstreams. 
  • Lead the RFP process, evaluate vendor proposals, and contribute to negotiations with publisher and technology partners. 
  • Coordinate with delivery and technology partners on measurement and tracking implementation; continually improve operational processes across the pod. 
  • Act as the key day-to-day client contact; facilitate and lead client status meetings, present omnichannel and integrated recommendations, and deliver campaign analytics directly to clients. 
  • Maintain proactive client communication that keeps clients informed and confident in the agency's approach. 
  • Supervise workflow and deadlines across Associate through Senior Manager-level colleagues; lead internal team syncs to communicate and manage priorities across the pod. 
  • Manage the team to deliver quality assurance, campaign analysis, and performance against plan — including QA of all ad placements and the financial accuracy behind them. 
  • Monitor financial performance for assigned brands; partner with Biz Ops on campaign authorizations and vendor reconciliation to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery. 
  • Lead internal training of junior team members, provide timely feedback, and contribute to performance evaluation processes. 
  • Mentor the planning bench, assist in hiring new team members, and model a collaborative, adaptable leadership style. 
  • Proactively identify, resolve, or escalate issues; deliver POVs that demonstrate industry knowledge and strategic thinking. 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an "I" – really speak to you. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We're always evolving. 
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data. 
  • You are a highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. 

 

What you should have: 

  • 6–8 years of experience in digital marketing, client services, omnichannel strategy, or a related agency environment. 
  • Demonstrated expertise across omnichannel, CRM, MarTech, and customer experience, with the ability to lead tactical planning and present recommendations confidently to clients. 
  • Proven experience leading RFP processes, evaluating vendor proposals, and contributing to negotiations. 
  • Track record of supervising and developing junior to mid-level team members, with strong skills in workflow management, quality assurance, and priority-setting. 
  • Strong financial acumen — comfortable owning budget oversight, campaign authorizations, and reconciliation processes for assigned brands. 
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills; a confident presenter who performs well under pressure and across varied client cultures. 
  • Experience with project management tools (Workfront, Asana) and digital marketing platforms, measurement, and reporting tools. 
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with demonstrated ability to deliver POVs grounded in industry knowledge. 
  • Experience assisting in hiring and onboarding new team members a plus. 
  • Healthcare, pharma, or regulated industry experience a plus.

job.title: Supervisor, Search
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media is a data-driven media and omnichannel activation practice redefining how healthcare brands connect with the people who matter most. Powered by proprietary data, advanced technology, AI, automation and deep healthcare expertise, we create seamless, audience-first experiences that connect brands with patients, caregivers and healthcare professionals. Through strategic media planning, precision targeting, cross-channel activation and continuous optimization, we help clients deliver the right message to the right audience at the right moment, driving measurable business outcomes and meaningful impact across the customer journey.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Supervisor, Paid Search to join our growing team!

The Supervisor, Paid Search serves as the day-to-day client relationship and strategic channel lead across a dedicated portfolio of accounts, owning paid search strategy, campaign performance, and operational excellence. This individual translates client business objectives into comprehensive channel media plans, oversees account evolution and innovation, and is accountable for consistently delivering and exceeding established performance expectations. The Supervisor leads and develops a team of paid search professionals, orchestrates account priorities and cross-functional initiatives, and serves as a trusted channel expert to clients and internal stakeholders while advancing the capabilities of the broader Paid Search practice.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—New York City, Boston, Chicago, San Francisco, Indianapolis, or Lambertville (NJ)—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you'll do:

  • Own the day-to-day client relationship for a dedicated paid search portfolio — serving as the primary contact for questions, updates, and strategic recommendations across all levels of client engagement
  • Own the development of paid search media plans, comprehensive media briefs, channel strategies, and measurement recommendations that directly align with client business objectives and broader integrated media strategies
  • Oversee all aspects of campaign management, including objectives, audiences, testing frameworks, and account restructures, ensuring flawless launches and consistently strong performance against KPIs
  • Design and lead optimization initiatives and innovation roadmaps; introducing new platforms, audiences, and technologies to drive account evolution and cross-channel integration
  • Lead the resolution of complex client business and campaign performance challenges, overseeing strategic optimization initiatives and account restructures to improve business outcomes
  • Translate media metrics and campaign performance into clear client business insights, owning the ROI narrative with authority
  • Oversee budget tracking and allocation across campaigns to maximize return, ensuring compliance with regulatory and industry standards including promotional review requirements
  • Supervise, mentor, and develop junior team members — providing guidance, training, and performance feedback in both in-person and remote settings
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives with Integrated Media, Analytics, Strategy, Creative, Client Experience, Ad Operations, and agency partners to advance integrated media strategies and identify opportunities for cross-channel collaboration
  • Drive process improvements, evolve practice documentation, and champion the adoption of best practices, operational standards, and platform innovations across the Paid Search team

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values — Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I" — genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

What you should have:

  • 5+ years of paid search experience, with a track record of managing and growing client accounts, ideally within an agency or healthcare/pharma setting
  • Deep platform expertise across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising; experience implementing new platforms, DSPs, or audience technologies is a strong plus
  • Proven ability to develop and present channel strategy, media plans, and performance narratives directly to clients with confidence and authority
  • Strong analytical mindset — able to make data-driven decisions, defend them to stakeholders, and translate complex metrics into actionable business insights
  • Experience supervising or mentoring junior team members, with the ability to coach and develop talent in a remote or hybrid environment
  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, cross-functional workstreams, and competing priorities simultaneously
  • Familiarity with regulatory and promotional review requirements in healthcare or pharmaceutical advertising preferred
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build and sustain strong client and internal relationships

Pay Range: $90,000 - $105,000

The anticipated salary range for this position is listed above. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and internal parity.

In addition to base salary, Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefits package and a variety of programs designed to support our employees' well-being, growth, and success.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

2027 Weiss Center Ambassadors

*IMPORTANT NOTE*: This application is only for students who are currently enrolled at Syracuse University. If you are not a current Syracuse University student but are interested in applying for Real Chemistry's 2027 summer internship program, please keep an eye out for the job posting, which will go live in December 2026. We look forward to receiving and reviewing your applications then!

2027 Application Deadline: December 4, 2026

About the Weiss Center:
The Weiss Center is a student, faculty and industry-powered incubator that complements classroom curriculum through immersive, real-world application. By connecting classroom learning with the pace and expectations of the communications field, the Center helps students build the skills, perspective and confidence to enter the industry with a leg up.  

About the Role:
Each year, two Syracuse University students are selected to serve as Weiss Center Brand Ambassadors. The program offers a multifaceted experience that allows students to represent the Center on campus, contribute to its programming, and work alongside Real Chemistry experts and clients through a summer internship and other hands-on opportunities. Along the way, Ambassadors build the professional skills, experience and relationships needed to succeed in an evolving communications industry. 

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Summer Internship: Complete a full-time, paid, 10-week summer internship with Real Chemistry 
  • Promote Center programming: Work alongside Real Chemistry staff to drive awareness and provide on-the-ground support for the Center’s fall and spring programming, including the Jim Weiss Lecture Series, expert-led workshops, class visits and other hands-on learning experiences. 
  • Manage social and digital content: Manage Weiss Center social channels and collaborate with peers to develop blog posts and multimedia content. 
  • Build professional connections: Attend exclusive networking opportunities with Real Chemistry executives, staff and clients, as well as Syracuse faculty. 
  • Support a potential NYC benchmark trip: Help plan and attend a visit to the Real Chemistry office and other firms, pending schedule. 
  • SXSW trip: Participate in an all-expenses-paid trip to Austin, Texas to attend Real Chemistry’s events at the SXSW Interactive conference and support social media and digital content development

Candidate Profile:
We are seeking students who are enthusiastic about communications, curious about emerging industry trends and eager to help their peers connect with professional learning opportunities. 

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to adapt messages for student audiences.
  • Interest in social media, digital storytelling, AI & technology, analytics and/or the evolving communications industry.
  • Creativity, initiative and a collaborative approach to projects.
  • Organization and time-management skills, including the ability to follow through on agreed responsibilities.
  • Comfort engaging with peers and helping foster an inclusive campus community.
    • Other on-campus involvement is a plus 
  • Willingness to learn, receive feedback and contribute new ideas. 

Eligibility for the 2027 cohort: 

  • Qualified Syracuse University sophomores and juniors who will be on campus for the Spring and Fall 2027 semesters.
  • Minimum GPA: 3.0.
  • Selection as an Ambassador is contingent on being qualified for the summer 2027 internship program with Real Chemistry.
  • Particular interest in students with a background or interest in public relations, communications, advertising, marketing and/or information studies. 

2027 Ambassador Program Details:

  • Term: Proposed Spring and Fall 2027 on-campus service, plus a full-time, paid, 10-week summer internship. Note: Specific dates of summer 2027 internship program TBD (tentatively June-August 2027)
  • SXSW attendance: Ability to travel for all-expense paid trip to Austin, Texas (tentatively March 14-17), pending schedule
  • Time commitment: Full-time during the 10-week summer internship (40 hours/week). Anticipate dedicating approximately 2-5 hours per week during the spring and fall 2027 semesters to the Weiss Center Brand Ambassador Program 
  • Location: On-campus availability for the Spring and Fall 2027 semesters, with potential program travel for one to two all-expenses paid events, pending schedule.
  • Compensation: The summer internship is paid ($20/hour); any potential travel (Austin, TX and/or NYC) are all-expenses-paid. The Brand Ambassador Program is an unpaid, volunteer opportunity.

job.title: Education & Community Engagement Manager
job.description:
This is a hybrid position. Applicants must reside in the Tri-State Area to be on location for occasional programming and meetings.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 

The Education and Community Engagement Manager supports the development, implementation, and refinement of Grammy Museum Education & Community Engagement programs with a focus on educator-facing initiatives, curriculum development, professional development, student recruitment, and regional program support. Based in New York City, you will help expand the Museum’s East Coast education presence and support programs primarily East of the Mississippi River including Grammy in the Schools, professional development sessions, and seasonal Grammy Camp support.

 

You will provide curriculum expertise across programs to ensure consistency, continuity, and alignment with the Museum’s educational goals. You will build and maintain relationships with K-12 teachers, school partners, districts, and arts education organizations to support educator engagement, student recruitment, and professional development. You will also support application and recruitment processes for student and educator programs, ensuring outreach, application review, and participant communication reflect program goals and expand access for students and teachers.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 

Professional Development & Educator Engagement

  • Lead planning, development, and facilitation of educator professional development programs, including virtual, in-person, district-based, and conference-based sessions.
  • Build and maintain relationships with K–12 teachers, school districts, arts coordinators, and education partners to support professional development, program participation, student recruitment, and ongoing educator engagement.
  • Identify and cultivate professional development opportunities with schools, districts, conferences, and partner organizations.
  • Collect and synthesize educator feedback to inform future professional development offerings, curriculum tools, and program improvements.

 

Program Alignment

  • Provide curriculum expertise across Education programs to ensure consistency, continuity, and alignment with departmental learning goals, while remaining adaptable to different student, teacher, and community contexts.
  • Develop and refine learning objectives, instructional materials, rubrics, classroom extensions, and develop and maintain program manuals.
  • Support alignment of programs with music education, arts education, career and technical education, college/career readiness, and workforce development frameworks where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with internal team members to connect curriculum and instructional design across Grammy Camp, Grammy in the Schools, Industry Sessions, professional development, and other education initiatives.

 

Recruitment, Applications & Program Process Support

  • Support recruitment for student and educator programs including outreach to schools, teachers, districts, community partners, and professional networks, building an application pipeline.
  • Support application and review processes for selected programs, including outreach, applicant communication, submission tracking, rubric development, review coordination, and documentation.
  • Help ensure recruitment and application processes are accessible, organized, and aligned with program goals, student readiness, educator needs, and equity of access.
  • Collaborate with the Coordinator and program leads to maintain accurate applicant records, support review timelines, and communicate next steps to applicants and participants.

 

Grammy in the Schools Support

  • Support planning and implementation of Grammy in the Schools programs, particularly those based on the East Coast and primarily East of the Mississippi River.
  • Assist with educator and school partner communication, program planning, instructional materials, and on-site implementation.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure Grammy in the Schools programming is educationally consistent, student-centered, and aligned with the Museum’s broader learning goals.
  • Support development of program resources that help students connect music learning to industry pathways, creative careers, and transferable skills.

 

Grammy Camp Support

  • Support Grammy Camp planning and implementation including curriculum alignment, faculty support, student learning outcomes, and summer travel for on-site program delivery.
  • Support faculty onboarding, curriculum implementation, instructional planning, and integration of curriculum benchmarks across the camp model.
  • Help ensure consistency across camp cities while supporting local adaptation based on partners, faculty, students, and facilities.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Vice President, Senior Director, Senior Manager, and Coordinator to support program strategy, planning, implementation, and evaluation.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Communications, Advancement, Production, Guest Services, and Finance as needed.
  • Support public programs in New York as needed.
  • Represent the Education & Community Engagement team in meetings with schools, districts, partners, artists, faculty, and external stakeholders.
  • Travel for programs, conferences, partner meetings, Grammy Camp, Grammy in the Schools and other education initiatives as needed.
  SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 

  • Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s degree preferred in music education, arts education, curriculum and instruction, education, music industry, or a related field.
  • 3-5+ years of experience in music education, arts education, curriculum development, professional development, or youth program implementation.
  • Experience designing or facilitating professional development for educators preferred.
  • Strong understanding of secondary music education, music technology, ensemble instruction, career-connected learning, and/or music industry pathways.
  • Experience developing curriculum, lesson plans, educator resources, rubrics, or instructional materials.
  • Experience supporting student or educator recruitment and application review processes preferred.
  • Ability to build relationships and collaborate with educators, students, artists, K-12 schools, districts, partners, and internal teams.
  • Strong writing, facilitation, and presentation skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple programs and timelines.
  • Willingness and ability to travel including significant summer travel to support Grammy Camp.

 

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS FOR CERTAIN ROLES

 

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be required to stand, walk, and sit for long periods of time, and work at a computer for long periods of time.

 

The employee may be required to lift and/or move up to 60 pounds.

 

 

SALARY AND BENEFITS

 

The starting salary for this position is $66,300 to $70,800 per year, benchmarked against industry standards. Salaries for positions required to be in specific geographic locations reflect the corresponding labor market. 
 
The actual offer extended will depend on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and the role's requirements. Positions working 20+ hours per week also receive our comprehensive benefits package (with medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401k match, generous paid time off, and more). Click here for an overview of our company benefits.


Explore our career opportunities to join a team that values creativity, innovation, and diversity. 

 

 

ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES

 

RECORDING ACADEMY

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the Grammy Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the Grammy Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. As the world's leading society of music professionals, we work year-round to foster a more inspiring world for creators.

 

LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY

The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation.

 

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives.

 

MUSICARES

A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. A four-star charity and safety net in times of need, MusiCares offers confidential preventative, recovery, and emergency programs to address financial, medical, and personal health issues. Through the generosity of our donors and volunteer professionals, our dedicated team works across the country to ensure the music community has the resources and support it needs.

 

GRAMMY MUSEUM

The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include Grammy in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States. 

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The Recording Academy, its affiliates, and the music industry have a strong culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. The Recording Academy makes intentional, courageous, and principled decisions for stronger business outcomes and ensures that all creators and professionals live and work in a fair and safe environment. It is the Recording Academy's policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees. The Recording Academy does not discriminate on the basis of race (nor traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion (including religious dress and grooming), creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), national origin, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law. The Recording Academy will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to the Recording Academy. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including selection, job assignment, compensation, promotion, discipline, termination, access to benefits and training, recruitment, hiring, transfer, and social and recreational programs.

job.title: Intern, Advocacy & Public Policy
job.description:
INTERNSHIP DETAILS 

 

SPRING INTERNSHIP 

APPLICATION DEADLINE FOR STUDENTS: 11/20/2026 

SPRING INTERNSHIP PROGRAM DATES: 1/11/2027 – 4/16/2027  

*The Advocacy & Public Policy Intern position pays county/state minimum wage rates, based on work location. 



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

 

The Recording Academy Advocacy & Public Policy team is seeking a “rock star” student for a spring 2027 Internship with our team. 


Celebrating music through the Grammy® Awards, The Recording Academy continues its legacy as the premier national organization for honoring achievements in the recording arts and supporting the music community. As a membership organization, we represent the most talented music professionals in the world. Our members include recording artists, producers, engineers, attorneys, music supervisors, composers/arrangers, managers, agents, social media and record label executives and many others. 


Our paid Internship Program offers a unique opportunity for full-time college students (juniors or seniors) to gain on-site training in office administration, advocacy, and public policy, in exchange for college credit. Candidates should be energetic, hard-working and have aspirations of a career in the music industry. 



WHAT YOU'LL DO


  • Internship duration is for a semester (12 weeks or equivalent).
  • Hours are part-time (20-24 hours a week).
  • Intern will work both remotely and in the office during regular business hours. 
  • Intern will require personal laptop.
  • Projects will include assisting with the Academy’s grassroots advocacy initiatives, outreach to congressional offices, legislative research, database management, and administrative office support.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE


  • Students must be currently enrolled in a College/University for an Undergraduate or Graduate program.
  • One year of course work towards degree in related field is preferred.
  • Letter from school stating that intern will receive college credit for the Recording Academy internship program.
  • Display an interest in music and/or government and advocacy work.
  • Possess strong verbal, written and analytical skills.
  • Exhibit proficient computer skills and social media proficiency.
  • Be a sophomore, junior, senior or graduate student.

job.title: Operations Coordinator, Nashville Chapter
job.description:
This is a hybrid position requiring a minimum of three days per week in the Nashville, TN office.

 

 

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 

The Recording Academy’s mission is to recognize musical excellence, advocate for the well-being of music makers and ensure music remains an indelible part of our culture. The Academy is a professional membership organization of musicians, producers, engineers, and recording professionals that is dedicated to improving the cultural condition and quality of life for music and its makers.

 

We’re looking for a highly motivated, idea-generating self-starter who will coordinate office operations, high-quality initiatives, programs, and content with professionalism for the Nashville Chapter. As part of the Nashville Chapter team, you will be responsible for developing and managing programs to ensure member retention, working with local outreach committees, and building coalitions in our Chapter city as well as the surrounding Chapter region. You will also be responsible for the day-to-day logistics of the Nashville Chapter office. You are a team player ready to roll up your sleeves with impeccable follow-through.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 

Work with the Senior Executive Director to coordinate operations for the Nashville Chapter office:

  • Liaison with the property manager and the Recording Academy’s Facilities Operations department.
  • Manage the schedule for shared meeting rooms including communicating with various stakeholders.
  • Liaison with service vendors including researching best companies, scheduling services, discussing prices, and managing invoicing.
  • Know the building systems including security, internet, fire safety, etc.
  • Coordinate in-office artist visits with Academy staff.
  • Handle all office supplies and needs including general office supplies, postage, kitchen supplies, mail, UPS, FedEx, etc.

 

Facilitate the Chapter’s Grammy U Program, interns, and temps:

  • Recruit and facilitate interviews and the hiring process for Chapter Grammy U Reps.
  • In coordination with the Grammy U Program lead, work with the Grammy U Rep in training on programming, membership presentations and outreach, program Invitations and RSVP process, and copy writing.
  • In coordination with the Chapter Manager, structure a regular meeting schedule to monitor university and membership outreach and set yearly goals for Grammy U membership growth.
  • Facilitate the recruitment, interview, and hiring process for temps and interns.

 

Serve as the staff liaison for a variety of Chapter committees:

  • Work with committee chairs to schedule meetings and minutes.
  • Implement follow-up materials including collaborating with the Chapter Manager on related program initiatives.

 

Execute the Chapter’s social media marketing initiatives and strategy:

  • Work closely with the Chapter Manager on each program’s social media needs, creating the social plan strategy in partnership with the Academy’s social media team and set timeline.
  • Manage the day-to-day administration of the Chapter’s Facebook Group and work to grow followers including best practices to utilize the platform.
  • Manage Chapter’s social media calendar.

 

Legal Agreements:

  • Facilitate all vendor and performance agreements and releases pertaining to Chapter programs and initiatives.
  • Work closely with the Academy’s Legal Affairs and Executive Director department on agreements.
  • Ensure timely delivery and receipt of signatures from vendors and program participants.

 

Programming:

  • Attend all Chapter programs and Board meetings.
  • Work closely with the Academy’s Communications department to book and manage Getty photographers and security guards as it pertains to Chapter programs.
  • Ensure contracts for all security and catering/bartender requests are reviewed with the Academy’s Legal Affairs Department, signed promptly, and paid according to each vendor’s desired schedule, and event confirmation details are appropriately relayed ahead of each event.
  • Coordinate with the Chapter Manager in liaising with the social media and editorial teams, coordinating support and activations for Chapter events.
  • Track RSVPs and coordinate check-in/registration at programs.
  • Other programming duties as needed.

 

 

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 

  • Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in music business or related.
  • 3+ years of executive level administration experience in the music industry.
  • Proficiency in Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and various Microsoft applications.
  • Strong marketing skills through social media.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain composure under pressure and make decisions/problem solve in high-stress situations.
  • Outstanding organizational, time management, and multitasking skills.
  • Adaptability to change and openness to innovative ideas.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proven ability to foster teamwork and contribute positively to team dynamics.
  • Must be proactive with the ability to manage upwards.
  • Ability to uphold the highest levels of integrity and ethics.

 

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS FOR CERTAN ROLES

 

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for long periods of time, and work at a computer for long periods of time.

 

The employee will be required to lift and/or move up to 60 pounds.

 

 

SALARY AND BENEFITS

 

The starting rate for this position is $21.70 to $23.50 per hour, benchmarked against industry standards. Rates for positions required to be in specific geographic locations reflect the corresponding labor market. 
 
The actual offer extended will depend on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and the role's requirements. Positions working 20+ hours per week also receive our comprehensive benefits package (with medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401k match, generous paid time off, and more). Click here for an overview of our company benefits.


Explore our career opportunities to join a team that values creativity, innovation, and diversity.

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the Grammy Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the Grammy Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation.

 

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives.

 

MUSICARES

A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. A four-star charity and safety net in times of need, MusiCares offers confidential preventative, recovery, and emergency programs to address financial, medical, and personal health issues. Through the generosity of our donors and volunteer professionals, our dedicated team works across the country to ensure the music community has the resources and support it needs.

 

GRAMMY MUSEUM

The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include Grammy in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States. 

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The Recording Academy, its affiliates, and the music industry have a strong culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. The Recording Academy makes intentional, courageous, and principled decisions for stronger business outcomes and ensures that all creators and professionals live and work in a fair and safe environment. It is the Recording Academy's policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees. The Recording Academy does not discriminate on the basis of race (nor traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion (including religious dress and grooming), creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), national origin, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law. The Recording Academy will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to the Recording Academy. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including selection, job assignment, compensation, promotion, discipline, termination, access to benefits and training, recruitment, hiring, transfer, and social and recreational programs.

job.title: Coordinator, Operations
job.description:
About The Company Reservoir is an independent music company based in New York City and with offices in Los Angeles, Nashville, Toronto, London, Abu Dhabi, and Mumbai. Reservoir is the first female-founded and led publicly traded independent music company in the U.S. Founded as a family-owned music publisher in 2007, Reservoir has grown to represent over 150,000 copyrights and 36,000 master recordings with titles dating as far back as 1900 and hundreds of #1 releases worldwide. Reservoir frequently holds a Top 10 U.S. Market Share according to Billboard’s Publishers Quarterly, was twice named Publisher of the Year by Music Business Worldwide’s The A&R Awards and won Independent Publisher of the Year at the 2020 and 2022 Music Week Awards. Reservoir also represents a multitude of recorded music through Chrysalis Records, Tommy Boy Records, and Philly Groove Records and manages artists through its ventures with Blue Raincoat Music and Big Life Management. The Position The Coordinator, Operations supports the day-to-day operations of Reservoir’s New York office while providing executive support to the CEO, COO, and CFO and assisting the Chief of Staff with research, strategic initiatives, and special projects. This hands-on, entry-level position offers a unique opportunity to gain exposure to various aspects of the music business, contribute to company-wide initiatives, and build a strong foundation for career growth within the industry. The ideal candidate is highly organized, resourceful and proactive, with sound judgment and a genuine interest in music. This is an in-office role in New York, reporting to the Chief of Staff.

Responsibilities

include, but are not limited to: Running day-to-day operations of the New York office, making sure workspaces, conference rooms, the kitchen and common areas are organized, stocked and ready for the team and guests. Greeting and welcoming visitors, guests, artists and songwriters, and serve as the team's first point of contact for office needs. Managing office purchasing, vendors, inventory, mail, deliveries, catering and office events. Providing executive support to the CEO, COO and CFO, including calendars, scheduling, travel and expense reports. Partnering with IT so the office's facilities and technology work well, including setup for new hires, meeting rooms and visitors. Supporting the Chief of Staff with decks and materials for leadership and the Company. Conducting research on potential business opportunities, market developments and competitive activity. Analyzing music industry data using platforms such as Chartmetric, Luminate and Billboard to track artist performance, streaming trends, audience growth and emerging opportunities, and summarize key insights for the team and leadership. Keeping trackers, documentation and internal updates organized and current. Scouting new artists, songwriters and producers across DSPs, socials, live shows, playlists. Working with team to identify catalog songs with momentum, and help build sample packs and a pitch-ready library. Handling ticket purchases for shows and events for the New York office. Supporting teams in the New York office with ad hoc tasks and requests.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Music Business, Music Industry, Music Management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant

experience

in the music industry. 0–2 years of professional experience, including internships, with prior exposure to the music industry preferred. Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, able to juggle competing priorities and follow through. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and effectively across all levels of the organization. Eager to learn, takes initiative, and comfortable owning work from start to finish. Discreet with confidential information, with sound judgment and a professional approach. Genuine interest in music; familiarity with DSPs is a plus. Proficient in Microsoft Office, Slack and Zoom.

Experience

using AI tools to improve productivity, research, and workflows. Equal Employment Opportunity Reservoir is an

equal opportunity employer

committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, ethnicity, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe that embracing diversity strengthens our culture, drives innovation, and contributes to our continued success. If you require assistance or an accommodation in completing any aspect of the application process, please contact the Reservoir Recruiting team at: jobs@reservoir-media.com.

We believe in creativity, innovation, and collaboration in everything we do, and we are looking for people who share this mindset to join us. Then CityNews is looking for you. 

Responsibilities:

  • Shoots, edits, reports and presents news stories on all platforms - including continuous posting to website, X, Facebook, Instagram, and other platforms, throughout the shift to engage audience 
  • Organizes material and writes engaging, relevant and concise news stories under tight deadlines according to prescribed editorial style and format standards
  • Presents scripted and unscripted coverage live on-air and on other media platforms from remote locations and/or in-studio environment - including LIVE on social media platforms
