job.title: Anchor Producer, CNN This Morning – Kaitlan Collins
job.description:
Every great story has a new beginning, and yours starts here.

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

We are the now and the next. The power behind the people building the future. We are born from the spirit of innovation. We are created from the idea that people around the world want more, need more, deserve more. We are the home of the global digital revolution. We are CNN.

See what it’s like to work at CNN! Follow us on Instagram, Twitter and Facebook.

Your New Role…

CNN is looking for a Producer I for our new morning program anchored by Don Lemon, Poppy Harlow, and Kaitlan Collins. The Producer I will work with Kaitlan, ensuring editorial and show preparation needs are met for each show. This includes all editorial components of the program and field production for breaking news and special events. This role is highly collaborative – you’ll be responsible for producing and executing live segments on an early morning shift and assisting with research upon request. It’s critical that you are editorially mature and understand the driving headlines and moving markets around the world each morning. The ideal candidate should work well with talent, anticipate their needs and communicate clearly with the control room. You’ll be expected to think critically about the world and the show, while bringing your own story ideas or potential interviews to the table. Importantly, you’ll work closely with the show’s EP and Senior Staff to ensure your anchor, and all of us, reach our full potential.

This producer will back up the show’s other Anchor Producers as needed.

Your Role Accountabilities…

  • Produce segments for broadcast as directed.

  • Segments include newsmaker interviews, panel discussions, and at times producing reporter hits under tight deadlines.

  • Write craft hard-hitting questions and research pushback for news interviews.

  • Work with your anchor and the control room team to ensure all segments are executed according to plan.

  • Fact check segments on the fly during the show.

  • Select and/or produce key elements including sound bites, graphics, and video to help tell stories.

  • Provide research on guests, current events and other projects as directed.

  • Collaborate with our editorial producers to secure bookings.

  • Work with EP and Senior Staff to communicate what you and your anchor need to be successful.

  • Travel to cover breaking news and other stories in the field as the show requires.

  • Attend daily editorial meetings.

  • Work cross functionally with newsgathering, other linear shows, digital, booking, marketing and comms to maximize your work.

  • Contribute ideas for long form interviews, town halls, and other special programming.

  • Juggle not only day-of show assignments but also work on longform pieces, deep interview research, and planning ahead for future newsmaker interviews.

Qualifications & Experience…

  • 4+ years of editorial experience in cable, streaming or network television.

  • A bachelor’s degree is preferred, or equivalent experience.

  • Outstanding news judgment, critical and strategic thinking, and an ability to be persistent yet diplomatic.

  • Control room experience necessary, additional field experience preferred.

  • Collaborative personality with an aptitude for working under pressure with diverse talent and staff in addition to managing on-air personalities.

  • Cool, calm, and always collected.

  • Willingness to come in very early and be available throughout the day.

  • Must be able to work an extended schedule as the news cycle and deadlines require.

  • Proven ability to be a team player in a dynamic, pressure packed environment.

  • Must be able to travel on a moment’s notice.

  • Meticulous attention to detail is needed.

  • Relentless drive to pursue excellence.

  • Naturally curious and empathetic.

  • Motivational and inspiring presence.

  • Strong writing skills.

  • Strong collaborative skills, as well as the ability to delegate and prioritize effectively.

  • Knowledge of iNews.

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

The Legal Bits…

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. $85,540.00 - $158,860.00 salary per year. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards. In addition, Warner Bros. Discovery provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and paid time off (PTO).

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects the diversity of our society and the world around us. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you need a reasonable accommodation in order to apply for this position, please contact us at recruitadmin@wbd.com.

job.title: Content Producer, NBC Connecticut
job.description:
Company Description

NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

NBC Connecticut is looking for a Content Producer to collaborate with our team of exceptional journalists to create engaging and compelling content for our broadcast and digital platforms.  

Here You Can:  

  • Take charge of the big headlines with innovative showcasing and storytelling  
  • Create memorable newscasts for television and digital platforms  
  • Produce, write, and edit segments as assigned  
  • Collaborate with an experienced award-winning team  
  • Contribute ideas for stories based on the NBC Connecticut News Strategy  
  • Fill in as a producer when needed on other NBC CT newscasts  
  • Develop within the NBC Owned station group  

The ideal candidate will:  

  • Play an active role in the editorial process  
  • Have strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills  
  • Have basic editing skills on non-linear programs  
  • Have strategic thinking, researching and organizational skills  
  • Have excellent time-management skills, prioritize assignments to meet deadlines  
Qualifications

Basic Qualifications  

  • Bachelor’s Degree  
  • At least one year of related-work experience or equivalent experience  

Desired Characteristics:   

  • Bachelor's degree in communications or journalism  
  • Knowledge and understanding of various media platforms   
  • A focus on keeping up to date on news and current events in Connecticut    
  • Pioneering spirit with a desire and urgency to learn emerging technologies and invent the future   
  • Ability to solve problems, prioritize decisions and act decisively under deadline   
  • Stay connected with local news in our communities through emails, social media, and news releases   
  • Understanding of social media   

Eligibility Requirements:   

  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/cover letter through nbcunicareers.com to be considered   
  • Must be willing to work at the station in West Hartford, CT   
  • Must have a flexible schedule with ability to work any shift including holidays and weekends with short notice   
  • Must have the ability to work any of a 24 x 7 shift   
  • Must be covered by Solutions, NBCU’s Alternative Dispute Resolution Program   
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States   
  • Required on site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.   

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $55,000 - $70,000

Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

job.description:
Company Description

NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. Job Description

Telemundo Utah is seeking a creative, highly motivated Creative Services Producer to join its marketing team. The Creative Services Producer collaborates with the Creative Services Manager and cross-functional teams to develop and execute promotional content, marketing initiatives, and community-focused projects across broadcast, streaming, digital, social, print, radio, outdoor, and experiential platforms. This role supports station priorities, special programming, news promotion, sales efforts, and community engagement activities through compelling and culturally relevant creative content.

The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller with exceptional writing, producing, shooting, editing, and motion graphics skills who understands how to connect with Hispanic audiences through engaging and culturally relevant content.

This position reports directly to the Creative Services Manager and works closely with News, Sales, Digital, and Community teams to support station marketing and promotional objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Write, shoot, edit, and produce station image, news, sales, topical, and special promotional content from concept through final delivery.
  • Create compelling content across broadcast, digital, streaming, OTT, social media, and emerging platforms.
  • Collaborate with the Creative Services Manager, internal and external stakeholders to develop creative campaigns, promotional content, and marketing projects while adhering to Telemundo and NBCUniversal brand standards.
  • Support annual Creative Services plans, station tentpoles, key initiatives, special programming, and major marketing priorities.
  • Collaborate on the development and execution of promotional campaigns, marketing efforts, and community-focused initiatives that support station objectives, audience engagement, and brand awareness.
  • Produce marketing and promotional materials for television, digital, social media, print, radio, outdoor, and experiential activations.
  • Operate DSLR and full-frame camera systems, professional audio equipment, and lighting packages for studio and field productions.
  • Transport, set up, and operate production equipment, including lighting, audio systems, wireless microphones, and related accessories.
  • Perform post-production editing, color correction, audio adjustments, graphic integration, voice-over synchronization, music selection, and final finishing utilizing Adobe Creative Cloud applications.
  • Partner with News, Sales, Digital, and Community teams to create news, image, branded, and promotional content while maintaining consistency across all platforms.
  • Ensure promotional content meets broadcast, legal, technical, and NBCUniversal quality standards.
  • Maintain production schedules, project trackers, standard operating procedures, and workflow processes that support efficient execution and delivery of projects.
  • Collaborate closely with newsroom, sales, digital, and community teams to support station initiatives and sponsorship opportunities.
  • Participate in sales meetings and assist with the development of sponsorship opportunities, branded content, and client-focused marketing solutions.
  • Support community engagement programs and partnership events that strengthen the station's visibility and relationships throughout the market.
  • Support emcee, hosting, speaking, and other public-facing opportunities as assigned to help elevate station talent and brand presence.
  • Coordinate with internal teams on promotional shoots, marketing initiatives, and community events.
  • Develop digital and print creative assets utilizing Adobe Creative Cloud applications.
  • Ensure station promotional vehicles and event assets are clean, presentable, and event-ready while coordinating with designated operational and maintenance resources as needed.
  • Assist the Creative Services Manager with special projects and assignments as needed.
  • Maintain flexibility to work nights, weekends, holidays, and extended hours as needed 24/7.
Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • Fluency in Spanish and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both languages.
  • Minimum three (3) years of experience producing promotional, branding, commercial, marketing, or news content for television, media, agency, or related industries.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Production, Digital Media, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience writing, producing, shooting, and editing video content.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, including Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Audition, and Lightroom.
  • Experience operating professional video cameras, audio equipment, and lighting systems.
  • Strong scriptwriting and storytelling abilities.
  • Strong understanding of the U.S. Hispanic consumer.
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 applications.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across departments and contribute to community initiatives and events.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be 18 years or older.
  • Candidates must submit a resume/CV via www.nbcunicareers.com
  • Portfolio or demo reel of relevant work is strongly encouraged. Candidates should include a link when submitting their application, if available.
  • Must be willing to work in Salt Lake City, Utah.
  • Must be flexible to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and changing schedules as business needs require.
  • Must be willing to travel as needed.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license and maintain an acceptable driving record.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience creating content and promotional efforts across broadcast, digital, social, streaming, and experiential platforms.
  • Prior experience working in Spanish-language television, media, or entertainment.
  • Familiarity with digital and social media performance metrics.
  • Strong motion graphics and design skills.
  • Experience supporting community engagement programs and local marketing efforts.
  • Advanced proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud and demonstrated ability to create high-quality station image, commercial, branded, and promotional content.
  • Experience directing and producing promos, commercials, branded content, digital content, and news marketing projects.
  • Knowledge of WideOrbit and related media workflow systems is a plus.
  • Familiarity with evolving creative production tools and workflows.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Positive attitude, strong work ethic, and commitment to creative excellence.
  • Ability to receive feedback constructively and adapt quickly to changing priorities.
  • Strong team player who collaborates effectively across departments.

Additional Requirements

Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

job.title: Digital Media Producer, NBC & Telemundo San Diego
job.description:
Company Description

NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

The Digital Media Producer plays a major role in the day-to-day execution of NBC 7 and Telemundo 20’s digital news strategy, working with other local newsroom staff to ensure the offering is consistently up-to-the-minute, differentiated, impactful and relevant to a multiplatform audience. The role combines acute attention to detail, rapid response, strong editorial judgment, and consistent day-to-day execution and project-management responsibilities within a 24/7 newsgathering operation. You will be required to create and produce news content for broadcast or digital platforms based on daily newsroom needs. This role requires strong editorial judgment, adaptability, and the ability to deliver accurate, compelling content under deadline. 

Job Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for overall production and content of newscasts on any platform
  • Write news scripts, teases, headlines for broadcast and edit video
  • Execute live shots and communicate with anchors during live newscasts
  • Respond to breaking news with accuracy and urgency
  • Contribute to the creation of videos for OTT, FAST and all platforms
  • Collaborate with reporters on daily stories to deliver content across all platforms
  • Write text articles, create and publish videos, photos and podcast for our website
  • Curate YouTube channels
  • Manage video livestreams when necessary
  • Stay well-informed of daily news events and knowledgeable of the San Diego news market
  • Contribute story ideas, participate in daily coverage decisions and editorial meetings
  • Perform other related duties as assigned
Qualifications
  • A minimum of 2 years of experience as broadcast line producer and/or digital producer
  • Bachelor’s degree in communication, journalism or related field
  • At least 1-year prior news editing experience
  • Familiarity with Adobe Premiere and/or other editing programs
  • Ability to work on multiple tasks and stories simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to react to breaking news, updating the news as stories evolve and write intros and leads to video online content
  • Experience working with online publishing tools or content management system
  • Demonstrated knowledge of AP style writing and guidelines

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV through the www.nbcunicareers.com site
  • Internal applicants must submit via myNBCU Careers
  • Must be willing to work at the station in San Diego location
  • Must be 18 years or older
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
  • Must have valid driver’s license
  • Must have ability to work any of a 24x7 shift
  • Must submit a sample of own work to be considered
  • Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

Desired:

  • Demonstrated leadership abilities and communication skills
  • Experience writing scripts, captions and text for video graphics
  • Ability to communicate effectively and work well with people while under pressure
  • Experience in editing video for web, social media platforms and TV
  • Knowledge of laws of libel, slander and applicable FCC rules and regulations
  • Personal initiative and ability to work with minimum supervision
  • Team player who is flexible
  • Displays a positive work ethic and can work under tight deadlines
  • High degree of integrity and professionalism
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) both written and verbal preferred

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $71,000 - $90,000

Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

job.title: Duopoly Reporter, NBC & Telemundo New York
job.description:
Company Description

NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

The WNBC/WNJU New York Duopoly is seeking a dynamic, Reporter to join our integrated newsroom. This role is designed to serve audiences across both WNBC and WNJU, delivering original journalism in English and Spanish across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms.

The ideal candidate is an enterprising, multiplatform journalist with strong live reporting skills, excellent news judgment, and the ability to tell compelling stories for both English- and Spanish-language audiences. This reporter will play an important role in our duopoly approach to news coverage, working seamlessly across both stations to maximize original reporting, share content effectively, and serve the diverse communities of the New York Tri-State area.

The reporter must be equally comfortable covering breaking news, developing enterprise and community-driven stories, conducting live interviews, producing content for multiple platforms, and adapting storytelling for the audiences of WNBC and WNJU.

Responsibilities

  • Report, write, and deliver original stories for both WNBC and WNJU across newscasts, streaming platforms, websites, social media, and emerging platforms.
  • Report and present stories in both English and Spanish, adapting content appropriately for each station's audience rather than simply translating material.
  • Cover breaking news and major events from the field through live shots, interviews, digital updates, and packaged reports.
  • Develop distinctive enterprise and community-focused stories that are relevant to audiences throughout the New York Tri-State area.
  • Pitch original story ideas and cultivate a broad and diverse network of sources across communities, beats, and geographic areas.
  • Work collaboratively across the duopoly newsroom to identify opportunities to share and maximize reporting while reducing unnecessary duplication of coverage.
  • Partner closely with producers, assignment editors, photographers, anchors, digital teams, and newsroom leadership across WNBC and WNJU.
  • Create and adapt content specifically for broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms, recognizing the different storytelling needs of each.
  • Demonstrate flexibility in reporting assignments and work across both stations based on daily editorial priorities and breaking news needs.
  • Contribute to special projects, major event coverage, investigative or enterprise initiatives, and other duopoly-wide editorial efforts.
  • Represent WNBC and WNJU at community events and public appearances as assigned.
  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of local, national, and international news developments.
  • Uphold NBCUniversal journalistic standards, ethics, and editorial guidelines.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Broadcasting, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of reporting experience in a television news environment.
  • Full proficiency in English and Spanish, including speaking, writing, translating, interviewing, and live reporting.
  • Strong live reporting, interviewing, writing, and storytelling skills.
  • Experience covering breaking news and developing stories under tight deadlines.
  • Excellent writing, storytelling, and editorial judgment.
  • Strong editorial judgment and ability to make sound decisions in fast-moving news situations.
  • Ability to work independently in the field and collaborate effectively within a team environment.
  • Experience creating content for broadcast, digital, streaming, and social media platforms.
  • Valid driver's license with a good driving record.
  • Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours during major news events.
  • Must be willing to work throughout the New York metropolitan area and surrounding coverage regions.
  • Must be willing to join SAG-AFTRA.

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong knowledge of the New York Tri-State area and an understanding of the diverse communities served by WNBC and WNJU.
  • Proven ability to generate original enterprise reporting and develop trusted sources.
  • Experience working across English- and Spanish-language news operations or in a bilingual/multicultural newsroom.
  • Strong understanding of how storytelling and editorial priorities may differ across audiences, platforms, and brands.
  • Strong social media and audience-engagement skills.
  • Ability to ad-lib confidently, accurately, and calmly during breaking news situations.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively across multiple platforms and brands.
  • Collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for working within an integrated duopoly newsroom.
  • Passion for local journalism, community connection, and public-service reporting.
  • Experience with investigative, consumer, political, or community-focused reporting is a plus.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV and demo reel through NBCUniversal Careers.
  • Must be willing to work in New York City.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization in the United States.

Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

Salary Range: $160,000-185,000

Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

job.title: Freelance Producer, Pre/Post Game Shows - Kansas City, Missouri
job.description:
MLB Local Media is seeking a creative, organized, and highly motivated Producer to lead the production of Kansas City Royals pre-game and post-game television programming. This individual will be responsible for the editorial direction, content development, and live execution of shows, delivering compelling, informative, and entertaining coverage that connects Royals fans to their team. The ideal candidate combines strong baseball knowledge, excellent storytelling instincts, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced live television environment. This position requires close collaboration with on-air talent, production personnel, editors, and the Royals organization to create programming that is timely, engaging, and reflective of the team's identity.

Responsibilities:

Editorial & Content Development

  • Develop and execute the editorial vision for Royals pre-game and post-game programming.
  • Identify compelling storylines, news, statistics, and discussion topics that resonate with Royals fans.
  • Create daily show rundowns, establish segment priorities, and determine the overall flow and pacing of each broadcast.
  • Collaborate with on-air talent to develop insightful analysis, engaging conversations, and meaningful storytelling.
  • Incorporate player interviews, feature stories, highlights, statistical analysis, and other original content into each show.
  • Adjust editorial priorities in response to breaking news, roster developments, injuries, and game results.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the Royals, their players, organizational storylines, and the broader Major League Baseball landscape.

Live Show Production

  • Serve as the lead producer for live Royals pre-game and post-game shows.
  • Coordinate with directors, technical crews, graphics operators, editors, and other production personnel to ensure seamless execution.
  • Manage live show timing, segment transitions, commercial breaks, and changing production requirements.
  • Make quick editorial decisions during live broadcasts while maintaining accuracy, clarity, and production quality.
  • Oversee the integration of highlights, replays, graphics, interviews, and other supporting elements.
  • Adapt post-game programming to reflect the most important moments, performances, and developments from each game.
  • Ensure shows maintain consistent production standards while allowing for creativity, personality, and spontaneity.

Talent & Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with hosts, analysts, reporters, and other on-air personalities to maximize their strengths and develop engaging content.
  • Lead daily editorial meetings and communicate show priorities and expectations.
  • Coordinate with the Royals' communications and baseball operations personnel regarding interviews, access, and relevant team information.
  • Collaborate with the game broadcast producer to maintain editorial continuity between pre-game coverage, the live game telecast, and post-game analysis.
  • Build productive relationships across MLB Local Media's production, operations, and editorial teams.

Creative Development & Quality Control

  • Develop new segments, recurring features, and creative approaches that enhance the viewing experience.
  • Identify opportunities to incorporate original reporting, behind-the-scenes access, and unique Royals content.
  • Maintain high standards for editorial accuracy, production value, graphics, and storytelling.
  • Review broadcasts and identify opportunities to improve pacing, presentation, content, and overall execution.
  • Contribute ideas that strengthen the Royals' broadcast identity and deepen fan engagement.
  • Stay current with evolving sports television production techniques, technologies, and audience expectations.
  • Other such duties as required.

Qualifications and Skills:

Required Qualifications

  • Experience producing live sports television programming, preferably within Major League Baseball or another professional sports environment.
  • Strong understanding of baseball, including game strategy, statistics, personnel, and current MLB storylines.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop editorial content and execute live studio or remote productions.
  • Experience creating show rundowns and coordinating multiple production elements under tight deadlines.
  • Excellent editorial judgment, communication skills, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to make sound decisions quickly in a live television environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
  • Willingness to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and a schedule aligned with the MLB season and travel with team as dictated by the Royals schedule.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience producing MLB pre-game or post-game programming.
  • Experience working with professional sports teams, regional sports networks, or national sports television networks.
  • Familiarity with live sports production workflows, highlight editing, graphics systems, and video playback platforms.
  • Demonstrated creativity in developing original sports programming and recurring editorial features.
  • Experience working directly with high-profile on-air talent and professional athletes.
  • Strong understanding of the Kansas City Royals, their history, and their fan base.

Key Attributes for Success

  • Editorial Instincts: Recognizes the stories that matter and understands how to present them effectively.
  • Creativity: Consistently brings fresh ideas, compelling segments, and innovative storytelling approaches.
  • Leadership: Establishes clear expectations, communicates effectively, and creates a collaborative production environment.
  • Adaptability: Remains composed and decisive when live television requires immediate adjustments.
  • Preparation: Anticipates production needs, understands the day's storylines, and ensures the entire team is prepared.
  • Accountability: Takes ownership of the finished product and continuously works to improve broadcast quality.
  • Passion for Baseball: Brings genuine enthusiasm and a deep understanding of the sport to every production.

Position Expectations

  • This role requires a producer who can balance strong editorial preparation with the flexibility and creativity necessary for live sports television.
  • The Producer should approach every broadcast with a clear understanding of the most important Royals storylines, a plan for how to communicate them effectively, and the ability to adjust that plan as the game and news cycle unfold.

Pay Range: $1,000 - $1,200 per day

job.title: Host - new daily show
job.description:
Host, New Daily Show

KNKX | Full-time onsite in Tacoma, WA

Salary Range: $90,000 - $100,000 annually, depending on experience


About the Opportunity

KNKX has a strong history of creating memorable, award-winning content. From long-form documentaries to deep reporting, the station has always valued creativity and the stories that matter to Western Washington.

Now, KNKX is launching something new: a daily, one-hour news, interview, and storytelling program airing Monday through Friday at 3 PM. The show will cover the news of the day while making space for arts, culture, and the stories that surprise and connect us as a region.


We are hiring two Hosts for this show. This is a rare chance to be a founding voice of a new program at a station that is investing and growing. In a media landscape where newsrooms are contracting, KNKX is creating something, and the right people get to shape what it becomes.


This position is based in KNKX's Tacoma, WA studios 5 days a week. This is a SAG-AFTRA union position.


Why This Role Stands Out

  • Be a founding voice of a brand-new daily show and help define its identity from day one.
  • Join a collaborative 6-person production team that values ideas from everyone.
  • Work at a station with deep community trust and a signal that reaches from Vancouver, BC to the Oregon border.
  • Fill a real need: this show is part of KNKX's commitment to serving Western Washington with useful, engaging journalism.


The Role

As Host, you will be one of two on-air voices leading this new program. Reporting to the Executive Producer, and working in partnership with your co-host, and a production team, you will help shape the daily editorial direction, conduct interviews, and deliver a show that is warm, sharp, curious, and grounded in the community.


This is not a role where you show up and read what is handed to you. You are part of the producing force. You bring ideas, you pitch stories, you help decide who gets interviewed and what gets covered. You are also the backstop: the last person to touch something before it goes over the air. That means composure under pressure, the ability to pivot when news breaks, and the instinct to follow a conversation wherever it leads.


Key Responsibilities

On-Air Hosting

  • Host a daily, one-hour live news and culture program, managing show flow, timing, and transitions under live-broadcast pressure.
  • Lead 2-4 daily segments ranging from 10- to 20-minute interviews with newsmakers, community leaders, artists, and experts.
  • Pivot when news breaks. Be willing and able to rework the rundown on the fly during a live broadcast.
  • Interact with listeners through call-in segments and participate in live community events.


Segment Production and Editorial Sourcing

  • Write and edit scripts, intros, commentary, and promotional copy to public radio standards.
  • Source interview subjects and segment topics and pitch ideas in daily team meetings.
  • Collaborate with the Digital Editor to adapt on-air content for digital, podcast, and social media formats.


Community Engagement and Ambassadorship

  • Represent KNKX at public panels, live town halls, station events, fund drives, and community gatherings across Western Washington.
  • Engage authentically with listeners across digital, audio, and social channels to build trust and expand audience reach.
  • Take the show on the road through live remotes and community events.


What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Experience: 7+ years of live broadcast experience in radio, television, or a comparable live format. We need someone with time in the saddle who has handled breaking news, quick pivots, and the pressure of live programming.
  • Interviewing Instincts: A skilled, curious interviewer who comes prepared but knows when to put the questions down and follow the conversation where it leads. You seek the "why" behind every story.
  • Collaboration: A team player who brings ideas, collaborates with producers, and contributes to the editorial direction of the show. This is not a role for someone who only cracks open the mic.
  • On-Air Presence: Someone warm, genuine, and authoritative. You connect with people across political, ideological, and geographic lines through empathy.
  • Writing: Sharp, concise broadcast writing for intros, commentary, scripts, and promotional copy.
  • Technical Proficiency: Working familiarity with digital audio workstations (e.g., Audition, Pro Tools, Hindenburg).
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Political Science, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • Location: This position is based in KNKX's Tacoma, WA studios 5 days a week. This is a SAG-AFTRA union position.


Sets You Apart

  • Strong understanding of Pacific Northwest political dynamics, regional history, and Western Washington community issues.
  • Prior experience in public media (NPR/PRI/PRX network ecosystem).
  • Experience hosting or moderating live audience events and community panels.
  • A proven track record of sourcing diverse, non-traditional community voices across ideological and geographic boundaries.
  • A flexible, audience-first mindset. You think about what listeners need, not just what is interesting to you.
  • We want hosts who can handle the hard things and still bring joy and a twinkle in the eye.


About Us

At KNKX we work hard to create a culture where employees feel valued and respected, are trusted and encouraged to be a part of improvements that impact their work, create value, and help build trust in public media. KNKX's vision is to grow and become a more inclusive organization that brings joy, meaning, and understanding into people's lives. We value diverse perspectives and an array of life experiences.

KNKX is a Western Washington public media company, dedicated to bringing jazz, blues, regional news, and NPR programs to the Northwest and beyond. As an independent dual-format station, KNKX employees are energized in their mission to provide the very best music and news content to an audience of more than 400,000 weekly.


How to Apply

Apply here: https://knkx.bamboohr.com/careers/67?source=aWQ9NjE%3D

Submit your:

  • Resume
  • Cover letter detailing your connection to the Pacific Northwest and your editorial philosophy
  • Audio reel (3-5 minutes) featuring live interviews or hosting clips


Compensation and Benefits

Salary: $90,000 - $100,000 annually, depending on experience

KNKX offers a strong benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage with FSA option
  • PTO and holidays, including the full week between Christmas and New Year's
  • 401(k) with generous company match
  • Disability, life, and AD&D insurance options
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)


Interview Process

  • One-way video interview (4 short questions recorded on your own time)
  • Phone screening with the myHR Partner hiring team
  • Interview with the KNKX hiring committee
  • Recording a test segment with KNKX on-air talent
  • Final onsite interview


Our hiring management partner is myHR Partner. myHR Partner is not a staffing service or recruiter. All resumes/applications will be reviewed for this position and only for our organization.


Thank you for considering us as a potential employer!


Additional Information and Conditions of Employment:

Prior to hire, references and a background check including criminal record history will be conducted. Information from the background check will not necessarily preclude employment but will be considered in determining the applicant's suitability and competence to perform in the position. This is a SAG-AFTRA represented position. Union membership will be required as a condition of employment, per the terms of the collective bargaining agreement.


KNKX is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, sex (including gender identity), marital status, sexual orientation, race, creed, color, national origin, veteran or military status, or the presence of any sensory, mental, or physical disability or the use of a trained dog guide or service animal by a person with a disability. You are welcome to include the name and pronoun you would like to be referred to in your materials and we will honor it. Persons requiring accommodation in the application process, during the recruitment process, or who need this job announcement in an alternative format, may contact the Human Resources Office at knkxhr@myhrpartner.com.

About the Agency

The United States Agency for Global Media (USAGM) is an exciting, multi-media, multi-cultural, global media agency that carries out all United States civilian international broadcasting. Our media networks complement and reinforce one another in a shared mission vital to U.S. national interests: to inform, engage, and connect people around the world in support of freedom and democracy. Our staff of dedicated professionals serve as an example of a free and independent media, bringing news, information, and relevant discussions to a weekly audience of over 278 million people worldwide in over 60 languages via radio, television, Internet, and social media.

USAGM networks include the Voice of America and the Office of Cuba Broadcasting (Radio and TV Marti) and three grantee organizations: Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty, the Middle East Broadcasting Networks (Alhurra TV and Radio Sawa), and Radio Free Asia.

This is not an announcement for a federal job. This position is for employment as a personal services contractor with VOA News. All personal service contractors must pass a thorough background check.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents are encouraged to apply. Employer sponsorship for work visas is not available for this position.

job.title: Morning Show Producer, NBC Bay Area
job.description:
Company Description

NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

NBC Bay Area is looking for an experienced, energetic morning show producer who understands what viewers need when they wake up and knows how to deliver it with urgency, creativity, and personality.

Morning news is about getting people ready for their day. That means delivering the latest news, breaking developments, weather and traffic, while also creating a show that feels fresh, relevant, engaging and connected to the Bay Area community.

We’re looking for someone who loves producing morning news and comes to work ready to make the show better every day. You should be an aggressive news producer who knows how to handle the show when breaking news happens, make smart editorial decisions quickly, and keep viewers informed as a story develops.

We’re looking for someone who already has a few years of daily newscast producing experience and is ready for more. Someone who wants to grow, experiment, innovate and help us make our morning newscast smarter and more useful to the Bay Area.

What You’ll Do

  • Produce a fast-paced, informative and engaging morning newscast that helps Bay Area viewers start their day.
  • Build smart, compelling rundowns that prioritize the latest news, breaking developments, weather, traffic and stories that matter to our communities.
  • Aggressively respond to breaking news, including quickly restructuring the newscast and adjusting coverage as stories develop.
  • Write clear, conversational and accurate copy under tight deadlines.
  • Work closely with anchors, reporters, assignment editors, weather, traffic, digital teams and production crews to execute a strong, cohesive broadcast.
  • Constantly look for ways to make the newscast more useful, interesting and distinctive.
  • Find creative ways to showcase important stories rather than simply relying on traditional formats.
  • Incorporate digital, streaming and social content into the morning news workflow.
  • Make strong editorial decisions quickly and confidently while maintaining NBC Bay Area’s standards for accuracy and fairness.
  • Bring energy, ideas and enthusiasm to the newsroom—even in the very early morning hours.

What We’re Looking For

  • A producer who understands the unique needs and habits of a morning audience.
  • A strong news producer who knows how to recognize a big story and aggressively pursue it.
  • Someone who thrives during breaking news and remains calm, decisive and accurate when the rundown changes quickly.
  • A producer who understands that weather and traffic are essential parts of a successful morning newscast and knows how to integrate them effectively throughout the show.
  • A creative thinker who wants to experiment with new storytelling, formats and ways to connect with viewers.
  • Strong editorial judgment and excellent news writing skills.
  • Someone who is curious and/or knowledgeable about the Bay Area and wants to serve the local community.
  • A collaborative team player who communicates well and understands that producing a successful morning show requires everyone working together.
  • Someone who wants to grow as a producer, take on more responsibility and contribute ideas that make the entire morning team better.
Qualifications

Qualifications

job.title: News Producer
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The News Producer is responsible for their individual, assigned newscast. Each Producer works with their Executive Producer and other newsroom staff to take daily reporter assignments, voiceovers (VOs), voice-over sound on tape (VOSOTs) and other stories to build compelling, informative newscasts. Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following duties.

Duties/Responsibilities

  • Manage daily production of newscasts by compiling and writing stories, logging video, etc. within specific time constraints to meet news deadlines.
  • Manage the Control Room during assigned newscasts, working closely with Directors and Production teams to ensure live programs are executed flawlessly.
  • Provide direction and talent instruction to crews in the field and in studio.
  • Collaborate about changes with Executive Producer prior to air and during newscasts.
  • Supervise and oversee Writers assigned to the shift, assign writing ideas to APs, edit AP scripts, and provide feedback.
  • Work with reporters to develop story scripts, edit Reporter scripts, and provide feedback.
  • Assign voiceovers and VO-SOTs to Reporters and Anchors.
  • Collaborate with on-air staff to assist with story development and story support.
  • Work with field crews, via telephone, to manage stories, provide graphics support, video, and logistical support.
  • Log, edit, and transcribe soundbites, write VOs, teases and opens, create basic graphics and coordinate closely with video editors.
  • Work closely with Assignment Desk staff to coordinate live shots and Reporter and Photographer assignments.
  • Maintain open communication with News Director, the news management team, and all station personnel to efficiently, respectfully, and professionally complete news assignments.
  • Collaborate with web/social media team to coordinate coverage for online and on-air stories.
  • Quickly add appropriate information to newscasts in the event of breaking news.
  • Produce unscheduled breaking news or other items as events warrant.
  • Attend and participate in department meetings. Provide suggestions for news related stories and participate in post-production critiques.
  • Demonstrate responsibility for all equipment issued by FOX.
  • Comply with all FOX Corporate computer requirements.
  • Comply with all FOX Corporate and station policies.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills and Abilities

  • Proficiency with MS Office including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to work under daily pressure and successfully manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • This is a full-time position on a regular shift, but the news is a 24/7 world and that could occasionally include other shifts as breaking news or other circumstances warrant.

Education and Experience

  • One (1) year of experience in a medium to major television market is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Radio/TV or related discipline preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working at a computer.
  • Regularly stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear.
  • Occasionally required to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • Regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
  • Vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

News moves fast, and great radio keeps people connected to what's happening around them. The LEGENDARY Mighty 790 KFGO, is looking for a full-time, curious, and driven storyteller who knows how to inform, engage, and connect with listeners through compelling local news and conversation.

Fox Sports

FOX Sports, the industry leader in live events, is the umbrella entity representing Fox Corporation’s wide array of multi-platform US-based sports assets.   • Collaborate with Supervisor, On-Campus Content to produce video content for digital and social platforms (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube)

  • Drive day-to-day content collaboration with the Purdue Athletics Department (Communications, Social Media, and Video Teams)

  • Shoot, edit, and deliver content from live sporting events
  • Perform pre/post video production optimized for social media sharing
  • Ensure all content aligns with brand standards – consistent in style, quality, and voice
  • Cover real-time breaking Purdue Athletics news
  • Occasionally execute duties of field producer on ENG shoots

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Extensive knowledge of digital video production and content management systems
  • Demonstrated production and editing experience with intercollegiate athletics programs or professional sports teams is strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to shoot video content at sporting events
  • Demonstrated ability to provide constructive feedback to others as well as seek out and accept constructive feedback for your individual performance

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

Job Description

Dateline NBC is seeking an experienced Producer to develop, report, and produce longform investigative and true crime stories for broadcast, streaming, and digital platforms. Working closely with correspondents, senior producers, editors, legal teams, and production staff, the Producer will play a key role in all phases of production—from story development and reporting through scripting, field production, editing, and post-production.

The ideal candidate is a strong journalist and storyteller with exceptional editorial judgment, strong organizational skills, and a passion for investigative reporting and true crime programming.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, research, and produce original longform stories for Dateline NBC.
  • Conduct extensive reporting, including interviews with sources, attorneys, law enforcement officials, experts, and key stakeholders.
  • Identify, cultivate, and maintain relationships with sources and potential interview subjects.
  • Write and edit scripts, teases, and promotional materials.
  • Collaborate with correspondents to shape story structure and editorial direction.
  • Plan and oversee field shoots, including interviews, as well as character and location b-roll.
  • Work closely with editors to craft visually compelling, accurate, and engaging stories.
  • Review court records, legal filings, police reports, and other source materials to verify facts and support reporting.
  • Coordinate with Standards, Legal, and Rights & Clearances teams to ensure compliance with NBC News policies and practices.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting production deadlines.
  • Contribute story ideas and editorial updates as cases develop.
  • Collaborate with digital, streaming, audio and promotional teams to extend storytelling across platforms.
Qualifications
  • Minimum 5 years of experience producing longform news, documentary, investigative, or true crime programming.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience reporting, researching, and producing complex stories.
  • Experience managing productions and production budgets from development through post-production.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills.
  • Experience conducting interviews with victims, families, attorneys, and law enforcement personnel, and on sensitive subject matter.
  • Must be willing to travel domestically as needed.
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY or Los Angeles, CA.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Exceptional editorial judgment and journalistic integrity.
  • Strong knowledge of the criminal justice system, investigative journalism, and current events.
  • Ability to synthesize large volumes of information and identify compelling story angles.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize competing deadlines and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Familiarity with broadcast journalism guidelines, standards and ethics.

Additional Job Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week when not in the field. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

job.title: Radio Producer - International Multimedia Journalist III
job.description:
Primary Responsibilities:

 Writes and produces news and feature content and programming as assigned for use in radio broadcasts  

 As assigned, during programs, serves as line producer for a complex show incorporating audio, effects, multiple remote live sources, etc  

 Conducts and writes up interviews for inclusion in his/her assigned stories  

 Adapts and/or translates content produced in English into native language, as assigned  

 Versions content produced in native language into English for distribution, as assigned  

 Participates in the creation and development of regularly scheduled or special radio and/or tv programs and/or web and social media sections, as assigned  

 Voices material for/during broadcasts as assigned, including material prepared by others  

 Contributes to production elements of programs and content for broadcast and/or web and social media, including fine editing of taped material, as assigned  

 As assigned, edits and approves copy and content prepared or written by others for broadcast and/or publication for inclusion in his/her assigned stories  

 Adapts and/or translates content produced in English into native language, as assigned  

 Versions content produced in native language into English for distribution, as assigned  

 Participates in the creation and development of regularly scheduled or special radio and/or tv programs and/or web and social media sections, as assigned  

 Contributes finished products meeting standards to production elements of programs and content for broadcast and/or web and social media, including fine editing of taped material and static and motion graphics, as assigned  

 Performs technical functions including operation of equipment, as assigned  

 Contributes to teamwork, facilitating tasks of teammates, as needed  

 Meets VOA standards for productivity, quality, and meeting deadlines  

 Makes suggestions about policy and workflow improvements  

 Works independently or as a member of a team  

 Fluency in target language (written, spoken) and deep knowledge of the target area, plus the ability to adapt stories into English as assigned, within the time assigned  

 Logs and conducts data entry and other functions connected with VOA’s digital asset management system  

 Other related duties as assigned  

 

About the Agency

The United States Agency for Global Media (USAGM) is an exciting, multi-media, multi-cultural, global media agency that carries out all United States civilian international broadcasting. Our media networks complement and reinforce one another in a shared mission vital to U.S. national interests: to inform, engage, and connect people around the world in support of freedom and democracy. Our staff of dedicated professionals serve as an example of a free and independent media, bringing news, information, and relevant discussions to a weekly audience of over 278 million people worldwide in over 60 languages via radio, television, Internet, and social media.

USAGM networks include the Voice of America and the Office of Cuba Broadcasting (Radio and TV Marti) and three grantee organizations: Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty, the Middle East Broadcasting Networks (Alhurra TV and Radio Sawa), and Radio Free Asia.

This is not an announcement for a federal job. All personal service contractors must pass a thorough background check.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents are encouraged to apply. Employer sponsorship for work visas is not available for this position.

job.description:

NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

The NBC News Breaking News Specials team seeks a seasoned Senior Producer to drive our weekend prime and overnight breaking news coverage and contribute to Early Today. You will lead editorial and operational execution when news breaks, ensuring broadcasts are fast, accurate, and compelling.
 

Responsibilities:

  • Lead live breaking-news coverage during major events
  • Coordinate with control-room staff, on-air talent, and field reporters
  • Make split-second editorial decisions that uphold accuracy and clarity
  • Serve as the primary editorial lead for Friday, Saturday, and Sunday prime and overnights
  • Contribute to Early Today as needed
  • Mentor and guide the weekend prime and overnight editorial team
  • Collaborate with the Specials team on event planning and execution
  • Partner with technical, graphics, audio, and talent departments to maintain top-tier production quality
  • Produce live cut-ins, special segments, and additional content as needed for NBC Network and NBC News Now
Qualifications
  • At least 6 years in broadcast or cable news production, including 3 years on breaking news or live event teams
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent newsroom experience
  • Proven track record of rapid, accurate editorial judgment under deadline pressure
  • Expertise in control room operations from rundown creation through final sign-off
  • Proficiency with automated control room systems and rundown tools –– or clear aptitude to learn them quickly
  • Flexibility to work overnights, weekends, and be on call for urgent breaking events
  • Willingness and ability to work in person at 30 Rock five nights a week

Desired Characteristics:

  • Steady under pressure: A composed and decisive leader who excels in fast-paced, high-stakes breaking news situations
  • Clear communicator: Articulates direction with clarity and confidence –– both in writing and during live broadcasts
  • Collaborative mentor: Invested in nurturing emerging talent and fostering a culture of growth and teamwork
  • Editorial excellence: Brings sharp editorial judgment and can guide a team through fast-moving, unpredictable live events

Additional Requirements:

  • Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

job.title: Senior Writer/Producer - CNN
job.description:
Every great story has a new beginning, and yours starts here.

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

We are the now and the next. The power behind the people building the future. We are born from the spirit of innovation. We are created from the idea that people around the world want more, need more, deserve more. We are the home of the global digital revolution. We are CNN.

See what it’s like to work at CNN! Follow us on Instagram, Twitter and Facebook.

Your New Role…

We're seeking an experienced Senior Writer/Producer to join the award-winning CNN Creative Marketing team. In this role, you'll be responsible for creating compelling promotional content for the overall CNN brand including longform content like CNN Original Series, and digital properties like CNN Audio and CNN.com. Working out of our CNN New York office, you'll report to the Creative Director and collaborate with our team of writers, producers, designers and editors to produce high-quality A/V campaigns that captivate and engage our audience. The ideal candidate will have exceptional editorial skills, be an excellent writer across a variety of tones and styles, and have a proven track record of crafting compelling trailers, promos, and complete 360 campaigns.

Your Role Accountabilities…

  • Craft compelling trailers, promos, and complete 360 campaigns that captivate and engage our audience.

  • Research and develop new avenues for marketing the unique and award-winning content of CNN.

  • Collaborate with the production team to produce eye-catching campaigns that effectively communicate the brand message and drive ratings and visits.

  • Participate in brainstorming sessions to generate innovative promotional ideas and campaigns.

  • Work with internal teams to ensure that promotional content meets all relevant broadcast standards and guidelines

  • Manage project schedules, timelines, and deliverables to ensure projects are completed on time and on budget.

  • Work with the operations, media strategy, and promo scheduling teams to coordinate the delivery of marketing assets.

  • Provide leadership and guidance to junior members of the team.

Your Experience & Qualifications…

  • You have at least 10 years of experience in a broadcast environment or creative agency.

  • You have unrivaled editorial skills and the ability to craft compelling trailers, promos, and complete 360 campaigns that are the envy of other creatives.

  • You have an uncanny ability to write compelling narratives, select stunning visuals and create music cuts that stick in the minds of viewers and users, and have a portfolio that demonstrates it.

  • You have exceptional project management, organizational, and multitasking skills.

  • You're a self-starter and strong team player who can work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced news environment.

  • You have a keen eye for detail and can anticipate needs.

  • You have professional judgment for handling confidential information.

  • You're capable of meeting deadlines and working under daily time constraints.

  • You love the creative process and excel in collaborative environments.

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

The Legal Bits…

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. $103,460.00 - $192,140.00 salary per year. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards. In addition, Warner Bros. Discovery provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and paid time off (PTO).

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects the diversity of our society and the world around us. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you need a reasonable accommodation in order to apply for this position, please contact us at recruitadmin@wbd.com.

job.description:
