Job Description

This key position within Peacock’s Creative Marketing Team will execute a high volume of promotional assets for Peacock Original content, with an emphasis on scripted series, but also including unscripted series, documentaries, original movies, and more. The person in this role will work closely with the Creative Director and ACD on high-profile campaigns for Peacock Originals. This role requires a conceptual thinker and leader with a strong editorial and production background, who can turn marketing goals into high-impact 360 creative.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee, produce, and directly edit high-volume creative video content (trailers, sizzle reels, episodic promos, and social videos).
  • Partner closely with the Sr. Creative Director, ACDs, Sr Writer/Producers, W/Ps, APs, design teams, and broader marketing stakeholders (Social, PR, Media, Integrated Marketing, etc) to execute best-in-class launch campaigns for Peacock Originals across all digital, broadcast, and streaming platforms.
  • Collaborate with outside creative agencies, production companies, and editorial vendors to guide the creation of 360 external marketing assets.
  • Develop and execute 360 promotional ideas for critical tentpole launches, including hero AV creative, OOH & marketing stunts, paid media, social, performance, and other varied cross-functional needs.
  • Oversee and manage post-production, including full audio mix sessions, music and footage selection, voiceover (VO) recording, and motion GFX for marketing materials.
  • Supervise on-set content capture at creative marketing shoots. Ability to direct talent (when needed) a plus.
  • Pitch creative to Executive Producers (EPs) and network stakeholders, securing alignment and effectively translating marketing briefs into actionable trailer and promo concepts.
Qualifications

Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Film & Television Production, Communications/Media Studies, Digital Arts or related field, Entertainment Marketing, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of experience producing and editing promotional AV content at a network, streaming service, studio, or entertainment marketing agency.

Desired Characteristics

  • Proficiency with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects and DaVinci Resolve
  • Experience leading 360° creative campaigns in television or entertainment. Streaming/direct-to-consumer and scripted experience preferred.
  • A diverse portfolio demonstrating a history of high-profile entertainment promo work, sharp design integration, advanced video editing skills, and clear storytelling.
  • A strong pulse on popular culture, entertainment trends, social media platforms, emerging content platforms, and industry news/developments.
  • Mastery and proficiency editing with Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • Strong technical understanding of digital video file formats; working with source video/material of varying quality and technical specs (frame rate, codecs, etc)
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present creative concepts to senior executives and external stakeholders.
  • Deep understanding of the creative production process – from pre-production (brainstorming, ideation), to shoots and on-set production, to post-production workflows (including editing, finishing, versioning, etc)
  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadlines in a quick-moving environment.
  • Experience managing and mentoring junior writer/producers, editors, interns, and pages

Additional Requirements:

  • This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $105,000 - $140,000 (bonus eligible).

job.title: Streaming News Producer
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KCPQ/KZJO FOX 13 Seattle is seeking a Streaming News Producer with strong technical instincts and a deep understanding of digital-first news production. This role is centered on live streaming, social video, and platform-native storytelling. You will be responsible for producing, managing, and optimizing live and on-demand content across FOX LOCAL and major social platforms, ensuring coverage is fast, accurate, visually compelling, and technically sound.

Reporting to the Streaming Executive Producer, the ideal candidate is fluent in the mechanics of streaming production and social/digital distribution, CTV, and understands how audiences consume news outside of linear TV with a balance of speed, quality, and journalistic integrity. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in a live environment and wants to build the future of local news.

Does This Sound Like You?

You are digitally native, technically confident, and calm under pressure. You understand streaming workflows, live video production, and best practices for digital and social platforms. You have strong news judgment, pay close attention to detail, and can make smart editorial and technical decisions quickly. You enjoy collaborating across teams, experimenting with new formats, and using data to improve performance. You want to create content that reaches audiences where they are and keeps them coming back.

Responsibilities

  • Produce and manage live streaming coverage of breaking news, live events, press conferences, and original programming for FOX LOCAL and social platforms.
  • Operate and oversee streaming production tools, including live switching, encoding, clipping, publishing, and real-time troubleshooting.
  • Create platform-native digital and social video content, including live clips, short-form video, graphics, and text-based storytelling optimized for mobile & CTV consumption.
  • Distribute and optimize content across the FOX Local app, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, and emerging platforms with an emphasis on audience growth and engagement.
  • Collaborate with newsroom, digital, social, and production/engineering teams to align coverage, workflows, and priorities across platforms.
  • Monitor real-time analytics, audience behavior, and trending topics to inform editorial and production decisions before, during, and after live streams.
  • Ensure all content meets journalistic standards, legal requirements, and FOX group guidelines for quality, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Participate in ongoing testing and refinement of streaming formats, tools, and workflows.
  • Assist in the planning, production and publication of regular podcasts on both VOD and audio platforms.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.



Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, ideally in Journalism, Communications, Media Production, TV/Film production, or a related field with a digital focus.
  • 3 or more years of experience producing digital video, live streams, or social-first news content; newsroom experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong technical proficiency with live streaming workflows, including video switching, live publishing, clipping, and distribution.
  • Hands-on experience with video editing tools and production software, Adobe Creative Suite experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated understanding of social media platforms, video formats, and audience behavior across digital ecosystems.
  • Experience using analytics tools to measure performance and adjust content strategy in real time.
  • Excellent editorial judgment, writing skills, and attention to detail in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.
  • Flexibility to work weekends, holidays, and non-traditional hours as news demands.

job.title: Video Producer, The Diary of a CEO
job.description:
VIDEO PRODUCER, THE DIARY OF A CEO

COMPANY: FLIGHTSTORY

THE SHOW: THE DIARY OF A CEO

REPORTS TO: HEAD OF PRODUCTION OPERATIONS

LOCATION: LOS ANGELES, USA - INCLUDES GLOBAL TRAVEL

ABOUT FLIGHTSTORY

We are a media and investment company, and we are on a mission to elevate the stories, build the communities, and support the founders that inspire a happier, healthier humanity. We scale creator-led media, ventures and communities.

MISSION

To own the technical capture of The Diary of a CEO — the picture and sound of every recording, anywhere in the world. This person leads the crew who deliver it, so that every episode is captured flawlessly, at the show’s elite technical and editorial standard, with zero unforced errors. A hands-on hybrid of Director of Photography, Technical Director, and Audio Mixer, this is the person who guarantees that what happens in the room is captured perfectly in image, sound, and atmosphere, while keeping the recording environment calm, intimate, and uncompromised.

OUTCOMES

  • Flawless capture: Every DOAC recording is captured at broadcast-grade quality across picture, sound, and look, right the first time, with nothing lost, mistracked, or compromised.

  • The room protected: The intimacy and calm of every recording is preserved; the capture operation is never seen and never heard.

  • Consistency everywhere: Every shoot, in every market, looks and sounds unmistakably like DOAC, whether run personally or with crew sourced cold.

  • A crew that holds the bar: Freelance technical crew, wherever they are hired, deliver to the DOAC standard under clear direction.

  • Marginal gains, every week: Image, sound, setup, and workflow get measurably better through a relentless 1% improvement habit.

RESPONSIBILITY

1. Technical Capture & Floor Execution

  • Own the picture and sound of every recording, operating as DP, Technical Director, and Audio Mixer across DOAC’s multi-camera setup.

  • Run the camera package personally, covering lighting, framing, exposure, and look, and direct camera operators to the DOAC standard.

  • Operate the switcher and the live multi-camera cut, managing ISO records and multi-format delivery.

  • Run sound recording across mics, levels, and a clean, broadcast-grade audio capture for every guest, every segment.

2. Crew Leadership & Quality Bar

  • Build and direct freelance technical crew across camera, technical direction, sound, and specialist roles, holding the craft standard on who works on DOAC.

  • Source and vet crew in unfamiliar markets, exercising the taste to judge an unknown operator, mixer, or TD cold and hold them to the bar.

  • Brief and run the crew on the day so the whole capture team operates as one calibrated unit, accountable to DOAC’s technical and editorial standards.

3. The Room: Discretion, Intimacy & Judgment

  • Protect the recording environment. DOAC conversations are sensitive and high-trust, and the capture operation must never disturb that.

  • Enforce the “neither seen nor heard” doctrine. Crew invisibility is the baseline standard, not the aspiration.

  • Read the room and exercise judgment in real time, knowing when to move, when to hold, and when a technical need yields to the moment in front of the guest.

  • Ensure every guest’s in-studio experience is flawless and undisturbed, from arrival through wrap.

4. Global Production & Travel

  • Travel with the show to LA, NYC, London, and anywhere DOAC records, running capture personally on the road, often at short notice.

  • Stand up technical capture in any market, covering equipment logistics, freight, local crew, and setup, holding the same standard wherever the show shoots.

  • Maintain consistency across geographies so that every recording, wherever it happens, looks and sounds like DOAC.

5. Post-Production Craft

  • Bring proficient-to-expert post skills across video editing, sound mixing, and Photoshop, to inform capture decisions upstream and to execute when needed.

  • Capture for the edit, shooting and recording with a deep understanding of how material is cut, graded, and mixed downstream.

  • Partner with Post to close the loop between capture and delivery, eliminating problems at source rather than fixing them in the edit.

6. Details, Marginal Gains & Continuous Improvement

  • Obsess over the 1%, committing to marginal gains in image, sound, setup, and workflow every single week.

  • Own the technical setup, evolving the camera, switching, and sound systems, tools, and infrastructure at the capture level.

  • Introduce and evaluate new technologies, including AI tools, to raise capture quality and speed, and contribute to DOAC’s production experimentation engine.

7. Partnership & Operating Cadence

  • Partner with the Head of Production & Production Manager. They own logistics, budget, and coordination; the Video Producer owns the technical craft and the capture itself.

  • Operate inside the production plan, delivering flawless capture against the schedule, crew, and resources the production team sets, and flagging technical needs and risks early.

COMPETENCIES

  • Hybrid technical mastery: Genuine craft as a DP and operator, a Technical Director who can run a live multi-camera switcher, and an audio mixer who can run sound recording, all in one person.

  • Proficient in Post-Production across video editing, sound mixing, and Photoshop, to inform capture decisions upstream and fill in gaps in edits, thumbnail designs, and supporting assets as needed.

  • Editorial and emotional intelligence: Exceptional discretion, able to read the room and operate invisibly inside sensitive, high-trust conversations.

  • Detail and follow-through: Obsessive about the small things and driven by a marginal-gains mindset, never satisfied with “good enough.”

  • Decision velocity under pressure: Makes the right technical call fast, in the moment, calmly and reliably in a zero-error environment.

  • Craft leadership: Builds, directs, and holds a freelance crew to the standard, including in markets the team has never worked in before.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

  • A seasoned multi-camera technical operator with minimum 5 years experience — a true DP, Technical Director, and sound mixer hybrid — with demonstrated experience capturing at DOAC’s technical complexity, including multi-camera, live switching, ISO records, multi-format delivery, and broadcast-grade sound.

  • Proven on the road, building and directing crews in unfamiliar markets and managing the realities of international capture, including kit travel, freight, local crew, and time zones.

  • Proficient-to-expert in post-production, covering video editing, sound mixing, and Photoshop.

  • Discreet, unflappable, and detail-obsessed, with the emotional intelligence to protect the intimacy of a sensitive recording.

  • Energised by a fast-paced, high-expectation, in-person environment and willing to travel globally with the show.

job.title: Writer and Editor - International Multimedia Journalist III
job.description:
Primary Responsibilities:

 Writes and produces news and feature content and programming as assigned for use in broadcasts and web and social media  

 Conducts and writes up interviews for inclusion in his/her assigned stories  

 Adapts and/or translates content produced in English into native language, as assigned  

 Versions content produced in native language into English for distribution, as assigned  

 Participates in the creation and development of regularly scheduled or special radio and/or tv programs and/or web and social media sections, as assigned  

 Contributes to production elements of programs and content for broadcast and/or web and social media, including fine editing of taped material, as assigned  

 As assigned, edits and approves copy and content prepared or written by others for broadcast and/or publication for inclusion in his/her assigned stories  

 Adapts and/or translates content produced in English into native language, as assigned  

 Participates in the creation and development of regularly scheduled or special radio and/or tv programs and/or web and social media sections, as assigned  

 Contributes finished products meeting standards to production elements of programs and content for broadcast and/or web and social media 

 Contributes to teamwork, facilitating tasks of teammates, as needed  

 Meets VOA standards for productivity, quality, and meeting deadlines  

 Makes suggestions about policy and workflow improvements  

 Works independently or as a member of a team  

 Fluency in target language (written, spoken) and deep knowledge of the target area, plus the ability to adapt stories into English as assigned, within the time assigned  

  Must have knowledge of Cuba’s history, Cuba/U.S. relations 

 Other related duties as assigned  

 

About the Agency

The United States Agency for Global Media (USAGM) is an exciting, multi-media, multi-cultural, global media agency that carries out all United States civilian international broadcasting. Our media networks complement and reinforce one another in a shared mission vital to U.S. national interests: to inform, engage, and connect people around the world in support of freedom and democracy. Our staff of dedicated professionals serve as an example of a free and independent media, bringing news, information, and relevant discussions to a weekly audience of over 278 million people worldwide in over 60 languages via radio, television, Internet, and social media.

USAGM networks include the Voice of America and the Office of Cuba Broadcasting (Radio and TV Marti) and three grantee organizations: Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty, the Middle East Broadcasting Networks (Alhurra TV and Radio Sawa), and Radio Free Asia.

This is not an announcement for a federal job. All personal service contractors must pass a thorough background check.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents are encouraged to apply. Employer sponsorship for work visas is not available for this position.

job.title: Writer/Producer - CNN
job.description:
Every great story has a new beginning, and yours starts here.

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Your New Role…

We're seeking an experienced Writer/Producer to join the award-winning CNN Creative Marketing team, with a focus on brand and special projects. In this role, you'll be responsible for creating compelling promotional content for CNN, including brand sizzles, proof-of-performance spots, upfront materials, and high-profile special projects. Working out of our CNN New York office, you'll report to the Creative Director and collaborate with our team of writers, producers, designers and editors to produce high-quality marketing materials that engage and captivate our audience. The ideal candidate will have a passion for storytelling, a proven track record of creating high-quality campaigns, and exceptional skills in crafting compelling narratives.

Your Role Accountabilities…

  • Collaborate with the creative team to develop innovative marketing materials that effectively convey the CNN brand and resonate with our audience.

  • Write and produce captivating and impressive brand sizzle reels, upfront materials, and other content around strategic priorities.

  • Research footage, music, and other content to build compelling narratives that support projects under the supervision of the Creative Director.

  • Participate in brainstorming sessions to generate innovative ideas and campaigns.

  • Work closely with internal teams to ensure that promotional content meets all relevant broadcast standards and guidelines.

  • Manage project schedules, timelines, and deliverables to ensure projects are completed on time and on budget.

Your Qualifications & Experience…

  • You have at least 5 years of experience in a broadcast environment or creative agency, with a focus on brand and longform content.

  • You have a passion for storytelling and are skilled at crafting compelling narratives.

  • You have excellent editing skills and the ability to craft narratives, select compelling visuals and create music cuts to form top-notch A/V campaigns.

  • You have a proven track record of creating high-quality campaigns that engage and captivate audiences, and have a portfolio that demonstrates it.

  • You're well-versed in Adobe Premiere and the Adobe Creative Suite.

  • You have exceptional project management, organizational, and multitasking skills.

  • You're a self-starter and strong team player who can work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced news environment.

  • You have a keen eye for detail and can anticipate needs.

  • You have professional judgment for handling confidential information.

  • You're capable of meeting deadlines and working under daily time constraints.

  • You love news, current events, nonfiction storytelling and CNN.

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

The Legal Bits…

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. $77,840.00 - $144,560.00 salary per year. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards. In addition, Warner Bros. Discovery provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and paid time off (PTO).

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects the diversity of our society and the world around us. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you need a reasonable accommodation in order to apply for this position, please contact us at recruitadmin@wbd.com.

job.title: Traffic Manager (Full-Time) – Portland Media Group
job.description:
Portland Media Group · South Portland, Maine · On-site

Ever wonder how the right ad hits the airwaves at exactly the right moment?

That’s the job. As our Traffic Manager, you’re the person behind the scenes keeping ads running on time across 8 radio stations and our digital platforms. When the schedule runs smoothly, it’s because of you.

Who we are

Portland Media Group is a local media company focused on clicks, visits, calls and searches. We help businesses get wanted, found and chosen by more customers using radio, search and targeted display. We’re a tight-knit team that works together, gets better every day and we actually like what we do!

What you’ll do day to day

  • Run the schedule. Place commercials across 8 radio stations and other platforms.
  • Work with the team. Partner with sales, production and programming to get ad materials in on time.
  • Manage inventory. Figure out where ads land so they get the best results while maximizing inventory.
  • Fix problems fast. When an issue becomes known, reach out to appropriate person and resolve quickly.
  • If you see something say something, if you need something make the request.

You’ll do well here if you…

  • Like having a system and love crossing things off a list
  • Catch the small details other people miss
  • Can handle a few things at once without dropping any of them
  • Communicate clearly and like working with a team
  • Pick up new software quickly

Bonus points (not required)

  • Experience in traffic, scheduling, media, or something close to it
  • Experience with Marketron or other traffic software

Don’t check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about how you work and how fast you learn than about a perfect résumé.

What’s in it for you

  • Competitive pay: $38,500 – $42,450 salary range
  • Benefits: health, dental, 401K, PTO
  • Room to grow: cross training and promoting from within
  • A team that has your back: supportive, inclusive, and not ego driven

Ready to apply?

Send your résumé and a few lines about why this role caught your eye to talent@portlandmediagrp.com. You don’t need a formal cover letter.

Portland Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Overview

Salem Influencer Network, a division of Salem Media, is seeking an early-career seller to develop new brand partnerships across our national influencer portfolio and event opportunities. We connect consumer brands with trusted creators through sponsored content, social campaigns, and live experiences. We’re looking for someone who understands creator culture, follows consumer brands, and can recognize what makes a partnership feel authentic to talent and valuable to an advertiser. If you follow creators, notice which brands sponsor their content, and have ideas about who they should partner with next, this might be the role for you. If you understand what makes a collaboration feel authentic to a creator and compelling to a brand and now you want to turn that knowledge into new business, this is the role for you. This is a revenue-generating, business-development role with a strong focus on bringing partners who are new to Salem into the business. You will build your own book of business through research, proactive outreach, thoughtful pitches, and consistent follow-through. An established client roster is welcome, but it is not required. Ideal background: influencer marketing, talent or creator agencies, brand partnerships, business development, social media, or event sponsorships.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

· Prospect mainstream consumer brands, DTC companies, startups, and agencies that align with our talent’s audiences, content, values, and partnership goals. · Identify decision-makers, personalize outreach, book discovery meetings, and build new brand and agency relationships. · Learn our creators’ voices and communities to develop compelling brand matches across categories such as beauty, wellness, fashion, food, home, family, and travel. · Pitch partnerships spanning sponsored social content, creator endorsements, podcast integrations, paid amplification, and talent appearances. · Develop event sponsorship concepts, including product sampling, on-site activations, and creator content before, during, and after events. · Manage outreach, proposals, negotiations, and closing; coordinate with internal teams on pricing, talent approvals, deliverables, and campaign handoff. · Maintain an organized pipeline, meet new-business revenue goals, and grow first-time campaigns into repeat partnerships.

experience

in sales, influencer marketing, brand partnerships, talent or agency work, or event sponsorships. Strong internship or hands-on

experience

may also be considered. · A working understanding of Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, including creator formats, audience engagement, and sponsored content. · Ability to identify relevant consumer brands and explain a partnership idea through both talent fit and the brand’s marketing goals. · Confidence initiating new conversations, asking discovery questions, presenting ideas, and following up consistently. · Familiarity with campaign deliverables, content usage rights, exclusivity, paid amplification, and measures such as engagement, traffic, and conversions. · Strong writing, presentation, and organizational skills, with a willingness to learn and take ownership of sales results. Existing brand relationships, CRM experience, and exposure to event activations are a plus. Traditional media sales

experience

is not required. Who Will Thrive Here · People who can spot an authentic creator and brand match and explain why it works. · Self-starters who enjoy reaching new contacts and building relationships from scratch. · People who follow consumer trends and understand how brands work with creators. · Persistent, coachable professionals who want to turn creative partnership ideas into revenue.

Overview

Salem Podcast Network, a division of Salem Media Group, is the fastest-growing podcast network in the conservative and faith-based space, home to some of the most influential voices in media today. We're looking for a seasoned, self-directed Senior Podcast Sales Executive who can own the entire sales cycle, from opening the door to renewing the partnership, and grow revenue across our national network. This isn't a role where you hand off a signed deal and move on. We want a proven seller who can prospect, pitch, negotiate, close, and then manage, grow, and renew every account they bring in. If you've built and run a book of national business with little handholding and know how to make both clients and talent happy, this is your seat.

Responsibilities

Find and win new business Prospect and open doors with national brands, agencies, DTC companies, and organizations aligned with Salem's audience. Bring your existing client and agency relationships to the table and turn them into revenue quickly. Negotiate and close deals across host endorsements, dynamic ad insertion (DAI), branded content, and sponsorship integrations. Build the campaign Create insight-led, prescriptive proposals that turn audience and performance data into clear results for advertisers. Build integrated campaigns across Salem's One World platform: podcasts, radio, Salem News Channel, Townhall Media, Influencer Network, Event Partnerships, and Salem's owned and operated digital properties. Manage the host endorsement process from start to finish, including category exclusivity, talent approvals, talking points, and creative briefs. Run the account Serve as the client's main point of contact after the sale, coordinating with talent, production, ad operations, and finance so campaigns launch on time and run smoothly. Own the number Exceed monthly and annual revenue targets. Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast in the CRM. 10+ years in national audio, podcast, digital media, or network/agency sales, with a consistent record of closing new business and exceeding targets.

Experience

managing the full sales cycle independently, from prospecting through negotiation, execution, reporting, and renewal. Established national advertiser and agency relationships, with the ability to get meetings quickly. Deep knowledge of podcast ad formats (host endorsements, DAI, branded content, sponsorships, and performance-driven campaigns) and how to measure them. A consultative, strategic approach: you build integrated programs, not just sell inventory. Strong negotiation skills and comfort structuring complex, multi-platform deals. Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to make complex media strategies simple and compelling.

working directly with on-air talent and managing the client-talent relationship. CRM proficiency, disciplined pipeline management, and reliable forecasting.

job.title: Account Executive, Networks
job.description:
Are you a powerhouse sales professional who thrives on big-picture strategy and game-changing client partnerships? Scripps Networks is looking for a driven, forward-thinking revenue leader to help grow our full portfolio across some of the most exciting platforms in media today — from linear TV and Connected TV to Scripps Sports, programmatic, and data-driven video. In this enterprise-level role, you'll partner with internal experts and clients alike to deliver innovative, cross-platform solutions that make a real impact. If you're ready to bring your best to a company that's reshaping the media landscape, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Generate revenue for Scripps portfolio offerings across all platforms including linear, CTV, digital, Scripps Sports, programmatic, local and data-driven video.
  • Negotiate and close upfront and scatter deals.
  • Manage agency and client needs by overseeing inventory and schedules assuring client needs and marketing objectives are met.
  • Create, develop and maintain strong working relationships with assigned agencies and clients.
  • Proactively source, pitch and close new business across all platforms to expand client roster and revenue streams.
  • Utilize deep understanding of sports rights and sponsorships, including monetization strategies for women's sports and non-media assets.
  • Manage multiple campaigns and stakeholders while delivering on revenue targets.
  • Present and position all of Scripps Networks and the value they offer clients by using research, marketing opportunities and delivery platforms.
  • Maintain a thorough and extensive knowledge of the marketplace including category and industry trends as well as competitive capabilities.
  • Collaborate with Pricing & Planning team to manage and maximize inventory optimization.
  • Work closely with VP of Sales to align on strategy and optimize go-to-date market plans.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 5 + years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Analytical mindset skilled in using research and market data to inform strategy and execution
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Results-oriented with the ability to achieve established goals
  • Full knowledge of CTV, Sports and data-driven video landscape strongly preferred
  • Accomplished in providing creative solutions
  • Team oriented mindset

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Chicago is one of America's great cities — a place where world-class architecture lines the lakefront, iconic neighborhoods pulse with energy, and no two days feel the same. Whether you're walking the Magnificent Mile, taking in the skyline from Millennium Park's Cloud Gate, or catching a show at the legendary Second City, there's always something new to discover. The city's food scene is just as diverse as its people, ranging from deep-dish pizza and Chicago-style hot dogs to James Beard-recognized restaurants representing cuisines from every corner of the world.


Sports are a way of life in Chicago, with passionate fan bases rallying behind the Cubs, White Sox, Bears, Bulls, and Blackhawks. Beyond the stadiums, the city offers miles of lakefront trails, beaches along Lake Michigan, and green spaces like Lincoln Park that give residents a genuine urban-outdoor balance. The Chicago Riverwalk and neighborhoods like Wicker Park, Logan Square, and River North each offer their own distinct character — from live music and galleries to farmers markets and craft cocktail bars.


Chicago also punches well above its weight as a media and business hub, making it an ideal home base for a media sales professional. With a robust transit system, a thriving creative community, and a Midwest sensibility that keeps things grounded, Chicago offers a quality of life that's hard to match — and a career landscape full of opportunity.

job.title: Account Executive, WCPO
job.description:
Are you ready to help local businesses thrive while building your own successful sales career?  WCPO, the E.W. Scripps affiliate in Cincinnati, Ohio, is seeking a dynamic Account Executive who will help local businesses realize growth opportunities by reaching customers through compelling multi-platform advertising solutions. You'll be at the forefront of the evolving media landscape, offering everything from traditional broadcast television to cutting-edge digital marketing solutions.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 

  • Sell advertising solutions to local and regional businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Apply the Scripps Sales Process (SSP) to analyze current and prospective customer needs and apply customized advertising solutions that provide return on their investment.
  • In addition to television commercial airtime sales, facilitate the customer’s ability to take advantage of the full array of digital marketing options available.
  • Independently prospect, secure appointments, perform needs analysis, develop customized solutions, present and close sales to develop and maintain new business from traditional and non-traditional advertisers.
  • Use ratings data, qualitative information, and market trends to negotiate program ratings and advertising rates with advertising agencies in order to maximize revenue as well as develop custom solutions for new advertisers.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor with new and existing clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.
  • Perform client services, including but not limited to media avail negotiations, presentation preparation delivery and execution, copy writing, credit applications, and collection of revenue due.
  • Effectively and proactively manage a sales funnel by way of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, monitoring and achieving key performance indicators and expected activity levels.
  • Contribute to the creative development of campaigns through client communication and needs analysis, storyboard and concept creation, and assistance in production aspects.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, which may include entertaining prospective and existing clients.
  • Perform routine administrative functions of a media salesperson including makegood resolution, continuous update of CRM system with activity, account information and pending revenue, and communication with sales leadership regarding the status of accounts
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
     

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

 

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 2+ years of proven sales success preferred
  • Experience in strategic account management, broadcast ratings and digital execution preferred

 

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

 

  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused
  • Highly creative and innovative thinker
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Strong time management and organizational skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint)
  • Working knowledge of Google Office (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and virtual conferencing platforms (E.g. Skype, WebEx, Zoom or MS Teams etc.)
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

 

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

 

Cincinnati offers an incredible blend of Midwestern charm and big-city amenities, making it one of the most livable cities in America. Known for its rich history, world-class museums, and vibrant arts scene, Cincinnati is home to the renowned Cincinnati Symphony Orchestra, Cincinnati Ballet, and the contemporary arts scene in Over-the-Rhine. The city boasts an amazing culinary landscape, from famous Cincinnati chili to craft breweries and farm-to-table restaurants.

 

Sports fans will love cheering on the Cincinnati Bengals, Cincinnati Reds, and FC Cincinnati. The city's beautiful riverfront along the Ohio River provides stunning views and recreational opportunities, while nearby parks and trails offer endless outdoor adventures. With affordable housing, excellent neighborhoods like Hyde Park, Mount Adams, and the trendy Over-the-Rhine district, Cincinnati provides the perfect backdrop for both career growth and quality of life.

job.title: Analyst, Client Retention
job.description:
Are you passionate about building lasting client relationships and driving measurable results? The E.W. Scripps Company is seeking a dynamic Analyst, Client Retention to join our team. In this remote role, you'll be the trusted advisor for our clients, helping them achieve their business goals while maximizing the impact of their advertising investments across all platforms. This is your opportunity to combine analytical expertise with exceptional client service.

This is a remote position. We welcome candidates located in markets where Scripps currently has a presence.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Serve as the main point of contact for an assigned portfolio of clients and help manage their projects
  • Stay current regarding clients' needs and their business evolution in order to maximize client satisfaction
  • Maintain current knowledge of our products and services, across all platforms
  • Assist in training sales team on attribution products and services
  • Collaborate with the Sales Managers to deliver services to clients and maintain client relationships
  • Track and measure progress on advertiser investments and keep the sales staff informed of status
  • Collaborate with the Sales staff on a pre-sales basis to help determine optimal product mix to meet client KPIs and goals
  • Collaborate with the Ad Operations Campaign Manager on optimization strategies to provide the best opportunities for campaign success

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in related field preferred

  • Exceptional analytical abilities including data visualization
  • Demonstrated ability using statistical analysis and research to drive positive change in a business setting

  • Must have advanced written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • "Consultative" client management approach
  • Strong problem-solving ability
  • Excellent time management, prioritizing and multitasking skills
  • High attention to detail
  • Calm under pressure
  • Ability to work independently and with a team
  • Understanding of web technologies strongly preferred

job.title: Anchor/MMJ, KKCO
job.description:
If you're ready to be the face of local news in one of Colorado's most stunning and storied regions, KKCO - The E.W. Scripps station - in Grand Junction, Colorado, is looking for you. We need a talented and driven Anchor/MMJ to prepare and deliver accurate, compelling news reports that inform and engage our community. In this role, you'll bring energy and credibility to our newscast, hitting the field as a multimedia journalist and anchoring broadcasts that connect viewers to the stories that shape their lives.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Anchor the newscast.
  • Research, gather, write and develop news content for multiple platforms.
  • May report live on location from various news events.
  • Perform various community service activities for station, including performing as master of ceremonies for public service events and as host/hostess for station events.
  • Perform other duties as needed and assigned.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelors degree in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 3+ years on camera experience preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Must connect on camera with a sense of urgency
  • Ability to cultivate sources and mine stories
  • Knowledge of newsroom computers and computer databases strongly preferred
  • Must demonstrate strong news judgment and organizational skills
  • Must have keen sense of logistics and ability to work well under intense pressure and deadlines
  • Must have good creative and editorial judgment, mastery of journalistic ethics and libel law
  • Must be able to speak clearly and concisely
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Grand Junction is Colorado's western gem — a sun-drenched city where canyon country meets mountain living. Nestled along the Colorado River at the foot of the Grand Mesa, the city is surrounded by some of the most breathtaking scenery in the American West. Colorado National Monument rises just minutes from downtown, offering dramatic red rock canyons, sweeping vistas, and world-class hiking and cycling. For a bigger adventure, the legendary trails of Moab, Utah — including access to Arches National Park and Canyonlands — are just a 90-minute drive away. With over 300 days of sunshine a year and a low cost of living compared to Colorado's Front Range cities, Grand Junction is a place where an active, fulfilling lifestyle is always within reach.

job.title: Broadcast Engineer, WGBA
job.description:
WGBA Green Bay is looking for a skilled Broadcast Engineer to join our team and help us deliver world-class content to our community. This is your opportunity to work with cutting-edge broadcast technology while supporting a team dedicated to serving the people of Green Bay and beyond. If you're passionate about solving complex technical challenges, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to make a real impact, we want to hear from you!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Provide world class customer service to all business partners internal and external to the Scripps organization with a positive "can do" attitude.

  • Support, maintain, and install the full range of broadcast, Radio Frequency (RF), and production systems based on both Serial Digital Interface (SDI), and Internet Protocol (IP) based architecture.

  • Setup and enhance software, hardware, server, automation and workflow systems, projects and equipment to enable our teams to be both productive and efficient. Ensure all meet current industry standards and comply with Company policies and expectations.

  • Partner with the news department to develop, build and support content workflow and support systems including integration and problem-solving software, hardware, networking and infrastructure. This will include support and integration of audio and video, cameras, editing systems, streaming, content management and workflow.

  • Use company purchasing management system to purchase and track assets and services as well as replacement cycles. This will include contributing to budgeting planning with the team and Director of Engineering to support business needs.

  • Drive and assist in the operation, support, and maintenance of mobile live trucks which may involve work in confined spaces and on top of vehicle with the use of mobile work platform. Live truck technology may include microwave, satellite, cellular bonding, and video/audio equipment.

  • Resolve complex problems not covered by existing procedures or practices independently, often under pressure.

  • Design improvements to our operation.

  • Maintain logs and reports as per FCC Rules and Regulations.

  • Provide, enhance, and utilize proactive monitoring system to anticipate technical issues and be able to act accordingly.

  • Update technical plan documentation when installations are completed to include changes that are made.

  • Document and maintain records of equipment repairs.

  • Research part numbers and pricing to determine where to purchase and the cost of repairs.

  • Operate studio, news and control room equipment.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Associates degree in related field or equivalent years of experience preferred

  • Generally, 5+ years experience in related field preferred

  • Network certification required (Cisco, CompTIA Network+)

  • SBE certification preferred

  • At least 3 year broadcast operations experience preferred

  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Must have working knowledge of all the following areas, and specialize in at least one of these areas:

  • Broadcast and production systems support and engineering including SDI and IP based technology and workflow

  • Extensive knowledge of computer networking, broadcast automation and workflow systems

  • Transmitter support and engineering

  • Strong understanding and ability to work with IT/cellular systems, servers, and devices, and actively pursue emerging technology in these areas

  • Solid working knowledge of software for server and client operating systems including active directory

  • Working knowledge of Computer Aided Design (CAD)

  • Positive "can do" attitude and willingness to learn and grow with the job

  • Strong interpersonal skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver a high level of customer service

  • Team player

  • Effective communication skills with all level of internal and external customers and partners

  • Ability to resolve complex problems not covered by existing procedures or practices independently often whilst under pressure

  • Knowledge of FCC rules

  • Ability and willingness to learn complex new systems

  • Self-motivated to work independently under timeline to achieve departmental and station goals

  • Ability to comprehend schematics, mechanical drawings and technical manuals

  • Ability to prioritize tasks and work within deadlines

  • Familiarity with various test instruments, alignment apparatuses and knowledge of personal computers

  • Deep operational knowledge of studio, news and control room technology

  • Ability to guide and coach colleagues

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY

Green Bay, Wisconsin offers the perfect blend of small-town charm and big-city amenities. As the proud home of the Green Bay Packers and legendary Lambeau Field, this vibrant community pulses with sports passion and Midwestern hospitality. Beyond game day, Green Bay boasts a thriving downtown with excellent restaurants, craft breweries, and cultural attractions along the scenic Fox River. Outdoor enthusiasts will love the area's abundant parks, trails, and easy access to Door County's stunning peninsula just 45 minutes away. With four distinct seasons offering everything from summer festivals to winter activities, plus a strong economy and affordable cost of living, Green Bay provides an exceptional quality of life for those looking to put down roots in a welcoming community.

job.title: Category Growth & Business Development Manager - Remote
job.description:
Are you a category-savvy sales strategist who thrives at the intersection of market intelligence and revenue growth? Operations Shared Services, part of The E.W. Scripps Company, is looking for a Category Growth & Business Development Manager to accelerate revenue across Scripps local television markets by serving as a go-to expert in priority advertising industries.

In this role, you'll partner directly with local sales leadership and account executives across the country, bringing category expertise, hands-on sales support and strategic vision to integrated linear and digital advertising opportunities. Your work will shape how Scripps competes and wins in key categories like automotive, legal and healthcare, making a measurable impact on markets from coast to coast.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop and execute division-wide growth strategies for priority business categories, including automotive, legal, healthcare and others identified by the organization.
  • Serve as the subject-matter expert for assigned categories by monitoring advertiser business models, customer-acquisition strategies, consumer behavior, competitive conditions, regulatory considerations, advertising trends and emerging marketing technologies.
  • Partner with local sales managers and account executives to identify high-potential prospects and revenue-growth opportunities across Scripps markets.
  • Participate directly in the sales process by supporting prospecting, discovery, needs analysis, solution development, proposals, presentations and negotiations, and assist in closing new business and expanding existing advertiser relationships through integrated linear and digital solutions.
  • Create scalable, category-specific sales strategies, prospecting approaches, discovery questions, presentations, case studies and other resources for consistent use by local teams.
  • Translate advertiser needs, audience insights, market research, performance data and industry trends into compelling marketing recommendations, and communicate actionable guidance to local sales teams, sales leadership and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop and deliver ongoing training, coaching and sales tactics that improve category knowledge, prospecting effectiveness, advertiser conversations, solution development and closing performance.
  • Join local sales representatives and leaders in advertiser and agency meetings to provide category expertise and advance priority opportunities.
  • Build relationships with key advertisers, agencies, industry associations and strategic partners that generate opportunities across multiple Scripps markets.
  • Collaborate with digital sales, research, marketing, creative, revenue operations and campaign execution teams to ensure solutions are strategically sound, executable, scalable and positioned to produce measurable advertiser outcomes.
  • Support campaign reviews, performance discussions, renewal strategies and upsell recommendations to improve advertiser retention and grow existing business.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity, pipeline, activity, billing and forecast information in applicable CRM and reporting systems.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience.
  • Generally, 8+ years of experience in related field preferred.
  • Valid driver's license and good driving record required. In addition, proof of insurance and liability coverage may be required.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated success developing new business, closing complex opportunities and growing revenue from existing advertiser relationships.
  • Expertise in selling or supporting integrated linear television and digital advertising solutions strongly preferred.
  • Understanding of automotive, legal, healthcare or other high-value local advertising categories preferred.
  • Skilled in supporting sales teams across multiple markets or geographic regions preferred.
  • Adept at delivering sales training, coaching, presentations or category-specific enablement preferred.
  • Strong understanding of category-based selling, consultative sales practices, advertiser needs analysis and solution development.
  • Superior knowledge of linear television advertising and digital marketing products, strategies, performance measures and emerging capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence sales outcomes and lead cross-functional initiatives without direct reporting authority.
  • Ability to establish credibility and build productive relationships with local sales leaders, account executives, corporate partners, advertisers and agencies.
  • Strong coaching and facilitation skills, with the ability to improve sales performance through practical guidance, field support and category expertise.
  • Ability to convert industry research, audience insights, performance data and advertiser information into practical sales strategies and compelling proposals.
  • Excellent presentation, negotiation, written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to manage revenue goals, forecasts, pipelines and performance reporting.
  • Highly organized, self-motivated and goal-focused, with the ability to manage multiple categories, markets and sales opportunities simultaneously.
  • Ability to balance strategic planning with direct, hands-on participation in advertiser opportunities.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms, sales-reporting tools, Microsoft Office applications and virtual collaboration platforms.

job.title: Community Connections Coordinator, KNXV
job.description:
KNXV | Phoenix, AZ | Full-time | Onsite

What does it take to truly connect a newsroom with the community it serves? At KNXV in Phoenix, AZ, we're looking for a passionate and people-first Community Connections Coordinator to be that essential bridge. In this role, you'll cultivate meaningful relationships with community organizations, residents, and local leaders — surfacing the stories that matter, supporting journalists with trusted voices and timely intelligence, and coordinating the events and conversations that bring our station closer to the people we serve. If you thrive at the intersection of community, journalism, and engagement, this role was made for you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain relationships with community organizations, residents, leaders, and trusted sources to gather community insights and identify emerging issues, events, and story opportunities.
  • Monitor, track, and route audience tips, questions, and leads from community channels, ensuring timely communication and escalation to newsroom teams.
  • Support newsroom listening efforts, community conversations, and source development by connecting journalists with credible and diverse community voices.
  • Assist with breaking and developing news coverage by gathering community context, maintaining source networks, and providing timely intelligence to newsroom staff.
  • Serve as a responsive point of contact for community organizations and residents, fostering positive relationships and trust.
  • Coordinate outreach, maintain partner and contact records, and represent the station at community meetings, events, and activities.
  • Support newsroom talent by coordinating interviews, identifying community contacts, gathering background information, and facilitating community appearances.
  • Coordinate logistics and execution for community conversations, listening sessions, public programs, newsroom events, special coverage initiatives, and station appearances.
  • Manage event-related activities including outreach, scheduling, partner coordination, participant communications, on-site support, and post-event follow-up.
  • Support audience engagement across digital and in-person channels, including live discussions, community groups, neighborhood platforms, and other audience interaction opportunities.
  • Maintain community calendars, project plans, contact databases, and engagement records to support execution of the market community strategy.
  • Track community insights, engagement outcomes, story leads, and best practices, preparing summaries and reports that help inform newsroom and community engagement priorities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Associates degree in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in journalism, communications, community engagement, nonprofit work, events, public relations or related fields
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Strong listening, relationship-building and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to establish rapport with diverse community members and organizations
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization, follow-through and attention to detail
  • Ability to identify and communicate relevant community information quickly and accurately
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with journalists and station teams
  • Comfort working independently in the community and adapting to newsroom needs
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM/contact systems, social platforms and collaboration tools
  • Solid news judgment, comfort with newsroom urgency, ability to verify and relay information quickly, and understanding of how community tips can develop into stories
  • Ability to communicate clearly and accurately across digital platforms, maintain professionalism in public-facing conversations and collaborate closely with reporters, producers, anchors, meteorologists and newsroom leaders

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Phoenix is one of America's most dynamic and fast-growing cities, offering a lifestyle as big and bold as the desert sky. As the capital of Arizona and the fifth-largest city in the country, Phoenix is a hub of culture, cuisine, and outdoor adventure. Explore world-class attractions like the Desert Botanical Garden, the Heard Museum celebrating Native American art and culture, and the Phoenix Art Museum. The city's thriving food scene spans everything from authentic Sonoran cuisine to innovative farm-to-table dining, and the year-round sunshine makes rooftop dining and outdoor festivals a regular pleasure.

Sports fans will feel right at home — Phoenix is a proud major-league city, home to the NBA's Phoenix Suns, the NFL's Arizona Cardinals, the MLB's Arizona Diamondbacks, and the WNBA's Phoenix Mercury. When you're ready to get outside, iconic destinations like Camelback Mountain and South Mountain Park offer hiking and climbing with breathtaking city and desert views just minutes from downtown. For a weekend escape, the red rock formations of Sedona and the grandeur of the Grand Canyon are both within easy driving distance, making every weekend a potential adventure.

job.title: Executive Reporter, KMGH
job.description:
KMGH, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Denver, Colorado, is seeking an Executive Reporter who will lead our mission to enhance storytelling and inspire the next generation of journalists. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the narrative of our community while mentoring talented reporters and MMJs to reach their full potential.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead, develop, and enhance the storytelling skill and abilities of all reporters and MMJs in the station.
  • Collaborate with other newsroom leaders to consistently execute the content strategy through authentic, meaningful storytelling.
  • Oversee the writing of stories for all platforms; provide timely feedback to foster continuous improvement.
  • Develop and supervise effective workflow strategies and procedures for multiple news programs and outlets.
  • Ensure that all content adheres to journalistic standards and ethical guidelines.
  • Deliver a vision and create trust among reporters, photographers and newsroom staff.
  • May provide on-air, multi-platform coverage for breaking news as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred, or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 7+ years of experience in a related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated expertise in storytelling
  • Knowledge and demonstration of editorial judgment, journalistic ethics, and libel laws
  • Curiosity for the community, city, state, and world we report on daily
  • Deep understanding of content strategy
  • Ability to work a variety of shifts including nights, weekends, early mornings, and holidays

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Denver, Colorado, combines big-market journalism opportunities with an unmatched outdoor lifestyle. As the Mile High City, Denver is one of the fastest-growing and most dynamic metropolitan areas in the country, offering journalists the chance to cover everything from rapid economic growth and innovation to government, transportation, education, public safety, and environmental issues that shape the future of the American West.


Situated at the foot of the Rocky Mountains, Denver provides year-round access to world-class skiing, hiking, mountain biking, camping, and countless outdoor adventures. The city features a thriving arts and culture scene, professional sports teams including the Broncos, Nuggets, Rockies, Avalanche, and Rapids, award-winning restaurants, and vibrant neighborhoods filled with unique stories and diverse perspectives.


KMGH is a trusted news leader serving one of the nation's most competitive and exciting media markets. With breathtaking scenery, an exceptional quality of life, and a community that values strong local journalism, Denver offers a remarkable place to build a meaningful career while making a lasting impact through storytelling.

job.title: Executive Reporter, KNXV
job.description:
KNXV, The E.W. Scripps ABC affiliate in Phoenix, Arizona, is looking for an Executive Reporter who is as passionate about the craft of storytelling as they are about the community. In this role, you'll leading, inspiring, and mentoring reporters and MMJs at every level to discover powerful ways to grow their storytelling skills. You'll partner with newsroom leaders to execute a content strategy rooted in authenticity, impact, and journalistic integrity, all while shaping a culture where great stories aren't just told — they're felt. If you're ready to elevate the voices that matter most and leave a lasting mark on local journalism in one of the country's most vibrant and fast-growing cities, we want to hear from you. 

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead, develop, and enhance the storytelling skill and abilities of all reporters and MMJs in the station.
  • Collaborate with other newsroom leaders to consistently execute the content strategy through authentic, meaningful storytelling .
  • Oversee the writing of stories for all platforms; provide timely feedback to foster continuous improvement.
  • Develop and supervise effective workflow strategies and procedures for multiple news programs and outlets.
  • Ensure that all content adheres to journalistic standards and ethical guidelines.
  • Deliver a vision and create trust among reporters, photographers and newsroom staff.
  • May provide on-air, multi-platform coverage for breaking news as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred, or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 7+ years of experience in related field preferred 

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated expertise in storytelling
  • Knowledge and demonstration of editorial judgment, journalistic ethics and libel laws
  • Curiosity for the community, city, state and world we report on daily
  • Deep understanding of the content strategy
  • Ability to work a variety of shifts including nights, weekends, early morning, and holidays

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Phoenix, Arizona, is one of the most dynamic and fast-growing cities in the United States — a sprawling desert metropolis that blends stunning natural beauty with a thriving urban energy. Surrounded by the Sonoran Desert, Phoenix offers year-round sunshine and unmatched outdoor adventures, from hiking the iconic trails of Camelback Mountain and South Mountain Park to exploring the scenic beauty of the Tonto National Forest just an hour away. The city is a haven for golf enthusiasts, cyclists, and outdoor lovers of all kinds.

Beyond the desert landscape, Phoenix boasts a rich and diverse cultural scene. The city is home to world-class museums like the Heard Museum, dedicated to Native American art and culture, and the Phoenix Art Museum, one of the largest art museums in the Southwest. The downtown core is alive with acclaimed restaurants, craft breweries, and a vibrant nightlife, while neighborhoods like Roosevelt Row serve as the beating heart of the local arts community. From the Phoenix Symphony to the bustling farmers markets and food halls, there is always something new to discover.

Sports are a way of life in the Valley of the Sun. Phoenix is home to the NFL's Cardinals, the NBA's Suns, the MLB's Diamondbacks, the NHL's Coyotes, and the WNBA's Mercury — giving residents a full calendar of live sports action. Whether you're catching a game, exploring a new trail, or dining at one of the city's award-winning restaurants, Phoenix offers an extraordinary quality of life in one of America's most exciting and welcoming cities.

job.title: Local Sales Manager, WCPO
job.description:
Are you a proven sales leader who knows how to inspire a team, build winning strategies, and drive real results? WCPO is looking for a Local Sales Manager who thrives at the intersection of media, marketing, and leadership. In this role, you'll guide a talented team of Account Executives to help local businesses grow by connecting them with customers through a powerful suite of multi-platform advertising solutions — from broadcast television to Over The Top (OTT) video, SEO/SEM, social media, digital display, and email targeting. If you're energized by coaching people, developing creative sales strategies, and making a measurable impact in your market, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Collaborate with DOS and other sales managers and departments to accomplish the objectives of the station.
  • Organize, direct and manage the execution and performance of a team of local sales Account Executives.
  • Negotiate ratings, rates and budgets.
  • Develop new business for station utilizing and maximizing all station platforms including but not limited to broadcast, digital and mobile.
  • Develop working knowledge of Scripps Sales Process (SSP) and coach Account Executives regarding SSP in the field.
  • Utilize SSP, resources and tools provided to build effective sales strategies.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales and Sales Managers to train, develop and motivate the local sales team so that revenue goals are achieved.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales and Sales Managers to foster career growth and development of the local sales team so that a pipeline of talent for future Scripps sales management openings is ready.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with outside vendors.
  • Interface with traffic systems and personnel to ensure efficient management of airtime inventory.
  • Oversee accounts receivable and credit policies.
  • Develop and implement pricing and packaging to fill needs of both client and station.
  • Know the strengths and weaknesses of the competing stations, other advertising mediums and position the station accordingly.
  • Effectively forecast sales revenue and manage department expenses so that financial goals are achieved.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in business or related field or equivalent experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years proven success in media sales
  • Experience in agency and direct strategic account management, broadcast inventory and digital/video capabilities required
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Demonstrated aptitude for informal leadership and mentoring; fosters open dialogue, empowers others, addresses conflict quickly and directly
  • Strong coaching and feedback skills
  • Strong ability to motivate others toward team goals
  • Able to foster an environment that enables creative and innovative thinking
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to help others translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Strong time management and organization skills
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Working knowledge of Google Office (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and virtual conferencing platforms (E.g. Skype, WebEx, Zoom or MS Teams etc.)
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • May require some travel

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Cincinnati is a city that punches well above its weight — a vibrant, welcoming river city with a rich history, world-class culture, and a food scene that has earned national recognition. The Cincinnati Art Museum, the Cincinnati Symphony Orchestra, and the American Sign Museum are just a few of the cultural gems that make the city a destination in its own right. The revitalized Over-the-Rhine neighborhood, with its stunning 19th-century architecture, craft breweries, and acclaimed restaurants, has become one of the most celebrated urban districts in the Midwest.


Sports are a serious way of life here. Cincinnatians are passionate about the Bengals, the Reds, and FC Cincinnati — and attending a game at Paycor Stadium or Great American Ball Park along the Ohio River is an experience unlike any other. Beyond the stadiums, the region offers beautiful parks, miles of trails along the Little Miami Scenic Trail, and easy access to the rolling hills of both Ohio and Northern Kentucky, making it a great place for hikers, cyclists, and outdoor enthusiasts.


Cincinnati is also an incredibly affordable place to live, with a strong job market, diverse and distinct neighborhoods — from Hyde Park and Oakley to Covington just across the river in Kentucky — and a genuine sense of community. Whether you're raising a family, building a career, or simply looking for a city with authentic character and momentum, Cincinnati delivers on all fronts.
