job.title: Maintenance Engineer II, WXYZ
job.description:
Are you a technically skilled problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced broadcast environment? WXYZ in Detroit, MI, is looking for a Broadcast Engineer who will serve as the technical backbone of our operations — from preventive maintenance and emergency repairs to the hands-on support of video, audio, and radio frequency (RF) systems, including satellite and microwave equipment. In this role, you'll keep our broadcast, production, and live-truck technology running flawlessly, partnering closely with news teams and engineering leadership to push our capabilities forward. If you love tackling complex challenges, staying ahead of emerging technology, and making a real impact on what goes on air, this is the opportunity for you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Provide world-class customer service to all business partners, internal and external to the Scripps organization, with a positive "can-do" attitude.
  • Support, maintain, and install the full range of broadcast, Radio Frequency (RF), and production systems based on both Serial Digital Interface (SDI) and Internet Protocol (IP) based architecture.
  • Set up and enhance software, hardware, server, automation, and workflow systems, projects, and equipment to enable our teams to be both productive and efficient. Ensure all meet current industry standards and comply with Company policies and expectations.
  • Partner with the news department to develop, build, and support content workflow and support systems, including integration and problem-solving software, hardware, networking, and infrastructure. This will include support and integration of audio and video, cameras, editing systems, streaming, content management, and workflow.
  • Use the company purchasing management system to purchase and track assets and services, as well as replacement cycles. This will include contributing to budgeting and planning with the team and Director of Engineering to support business needs.
  • Drive and assist in the operation, support, and maintenance of mobile live trucks, which may involve work in confined spaces and on top of the vehicle with the use of a mobile work platform. Live truck technology may include microwave, satellite, cellular bonding, and video/audio equipment.
  • Resolve complex problems not covered by existing procedures or practices independently, often under pressure.
  • Design improvements to our operation.
  • Maintain logs and reports as per FCC Rules and Regulations.
  • Provide, enhance, and utilize a proactive monitoring system to anticipate technical issues and be able to act accordingly.
  • Update technical plan documentation when installations are completed to include changes that are made.
  • Document and maintain records of equipment repairs.
  • Research part numbers and pricing to determine where to purchase and the cost of repairs.
  • Operate studio, news, and control room equipment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Associate's degree in a related field or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 5+ years' experience in a related field preferred
  • Network certification required (Cisco, CompTIA Network+)
  • SBE certification preferred
  • At least 3 years of broadcast operations experience preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company's required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Must have working knowledge of all the following areas, and specialize in at least one of these areas: Broadcast and production systems support and engineering, including SDI and IP-based technology and workflow; extensive knowledge of computer networking, broadcast automation, and workflow systems; transmitter support and engineering
  • Strong understanding and ability to work with IT/cellular systems, servers, and devices, and actively pursue emerging technology in these areas
  • Solid working knowledge of software for server and client operating systems, including Active Directory
  • Working knowledge of Computer Aided Design (CAD)
  • Positive "can do" attitude and willingness to learn and grow with the job
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver a high level of customer service
  • Team player
  • Effective communication skills with all levels of internal and external customers and partners
  • Ability to resolve complex problems not covered by existing procedures or practices independently, often whilst under pressure
  • Knowledge of FCC rules
  • Ability and willingness to learn complex new systems
  • Self-motivated to work independently under a timeline to achieve departmental and station goals
  • Ability to comprehend schematics, mechanical drawings and technical manuals
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and work within deadlines
  • Familiarity with various test instruments, alignment apparatuses, and knowledge of personal computers
  • Deep operational knowledge of studio, news, and control room technology
  • Ability to guide and coach colleagues
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule, including able to work multiple days, holidays, evenings, weekends, and possible overtime hours as needed
  • Availability to travel over multiple days is possible
  • Must be able to work in changing weather conditions
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Detroit is a city of grit, creativity, and reinvention — and there is no place quite like it. Known worldwide as the Motor City and the birthplace of Motown, Detroit carries a proud heritage in both the automotive industry and American music that you can feel throughout its neighborhoods, museums, and arts venues. The Detroit Institute of Arts ranks among the premier art museums in the country, while Eastern Market — one of the oldest and largest public market districts in the United States — buzzes with energy every weekend, offering local produce, artisan goods and some of the best street art in the Midwest.


Sports fans will feel right at home, with Detroit fielding beloved franchises across all four major professional sports: the Tigers (MLB), Lions (NFL), Red Wings (NHL) and Pistons (NBA). The Detroit Riverfront offers stunning views across the river to Windsor, Ontario, and Belle Isle Park — a 982-acre island state park in the Detroit River — provides a beautiful escape for running, cycling and recreation right in the heart of the metro area.

Detroit's neighborhoods are a draw all their own. Corktown, the city's oldest surviving neighborhood, is a hub of independent restaurants, craft breweries and creative energy. The downtown core has experienced a remarkable revitalization in recent years, bringing new restaurants, entertainment venues and businesses that complement the city's enduring character. With a relatively affordable cost of living compared to other major metros, a passionate community spirit, and a region rich in both culture and natural beauty, Detroit is a remarkable place to build a career and a life.

job.title: Maintenance Engineer III
job.description:
Are you a highly skilled broadcast technician who takes pride in keeping complex systems running at peak performance? KSHB/KMCI in Kansas City, Missouri, is looking for a Maintenance Engineer III to be the technical foundation of our operation — providing preventive maintenance and emergency repairs of video, audio, and radio frequency (RF) systems, including satellite and microwave equipment. Whether you're behind the scenes maintaining our studio gear or out in the field with a satellite IP truck, your expertise directly ensures our content reaches the Kansas City community without interruption. If you're a seasoned, solutions-driven engineer ready to make a real impact, we'd love to have you on our team.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Responsible for preventive maintenance and emergency repairs of video, audio and radio frequency (RF) systems, including satellite and microwave equipment.
  • Drive, set up and operation of a Satellite IP truck.
  • Maintain logs and records as required by laws and per FCC Rules and Regulations.
  • Install and maintain video, audio, RF and computer equipment. These systems include digital transmitter system, microwave systems and of all broadcast equipment including, but are not limited to studio camera and switching systems, video monitors and technical measurement devices, video file servers and automation systems, electronic graphic systems.
  • Install, maintain and operate all studio equipment.
  • Maintain and repair news bureau equipment, ENG equipment, IP truck, satellite dishes and related equipment.
  • Assist in the design of any improvements to our operation.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Associates degree in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Specialized training/certification may be required
  • Generally, 2+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Ability to use a variety of equipment including but not limited to: Ross switchers, Logitek audio consoles, Panasonic cameras, Ross Inception, Ross Xpression, Final Cut editing systems, Harris automation and Nexio video servers. RF and transmitter experience a plus. CAD experience a plus
  • Must be a senior technician or paraprofessional highly experienced with a similar level of responsibility
  • Ability to resolve complex problems not covered by existing procedures or practices independently
  • Must have knowledge of FCC rules. The use of test equipment and soldering skills required.
  • Ability to guide and coach colleagues
  • Ability to effectively communicate with departmental and station personnel as required
  • Ability to work independently under timeline to achieve departmental and station goals
  • Must be able to comprehend schematics, mechanical drawings and technical manuals
  • Ability to prioritize
  • Must be able to work with microwave, transmitters and satellites
  • Ability to effectively work and communicate with others
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule including able to work multiple days, holidays, evenings, weekends, and possible overtime hours as needed. Availability to travel over multiple days is essential
  • Ability to work in changing weather conditions
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Kansas City, Missouri, sits at the confluence of the Missouri and Kansas rivers and punches well above its weight as a cultural, culinary, and sports destination. The city is internationally celebrated for its legendary barbecue — a tradition so serious that it has spawned its own distinct style — alongside a thriving restaurant scene that stretches from the historic River Market district to the lively Crossroads Arts District. World-class museums including the Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art and the National WWI Museum anchor a rich cultural landscape, while the 18th & Vine Jazz District pays homage to the city's deep musical roots.

Kansas City is a passionate sports town, home to the Kansas City Chiefs (NFL), the Kansas City Royals (MLB), and Sporting Kansas City (MLS), giving residents an exciting game-day culture across three seasons. The expansive Loose Park, the green trails of the Kaw Point Confluence, and the nearby Swope Park offer ample outdoor recreation in the heart of the metro. With a lower cost of living than many major U.S. cities, well-regarded neighborhoods like Brookside and Waldo, and a genuine Midwestern sense of community, Kansas City is a welcoming place to put down roots and build a career.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KERO - Kern River Valley
job.description:
At KERO 23 ABC, we believe every community deserves a journalist who knows its people, understands its challenges, and tells its stories with authenticity. As our Multimedia Journalist serving California's Kern River Valley, you'll be more than a reporter, you'll be the trusted voice covering a region whose stories often go untold by larger markets. This role is designed for someone who thrives working independently, building relationships, and becoming part of the fabric of a close-knit community. Nestled around Lake Isabella and surrounded by some of California's most stunning outdoor recreation, the Kern River Valley offers a unique lifestyle for journalists who value adventure, connection, and meaningful local storytelling. You'll have the opportunity to shine a spotlight on the issues, triumphs, and people that make this region special while ensuring local residents see their communities represented in the news every day.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop and pitch original story ideas that are relevant to Kern River Valley communities.
  • Research, write, shoot, and edit daily news stories for multiple platforms.
  • Deliver accurate, engaging live reports from the field.
  • Cultivate sources and build strong relationships with community leaders and residents.
  • Report on breaking news, public safety issues, weather impacts, and community events.
  • Produce compelling digital content, including videos, articles, and social media updates.
  • Work closely with producers, assignment editors, photographers, and newsroom leadership.
  • Generate enterprising story content that reflects the needs and interests of local audiences.
  • Meet daily deadlines while maintaining high journalistic standards.
  • Represent KERO professionally at community events and public appearances.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred.
  • Previous reporting, multimedia journalism, or newsroom experience required.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and the ability to travel throughout the coverage area.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Strong storytelling, writing, and on-camera presentation skills.
  • Ability to shoot and edit video content independently.
  • Sound news judgment and a commitment to accuracy, fairness, and ethics.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • A passion for community-focused journalism and audience engagement.
  • Confidence working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Proficiency with digital publishing tools, social media platforms, and mobile journalism techniques.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to breaking news situations and changing priorities.
  • Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as news coverage requires.
  • Ability to safely lift and carry standard field reporting equipment and work outdoors in varying weather conditions.

OUR TEAM:

The KERO 23 ABC newsroom is made up of dedicated journalists who care deeply about the communities they serve. We're collaborative, innovative, and driven by a shared mission to deliver accurate, impactful local news. Our team brings diverse experiences, perspectives, and talents together to create meaningful journalism that informs, connects, and empowers viewers across Kern County and beyond.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Nestled along the scenic Kern River and surrounded by mountains, lakes, and outdoor recreation, the Kern River Valley offers a unique lifestyle for adventurous storytellers. The area is known for its tight-knit communities, stunning natural beauty, and year-round opportunities for hiking, fishing, boating, camping, and exploring the outdoors.

You'll live and work in a region rich with local character and compelling stories, while remaining connected to the broader Bakersfield market. From community celebrations and small-town traditions to important issues affecting local residents, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact through your reporting every day.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KMTV
job.description:
KMTV, the E.W. Scripps CBS affiliate in Omaha, Nebraska, is seeking an experienced Multimedia Journalist to research, write, shoot, and edit compelling stories across multiple platforms. You'll cover the stories that matter most to our community while working both independently and collaboratively in an award-winning newsroom. We are looking for journalists with experience who want to continue growing their skills. Omaha is Nebraska's largest city, offering a blend of Midwest values and urban opportunities. With affordable living, a thriving downtown, and attractions like the Henry Doorly Zoo and the historic Old Market district, Omaha delivers big-city amenities with a strong sense of community. Apply today and work with a fantastic management team!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interviews, observation, and research.
  • Organize material and write stories according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.

  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KNXV
job.description:
We're looking for a storyteller who can do it all — shoot, write, report and most importantly - connect with the community. KNXV, ABC 15 in Phoenix, Arizona, is looking for a talented Multimedia Journalist to join our newsroom. At ABC 15, you'll be more than a journalist — you'll be a one-person powerhouse who brings the stories of the Valley of the Sun to life across television and digital platforms. From breaking news to in-depth community coverage, your work will inform, inspire and make a real difference in the lives of viewers across one of the nation's fastest-growing markets.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration
  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Phoenix is one of America's most exciting and sun-soaked cities, offering an extraordinary quality of life for those who call it home. With more than 300 days of sunshine a year, the Valley of the Sun is a playground for outdoor enthusiasts — whether you're hiking the iconic trails of Camelback Mountain and South Mountain Park, kayaking along the Salt River, or exploring the stunning red rocks just a short drive away in Sedona. The sprawling Sonoran Desert landscape is unlike anywhere else on earth, and it's right at your doorstep.

Beyond the outdoors, the downtown arts district offers a vibrant scene that includes the Phoenix Art Museum, one of the largest in the Southwest, as well as the Musical Instrument Museum — a one-of-a-kind destination that draws visitors from around the globe. The local food scene reflects the city's rich cultural diversity, from authentic Sonoran-style Mexican cuisine and acclaimed farm-to-table restaurants to a thriving craft brewery and coffee culture. The city also hosts beloved annual events like the Barrett-Jackson car auction and the Waste Management Phoenix Open, one of the most attended sporting events in the world.

For sports fans, Phoenix is a major-league city all the way, home to the NFL's Cardinals, the NBA's Suns, the WNBA's Mercury, the NHL's Coyotes, and MLB's Diamondbacks. With a booming economy, a young and diverse population, and world-class amenities at every turn, Phoenix isn't just a great place to work — it's a phenomenal place to build a life.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KSTU
job.description:
News is changing, and we’re looking for journalists who want to help shape what comes next. At KSTU Fox 13, an E.W. Scripps station, you’ll do more than report the news. You’ll help reimagine how stories are discovered, told, and experienced across every platform.


As a Multimedia Journalist, you’ll be part of a newsroom that believes local journalism can spark conversation, strengthen communities, and make a real difference. If you’re energized by breaking news, meaningful storytelling, and the opportunity to connect with one of the nation’s rapidly growing communities, this is your chance to be part of something bigger.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information through interviews, observation, and research.
  • Organize materials and write stories according to editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit or assist in editing videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on TV in live or pre-recorded situations.
  • Work cooperatively with photographers assigned to stories, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscasts.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multimedia stories.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in a related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on non-linear systems
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company-required insurance limits

OUR TEAM:

You’ll join a newsroom filled with curious, creative people who believe great journalism starts with understanding the community we serve. Our team brings different perspectives, backgrounds, interests, and experiences to the table, united by a shared drive to tell stories that matter. Whether you thrive on breaking news, unforgettable characters, accountability reporting, or finding the story everyone else overlooked, there’s room here to make your mark.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Salt Lake City gives you the rare chance to pursue ambitious journalism in a place where adventure is practically part of the commute. The Wasatch Mountains rise just outside the city, putting legendary skiing, hiking, biking, and mountain landscapes within easy reach, while Utah’s red rock country and five national parks make weekend road trips hard to beat.

Beyond the outdoors, Salt Lake City offers a vibrant mix of neighborhoods, restaurants, arts, culture, sports, and a thriving tech scene. It’s a place where your career can grow alongside the community you cover, with no shortage of people to meet, places to explore, or stories waiting to be told.

job.title: Multimedia Managing Editor, KJRH
job.description:
KJRH, the NBC affiliate in Tulsa, Oklahoma, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company, is creating a new role for a new era of local news. We're looking for a newsroom leader who understands that today's audience expects news wherever they are, whether that's on a streaming channel, a phone, social media, or television. You'll be at the center of our operation, helping drive a 24/7 news stream while making sure the newsroom stays connected, informed, and focused on the stories that matter most. This role is part coach, part editor, part conductor. You'll help reporters and MMJs tell stronger stories, make smart decisions in the moment, and find creative ways to connect our journalism with the communities we serve.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Lead the daily execution of KRJH's 24/7 streaming news channel, ensuring a constant flow of relevant, timely, and engaging content.
  • Serve as the central hub for information entering and leaving the newsroom, helping teams stay aligned on priorities and coverage plans.
  • Coach and develop reporters, MMJs, and content creators to elevate storytelling across all platforms.
  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership to execute audience-focused content strategies that deliver meaningful community impact.
  • Oversee story writing, editing, and publishing workflows across broadcast, digital, social, and streaming platforms.
  • Provide timely and constructive feedback that drives continuous growth and stronger journalistic performance.
  • Develop and refine newsroom processes that improve efficiency, communication, and content execution.
  • Ensure all content meets the highest standards of journalistic ethics, editorial judgment, accuracy, and fairness.
  • Inspire trust and collaboration among reporters, photographers, producers, and newsroom staff.
  • Contribute to breaking news coverage and provide multi-platform reporting or on-air support when needed.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Seven or more years of newsroom, content leadership, digital media, streaming, or related experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading editorial decision-making and managing content workflows in a fast-paced news environment.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Deep expertise in digital journalism, streaming content strategy, and audience engagement.
  • Strong understanding of broadcast-style storytelling and how to adapt content across multiple platforms.
  • Exceptional editorial judgment and thorough knowledge of journalistic ethics, media law, and libel considerations.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence, mentor talent, and foster a culture of collaboration and growth.
  • Curiosity about the communities, cities, states, and world we cover every day.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize rapidly changing news situations.
  • A passion for innovation and finding new ways to tell stories that resonate with audiences.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to connect teams around a common vision.
  • Flexibility to work a variety of shifts, including nights, weekends, early mornings, and holidays as newsroom needs require

WTMJ, the NBC affiliate in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company is looking for an experienced News Photographer. You’ll be a video journalist, shooting, and editing stories that matter to the community. TMJ4 is a newsroom that take great visuals seriously. The schedule could be three days a week on dayside plus weekend nights, but no schedule is guaranteed. And the backdrop? Milwaukee, with lakefront views, big festivals and a story on every block. Apply today!

job.title: Producer, KMVT
job.description:
If you’re looking to start or grow your career in local news, KMVT in Twin Falls gives you the opportunity to build real newsroom experience while enjoying a quality of life that can be harder to find in larger markets. You’ll help shape daily newscasts, make real-time editorial decisions and work alongside reporters, anchors and newsroom leaders to tell stories that matter to Southern Idaho. Twin Falls also offers an affordable place to build your career, put down roots and enjoy life outside of work.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop and organize newscasts and local programs.
  • Write stories and help determine how they are showcased across platforms.
  • Collaborate with reporters, anchors, news managers and assignment editors to determine daily content needs.
  • Enhance storytelling with graphics, video, research and station branding.
  • Make smart, time-sensitive editorial decisions.
  • Oversee live broadcasts and adjust content as news develops.
  • Perform desktop editing.
  • Publish content to the station’s digital platforms.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related discipline preferred, or equivalent experience.
  • Generally, 2+ years of experience in a related field preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • A passion for local news and an understanding of the stories, events and trends that matter to the community.
  • Strong news judgment and the ability to develop and advance stories.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • A passion for writing and creative storytelling, with close attention to grammar, spelling, accuracy and the details that make a story stronger.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • The ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced, deadline-driven newsroom.
  • Strong self-motivation.
  • Working knowledge of journalistic ethics and libel laws, along with strong editorial judgment.
  • Familiarity with web analytics.
  • Proficiency with newsroom computer systems; Microsoft Office experience is a plus.
  • Flexibility to work varying hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays.

OUR TEAM:

At KMVT, you’ll be part of a local newsroom focused on serving the Twin Falls community and Southern Idaho. This is an opportunity to learn by doing, take on meaningful responsibility and develop the writing, editorial and production skills that can help build a long-term career in journalism.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Twin Falls can be a great place to begin your career without some of the financial pressures that come with starting out in a larger market. It offers a combination of affordability, community and access to the outdoors that makes it possible to build your career while still having a life outside the newsroom.

For someone looking for that first big opportunity in the business, Twin Falls offers the chance to gain hands-on experience, grow your skills and establish yourself in a community where local journalism matters.

job.title: Regional Sr Director Sales
job.description:
Are you a seasoned sales leader ready to make a sweeping impact across multiple markets? We are currently looking for a Regional Sr. Director, Sales to lead our sales organizations and help local and national businesses unlock growth through compelling multi-platform advertising solutions in the Montana Market. In this role, you will provide strategic leadership, revenue oversight, talent development, and operational excellence across a designated geographic zone — partnering cross-functionally to drive consistent revenue growth, maximize inventory performance, and ensure execution of company sales strategies and initiatives. If you thrive on building high-performing teams, forging strong client relationships, and translating strategy into measurable results, this is the opportunity for you.


*Location flexibility is available across our Montana stations, including KBZK, KTVQ, KPAX, KTVH, and KRTV.*

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Partner with market leaders and local sales leadership across multiple markets to establish and achieve revenue, profitability, and strategic objectives.
  • Develop and oversee zonal revenue plans, budgets, forecasts, and performance targets to ensure annual revenue goals are achieved across all assigned markets.
  • Provide strategic direction to market sales leaders while ensuring alignment with company sales strategies, priorities, and performance expectations.
  • Monitor market performance through regular business reviews, identifying opportunities, risks, and corrective actions to optimize results.
  • Drive consistency in inventory management, pricing strategy, and revenue optimization practices across all assigned markets.
  • Collaborate with local sales leaders to maximize broadcast, streaming, and digital revenue opportunities and ensure effective sales execution.
  • Partner with enterprise and national sales leaders to strengthen cross-market selling strategies and maximize revenue opportunities.
  • Meet with key clients, agencies, advertisers, and community stakeholders throughout the zone to strengthen relationships and support business growth.
  • Establish and promote best practices across assigned markets to improve sales effectiveness, productivity, and customer outcomes.
  • Lead and support enterprise, regional, and local revenue initiatives across multiple markets.
  • Build and maintain a strong leadership and talent pipeline across the zone, identifying successors for key sales leadership positions.
  • Collaborate with traffic, finance, and operational teams to optimize inventory utilization and revenue management practices.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and political advertising guidelines across all assigned markets.
  • Assess competitive market dynamics across the zone and develop strategies that strengthen market position and revenue growth.
  • Maintain the highest standards of integrity, accountability, and business conduct.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field, or equivalent experience preferred
  • Generally, 10+ years of proven success in media sales leadership with significant responsibility for multi-market, regional, or enterprise revenue management
  • Demonstrated success leading sales leaders and sales organizations across multiple locations
  • Advanced experience in inventory management, pricing strategy, political advertising, and revenue forecasting
  • Experience in agency and direct strategic account management, broadcast inventory management, streaming, digital, and video advertising solutions
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Proven ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organizational structure
  • Strong strategic and analytical capabilities with the ability to translate insights into actionable business plans
  • Demonstrated ability to lead geographically dispersed teams and drive organizational alignment
  • Strong executive presence and ability to effectively influence senior leaders and stakeholders
  • Proven leadership skills that foster accountability, collaboration, engagement, and performance
  • Exceptional coaching and talent development capabilities
  • Ability to identify and scale best practices across multiple markets
  • Strong change management and organizational effectiveness skills
  • Effective decision-making abilities in complex and rapidly changing environments
  • Advanced oral, written, and presentation communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining focus on strategic outcomes
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, CRM platforms, sales analytics tools, and virtual collaboration technologies
  • Frequent travel throughout assigned markets and corporate locations as needed

OUR TEAM:

We have hikers, rock climbers, mountain bikers, kayakers, runners, skiers, fishing enthusiasts, boaters, and every other mixture of diverse backgrounds, passions, and life experiences. We are a community of welcoming, mission-focused, and lively people who continue to grow as we grow our company and rise to our full potential in every aspect of our business.



WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Bozeman, Montana, has a history still alive with the remnants of bygone days and sustains a local heritage that can still be found throughout the community, with nine historical districts and more than 40 individual properties listed on the National Register of Historic Places. The town of Bozeman provides a unique environment for a different kind of lifestyle and often tops lists of best places to live. It is blessed with relatively good weather, outstanding scenery, unparalleled recreational opportunities, world-class fishing, plenty of cultural activities, galleries, museums, and the like. Tech start-up companies are prevalent and growing in the area. The Bozeman area has served as a filming site for a number of films, including The Wildest Dream, A River Runs Through It, A Plumm Summer and Amazing Grace, and Chuck. Bozeman is a short (and beautiful) drive to Yellowstone National Park. Big Sky resort draws the world's wealthiest people as well as A-list celebrities. If you're skiing at Big Sky, you could literally run into your favorite celebrity or professional athlete. Bozeman is also an up-and-coming foodie town. We have very few chain restaurants because people here want the unique experience of dining local, from pizzerias that feature southwest Montana's best home-grown ingredients to steakhouses that showcase local grass-fed and sustainably raised beef.

job.title: Scripps Sports Partnership Lead
job.description:
Are you ready to be part of one of the most exciting partnerships in sports broadcasting? Scripps Sports is seeking an Account Executive who will sell linear, digital, and sponsorship solutions for Scripps Sports, including our partnership as the official broadcast partner of the Nashville Predators on ION and WNPX-TV/WTVF Channel 5. You'll work with regional and national clients to create innovative advertising solutions that connect brands with passionate sports fans, while helping achieve the revenue plan of our growing sports division.

This position can be remote in Nashville, TN, Charlotte, NC, or Atlanta, GA.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Independently prospect regional and national accounts, secure appointments, perform needs analysis, develop customized solutions, conduct presentations and close sales.
  • Create and sell sponsorship/advertising solutions utilizing acquired league and team controlled sports inventory.
  • Attend internal meetings to establish strategy and revenue goals and attend weekly sports division meetings.
  • Serve as trusted advisor with new clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.
  • Perform client services, including but not limited to media avail negotiations, presentation preparation delivery and execution, copy writing, credit applications, collections of revenue due and retention reports.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, which may include entertaining prospective and existing clients, attending sporting events or other associated functions.
  • Perform routine administrative functions of media sales including makegood resolution, continuous update of CRM system with activity, account information and pending revenue, and communication with VP of Revenue regarding status of accounts.
  • Assist Scripps national or local AE's on key client sales calls for sports sponsorships.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related field required, or equivalent experience
  • Generally 5+ years of sports-related experience required
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated record of success in a goal-oriented, highly accountable sales environment
  • Proficient use of Microsoft Office and other programs such as customer relations software
  • Working knowledge of various media sales platforms
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills required
  • Must have good organizational skills and time management
  • Ability to present and negotiate with confidence and professionalism
  • Strong attention to detail, ability to multitask and meet deadlines in fast pace environment
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused
  • Travel required up to 25%

WHAT WE'LL OFFER:

  • Uncapped sales commission
  • Monthly allowance for mileage and cell phone
  • Extensive Scripps Sales Process training
  • A career path to grow your professional experiences
  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits
  • Retirement savings plan with company match
  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, life insurance, ID protection, pet discount program, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Nashville, Tennessee is Music City—but it's so much more. As one of the fastest-growing cities in America, Nashville offers an unbeatable blend of Southern charm, creative energy, and economic opportunity. Beyond the honky-tonks of Broadway, you'll discover a thriving food scene with James Beard Award-winning chefs, a booming healthcare and technology sector, and neighborhoods brimming with character from East Nashville's artistic vibe to the historic charm of Germantown. Sports fans will love cheering on the NFL's Tennessee Titans, NHL's Nashville Predators, and MLS's Nashville SC. With no state income tax, a relatively affordable cost of living for a major metro, mild winters, and a community that welcomes newcomers with open arms, Nashville truly lives up to its reputation as a city where dreams are made.

job.title: Scripps Sports Partnership Lead, Nashville
job.description:
Scripps Sports is looking for a passionate, experienced sports sales professional to help drive revenue growth for the Nashville Predators TV Broadcasts on Scripps Sports, one of the NHL's most recognized franchises. As a Scripps Sports Partnership Lead, you'll leverage the power of live sports and the strength of the Predators-Scripps partnership to develop strategic sponsorships, build lasting client partnerships, and create innovative linear and digital advertising and marketing solutions for regional and national advertisers. If you're a proven seller who thrives on developing new business, exceeding revenue goals, and delivering winning solutions, this is an exciting opportunity to make an immediate impact with a growing sports media organization.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Prospect and develop relationships with regional and national accounts to generate new business opportunities.
  • Conduct needs analyses and create customized sports sponsorship and advertising solutions that align with client objectives.
  • Secure appointments, present recommendations, negotiate agreements, and close sales to achieve revenue goals.
  • Create and sell sponsorship packages utilizing acquired league and team-controlled sports inventory, with a primary focus on Nashville Predators partnership opportunities.
  • Leverage the strength and visibility of the Nashville Predators brand to develop creative, integrated marketing solutions that deliver measurable results for clients.
  • Collaborate with Scripps national and local Account Executives on strategic sports sponsorship opportunities.
  • Participate in internal planning meetings to establish sales strategies, revenue targets, and growth initiatives.
  • Build long-term client partnerships through exceptional service, retention efforts, and referral generation.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to new and existing clients while identifying opportunities to expand partnerships and drive incremental revenue.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling presentations, sponsorship pitches, and partnership recommendations to clients and stakeholders.
  • Manage all aspects of client service, including media negotiations, proposal development, campaign execution, collections, reporting, and account retention activities.
  • Entertain prospective and existing clients through sporting events and other business development opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate client activity, pipeline, forecasting, account information, and revenue projections within CRM systems.
  • Resolve makegoods and other sales-related issues while ensuring client satisfaction.
  • Communicate regularly with sales leadership regarding account status, revenue performance, and business opportunities.
  • Travel up to 25% as needed to support client meetings, sponsorship opportunities, sporting events, and business development activities.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Sports Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in sports, media, sponsorship, advertising, partnership sales, or a related industry.
  • Proven track record of success achieving and exceeding revenue goals in a highly accountable sales environment.
  • Valid driver's license, satisfactory driving record, and proof of insurance meeting company requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Strong understanding of sports sponsorships, media sales, and integrated marketing solutions.
  • Ability to identify client needs and develop strategic, customized partnership programs.
  • Exceptional prospecting, relationship-building, negotiating, and closing skills.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and uncover new revenue opportunities.
  • Experience using CRM platforms and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Knowledge of media sales platforms and advertising solutions.
  • Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to confidently present to executives and audiences of all sizes in both virtual and in-person settings.
  • Strong organizational and time management capabilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across teams and departments.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented approach with a strong sense of accountability.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for sports, partnership development, and revenue generation.
  • Ability to effectively represent the Nashville Predators and Scripps Sports brands in the marketplace.

WHAT WE'LL OFFER

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission opportunity.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Retirement savings opportunities, including company matching.
  • Generous paid time off and holidays.
  • Employee wellness programs and resources.
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities.
  • The opportunity to represent one of the most exciting brands in professional sports while helping clients connect with passionate fans.
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture where your contributions directly impact business growth and success.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY

At Scripps Sports, you'll join a team that is redefining local sports media and building powerful connections between fans, teams, and advertisers. Utilizing our Nashville Predators broadcasts, you'll help brands tap into the passion, reach, and engagement of live sports while creating partnerships that drive measurable business results. If you're energized by sports, motivated by sales success, and excited about representing a premier NHL franchise, you'll find an incredible opportunity to grow your career and make a lasting impact in Nashville, Tennessee, one of the country's most vibrant sports, entertainment, and business communities.

job.title: Senior Manager, Community Connections, WTVF
job.description:
At Scripps, we believe strong local journalism starts with strong community connections. As the Sr. Manager, Community Connections at WTVF, NewsChannel 5 in Nashville, Tennessee, you’ll serve as a primary connector between the station and the communities of Nashville and Middle Tennessee, building trusted relationships that deepen local engagement, inform our journalism and create meaningful partnerships.

You’ll bring community voices and insights into the newsroom while helping ensure questions, concerns and story ideas are heard and acted on thoughtfully. Working across News, Sales, Marketing and station leadership, you’ll turn community intelligence into opportunities for greater impact. Your work will help ensure NewsChannel 5 remains an essential, responsive and trusted part of life across Middle Tennessee.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, government and other community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze and share community insights with station leadership, newsroom teams and partners to help inform decision-making, journalism and local engagement.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources and strengthen audience engagement across community channels.
  • Represent WTVF throughout Nashville and Middle Tennessee and develop partnerships that create long-term value, trust and local impact.
  • Respond to community members, partners and stakeholders with timely, professional communication, ensuring audience questions, concerns and story tips are acknowledged, routed and resolved appropriately.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs and other community engagement activities.
  • Collaborate with News, Sales, Marketing, Operations and station leadership to develop meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics and stakeholder coordination while measuring effectiveness to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities, advising leadership on community needs, emerging issues and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, sharing best practices, tracking outcomes and helping build engagement capabilities across teams.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of relevant experience preferred.
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations or a related field.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company-required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills, with the ability to establish credibility across a wide range of communities and organizations.
  • Strong community listening skills and the ability to recognize emerging issues, needs and opportunities.
  • Strategic thinking and sound judgment, with the ability to translate community insights into meaningful action.
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing and presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations, station leadership and external community organizations.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion and integrity when working with diverse communities and sensitive topics.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative and adapt effectively to changing community and business needs.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM or community relationship platforms and collaboration tools.
  • A strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns and sensitive community issues.

Application Review:

Applications received by November 18, 2026 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.


Nashville is a growing, dynamic community with a rich history, vibrant neighborhoods and a culture all its own. Known around the world as Music City, Nashville is also home to a thriving business community, major league sports, renowned universities, diverse arts and food scenes, and communities that care deeply about the future of Middle Tennessee. This is an opportunity to build meaningful connections across the market and help WTVF continue making a difference in the communities it serves.

job.title: Sr Mgr, Community Connections, WGBA
job.description:
WGBA, the NBC affiliate in Green Bay, Wisconsin, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company, is searching for a Senior Manager of Community Connections. You'll be the station's main link to the community, building trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, education and government leaders. You'll turn community insights into stronger journalism, partnerships that matter and events people show up for, like town halls and public forums. You'll also lead the newsroom's daily community engagement and make sure audience questions, story tips and concerns get a fast, thoughtful response. If you love connecting people and making a real local impact, we want to hear from you.

From Lambeau Field to the Fox River trails, Green Bay is a close-knit city with big hometown pride. It has a friendly, small-city feel, easy access to the waters of Green Bay and Door County, and some of the most loyal fans anywhere, so it's easy to feel at home in Titletown. Apply today!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Build and maintain relationships with community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and communicate community insights to station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to inform decision-making and coverage.

job.title: Sr Reporter, KTVH
job.description:
KTVH is looking for an experienced Senior Reporter who believes local journalism should make a difference. You’ll take on investigations, long-form reporting and major breaking news while building strong connections across the Helena community.


This role is for a journalist who can dig deeper, develop trusted sources and turn complex stories into meaningful, compelling coverage across platforms. You’ll also serve as a newsroom leader, modeling strong journalistic standards and helping elevate storytelling across the team.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Develop a strong network of sources and local experts throughout the community.
  • Research and investigate stories using public records, personal sources and other contacts.
  • Take the lead on in-depth reporting, long-form journalism and major breaking news.
  • Report live from the field and cover news as it develops.
  • Shoot still photography and video and incorporate strong visuals, graphics and digital elements into your storytelling.
  • Create distinctive content for broadcast, digital and social platforms.
  • Find stories and perspectives that reflect the diversity of the communities we serve.
  • Maintain high standards for accuracy, fairness, objectivity and journalistic ethics.
  • Collaborate with newsroom teams on editorial planning, content strategy, workflows and best practices.
  • Participate in community events and build authentic connections with viewers and community members.
  • Provide backup editorial coverage as needed.
  • Drive a personal or company vehicle to cover assignments throughout the market.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Generally, 5+ years of news reporting experience, including in-depth or long-form reporting.
  • Experience in community, digital and solutions-based journalism preferred.
  • Valid driver’s license and good driving record.
  • Ability to provide proof of insurance meeting company-required insurance limits.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Strong expertise in investigative, in-depth and long-form journalism.
  • Compelling storytelling skills and a distinct, engaging on-air presence.
  • A strong understanding of what audiences need and expect from local news.
  • Experience with multimedia journalism, including reporting, writing, web publishing, photography, video, infographics, databases and social media.
  • Knowledge of journalism fundamentals, including privacy, ethics, access to information, open meetings and public records laws.
  • High standards for accuracy and fairness.
  • Strong writing and editing skills.
  • Working knowledge of Associated Press style.
  • Ability to use digital tools, video, mapping, social media and other technology to strengthen reporting.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and web publishing tools.
  • Adaptability, sound judgment and strong emotional intelligence.

OUR TEAM:

At KTVH, you’ll be part of a local newsroom focused on journalism that matters to the people we serve. We’re looking for someone who can bring experience and leadership to the newsroom while still being excited to get out into the community, chase stories and report from the field.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Helena gives you something pretty unique: the opportunity to live and report in Montana’s capital city while having the outdoors practically in your backyard. The city manages more than 1,950 acres of open lands, including Mount Helena City Park, and the greater Helena area offers more than 100 miles of trails for hiking, mountain biking and exploring.


When the workday ends, you can head straight for Mount Helena, Mount Ascension or the South Hills trail system, where more than 80 miles of singletrack connect the community to the surrounding landscape.


For a journalist, Helena offers an especially interesting combination: a connected local community, the stories that come with covering a state capital, and easy access to the kind of outdoor lifestyle people move to Montana to find. If you want meaningful reporting without giving up hiking, biking and weekends outside, Helena is a pretty great place to call home.

job.title: Sr. Account Manager, SMB Growth & Direct Response
job.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at the intersection of media innovation and client success? Scripps is seeking a strategic Sr. Account Manager, SMB Growth & Direct Response to join our dynamic team in New York City. In this role, you'll be the driving force behind strengthening advertiser and agency relationships while delivering integrated media solutions that span linear television, digital, and streaming/CTV platforms. If you're passionate about maximizing campaign performance and building strategic partnerships that drive real business results, this is your opportunity to shine.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage the day-to-day execution, delivery, and performance of assigned accounts and campaigns to meet client objectives, revenue goals, retention targets, and performance KPIs.
  • Serve as a contact for advertisers and agencies, developing a strong understanding of their business objectives, target audiences, marketing strategies, and performance goals while providing responsive, solutions-oriented support as well as upselling opportunities.
  • Partner with account executives and sales leadership on media plans, proposals, presentations, pipeline management, account growth, retention, and opportunities to increase advertiser investment.
  • Proactively monitor campaign pacing, delivery, and performance; analyze KPIs including CPA, CPL, ROAS, response, conversion, reach, and frequency; and implement optimization strategies to maximize campaign effectiveness.
  • Analyze campaign and account performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement, and develop client-facing reports, campaign recaps, recommendations, and strategic insights.
  • Coordinate the campaign lifecycle from proposal through order entry, trafficking, scheduling, optimization, reporting, makegoods, and reconciliation while maintaining accurate account, campaign, and revenue information in applicable systems.
  • Partner with Sales, Ad Operations, Traffic, Inventory, Research, Marketing, Content, Finance, and other internal teams to ensure effective planning, execution, issue resolution, and delivery of client commitments.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Demonstrated understanding of national advertising landscapes, agency structures, and enterprise-level client requirements preferred
  • Strong and comprehensive understanding of linear TV, digital, and streaming/CTV media planning, buying, and optimization across integrated platforms
  • Knowledge of Direct Response advertising, performance metrics (CPA, CPL, ROAS, conversion rates), and campaign management processes
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret campaign data, identify optimization opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations
  • Exceptional client-service and communication skills
  • Ability to effectively present strategic recommendations to advertisers, agencies, and internal stakeholders
  • Demonstrated capability in end-to-end campaign oversight with focus on revenue optimization and strategic partnership alignment
  • Proficiency in CRM, analytics platforms, and Microsoft Office with strong organizational skills to prioritize competing demands in fast-paced environments

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY


New York City is the epicenter of media, advertising, and innovation—and there's no better place to advance your career in strategic account management. As the nation's largest media market, NYC offers unparalleled access to leading agencies, brands, and industry events. Beyond work, the city pulses with world-class dining, arts, culture, and entertainment. From Broadway shows to rooftop bars, Central Park to Brooklyn's vibrant neighborhoods, you'll find endless ways to explore and be inspired. With excellent public transportation and a hybrid work model, you'll enjoy the perfect balance of professional growth and urban living at its finest.

job.title: Sr. Analyst, Strategic Partner Development
job.description:
Are you ready to drive revenue growth and operational excellence in the fast-paced world of digital media? We're looking for a strategic, results-driven Senior Analyst, Strategic Partner Development to lead the optimization of our digital monetization platforms and partner-managed revenue channels. In this role, you'll be at the intersection of technology, revenue strategy, and cross-functional collaboration—maximizing performance, solving complex challenges, and ensuring our digital operations align with business priorities and brand safety standards.


If you thrive on turning data into action, building strong partnerships, and leading initiatives that directly impact the bottom line, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact at Scripps.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with external platform partners or clients serving as key operational contact.
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key platform and technology partners, including YouTube/Google, serving as a primary liaison to drive revenue growth, platform optimization, content monetization, and partner success.
  • Lead day-to-day platform performance, revenue activity, and compliance requirements for assigned digital monetization platforms, accounts, or partner channels.
  • Support the development, implementation, and refinement of monetization strategies to improve revenue yield, operational efficiency, content monetization, rights management, brand safety, and policy compliance.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex platform, policy, delivery, reporting, or monetization issues; assess root causes and develop practical solutions.
  • Provide timely reporting and analysis to cross-functional teams that connects platform performance, revenue trends, audience behavior, inventory performance, and partner updates to identify risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Content, Product, Sales, Ad Operations, and other stakeholders to identify and execute new monetization opportunities, evaluate emerging platform capabilities, and support business development initiatives that advance Scripps' digital revenue strategy.
  • Maintain a consistent operating rhythm with external platform or technology partners by coordinating updates, tracking follow-through, and communicating changes that may affect revenue, workflows, or compliance.
  • Support cross-functional projects related to platform launches, monetization tools, workflow improvements, reporting enhancements, or partner initiatives.
  • Develop documentation, training materials, and best-practice guidance to support consistency, accountability, and scalability across accounts or platforms.
  • Act as a resource for less experienced team members by providing guidance on complex issues, reviewing work for accuracy, and sharing platform knowledge.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Experience building strategic partnerships with digital platforms, including YouTube/Google, to drive revenue growth and content monetization, is strongly preferred
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Advanced skill with digital ad operations, platform monetization, video operations, or a related digital media role with a track record of increasing responsibility
  • Strong understanding of platform policies, partner requirements, brand safety, rights management, and compliance impacts
  • Ability to analyze complex performance data and translate insights into revenue-focused recommendations
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex, ambiguous, or non-routine issues independently
  • Project leadership skills, including cross-functional coordination, stakeholder influence, and initiative execution
  • Clear communication skills for technical, operational, business, and leadership audiences
  • Strong relationship-building skills with internal teams and external platform or technology partners
  • Ability to mentor others and promote consistent practices across teams or accounts

job.title: Sr. Manager, Community Connections - Central Coast & Southern Central Valley
job.description:
At Scripps, we believe strong local journalism starts with strong community connections. As the Sr. Manager, Community Connections for the Central Coast (KSBY) and Southern Central Valley (KERO), you’ll serve as the station’s primary connector to the Central Coast community and Southern Central Valley Coast, building trusted relationships that deepen local engagement, inform our journalism, and create meaningful partnerships. You’ll bring community voices and insights into the newsroom while helping ensure questions, concerns, and story ideas are heard and acted on thoughtfully. Working across News, Sales, Marketing, and station leadership, you’ll turn community intelligence into opportunities for greater impact. Your work will help ensure these communities remains an essential, responsive, and trusted part of community life. This position will be located on-site at KSBY in San Luis Obispo, CA.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with civic, nonprofit, business, educational, government, and other community stakeholders to understand emerging issues, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, and share community insights with station leadership, newsroom teams, and partners to help inform decision-making, journalism, and local engagement.
  • Partner with News to identify story opportunities, connect journalists with trusted sources, and strengthen audience engagement across community channels.
  • Represent the station throughout the community and develop partnerships that create long-term value, trust, and local impact.
  • Respond to community members, partners, and stakeholders with timely, professional communication, ensuring audience questions, concerns, and story tips are acknowledged, routed, and resolved appropriately.
  • Lead the planning and execution of forums, town halls, public-service initiatives, educational programs, and other community engagement activities.
  • Collaborate with News, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and station leadership to develop meaningful opportunities that strengthen audience relationships and community impact.
  • Oversee event logistics and stakeholder coordination while measuring effectiveness to ensure engagement activities are inclusive, relevant, and impactful.
  • Develop and execute a market-wide community engagement strategy aligned with station and regional priorities, advising leadership on community needs, emerging issues, and opportunities to strengthen trust and local impact.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional community engagement efforts, sharing best practices, tracking outcomes, and helping build engagement capabilities across teams.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of relevant experience preferred.
  • Generally, 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in community engagement, journalism, nonprofit leadership, communications, public affairs, partnership development, government relations, or a related field.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional relationship-building and networking skills, with the ability to establish credibility across a wide range of communities and organizations.
  • Strong community listening skills and the ability to recognize emerging issues, needs, and opportunities.
  • Strategic thinking and sound judgment, with the ability to translate community insights into meaningful action.
  • Strong facilitation, public speaking, writing, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across News, Sales, Marketing, Operations, station leadership, and external community organizations.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Empathy, cultural awareness, diplomacy, discretion, and integrity when working with diverse communities and sensitive topics.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and adapt effectively to changing community and business needs.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM or community relationship platforms, and collaboration tools.
  • A strong customer-service mindset, conflict-resolution skills, and sound judgment when responding to audience questions, concerns, and sensitive community issues.

Application Review: Applications received by November 9, 2026 will receive priority consideration. Applications received after this date may continue to be reviewed as needed.


OUR TEAM:

We’re a team of journalists, storytellers, relationship builders, and community advocates who care deeply about the people and places we serve. At KSBY, we bring different backgrounds, perspectives, interests, and experiences to our work, united by a shared commitment to meaningful local journalism and stronger communities. You’ll work alongside collaborative colleagues who value curiosity, authenticity, responsiveness, and finding new ways to connect with audiences both inside and outside the newsroom.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

San Luis Obispo offers an incredible Central Coast lifestyle, surrounded by rolling hills and within easy reach of California’s coastline. The area blends an active outdoor lifestyle with a welcoming community, local restaurants, wineries, farmers markets, arts, and plenty of opportunities to hike, bike, explore, and enjoy the outdoors.

As Sr. Manager, Community Connections, you’ll have the opportunity to build relationships with the people and organizations that shape San Luis Obispo and communities across the Central Coast. Whether you’re attending a community event, meeting with local leaders, or discovering the stories people are talking about, you’ll be immersed in the communities KSBY serves.

job.title: Sr. Manager, Sales Assistant
job.description:
Are you a strategic, people-first leader who thrives in the middle of change? Scripps is looking for an experienced manager to lead a virtual Sales Assistant team that powers the engine of our linear and digital sales operation. In this role, you'll set the standard for excellence — building scalable processes, growing talent, and partnering with Sales Leadership to elevate seller productivity and customer experience. If you're energized by transformation, motivated by results, and committed to developing high-performing teams in a fast-moving media environment, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Establish clear performance expectations, accountability measures, and service standards to ensure consistent execution.
  • Oversee staffing, workload balancing, and resource allocation to maximize team efficiency and seller support.
  • Create and lead training, onboarding, and professional development programs that build media sales and systems expertise.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, customer service, and ongoing learning.
  • Serve as a change leader by guiding teams through evolving business priorities, technologies, and transformation initiatives.

  • Expertise in change management and organizational effectiveness
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
