job.title: SVP, Marketing
job.description:
Are you a visionary marketing leader ready to shape the future of one of America's most storied media companies? The E.W. Scripps Company is looking for a Senior Vice President of Marketing to define and lead the overall marketing strategy for the organization — with a bold emphasis on creativity, brand excellence, performance, and engagement across multiple platforms. In this high-impact executive role, you will set the vision for Scripps' brands and marketing strategies, ensuring alignment with business objectives to drive audience and ratings growth, strengthen Scripps-owned brands, and support ad sales and distribution value. If you thrive at the intersection of storytelling, data, and innovation, this is your opportunity to leave a lasting mark on a company that has been illuminating communities for generations.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Collaborate with leaders across Programming, Ad Sales, Sports, Distribution, News, and Research to develop and execute comprehensive marketing and brand strategies for the enterprise, including news, sports, and entertainment.
  • Lead a team across Brand, Audience growth (performance marketing) and Creative production.

Brand and Creative

  • Define and strengthen brand positioning, architecture and messaging across Scripps' portfolio.
  • Lead creative strategy, development and production to build distinctive brands, drive audience engagement and ensure consistent, compelling storytelling across channels and touchpoints.

Audience Growth / Performance Marketing and Measurement

  • Drive incremental audience growth through audience insights, segmentation and integrated marketing across paid, owned, earned and social channels.
  • Own media strategy, investment allocation, campaign execution and performance measurement.
  • Partner with Market Research to translate consumer insights, viewing behaviors and audience preferences into more effective targeting, media planning and campaign strategies.
  • Continuously optimize marketing effectiveness, efficiency and ROI.

Strategic Partnerships & Commercial Enablement

  • Develop and activate strategic partnerships with leagues, talent, creators, platforms and other ecosystem players to expand audience reach, engagement and brand visibility.
  • Collaborate with Programming, Ad Sales and Distribution to unlock growth opportunities, strengthen advertiser propositions and drive measurable audience and commercial impact.
  • Identify and activate high-impact events, industry forums and external platforms to amplify Scripps' brands and content, extend reach beyond owned properties and build strategic relationships.

Marketing Capabilities, Organization & AI-Enabled Marketing

  • Build a high-performing, future-ready marketing organization by developing talent, capabilities and processes.
  • Establish effective cross-functional ways of working to strengthen collaboration, streamline decision-making and improve execution.
  • Lead the transformation toward an AI-enabled marketing operating model, leveraging data, analytics, automation and technology to accelerate execution, increase efficiency and scale marketing impact.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or a related field.
  • 15+ years of relevant experience in product/brand marketing, preferably with at least 10 years in media organizations.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Proven experience as a Vice President of Marketing or similar role with a strong track record of success.
  • Demonstrated capability in developing effective strategies and business plans across all marketing aspects, including branding and product promotion.
  • Previous experience in sports marketing preferred.
  • Strong understanding of linear TV and digital measurement; experience using testing and analytics to drive decisions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of presenting ideas effectively to large groups and senior management.
  • Strong analytical skills with a solid understanding of market research and data analysis methods.
  • Ability to lead and foster collaboration among diverse teams; committed to creating an inclusive work atmosphere.
  • Knowledgeable in contemporary marketing tools and digital marketing strategies, with the ability to apply effective techniques across multiple channels.
  • Familiarity with different business disciplines (e.g., IT, finance) and experience managing marketing operations within a matrix organizational structure.

Priority consideration will be given to all applications submitted by Friday, December 4, 2026.

job.title: Temporary Senior Multimarket Digital Content Producer
job.description:
Scripps is seeking a Sr Multimarket Digital Content Producer who will independently execute, optimize, and improve digital content across an assigned group of local station markets. Apply advanced digital storytelling, social media, video, platform, and analytics knowledge to develop market-specific content approaches, troubleshoot complex content and platform performance challenges, and contribute to measurable audience growth across social media, owned-and-operated (O&O) web platforms, mobile apps, and connected TV (CTV) applications. The Regional Digital Content Producer partners with station teams, Multi-Media Journalists (MMJs), and regional digital leadership to translate Content Strategy 3.0 into actionable digital plans, coordinate priority digital initiatives, and share best-practice recommendations that improve reach, engagement, and platform performance.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Partner with station teams, Multi-Media Journalists (MMJs), and regional digital leadership to translate Content Strategy 3.0 into actionable digital plans, coordinate priority digital initiatives, and share best-practice recommendations that improve reach, engagement, and platform performance.
  • Optimize digital content and web content management for multiple station markets, determining the best approach to meet audience, brand, and platform performance goals
  • Develop and produce priority vertical video content across social and owned-and-operated (O&O) platforms, applying strong video production and content creation judgment to support audience engagement
  • Create and refine social media graphics, thumbnails, and visual packages for priority content, applying graphic design and image editing practices to support performance across platforms
  • Manage above-the-fold execution on station websites, using content optimization, audience behavior, and user experience insights to address performance issues and improve engagement
  • Apply strong video judgment to select, package, and optimize video content for live video streaming on station websites, mobile apps, and owned CTV applications;
  • Implement live video streaming strategy across social platforms in alignment with established KPIs and social media content management standards.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve any issues as they occur to ensure smooth execution in delivery.
  • Develop, publish, and optimize local article strategies supporting Content Strategy 3.0 on individual station websites using advanced content management systems and web content best practices
  • Advise MMJs and station teams on digital-first storytelling approaches, strengthening digital content creation, community connection, audience interaction, and social media content development
  • Use social media listening tools and audience data to identify emerging story opportunities, evaluate user generated content (UGC), and recommend content approaches to station teams
  • Evaluate and apply AI and automation tools to support workflow improvements, process efficiencies, and daily digital content creation, including identifying repeatable practices that may benefit station teams
  • Analyze Parsely real-time data and website analytics to identify performance barriers, recognize trends, develop recommendations, and make content optimization decisions that support O&O results.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

Content Creation & Publishing

  • Digital Content Creation
  • Web Content Management
  • Content Optimization
  • Content Strategy

Social Media & Platform Expertise

  • Social Media Management
  • Social Media Content Development
  • Live Video Streaming
  • Media Platforms

Visual & Video Production

  • Image Editing
  • Motion Graphics
  • Analytics & Tools
  • Website Analytics
  • Digital Analytics
  • Social Network Analysis (SNA)
  • Process Efficiencies

Storytelling & Journalism Support

  • Storytelling
  • Digital Media

job.title: Traffic Copy Editor - Remote
job.description:
We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment. Join the Scripps team as a Traffic Copy Editor, where you'll play an important role in ensuring advertising campaigns are scheduled accurately and commercial content is ready for air.

In this full-time position, you’ll partner closely with account executives, sales management, clients and advertising agencies while supporting the day-to-day traffic operation.


This is a remote position; however, candidates must be located within the Eastern Time Zone and able to work a schedule aligned with Eastern Time business hours.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Secure and enter advertising traffic instructions for advertisers.
  • Enter and maintain commercial copy information using ad management and traffic software.
  • Maintain traffic instruction files, commercial copy libraries and other traffic-related records.
  • Work closely with account executives, sales management, clients and advertising agencies to ensure advertising instructions are accurate and complete.
  • Serve as a backup to the Traffic Log Editor as needed, ensuring commercial inventory is scheduled in the appropriate time slots and the engineering team has the information required for broadcast.
  • Help resolve traffic, scheduling and commercial copy issues while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum of 1 year of related experience preferred.
  • Previous broadcast experience, particularly experience with ad management or broadcast traffic systems such as WideOrbit or OSI, is preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
  • Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with account executives, sales teams, clients, agencies and other internal partners.
  • A team-oriented mindset and demonstrated ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Standard office environment.
  • Limited overtime may be required to provide coverage during vacations and holidays.

job.title: VP, Revenue Operations
job.description:
Are you a transformative leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, technology, and operational excellence? Scripps is seeking a VP, Revenue Operations to provide strategic direction for enterprise revenue delivery and operations capabilities serving its Local Media and Scripps Networks revenue teams. In this high-impact role, you will develop and execute a long-term vision that elevates revenue performance, sales productivity, and customer experience — while leading the evolution toward a future-state operating model built on workflow simplification, automation, technology optimization, and clear accountability. As a trusted cross-functional partner to Sales, Finance, Technology, Product, and Operations leaders, you will build scalable capabilities, establish consistent enterprise practices, and develop high-performing teams that deliver timely, accurate, compliant, and impactful results across the business.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Develop and execute the enterprise Revenue Delivery and Operations strategy in support of revenue growth across Local Media and Scripps Networks.
  • Assess current-state work and design future-state operating models that simplify processes, clarify roles and decision rights, improve efficiency, and scale with the business.
  • Lead enterprise transformation through process redesign, automation, technology modernization, standardization, change management, and the adoption of new ways of working.
  • Establish service expectations, key performance indicators, quality standards, escalation paths, operating controls, and governance practices that strengthen accountability, safeguard revenue integrity, reduce risk, and support compliance.
  • Build a culture of operational excellence centered on customer service, accuracy, responsiveness, efficiency, ownership, and measurable continuous improvement.
  • Partner with senior Sales leaders and cross-functional teams to align priorities, remove barriers affecting seller productivity and the advertiser experience, and deliver enterprise initiatives.
  • Set business priorities for revenue operations technology and work with Technology and Product teams to translate requirements into scalable workflow, data, reporting, and automation solutions.
  • Use operational analytics and performance reporting to identify root causes, prioritize improvements, manage risk, support business decisions, and inform enterprise operating standards.
  • Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing organization with clear expectations, strong leadership capability, succession plans, and readiness for change.
  • Ensure operational readiness for new products, revenue streams, partnerships, sales motions, and go-to-market strategies while bringing forward relevant industry practices and emerging capabilities that enable future growth.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in a related discipline preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Generally, 10+ years of progressive experience in revenue operations, sales operations, business operations, advertising operations, shared services, or a related field
  • Prior managerial experience preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Significant leadership and team development capability within complex, cross-functional organizations
  • Proven ability to assess current-state operations and design and implement future-state operating models that improve efficiency, service, scalability, controls, and business outcomes
  • Expertise in revenue operations technology, including WideOrbit
  • Comprehensive knowledge of advertising sales operations, order management, traffic and inventory, campaign execution, revenue delivery, support processes, and related controls
  • Expertise in process redesign, automation, technology modernization, and organizational change
  • Knowledge of the media or advertising industry preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute enterprise operating strategies that support revenue growth and business transformation, balancing enterprise vision, business-specific needs, and day-to-day execution
  • Proven ability to evaluate complex work, define a compelling future state, and translate strategy into practical operating models, processes, roles, measures, and disciplined execution
  • Expertise in process improvement, workflow optimization, automation, operating model design, organizational effectiveness, and change leadership
  • Strong business and operational acumen, with the ability to quickly learn revenue workflows, technology ecosystems, customer needs, and control requirements and apply that understanding to business decisions
  • Working knowledge of internal controls, compliance, risk management, audit readiness, governance, service expectations, quality programs, and continuous improvement practices within a revenue-generating organization
  • Exceptional communication, collaboration, stakeholder management, and executive presence, with the ability to explain complex operational and technology topics, influence across boundaries, and build trust at all levels
  • Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives, manage competing priorities, create alignment, and deliver results through others
  • Strong analytical, financial, and problem-solving capabilities, with a data-driven approach to establishing performance measures, identifying root causes, prioritizing improvements, and making decisions
  • Demonstrated success building and developing high-performing teams through ambiguity, change, and growth, with an inclusive and accountable leadership style that sets clear direction, develops others, invites diverse perspectives, and creates ownership for outcomes

job.title: Client Coordinator
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About the Role

The Client Coordinator sits within Semafor’s Revenue Operations team and plays a central role in supporting sales, client partnerships, and integrated program delivery.

This role is the connective tissue between Sales, Marketing, Program Management, Events, and Ad Operations. The Client Coordinator supports the execution of integrated media programs by partnering with Sales and cross-functional teams to translate client goals into proposals and ensure seamless delivery across pre-sale functions. This role plays a critical part in maintaining organized workflows, clear communication, and a high-quality client experience across Semafor’s media and events portfolio.

This is an ideal role for a highly organized, detail-oriented individual who is excited to learn the media business end-to-end and grow into sales, client strategy, or revenue operations over time.

Key Responsibilities

Media Planning, Pre-Sale Strategy & Sales Support

  • Partner with Sales to support the development of integrated media programs and media plans across newsletters, digital products, custom content, and events.
  • Support pricing inputs, packaging, deal revisions, and rate guidance within established yield and inventory frameworks.
  • Coordinate proposal kick-offs, deal brief creation, internal feasibility checks, cross-functional inputs, and timeline management 
  • Support RFP responses and the creation of polished, visually engaging proposal decks.
  • Prepare for client meetings by compiling research, agendas, and supporting materials; capture notes and draft follow-ups to ensure clear next steps and accountability.

Client Communication & Relationship Support

  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for client coordination, ensuring timely communication and follow-through.
  • Build familiarity with client priorities, sensitivities, and goals to anticipate needs.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure clarity on scope, deliverables, and timelines.

Post-Sale Transition & Program Coordination

  • Support smooth transitions from pre-sale into execution.
  • Maintain client-facing timelines and deliverable trackers.
  • Coordinate campaign launches across newsletters and digital media.
  • Support asset collection, ad specifications, proofs, and confirms in partnership with Ad Ops and Editorial.

Campaign Support, Performance & Optimization

  • Assist with mid-campaign check-ins and performance updates, including basic metric review and insight generation.
  • Help identify potential optimization, added-value, or upsell opportunities in collaboration with Sales.
  • Ensure a consistently high bar for client experience throughout the lifecycle of the program.

Revenue Operations & Internal Coordination

  • Maintain accurate documentation and updates in our CRM (boostr) and workflow tools.
  • Ensure opportunities, products, budgets, and deal details are up to date and accurate.
  • Support maintenance of rate cards, packaging menus, and go-to-market materials.
  • Contribute to process improvements that strengthen pre-sale workflows and cross-functional alignment.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • 2–4 years of experience in media, advertising, communications, client services, account coordination, or related commercial role. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Media, or a related field.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, judgement, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with comfort interacting with clients.
  • Ability to synthesize concepts into actionable next steps.
  • Interest in media planning, integrated programs, and the business of journalism.
  • Ability to operate calmly under pressure and adapt in fast-moving environments.
  • Comfortable managing a high volume of fast-moving work and shifting priorities
  • High ethical standards and respect for diverse perspectives.
  • Comfort managing administrative details, timelines, and a T&E budget responsibly.
  • Boostr experience is a plus.

Additional Job Details

This position is based in New York, NY.

Comprehensive employee benefits: unlimited PTO, medical, dental, vision, short & long-term disability, flexible spending, health savings accounts, life insurance, 401(k), pre-Tax commuter benefits.

Salary Range: Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, etc. Base: $65,000 - $72,000 per year.

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

Semafor, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and enthusiastically encourages people from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. Semafor, Inc. will consider all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Reporting to the Head of Partnerships Management, the Director will own the strategic relationship for an assigned portfolio of clients. You will build trusted relationships with senior executives, understand their business priorities, and ensure Semafor's partnerships deliver meaningful value.

  • Develop tailored account strategies aligned with each client's business objectives, and lead executive-level conversations and planning sessions.

Partnership Strategy and Delivery Leadership

  • Own accountability for delivering contracted partnerships to Semafor's quality standards.
  • Partner with Sales in late-stage deals and lead kickoffs that set objectives, expectations, and success measures.
  • Provide strategic leadership across integrated programs spanning live events, executive convenings, digital advertising, custom content, podcasts, video, and research.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Work with Project Managers to keep visibility into commitments, progress, and risks without duplicating day-to-day administration.
  • Resolve competing priorities with functional leaders and recommend improvements to the broader operating model.

Commercial Growth and Retention

  • Partner with Sales on retention, renewals, and expansion, identifying opportunities to deepen partnerships through additional Semafor offerings.
  • Lead post-program reviews, translate performance reporting into client insights, and make evidence-based recommendations for future investment.

Executive Engagement and Client Experience

  • Design executive engagement strategies that maximize the value of Semafor's global convenings, editorial platforms, and leadership communities.
  • Serve as a senior point of contact at major events and executive interactions, navigating sensitive requests with discretion and sound judgment.
  • Represent Semafor confidently and professionally while maintaining high standards for responsiveness and client satisfaction.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in program management, client services, or a related field within media, marketing, or editorial environments.
  • Experience working with global clients across the US, the Gulf, and beyond, with a deep understanding of and appreciation for cultural, business, and geopolitical dynamics. Experience with clients focused on B2B and B2G strategies is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, integrated projects involving multiple stakeholders and deliverables.
  • Experience managing large- and small-format events, digital advertising campaigns, podcasts, and marketing services.
  • Expertise in project management tools and methodologies, with a strong focus on operational efficiency.
  • Deep understanding of and respect for media, journalism, and the importance of editorial independence.

job.description:

As the Editorial Event Producer, you will work closely with Semafor’s Executive Editor and live journalism team to help produce our flagship global economic event. You will engage prospective guests, develop thoughtful programming recommendations, and manage multiple executive relationships with exceptional communication. The role requires the ability to speak fluently across industries and global economic issues, understand what makes an executive or policymaker compelling on stage, and connect their expertise to the broader editorial agenda.

You will take ownership of guest outreach and booking timelines, working proactively to move conversations forward and navigate complex organizations to reach the right people. You should be a resourceful, self-starting researcher who knows how to find information when it is not readily available, quickly get up to speed on unfamiliar companies, industries, and leaders. Throughout, you will bring strong editorial judgment, curiosity, creativity, and an entrepreneurial mindset to building a newsworthy, high-caliber program featuring some of the most influential leaders in business, government, technology, and finance.

Your Responsibilities 

  • Own outreach and booking for a portfolio of senior executives, government leaders and other high-profile prospective guests for Semafor’s flagship economic event.
  • Identify contacts and pursue outreach with persistence, creativity, and sound judgment across executive offices, communications teams, and other channels.
  • Own outreach pipelines, leading follow-ups and updates as needed to secure commitments..

  • Leverage the strongest verbal communication skills when communicating with executive teams and exhibit professionalism, warmth, responsiveness and attention to detail throughout the booking process.
  • Lead pre-event editorial calls with executive teams to discuss programming, surfacing the most compelling areas for conversation and detailed notes for moderators.
  • Develop a strong understanding of each individual executive, their company, industry, and areas of expertise, articulating how each will contribute meaningfully to the broader program.
  • Apply strong editorial and strategic judgment to assess the relevance and significance of prospective guests and make thoughtful programming recommendations.

What makes you qualified

  • A Bachelor's degree is required.
  • 7+ years in broadcast journalism, executive communications, event content or programming development, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex editorial programs across dozens of speakers and sessions.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills and proven ability to engage confidently with senior-level executives.
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication, including the ability to craft compelling invitations and executive briefs.
  • Strongest organizational and time-management skills, adept at juggling multiple relationship streams.
  • Knowledgeable about major business and economic trends, along with skills to translate them into mainstage moments and other convenings for executives, with assistance from the editorial team. 
  • An entrepreneurial drive grounded in an eagerness to learn and grow alongside the company as it continues to scale and evolve. 
  • Passion for the media industry and great journalism.

This position is remote, though candidates based in Washington, DC, or New York, NY are preferred. Candidates must be willing to work flexible hours.

job.title: Senior Digital Designer
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

Your Responsibilities:

  • Design how Semafor's journalism is presented across digital products, bringing rigorous typography, clear information hierarchy, and strong editorial layout to every story, newsletter, and feature.
  • Work with Product and Editorial to envision and design new news products and formats, exploring multiple visual and structural approaches while keeping readability and usability top of mind.
  • Partner closely with Editorial, Product, and Engineering to design and launch elegant, technically feasible solutions, from story templates to special editorial packages.
  • Hold a high bar for the Semafor reading experience, ensuring our products feel cohesive, considered, and unmistakably ours.
  • Own and evolve typographic standards within Semafor's design system and brand guidelines; ensure visual consistency across platforms and teams globally.
  • Support Marketing and Audience teams in creating brand materials that align with Semafor's digital products.
  • Collaborate with freelancers and other designers, offering critique and feedback that keeps design output consistently high quality.
  • Help build a collaborative, productive design culture as a member of Semafor's design team.
  • Bring a strong point of view on how other news and media brands design for readers: what they do well, where they fall short, and how Semafor can break through.

What Makes You Qualified

  • 5+ years of digital and visual design experience, ideally in media, publishing, or high-growth consumer companies.
  • Sophisticated design sensibilities, with deep command of typography, information hierarchy, grid, and layout.
  • Editorial design experience: you know how to make complex information clear, scannable, and compelling for readers.
  • A portfolio that shows typographic and editorial work alongside shipped digital products.
  • Ability to produce high-quality, production-ready designs with a high degree of independence.
  • Solid grounding in product and interaction design for web and mobile.
  • Experience working with, and ideally developing, design systems.
  • Enthusiasm for collaborating with engineers, editors, product managers, and business stakeholders.
  • Experience working on diverse teams with colleagues from many different backgrounds.
  • Comfort incorporating AI tools into your workflow while holding a strong point of view on craft and quality.
  • Experience in a start-up or fast-moving environment, with flexibility and a willingness to jump in wherever needed.
  • An entrepreneurial drive and an eagerness to learn and grow as the company scales.
  • Passion for the media industry and great journalism.
  • Willingness to work in person four days per week in New York and to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

The base salary for this position ranges from $130,000 - $170,000 per year. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including business needs, experience, level of responsibility, and qualifications.

Additional Job Details:

job.title: A&R Coordinator- Runner Music (West Hollywood)
job.description:
Runner is seeking an A&R Coordinator to play a key administrative and operational role within the A&R department. This position requires a proactive, resourceful individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can manage multiple priorities with discretion and professionalism. The ideal candidate is highly organized, adaptable, has a general understanding of the music business, and passionate about popular music.


What You Will Be Doing: 


  • Provide day-to-day administrative support to CCO + President of A+R.
  • Manage CCO’s calendars, schedule meetings, and coordinate internal and external appointments.
  • Prepare and submit expense reports.
  • Maintain DISCO and update all digital assets as well as coordinating information with Administrator.
  • Coordinate company logistics for internal and external events and meetings.
  • Compile weekly charts and other various internal documents.
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements (flights, hotels, transportation, etc.) and create detailed travel itineraries.
  • Manage last-minute schedule changes and troubleshoot travel issues.
  • Book recording studio and coordinate session logistics for the A&R team.
  • Liaise with producers, engineers, and artists regarding scheduling, ensure all session details are confirmed and properly communicated for the A&R team.
  • Maintain Runner studio calendars and track availability for the A&R team.
  • Keep the office running in sync by maintaining clean, organized, and well-stocked spaces.


What Makes You Qualified:


  • 1+ years of administrative or assistant experience (music industry experience preferred).
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with a strong operational mindset, high attention to detail, and an ability to effectively. prioritize work to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • A proactive problem solver who can anticipate team needs.
  • Proficiency in DISCO, Canva, Excel.
  • Professional demeanor and high level of confidentiality.
  • Passion for music and understanding of the A&R process.
  • Experience booking studios or coordinating creative sessions.
  • Ability to work flexible hours when needed.
  • Willingness to learn and develop in a dynamic and growing company.



This role will require you to commute to our West Hollywood office five days a week.

job.title: Customer Service Supervisor- SESAC (Nashville)
job.description:
SESAC is looking for a Customer Service Supervisor to join our Nashville team. The ideal candidate ensures customers receive accurate, timely and professional support by motivating, supporting and providing day-to-day management of a dedicated internal and external team of service representatives.


This role oversees daily team operations, tracks performance and service quality, and coaches representatives so they understand company policies and processes. The Supervisor also resolves escalated customer issues and finds ways to improve efficiency and the customer experience.



What You Will Be Doing:

  • Mentoring Customer Service Representatives by answering questions and providing ongoing training.
  • Addressing customer inquiries/concerns that have been escalated due to complexity and/or sensitivity.
  • Establishing team/department goals that help achieve efficiency and improve processes.
  • Monitoring team productivity metrics and developing solutions to barriers that impact overall efficiency.
  • Reviewing and responding to customer inquiries, questions, and concerns via all utilized communication channels; ensuring concerns are resolved in a timely and accurate manner; Processing customer payments and adjustments as needed.
  • Leading team onboarding and training for new hires.
  • Leading assigned projects that relate to system enhancements, improved processes, workflow, etc.
  • Gathering team feedback and working with leadership to implement process improvements that support increased efficiency and improve customer experience.
  • Managing the external call support partner relationship to ensure a seamless customer experience.
  • Special projects, as assigned.


What Makes You Qualified:

  • BA/BS or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years’ experience in a Customer Service role; supervisory experience preferred.
  • A proven ability to organize and prioritize projects and timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills and an ability to build strong professional relationships and work with differing personalities.
  • Competency working in a CRM and/or ERP system, in addition to being comfortable learning/implementing new systems/technologies.
  • Proven ability to think proactively and help develop solutions to business problems.
  • High attention to detail and ability to delivery accurate work in a fast-paced deadline driven environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and an ability to work independently and effectively prioritize workload.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills and a desire to learn and take on special projects.


This is a hybrid role that will require you to commute to our Nashville office a minimum of three days a week.

job.title: Label Services Coordinator- Music Services (Nashville)
job.description:
Music Services is hiring a Label Services Coordinator to join our team in Nashville, TN. In this role, you will manage the administrative aspects of music publishing as it relates to record labels to ensure accurate and timely royalties to artists, publishers, and songwriters.



What You Will Be Doing:


  • Importing and formatting large amounts of client data into a proprietary system.
  • Entering manual statements from vendors to process royalties for artists, publishers, and/or songwriters.
  • Reviewing whitesheets and contracts to apply accurate information during product setup.
  • Building and maintaining accurate and up-to-date records of songs, masters, and contracts in the royalty database.
  • Entering and updating song and master categories as well as artist and participant rates in the royalty database, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Applying expenses of various types to products and participants to track participant recoupments or advances on behalf of clients.


What Makes You Qualified:


  • 1+ Years of experience in music publishing, label administration, or data analysis.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite including Excel and Word.
  • Excellent organizational skills and an ability to manage competing priorities and meet established deadlines.
  • Attention to detail and proven ability to produce complete and accurate work.
  • Being able to work well independently or as part of a team.
  • A team-oriented attitude and willing to support team members when needed.



This is a hybrid role that will require you to commute to our Nashville office a minimum of three days a week.

job.title: Licensing Operations and Billing Specialist- SESAC (Nashville)
job.description:
SESAC is looking for a Licensing Operations and Billing Specialist to join our Nashville team. This role is key to ensuring the accuracy, efficiency and integrity of the day-to-day Licensing Administration operations and billing functions by managing end-to-end billing processes, maintaining accurate records, performing audits, resolving discrepancies and supporting operations workflows. 

The Licensing Operations and Billing Specialist also supports timely and accurate financial and operational reporting through data collection, analysis, report writing and process improvement.

 

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Responsible for managing the end-to-end billing process to ensure timely and accurate generation of invoices, validate that billings are booked to the correct markets, and adherence to company protocols/procedures.
  • Supports resolution of problematic billing by collaborating with the Operations and IT teams to identify and implement solutions. 
  • Contributes to projects aimed at improving billing processes and policies, ensuring continued compliance with internal procedures, license agreements, and external reporting requirements.
  • Runs reporting to assess actual vs. expected billings, investigate variances and shares findings with appropriate team members.
  • Works with the Billing, Licensing Administration and IT team on any billing related issues. 
  • Responsible for communicating/training/documenting any updated billing processes. 
  • Reviews negotiated contracts to ensure proper processing and supply needed details to finance.
  • Participates in testing of upgrades and/or enhancements to the billing systems/processes. 
  • Reviews, analyzes and audits billing information to ensure billings are complete and accurate. 
  • Monitor billing efforts to ensure adherence to company protocols and measure against goals. 
  • Performs audits of licensing processing to identify errors and inform additional team training that may be needed.
  • Supports requests for reporting and analysis received from external auditors
  • Supports revenue related inquiries and month end close process by addressing inquiries from the finance team related to variances between expected billing revenue vs actuals.
  • Utilizes understanding of licensing process, billing impacts and database structure to identify potential issues and recommend solutions to improve data integrity and licensing administration operations.
  • Builds, maintains, analyzes, and validates operational reports, queries, and dashboards to support accurate billing, review outstanding/diligent payments, ensure accuracy of data, etc.
  • Assists with Licensee/Process Audits as needed
  • Reviews current processes and procedures for effectiveness and makes recommendations for changes.
  • Other duties and special projects as assigned.

What Makes You Qualified:

  • 2+ years’ experience in a Licensing Specialist role.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. 
  • Oracle EBS and/or Salesforce experience is a plus. Comfortable working with and learning technologies.
  • Must have strong customer support orientation, professional demeanor, and ability to maintain confidential information. 
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to think proactively and help develop solutions to business problems.
  • Time management and organizational skills in deadline-oriented environment. 
  • High Attention to detail, proven accuracy of work, and positive attitude. 
  • Ability to learn and adapt to change. 
  • Works effectively as a collaborative team member by contributing to shared goals, supporting colleagues, and fostering a positive and cooperative team environment.


This is a hybrid role that will require you to commute to our Nashville office a minimum of three days a week.

job.title: Manager, Sales Agency Relations- SESAC (Nashville)
job.description:
SESAC is looking for a Manager, Sales Agency Relations to join our Nashville team. This role is responsible for ensuring external sales partners meet sales goals. By serving as the primary contact, this role provides training, ensures an understanding of company processes, policies and expectations, and identifies and resolves barriers that affect performance.

 

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Act as the primary liaison for external sales agencies and consultants, building strong working relationships that drive results.
  • Monitoring sales team performance and taking action to address gaps. 
  • Identifying and resolving obstacles that affect partner productivity and efficiency. Gathering partner feedback and working with leadership to implement improvements that grow sales.
  • Communicating process and policies clearly and consistently so partners stay aligned.
  • Training sales partners on policies, procedures and systems, including onboarding of new reps and ongoing education of existing reps.
  • Addressing prospective customer inquiries/concerns that have been escalated due to complexity and/or sensitivity.
  • Reviewing monthly commission reports for accuracy.
  • Reviewing and resolving issues related to external sales teams such as credit, duplicate accounts, fee factors, policy violations and customer assignments.
  • Special project, as assigned.

What Makes You Qualified:

  • BA/BS or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years in a Sales or Sales Management role
  • A proven ability to organize and prioritize project timelines.
  • Excellent communication skills and an ability to build strong professional relationships and work with differing personalities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including comfort working with sales metrics and commission data.
  • Understanding of the US Copyright Law as it pertains to licensing non-dramatic public performances of copyrighted music.
  • Competency in Oracle EBS and/or Salesforce, in addition to being comfortable learning/implementing new systems/technologies.
  • Proven ability to think proactively and help develop solutions to business problems.
  • High attention to detail and ability to deliver accurate work in a fast-paced deadline driven environment.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to make fair, consistent decisions.
  • Strong organizational skills and an ability to work independently and effectively prioritize workload.


This is a hybrid role that will require you to commute to our Nashville office a minimum of three days a week.

job.title: Ad Operations Coordinator, Podcasting Specialist
job.description:
Sinclair is seeking an Ad Operations Coordinator, Podcasting Specialist to join our team!

The Podcast Coordinator supports the planning, execution, and ongoing management of podcast sponsorship campaigns. This role serves as a central point of coordination between Sales, Production, Ad Operations, Campaign Management, and other internal partners to ensure all campaign elements are accurately set up, delivered, paced, and reported. 

 Key Responsibilities 

  • Help maintain podcast sales decks and supporting materials, including current social audience metrics (Sprout), O&O digital metrics, sponsorship offerings, and product details. 
  • Own ongoing podcast Media Kit upkeep, ensuring show pages, decks, marketing materials, and available sponsorship opportunities remain current and accurate. 
  • Assist Sales with Web IO entry and ensure required podcast fields, campaign details, deliverables, and supporting documentation are complete before submission. 
  • Support AOS order entry and billing setup, including verification of campaign details, revenue, flight dates, and sponsorship components. 
  • Serve as the primary JIRA ticket owner once a podcast campaign is submitted by Sales; monitor ticket progress, coordinate next steps, and ensure questions or blockers are resolved promptly. 
  • Schedule and facilitate campaign kickoff call with Sales, Production, Ad Operations, Campaign Management, talent/show teams, and other relevant stakeholders. 
  • Coordinate campaign execution across teams to ensure all sponsorship components—such as social, YouTube, audio, live show, podcast page, and O&O display placements—are assigned, launched, and delivered as sold. 
  • Maintain clear communication with internal stakeholders throughout the campaign lifecycle, escalating risks, missing assets, timeline concerns, or delivery issues as needed. 
  • Own the podcast reporting and pacing trackers, ensuring revenue, delivery, campaign status, upcoming deadlines, and sponsor-specific reporting needs are accurately maintained. 
  • Coordinate recurring reporting and pacing updates using available sources, including social, YouTube, audio, O&O digital, and other show-specific reporting platforms. 
  • Support post-campaign reporting and wrap-up by confirming all deliverables have been completed, and reporting has been distributed to the appropriate teams. 
  • Identify process gaps and recommend improvements that streamline podcast campaign submission, execution, reporting, and billing workflows. 

 

Skills & Qualifications Requirements 

  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines at once. 
  • Exceptional attention to detail and follow-through. 
  • Comfortable working across multiple platforms and systems, including Web IO, AOS, JIRA, reporting trackers, and presentation tools. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Ability to work cross-functionally, manage competing priorities, and proactively resolve issues. 
  • Experience: 1–3 years in ad operations, digital media, audio production, or a related coordination role. Familiarity with podcast production coordination a plus. 
  • Experience in digital advertising, media operations, podcasting, sponsorships, or campaign management preferred. 
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in communications, media, broadcasting, marketing, or a related field

job.title: Coordinator II, Human Resources
job.description:
WHAM-TV (Sinclair) looking for a dynamic Human Resources Coordinator who will be responsible for direct support and guidance in various functional areas of human resources for multiple TV stations under the general direction of Corporate Human Resources. Positive attitude, effective communication, follow-through, and attention to detail are must-have attributes for this position. Visits to other TV stations, including some occasional overnight travel will be required. 

This is a full-time, five-day, in-office position.

We're hard-working, we're award-winning, and we believe in the value of each and every member of our team.  

While no day will be exactly the same, you’ll be involved in a variety of HR functions, including but not limited to:

  • Provide responsive, professional HR support to employees and managers.
  • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of our people, work, and culture.
  • Support talent acquisition activities, including job postings, pre-screening, interview coordination, candidate communications, offer letter preparation, ATS updates, pre-employment steps, and FCC/EEO recruitment recordkeeping.
  • Ensure compliance with employment regulations, including FLSA, ADAA, EEO, and applicable state and local employment laws.
  • Interpret and apply company policies and procedures.
  • Coordinate onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring all required tasks are completed in the appropriate systems.
  • Maintain working knowledge of HR systems, including Oracle Cloud HRIS.
  • Support benefits administration, including employee education and communication, Open Enrollment, and audits as needed. 
  • Administer and track leaves of absence, including FMLA, NYDI, and NY PFL and other applicable state and local sick leave requirements; coordinate the reasonable accommodation process.
  • Assist Regional HR Manager and local leadership to address employee relations matters, including performance concerns, employee complaints, investigations, disciplinary actions, and policy interpretation.
  • Respond to unemployment claims, workers’ compensation claims, and employment verifications.
  • Maintain confidential electronic HR records and accurate employee data.
  • Support HR compliance, reporting, and audit activities, including required documentation and recordkeeping.
  • Assist in planning and coordinating team trainings, morale events, and activities.
  • Perform other related duties and HR initiatives as assigned.

 

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • 3+ years of Human Resources experience, including experience in recruitment workflows, ATS, and NY leave administration required.
  • Broadcast or related media experience is preferred.
  • Ability to collaborate with a team while independently managing time, priorities, and projects.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, TEAMS and Word.
  • Previous HRIS experience required, Oracle HRIS or other cloud-based platform experience is a plus.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and proactively with employees at all levels in person, by phone, on camera, and in writing.

  • Positive attitude and strong commitment to executing job responsibilities.

job.title: Customer Service Manager
job.description:
Are you ready to help customers get clear, timely answers and a dependable support experience? In this fast-paced role, you will guide digital support requests from intake through resolution, helping stations and sales teams get the information they need to keep campaigns moving.

The Customer Support Manager is a part of a team that manages inquiries through the Digital Helpdesk and responds to questions about programmatic delivery, campaign setup, access, products, and performance. The team uses a ticketing system to organize and prioritize work, investigate issues, coordinate with internal teams and vendors, and keep customers informed until each request is resolved.

We value thoughtful communication, accountability, and a strong focus on service quality. If you enjoy solving problems and making support easier for customers, this role offers a meaningful way to contribute to our digital media work.

Customer Support Duties:

  • Manage customer inquiries in the Helpdesk ticketing system from intake through resolution, organizing, prioritizing, and tracking each request.
  • Respond promptly to customer questions and issues, keep requests moving, and resolve them within agreed-upon time frames and service-level expectations.
  • Answer questions about programmatic delivery, campaign setup, product access, and performance in clear language customers can understand.
  • Review ticket history, order details, campaign setup, pacing, and available reporting to investigate issues and identify next steps.
  • Resolve requests directly when appropriate and coordinate escalations to Ad Operations, Analytics, Technical Account Support, Product, Engineering, or vendors when additional expertise is needed.
  • Provide clear status updates, explain next steps, and maintain professional communication with customers and internal partners throughout the resolution process.
  • Maintain accurate ticket notes, supporting details, customer communications, and resolution steps so each request has a clear record and can be followed through to closure.
  • Become an expert in the ticketing system and use its features to manage, monitor, and resolve customer inquiries effectively.
  • Meet or exceed established service-level agreements and other service measures for response, resolution, and ticket quality.

 

Role Requirements

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain information in a customer-friendly way.
  • Strong reading comprehension, active listening, and problem-solving skills.
  • Good organization, attention to detail, and reliable follow-through on open requests.
  • Able to prioritize competing requests and work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, hybrid environment.
  • Able to stay calm, professional, and helpful when responding to customer questions or concerns.
  • Commitment to meeting service-level agreements, response and resolution time frames, and quality standards.
  • Willing to learn, receive feedback, and adapt to changing products, systems, and priorities.
  • Customer service, helpdesk, or digital advertising experience preferred.
  • Experience with Jira or another ticketing system is a plus; able to learn ticket workflows and system features in depth.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel, or similar tools.
  • Knowledge of programmatic advertising, digital campaign delivery, or ad operations is a plus.
  • Candidates must be available during regular US business hours, including Pacific Standard Time as needed 

 

Qualifications

  • College Degree
  • 2+ years job experience ideally in the digital industry

 

The hourly compensation range for this role is $20.43 to $24.03. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. job.title: Digital Content Producer
job.description:
WJAR, Southern New England’s News Leader, is seeking a full-time Digital Content Producer! The successful candidate will be responsible for crafting engaging content and social media posts that will drive audience engagement and help bolster WJAR’s digital presence. This position will consistently look for and create a diverse range of web content from a variety of sources. This position will also work closely with the Digital Executive Producer, News Director, Assistant News Director, and Creative Services Director.

Responsibilities and Requirements:

  • Must have their pulse on the 24/7 news environment
  • Must be extremely proficient with the use of multiple video-sharing and social media platforms including YouTube, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and TikTok
  • Creative in cross-promotions between on-air and online
  • Solid news judgment
  • Be a compelling and accurate writer
  • Must be proficient in AP Style
  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment
  • Must have strong leadership and communication skills
  • Ability to execute news strategies and goals in daily digital production
  • Flexibility and on-the-spot problems solving abilities are a must
  • Proficiency with non-linear editing (i.e. Avid) and newsroom systems, such as iNews is a plus
  • May be asked to help on the assignment desk as needed
  • Willing to work weekends, overnights, and holidays

 

When applying online, please include a recent web link to your work.

job.title: Digital Content Producer
job.description:
The Digital Content Producer is responsible for producing, publishing, and managing timely, accurate, and engaging content across the station’s digital platforms, including the website, social media channels, mobile apps, YouTube, and email communications.

This role actively monitors breaking news, gathers information from official sources, and creates digital-first content that keeps audiences informed in real time. The Digital Content Producer collaborates with News, Sales, Promotions, and Station Management to ensure consistent messaging, audience engagement, and strong digital storytelling while maintaining journalistic integrity and brand standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Write, edit, and publish news stories and multimedia content for the station website and digital platforms.
  • Manage and maintain all station social media platforms, including posting content, monitoring engagement, and responding to audience interaction when appropriate.
  • Monitor breaking news and developing stories, gathering information from official sources and public officials when necessary.
  • Conduct phone calls and outreach to law enforcement, public information officers, and other officials to confirm details and obtain updates on developing stories.
  • Create and publish digital-first content across multiple platforms, including social media, YouTube, mobile apps, and newsletters.
  • Review and edit reporter scripts, video, and multimedia assets for digital publication, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and adherence to journalistic standards.
  • Update digital platforms throughout the day with breaking news, live updates, and timely information to keep audiences informed.
  • Coordinate and execute digital promotions and contests in partnership with Sales, News, and Promotions teams.
  • Maintain consistent brand voice and visual standards across all digital platforms.
  • Track digital engagement and content performance metrics as directed by management.
  • Communicate closely with newsroom staff and management to support daily news coverage and digital initiatives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.

 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience in digital journalism, news production, or multimedia content creation preferred.
  • Strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Experience managing social media platforms and creating platform-specific content.
  • Familiarity with content management systems (CMS), social media tools, and basic video editing.
  • Ability to work quickly and effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven news environment.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across multiple departments.
  • Demonstrated commitment to journalistic ethics, accuracy, and responsible reporting.

 

Physical Requirements / ADA Compliance

  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while working at a computer.
  • Capable of occasional lifting or moving of light equipment (up to 20 lbs).
  • Visual acuity sufficient to work with computer screens and multimedia content.

  • Ability to work flexible hours, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays as news coverage requires.

job.title: Director, Sales and Marketing
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

o Help Us Thrive: You'll be at the forefront of our efforts to amplify our sales and marketing strategy. Your main mission will be to amplify our market presence while ensuring we hit our ambitious sales targets. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!


o Results-Driven: Amplify our media sales efforts by leading the sales team to implement local sales and marketing strategies to attract, grow and retain business, showcase opportunities and deliver results across our multi-media content platforms and digital assets.


o Strategic Planning: You'll develop and implement innovative sales and marketing strategies that will amplify our sales performance. You'll be the mastermind behind tactics that not only meet but exceed our sales goals.


o Team Development:  Leading, mentoring, and inspiring a team of sales professionals is no small feat! Your ability to motivate and enhance their skills will be crucial in driving performance and achieving success together.


o Market Analysis: Dive deep into market trends, data, and customer needs. By understanding what drives our clients, you'll identify new opportunities for expansion and growth, ensuring we stay ahead of the competition.


o Authentic Relationships: Building strong, lasting relationships with key clients and stakeholders is crucial. You'll be the driving force behind our brand, amplifying customer satisfaction and loyalty through excellent service.


What We're Looking For 

o Proven Sales Ability: We're looking for someone with experience as a Sales Director or other sales management and leadership roles, ideally in a media-related industry. We value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 


o High-Impact: A passion for achieving sales goals, amplifying growth and a results-driven mindset will set you apart. We want someone who's excited to push boundaries in a digital first environment and make an impact.


o Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical skills to assess market data and trends. Your insights will help guide our sales and marketing strategies.


o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships, negotiating and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 


o A Passion for Leading Others: You should be able to inspire your team, amplify their strengths while guiding them toward our collective goals, foster a collaborative environment and make a difference.


o A Willingness to Grow:  Do you thrive in unified environments? The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.


The Practical Stuff 

o A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 


Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a bold team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.


o The Compensation Package: Enjoy competitive base salary with an enticing results-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.


o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)


o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.


AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.   

  

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY

job.title: Drive Auto Account Manager
job.description:
AMP is seeking an accomplished, proactive, and strategically minded Drive Auto Account Manager to join our automotive Account Management team. This role serves as a knowledgeable digital marketing resource and strategic partner to local sales teams and automotive advertisers, with a particular focus on the highly competitive Tier 3 automotive dealership market.

The ideal candidate combines strong digital advertising knowledge, analytical thinking, and communication skills with a proven ability to build and maintain client relationships. This individual will leverage performance data, industry expertise, and strategic insights to help automotive advertisers achieve their business objectives while identifying opportunities for continued growth.

As a key partner in the post-sale client relationship, the Drive Auto Account Manager will proactively oversee advertising performance, collaborate with internal teams to address challenges, and deliver analysis and recommendations that support client retention and long-term success. Success in this role requires someone who takes ownership, works independently, and builds trust through strong communication and follow-through.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Manage assigned automotive advertiser relationships, identify potential risks, and build strong partnerships with local markets and clients to support long-term retention.
  • Partner with local sales teams, automotive advertisers, and internal stakeholders to evaluate marketing strategies, identify optimization opportunities, and keep advertising programs aligned with client objectives.
  • Proactively monitor campaign pacing, performance, and overall account health. Identify trends, investigate concerns, and recommend adjustments that support advertiser goals.
  • Prepare and lead Business Reviews that go beyond campaign metrics to explain performance, identify contributing factors, connect results to dealership business objectives, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Investigate campaign concerns, coordinate solutions with internal teams, and maintain ownership and follow-through to ensure issues are resolved.
  • Maintain clear, proactive communication with clients and local markets, providing timely updates, setting expectations, and strengthening relationships.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing advertiser relationships through strategic recommendations, additional digital advertising products, and investment opportunities aligned with client objectives.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of digital advertising products, dealership operations, consumer behavior, and industry trends to support informed recommendations.
  • Work closely with Media, Technology, Operations, and other internal teams to coordinate campaign needs and support successful execution.
  • Maintain accurate account information, manage competing priorities, track outstanding responsibilities, and ensure appropriate documentation and timely follow-through.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned in support of the Account Management team and organizational objectives.

 

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in digital account management, client success, digital marketing, or a related client-facing role.
  • Strong understanding of digital advertising products, campaign performance, and common marketing KPIs.
  • Demonstrated experience building, maintaining, and strengthening client relationships.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to interpret data and develop meaningful recommendations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and confidently.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple accounts, deadlines, and competing priorities.
  • Proven ability to independently investigate concerns, solve problems, and coordinate solutions across teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in digital advertising, account management, or client success.
  • Experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, YouTube advertising, and Connected TV (CTV/OTT).
  • Familiarity with Tier 3 automotive advertising, dealership operations, inventory management, lead generation, and key dealership business drivers.
  • Experience analyzing multi-channel advertising performance and connecting marketing results to business objectives.
  • Familiarity with marketing technology (MarTech), attribution platforms, CRM systems, and digital reporting dashboards.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Jira, or similar account-management and workflow systems.
  • Experience presenting campaign performance, leading client meetings, and developing strategic recommendations.
