job.title: Editor, Criminally Obsessed
job.description:
About Criminally Obsessed

Criminally Obsessed is Sinclair’s true crime media brand, and it is focused on the cases, investigations and stories that capture the public’s attention. Criminally Obsessed brings together compelling crime news and journalism, expert analysis, exclusive interviews and original storytelling and content across digital platforms.

The Criminally Obsessed Daily Show is a daily crime news and analysis program covering the biggest and most compelling criminal stories making headlines across the country. It goes beyond simply recapping the day’s news. Each episode is built around the most interesting development, question, detail or perspective surrounding a case and is led by an interview that drives the conversation. It is a vodcast and podcast, so the production team constructs each episode keeping in mind that the audience will need to be interested visually and audibly. 

About Sinclair

Sinclair is one of the largest media companies in the United States, with an extensive portfolio in digital media, national programming, local television, news, sports, and entertainment. Sinclair’s portfolio is an asset to Criminally Obsessed, with nearly 30 years of archival content, reporters and photographers on the ground, on the scene and in court. 

Sinclair’s strength is in its wide reach combined with its deep connection to local audiences and journalism. The company continues to expand its digital footprint andcontinues to develop content designed for a multiplatform audience.

About the role

Criminally Obsessed is looking for a talented and creative Editor to join the production team behind the daily show. This is more than a technical editing position. We are lookingfor someone who understands storytelling, pacing, visual language and YouTube audience retention – someone who knows how to turn raw material into a compelling piece of content that makes people want to click, watch and keep watching. 

The Editor for Criminally Obsessed is responsible for the editorial preparation, production, post-production, and delivery of daily and episodic content. This role works closely with the Producer, Senior Producer, Production Assistant, the host, and guests to ensure content is accurate, compelling, visually engaging, technically sound, and delivered on deadline.

The Editor is expected to have a strong understanding of true-crime news, storytelling, editorial standards, broadcast and digital production workflows, and the technical requirements necessary to deliver polished content across multiple platforms. The position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound editorial judgment, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced production environment. 

We are particularly interested in candidates who understand the unique demands of YouTube as a viewing platform and can bring a digital-first approach to editing, with an eye toward creating content that captures attention, sustains viewer interest, and encourages audiences to keep watching. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Attend Content Strategy Sessions to pitch and produce original social-first true crime content
  • Collaborate with assigned producers and talent to research and gather all necessary creative materials for approved projects
  • Work independently to assemble and edit assigned content through all stages of post-production and the review process
  • Utilize the full Adobe Creative Suite and other design tools to create motion graphics, to deliver high-quality content
  • Design social graphics including thumbnails that maintain brand guidelines
  • Make informed editorial decisions around content, episode length, and metadata, optimizing show for maximum audience growth
  • Advise on workflows to ensure production efficiency; educate both internal and external teams on best practices
  • Keep up with latest trends, software updates, and platform changes to help drive innovative ways to create new content

CORE RESPONSIBILITIESPRE-PRODUCTION

  • Once a topic or editorial angle for the Daily Show has been selected, thoroughly familiarize yourself with the case and the planned story.
  • Develop a working knowledge of the key people, locations, timeline, events, and relevant facts associated with each case. 
  • Review and become familiar with all available editorial, archival, photographic,video, audio, and other media assets.
  • Gather, organize, label, and prepare assets for efficient use during the editing process.
  • Research and obtain appropriate guest information, including names, backgrounds, photographs, video, and information required for lower thirds and other on-screen graphics.
  • Review interview shots and technical setup prior to recording to ensure appropriate framing, lighting, video quality, and audio quality.
  • Be available during recordings to identify and troubleshoot technical or visual issues as they arise.
  • Review raw recordings and correct or flag audio, video, or other technical issues to ensure the highest possible quality before editing.

PRODUCTION / EDITING

  • Edit Producer-created papercuts/scripts, A-roll, and other editorial materials into a polished and cohesive Daily Show segment.
  • Review and incorporate media gathered by the Editor, Senior Producer, Producer, or Associate Producer and identified in the papercut.
  • Select and appropriately place B-roll and supporting visual elements to complement the narration, interviews, and editorial beats of each story.
  • Maintain strong visual storytelling throughout each segment, using appropriatepacing, imagery, graphics, sound, and transitions.
  • Proactively communicate with the Producer and Senior Producer regarding editorial changes, creative opportunities, or potential improvements to the visual presentation, audio quality, pacing, and overall flow of the Daily Show.
  • Create and incorporate graphics for the Daily Show, including fullscreens,dates/courtesies, lower thirds, and other required on-screen elements.
  • Ensure graphics, captions, names, dates, and other editorial information areaccurate and consistent with established production standards.
  • Deliver a clean, polished first pass to the Producer/Senior Producer for review.
  • Implement notes, corrections, and editorial changes efficiently and accurately through subsequent edit passes.
  • Maintain appropriate legal courtesies and source attribution for non-Sinclair content in accordance with established standards and requirements.
  • Complete final edits and deliver finished episodes including accurate time codes for designated advertising breaks.
  • Meet established production deadlines while maintaining a high standard of editorial and technical quality.
     

POST-PRODUCTION

  • Archive and properly organize all content and media assets used in each episode in accordance with established file management and archival procedures.
  • Edit and deliver episodes for a digital broadcast tv network
  • Prepare and edit content intended for broadcast on Sinclair news stations and upload completed materials to location.
  • Edit sales-related audio and video advertisements and promotional materials for sponsorships as assigned.
  • Ensure all final deliverables meet applicable technical specifications, formatting requirements, and deadlines.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Stay current on true-crime content creators, podcasts, news organizations, emerging stories, and relevant industry trends, and proactively contribute compelling content ideas during daily editorial meetings.
  • Maintain awareness of developing stories and potential editorial opportunities that may be relevant to Criminally Obsessed.
  • Collaborate effectively with Producers, Senior Producers, Associate Producers, and other members of the production team.
  • Communicate proactively regarding production challenges, scheduling concerns, technical issues, or potential delays.
  • Maintain organized project files, media, and editorial materials to support an efficient production workflow.
  • Perform other job-related duties and special projects as assigned by the manager.
  • Schedule and hours may flex based on business needs, production requirements, breaking news, or other editorial priorities. Occasional after-hours or weekend coverage may be required when warranted.
  • Travel approximately 10–20% as needed for conferences, training, on-site content coverage, or other business-related assignments.
  • Safely lift, carry, and maneuver equipment or production gear weighing up to 25 pounds, while following all applicable safety procedures and protocols.

PROFESSIONAL EXPECTATIONS

  • Demonstrate strong editorial judgment, attention to detail, and commitment to accuracy.
  • Consistently meet deadlines and communicate promptly when priorities or circumstances may affect delivery.
  • Maintain a collaborative, solution-oriented approach when working with the production team.
     
  • Exercise discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive, graphic, or confidential subject matter.
  • Follow all applicable company policies, editorial standards, legal requirements, technical specifications, and production procedures.
  • Take ownership of assigned projects from initial preparation through final deliveryand archival.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years hands-on experience in all aspects of video production and post production including shooting, lighting, sound recording & editing, and ability to operate and troubleshoot all associated equipment
  • Highly skilled across Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, Premiere Rush, Photoshop,After Effects, etc), and other creative software
  • Demonstrated experience editing content for an established YouTube channel, with an understanding of YouTube-specific storytelling, audience retention, pacing, and visual engagement.
  • Experience using YouTube performance metrics, including audience retention and watch time, to inform editing decisions and identify opportunities to improve viewer engagement and overall channel performance
  • Strong understanding of video editing techniques and storytelling
  • Demonstrated experience in motion graphics and creating social media video content
  • Strong knowledge of YouTube and its best practices
  • Proficiency in designing graphics, including thumbnails and infographics
  • An eye for quality content, with an understanding of what plays well across various channels
  • This position requires impeccable spelling and grammar, a deep understanding of social media trends and what works on each platform, vertical video editing skills, and the ability to capture well-composed videos on a phone
  • Must be highly motivated, extremely organized, and come to the position with a uniquely creative mind
  • Flexibility to travel and work nights and/or weekends, as projects call for
  • Only applicants with portfolios, sites, or reels of their work will be considered
     

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY:

job.title: General Assignment Reporter
job.description:
WLUK/WCWF is looking for a take-charge General Assignment Reporter to help us continue to grow and empower our audiences! No day will look the same as a reporter, however, the main responsibilities of the role will include:

job.title: Human Resources Generalist
job.description:
Sinclair is looking for an experienced Human Resources Generalist to join KABB and WOAI-TV in providing front-line, on-site, day-to-day HR support. The HR Generalist will also support our station in Corpus Christi, TX.

The HR Generalist provides on-site, practical, day-to-day guidance across each of the functional areas of human resources including recruiting, onboarding and offboarding, benefits, leaves of absence, employee relations, training, and performance management. The successful candidate brings three to five years of human resources experience in a fast-paced environment, along with sound judgment, clear communication, reliable follow-through, and strong attention to detail.
 

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with HR colleagues and station leaders to provide responsive, practical support to employees and managers across multiple stations, while building an understanding of each station’s people, operations, and culture.

  • Help ensure compliance with applicable employment laws and regulations, including FMLA, FLSA, workers’ compensation, ADA, and EEO requirements; interpret and apply company policies consistently and help managers understand their responsibilities.

  • Support employee relations matters, including being responsive to complaints and investigations in coordination with the Regional HR Manager.

  • Coordinate onboarding and offboarding actions, including preparing materials, presenting information, and collecting required documentation.

  • Support recruiting by posting openings, preparing offer letters, coordinating pre-employment requirements, maintaining accurate tracking records, communicating promptly with candidates, and helping ensure compliant hiring practices.

  • Support benefits administration by maintaining working knowledge of company plans, assisting with Open Enrollment communications and employee education, and participating in audits as needed.

  • Support performance management and review cycles, including compliance tracking, follow-up, and audits.

  • Administer leaves of absence in accordance with company policy, benefit plan requirements, and applicable federal, state and local laws.

  • Respond to unemployment, worker’s compensation claims and employment verification requests.

  • Maintain accurate, confidential electronic HR and personnel records, and handle sensitive employee information with discretion.

  • Help plan and coordinate employee training, morale events, and team activities, manage assigned HR projects and perform other related duties as needed.

  • This is an onsite position supporting our stations in San Antonio, Corpus Christi, with the potential to expand to additional Sinclair stations.

  • Some travel to assigned locations required.

     

 Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources or a related field.
  • Three to five years of human resources experience.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Strong interpersonal and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with employees and managers at all levels.
  • A positive, service-oriented approach and dependable follow-through on assigned work.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information and sensitive situations, including when under pressure and/or tight deadlines.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, the ability to manage competing priorities, and close attention to detail.
  • Oracle HRIS experience is a plus.

job.title: Investigative Journalist, Spotlight on Maryland
job.description:
Sinclair’s Spotlight on Maryland is looking for Investigative Journalists who are comfortable asking elected leaders and government officials smart, thought provoking, and tough questions. Spotlight on Maryland produces high impact and accountability stories for digital, social, print and television. These stories go beyond the basics of general reporting to expose a problem, hold government and elected leaders accountable for their actions and press for a solution. Our goal is to offer audiences on multiple platforms something meaningful that will have an impact on the communities we serve.   

The ideal candidate will have strong news judgment, be a compelling and fact-based writer, and be able to multitask. We are looking for someone with a clear understanding of how to dig for a story, research it, write it with a thought-provoking edge. Knowledge of the FOIA (Freedom of Information Act) process, computer-assisted reporting, and data-driven reporting is required along with familiarity of legal issues related to investigative news reporting. Strong writing skills and knowledge of current events is essential. Dynamic storytelling skills are a must.

This is a highly collaborative environment. The ability to work as part of a team is a must.

Essential Duties and Requirements include the following:

  • Develop and maintain contacts and sources in the community to enterprise story ideas
  • Identify and pitch investigative angles on big daily news stories
  • Work closely with local and corporate news leadership to refine investigative pitches and story scripts
  • Write online, print and broadcast versions of investigative reports and produce digital specific content for each investigation
  • The position is located on-site in Hunt Valley, MD*
  • Other duties as assigned

 

Qualifications- To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. 

  • Three (3) years of reporting/producing experience preferred
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field preferred
  • Must be a strong storyteller with the ability to make the complicated understandable
  • Must be able to use all available tools to enhance stories, from graphics to social media
  • Should be able to generate story ideas and determine the legitimacy of viewer tips
  • Strong writer, storyteller
  • Must be naturally inquisitive with an interest in holding government officials accountable

 

Please provide a link to examples of your work.

*This is an in-office role, 5 days a week at our Sinclair Headquarters located at 10706 Beaver Dam Road, Hunt Valley, MD 21030.

 Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: IT Engineer
job.description:
WCTI/WYDO has an excellent career opportunity for a full-time IT Engineer to support the Engineering Department on its daily computer and network operations. This position involves maintaining computers and servers related to television transmission and video automation systems, as well as business-side work stations. The candidate will be directly responsible for hands-on support of modern broadcast and IT equipment.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Provide support in the management of Servers, Network Security and Network Services
  • PC/Mac hardware/software support of on-site installing, servicing and repairing workstations
  • Provide support for the technical needs of the News Department
  • Assist with video equipment set-up and maintenance
  • Assist Engineering with Transmitter and Master Control maintenance
  • Assist with LAN and WAN related hardware and software maintenance
  • Develop knowledge of facility specific IT needs and assist in supporting these systems
  • Apply regular security updates
  • Perform physical inventory of equipment
  • Maintain digital telephone system

 

Requirements:

  • Associates degree or higher in IT, electronics or computer related field
  • 2 - 4 years of related broadcast experience
  • A great team-oriented attitude and dedication to quality
  • Strong familiarity with Microsoft, Mac and Linux operating systems
  • Knowledge and competency in core hardware and computer system technologies, including installation, configuration, diagnosing, preventive maintenance and LAN/WAN networking
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting problems and responding quickly under pressure
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Familiarity with Avid related software and hardware products a plus

 

Physical Demands/Work Environment:

  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule
  • On-call duty, including weekends and holidays
  • Ability to lift computers and equipment generally less than 50 pounds

 

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY:

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: IT Engineer
job.description:
KOMO is seeking a full-time IT Technician to join our Engineering Department and support the computer, network, and broadcast systems that keep our station operating around the clock.

This hands-on role supports a wide range of technology, including newsroom editing systems, television transmission equipment, broadcast automation, servers, and business workstations. If you enjoy solving technical problems, helping others, and learning how IT powers live television, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities

  • Provide responsive technical support to station staff and operational users.
  • Install, configure, troubleshoot, service, and repair PC and Mac workstations, hardware, and software.
  • Assist with server administration, network security, and network services.
  • Support the News Department’s daily technical needs, including newsroom and editing systems.
  • Install and maintain video equipment and assist with the installation and maintenance of master control systems.
  • Assist with LAN and WAN hardware and software maintenance.
  • Develop an understanding of broadcast-specific IT requirements and help support those systems.
  • Deploy regular security updates using Tanium.
  • Maintain accurate equipment inventory records.
  • Support the station’s Microsoft Teams telephone system.
  • Perform technical work and equipment installations in accordance with established engineering standards and practices.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Live Newscast Support

During assigned early morning, evening, and weekend newscasts, responsibilities may also include:

  • Coordinate live shots and interruptible foldback (IFB) audio routing using iNews and station routing systems.
  • Route, initialize, and record incoming feeds.
  • Perform quality-control checks to ensure feeds meet station requirements.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues affecting live news operations.

 

Work Schedule and Availability

This position is primarily scheduled for the day shift. Because KOMO operates 24 hours a day, seven days a week, candidates must be flexible and available to work early mornings, evenings, nights, and weekends as needed. Participation in a rotating on-call schedule is required to support station operations and respond to urgent technical issues outside scheduled work hours.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Associate degree in information technology, electronics, a computer-related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong familiarity with Microsoft Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems.
  • Basic knowledge of video systems and a willingness to learn broadcast technology.
  • Technical aptitude and the ability to complete training on station systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and a commitment to excellent customer service.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and complete projects with minimal supervision.
  • A collaborative, team-oriented approach and dedication to quality work.
  • Flexibility to meet the scheduling and on-call requirements of a 24/7 broadcast operation.

job.title: Lead Product Designer
job.description:
Tennis Channel is looking for a Lead Product Designer to help shape the future of our digital experiences across streaming (OTT), mobile, and web. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, craft, and execution. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and content teams to design industry-leading streaming applications that make tennis—and everything around it—more accessible to fans.

 

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys taking products from 0–1, brings strong design thinking to organizations ready for it, and loves solving complex, strategic problems through systems design. As an early hire in a growing product organization, you’ll help raise the bar for design quality, establish expectations of excellence, and influence how design shows up across the company. You’ll also learn how to take ideas from concept to production, help shift an organization toward a true product mindset, and grow through close 1:1 mentorship as part of a small, high-impact team.

 

We’re a team of tennis obsessives who care deeply about the sport and take pride in building great products together. We work hard, play hard, and genuinely enjoy collaborating with people who are curious, thoughtful, and passionate about what they do.

Tennis Channel operates multiple broadcast and digital platforms, including Tennis Channel, T2, Pickleball TV, and Tennis.com. While this role will focus on our dedicated OTT experiences, responsive web, and native mobile apps, you’ll be designing within a broader ecosystem that reaches fans wherever they watch and engage with the sport.

 

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Design end-to-end product experiences across OTT, mobile, and web — from early concepts and AI-assisted prototyping through high-fidelity execution

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineers to define problems, rapidly prototype and explore solutions using AI-powered tools, and ship high-quality work

  • Contribute to and help evolve the Tennis Channel design system, patterns, and accessibility standards

  • Evolve the brand look and feel across the digital ecosystem

  • Present work clearly to cross-functional partners and leadership, articulating design rationale and tradeoffs

  • Participate in critiques and feedback loops, both giving and receiving thoughtful, actionable feedback

  • Conduct or collaborate on research to incorporate insights, testing, and validation into your design process

  • Balance multiple projects and priorities while maintaining a high bar for craft and usability

  • Model strong design processes and collaboration practices within the team, embracing AI-powered tools to accelerate prototyping, experimentation, and iteration.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience as a product designer working on consumer-facing digital products

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work, including complex flows and systems

  • Experience designing for mobile and web; OTT/TV experience is a strong plus

  • Excellent visual, interaction, and systems design skills with strong attention to detail

  • Comfort working in Figma, including components, libraries, and design systems

  • Experience using AI-powered tools to rapidly prototype, explore interactions, and accelerate design iteration. 

  • Solid understanding of accessibility, usability, and inclusive design principles

  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and communicate clearly with non-design partners

  • Ability to think strategically while staying grounded in execution

  • Passion for sports, media, or entertainment products is a plus (tennis fans get bonus points)

  • Ability to work in person in Santa Monica three days per week

Tennis Channel is proud to be equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

About Tennis Channel

Tennis Channel is the only multiplatform destination dedicated solely to tennis year-round. Together, the Tennis Channel flagship network, Tennis Channel 2, and the Tennis Channel app (tennischannel.com) deliver the most accessible and concentrated single-sport coverage anywhere. As the exclusive U.S. home of the ATP Tour and WTA Tour, Tennis Channel features live coverage of every Masters 1000 tournament — including Indian Wells, the Miami Open, Madrid, Rome, Cincinnati, and more — alongside live studio programming including its premier series, TC Live. Tennis Channel 2, a free FAST channel available in over 100 million homes, brings fans matches from across the globe at every level of the game. The Tennis Channel app brings it all together in one place, delivering live and on-demand matches, original content, and a personalized multi-view experience for fans, available on mobile and connected TV devices. Owned by Sinclair, Tennis Channel is also a co-owner of PickleballTV (pickleballtv.com), a joint venture with the Professional Pickleball Association.

job.title: Manager, Sales and Marketing
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 
At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 
Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat.    Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 
o Help Us Thrive: You'll be at the forefront of our efforts to amplify our sales strategies and elevate our market presence. Your main mission will be to lead our sales team to new heights while fostering a culture of success and motivation. We believe that with the right guidance, our team can achieve remarkable results, and that's where you come in. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!
o Results-Driven: Amplify our media sales efforts by managing the sales team to implement local sales and marketing strategies to attract, grow and retain business, showcase opportunities and deliver results across our multi-media content platforms and digital assets.
o Strategic Planning: You'll develop and implement cutting edge sales and marketing plans that not only amplify our reach but also align with our company goals.
o Team Leadership:  Leading a team of sales professionals is no small feat! You'll mentor and inspire them to hit and exceed their targets while cultivating a collaborative environment.
o Market Analysis: Keeping an eye on market trends and customer needs is essential. You'll identify new opportunities for expansion and growth, ensuring we stay ahead of the competition.
o Authentic Relationships: Building strong, lasting relationships with key clients is crucial. You'll be the face of our brand, amplifying customer satisfaction and loyalty through excellent service.
o Dynamic Oversight: You'll track sales performance metrics and provide insightful reports to senior management, helping us make data-driven decisions.
What We're Looking For 
o Proven Sales Ability: We're looking for someone with experience in sales management or someone fully ready to take their next career step in sales leadership, ideally in a media-related industry. We value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 
o High-Impact: A passion for achieving sales goals and a results-driven mindset will set you apart. We want someone who's excited to push boundaries in a digital first environment and make an impact.
o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships, negotiating and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 
o A Passion for Leading Others: You should be able to inspire your team, amplify their strengths while guiding them toward our collective goals, and make a difference.
o A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in transformative environments? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.
The Practical Stuff 
o A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 
Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 
o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of an agile team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.
o The Compensation Package: Enjoy a competitive base salary with an enticing results-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.
o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)
o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.
AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.       EEO AND INCLUSIVITY  Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be inﬂuenced or aﬀected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Meteorologist
job.description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Meteorologist in Baltimore, MD. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of meteorology and its application in the context of local weather patterns and events. The Meteorologist will be responsible for providing accurate and timely weather forecasts, and effectively communicating weather-related information to our audience. Additionally, proficiency in managing and posting content across various social media platforms is crucial for this role. Other Responsibilities:
  • Develop and present comprehensive and detailed weather reports for various segments, ensuring clarity and accessibility for a diverse audience.
  • Monitor weather conditions, analyze data, and utilize state-of-the-art technology to provide timely and precise weather updates and alerts.
  • Collaborate with news producers, reporters, and other team members to integrate weather information seamlessly into news broadcasts and other programming.
  • Maintain a strong social media presence by regularly posting weather updates, forecasts, and relevant content across various platforms to engage and inform the community.
  • Develop and implement strategies to enhance the station's digital weather presence, including interactive weather maps, live streaming, and other innovative features.
  • Build and maintain relationships with local authorities, emergency management agencies, and community organizations to ensure effective communication during severe weather events and emergencies.
  • Participate in community outreach events, educational programs, and public speaking engagements to promote weather awareness and preparedness within the local community.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's or master's degree in meteorology, atmospheric science, or a related field.
  • 7-10 years of experience in a professional meteorology role, preferably in a broadcast environment.
  • Profound knowledge of meteorological tools and software, including weather radar systems, satellite imagery, and forecasting models.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with a demonstrated ability to present complex weather information in a clear and engaging manner.
  • Proven experience in managing and leveraging various social media platforms to disseminate weather information and engage with the audience effectively.
  • Ability to work under pressure and in a fast-paced environment, particularly during severe weather situations.
  • Familiarity with the Baltimore, MD, metropolitan area and its unique weather patterns is preferred.
 

If you are passionate about meteorology, possess strong leadership skills, and have a keen interest in leveraging social media for community engagement, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

The base salary compensation range for this role is $78,600 to $98,200.  Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, quarterly and annual incentive plan bonuses, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Meteorologist
job.description:
KATU News is seeking a creative, forward-thinking Evening Meteorologist to lead weather coverage across our broadcast and digital platforms. We're looking for more than a great forecaster. We want an innovative storyteller and newsroom leader who can help viewers prepare for what's ahead by tracking the "next big weathermaker" and explaining how changing conditions will impact their lives.

 

The ideal candidate combines strong forecasting skills with engaging, conversational storytelling and a willingness to experiment with new ways to reach audiences. This role requires someone who can take ownership of our evening weather coverage, develop original reporting, and help shape the future of local weather.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver accurate, engaging, and conversational weather forecasts during evening newscasts, with an emphasis on tracking the next big weathermaker and its potential impacts.
  • Take a leadership role in shaping the station's weather coverage and identifying opportunities for innovation.
  • Develop original, enterprise weather stories that go beyond the daily forecast to explain trends, impacts, and issues affecting our communities.
  • Create compelling, platform-specific content, including short-form videos, explainers, live streams, and interactive storytelling.
  • Experiment with emerging technology, new storytelling formats, and creative approaches to audience engagement.
  • Provide authoritative, calm, and timely coverage during breaking and severe weather, including live cut-ins and extended coverage.
  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership, producers, reporters, and digital teams to develop creative and impactful weather coverage.
  • Build strong connections with viewers through authentic storytelling, audience interaction, and community engagement.
  • Help establish KATU as a trusted, innovative source for weather information across the Portland DMA.
  • Represent the station professionally on-air, online, and at community events.

 

Qualifications

  • Degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong forecasting skills and a confident, conversational on-air presentation style.
  • Demonstrated creativity and a willingness to challenge traditional approaches to weather storytelling.
  • Experience or strong interest in developing original content for social media, streaming, and emerging platforms.
  • Strong leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to inspire new ideas and help bring them to life.
  • Ability to explain complex weather topics in clear, relatable, and audience-focused ways.
  • Comfortable experimenting, taking creative risks, and adapting to changing audience habits.
  • Ability to work effectively under deadline pressure and respond quickly during severe or breaking weather.
  • Commitment to Sinclair's core values and weather philosophy.

 

What We're Looking For

We want a meteorologist who sees opportunity beyond the forecast. Someone who is passionate about helping viewers understand what's coming next, asks "How can we tell this story differently?" and is willing to turn creative ideas into meaningful coverage.

If you're passionate about forecasting, energized by innovation, and ready to help shape the future of local weather coverage, we want to hear from you.

job.title: Morning Anchor/Reporter
job.description:
WCTI has an exciting opportunity for a full-time Morning News Anchor/Reporter. We are looking for a strong journalist who can lead morning newscasts with credibility, connect with viewers, and deliver meaningful stories across television, digital, social, and streaming platforms.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with excellent news judgment, a clear understanding of current events, and a passion for enterprise reporting. You should be able to dig for stories, conduct thorough research, write with clarity and edge, and use compelling storytelling and strong television production to make each story impactful and memorable. Dynamic live television and reporting skills are essential.

Responsibilities:

  • Anchor and help produce morning newscasts
  • Report, shoot, write, and edit news stories for broadcast, digital, social, and streaming platforms
  • Develop and pitch original, enterprise story ideas daily
  • Deliver live reports and breaking-news coverage as needed
  • Research, write, and present stories that are accurate, engaging, and relevant to the Eastern Carolina community
  • Maintain an active and professional social media presence to build your brand, promote stories, and connect with viewers
  • Collaborate with producers, photographers, assignment editors, and the newsroom team to deliver high-quality coverage
  • Perform other duties as assigned by news management


Qualifications & Skills:

  • Previous anchoring experience is required
  • At least one year of on-air reporting experience is required
  • Live-shot experience is required
  • Strong writing, verbal communication, and on-camera presentation skills
  • Demonstrated ability to enterprise stories and tell them creatively across platforms
  • Sound editorial judgment, strong research skills, and a commitment to journalistic ethics
  • Ability to work independently while contributing positively in a collaborative newsroom environment
  • A valid driver’s license and good driving record are required
  • A link to recent work or a demo reel is required
     

Why WCTI/WYDO?

At WCTI and WYDO, you'll tell stories that matter while serving communities across Eastern North Carolina. You'll gain hands-on experience covering everything from breaking news and severe weather to enterprise and community-focused reporting—all while working in a newsroom committed to developing the next generation of journalists.

While applying online, please include a link to your online demo reel

job.title: Production Manager, Remote & Studio
job.description:
Tennis Channel is seeking a Production Manager to plan and execute full-scale productions for live remote events and studio shows, both domestic and international. This role calls for a highly organized, proactive, and quick-thinking professional with strong communication and interpersonal skills. As a representative of Tennis Channel at events around the world, the Production Manager will maintain a professional appearance and demeanor and serve as an ambassador for the network on an international stage.

What You’ll Do

Remote Production

  • Serve as the primary liaison between production teams and a wide range of partners, including facility management, senior production staff, production and technical crews, talent, site operations, vendors, tournament directors, and other network representatives.
  • Coordinate facilities with host venues and broadcasters, including [V&A] bookings, office space, power, venue logistics, shipping, and transmission.
  • Supervise staffing needs for domestic and international remote productions and help source experienced crews for ATP Masters 1000 events.
  • Oversee the acquisition and distribution of production elements such as event footage, music and music cue sheets, graphics, and equipment.
  • Partner with the Travel and Finance teams to coordinate hotel accommodations.
  • Manage credentials, venue access, parking, catering, and crew scheduling.
  • Plan and track rental equipment, logistics, and shipping.

Studio Production

  • Help supervise studio coordination, staff, and facilities alongside the Production Coordinator.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between internal and external partners during world feed production.
  • Collaborate with production teams to ensure assigned productions meet the network’s creative and technical objectives.
  • Help train new hires in production department processes and procedures.

Across Remote and Studio

  • Create, maintain, and quality-check production books, call sheets, daily crew call times, schedules, trackers, and planning documents using Lasso and established Excel templates.
  • Partner with the Director of Finance and the Production Accountant to manage costs, coordinate crew and show requirements, and ensure timely processing of timecards and contracts/deal memos.

What You Bring

  • Preferred 5+ years of experience in production management or a related role in sports or entertainment production.
  • Proven ability to oversee complex remote productions, manage venue operations and logistics, and work closely with venue management and host broadcasters.
  • Strong ability to multitask and manage several productions from start to finish in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to adapt and thrive in constantly changing environments with unpredictable challenges and a wide range of personalities.
  • Enthusiasm for hands-on work and the resourcefulness to roll up your sleeves and make things happen.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Experience with Smartsheet preferred; familiarity with Lasso is a plus.

Schedule and Travel

  • Domestic and international travel averaging about 4 months per year, including Grand Slams and other tournaments as needed.
  • Willingness to work 50+ hours per week on a flexible schedule that includes days, nights, weekends, and holidays. The tennis season runs January through November, with the heaviest workload from May through September.

 

Tennis Channel is proud to be equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. About Tennis Channel
 

Tennis Channel is the only multiplatform destination dedicated solely to tennis year-round. Together, the Tennis Channel flagship network, Tennis Channel 2, and the Tennis Channel app (tennischannel.com) deliver the most accessible and concentrated single-sport coverage anywhere. As the exclusive U.S. home of the ATP Tour and WTA Tour, Tennis Channel features live coverage of every Masters 1000 tournament — including Indian Wells, the Miami Open, Madrid, Rome, Cincinnati, and more — alongside live studio programming including its premier series, TC Live. Tennis Channel 2, a free FAST channel available in over 100 million homes, brings fans matches from across the globe at every level of the game. The Tennis Channel app brings it all together in one place, delivering live and on-demand matches, original content, and a personalized multi-view experience for fans, available on mobile and connected TV devices. Owned by Sinclair, Tennis Channel is also a co-owner of PickleballTV (pickleballtv.com), a joint venture with the Professional Pickleball Association.

job.title: Project Baltimore Photojournalist
job.description:
Sinclair, Inc. is seeking an experienced photojournalist to join the award-winning Project Baltimore team. This special investigative reporting unit of WBFF Fox 45 News is one of the top investigative teams in the country. Project Baltimore produces regularly scheduled investigative reports on issues in the public education system. The team also produces documentaries, town halls, and program specials. We are looking for a team member who is eager to hone their craft and set industry-standards for impactful storytelling that combines research and data with human emotion. Must be able to shoot and edit character-driven stories with visual punctuation. The ideal candidate will be passionate about storytelling and skilled in creating cutting-edge graphics to help showcase documents and data.

This is a rare opportunity. Project Baltimore is a five-person team of motivated journalists, committed to digging deeper, holding officials accountable and being a voice for the voiceless. As a member of this team, you will be expected to share ideas and work well with others as part of the collaborative process.

Since its creation in 2017, Project Baltimore’s investigative work has been recognized with dozens of honors, including a National Emmy for Investigative Reporting, four prestigious IRE Awards, five first place National Headliner Awards, the SPJ Sigma Delta Chi Award, a National Press Photographers Association First Place award for best documentary. Additionally, Project Baltimore has been named an Alfred I. duPont finalist and has won 50 Regional Emmy Awards, 13 Regional Edward R. Murrow Awards and 11 Associated Press Awards.

Requirements:

  • At least five (5) years of television news photography and non-linear editing experience
  • Must be professional, organized, and responsible
  • Team-player with a good attitude and strong work ethic
  • Self-motivated to work on long-term projects
  • Ability to communicate effectively with team members and interview subjects
  • Ability to accept input and constructive criticism
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, especially After Effects and Premiere Pro
  • Experience with cine-style FX/alpha series Sony cameras is a plus
  • Part 107 Drone License is a plus

 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Associate
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

Start Inside. Grow Into Sales.

Ready to launch a career in sales? At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, you can build the skills, confidence, and media know-how to grow into a client-facing sales role.

You’ll start by learning the business from the inside: supporting our sales team, helping develop media marketing solutions, coordinating campaigns, and seeing how great ideas turn into results for clients. As you gain experience and demonstrate your strengths, you’ll have the opportunity to take on more responsibility and work toward a client-facing role.

We’re looking for a curious, motivated teammate who enjoys learning, communicating, and being part of a team that gets things done. You don’t need years of sales experience—just a strong work ethic, a positive attitude, and an interest in building a career.

If you’re graduating soon or recently earned your degree and want a real starting point in media sales, this could be your next step. Take a look at the checklist below. If it sounds like you, hit Apply Now and let’s talk about where this opportunity could take you.

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

o Help Us Thrive: Amplify our sales and marketing team efforts, by helping us to grow our customer base and enhance our brand presence in the market and providing day-to-day business support. This means helping them fulfill orders, manage accounts, craft proposals, create engaging presentations, and develop materials that clearly communicate the benefits of our services. Your creativity will play a huge role here in driving results. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!

 

o Campaign Development: Work with the sales and marketing team to design and implement campaigns that drive sales and amplify brand awareness across various multimedia platforms.

 

o Market Research: Conduct in-depth market research to understand trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities to amplify our sales strategies.

 

o Data Analysis:  Data-driven decisions are the name of the game! Report and analyze sales data, providing insights to optimize our strategies for better results.

 

o Unleash Your Potential: Dive headfirst into the exciting world of media sales, where every interaction is an opportunity to make a lasting impression!

 

o Collaborate and Grow: Work closely with our focused media sales teams and other departments. Ensuring everyone is on the same page creates a cohesive approach to sales marketing, which is super important for overall success. Connect with internal and external clients, building relationships to understand their needs to provide support. Together, we'll amplify our impact and achieve remarkable results!

 

o Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep your finger on the pulse of industry trends and competitive strategies to ensure we're always a step ahead in the marketplace.

 

What We're Looking For 

o Proven Business Support Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn): Whether you're a seasoned business support specialist or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results.  

 

o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Analytical thinking is important, as you'll be interpreting data and helping with making informed decisions. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must.  

 

o A Passion for helping Others: You are committed to collaborate with various people and departments, so being adaptable and open to working with others will help you thrive in this role to understanding our teams' needs, providing top-notch administrative and business support, and making a difference.

 

o A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.

 

o Attractive Rewards: Enjoy competitive compensation that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.

 

o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)

 

o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.

 

o Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.   

  

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY

Employment practices will not be inﬂuenced or aﬀected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  


A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.

From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth.

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.

Proven Sales Ability and an Unstoppable Desire to Learn

You're a seasoned sales professional and we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results.

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.

job.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
job.description:
Make your mark in Broadcasting and Digital Media. Sinclair Broadcast Group and Sinclair Digital Solutions are dedicated to making Sinclair a communications powerhouse! We are the largest and most diversified television broadcasting company in the country. Sinclair owns and operates, programs, or provides services to more television stations than anyone and has affiliations with all major networks. Sinclair Digital group is focused on bringing the most engaging content to web, mobile and over-the-top broadcasting to audiences all over the
country!  Our success is the result of extraordinary employees and an exemplary management team who believe in a vision and are dedicated to ensuring a great future for our employees.  Whether you are an industry veteran or a just starting out, you can find it at Sinclair!  We are advancing the world of Broadcasting and we want YOU to join our winning team!
 
Sinclair Broadcast Group seeks a motivated and experienced Senior Cloud Engineer to join the Cloud Engineering Team. The individual will develop, integrate, and support key Enterprise infrastructure solutions.

Responsibilities:
 

  • Be part of a team that builds programs to design, develop, and govern cloud infrastructure across the enterprise.
  • Collaborate with other internal teams and third-party vendors to define best-in-class solutions.
    Proactively monitor KPIs and address areas of improvement for public, private, and hybrid cloud solutions.
  • Configuration, management, and maintenance of cloud-based solutions across public, private, and hybrid clouds.
  • Configuration, management, and maintenance of Windows and Linux servers across multiple cloud environments.
  • Support and deployment of applications running as containers.
  • Develop and maintain business continuity and disaster recovery processes.
  • Ensure cloud security measures are incorporated into infrastructure implementation.
  • Support and participate in the development of architecture designs for enterprise-wide systems infrastructure environments.
  • Drive efficiencies through process automation and Infrastructure as Code frameworks
  • Work with and support all other Cloud Engineering and DevOps team members.

 

Experience, Skills & Competencies:

  • 7+ years of experience in IT engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience directly building, administering, and supporting cloud solutions including compute, networking, load balancers, storage, identity management, and security.
  • 5+ years of experience with scripting and IT process automation – shell scripting, Terraform, Go, JSON, Jenkins, etc.
  • 3+ years of experience with Python development.
  • 5+ years of Linux systems administration in an enterprise level environment.
  • Experience in the architecture, engineering, and operation of containerization and virtualization technologies.
  • Understanding of industry best practices surrounding proper maintenance and support of a 24x7 cloud infrastructure – service and server hardening, tuning, vulnerability management, and patch management.
  • Demonstrable implementation of infrastructure lifecycles including planning, forecasting, implementation, and tracking of projects/assets deployment.
  • Experience supporting and managing private, public, and hybrid cloud solutions.
  • Experience working within an Agile/SAFe framework.
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills with a focus on data-driven decision-making.
  • Strong presentation skills with deep experience in data usage in dash-boarding platforms.
  • Advanced understanding and experience with monitoring tools.
  • Advanced experience developing Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Ability to quickly grasp technical issues and offer solutions.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Outgoing and enthusiastic personality.
  • Professional business demeanor.
  • Customer-focused attitude and desire to interface directly with end-user clients.
  • Relevant AWS Certifications required – Solutions Architect Associate, and SysOps Engineer.
  • Additional AWS Certifications desired – Security Specialty, Advanced Networking Specialty
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Management Information Systems, or a related field or equivalent work experience.
  • Immediate authorization to work in the US.

 

The base salary compensation range for this role is $130,490.25 to $173,987. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY:

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

About Sinclair:

Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 177 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts; and multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR and The Nest. Sinclair’s AMP Media produces a growing portfolio of digital content and original podcasts. Additional information about Sinclair can be found at www.sbgi.net.

 About the Team

The life-blood of our organization is our people. We have a compelling story, a goal-oriented culture, and we take really good care of people. How good? Here is a glimpse: great benefits, open-door policy, upward mobility and a strong desire to see you succeed. Ready to be part of a winning team? Let’s talk.

job.title: Senior Creative Producer/Videographer, Original Content
job.description:
AMP Sports is quickly emerging as one of the leading sports media companies producing highly engaging content across podcasts, YouTube, and social platforms. Home to some of the top sports podcasts, including “Cousins with Vince Carter and Tracy McGrady,” “The Triple Option with Urban Meyer, Mark Ingram II, and Rob Stone,” “Unfiltered Soccer with Landon Donovan and Tim Howard,” “Post Moves with Candace Parker and Aliyah Boston,” and “Style of Play with Julie Ertz and Kealia Watt” as well as a network of team-focused podcasts, with more shows slated for 2026 and beyond. With a rapidly expanding digital footprint and a reach spanning 180+ broadcast stations and tens of millions of followers, AMP Sports continues to build scalable content ecosystems that drive audience growth, engagement, and revenue.

We are seeking a Senior Creative Producer/Videographer, Original Content to develop, shoot, produce, and launch original, audience-first video and social franchises across the AMP Sports portfolio that expand our shows beyond the core podcast, drive audience growth, and increase the long-term value of our talent and show IP.

Partnering closely with leadership, content, social, production, and marketing, this role will proactively identify programming opportunities, pitch new concepts, and own approved projects from idea through delivery. They will also work with individual show teams to develop more creative, visual, and repeatable in-show formats designed to perform across YouTube, social, and the broader digital ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a highly creative video-first producer and director with exceptional original content instincts and the production experience to turn ambitious ideas into finished programming. They are a creator and storyteller, and understand how talent-led digital brands grow across YouTube and social platforms. They should be equally comfortable developing a franchise, directing talent in the field, managing a production budget and external crew, or helping a show producer build a stronger recurring segment. Strong hands-on video production skills are required.

What You’ll Do

  • Proactively develop, pitch, shoot, and produce premium original video franchises, recurring series, tentpole concepts, and shoulder programming built around AMP Sports shows and talent designed to drive audience growth.
  • Own creative process from concept through delivery, including development, ideation, pre-production through post-production, and final delivery.
  • Partner with show producers to level up existing programming through creative concepts designed to improve audience growth, retention, and engagement.
  • Extend the AMP Sports talent and show IP beyond the core podcast, with a particular focus on premium YouTube video, repeatable franchises, and original concepts.
  • Own the entire production process of original video content in, studio, field, and remote environments, maintaining a high standard of creative and technical execution.
  • Direct on-camera talent, athletes, and creators in studio and on location, with the ability to shape story, conversation, performance, and creative execution.
  • Lead post-production process, partner with editors and post-production teams to shape narrative through the edit, providing creative direction on larger projects.
  • Ideate original programming built for discovery, distribution, and growth across YouTube and social platforms; use audience and performance insights to inform creative decisions.
  • Work with show leads to develop and maintain a pipeline of programming ideas and opportunities; consult on new show launches and talent development when appropriate.
  • Serve as a flexible senior creative resource across the portfolio, with the ability to step into lead producer responsibilities when needed.
  • Assist developing and managing project budgets, and hire and oversee freelance production teams, vendors, and other external resources to execute approved concepts.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 

Who You Are

  • 7+ years producing and shooting premium original digital video for a media or production company, sports or entertainment brand, agency, creator-led business, or similar.
  • A highly creative developer and storyteller, with a proven track record of originating compelling programming, video concepts, recurring franchises, or similar and bringing them from concept through execution across YouTube, long-form video, social, and other digital platforms.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates exceptional creative instincts and format development skills across premium digital video content.
  • Expertise producing, shooting, and editing content in both field and studio environments across a variety of formats.
  • Exceptional storytelling skills and editorial instincts, with the ability to identify compelling narratives and turn those into high value content that connects with audiences.
  • Experience directing on-camera talent, creators, athletes, and high-profile personalities, maximizing their skillsets.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (or similar), as well as hands-on production skills with cameras, lighting, microphones, etc. in field, studio, and remote settings.
  • Strong understanding of social and YouTube best practices, audience retention, content packaging, SEO, and how content is consumed by audience across platforms.
  • A self-starter, highly collaborative, and able to lead and work across multiple teams while also working independently without oversight.
  • Someone who has a strong passion for creating digital-first content that cuts through the noise and drives significant audience growth.
  • Experience developing and managing production budgets, and onboarding and managing freelancers, vendors, and other external resources is a plus.
  • Highly organized and communicative, ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring all projects stay on timeline and all key stakeholders are involved.
  • Ability to travel and work nights, weekends, or holidays as projects call for.

 

The base salary compensation range for this role is $100,000 to $130,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave,vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Spring 2027 Intern
job.description:
As a part of our commitment to community service and educational enrichment, ABC 7/WJLA 24/7 News is offering a limited number of highly-sought unpaid internships, aimed at providing a springboard for college students interested in developing careers in broadcast and/or cable television. These internships are offered to selected participants currently enrolled institutions of higher learning. Student interns will experience all phases of a major market television station's day-to-day operations as a supplement to their academic curriculum.

Internship areas include:

  • Desk/Digital News
  • Sports
  • News Producing

 

Eligibility/Qualifications:

  • Upcoming junior or senior registered in a four-year undergraduate program at an accredited college or university. First year graduate students welcome to apply. 
  • Students entering their second year in a two-year junior or community college program may also be considered
  • Applicants should possess declared majors in journalism, meteorology, communication, or some similar related area
  • Applicants must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Since this is an in-person internship, students who live in the DC-Maryland-Virginia area will be highly preferred.

 

General qualifications:

  • A current college student who boasts a strong academic record
  • Able to receive college credit for this internship
  • A responsible professional who has prior internship and/or work experience
  • A candidate with a terrific attitude who can work well with a team as well as independently
  • A creative self-starter who can communicate effectively and work well under constant deadline
  • Willing to work mornings, nights and/or weekends to support our newscasts varying hours: We will do our best to work with your schedule
  • If interested in working with Good Morning Washington: In addition to general requirements, must be able to work early mornings

 

You must submit the following:

  • Resume

 

Deadline for Submitting Applications: December 18, 2026

This is an unpaid internship. Interns will not receive wages or salary for participation in this program. To be eligible, students must receive academic credit from their college or university for the internship.

       Adini Parikh, Human Resources Coordinator

       Email: aparikh@sbgtv.com

       Office Phone: 703-236-9216

*Incomplete submissions will not be considered!

Internship Stipend: No stipend
