job.title: Sr. Security Engineer
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced, technically driven security professional to advance Sinclair’s Information Security program. You will serve as a Senior Information Security Engineer focused on Security Operations, incident response, and advanced detection engineering. You will independently investigate complex threats, engineer high-fidelity detections across endpoint, identity, network, and cloud environments, and strengthen incident response through security tooling, workflow orchestration, and automation. You will also help evaluate and apply AI-assisted capabilities where they improve investigation quality and response efficiency. You will partner with internal teams, business stakeholders, and external security providers to improve detection coverage, accelerate response, and reduce enterprise risk.

Responsibilities:

Processes & Execution

  • Lead technical investigation, triage, containment, eradication, and recovery activities for complex security incidents across on-premises, cloud, identity, and endpoint environments.

  • Analyze security telemetry, authentication activity, process execution, network traffic, and threat intelligence to determine root cause, attack scope, impact, and appropriate response.

  • Perform proactive threat hunting and retrospective investigations; identify gaps in telemetry, detections, and response capabilities.

  • Own high-severity incident investigations, document evidence-based findings, communicate business impact, and coordinate timely remediation with system owners and external partners.

  • Apply MITRE ATT&CK and other relevant threat-informed methodologies to improve investigation quality, detection coverage, and response effectiveness.

  • Demonstrate independent technical judgment, clear communication, and accountability for outcomes in time-sensitive situations.

Engineering, Collaboration & Partnerships

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and continuously tune complex detection mechanisms for multi-stage attacks, identity compromise, lateral movement, persistence, exfiltration, and other advanced adversary behaviors.

  • Correlate endpoint, SIEM, identity, email, network, and cloud telemetry to create behavioral, contextual, and risk-based detections rather than relying solely on static indicators.

  • Develop and maintain detection-as-code content, queries, analytics, and validation tests; assess false positives, data quality, precision, and detection gaps.

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated SecOps and incident response workflows using security platforms, APIs, SOAR technologies, and enterprise ticketing systems to streamline enrichment, investigation, containment, and remediation.

  • Advance security operations automation by integrating AI-assisted analysis and agent-based capabilities, where appropriate, into existing investigation and response processes to improve context, prioritization, and analyst efficiency.

  • Apply established security engineering controls to automated response workflows, including least-privilege access, action validation, approval for high-impact remediation, logging, exception handling, and escalation to analysts.

  • Integrate third-party alert and investigation outputs with internal telemetry to support independent validation, deeper investigation, and consistent remediation.

  • Collaborate with infrastructure, IAM, cloud, endpoint, IT operations, and external security partners to validate detections, remediate threats, and operationalize new capabilities.

Performance Improvement

  • Measure and improve detection coverage, fidelity, mean time to detect/respond, investigation quality, automation success, and analyst effort saved.

  • Continuously test detections and response workflows using attack simulations, adversary emulation, incident lessons learned, and controlled validation.

  • Document engineering designs, investigation procedures, response decision criteria, automation safeguards, and operational runbooks.

  • Identify repetitive analyst tasks suitable for automation while preserving human oversight for uncertain, destructive, or business-disruptive actions.

  • Mentor engineers and analysts through technical reviews, investigation feedback, and knowledge sharing; promote sustainable engineering standards.

  • Evaluate new security detection and response technologies, including AI-assisted capabilities, based on practical operational value, reliability, security, and measurable risk reduction.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, threat detection, security engineering, or a closely related discipline, including ownership of complex investigations.

  • Demonstrated experience building and tuning advanced detections in a SIEM, EDR/XDR, or cloud security analytics platform; ability to explain detection logic and validate underlying evidence.

  • Strong understanding of attacker techniques, Windows and Linux internals, identity-based attacks, network protocols, cloud security, and incident response methodology.

  • Hands-on experience integrating security platforms through APIs, developing orchestration workflows, and implementing automated investigation or response actions using SOAR tools and enterprise IT service management platforms.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted security investigation, agent-based automation, or LLM-enabled security workflows is a plus; specialized AI development or production AI-agent experience is not required.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with the Microsoft Defender security suite (such as Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365, or Defender XDR) and related Microsoft security/identity technologies, including Entra ID.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with enterprise security technologies such as Zscaler, CrowdStrike Falcon, Abnormal Security, Tines, Armis, and Splunk, or equivalent platforms; strong experience across multiple tools is expected, but experience with every named product is not required.

  • Proven ability to investigate incidents and engineer or tune detections directly in EDR/XDR, SIEM, network security, email security, and identity platforms, including querying telemetry, investigating alerts, and operationalizing response actions.

  • Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, NIST incident response guidance, and security engineering best practices.

  • Professional security certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, GCDA, or equivalent preferred.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, cross-functional collaboration, and demonstrated ownership of technical initiatives.

 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

The base salary compensation range for this role is $111,000 to $147,805. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Strategic Sourcing Associate
job.description:
The Procurement team is growing and looking for a full-time Strategic Sourcing Associate to join our team!

This is an excellent opportunity for an early career procurement or supply chain professional looking to build experience in strategic sourcing, vendor management, and purchasing operations. Working closely with the Purchasing Manager, you'll support sourcing initiatives, collaborate with internal stakeholders, assist with vendor purchasing programs, and help identify cost savings opportunities that contribute to the success of the business.

This role offers hands on experience with sourcing, procurement analytics, vendor management, and contract administration while providing opportunities for professional growth and career advancement within Procurement.

The successful candidate will have 0 to 2 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, supply chain, business operations, or a related field. Internship or co-op experience is welcomed. This position reports to the Purchasing Manager.

Essential Job Functions

  • Assist with vendor contract negotiations, renewals, and purchasing activities while partnering with corporate departments and stakeholders.
  • Support sourcing initiatives and assist in identifying cost savings opportunities across vendor spend.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to assess current and future purchasing needs while identifying opportunities to consolidate spend, improve efficiencies, and increase preferred vendor compliance.
  • Analyze purchasing and spend data to help identify sourcing opportunities, vendor trends, and process improvements.
  • Submit requisitions in the Purchasing system on behalf of business units as needed.
  • Administer various vendor purchasing programs across the company.
  • Partner with the Purchasing Manager on sourcing projects and procurement initiatives throughout the year.
  • Gather feedback from business units regarding vendor performance and assist with resolving purchasing related issues.
  • Obtain vendor quotes and support pricing and contract negotiations with guidance from the Purchasing Manager.
  • Assist in resolving vendor issues related to contract obligations, service levels, product quality, and pricing.
  • Provide support to business units regarding purchasing processes, policies, best practices, and contract submissions.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Other Skills

  • Ability to build professional working relationships with employees, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and problem solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable working independently as well as collaboratively on a team.
  • Strong computer skills and willingness to learn new systems and procurement tools.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Eagerness to learn procurement best practices, vendor management, and negotiation techniques.
  • Adaptable and willing to take on new responsibilities as business needs evolve.

 

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Purchasing, Finance, Operations, or a related field preferred.
  • 0 to 2 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, operations, finance, or another related business function.
  • Internship or co-op experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, or sourcing is a plus.
  • Strong interest in procurement, vendor management, and strategic sourcing.
  • Experience organizing or analyzing data in Microsoft Excel is preferred.
  • Knowledge of purchasing principles or vendor management is a plus.
  • Oracle Cloud experience is a plus.
  • Purchasing certification is a plus.

 

This position is on site in Hunt Valley, MD. Candidates must be local or willing to commute.

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

job.title: Director, Global Benefits & Wellness
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

 

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

 

SiriusXM

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

 

How you’ll make an impact:

The Director, Global Benefits & Wellness leads the execution and ongoing improvement of global benefits and wellness programs in alignment with the company’s Total Rewards strategy. Managing a team of benefits professionals and partnering with HR, Finance, Legal, Payroll, and Procurement, this role oversees program performance, financial stewardship, compliance, and vendor delivery to support a competitive, inclusive, and cost-effective employee experience.

 

What you’ll do:

Program Design & Implementation

  • Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of global benefits and holistic wellness programs (physical, mental, financial, and social) within the broader Total Rewards strategy.
  • Evaluate benefits plans across regions, recommend improvements to address gaps and redundancies, and coordinate adaptations to local statutory requirements and employee needs.
  • Financial Responsibility & Program Performance
  • Manage self-insured and fully insured plan performance, including forecasts, renewals, reserve planning, and claims utilization analysis.
  • Develop annual budgets, funding recommendations, and clear analyses of cost, affordability, and program risks for senior leadership review.
  • Implement value-driven cost-containment initiatives that protect care quality, accessibility, and the employee experience.

Vendor Management & Procurement

  • Manage vendor relationships and procurement activities, including RFPs, contract negotiations, service-level agreements (SLAs), and coordination of data security requirements.
  • Use vendor scorecards to evaluate carriers, TPAs, and digital health partners against operational delivery, outcomes, and member satisfaction.

Governance, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Maintain program governance, documented policies, controls, and approval processes in partnership with Legal, Tax, and Payroll.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance and implement program updates according to updated program criteria (e.g., 401(k), Deferred Compensation Plans).
  • Oversee compliance monitoring and audit readiness across applicable jurisdictions, coordinating U.S. filings (including Form 5500 and nondiscrimination testing) and international statutory program obligations with internal and external specialists.

Employee Experience, Analytics & Digital Innovation

  • Improve benefits communications, open enrollment, and employee self-service experiences through digital platforms and targeted engagement.
  • Assess opportunities for secure, responsible AI and automation to improve benefits administration and employee support.
  • Track program impact using employee sentiment, ERG feedback, enrollment trends, and clinical/cost analytics to guide continuous program refinement.

Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of benefits and wellness professionals, setting priorities, monitoring service delivery, and building functional expertise.
  • Establish team goals, performance expectations, and clear accountability while fostering collaboration and a service-oriented culture.

 

What you’ll need:

  • 10 or more years of progressive benefits and wellness experience, including 5 or more years of management experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience managing multi-country benefits programs and executing plan redesigns, vendor transitions, or M&A integration activities.
  • Expertise in self-insured health plans, claims utilization analysis, cost drivers, and sustainable cost-containment approaches.
  • Experience with benefits vendor management, competitive procurement, SLA oversight, financial modeling, forecasts, and renewals.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to construct data-driven business cases, budget models, and contract negotiations.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. benefits compliance, ERISA standards, and Form 5500 reporting, maintaining clear plan-sponsor accountability alongside third-party consultants.
  • Working knowledge of international regulatory, tax, and labor environments across diverse regions.
  • Strong communication and change-management skills, with the ability to explain financial and policy trade-offs to cross-functional partners and senior leaders.
  • Familiarity with modern benefits administration platforms, digital health ecosystems, and HR technology, including the responsible use of AI and automation.
  • Experience operating within a publicly traded company, navigating executive visibility, financial controls, and audit-readiness standards.
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

 

Skills:

  • Global Benefits & Wellness Program Management
  • Benefits Financial Analysis & Cost Management
  • Vendor Management & Procurement
  • Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management
  • People Leadership & Development
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

 

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $163,000 to $203,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

 The Payments domain is responsible for modernizing how SiriusXM manages payment information and payment processing across its commercial ecosystem, reducing PCI scope, simplifying platform architecture, and creating secure, scalable payment capabilities that can evolve independently of downstream payment providers.
 This team is responsible for building and operating the next generation of payment services that support payment tokenization, secure payment workflows, payment-provider integrations, and the architectural evolution required to reduce enterprise PCI scope.
 As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help design, build, and operate secure, resilient payment services while partnering closely with Product Management, Principal Engineers, and Engineering leadership to deliver high-quality solutions in a complex and evolving problem space. You will contribute to technical discovery, solution shaping, and system design activities while helping ensure the systems we build remain scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable.

Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How You'll Make an Impact

At SiriusXM and Pandora, search plays a critical role in how listeners discover and access the content they love. As a Senior Staff Machine Learning Scientist, Search, you will serve as a technical leader responsible for advancing the long-term direction of search and discovery capabilities across our audio ecosystem. You will drive the development of next-generation retrieval, ranking, query understanding, personalization, and AI-powered search experiences that improve how millions of listeners discover music, podcasts, channels, live programming, and emerging content experiences.

Operating with significant autonomy, you will lead highly complex initiatives, influence technical strategy across multiple teams, and help shape the evolution of search systems through deep expertise in machine learning, information retrieval, and generative AI. Your work will have broad impact across products and business objectives, requiring the ability to solve ambiguous problems, drive alignment among stakeholders, and translate emerging technologies into scalable production solutions.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead the design, development, and evolution of advanced machine learning systems supporting search relevance, retrieval, ranking, query understanding, and personalization across diverse audio content types.

  • Define technical approaches and drive execution for highly complex search and discovery initiatives that span multiple products, systems, and stakeholder groups.

  • Develop and improve transformer-based, deep learning, semantic retrieval, and generative AI solutions that enhance content discovery and user engagement.

  • Establish and refine methodologies for search evaluation, experimentation, offline relevance measurement, and online testing to ensure continuous improvement of user experiences.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Content teams to influence roadmap decisions and align technical investments with business priorities.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert in search and machine learning, providing technical leadership and consultation on complex challenges across multiple teams.

  • Drive adoption of emerging technologies and industry best practices related to information retrieval, large language models, semantic search, recommendation systems, and machine learning infrastructure.

  • Lead the investigation and resolution of highly ambiguous technical problems that require innovative approaches, sound judgment, and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Establish best practices, standards, and scalable approaches for machine learning development, deployment, monitoring, experimentation, and model lifecycle management.

  • Influence technical direction through architectural guidance, technical reviews, and mentorship of scientists and engineers.

  • Contribute to the growth and development of the organization by mentoring team members, sharing expertise, and fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.

  • Continuously evaluate business impact through metrics, experimentation, and operational performance to ensure solutions drive measurable outcomes.

  • This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities.

What You'll Need:

  • Education: M.S. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field required; Ph.D. preferred.

  • Experience: 8+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning systems in production environments, including significant experience solving complex search, ranking, retrieval, or recommendation problems at scale.

  • Technical Expertise: Deep expertise in information retrieval, search relevance, ranking systems, semantic search, query understanding, transformer architectures, and modern machine learning methodologies.

  • Production ML: Extensive experience designing, deploying, monitoring, and optimizing production machine learning systems, including experimentation frameworks, model lifecycle management, feature stores, and large-scale distributed systems.

  • Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives, influence decisions across teams, and drive outcomes without direct authority.

  • Problem Solving: Proven success solving ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges and translating emerging technologies into scalable business solutions.

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Collaboration: Strong track record of working cross-functionally to align priorities, drive execution, and deliver measurable business results.

  • Mindset: Self-motivated, strategic, and passionate about solving challenging problems while continuously advancing technical excellence.

job.title: Staff Software Engineer, Growth Engineering - Payments
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories, and music they love wherever they are.

 

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

 

We are proud to have launched a new state-of-the-art technology facility in Dublin, Ireland. The Dublin-based team plays a critical role in our continued digital transformation and will function as a centre of excellence for SiriusXM’s global Product and Technology organization.

 

How you’ll make an impact:

We are looking for a Staff Engineer to be the Tech Lead of the Token Services team within the Growth Engineering organization.
 Token Services owns mission-critical systems that underpin SiriusXM’s Atlas platform across both streaming and automotive use cases, and that every signed-in listener depends on. The team is responsible for session management (creation, refresh, and revocation), token and JWT minting, first-party authorization and third-party account linking flows for platforms such as Alexa, Google, Roku, and Sonos, and IP-based location resolution, including third-party data integrations.
 These capabilities serve SiriusXM streaming and automotive clients, external platforms such as voice assistants and connected devices, and B2B partners. The team plays a critical role in key initiatives such as our next-generation in-vehicle experience and continued improvements to the reliability, observability, and lifecycle behaviour of our session platform. As Tech Lead, you will provide technical and day-to-day leadership for a geographically distributed team of engineers, partnering closely with Product Management, Principal Engineers, Technical Program Managers, and Engineering leadership to translate strategy into execution. You will create clarity in ambiguous problem spaces, lead technical discovery and solution shaping, and ensure the team consistently delivers secure, resilient, and high-quality outcomes.
 This is a Staff Engineer role with team leadership at its heart. As the team evolves, line management responsibilities may come into scope, so we are looking for someone who is open to taking on people leadership alongside their technical leadership.

 

What you’ll do:

● Provide day-to-day technical and team leadership for the Token Services team, fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
● Lead the technical design, implementation, and evolution of highly available, security-critical services responsible for session management, token minting and refresh, third-party account linking, and IP-based location resolution.
● Partner with Product Management, Principal Engineers, Technical Program Managers, and Engineering leadership to translate strategic objectives into executable roadmaps and delivery plans, balancing short-term business priorities with long-term platform investments.
● Lead technical discovery, requirements refinement, solution shaping, and system design for complex initiatives spanning multiple services, client platforms, and external partners.
● Collaborate closely with Principal Engineers and partner teams across identity, device, entitlements, and edge to ensure architectural consistency, clean service boundaries, and alignment with broader platform strategy.
● Champion contract-driven development, API design, and event-driven integration patterns, keeping token and session contracts stable for the many clients and services that depend on them.
● Establish and maintain strong engineering practices across the team, including code quality, testing, observability, operational readiness, on-call, and incident management.
● Ensure systems meet demanding requirements around security, privacy, reliability, scalability, and resilience.
● Investigate complex production issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive improvements in reliability, performance, and supportability.
● Manage delivery risks, dependencies, and execution challenges across partner teams and domains.
● Drive continuous improvement in engineering effectiveness, leveraging modern delivery practices, platform capabilities, and AI-enabled development workflows to improve developer productivity, software quality, and delivery outcomes.
● Mentor and coach engineers through pairing, design reviews, and code reviews, growing technical capability across the team. As line management comes into scope, take on performance management, career development, and succession planning.● Contribute to architecture reviews, technical design discussions, RFCs, and planning processes.
● Help attract, hire, and retain exceptional engineering talent.

 

What you’ll need:

● Minimum of seven years of professional software engineering experience, including experience leading engineering teams or significant technical initiatives.
● Demonstrated technical leadership of a team delivering complex distributed systems, including mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction.
● Experience leading, mentoring, and developing software engineers in a production environment, and openness to taking on line management responsibilities as the team evolves.
● Fluency in at least one modern programming language within JVM ecosystems such as Scala, Java, or Kotlin.
● Proven success designing, delivering, and operating complex distributed systems in cloud-native environments.
● Deep knowledge of API design, scalability, fault tolerance, and performance optimization for high-throughput, low-latency services.
● Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, including technical discovery, requirements refinement, planning, delivery, testing, and operational support.
● Experience collaborating closely with Product Management and business stakeholders to evaluate tradeoffs, shape scope, and deliver customer and business value.
● Strong understanding of modern software architecture patterns, including service-oriented and event-driven systems.
● Experience with contract-driven development practices using technologies such as OpenAPI, Smithy, gRPC, or similar approaches.
● Experience operating highly available, mission-critical systems with demanding requirements around reliability, security, scalability, and resilience, including production on-call and incident management.
● Experience evolving engineering processes, delivery practices, or team operating models to improve alignment, predictability, and execution.
● Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions across teams.

Preferred Qualifications:
● Experience building or operating authentication, authorization, session management, or token issuance systems, such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT/JWS, or account linking and federation flows.
● Experience with Scala and functional programming paradigms, ideally including libraries such as Cats Effect and http4s.
● Deep familiarity with AWS services across compute, storage, containers, and serverless technologies, such as DynamoDB, Lambda, Kinesis, and ECS/Fargate.● Experience with event-driven architectures, event sourcing, streaming platforms, and asynchronous integration patterns.
● Experience integrating with external platforms and partners, such as voice assistants, connected devices, automotive OEMs, or B2B integrators.
● Experience leading teams responsible for secure or privacy-sensitive systems.
● Familiarity with observability, reliability engineering, and operational excellence practices.
● Experience working across polyglot service environments, including services written in languages such as Go.

  • Partner with Operations to execute content deletions, takedowns, price tier changes, territory/DSP availability updates, and overall digital catalog maintenance.
  • Manage video delivery workflows, including video release approvals, updates, copyright claims, and channel partnerships.

Technical Expertise & Compliance

  • Complete and maintain required platform certifications (YouTube, Label Management, Metadata tests) and demonstrate expert navigation of internal systems and DSP tools (Zendesk, Spotify Catalog Manager, Apple Music / iTunes Connect).
  • Work directly with the Claims team to engage clients on flagged content issues and resolve rights disputes.

Who you are:

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex client onboarding and account setup processes, including coordinating multiple internal stakeholders and ensuring payment and distribution readiness.
  • Strong understanding of music metadata, digital rights, ownership, territories, DSP availability and content delivery requirements, with a high level of attention to catalogue integrity.
  • Proven ability to manage back-office and operational workflows, including Legal, Finance, Operations, Claims and Contract Administration.
  • Strong technical aptitude and confidence navigating multiple platforms, systems and digital tools; experience with Zendesk, Spotify for Artists/Catalog Manager, Apple Music/iTunes Connect, YouTube CMS and similar platforms is advantageous.

  • Strong understanding of content review, release approvals and quality-control processes, with the ability to make sound decisions while protecting catalogue and client interests.

job.title: Vice President, Privacy, Business & Legal Affairs
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music is seeking a Vice President, Privacy, Business & Legal Affairs to serve as a senior legal advisor on privacy, data protection, artificial intelligence, and emerging technology matters across the company's global operations. Reporting to the Associate International General Counsel and Chief Privacy Officer, this role will play a critical part in advancing Sony Music's privacy governance and compliance efforts while helping the business responsibly leverage data, technology, and innovation.

The Vice President will partner closely with senior leaders across Legal, Information Security, Product, Technology, Marketing, Corporate Development, and other business functions to navigate evolving legal and regulatory requirements, support strategic business initiatives, and manage privacy and technology-related risk in a rapidly changing environment.

What you'll do:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to business and functional leaders on privacy, data protection, artificial intelligence, and emerging technology matters, providing practical guidance that supports innovation while managing legal and regulatory risk.
  • Lead the implementation and ongoing enhancement of privacy compliance frameworks, policies, and governance processes to support compliance with applicable global privacy laws, regulatory requirements, and Sony Music standards.
  • Partner with product, technology, digital, marketing, and information security teams to review new products, services, data uses, and technology initiatives, ensuring privacy, AI, and data governance considerations are appropriately addressed throughout the business lifecycle.
  • Advise on the legal and regulatory implications of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and machine learning, and help develop responsible governance practices that align with business objectives and evolving regulatory expectations.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate privacy and data protection provisions in a wide range of commercial agreements, including technology, vendor, digital services, marketing, licensing, and strategic partnership arrangements.
  • Support mergers, acquisitions, investments, and other strategic transactions by advising on privacy, cybersecurity, and data governance considerations and working closely with transactional attorneys and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Monitor and assess developments in privacy, AI, digital regulation, and related areas, providing insights and recommendations to senior leadership regarding emerging risks, regulatory changes, and business impacts.
  • Support privacy-related audits, investigations, regulatory inquiries, compliance reporting, and enterprise risk management activities, while helping foster a culture of responsible data stewardship and accountability across the organization.
  • Collaborate with Sony Music legal teams globally, Sony Group privacy leaders, and external counsel to promote consistent approaches to privacy governance and compliance across jurisdictions.

Who you are:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school.
  • Member of the New York Bar in good standing.
  • Significant experience advising on privacy, data protection, technology, digital media, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, or regulatory compliance matters in a law firm, multinational corporation, or similarly complex environment.
  • Deep understanding of global privacy laws, regulatory frameworks, and emerging developments related to artificial intelligence, data governance, and digital technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and partner effectively across highly matrixed organizations.
  • Strong business judgment with the ability to balance legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational considerations.
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to independently lead complex matters and drive cross-functional alignment on high-impact business initiatives.
  • Solutions-oriented, intellectually curious, and highly collaborative, with a commitment to delivering practical legal advice that enables business growth and innovation.
 

What we give you:

  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans

  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next

job.title: Analyst - Community Intelligence
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.   SoundCloud is looking for an Analyst, Community Intelligence to help us build a deeper understanding of the creators and listeners who make SoundCloud what it is.

Sitting at the intersection of Community, Product, Data, Growth, and Music, you will build the intelligence engine that connects what happens on SoundCloud with what is happening across the broader creator, music, and cultural ecosystem. You will combine product behavior, support conversations, surveys, social signals, market trends, and external intelligence to understand who our creators and listeners are, what they need, where they experience friction, and what drives long-term engagement and retention.

A core part of this role will be owning SoundCloud’s creator segmentation and lifecycle framework, creating a durable understanding of how creators evolve across the platform and turning that understanding into strategic recommendations for Product, Growth, Marketing, Music, and senior leadership. You will also partner closely with our Music Intelligence function, applying the same analytical lens to artist discovery, music trends, forecasting, and artist ecosystem research.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own and evolve SoundCloud’s creator and listener intelligence framework, combining behavioral, transactional, attitudinal, and qualitative data into a clear understanding of our community.
  • Lead the development of creator segmentation and lifecycle models, identifying meaningful creator groups, needs, behaviors, ambitions, and stages of development.
  • Analyze creator journeys, cohorts, funnels, and retention patterns to understand what drives activation, growth, engagement, monetization, and churn.
  • Build a holistic Voice of the Community program by connecting signals from support interactions, NPS and surveys, social channels, community feedback, and in-product behavior.
  • Identify recurring friction points, unmet needs, and emerging shifts in community behavior, and translate them into strategic recommendations for the Product, Engineering, Growth, Marketing, Music, and Business teams.
  • Bring external intelligence into our understanding of the SoundCloud community by monitoring creator-economy trends, competitor and platform developments, music and cultural signals, and relevant industry benchmarks.
  • Connect external shifts with SoundCloud first-party data to identify emerging risks, opportunities, and changes in creator and listener needs.
  • Partner with Music Intelligence on artist discovery, audience and trend analysis, forecasting, and research into emerging artists, genres, scenes, and communities.
  • Articulate cultural trends through data, leveraging contextual and qualitative data types to turn growth trends into fuel for storytelling about where music is heading.  
  • Support reporting around creator and streaming trend analysis, building self-serve tools to allow Music Intelligence, Community and adjacent teams to tell stories about music movements on the platform.
  • Own reporting around NPS, community sentiment, creator behavior, lifecycle health, and experience drivers, turning complex data into clear narratives for senior stakeholders.
  • Leverage analytics, automation, and AI-enabled tools to accelerate research and synthesis while applying strong judgment to validate outputs and turn them into reliable insights.
  • Partner closely with Data Science, Analytics, Research, Product, and Community teams to build scalable frameworks and establish Community Intelligence as a trusted source of user and creator knowledge across SoundCloud.

Experience and Background:

  • 2+ years of experience in customer or consumer insights, product analytics, audience intelligence, strategy, research, or a similar analytical role, ideally within consumer technology, media, entertainment, social, creator, or music businesses.
  • Strong experience turning complex datasets into strategic recommendations that influence product, customer, or business decisions.
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with BI and visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Experience with segmentation, cohort analysis, lifecycle analysis, funnel analysis, and retention/churn analytics.
  • Comfortable combining quantitative analysis with qualitative inputs such as surveys, support conversations, social listening, community feedback, and market research.
  • Strong understanding of customer or audience research methodologies, including NPS, Voice of Customer, segmentation, and behavioral analysis.
  • Strong business judgment and the ability to move from data to insight to a clear recommendation.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with experience presenting complex findings to senior and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Comfortable using AI-enabled tools to accelerate research, analysis, and synthesis while maintaining strong analytical rigor and judgment.
  • A genuine curiosity for creators, music, technology, culture, and online communities.

Nice to Have 

  • Experience in music, entertainment, social media, streaming, or the creator economy.
  • Familiarity with music and audience intelligence tools, social listening platforms, or external market datasets.
  • Experience with Python/R, statistical analysis, forecasting, or network analysis.
  • Experience with artist discovery, cultural trend analysis, or creator growth ecosystems.

The salary range for this role is $115,000 - $122,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below!

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as mental health resources
  • Robust 401k program
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
  • 16 paid weeks for all parents (birthing and non-birthing), regardless of gender, to welcome newborns, adopted and foster children
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Recommendations (Core)
job.description:
We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join ML Core, the team that builds the shared ML models behind SoundCloud’s recommendations, search and content understanding. New sounds start on SoundCloud. Our job is to connect artists with the communities that will care about their music, and help listeners discover the gems and emerging scenes they’d never find on their own. Recommendations are our largest area, but you’ll work across problems that share the same foundations: representing users, tracks and creators, and ranking them well. We’re also in the middle of modernizing our stack, moving from classical approaches to deep learning on GPU, and you’ll play a big part in that.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, train and ship models for recommendations (candidate generation, user/item modeling, ranking) and related problems in search and content understanding.
  • Lead the move of key models from classical approaches (e.g., word2vec-style embeddings) to PyTorch-based models trained and served on GPU.
  • Adapt, fine-tune and evaluate open-source embedding and ranking models for our catalog and use cases.
  • Own evaluation end to end: offline metrics, A/B experiments, and making sure offline gains show up online.
  • Work with ML, data and backend engineers to get models into production and keep them healthy, and help set modeling standards across the team.

What we’re looking for:

  • 3+ years building ML systems in production, with end-to-end ownership of at least one ranking, retrieval or recommendation model.
  • Strong deep learning skills in PyTorch (or similar frameworks), and a good grasp of recommendation and retrieval fundamentals (embeddings, two-tower models, learning to rank, multi-objective ranking) and their trade-offs.
  • Solid experience with evaluation and experimentation for ranking systems, including biases in implicit feedback such as clicks and plays.
  • Strong Python; comfortable with large-scale data processing (e.g., Spark/BigQuery) and with getting models to production on a cloud platform (GCP preferred).
  • M.Sc. in a quantitative field or equivalent experience.

Nice to have:

  • Fine-tuning or serving transformer-based embedding/ranking models.
  • Applying LLMs or foundation models to recommendations (content understanding, semantic IDs, generative retrieval, feature generation).
  • Audio or music ML, or multimodal representations.
  • Contextual bandits, RL or causal methods for long-term value.
  • Publications at RecSys, KDD, SIGIR, WSDM, NeurIPS or similar.
  • Experience with ANN/vector search and GPU training or serving at scale.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification. Research suggests that some applicants may doubt their candidacy, so please submit an application if you are interested.

job.title: Lead Software Engineer (Portals)
job.description:
About SoundExchange

SoundExchange is the largest global neighboring rights organization in the world, redefining how creators in the music industry get paid. By turning data into fast, accurate revenue for artists and rights owners, we have collected and distributed more than $13 billion in digital performance royalties to date on behalf of more than 800,000 music creators. As the sole organization designated by the U.S. government to administer the Section 114 sound recording license, SoundExchange seamlessly collects and distributes digital performance royalties from platforms like Pandora, SiriusXM, iHeartRadio, and thousands more, as well as all available international performance royalties through a strong global partnership network. 

 

Title: Lead Software Engineer/Engineering Manager (Portals Team)
Department: Technology
Job Location: Washington, DC or anywhere (Continental US) (If local, on-site Tuesdays and Wednesdays)
Reports To: Director, Engineering
Supervisory Role: No
FLSA Status: Exempt

Position Summary:

The Lead Software Engineer for our Portals team will be a key contributor to full lifecycle software development while coaching, leading, and mentoring their small technical team. This role oversees the technical details and day-to-day execution of all new features and operational activities within the development team in collaboration with the technical product owner. The Lead Engineer is a critical element in our agile delivery process for new features and capabilities to support our growing music royalty processing platform.

Essential Functions:

• Provide hands-on technical leadership to a small team of software engineers
• Collaborate across teams to estimate, design, develop, support, test, and deliver data driven solutions
• Facilitate architecture discussions and decision-making both within and across teams
• Interface with key project stakeholders, mentor team members, and promote and improve software engineering practices
• Demonstrate responsibility, accountability, and dedication to engineering team and company success
• Establish and promote use of technologies and processes that lower risk and increase efficiency
• Support and improve software development standards and best practices, including generative coding, peer reviews, and source control
• Support and improve existing software applications and design, or collaborate on designing, new software applications or features
• Take responsibility for full Agile SDLC, especially from refinement to release
• Lead, coach, and develop team members by setting clear expectations, providing timely feedback, supporting growth, and fostering a collaborative and accountable work environment

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (KSAs):

• Proficiency at designing and developing software using many of the following: Python, Django, SQL (Postgres), AWS (S3, ECS, OpenSearch, RDS, Cloudfront, etc.), JavaScript, Typescript, JPax, Git, Kiro
• Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure as code technologies
• Experience with Vue3 or other UI frameworks
• Experience with migrating legacy application to modern technologies
• Experience building enterprise software with complex business rules and data models
• Experience designing and developing microservices or other distributed systems
• Experience with scaling to work with large data sets
• Ability to influence and communicate effectively with team members, peers, and business partners
• Proficiency in Agile software development methodology, processes, and practices

Required Education, Certifications/ Licenses, Related Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent experience
• 7 or more years of experience in software engineering
• At least 2 years of experience leading a software engineering team

ADA Specifications:

• This position requires the ability to remain in a stationary position (standing and/or seated) all of the time
• This position requires the ability to spend all of the time viewing computer monitors

Travel Requirements:

• If hired remote, this person is expected to travel to the Washington DC corporate office as needed (3-4 times per year).

 

PAY RANGE: $171,000.00 - $209,000.00 

Note:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary.

Taking Care Of The Band:

At SoundExchange we empower creators and help shape the future of music. One way we do this is by respecting different voices, varied perspectives, and distinct backgrounds of all our team members. We are intentional in creating a culture where we recognize that all employees have the opportunities and support needed to thrive. We strive to create teams that reflect the music community we serve – every individual’s unique attributes and abilities are valued, and are part of how we innovate, create, and deliver experiences to the creators we champion.

SoundExchange has an employee-led committee that focuses on amplifying different voices and backgrounds and undertakes activities to promote inclusion and access. It helps to cultivate SoundExchange culture and policies, advocates for equality within the music industry, and participates in community building activities in the Washington, DC area where SoundExchange is located.

All with the goal of promoting more belonging and access in the workplace, music industry, and local community.

Accommodations:

SoundExchange is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the SoundExchange Careers website as a result of your disability. We will make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.  If you need an accommodation, please email jobs@soundexchange.com.

job.description:
Spanish Broadcasting System, Inc.

Job Title: Part-Time Promotions Assistant

Reports To: Marketing & Promotions Manager

Position Type: Part-time

Location: San Jose, CA

 


About the Role:

The Promotions Assistant plays a vital role in supporting the marketing and promotional efforts within the Information and Media Services industry. This position is responsible for assisting in the development, coordination, and execution of promotional campaigns that enhance brand visibility and audience engagement. The ideal candidate will work closely with the marketing team to manage promotional materials, track campaign performance, and liaise with external partners and vendors. By ensuring smooth operational support and timely delivery of promotional activities, the Promotions Assistant contributes directly to the growth and success of the organization’s media presence. This role requires a proactive individual who can manage multiple tasks efficiently while maintaining attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality.


Because this position requires the operation of Company and station vehicles, candidates must possess a valid driver’s license and authorize SBS to obtain a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) as part of the pre-employment screening process. Any offer of employment will be contingent upon the candidate having an acceptable driving record and receiving approval to operate Company vehicles under SBS’s applicable insurance requirements. The employee must maintain a valid driver’s license and continued insurability throughout employment in this position.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred.
  • Basic understanding of marketing principles and promotional strategies.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in the Information and Media Services industry or a related marketing environment.
  • Familiarity with digital marketing tools and social media platforms.
  • Knowledge of graphic design software such as Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Experience with event coordination and vendor management.
  • Ability to analyze marketing data and generate reports.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the planning and execution of promotional campaigns across various media platforms.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors to produce and distribute promotional materials.
  • Monitor and report on the effectiveness of promotional activities and suggest improvements.
  • Maintain accurate records of promotional schedules, budgets, and inventory of marketing collateral.
  • Support event planning and on-site promotional activities as needed to maximize audience engagement.

Benefits & Compensation

  • Employee benefits are available for this position subject to meeting eligibility requirements.

Skills:

The Promotions Assistant utilizes strong organizational and communication skills daily to coordinate promotional campaigns and collaborate effectively with team members and external partners. Proficiency in Microsoft Office enables the creation and management of schedules, reports, and presentations that support campaign tracking and decision-making. Familiarity with digital marketing tools and social media platforms allows the assistant to contribute to online promotional efforts and audience engagement strategies. Knowledge of graphic design software is beneficial for assisting in the development of visually appealing marketing materials. Analytical skills are applied to monitor campaign performance and provide actionable insights that enhance future promotional activities.

job.title: Accounting Analyst, Content Accounting
job.description: Our Global Content Accounting Operations team makes sure the songwriters behind the music on Spotify are accurately accounted for and paid, everywhere in the world. Reporting to the Manager of Content Accounting, you’ll support songwriter royalty accounting globally and partner closely with Legal, Licensing, Technical Accounting, and Engineering. You’ll also help shape what comes next: rolling out claiming processes in new territories as Spotify expands, finding new ways to show the accounting impact of business decisions, steering updates to our claiming systems, and streamlining month-end close in a fast-growing region.

job.title: Analyst, Royalty Operations
job.description: Royalty Operations owns the operations behind Spotify’s royalty process across music, audiobooks, lyrics, and creator content. We implement content licenses in Spotify’s proprietary royalty systems, calculate and report royalties to our rightsholder partners, provide analytics to Accounting stakeholders, and serve as the go-to team for royalty questions across the company. As our business grows more complex, we’re focused on staying accurate and on time while getting faster and more flexible through scripting, Gen AI, and agentic workflows.

job.title: Associate Artist Label Partnerships Manager, South Korea
job.description:
Spotify’s Artist & Label Partnerships (ALP) team works with artists, managers, record labels and distributors to help artists grow their audiences and connect with fans.

As an Associate Artist & Label Partnerships Manager on the Korea Music team, you’ll manage relationships with selected partners and lead campaigns that help Korean artists reach more listeners at home and around the world. You’ll work with artist and label teams to understand their goals and turn them into opportunities for fans to discover and engage with their music.

job.title: Associate Director, Music Policy, Spotify for Artists
job.description:
We’re looking for a leader to manage Spotify’s Music Policy team, driving our strategy and execution for many of the most important issues facing the music industry for the next decade. As our Head of Music Policy, you will lead the team shaping the rules, standards, and incentives governing Spotify’s music ecosystem, positively impacting millions of artists around the world.

The music policy team focuses on developing and implementing policies that further our mission to provide a fair and equitable opportunity for artists, songwriters, distributors, labels, and publishers on Spotify — as well as educating the music industry about our approach. The role requires a deep understanding of the music supply chain, and will work heavily in collaboration with our tech and product teams, as well as our artist partnerships team, to build and roll out policy solutions. 

The scope of policies include how Spotify’s $11 billion+ annual royalty pool is allocated; owning policy programs like Verified by Spotify, AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, and Music Spam Filter; tactics to remove incentives for bad actors and spammers; guardrails and rules for content providers around platform integrity and metadata; and strategies to future proof our platform for new trends or technologies in the music industry, like AI. In communicating these policies publicly, our focus is to educate artists and the music industry at scale, so everyone has equal access to information and resources.

In this role, you’ll work with a cross-functional team from Licensing, Marketing, Public Affairs, Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety, Music Partnerships, Music Economics, and more in leading policy initiatives for the Spotify for Artists team — from the strategy, development, and implementation of new policies, to public messaging and education, to industry advocacy and engagement.

job.title: Backend Engineer - Subscriptions
job.description:
Our mission on the Advertising Product & Technology team is to build a next generation advertising platform that aligns with our unique value proposition for audio and video. We work to scale the user experience for hundreds of millions of fans and hundreds of thousands of advertisers. This scale brings unique challenges as well as tremendous opportunities for our artists and creators.

At Spotify, our Subscriptions mission helps make the subscription experience seamless and reliable for millions of listeners around the world. We're building the technology that supports subscribers throughout their journey, from their first purchase to renewals, plan changes, and beyond.

We're looking for a Backend Engineer to join Rover, the team responsible for Spotify's core subscription system. Our services manage the lifecycle of every Spotify subscription, including activation, renewals, plan changes, grace periods, and cancellations.

You'll help build and improve the backend services and data systems that millions of subscribers depend on. Whether you're growing your engineering experience or looking for a new technical challenge, you'll have opportunities to learn, collaborate, and make a meaningful impact on Spotify's subscription experience.

job.title: Client Partner - Emerging & Scaled (French Speaking)
job.description:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 

Sell what you love. For us - and millions of users across the globe - that’s Spotify. If you’re ready to join a team that’s passionate, innovative, and driven, then this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact. At Spotify, our Sales team isn’t just about selling creative solutions, it’s about shaping how the world connects with music and podcasts. We use our deep expertise in ad products, sales channels, and industry trends to redefine our clients’ experience and unlock growth opportunities.

We are looking for an exceptional Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled team, one of the fastest-growing units within Spotify’s Ad Sales organization. This role is perfect for someone who wakes up every morning excited to connect with clients and inspire them with the power of Spotify. 

You bring curiosity, resilience, and a collaborative mindset, along with a passion for building meaningful client partnerships. Integrity and a healthy work-life balance are non-negotiable. You’ll shape how Spotify advertisers reach audiences and elevate their connection to our platform. Collaborating closely with fellow EU Client Partners and Sales leadership, you’ll grow and expand Spotify’s advertising presence with advertisers in France.

job.title: Editor, UK & Ireland
job.description:
The Music Mission team owns Spotify’s end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale.

Editorial UK & Ireland sits at the heart of the listener experience on Spotify. We reflect culture and drive artist discovery through playlists, storytelling formats, and tools, with a focus on new music. As our Pop Editor, you’ll bring deep cultural expertise and a data-informed approach to shape how millions of people discover music across playlists, video, and other parts of the app.

job.title: Head of Advertising Business Development, New York
job.description:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 
Reporting to the VP of Advertising and Commercial Partnerships, you'll own deal architecture end to end. That means deciding which partners we pursue and why alongside cross-functional and strategy leaders, structuring and negotiating the deals, and making sure every partnership is commercially ready to drive revenue once signed.

job.title: Head of Measurement & Advertising Effectiveness
job.description:
Spotify is building the next generation of advertising, connecting brands with audiences through audio, video, and experiences that are deeply embedded in people's lives. As our advertising business evolves, demonstrating the impact of advertising on Spotify, and helping advertisers achieve better outcomes, will be critical to our long-term success.

We are seeking a Head of Measurement & Advertising Effectiveness to define how Spotify proves the value of its advertising, advances measurement science, and makes advertiser effectiveness a lasting competitive advantage.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Advertising, you will be a member of the global Advertising leadership team, operating within a business with end-to-end P&L accountability. You will play an influential role in shaping our strategy, guiding investment priorities, and strengthening the value we deliver to advertisers.

This is an opportunity to build and lead a differentiated measurement and effectiveness organization at a time when the industry is being reshaped by AI, evolving privacy expectations, and increasing demand for measurable business outcomes. We are looking for a leader who combines scientific rigor, strategic vision, commercial judgment, and exceptional people leadership—and who can represent Spotify as a credible and influential voice in the industry.

job.title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager II
job.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

At Spotify, great personalization is about more than recommending the right song. It's about creating listening experiences that feel effortless and meaningful while balancing the needs of listeners, creators, and our business.
The Samba team, part of Spotify's Personalization Mission, works on multi-objective balancing and sequencing for personalized listening experiences like Autoplay, Radio, and Mixes. Our engineers bring together machine learning, backend engineering, and data engineering to build systems that support Spotify's financial objectives while keeping listeners at the center of what we do.


We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, develop our engineers, and help shape the technical direction of systems that influence how millions of people experience Spotify.

job.description:
