job.title: Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead
job.description:
At Spotify, our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by connecting creators with fans and helping listeners discover the audio they love. As we continue to grow in India, building lasting relationships with our listeners is central to our success.

Our Marketing team plays a key role in shaping how people discover, experience and stay connected to Spotify. We're looking for a Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead to develop strategies that deepen listener engagement, reduce churn and bring inactive users back. You'll combine consumer insights, data and creativity to build experiences that give listeners more reasons to return to Spotify.

job.title: Senior Accountant, General Ledger Accounting
job.description:
We are looking for a Senior Accountant to join our Global Record to Report (RTR) team. Our close is evolving fast, and we’re looking for someone who combines strong accounting judgment with curiosity about how AI and automation can change how we work, and who wants to help build that future rather than wait for it.

As a Senior Accountant on the General Ledger team, you will own key close processes end to end, from preparation and analysis to explaining results to partners across Finance. You will use data and AI tools to remove manual work, spend more of your time on review and insight, and help shape how a lean, global team scales.

job.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Subscriptions
job.description:
The Subscriptions Mission builds and scales the products, platforms, and business models that turn free listeners into lifelong Premium subscribers. We focus on attracting new subscribers, improving conversion and retention, and creating seamless commerce experiences that support Spotify's growth and bring fans closer to the creators they love.

At Spotify, subscription data helps shape the decisions and experiences behind our 700M+ monthly active users and 290M+ Premium subscribers. You'll join a collaborative team building the backend systems that power merchandising, personalized experiences, and subscription journeys at a global scale. Your work will help listeners discover the value of Premium and give them more reasons to stay.

job.title: Senior Director, Global Advertising Product Marketing
job.description:
Spotify is shaping the future of advertising by connecting brands with fans through audio, video, and experiences that are part of people's everyday lives. As our advertising business grows, we're focused on bringing innovative products to market, helping advertisers succeed, and turning new ideas into meaningful business growth.

We're looking for a Senior Director, Global Advertising Product Marketing to lead the next chapter of our global Advertising Product Marketing team. Reporting to the Head of Advertising Business Marketing, you'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing leaders to shape product strategy, strengthen our market position, and help advertisers get more value from Spotify.

This is an opportunity to build and lead a product marketing function with a clear voice in product decisions and a direct impact on business growth. You'll bring customer insights into product development, establish a disciplined approach to go-to-market execution and product adoption, create compelling reasons for advertisers to choose Spotify, and help a global team deliver measurable results.

job.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Agentic Products
job.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Generative AI is changing what Spotify’s products can do and how they’re built. When listeners can describe what they want in natural language, our products can meet more needs and build richer connections between listeners and the things they love. As Senior Engineering Manager for Agentic Products, you’ll lead multiple teams that prototype, design, and build Spotify’s consumer-facing AI products, and you’ll set technical strategy in a fast-moving space alongside partners across the company.

job.title: Senior Product Manager - Free and Premium Conversion
job.description:
Hundreds of millions of people come to Spotify to listen for free. Our ambition is to make that experience great while helping listeners discover the value of Premium. Getting that balance right is one of the most important opportunities for Spotify's continued growth.

The Freemium Funnel team shapes the journey from Free listening to Premium subscription and beyond. We bring together Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Research, and Marketing to understand what listeners value, remove barriers to conversion, and create experiences that make Premium a compelling choice.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Free and Conversion Surfaces team. You'll shape how listeners engage with Spotify Free, discover Premium, make the decision to subscribe, and experience their first moments as paying subscribers. From Premium education to conversion experiences and early retention, you'll work on meaningful product challenges that directly influence Spotify's growth.

This is an opportunity to think strategically, build at scale, and turn complex challenges into simple, engaging experiences that work for both our listeners and our business.

job.title: Senior Product Manager — Subscriptions (Freemium)
job.description:
Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.

The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on helping listeners discover, experience, and unlock the full value of Spotify through awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to help shape the future of Spotify's Freemium experience. You'll lead product initiatives that make Premium more compelling, improve the journey from Free to Paid, and create experiences that reflect the needs of local audiences. Working closely with engineering, design, data science, research, marketing, and regional teams, you'll turn consumer insights into meaningful product experiences that drive sustainable subscriber growth.

job.title: VP, Head of Engineering - Advertising
job.description:
Our mission on the Advertising Product & Technology team is to build a next generation advertising platform that aligns with our unique value proposition for audio and video. We work to scale the user experience for hundreds of millions of fans and hundreds of thousands of advertisers. This scale brings unique challenges as well as tremendous opportunities for our artists and creators.

Spotify is building the next generation of advertising, investing in the technology and capabilities that enable advertisers to reach audiences, deliver relevant experiences, and achieve measurable business outcomes across audio, video, and beyond.

As our advertising business evolves, the scale, intelligence, reliability, and efficiency of our technology platform will be fundamental to our ability to compete and grow.

We are seeking a VP, Head of Engineering, Advertising to define and lead our global advertising engineering strategy, strengthen and scale our technology platform, and shape the architecture and engineering capabilities required for Spotify Advertising's future.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Advertising, you will be a member of the global Advertising leadership team, operating within a business with end-to-end P&L accountability. You will lead a large, multidisciplinary organization spanning Advertising Engineering and Insights, working closely with Product, Data, and Commercial leadership.

This is an opportunity to shape the future of a sophisticated advertising technology platform, advancing real-time decisioning, machine learning, AI, and engineering excellence while building the technical foundation for a significantly larger business.

We are looking for an exceptional engineering executive who combines deep technical and architectural judgment, experience leading at scale, strong commercial instincts, and the ability to build outstanding engineering organizations.

job.title: VP, Head of Product - Advertising
job.description:
Our mission on the Advertising Product & Technology team is to build a next generation advertising platform that aligns with our unique value proposition for audio and video. We work to scale the user experience for hundreds of millions of fans and hundreds of thousands of advertisers. This scale brings unique challenges as well as tremendous opportunities for our artists and creators.

Spotify has the opportunity to build one of the world's most distinctive advertising businesses at the intersection of audio, video, display, and creator culture, powered by deep audience insights and a global platform reaching hundreds of millions of people.

We're looking for a VP, Head of Product, Advertising to help define what advertising on Spotify becomes. Building on the transformation of our advertising platform, you'll shape the next generation of advertising products and experiences, how brands connect with audiences, and unlock new opportunities for growth. You'll balance strengthening and scaling our core platform with creating entirely new products, capabilities, and business opportunities that differentiate Spotify in the market.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Advertising, you'll be a member of the global Advertising leadership team within a business with end-to-end P&L accountability. You'll set the strategic direction for our advertising product portfolio, lead a global Product and Design organization, and partner closely with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Business Development, and Partnerships to translate Spotify's unique position in content, culture, and technology into compelling advertiser experiences and sustainable business growth.

job.title: Client Strategy Leader, Enterprise AI Solutions
job.description:
About Us

Stagwell (NASDAQ: STGW) is the challenger network built to transform marketing. Founded in 2015 by Mark Penn with backing from former Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer, Stagwell grew from launch to nearly $3 billion in revenue in ten years ($2.9 billion in 2025). Today 13,000+ employees across 70+ agencies in more than 40 countries serve 4,500+ clients, including some of the world's most recognized brands.

Mark, our Chairman and CEO, has spent five decades at the intersection of data, technology, and strategy. He was Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy Officer of Microsoft, CEO of the global communications firm Burson-Marsteller, co-founder of the polling firm Penn Schoen, a presidential pollster and strategist, and author of the bestselling Microtrends. Under his leadership, Stagwell is leaning hard into AI: through Stagwell AI, we build agentic AI solutions that connect data, intelligence, and execution for the world's most ambitious brands.

Agentic AI will change the marketing profession. AI agents that research, plan, create, launch, and optimize alongside marketers will let brands move faster and spend smarter. It is one of the fastest-growing categories in technology (Gartner projects agentic AI software spending will approach $1 trillion by 2030), and marketing is one of the functions where AI is expected to create the most value. Stagwell is building for it: in January 2026 we launched The Machine, which we call marketing's first agentic operating system, and our Machines reach the world's largest brands through Stagwell's agencies and clients.

Stagwell AI is seeking a client-focused, commercially minded Client Strategy Leader, Enterprise AI Solutions to lead how our clients adopt, get value from, and grow with the Machines, our AI-powered marketing solutions. You will join Stagwell's Enterprise AI Solutions go-to-market organization, a new Stagwell-level team that sells the Machines across Stagwell's agencies, clients, and partners. We start with a small founding team in every function and scale on what the data shows works.

This is a player-coach role reporting to the SVP, Enterprise AI Solutions. At launch there is no separate implementation team: you and your customer success managers own go-live, adoption, value realization, and first-line support. You will run the first go-lives personally, and build account strategies with Account Executives and agency client leads that turn a first Machine into a multi-Machine program.

Responsibilities

  • Own the post-sale journey: onboarding, go-live, adoption, value reviews, and renewal readiness.
  • Run the first go-lives personally while building and coaching the customer success team.
  • Build customer success plans, health scores, and playbooks for each Machine.
  • Lead executive business reviews that show measurable outcomes and return on investment.
  • Build account growth plans with Account Executives and agency client leads: which Machine comes next, for which team, and when; hand expansion opportunities to the AE and partner on renewals.
  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, agency delivery teams, and the existing Machine teams on implementation and support.
  • Turn customer feedback into product priorities with Product and Engineering.
  • Report on adoption, account health, and retention to leadership.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in customer success, client strategy, account management, or client services for B2B technology, including team leadership.
  • Experience owning onboarding, implementation coordination, adoption, and renewals for enterprise clients.
  • Track record of improving retention and showing measurable customer outcomes.
  • Builds trusted relationships with senior executives and day-to-day practitioners.
  • Strong analytical and project management skills.
  • Commercial acumen for renewals and expansion.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in SaaS, AI, marketing technology, advertising, or media.
  • Supported customers adopting generative or agentic AI.
  • Built a customer success function from scratch, using platforms such as Gainsight or Planhat.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What Success Looks Like 

  • On-time go-lives: New customers go live on schedule without a separate implementation team.
  • Faster time to value: Customers reach their first measurable outcome quickly.
  • Retention and growth: Clients renew and add Machines, with expansion plans agreed with the AE and agency team.
  • A clear health view: Leadership has a reliable view of adoption and account health.

 

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of total compensation for this role is $160K (70/30 split). Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

  • Scope work realistically and hand off cleanly to Customer Success and delivery teams for go-live.
  • Share field feedback with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in solutions engineering, sales engineering, pre-sales, or solution architecture, including team leadership.
  • Experience supporting complex B2B technology, SaaS, AI, or data sales.
  • Strong grasp of AI and its practical use in business workflows, plus APIs, integrations, and data platforms.
  • Proven at running executive demonstrations and proofs of concept that convert.
  • Clear storyteller who can explain technical concepts to executives and engineers alike.
  • Commercially minded about scope, complexity, and value.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in marketing technology, advertising, media, or marketing analytics.
  • Built agentic AI, LLM, or retrieval-based solutions for enterprise clients.
  • Built or scaled a solutions engineering team in a growing technology company.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • Coverage that scales: Every seller has solutions support, and the team grows with the sales team.
  • Higher technical win rates: More qualified opportunities pass technical evaluation and close.
  • Faster cycles: Structured discovery and tailored demos shorten time to decision.
  • Deliverable solutions: What we sell goes live on time and on scope.

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of total compensation for this role is $250K OTE (70/30 split). Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

job.title: Director, Travel & Expense (T&E) Procurement
job.description:
About Us

Stagwell empowers talented, passionate, and creative leaders with vision to deliver breakthrough ideas on behalf of the world’s most ambitious clients.We believe that the differences among us fuel innovation and drive us to achieve extraordinary results. We take great pride in a work force with rich diversity of age, race, ethnicity, gender, nationality, sexual orientation, ability and background. As a network, we seek out a skilled and dynamic talent pipeline, invest in programs that help develop diverse talent for the future benefit of our industry, and strive to build an inclusive environment where all employees can bring their full selves to work.Creating a collaborative environment at our state-of-the-art campuses, where we can bring people together at the office to inspire and innovate, is central to our culture-moving creative edge. We believe that by being together, we can transform marketing. Join us at www.stagwellglobal.com. 

Overview

The Director, Travel & Expense (T&E) Procurement, will be a key leader within the Global Operations team, reporting directly to the VP of Global Procurement. This individual will be responsible for developing and executing the global sourcing strategy for enterprise-wide travel & expense programs. This role owns supplier strategy, commercial negotiations, policy governance, stakeholder engagement, and program performance across key categories including air, hotel, ground transportation, travel management services, expense management platforms, and corporate card programs. 

 

This person will partner closely with Finance, HR, Tax, Treasury, Legal & IT, and business leaders across Stagwell Global to deliver best-in-class traveler experience while optimizing total cost of ownership, supplier performance, compliance, and risk management. This leader will drive strategic initiatives that support operational excellence, policy & program adoption across the Travel & Expense ecosystem. 

Responsibilities

Category Strategy & Leadership 

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive global sourcing strategy for Travel & Expense categories.

  • Establish short and long term category roadmaps aligned with corporate objectives and business growth plans.

  • Continuously assess market trends, supplier innovations, industry benchmarks, and emerging technologies to identify value creation opportunities.

  • Lead strategic sourcing initiatives and enterprise wide procurement projects supporting business priorities. 

Supplier Management & Strategic Sourcing 

  • Direct competitive sourcing events, contract negotiations, and supplier selection processes.

  • Manage strategic relationships with:  

    • Travel Management Companies (TMCs)

    • Airlines

    • Hotel chains

    • Ground transportation providers

    • Corporate card issuers

    • Expense management software providers

    • Meetings and events partners 

  • Establish supplier governance frameworks, scorecards, and business review processes.

  • Identify and implement supplier consolidation, optimization, and cost reduction opportunities. 

Travel Program Management 

  • Oversee the organization's travel program, policies, and preferred supplier agreements.

  • Partner with business leaders to balance cost management, traveler satisfaction, duty of care, and operational effectiveness.

  • Drive traveler adoption of preferred channels and compliance with company policy.

  • Lead initiatives related to traveler experience, sustainability, and digital travel solutions. 

Expense & Payment Program Management 

  • Manage procurement support for expense management platforms and corporate card programs.

  • Collaborate with Finance and Treasury to optimize payment solutions, incentive programs, and controls.

  • Drive compliance with expense policies and identify opportunities for process simplification and automation.

  • Support reporting and analytics to improve employee experience and expense visibility. 

 

Stakeholder Engagement 

  • Serve as the primary procurement advisor for senior executives and key functional stakeholders.

  • Build trusted partnerships across Finance, HR, IT, Treasury, Tax, Legal and Internal Audit.

  • Facilitate governance committees and executive reviews related to travel and expense programs.

  • Influence decision-making through data-driven recommendations and business cases. 

Financial Performance & Analytics 

  • Deliver annual productivity, cost savings, and value creation targets.

  • Develop KPIs and dashboards to measure program effectiveness, supplier performance, compliance, and traveler satisfaction.

  • Monitor category spend, market conditions, and supplier economics to optimize commercial outcomes.

  • Leverage analytics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. 

Risk Management & Compliance 

  • Ensure supplier contracts comply with legal, regulatory, data privacy, and security requirements.

  • Partner with Risk Management and Security teams to support traveler safety and duty-of-care programs.

  • Maintain strong internal controls and audit readiness.

  • Monitor geopolitical, operational, and supplier risks that may impact business continuity. 

Team Leadership 

  • Lead, coach, and develop supporting roles.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Partner with VP, Global Procurement to assess and improve procurement processes that enhance efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and service quality. This will include but not limited to; Honing operational needs, reporting, dashboards, initiative tracking, tools, communication and data gathering.

Qualifications

Required 

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, Finance, Economics, or related field.

  • 10+ years of procurement, strategic sourcing, or category management experience.

  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing teams and cross-functional initiatives.

  • Significant experience managing and implementing Travel & Expense programs, corporate travel, procurement, or related indirect spend categories.

  • Demonstrated success negotiating complex commercial agreements and driving measurable savings.

  • Strong financial acumen and analytical capabilities.

  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills. 

 

Preferred 

  • Master's degree (MBA or related discipline).

  • Professional certifications such as CPSM, CPSD, C.P.M., GTP, or equivalent.

  • Experience with travel and expense platforms such as well as brings experience with new partners to the table.

  • Experience supporting a global, multinational organization.

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of base compensation in New York City for this role is $125,000-170,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

job.title: Manager, Revenue Operations
job.description:
About Us

The Marketing Cloud (TMC) is Stagwell's technology division, bringing together marketing technology, media intelligence, AI-driven products, and data solutions that help brands better understand audiences and drive growth.

Overview

The Marketing Cloud is seeking a Manager, Revenue Operations to join a team focused on leveraging financial data to help the business scale.  This is a senior position responsible for creating a predictable, scalable, and data-driven revenue engine across Sales, Marketing, and Finance teams supporting a dozen differentiated global brands. The role will build and lead the systems, processes, and insights that power our growing revenue organization. The role will partner with sales leadership across the company to provide timely, fact-based, data-driven decision support to help drive critical revenue decisions supporting our mandate for growth at all costs. This includes forecasting, territory and quota planning, pipeline management, reporting, systems, new product roadmaps, process optimization, and cross-functional GTM planning.  This is a forward-looking team.  We support a global business with a diverse product set and go to market strategy.  The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced and consistently evolving environment.  This role requires an ability to build close working relationships with stakeholders across the business.  A revenue first mindset and constant focus on driving growth and long-term scale is expected, along with a strategic and hands-on approach dynamic enough to establish best practice, bring together disparate data, and handle ad hoc requests with ease.  Excellent communication skills and an ability to work within a global organization are required.  This is a unique opportunity to build processes, take ownership, and make an immediate impact while growing alongside the business.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with C-level and Sales leadership across our brands to develop strategies for scaling the revenue organization, introducing new products and services to market, pricing, packaging, and new monetization opportunities
  • Identify opportunities to improve revenue growth, productivity, and retention through data and operational insights
  • Develop forecasting methodologies, pipeline coverage models, and performance benchmarks
  • Monitor pipeline health, conversion rates, sales cycles, win rates, churn, retention, and expansion
  • Identify risks and opportunities within the revenue funnel and proactively recommend actions
  • Establish a single source of truth for pipeline, forecast, and revenue reporting
  • Build and mature scalable processes, playbooks, and workflows across the revenue lifecycle
  • Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies and implement solutions that improve conversion, productivity, and time-to-close
  • Drive consistent process adoption across Sales teams
  • Continuously assess whether existing systems and tools are effectively supporting the needs of the business
  • Build scalable infrastructure that can support continued growth and scale
  • Build dashboards, reporting, and analytical models for Sales and executive leadership
  • Translate complex data into clear business insights and actionable recommendations
  • Develop reporting that enables leaders to understand performance, identify trends, and make better decisions
  • Ensure leadership has a clear understanding of the health and trajectory of the pipeline
  • Deeply understand and effectively communicate the business to internal and external stakeholders
  • Use our tools and systems to streamline processes, improve visibility and understanding, and increase team efficiency
  • Identify, develop, implement, and champion financial and non-financial KPIs that are tangible to the business

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of progressive Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, or FP&A experience, ideally at a global, technology focused, Rule of 40 company
  • Experience building or significantly scaling a RevOps organization, ideally in a growth-stage company
  • Proven experience with forecasting, revenue planning, territory design, quota setting, pipeline management, and GTM analytics
  • Experience in varied forecasting ERPs (Salesforce, Hubspot, OneStream, and Maconomy a plus)
  • Demonstrated history of working with C-level, board, or senior leadership teams
  • Keen attention to detail and financial data accuracy
  • Strong analytical, financial, and data modeling skills
  • Experience using data and technology to improve revenue performance and operational efficiency
  • A growth mindset

Compensation

150K

job.title: New Business Development Associate
job.description:
About Us

Numetrix combines consumer research and location intelligence to help you clearly define, measure, and understand real-world consumer behavior. We deliver the evidence-based insights you need to make confident decisions about audiences, media, and investment, grounded in verified data, not assumptions.

Overview

Numetrix is seeking a New Business Development Associate to help grow its client base across mobility data, survey, research, and measurement solutions. 

This role is designed for an early-career sales professional who is motivated by prospecting, building relationships, and creating new business opportunities. The ideal candidate is curious, persistent, comfortable with outbound outreach, and eager to develop their consultative selling skills within the data, research, and measurement space. 

The successful candidate will focus primarily on building pipeline and developing mid-market opportunities across brands, agencies, media organizations, and other potential buyers of Numetrix's solutions. 

This is a hands-on hunter role offering the opportunity to build a foundation in new-business development while gaining exposure to increasingly sophisticated data, research, and measurement solutions. 

Responsibilities

  • Generate new business opportunities through consistent outbound prospecting and relationship development. 
  • Research and identify prospective clients, decision-makers, and relevant business opportunities.

  • Support and increasingly own opportunities through presentations, proposals, follow-up, negotiation, and close.

Qualifications

Required Experience 

  • 1+ years of experience in sales, business development, client services, research, media, marketing, analytics, or a related field. 
  • Demonstrated interest in building a career in new-business development and consultative sales. 
  • Strong communication skills with the confidence to engage prospective clients and ask thoughtful questions. 
  • Self-motivated and persistent, with the organization and follow-through required for consistent outbound prospecting. 
  • Ability to learn new products and concepts quickly and communicate their value clearly. 
  • Comfort working toward measurable activity, pipeline, and performance goals. 
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 

 

Preferred Background

  • Previous experience with outbound prospecting, lead generation, or client-facing work.

This role also includes a commission incentive. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

job.title: Regional VP, Sales, Enterprise AI Solutions
job.description:
About Us

Stagwell (NASDAQ: STGW) is the challenger network built to transform marketing. Founded in 2015 by Mark Penn with backing from former Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer, Stagwell grew from launch to nearly $3 billion in revenue in ten years ($2.9 billion in 2025). Today 13,000+ employees across 55+ agencies in more than 40 countries serve 4,500+ clients, including some of the world's most recognized brands.

Mark, our Chairman and CEO, has spent five decades at the intersection of data, technology, and strategy. He was Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy Officer of Microsoft, CEO of the global communications firm Burson-Marsteller, co-founder of the polling firm Penn Schoen, a presidential pollster and strategist, and author of the bestselling Microtrends. Under his leadership, Stagwell is leaning hard into AI: through Stagwell AI, we build agentic AI solutions that connect data, intelligence, and execution for the world's most ambitious brands.

The Opportunity

Agentic AI will change the marketing profession. AI agents that research, plan, create, launch, and optimize alongside marketers will let brands move faster and spend smarter. It is one of the fastest-growing categories in technology (Gartner projects agentic AI software spending will approach $1 trillion by 2030), and marketing is one of the functions where AI is expected to create the most value. Stagwell is building for it: in January 2026 we launched The Machine, which we call marketing's first agentic operating system, and our Machines reach the world's largest brands through Stagwell's agencies and clients.

Stagwell AI is seeking a hands-on, coaching-focused RVP of Sales, Enterprise AI Solutions to lead a team of Account Executives who sell the Machines, our AI-powered marketing solutions, to Stagwell's largest clients and to new companies. You will join Stagwell's Enterprise AI Solutions go-to-market organization, a new Stagwell-level team that sells the Machines across Stagwell's agencies, clients, and partners. We start with a small founding team in every function and scale on what the data shows works.

This is a first-line, player-coach sales leadership role reporting to the SVP, Enterprise AI Solutions. You will directly manage a team of about 8 individual contributors: Account Executives for strategic accounts (Stagwell's largest clients) and New Logo (companies not yet Stagwell clients), plus business development representatives. You will work closely with the partnership manager and the sales leaders for agency accounts, join key deals, and carry some personally while the team ramps.

Responsibilities

  • Own your team's pipeline, forecast, and annual contract value target; run weekly deal and forecast reviews.
  • Hire, onboard, and coach your Account Executives and BDRs through ramp to full productivity.
  • Keep account ownership and coverage clear for every seller, working with RevOps on territories and credit rules.
  • Join key deals: discovery, executive meetings, proposals, negotiation, and close.
  • Work with agency teams on co-selling, with Stagwell's growth team on direct pitches, and with the partnership manager on partner deals.
  • Coach on account planning, consultative selling, and deal strategy; inspect activity and pipeline every week.
  • Feed win/loss insight back into our ICP, personas, use cases, and messaging.

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of total compensation for this role is $450K - 500K OTE (50/50 split). Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

job.title: Senior Manager, Indirect Procurement
job.description:
About Us

Stagwell empowers talented, passionate, and creative leaders with vision to deliver breakthrough ideas on behalf of the world's most ambitious clients.We believe that the differences among us fuel innovation and drive us to achieve extraordinary results. We take great pride in a workforce with rich diversity of age, race, ethnicity, gender, nationality, sexual orientation, ability and background. As a network, we seek out a skilled and dynamic talent pipeline, invest in programs that help develop diverse talent for the future benefit of our industry, and strive to build an inclusive environment where all employees can bring their full selves to work.Creating a collaborative environment at our state-of-the-art campuses, where we can bring people together at the office to inspire and innovate, is central to our culture-moving creative edge. We believe that by being together, we can transform marketing. Join us at www.stagwellglobal.com.

Overview

The Senior Manager, Indirect Procurement is responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies across General & Administrative (G&A) spend categories to optimize cost, mitigate risk, improve supplier performance, and support business objectives. This role reports to the VP, Global procurement and partners closely with functional leaders across Human Resources, Finance, Legal, Business Applications, and other corporate functions to deliver strategic procurement solutions and measurable business value. 

 

The successful candidate will lead sourcing initiatives, manage strategic supplier relationships, negotiate complex commercial agreements, and drive continuous improvement opportunities across the indirect procurement portfolio. This role requires strong business acumen, stakeholder management capabilities, and the ability to influence decisions across a diverse set of functional partners. 

Responsibilities

  • Category Strategy & Execution: As key member of the procurement team you will have an opportunity to shape the category strategy across the Stagwell network, driving initiatives that ensure businesses have the right tools, services, and resources at the best possible value.

  • Contractual Organization: Ownership of category contractual life cycle management across MSA, Pricing, Enterprise and other agreements collaborating with Legal, Finance, Brand CFOs and other cross functional departments to ensure contracts are optimized, compliant, and effectively structured to meet the needs of Stagwell’s global network.

  • Vendor Management & Negotiations: Develop and maintain relationships with key vendors, ensuring quality service delivery, owning the state of the partnership, via continuous improvement and risk mitigation. Negotiate favorable terms and pricing based on an in-depth understanding of business needs and spend data.

  • Spend Analysis & Reporting: Work closely with FP&A, Business Applications and ERP teams to track and analyze category spend across all areas of the business. Use data to identify opportunities for cost optimization, strategic sourcing and consolidation.

  • Tool & Product Knowledge: Gain an in-depth understanding of the category tools, products, and services used by Stagwell businesses, collaborating with internal stakeholders to identify gaps, needs, and opportunities to improve operations.

  • Process Improvement: Partner with VP, Global Procurement to assess and improve procurement processes that enhance efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and service quality. This will include but not limited to; Honing operational needs, reporting, dashboards, initiative tracking, tools, communication and data gathering. 

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, Finance, Economics, or related field.

  • 5 - 10+ years of procurement, strategic sourcing, or category management experience.

  • Demonstrated success leading strategic sourcing initiatives and supplier negotiations including but not limited to large-scale software, cloud and technology agreements.

  • Experience managing indirect or G&A spend categories.  

  • Strong analytical, financial, and commercial acumen.  

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.  

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and complex stakeholder environments. 

Preferred 

  • Professional certifications such as CPSM, CPSD, C.P.M., CSCP, or equivalent.

  • Experience supporting a global, multinational organization.

  • Experience using sourcing, contract management, and spend analytics platforms.

  • Knowledge of software asset management, FinOps, cloud economics, and third-party risk management practices. 

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of total compensation for this role is $110,000–150,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Stephens Media Group is a privately-owned company that helps to generate revenue for local businesses. We do this by communicating the right message, to the right audiences, so businesses can start seeing new customers right away.

We are looking for a skilled Account Executive to find business opportunities and manage customer relationships. You’ll be directly responsible for the preservation and expansion of our customer base. The ideal candidate will have a passion for sales and experience in media and digital advertising with exceptional customer service. The right candidate is a reliable professional able to achieve a balance between customer orientation and a results-driven approach.   • Present products & capabilities to prospective clients

Send materials to Laurie Hammermeister

job.title: Stingray Jobs
job.description:
Department Sales Location Toronto

At Stingray, creativity, collaboration, and innovative technology are at the core of our DNA. Are you ready to rock your career by joining a fast-growing company and a team of music enthusiasts in a stimulating and fun work environment? 

We are currently looking for a passionate, experienced Digital Campaign Manager to join our fun, creative, and energetic team! This position reports to the Ad Operations Manager, and is ideally located in Toronto but open to candidates located anywhere Stingray Radio has an office.

At Stingray, we aim to deliver the best digital offerings to our clients. We offer a full range of products, including audio streaming, programmatic display and video, connected TV, digital out-of-home, social, and search engine marketing solutions.

Your day-to-day

  • Manage the execution and optimization of digital advertising campaigns across various platforms, including Adswizz, Meta, Google, DV360, Hivestack and StackAdapt.
  • Manage campaign setup, pacing, performance tracking, and continuous optimization to ensure client objectives are met.
  • Respond to rep and client inquiries and help prepare strategic proposals.

  • Function as an internal and external expert for proposals
  • Attend client meetings, covering campaign reporting, analytics insights, and optimization recommendations
  • Collaborate closely with sales and creative to ensure seamless execution of digital campaigns
  • Proactively identify opportunities for campaign improvement and process optimization
  • Partner with sales reps to deliver account reporting by compiling campaign performance data into customized KPI-driven client reports and analysis.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Your qualifications

  • Minimum 3+ years’ experience running streaming audio campaigns
  • You have strong multi-tasking, analytical and problem-solving skills
  • You are detail oriented, and deadline driven
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong understanding of digital media platforms including Adswizz, Meta, Google, DZ360, Hivestack, Bing and Stackadapt.
  • Must have experience working on accounts with a clean compliance history and no prior violations of platform policies.

Life at Stingray

  • A positive, team-oriented work environment
  • An opportunity to work with and learn from the best in the business
  • Pension Plan and Share Purchase Plan (with a contribution from Stingray)
  • Comprehensive benefits plan and Employee and Family Assistance Plan
  • Hybrid work policy (for positions that qualify)
  • And much more!

Stingray Group Inc. is a leading music, media, and technology company with over 1,200 employees worldwide. As a premium provider of curated direct-to-consumer and B2B services, we reach 400 million subscribers in 156 countries.

job.title: IT Engineer
job.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

Our Los Angeles office is home to Suno's largest concentration of musicians, producers, and music-industry partners, and the technology they depend on is different from a typical office: studios, DAWs, audio interfaces, monitoring, high-resolution playback, and the networks and storage that move large sessions around. As Staff IT Engineer, you'll own the audio and studio technology domain for Suno company-wide — designing, building, and supporting the production environments our Music team works in — while also serving as the senior IT presence on the ground in LA. You'll report to the Senior Manager, IT Operations and work alongside IT Engineers in Cambridge, NYC, and San Francisco, who manage identity, endpoint, SaaS, and office-infrastructure. You'll work with the rest of the team to manage our Corporate IT systems stack, but you'll be our audio and A/V expert. Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/ldMCcRAh5ln0LgNA

What You'll Do

Run IT for the LA office — identity and onboarding, endpoint management, SaaS Administration, wired/wireless networking, zero-trust VPN, and A/V and videoconferencing. Own audio and studio systems as a domain — set the standard for how Suno builds and supports production spaces across offices: studio and listening-room design in partnership with acousticians and integrators, DAW and plugin management, audio interfaces and I/O, monitoring and calibration, and the storage and networking that production work needs. Support the Music team at a professional bar — keep sessions running; manage DAW environments (Pro Tools, Logic, Ableton, and others), licensing, plugin fleets, and audio drivers across a Mac fleet; troubleshoot latency, clocking, and routing problems the rest of IT can't. Partner on the product — work with Engineering and the Suno Studio team to make sure internal creators have the hardware, routing, and environments they need to use and test our tools the way professional producers do. Design for the next space — specify audio, A/V, and network requirements for LA buildouts and expansions and for studio spaces in other offices; manage integrators and vendors to a result. Scale support — write runbooks and knowledge articles that let office managers and AI-powered self-service handle the routine, and automate what you've done twice.

What You'll Need

Must-Haves 10+ years of IT engineering experience, including significant time supporting professional audio production environments — studios, post-production, broadcast, live, or music-technology companies. Deep professional-audio competence — signal flow, digital audio (sample rates, clocking, word clock, Dante or AVB), DAW administration, audio interfaces and converters, monitoring and room calibration — and the ability to diagnose problems producers describe by ear. Demonstrated breadth across the IT stack — identity, endpoint, SaaS administration, networking, and office IT — with the depth to operate independently as the only IT engineer in an office.

Experience

owning a technical domain end to end — you've set the standard others follow, not just executed it. Strong written and verbal communication — you can work comfortably with producers, engineers, executives, and vendors, and translate between them. Learning agility — you pick up new platforms quickly, you're comfortable being the first person at the company to figure something out, and you aren't afraid to ask for help. Nice-to-Haves Studio design and buildout

experience

— acoustic treatment, room tuning, patchbay and infrastructure design, working with acousticians and AV integrators. Hands-on

experience

with a modern IdP (Okta or equivalent), modern Apple MDM (Iru, Jamf, Jumpcloud), and endpoint security (CrowdStrike or similar). Networking depth — AV-over-IP, multicast, QoS for audio networks, and managed switching.

Experience

supporting creative or music teams at a technology company, or IT at a label, studio, or music-tech company. Comfort with at least one scripting language (Python, TypeScript, or Bash) and config-as-code approaches. Working knowledge of music production — you've made or recorded music yourself.

Work Location

Policy This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. Willingness to travel (up to 20%) to collaborate with team members and support studio spaces across Suno office locations. Perks &

Benefits

for Full-Time Employees Company Equity Package 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k) Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options) 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave Creative

Education

Stipend Generous Commuter Allowance In-Office Lunch (5 days per week) Compensation: The annual salary range for this role is $160K-$217K + target equity +

benefits

(including medical, dental, vision, and 401k) Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

As a Senior/Staff Software Engineer on Suno’s new Bots & Fraud team, you’ll design and build the backend systems behind our defenses against abuse, fraud, and bots. You’ll build real-time services that turn request telemetry, behavioral signals, and device and app attestation into enforcement, such as rate limits, challenges, and account actions, across every layer from the edge to product services. The team is new and pulls together work from across the company, so you’ll help shape what we build and how we build it. You’ll report to the Bots & Fraud Engineering Manager. Listen to the Suno version of this role! https://suno.com/s/rieJJLO5xgUm2L0B

What You'll Do

Design and build backend services for real-time abuse, fraud, and bot defense, including rate limiters, challenge flows (CAPTCHA, proof-of-work, 2FA), rules engines, and account enforcement APIs. Deploy defenses from the edge to product services, with detection and enforcement that’s easy to roll back, auditable, and low-friction for real users. Build the logging and metrics that show what’s getting through, what we block, and our false-positive rate. Protect high-value flows, including signup, login, payments, and song generation, from account farming, credential stuffing, card testing, and credit abuse. Contribute to the new Bots and Fraud team's architecture, roadmap, and on-call rotation, and help other engineers grow through code and design reviews. Protect the people Suno is built for, so the platform stays a place where anyone can make music and that becomes part of everyday life.

experience

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KENS-TV San Antonio, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in San Antonio, is seeking a competitive, coachable and results-driven Account Executive to develop new business and grow a portfolio of advertising clients. This is an opportunity to build a career in media sales while gaining experience across broadcast television, streaming, connected TV and digital advertising.

You’ll sell one of the strongest portfolios in the market, combining the reach and trust of KENS broadcast television with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you’ll connect advertisers with the large, engaged local audiences that turn to San Antonio’s trusted news and programming. On the streaming side, you’ll leverage Premion, TEGNA’s streaming and CTV advertising business, to reach cord-cutting audiences across a premium marketplace of 125+ OTT and connected-TV publishers. Together with digital video, display and content solutions, you’ll have a powerful cross-screen portfolio to help local businesses reach their customers and achieve their goals.

We provide the coaching, tools and support to help you build your skills and your business. You bring the drive to learn, compete and succeed.

Responsibilities

Develop new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline through consistent prospecting. Research local businesses, identify key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.

Manage the full sales process. Prospect, qualify, uncover client needs, present solutions, handle objections and close business while working toward established activity and revenue goals.

Sell consultatively. Learn each client’s business and marketing goals and recommend the right mix of broadcast television, Premion streaming/CTV and digital solutions to deliver measurable results.

Build compelling proposals. Develop data-informed presentations that demonstrate how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting can work together to meet client objectives.

Grow client relationships. Build new accounts into long-term partnerships by delivering results, maintaining strong relationships and identifying opportunities for continued growth.

Manage your pipeline. Use CRM and prospecting tools to manage activity, maintain an accurate pipeline and keep opportunities moving. Partner with account, creative and product teams to deliver effective campaigns for clients.

Requirements

Competitive, self-motivated and goal-oriented with a genuine interest in building a career in sales.

Strong communication, presentation and relationship-building skills.

Coachable, curious and motivated to learn consultative media sales.

Strong organizational skills and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Interest in broadcast television, streaming/CTV and digital advertising, with a willingness to learn and stay current on the evolving media landscape.

Sales, customer service, marketing or advertising experience preferred but not required. Internships, relevant coursework and transferable experience are welcome.

Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Comfort with Microsoft Office; familiarity with CRM or digital advertising tools is a plus.

Valid driver’s license and ability to travel locally to meet with clients as needed.

Salary: Competitive base + commission

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. You then become a marketing consultant to the clients helping them define and achieve their business objectives.

Current driver's license is required.

What We Offer:

  • Winning, inclusive, collaborative, supportive, and fun culture
  • Base Salary + Uncapped Commissions
  • Leading media products
  • Training resources
  • Generous benefit
  • Career growth opportunities at one of our 64 ABC, NBC, CBS, or FOX stations.

What You Will Do:

  • Consistently prospect for new revenue opportunities using client and category insights. 
  • Upsell current clients by engaging them in the full product line of WVEC-TV offerings. 
  • Create custom solutions-driven campaigns that meet client needs across multiple media platforms including broadcast, digital, and Streaming (OTT). 
  • Seek opportunities to expand relationships with key clients by taking an active role in understanding their business needs and competitive landscape. 
  • Establish strong relationships with internal team members by providing the Account Management team with clear and concise direction for the successful execution of campaigns. 
  • Partner with your Account Manager to provide exceptional customer service and contract fulfillment. 
  • Strategically utilize Matrix and station CRM to manage day-to-day activity, pipeline, and forecasts.
  • Positively and professionally represent the media group to the community at events and surrounding businesses.

What You Need:

  • 1-3 years of account engagement in a professional, fast-paced media sales environment. 
  • Proven track record of successfully achieving or exceeding sales goals and developing new business opportunities as a seller.
  • Established knowledge of marketing solutions including broadcasting and digital advertising including audio and interactive, and be a perpetual learner, eager to continuously expand your knowledge.

KFSM 5NEWS, a TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Fayetteville–Fort Smith, Arkansas, is seeking an engaging Anchor / Multi-Skilled Journalist to lead our weekend morning newscasts and report stories that matter across Northwest Arkansas and the River Valley. This journalist will help viewers start their day informed, prepared and connected to their communities.
We are looking for a journalist with strong news judgment, clear and conversational on-air delivery, and the curiosity to find the people and context behind the headlines. The successful candidate will work closely with producers and the newsroom team to shape useful, accurate newscasts, while also reporting, shooting, writing and editing original stories for broadcast and digital platforms. This is a visible newsroom role that calls for a dependable teammate, a thoughtful community presence and a calm, flexible approach to breaking news.

Responsibilities
• Anchor 5NEWS This Morning on Saturday and Sunday with accuracy, warmth, authority and energy.
• Partner with producers, editors, photographers and newsroom leaders to plan and deliver clear, compelling newscasts; contribute ideas, editorial judgment and strong writing.
• Prepare for each broadcast by reviewing scripts, confirming facts and pronunciations, tracking developing stories and making timely updates as news changes.
• Report, write, shoot, produce and edit original stories and live reports for television, streaming, mobile and social platforms.
• Develop enterprise and community-focused stories through social listening, public records, independent research and trusted local sources.
• Build and maintain relationships with people and organizations throughout Northwest Arkansas and the River Valley, reflecting the range of communities in our viewing area.
• Use social media and digital tools to discover story ideas, engage with the audience and distribute accurate, useful journalism.
• Create or contribute to digital content, including web stories, video, live updates, images and social posts, in coordination with the newsroom.
• Deliver clear, authoritative live coverage during breaking news and severe weather, adapting quickly while following newsroom standards and direction.
• Represent 5NEWS professionally at community events
• Serve as a fill-in anchor and fulfill other duties as assigned

Requirements
• 1-3 years news anchor/reporting experience preferred
• Journalism, communications or related degree preferred
• Excellent writing, interviewing and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex issues in clear, conversational language.
• Sound editorial judgment and a demonstrated commitment to accuracy, fairness, ethics and accountability.
• Ability to shoot and edit video and produce content for broadcast and digital platforms.
• Experience with newsroom systems, editing tools and graphics
• Ability to report, publish and engage with the community on social media daily.
• Ability to work any shift in a 24/7 newsroom environment

job.title: Associate Producer
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KENS 5, the CBS affiliate in San Antonio, Texas, is seeking a highly motivated, organized, and creative Associate Producer to join our weekday morning lifestyle program, Great Day SA. This position is ideal for someone looking to grow their television production career while contributing to a dynamic, live-broadcast environment.


The Associate Producer will play a key role in the day-to-day execution of the show by helping develop engaging content, coordinating guests, managing production logistics, and supporting broadcast, digital, and social media initiatives. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, thrives under tight deadlines, embraces collaboration, and has a passion for storytelling, audience engagement, and creative content development. If this is you, apply today!


Responsibilities
•    Assist producers with the planning, coordination, and execution of daily LIVE broadcasts.
•    Research and develop segment ideas, trending topics, community stories, local events, and guest opportunities.
•    Coordinate and book guests for in-studio, remote, and pre-recorded segments.
•    Serve as a primary point of contact for guests, clients, and community partners before, during, and after their appearances.
•    Write and format segment scripts, teases, graphics information, and supporting show materials.
•    Assist with daily show rundowns and ensure all production elements are accurate, organized, and ready for air.
•    Support pre-show preparation, live production needs, and post-show follow-up.
•    Manage studio logistics, including set preparation, prop placement, display setup, and guest microphone coordination.
•    Collaborate closely with producers, hosts, editors, photographers, sales teams, and other members of the production staff.
•    Lead and manage Great Day SA's social media presence across multiple platforms.
•    Create, schedule, and publish engaging daily content that promotes upcoming segments, highlights memorable moments, and strengthens audience engagement.
•    Develop original digital content and innovative segment ideas that enhance and extend the Great Day SA brand.
•    Write compelling and accurate social media copy, website content, and promotional materials.
•    Monitor social media trends, audience analytics, and engagement metrics to identify growth opportunities and optimize performance.
•    Utilize Cuez to manage show rundowns, coordinate workflows, and facilitate communication across the production team.
•    Produce and manage original content for KENS 5 streaming platforms, including planning, writing, and executing recorded streaming shows.

Requirements
•    Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, Television Production, Film, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
•    Strong writing, communication, and organizational skills.
•    Ability to create and adapt content for broadcast, digital, web, and social media platforms.
•    Demonstrated ability to generate fresh, creative content ideas and proactively pitch segment and digital opportunities.
•    Strong understanding of social media platforms, content creation strategies, and audience engagement best practices.

The person filling this role will be tasked with the technical directing and switching of our live broadcasts using Sony ELC Production Automation. KING 5 produces over 14 hours of local content per day. We are seeking an individual who collaborates well with producers and other staff and can execute at a high level in the ever-changing world of live local news and local programming. This position is responsible for coding ELC and directing/operating studio and control room equipment to produce our locally produced content. The director works closely with a team of production professionals and news producers to place the most compelling and clean products on the air. The ideal candidate will be required to provide technical direction of live and pre-produced shows and segments as well as assist with occasional remote productions and approaches content with innovative, forward-thinking production ideas to engage a constantly changing viewer base.

Responsibilities:
•    Code and switch live newscast, recorded shows, and other local productions using Sony ELC.
•    Ability to adapt and quickly change production for breaking news and unexpected special events.
•    Knowledge and experience with operation and understanding of studio cameras, production switchers, video routers and audio consoles and automation, intercom and graphics systems
•    Efficiency with ELC Automation, Chyron playout, Bitcentral video playout, and ENPS
•    Work closely with the News Operations/Production Manager to facilitate any changes and updates to our systems as they work hand-in-hand with News Automation workflows.

Requirements:
•     At least three years’ experience working as a newscast director or equivalent.
•    Oversee and execute the technical production of assigned local product across multiple platforms.
•    Ability to work with a team of people to achieve technically clean programs.

•    Must be able to work quickly, efficiently and communicate effectively under pressure.

The ideal candidate can balance multiple ongoing projects while addressing the immediate maintenance needs of a 24/7 operation. If you enjoy problem solving, are a people person, like solving technical/IT challenges and enjoy communicating, we want to hear from you.

Current driver’s license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations required

  • Support day to day operations of station including all daily news operations, equipment, and computer-based IT systems.
  • Install and maintain broadcast and IT equipment at studio facilities, transmitter site, in remote broadcast vehicles, and at other remote locations.
  • Troubleshoot equipment issues, making repairs or implementing workarounds as needed.
  • Perform routine security updates and reboots of broadcast servers.
  • Contribute to technical documentation that accurately represents installed equipment.
  • Occasional field work on remote productions.
  • Minor building-related maintenance tasks occasionally required.

Requirements: 

  • 1-3 years’ experience in broadcast engineering or related.
  • Strong organizational, communications, and time-management skills. Able to work efficiently without direct supervision.
  • Ability to work well under pressure, take initiative, and work well with others.
  • Solid understanding of current computer hardware, network technologies, and Microsoft’s Active Directory environment.
  • Ability to plan technical projects and clearly communicate the status of problems, provide updates to progress on projects, and offer solutions to technical issues.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. Available on call.

job.title: Cloud Team Lead
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are looking for a Cloud Team Lead to lead the cloud and DevOps team that builds and operates the infrastructure behind TEGNA's content management and streaming platforms across Azure and AWS. Content management runs on Azure (C#/.NET Function Apps, Service Bus), streaming runs on AWS media services, and cloud-agnostic services run on Kubernetes — all Terraform-managed. Reporting to the Platform Engineering Manager, this is a hands-on technical leadership role: you lead a team of onshore and offshore cloud engineers, own the team's delivery and the reliability of the platform's infrastructure, and stay hands-on in the work. You partner closely with the Cloud Architect — who sets reference architectures and standards and holds production approval — to deliver well-architected infrastructure, and with the microservices pods on their infrastructure needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead a distributed team of cloud/DevOps engineers (onshore and offshore), owning planning, delivery, quality, and day-to-day technical direction.
  • Remain hands-on: contribute to Terraform/infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and Kubernetes workloads across Azure and AWS.
  • Own the reliability, performance, and operational excellence of the platform's infrastructure, including incident response and the on-call rotation.
  • Break infrastructure initiatives and epics into actionable, well-sequenced work, balancing near-term delivery with long-term platform health.
  • Partner with the Cloud Architect to apply the standards, reference architectures, and guardrails they define, and with the dev pods to support their delivery.
  • Drive engineering practices across the team: IaC standards, pipeline safety, observability, and security.
  • Mentor and grow engineers, and manage the throughput and quality of offshore contributors.
  • Run an Agile/Scrum delivery cadence with disciplined source control.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years in cloud, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering, including 2+ years leading or mentoring a team.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform/infrastructure-as-code across Azure and/or AWS; multi-cloud experience is a strong plus.
  • Solid experience with CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, cloud networking, IAM/identity, observability, and security best practices.
  • Experience operating production infrastructure and leading incident response.
  • Proven ability to lead distributed and offshore teams, keeping quality and velocity high across time zones.
  • Strong communication skills across front-end, architecture, and microservice development teams.
  • Media, streaming, or high-traffic platform experience is a plus.

Why Join TEGNA?

You'll lead the team that keeps modern digital products running at real scale, in a genuinely multi-cloud Azure/AWS environment with a rich media and streaming footprint. This is an opportunity to shape both the reliability of the platform and the engineering culture of the team that powers content management and streaming delivery across all of TEGNA's media properties. We are investing heavily in AI-assisted development, modern cloud-native services, and flexible architecture patterns that let our teams innovate quickly while delivering high-quality, high-impact products.
