job.title: Commercial Producer
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

The Commercial Producer is responsible for leading and managing the production of commercial content from concept through completion for a range of clients. This role involves working closely with clients to understand their vision and needs, overseeing project development, managing budgets, and coordinating cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality productions on time and within budget.

Responsibilities:

  • Client Management:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the commercial production process.
    • Collaborate with clients to understand their goals and needs for commercial production.
    • Provide creative direction and guidance to ensure the final product aligns with client objectives.
  • Videography & Photography:
    • Plan, set up, and execute video shoots for commercials and branded content, ensuring top-notch quality and creativity.
    • Capture high-quality still images as needed for projects or client campaigns.
    • Operate a range of professional cameras, lighting, and other production equipment.
  • Project Planning & Development:
    • Develop and present creative concepts, storyboards, scripts, and production strategies.
    • Create and manage project timelines, budgets, and production schedules to ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
    • Work with internal teams, freelancers, and contractors as needed for project execution.
  • Production Execution:
    • Ability to shoot all aspects of video and content production, including pre-production, shooting, post-production, and final delivery.
    • Monitor shoots, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with all legal, safety, and quality standards.
    • Ability to edit all aspects of video.
  • Budget Management:
    • Prepare and manage production budgets, including cost estimations, negotiations with vendors, and budget reconciliation.
    • Identify opportunities for cost savings and efficient resource allocation.
  • Creative Direction:
    • Provide input on creative elements, such as visuals, graphics, animations, and other components to achieve a high-impact commercial product.
    • Ensure all content meets brand standards and reflects the client's vision and objectives.
  • Post-Production Supervision:
    • Oversee editing, audio, color grading, and any special effects work.
    • Ensure the final product meets client expectations and maintains high production values.
    • Facilitate client reviews and make necessary revisions based on feedback.
  • Collaboration & Communication:
    • Collaborate with sales, marketing, and creative teams to align on project goals and client needs.
    • Maintain clear and consistent communication with clients and internal stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Equipment Management:
    • Maintain, transport, and set up production equipment, including cameras, lighting, and sound equipment.
    • Ensure all equipment is in working order, perform regular maintenance checks, and troubleshoot any technical issues during shoots.
    • Stay updated on new gear, tools, and technology that can enhance production quality.

 

Requirements: 

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years of experience in commercial production, video production, or related roles.

job.title: Data Scientist
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are looking for a Data Scientist to help build the data science and applied AI capabilities behind TEGNA’s content platform, the systems that turn a high volume of news and media content into insight, enrichment, and better experiences for millions of users. You’ll work with large, messy, text-heavy datasets and use NLP and large language models to turn them into production solutions that make content more discoverable, better organized, and more useful to editorial, product, and audience teams. You’ll be a technical anchor on the team: framing ambiguous business problems as data science problems, setting the bar for rigor in experimentation and evaluation, and mentoring analysts and mid-level data scientists. You’ll partner with engineering and cloud teams on how models and LLM-based services are deployed, monitored, and operated in production.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and evaluate data science solutions that apply NLP and LLMs to content problems such as classification, tagging and taxonomy, entity extraction, summarization, similarity and recommendation, and semantic search.
  • Develop LLM-powered solutions, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vector search, and fine-tuning where it is warranted, with a pragmatic eye on cost, latency, and quality.
  • Own evaluation. Define metrics, build benchmark and golden datasets, and run offline and online experiments (including A/B tests) to show that a solution works, and keep checking that it keeps working.
  • Frame ambiguous business and editorial problems as well-defined data science problems, and help convert epics and tech briefs into actionable, well-scoped stories alongside the team lead.
  • Work with engineers to take models and prototypes into production as reliable services, covering monitoring, drift detection, guardrails, and responsible-AI practices such as hallucination, bias, and content-safety controls.
  • Explore, clean, and model large structured and unstructured datasets, and communicate findings and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Set standards for reproducibility, experiment tracking, code quality, and documentation across the team.
  • Mentor analysts and mid-level data scientists, raising the overall technical maturity of the team.
  • Partner with engineering and cloud teams (who own infrastructure realization, CI/CD, and standards).
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum team with disciplined source control.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data science or applied machine learning, with models or analytical solutions delivered into production.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and the core data science stack (pandas, scikit-learn, and a deep learning framework such as PyTorch), plus solid SQL.
  • Strong grounding in statistics, experimental design, and model evaluation, and the judgment to choose the simplest approach that solves the problem.
  • Hands-on experience with NLP (text classification, named entity recognition, topic modeling, embeddings, semantic similarity) and with modern transformer-based approaches.
  • Practical experience building with LLMs: prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings and vector databases, and evaluating LLM output quality. Experience with Hugging Face or comparable platforms is expected.
  • Experience taking data science work to production in a cloud environment (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and an understanding of MLOps fundamentals: versioning, monitoring, reproducibility, and retraining.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders and explain model behavior, limitations, and trade-offs to non-technical audiences.
  • A track record of mentoring others and elevating team practices.
  • Fluent in Agile/Scrum delivery and Git-based source control.
  • Media, publishing, streaming, or high-traffic content platform experience is a plus.
  • Experience with knowledge graphs or Graph-RAG, with Databricks or a managed vector search platform, or with fine-tuning and evaluating open-source LLMs is a plus.
Pay Range$100,000—$125,000 USD

job.title: FullStack Engineer (UI/UX)
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer (with UI/UX expertise) to help build and evolve the web applications and supporting services our teams and audiences rely on every day. You’ll work across the stack, from modern React front ends to the APIs and services behind them, and you’ll be a strong contributor to how we structure, ship, and scale user-facing software. We build with micro-frontends so that teams can deliver independently without sacrificing a cohesive experience, and we embrace agentic software development, using AI agents as real collaborators in design, implementation, testing, and review. You’ll take product requirements and technical briefs and turn them into well-structured, well-tested features, working closely with product, design, architecture, and platform partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate full stack features, from React UIs through to the backend APIs and services that support them.
  • Develop and evolve micro-frontend architectures, including module boundaries, shared component libraries, versioning, and runtime integration across independently deployed applications.
  • Use agentic development methods in day-to-day work: directing AI coding agents, writing effective specs and prompts, reviewing and validating agent-generated code, and building guardrails (tests, linting, CI checks) that keep agent output reliable.
  • Set and uphold standards for code quality, testing, accessibility, performance, and observability across the front end and back end.
  • Contribute to technical design for meaningful features and help break epics into actionable, well-scoped stories alongside the team lead.
  • Share what works in agent-assisted workflows, and help teammates build effective habits and practices.
  • Modernize legacy front ends and monolithic UIs into scalable, maintainable, componentized applications.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, architects, and platform teams to deliver cohesive user experiences.
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum team with disciplined source control and code review practices.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building production web applications.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript, including state management, hooks, performance optimization, and component design.
  • Practical experience with micro-frontend architectures (e.g., Module Federation, single-spa, or equivalent approaches), including managing shared dependencies, design systems, and cross-team integration.
  • Solid backend experience building RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs in a language such as Node.js, C#/.NET, or similar, with a working understanding of databases and data modeling.
  • Demonstrated experience with agentic or AI-assisted software development, and good judgment about when to trust, verify, and correct agent output.
  • Strong grasp of web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, accessibility, browser performance, and security basics (authentication, authorization, XSS/CSRF).
  • Strong testing discipline across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, and a genuine concern for code structure and maintainability.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-hosted applications in AWS, Azure, or similar environments.
  • Fluent in Agile/Scrum delivery and Git-based source control.
  • Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach, including a willingness to mentor and learn from teammates.
  • Exposure to Docker, monorepo tooling, or design-system development is a plus.
  • Media, streaming, or high-traffic consumer web experience is a plus.

We are seeking an HRIS Analyst to play a key role in supporting, maintaining, and optimizing HR technology and operational processes across the Human Resources department. This role will serve as a system administrator and subject matter resource for ServiceNow.    ````    ``````    
The HRIS Analyst will work closely with HR, IT, and business partners to ensure systems are functioning effectively, data remains accurate, and HR processes are efficient, consistent, and user-friendly.

Responsibilities:
•    Serve as a system administrator for ServiceNow, ensuring system accuracy, functionality, compliance, and usability.
•    Configure and maintain system settings, workflows and other system functionality to support HR processes.
•    Partner with HR and IT teams to identify system enhancements, implement solutions, and improve the overall user experience.
•    Build and deliver reports and dashboards to provide insights into case metrics to support HR operations and other business needs.
•    Support HR technology projects and system integrations, including connections with Greenhouse Recruiting and other HR applications.
•    Provide end-user training and guidance to promote system adoption and ensure effective utilization of available functionality.
•    Communicate project updates, process changes, and key deliverables to relevant stakeholders.
•    Provide general support for cross-functional HR initiatives and special projects as needed.

Requirements:
•    Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
•    2+ years of experience administering an HRIS, applicant tracking system (ATS), or other HR technology platform; ServiceNow experience preferred.
•    Experience with knowledge management systems, intranet administration, or content management platforms.
•    Experience with system configuration, workflow design, reporting, data audits, and end-user training.
•    Experience supporting HR operations, process coordination, or project management.
•    Proficiency with HR information systems and ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow.
•    Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
•    Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
•    Ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate projects, and meet established deadlines.

Desired Attributes
•    Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
•    Ability to analyze existing processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and develop practical solutions.
•    Self-motivated with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
•    Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities in a dynamic environment.
•    Ability to communicate technical concepts and process changes effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
•    Customer-service mindset with a focus on providing efficient, responsive support to employees and internal HR partners.
•    Adaptability and willingness to take ownership of new responsibilities and initiatives.

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. KSDK, TEGNA’s NBC affiliate in St. Louis, is looking for an experienced Investigative Multi-Skilled Journalist to join our award-winning team. We’re seeking a journalist with a strong investigative track record who produces stories that create real impact. The ideal candidate is a dynamic and creative storyteller who thrives on uncovering the truth, holding those in power accountable, and delivering original journalism across all platforms, including broadcast, digital and streaming. This role is built for a curious, ethical and relentless reporter with a passion for enterprise and investigative work. Whether it's a deep-dive data piece, a fast-paced accountability story, or a visually rich digital experience, you know how to tell stories that matter—and make audiences care.

Responsibilities:
• Pitch, develop, and produce both short- and long-term investigative and enterprise stories.
• Dig deep into complex issues, find untold angles and uncover what others miss.
• Use open records laws, data analysis and innovative research methods to drive reporting.
• Build and maintain strong source networks across our coverage area.
• Write and deliver stories in a clear, compelling, and authentic voice across streaming, TV, digital and social platforms.
• Shoot and edit high-quality visual content using the latest gear and editing tools.
• Create content that’s not only informative but highly shareable and impactful.
• Enhance storytelling with graphics, data visualizations, social media elements and user-generated content.
• Collaborate with producers, editors, photographers and digital staff to maximize storytelling potential.
• Contribute to story development meetings and help shape the direction of ongoing coverage.
• Help cover breaking news as needed.

Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or related field.
• 5-7+ years of investigative journalism experience preferred.
• Experience using open records tools, PACER, LexisNexis and public databases.
• Strong storyteller skills with the ability to make the complicated understandable.
• Clear, compelling writing style adaptable for multiple platforms.
• Must be able to use all available tools to enhance stories, including AI.
• Digital-first mindset with strong understanding of social platforms and audience engagement.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Calm and confident under pressure, especially in breaking news situations.
• Strong organizational and time management skills.

job.title: Lifestyle Host/Reporter
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KSDK-TV Saint Louis, the NBC TEGNA-owned affiliate in St. Louis, Missouri is looking for a dynamic, creative and engaging Lifestyle Host & Multimedia Journalist to join Show Me St. Louis, our locally produced lifestyle and entertainment program. We are interested in finding a journalist who can create unique, memorable and well written stories, who can share them on all platforms.
St. Louis is filled with incredible people, neighborhoods, restaurants, businesses, nonprofits, attractions and experiences, and we’re looking for someone who is excited to tell their stories.


The ideal candidate is an engaging on-air personality and strong storyteller who is equally comfortable hosting in the studio, reporting in the field and working behind the camera. This person should know how to take an idea from concept to air, whether that means interviewing a guest live, shooting and editing a feature story, creating an engaging live shot or working with a local business or community partner to develop compelling content. Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities:
•    Host Show Me St. Louis and deliver on-air content in an engaging, conversational and accurate manner.
•    Shoot, write, edit and report compelling lifestyle and community stories.
•    Conduct engaging interviews both in studio and in the field.
•    Develop original content showcasing the people, places, businesses, food, entertainment, nonprofits and experiences that make the St. Louis region unique.
•    Pitch fresh, creative and timely story ideas and help shape future Show Me St. Louis programming.
•    Generate fun, creative and content-driven live shots and field segments.
•    Work professionally and collaboratively with advertising clients and community partners to turn their ideas into compelling television.
•    Create content for broadcast, digital and social platforms.
•    Maintain an active and professional social media presence while finding new ways to engage with viewers.
•    Use photography and editing tools to create polished, visually engaging stories.
•    Contribute to sponsored content, station initiatives, special programming and community events.
•    Collaborate with producers, photographers, sales teams and other departments to execute content across platforms.
•    Manage multiple stories and projects while consistently meeting deadlines.

Requirements:
•    2–4 years of experience in broadcast journalism, multimedia journalism, lifestyle television, hosting or a related field preferred.
•    Strong on-camera presence with an authentic, approachable personality.
•    Strong interviewing, writing and storytelling skills.
•    Experience shooting and editing video.
•    Ability to independently take a story from idea to finished product.
•    Comfortable working with advertising clients, local businesses, nonprofits and community organizations.
•    Creative thinker who understands how to make lifestyle content informative, entertaining and visually compelling.
•    Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to perform under tight deadlines.
•    Experience in creating content for social and digital platforms.
•    Experience with ENPS and EDIUS is preferred.
•    Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field preferred.

Who We're Looking For
We want someone who is curious about St. Louis and genuinely excited to explore it. Someone who can walk into a restaurant kitchen, community event, local business or live studio interview and immediately make people feel comfortable.
This person should bring personality and creativity to the show while also having the journalistic and production skills to find a story, shoot it, write it, edit it and tell it well.


Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to help viewers discover something new about St. Louis every day.

job.title: Master Control Hub Operator
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

TEGNA's broadcast operations hub in Charlotte, NC seeks a Broadcast Hub Operator to join our team. This position is part of a team responsible for the live operation, monitoring and support of multiple stations 24 by 7 in a single centralized environment. This position will perform duties to ensure the on-air integrity of multiple network programming feeds and provide immediate response to emergency situations that may affect on-air programming. The ideal candidate is a self-starter capable of working independently or as part of a team. Must be willing to work onsite at our facility in Charlotte, North Carolina.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and manipulate on-air playlists, execute program/commercial/marketing changes, support live-event and off-air workflows, send logs for reconciliation and troubleshoot channel playout issues
  • Responsible for the ingest and quality control of broadcast materials into all automation systems
  • Manage commercial integration, including rolling commercial breaks, during taped and live programming
  • Monitor and maintain the continuity and availability for multiple channel streams
  • Ensure continuity of programming by confirming that every piece of material is accounted for and ready for on-air playout
  • Act as first line responders for internal clients
  • Vigilantly protect our air by simulating the experience of a viewer and constantly checking for proper audio, video, captioning and picture quality
  • With the guidance of Technical Managers and supervisors, work as a team to promptly recover from any on-air discrepancies
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

  • BA/BS in a related field or equivalent experience
  • Basic understanding of television production, broadcast operations, and/or news/sports/entertainment technical production requirements
  • Proficient in Excel and the entire Microsoft O365 suite of tools
  • Knowledge of and ability to use electronic equipment and computer hardware and software related to television broadcast operations, including video and audio routing equipment, file servers, remote transmitter monitoring equipment and multi-channel automation systems
  • Ability to troubleshoot, take immediate action, and resolve broadcast issues
  • Strong customer service attributes and skills
  • Strong organization and time management skills
  • Unwavering composure in high-pressure situations
  • Acute attention to detail
  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills
  • Experience working successfully as part of a team
  • Must be willing to work onsite at our facility in Charlotte, North Carolina
  • Must be willing and available to work flexible hours, including overnight shifts, weekends, holidays in order to meet the needs of a 24x7 operation

Desired:

  • 1-3 years of experience in a master control or production control room television environment
  • Proven passion for media, television, and technology

job.title: Mobile CMS Team Lead
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. We are looking for a Mobile CMS Team Lead to lead the team building TEGNA's mobile content experiences — the applications that deliver news and content to audiences on mobile devices, powered by our content management platform. Our content management systems run on Azure (C#/.NET Function Apps, Service Bus), and the mobile apps integrate with those backend microservices and content APIs. Reporting to the Platform Engineering Manager, this is a hands-on technical leadership role: you lead a team of onshore and offshore mobile engineers, own the team's delivery and the quality of the apps, and stay hands-on in the work. You partner with the CMS Solutions Architect, who sets product and platform direction, and with the content and microservices teams whose services your apps consume.

Responsibilities
●    Lead a distributed team of mobile engineers (onshore and offshore), owning planning, delivery, code quality, and day-to-day technical direction.
●    Remain hands-on in mobile development across native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) and/or cross-platform frameworks.
●    Own mobile app quality, performance, and release management — including app store submissions, versioning, and post-release monitoring.
●    Integrate mobile apps cleanly with backend CMS microservices and content APIs, handling offline, error, and failure states gracefully.
●    Break product initiatives and epics from the Solutions Architects into actionable, well-sequenced mobile work.
●    Drive engineering practices across the team: code review, testing, crash reporting and observability, and release safety.
●    Partner with product, design, and architecture, and the web CMS and microservices teams to deliver cohesive experiences.
●    Mentor and grow engineers, and manage the throughput and quality of offshore contributors.
●    Run an Agile/Scrum delivery cadence with disciplined source control.

Requirements
●    7+ years of software engineering experience with significant mobile development experience, including 2+ years leading or mentoring a team.
●    Strong hands-on mobile expertise: native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin). Cross-platform frameworks (e.g., .NET MAUI, React Native) are a plus.
●    Experience integrating mobile apps with backend services and APIs (REST, and ideally event-driven patterns).
●    Solid experience with mobile release management, app store processes, and mobile observability/crash reporting.
●    Proven ability to lead distributed and offshore teams, keeping quality and velocity high across time zones.
●    Strong communication skills across product, design, engineering, and architecture stakeholders.
●    Content, media, or streaming mobile application experience is a plus.

job.title: Multiskilled Journalist-Sports
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WFAA is looking for a creative, energetic sports multimedia journalist to join our award-winning sports team. We're looking for someone who can help lead our daily sports coverage, bring fresh ideas to the table and connect with sports fans across North Texas.

This is a unique opportunity for a journalist who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about creating content across multiple platforms. From reporting and anchoring in our linear newscasts to co-hosting a daily sports streaming show to driving the DFW sports conversation through compelling digital and social coverage, this person will play an important role in how WFAA delivers sports to our audience.

WFAA is also a broadcast partner with several professional sports properties. This journalist will play an important content role, developing original stories, features and other compelling content that brings these teams, athletes and events to life for our audience. WFAA is uniquely positioned in one of the most dynamic and competitive sports markets in the country. North Texas is home to an incredible range of professional and collegiate teams, high school sports, major golf tournaments, bowl games, auto racing and some of the biggest sporting events in the world. With sports stories and events happening year-round, there is no shortage of opportunities to tell compelling stories, uncover unique perspectives and connect with passionate sports fans across the region.

What You'll Do
•    Produce, shoot, edit and report original sports content, including packaged stories and features, for linear, streaming, digital and social platforms.
•    Co-host a high-energy daily sports streaming show, helping shape the format, develop segments and create engaging content from concept through execution.
•    Anchor sportscasts and deliver daily sports coverage across WFAA's linear newscasts.

•    Produce cinematic, original, long-form sports stories that showcase the personalities, passion and events.
•    Cultivate strong industry and team contacts, consistently generating leads and serving as a key contributor to breaking sports news and developing exclusive stories.

•    Strong knowledge of the North Texas sports landscape.
•    Experience shooting with professional ENG cameras.
•    Ability to produce and edit video using Adobe Premiere Pro, Edius or equivalent editing software.
•    A digital-first mindset with demonstrated experience creating content for digital, streaming and social platforms, including an understanding of CTV.
•    Ability to create engaging, conversational sports content that connects with audiences and that sports fans want to click, watch and share.

•    A collaborative, solutions-oriented attitude and a willingness to bring fresh ideas to the table.
•    Bachelor's degree in journalism, Communications, Film and Video or a related field preferred.

Join WFAA's tradition of sports excellence and help tell the stories that matter to sports fans across North Texas. At TEGNA, we are committed to our core values: We Win, We Work Smarter, We Demand the Truth, and We Do the Right Thing. These values guide how we create content and serve our communities.

  • Use your natural curiosity to pitch compelling stories.
  • Show off your creativity and storytelling skills.
  • Craft stories of all lengths on all platforms for specific audiences.
  • Meet daily deadlines.
  • Combine live pictures, graphics, compelling video and emotional sound to create an engaging experience for our audience.
  • Booth continuous coverage on our live streams for breaking news and community events.
  • Consistently try new things after thoughtful discussion with supervisors.
  • Allow the impactful and emotional conversations the community needs to drive the content in your rundown.
  • Use data analytics to help shape the content of your show.
  • Challenge traditional ways of doing things.
  • Ensure all communities and viewpoints have a voice and presence in your show.

  • Skills in producing engaging, content-driven newscasts and digital content.
  • Strong social media skills, including an active news hound presence on your preferred social platforms.

About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. KPNX-TV, the NBC TEGNA affiliate, is looking for an experienced Multi-Skilled Journalist to help maintain our tradition of superior reporting and newsgathering. We are interested in finding a journalist who can create unique, memorable and well written stories, who can share them on all platforms with a mix of outstanding photography and unforgettable editing. If you're a creative storyteller who understands true multi-platform journalism and who is not bound by the methods of traditional TV news – we want to hear from you! 

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities: 

  • Perform authoritative, compelling live shots in a developing story or in breaking news situations
  • Develop story ideas
  • Mine the community to find sources who will keep you informed about events and ideas in their areas of expertise
  • Ability to identify, write and produce stories within a specific framework.
  • Research for facts and credibility.

The Sales Assistant provides administrative and sales support to the Account Executives and Sales Management team. job.title: Sales Assistant-Development
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

The Sales Assistant / Sales Development position provides comprehensive support to the KWES Sales Department and Director of Sales while gaining broad exposure to the station's sales, operational and client-service functions. This is a department-wide sales support position and is not dedicated exclusively to individual Account Executives. Responsibilities and priorities may shift based on the operational, Account Manager, sales and leadership needs of the department.
  The position will support sales leadership, assist Account Executives as needed, provide backup Account Manager coverage, and develop knowledge of KWES's broadcast, streaming and digital sales solutions. This role is also designed to provide professional development and exposure that may prepare a successful employee for a future Account Executive opportunity as business needs and openings arise.
Four Core Areas of Responsibility
1. Director of Sales & Department Support
Serve as a primary support resource to the Director of Sales and overall
KWES sales organization.
Responsibilities include:
• Assist the DOS with sales reports, presentations, meeting preparation
and follow-up. • Support preparation for weekly sales meetings, revenue discussions
and sales initiatives.
• Assist with revenue, inventory and sales activity reporting.
• Maintain current sales materials, programming information,
sponsorship opportunities and other department resources.
• Track department deadlines, outstanding items and projects requiring
follow-up.
• Assist with special sales initiatives, client events and station
opportunities.
• Coordinate information and workflow between Sales and other
departments, including Traffic, Creative Services, Finance, Digital and
Sales Fulfillment.
• Assist with organization and execution of seasonal programming,
sports, political and special sales opportunities.
• Provide administrative and project support as assigned by the DOS.
• Take on additional responsibilities based on changing department
priorities and business needs.
2. Account Executive & Sales Support
Provide operational and administrative support to Account Executives as
needed and based on department priorities to allow sellers to maximize
client-facing and new-business development time.
Responsibilities include:
• Assist with order entry, revisions and schedule changes.
• Support campaign setup and maintenance.
• Monitor active schedules and campaign delivery.
• Assist with makegoods, preemptions and discrepancy resolution. • Prepare and update client presentations, proposals and sales
materials.
• Assist with avails and inventory coordination.
• Coordinate commercial materials, scripts and creative needs.
• Follow up with Traffic, Creative Services and Sales Fulfillment on
outstanding items.
• Assist with routine client and agency administrative requests.
• Support campaign recaps and post-campaign reporting.
• Help maintain accurate client, account and campaign information.
• Assist with Matrix/CRM administrative support while maintaining AE
accountability for prospecting activity, opportunities and pipeline
management.
The Sales Assistant supports the business of the sales department rather
than being permanently assigned to any individual Account Executive.
3. Account Manager Coverage & Operational Support
Develop proficiency in Account Manager responsibilities to provide reliable
backup coverage during vacations, PTO, vacancies, periods of increased
workload or other business needs.
Responsibilities include:
• Become proficient in WO Media Sales and applicable sales systems.
• Enter and revise orders accurately.
• Understand Traffic workflow, deadlines and requirements.
• Assist with schedule maintenance and campaign stewardship.
• Coordinate makegoods and resolve scheduling discrepancies.
• Assist with billing and invoice questions as appropriate.
• Track commercial materials and creative requirements. • Understand MediaFerry and applicable creative workflows.
• Provide professional client and agency administrative communication.
• Coordinate with internal departments to ensure campaign fulfillment.
• Maintain continuity of sales operations when Account Manager
coverage is needed.
The expectation is that this employee becomes a dependable cross-trained
resource who can step into operational gaps without disrupting service to
clients or the sales team.
4. Account Executive Development
Develop the foundational skills, product knowledge and sales experience
necessary to potentially advance into a future Account Executive position.
Development opportunities may include:
• Participate in sales and product training.
• Develop knowledge of KWES/KIDY/KXVA broadcast programming and
sales opportunities.
• Learn TEGNA's Total TV approach: Broadcast + Streaming + Digital.
• Develop working knowledge of Premion, CTV/OTT, Audience
Marketplace and other digital solutions.
• Learn Matrix CRM and proper pipeline management.
• Participate in prospect research and new-business development
exercises.
• Learn effective prospecting techniques.
• Observe and participate in client discovery.
• Attend selected client meetings and AE ride-alongs.
• Assist with development of integrated client recommendations.
• Learn proposal development and presentation skills. • Gain exposure to pricing and inventory strategy.
• Develop understanding of campaign measurement, stewardship and
renewal.
• Participate in role-play, presentation and sales-development exercises.
• Demonstrate the ability to communicate the value of
KWES/KIDY/KXVA and TEGNA solutions to local businesses.
Career Development Opportunity
This position is designed to provide broad exposure to the KWES/KIDY/KXVA sales organization and may serve as a developmental pathway toward a future Account Executive opportunity. As the employee demonstrates proficiency in their core responsibilities, additional opportunities may be provided to develop prospecting, discovery, presentation, client relationship and new-business skills. Advancement into an Account Executive position is not guaranteed and will depend upon individual performance, demonstrated sales readiness, business needs and future position availability.
Key Qualifications
The ideal candidate should demonstrate:
• Strong organization and attention to detail.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
• Professional written and verbal communication.
• Strong customer-service mindset.
• Ability to work effectively across multiple departments.
• Comfort learning new software, systems and processes.
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Teams,
PowerPoint and Excel. • Ability to analyze information and identify potential problems before
they affect clients.
• Initiative and willingness to take ownership of assignments.
• Interest in sales, marketing, advertising and business development.
• Ability to work independently while functioning as part of a larger
sales team.
• Desire to learn and grow within the organization.
Experience in media, advertising, sales support, customer service or account
management is beneficial but not necessarily required for the right
candidate.
Measures of Success
Success in this position will be measured by:
• Accuracy and timeliness of work.
• Responsiveness to DOS and department priorities.
• Reliability of AE and AM support.
• Ability to manage and follow through on assigned projects.
• Reduction of administrative and operational workload on sellers and
sales leadership.
• Quality of internal and external communication.
• Campaign and order accuracy.
• Ability to identify and resolve issues proactively.
• Growth in product, system and sales knowledge.
• Demonstrated readiness to assume increasing responsibility.     Role Philosophy
The purpose of this position is straightforward: Support the sales operation. Protect the client experience. Give sellers more time to sell. Provide the DOS with additional operational support. Build organizational depth. Develop future sales talent.

Benefits:

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.
The Role
We are looking for a Senior FullStack Developer with a strong front-end focus to build the web experiences and modular front-end framework behind TEGNA's digital content management system. You'll work primarily in React and TypeScript, building scalable, reusable interfaces — ideally within a micro-frontend (MFE) architecture — that compose cleanly across teams and product lines. These front-ends are backed by our C#/.NET microservices on Azure, so you'll integrate closely with backend services and APIs. You'll partner with the Solutions Architects, who set the overall platform direction, and with the microservices teams whose services you consume. As a senior, you'll set front-end standards, mentor other engineers, and raise the bar for quality and maintainability across the UI/UX layer.
  Responsibilities
● Build and maintain performant, accessible web front-ends in React and TypeScript, and contribute to our modular, micro-frontend architecture.
● Design reusable UI components and front-end modules that standardize experiences and accelerate delivery across teams.
● Integrate front-ends with backend C#/.NET microservices and APIs (REST and event-driven), handling loading, error, and failure states gracefully.
● Own front-end quality — testing, performance, accessibility, and cross-browser/device behavior.
● Set and uphold front-end standards and patterns, and mentor mid-level engineers on UI architecture and best practices.
● Turn designs and product requirements into well-structured, maintainable implementations, and help shape them with product and design partners.
● Collaborate with the Solutions Architects and microservices teams to align the front-end with the broader platform direction.
● Work cloud-native in an Agile/Scrum team with disciplined Git-based source control.
Requirements
● 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong front-end emphasis.
● Deep, hands-on expertise with React and TypeScript, and modern front-end tooling (build systems, state management, component libraries).
● Experience with micro-frontend architecture (e.g., module federation or equivalent composition patterns) is strongly preferred.
● Solid experience integrating front-ends with backend services and APIs (REST, and ideally event-driven patterns).
● Strong grasp of front-end performance, accessibility, and testing practices. ● Full-stack range — comfort working close to the backend; familiarity with C#/.NET is a plus, since our services are .NET.
● A track record of setting front-end standards and mentoring other engineers.
● Fluent in Agile/Scrum delivery and Git-based source control.
● Media, streaming, CMS, or high-traffic consumer platform experience is a plus.
Why Join TEGNA?
You'll shape the front-end framework and user experiences that reach more than 100 million people across all of TEGNA's media properties, working at the intersection of modern UI architecture and a rich cloud-native backend. We are investing heavily in AI-assisted development, modern cloud-native services, and flexible, modular architecture patterns that let our teams innovate quickly while delivering high-quality, high-impact products for our users

Responsibilities:

- Own the design and delivery of significant features and subsystems, including playback, advertising, deep linking, analytics, and the configuration-driven page and module pipeline.
- Design SceneGraph components and task-based asynchronous flows that stay responsive within Roku's memory and threading constraints.
- Maintain and improve live and on-demand video playback, including server-side and client-side ad integration.
- Support a multi-station build process that produces branded channels for many local stations from one codebase.
- Integrate and maintain third-party SDKs for analytics, video quality monitoring, feature flagging, user consent, and attribution.
- Improve test coverage and quality tooling (unit tests, linting, formatting, on-device test runs in CI) and keep releases predictable.
- Manage Roku certification requirements and channel packaging and publishing.
- Lead code reviews, mentor engineers, and make pragmatic decisions about technical debt and refactoring in a long-lived codebase.
- Triage production errors and crashes using monitoring and logging tools.

- 6+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience shipping on **Roku** (BrightScript and SceneGraph), or a comparable connected TV platform with demonstrated ability to become productive in BrightScript quickly.
- Strong understanding of the SceneGraph component model, node and task threading, field observers, and RowList/grid-based UI.
- Experience with video playback on Roku, including HLS and ad integration (e.g., RAF, server-side ad insertion).
- Experience with REST/JSON APIs, token-based authentication, and resilient caching and error-recovery strategies.
- Strong testing and code quality habits, with experience in unit testing frameworks and static analysis.
- Ability to debug on-device, including memory and performance profiling.
- Clear communication and a track record of mentoring other engineers.

- Experience with **BrighterScript**, **Rooibos**, bslint/bsfmt, and the Roku developer toolchain.
- Experience with CI/CD for Roku, including automated on-device testing.

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KBMT/K-JAC, a TEGNA ABC and NBC affiliate in Beaumont, Texas, is searching for a creative, enterprising Sports Director to lead the station's sports product across every platform. 12NEWS is Southeast Texas' home of the Dallas Cowboys! It is also Cardinals country! Lamar University, a D-1 sports program in the Southland Conference, has highly competitive teams, with rivals nearby. High school sports are a major emphasis for 12NEWS. This is a job for a storyteller who breaks news rather than recaps it, and who understands that today's sports audience finds you on their phone first. You will set the editorial vision for our sports coverage, host a daily streaming show, and build a following that travels with you wherever the story is. Current driver's license and ability to operate a news-gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.


Requirements:
Minimum 1-3 years of sports reporting and anchoring experience.
Journalism or Communications degree preferred.
Strong on-camera presence and the ability to write in an exciting, authentic and accurate voice.
Proficiency shooting and editing with current field and nonlinear editing tools.
Demonstrated social media following and a portfolio of original mobile and vertical content.
Proven ability to develop sources and break stories.
Exceptional organization and the ability to manage overlapping seasons, a daily show and breaking news at the same time.
Sound editorial judgment and a firm grasp of the tenets of professional journalism.
Willingness to work nights, weekends and holidays, with a schedule that follows the sports calendar.
Ability to lift and carry field equipment.

Responsibilities:
Set the editorial direction for the station's sports coverage across broadcast, streaming, digital and social.
Host and help produce a daily streaming sports show.
Cover the Lamar Cardinals, including games, practices, news conferences, recruiting and the stories behind the program.
Lead year-round high school sports coverage.
Break news through cultivated sources, social listening and independent enterprise reporting.
Develop story ideas and shoot, write, edit and voice your own content.
Create mobile-first and vertical video built for the platform it lives on.
Write and post daily to the website, the app and all social platforms.
Build and maintain an active, credible personal social media presence that reflects the 12NEWS brand.
Work with news managers and producers to integrate sports into daily newscasts and coordinate highlight coverage on busy game nights.
Represent the station in the community and maintain strong relationships with coaches, athletic directors and sports information staff.
Perform other duties as assigned by the News Director.

Current driver's license and ability to operate a news-gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

job.description:

Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

Senior Software Engineer, Fire TV

What You'll Do
- Own the design and delivery of significant features and subsystems, such as playback, advertising, authentication, analytics, and configuration-driven page layouts, from ambiguous requirements through production.
- Evolve and enforce the app's architecture and keep technical debt in check.
- Drive performance work on resource-constrained Fire TV hardware, including cold-start time, memory, and playback quality, against measurable targets.
- Build and refine live and on-demand video playback, including HLS streaming and ad integration.
- Integrate and maintain third-party SDKs for analytics, video quality monitoring, feature flagging, user consent, and attribution, and make upgrade and adoption decisions.
- Lead code reviews, mentor engineers, and raise the team's testing and engineering standards.
- Partner with product, design, QA, and backend teams on estimation, roadmap, and release readiness.
- Support release pipelines and store submissions across our dev, QA, stage, and production builds, and help triage production issues.

What You'll Bring
**Required**
- 6+ years of software engineering experience, including multiple shipped consumer apps on Android, Fire TV, Android TV, or similar connected TV platforms.
- Strong **Kotlin** skills, including Coroutines and Flow.
- Production experience with 10-foot, D-pad-driven UI and focus management.
- Experience with Clean Architecture and MVVM.
- Experience with **Media3/ExoPlayer** or equivalent, HLS streaming, and client-side ad integration (e.g., IMA).
- Solid experience with REST/JSON APIs, token-based authentication, and caching strategies.
- Strong automated testing habits (unit and integration tests; JUnit, MockK, or similar) and static analysis tooling.
- Experience profiling and optimizing app performance on low-end devices.
- Clear written and verbal communication, and a track record of mentoring other engineers.

**Nice to have**
- Experience with multi-module Gradle builds, product flavors, and CI/CD for Android.
- Experience publishing to the Amazon Appstore and supporting multiple Fire OS versions and device generations.
- Experience with architecture testing and code coverage tooling.
- Familiarity with feature flag platforms, analytics instrumentation, and privacy/consent frameworks (CCPA/GDPR).
- Background in news, media, or live streaming.

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KIII the ABC affiliate in Corpus Christi, TX, is transforming the way we gather and present news, and we're looking for a Story Desk Editor to embrace our transition to the newsroom of the future. This hybrid role combines the skills of an assignment editor and a digital content producer to serve as the hub of the newsroom. The Story Desk Editor drives daily editorial execution, curates and produces impactful stories, and ensures our content connects authentically with audiences across streaming, digital, social and broadcast platforms.

Role Summary:

As a Story Desk Editor, you will be part of the Story Management Desk (SMD), a unified desk that replaces the legacy assignment and digital desks. The SMD model ensures a single, streamlined workflow for planning, producing and curating stories across platforms. You will lead coverage during breaking news, shape daily story planning, and curate content across platforms. This position requires decisive editorial judgment, strong writing skills, and the ability to thrive under tight deadlines. You will collaborate with MSJs, producers and photojournalists to deliver accurate, relevant and engaging stories that serve the community.

Responsibilities:

Lead and communicate newsroom coverage during breaking news, ensuring accuracy, urgency and balance
Identify and plan stories that matter most to the community, using editorial judgment and social listening
Create and edit engaging content for digital platforms: website, mobile app and streaming
Guide newsroom logistics and provide editorial support for MSJs, producers, and photojournalists
Edit reporter content for accuracy, grammar, AP style, digital best practices, fairness and ethical considerations
Enhance storytelling with creative elements (graphics, video, audience-submitted content, etc.)
Use available metrics to inform coverage and improve audience reach
Support newsroom operations and coverage planning as needed
Uphold TEGNA's journalistic standards and values across all platforms

Requirements:

3-5 years of journalism experience in a local newsroom, digital production, or related role
Strong news judgment and the ability to make fast, sound editorial decisions under pressure
Excellent writing skills, with the ability to produce accurate and compelling content quickly
Experience with newsroom systems, CMS tools
Organizational skills to manage competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment
A collaborative, solutions-focused mindset that thrives in a team environment
Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, or equivalent experience

With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KPNX-TV Phoenix, the TEGNA-owned NBC affiliate in Phoenix is searching for an ambitious Digital Content Producer who thrives in a fast-paced news environment and has an audience-first approach to writing, producing and distributing local news content.

Our digital producers monitor digital audience trends to identify and write engaging local news content that broadens our audience. They are responsible for curating quality content and overseeing the audience experience across all KPNX-TV Phoenix website, mobile, app, streaming and social media platforms. They work as part of the larger content team to break news and tell great stories in a 24/7 news environment.

The ideal candidate is an avid news consumer and writes accurate, compelling content with a sense of urgency.

Qualified candidates should be strong writers, first, with the ability to write quickly and accurately while tracking multiple streams of information. They should also have solid news judgment and experience producing and copy-editing content for digital platforms. Experience with SEO best practices and audience listening are a big plus.

We’re also looking for someone with strong initiative and an inner drive who is ready to learn and grow.

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Write and distribute original and accurate breaking news content
  • Curate and schedule news content on all station platforms, including website, mobile app, social media and streaming platforms
  • Edit reporter stories for grammar, clarity, structure, AP style and optimize the content for digital
  • Use creative production or story-packaging techniques, like subheads, hyperlinks, graphics and media (viewer pictures, user-generated content, etc.) to enhance digital stories
  • Write in an exciting, captivating and authentic manner
  • Research for facts and credibility
  • Monitor news releases and use social listening to find new content, enterprise stories and make community contacts
  • Analyze and actively use data and metrics to inform editorial and strategic decisions
  • Perform other tasks as required by supervisor or senior digital producers
  • Ensure the newsroom upholds journalistic integrity and the station brand across platforms

Requirements: 

  • BA/BS in journalism, communications and/or equivalent experience in the field
  • 3-5 years of experience writing breaking news articles or writing news articles in AP style
  • Strong communication and organizational skills and the ability to work under constant time pressure and meet deadlines
  • Ability to calmly handle live, breaking news situations and rapidly changing coverage
  • Strong news and editorial judgment, and an understanding of the tenets of professional journalism
  • Strong knowledge of AP style, copy editing and SEO best practices
  • Experience with CMS, photo and video-editing systems preferred
  • The ability to write in an exciting, captivating and conversational tone is preferred
  • Experience creating and managing content on social media platforms, including Instagram, Twitter and Facebook
  • An aptitude for creating and packaging engaging, audience-driven content
  • Knowledge of how to interpret and use digital analytics is a plus
  • Knowledge of ENPS, Edius, Canva is a plus
  • Ability to work various shifts, including mornings, nights and weekends

TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

job.description:

The perfect candidate will possess prior TV leadership experience, is committed to delivering best-in-class content to our audiences on all platforms, and a desire to mentor and offer regular feedback to the team. Our team strives for growth, and we seek a leader who shares this ambition. As the executive producer, you will work closely with producers to create captivating shows and explore new methods of presenting audience-focused content that aligns with the needs of our community on both broadcast and digital platforms. Having a strong technical knowhow is critical for success in this role. The role will also feature an on-air component, so being comfortable in front of the camera is a necessity. Experience in the control room, integrating multiple live images and feeds, a keen interest in newsgathering and responsiveness and a proven track record of producing high-quality content will make your application stand out.   • Organizational skills and the ability to work under deadlines.
  • Ability to calmly handle live, breaking news situations and changing events.

job.title: Videographer/Producer -
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

The YCL Videographer/Producer is responsible for capturing, producing, and supporting the creation of engaging lifestyle content for Your California Life. This hybrid role combines field and studio videography, technical production, control room automation, and segment development.

Working closely with the Host/Executive Producer and the YCL team, this position supports daily program production and contributes to field segments, special programming, and branded or partner content. The successful candidate brings strong technical skills, creative storytelling ability, sound judgment, and a collaborative approach, with the opportunity to expand producing and writing

Responsibilities:

Videography and Content Production
•    Shoot field segments, lifestyle features, interviews, packages, and other program content that aligns with YCL’s editorial and creative objectives.
•    Capture high-quality video and audio in field and studio environments.
•    Collaborate with the production team to develop visually engaging stories and segments for broadcast and digital platforms.
•    Assist with planning and executing field-based specials, seasonal programming, location shoots, and partner packages.
Studio and Control Room Operations
•    Operate show automation, including Cuez, during YCL tapings and productions.
•    Support studio production by setting up and adjusting cameras, preparing microphones, and assisting talent and guests.
•    Monitor production workflows and troubleshoot technical issues to help ensure smooth, timely recordings.
•    Coordinate with studio crew and station operations teams to maintain production quality and readiness.
Producing and Editorial Support
•    Collaborate with the Host/Executive Producer on daily show planning, segment development, and production needs.
•    Assist with researching, developing, and preparing lifestyle content and guest segments.
•    Contribute to writing and producing segments, with coaching and support from the Executive Producer.
•    Help coordinate field shoots, production elements, and content requirements to meet program deadlines.

Collaboration and Production Coordination
•    Work closely with the YCL team, studio crew, and station departments to deliver polished programming on schedule.
•    Communicate production needs, schedules, and technical considerations effectively.
•    Demonstrate flexibility and initiative in balancing creative, technical, and operational responsibilities.
•    Perform other related duties as assigned.

Requirements:
•    Demonstrated hands-on videography experience, including field and/or studio shooting.
•    Experience in broadcast production, such as studio, control room, or master control operations.
•    Working knowledge of cameras, audio equipment, microphones, and related production technology.
•    Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and adapt to changing production needs.
•    Strong organizational, communication, and collaboration skills.
•    Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced broadcast environment.
•    Interest in developing producing, writing, and editorial skills.
•    A proactive, flexible, and team-oriented approach to work.
Preferred Qualifications
•    Experience with broadcast automation systems, including Ross Overdrive, Sony ELC, Cuez, or vMix.
•    Previous experience as a director, technical director, production supervisor, or operations manager.
•    Master control experience, including playlist execution and coordination with a hub.
•    Production assistant experience supporting studio or field operations.
•    Producing or writing experience in lifestyle, news, entertainment, or other broadcast programming.
•    Experience supporting field-based specials, branded content, or partner productions.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
•    Strong visual storytelling and production skills.
•    Ability to operate technical equipment while maintaining awareness of editorial and creative goals.
•    Sound problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
•    Ability to work independently in the field and collaboratively in a studio environment.
•    Willingness to learn new technologies, production workflows, and creative approaches.
•    Ability to remain composed and responsive in a deadline-driven environment.
This position operates in studio, control room, and field environments and may require schedule flexibility based on production needs, shoots, tapings, and special programming. It provides opportunities to expand responsibilities in segment producing, writing, and creative development while continuing to contribute to the technical and operational execution of YCL programming.

Pay Range$27.40—$28.85 USD

job.description:

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. KTHV11, a TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Little Rock, Arkansas, is seeking an engaging Anchor/Multi-Skilled Journalist to lead our Saturday morning newscasts and report stories that matter across central Arkansas. This journalist will help viewers start their weekend informed, prepared and connected to their communities. We are looking for a journalist with strong news judgment, clear and conversational on-air delivery, and the curiosity to find the people and context behind the headlines. The successful candidate will work closely with producers and the newsroom team to shape useful, accurate newscasts, while also reporting, shooting, writing and editing original stories for broadcast and digital platforms. This is a visible newsroom role that calls for a dependable teammate, a thoughtful community presence and a calm, flexible approach to breaking news.

Responsibilities
• Anchor THV11 Morning News on Saturday with accuracy, warmth, authority and energy.
• Partner with producers, editors, photographers and newsroom leaders to plan and deliver clear, compelling newscasts; contribute ideas, editorial judgment and strong writing.
• Prepare for each broadcast by reviewing scripts, confirming facts and pronunciations, tracking developing stories and making timely updates as news changes.
• Report, write, shoot, produce and edit original stories and live reports for television, streaming, mobile and social platforms.
• Develop enterprise and community-focused stories through social listening, public records, independent research and trusted local sources.
• Build and maintain relationships with people and organizations throughout Northwest Arkansas and the River Valley, reflecting the range of communities in our viewing area.
• Use social media and digital tools to discover story ideas, engage with the audience and distribute accurate, useful journalism.
• Create or contribute to digital content, including web stories, video, live updates, images and social posts, in coordination with the newsroom.
• Deliver clear, authoritative live coverage during breaking news and severe weather, adapting quickly while following newsroom standards and direction.
• Represent THV11 professionally at community events
• Serve as a fill-in anchor and fulfill other duties as assigned

Requirements
• 1-3 years news anchor/reporting experience preferred
• Journalism, communications or related degree preferred
• Excellent writing, interviewing and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex issues in clear, conversational language.
• Sound editorial judgment and a demonstrated commitment to accuracy, fairness, ethics and accountability.
• Ability to shoot and edit video and produce content for broadcast and digital platforms.
• Experience with newsroom systems, editing tools and graphics

job.title: Analista en Ad Operations & Google Ad Manager 360
job.description:
Analista en Ad Operations & Google Ad Manager 360

Ubicación: Ciudad de México (Santa Fe), Presencial

 

Acerca del puesto y el equipo

Forma parte del equipo de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder mundial en medios y contenido en español. Con la videoteca más extensa de contenido propio y una capacidad de producción sin igual en la industria, impulsamos nuestras plataformas de streaming, televisión tradicional y radio, creando experiencias que conectan con millones de personas.

Somos una empresa vibrante con más de 10,000 colaboradores en México, Colombia y Estados Unidos, unidos por la pasión por el entretenimiento, la creatividad y la innovación. En TelevisaUnivision encontrarás un entorno inclusivo, dinámico y lleno de oportunidades para crecer personal y profesionalmente, ¡Únete y sé parte de este gran equipo creativo!

TelevisaUnivision está en búsqueda de un Especialista AdOps ADTV (Google Ad Manager 360) para integrarse a la VP. de Ventas, Dirección de Ad Operations.


El área es responsable del trafficking, la configuración técnica y la operación diaria de las campañas de Addressable TV (ADTV) de izzi dentro del ecosistema digital de TelevisaUnivision, asegurando la correcta entrega de campañas en video y CTV, el cumplimiento de SLAs y el correcto reconocimiento de ingresos.


Sobre ti

Eres un perfil técnico y analítico con experiencia en Ad Operations y ad serving de video y CTV, capaz de ser el enlace entre izzi y TelevisaUnivision, con gran atención al detalle y habilidad para resolver problemas bajo presión.


Tu día a día

  • Ejecutar el trafficking de campañas ADTV en Google Ad Manager 360: órdenes, line items, creatividades y segmentación.
  • Configurar y mantener el targeting addressable en GAM, en coordinación con izzi y el área de datos.
  • Elaborar forecast y gestionar la disponibilidad de inventario ADTV por canal, señal y evento.
  • Operar y dar soporte técnico a la entrega de video y CTV (tags VAST, SSAI, pods y SCTE-35).
  • Monitorear la entrega y conciliar discrepancias entre GAM y los as-run de izzi, asegurando el correcto reconocimiento de ingresos.
  • Configurar, activar y dar seguimiento a deals Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) y Private Marketplace (PMP) con DV360, Amazon DSP y otras plataformas.
  • Coordinar con izzi, programación de canales y producción la operación comercial de eventos en vivo.
  • Generar reportes de entrega, rendimiento y calidad, y proponer mejoras de procesos y automatización de la operación ADTV.


Tu deberías de tener

  • Licenciatura concluida en Comunicación, Mercadotecnia, Sistemas o afín.
  • Conocimiento comprobable de Google Ad Manager 360; deseable certificación GAM, DV360 o Amazon DSP.
  • Experiencia en Ad Operations / trafficking en medios, broadcaster, OTT o agencia.
  • Experiencia en video y CTV: VAST, SSAI, pods y SCTE-35.
  • Experiencia en conciliación de entrega y activación de deals PG y PMP.
  • Deseable experiencia en Addressable TV / Pay TV (izzi, Sky u operadores de cable) y conocimientos de SQL / BigQuery.
  • Pensamiento analítico, atención al detalle y capacidad de trabajar bajo presión en eventos en vivo.
  • Modalidad de trabajo:En sitio

Experiencia requerida: +3 años. Inglés intermedio-avanzado (B2 técnico); deseable C1.


Beneficios

En TelevisaUnivision, valoramos el bienestar integral de nuestros colaboradores. Promovemos un equilibrio saludable entre la vida personal y profesional, ofreciendo beneficios de ley y superiores que impulsan la productividad, la creatividad y el desarrollo personal y profesional.

job.title: Anchor & Multimedia Journalist
job.description:
N+ Univision 23 in DFW is looking for an Anchor/MMJ to join our team at KUVN! The successful candidate should be proud of the commitment to serving our local community. This role will anchor the morning newscast and other shows as assigned, and work as a multimedia journalist (MMJ) during other shifts, gathering, shooting, and editing content for assigned newscasts.


ABOUT YOU:

The Anchor/MMJ will research, enterprise, develop, write, shoot and edit stories on deadline for live or recorded newscasts. MMJ will be responsible for reporting, and at times anchoring, as well as any other assigned newscast as needed. MMJ contributes to special features and stories as well as participates in coordinating coverage of major stories, breaking news, and specials. You will be responsible for generating story ideas, as well as making and maintaining contacts with community leaders, government officials, and local authorities. You will present reports in a clear, concise, objective manner; as well as present enterprising stories and sweeps series ideas. You are a team player with solid news judgment and must be a “one-person band” to complete a story from beginning to end. You must be able to work independently with the camera, write, edit your own story, and interact with the viewers through all the Univision media platforms. You will report to VP of News.


YOUR DAY-DAY:

  • Produce daily content for a variety of platforms, including TV, web, mobile etc.
  • Writes and delivers news stories in a clear and concise manner
  • Proofread reporters and writers copy for accuracy prior to going on air.
  • Establish a good working-relationship with newscast producers, reporters and co-anchors to ensure a well-paced, accurate and informative broadcast.
  • Must be a strong and fast writer and have solid news judgment.
  • Attend and participate in off-site company-sponsored and community events as assigned by station management.
  • Work flexible hours, including holidays, weekends, and evenings.
  • Gather information about events through research, interviews, experience, and attendance at political, news, sports, artistic, social, and other functions.
  • Investigate breaking news developments such as disasters, crimes, and human interest stories, among others topics.

 

YOU HAVE:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Communications, Journalism, or related field, plus 5 years of experience in the field or as a television journalist.
  • Excellent command of Spanish and English both written and verbal.
  • Previous experience as an anchor highly preferred.
  • Applicants must be able to use newsroom computer systems and applications (both hardware/software).
  • Knowledge of iNews, video editing (Adobe Premiere and Adobe creative cloud preferred), and file sharing systems preferred.
  • High ethical and journalistic standards.
  • Advanced knowledge in the use of field cameras, gear and editing systems.Ability to work nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • A valid driver’s license with a good driving record.Ability to sit, stand and walk for up to (8) hours without restrictions.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 30 pounds for extended periods of time.

 

OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.
