job.title: Assignment Editor and Producer - Temp
job.description:
JOB TITLE: Assignment Desk Editor and Producer - Temp

LOCATION: Dallas, TX


ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:


N+ Univision 23 in Dallas–Fort Worth is looking for a dynamic, competitive and creative Temporary Assignment Desk Editor and Producer to join our newsroom at KUVN, Channel 23. This role helps shape daily coverage, coordinates field logistics and produces compelling journalism for broadcast, digital and social platforms. The successful candidate is committed to serving North Texas communities and identifying the stories that matter most to our audience.


ABOUT YOU:


You are a collaborative newsroom leader with strong news judgment, a sense of urgency and a passion for distinctive, visually engaging storytelling. You arrive at editorial meetings informed and prepared to help set the direction of the news day, ask thoughtful questions and develop compelling angles. You communicate priorities clearly, deploy resources strategically and adapt coverage as stories develop. You work closely with reporters, photographers, producers and digital teams to advance stories, verify information and deliver accurate, relevant coverage across platforms.


YOUR DAY-DAY:


• Identify, research, develop, write and produce high-impact stories for broadcast and digital platforms, with a focus on the Dallas–Fort Worth area and the communities we serve.

• Help lead editorial meetings, establish daily priorities and develop strong angles, follow-ups and enterprise opportunities that distinguish our coverage.

• Assign stories and provide crews with the information, contacts, context and editorial expectations needed to execute coverage.

• Monitor scanners, wire services, newsroom feeds, social media and other sources to identify breaking news and developing stories; verify information and determine when immediate action is needed.

• Deploy crews and coordinate interviews, field logistics, planned events, breaking news and future coverage. Field produce as needed.

• Maintain clear communication with newsroom managers, producers, reporters, photographers, digital teams and outside agencies as stories develop.

• Monitor competitors and find opportunities to advance stories, answer outstanding questions and strengthen our reporting.

• Line produce newscasts as assigned, contributing to story selection and placement, writing, teases, timing, graphics and other production elements.

• Use video, sound, graphics, live elements and reporter involvement to create engaging, visually compelling newscasts.

• Work with reporters to develop and strengthen story packages while ensuring accuracy and compliance with station editorial standards.

• Source and verify content from social and digital platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, X, Reddit and emerging platforms.

• Share confirmed information, developing stories, video and other available elements promptly with digital and broadcast teams.

• Build relationships with viewers, community organizations, public officials and other sources to generate and develop story ideas.

job.title: Audience & Segmentation Specialist Jr
job.description:
Título: Audience & Segmentation Specialist Jr

Ubicación: Ciudad de México, Santa Fe, Presencial


Acerca del puesto y el equipo:

 Forma parte del equipo de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder en el mundo de medios y contenido en español, TelevisaUnivision cuenta con la más extensa videoteca de contenido propio y es líder en capacidad de producción en el sector, lo que impulsa su contenido digital de streaming, televisión tradicional y plataformas de radio.

 

Somos una empresa vibrante con más de 10,000 colaboradores en México, Colombia y EE. UU, nos une la pasión por el entretenimiento, la creatividad y los grandes hitos. en TelevisaUnivision encontrarás un ambiente amigable y lleno de equidad para crecer personal y profesionalmente.

 

¡Únete y se parte de este gran equipo dinámico!

 

TelevisaUnivision está en búsqueda de un Audience & Segmentation Specialist Jr para el área de Ventas.

 

El área de Ventas se enfoca en generar ingresos y aumentar la participación de mercado mediante la identificación y satisfacción de las necesidades de los clientes. Esto implica desarrollar estrategias de ventas, establecer relaciones con clientes, presentar productos o servicios y cerrar acuerdos comerciales para alcanzar metas y objetivos de ventas.

 

Sobre ti:

 

Recolección, preparación y análisis básico de los datos de audiencia, así como en la ejecución operativa de las estrategias de segmentación, contribuyendo así a la construcción de perfiles de usuario y a la optimización de la monetización publicitaria. Garantizar la calidad y precisión de los datos, y realizar las tareas fundamentales que permiten generar insights más profundos y activar segmentos de audiencia estratégicos.

 

Tu día a día: 

  • Extracción y consolidación de datos de comportamiento de visualización y engagement de los usuarios.
  • Realizar análisis iniciales y exploratorios de estos datos para identificar tendencias básicas o anomalías.
  • Colaborar en la limpieza, validación y preparación de datos de primera parte (1P data).
  • Asistir en la integración de diferentes fuentes de datos (1P, 2P, 3P)
  • Supervisión, configuración y manutención de los segmentos de audiencia dentro de las herramientas (DMPs, CDPs) según las metodologías definidas.
  • Realizar el control de calidad de los segmentos creados para asegurar su precisión y coherencia.
  • Generar informes de rendimiento de segmentos y dashboards básicos.
  • Ayudar en la documentación de metodologías de segmentación y procesos de datos.
  • Aprender activamente sobre el ecosistema AdTech, las plataformas de datos y las mejores prácticas en análisis y segmentación de audiencias.
  • Desarrollar una sólida base en habilidades analíticas y de manejo de datos.
  • Control de Calidad y Verificación de Datos:
  • Realizar auditorías y verificaciones para asegurar la precisión y consistencia de los datos de audiencia y la correcta activación de los segmentos
  • Soporte en Pruebas A/B de Segmentos: Ayudar en la configuración, monitoreo y análisis de pruebas A/B relacionadas con diferentes estrategias de segmentación o targeting.
  • Asistir en la creación y el mantenimiento de la documentación interna sobre los procesos de recolección de datos, las definiciones de segmentos y las metodologías de análisis utilizadas por el equipo.
  • Preparar resúmenes o diapositivas con hallazgos iniciales de análisis de datos para presentaciones internas, bajo la supervisión del especialista.
  • undefined

Tu deberás tener: 


  • Inglés Avanzado
  • Análisis de Datos Digitales: Experiencia en la extracción y el procesamiento de datos de plataformas web o de aplicaciones.
  • Reporting y Creación de Dashboards: Haber trabajado en la generación de informes de rendimiento y la creación de paneles de control básicos.
  • Operaciones de Marketing Digital/Publicidad: Familiaridad con la configuración y el monitoreo de campañas en plataformas publicitarias (aunque sea a nivel básico).
  • Manejo de Bases de Datos: Experiencia (incluso básica) con SQL para consultar y manipular datos.
  • Control de Calidad de Datos: Haber participado en tareas de verificación y limpieza de datos.
  • Investigación de Mercado/Tendencias: Haber colaborado en la búsqueda de información sobre la industria o el consumidor.
  • 2 años de experiencia
  • Capacidad Analítica Básica, Manejo de Hojas de Cálculo (Intermedio/Avanzado),
  • Conocimiento de SQL (Básico), Atención al Detalle, Habilidades de Comunicación Escrita,
  • Curiosidad y Aprendizaje Rápido                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            

Beneficios:

En TelevisaUnivision, valoramos el bienestar integral de nuestros empleados. Creemos que un equilibrio saludable entre la vida personal y profesional es fundamental para el éxito. Por eso, ofrecemos: Beneficios de ley y Beneficios superiores que superan los requisitos legales. job.title: Executive Producer
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced journalist to serve as Executive Producer for our Sacramento newsroom. This position is responsible for driving the station's editorial vision, leading daily news coverage, mentoring newsroom staff, and ensuring the highest standards of journalism across all platforms.

The Executive Producer serves as a key newsroom leader, working closely with producers, reporters, assignment editors, and management to elevate storytelling, coordinate breaking news coverage, and execute the station's editorial strategy.


This position will also serve as an emergency or relief anchor as operational needs require, providing on-air coverage during breaking news, staff absences, vacations, or special events. the brand.

 

 

YOUR DAY-DAY:

  • Lead the daily editorial direction and content strategy for the Sacramento newsroom.
  • Facilitate editorial meetings and help establish daily news priorities.
  • Coach producers, reporters, MMJs, and newsroom staff to strengthen storytelling and journalistic quality.
  • Review scripts and provide editorial guidance to ensure accuracy, balance, and clarity.
  • Oversee breaking news coverage and coordinate newsroom resources during major events.
  • Develop enterprise reporting, investigations, explainers, and special projects.
  • Ensure consistent editorial standards across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms.
  • Collaborate with station leadership on newsroom strategy, audience growth, and content innovation.
  • Mentor newsroom staff and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Write and edit scripts and special coverage.
  • Conduct interviews with newsmakers and community leaders.
  • Participate in field reporting and special assignments as needed.
  • Create digital and social content that supports newsroom initiatives.
  • Serve as a versatile on-air anchor by leading breaking news, special reports, election coverage, and emergency or relief broadcasts, while representing the station at community events and public appearances as assigned, delivering accurate, engaging, and professional coverage under dynamic news conditions.



YOU HAVE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of newsroom leadership experience in a small - medium market,
  • Proven success producing high-impact, ratings-driven newscasts in competitive television markets.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead newsroom operations in fast-paced, high-pressure environments, including overnight shifts and extended coverage during breaking news and major events.
  • Strong expertise in developing multi-platform news strategies, seamlessly integrating broadcast, digital, streaming, and social media to maximize audience engagement.
  • Exceptional editorial judgment, decisive leadership, and the ability to make sound decisions under tight deadlines.

You can independently line-produce newscasts, manage iNews rundowns, coordinate with production teams, and ensure broadcasts reflect the station’s editorial priorities, production standards, and brand identity.
  • Strategic thinker with a creative approach to storytelling, newsroom innovation, and audience growth.

  • Strong people-management skills with experience leading, motivating, and evaluating teams across multiple levels of responsibility.

job.title: Lead Software Engineer, Web & Connected TV
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

TelevisaUnivision is the world's leading Spanish-language media company, reaching millions of consumers through streaming, digital platforms, social media, audio, linear television, sports, news, entertainment, and live events. As we continue expanding our global streaming platform, ViX, we are investing in innovative technology and exceptional digital experiences to connect audiences with the content they love.

The ViX Product & Engineering team is responsible for developing and maintaining high-performance, scalable, and reliable streaming experiences across Web, Smart TV, Connected TV, mobile, and supporting platforms. Our engineers collaborate closely with Product, Design, Quality Assurance, Backend, Data, Advertising, and Operations teams across multiple markets.

We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer – Web & Connected TV to join our team in Santa Fe, Mexico. In this role, you will provide both technical leadership and direct people management for a team of software engineers responsible for developing and supporting ViX applications across modern web browsers and Connected TV platforms, with a particular focus on Samsung Tizen and LG webOS.

You will be responsible for driving engineering excellence, overseeing technical execution, developing team capabilities, managing performance, and ensuring the successful delivery of scalable, reliable, and high-quality streaming experiences. This position combines hands-on software engineering and architectural decision-making with responsibility for leading, coaching, and developing a high-performing engineering team.


ABOUT YOU:

You are an experienced software engineering leader with deep technical expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, and modern frontend architecture, complemented by practical experience developing applications for Smart TV and Connected TV platforms.

You have demonstrated success leading and managing software engineering teams, developing technical talent, driving accountability, and creating an environment where engineers can grow professionally while delivering meaningful business results.

You understand the unique challenges of building streaming applications across different devices, including browser compatibility, hardware limitations, memory constraints, video playback, and platform-specific requirements. You can make sound architectural decisions while balancing performance, scalability, customer experience, and delivery priorities.

You are a hands-on leader who enjoys solving complex technical problems, mentoring

engineers, and collaborating across functions. You are comfortable providing performance

feedback, establishing clear expectations, managing competing priorities, and supporting your

team's professional development.

You thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment and are passionate about building strong

engineering teams and delivering exceptional streaming experiences to millions of users.


YOUR DAY-DAY: (Responsibilities)

• Lead, manage, coach, and develop a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of

accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

• Oversee employee performance management, including goal setting, regular feedback,

performance evaluations, individual development plans, and career development

discussions.

• Partner with engineering leadership and Talent Acquisition on workforce planning,

recruitment, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and succession planning.

• Establish team priorities, coordinate workload distribution, and ensure accountability

for engineering deliverables, technical quality, and project timelines.

• Provide hands-on technical leadership in the architecture, design, development,

testing, deployment, and ongoing support of ViX applications across Web and

Connected TV platforms.

• Lead complex engineering initiatives from technical discovery and solution design

through implementation, testing, release, and post-launch optimization.

• Design and develop scalable, maintainable applications using TypeScript, JavaScript,

React, Next.js, HTML5, CSS, and platform-specific technologies.

• Drive frontend architecture and performance optimization, including server-side

rendering, caching, code splitting, application startup, navigation, and efficient

resource utilization.

• Develop and optimize Connected TV applications for Samsung Tizen and LG webOS,

accounting for device fragmentation, hardware limitations, firmware variations, and

platform-specific requirements.

• Establish reusable components, shared libraries, engineering standards, and

development practices that improve scalability, maintainability, and code quality

across platforms.

• Drive measurable improvements in application performance, including startup time,

rendering, memory utilization, playback reliability, buffering, and long-session stability.

• Oversee the development of television user experiences, including remote-control

navigation, focus management, playback controls, accessibility, and large-screen

interfaces.

• Lead the development and support of video streaming functionality across live, videoon-

demand (VOD), subscription-based, and advertising-supported experiences.

• Guide the integration and troubleshooting of video-player technologies such as

Bitmovin, Shaka Player, hls.js, dash.js, or comparable solutions.

• Support streaming protocols and technologies, including HLS, DASH, adaptive bitrate

streaming, digital rights management (DRM), captions, subtitles, and playback

authorization.

• Collaborate with Advertising teams to support server-side and client-side ad insertion

(SSAI/CSAI), advertising measurement, and seamless playback experiences.

• Oversee the design and maintenance of reliable GraphQL and REST API integrations,

including caching, error handling, retries, and performance monitoring.

• Establish and monitor application analytics, observability, and quality-of-experience

metrics to identify issues, measure performance, and drive continuous improvement.

• Define and implement comprehensive testing strategies across unit, integration, endto-

end, and physical Connected TV device testing.

• Oversee application packaging, certification, submission, deployment, and release

management processes for Samsung and LG platforms.

• Drive improvements in CI/CD pipelines, development tooling, automated testing, and

release processes to ensure efficient and reliable software delivery.

• Implement feature flags, experimentation, staged rollouts, and remote configuration

strategies to minimize deployment risk and improve application stability.

• Lead technical troubleshooting, production incident response, root-cause analysis,

and the implementation of long-term corrective solutions.

• Conduct architecture and code reviews, provide technical mentorship, and ensure

adherence to established engineering standards and best practices.

• Monitor team capacity, identify technical and operational risks, remove obstacles, and

escalate issues appropriately to support successful delivery.

• Partner with Product, Design, QA, Backend, Data, Advertising, Playback, Platform, and

Operations teams to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.

• Collaborate with engineering leadership to align team objectives, technical roadmaps,

resource planning, and development priorities with broader organizational goals.

• Leverage AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve engineering

productivity, testing, documentation, and code quality while maintaining security,

accuracy, and accountability.

• Stay informed about emerging technologies and industry trends across frontend

engineering, Connected TV, streaming, and software development, identifying

opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement.


YOU HAVE: (Required Skills, Qualifications and Experience)

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology,

or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant

experience developing and supporting large-scale consumer applications.

• Demonstrated experience directly managing software engineers, including

performance management, coaching, employee development, and team leadership.

• Proven ability to lead high-performing engineering teams while maintaining strong

hands-on technical expertise.

• Advanced proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, and modern frontend

development.

• Strong production experience with Next.js or comparable React-based frameworks.

• Professional experience developing applications for Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, or

other web-based Smart TV/Connected TV platforms.

• Strong understanding of frontend architecture, rendering, routing, hydration, caching,

code splitting, and web application performance.

• Knowledge of Connected TV development challenges, including hardware limitations,

device fragmentation, memory management, and platform compatibility.

• Experience designing and implementing remote-control navigation and focus-based

user interfaces for television applications.

• Strong understanding of video streaming technologies, including HLS, DASH, adaptive

bitrate streaming, DRM, live streaming, and VOD playback.

• Experience integrating, optimizing, and troubleshooting video players in production

environments.

• Experience developing and integrating GraphQL and REST APIs.

• Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS, accessibility standards, HTTP, CDN behavior,

responsive design, and web security fundamentals.

• Experience optimizing application performance, reliability, memory utilization, and

playback quality using measurable performance indicators.

• Experience with automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based

development, and software release management.

• Familiarity with Smart TV debugging tools, application packaging, certification, and

deployment processes.

• Demonstrated experience leading complex engineering initiatives, making architectural

decisions, and ensuring successful technical delivery.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including experience using application

logs, monitoring tools, performance metrics, and production dashboards.

• Proven ability to establish clear expectations, manage competing priorities, provide

constructive feedback, and support the professional growth of engineering teams.

• Strong interpersonal, organizational, and decision-making skills, with the ability to

collaborate effectively across technical and business functions.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with experience working

across geographically distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience developing streaming, OTT, media, entertainment, sports, or direct-toconsumer

digital products.

• Previous experience managing geographically distributed or cross-functional software

engineering teams.

• Experience supporting multiple generations of Samsung Tizen and LG webOS devices.

• Familiarity with video-player and DRM technologies such as Bitmovin, Shaka Player,

hls.js, dash.js, Widevine, PlayReady, or similar solutions.

• Experience supporting AVOD, SVOD, FAST, live sports, or high-concurrency streaming

environments.

• Knowledge of server-side and client-side advertising integrations, including SSAI, CSAI,

ad measurement, and advertising-supported playback.

• Experience with analytics and monitoring platforms such as Conviva, NPAW, New

Relic, Segment, Braze, or comparable solutions.

• Familiarity with monorepo architectures and development tools such as Turborepo, Nx,

or pnpm workspaces.

• Experience with cloud-based APIs, microservices, distributed systems, Node.js, and

CDN/edge architectures.

• Knowledge of A/B testing, feature flags, personalization, experimentation, and

progressive deployment strategies.

• Experience with authentication, subscription management, entitlement, content

protection, and privacy requirements.

• Exposure to additional Connected TV ecosystems, including Roku, Fire TV, Android TV,

Google TV, or Apple TV.

• Experience developing device testing strategies and supporting applications across

fragmented Smart TV environments.

• Experience modernizing legacy frontend or Connected TV applications while

maintaining production stability.

• Experience supporting workforce planning, technical succession planning, and

organizational development initiatives.

• Familiarity with AI-assisted software engineering tools and responsible development

practices.


ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

• Must be legally authorized to work in Mexico

• Employment and education verification may be required.

job.description:
¡TelevisaUnivision es la empresa líder de medios de comunicación en español a nivel mundial! Continuamos invirtiendo en nuestro contenido, talento y plataformas digitales, incluyendo streaming, redes sociales, audio, televisión lineal y eventos en vivo. A medida que expandimos nuestra plataforma global de streaming, ViX, buscamos impulsar la innovación tecnológica, optimizar nuestras operaciones y ofrecer experiencias digitales de alta calidad a nuestras audiencias.

 

TelevisaUnivision busca un Project Manager con sólida experiencia en la gestión de proyectos tecnológicos para coordinar la planificación, ejecución y entrega de iniciativas estratégicas dentro del área Digital y de nuestra plataforma de streaming ViX.

 

Esta posición será responsable de gestionar proyectos de principio a fin, facilitando la colaboración entre equipos multidisciplinarios de Ingeniería, Producto, Diseño, Operaciones y Tecnología. Su objetivo será asegurar el cumplimiento de los alcances, cronogramas, requerimientos técnicos y entregables establecidos, anticipando riesgos, gestionando dependencias y promoviendo una ejecución eficiente.

 

Asimismo, participará en la coordinación de iniciativas relacionadas con infraestructura de comunicaciones, procesos de votación digital, distribución de señales de video, monitoreo del desempeño técnico y mejoras en la estabilidad de los productos digitales, garantizando la alineación entre las soluciones tecnológicas y los objetivos del negocio.

 

SOBRE TI:

Eres un profesional organizado, analítico y orientado a resultados, con experiencia liderando la coordinación de proyectos tecnológicos en entornos dinámicos y multidisciplinarios.

 

Cuentas con la capacidad de gestionar múltiples iniciativas simultáneamente, establecer prioridades, anticipar riesgos y facilitar la colaboración entre equipos técnicos y de negocio. Comprendes los procesos de desarrollo e implementación de soluciones digitales y sabes traducir requerimientos complejos en planes de trabajo claros, medibles y ejecutables.

 

Te distingues por tu comunicación efectiva, capacidad de resolución de problemas, atención al detalle y habilidad para impulsar la ejecución de proyectos, manteniendo una visión integral de sus objetivos, dependencias y resultados.

 

 

TU DÍA A DÍA: (Responsabilidades)

·       Planificar, coordinar y dar seguimiento a proyectos tecnológicos de principio a fin, estableciendo alcances, cronogramas, hitos, prioridades y entregables alineados con los objetivos del negocio.

·       Coordinar la ejecución de iniciativas entre los equipos de Ingeniería, Producto, Diseño, Frontend, Backend, DevOps, QA y Operaciones, asegurando una comunicación efectiva y claridad en las responsabilidades de cada área.

·       Identificar, evaluar y gestionar riesgos, dependencias, cambios y obstáculos que puedan afectar el desarrollo de los proyectos, coordinando acciones preventivas y correctivas con los equipos responsables.

·       Monitorear el avance de los proyectos mediante indicadores de cumplimiento, cronogramas y entregables, proporcionando visibilidad oportuna sobre su estado, riesgos y próximos pasos.

·       Facilitar reuniones de seguimiento, coordinación técnica y revisión de avances, documentando acuerdos, compromisos y planes de acción para asegurar su cumplimiento.

·       Dar seguimiento a la validación de requerimientos técnicos y de negocio, coordinando con los equipos responsables las pruebas, revisiones y actividades necesarias para la implementación y salida a producción.

·       Coordinar con los equipos técnicos responsables las iniciativas relacionadas con infraestructura de redes y seguridad de los enlaces de comunicación de Digital y ViX, dando seguimiento a los requerimientos, controles y actividades necesarias para garantizar su continuidad operativa.

·       Colaborar con la Coordinación de Technical Program Management (TPM) Digital en la planificación anual de proyectos asociados con procesos de votación digital, incluyendo la coordinación de planes de prueba, requerimientos de seguridad y mecanismos de consolidación de datos.

·       Coordinar con los equipos de infraestructura y operaciones la entrega y recepción de señales de video en los sistemas de codificación (encoders), dando seguimiento a los requerimientos técnicos necesarios para soportar servicios de streaming de baja latencia y alta calidad.

·       Dar seguimiento a los objetivos e indicadores de desempeño técnico de las plataformas digitales, incluyendo las métricas VSF, TSH, VTF, SPI y CR, identificando desviaciones y coordinando con los equipos responsables los planes de acción correspondientes.

·       Coordinar el análisis de impacto y seguimiento de iniciativas técnicas (Tech Enablers) relacionadas con fallas y cierres inesperados (crashes) en productos digitales, facilitando la colaboración entre Operaciones, Backend, DevOps, QA y Frontend para su evaluación y resolución.

·       Promover la mejora continua de los procesos de gestión de proyectos, identificando oportunidades para optimizar la coordinación, comunicación, seguimiento y entrega de iniciativas tecnológicas.

 

TUS CONOCIMIENTOS Y EXPERIENCIA: (Requisitos)

Experiencia y habilidades requeridas

·       Licenciatura en Ingeniería, Sistemas Computacionales, Tecnologías de la Información, Administración de Proyectos o carrera afín.

·       Mínimo 7 años de experiencia en gestión de proyectos tecnológicos, incluyendo planificación, coordinación, ejecución, seguimiento e implementación de soluciones digitales.

·       Experiencia coordinando proyectos con equipos multidisciplinarios de Ingeniería, Producto, Diseño, Operaciones y Tecnología.

·       Conocimiento de metodologías de gestión de proyectos tradicionales y ágiles, así como de herramientas para el seguimiento de cronogramas, entregables, riesgos y dependencias.

·       Capacidad para comprender requerimientos técnicos y de negocio, facilitar su comunicación entre equipos y asegurar su alineación durante la ejecución de los proyectos.

·       Conocimiento de entornos de desarrollo de software y procesos tecnológicos, incluyendo Frontend, Backend, DevOps y aseguramiento de calidad (QA).

·       Experiencia en el seguimiento de indicadores de desempeño, análisis de resultados e identificación de desviaciones para facilitar la toma de decisiones.

·       Capacidad para gestionar múltiples proyectos simultáneamente, establecer prioridades y coordinar equipos con responsabilidades y objetivos diversos.

·       Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, organización, resolución de problemas y gestión de relaciones con equipos técnicos y diferentes niveles de la organización.

·       Orientación a resultados, atención al detalle y capacidad para anticipar riesgos y asegurar el cumplimiento de compromisos y entregables.

 

Experiencia y conocimientos deseables

·       Experiencia en proyectos tecnológicos relacionados con plataformas de streaming (OTT), medios digitales o modelos de negocio Direct-to-Consumer (DTC).

·       Familiaridad con tecnologías de distribución de señales de video, sistemas de codificación (encoding) y servicios de streaming de baja latencia.

·       Conocimiento de procesos de votación digital, incluyendo mecanismos de seguridad, planificación de pruebas y consolidación de datos.

·       Familiaridad con métricas de desempeño, calidad y estabilidad de plataformas digitales, así como con procesos de análisis y resolución de fallas técnicas.

·       Experiencia utilizando herramientas de gestión y seguimiento de proyectos como Jira, Confluence o plataformas similares.

·       Certificaciones en gestión de proyectos, como PMP, Scrum Master o equivalentes.

 

REQUISITOS DE ELEGIBILIDAD:

·       Disponibilidad para trabajar de manera presencial en las oficinas de TelevisaUnivision en Ciudad de México, zona Chapultepec.

·       La experiencia laboral y la formación académica estarán sujetas a verificación.

 

NUESTROS BENEFICIOS:

En TelevisaUnivision creemos que el bienestar de nuestros colaboradores y el equilibrio entre su vida personal y profesional son fundamentales para construir una cultura organizacional sólida. Por ello, ofrecemos una amplia variedad de beneficios y prestaciones que contribuyen a su desarrollo profesional y bienestar integral.

Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

job.title: Meteorologist
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

TelevisaUnivision at N+ Univision Chicago is looking for a Meteorologist to join our morning news team! The Meteorologist will be responsible for live weather reporting for 5am, 6am and midday newscast. The ideal candidate must be a certified broadcast meteorologist and have an “always-on” weather mindset. He or she should be an excellent communicator, possess commanding and professional on-camera presence with top-notch judgment. Strong knowledge required of severe weather including tornadoes and winter storms.

ABOUT YOU:

Our meteorologists take a proactive approach to active weather coverage, keeping audiences informed across multiple platforms with timely, accurate updates. They work in a collaborative and supportive role with our news producers, assignment desk, reporters, and our management team. Our meteorologists are essential to create engaging weather content on air and online while preparing audiences for changing conditions and potential threats.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Produce and effectively present lifestyle weather and daily forecast
  • Develop strategies for multiple dayparts, identifying opportunities to produce content for specific newscasts
  • Clearly communicating weather forecast and risk for potential active weather across platforms
  • Conceive creative graphics and execute them on air and online
  • Work in supportive role with other meteorologists to help produce content
  • Coordinates with news department to produce news coverage of active weather events
  • Produce and share content specifically designed for digital platforms

 

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

·       College degree in meteorology, atmospheric science or equivalent technical training in a meteorology-related institutional setting

·       5+ years of experience as a meteorologist, on-air in medium to large size markets

·       Well-versed in the latest weather technology, including The Weather Company (WSI Max)

·       Experience on-air covering severe weather (tornadoes, winter storms)

  • Ability to deliver extended, minute-by-minute live coverage of severe weather events with accuracy, clarity, and confidence.
  • Thrive under pressure, meeting tight deadlines

·       Flexibility to work any shift including overnight, weekends and holidays

  • Technology savvy with excellent computer skills
  • Must be willing to work from office in Chicago, IL

 

*This position will require the employee to be a member or join SAG-AFTRA.

 

OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

Base Salary: $82,000 - $93,000

#LI-ONSITE (for 100% onsite requirement)

 

TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist - Temp
job.description:
JOB TITLE: Multimedia Journalist  - Temporary

LOCATION: San Jose, CA

ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

The News Department at TelevisaUnivision is looking for a  Temporary Multimedia Journalist. The successful candidate should be proud of the commitment of serving our local community. As an MMJ, you will cover news in San Jose.

ABOUT YOU: You will be responsible for generating story ideas, as well as making and maintaining contacts with community leaders, government officials, and local authorities. You will present reports in a clear, concise, objective manner; as well as present enterprising stories and sweeps series ideas. You are a team player with solid news judgment and must be a “one-person band” to complete a story from beginning to end. You must be able to work independently with the camera, write, edit own story, and interact with the viewers through all the TelevisaUnivision media platforms. You will report to the News Director.

YOUR DAY-DAY:

•                     Gather information, conduct interviews, shoot video, produce, report, and edit assigned storiesdaily and establish Live shots as needed.

•                     Post video, pictures and stories to website, Facebook, and other social media outlets under thedirection of our Digital content producers.

•                     Maintain strong familiarity with local, state, and national news and events across our coveragearea.

•                     Establish and maintain news contacts in the community.

•                     Maintain a positive work atmosphere by behaving and communicating in a manner that workswell with coworkers, supervisors, and the community at large.

•                     Work independently while out in the field and under various weather elements.

YOU HAVE:

•                     A bachelor’s degree is preferred (i.e., communications, journalism, television broadcasting).

•                     1-year newsroom experience required; or equivalent combination of education and experiencewill be considered.

•                     Excellent command of Spanish and English both written and verbal.

•                     Applicant must be able to use newsroom computer systems and applications (bothhardware/software).

•                     Knowledge of iNews, video editing (such as Avid, Adobe Premiere, Final Cut), and file sharingsystems preferred.

•                     High ethical and journalistic standards.

•                     Advanced knowledge in the use of field cameras, gear and editing systems.

•                     Ability to work nights, weekends, and holidays.

•                     A valid driver’s license with a good driving record.

 

*This position will require the employee to be a member or join SAG-AFTRA.

 

Hourly rate: $50.40 Compensation for this position is determined in accordance with the applicable Union rates and collective bargaining agreement.

job.title: Planner Digital Jr
job.description:
Nombre de la Posición 

Planner Digital Jr

Ubicación

Ciudad de México, Presencial


Acerca del puesto y el equipo

Formarás parte de la Vicepresidencia de Ventas, dentro de la Dirección de Inventarios e Ingresos Publicitarios. El equipo es responsable de la planificación y optimización del inventario digital y la ejecución de campañas publicitarias en múltiples plataformas, trabajando de manera transversal con Marketing, Producto, Operaciones, Administración, agencias y clientes. 


Sobre el puesto

El objetivo del puesto es asistir en la planificación, ejecución y optimización de campañas de marketing digital, analizando datos de rendimiento y apoyando en la gestión de inventario digital. El rol colabora con el Planner Senior y otros stakeholders para asegurar una correcta planificación basada en datos históricos, disponibilidad de inventario y objetivos comerciales, contribuyendo al crecimiento de ingresos publicitarios digitales.


Sobre ti

Eres una persona analítica, organizada y orientada a datos, con interés en marketing digital y medios. Tienes facilidad para trabajar con múltiples tareas, comunicarte con diferentes áreas y aprender nuevas tecnologías. Te gusta trabajar en equipo, gestionar información compleja y convertir datos en insights accionables.


Tu día a día

• Desarrollar y ejecutar estrategias de publicidad digital alineadas con los objetivos comerciales. 
• Planificar y supervisar la implementación de campañas publicitarias en plataformas digitales de TelevisaUnivision. 
• Analizar métricas históricas de rendimiento digital para evaluar campañas, identificar tendencias y apoyar la planificación basada en datos. 
• Mantenerse actualizado sobre la disponibilidad de inventario digital en múltiples plataformas (AVOD, SVOD, Live Streaming, AA.EE). 
• Proponer proyectos e iniciativas que contribuyan al crecimiento de la Dirección de Inventario e Ingresos Publicitarios. 
• Realizar forecast y administración de inventario en eventos especiales. 
• Explorar el uso de data 1st y 3rd party para campañas digitales en operación diaria. 
• Colaborar con Marketing, Producto, Operaciones, Administración, agencias y equipos de ventas digitales. 


Tú deberás tener

• Licenciatura concluida. 
• Deseable certificaciones digitales (Google Ad Manager, Facebook Ads, Looker, conocimientos en programática). 
• Inglés nivel intermedio (B1–B2). 
• Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en marketing digital, medios, publicidad, ventas o administración de cuentas. 
• Conocimientos básicos en herramientas de marketing digital. 
• Excelentes habilidades analíticas y de resolución de problemas. 
• Capacidad para analizar datos, identificar tendencias y extraer insights. 
• Organización, atención al detalle y gestión de múltiples tareas. 
• Habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo. 
• Deseable habilidades de presentación y gestión de proyectos. 


Beneficios

Ofrecemos prestaciones de ley y superiores, así como oportunidades de desarrollo profesional dentro de una organización líder en medios y publicidad digital, con exposición a proyectos estratégicos y tecnologías de vanguardia.

job.title: Senior Director, Product Analytics
job.description:
JOB TITLE: Senior Director, Product Analytics

LOCATION: Miami, FL

 

ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

TelevisaUnivision is the world's leading Spanish-language media company, reaching millions of consumers through streaming, digital platforms, social media, audio, linear television, sports, news, entertainment, and live events. As we continue expanding our global streaming platform, ViX, we are investing in innovative technology, data capabilities, and advanced analytics to support business growth and deliver exceptional digital experiences.

The ViX Data & Insights team plays a critical role in enabling data-driven decision-making across our advertising-supported (AVOD) and subscription-based (SVOD) streaming businesses. Our team partners closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Acquisition, Advertising, Content, and other business functions to understand customer behavior, evaluate product performance, and identify opportunities to improve engagement, conversion, retention, and monetization.


We are looking for a Senior Director, Product Analytics to join our team in Miami, Florida. In this role, you will lead the Product Analytics function across ViX's digital platforms, including mobile, web, and Connected TV. You will be responsible for defining and executing the product analytics strategy, establishing measurement frameworks, advancing experimentation capabilities, and delivering actionable insights that influence product decisions, optimize customer experiences, and drive measurable business outcomes.

You will lead and develop a team of Product Analytics professionals, establishing priorities, driving accountability, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality analytical insights. You will also partner closely with senior Product, Engineering, Design, and Data leadership to improve data instrumentation, strengthen measurement capabilities, and promote a culture of data-driven decision-making across the organization.


ABOUT YOU:

You are an experienced analytics leader with a strong background in digital product analytics, customer behavior, experimentation, and data-driven product optimization. You have demonstrated success building and leading high-performing analytics teams that influence product strategy, improve customer experiences, and deliver measurable business outcomes, ideally within streaming, media, or direct-to-consumer digital businesses.

You have a deep understanding of the digital customer journey, from initial discovery and activation through engagement, conversion, retention, and monetization. You are skilled at identifying opportunities to improve product performance, establishing meaningful measurement frameworks, and translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations that inform strategic business decisions.

You bring strong expertise in product experimentation, A/B testing, funnel analysis, behavioral analytics, and statistical methodologies. You understand how to establish reliable experimentation practices, evaluate product initiatives, and distinguish meaningful performance improvements from statistical noise or external influences.

You recognize that effective product analytics depends on accurate instrumentation, consistent user identification, reliable data validation, and standardized metrics across mobile, web, Connected TV, and other digital platforms. You are comfortable partnering with Product, Engineering, QA, and Data Engineering teams to strengthen data quality and ensure trustworthy measurement.

You are a strategic, collaborative, and influential leader who can build strong relationships with senior executives and cross-functional stakeholders. You combine analytical judgment with business acumen, helping teams prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, business value, and measurable results.

You are passionate about developing analytical talent, fostering accountability, advancing experimentation practices, and leveraging modern analytics technologies and AI to improve decision-making, operational efficiency, and product outcomes.



YOUR DAY-TO-DAY (RESPONSIBILITIES):

Product Analytics Strategy & Leadership

  • Lead the development and execution of ViX's Product Analytics strategy, priorities, and measurement frameworks across digital platforms and markets.
  • Establish the strategic direction, operating priorities, and analytical capabilities required to support product innovation, customer experience optimization, and business growth.
  • Partner with senior Product and business leadership to influence product roadmaps, investment decisions, feature prioritization, and long-term optimization strategies.
  • Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement, conversion, retention, and monetization, translating analytical insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Define and monitor key performance indicators that measure product effectiveness, customer behavior, and the business impact of product initiatives.
  • Present product performance insights, analytical findings, and strategic recommendations to senior executives, influencing decisions through clear, data-driven storytelling.

People Leadership & Team Development

Lead, manage, coach, and develop a team of Product Analytics professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, analytical excellence, and continuous improvement.

  • Oversee employee performance management, including goal setting, ongoing feedback, performance evaluations, individual development plans, and career development discussions.
  • Establish team priorities, manage workload distribution, and ensure accountability for analytical deliverables, quality standards, and timelines.
  • Partner with leadership on workforce planning, talent acquisition, organizational capabilities, and succession planning to support the continued development of the Product Analytics function.
  • Provide technical and analytical guidance to team members, strengthening expertise in experimentation, statistical analysis, product measurement, and business insights.
  • Promote knowledge sharing, professional development, and consistent analytical methodologies across the team.

Customer Journey & Product Performance

  • Lead the development and execution of customer journey analytics strategies across discovery, onboarding, activation, engagement, conversion, and retention.
  • Oversee analyses that identify customer friction points, behavioral patterns, and opportunities to improve user experience, feature adoption, and conversion funnels.
  • Establish measurement frameworks to evaluate the effectiveness of content discovery, search, recommendations, personalization, and other product experiences.
  • Drive consistent evaluation of product performance across AVOD and SVOD business models, customer segments, devices, and geographic markets.
  • Partner with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to identify opportunities for product improvements and prioritize initiatives based on customer impact and business value.
  • Ensure product analytics insights inform strategies that improve customer engagement, subscription conversion, retention, and long-term customer value.

Experimentation & Product Optimization

  • Lead the strategy, development, and continuous improvement of ViX's product experimentation and A/B testing capabilities.
  • Establish standards and best practices for experimental design, statistical analysis, hypothesis development, and measurement methodologies.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Design teams to define experiment objectives, success metrics, audience requirements, and analytical approaches.
  • Oversee experiment quality and reliability, including validation of audience allocation, sample sizes, statistical significance, data integrity, and measurement accuracy.
  • Guide the interpretation of experimental results and ensure findings translate into actionable recommendations for product launches, feature enhancements, and optimization initiatives.
  • Promote a culture of continuous experimentation and evidence-based decision-making across Product and Engineering teams.

Product Instrumentation & Data Quality

  • Define and oversee product analytics instrumentation strategies, event tracking requirements, measurement plans, and data collection standards across digital platforms.
  • Partner with Engineering, QA, and Data Engineering teams to ensure accurate event tracking, user identification, cross-device measurement, and data validation.
  • Establish consistent definitions and methodologies for product metrics to ensure reliable reporting and meaningful performance comparisons across platforms and markets.
  • Identify measurement gaps, data quality issues, and instrumentation opportunities, partnering with technical teams to implement sustainable improvements.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering and Data Product Management teams to ensure underlying data capabilities support product analytics requirements and evolving business needs.

Reporting, Insights & Business Impact

  • Define and oversee the development of product performance dashboards, executive reporting, and self-service analytics capabilities that support timely, informed decision-making.
  • Lead analytical initiatives connecting customer behavior and product performance to engagement, subscription growth, retention, advertising monetization, and customer lifetime value.
  • Establish frameworks to measure the business impact of product releases, user experience changes, experimentation initiatives, and strategic product investments.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex analytical findings into clear recommendations and measurable business actions.
  • Monitor the effectiveness and adoption of product analytics capabilities, identifying opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, analytical quality, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation, advanced analytics, and emerging AI capabilities to improve analytical workflows, insight generation, and operational efficiency.

YOU HAVE (QUALIFICATIONS):

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Product Analytics, Digital Analytics, Data Science, Business Analytics, or related functions, including significant experience leading analytics teams and strategic initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience directly managing and developing analytics professionals, including performance management, coaching, talent development, and team leadership.
  • Proven success building or scaling Product Analytics capabilities for large-scale consumer digital products, preferably within streaming, OTT, media, entertainment, gaming, or subscription-based businesses.
  • Strong understanding of digital product performance measurement, including customer journeys, activation, conversion funnels, feature adoption, engagement, retention, and monetization.
  • Extensive experience designing, analyzing, and interpreting A/B tests and controlled experiments, including statistical significance, sample size estimation, statistical power, and experiment validation.
  • Strong knowledge of statistical analysis, experimental design, cohort analysis, segmentation, funnel analysis, and customer behavioral analytics.
  • Advanced SQL proficiency and demonstrated experience working with large-scale analytical datasets, cloud data warehouses, and complex data models.
  • Experience with digital product analytics and event tracking technologies, including Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong understanding of product event instrumentation, data collection methodologies, user identification, cross-platform tracking, and data quality validation.
  • Experience establishing product KPIs, analytical frameworks, executive reporting, and measurement standards that translate complex datasets into actionable business insights.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with senior Product, Engineering, Design, and business leaders to influence product strategy and drive measurable improvements.
  • Proven ability to establish team priorities, manage resources, oversee complex analytical initiatives, and ensure accountability for deliverables and business outcomes.
  • Strong analytical reasoning and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to identify root causes, evaluate competing hypotheses, and develop evidence-based recommendations.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical findings to technical and nontechnical audiences, including senior executives.

  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives and collaborating effectively with geographically distributed teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience leading Product Analytics within streaming, OTT, digital media, entertainment, gaming, or direct-to-consumer subscription businesses.

job.title: Test Automation Architect

YOU HAVE: (Required Skills, Qualifications and Experience)

job.title: Breaking News Intern - Winter 2026/2027
job.description:
Breaking News Internship

The Daily Beast delivers award-winning original reporting and sharp opinions from big personalities in the arenas of politics, pop culture, world news, and more. Fiercely independent and armed with irreverent intelligence, The Daily Beast now reaches more than 20 million readers per month. The Daily Beast is based in New York and is an operating business of IAC (NASDAQ: IAC).

Job Description

The Daily Beast is seeking a talented, motivated, and dependable Breaking News Intern to join our award-winning newsroom on-site in New York as part of the Cheat Sheet/breaking news team. Open to undergraduate juniors and seniors, graduate students, and post-grads, the internship is an exciting opportunity for emerging journalists to learn how a newsroom works while gaining hands-on experience. The roles are full-time (37.5 hours/week) for three-month periods between September through November. It will include evening and weekend shifts.
Ideal candidates are newshounds who can work quickly, write cleanly and with some flair, and both take initiative and direction.

Qualifications

* Experience writing breaking news.

* A voracious news diet and appetite that covers politics, pop culture, power, and big issues in the national and global conversations.

* Prior knowledge of web publishing and using a content management system is a plus.

* Comfort meeting quick deadlines.

To apply, please submit a resume and a cover letter that includes links to 4-6 portfolio pieces. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

The pay for this position is $19.00 per hour.

Additional information

Don’t meet every single requirement listed here? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet each and every qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you’re interested in joining the Beast but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with this job description, we encourage you to give it a shot all the same. It might turn out that you're just the right candidate for this or other roles.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

job.title: Editorial Lawyer
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals, and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We’re now looking for an Editorial Lawyer to provide legal support and advice to our publications. 

 

The GNM Editorial Legal Department provides pre- and post- publication legal advice to all our editorial departments. You’ll be working alongside some of the top journalists and editors. The editorial lawyers have worked on many exciting news and investigative projects.

 

About the Role

Editorial lawyers work closely with our journalists and editors to make sure that what we publish is legally defensible. This involves reading stories before they are published and checking for legal risk in areas such as defamation, privacy and data protection, contempt and copyright. It can be a fast moving and demanding environment. In addition to this pre-publication review, editorial lawyers also advise on the merits of any court cases that may be threatened and / or filed against GNM, working with the appropriate journalists, editors and executives to define a strategic defence and/or approve settlements of disputes where warranted, as well as selecting, retaining, managing, and evaluating any outside solicitors or counsel as needed.

 

Additional responsibilities include:

  • Pre-publication legal and editorial code review on a real-time basis on all content-related issues

  • Managing pre and post publication litigation (including libel, breach of confidence, privacy, data protection, freedom of information, contempt of court (publication), production orders, copyright, open justice + challenging reporting restrictions)

  • Contributing to policy and lobbying discussions and documents

 

About You

  • 2-4 years post qualified experience or equivalent

  • Experience of civil and/or criminal litigation including ability to handle own caseload

  • Background in/knowledge of media law (including libel, breach of confidence, privacy, data protection, freedom of information, contempt of court (publication), production orders, copyright, open justice + challenging reporting restrictions and broadcast

  • Ideally proven experience of pre and post publication litigation work

  • Background in / knowledge of complaint handling and responding

  • Ideally, you’ll have a demonstrable ability to bring a diverse perspective to this role

 

We actively encourage applications from candidates from other groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media and legal profession. 

 

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people at the Guardian. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve,

where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future.

 

How to apply

To apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you’d love to take on this role, and why you’re a great match for what we’re looking for.

 

The closing date for applications is 6pm, Tuesday 1st December 2026.

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it easier and more comfortable for you. Please contact Sean on sean.brinkley@guardian.co.uk to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

 

Benefits at the Guardian

 

Culture & wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace.

 

You will also have the opportunity to hear unique insight from our journalists in our morning conference, a live discussion on the news story of the day.

 

We offer great tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including free yoga and pilates. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.

 

Learning & development

We encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships. 

 

Our working environment

We take pride in our surroundings and are pleased to offer versatile meeting rooms and colourful communal areas. We have a brilliant canteen that caters to breakfast, lunch and dinner, with views overlooking Regent’s Canal.

 

Additional benefits & policies

We offer 30 days annual leave per annum, plus an additional 5 day holiday purchase scheme. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

You are entitled to life cover, income protection, healthcare, sick pay and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

job.title: Multimedia Editor (Training)
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals, and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We are looking for a multimedia editor (training) to help build multimedia capability across our newsroom, in line with the Guardian’s Project Berger transformation. You’ll identify skills and development needs, design and deliver practical training, and work directly with journalists to help them create ambitious, engaging video and off-platform storytelling.

 

Combining hands-on video production expertise with coaching and mentoring, you’ll work directly with editors, reporters and production staff to develop their skills and confidence. You’ll provide practical support, tailor training to different levels of experience and help teams collaborate effectively with specialist multimedia producers. You’ll work closely with the Project Berger team throughout.

 

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract or staff secondment aligned to a 12-month training programme.

 

About the role

  • Work with journalists from predominantly text-based backgrounds to identify opportunities for ambitious and distinctive video/social storytelling, championing a visual, multi-format approach to our journalism.
  • Deliver practical, hands-on training, working directly with journalists to develop their multimedia skills, confidence and enthusiasm for video and off-platform journalism.
  • Support journalists to understand how to adapt stories and angles for different platforms, audiences and formats.
  • Help colleagues understand audience needs and behaviour across platforms, including the Guardian, YouTube, Instagram and TikTok.
  • Use audience data, feedback and learning evaluation to help assess what works and inform future training.
  • Support journalists and editors to understand how text, video, photography and graphics can work together to tell stories effectively.
  • Help colleagues develop practical production skills across a range of formats, including filming, editing, loops, carousels, headline cards and social graphics.
  • Work closely with other Guardian training teams and offices to ensure a coordinated approach to skills development, sharing expertise and avoiding duplication. Contribute to wider training programmes and masterclasses where required.

 

About you

  • Experience of designing, delivering or supporting training, coaching, mentoring or other learning and development activity.
  • Demonstrable experience of developing video stories and an understanding of how to structure compelling visual narratives for different platforms.
  • Ability to communicate technical and editorial concepts clearly to colleagues with different levels of experience.
  • Experience of creating video journalism for social platforms, including an understanding of different audience needs and behaviours.
  • Strong knowledge of video production equipment and editing and visual design tools, such as Adobe Premiere Pro and Figma.
  • Experience of video production, including practical filming, editing and working with contributors and presenters. 
  • Understanding of effective learning and development principles, including different learning styles and approaches.
  • Strong understanding of Guardian editorial standards, accuracy, verification, copyright and legal considerations relevant to video/social production.
  • Experience of managing projects, schedules and competing priorities.
  • Ideally, you’ll have a demonstrable ability to bring a diverse perspective to this role. 

 

We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media.

 

We operate in a hybrid environment working at least three days a week from our offices in King’s Cross in London.

 

The salary band for this role starts at £68,000, with the final offer determined by the successful candidate's skills, experience, and responsibilities.  

 

How to apply

To apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you’d love to take on this role, and why you’re a great match for what we’re looking for. 

We appreciate the time taken to prepare each application we receive. We do not use AI-assisted technology to review applications; every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team. 

 

The closing date for applications is Thursday 3rd December 2026.

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs.

 

Benefits at the Guardian

You'll have six weeks of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

 

You are entitled to life cover, private healthcare, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

 

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

 

Culture and wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace. We became the first major media organisation to achieve B Corp status.

 

We offer tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including access to our employee benefits platform which provides tailored support for health and wellbeing. In addition, we also offer free yoga and pilates classes. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.

 

Our canteen has views overlooking the Regents Canal and caters for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

 

Learning and development

We encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships.

  • Strong visual production, design and editorial skills, with an excellent eye for visual storytelling and detail.
  • Ideally, you’ll have a demonstrable ability to bring a diverse perspective to this role. 

 

We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media.

 

We operate in a hybrid environment working at least three days a week from our offices in King’s Cross in London.

 

The salary band for this role starts at £60,000, with the final offer determined by the successful candidate's skills, experience, and responsibilities.  

 

How to apply

To apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you’d love to take on this role, and why you’re a great match for what we’re looking for. 

 

We appreciate the time taken to prepare each application we receive. We do not use AI-assisted technology to review applications; every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team. 

 

The closing date for applications is Thursday 3rd December 2026.

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please email Sean, Senior Recruitment Partner at sean.brinkley@guardian.co.uk to let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs.

 

Benefits at the Guardian

You'll have six weeks of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

 

You are entitled to life cover, private healthcare, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

 

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

 

Culture and wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace. We became the first major media organisation to achieve B Corp status.

 

We offer tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including access to our employee benefits platform which provides tailored support for health and wellbeing. In addition, we also offer free yoga and pilates classes. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.

 

Our canteen has views overlooking the Regents Canal and caters for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

 

Learning and development

We encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships.

job.title: Video Editor
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals, and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We are looking for a video editor to edit a new video show format for the Guardian Studios YouTube channels and other digital platforms, the Close Up, a brand-new culture show hosted by journalist Carys Afoko and Guardian senior culture writer Lanre Bakare.

 

Launching in November as an always-on series, new episodes will be released twice a week in video and audio formats on the Guardian’s website and platforms including YouTube and Spotify.

 

The video editor will shape the material into a polished, engaging and visually distinctive film, with a particular focus on pace, storytelling and editorial rhythm.

 

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract or staff secondment.

 

About the role

  • Develop a strong, coherent video narrative, creating the structure, selecting the strongest moments and creating the overall flow of the conversation.
  • Bring excellent editorial judgement and a strong instinct for sizzle cutting, pacing, rhythm, hooks and moments that capture and sustain audience attention.
  • Shape the material into a compelling, polished piece that feels premium and editorially distinctive, while preserving the integrity and substance of the interview and is engaging to a YouTube-first audience.
  • Review and organise supplied footage, audio, project files and supporting assets, ensuring an efficient and well-managed editing workflow.
  • Attend shoots where necessary, working with the producer to start an edit plan while recording
  • Work in Adobe Premiere Pro, maintaining an organised, efficient and technically sound workflow, including appropriate media management, sequences and timelines.
  • Use Adobe After Effects and supplied GFX templates as required, adapting and integrating graphics, titles, captions and other visual treatments into the edit.
  • Undertake audio post-production, including dialogue clean-up, balancing levels and reducing distracting noise where possible, then deliver a clean, consistent final mix.
  • Maintain clear communication with the producer and executive producer, respond constructively to feedback and manage the work efficiently to meet the agreed deadline.

 

About you

  • Demonstrable experience editing long-form YouTube content, documentaries, video podcasts, interviews or other editorially driven digital video.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing storytelling, sizzle cutting, pace, narrative structure and editorial rhythm.
  • Excellent working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro, including offline editing, media organisation, timeline management, project handover and export workflows.
  • Working knowledge of Adobe After Effects, with the ability to use supplied templates and integrate motion graphics into an edit.
  • Experience working with interview or conversation-led material and shaping longer conversations into compelling, well-paced viewing experiences.
  • An understanding of YouTube-first content, audience retention, effective openings and the importance of maintaining visual engagement across longer-form films.
  • Experience using B-roll, cutaways, graphics, captions and other visual devices to support storytelling and add texture to interview footage.
  • A good understanding of online finishing, quality control, export settings, codecs, resolutions, frame rates and delivery specifications.
  • Knowledge of digital accessibility best practice for video and audio content, such as accurate captions and transcripts, audio description, and accessible on-screen text and graphics (e.g. WCAG guidelines).
  • Experience working with producers and incorporating editorial feedback under tight turnaround times.
  • Ideally, you’ll have a demonstrable ability to bring a diverse perspective to this role.

The New York Times' Advertising team is looking for an Associate Sales Director to join our Emerging Business Sales Team. job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company.
