job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs HR Decision Scientist Job ID 10164653 Location Burbank, California, United States / Lake Buena Vista, Florida, United States Business The Walt Disney Company (Corporate) Date posted Nov. 20, 2026 HR Decision Scientist Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements

About the Role

The HR Decision Scientist applies advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and machine learning to inform data-driven decisions across Human Resources at The Walt Disney Company’s Corporate segment. In this role, you will translate complex workforce data into clear, actionable insights that help maximize the success of Disney employees and support world-class storytelling around the globe.

Responsibilities

As an HR Decision Scientist, you will design and implement analytical solutions that support HR strategies, partnering closely with People Insights, HR, and business stakeholders to address complex workforce questions. You will be independently driven in solving complex problems, shaping analytical approaches, and ensuring insights are communicated in compelling, easy-to-understand ways. This role matters because it connects advanced decision science with practical HR and business needs, requiring a strong problem-solver, collaborator, and team player to be successful. Design and implement accurate, scalable statistical models and advanced machine learning processes that support HR decisions, business processes, tools, and products. Apply machine learning, statistics, and data mining techniques to address key workforce-related questions and measure the causal impact of HR initiatives. Develop scalable, reproducible, and efficient methods for data analysis and model development, working with large and complex data sets from multiple internal and external sources. Consult with HR and business partners to translate business objectives and analytical needs into repeatable analytical solutions and decision science products. Present and explain analytical results to both technical and non-technical audiences through compelling storytelling and visualizations that drive data-informed decisions. Share knowledge with peers and partners and contribute ideas that help improve project approaches and technical standards. Collaborate across People Insights and HR to connect insights from workforce data, people research, and analytics, ensuring integrated, holistic recommendations for stakeholders. Contribute to the evolution of analytical tools, platforms, and workflows by identifying opportunities to improve scalability, automation, and integration of decision science solutions.

Required Qualifications

Proficiency in statistical, econometric, machine learning, and data mining techniques to inform model development and business decisions.

Experience

querying and manipulating data using SQL. Demonstrated

experience

analyzing data and developing machine learning models using a data science programming language such as Python. Knowledge of supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms, forecasting, and model building (e.g., clustering, regression, decision trees, ensemble methods). Strong storytelling and presentation-building skills, with the ability to translate complex statistical concepts into simple, actionable insights for non-technical audiences. Self-motivated with strong project management skills and the ability to meet deadlines with minimal supervision. Critical thinking skills grounded in deep intellectual curiosity and an openness to learning new analytical techniques and tools. Ability to partner with stakeholders, build strong working relationships, and collaborate across teams as a dependable problem-solver and team player. Advanced degree (Master’s or above) in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Analytics / Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field. A minimum of 3-years

experience

applying advanced analytics, statistics, and machine learning in a professional or academic setting.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree (Master’s or above) in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Analytics / Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field. A minimum of 3-years

experience

using statistical, econometric, machine learning, or data mining techniques to inform model development and business decisions in a professional or academic setting.

Experience

working with HR or employee data (e.g., SAP, SuccessFactors, Workday) and integrating people analytics solutions into business processes.

Experience

analyzing quantitative survey data, including response rates, favorability scores, and basic significance testing; familiarity with analyzing open-ended comments is a plus.

Experience

applying large language model solutions to derive novel features from unstructured data sources, enabling deeper insights, improved predictive capabilities, and scalable analytics across complex business problems.

Experience

with analytic workflow or data platforms such as Dataiku, Databricks, Alteryx, or similar tools, as well as large database or cloud environments (e.g., Snowflake, RedShift, AWS). Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Burbank, CA is $128,700 -$157,100 per year and in Lake Buena Vista, FL is $122,500 - $149,700 per year. experience

among other factors. job.title: Security Officer Full-Time
job.description:
Keywords Location Search Jobs Security Officer Full-Time Job ID 10163865 Location New York, New York, United States Business The Walt Disney Company (Corporate) Date posted Nov. 20, 2026 Security Officer Full-Time Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs.

Job Summary

Job Requirements Would you like to be part of a team that keeps the cast, crew, celebrity guests and co-workers at The Walt Disney Company safe and secure? Our Security Officers do it all, from working special events like Disney shows to regular perimeter checks of our buildings and offices. If you thrive in an environment where no two days are exactly alike, and where professionalism and precision are valued, apply today to join us! As a Security Officer , you’d be part of a well-trained, cohesive team that provides 24/7 protection for co-workers and guests at our buildings and at special events. Your mission? To protect Disney property and safeguard our people! Every day as a Security Officer is different! Depending on your shift, on any given day you might: Greet visitors, check company IDs, and provide temporary IDs at building entrances Evaluate and screen the audience line at live TV shows Be a security presence at movie premiers, live performances, events, or private parties Patrol hallways and building perimeters to spot safety issues or irregularities Fill out the logbook precisely and completely Answer questions asked by visitors and employees in a friendly, professional way Use your know-how and training to diffuse a tense situation Respond to medical or fire incidents, and work directly with local first responders Assist private security details brought by celebrities, sports stars, politicians and visiting dignitaries – even the President has been known to stop by Control messenger flow and package delivery Utilize technology to report and document incidents and manage information flow Perform walk-through evaluation at off-site events Here’s what you will need to be successful in the job: 1 year of corporate security, law enforcement or military

experience

Must be able to work the 11:00 PM-7:30 AM shift with days off-TBD. Schedules can change as needed. Excellent communication skills, including fluent written and spoken English, and strong command of basic English grammar Ability to make quick decisions using your training and common sense The knack for talking to people in a friendly way that gets results A “team” orientation and willingness to collaborate Physical ability to perform all aspects of the job and be outside in all weather; and Flexible workdays/hours (this is a “shift work” role) and ability to work some overtime It would be a plus if you also have these skills: Valid Security Guard license issued by your state Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite

Experience

working under pressure Ability to take command and diplomatically control difficult situations

Education

is important to us, here is what we are looking for: High School Diploma or equivalent required Associate degree or higher preferred Some of the perks we offer include: Taking part in ongoing learning on subjects such as CPR, Imminent Threat Assessment and First Aid training. Attending a movie screening or television taping, enjoying the full array of

benefits

offered by The Walt Disney Company including paid time off, 401K participation, a retirement savings plan, discounts on a wide variety of offerings, medical/dental/vision insurance and educational reimbursement-just to name a few! #DisneySecurity #twdcmedia #corp_media Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in New York, NY is $43,300.00 - $57,900.00 per year based on a 40 hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and

experience

among other factors. job.title: Account Manager, CoCounsel Tax
job.description:
Job Description
 

The Account Manager, CoCounsel Tax Migration & Growth is a quota-carrying sales role responsible for driving revenue, retention, and expansion across new prospects and customers transitioning from legacy platforms to CoCounsel Tax. This role owns the commercial relationship through the sales and migration lifecycle — prospecting and conducting discovery through close and converting migration moments into renewal protection, upsell, cross-sell, and new logo opportunities. The Account Managers partners closely with Solution Consultants, Customer Success, Account Specialist, and Associate Sales Specialist roles to accelerate adoption, protect ARR, and grow account value. 

Location: remote based position must be based in the US.


Key Responsibilities

Sales Execution & Revenue Growth  

  • Own a book of business of prospects and existing customers migrating to CoCounsel Tax; carry an assigned quota for new business and for renewals, upsell, cross-sell, and net-new logo expansion within the install base. 
  • Run full-cycle sales motions — discovery, solution positioning, demonstrations, proposal, negotiation, and close — for new business, migration-tied opportunities and adjacent expansion plays. 
  • Protect and grow ARR by tying migration milestones to commercial outcomes (renewals on time, expanded entitlements, increased seat counts, added modules). 
  • Maintain accurate pipeline hygiene, next steps, forecast accuracy, and close dates in CRM (Salesforce). 
  • Forecast weekly with accuracy; meet or exceed quarterly and annual quota and KPIs. 
  • Track migration health through milestones, adoption signals, and risk indicators; escalate proactively to protect revenue. 
  • Maintain a territory plan that highlights key opportunities across new business and install base. Have a key action plan to prioritize opportunities, leverage cross-sell, and collaborate with territory account managers and front-line customer teams. 

Customer Relationship Management  

  • Build multi-threaded relationships across administrators, champions, and economic buyers to strengthen account and uncover growth opportunities. 
  • Territory point of contact for strategic migration customers — pricing, packaging, entitlements, order processing, and renewal conversations. 
  • Capture and act on customer feedback to inform product roadmap, deepen trust, and create expansion narratives. 

Solution Positioning & Demonstration  

  • Deliver compelling solution presentations and demonstrations — partnering with Solution Consultants — that translates migration value into business outcomes, ROI, and expansion rationale. 
  • Position AI-enabled workflows, research automation, and CoCounsel Tax capabilities to drive adoption and expansion across the customer footprint. 
  • Coordinate trials, POCs, and pilot programs that accelerate the commercial cycle. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration  

  • Partner with Solution Consultants and Engineering on technical positioning and demonstrations. 
  • Work with Customer Success and Account Specialist to ensure post-sales adoption protects renewal and creates expansion opportunities. 

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years in B2B sales, account management, or customer-facing commercial roles with quota responsibility. 
  • Demonstrated success selling, renewing, upselling, and cross-selling existing customers, with full-cycle deal experience. 
  • Experience supporting or leading platform migrations, product transitions, or customer adoption programs tied to commercial outcomes. 
  • Strong ability to translate customer workflows into solution narratives, business cases, and ROI conversations. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation, and time management skills. 
  • Proficiency with CRM (Salesforce or similar), sales engagement tools, CPQ/quoting, virtual demo platforms, and forecasting dashboards. 
  • Must be able to support time zones across the region as required. 
  • Analytical thinking and pipeline discipline 
  • Resilient, coachable, and action-oriented 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in tax, legal, compliance, risk, information services, or SaaS. 
  • Familiarity with CoCounsel Tax or enterprise research and knowledge platforms. 
  • Experience selling or enabling AI-powered workflows (copilots, research automation, semantic search, agentic systems). 
  • Experience in enterprise environments with sensitivity to security, privacy, and procurement requirements. 
  • Channel/partner sales exposure. 


#LI-TK1

 

 

What’s in it For You?

  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

 

 

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The target total cash compensation range varies across locations. For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the target total cash compensation range for this role is $136,500 USD - $253,500 USD. Pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay and any target sales incentive are part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. Target total cash compensation ranges are inclusive of both base pay and any target sales incentive.

This job posting will close 01/09/2027.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.

More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com

job.title: Associate Sales Executive
job.description:
Job Description


El Associate Sales Executive será responsable de impulsar el crecimiento de nuevos negocios dentro del segmento Mid Market Legal de Thomson Reuters en Argentina. Esta posición está enfocada en la venta de soluciones legales a estudios jurídicos pequeños y medianos, incluyendo productos habilitados con inteligencia artificial, contenido de investigación jurídica y soluciones de software adaptadas al mercado legal.


Esta posición requiere un profesional altamente proactivo, con fuerte orientación comercial, capaz de gestionar el ciclo completo de ventas de principio a fin, desde la prospección en frío y la generación de oportunidades, hasta las demostraciones de producto, negociación y cierre. La persona ideal deberá sentirse cómoda trabajando en un entorno comercial dinámico, donde el éxito depende de una actividad de prospección constante, resiliencia y capacidad para construir relaciones sólidas con profesionales del sector legal.



Key Responsibilities

  • Generar nuevas oportunidades de negocio dentro del mercado legal en Argentina.
  • Prospectar y contactar clientes potenciales mediante llamadas en frío, correos electrónicos y reuniones virtuales.
  • Gestionar el ciclo completo de ventas, incluyendo generación de leads, calificación, demostraciones de producto, conversaciones de precio, negociación y cierre.
  • Construir y mantener un pipeline comercial sólido, con foco en adquisición de nuevos clientes.
  • Dar seguimiento a leads entrantes generados por marketing o equipos de prospección, cuando aplique.
  • Comercializar soluciones legales de Thomson Reuters, incluyendo herramientas con inteligencia artificial, bases de datos jurídicas y software para estudios jurídicos pequeños y medianos.
  • Desarrollar relaciones sólidas con clientes y representar a Thomson Reuters de manera profesional en todas las interacciones.
  • Participar en eventos comerciales, actividades con universidades, colegios de abogados y visitas de campo ocasionales cuando sea necesario.
  • Utilizar herramientas CRM como Salesforce para gestionar actividades, oportunidades y visibilidad del pipeline.
  • Aplicar herramientas de inteligencia artificial y recursos digitales para mejorar la productividad, la preparación y la efectividad comercial.
  • Colaborar de manera cercana con el manager y stakeholders internos para alcanzar los objetivos de facturación y negocio.

Required Qualifications

  • Experiencia comprobable en ventas, desarrollo de negocio o adquisición de nuevos clientes.
  • Fuerte perfil comercial, con capacidad para generar oportunidades de manera proactiva.
  • Experiencia gestionando o participando en el ciclo completo de ventas, desde la prospección hasta el cierre.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y presentación.
  • Alto nivel de resiliencia y capacidad para manejar el rechazo en un entorno comercial de alta actividad.
  • Comodidad en el uso de sistemas CRM como Salesforce o similares.
  • Interés y apertura para utilizar inteligencia artificial como parte del trabajo diario.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experiencia vendiendo soluciones legales, tecnología, SaaS u otros servicios intangibles.
  • Experiencia vendiendo a estudios jurídicos o profesionales del sector legal.
  • Formación académica en Derecho o estudios jurídicos.
  • Conocimiento o exposición previa al mercado legal argentino.
  • Experiencia en entornos de ventas outbound con fuerte expectativa de prospección.

#LI-AC1

 

 


¿Qué te ofrecemos?

  • Modelo de Trabajo Híbrido: Hemos adoptado un entorno de trabajo híbrido y flexible para nuestros roles en oficina, ofreciendo una experiencia fluida que está conectada digital y físicamente.
  • Flexibilidad y Equilibrio entre Trabajo y Vida Personal: "Flex My Way" Consiste en un conjunto de políticas de apoyo en el entorno laboral, diseñadas para facilitar la gestión de las responsabilidades personales y profesionales, ya sea atendiendo a la familia, participando en actividades comunitarias o dedicando tiempo al descanso y la renovación personal. Estas políticas se basan en nuestro enfoque flexible de trabajo, que permite a los empleados trabajar desde cualquier lugar hasta 8 semanas al año, promoviendo así un equilibrio ideal entre sus compromisos laborales y personales.
  • Desarrollo y Crecimiento Profesional: Fomentamos una cultura de aprendizaje continuo y desarrollo de habilidades, preparando a nuestro talento para enfrentar los desafíos del futuro y ofrecer soluciones reales. Nuestro programa "Grow My Way" y el enfoque en habilidades garantizan que tengas las herramientas y conocimientos para crecer, liderar y prosperar en un futuro habilitado por la inteligencia artificial.
  • Beneficios Competitivos del Sector: Ofrecemos planes de beneficios integrales que incluyen seguros de gastos médicos, dos días de descanso por salud mental a nivel de la empresa, programas de incentivos para empleados y recursos para el bienestar mental, físico y financiero.
  • Cultura: Reconocida globalmente con una reputación premiada por inclusión y pertenencia, flexibilidad, equilibrio entre trabajo y vida personal, y más. Vivimos nuestros valores: Obsesión por nuestros Clientes, Competir para Ganar, Desafiar nuestro Pensamiento, Actuar Rápido / Aprender Rápido, y Más Fuertes Juntos.
  • Impacto Social: Genera un impacto en tu comunidad con nuestro Instituto de Impacto Social. Ofrecemos a los empleados dos días de voluntariado pagados anualmente y oportunidades para involucrarse en proyectos de consultoría pro bono e iniciativas de Medio Ambiente, Sociales y de Gobernanza (ESG).
  • Haciendo un Impacto Real en el Mundo: Somos una de las pocas compañías a nivel global que asiste a sus clientes en la búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Trabajando en conjunto con los profesionales e instituciones a los que servimos, contribuimos a sostener el estado de derecho, fomentar el comercio, detectar a los infractores, informar sobre los hechos y ofrecer información confiable e imparcial a personas en todo el mundo.

 

 

Quiénes somos

Thomson Reuters marca el camino hacia el futuro al reunir contenido confiable y la tecnología que las personas y organizaciones necesitan para tomar decisiones correctas. Servimos a profesionales en los sectores legal, fiscal, contable, de cumplimiento, gubernamental y de medios. Nuestros productos combinan software altamente especializado e información para capacitar a los profesionales con los datos, inteligencia y soluciones necesarias para tomar decisiones informadas y ayudar a las instituciones en su búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Reuters, parte de Thomson Reuters, es un proveedor líder mundial de periodismo y noticias confiables.

Contamos con el talento de 26,000 colaboradores en más de 70 países, donde todos tienen la oportunidad de contribuir y crecer profesionalmente en entornos de trabajo flexibles. En un momento en el que la objetividad, precisión, equidad y transparencia están bajo ataque, nos comprometemos a buscarlos. ¿Suena emocionante? Forma parte de nuestro equipo y contribuye a moldear las industrias que impulsan el progreso de la sociedad.

Como empresa global, confiamos en los antecedentes únicos, perspectivas y experiencias de todos los empleados para cumplir con nuestros objetivos comerciales. Para asegurarnos de poder hacerlo, buscamos colaboradores talentosos y calificados en todas nuestras operaciones alrededor del mundo, sin importar raza, color, sexo/género, incluyendo embarazo, identidad y expresión de género, origen nacional, religión, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad, estado civil, estado de ciudadanía, condición de veterano u otra clasificación protegida bajo la ley aplicable. Thomson Reuters se enorgullece de ser un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades laborales, proporcionando un ambiente de trabajo libre de drogas.

Asimismo, ofrecemos adaptaciones razonables para personas calificadas con discapacidades y para aquellas con creencias religiosas sinceras, conforme a la legislación vigente. Puedes encontrar más información sobre cómo solicitar una adaptación aquí.

job.title: Attorney Editor
job.description:
Attorney Editor

 

Job Description:

Want to work with a team of attorney editors to provide world-class annotated statutory and regulatory information for legal professionals using Thomson Reuters’ Westlaw, ProView and print products?

Attorney Editors provide legal interpretation in the form of research, analysis, and writing to support the development and maintenance of information in all media.  As well as ensure that published information contains premium content.  At Thomson Reuters, we deliver intelligent information quickly and efficiently, so professionals have knowledge to act. We combine industry expertise with innovative technology to deliver critical information to leading decision makers in the financial, legal, tax and accounting, intellectual property and scientific, healthcare, and media markets, powered by the world’s most trusted news organization.

 

Key Responsibilities:

In this opportunity as an Attorney Editor, you will be responsible for:

  • Legal Research, Analysis and Enhancement of Primary Law Content: Create editorial enhancements to help customers understand the context and developments of the law, classify legal information in the form of headnotes and other text, maintain up to date and accurate statutory text by analyzing and integrating enacted legislation, and review content rendered as print or electronic products for completeness and accuracy.
  • Editorial Responsibilities: Meet editorial publishing schedules and quality standards, follow editorial style and standards for the department and individual jurisdictions, verify your own work and that of others as required for accuracy and completeness, and to ensure that the information is properly presented and organized. In this role, you will develop legal knowledge and skills training as needed to complete work and stay current on legal trends and developments related to the employee’s editorial responsibilities.
  • Individual and Leadership Development:  As part of a larger team, you will attend and participate in meetings, prioritize your own work and the work of others, and take part in the employee evaluation process (both wider feedback and self-evaluation).  To be most effective at your job, you will develop knowledge of Thomson Reuters Legal publications and products related to your responsibilities, and those of competitors.

 

Members of our team understand the roles and responsibilities of each team member and how each role affects production.You will also be required to demonstrate competence on company specific systems necessary to perform job functions, including demonstrating competence in Westlaw navigation and on-line research tools.

 

Required Qualifications:

You are a fit for the role of Attorney Editor if your background includes:

  • J.D. degree from an American Bar Association accredited law school
  • Strong legal research and analytical skills
  • Exceptional editorial judgment and attention to detail
  • Ability to interpret, analyze, organize, and communicate complex legal material
  • Understanding of editorial production process and requirements
  • Ability to communicate appropriately and effectively with all contacts, both in and outside Thomson Reuters.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Skilled in the use of personal computers and has familiarity with word processing and on-line applications
  • Ability to prioritize tasks/projects
  • Able to work successfully in a collaborative or team environment

#LI-DS4

 

 


What’s in it For You?

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.

This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

job.title: Audit & Accounting Specialist Editor
job.description:
Accounting & Auditing Specialist Editor

Job Description:

Looking for an excellent work-life position outside the Big 4, large or mid-sized accounting firms? Desire a professional environment without the busy season hassle? Check this job out!

As a full-time editor in our audit and accounting business at Thomson Reuters, you will have the opportunity to apply your public accounting and technical skills in a highly professional environment, without the usual busy seasonal challenges of public accounting. This is a dynamic hybrid (working from one of these Thomson Reuters hub locations - Dallas/Frisco TX, or Minneapolis/Eagan, MN or Ann Arbor, MI or NYC) job that allows you to utilize and continuously expand your technical skills, develop information and technology solutions for accounting professionals in CPA firms or corporations across the U.S. and globally, while working with leaders in the profession and other highly expert audit and accounting professionals


Key Responsibilities:

  • Turn complex accounting and auditing guidance into clear narrative content and practical, workflow-ready checklists and practice aids.
  • Manage multiple assignments and deliver work by established deadlines.
  • Recommend updates, practical insights, and improvements to products.
  • Help determine how audit methodology and content should evolve for AI-native workflows.
  • Apply judgment when assessing the reliability and limitations of automated or AI-assisted tools and when designing procedures that satisfy standards, documentation, and professional skepticism requirements.

Required Qualifications:

  • CPA certification.
  • At least 7 years of practical audit experience, preferably at the Manager or Senior Manager level in public accounting.
  • Broad technical accounting and auditing knowledge, strong research skills, and working knowledge of current auditing standards, such as PCAOB, AICPA, and Uniform Guidance standards, as applicable.
  • Experience applying, reviewing, or updating audit methodology, including engagement methodology, quality management, or technical guidance.
  • Hands-on experience using automated or AI-assisted tools in engagements, such as data analytics or document analysis.
  • Judgment to assess a tool’s reliability and limitations and to design procedures around it that satisfy standards, documentation, and professional skepticism requirements.
  • Strong writing skills, including the ability to turn complex guidance into clear narrative content and practical, workflow-ready checklists and practice aids.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments to deadlines and recommend updates, practical insights, and product improvements, including how audit methodology and content should evolve for AI-native workflows.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with generative AI or machine learning in audit or assurance, including validating AI-generated output.

job.title: Director, Human Rights & Strategic Partnerships
job.description:
Job Description

The Director, Human Rights and Strategic Partnerships will lead Thomson Reuters' global human rights strategy, helping to ensure that the company's operations, supply chains, and business relationships align with international human rights frameworks, including the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGPs). The Director is responsible for the strategy, due diligence, reporting, and regulatory readiness of the human rights program.


The Director also supports the development and launch of strategic partnerships with governments, multilateral organizations, NGOs, academia, and industry peers, contributing to partnership strategy and governance in support of business goals, ESG commitments, and societal impact.


The role serves as the senior liaison between executive leadership and external stakeholders on human rights matters. It combines strategic thinking, technical depth, relationship skills, and sound judgment on sensitive issues.


Key Responsibilities

1. Human Rights Strategy, Policy, and Due Diligence

  • Strategy and policy: Update and embed the global corporate human rights policy and strategy across the enterprise, including refreshing saliency and impact assessments.
  • Due diligence: Design, deploy, and coordinate human rights impact assessments (HRIAs) and related due diligence processes across the enterprise.
  • Regulatory tracking: Monitor emerging legislation and regulation and ensure implementation of relevant human rights laws into the comprehensive ESG strategy, in coordination with stakeholders across the company.
  • Issue management: Lead the company's response to sensitive human rights issues and complex stakeholder dialogues.
  • Training: Develop and deliver programs that build human rights awareness across the enterprise.
  • Reporting: Author the human rights content of the annual ESG/Sustainability Report, the Human Rights Policy, Modern Slavery Statements, and related disclosures.

2. Strategic and Public-Private Partnerships

  • Partnership strategy: Design and implement a global partnership strategy that supports long-term business goals, human rights priorities, and ESG commitments. Lead the full lifecycle of alliances, from identifying opportunities through launch and governance.
  • Relationship management: Serve as primary relationship owner with senior officials in governments, international organizations (such as UN agencies and the World Bank), NGOs, and academic institutions.
  • Project governance: Oversee joint initiatives by setting KPIs, governance structures, and reporting metrics to track impact and return on investment.

3. Public Policy and Financial Crime

  • Policy analysis and advice: Monitor and advise on domestic and global legislation and regulation related to human trafficking, forced labor, fraud, and financial crime.
  • Public and private sector partnerships: Build trusted relationships with law enforcement agencies, financial regulators, and commercial banking partners, focused on thought leadership and the company's policy positions.

4. Cross-Functional Leadership and External Representation

  • Executive advisory: Advise senior leadership and integrate human rights, partnership, and public policy considerations into enterprise decisions.
  • Internal coordination: Coordinate with Legal, Risk and Compliance, Human Resources, Product, Responsible AI, and Finance to keep company practices aligned with new laws and regulations.
  • Thought leadership: Represent the company at multilateral forums, roundtables, trade associations, and industry coalitions on human rights, forced labor, fraud, and transnational organized crime.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in international law, human rights, government or public policy, international relations, business, sustainability, or a related field.
  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in human rights, corporate social responsibility, social compliance, public policy and government relations, or multi-stakeholder partnership leadership.
  • Human rights expertise: Public policy experience related to human rights, including knowledge of the UNGPs, OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises, ILO Core Labor Standards, and international human rights frameworks.
  • Due diligence experience: Demonstrated experience leading or managing human rights impact assessments or field-based social audits in complex supply chains.
  • Strategic partnerships: Demonstrated experience building partnerships with governments, corporations, foundations, academia, and NGO stakeholders.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal skills, including presenting to executives, government officials, and academic and civil society leaders, and translating technical or sensitive information into clear briefings for decisionmakers.

Core Competencies

  • Credibility with senior executives and external partners, including stakeholder convening and consensus building.
  • Sound judgment and discretion in handling sensitive issues.
  • Cross-cultural credibility and experience working in complex, politically sensitive environments.
  • Resilience and composure when engaging with stakeholders, media, and advocacy groups.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and lead through change in a rapidly evolving regulatory, geopolitical, and stakeholder environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A master's degree, J.D., or MBA.
  • Experience in a technology, information, financial services, or regulated-industry environment, including work on human rights issues related to technology, data, digital trust, responsible AI, or emerging technologies.
  • Experience negotiating or managing public-private partnerships or multilateral engagements.
  • Experience leading teams or managing external advisors.
  • Experience supporting ESG, sustainability, or human rights reporting frameworks, including voluntary and regulatory disclosures.
  • Familiarity with evolving global human rights and supply chain due diligence regulations, including the EU Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive (CSDDD), the EU Forced Labor Regulation, Modern Slavery Acts, and related reporting requirements.

job.title: Director, Site Reliability Engineering
job.description:
Are you passionate about leading global engineering teams that keep mission-critical enterprise products reliable, scalable, and resilient? Join Thomson Reuters as Director, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) within Service Management in our CIO organization, supporting the Corporate Tax and Trade product portfolio.
 

As Director of Site Reliability Engineering, you will lead a global organization responsible for the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of critical applications and services. Sitting within Service Management, this role will help strengthen how Thomson Reuters prevents, detects, responds to, and learns from service-impacting events. You will partner with senior technology, product, and business leaders to advance SRE practices, AI-driven operations, automation, observability, incident management, and resilience engineering—helping deliver trusted, high-performing solutions for customers and colleagues around the world.
 

About the Role

In this opportunity as Director, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), you will:

  • Lead 24x7 reliability, scalability, and operational excellence for a global portfolio of mission-critical applications and services within Service Management in the CIO organization.

  • Serve as the executive escalation point during major incidents, ensuring rapid coordination, timely resolution, and clear communication with senior technology, product, and business stakeholders.

  • Partner with product engineering teams to embed reliability into product design, development, and release processes, ensuring operational readiness for new products and features.

  • Define, implement, and continuously improve best-in-class observability, incident management, disaster recovery, and resilience engineering practices.

  • Champion automation and AI-driven operations to improve operational efficiency, reduce service disruption, and improve mean time to mitigation and resolution.

  • Shape and evolve the SRE strategy, operating model, and engineering behaviors across the Corporate Tax and Trade product portfolio, aligned to broader Service Management practices.

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a global team of SRE managers and engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, inclusion, continuous improvement, and service excellence.

About You

You're a fit for the role of Director, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) if your background includes:

  • 10+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, software engineering, infrastructure, platform engineering, enterprise technology, service management, or a related technology leadership role.

  • Proven experience leading global teams that support large-scale distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and mission-critical enterprise applications.

  • Strong expertise in reliability engineering practices, observability tools, automation frameworks, incident management, disaster recovery, and operational readiness.

  • Experience operating within or closely partnering with Service Management functions, including incident, problem, change, availability, and continuity management.

  • Experience influencing product and technology roadmaps to prioritize reliability, scalability, performance, resilience, and service quality improvements.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead transformation within a complex enterprise technology environment, including the adoption of automation, AI operations, and modern SRE practices.

  • Strong people leadership skills, including talent development, succession planning, performance management, and resource allocation across regions and technology domains.

  • Strong financial acumen, including experience managing large budgets and aligning investment decisions to business priorities.

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, engineering teams, and business partners at all levels.

job.title: Global Key Account Director
job.description:
Job Description


The Global Key Account  Director (GKAD) is a strategic relationship and business manager who leads, develops and executes the global account strategy for key strategic clients, in line with Corporates’ future vision and strategy.  The GKAD maximizes financial and strategic value and aligns short term needs to longer term business strategies and growth.  This role requires the incumbent to excel at highly strategic account management as well as tactical execution, cultivating and influencing senior clients and Thomson Reuters executives while also engaging those deep into both organizations.  Particular areas of focus include: ensuring all cross sell and up sell opportunities are realized across our full suite of products, owning and growing the C-suite relationships, proficiency in bringing industry insights and thought leadership to the Corporates firm, maximizing revenue/retention and identifying and closing new partnerships and sales opportunities working cross-functionally with various TR teams such as Product, Professional Services, Partnerships etc. This is a key role that requires entrepreneurship, innovation, agility and enthusiasm for serving the customer, while managing sales and book of business at the assigned accounts.   Working closely with global internal teams the GKAD will need a strong collaborative focus to ensure we meet changing customer expectations timely. 

This Global Key Account Director (GKAD) will manage and grow Thomson Reuters' relationships with a portfolio of key healthcare and industrial accounts as part of the Global Accounts Group.  ​ 


Key Responsibilities

  • Drive strategic engagement and growing commercial relationships with designated clients; increase new sales and revenue at each account in accordance with targets.  
  • Deep understanding of each firm’s business strategy and objectives to inform the direction of Thomson Reuters strategy and ensure we align our capabilities effectively.
  • Work with Product Management to shape the key value propositions sold by Thomson Reuters into the assigned industries, adding the voice of the customer to the development of the industry focus area.
  • Identify growth opportunities to create needs and competitive solutions.
  • Ensure we have the right connections between Thomson Reuters and the customer at all levels and the ability to bring the relevant stakeholder from both organizations into strategic meetings
  • Lead global communication amongst the account teams covering these clients globally; coordinate multi-country deals to ensure maximum value for Thomson Reuters and a well-coordinated customer experience while buying from Thomson Reuters.
  • Ensure customer satisfaction with Thomson Reuters; serve as a senior point of escalation for issues and take a leadership role in problem solving on behalf of the customer.
  • Serve as a primary relationship manager and senior escalation point for each customer; track and manage existing relationships and develop new ones.  Support other executives’ relationships with these clients and ensure that we are bringing to bear the right resources to serve each customer.
  • Lead a global virtual team across Thomson Reuters; know whom to engage, how to engage them to ensure delivery for client.
  • Build and leverage executive level relationship to drive engagement and strategic alignment with Thomson Reuters.  Ensure Thomson Reuters executives and others understand client needs; address over short- and long-term. Build, deliver and track strategic global account plan; forecast, track, report key information, performance indicators.
  • Collaborate effectively across Thomson Reuters to develop the account strategy for each assigned firm, agree on prioritization of opportunities with relevant sales and account management colleagues and take responsibility for driving progress on the account strategy, coordinating relevant touchpoints and acting as the point of coordination across Thomson Reuters

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS required with 10+ years work experience including sales, business development and managing large customer relationships
  • 5+ years’ industry experience at a minimum in one of the following industries - healthcare or industrial, either working within the industry or selling into the industry. Thorough knowledge of trends impacting the market and the needs of these customers. 
  • Strong network building in the industry and strategic partnering.
  • Strategic relationship/account management + consultative selling across sectors, focused on growing account value.
  • Lead and influence global teams (directly and/or virtually) across geographies and business lines.
  • Multi-functional track record (e.g., frontline sales, account management, sales/business ops, proposition/product management).
  • Entrepreneurial, adaptable, and effective in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.
  • Proven leader of complex strategic negotiations; strong follow-through on post-agreement delivery.
  • Strong C-suite engagement and executive relationship-building with large, complex global accounts; rigorous account planning.
  • Customer-first, outside-in mindset with strong influencing, problem-solving, conflict management, and innovative sales strategy execution.
  • Excellent communicator/collaborator; resourceful, highly organized, able to prioritize; global market experience and willing to travel.

  • Advanced degree preferred.

job.title: IT Support Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

TRSS is a small, dynamic, technology-driven, and security-focused organization of approximately 400 employees. IT team members contribute across multiple areas, including help desk support for onsite and remote employees, network systems maintenance, and the implementation of new technologies. This position primarily supports Windows-based systems and networking and occasionally requires after-hours support and system maintenance. Experience supporting and administering Microsoft 365 including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, Power Automate, and Entra ID is important. Experience with Apple iOS, macOS, Linux, VMware, and Cisco technologies is highly desirable.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day desktop and phone support for onsite and remote users during core business hours of 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday.
  • Provision and ship user laptops and mobile phones and configure associated accounts.
  • Troubleshoot network issues, including VPN connectivity problems.
  • Work effectively both independently and collaboratively with teammates.
  • Communicate clearly with users and team members and maintain accurate documentation.
  • Research technical issues and document solutions.
  • Support projects ranging from LAN maintenance to office expansions and other IT initiatives.
  • Perform after-hours maintenance and support as needed.
  • Track tasks and time accurately and thoroughly in the help desk ticketing system.
  • Maintain an accurate inventory of physical devices and components.

 

Required Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Windows 11.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft 365 applications, including Exchange Online email and Microsoft Teams.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Active Directory.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration.
  • Ability to design, implement, and support collaboration solutions using SharePoint Online, Power Automate, Teams, and Outlook.
  • Experience supporting Apple iOS devices and mobile device management through Microsoft Intune.
  • Ability to follow detailed procedures and manage time effectively.
  • Experience managing Active Directory user and computer accounts.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a computer-related field or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of three years of IT-related experience.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. national security clearance.
  • U.S. citizenship is required to comply with government contract, agency, or Federal Government requirements.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Entra management.
  • Experience with VMware vSphere and VMware Workstation.
  • Strong security background, including endpoint and network firewalls, antimalware software, security baselines such as STIG and CIS, and application allowlisting.

job.title: Pre Sales Tax Consultant(7+ years) - Chartered Accountant
job.description:
Job Description
Thomson Reuters is seeking a Solutions Consultant to drive revenue growth for its tax technology portfolio across the India market. This client-facing, commercially focused pre-sales role partners closely with Sales teams to identify, qualify, shape and close strategic opportunities, bringing deep domain expertise in indirect tax, GST, direct tax, e-invoicing, compliance workflows, global trade and tax technology solutions. The Solutions Consultant acts as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them understand how Thomson Reuters solutions address their business, compliance, operational and technology challenges.


Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales teams across the full sales cycle, from opportunity qualification through solution design, proposal development, negotiation support and deal closure, and help develop and close new business to meet and exceed gross sales targets.
  • Lead customer discovery to understand business challenges, compliance requirements, current tax processes, technology landscape and desired outcomes, then recommend the most appropriate Thomson Reuters tax solutions.
  • Translate complex indirect tax, GST and e-invoicing requirements into clear solution narratives and differentiated value propositions that position Thomson Reuters against competitors.
  • Own and deliver tailored product demonstrations, solution workshops, proof-of-concept discussions and functional deep-dives for stakeholders across tax, finance, IT, procurement, shared services and executive leadership.
  • Support RFPs, RFIs, tenders and customer questionnaires, contribute to business cases and commercial positioning, and work with Sales, Product, Legal and Commercial Policy to execute complex deals.
  • Stay current on indirect tax, GST, e-invoicing, regulatory change and tax technology trends in India, and bring these insights into customer conversations and industry forums.
  • Share customer feedback, market trends, competitive insights and product enhancement opportunities with Product and Business teams, acting as an internal advocate for customer needs.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity, activity and customer information in Salesforce and other CRM systems, and collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services and Support to keep forecasts accurate and customer requirements addressed.


Required Qualifications

  • CA qualification with typically 10+ years of relevant experience in indirect tax, GST, e-invoicing, tax technology, finance transformation, consulting, pre-sales or enterprise software solutions.
  • Strong understanding of global indirect tax regulations, GST compliance, e-invoicing, e-way bill processes and related tax technology workflows.
  • Proven customer-facing experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, tax technology consulting, enterprise software sales support or advisory services, with the ability to support or influence complex B2B sales cycles.
  • Strong commercial acumen and understanding of the sales process, including opportunity qualification, discovery, solution positioning, objection handling, proposal support and deal closure.
  • Experience supporting RFPs, RFIs, tenders, proposals, demonstrations or bid processes.
  • Ability to map customer business challenges to appropriate solutions, with a consultative mindset, strong problem-solving skills and a customer-first approach.
  • Strong presentation, storytelling and communication skills, both written and verbal, with confidence engaging senior stakeholders across tax, finance, accounting, IT, procurement and executive leadership.
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities, priorities and pre-sales projects simultaneously, with strong CRM discipline, preferably in Salesforce.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience identifying cross-sell and up-sell opportunities across a broader tax, accounting or compliance solution portfolio.
  • Experience with enterprise tax, ERP, compliance or finance automation solutions.
  • Prior experience with Thomson Reuters tax products or comparable tax technology platforms.

job.title: Sales Development Representative
job.description:
Job Description

Sales Development Representative (SDR)

As a Sales Development Representative, you'll develop and manage a sales pipeline by prospecting for new opportunities, identifying upsell and cross-sell possibilities, and driving revenue growth. You'll work closely with your team and leadership to hit ambitious targets while maintaining accurate records and continuously improving your skills in a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment.


Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as a Sales Development Representative, you will:

  • Prospect for new sales opportunities, develop a pipeline, and close opportunity or execute renewal contracts.
  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities and pass them to an appropriate resource.
  • Hit or exceed your monthly and annual targets and maintain consistently strong performance at 100% of your YTD goals.
  • Hit or exceed your daily contact targets and activity metrics.

job.description:
Job Description


Thomson Reuters is transforming the legal industry with unmatched legal content, expertise, and innovative technology. As part of this transformation, the Senior Director of Customer Success Management for Large Law will lead a team dedicated to ensuring our Large Law customers achieve their goals and realize the full value of our solutions.


This leader will oversee managers of customer success managers, and individual contributors, driving value realization, customer adoption, satisfaction, and retention within the Large Law sub-segment. As a consultative partner to senior executives at Large Law customers, this leader will bring a point of view specific to each customer, and will coach the team to engage with the same consultative, customer-centric approach.


This role reports to the Vice President, Customer Success Management.


Key Responsibilities


  • Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute customer success strategies tailored to the Large Law sub-segment, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives and maximizing customer value; Provide coaching and direction to managers, and individual contributors, fostering a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement
  • Drive Adoption and Value: Lead efforts to ensure Large Law customers fully leverage Thomson Reuters solutions, achieving measurable outcomes and business impact across complex, multi-product, multi-office environments
  • Be a Consultative Partner to Large Law Customers: Engage Large Law customers as a trusted advisor, going beyond product conversations to understand each customer’s business priorities, challenges, and goals; Bring a point of view specific to the customer, with insights and recommendations on how Thomson Reuters solutions can help them achieve their objectives
  • Build Senior Executive Relationships: Establish and sustain strategic relationships with senior executives at Large Law customers, such as managing partners, chief innovation officers, and other firm and legal department leaders, serving as an executive sponsor on key accounts
  • Foster Retention and Growth: Build strong relationships with Large Law customers, including senior executive stakeholders, minimize churn, and identify opportunities for account expansion and advocacy
  • Team Leadership: Recruit, develop, and empower managers, and individual contributors within the Large Law customer success team; Set clear goals, monitor performance, and provide ongoing feedback and mentorship
  • Coach a Consultative, Customer-Centric Team: Coach managers and Customer Success Managers to be consultative with customers: to ask discovery questions, understand customer needs, build executive-level relationships, and develop customer-specific recommendations; Model and reinforce a customer-centric mindset through account reviews, call coaching, and everyday leadership
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Product, and Enablement teams to align on Large Law customer needs and integrate customer success priorities into broader organizational strategies
  • Champion the Voice of the Customer: Serve as the internal advocate for Large Law customers, leveraging insights to drive continuous improvement and innovation in collaboration with Product and Leadership teams

job.description:
Job Description

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Solutions Manager, Legal AI FDE to lead product strategy and execution for customer-facing Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) engagements in CoCounsel Legal. In this role, you will own the product direction and execution of complex Legal FDE engagements, working directly with law firm customers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Professional Services, commercial segments, and core product teams.You will turn high-value legal workflow problems into well-defined solutions and scalable product capabilities. This role focuses on end-to-end AI product lifecycle management across multiple customer deployments and requires a keen interest in the legal industry and how legal teams operate in practice. You will combine customer discovery, disciplined delivery, and strategic product judgment to ensure bespoke solutions create immediate customer value while generating reusable insights and capabilities for the broader product portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer Engagement and Use-Case Discovery: Partner directly with law firms, corporate legal departments, legal operations teams, and internal stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, risk considerations, and operational constraints. Translate ambiguous needs into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
  • Product Leadership Across FDE Engagements: Lead product execution across multiple legal FDE engagements. Establish priorities, structure discovery, guide delivery decisions, and maintain alignment among customers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Professional Services, and core product teams.
  • Backlog and Execution Management: Own and maintain engagement backlogs with strong hygiene, prioritization, and transparency. Ensure work is scoped, sequenced, and tracked across discovery, build, validation, launch, and handoff.
  • End-to-End Product Lifecycle Ownership: Manage product work from intake through development, deployment, adoption, release readiness, and transition to core product teams or ongoing customer ownership. Ensure decisions, context, and learnings are documented and reusable.
  • Productization of Bespoke Legal Solutions: Identify recurring legal workflows, integration patterns, and solution components that can become repeatable capabilities. Recommend when work should remain customer-specific and when it should be generalized for broader market value.
  • Legal AI Quality and Trust: Partner with engineering, subject-matter experts, and product teams to define validation criteria appropriate for legal workflows, including accuracy, transparency, traceability, security, and responsible AI considerations.
  • Strategic Influence: Synthesize customer needs and deployment insights into recommendations for product roadmaps, reusable service offerings, enablement, and investment priorities.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of product management experience, ideally in enterprise SaaS, AI-enabled products, workflow platforms, integrations, or implementation-heavy environments.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, customer-facing product work across multiple stakeholders and parallel initiatives.
  • Proven ability to convert ambiguous customer problems into clear product strategy, requirements, prioritization, and execution plans.
  • Strong executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
  • Experience partnering closely with engineering teams and influencing cross-functional partners without direct authority.

Job Description

We are hiring a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner to support our Go-To-Market functions. This is an opportunity to help build the revenue teams behind one of the most significant transformations in professional services, with the scale, stability, and global reach of an established market leader. If you want meaningful, high-impact work with a global team, we’d love to talk.

The Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner, Go-To-Market, will partner with Thomson Reuters sales and commercial leaders to attract, engage, and hire top talent in Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and Professional Services. Sitting within Global Talent Acquisition in the People function, this role owns full-cycle recruiting for some of our highest-volume and most business-critical roles. You’ll act as a trusted advisor and market expert to hiring managers and HR Business Partners, driving hiring velocity and quality of hire while delivering an exceptional candidate experience. You’ll use data, AI-enabled tools, and consistent processes to help shape how Thomson Reuters builds its go-to-market teams for an AI-enabled future.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle GTM recruiting — intake to offer acceptance — for Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and Professional Services across multiple locations and business segments.

  • Build diverse pipelines of active and passive talent through proactive sourcing, market mapping, referrals, talent communities, and AI-enabled tools.
  • Present curated shortlists and drive fair, skills-based interviews by coaching hiring teams on structured evaluation and timely feedback.
  • Deliver a high-touch candidate experience from first outreach to close, advising on compensation and leading offers and negotiations with hiring managers and HRBPs.
  • Report weekly on pipeline health and key metrics (time to fill, funnel conversion, offer acceptance), flag risks early, and drive process improvements, recruiter enablement, and AI adoption.

job.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, FDE
job.description:
Job Description

FDE Engineering teams build AI solutions for customers. When those solutions go live, you make sure they stay reliable, secure and fast, and you decide how the rest of the organization will run them. As a member of the FDE SRE team, you'll own operations across AWS and Azure, set the pipelines and standards every new solution launches with, and champion the best custom builds into the core product. You'll lead and mentor a team of engineers and a growing crew of AI agents, digital teammates you design, deploy and supervise to handle routine monitoring and triage. That frees your team to work on hard problems and on engineering that improves the whole system.

 

Key Responsibilities

·       Operate and own reliability

·       Provide ongoing operational support for FDE-built solutions after handover, whether they run on AWS or Azure.

·       Operate MCP servers and APIs in production, including OAuth 2.0/OIDC and service-account authentication.

·       Own and meet the agreed SLAs for availability, reliability and performance.

·       Set severity levels, alerting and response times, and respond to incidents within them.

·       Provide 24x7 incident-response coverage through an on-call rotation, coordinating coverage with colleagues across time zones.

·       Plan capacity around critical deadlines, set change freezes for those windows, and run a surge on-call rotation when volume peaks.

·       Monitor availability, logs, integration health, failures and usage, and report findings and trends to stakeholders.

·       Create reports and dashboards to monitor capacity, consumption, cost, and solution adoption and usage.

 

Triage and resolve incidents

·       Work with Help Desk / Product Support on triage and routing, and with the FDE engineering team on defect fixes.

·       Take ownership of technical incidents routed by Help Desk / Product Support, from investigation through resolution within the agreed response times, and act as incident commander for high-severity events.

·       Resolve operational, infrastructure, configuration, security, vulnerability, capacity and availability issues that don't need a code change.

·       Troubleshoot queue-, webhook- and batch-based integrations, including retries, stuck or partial jobs and dead-letter queues, and escalate to the owning product team with evidence when the root cause sits in their system.

·       Engage the FDE engineering team only when a software defect is confirmed, with a complete package of logs, reproduction steps, impact and troubleshooting already done. Then see the fix through to release, and update runbooks with the resolution.

·       Run post-incident reviews and feed the learnings into runbooks.

 

CI/CD and environment onboarding

·       Design, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for new solutions once their landing zones are created, on AWS or Azure depending on the solution.

·       Set version control standards for source control, branching, code review and release management.

·       Provide reusable pipeline templates and standards, so each new solution doesn't need a custom setup.

·       Build deployment automation for each solution across environments, with approvals, rollback and change logging.

·       Integrate security scanning (vulnerability, dependency and secrets checks) and automated regression checks into the pipelines.

·       Onboard each new solution into monitoring, alerting, certificate management and the asset inventory before go-live.

·       Work with the FDE engineering team during handover so that pipelines, runbooks and access are in place before the solution is supported operationally.

·       Own the production-readiness checklist and sign off before a solution enters support. Shadow the FDE team during hypercare.

·       Deploy prebuilt, reusable solutions consistently for additional customers.

 

Automate and improve

·       Automate monitoring, alerting, recurring operational work and repeatable remediation.

·       Build and run AI agents as digital team members that handle alert triage, first-pass diagnosis and repeatable operational work alongside the human team. Keep a person in the loop for high-impact actions, with least-privilege access and full audit logs.

·       Maintain automated regression capability and run periodic regression checks.

·       Maintain the FDE productivity platforms assigned to the SRE team, including evaluation platforms and harnesses.

·       Define and track SLIs, SLOs and error budgets.

 

Security and lifecycle maintenance

·       Protect sensitive client data by enforcing least-privilege production access and keeping each customer's data separate.

·       Coordinate timely remediation of vulnerabilities, security findings, dependencies and patches.

·       Manage maintenance, version upgrades, release compatibility and end-of-life planning.

·       Manage certificate renewals, including installing certificates and retiring them in Venafi.

 

Knowledge and handover

·       Maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, known-issue records and escalation procedures.

·       Write and maintain approved knowledge articles so Help Desk / Product Support can resolve common issues and route escalations with the right information.

·       Keep Asset Insight and other solution records current.

·       Identify solutions that have become reusable, and advocate for them to be merged into the core product.

·       Work with the product team to make the merge happen: share the operating history, runbooks, pipelines and known issues, and support the operational transition until the product team owns the capability.

 

·       Leadership and mentoring

·       Lead, mentor and coach junior engineers: set priorities, assign and review work, and help them troubleshoot issues.

·       Run the daily team handoff and keep ownership and escalation paths clear across support, engineering and product teams.

·       Raise the engineering bar for the team through reviews, shared standards and example work.

 

Required Qualifications

·       7+ years of overall experience in SRE, DevOps or cloud infrastructure operations, running live, customer-facing solutions.

·       Must be able to obtain a U.S. security clearance

·       Strong hands-on production experience on AWS (EKS, ECS, networking, IAM, security controls), plus working experience on Azure (AKS, ACR, Entra ID, networking) to support the solutions deployed there.

·       Strong CI/CD experience: designing and maintaining pipelines in GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar, including artifact management, environment promotion and deployment automation, with source control, branching and code review practices.

·       Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK or similar). Experience working with landing zones, accounts, subscriptions and environment baselines.

·       Python and shell scripting, used to automate operational work.

·       Experience running LLM or AI applications in production, including provider outages, rate limits, model version changes, re-running evaluations after a change, and tracking token cost per customer.

·       Hands-on experience building automation or AI agents for operational work, connected to ticketing, monitoring and runbook tools, with appropriate guardrails.

·       Docker, container services and Kubernetes in production (ECS or Kubernetes).

·       Experience operating APIs and MCP servers, with OAuth 2.0/OIDC and service-account authentication.

·       Experience troubleshooting event-driven and batch integrations (queues, webhooks, scheduled jobs) and working across teams to resolve them.

·       Observability tools such as Datadog, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor or ELK: metrics, logs, tracing, alert tuning. Experience monitoring across AWS and Azure, and building dashboards and reports on availability, capacity, consumption and cost.

·       Incident, problem and change management in an ITIL-style process (ServiceNow), including post-incident reviews, within agreed severity levels and response times. Comfortable coordinating with colleagues across time zones.

·       Vulnerability and patch management, with scanner tools such as Wiz or Snyk.

·       Experience handling sensitive financial or personal data in production, with least-privilege access and customer data separation.

·       Leadership: experience mentoring engineers, assigning and reviewing work, and leading the team through major incidents. You take ownership, stay calm and decisive under pressure, and give clear, constructive feedback.

·       For the U.S.-based role: U.S. citizenship and experience working in FedRAMP or other government-regulated environments.

 

Preferred Qualifications

·       Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

·       AI-assisted operations, such as anomaly detection, alert correlation and AI-assisted triage.

·       Experience with LLM evaluation and tracing tools, feature-flag platforms.

·       Reusable pipeline templates, GitOps tooling (ArgoCD or similar) and policy-as-code guardrails.

·       Knowledge of runbooks, KB articles and escalation packages.

·       Certificate management (Venafi) and regression automation.

·       Experience in regulated or enterprise-customer environments (SOC 2 or similar) and 24x7 support models.

·       Experience running a consistent operating model, with shared tooling and standards, across AWS and Azure.

·       Experience moving a custom or project-built solution into a product platform.

  • Ensure compliance with all specialty rules, policies, and quality control standards.
  • Address performance or behavior concerns through feedback and corrective coaching.
  • Support contractor questions and provide support as needed.
