job.title: VP of Legal Engineering
job.description:
VP, Legal Engineering

Enterprise Legal and Risk


Job Description

Thomson Reuters is building a legal engineering function to serve corporate legal departments across our business, and we are looking for a leader to define what this function becomes, how it operates, and the impact it has on our customers and our business.


Legal engineers are practicing lawyers who sit with customers through the sales cycle and beyond, bringing practice depth to the conversation, shaping use cases, and showing how CoCounsel works inside a customer's own workflow. This function is the single source of that expertise for all of Corporate Legal, allocated to the opportunities where practice depth changes the outcome, while contributing to our scaled and digital efforts.


You will build the team, set the standard for what good looks like, and decide how a senior group of practitioners is deployed across a large and varied customer base.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and lead the legal engineering function, hiring and developing a team of practicing lawyers.
  • Set and hold the standard of expertise we put in front of customers, including for industry specialists covering sectors such as insurance and oil and gas.
  • Support the sales organization directly on large and complex opportunities, from discovery through workshops and custom engagements.
  • Contribute to the content other teams run on, including demonstration materials, discovery frameworks and talking points.
  • Work across the business, supporting forward deployed engineering with legal workflow knowledge, customer success with onboarding and adoption, and product marketing, demand generation and enablement with the practitioner perspective they need to speak credibly to a general counsel.
  • Bring the practitioner view into product decisions, so customer needs are represented directly in what we build.
  • Develop senior members of the team into coaching roles, carrying their own customer portfolio alongside responsibility for others.

Required Qualifications

  • J.D. from an accredited US or Canadian law school.
  • Significant post-qualification experience practicing law, in-house at a corporate legal department or at a major law firm, with substantial client-facing work.
  • Experience leading and developing teams, including hiring, performance management and building an operating model from a standing start.
  • Demonstrated understanding of how corporate legal departments work, across commercial, litigation, regulatory, compliance and legal operations.
  • Hands-on familiarity with generative AI applications and a practical view of where they help and where they do not.
  • Credibility with senior stakeholders, including general counsel and their leadership teams.
  • Comfort speaking publicly on behalf of the business, at customer events, industry conferences and advisory boards.
  • Experience building strong working relationships across functions, including sales, customer success, marketing and product, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
  • An understanding of how complex enterprise sales cycles run, and strong judgment about where your team’s expertise makes the most difference.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building a customer-facing technical or advisory function inside a software or professional services business.
  • Experience operating in a high-growth environment where structure has to be created rather than inherited.
  • Experience leading distributed teams.

#LI-LA

  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive 

*Non-Remote, In-Person Opportunity. * 

 

The Opportunity: 

Townsquare Media is looking for a bright, confident, driven individual to join our multimedia advertising sales team in Bozeman Montana.  Townsquare Media Bozeman is an industry leader in digital advertising and an accredited marketing partner of both Google and Meta as well as home to five top radio stations.   

 

At Townsquare Media Bozeman, we are a team of ambitious individuals who work together to push ourselves and those around us to grow personally and professionally. You can expect a dynamic and competitive work environment that fosters success, training, development, and an unlimited earning potential! 

 

If you’re ready to embark upon an exciting career that affords you the opportunity to form meaningful client relationships, develop creative advertising campaigns using our best-in-class multimedia solutions, all while having your finger on the pulse of Southwest Montana…then we want to hear from you!  

 

What You’ll Do: 

  • Identify, pursue, and schedule meetings with local business owners and decision makers to discuss and uncover their marketing needs and challenges 
  • Use our proprietary data, analytics, and multimedia marketing solutions to build, present, and sell customized advertising plans to potential clients  
  • Build, maintain and develop close working relationships with your clients to identify and upsell new advertising solutions 
  • Use your influence and relationship-building skills to provide ongoing customer service, research, and market analysis 
  • You will be responsible for bringing our premier marketing and advertising solutions to local and regional businesses in the Bozeman area and beyond 
  • You will work with and sell integrated advertising solutions including broadcast radio, LIVE event sponsorships and digital including website design, SEO, SEM, Programmatic, Social, Streaming TV and much more 

 

What You’ll Bring: 

  • 1+ year of sales or marketing experience (preferred) 
  • Strong marketing and advertising acumen 
  • Effective verbal and written communications are essential 
  • Experience selling or a working knowledge of digital advertising solutions preferred 
  • Goal-oriented, strong work ethic and a desire to learn and grow a career in Sales 
  • A passion towards customer focused solution sales 
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required) 
  • BA/BS degree (preferred) 

 

What’s In It for You? 

  • Competitive compensation package with UNCAPPED earning potential  
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days) 
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community 
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance 
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan 
  • Company-provided laptop 
  • Casual, high-energy, supportive, and collaborative work environment 
  • 4-week long sales training program  
  • Unlimited growth opportunities!  

 

Why Townsquare Media Group? 

Townsquare is a community-focused digital media, digital marketing solutions, and radio company focused outside the Top 50 markets in the U.S. Our assets include Townsquare Interactive, a digital marketing services subscription business providing websites, search engine optimization, social platforms, and online reputation management for approximately 21,900 SMBs; Townsquare IGNITE, a proprietary digital programmatic advertising technology with an in-house demand and data management platform; and Townsquare Media, our portfolio of 357 local radio stations in 74 cities with corresponding local news and entertainment websites and apps along with a network of national music/content brands.

job.title: Business Development Representative
job.description:
Business Development Representative

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

This Isn't Another Sales Job. It's Your Chance to Build Something Bigger.

Let's be honest—there are thousands of sales jobs.
Most ask you to sell one product. Make cold calls. Hit a quota. Repeat.
This isn't one of them.

At Townsquare Media Grand Rapids, you'll help shape the success of local businesses while representing some of the most recognized brands in West Michigan. You'll have the backing of a company that combines the power of market-leading radio stations, streaming audio, live events, streaming TV, websites, social media, search marketing, programmatic advertising, SEO, websites, and cutting-edge digital solutions—all under one roof.

Every day is different. Every client is different. Every success story is yours to create.

If you're energized by competition, love solving business challenges, and want unlimited earning potential while working alongside an exceptional team, we'd love to meet you.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare Media is one of America's largest and most innovative local media companies, operating 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets nationwide.

In Grand Rapids, we're more than a media company—we're woven into the fabric of the community. Our brands entertain, inform, and connect hundreds of thousands of people every week while helping businesses grow through powerful, measurable marketing solutions.

Our clients don't hire us to buy advertising.
They partner with us to grow their businesses.
That's where you come in.

 

What You’ll Do:

You'll become a trusted marketing advisor to local business owners and decision-makers, helping them navigate today's rapidly evolving media landscape.
You'll work with entrepreneurs, CEOs, marketing directors, nonprofits, and community leaders to develop customized marketing strategies that deliver real business results.

Every day you'll:

  • Build new relationships with businesses throughout West Michigan
  • Create strategic marketing plans using radio, streaming audio, streaming TV, websites, social media, SEO, search marketing, programmatic advertising, events, and more
  • Present creative ideas that help clients grow revenue and strengthen their brands
  • Negotiate and close new business
  • Collaborate with creative, digital, programming, and leadership teams to bring campaigns to life
  • Become a respected business resource within the community

No two days look alike—and that's exactly what makes this role exciting.

 

Who Thrives Here?

Our best Account Executives are naturally curious, highly competitive, resilient, and genuinely enjoy helping people succeed.
They don't see themselves as salespeople.
They see themselves as consultants, entrepreneurs, and problem-solvers.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Love building relationships
  • Enjoy winning new business
  • Are energized by goals and competition
  • Take pride in delivering exceptional client service
  • Want to continue learning in one of the fastest-changing industries in business
  • Believe your income should reflect your performance

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in sales (required)
  • Consistent record of meeting or exceeding sales goals
  • Confidence prospecting and developing new business opportunities
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)
  • BA/BS degree (preferred)

 

What’s In It for You?

We know sales is a grind, but the rewards are real. Here’s what you get:

  • Uncapped earning potential with a competitive compensation plan
  • Comprehensive onboarding and industry-leading sales training
  • Continuous coaching from experienced local leadership
  • Career advancement opportunities within one of America's leading media companies
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days)
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop

 

More Than a Job. Build your future. Build your community. Build something extraordinary—with Townsquare Media Grand Rapids.

When you join Townsquare Media Grand Rapids, you're joining a team that celebrates big wins, supports one another, embraces innovation, and believes local businesses deserve world-class marketing.
You'll help launch new ideas, work with recognizable brands, attend exciting community events, collaborate with talented teammates, and build a career where your effort directly impacts your success.
If you're looking for a place where your ambition is rewarded, your ideas matter, and no two days are ever the same, we'd love to talk.

job.title: Multi-Media Advertising Strategist
job.description:
Multi-Media Advertising Strategist

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Every now and then a great opportunity presents itself, that time is now, for you, at Townsquare Media in Bangor.  At Townsquare, we are a team of driven individuals who push ourselves and those around us to grow personally and professionally.  We have a current opening which includes an existing book of business that requires a strong marketing professional.  You can expect a dynamic and competitive work environment that fosters success, training, development, and above average pay. 

We have a rare opening for the right person to bring our best-in-class marketing solutions to local businesses in eastern and central Maine. We’re the number one local media company in each of the markets we serve. Our top-rated radio stations, our market exclusive digital media solutions and our exciting live events are a winning combination for you, and our customers.

 

Responsibilities:

  • determine strategy for identifying, connecting and closing new opportunities in the Bangor market.
  • prospect and identify potential clients using our proprietary data and analytics;
  • build and maintain close working relationships with internal teams to identify key accounts and build solution based strategic plans that help businesses grow.
  • responsible for bringing our premier marketing and advertising solutions to both local and regional businesses in eastern and central Maine.
  • diversifying our clients’ solutions through cross-selling a variety of marketing solutions including broadcast, digital (website design, SEO, SEM, Programmatic, Paid Search/Social, etc.), and live event sponsorship.

 

Qualifications:

  • B 2 B sales experience preferred
  • A strong business acumen
  • Outside sales experience in any field with a track record of success
  • General understanding digital advertising, broadcast media and event sponsorship
  • Goal-oriented, strong work ethic, and a desire to learn and grow a career in Sales

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation plan + UNCAPPED earning potential
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days)
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Hands-on training and dedicated support from your leadership team
  • Real opportunities for career growth in a fast-moving multi-media organization

 

About Us

Townsquare is a community-focused digital media, digital marketing solutions, and radio company focused outside the Top 50 markets in the U.S. Our assets include Townsquare Interactive, a digital marketing services subscription business providing websites, search engine optimization, social platforms, and online reputation management for approximately 21,900 SMBs; Townsquare IGNITE, a proprietary digital programmatic advertising technology with an in-house demand and data management platform; and Townsquare Media, our portfolio of 322 local terrestrial radio stations in 67 cities with corresponding local news and entertainment websites and apps including legendary brands such as WYRK.com, WJON.com, and NJ101.5.com, along with a network of national music brands including XXLmag.com, TasteofCountry.com, UltimateClassicRock.com, and Loudwire.com.

job.title: Part-Time Radio & Digital Media Internship – NYS Broadcaster
job.description:
Part-Time Radio & Digital Media Internship – NYS Broadcasters

Townsquare Media Group | Albany

 

The Opportunity:

Townsquare Media is excited to offer an educational internship program designed to give students hands-on exposure to the radio broadcasting and digital media industry.

As an intern, you’ll gain real-world experience by observing and participating in the day-to-day operations of our radio stations and digital platforms, providing a behind-the-scenes look at how a modern media company operates across broadcast, digital marketing, promotions, and sales. You’ll gain insight into how broadcast and digital media work together to support local businesses, engage audiences, and create impactful marketing campaigns while learning from experienced professionals across multiple departments and seeing firsthand how our teams collaborate to deliver results for clients and communities.

Our goal is to help students build practical skills, develop industry knowledge, and make meaningful professional connections that will serve as a strong foundation for a future career in media, marketing, or communications.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Albany stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Learn & Experience:

As a Townsquare Media intern, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Observe daily operations across radio broadcasting and digital media teams
  • Learn how traditional, non-traditional, and digital marketing solutions are developed and executed
  • Gain exposure to content creation, promotions, advertising, and digital platforms
  • Assist with various department projects and initiatives as appropriate
  • Develop an understanding of how media campaigns are planned, launched, and evaluated
  • Network with media professionals and gain career insights within the industry

This internship is intended to provide hands-on exposure and educational experience, giving students a clearer understanding of career paths within the media and marketing industries.

 

What You’ll Bring to the Program:

We’re looking for students who are curious, motivated, and excited to learn about the evolving media landscape.

Ideal candidates will have:

  • A strong interest in radio broadcasting, digital media, marketing, or communications
  • A positive attitude and willingness to learn
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • The ability to work collaboratively in a professional environment
  • A proactive approach to gaining new skills and experiences

 

Program Requirements:

  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • Must be a resident of New York State and/or attending school in New York State
  • Must be a first-time participant in the Townsquare Media internship program

 

Program Details:

  • Internships are available year-round
  • Compensation is $16/ hour
  • Typically 10–20 hours per week
  • Specific schedules will be agreed upon in advance to accommodate academic commitments
  • Internship experience may include exposure to broadcast operations, digital marketing, promotions, and sales

 

Launch Your Career in Media

This internship is an opportunity to explore the fast-moving world of media while building skills that will translate to a variety of careers in marketing, broadcasting, digital media, and communications.

If you're eager to learn, contribute, and gain valuable industry experience, we’d love to hear from you.

job.description:
Sales Internship, Townsquare Media Group – Boise

*This position requires you to work in-office and on-site as needed. * 

 

Launch Your Sales & Media Career:

Interested in a career in sales, advertising, or digital marketing? Townsquare Media’s Sales Internship gives college students the opportunity to gain real-world experience while learning how businesses use media and marketing to grow.

As a Sales Intern with our Boise team, you won’t spend your internship sitting on the sidelines. You’ll work alongside experienced sales professionals, learn the fundamentals of consultative selling, and gain exposure to the full sales process—from identifying prospective clients and qualifying opportunities to conducting needs analysis and securing appointments.

You’ll also get a behind-the-scenes look at how a local media company operates, with exposure to our radio brands, digital marketing solutions, on-air operations, community events, and the teams that bring it all together.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Boise stations.  

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As an intern on our Boise sales team, you’ll gain hands-on experience with the fundamentals that drive successful sales organizations. You’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Learn how to identify and research prospective local businesses
  • Develop prospecting skills through phone, email, and other outreach
  • Learn how to qualify potential clients and identify strong sales opportunities
  • Practice conducting needs analysis to better understand a business, its goals, and its marketing challenges
  • Build confidence communicating with business owners and decision-makers
  • Learn how to secure appointments and create opportunities for our sales team
  • Shadow experienced Account Executives throughout different stages of the sales process
  • Gain exposure to client meetings, sales presentations, and marketing strategy
  • Learn how our team uses broadcast, digital, programmatic, and event sponsorship solutions to help local businesses grow
  • Develop an understanding of pipeline management, sales activity, and performance goals

 

You’ll also have opportunities to experience other areas of our Boise operation, including our radio stations, on-air teams, promotions, and off-site events, giving you a broader understanding of how sales connects with the entire organization.

This is a sales-focused internship designed to give you practical experience, meaningful coaching, and a strong foundation in consultative selling.

 

What You’ll Bring:

We’re looking for students who are curious, motivated, and excited to learn. You don’t need previous sales experience—we’ll help you build the skills.

  • Currently pursuing a college degree in Sales, Business, Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or a related field
  • Genuine interest in exploring a career in sales
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Confidence starting conversations and willingness to step outside your comfort zone
  • Coachable mindset and desire to learn
  • Strong work ethic, organization, and follow-through
  • Positive attitude and ability to work collaboratively with a team
  • Interest in media, digital marketing, advertising, or local business is a plus
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)

 

What’s In It for You?

This internship is designed to give you more than something to add to your resume. You’ll leave with real-world experience and a better understanding of what it takes to build a career in sales.

  • Hands-on sales training and coaching
  • Real-world experience in prospecting, qualifying, needs analysis, and appointment setting
  • Opportunities to shadow successful Account Executives
  • Exposure to digital advertising, radio, programmatic marketing, events, and local media
  • Experience working with local businesses and understanding their marketing challenges
  • Opportunities to attend station and community events
  • Direct access to experienced sales and market leadership
  • A chance to build your professional network and résumé before graduation
  • Exposure to potential career opportunities with Townsquare Media

 

If you’re competitive, curious, comfortable talking to people, and interested in learning how great sellers build relationships and create opportunities, we’d love to meet you.

job.title: Associate Program Director
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

This role is based in Brooklyn, NY, with four days in office and one remote.

Position Summary

The Associate Program Director is the first level of program ownership above the Sr. PM. Reporting to the Group Program Director and managing Sr. Program Managers, Managers, and Associates, this role owns and manages complex, multi-channel Tier 1 programs and the delivery health of that program level, owns account-level scope and SOW, manages staffing across the account team, and co-leads client strategy from the delivery angle in true partnership with the Business Director (and GBD on the largest accounts). This is where a Sr. PM steps into the scoping partnership — beginning to co-own scope and SOW alongside Business Leadership rather than executing against it. The Associate Program Director typically owns one large, multi-channel program or account in partnership with a BD.

Responsibilities

Program & Delivery Health

  • Own program and delivery health across the account; lead internal program coordination at the account level
  • Own account / retainer-level scope tracking and SOW; manage staffing across the account team
  • Escalate capacity needs and scope shifts back to the GPD for redesign

Client Partnership

  • Co-lead client strategy from delivery; hold senior client relationships (director / VP) on operations and scoping

Client Partnership & Communication

  • Work collaboratively to ensure clients receive a seamless experience from strategy through execution.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Strategy, Creative, Production, Context, and Program Management.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional organization and attention to detail.
  • Experience mentoring junior team members and contributing to a collaborative team culture.
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing, creative development, and client service best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience supporting healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other regulated brands is a plus, but not required. Curiosity about the category and an eagerness to learn are valued.

job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters, Inc. is a first-of-its-kind company that lives at the intersection of culture, tech and storytelling. Through our creative solutions company, Translation, we build ideas that transcend traditional marketing to 

drive business results through cultural impact. Through our music tech platform, UnitedMasters, we power the careers of independent artists through music distribution services and partnership opportunities with the world’s biggest brands. As one-company, we are building a world where cultural capital is equitably exchanged at scale by serving as the go-to source for shared gains between artists and brands. 

If this description makes you feel like running through a brick wall, you’re in the right place.

This role is based in Brooklyn, NY, with four days in office and one remote.

The Role

Context Planning is the connective tissue between what we make and who we’re making it for. This is a team that only exists at Translation and we built it to help brands diffuse their ideas through culture by focusing on where, when and who they live through.

This role is for a leader who can translate raw insight into real influence, help brands find their voice inside the communities they are looking to engage with, and build systems that make great ideas scale. At your core, you're not just a comms planner. You’re a front row student of culture, a campaign conductor, and an idea amplifier. The Context Director is a leadership position that demands creative foresight, cultural nuance, business acumen, cross-functional collaboration, and a deep connection to what’s moving the world today. 

What You’ll Do

Functional Skills

  • Cultural Research: Lead and assign cultural deep dives that inform strategy and creative development.
  • Comms Planning: Own authorship of holistic GTM plans that connect the dots creatively while translating business objectives into actionable rollouts over time and space/channels.
  • Casting & Talent Strategy: Lead authorship of casting filters that help identify talent who personify our campaign message while ensuring brand safety and creative alignment. 
  • Creative World-Building: Analyze hero deliverables (e.g., film scripts) and provide cultural nuance that infuses insider fan perspective in the form Easter eggs, and additional engagement tactics that will resonate with core audience members.
  • Convergence & Collaboration: Facilitate onboarding for new hires to ensure alignment on Context’s function and value. Partner across PR, Media, and Social teams to preserve creative integrity and contextual fluency from pitch to publish.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a core member of the business leadership team, aligning day-to-day execution with our broader One Company Vision. Mentor DRs across IC1–IC3 levels and informally coach team members outside your direct reporting line.

Who You Are

  • A systems thinker who can orchestrate brand storytelling through people, platforms, and moments.
  • A culture junkie with strong intuition and analytical rigor—you know what’s next, and why it matters.
  • A collaborator who’s equally fluent in creative, strategy, talent, and media environments.
  • A researcher at heart, with a passion for ethnography, behavioral analysis, and emerging platforms.
  • A mentor and motivator who uplifts junior talent and brings out the best in cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

  • 7–9 years experience in cultural strategy, brand planning, or creative strategy roles.
  • Proven experience leading multi-channel campaigns from insight through execution.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills—must be comfortable presenting work to senior leaders and clients.
  • Proficiency in Keynote, Google Suite, and qualitative research tools.
  • Deep understanding of subcultures, niche internet communities, and artist ecosystems.
  • Bonus: Background or minor in a creative craft, artistic discipline, or subcultural space.

job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters, Inc. is a first-of-its-kind company that lives at the intersection of culture, tech and storytelling. Through our creative solutions company, Translation, we build ideas that transcend traditional marketing to 

drive business results through cultural impact. Through our music tech platform, UnitedMasters, we power the careers of independent artists through music distribution services and partnership opportunities with the world’s biggest brands. As one-company, we are building a world where cultural capital is equitably exchanged at scale by serving as the go-to source for shared gains between artists and brands. 

If this description makes you feel like running through a brick wall, you’re in the right place.

This role is based in Brooklyn, NY, with four days in office and one remote.

The Role

Context Planning is the connective tissue between what we make and who we’re making it for. This is a team that only exists at Translation and we built it to help brands diffuse their ideas through culture by focusing on where, when and who they live through.

This role is for a leader who can translate raw insight into real influence, help brands find their voice inside the communities they are looking to engage with, and build systems that make great ideas scale. At your core, you're not just a comms planner. You’re a front row student of culture, a campaign conductor, and an idea amplifier. The Context Director is a leadership position that demands creative foresight, cultural nuance, business acumen, cross-functional collaboration, and a deep connection to what’s moving the world today. 

What You’ll Do

Functional Skills

  • Cultural Research: Lead and assign cultural deep dives that inform strategy and creative development.
  • Comms Planning: Own authorship of holistic GTM plans that connect the dots creatively while translating business objectives into actionable rollouts over time and space/channels.
  • Casting & Talent Strategy: Lead authorship of casting filters that help identify talent who personify our campaign message while ensuring brand safety and creative alignment. 
  • Creative World-Building: Analyze hero deliverables (e.g., film scripts) and provide cultural nuance that infuses insider fan perspective in the form Easter eggs, and additional engagement tactics that will resonate with core audience members.
  • Convergence & Collaboration: Facilitate onboarding for new hires to ensure alignment on Context’s function and value. Partner across PR, Media, and Social teams to preserve creative integrity and contextual fluency from pitch to publish.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a core member of the business leadership team, aligning day-to-day execution with our broader One Company Vision. Mentor DRs across IC1–IC3 levels and informally coach team members outside your direct reporting line.

Who You Are

  • A systems thinker who can orchestrate brand storytelling through people, platforms, and moments.
  • A culture junkie with strong intuition and analytical rigor—you know what’s next, and why it matters.
  • A collaborator who’s equally fluent in creative, strategy, talent, and media environments.
  • A researcher at heart, with a passion for ethnography, behavioral analysis, and emerging platforms.
  • A mentor and motivator who uplifts junior talent and brings out the best in cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

  • 7–9 years experience in cultural strategy, brand planning, or creative strategy roles.
  • Proven experience leading multi-channel campaigns from insight through execution.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills—must be comfortable presenting work to senior leaders and clients.
  • Proficiency in Keynote, Google Suite, and qualitative research tools.
  • Deep understanding of subcultures, niche internet communities, and artist ecosystems.
  • Bonus: Background or minor in a creative craft, artistic discipline, or subcultural space.

job.title: Cloud Operations Engineer
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

We are currently seeking an eager and collaborative individual to serve as the technical resource on CloudOps team. Responsible to provide technical support and guidance regarding cloud-based SAP solutions as well a being a key technical support resource in supporting the greater cloud landscape.


Job Functions:


The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to, the following functions in the Operations organization:

  • Utilize technical skills and tools to coordinate, maintain, enhance, and deploy cloud-based solutions while following corporate standards and best practices
  • Work within a CloudOps team to meet project objectives in a timely fashion
  • Update project status reports (progress/risks/issues/roadblocks) as required by Senior Management
  • Use CloudOps methodology and toolsets to implement and support solutions in AWS, Azure, and GCP
  • Implement proposed solutions to ensure the delivery of a quality product or service
  • Ensure cloud resources meet UMG’s operational requirements and are in compliance with UMG infrastructure and security standards
  • Provide documentation and communication to peers and other IT Teams for status, coordination, objectives, and performance
  • Compile and remediate vulnerabilities identified by the securities team
  • Assess and troubleshoot, consult with vendors, and coordinate with other teams for problem resolution
  • Ensure high work standards regarding incident and change management tasks
  • Other tasks as deemed necessary or appropriate

Job Requirements:


Skills/Abilities:


Critical and Required Daily Skills

  • SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES) Administration: Deploy, configure, and manage SLES EC2 instances in AWS; troubleshoot boot issues; manage LVM (LVS, VGS, PVS); configure SUID, SGID, Sticky Bit; expand XFS file systems and EBS volumes; manage permissions and ACLs. User/group management, SSH security, package management (zypper, rpm), process/service management (systemd), log analysis, networking (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls), backup/restore, patching and security hardening.

job.title: Coordinator, Catalog Efficiency
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 


How We Lead:

The Catalog Efficiency Coordinator ensures client catalogs move accurately and efficiently through Songtrust’s publishing systems. This role identifies catalog bottlenecks, resolves metadata or system issues, and collaborates across teams to maintain transparency and accuracy throughout Songtrust’s catalog workflows.



How You'll Create:

  • Monitor and review new and existing Users, Songwriters, and Songs to identify where catalogs may be stalled between systems.
  •  Identify and follow up on clients failing the Letter of Direction (LOD) process to ensure completion of songwriter information.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to report and help resolve recurring system malfunctions, automation errors, or data inconsistencies.
  • Review weekly Music Maestro automation errors and coordinate with internal teams to resolve failed song processing.
  • Analyze terminated accounts where works remain active to ensure proper catalog cleanup and reconciliation.
  • Conduct periodic reviews to identify and address duplicate works, claims, and client records across systems.
  • Monitor and investigate RMP ETL errors, ensuring songs successfully process for delivery.
  • Review RMP catalog for songs failing to reach the CWR process, documenting issues and recommending improvements.
  • Provide regular insights on catalog flow and partner with teams to enhance metadata accuracy and system efficiency.

Bring Your Vibe:

  • 1–3 years of experience in music publishing operations, metadata management, or music data analysis
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with music publishing systems, metadata standards (ISWC, ISRC, IPI), and CWR delivery processes.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in Excel, data tracking tools, and workflow management platforms
  • Ability to manage multiple catalog and data review workflows simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Digital Rights Administrator
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

UMG’s Digital Rights Administration team is dedicated to monitoring and monetizing content on digital platforms. We are currently seeking eager and exceptional new hires with familiarity to Universal’s artists and catalogue to focus exclusively on managing UMG assets on YouTube. The team’s goal is to maximize value from the rights of UMG’s recording artists in the digital space through content claiming.


How You’ll CREATE:

  • Establish an in-depth understanding of YouTube’s Content Management System (“CMS”) and its relation to the protection and exploitation of UMG music on YouTube
  • Increase advertising revenue by exploring YouTube for popular User Generated Content (“UGC”) and claiming videos that incorporate UMG’s recordings
  • Monitor claims regularly and adapt/change strategies to ensure goals are reached each quarter
  • Manage and assess the accuracy of sound recording-related data in CMS
  • Review videos that have been automatically claimed as UMG property by YouTube’s Content ID system and determine the accuracy of those claims
  • Track uses of the UMG catalogue and take appropriate steps to evaluate and take action on any infringing videos
  • Work with UMG repertoire owners, distributed labels to guarantee the satisfactory use of their recordings, as well as with third-parties to resolve claim disputes and ownership conflicts
  • Field inquiries from YouTube users regarding unauthorized exploitations of UMG content and provide detailed rationale explaining the removal of any user-uploaded video
  • Communicate with other rights holders to resolve disputes and conflicts relating to the ownership of UMG recordings
  • Surface any issues encountered while using the CMS tool and UMG internal systems to team operations lead and coordinate to develop solutions
  • Engage with other UMG departments as needed, helping to ensure that all stakeholders are aware of our claiming activities
  • Provide UMG staff and/or stakeholders with detailed reports highlighting relevant analytics supplied by YouTube, including summaries of monetized and blocked videos
  • Handle requests in YouTube Operations mailbox on Thursday evenings to ensure proper claiming of new releases

Bring your VIBE:


Skills/Abilities:

  • Familiarity with Universal’s artists and catalogue, ability to creatively search for UGC using UMG’s content
  • Experience using new media and social networks, specifically YouTube
  • YouTube content management or claiming experience preferred
  • Superior organizational skills and task management
  • Proficiency in Excel, Word and Google Sheets
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills
  • Passion for music and technology
  • Forward thinking and ambitious; ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluency in Spanish and English preferred

Experience:

  • Experience in new media and social networks, specifically YouTube
  • 1-2 years at a music or entertainment company, digital platform, social network, rights management firm, preferred
  • Rights management or copyright experience, a plus

Education:

  • College degree preferred
  • YouTube certification, a plus

job.title: Director, Business Intelligence
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Director of Business Intelligence

CD Baby | A Virgin Music Group Company

Full-Time | Los Angeles, CA / Nashville, TN / New York, NY | Remote Considered

The Opportunity

As Director of Business Intelligence, you will define and own the strategy and roadmap for making data accessible, trusted, and actionable across CD Baby. You’ll establish the metrics that matter most, drive data normalization across teams, and build the infrastructure that enables self-service insights at scale.

You will partner closely with Product, Marketing, Finance, Data Engineering and stakeholders across the company to prioritize the highest-impact KPIs, ensure consistent definitions across the organization, and embed data into how decisions get made.

This role is both strategic and hands-on: you’ll architect the BI function while also building dashboards, leading analyses, and translating complex data into clear business recommendations.

What You'll Do

Define the BI Strategy & Roadmap

• Establish a company-wide BI vision and multi-quarter roadmap.

• Standardize core metrics and KPIs across business, product and technology teams.

• Prioritize the highest-impact insights that drive growth, retention, and artist success.

• Build scalable and self-service reporting that reduces ad hoc dependency.

• Evaluate and deploy AI-enabled analytics tools that scale insight generation and reduce dependency on manual reporting

Drive Customer & Product Insights

• Lead segmentation, cohort analysis, lifetime value modeling, and churn analysis.

• Identify growth opportunities, at-risk artists, and high-value segments.

• Define and measure success metrics for new product and feature launches.

• Support experimentation and A/B testing with rigorous statistical analysis.

• Analyze streaming consumption, revenue, and audience trends across digital platforms to identify opportunities for artist growth, monetization, and business performance.

Build Data Analytics Models

• Partner with Data Engineering to continuously improve data quality, modeling, and governance.

• Own the business-facing analytics layer, building scalable data models, reporting infrastructure, and self-service tools that enable trusted, actionable insights across the organization.

• Translate complex datasets into clear, executive-ready narratives.

What You Bring

• 7 or more years of experience in data analytics, customer insights, business intelligence, or a related field.

• Advanced SQL; experience with modern BI tools and cloud warehouses, such as Snowflake,

BigQuery, dbt, Cube.

• Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in enterprise BI tools.

• Strong foundation in customer and commercial analytics, including segmentation, lifetime value,

retention, churn, experimentation, and revenue performance.

• Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and communicate clearly at all levels.

About CD Baby

CD Baby is a music industry pioneer, empowering independent artists to distribute, monetize, and grow

their music careers globally. As a Virgin Music Group company, we combine the entrepreneurial spirit of

an indie platform with the resources and reach of a major music group. Our technology and data teams sit

at the heart of how we serve millions of artists worldwide.

job.title: Director, Privacy and Data Protection
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Director, Privacy & Data Protection

Job Category: Business & Legal Affairs


How We LEAD:

The Director, Privacy & Data Protection will be an experienced privacy attorney supporting Universal Music Group's global privacy and data protection program. Working closely with the Senior Vice President, Privacy & Data Protection, this role will provide practical, hands-on legal support across privacy contracting, data subject rights, cybersecurity incidents, digital marketing and other matters involving the collection, use, sharing and protection of personal data.


As the world leader in music-based entertainment, UMG operates across a broad range of labels, artist businesses, digital platforms, e-commerce experiences, marketing initiatives and fan-facing services. The Director will work with colleagues across Legal, Information Security, Technology, Digital, Marketing, E-Commerce and the business to help UMG use data responsibly while supporting artists, creators and fans around the world.


The ideal candidate will combine strong privacy law fundamentals with excellent drafting and negotiation skills, sound judgment and a practical, business-oriented approach. This role requires an attorney who is comfortable managing a significant volume of day-to-day matters, can independently handle work within established frameworks, and recognizes when novel, sensitive or higher-risk issues require escalation.


How You'll CREATE:

  • Draft, review and negotiate data protection and privacy terms in commercial agreements, including data processing agreements, data-sharing arrangements, international data transfer provisions, information security terms and other privacy-related contractual provisions.
  • Partner with UMG's Business & Legal Affairs teams on privacy issues arising in artist, vendor, technology, platform, licensing, e-commerce, marketing and other commercial arrangements involving personal data.
  • Handle UMG's day-to-day legal work relating to data subject and consumer privacy rights requests, including assessing request scope and applicable legal requirements, advising on exemptions and response obligations, coordinating with privacy operations and relevant business teams, reviewing and drafting responses, and escalating complex or sensitive matters as appropriate.
  • Support the privacy-law aspects of cybersecurity and data security incidents, working closely with Information Security, Legal and other stakeholders to assess incident facts and affected data, analyze applicable notification and regulatory requirements, document legal assessments, and draft or review incident-related communications.
  • Assist with investigations of potential privacy and data security issues, including gathering relevant facts, evaluating legal obligations and coordinating with outside counsel where appropriate.
  • Advise business and legal teams on privacy requirements affecting UMG's websites, applications, digital platforms, artist and fan experiences, e-commerce operations, advertising and marketing activities.
  • Provide practical guidance on online advertising and tracking technologies, marketing communications, consent and preference management, and related privacy and consumer protection requirements.
  • Advise on compliance with U.S. federal and state privacy laws, GDPR and other applicable international privacy and data protection requirements.
  • Support privacy reviews of new and evolving business initiatives, technologies, vendors, products and uses of data, including privacy impact assessments where appropriate.
  • Assist with third-party privacy and data protection matters, including vendor diligence, data-transfer requirements, privacy questionnaires and remediation of identified issues.
  • Help maintain and improve privacy policies, procedures, templates, playbooks and other resources that support consistent and scalable privacy practices across UMG's labels, territories and business units.
  • Work with privacy operations, Information Security and business teams to identify recurring issues and improve processes for contract review, rights requests, incident response and other recurring privacy matters.
  • Support responses to regulatory inquiries, audits and other privacy or data protection matters as needed.
  • Monitor relevant developments in privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, digital marketing and consumer protection law and provide clear, practical guidance regarding developments relevant to UMG's businesses.
  • Provide privacy guidance and training to Legal, business and operational teams as needed.
  • Support privacy issues arising from emerging technologies and new uses of data as appropriate.
  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues across UMG's labels, business units and territories, handling routine and moderately complex matters independently and escalating novel, sensitive or significant matters as appropriate.

Bring Your VIBE:

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 8+ years of relevant legal experience, with substantial experience in privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, technology transactions or a closely related field, gained at a law firm, in-house legal department or a combination of both.
  • Experience drafting and negotiating data processing agreements and privacy, data use and security provisions in commercial agreements.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. federal and state privacy laws, including CCPA/CPRA and other comprehensive state privacy laws, and meaningful familiarity with GDPR and international data protection requirements.
  • Experience advising on data subject and consumer privacy rights requests, including access, deletion, correction and related requests.
  • Experience advising on privacy issues arising from websites, digital advertising, online tracking technologies, e-commerce, marketing and other consumer-facing data practices.
  • Familiarity with consumer protection and marketing requirements relevant to digital and direct-to-consumer activities.
  • Meaningful experience supporting cybersecurity or data security incident response, including familiarity with breach-notification requirements and experience working with information security or technical teams during investigations.
  • Strong legal research, analytical, drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to identify the issues that matter and provide clear, practical and business-oriented advice.
  • Ability to understand technical and operational facts sufficiently to identify relevant privacy, cybersecurity and digital marketing legal issues.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to handle a significant volume of matters independently while recognizing when an issue warrants escalation.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple matters and competing priorities in a fast-moving, global and highly collaborative environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain complex privacy and data protection requirements clearly to lawyers and non-lawyers.
  • CIPP/US, CIPP/E or another relevant privacy certification preferred.
  • Experience in entertainment, music, digital media, technology, e-commerce, advertising or another consumer-facing and data-intensive industry is a plus.

job.title: Executive Assistant
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Downtown Music is a modern global music company committed to building a more equitable music industry. As the preferred partner for some of the world’s most beloved songwriters, storied music catalogs, and emerging artists at the forefront of pop culture, we offer bespoke distribution, publishing administration, creative marketing and finance solutions to entrepreneurial creators and their partners.


Downtown Music Publishing is looking for an Executive Assistant to support the President and Chief Creative Officer (CCO). This is an incredible opportunity to be at the intersection of music and technology in a fast-growing global organization. The right candidate will love music, be incredibly organized and be able to utilize their skills to ensure our executives can focus on the most critical issues of the day.


How You'll Create:

  • Provide high-level administrative and operational support to the President and Chief Creative Officer, developing a strong understanding of their priorities and the broader business.
  • Proactively manage complex calendars, serving as a thoughtful steward of executive time by prioritizing high-value activities, resolving conflicts, and protecting time for strategic work.
  • Coordinate internal and external meetings, virtual calls, and a high volume of domestic and international travel.
  • Prepare executives for meetings by coordinating agendas, pre-reads, background materials, presentations, meeting logistics, and other relevant context.
  • Attend management and other key business meetings; capture decisions, notes, and action items; distribute follow-ups; and maintain accountability with responsible parties. AI tools may be used, but this role owns the accuracy and completeness of meeting records.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who combines strong software and systems expertise with practical knowledge of the AI and ML lifecycle.


You will turn models, data products, and AI workflows into maintainable production capabilities across revenue forecasting, artist, catalog intelligence and talent scouting, release marketing, and rights and ecosystem integrity. The role focuses on reproducible development, rigorous evaluation, safe deployment, observability, cost efficiency, and continuous improvement.


How you’ll CREATE:

Core MLOps & Production Infrastructure

  • Lead initiatives from problem framing and data assessment through deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and sustained adoption (versus reach a well-evidenced decision not to build).
  • Build and operate reliable ML and LLM-powered workflows, including retrieval and grounding, structured outputs, tool and API integrations, orchestration, batch or real-time inference, CI/CD, and safe rollback.
  • Establish AI evaluation and observability using representative and adversarial test sets, regression tests, human review where appropriate, traces, drift detection, latency, quality, safety, usage, and cost metrics.

  • Build reliable data and feature pipelines from streaming consumption data, release metadata, social campaign data, catalog information, and commercial finance systems; monitor completeness, freshness, anomalies, and data lineage.

  • Move generative and multimodal AI capabilities from prototypes into dependable, cost-effective workflows that help people make decisions and take action.

What success looks like in your first 12 months

job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 


Software Engineer — Publishing Platform


Downtown Music Publishing is looking for a driven individual to join us as a Software Engineer to help build our next-generation music publishing platform from the ground up. You'll help in shaping the architecture, tooling, and engineering culture of a catalog management platform that powers musical work registration, rights tracking, and royalty collection for publishers worldwide. Currently seeking candidates local to the Nashville Area.


What you'll do


●      Build a new platform from first principles — data model, API design, and infrastructure — rather than maintaining legacy systems, while making pragmatic decisions that hold up at production scale.

●      Design and implement a schema-first GraphQL API (Apollo Server) over PostgreSQL, including multi-tenant data isolation (row-level security), type-safe query layers, and performance patterns like DataLoader batching.

●      Develop React/TypeScript (Next.js) interfaces used by both internal teams and clients to manage catalogs, registrations, and data-quality workflows.

●      Build AI-native features as a core part of the product: AI-assisted data ingestion and matching, agent-accessible APIs via Model Context Protocol (MCP), and LLM-powered workflows using the Vercel AI SDK and Amazon Bedrock.

●      Work in an AI-augmented, spec-driven development workflow — architecture specs, agent-assisted implementation, and rigorous automated review are how the team ships, not an experiment on the side.

●      Own components end-to-end: design, implementation, integration testing against real databases, deployment (AWS CDK), and operational responsibility.

●      Model and implement music publishing domain logic — works, writers, shares, agreements, and society registration formats (e.g., CWR) — with the precision that financial and rights data demands.


You are / have


●      Bachelor's degree in computer science, software development, or equivalent experience.

●      5+ years of experience developing web-based software solutions.

●      Experience architecting new systems or services from scratch — you're comfortable with ambiguity, and you document the "why" behind decisions, not just the "what."

●      Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js across the full stack.

●      Solid relational database fundamentals: schema design, migrations, transactions, and query performance in PostgreSQL (or similar).

●      Experience with both traditional software development lifecycle and agentic software development — including spec-driven development, AI-augmented engineering, and working effectively with coding agents.

●      Interest in the music industry — prior experience with rights management, royalties, or metadata standards (CWR, DDEX, ISWC/ISRC) is a plus, not a requirement.


Ideally, significant experience with some of the following technologies or similar tools:


Backend: Node.js, GraphQL (Apollo Server, schema-first), PostgreSQL, etc.

Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, modern state management (e.g., Zustand)

AI/Agents: Vercel AI SDK, SpecKit, CodeX, Amazon Bedrock, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLM tool design.

Infrastructure: AWS (including CDK), Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions

Testing: Vitest, Testcontainers (integration testing against real databases), Playwright

Observability: Datadog, Sentry, structured logging

We are looking for a lifer, someone who gets us and wants to grow with us long-term 😉 We’re collaborative, supportive, and passionate about what we do, and we’re looking for a teammate who enjoys keeping financial processes running smoothly behind the scenes.

If you are looking for a role where accuracy, organization, and teamwork make a real difference in day-to-day operations, we’re ready to talk to you!

About the Job:

Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills

job.title: Audio/Video Producer, Today, Explained and Explain It to Me
job.description:
Vox is a user’s guide to the news produced by those who know it best. Today, Explained and Explain It to Me are the podcast expressions of that mission. 

As a multiplatform community of journalists and storytellers, business professionals, creators and technologists, at Vox Media we believe it is a moral and business imperative to amplify voices. This applies to our candidates, our teams, our storytelling, our creative work, and our platforms, products, and partnerships.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

We’re looking for an experienced and versatile audio and video producer with a track record of producing creative and ambitious podcasts across platforms. This role will involve producing episodes for both our daily and weekly shows, helping organize vertical video production, and ideating on future video elements for the shows. Producers on this team come up with smart pitches; book and interview guests; construct the segments; and edit and score episodes. The right person for this position is delighted by the idea of innovating on foundational news formats in both audio and video, and has a demonstrated knack for taking unexpected approaches to curiosity-driven stories. 

  • Research timely and distinctive story segments; pitch ideas for both Today, Explained and Explain It to Me
  • Cover news and feature topics clearly and respectfully, never underestimating the audience’s intelligence or overestimating how much they know
  • Assemble research prep and write sharp, focused host questions for interviews 
  • Locate and book diverse sources and podcast guests 
  • Edit episodes using ProTools 
  • Score and edit audio segments
  • Produce vertical videos using Descript or Premiere 
  • Ideate on social video and podcast video formats
  • Write site posts for Vox.com 

 WHO YOU ARE

The successful candidate for this role is an editorial-minded producer with a focus on serving the audience. The right person is ambitious and innovative across platforms; they are a voracious learner excited by domestic and global news as well as by internet and culture. 

What you’ll bring:

  • Significant experience creating audio stories as part of a fast-moving, collaborative team under deadline pressure

Proficiency in audio editing/mixing in ProTools

  • Proficiency in video editing and experience producing social video content
  • A portfolio that demonstrates an ear for great tape and inventive approaches to storytelling
  • Experience working on complex teams in newsrooms 
  • A highly organized and dogged approach to landing bookings on a quick turnaround
  • Experience scripting and editing compelling, curiosity-driven stories or segments
  • A track record of developing stories that draw on diverse perspectives/source lists
  • Creativity and a desire to be innovative

WHERE YOU’LL WORK

This position is based in Washington, DC, and the candidate will work from the Vox office at least 2 days a week.

Please note: Your application should include your resume and a short cover letter describing your interest in the position. Also Include links to examples of your work and descriptions of what your role was on relevant previous projects. 

This role is a part of the Vox Media Union, represented by the Writers Guild of America, East

job.title: Director, Podcast Partnerships
job.description:
Who We Are

The Vox Media Podcast Network is one of the largest U.S. podcast publishers, home to some of the most popular and influential shows. Reaching a monthly audience of tens of millions across audio, video, and social platforms, our podcasts spark conversations and shape culture, covering everything from politics, technology, and business to food, lifestyle, sports, entertainment, and more. The Vox Media Podcast Network is powered by thought leaders in modern media, and home to a prestigious portfolio of voices from New York Magazine, Vox.com, and The Bulwark. Learn more at podcasts.voxmedia.com.

 

As a Director of Podcast Partnerships, you will be an important revenue contributor responsible for expanding high-value agency and client direct relationships and driving new business growth across the Vox Media Podcast Network. You will serve as a trusted strategic partner to brand and growth marketers and agencies, delivering innovative podcast and talent solutions that connect brands with highly engaged, intellectually curious communities at scale.

Leveraging Vox Media's premium podcast network — including leading shows and high profile talent across technology, business, sports, science, and culture — high-value audiences, and unique scale, you will build partnerships that drive measurable business outcomes. This role demands a consultative mindset, strong relationship-building skills, the ability to influence across all levels of marketing organizations, a passion for podcasts and talent, and a relentless drive to grow revenue in a fast-paced, ambitious environment.

What You'll Do

Lead Strategic Growth: Develop and execute a long-term revenue strategy to expand business with existing and new direct-response clients across the Vox Media Podcast Network.  This role will focus on both upfront deal expansion and 360 campaign partnerships, integrating performance and growth marketers across audio, video and social platforms.

Cultivate Executive-Level Relationships: Build and deepen relationships with key decision-makers at agencies and pertinent client side partners - VPs of Marketing, Heads of Brand & Growth Marketing - positioning Vox Media as a go-to strategic partner for podcast and talent investment.

Proactive Market Engagement: Identify industry trends, evolving buyer behaviors, and client challenges within the performance marketing sector, proactively delivering cross-platform podcast and talent solutions before RFPs are issued.

Consultative Sales Leadership: Translate client objectives into high-impact campaigns using Vox Media podcasts, host talent, video, social and live event capabilities.

Build & Develop Key Relationships:  Bring a deep understanding of the structure, hierarchy, and strategy of the major performance agencies in order to unlock increased investment, new strategic partners, and a diversified buying approach.

Revenue Accountability: Own forecasting, pipeline development, and quarterly and annual sales targets, with full accountability for results and strategic account planning.

Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with editorial, marketing, creative, production and operations teams to deliver custom, culturally resonant proposals that reflect how performance brands communicate with their audiences.

Brand Advocacy: Represent the Vox Media Podcast Network at key industry events and client forums to expand our presence and thought leadership within the performance marketing  ecosystem.

Who You Are

Proven Media Seller: 7+ years of digital media and/or podcast & talent sales experience with a demonstrated track record of success in direct-response and growth marketing space. This is a NYC based role with potential for additional national travel responsibilities.

Strategic Dealmaker: Skilled in complex, consultative sales to marketing executives and agency leadership, with experience securing large-scale, integrated partnerships.

Podcast & Talent Native: Deep familiarity with the podcast and talent advertising landscape — editorial and talent integrations, multi-platform partnerships, scaled podcast buys — and a genuine passion for the medium.

Visionary & Entrepreneurial: A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with the ability to anticipate market shifts and client needs before they surface.

Influential Communicator: Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to inspire and persuade at the highest levels of a client organization. Ability to think critically, connect advertiser needs to the right show and talent and communicate the value proposition with clarity and confidence.

Data-Informed Strategist: Comfortable leveraging performance data, audience insights, and category trends to craft compelling, measurable solutions that justify and grow podcast and talent investment.

In this role, you are not just selling media — you are shaping how performance brands connect with audiences through premium audio and video content, trusted voices, and unique scale. As a Director of Podcast Partnerships, your ability to see around corners, anticipate client needs, and deliver category-defining ideas will directly influence Vox Media's position as a leading force in the podcast and talent space!

Where You’ll Work

This job is located in New York City and requires in-office presence Tuesday through Thursday, with additional in-person expectations for client and agency meetings in and outside of NYC.

 

Compensation

This role is compensated on both a base and bonus structure. The compensation listed below reflects only the base salary.

job.title: Head of Podcast Growth & Operations
job.description:
Vox Media is seeking three entrepreneurial, action-oriented Heads of Podcast Growth & Operations to own the growth, business performance, and operations for three distinct groups of shows and talent in our fast-growing portfolio: business, tech, and leadership; news, politics, and current affairs; lifestyle, culture, and sports. 

The Head of Growth & Operations will be accountable for day-to-day operations, P&L performance, and audience and revenue growth for each show in their portfolio. They will convene a dedicated cross-functional team spanning sales, sales marketing, production, audience marketing, YouTube and social strategy, and business operations. They will also bring sharp insight on the podcast industry, the creator economy, and the competitive landscape to shape how we grow the category and its key franchises. 

This is a hands-on role: the Head of Growth & Operations is close to the week-to-week details of every show, including release calendars, ad load and inventory, guest booking, episode performance, and production workflows, and steps in directly when something slips.

Key responsibilities

  • Set growth strategy and execution roadmaps for the shows in the category, working with the category team to monitor and drive audience and revenue growth
  • Drive cross-functional progress by setting priorities and KPIs, tracking and managing progress, and leading weekly operating meetings
  • Build strong relationships with host talent, agents, and business counterparts; serve as the show’s first point of contact on all aspects of the business; set and lead regular touchpoints with external partners and leadership
  • Own the category P&L, budgeting and forecasting, and regular business reviews for the category and its key franchises

Qualifications 

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and driving outcomes across many internal and external stakeholders
  • Experience owning a P&L or business line in media, entertainment, podcasting, or the creator economy, with fluency in KPI tracking and creator and digital media business models
  • A track record of growing audience and revenue across platforms (audio, YouTube, social, and live)
  • Experience managing high-profile talent relationships and complex partnerships, with the empathy and directness to deliver hard news well

Leadership qualities

  • A high-metabolism, action-oriented leader, who will drive progress week-to-week 
  • An ownership mentality, excited to "roll up your sleeves" and get things done
  • A confident, poised, clear communicator with senior audiences
  • A collaborative teammate who leads through influence
  • An ambitious and entrepreneurial mindset
  • A detail-obsessed operator who is as comfortable fixing a missed ad read or a broken release workflow as presenting a business review to leadership.
  • Leads from the front: no task is too small, and you hold the team to a high bar on execution quality.
