job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.

For more information, visit WPP.com.
 


ポジション概要
本ポジションは、当社の最重要クライアントのビジネス目標達成を支援するため、世界水準のコミュニケ ーション制作を高い品質で開発・実行する役割です。勤務地は東京です。 プリント・プロダクションマネージャーは、さまざまな素材に印刷する制作物について、優れたプロジェ クトマネジメントスキルを活かし、制作スケジュールを管理します。対象となる制作物には、パッケージ 、各種販促物、店舗ウィンドウおよび店内グラフィック、イベント用グラフィック、サイネージ、ギフト カード、プレミアム・販促品などが含まれます。 候補者には、高い色彩分析力に加え、プリプレス、大判・小判のオフセット印刷、各種加工技術に関する 幅広い知識が求められます。また、デジタル媒体および写真媒体の制作経験と、現場での施工・設置作業 を監督した経験が必要です。

主な業務内容
• 印刷案件を管理し、サプライヤーへ適切なブリーフィングを行います。必要に応じて、印刷管理業務 を外部のプロダクションエージェンシーへ委託します。
• 色校正、カラーマネジメント、印刷工程においてサプライヤーを監督します。これには、印刷現場お よび製本現場での確認、加工、品質管理、キット内容の抜き取り確認が含まれます。キットの梱包お よびフルフィルメントに最適な方法を提案し、定期的にフルフィルメント現場を訪問します。
• 外部のプロダクションエージェンシーが上記サービスを提供する場合、その業務を監督します。 • 他チームと密接に連携し、エージェンシーおよびサプライヤーが制作仕様とスケジュールを厳格に遵 守していることを確認します。
• 色に関するガイダンスを提供し、品質管理に最適な方法について助言します。
• 外部ビジネスパートナーとともに印刷現場に立ち会い、必要に応じて品質や使用素材の観点から納品 物を最適化します。 • すべてのプロジェクトについて、制作状況をクライアントへ随時報告します。 

応募要件
• 大学卒業資格を有し、広告代理店または企業内のグラフィックデザイン部門において、4～6 年の印刷 制作経験があること。
• 主体性があり、高い整理・管理能力を備えていること。複数の業務を同時に進めることに優れ、プレ ッシャーのある状況でも落ち着いて対応し、チームの一員として効果的に働けること。
• Adobe Creative Suite の使用経験があれば望ましいですが、必須ではありません。
 • 業務上必要な出張に対応できること。

このポジションで重視される専門性
• 印刷制作における進行管理、スケジュール管理、サプライヤーおよび外部エージェンシーのマネジメ ント
• プリプレス、オフセット印刷、大判・小判印刷、製本・表面加工・仕上げ工程に関する実務知識
• 色校正、カラーマネジメント、品質管理、印刷立ち会いに関する専門性
• 店舗・イベント向けグラフィックやサイネージなどの現場施工・設置監督経験


WPP Productionについて

私たちWPP Productionは、WPPグループ内のあらゆるコンテンツプロデューサー、スタジオ、そして制作（クラフト）の専門家を結集し、ひとつの繋がった組織として統合されたグローバル・プロダクション・カンパニーです。

世界最高峰の人間によるクラフトマンシップ（熟練した制作技術）と次世代テクノロジーを融合させ、大規模なマルチチャネル・コンテンツシステムを企画・デザインし、世界へと届けています。

国境のないボーダレスなコラボレーションを前提に構築され、深い制作技術の専門性に裏打ちされた私たちは、常時稼働（Always-on）かつAI主導で動く現代のマーケティング世界のために設計された「プロダクション・エンジン（制作の中核）」です。　なお、WPP ProductionはWPPグループの一員です。

job.title: Analyst, Newsroom Data
job.description:
Job Description:


WSJ Newsroom | Data Analyst (September 2026)

Title: Data Analyst, Newsroom Analytics

The Wall Street Journal is seeking a Data Analyst to join our newsroom data team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Newsroom Analytics. You will work alongside our senior analysts to produce the reports, dashboards, and analyses the newsroom relies on to make editorial, audience, and product decisions every day.

This role is a chance to build real analytical range in a fast-moving newsroom environment. You will spend most of your time in SQL, pulling data, building and maintaining dashboards, and helping the newsroom get answers quickly. You will use AI tools to accelerate this work, building lightweight utilities and automations that improve efficiency across the team and free up time for deeper analysis. You will collaborate closely with more senior colleagues as you take on progressively more independent work, from ad hoc analyses to experiment analysis and measurement projects.

This position will be based in our New York office.

You will:

  • Write SQL to answer questions from newsroom editorial, audience, and product partners, translating requests into clean, well-scoped queries and clearly communicated results.

  • Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports that expand self-serve access to newsroom data.

  • Support deep-dive analyses on major news events, high-priority moments, and shifts in performance.

  • Help keep the reporting stack reliable by troubleshooting data quality issues, tracing problems back to their source, and partnering with data engineering to resolve them.

  • Contribute to A/B tests and experiment analysis in partnership with senior analysts, growing into independent experiment ownership over time.

  • Learn the newsroom's taxonomies, instrumentation, and foundational datasets, and help maintain shared documentation and analytical patterns the team pulls from.

You have:

  • 1 to 2 years in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, or an equivalent internship and project background.

  • Proficient SQL skills, with experience writing queries against non-trivial datasets.

  • Comfort with a modern BI or dashboarding tool (Looker, Tableau, Mode, or similar).

  • Curiosity and speed in picking up new technical concepts and frameworks, and a track record of getting productive on unfamiliar stacks.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to explain data clearly to non-technical partners.

  • Care for accuracy and detail in work the newsroom will act on.

Standout candidates will have strengths in one or more of the following:

  • Experience with large-scale data warehouses like BigQuery or Snowflake, or with dbt.

  • Familiarity with Python for analysis, data wrangling, or automation, and comfort maintaining code in Git.

  • Exposure to A/B testing and applied statistics.

  • A background or strong interest in journalism, media, or content, and enthusiasm for driving journalistic outcomes.

  • Comfort using AI/LLM tooling to speed up analytical workflows.

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. job.title: Audience Data Analyst, Opinion
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

The Wall Street Journal is a global news organization that provides leading news, information, commentary and analysis. The Wall Street Journal engages readers across print, digital, mobile, social, podcast and video. Building on its heritage as the preeminent source of global business and financial news, the Journal includes coverage of U.S. & world news, politics, arts, culture, lifestyle, sports, and health. It holds 38 Pulitzer Prizes for outstanding journalism. The Wall Street Journal is published by Dow Jones, a division of News Corp (Nasdaq: NWS, NWSA; ASX: NWS, NWSLV).

 

The WSJ Opinion section has long served as a forum for intelligent, values-driven commentary, dedicated to advocating a consistent philosophy that can be summed up as ‘free markets, free people.’ While we aim to persuade, every word we publish is the product of rigorous reporting, research and debate. WSJ Opinion offers sharp, original analysis and strong points of view on the news of the day. This position supports the Opinion section’s audience data and insights work.

 

About the Role:

The Wall Street Journal’s Opinion section is seeking an Audience Data Analyst based in New York to support our audience reporting and editorial performance tracking.

Reporting directly to the Manager of Audience Data Analysis and Insights, you will be responsible for tracking audience trends, updating reporting dashboards, and translating audience behavior into clear takeaways for editorial leadership. You will assist in compiling recurring reports and ad-hoc analyses covering Opinion, Free Expression, Books and Arts in Review across web, mobile apps, newsletters, video, and podcasts. This is a hybrid role based in New York, with an expectation of working in the office three days per week.


You Will:

  • Extract, validate, and analyze reach, engagement, and subscription data from Snowflake using SQL to support editorial decision-making.
  • Help build, update, and maintain dashboards and reporting views in Tableau.
  • Support the Manager of Audience Data Analysis and Insights in compiling the recurring weekly analytics report and monthly performance summaries, with the expectation of taking ownership of these reporting processes.
  • Monitor audience interaction, visitor loyalty, and how effectively content converts visitors into subscribers across articles, newsletters, video series, and podcasts.
  • Utilize Adobe Analytics, Parse.ly, and native analytics tools from platforms such as YouTube Studio, TikTok Studio, and Meta Business Suite to pull performance data
  • Assist with data quality assurance, reviewing query outputs and validating metrics between reporting dashboards and warehouse data sources.
  • Contribute to code updates and documentation following team version control practices in GitHub.

You Have:

  • 1–4 years of professional experience in data analytics, digital analytics, or business intelligence, preferably in a media, publishing, or subscription environment.
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries to aggregate, filter, and join multi-table datasets.
  • Experience developing and updating data visualizations and dashboards in Tableau.
  • Knowledge of GitHub for basic version control and documentation.
  • Experience working with audience, subscription, or editorial performance data preferred.
  • Experience using AI-assisted productivity tools such as Claude or Glean preferred.
  • Familiarity with Python or dbt preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail, with a focus on data accuracy and proactive communication regarding task progress.
  • An interest in news and opinion journalism, and an appreciation for the Opinion section's editorial standards and philosophy.

job.title: Client Success Manager
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team

Our team brings together the capabilities to position, commercialize, and grow Dow Jones’s B2B and enterprise portfolio. We translate customer needs, audience insight, and market intelligence into product strategy, clear value propositions, differentiated positioning, and relevant product and content experiences.


We enable commercial performance through sales operations, go-to-market enablement, and cross-functional coordination. We also help drive client outcomes across onboarding, adoption, engagement, and retention. Working in close partnership with Product, Editorial, Sales, and Client Success, we ensure Dow Jones’s enterprise solutions are compelling in the market, equipped for commercial success, and deliver sustained value to clients.


About the Role

We are seeking a Client Success Manager to support the post-sale client journey for assigned new business accounts from signed deal through launch, activation, early adoption, and handoff into ongoing account management. This role sits within Client Success and serves as the day-to-day point of contact for a portfolio of standard accounts. The Client Success Manager works closely with Client Success Managers, Sales, Regional Sales Coordinators, Operations, Engagement, Customer Care, and Account Management partners.


The objective of the role is to deliver a consistent, high-quality onboarding experience at scale by reducing friction, accelerating time to value, flagging risk early, and making sure clients are connected to the right resources.


The Client Success Manager owns onboarding and early adoption execution for a portfolio of standard accounts and supports Client Success Managers on larger or more complex launches. This role follows established playbooks and success milestones to keep launches on track, and escalates to the Director of Client Success when an account needs more strategic or specialized support.


This role does not carry a direct revenue quota, renewal target, or quota-carrying expansion responsibility. Success is measured by how effectively clients launch, activate, adopt key products and workflows, engage early, and transition cleanly into ongoing account management.


You Will:

  • Serve as the primary post-sale point of contact for assigned standard accounts from signed deal through onboarding and early adoption.
  • Participate in the handoff from Sales and document client goals, use cases, stakeholders, and launch priorities in CRM.
  • Execute structured 60 to 90 day onboarding milestones and success plans using established templates, so clients know what success looks like and achieve early wins quickly.
  • Maintain regular, proactive communication with clients and internal stakeholders to keep launches on schedule.
  • Partner with Client Success Managers on strategic, complex, or multi-stakeholder launches, owning assigned workstreams such as user provisioning tracking, training scheduling, and status reporting.
  • Prepare launch materials, meeting agendas, recap notes, and action trackers to keep cross-functional teams aligned.
  • Work with Regional Sales Coordinators to track sales order processing, account setup, account changes, billing requirements, and CRM updates through to completion.
  • Work with Operations and Fulfillment teams to confirm provisioning, entitlements, and technical readiness ahead of launch.
  • Follow up on open items and escalate operational blockers to the Director of Client Success.
  • Deliver standard onboarding and product training sessions using playbooks, success milestones, and training guidance.
  • Make sure clients understand how to get started, what steps are required for activation, and how to build early product usage habits.
  • Recognize when a client needs more specialized support and escalate to the Director of Client Success.
  • Connect clients to the right communications, campaigns, webinars, and enablement programs from Engagement Strategy & Performance and Customer Lifecycle Marketing.
  • Use engagement reporting, health signals, and recommended plays to prioritize outreach across the portfolio.
  • Monitor usage, activation milestones, and health signals across assigned accounts to spot stalled onboarding, weak adoption, or early churn risk.
  • Flag risks promptly to the Director of Client Success with context and recommended next steps.

job.title: Director, Business Optimization & Operational Excellence
job.description:
Job Description:

About the Team

Dow Jones Energy is a leading global energy intelligence business providing trusted price reporting from our specialist Price Reporting Agency (PRA) OPIS, Chemical Market Analytics (CMA) and McCloskey, proprietary data, market intelligence, news and research to help customers navigate increasingly interconnected energy markets. Through our specialist businesses, Dow Jones Energy makes it easier to discover and access trusted expertise spanning oil and gas, chemicals, refined fuels, coal, electric vehicle infrastructure and renewables. Our specialist businesses combine rigorous pricing methodologies with world-class human judgment to deliver the trusted intelligence and specialist insight customers need to make confident decisions. 

About the Role

The Director of Business Optimization & Operational Excellence will play a pivotal role in transforming commercial operations into a highly efficient, value-impacting engine. Reporting directly to the VP of Operational Excellence, this role is tasked with managing the Business Optimization team driving the end-to-end Customer Journey process improvement, strengthening commercial and commercial operations execution, and enabling sustainable business growth. In addition, implement systematic collection of VOC across customer facing functions for actionable insights.The successful candidate will leverage Lean management frameworks, process mapping methodologies, automation technologies, and advanced Salesforce CRM optimization to eliminate friction across commercial workflows. Furthermore, this role will champion cross-functional alignment and operational efficiency across critical commercial partnering functions, including Sales Excellence, Customer Service, Sales Coordination, RevOps, Marketing, Billing and Legal teams. 

You Will

1. Process Mapping, Streamlining & Lean Optimization

  • Workflow Documentation: Map existing end-to-end commercial operations, creating comprehensive As-Is process maps, standard operating procedures, and To-Be future-state designs.  
  • Lean & Continuous Improvement: Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen methodologies to identify operational bottlenecks, redundancies, waste, and friction points across departments. 
  • Optimization Execution: Redesign Lead to Cash workflows to reduce cycle times, minimize error rates, eliminate rework, and enhance overall service delivery quality.
  • Customer Journey Optimization: Partner with marketing, sales and sales operations to design, evaluate, and refine automated lead journeys that nurture prospects and generate high-intent sales leads. 

2. Salesforce CRM Maximization & Commercial Enablement

  • Salesforce Utilization & Optimization: Serve as the primary business bridge between commercial teams and Salesforce administrators to enhance user adoption, workflow automation, lead-to-cash process efficiency, and pipeline management.
  • Commercial Execution & Sales Enablement: Streamline sales workflows, lead routing, opportunity tracking, and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) integration to remove administrative burden from sales. 
  • Manage the implementation of digital adoption training tools (WalkMe).

3. Process Innovation, Digital Transformation & Automation

  • Automation Tool Integration: Identify and champion innovative technology solutions, including Robotic Process Automation (RPA), AI-driven workflows, smart forms, and document management automation.
  • Digital Workflow Solutions: Modernize manual, e-mail based, paper-based, or spreadsheet-heavy tasks across commercial and support operations into automated digital tools.

4. Cross-Functional Support Team Operational Efficiency 

  • Commercial Support Optimization: Drive operational excellence across Customer Service, Contract Support, and Sales Coordinator teams to align service metrics with commercial growth objectives.
  • Customer Service & Order Execution: Enhance ticket resolution workflows, order management, and inquiry handling to improve Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) and key SLA performance. 

You Have

Experience

  • 12+ years of progressive professional experience in business operations, management consulting, or commercial operational excellence.
  • 4-5+ years of direct people management, with proven success leading optimization or continuous improvement teams
  • Lean / Six Sigma: Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification strongly preferred.
  • Salesforce Expertise: Proven experience optimizing Salesforce CRM from a business/ operational perspective (Salesforce Administrator certification or deep business architecture experience is a strong plus).

Skills & Technical Proficiencies

  • Process Mapping Tools: Advanced proficiency in Visio, Lucidchart, Signavio, or similar workflow mapping platforms.
  • Sales Enablement & CRM: Deep understanding of Salesforce functionality, pipeline hygiene, reports/dashboards, and automated commercial workflows.
  • Change Management & Leadership: Strong stakeholder management skills with a demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional leaders and drive change adoption without direct line authority.

  • Paid Time Off and Leaves

job.title: Executive Assistant, Office of the CEO
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team

The Office of the CEO is a highly collaborative, fast-moving team at the center of the organization, working closely with senior leaders and cross-functional partners to help drive key business priorities forward. Supporting the Chief of Staff to the CEO, you’ll be part of a team that values organization, discretion, sound judgment, and a proactive approach to moving the needle within the organization.


About the Role 

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and adaptable professional to serve as a trusted partner to the Chief of Staff to the CEO. This role combines high-level executive assistant responsibilities, such as calendar management, travel booking, expense reporting, with associate-level project management, research, and reporting work. The ideal candidate will work closely with the CoS and OCEO team, thrive in a fast-paced environment, maintain strict confidentiality, and step in wherever support is needed to help drive key business objectives.

This role is based in our NYC office and requires five days a week in the office.


You Will 

Executive Support:

  • Manage complex calendars for the CoS, including internal and external meetings, scheduling across time zones, and prioritizing competing requests
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel, including accommodations, and prepare detailed itineraries
  • Prepare meeting agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up actions, and track them to completion
  • Screen inbound requests and inquiries, determine priority and next steps, and prepare the CoS for each meeting
  • Assist with business operations functions such as document organization and communications planning
  • Allocate time effectively and adjust priorities as business needs evolve
  • Process expense reports, purchase orders, and invoices in a timely manner

Special Projects: 

  • Serve as point person for the CoS project list, providing status updates connecting teams working on key initiatives
  • Support key and special projects, such as new strategic initiatives, sales enablement, and cross-department work designated by the CoS or the Business Operations Manager 
  • Prepare presentations, decks, reports, and ad hoc analysis, including quarterly progress reports and annual strategy and budget materials
  • Conduct research and prepare briefings for meetings, speaking engagements, and interviews
  • Support onboarding of new team members and vendors

You Have 

Experience

  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience supporting senior level/C suite leadership, preferably in a global organization. Strategy background a plus, but not a requirement.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree or relevant experience. A project management qualification is preferred.

Skills

  • Exceptional organizational, time management, and multitasking skills, with strong attention to detail and the persistence to see work through
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills. Able to engage with individuals at all levels of the organization and across departments
  • Proven ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain confidentiality

  • Proficiency in Google Suite; familiarity with tools such as Zoom, Concur, and Slack.

job.title: Executive Director - Chemical Markets Price Reporting
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

As Executive Director - Chemical Markets Price Reporting, you will lead Dow Jones Energy's global chemicals price reporting business. You will oversee the editorial teams responsible for the assessment and publication of benchmark prices, assessments and market-moving news across global petrochemical and chemical markets from our PCW brand.

You ensure the integrity, quality, transparency, and market relevance of chemical price assessments while maintaining the highest ethical and methodological standards. You will lead a global team of price reporters and editors responsible for market coverage across key chemical value chains - including aromatics, olefins, plastics, polymers, syngas, methanol, feedstocks, and emerging chemical markets.

You will drive editorial excellence, benchmark innovation, and market engagement, while ensuring compliance with legal requirements and industry standards. You will partner closely with Product, Standards & Compliance, Risk, and other Editorial leaders to ensure Dow Jones Energy's chemicals assessments remain trusted, transparent, and indispensable to global commodity markets.

You will report to the SVP - Markets & Price Reporting.

About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.

Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.

You Will:

  • Lead and develop a global team of chemicals price reporters, editors, and market specialists, fostering a culture of editorial excellence, accountability, and collaboration

  • Ensure all chemical market assessments are developed, maintained, and published in accordance with the highest standards of price assessment integrity, market transparency, governance, and ethical conduct consistent with Dow Jones’ and The Wall Street Journal’s values

  • Lead methodology development, periodic methodology reviews, market consultations, and stakeholder engagement processes to ensure pricing methodologies remain robust, representative, and responsive to evolving market dynamics

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with producers, consumers, traders, brokers, exchanges, trade associations, and other market participants to strengthen market engagement, data integrity, and confidence in Dow Jones Energy's petrochemical and chemical markets assessments

  • Partner with Standards & Compliance, Legal, and Risk teams to ensure ongoing compliance with applicable benchmark regulations, internal controls, audit requirements, and governance frameworks

  • Partner with Product to execute the strategic roadmap for global chemicals market coverage, including identifying opportunities for new benchmarks, market expansion, and portfolio optimization

  • Monitor benchmark performance, market adoption, customer feedback, and competitive developments - recommending changes to methodologies, coverage, and editorial priorities as appropriate

  • Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain high-performing editorial talent, ensuring appropriate succession planning, capability development, and organizational resilience across the chemicals price reporting organization

  • Act as a senior spokesperson and subject matter expert for chemicals markets, representing Dow Jones Energy at industry conferences, customer engagements, webinars, and regulatory forums

You Have:

  • 15+ years’ experience in commodity price reporting, market intelligence, or related information services organization

  • Deep knowledge of global chemicals and petrochemical markets, including physical market structures, trading practices, supply chains, and pricing mechanisms

  • Significant leadership experience managing geographically dispersed editorial, price reporting, or market analysis teams

  • Demonstrated experience developing, managing, or launching benchmark price assessments, methodologies, or market intelligence products

  • Strong understanding of IOSCO Principles for Oil Price Reporting Agencies and familiarity with benchmark regulation, governance, assurance, and audit requirements

  • Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to cultivate relationships with senior leaders and external market participants

  • A university degree -OR- relevant professional experience

job.title: Executive Producer, Original Video
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role

 

Dow Jones is building something ambitious in video, rooted in the authority of The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and Investor’s Business Daily, and designed for how audiences actually watch business news now. The Executive Producer will lead the editorial development and production of video programming, working across the newsroom and video teams to deliver clear, distinctive journalism for audiences. This hands-on leader will be accountable for execution from planning through publication and turn stories backed by reporting into engaging video.

 

You Will

  • Own a specific show’s editorial planning and rundown through live production and post-show delivery, ensuring decisions, deadlines and follow-through stay on track.
  • Shape each show around the news agenda, a clear editorial point of view and what viewers need to understand that day.
  • Build segments around a strong question, authoritative WSJ reporting, the right voice, and a memorable visual or practical takeaway.
  • Work with hosts, reporters and editors, bookers, and producers to develop stories, interviews and contributions.
  • Write and edit scripts, interview arcs, tosses, and transitions; keep the show focused, clear, and moving.
  • Run live production with the studio and control-room teams, making sound editorial calls under deadline.
  • Build a flexible show structure by using recurring franchises when they serve the story, and change the shape of the show when the news or a standout guest calls for it.
  • Coordinate with video, audience, and distribution partners to make segments work across live, on-demand, audio, and social formats.
  • Protect newsroom standards through strong sourcing, fact-checking and editorial judgment at every stage.
  • Build a repeatable daily workflow that helps the team move quickly without sacrificing quality.

You Have

  • 12+ years of experience producing daily or live news and interview-led programming, digitally native live experience is preferred.
  • Excellent editorial judgment and a strong command of business news and expertise in business topics.
  • Recent, hands-on experience writing rundowns and scripts, shaping interviews, booking guests and producing live shows.
  • Experience leading a lean team, with the ability to set priorities, stay hands-on, and make limited resources a strength without compromising ambition or quality.
  • The ability to turn complex reporting into clear, engaging segments without losing nuance.
  • A collaborative approach to working with journalists, hosts, contributors and production teams.
  • Calm, decisive instincts in a fast-moving newsroom and the ability to solve problems in real time.
  • An understanding of how strong segments can travel across video, audio and social platforms.
  • Comfort with an early schedule and pace of live shows.

job.title: Lead Data Scientist, Newsroom Analytics
job.description:
Job Description:


The Wall Street Journal is seeking a Lead Data Scientist, Newsroom Analytics to drive our newsroom's audience-data strategy. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Newsroom Data, you will be embedded in one of the world's most influential newsrooms, working directly with newsroom coverage, audience, and product strategy teams on the decisions that shape how news is reported, prioritized, and delivered to millions of readers. 


This is a highly autonomous and strategic role that demands both rigorous data science and sharp analytical instincts in equal measure. Working closely with editorial and audience leaders, you'll surface the right problems and own the full arc from solution design to adoption, building the metrics, models, and forecasts that teams rely on. This includes developing tools teams actually use, translating complex methodologies into clear recommendations, and consistently connecting your work to outcomes that matter: how readers discover, engage with, and return to WSJ journalism. Beyond your own output, you will serve as a technical anchor for the team, mentoring colleagues, establishing shared standards for analytical rigor, and proactively driving continuous improvements across our workflows. The ideal candidate seamlessly balances statistical rigor, strategic newsroom thinking, and a genuine investment in the people and practices around them.


This position will be based in our New York office.

You will:


  • Partner with our digital strategy, coverage and product teams to identify the highest-impact analytical opportunities, define the right questions, and shape the data science roadmap around problems that drive real newsroom outcomes.
  • Design and build predictive and explanatory models end-to-end, from feature engineering and validation through production, making principled tradeoffs between complexity and interpretability along the way.
  • Translate quantitative findings into clear, actionable recommendations for senior newsroom and business stakeholders, and partner with cross-functional teams to see those recommendations through to adoption.
  • Own the core metrics and measurement systems that newsroom teams rely on to evaluate performance and make editorial decisions,  ensuring they are accurate, well-documented, and trusted.
  • Apply rigorous statistical thinking to measure real-world editorial and audience impact, drawing on causal inference and observational methods alongside controlled experimentation to isolate what's actually driving outcomes. 
  • Mentor and develop junior data team members, establishing shared standards for rigorous, production-ready analysis and building the team's collective technical capability over time.


 

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or applied machine learning, preferably in a media, publishing, or subscription-based environment.
  • Proven ability to own models end-to-end in a lean team setting, including scheduling, maintaining, and iterating on outputs using orchestration tools such as Airflow.
  • Strong proficiency in Python including feature engineering, model training, validation, and interpretation, with experience maintaining production-quality, reproducible code in Git.
  • Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with large-scale data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery) as well as ETL workflows/analytics engineering frameworks (dbt).
  • Experience applying causal inference and statistical methods to measure real-world outcomes from observational data.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to frame quantitative findings as clear business or editorial recommendations for senior non-technical stakeholders, and a demonstrated ability to influence decisions without direct authority.
  • Experience building models that influence content strategy, audience development, or consumer retention.

Standout candidates will have strengths in one or more areas of the following:

  • Experience with NLP or text analysis methods, including topic modeling, classification, or entity extraction applied to content data.
  • Familiarity with off-platform attribution and audience measurement, specifically modeling the relationship between distributed content, platform referrals, and downstream subscription or engagement outcomes.
  • Experience leveraging AI to democratize data and enable faster time-to-insight.

To apply, please submit a resume and a cover letter explaining how your skills, experience and interests align with the expectations of the role by July 28th. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and we encourage early submission as the position may be filled before the deadline.


The Journal’s reporters, editors, developers, and audio and visual journalists create important and impactful stories, firmly rooted in fact and adhering to the highest ethical standards. We report without fear or bias, and we maintain a proper sense of perspective, detachment and objectivity in our reporting.

*LI-JA1-WSJ.

job.description:
Job Description:



About the Team 

The Integrated Marketing team leads the process of developing RFP responses from end to end, ensuring that they're not only delivered on time and on budget for our clients but that they also promote our clients' businesses and lead to long term partnerships with The Wall Street Journal and Barron's Group.

 

Our team brings together the right people and resources to provide the best possible ideas and strategies to our customers -- understanding client goals, assembling teams of specialists, and leading the process to completion. We oversee the RFP response from end to end, starting with 'what is the problem we're solving?' to 'how are we going to measure success?', and we work with the right people to get to those answers.

 

Success within the Integrated Marketing team requires a passion for media, an editorial mindset, and a high standard for visual presentations, all brought to life through a working understanding of the media and advertising landscape, and an ability to translate data and insights into compelling and engaging advertising and branded content programs.


About the Role

We are looking for a Manager, Integrated Marketing. You will report to the Executive Director of Enterprise, Integrated Marketing and work in our Midtown Manhattan office 3 days each week.

 

You Will

  • Manage daily pitch and proposal work that responds to client needs and telegraphs the value of The Wall Street Journal & Barron's Group media offerings
  • Develop a broad understanding of all The Wall Street Journal & Barron's Group media ad products and creative capabilities
  • Develop and articulate creative marketing programs in many forms, including written creative proposals and visually-motivated pitch decks (often in collaboration with other disciplines such as our creative studio, Events, etc.)
  • Use research and data to share insights and support value propositions for client pitches and proposals
  • Work with and project manage across relevant areas of the organization (including Sales, Product Marketing, Ad Operations & Planning, Research, Events, etc.) to develop pitches and integrated programs for clients

  • Engaging and able to build relationships and credibility

You Have

job.title: New Business Sales Executive
job.description:
Job Description:


About Dow Jones:


At Dow Jones, we empower global organizations to navigate an increasingly volatile world, where geopolitical shifts, financial crime, regulatory expansion and emerging AI technologies redefine risk every day. Powered by market-leading intelligence capabilities—including Dow Jones Risk & Compliance, Dragonfly, Oxford Analytica, Storyful, Dow Jones Risk Journal, Factiva and Dow Jones Newswires—we deliver the trusted insights our customers need to build resilience, protect their reputations and make mission-critical decisions with confidence.


When you join Dow Jones, you become part of one of the most dynamic, creative and savvy news and information companies in the world. As a global leader in news and business intelligence, we're newswires, websites, newspapers, apps, newsletters, databases, magazines, radio and television - including some of the widest-read and most-respected brands, like Factiva, Dow Jones Risk & Compliance, The Wall Street Journal, Barron's and MarketWatch. Our media inform the discussions and decisions that are vital to the world's commerce, while our databases make the business world more transparent. We continually develop technology to transform information into insight and insight into prosperity. From 58 countries and in twenty five languages, we enlighten and inspire audiences with authoritative, differentiated and trusted content.


About the role:


Our Business Sales team is currently seeking a New Business Sales Executive to join Direct Sales.  The New Business Sales Executive (NBSE) is responsible for driving new business of Dow Jones products through prospecting, cold-calling and client-calls. The NBSE will nurture leads while feeding their prospect funnel. The NBSE is responsible for initiating sales activity with new-to-company prospects and new buying centers within existing clients through lead research and qualification.  The NBSE will develop and execute targeted campaigns to contact prospects via telephone, email and social media.  Using a consultative sales approach, the NBSE will identify and develop a good understanding of the clients’ business needs and deliver an initial value proposition of Dow Jones products to generate interest. The NBSE is responsible for managing the complete sales cycle from start to finish and based on the complexity of the opportunity, the NBSE may engage outside sales specialists.  The NBSE must maintain accurate and appropriate client records within the Company’s CRM.  The NBSE will develop product subject matter expertise and align with the outside sales specialists for collaboration and best practices. 


You Will

  • MEET NEW BUSINESS TARGETS: Generate new streams of Dow Jones revenue through sales of products and services to 'new to company' prospects which address their business needs
  • IDENTIFY PROSPECTS: Complete market analysis to identify good potential 'new to company' target organizations, plus the specific roles and individuals to be prospected
  • PROSPECT: Pro-actively contact the targets identified. The NBSE will need to quickly qualify genuine opportunities and move these to the next stage of the sales process, or quickly move on in cases where no worthwhile opportunity exists
  • ANALYSE OPPORTUNITIES: Understand the business issues affecting targeted industry sectors and/or specific prospects, then ensure this knowledge is the foundation for our communications with prospects
  • PRODUCT KNOWLEDGE: Clearly express the value proposition and benefits of the Dow Jones products and solutions, and use this knowledge to ensure that solutions address clear business needs for the prospect
  • FORECAST: Manage Sales Forecast and Pipeline to ensure accurate recording of prospecting activity, conversion success, active sales opportunities at each stage of the sales process and forthcoming new business revenue
  • TRACK ACTIVITY AND SUCCESS:  A PROVEN SUCCESSFUL TRACK RECORD in a new business development role that requires cold calling
  • MANAGE PROSPECT/CLIENT INFORMATION: Keep accurate and clear records within the global CRM system to provide a solid deal history, showing clearly the steps taken to reach closure on new business deals

You Have

  • Confident at cold calling, understanding the best times to successfully reach prospects when they are ready to listen
  • Strong results orientation, with the commitment and drive to achieve a new business goal in a demanding and competitive business environment
  • Passionate about closing business, with a 'can do' attitude and ability to work independently when needed
  • Good communication skills (listening, questioning, written and verbal) to ensure the Dow Jones value position is clearly articulated to prospects and a persuasive business case is presented in email and verbal communications
  • Excellent telephone skills; successful NBSEs will feel comfortable building rapport, developing business relationships and demonstrating products over the telephone
  • High level of business awareness to help build credibility with the prospect, spot potential opportunities within a peer group or industry sector, and express the benefits of Dow Jones in the appropriate business context
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills to build a solid and persuasive business case, overcome objections, use solid supporting information where necessary, and ensure sales opportunities are managed to a successful conclusion
  • A proven successful track record in a new business development role that requires cold calling in to Fortune 1000 companies
  • Experience selling subscription based products (business information and research) is a plus.

job.title: People Experience Partner
job.description:
Job Description:



About the Role

Dow Jones has an exciting opportunity to join our People team as a People Experience (PX) Partner. This role will partner closely with People Business Partners, Centers of Excellence, People Operations, and operational teams to create better experiences for employees and managers across the full lifecycle.


This is an opportunity to shape how People support is delivered in a modern, global organization. The role will focus on improving employee journeys, simplifying processes, resolving pain points, and moving repeatable transactional work to People Operations to keep the operating model efficient and evolving.


You will work in our Midtown Manhattan office 3 days a week and report to the Senior Manager, People Experience.


You Will

  • Support global People priorities aligned to People Team strategy and business goals, delivering scalable solutions first and tailoring for regional requirements where needed to drive efficiency and consistency.
  • Use data, employee feedback, case trends and service insight to identify opportunities to improve key employee and manager moments across the employee lifecycle, escalating recurring themes and helping prioritize meaningful improvements.
  • Provide high-quality support to employees and managers across complex or higher-impact moments in the employee lifecycle, requiring sound judgement, clear ownership and effective coordination.
  • Support the delivery of simpler, faster and more human-centered processes that improve employee journeys and reduce friction.
  • Use AI and technology solutions to improve self-service, knowledge quality, service efficiency and employee experience, following established governance, privacy and compliance standards.
  • Partner with People Operations and regional stakeholders to ensure work is owned by the right team, routed efficiently and delivered effectively across the operating model.
  • Move repeatable or transactional activity to People Operations, self-service or automated channels, creating more capacity for higher-value support.
  • Support complex or sensitive employee matters, ensuring clear ownership, strong communication and a positive employee experience.
  • Partner with People Business Partners, Legal, Compensation, Mobility and specialist teams to deliver joined-up solutions.
  • Support change initiatives, pilots and continuous improvement programmes that can scale globally.
  • Measure success through service improvements, reduced friction, stronger satisfaction and smarter ways of working.
  • Support the creation of clear, trusted and scalable knowledge content for employees and managers.
  • Provide practical guidance and support to leaders and stakeholders to improve team effectiveness and employee outcomes.
  • Contribute to global People projects and help scale successful ideas across other regions.

You Have

  • 4+ years of experience in an HR, employee experience, people operations, or advisory role, ideally within an international or multi-country environment (relevant internships and co-ops will be considered)
  • Strong understanding of HR processes across the employee lifecycle
  • Experience using data, insights, and metrics to identify trends and guide decisions
  • Experience using HR systems and technology platforms to improve processes, employee experience and service delivery
  • Experience supporting employees and managers through a range of people-related matters
  • Experience contributing to change, continuous improvement or service transformation initiatives
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to balance employee experience and business needs
  • Experience using or the aptitude to use AI-enabled solutions and digital tools to improve efficiency, service delivery and employee experience
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple stakeholders
  • High attention to detail and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Positive, proactive mindset with a collaborative approach
  • Willingness to work onsite in our Midtown Manhattan office 3 days each week

You'll Get

  • The opportunity to play a key role in building and evolving a new People Experience model within a global, fast-paced organization
  • Meaningful work that improves how employees and managers experience Dow Jones every day
  • Exposure to multiple markets and diverse employee groups across the region

job.title: Price Reporter - US Refined Products Markets
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.


Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.



About the Role:

As Price Reporter - US Refined Products Markets, will be responsible for contributing to the Dow Jones Energy East of the Rockies Refined Spot Report, which is focused on news and pricing activity in U.S. gasoline, diesel and jet fuel markets. In this role, you will report on daily market pricing and market fundamentals,  and create news alerts relevant to the refined spot market industry. You will report to the Manager - Price Reporter. 



You Will:
  • Accumulate spot market price transactions from industry participants
  • Verify the legitimacy of transactions and adhere to Dow Jones Energy pricing methodology to create daily price assessments and update the Dow Jones Energy Spot Ticker
  • Develop and maintain rapport with key contacts and liaise daily with industry stakeholders (Producers, Consumers, Traders, Brokers and other participants) to collect bids, offers and spot deals
  • Generate stories for real-time news service as well as longer, more analytical content focusing on industry trends and emerging issues, while adhering to strict deadlines
  • Contribute to social media content, blog posts, industry analysis
  • Contribute to, compile, and publish OPIS reports
  • Giving market presentations at client meetings and industry conferences
  • Develop new contacts and relationships within refined products markets by attending industry events, and reaching out to market participants to further develop Dow Jones Energy’s refined spot market business



You Have:
  • At least 2 years’ prior experience in energy markets, professional reporting, or as an analyst
  • A commitment to the highest level of accuracy and completing all writing within established deadlines
  • A basic understanding of commodity markets
  • Ability to translate technical materials into content that engages and instructs readers.
  • Proven ability to generate story ideas and exclusive content
  • Solid grasp of math fundamentals and spreadsheet formulas
  • Experience using data science and data visualization tools
  • Willingness and ability to travel within the Americas and to other regions (as necessary)

job.title: Principal - Finance Operations (Dow Jones Technology)
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

 As Principal - Finance Operations, you will transform Technology Finance Operations from a manual, spreadsheet-driven function into an AI-enabled, systems-oriented operating model that delivers greater speed, transparency, and operational leverage. 

You will own the business and financial operating cadence for Technology Operations while helping redesign how planning, governance, and execution works across both capital and operating investments. You will lead the redesign of the FY28 budget process, modernizing how Product, Engineering, and Design triads operate alongside PMO partners, business stakeholders and executives, and build scalable operating systems that allow Technology to accelerate with precision and accountability. 

This is a rare opportunity to build an operating model rather than inherit one. You will help shape how Technology plans investments, governs execution, and measures performance across a $300M+ portfolio while partnering directly with senior Technology and Finance leadership. 

You will report to the Vice President - Head of Financial Operations. 

About the Team:

Technology Operations is in the middle of a significant operating-model transformation: shifting from initiative tracking to OKR-driven governance, driving a vendor-partnered efficiency transformation, consolidating location strategy around strategic hubs, and redesigning processes with automation and AI-enabled capabilities at the core. Business Operations helps translate these strategic priorities into measurable operational and financial outcomes.

Working across Technology, Finance, Sourcing, Human Resources, the PMO, and external vendors, our team provides the operational discipline, financial stewardship, and governance needed to turn strategy into execution, enable better investment decisions, and build a simpler, more scalable operating model.

You Will:

  • Own the Technology Operations business management function, establishing the operating rhythm for planning, forecasting, decision support, governance, and execution

  • Lead the redesign of the FY28 budget process

  • Oversee the operating cadence for the $300M+ Product & Technology budget

  • Reengineer recurring financial and operational workflows by replacing manual processes with automation, intelligent workflows, and durable management systems

  • Partner with Finance, Sourcing, Human Resources, PMO, and Technology Executive and other stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into annual and multi-year operating plans

  • Improve governance and planning across triads by strengthening decision-making, planning discipline, accountability, and operating transparency in partnership with PMO leadership

  • Build and continuously evolve executive dashboards, KPIs, and operating reviews

  • Oversee vendor and investment governance across a complex technology portfolio

  • Establish scalable governance and financial controls across planning, forecasting, reporting, capitalization, and monthly operating reviews

  • Identify and deliver cost optimization opportunities while protecting service quality, resiliency, and long-term transformation objectives

  • Continuously raise the standard for business operations, financial stewardship, systems thinking, and execution excellence

You Have:

  • 12+ years’ experience in business operations, financial operations, FP&A, PMO, strategic planning, or related leadership roles supporting technology, infrastructure, or enterprise operations

  • Significant experience managing budgets, forecasts, business cases, capitalization planning, and executive financial reporting within complex organizations

  • A proven track record of redesigning operating models, governance frameworks, planning processes, or business management functions

  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional transformation in ambiguous, high-impact environments while influencing senior leaders across multiple functions

  • Strong expertise in financial operations, vendor management, investment governance, cost optimization, and executive reporting

  • Experience designing executive dashboards, KPIs, and operating review mechanisms that improve business decisions

  • Proven ability to translate strategic priorities into structured plans, measurable outcomes, and repeatable operating systems

  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and align organizations without direct authority.

  • A systems-thinking mindset with sound business judgment and a bias toward simplification, standardization, and continuous improvement

  • Experience designing, implementing, or leading the adoption of automation, analytics, dashboards, or AI-enabled workflows that materially reduced manual work in finance, planning, or business operations

  • Comfort working hands-on with automation, advanced analytics, and modern technology to improve cycle time, quality, and operational effectiveness

job.title: Principal Product Designer - Market Data
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

As Principal Product Designer - Market Data, you will own the design strategy for our Market Data platform—the real-time quotes, charting, watchlists, screeners, and visualization systems that power how millions of people read and act on financial markets across The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and Investor's Business Daily. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who sets direction across our financial brands and is the go-to design expert for how Dow Jones presents market data.

Market Data connects across every one of our financial brands, and this role sets the design strategy that spans all of them. Your decisions will establish shared patterns—for quotes, charts, tables, portfolios, and alerts—that these brands build on. You will own the direction for how investors of every kind, from first-time savers to sophisticated professionals, interpret dense, fast-moving data and turn it into confident decisions, balancing the distinct needs of each brand against the consistency and quality users expect wherever they encounter our data.

And this reach won't stop at the consumer. Market and pricing data runs across much of Dow Jones—so your influence will extend well beyond the consumer brands into our professional and enterprise products, from Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance to Dow Jones Energy, wherever market data underpins the experience. Where data meets the broader product, you will be the design lead who makes it cohere.

This is a role of real influence and scope. You will shape strategy with senior leadership, resolve tension between individual brand priorities and platform consistency, define the market-data patterns that live in our Index Design System, and mentor senior designers across the financial brands. You will be the design authority for your domain—navigating ambiguity and setting the standard others in your area build on.

You will report to the VP of Product Design within the Design & Research organization.

About the Team:

Our Design & Research org brings together world-class designers and researchers with a unified purpose: to connect people to the news and information that matters most. We're the strategic force that transforms deep user understanding into exceptional product experiences across our entire portfolio—from The Wall Street Journal to Factiva.

Our integrated approach ensures that research insights directly shape design decisions, while design explorations reveal new research opportunities. Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135-year legacy while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our combined expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise.

You Will:

  • Own the design strategy for the Market Data platform across our financial brands—setting a coherent, multi-year direction for quotes, charting, watchlists, screeners, portfolios, and data visualization that spans The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and IBD, and connecting it to measurable outcomes like engagement, retention, and revenue

  • Shape strategy with senior leadership. Present your design direction for the Market Data platform to senior design, product, and business leaders—and to executives where the work warrants—building the partnerships that advance it across brands and making the case for how well-designed data experiences create competitive advantage

  • Solve the hard, ambiguous problems in your domain—developing new patterns, methods, and approaches for presenting complex financial information across multiple brands, and building a deep understanding of the problem space that lets you see opportunities ahead

  • Shape the market-data patterns in our Index Design System. Establish the charting, data-table, real-time, and visualization standards that become the norm across the financial brands—knowing when consistency serves the user and when a brand's audience warrants a tailored approach—and help adjacent teams adopt and evolve them

  • Extend your influence beyond our consumer brands into the wider portfolio—the professional and enterprise products, from Factiva and Risk & Compliance to Newswires and OPIS, where market and pricing data is just as central—so the experiences built on our data share the same clarity, rigor, and craft. Be the design lead wherever data shapes the product

  • Set a high bar for craft. Define what excellence looks like for dense, real-time financial information—typography, information density, motion, and the accessibility of complex tables and charts—and ensure consistent quality across the brands through design reviews and audits

  • Connect design to outcomes. Partner with Research and analytics to tie your decisions to engagement, retention, and subscription metrics, and help teams across the financial brands understand which measures matter for market-data experiences

  • Mentor and grow senior designers across the financial brands, shape a strong design culture, and strengthen the talent pipeline through the standards you set and the craft you share

You Have:

  • 10+ years of product design experience, including significant time owning complex, systems-level or platform work, with a track record of setting design direction that spans multiple products or brands

  • Deep expertise designing data-rich experiences—financial data, analytics, dashboards, data visualization, or other complex information display—where clarity, density, and trust matter as much as visual polish

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strategic impact across multiple products or brands: platform or design-system contributions, cross-team pattern-setting, and strong end-to-end craft on sophisticated products

  • A proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, translating design strategy into business terms and building alignment across teams whose priorities compete

  • Mastery of data visualization and information design—charting, tables, real-time data, progressive disclosure—and the judgment to know when complexity serves the user and when it gets in the way

  • Strong systems thinking and deep experience with design systems, including establishing patterns that other teams adopt and evolve

  • Excellence in Figma, with the ability to set standards for design communication, specifications, and documentation across teams

  • A deep command of design fundamentals and accessibility standards (WCAG), with particular fluency in making dense, complex data usable for everyone

  • A track record of mentoring designers and helping raise the craft and quality of the teams around you

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity—setting direction in your domain amid shifting priorities and emerging technology, and acting as the go-to expert others turn to

  • Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, related field -OR- equivalent experience 

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing for financial services, investing, trading, or fintech products

  • Familiarity with real-time or streaming data systems and the constraints they place on design

  • Working knowledge of financial concepts—markets, instruments, portfolio construction—sufficient to partner deeply with domain experts

  • Background in news media, publishing, or other content-heavy products

  • Experience designing across a multi-brand portfolio

  • Experience contributing meaningfully to a design system

  • An external presence through speaking or writing on data visualization, information design, or design at scale

  • International or cross-cultural design experience

job.title: Principal Product Designer - Subscription Growth (Acquisition)
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

As Principal Product Designer - Subscription Growth (Acquisition), you will define the future of subscriber growth across Dow Jones' portfolio of brands, including The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, Investor's Business Daily, and future subscription products.

In this senior individual contributor role that operates at the intersection of design strategy, business strategy, and growth, you'll establish the long-term vision for how prospective customers discover, evaluate, and subscribe across our Commerce ecosystem - spanning registration, paywalls, shop experiences, pricing and packaging, checkout, identity, and experimentation.

You will partner closely with Product, Marketing, Brand, Engineering, Research, Analytics, and executive leadership to solve highly ambiguous challenges and shape investment priorities that accelerate subscriber growth. Your work will define scalable Commerce patterns, influence our acquisition platform strategy, and connect design decisions to measurable business outcomes across multiple brands.

Beyond delivering exceptional product experiences, you'll mentor senior designers, elevate design quality across Commerce, and establish standards that scale throughout the organization.You will report to the Director of Product Design, Commerce.

About The Team:

Our Design & Research org brings together world-class designers and researchers with a unified purpose: to connect people to the news and information that matters most. We're the strategic force that transforms deep user understanding into exceptional product experiences across our entire portfolio—from The Wall Street Journal to Factiva.

Our integrated approach ensures that research insights directly shape design decisions, while design explorations reveal new research opportunities. Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135-year legacy while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our combined expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise.

You Will:

  • Define the long-term design strategy for subscriber growth across multiple Dow Jones brands.

  • Lead highly ambiguous, business-critical initiatives spanning registration, identity, paywalls, shop experiences, pricing, packaging, checkout, and experimentation.

  • Partner with senior leadership across Product, Marketing, Brand, Engineering, Research, and Analytics to shape roadmap priorities and strategic investments.

  • Create scalable acquisition patterns, frameworks, and interaction models that extend our Index Design System and can be reused across brands.

  • Drive experimentation strategy by identifying high-impact opportunities throughout the acquisition funnel and translating insights into long-term product improvements.

  • Translate customer research, behavioral data, market trends, and business goals into experiences that improve acquisition performance while maintaining a high bar for user experience.

  • Lead strategic design explorations, vision work, and cross-functional workshops that align teams around future Commerce investments.

  • Mentor junior and mid-level designers through design reviews, coaching, and thoughtful feedback that elevates craft across the organization.

  • Influence how Commerce measures success by defining experience quality metrics alongside conversion, acquisition, and revenue KPIs.

  • Represent Commerce Design within the broader Design & Research organization while contributing to company-wide design strategy and thought leadership.

You Have:

  • 10+ years of product design experience leading complex digital products.

  • Portfolio demonstrating systems thinking, product vision, and measurable business impact.

  • Experience leading highly ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives.

  • Exceptional interaction, visual, systems, and service design skills.

  • Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across disciplines.

  • Experience defining design systems, reusable frameworks, and scalable product patterns.

  • Outstanding communication and storytelling skills.

  • Expert proficiency in Figma and modern design workflows.

  • Deep understanding of accessibility and inclusive design.

  • Experience mentoring senior designers and raising design quality across organizations.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience designing subscription acquisition, paywalls, registration, or checkout experiences.

  • Experience partnering closely with Marketing or Growth organizations.

  • Familiarity with pricing strategy, packaging, promotional offers, or experimentation platforms.

  • Background in media, publishing, or consumer subscription businesses.

  • Experience working across globally distributed organizations.

job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team

The Dow Jones Customer Service (DJCS) mission is to provide great service for our customers and great experiences for our people. 

Our team has the privilege of delivering impactful experiences by helping our customers access the trusted news and business information published and produced by our marquee brands including, The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch, Investor’s Business Daily, Dow Jones Factiva, and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance. You will find that we are a collaborative group, focused on delivering excellence during every customer interaction.We encourage anyone who wants to join us in our mission to apply.


About the Role:

Oversee a variety of high-priority enablement initiatives across Dow Jones Customer Service. The individual will be accountable for leading projects and programs that are cross-functional, translating broad strategic goals into actionable projects, and ensuring timely completion of such initiatives. You will be based in our New Jersey office reporting to the Senior Manager, Projects & Continuous Improvement.

 

You Will:


AI Portfolio Growth & Project Execution

  • Lead an evolving portfolio of AI initiatives, managing multiple projects simultaneously from planning through implementation and adoption.
  • For assigned priorities, develop detailed project plans, define workstreams, establish milestones and timelines. Manage project execution, ensuring tasks are completed on schedule and within scope.
  • Proactively respond to and effectively execute on ad-hoc requests, accurately assessing the time and resources required for completion.
  • Drive DJCS readiness, stakeholder engagement, and change management to ensure successful adoption of AI solutions.
  • Develop executive-level documentation and communicate program status, risks, decisions, and business impact to senior leadership.
  • Clearly communicate changes in process and technology to stakeholders.
  • Effectively manage stakeholder expectations through clear and consistent communication. Conduct regular status meetings and provide timely updates on project progress, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Ensure all relevant parties are informed and aligned.

  • Proactively identify and manage project risks and issues. Develop mitigation plans and escalate issues as needed.
  • Provide timely status updates to key stakeholders on product initiatives.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across Customer Experience Insights, Business Operations, Training, IT, Legal, Compliance, and other functions to deliver business and customer-impacting initiatives.
  • Ensure that functional SMEs are engaged as accountable decision-makers.

Business Impact & Continuous Improvement

  • Bring agent & customer experience expertise to projects external to DJCS to mitigate potential risks and issues.

job.title: Sales Specialist
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Our Global Risk Insights business provides geopolitical, security, macroeconomic and regulatory insights to a wide range of customers including financial institutions, corporations, universities, government agencies, executives and business professionals. We help organizations navigate an increasingly complex world and manage risk to their business and staff. This role will be driving sales for Global Risks Insights on Oxford Analytica and Dragonfly platforms as well as bespoke advisory projects. 


About the Role:

As a Sales Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in expanding Dow Jones' footprint across the US by driving adoption of our geopolitical, security and macroeconomic analysis. This role is designed for a seasoned sales professional with a strong track record in enterprise solution selling, deep understanding of the security and geopolitical risk, and the ability to influence senior business and technical stakeholders.

You’ll partner closely with Sales Generalists, Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams to craft strategic solution narratives that resonate with enterprise clients. Your consultative approach, commercial acumen, and ability to translate complex technology into meaningful business impact will be key to your success.

 

You Will:

  • Own and drive complex, high-value sales cycles for Global Risk Insights solutions across the European region. This includes but is not limited to our flagship subscription services Security Intelligence and Analysis Service (SIAS), the Oxford Analytica Daily Brief and our advisory services.
  • Create a sales strategy to maximise revenue growth and market expansion within your geographical territory and specialization.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders (e.g., CSO, Head of Intelligence, Head of Public Affairs etc), positioning Dow Jones GRI as a long-term strategic partner.
  • Lead advisory discussions with the internal Advisory  teams and external client stakeholders to shape integrated use cases that align to customer priorities 
  • Exceed on the position’s sales target and role based KPIs - the role’s primary focus will be on generating and closing new opportunities across your geographical territory
  • Drive strategic pursuit planning and pipeline development in collaboration with Sales Generalists, unlocking net-new opportunities and expanding existing relationships
  • Contribute to or lead the writing of any proposal, statement of work or technical document relating to the products
  • Analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics to identify whitespace opportunities and differentiate Dow Jones’ offerings
  • Participate in, lead or coach the negotiation of terms, conditions, or prices leading to the closure of the contract
  • Contribute to thought leadership and client education through events, briefings, and strategic workshops.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap based on customer feedback and emerging market needs.
  • Maintain accurate sales reporting, pipeline forecasts, and opportunity tracking in our global CRM system
  • Other activities, tactics and behaviours as directed by management

You Have:

  • 7+ years of quota carrying experience in enterprise sales or business development, with a focus on the geopolitical/security/macroeconomic/data or analysis space
  • Proven success in selling to large enterprises and managing complex deal cycles with multiple stakeholders across business and technology functions.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate strategic accounts, identify key decision-makers, and build influence at the executive level.
  • Strong commercial acumen with consultative selling skills and familiarity with methodologies such as Challenger, MEDDPICC, or SPIN.
  • A collaborative mindset with experience working across matrixed teams including marketing, product, and customer success.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills tailored to both business and technical audiences.
  • Regional experience and cultural fluency across relevant markets.
  • Business-level proficiency in local language is a plus; English fluency is required. Additional languages are preferable. 
  • Experience in field sales and willingness to travel across the region (approximately 30%).

job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team

Dow Jones Risk Sales is a dynamic, global organization focused on helping businesses make smarter decisions through trusted news, data, insights, and information solutions. Our teams partner with organizations across industries to understand their unique challenges and connect them with the Dow Jones products and services that drive growth, manage risk, and support informed decision-making.


About the Role

Dow Jones is seeking a Senior Account Manager to manage a complex portfolio of customers across our Risk & Compliance, Factiva, and Newswires solution lines. This role oversees a sophisticated book of business consisting of multiple high-value Financial Services accounts with diverse stakeholders and significant growth potential.


The Senior Account Manager is a seasoned commercial professional who leverages 8+ years of experience to build strategic customer relationships, drive revenue growth, manage complex renewals, and lead account strategy across challenging customer environments. The role also provides guidance, coaching, and training to SDRs and other Account Managers and frequently acts as the lead commercial resource on the organization’s most complex accounts.


You Will:

Strategic Account Management

  • Manage a complex portfolio of strategic accounts within the Financial Services sector with significant revenue responsibility.
  • Develop deep relationships with senior customer stakeholders and become a trusted advisor to clients.

  • Lead account strategy and coordinate cross-functional resources to deliver customer value.

Revenue Growth & New Business

  • Generate new revenue streams through the sale of Dow Jones products and services that address customer business needs.
