job.title: Senior Analyst, Newsroom Data
job.description:
Job Description:


WSJ Newsroom | Senior Data Analyst (September 2026)

The Wall Street Journal is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our newsroom data team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Newsroom Analytics. You will work directly with editorial, audience, and product teams on the decisions that shape how our journalism is reported, prioritized, and delivered to readers.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role that blends strong analytical craft with sharp newsroom judgment. You will own the analyses, dashboards, and measurement frameworks the newsroom depends on, and see your work through from question to adopted decision. You will also help set the technical bar for the data team, mentoring more junior colleagues and strengthening our shared practices.

This position will be based in our New York office.

You will:

  • Serve as a trusted analytics partner to newsroom editorial and strategy leaders, driving audience growth, engagement and retention. Frame the right questions, answer them with rigorous analysis, and translate findings for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Develop and maintain centralized dashboards and automated reports that expand self-serve access to newsroom data.

  • Run deep-dive analyses on areas of opportunity, major news events, high-priority moments, and unexplained shifts in performance.

  • Push measurement forward by developing novel metrics and analytical frameworks that inform newsroom strategy, and drive adoption across editorial, product, and business teams.

  • Own and maintain the reporting stack, partnering with data engineering and product to keep our data accurate, fresh, and high-quality, and to strengthen the taxonomies, instrumentation, and foundational datasets the newsroom relies on. Respond to and prevent pipeline incidents so daily reporting stays reliable.

  • Design and run A/B tests and experiments in partnership with strategy, product, and tech teams, applying statistical measurement to interpret results and translate them into decisions about editorial and audience strategy.

  • Mentor junior analysts, set shared standards for technical and non-technical outputs, and contribute to a shared library of methods and lessons the team can pull from.

You have:

  • 3+ years in data analytics, data science, or a related field, preferably in media, publishing, or content.

  • Track record of owning recurring reporting end-to-end and delivering analyses whose findings have shaped business decisions.

  • Strong SQL skills, with experience working in large-scale data warehouses like BigQuery or Snowflake, and analytics-engineering frameworks like dbt.

  • Experience designing and running A/B tests, and applying statistical methods to interpret results

  • Proficiency in Python for analysis, data wrangling, and automating analytical workflows, with experience  maintaining code in Git.

  • Strong communication skills, with a track record of driving alignment and consensus across cross-functional groups.

Standout candidates will have strengths in one or more of the following:

  • A background in content performance analysis, audience segmentation, cohort analysis, or editorial research.

  • Working knowledge of off-platform attribution, connecting distributed content and platform referrals to downstream engagement.

  • Comfort using AI/LLM tooling to speed up analytical workflows or make data more accessible to non-technical partners.

  • Prior newsroom experience with an interest in driving journalistic outcomes.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. EEO/Disabled/Vets

job.title: Senior Client Success Manager
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team

Our team brings together the capabilities to position, commercialize, and grow Dow Jones’s B2B and enterprise portfolio. We translate customer needs, audience insight, and market intelligence into product strategy, clear value propositions, differentiated positioning, and relevant product and content experiences.


We enable commercial performance through sales operations, go-to-market enablement, and cross-functional coordination. We also help drive client outcomes across onboarding, adoption, engagement, and retention. Working in close partnership with Product, Editorial, Sales, and Client Success, we ensure Dow Jones’s enterprise solutions are compelling in the market, equipped for commercial success, and deliver sustained value to clients.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Client Success Manager to own the post-sale client journey for assigned new business accounts-  from signed deal through launch, activation, early adoption, and handoff into ongoing account management. This role serves as the primary relationship owner and cross-functional coordinator during the early post-sale phase, working closely with Sales, Regional Sales Coordinators, Operations, Engagement, Customer Care, and Account Management.


The goal is a seamless transition from signed account to active, engaged client-  reducing friction, accelerating time to value, surfacing risk early, and bringing in the right resources at the right time.


The Senior Client Success Manager is the primary post-sale relationship owner and "quarterback" across the early client lifecycle, accountable for client readiness, launch coordination, onboarding progress, standard-account adoption execution, early engagement, and risk management. The role doesn't personally own every specialist workstream, but ensures each one happens successfully.


This is not a quota-carrying role. Success is measured by how effectively clients launch, activate, adopt key products and workflows, engage early, and transition cleanly into ongoing account management.


You Will:

Own the post-sale relationship and launch orchestration

  • Serve as the primary point of contact from signed deal through onboarding and early adoption.
  • Lead the handoff from Sales, ensuring client goals, use cases, stakeholders, and launch priorities are clearly understood and documented.
  • Build 60–90 day onboarding milestones and success plans so clients know what success looks like and can achieve early wins.
  • Maintain proactive, coordinated communication with clients and internal stakeholders to keep launches on track.

Coordinate account setup with Regional Sales Coordinators and Operations

  • Partner with RSCs on order processing, account setup/changes, billing, CRM updates, and related handoffs.
  • Partner with Operations and Fulfillment on provisioning, entitlements, technical readiness, SLA readiness, and launch execution.
  • Own coordination and follow-through, while RSCs and Operations retain responsibility for their own administrative execution.

Drive onboarding and adoption for standard accounts

  • Execute onboarding using established playbooks, milestones, and training guidance.
  • Ensure clients understand activation steps and build early usage habits.
  • Support in designing and implementing playbooks and frameworks
  • Apply learnings and best practices across the client base.

Partner with Engagement and Lifecycle teams to deepen usage

  • Work with Engagement Strategy & Performance and Customer Lifecycle Marketing to ensure clients get the right communications, campaigns, and enablement programs.
  • Use engagement reporting and health signals to prioritize interventions.
  • Connect clients to the right in-life programs as they move from onboarding into sustained engagement.

Monitor account health and manage risk

  • Track usage, activation milestones, and health signals to catch stalled onboarding, weak adoption, or early churn risk.
  • Escalate early and coordinate support across Engagement, Customer Care, Operations, and Account Management.
  • Ensure critical issues stay owned and teams stay aligned on actions and timing.

Act as the voice of the client internally

  • Share feedback, adoption insights, and emerging needs with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Care, and Client Success leadership.
  • Partner with the Enterprise Customer Care & Voice of Customer Lead on escalations and service themes.

Support a clean handoff into ongoing account management

  • Ensure a clear transition from early post-sale ownership into the ongoing account management motion once onboarding and early adoption are complete.
  • Share account context, progress, risks, and adoption status with Account Managers so momentum carries through on high-value accounts.

Success Measures

Measured on adoption, engagement, readiness, and handoff outcomes rather than direct revenue. KPIs may include:

  • Account launch readiness and setup completion rate
  • Time to onboarding completion and time to first value
  • Activation and seat activation rate
  • Adoption of priority products, workflows, and features
  • Usage frequency, engagement depth, and health score movement
  • Participation in training, webinars, and lifecycle programs
  • Early identification and escalation of churn risk or stalled onboarding
  • Quality of handoff into ongoing account management

Cross-Functional Partnerships

  • Sales Account Executives — post-sale handoff and continuity from signed deal into launch
  • Regional Sales Coordinators — order processing, account setup/changes, billing coordination
  • Operations and Fulfillment — provisioning, entitlements, technical readiness, launch execution
  • Engagement Strategy & Performance / Customer Lifecycle Marketing — health monitoring, engagement plays, in-life programs
  • Enterprise Customer Care & Voice of Customer — escalations, white-glove service, feedback loops
  • Account Managers — transition planning and ongoing relationship continuity

You Have:

  • 7 years of experience in client success, onboarding, implementation, account coordination, or related post-sale roles in B2B, SaaS, media, or subscription environments
  • Strong cross-functional project management skills, able to coordinate multiple stakeholders through launch, onboarding, and adoption milestones
  • Excellent client communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills
  • Comfort using data and health indicators to monitor trends and flag risk early
  • A proactive, organized, solutions-oriented approach to client coordination
  • A client-first mindset focused on driving value through usage, adoption, and engagement — not transactional account support

job.title: Senior Content Integration Specialist, Middle East
job.description:
Job Description:

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Content Integration Specialist to join the Risk & Compliance Implementation and Integration team. Based in Dubai, this role will support customers and partners operating in and from the Middle East.



The role will be heavily market facing, with interactions with customers pre- and post-sales. The successful candidate will combine strong technical integration expertise with proven customer-facing and commercial experience. They will work in a fast-growing market where customers often require hands-on guidance throughout pre-sales, implementation, migration, go-live, and post-go-live support.



This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can confidently engage with technical teams, business stakeholders, senior executives, and commercial teams. They will be expected to own complex integration conversations, influence solution design, identify risks and opportunities, and represent Dow Jones credibly with strategic customers and partners.



The role will report to the Director of Implementation and Integration, EMEA.




You Will

  • Own and lead complex customer and partner integrations involving Dow Jones Risk & Compliance products, APIs, data feeds, and associated workflows.
  • Provide expert guidance during pre-sales, solution design, implementation, migration, testing, go-live, and post-go-live activities.
  • Act as a senior technical and business-facing advisor to customers, partners, Sales, Product, Technology, Support, and Implementation teams.
  • Translate customer requirements into practical integration approaches, including data mapping, API usage, workflow design, testing, monitoring, and operational handover.
  • Lead the investigation and resolution of complex API, data feed, upload, data quality, and workflow issues.
  • Coordinate cross-functional responses to high-priority customer issues, ensuring clear ownership, communication, escalation, and resolution plans.
  • Facilitate customer workshops, technical discovery sessions, integration reviews, implementation meetings, and executive-level discussions.
  • Work closely with Sales to shape commercially viable integration solutions, support proposals and opportunities, and improve the likelihood of successful conversion and adoption.
  • Identify opportunities to expand customer value, improve retention, support migrations, and contribute to revenue growth.
  • Support high-touch customers through guided, step-by-step implementation and integration decisions where self-service documentation is insufficient.
  • Develop reusable integration patterns, troubleshooting guidance, customer-facing documentation, and best practices.
  • Represent regional customer needs globally and ensure local requirements are reflected in internal planning.
  • Help scale the operating model by mentoring colleagues and sharing knowledge across the wider team.





You Have

  • Typically approx 10 years of relevant experience in technical integration, solution consulting, implementation, professional services, technical account management, customer success engineering, or a closely related field.
  • A demonstrable track record of working directly with enterprise customers and strategic partners.
  • Deep knowledge of the Risk and Compliance domain.
  • Significant experience leading customer-facing technical engagements from discovery through implementation and production adoption.
  • Strong practical understanding of APIs, data feeds, integration patterns, data mapping, testing, authentication, error handling, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience translating complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders within Dow Jones and clients.
  • Strong project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple customers, priorities, deadlines, and dependencies.
  • Experience working across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and Implementation teams in a global organisation.
  • High level of initiative, ownership, judgement, and accountability.
  • Willingness and ability to travel within the Middle East.

job.title: Senior Director - AI Operations & Enablement
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Our Technology team drives the evolution of our Technology, Engineering, Data, Product and User Experience functions. With a keen focus on delivering cutting-edge solutions, we shape the digital landscape for our customers, readers and users. From revolutionizing visuals to optimizing tools and harnessing the power of data, mobile, video and social platforms, our team is committed to providing a seamless and immersive experience across all touchpoints. Collaborating closely with our newsrooms and strategic partners, we spearhead the development of groundbreaking products and technologies.

About the Role:

As Senior Director - AI Operations & Enablement, you will be an operator-builder who pairs executive-grade strategic judgment with hands-on technical fluency in modern AI tooling. You will be the trusted force-multiplier for the most consequential Tech Ops priorities at Dow Jones: reengineering how work gets done across Product & Technology, prototyping AI-enabled workflows directly, and turning fragmented, manual processes into scalable, AI-native operating models. In this high-autonomy role, you will diagnose the as-is, design the to-be, and ship the change - for quick wins and full rebuilds across a 130-year-old global news and information business. You will report to the SVP - Head of Technology Operations.

You Will:

  • Operate as a Strategic Force-Multiplier

    • Independently own and drive critical Tech Ops priorities end-to-end, with the judgment to know when to escalate and when to ship

    • Translate executive intent into structured plans, decisions, and outcomes

    • Represent Tech Ops in cross-functional forums where the SVP cannot be present, with full credibility to commit and decide

  • Reengineer How Work Gets Done

    • Lead wholesale process reengineering across Tech Ops and adjacent Product & Technology functions

    • Design target-state operating models that materially improve speed, quality, and cost

    • Define measurable efficiency outcomes and own them through delivery

  • Build AI-Native Workflows Directly (Hands-On)

    • Prototype AI-enabled automations and internal tools 

    • Use modern AI coding assistants and agentic development tooling to compress build time

    • Integrate AI capabilities into the SaaS stack the business already runs on

    • Set the technical bar for what "AI-native" means inside Tech Ops

  • Bridge Technology and the Business

    • Build trusted relationships with leaders across Product, Technology, GM-led business teams and our parent News Corp organization

    • Translate fluently between technical capability and business outcome

    • Drive enterprise-wide AI adoption 

    • Influence more efficient governance processes

  • Scale What Works through Systems Thinking 

    • Convert one-off wins into reusable playbooks, frameworks, and internal products

    • Document, train, and enable others to extend the operating model 

    • Identify when a workstream is mature enough to staff out

You Have:

  • At least 15 years’ progressive experience spanning technology operations, product or program management, management consulting, or transformation roles 

  • Demonstrated ownership of cross-functional process reengineering at enterprise scale

  • Strong systems thinking mentality

  • Hands-on technical fluency with modern AI tooling to build prototypes, automations, and internal tools with the use of AI coding assistants and agentic development environments

  • Working understanding of how AI is reshaping enterprise operations

  • Track record of operating as a trusted force-multiplier to a senior executive

  • Proven ability to balance strategic framing  with tactical execution 

  • Strong relationship-building instincts across Product, Technology, and business/GM stakeholders;

  • The ability to translate technical decisions into business terms and vice versa

  • Bachelor's degree - OR- equivalent work experience

job.title: Senior Manager, Training & Quality Assurance
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

The Dow Jones Customer Service (DJCS) mission is to provide great service for our customers and great experiences for our people.  

Our team has the privilege of delivering impactful experiences by helping our customers access the trusted news and business information published and produced by our marquee brands including, The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch, Dow Jones Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance. You will find that we are a collaborative group, focused on delivering excellence during every customer interaction. We encourage anyone that wants to join us in our mission to apply.

 

About the Role:

The Senior Manager, Training & Quality Assurance is responsible for new hire training, ongoing learning, knowledge management, and quality assurance across DJCS globally.  You will report to the Vice President of Customer Support Operations and be based in our New Jersey office.

 

You Will


  • Own and modernize curricula across DJCS, defining content, sequence, timing, delivery methods, and readiness standards to shorten time to proficiency and support development beyond initial onboarding. Coordinate Training-led modules and specialist instruction from hiring teams within the agreed plan.
  • Lead the expansion of web-based, self-paced learning for onboarding and ongoing uptraining, combining it with live instruction, systems practice, and shadowing where appropriate.
  • Improve knowledge accuracy, usability, adoption, and maintenance, and prepare the team, content, and working practices for AI-enabled tools.
  • Lead the adoption and validation of automated quality management (AQM) across teams and contact types, establish standards for coaching and performance scoring, and redeploy human QA toward targeted investigation and improvement.
  • Develop staff capabilities and close Consumer/B2B knowledge gaps through cross-training and shared responsibilities, identifying where tools or specialist support are needed.
  • Manage training capacity and delivery, oversee curriculum standards and trainer quality across outsourcing partners, and extend product training and onboarding capability beyond DJCS.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand needs, agree priorities and delivery commitments, and communicate progress and tradeoffs. Measure both program results and stakeholder feedback to ensure the team delivers effective support and a reliable partnership.

 

Who you Are


  • You set a clear direction, challenge established approaches, and turn ideas into practical improvements.
  • You are resourceful and persistent, working through obstacles and balancing change with daily operational demands.
  • You develop people and deliver through others, setting clear expectations, building skills, and getting into the details when needed.
  • You build stakeholder trust through responsiveness, honest communication, and follow-through.
  • You use data, employee and stakeholder feedback, and testing to set priorities, make decisions, and measure results.

You Have


  • 7+ years of relevant experience.
  • Experience managing a training or related performance improvement team in a contact center environment, including developing staff capabilities.
  • Demonstrated success leading changes to onboarding or ongoing learning, with measurable improvements in proficiency, productivity, and learning effectiveness.
  • Experience leading blended learning development and delivery, including self-paced digital content, through internal teams or external specialists.
  • Experience using quality evaluation or interaction analytics to identify performance gaps and measure the results of improvement initiatives.
  • Experience delivering cross-functional initiatives against agreed commitments, supported by examples of effective stakeholder partnerships.
  • Ability to travel up to 20%, both domestically and internationally.
  • Experience implementing or expanding AQM (preferred).
  • Experience managing knowledge resources or implementing AI-enabled learning, knowledge, or employee-support tools (preferred).
  • Experience selecting or managing learning technology, external specialists, or outsourced training and QA programs (preferred).

job.title: Senior Media Sales Planner
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team

Dow Jones Media Sales connects leading brands with influential audiences through our trusted portfolio, including The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch and Investor’s Business Daily. Our teams across Sales, Marketing, Creative and Client Success work together to deliver innovative advertising solutions and exceptional client experiences across digital, print, video, audio, events and custom content.

About the Role

We are looking for a solution driven candidate who would describe themselves as being analytical, collaborative and highly organized. The Sales Planning team is comfortable working in a deadline driven environment and being communicative about their deliverables. The most successful individuals understand how to prioritize their workload and can be agile and adapt quickly if an urgent matter arises. The team is focused on pricing integrity, media plan strategy and campaign delivery, but also on continued upskilling and leadership training and opportunities. By joining our global Sales Planning organization you will be a part of a diverse and growing team where you will continue to learn, be challenged and work directly with our clients on best-in-class advertising campaigns.

 

You Will: 

  • Partner with the sales team on RFPs to provide proposal ideas and inventory solutions that best meet the client expectations and proposal objectives while maintaining pricing integrity and inventory package strategy

  • Work directly with advertisers or media agencies to collect campaign assets and communicate across internal teams for a successful and timely launch

  • Maintain a strong understanding of Dow Jones product offering and operational capabilities

  • Collaborate with Planning Managers by utilizing historical data to support strategic decision about new media sales initiatives 
  • Assist Planning Managers to coordinate onboarding and train new hires on digital best practices and policies


You Have:

  • Experience using one or more ad serving and/or order management systems (i.e. Google Ad Manager, OperativeOne, etc.) preferred
  • Ability to work independently as well as with a team
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast paced environment while managing multiple projects and tight deadlines

job.title: Senior Product Implementation Manager - Customer Success
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.


Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.



About the Role:

As Senior Product Implementation Manager - Customer Success,  you will be the trusted technical leader responsible for driving the successful delivery, integration, and adoption of our AI-powered pricing solutions. You will own the end-to-end customer delivery lifecycle; from discovery to go-live and continuous optimization; ensuring every engagement delivers measurable business impact.


In this role, you will lead complex technical deployments, act as the bridge between customers and product teams, and mentor junior engineers to ensure consistent excellence in delivery execution. Your blend of technical depth, customer empathy, and delivery discipline will make you a key contributor to our customers’ success and Dow Jones Energy’s continued growth. You will report to the Director - Customer Success. 



You Will:
  • Project Leadership & Delivery Excellence
    • Lead multiple concurrent delivery projects from kickoff to production rollout, ensuring high-quality, on-time, and in-scope outcomes
    • Translate business requirements into robust technical implementation plans and data integration workflows
    • Drive delivery governance; risk management, progress tracking, and stakeholder communication  to ensure customer confidence and alignment
  • Customer Engagement & Success
    • Act as the technical lead and trusted advisor for enterprise customers throughout their journey
    • Guide customers through onboarding, configuration, and integration, ensuring seamless adoption and measurable ROI
    • Collaborate closely with customer success managers to ensure post-launch value realization and continuous improvement
  • Integration & Automation Expertise
    • Design and implement integrations using APIs, ETL pipelines, and automation scripts to connect PriceCast with customers’ IT and POS ecosystems
    • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring system performance and data integrity
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partner with Product Management and R&D to communicate customer insights, shape roadmap priorities, and influence future capabilities
    • Contribute to the development of reusable tools, templates, and best practices that elevate delivery efficiency and consistency across projects
  • Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing
    • Support the professional growth of delivery engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and methodology improvements
    • Champion a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous learning within the Customer Success team



You Have:
  • 5+ years of experience delivering complex SaaS, cloud, or enterprise software implementations, ideally in customer-facing roles
  • Proven track record in leading delivery or integration projects, managing stakeholders, and ensuring customer success
  • Strong hands-on skills in data integration and automation including APIs, data mapping, and scripting (Python, SQL)
  • Experience in retail, pricing, fuel, convenience industries or at other large enterprises is highly advantageous
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and business audiences

job.description:
Job Description:

About the Role:

Support Global Engineering Resins Report (GERR) team as a Senior Market Research Analyst working with external clients on a regular basis as well as with the global internal team in the Shanghai office. You are expected to be a high level analyst with knowledge of the external market dynamics for plastics specific to engineering resins. This role will be filled by a client facing, dynamic individual who works well in team settings and will report to the Director of GERR based in Shanghai. 


About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy is a leading global energy intelligence business providing trusted price reporting from our specialist Price Reporting Agency (PRA) OPIS, Chemical Market Analytics (CMA) and McCloskey, proprietary data, market intelligence, news and research to help customers navigate increasingly interconnected energy markets. Through our specialist businesses, Dow Jones Energy makes it easier to discover and access trusted expertise spanning oil and gas, chemicals, refined fuels, coal, electric vehicle infrastructure and renewables. Our specialist businesses combine rigorous pricing methodologies with world-class human judgment to deliver the trusted intelligence and specialist insight customers need to make confident decisions.


You Will:

  • Be responsible for development and maintenance of sophisticated and complex econometric model for the plastics and polymers markets Responsible for supporting balancing of Asian balances twice a year as well as developing multiple year trade grids.
    Contribute to consulting projects as needed.
  • Participate in industry market updates with clients as needed and handling client inquiries as needed.
  • Support senior leadership in IP development for conference presentations
  • Promptly responds to internal and external client questions and serves as a resource for client brainstorming/discussions. Contributes market expertise to proprietary projects, as needed.
  • Develop market presentations for global plastics team consultants.
  • Update the production capacity database and supply-demand balances.
  • Regularly interfaces with global Market Advisory Services team members to ensure analysis consistency.

You Have:

  • 3-5 years of prior experience in market research, industry analysis, or intelligence research, preferably within the energy or commodities sectors. Knowledge and experience of the olefins market is highly beneficial
  • University degree in Chemical engineering or chemistry degree preferred, economics is acceptable; MBA or other graduate degree is desirable (or equivalent experience)
  • Demonstrated organized ability to research through established contacts with diverse market participant channels in telephone, videocalls, email and face-to-face interfaces; ability to manage
    multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent analytical and organizational skills; ability to identify and articulate core/essential issues within complex problems and deliver insights and solutions. Deals well with ambiguity

job.description:

About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy enables energy and chemical stakeholders around the global to improve operational efficiency and make strategic decisions with deep insights, future outlooks, price discovery and consultation from a celebrated team of subject matter experts. We offer short- and long-term market coverage for more than 200 core building-block chemicals with a full suite of advisory services and top-tier events held around the globe. Our bespoke consulting team has experience from upstream oil, gas, and minerals operations to chemicals, plastics and downstream end-use markets. job.title: Social Video Journalist
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

MarketWatch provides real-time business news, analysis and stock market data to the general public. Providing insight into what the news of the moment means for your money, empowering you to take control of financial decisions.


About the Role:

MarketWatch is seeking a versatile and creative Video Journalist to produce short-form vertical video that brings personal finance, stock and market stories to life across social platforms, including Instagram, TikTok and others.

Part journalist, part storyteller and part creator — you are comfortable breaking down complex financial topics and producing them in a highly visual format built for scrolling audiences. In this role, you will pitch, shoot, write, edit and appear on camera while working with reporters to turn headlines and data points into short, smart, and engaging stories that help audiences make sense of the economy and their own money.


You Will:

  • Partner with the newsroom to identify compelling stories, trends and data points. Translate these insights into engaging short-form vertical videos that spotlight MarketWatch’s reporters.
  • Pitch, write and produce short-form video stories that explain current events in markets and the broader economy.
  • Appear on camera to deliver explainers, voiceovers and quick-hit market updates.
  • Shoot and edit your own stories from start to finish.
  • Modify and adapt existing long-form content into highly engaging vertical clips.
  • Utilize analytics tools (Instagram metrics, TikTok Insights) to understand what resonates with our audience and iterate on future stories.

You Have:

  • 2+ years of experience creating vertical video for social media platforms.
  • Demonstrated success in producing informative and engaging video journalism in a fast-paced environment, with strong hooks and storytelling skills.
  • Experience writing, producing and editing short-form vertical videos on tight deadlines.
  • Expertise in video and graphics editing using Adobe Premiere and After Effects.
  • Experience in archive producing, including sourcing and utilizing photos, video, graphics, and audio.
  • Deep knowledge of platform-specific trends on YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram, with an eagerness to experiment with new forms of mobile visual storytelling.
  • Strong journalistic fundamentals: writing, story ideation, research, fact-checking, interviewing experts, and sifting through data to produce accurate, compelling videos.
  • A solid understanding of business/finance news, markets, and current affairs.

job.title: Staff Assistant I
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team

The Print Team supports the end-to-end lifecycle of Dow Jones’ print publications—including The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, Investor’s Business Daily, and the New York Post. Operating across ad intake, production workflows, plant operations, printing, packaging, single copy and amenity sales, Reprints and Licensing, and distribution; the team collaborates with internal cross-functional partners and external vendors, distributors, and the USPS to ensure quality, content freshness, safety, and cost efficiency from creation to final delivery.


About the Role

The Staff Assistant I supports the overall delivery operations for WSJ, Barron’s, and the New York Post. With minimal supervision, this position performs a variety of administrative, customer service, payment processing, and delivery reporting activities to support the department’s daily operations. The role requires strong attention to detail, effective communication skills, and the ability to navigate multiple computer systems while managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. You will be based at our Chicopee, Massachusetts office and will report to the Manager, Dist Del Systems & Supt.


You Will

  • Customer and Contractor Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone and email and communicate with delivery contractors regarding delivery-related issues. Navigate multiple computer systems to investigate and troubleshoot subscriber address problems and other delivery concerns.
  • Payment Processing: Prepare weekly payments to delivery and trucking contractors by gathering payment and vendor information, validating details, and accurately entering data into the appropriate systems. Ensure payment information is complete and accurate.
  • Delivery Issue Reporting: Gather, review, and report late and missed delivery information on a national level for WSJ, Barron’s, and the New York Post. Communicate with delivery contractors and managers via phone and email to clarify details and ensure delivery issues are accurately documented.
  • Executive Reporting: Prepare daily summary reports providing a national overview of delivery issues across WSJ, Barron’s, and the New York Post. Ensure reporting is accurate, timely, and suitable for distribution to executive management.
  • Administrative and Operational Support: Perform assigned administrative and departmental duties with minimal supervision. Manage multiple tasks, prioritize a fluctuating daily workload, and support the effective execution of daily delivery operations.

You Have 

  • 1–2 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Prior customer service experience required.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and strong Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy, particularly when processing payments and preparing reports.
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems and troubleshoot delivery-related and subscriber address issues.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, prioritize competing demands, and adapt to a fluctuating daily workload.
  • Knowledge of home delivery operations or prior delivery-related experience is preferred.
  • Ability to work the 6:00 a.m. Saturday shift on a rotating basis and provide vacation coverage for the Monday–Friday 6:00 a.m. shift.

job.title: Summer 2027 Internship Program -- B2B Risk Marketing Intern
job.description:
Job Description:


Summer 2027 Internship – B2B Risk Marketing Intern

Application Deadline: November 13, 2026
We encourage you to submit your application as early as possible, as internship applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

AMER Internship Dates: June 7, 2027 – August 13, 2027
(You must be available to work full-time, in-office during this period.)


About Our Organization:

Dow Jones is a global provider of news and business information, delivering content to consumers and organizations around the world. Dow Jones has produced unrivaled quality content for more than 130 years and today has one of the world’s largest news-gathering operations globally. It is home to leading publications including the flagship Wall Street Journal, America’s largest newspaper by paid circulation. Dow Jones works with many Global Fortune 500 companies providing the data, news and intelligence to help them reduce risk, ensure compliance and identify business opportunities. Dow Jones is a division of News Corp (Nasdaq: NWS, NWSA; ASX: NWS, NWSLV).




About the Team:

As part of the Risk and Enterprise organization, the B2B Risk and Enterprise Marketing team drives business growth in partnership with sales, proposition, and product teams across our core businesses: Dow Jones Risk & Compliance, Global Risk Insights, Storyful, Factiva, and Newswires. We work collaboratively across the organization, connecting teams and aligning efforts to support shared business objectives. With a client-centric approach, we develop and execute integrated marketing strategies and campaigns designed to build brand awareness, strengthen our reputation, attract and engage customers, and deepen client relationships. We champion the voice of the customer and continuously seek innovative ways to enhance our marketing impact.



About the Role: 

We are looking for an enthusiastic and curious Marketing Intern to join our global B2B marketing team for the summer. This role offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience across a variety of marketing initiatives while learning how marketing supports business growth, customer engagement, and brand visibility.


As part of the team, you will collaborate with marketing professionals and cross-functional partners to support projects spanning campaign planning, content development, digital marketing, social media, events, and other strategic initiatives. You'll gain exposure to different marketing channels, audiences, and approaches while contributing to ongoing team priorities.


Throughout the internship, you'll have opportunities to apply your creativity, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. You'll also gain insight into how a global organization develops and delivers marketing programs to engage business audiences.


This internship is an opportunity to explore different aspects of B2B marketing, build practical skills, and learn from experienced professionals while making meaningful contributions to the team.


You Will:

  • Support the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across various channels, including digital, content, social media, and events.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Digital, Content, Creative, Sales and Product to support marketing initiatives and business objectives.
  • Assist in developing, reviewing, and coordinating marketing content and assets across multiple platforms.
  • Support the tracking, analysis, and reporting of marketing performance metrics to help evaluate campaign effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Contribute ideas and insights during team meetings, brainstorming sessions, and collaborative projects.

You Have:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field; completion of at least two years.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a keen eye for detail and an appreciation for storytelling.
  • Passionate about brand-building, customer engagement, and marketing events, with a creative and curious mindset.
  • Familiarity with marketing and content tools such as Google Suite, Canva, CRM platforms.
  • Solid understanding of social media platforms, digital marketing trends, and content strategies.
  • Highly organized, results-driven, and able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.
  • Self-starter with a positive attitude, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

Program Eligibility: 

  • Enrollment in a 4-year undergraduate degree program 
  • Graduating in Dec 2027 – July 2029 (U.S.)  
  • Does not require sponsorship for employment visa status (now or in the future) in the country where applying.

job.title: Video Producer/Editor, Investor’s Business Daily
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:
Investor’s Business Daily is looking for a versatile producer/editor to join its video team to produce highly engaging and shareable videos about business, finance and stock market investing for Investors.com, YouTube and our social media channels. Videos will range from interviews and market explainers to in-studio features, livestreams and on-location shoots. You should excel at generating ideas, scripting videos, shooting, editing and graphics in
order to create compelling videos from concept to delivery. You should have experience working with on-air talent as well as directing and recording
subjects via remote setups, with the versatility to step in front of the camera as needed for market explainers, daily hits and social video segments. The producer/editor is responsible for producing, editing and shooting informative and topical hosted market- and finance-focused videos and vodcasts. Top candidates for this position will have a professional background in creating digital video in a native web and social style, demonstrate
exceptional producing and editing skills, have hands-on experience creating motion graphics, manage studio and field shoots, develop talent and possess a solid grasp of market news. The producer/editor must also develop a working knowledge of IBD’s proprietary investing methodology and platform tools.

You Will:
● End-to-End Production: Produce and edit for a variety of video formats, including daily market explainers, long-form features, live-to-tape interviews, livestreams and vodcasts.
● Scripting & Development: Pitch, research, develop and write scripts for news stories and explainer topics under tight market-hour deadlines.
● Studio & Field Cinematography: Shoot in-studio and field interviews, setting up and operating camera, lighting and audio gear.
● Talent Direction & On-Camera Delivery: Produce and develop on-camera talent, with the capability to appear on camera yourself as needed for market updates, educational explainers and social clips.
● Motion Graphics & Visual Design: Create graphics and motion visual elements for videos utilizing After Effects, Photoshop and Illustrator.
● Project Management: Help ideate stories and see them through to completion, project managing all aspects of production from concept to delivery.

● Newsroom Coordination: Assist with coordinating the day-to-day workflow of video production, including content creation, scheduling, guest booking, sourcing, production and post-production.
● Packaging & Optimization: Implement best practices of a digital production process—including high-CTR thumbnails, compelling headlines and metadata—in service
of growing views and engagement across Investors.com, YouTube and social media channels.
● Audience Retention & Analytics: Hone creative based on performance metrics, SEO and audience retention data to expand viewership across platforms.
● Methodology & Editorial Alignment: Work closely with newsroom reporters, editors and ideo stakeholders to ensure IBD’s unique market analysis and investing methodology are accurately reflected in every video published.
● Journalistic Integrity & Compliance: Demonstrate great editorial and news judgment, fact-checking scripts and ensuring all journalistic, legal and Dow Jones compliance standards are strictly followed.
● Social & Vertical Formats: Create social cut-downs and vertical video assets tailored for YouTube Shorts, Instagram, X, LinkedIn and TikTok.

You Have:
● Experience: 3–5 years of professional experience producing, editing and creating graphics for video in a digital media or newsroom environment.
● Multi-Platform Acumen: Demonstrated track record producing native digital video content across web platforms, YouTube and major social channels.
● Production Versatility: Proven ability to shoot, produce and edit both on-location videos and in-studio interviews, as well as livestream and podcast programming.
● On-Camera Capability: Proven comfort and ability to appear on camera as an occasional host or presenter for market reports, educational explainers and social video hits.
● Software Mastery: Professional competency editing with Adobe Premiere Pro and creating visual assets utilizing Adobe After Effects, Photoshop and Illustrator (advanced
motion graphics experience is a strong plus).
● Technical Camera & Studio Skills: Familiarity with professional camera packages and workflows, including Sony FX/FS series, Sony Alpha mirrorless cameras, studio lighting setups, lavalier/boom audio capture and remote recording platforms (Zoom, Riverside,
etc.).
● Financial Acumen: Demonstrated interest, understanding, or experience in business news, financial markets and investing concepts, with the eagerness and ability to learn and apply IBD’s proprietary investing methodology.
● Editorial Hustle: Experience booking guests, finding sources and writing scripts under tight market-driven deadlines.
● Agility & Communication: Nimble, collaborative self-starter with exceptional written and verbal communication skills who thrives in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

Preferred Qualifications
● Prior background covering financial markets, equities, economics or business journalism.
● Direct experience producing livestream programming, market shows or studio podcasts.
● Familiarity with web video content management systems (CMS) and video platforms
(e.g., WordPress) and project management software.


Equal Opportunity Employer


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. EEO/Disabled/Vets

job.title: VP, Head of Consulting
job.description:
Job Description:

About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition. Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.

 

About the Role:

Reporting to the SVP, Head of Research, Consulting & Community, the VP,  Head of Consulting leads the Dow Jones Energy bespoke solutions business across both public and private sector markets — owning its strategy, proposition, commercial performance, and external profile. The role combines commercial leadership with operational rigor and a strong external presence, scaling a professional services practice that translates the analytical depth of Dow Jones Energy data and insights into high-impact engagements for corporate, government, and multilateral clients.

 

You Will:

  • Design and execute the growth strategy for the Energy Consulting business, setting clear commercial, brand, and delivery targets.
  • Ensure the consulting team meets or exceeds business development and growth targets
  • Drive the evolution and scaling of the consulting practice — its operating model, talent and delivery capabilities.
  • Own the business with a relentless focus on customer value, output quality, business margin, expert utilization, and delivery efficiency across every engagement.
  • Design, champion, and continuously evolve the Energy Consulting value proposition, articulating differentiated offerings that capitalize on Dow Jones Energy’s expertise across energy, chemicals and resources, as well as the broader Dow Jones capability suite
  • Serve as a senior external face of the business — representing Dow Jones Energy on stage, on air, and in print to shape how clients and the broader market understand global energy and chemical market dynamics.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Research and Community leadership within Dow Jones Energy to translate our analytical depth into commercially successful consulting engagements.
  • Support business development and consulting operations with travel to all regions up to 40% of time 

 

You Have:

  • 20+ years of experience in the energy, chemical, or commodity consulting space.
  • A track record of leading an advisory business of $20M+ in revenue with full P&L accountability and proven topline and margin growth.
  • Experience presenting at industry conferences on panels and to groups of c-suite decision makers
  • Proven experience scaling a professional services business — building delivery models, talent pipelines, and operating discipline that enable durable, profitable growth.
  • Experience delivering advisory work for both public sector (government, defense, multilateral) and private sector (corporate, financial) clients.
  • Knowledge of and familiarity with key players and competitors in the energy and chemical consulting space.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams.
  • History of successful stakeholder management at executive levels.

  • Comprehensive Insurance Plans
  • Paid Time Off

  • Access to Dow Jones Products
  • Subscription Discounts
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Employee Well-being Support & Fitness Programs

job.title: Manager, TV Audio Infrastructure
job.description:
Who We Are:

WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. WWE is part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO). Additional information on WWE can be found at wwe.com and corporate.wwe.com. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

This position requires weekly travel to WWE shows (Raw, Smackdown, Live Events and PLE's), both domestically and internationally, based on the show schedule.


Position Summary

The Manager of Broadcast TV Audio Infrastructure assists senior management with responsibilities for the design, operation, maintenance, and strategic development of audio systems while supporting live and recorded television production. This role supports a team of broadcast audio technicians, ensuring reliable, high-quality audio across studios, control rooms, remote productions, and transmission facilities. The manager works closely with production, engineering, IT, and operations teams to support current workflows while planning future technology upgrades.


Key Responsibilities

Audio Infrastructure Management

  • Oversee the operation and maintenance of broadcast audio systems, including intercoms (wired/wireless), audio-over-IP networks, RFOF systems, RF Microphones and IEM monitoring systems.
  • Develop and maintain preventative maintenance schedules and system documentation.
  • Collaborate with external vendors to prioritize, schedule, and expedite repairs, ensuring maximum system reliability and uptime.

 

Technical Leadership

  • Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex audio and broadcast infrastructure issues.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend upgrades to improve efficiency, scalability, and audio quality.
  • Collaborate with IT teams on networked audio systems.

Project Management

  • Plan and execute capital projects, upgrades, technical work books, equipment refreshes, and system integrations.
  • Coordinate installation, testing, commissioning, and acceptance of new systems.
  • Demoing new audio technologies.

Team Leadership

  • Collaborate with upper management to supervise, mentor, and develop broadcast audio engineers and technical staff.
  • Coordinate staffing and technical support coverage for live events and special productions.

 

Operational Support

  • Support live broadcast, entertainment, and special event productions.
  • Ensure compliance with FCC regulations, company standards, and industry best practices.
  • Participate in on-call escalation support for critical broadcast operations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Engineering, Audio Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in broadcast engineering, professional audio, or television infrastructure environments.
  • Extensive knowledge of broadcast audio systems, signal routing, and transmission workflows.
  • Understanding Dante platforms.
  • Strong understanding of television production environments and live broadcast operations.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale network television operations.
  • Familiarity with broadcast intercom systems.
  • Professional certifications in broadcast engineering.
  • Experience with wireless communications, and Audio production technologies.

Key Competencies

  • Broadcast systems infrastructure
  • Audio engineering expertise
  • Project planning and execution
  • Problem-solving under pressure
  • This role combines broadcast audio engineering expertise with operational leadership to ensure reliable, high-quality audio delivery across all television platforms.

Per local requirements and in the interest of transparency, the hourly rate shown below reflects the prevalent current hiring range for this position. Hiring pay rates are based on a number of factors, including location and may vary depending on job-related qualifications, knowledge, skills and experience. The company strives to provide locally competitive rewards packages, which include base rate along with, as applicable, short- and long-term incentives, growth and developmental opportunities, and robust benefits, such as health care, retirement, vacation and other paid time off, and additional offerings.

Hiring Rate Minimum:

$101,250 annually (minimum will not fall below the applicable State/local minimum salary thresholds)

Hiring Rate Maximum:

$135,000 annually

WWE is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws regarding non-discrimination in employment. job.description:

WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Position Summary

The Project Manager, Creative Services manages the flow of creative work from intake through final delivery in a high-volume, fast-paced environment. This role primarily supports WWE, with additional project support for AAA, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing as needed. The Project Manager coordinates timelines, approvals, production requirements, resources, budgets, and communication across internal teams and external partners while helping projects move efficiently from concept through completion.


Work Arrangement

This is an on-site role based at WWE headquarters in Stamford, CT. The role primarily supports WWE, with additional support for AAA, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing as needed. Some travel is required to support wardrobe responsibilities and other business needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with teams across WWE, including Creative, Marketing, Consumer Products, Corporate Communications, Digital, Production, the TV Studio, and related business functions. Provide support to AAA, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing stakeholders as needed.
  • Manage projects through all phases of the creative, approval, and production process to ensure timelines, budget requirements, and job specifications are met.
  • Coordinate project intake, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and approvals across multiple concurrent assignments, ensuring clear communication and accountability at every stage.
  • Partner closely with designers and creative leads to determine specifications, production approaches, and workflow needs while helping troubleshoot issues and identify practical solutions.
  • Keep current with WWE programming, talent, storylines, events, products, and brand priorities. Maintain awareness of AAA, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing priorities when supporting related work.
  • Obtain estimates and help secure vendors based on quality, cost, service, and turnaround time when outside production support is needed.
  • Interface with external vendors and production partners, staying current with industry practices and helping resolve production-related issues quickly and effectively.
  • Address potential printing, production, or execution issues before they impact delivery, helping teams stay ahead of risks and maintain momentum.
  • Help ensure final deliverables are produced accurately, on brand, on time, and within scope across a range of creative applications.
  • Monitor project budgets, specifications, approvals, and delivery requirements, escalating risks or changes as appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate timelines, status updates, project trackers, and workflow systems to improve visibility into project progress, next steps, dependencies, and resource needs.
  • Use AI tools and workflow systems in practical ways to improve job organization, task tracking, status visibility, and overall project efficiency across the team.
  • Help the team adopt tools and ways of working that improve project tracking, communication, and operational clarity, while identifying process improvements that support consistent, efficient execution without disrupting creative quality or delivery.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in project management within an agency, in-house creative department, design studio, entertainment company, sports property, or related fast-paced creative environment.
  • Thorough knowledge of project and production management principles and practices, with working knowledge of print and digital production workflows.
  • Proven experience establishing and maintaining schedules, budgets, and deliverables for multiple concurrent, deadline-driven projects through all phases of design, approvals, and production.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and project tracking or workflow management tools. Familiarity with AI-assisted productivity tools is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, including InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop, is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Excellent negotiation, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively and persuasively with a wide range of internal and external partners.
  • Ability to multitask, stay detail-oriented, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • Reliable, punctual, self-directed, and flexible in responding to changing priorities and business needs.
  • Ability to work on-site at WWE headquarters in Stamford, CT.

Work Environment

This position supports a fast-paced, deadline-driven creative environment and requires flexibility to respond to changing priorities and business needs.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Director of Broadcast Engineering to lead engineering strategy, operations, and technical teams for a multi-platform broadcast organization. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, this role is accountable for delivery of reliable, high-quality live and scheduled broadcast services across linear, OTT, streaming, and contribution/distribution networks. The Senior Director will drive engineering standards, architecture, capital planning, disaster recovery, and cross-functional initiatives with product, programming, and IT.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead and grow a cross-functional engineering organization (broadcast, master control, play-out, IP/SDI transport, streaming, encoding, CDN integration, and facilities engineering).

  • Define and execute broadcast engineering strategy aligned to business goals: migration to IP/SMPTE ST 2110.

  • Communicate and develop professional relationships with our broadcast partners.

  • Oversee design, implementation, and operations of transmission, contribution, distribution, and content delivery systems (encoders, decoders, transcoders, multiplexers, routers.

  • Own network and systems architecture for reliability, scalability, latency, and monitoring; collaborate with Network and IT for WAN, multicast, QoS, and security.

  • Establish engineering standards, documentation, test procedures, and change-control processes.

  • Manage capital and operating budgets for engineering projects, vendor contracts, and lifecycle refresh programs; prioritize projects and approve procurement.

  • Lead technology evaluation, pilot programs, vendor selection, and contract negotiations with vendors, integrators, and cloud providers.

  • Build and mentor high-performance teams: recruit, develop, set goals, conduct performance reviews, and create career paths for engineering staff.

  • Coordinate disaster recovery and business continuity planning, including redundancy, failover, and public-safety broadcast contingencies.

  • Act as technical liaison to key members of our live production team.

Required qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive broadcast engineering experience, with at least 5 years in senior leadership or director-level roles.

  • Deep technical expertise in broadcast transmission and playout systems, live production workflows, and OTT streaming technologies.

  • Demonstrated experience with IP-based media (SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS), SDI infrastructures, encoders/transcoders, CDN and cloud streaming platforms and software-defined media workflows.

  • Strong knowledge of networking  and cybersecurity best practices for media infrastructure.

  • Experience managing large capital projects, vendor contracts, and cross-functional program delivery.

  • Proven track record building and leading technical teams, managing 24/7 operations, incident response, and continuous improvement programs.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to present complex technical plans to executives and non-technical teams.

job.description:
Digital Marketing Strategist - Columbia, MO - Zimmer Communications Jobs Jobs | Login Location: Columbia, MO, USA Pay Rate: Pay Type: Employment Type: Full Time Email Me This Job Digital Marketing Strategist Our purpose is to help our clients' business grow. Our efforts will be focused on developing ourselves through training and coaching. We'll accomplish this through an environment where exceeding company standards, continual improvement, initiative and innovation are recognized and rewarded. Zimmer Communications will be a vital part of the community by being a free source for news, entertainment and information. We will also be involved in helping the various public service initiatives in each local market. The outgrowth of our work together will result in a sense of pride, a spirit of involvement, personal accomplishment and partnership. Job Description : Zimmer Communications is growing! Zimmer is looking for a digital marketing analyst to join our digital marketing team. Your

responsibilities

will include monitoring, collecting and analyzing campaign data, optimizing digital campaign performance, creating client presentations and communicating with the sales and marketing team on digital campaigns. To be successful as a digital marketing analyst, you should be comfortable reviewing and analyzing campaign data with the ability to identify digital trends and the most effective digital strategies for clients. A top-performing digital marketing analyst should be analytical, detail-oriented, organized and communicate clearly within a team environment.

Primary Responsibilities

B2B digital sales-current and new accounts Management of both large and small digital campaigns including SEM, Display, Video, Remarketing and Connected TV Join sales team on client meetings to help close digital accounts Ownership of digital marketing strategies to hit client goals Development of digital strategies with internal team to hit revenue goals Monitor and adjust digital campaigns weekly to achieve client goals Work with leadership team to innovate and grow the digital department Meet with sales staff regularly to provide support and feedback on digital platforms Conduct monthly meetings with current digital clients to review analytics and pacing to client goals and objectives Execute digital training for sales management, account executives and other team members Continue to grow the digital department and revenue with new technology and capabilities to maintain a competitive advantage in the market for Zimmer Communications

Qualifications

2 years working in digital marketing or equivalent

experience

Google Ads Search Certification Google Analytics Individual Qualification (familiarity with GA4 preferred) Understanding of digital marketing metrics and

experience

analyzing digital marketing performance

Experience

managing Google Ads search campaigns Working knowledge of Google Analytics Working knowledge of targeted display, video (YouTube) and streaming TV advertising. Working knowledge of new digital media capabilities. Effective relationship building, customer service, communication and negotiation skills College degree preferred Passionate about new and emerging marketing technology Goal-oriented with a passion for helping clients grow Sales driven, marketing minded More Information : Zimmer Communications is an equal opportunity employer. job.title: Part – Time TALK SHOW CO-HOST - 93.9 The Eagle — Wake Up Missouri - Columbia, MO
job.description: Part – Time TALK SHOW CO-HOST - 93.9 The Eagle — Wake Up Missouri - Columbia, MO - Zimmer Communications Jobs Jobs | Login Location: Columbia, MO, USA Pay Rate: Pay Type: Employment Type: Part Time Email Me This Job Part - Time TALK SHOW CO-HOST - 93.9 The Eagle - Wake Up Missouri 93.9 The Eagle is looking for a dynamic Co-Host to join our top-rated morning News/Talk show, Wake Up Missouri . This is an opportunity to co-host a fast-paced, three-hour morning show heard across Missouri. ARE YOU THE PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR? Do you have an opinion about almost anything at the drop of a hat? Do you love sharing observations about your life, your experiences and the events everyone is talking about? Are you a storyteller who can turn an everyday experience into entertaining radio? Are you a team player who understands that great radio comes from chemistry, preparation and collaboration? Can you comfortably talk about news, politics, sports, movies, music and pop culture ? Are you willing to tease your fellow hosts-and be teased right back? If so, we want to hear from you. ABOUT WAKE UP MISSOURI Wake Up Missouri focuses on the biggest stories and conversations of the day. There are occasional newsmaker interviews, but the heart of the show is personality, opinions, observations, storytelling and debate . The show moves quickly. When breaking news happens, we change direction and go with it. You need to be prepared, curious, conversational and nimble enough to contribute wherever the show goes. Our target audience is clearly defined, and the show is built to give its personalities the opportunity to connect with listeners and succeed. WHAT YOU'LL GET You'll join a terrific on-air team in a supportive, creative environment. You'll also receive top-notch coaching and ongoing feedback designed to help you develop your personality, sharpen your skills and win in this role. We're looking for someone who doesn't just want to be on the radio. We're looking for someone who has something to say.
